verses.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.en: In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.tr: bismi Allāh ar-raḥmāni ar-raḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: In the name of God, the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy!
verses.pickthall: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord of the worlds -
verses.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Praise belongs to God, Lord of the Worlds,
verses.pickthall: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,

verses.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.en: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
verses.tr: ar-raḥmāni ar-raḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy,
verses.pickthall: The Beneficent, the Merciful.

verses.ar: مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
verses.tr: māliki yawmi ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: Master of the Day of Judgement.
verses.pickthall: Master of the Day of Judgment,

verses.ar: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
verses.en: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
verses.tr: ʾiyyāka naʿbudu wa-iyyāka nastaʿīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: It is You we worship; it is You we ask for help.
verses.pickthall: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.

verses.ar: ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
verses.en: Guide us to the straight path -
verses.tr: āhdinā aṣ-ṣirāṭa al-mustaqīma
verses.abdelhaleem: Guide us to the straight path:
verses.pickthall: Show us the straight path,

verses.ar: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.en: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
verses.tr: ṣirāṭa adh-dhīna ʾanʿamta ʿalayhim ghayri al-maghḍūbi ʿalayhim walā aḍ-ḍāllīna
verses.abdelhaleem: the path of those You have blessed, those who incur no anger and who have not gone astray.
verses.pickthall: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.

verses.ar: الٓمٓ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Meem.
verses.tr: al-m
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Mim
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Mim.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allāh -
verses.tr: dhālika al-kitābu lā rayba ۛ fīhi ۛ hudanā llilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is the Scripture in which there is no doubt, containing guidance for those who are mindful of God,
verses.pickthall: This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil).

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.en: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yuʾminūna bi-l-ghaybi wayuqīmūna aṣ-ṣalawāha wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who believe in the unseen,keep up the prayer, and give out of what We have provided for them;
verses.pickthall: Who believe in the Unseen, and establish worship, and spend of that We have bestowed upon them;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yuʾminūna bimā ʾunzila ʾilayka wamā ʾunzila min qablika wabālākhirahi hum yūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who believe in the revelation sent down to you [Muhammad], and in what was sent before you, those who have firm faith in the Hereafter.
verses.pickthall: And who believe in that which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika ʿalā hudanā mmin rrabbihim ۖ wa-ūlāʾika humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Such people are following their Lord’s guidance and it is they who will prosper.
verses.pickthall: These depend on guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā sawāʾun ʿalayhim ʾaʾandhartahum ʾam lam tundhirhum lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who disbelieve, it makes no difference whether you warn them or not: they will not believe.
verses.pickthall: As for the Disbelievers, Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not it is all one for them; they believe not.

verses.ar: خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ ۖ وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ غِشَـٰوَةٌ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: Allāh has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.
verses.tr: khatama Allāh ʿalā qulūbihim waʿalā samʿihim ۖ waʿalā ʾabṣārihim ghishāwahun ۖ walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: God has sealed their hearts and their ears, and their eyes are covered. They will have great torment.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be an awful doom.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh and the Last Day," but they are not believers.
verses.tr: wamina an-nāsi man yaqūlu āmannā billāh wabālyawmi al-ākhiri wamā hum bimuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Some people say, ‘We believe in God and the Last Day,’ when really they do not believe.
verses.pickthall: And of mankind are some who say: We believe in Allah and the Last Day, when they believe not.

verses.ar: يُخَـٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَمَا يَخْدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: They [think to] deceive Allāh and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.
verses.tr: yukhādiʿūna Allāh wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā wamā yakhdaʿūna ʾillā ʾanfusahum wamā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They seek to deceive God and the believers but they only deceive themselves, though they do not realize it.
verses.pickthall: They think to beguile Allah and those who believe, and they beguile none save themselves; but they perceive not.

verses.ar: فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْذِبُونَ
verses.en: In their hearts is disease, so Allāh has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.
verses.tr: fā qulūbihim mmaraḍun fazādahumu Allāh maraḍan ۖ walahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun bimā kānūā yakdhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There is a disease in their hearts, to which God has added more: agonizing torment awaits them for their persistent lying.
verses.pickthall: In their hearts is a disease, and Allah increaseth their disease. A painful doom is theirs because they lie.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla lahum lā tufsidūā fā al-ʾarḍi qālūā ʾinnamā naḥnu muṣliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When it is said to them, ‘Do not cause corruption in the land,’ they say, ‘We are only putting things right,’
verses.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Make not mischief in the earth, they say: We are peacemakers only.

verses.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدُونَ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.
verses.tr: ʾalā ʾinnahum humu al-mufsidūna walākin llā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but really they are causing corruption, though they do not realize it.
verses.pickthall: Are not they indeed the mischief-makers? But they perceive not.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not.
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla lahum āminūā kamā āmana an-nāsu qālūā ʾanuʾminu kamā āmana as-sufahāʾu ۗ ʾalā ʾinnahum humu as-sufahāʾu walākin llā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When it is said to them, ‘Believe, as the others believe,’ they say, ‘Should we believe as the fools do?’ but they are the fools, though they do not know it.
verses.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: believe as the people believe, they say: shall we believe as the foolish believe? are not they indeed the foolish? But they know not.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ شَيَـٰطِينِهِمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."
verses.tr: wa-idhā laqūā adh-dhīna āmanūā qālūā āmannā wa-idhā khalawā ʾilā shayāṭīnihim qālūā ʾinnā maʿakum ʾinnamā naḥnu mustahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they meet the believers, they say, ‘We believe,’ but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, ‘We’re really with you; we were only mocking.’
verses.pickthall: And when they fall in with those who believe, they say: We believe; but when they go apart to their devils they declare: Lo! we are with you; verily we did but mock.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّهُمْ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.en: [But] Allāh mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.
verses.tr: Allāh yastahziʾu bihim wayamudduhum fā ṭughyānihim yaʿmahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God is mocking them, and allowing them more slack to wander blindly in their insolence.
verses.pickthall: Allah (Himself) doth mock them, leaving them to wander blindly on in their contumacy.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَـٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
verses.en: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna āshtarawā aḍ-ḍalālaha bi-l-hudā famā rabiḥat ttijāratuhum wamā kānūā muhtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They have bought error in exchange for guidance, so their trade reaps no profit, and they are not rightly guided.
verses.pickthall: These are they who purchase error at the price of guidance, so their commerce doth not prosper, neither are they guided.

verses.ar: مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allāh took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.
verses.tr: mathaluhum kamathali adh-dhā āstawqada nāran falammā ʾaḍāʾat mā ḥawlahu dhahaba Allāh binūrihim watarakahum fā ẓulumātin llā yubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They are like people who [labour to] kindle a fire: when it lights up everything around them, God takes away all their light, leaving them in utter darkness, unable to see-
verses.pickthall: Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindleth fire, and when it sheddeth its light around him Allah taketh away their light and leaveth them in darkness, where they cannot see,

verses.ar: صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].
verses.tr: ṣummun bukmun ʿumāun fahum lā yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: deaf, dumb, and blind: they will never return.
verses.pickthall: Deaf, dumb and blind; and they return not.

verses.ar: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَـٰتٌ وَرَعْدٌ وَبَرْقٌ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌۢ بِٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allāh is encompassing of the disbelievers.
verses.tr: ʾaw kaṣayyibin mmina as-samāʾi fīhi ẓulumātun waraʿdun wabarqun yajʿalūna ʾaṣābiʿahum fā ādhānihim mmina aṣ-ṣawāʿiqi ḥadhara al-mawti ۚ wallāh muḥīṭun bi-l-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Or [like people who, under] a cloudburst from the sky, with its darkness, thunder, and lightning, put their fingers into their ears to keep out the thunderclaps for fear of death- God surrounds the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein is darkness, thunder and the flash of lightning. They thrust their fingers in their ears by reason of the thunder-claps, for fear of death, Allah encompasseth the disbelievers (in His guidance, His omniscience and His omnipotence).

verses.ar: يَكَادُ ٱلْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ أَبْصَـٰرَهُمْ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُم مَّشَوْا۟ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا۟ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
verses.tr: yakādu al-barqu yakhṭafu ʾabṣārahum ۖ kullamā ʾaḍāʾa lahum mmashawā fīhi wa-idhā ʾaẓlama ʿalayhim qāmūā ۚ walaw shāʾa Allāh ladhahaba bisamʿihim wa-abṣārihim ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: The lightning almost snatches away their sight: whenever it flashes on them they walk on and when darkness falls around them they stand still. If God so willed, He could take away their hearing and sight: God has power over everything.
verses.pickthall: The lightning almost snatcheth away their sight from them. As often as it flasheth forth for them they walk therein, and when it darkeneth against them they stand still. If Allah willed, He could destroy their hearing and their sight. Lo! Allah is able to do all things.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu āʿbudūā rabbakumu adh-dhā khalaqakum wa-adh-dhīna min qablikum laʿallakum tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: People, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, so that you may be mindful [of Him]
verses.pickthall: O mankind! worship your Lord, Who hath created you and those before you, so that ye may ward off (evil).

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِرَٰشًا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allāh equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].
verses.tr: adh-dhā jaʿala lakumu al-ʾarḍa firāshan wa-as-samāʾa bināʾan wa-anzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan fa-akhraja bihi mina ath-thamarāti rizqan llakum ۖ falā tajʿalūā lillāh ʾandādan wa-antum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who spread out the earth for you and built the sky; who sent water down from it and with that water produced things for your sustenance. Do not, knowing this, set up rivals to God.
verses.pickthall: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).

verses.ar: وَإِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍ مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ وَٱدْعُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down [i.e., the Qur’ān] upon Our Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)], then produce a sūrah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses [i.e., supporters] other than Allāh, if you should be truthful.
verses.tr: wa-in kuntum fā raybin mmimmā nazzalnā ʿalā ʿabdinā fa-tūā bisūrahin mmin mmithlihi wādʿūā shuhadāʾakum mmin dūni Allāh ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you have doubts about the revelation We have sent down to Our servant, then produce a single sura like it- enlist whatever supporters you have other than God- if you truly [think you can].
verses.pickthall: And if ye are in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto Our slave (Muhammad), then produce a surah of the like thereof, and call your witness beside Allah if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَلَن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ ۖ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is people and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.
verses.tr: fa-in llam tafʿalūā walan tafʿalūā fāttaqūā an-nāra at-tā waqūduhā an-nāsu wa-l-ḥijārahu ۖ ʾuʿiddat lilkāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you cannot do this- and you never will- then beware of the Fire prepared for the disbelievers, whose fuel is men and stones.
verses.pickthall: And if ye do it not - and ye can never do it - then guard yourselves against the Fire prepared for disbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones.

verses.ar: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزْقًا ۙ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى رُزِقْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَأُتُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُتَشَـٰبِهًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَآ أَزْوَٰجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ ۖ وَهُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.
verses.tr: wabashiri adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ʾanna lahum jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru ۖ kullamā ruziqūā minhā min thamarahin rrizqan ۙ qālūā hādhā adh-dhā ruziqnā min qablu ۖ wa-utūā bihi mutashābihan ۖ walahum fīhā ʾazwājun mmuṭahharahun ۖ wahum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], give those who believe and do good the news that they will have Gardens graced with flowing streams. Whenever they are given sustenance from the fruits of these Gardens, they will say, ‘We have been given this before,’ because they were provided with something like it. They will have pure spouses and there they will stay.
verses.pickthall: And give glad tidings (O Muhammad) unto those who believe and do good works; that theirs are Gardens underneath which rivers flow; as often as they are regaled with food of the fruit thereof, they say: this is what was given us aforetime; and it is given to them in resemblance. There for them are pure companions; there for ever they abide.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْىِۦٓ أَن يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا بَعُوضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۘ يُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِى بِهِۦ كَثِيرًا ۚ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allāh intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinna Allāh lā yastaḥāi ʾan yaḍriba mathalan mmā baʿūḍahan famā fawqahā ۚ fa-ammā adh-dhīna āmanūā fayaʿlamūna ʾannahu al-ḥaqqu min rrabbihim ۖ wa-ammā adh-dhīna kafarūā fayaqūlūna mādhā ʾarāda Allāh bihādhā mathalan ۘ yuḍillu bihi kathīran wayahdā bihi kathīran ۚ wamā yuḍillu bihi ʾillā al-fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God does not shy from drawing comparisons even with something as small as a gnat, or larger: the believers know it is the truth from their Lord, but the disbelievers say, ‘What does God mean by such a comparison?’ Through it He makes many go astray and leads many to the right path. But it is only the rebels He makes go astray:
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah disdaineth not to coin the similitude even of a gnat. Those who believe know that it is the truth from their Lord; but those who disbelieve say: What doth Allah wish (to teach) by such a similitude? He misleadeth many thereby, and He guideth many thereby; and He misleadeth thereby only miscreants;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مِيثَـٰقِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: Who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yanquḍūna ʿahda Allāh min baʿdi mīthāqihi wayaqṭaʿūna mā ʾamara Allāh bihi ʾan yūṣala wayufsidūna fā al-ʾarḍi ۚ ʾūlāʾika humu al-khāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who break their covenant with God after it has been confirmed, who sever the bonds that God has commanded to be joined, who spread corruption on the earth- these are the losers.
verses.pickthall: Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined, and (who) make mischief in the earth: Those are they who are the losers.

verses.ar: كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَكُنتُمْ أَمْوَٰتًا فَأَحْيَـٰكُمْ ۖ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: How can you disbelieve in Allāh when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.
verses.tr: kayfa takfurūna billāh wakuntum ʾamwātan fa-aḥyākum ۖ thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥyīkum thumma ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How can you ignore God when you were lifeless and He gave you life, when He will cause you to die, then resurrect you to be returned to Him?
verses.pickthall: How disbelieve ye in Allah when ye were dead and He gave life to you! Then He will give you death, then life again, and then unto Him ye will return.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ ۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā khalaqa lakum mmā fā al-ʾarḍi jamīʿan thumma āstawā ʾilā as-samāʾi fasawwāhunna sabʿa samāwātin ۚ wahuwa bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It was He who created all that is on the earth for you, then turned to the sky and made the seven heavens; it is He who has knowledge of all things.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who created for you all that is in the earth. Then turned He to the heaven, and fashioned it as seven heavens. And He is knower of all things.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى جَاعِلٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we exalt You with praise and declare Your perfection?" He [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla rabbuka lilmalāʾikahi ʾinnā jāʿilun fā al-ʾarḍi khalīfahan ۖ qālūā ʾatajʿalu fīhā man yufsidu fīhā wayasfiku ad-dimāʾa wanaḥnu nusabbiḥu biḥamdika wanuqaddisu laka ۖ qāla ʾinnā ʾaʿlamu mā lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], when your Lord told the angels, ‘I am putting a successor on earth,’ they said, ‘How can You put someone there who will cause damage and bloodshed, when we celebrate Your praise and proclaim Your holiness?’ but He said, ‘I know things you do not.’
verses.pickthall: And when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to place a viceroy in the earth, they said: Wilt thou place therein one who will do harm therein and will shed blood, while we, we hymn Thy praise and sanctify Thee? He said: Surely I know that which ye know not.

verses.ar: وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلْأَسْمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنۢبِـُٔونِى بِأَسْمَآءِ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."
verses.tr: waʿallama ādama al-ʾasmāʾa kullahā thumma ʿaraḍahum ʿalā al-malāʾikahi faqāla ʾanbiwnā biʾasmāʾi hāʾulāʾi ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He taught Adam all the names [of things], then He showed them to the angels and said, ‘Tell me the names of these if you truly [think you can].’
verses.pickthall: And He taught Adam all the names, then showed them to the angels, saying: Inform Me of the names of these, if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."
verses.tr: qālūā subḥānaka lā ʿilma lanā ʾillā mā ʿallamtanā ۖ ʾinnaka ʾanta al-ʿalīmu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘May You be glorified! We have knowledge only of what You have taught us. You are the All Knowing and All Wise.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ أَنۢبِئْهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَنۢبَأَهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
verses.en: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."
verses.tr: qāla yādamu ʾanbiʾhum biʾasmāʾihim ۖ falammā ʾanbaʾahum biʾasmāʾihim qāla ʾalam ʾaqul llakum ʾinnā ʾaʿlamu ghayba as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wa-aʿlamu mā tubdūna wamā kuntum taktumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then He said, ‘Adam, tell them the names of these.’ When he told them their names, God said, ‘Did I not tell you that I know what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and that I know what you reveal and what you conceal?’
verses.pickthall: He said: O Adam! Inform them of their names, and when he had informed them of their names, He said: Did I not tell you that I know the secret of the heavens and the earth? And I know that which ye disclose and which ye hide.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.
verses.tr: wa-idh qulnā lilmalāʾikahi āsjudūā lādama fasajadūā ʾillā ʾiblīsa ʾabā wāstakbara wakāna mina al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When We told the angels, ‘Bow down before Adam,’ they all bowed. But not Iblis, who refused and was arrogant: he was one of the disobedient.
verses.pickthall: And when We said unto the angels: Prostrate yourselves before Adam, they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He demurred through pride, and so became a disbeliever.

verses.ar: وَقُلْنَا يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنْهَا رَغَدًا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."
verses.tr: waqulnā yādamu āskun ʾanta wazawjuka al-jannaha wakulā minhā raghadan ḥaythu shiʾtumā walā taqrabā hādhihi ash-shajaraha fatakūnā mina aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We said, ‘Adam, live with your wife in this garden. Both of you eat freely there as you will, but do not go near this tree, or you will both become wrongdoers.’
verses.pickthall: And We said: O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden, and eat ye freely (of the fruits) thereof where ye will; but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers.

verses.ar: فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ عَنْهَا فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِ ۖ وَقُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."
verses.tr: fa-azallahumā ash-shayṭānu ʿanhā fa-akhrajahumā mimmā kānā fīhi ۖ waqulnā āhbiṭūā baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun ۖ walakum fā al-ʾarḍi mustaqarrun wamatāʿun ʾilā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: But Satan made them slip, and removed them from the state they were in. We said, ‘Get out, all of you! You are each other’s enemy. On earth you will have a place to stay and livelihood for a time.’
verses.pickthall: But Satan caused them to deflect therefrom and expelled them from the (happy) state in which they were; and We said: Fall down, one of you a foe unto the other! There shall be for you on earth a habitation and provision for a time.

verses.ar: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
verses.tr: fatalaqqā ādamu min rrabbihi kalimātin fatāba ʿalayhi ۚ ʾinnahu huwa at-tawwābu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Then Adam received some words from his Lord and He accepted his repentance: He is the Ever Relenting, the Most Merciful.
verses.pickthall: Then Adam received from his Lord words (of revelation), and He relented toward him. Lo! He is the relenting, the Merciful.

verses.ar: قُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِنْهَا جَمِيعًا ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.en: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
verses.tr: qulnā āhbiṭūā minhā jamīʿan ۖ fa-immā yaʾtiyannakum mminnā hudanā faman tabiʿa hudāa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We said, ‘Get out, all of you! But when guidance comes from Me, as it certainly will, there will be no fear for those who follow My guidance nor will they grieve-
verses.pickthall: We said: Go down, all of you, from hence; but verily there cometh unto you from Me a guidance; and whoso followeth My guidance, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā wakadhabūā bāyātinā ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri ۖ hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who disbelieve and deny Our messages shall be the inhabitants of the Fire, and there they will remain.’
verses.pickthall: But they who disbelieve, and deny Our revelations, such are rightful Peoples of the Fire. They will abide therein.

verses.ar: يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِىٓ أُوفِ بِعَهْدِكُمْ وَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
verses.en: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.
verses.tr: yābanā ʾisrāʾīla ādhkurūā niʿmatāa at-tā ʾanʿamtu ʿalaykum wa-awfūā biʿahdā ʾūfi biʿahdikum wa-iyyāa fārhabūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Children of Israel, remember how I blessed you. Honour your pledge to Me and I will honour My pledge to you: I am the One you should fear.
verses.pickthall: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you, and fulfil your (part of the) covenant, I shall fulfil My (part of the) covenant, and fear Me.

verses.ar: وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلْتُ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ وَلَا تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَوَّلَ كَافِرٍۭ بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِى ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا وَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.en: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.
verses.tr: waminūā bimā ʾanzaltu muṣaddiqan llimā maʿakum walā takūnūā ʾawwala kāfirin bihi ۖ walā tashtarūā bāyātā thamanan qalīlan wa-iyyāa fāttaqūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Believe in the message I have sent down confirming what you already possess. Do not be the first to disbelieve in it, and do not sell My messages for a small price: I am the One of whom you should be mindful.
verses.pickthall: And believe in that which I reveal, confirming that which ye possess already (of the Scripture), and be not first to disbelieve therein, and part not with My revelations for a trifling price, and keep your duty unto Me.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].
verses.tr: walā talbisūā al-ḥaqqa bi-l-bāṭili wataktumūā al-ḥaqqa wa-antum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not mix truth with falsehood, or hide the truth when you know it.
verses.pickthall: Confound not truth with falsehood, nor knowingly conceal the truth.

verses.ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱرْكَعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
verses.en: And establish prayer and give zakāh and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].
verses.tr: wa-aqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha watūā az-zakawāha wārkaʿūā maʿa ar-rākiʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and bow your heads [in worship] with those who bow theirs.
verses.pickthall: Establish worship, pay the poor-due, and bow your heads with those who bow (in worship).

verses.ar: ۞ أَتَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبِرِّ وَتَنسَوْنَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَتْلُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?
verses.tr: ۞ ʾataʾmurūna an-nāsa bi-l-birri watansawna ʾanfusakum wa-antum tatlūna al-kitāba ۚ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How can you tell people to do what is right and forget to do it yourselves, even though you recite the Scripture? Have you no sense?
verses.pickthall: Enjoin ye righteousness upon mankind while ye yourselves forget (to practise it)? And ye are readers of the Scripture! Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: وَٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلْخَـٰشِعِينَ
verses.en: And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allāh]
verses.tr: wāstaʿīnūā bi-aṣ-ṣabri wa-aṣ-ṣalawāhi ۚ wa-innahā lakabīrahun ʾillā ʿalā al-khāshiʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Seek help with steadfastness and prayer- though this is hard indeed for anyone but the humble,
verses.pickthall: Seek help in patience and prayer; and truly it is hard save for the humble-minded,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.en: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yaẓunnūna ʾannahum mmulāqūā rabbihim wa-annahum ʾilayhi rājiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who know that they will meet their Lord and that it is to Him they will return.
verses.pickthall: Who know that they will have to meet their Lord, and that unto Him they are returning.

verses.ar: يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَنِّى فَضَّلْتُكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds [i.e., peoples].
verses.tr: yābanā ʾisrāʾīla ādhkurūā niʿmatāa at-tā ʾanʿamtu ʿalaykum wa-annā faḍḍaltukum ʿalā al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Children of Israel, remember how I blessed you and favoured you over other people.
verses.pickthall: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you and how I preferred you to (all) creatures.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًا لَّا تَجْزِى نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا شَفَـٰعَةٌ وَلَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.
verses.tr: wāttaqūā yawman llā tajzā nafsun ʿan nnafsin shayā walā yuqbalu minhā shafāʿahun walā yuʾkhadhu minhā ʿadlun walā hum yunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Guard yourselves against a Day when no soul will stand in place of another, no intercession will be accepted for it, nor any ransom; nor will they be helped.
verses.pickthall: And guard yourselves against a day when no soul will in aught avail another, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be received from it, nor will they be helped.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And [recall] when We saved you [i.e., your forefathers] from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
verses.tr: wa-idh najjaynākum mmin āli firʿawna yasūmūnakum sūʾa al-ʿadhābi yudhabbiḥūna ʾabnāʾakum wayastaḥyūna nisāʾakum ۚ wafā dhālikum balāʾun mmin rrabbikum ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when We saved you from Pharaoh’s people, who subjected you to terrible torment, slaughtering your sons and sparing only your women- this was a great trial from your Lord-
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk, who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaying your sons and sparing your women: that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ فَرَقْنَا بِكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰكُمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.
verses.tr: wa-idh faraqnā bikumu al-baḥra fa-anjaynākum wa-aghraqnā āla firʿawna wa-antum tanẓurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and when We parted the sea for you, so saving you and drowning Pharaoh’s people right before your eyes.
verses.pickthall: And when We brought you through the sea and rescued you, and drowned the folk of Pharaoh in your sight.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ وَٰعَدْنَا مُوسَىٰٓ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذْتُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَنتُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him [i.e., his departure], while you were wrongdoers.
verses.tr: wa-idh wāʿadnā mūsā ʾarbaʿīna laylahan thumma āttakhadhtumu al-ʿijla min baʿdihi wa-antum ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We appointed forty nights for Moses [on Mount Sinai] and then, while he was away, you took to worshipping the calf- a terrible wrong.
verses.pickthall: And when We did appoint for Moses forty nights (of solitude), and then ye chose the calf, when he had gone from you, and were wrong-doers.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ عَفَوْنَا عَنكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.
verses.tr: thumma ʿafawnā ʿankum mmin baʿdi dhālika laʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Even then We forgave you, so that you might be thankful.
verses.pickthall: Then, even after that, We pardoned you in order that ye might give thanks.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْفُرْقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided.
verses.tr: wa-idh ātaynā mūsā al-kitāba wa-l-furqāna laʿallakum tahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when We gave Moses the Scripture, and the means to distinguish [right and wrong], so that you might be guided.
verses.pickthall: And when We gave unto Moses the Scripture and the criterion (of right and wrong), that ye might be led aright.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنَّكُمْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنفُسَكُم بِٱتِّخَاذِكُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ فَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمْ فَٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ عِندَ بَارِئِكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves [i.e., the guilty among you]. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi yāqawmi ʾinnakum ẓalamtum ʾanfusakum bāttikhādhikumu al-ʿijla fatūbūā ʾilā bāriʾikum fāqtulūā ʾanfusakum dhālikum khayrun llakum ʿinda bāriʾikum fatāba ʿalaykum ۚ ʾinnahu huwa at-tawwābu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said to his people, ‘My people, you have wronged yourselves by worshipping the calf, so repent to your Maker and kill [the guilty among] you. That is the best you can do in the eyes of your Maker.’ He accepted your repentance: He is the Ever Relenting and the Most Merciful.
verses.pickthall: And when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Ye have wronged yourselves by your choosing of the calf (for worship) so turn in penitence to your Creator, and kill (the guilty) yourselves. That will be best for you with your Creator and He will relent toward you. Lo! He is the Relenting, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهْرَةً فَأَخَذَتْكُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allāh outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.
verses.tr: wa-idh qultum yāmūsā lan nnuʾmina laka ḥattā narā Allāh jahrahan fa-akhadhatkumu aṣ-ṣāʿiqahu wa-antum tanẓurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when you said, ‘Moses, we will not believe you until we see God face to face.’ At that, thunderbolts struck you as you looked on.
verses.pickthall: And when ye said: O Moses! We will not believe in thee till we see Allah plainly; and even while ye gazed the lightning seized you.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَـٰكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful.
verses.tr: thumma baʿathnākum mmin baʿdi mawtikum laʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then We revived you after your death, so that you might be thankful.
verses.pickthall: Then We revived you after your extinction, that ye might give thanks.

verses.ar: وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ ۖ كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ ۖ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.
verses.tr: waẓallalnā ʿalaykumu al-ghamāma wa-anzalnā ʿalaykumu al-manna wa-as-salwā ۖ kulūā min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum ۖ wamā ẓalamūnā walākin kānūā ʾanfusahum yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We made the clouds cover you with shade, and sent manna and quails down to you, saying, ‘Eat the good things We have provided for you.’ It was not Us they wronged; they wronged themselves.
verses.pickthall: And We caused the white cloud to overshadow you and sent down on you the manna and the quails, (saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you - they wronged Us not, but they did wrong themselves.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ رَغَدًا وَٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَقُولُوا۟ حِطَّةٌ نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطَـٰيَـٰكُمْ ۚ وَسَنَزِيدُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city [i.e., Jerusalem] and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens [i.e., sins].' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."
verses.tr: wa-idh qulnā ādkhulūā hādhihi al-qaryaha fakulūā minhā ḥaythu shiʾtum raghadan wādkhulūā al-bāba sujjadan waqūlūā ḥiṭṭahun nnaghfir lakum khaṭāyākum ۚ wasanazīdu al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when We said, ‘Enter this town and eat freely there as you will, but enter its gate humbly and say, “Relieve us!” Then We shall forgive you your sins and increase the rewards of those who do good.’
verses.pickthall: And when We said: Go into this township and eat freely of that which is therein, and enter the gate prostrate, and say: "Repentance." We will forgive you your sins and will increase (reward) for the right-doers.

verses.ar: فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verses.en: But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment [i.e., plague] from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying.
verses.tr: fabaddala adh-dhīna ẓalamūā qawlan ghayra adh-dhā qīla lahum fa-anzalnā ʿalā adh-dhīna ẓalamūā rijzan mmina as-samāʾi bimā kānūā yafsuqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But the wrongdoers substituted a different word from the one they had been given. So, because they persistently disobeyed, We sent a plague down from the heavens upon the wrongdoers.
verses.pickthall: But those who did wrong changed the word which had been told them for another saying, and We sent down upon the evil-doers wrath from heaven for their evil-doing.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِذِ ٱسْتَسْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْحَجَرَ ۖ فَٱنفَجَرَتْ مِنْهُ ٱثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا ۖ قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ ۖ كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people [i.e., tribe] knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allāh, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
verses.tr: ۞ wa-idhi āstasqā mūsā liqawmihi faqulnā āḍrib bbiʿaṣāka al-ḥajara ۖ fānfajarat minhu āthnatā ʿashraha ʿaynan ۖ qad ʿalima kullu ʾunāsin mmashrabahum ۖ kulūā wāshrabūā min rrizqi Allāh walā taʿthawā fā al-ʾarḍi mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when Moses prayed for water for his people and We said to him, ‘Strike the rock with your staff.’ Twelve springs gushed out, and each group knew its drinking place. ‘Eat and drink the sustenance God has provided and do not cause corruption in the land.’
verses.pickthall: And when Moses asked for water for his people, We said: Smite with thy staff the rock. And there gushed out therefrom twelve springs (so that) each tribe knew their drinking-place. Eat and drink of that which Allah hath provided, and do not act corruptly, making mischief in the earth.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصْبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٍ وَٰحِدٍ فَٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخْرِجْ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنۢ بَقْلِهَا وَقِثَّآئِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَا ۖ قَالَ أَتَسْتَبْدِلُونَ ٱلَّذِى هُوَ أَدْنَىٰ بِٱلَّذِى هُوَ خَيْرٌ ۚ ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِصْرًا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلْتُمْ ۗ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ وَٱلْمَسْكَنَةُ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allāh [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allāh and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.
verses.tr: wa-idh qultum yāmūsā lan nnaṣbira ʿalā ṭaʿāmin wāḥidin fādʿu lanā rabbaka yukhrij lanā mimmā tunbitu al-ʾarḍu min baqlihā waqithāʾihā wafūmihā waʿadasihā wabaṣalihā ۖ qāla ʾatastabdilūna adh-dhā huwa ʾadnā bi-adh-dhā huwa khayrun ۚ āhbiṭūā miṣran fa-inna lakum mmā saʾaltum ۗ waḍuribat ʿalayhimu adh-dhillahu wa-l-maskanahu wabāʾū bighaḍabin mmina Allāh ۗ dhālika biʾannahum kānūā yakfurūna bāyāti Allāh wayaqtulūna an-nabiyyina bighayri al-ḥaqqi ۗ dhālika bimā ʿaṣawā wwakānūā yaʿtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when you said, ‘Moses, we cannot bear to eat only one kind of food, so pray to your Lord to bring out for us some of the earth’s produce, its herbs and cucumbers, its garlic, lentils, and onions.’ He said, ‘Would you exchange better for worse? Go to Egypt and there you will find what you have asked for.’ They were struck with humiliation and wretchedness, and they incurred the wrath of God because they persistently rejected His messages and killed prophets contrary to all that is right. All this was because they disobeyed and were lawbreakers.
verses.pickthall: And when ye said: O Moses! We are weary of one kind of food; so call upon thy Lord for us that He bring forth for us of that which the earth groweth - of its herbs and its cucumbers and its corn and its lentils and its onions. He said: Would ye exchange that which is higher for that which is lower? Go down to settled country, thus ye shall get that which ye demand. And humiliation and wretchedness were stamped upon them and they were visited with wrath from Allah. That was because they disbelieved in Allah's revelations and slew the prophets wrongfully. That was for their disobedience and transgression.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ وَٱلصَّـٰبِـِٔينَ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who believed and those who were Jews or Christians or Sabeans [before Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] - those [among them] who believed in Allāh and the Last Day and did righteousness - will have their reward with their Lord, and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā wa-adh-dhīna hādūā wa-an-naṣārā wa-aṣ-ṣābīna man āmana billāh wa-l-yawmi al-ākhiri waʿamila ṣāliḥan falahum ʾajruhum ʿinda rabbihim walā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The [Muslim] believers, the Jews, the Christians, and the Sabians- all those who believe in God and the Last Day and do good- will have their rewards with their Lord. No fear for them, nor will they grieve.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Those who believe (in that which is revealed unto thee, Muhammad), and those who are Jews, and Christians, and Sabaeans - whoever believeth in Allah and the Last Day and doeth right - surely their reward is with their Lord, and there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَـٰقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [O Children of Israel, to abide by the Torah] and We raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that perhaps you may become righteous."
verses.tr: wa-idh ʾakhadhnā mīthāqakum warafaʿnā fawqakumu aṭ-ṭūra khudhūā mā ātaynākum biquwwahin wādhkurūā mā fīhi laʿallakum tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when We took your pledge, and made the mountain tower high above you, and said, ‘Hold fast to what We have given you and bear its contents in mind, so that you may be conscious of God.’
verses.pickthall: And (remember, O Children of Israel) when We made a covenant with you and caused the mount to tower above you, (saying): Hold fast that which We have given you, and remember that which is therein, that ye may ward off (evil).

verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ فَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ لَكُنتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: Then you turned away after that. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, you would have been among the losers.
verses.tr: thumma tawallaytum mmin baʿdi dhālika ۖ falawlā faḍlu Allāh ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu lakuntum mmina al-khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Even after that you turned away. Had it not been for God’s favour and mercy on you, you would certainly have been lost.
verses.pickthall: Then, even after that, ye turned away, and if it had not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy ye had been among the losers.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verses.en: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
verses.tr: walaqad ʿalimtumu adh-dhīna āʿtadawā minkum fā as-sabti faqulnā lahum kūnūā qiradahan khāsīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You know about those of you who broke the Sabbath, and so We said to them, ‘Be like apes! Be outcasts!’
verses.pickthall: And ye know of those of you who broke the Sabbath, how We said unto them: Be ye apes, despised and hated!

verses.ar: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا نَكَـٰلًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا خَلْفَهَا وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allāh.
verses.tr: fajaʿalnāhā nakālan llimā bayna yadayhā wamā khalfahā wamawʿiẓahan llilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We made this an example to those people who were there at the time and to those who came after them, and a lesson to all who are mindful of God.
verses.pickthall: And We made it an example to their own and to succeeding generations, and an admonition to the Allah-fearing.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تَذْبَحُوا۟ بَقَرَةً ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوًا ۖ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
verses.en: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "Indeed, Allāh commands you to slaughter a cow." They said, "Do you take us in ridicule?" He said, "I seek refuge in Allāh from being among the ignorant."
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi ʾinna Allāh yaʾmurukum ʾan tadhbaḥūā baqarahan ۖ qālūā ʾatattakhidhunā huzuwan ۖ qāla ʾaʿūdhu billāh ʾan ʾakūna mina al-jāhilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when Moses said to his people, ‘God commands you to sacrifice a cow.’ They said, ‘Are you making fun of us?’ He answered, ‘God forbid that I should be so ignorant.’
verses.pickthall: And when Moses said unto his people: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye sacrifice a cow, they said: Dost thou make game of us? He answered: Allah forbid that I should be among the foolish!

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِىَ ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا فَارِضٌ وَلَا بِكْرٌ عَوَانٌۢ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ فَٱفْعَلُوا۟ مَا تُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.en: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[Allāh] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."
verses.tr: qālūā ādʿu lanā rabbaka yubayyin llanā mā hāa ۚ qāla ʾinnahu yaqūlu ʾinnahā baqarahun llā fāriḍun walā bikrun ʿawānun bayna dhālika ۖ fāfʿalūā mā tuʾmarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Call on your Lord for us, to show us what sort of cow it should be.’ He answered, ‘God says it should be neither too old nor too young, but in between, so do as you are commanded.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Pray for us unto thy Lord that He make clear to us what (cow) she is. (Moses) answered: Lo! He saith, Verily she is a cow neither with calf nor immature; (she is) between the two conditions; so do that which ye are commanded.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا لَوْنُهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ صَفْرَآءُ فَاقِعٌ لَّوْنُهَا تَسُرُّ ٱلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers.'"
verses.tr: qālūā ādʿu lanā rabbaka yubayyin llanā mā lawnuhā ۚ qāla ʾinnahu yaqūlu ʾinnahā baqarahun ṣafrāʾu fāqiʿun llawnuhā tasurru an-nāẓirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Call on your Lord for us, to show us what colour it should be.’ He answered, ‘God says it should be a bright yellow cow, pleasing to the eye.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Pray for us unto thy Lord that He make clear to us of what colour she is. (Moses) answered: Lo! He saith: Verily she is a yellow cow. Bright is her colour, gladdening beholders.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِىَ إِنَّ ٱلْبَقَرَ تَشَـٰبَهَ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنَّآ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَمُهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allāh wills, will be guided."
verses.tr: qālūā ādʿu lanā rabbaka yubayyin llanā mā hāa ʾinna al-baqara tashābaha ʿalaynā wa-innā ʾin shāʾa Allāh lamuhtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Call on your Lord for us, to show us [exactly] what it is: all cows are more or less alike to us. With God’s will, we shall be guided.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Pray for us unto thy Lord that He make clear to us what (cow) she is. Lo! cows are much alike to us; and Lo! if Allah wills, we may be led aright.

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا ذَلُولٌ تُثِيرُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَا تَسْقِى ٱلْحَرْثَ مُسَلَّمَةٌ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَا ۚ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ جِئْتَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.'" They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnahu yaqūlu ʾinnahā baqarahun llā dhalūlun tuthīru al-ʾarḍa walā tasqā al-ḥartha musallamahun llā shiyaha fīhā ۚ qālūā al-na jiʾta bi-l-ḥaqqi ۚ fadhabaḥūhā wamā kādūā yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He replied, ‘It is a perfect and unblemished cow, not trained to till the earth or water the fields.’ They said, ‘Now you have brought the truth,’ and so they slaughtered it, though they almost failed to do so.
verses.pickthall: (Moses) answered: Lo! He saith: Verily she is a cow unyoked; she plougheth not the soil nor watereth the tilth; whole and without mark. They said: Now thou bringest the truth. So they sacrificed her, though almost they did not.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَتَلْتُمْ نَفْسًا فَٱدَّٰرَْٰٔتُمْ فِيهَا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ مُخْرِجٌ مَّا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
verses.en: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but Allāh was to bring out that which you were concealing.
verses.tr: wa-idh qataltum nafsan fāddārātum fīhā ۖ wallāh mukhrijun mmā kuntum taktumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then, when you [Israelites] killed someone and started to blame one another- although God was to bring what you had concealed to light-
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when ye slew a man and disagreed concerning it and Allah brought forth that which ye were hiding.

verses.ar: فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِبُوهُ بِبَعْضِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُحْىِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: So We said, "Strike him [i.e., the slain man] with part of it." Thus does Allāh bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.
verses.tr: faqulnā āḍribūhu bibaʿḍihā ۚ kadhālika yuḥāi Allāh al-mawtā wayurīkum āyātihi laʿallakum taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We said, ‘Strike the [body] with a part of [the cow]’: thus God brings the dead to life and shows His signs so that you may understand.
verses.pickthall: And We said: Smite him with some of it. Thus Allah bringeth the dead to life and showeth you His portents so that ye may understand.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِىَ كَٱلْحِجَارَةِ أَوْ أَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنْهُ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمَآءُ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَهْبِطُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allāh. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.
verses.tr: thumma qasat qulūbukum mmin baʿdi dhālika fahāa ka-l-ḥijārahi ʾaw ʾashaddu qaswahan ۚ wa-inna mina al-ḥijārahi lamā yatafajjaru minhu al-ʾanhāru ۚ wa-inna minhā lamā yashaqqaqu fayakhruju minhu al-māʾu ۚ wa-inna minhā lamā yahbiṭu min khashyahi Allāh ۗ wamā Allāh bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Even after that, your hearts became as hard as rocks, or even harder, for there are rocks from which streams spring out, and some from which water comes when they split open, and others which fall down in awe of God: He is not unaware of what you do.
verses.pickthall: Then, even after that, your hearts were hardened and became as rocks, or worse than rocks, for hardness. For indeed there are rocks from out which rivers gush, and indeed there are rocks which split asunder so that water floweth from them. And indeed there are rocks which fall down for the fear of Allah. Allah is not unaware of what ye do.

verses.ar: ۞ أَفَتَطْمَعُونَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَقَدْ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ كَلَـٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allāh and then distort it [i.e., the Torah] after they had understood it while they were knowing?
verses.tr: ۞ ʾafataṭmaʿūna ʾan yuʾminūā lakum waqad kāna farīqun mminhum yasmaʿūna kalāma Allāh thumma yuḥarrifūnahu min baʿdi mā ʿaqalūhu wahum yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So can you [believers] hope that such people will believe you, when some of them used to hear the words of God and then deliberately twist them, even when they understood them?
verses.pickthall: Have ye any hope that they will be true to you when a party of them used to listen to the word of Allah, then used to change it, after they had understood it, knowingly?

verses.ar: وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ قَالُوٓا۟ أَتُحَدِّثُونَهُم بِمَا فَتَحَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لِيُحَآجُّوكُم بِهِۦ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "Do you talk to them about what Allāh has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your Lord?" Then will you not reason?
verses.tr: wa-idhā laqūā adh-dhīna āmanūā qālūā āmannā wa-idhā khalā baʿḍuhum ʾilā baʿḍin qālūā ʾatuḥaddithūnahum bimā fataḥa Allāh ʿalaykum liyuḥājjūkum bihi ʿinda rabbikum ۚ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they meet the believers, they say, ‘We too believe.’ But when they are alone with each other they say, ‘How could you tell them about God’s revelation [to us]? They will be able to use it to argue against you before your Lord! Have you no sense?’
verses.pickthall: And when they fall in with those who believe, they say: We believe. But when they go apart one with another they say: Prate ye to them of that which Allah hath disclosed to you that they may contend with you before your Lord concerning it? Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: أَوَلَا يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verses.en: But do they not know that Allāh knows what they conceal and what they declare?
verses.tr: ʾawalā yaʿlamūna ʾanna Allāh yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿlinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not know that God is well aware of what they conceal and what they reveal?
verses.pickthall: Are they then unaware that Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim?

verses.ar: وَمِنْهُمْ أُمِّيُّونَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّآ أَمَانِىَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
verses.en: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except [indulgement in] wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.
verses.tr: waminhum ʾummiyyūna lā yaʿlamūna al-kitāba ʾillā ʾamānāa wa-in hum ʾillā yaẓunnūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Some of them are uneducated, and know the Scripture only through wish-ful thinking. They rely on guesswork.
verses.pickthall: Among them are unlettered folk who know the Scripture not except from hearsay. They but guess.

verses.ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَكْتُبُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ هَـٰذَا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَشْتَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لَّهُم مِّمَّا كَتَبَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَوَيْلٌ لَّهُم مِّمَّا يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: So woe to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allāh," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn.
verses.tr: fawaylun llilladhīna yaktubūna al-kitāba biʾaydīhim thumma yaqūlūna hādhā min ʿindi Allāh liyashtarūā bihi thamanan qalīlan ۖ fawaylun llahum mmimmā katabat ʾaydīhim wawaylun llahum mmimmā yaksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So woe to those who write something down with their own hands and then claim, ‘This is from God,’ in order to make some small gain. Woe to them for what their hands have written! Woe to them for all that they have earned!
verses.pickthall: Therefore woe be unto those who write the Scripture with their hands and then say, "This is from Allah," that they may purchase a small gain therewith. Woe unto them for that their hands have written, and woe unto them for that they earn thereby.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَةً ۚ قُلْ أَتَّخَذْتُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَهْدًا فَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ عَهْدَهُۥٓ ۖ أَمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for [a few] numbered days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allāh? For Allāh will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?"
verses.tr: waqālūā lan tamassanā an-nāru ʾillā ʾayyāman mmaʿdūdahan ۚ qul ʾattakhadhtum ʿinda Allāh ʿahdan falan yukhlifa Allāh ʿahdahu ۖ ʾam taqūlūna ʿalā Allāh mā lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘The Fire will only touch us for a few days.’ Say to them, ‘Have you received a promise from God- for God never breaks His promise- or are you saying things about Him of which you have no real knowledge?’
verses.pickthall: And they say: The Fire (of punishment) will not touch us save for a certain number of days. Say: Have ye received a covenant from Allah - truly Allah will not break His covenant - or tell ye concerning Allah that which ye know not?

verses.ar: بَلَىٰ مَن كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةً وَأَحَـٰطَتْ بِهِۦ خَطِيٓـَٔتُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: Yes, [on the contrary], whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
verses.tr: balā man kasaba sayyiʾahan wa-aḥāṭat bihi khaṭītuhu fa-ūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri ۖ hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly those who do evil and are surrounded by their sins will be the inhabitants of the Fire, there to remain,
verses.pickthall: Nay, but whosoever hath done evil and his sin surroundeth him; such are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu al-jannahi ۖ hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: while those who believe and do good deeds will be the inhabitants of the Garden, there to remain.
verses.pickthall: And those who believe and do good works: such are rightful owners of the Garden. They will abide therein.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَـٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ لَا تَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا وَذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينِ وَقُولُوا۟ لِلنَّاسِ حُسْنًا وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنكُمْ وَأَنتُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: And [recall] when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel, [enjoining upon them], "Do not worship except Allāh; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakāh." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing.
verses.tr: wa-idh ʾakhadhnā mīthāqa banā ʾisrāʾīla lā taʿbudūna ʾillā Allāh wabālwālidayni ʾiḥsānan wadhā al-qurbā wa-l-yatāmā wa-l-masākīni waqūlūā lilnnāsi ḥusnan wa-aqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha watūā az-zakawāha thumma tawallaytum ʾillā qalīlan mminkum wa-antum mmuʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when We took a pledge from the Children of Israel: ‘Worship none but God; be good to your parents and kinsfolk, to orphans and the poor; speak good words to all people; keep up the prayer and pay the prescribed alms.’ Then all but a few of you turned away and paid no heed.
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when We made a covenant with the Children of Israel, (saying): Worship none save Allah (only), and be good to parents and to kindred and to orphans and the needy, and speak kindly to mankind; and establish worship and pay the poor-due. Then, after that, ye slid back, save a few of you, being averse.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَـٰقَكُمْ لَا تَسْفِكُونَ دِمَآءَكُمْ وَلَا تُخْرِجُونَ أَنفُسَكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
verses.en: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed your [i.e., each other's] blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing.
verses.tr: wa-idh ʾakhadhnā mīthāqakum lā tasfikūna dimāʾakum walā tukhrijūna ʾanfusakum mmin diyārikum thumma ʾaqrartum wa-antum tashhadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We took a pledge from you, ‘Do not shed one another’s blood or drive one another from your homelands.’ You acknowledged it at the time, and you can testify to this.
verses.pickthall: And when We made with you a covenant (saying): Shed not the blood of your people nor turn (a party of) your people out of your dwellings. Then ye ratified (Our covenant) and ye were witnesses (thereto).

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ تَقْتُلُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتُخْرِجُونَ فَرِيقًا مِّنكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِهِمْ تَظَـٰهَرُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَإِن يَأْتُوكُمْ أُسَـٰرَىٰ تُفَـٰدُوهُمْ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِخْرَاجُهُمْ ۚ أَفَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِبَعْضِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَتَكْفُرُونَ بِبَعْضٍ ۚ فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَن يَفْعَلُ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمْ إِلَّا خِزْىٌ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَشَدِّ ٱلْعَذَابِ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Then, you are those [same ones who are] killing one another and evicting a party of your people from their homes, cooperating against them in sin and aggression. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them, although their eviction was forbidden to you. So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part? Then what is the recompense for those who do that among you except disgrace in worldly life; and on the Day of Resurrection they will be sent back to the severest of punishment. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.
verses.tr: thumma ʾantum hāʾulāʾi taqtulūna ʾanfusakum watukhrijūna farīqan mminkum mmin diyārihim taẓāharūna ʿalayhim bi-l-ʾithmi wa-l-ʿudwāni wa-in yaʾtūkum ʾusārā tufādūhum wahuwa muḥarramun ʿalaykum ʾikhrājuhum ۚ ʾafatuʾminūna bibaʿḍi al-kitābi watakfurūna bibaʿḍin ۚ famā jazāʾu man yafʿalu dhālika minkum ʾillā khizāun fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۖ wayawma al-qiyāmahi yuraddūna ʾilā ʾashaddi al-ʿadhābi ۗ wamā Allāh bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet here you are, killing one another and driving some of your own people from their homes, helping one another in sin and aggression against them. If they come to you as captives, you still pay to set them free, although you had no right to drive them out. So do you believe in some parts of the Scripture and not in others? The punishment for those of you who do this will be nothing but disgrace in this life, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be condemned to the harshest torment: God is not unaware of what you do.
verses.pickthall: Yet ye it is who slay each other and drive out a party of your people from their homes, supporting one another against them by sin and transgression? - and if they came to you as captives ye would ransom them, whereas their expulsion was itself unlawful for you - Believe ye in part of the Scripture and disbelieve ye in part thereof? And what is the reward of those who do so save ignominy in the life of the world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be consigned to the most grievous doom. For Allah is not unaware of what ye do.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: Those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the Hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna āshtarawā al-ḥayawāha ad-dunyā bi-l-ākhirahi ۖ falā yukhaffafu ʿanhumu al-ʿadhābu walā hum yunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: These are the people who buy the life of this world at the price of the Hereafter: their torment will not be lightened, nor will they be helped.
verses.pickthall: Such are those who buy the life of the world at the price of the Hereafter. Their punishment will not be lightened, neither will they have support.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَقَفَّيْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ بِٱلرُّسُلِ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَا عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَأَيَّدْنَـٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ ۗ أَفَكُلَّمَا جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُكُمُ ٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ فَفَرِيقًا كَذَّبْتُمْ وَفَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ
verses.en: And We did certainly give Moses the Scripture [i.e., the Torah] and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit [i.e., the angel Gabriel]. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed.
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā mūsā al-kitāba waqaffaynā min baʿdihi bi-ar-rusuli ۖ wataynā ʿīsā ābna maryama al-bayyināti wa-ayyadnāhu birūḥi al-qudusi ۗ ʾafakullamā jāʾakum rasūlun bimā lā tahwā ʾanfusukumu āstakbartum fafarīqan kadhabtum wafarīqan taqtulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave Moses the Scripture and We sent messengers after him in succession. We gave Jesus, son of Mary, clear signs and strengthened him with the Holy Spirit. So how is it that, whenever a messenger brings you something you do not like, you become arrogant, calling some impostors and killing others?
verses.pickthall: And verily We gave unto Moses the Scripture and We caused a train of messengers to follow after him, and We gave unto Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs (of Allah's sovereignty), and We supported him with the Holy spirit. Is it ever so, that, when there cometh unto you a messenger (from Allah) with that which ye yourselves desire not, ye grow arrogant, and some ye disbelieve and some ye slay?

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا غُلْفٌۢ ۚ بَل لَّعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَقَلِيلًا مَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped." But, [in fact], Allāh has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe.
verses.tr: waqālūā qulūbunā ghulfun ۚ bal llaʿanahumu Allāh bikufrihim faqalīlan mmā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘Our hearts are impenetrably wrapped [against whatever you say],’ but God has rejected them for their disbelief: they have little faith.
verses.pickthall: And they say: Our hearts are hardened. Nay, but Allah hath cursed them for their unbelief. Little is that which they believe.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مَّا عَرَفُوا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ فَلَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
