And if one of you entrusteth to another let him who is trusted deliver up that which is entrusted to him (according to the pact between them) and let him observe his duty to Allah his Lord. Hide not testimony. He who hideth it, verily his heart is sinful. Allah is Aware of what ye do.

verses.ar: لِّلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِن تُبْدُوا۟ مَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Whether you show what is within yourselves or conceal it, Allāh will bring you to account for it. Then He will forgive whom He wills and punish whom He wills, and Allāh is over all things competent.
verses.tr: lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۗ wa-in tubdūā mā fā ʾanfusikum ʾaw tukhfūhu yuḥāsibkum bihi Allāh ۖ fayaghfiru liman yashāʾu wayuʿadhibu man yashāʾu ۗ wallāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Whatever is in the heavens and in the earth belongs to God and, whether you reveal or conceal your thoughts, God will call you to account for them. He will forgive whoever He will and punish whoever He will: He has power over all things.
verses.pickthall: Unto Allah (belongeth) whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; and whether ye make known what is in your minds or hide it, Allah will bring you to account for it. He will forgive whom He will and He will punish whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allāh and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination."
verses.tr: āmana ar-rasūlu bimā ʾunzila ʾilayhi min rrabbihi wa-l-muʾminūna ۚ kullun āmana billāh wamalāʾikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi lā nufarriqu bayna ʾaḥadin mmin rrusulihi ۚ waqālūā samiʿnā wa-aṭaʿnā ۖ ghufrānaka rabbanā wa-ʾilayka al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: The Messenger believes in what has been sent down to him from his Lord, as do the faithful. They all believe in God, His angels, His scriptures, and His messengers. ‘We make no distinction between any of His messengers,’ they say, ‘We hear and obey. Grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord. To You we all return!’-
verses.pickthall: The messenger believeth in that which hath been revealed unto him from his Lord and (so do) believers. Each one believeth in Allah and His angels and His scriptures and His messengers - We make no distinction between any of His messengers - and they say: We hear, and we obey. (Grant us) Thy forgiveness, our Lord. Unto Thee is the journeying.

verses.ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: Allāh does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."
verses.tr: lā yukallifu Allāh nafsan ʾillā wusʿahā ۚ lahā mā kasabat waʿalayhā mā āktasabat ۗ rabbanā lā tuākhidhnā ʾin nnasīnā ʾaw ʾakhṭaʾnā ۚ rabbanā walā taḥmil ʿalaynā ʾiṣran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿalā adh-dhīna min qablinā ۚ rabbanā walā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqaha lanā bihi ۖ wāʿfu ʿannā wāghfir lanā wārḥamnā ۚ ʾanta mawlānā fānṣurnā ʿalā al-qawmi al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God does not burden any soul with more than it can bear: each gains whatever good it has done, and suffers its bad- ‘ Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make mistakes. Lord, do not burden us as You burdened those before us. Lord, do not burden us with more than we have strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelievers.’
verses.pickthall: Allah tasketh not a soul beyond its scope. For it (is only) that which it hath earned, and against it (only) that which it hath deserved. Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark! Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as thou didst lay on those before us! Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, Thou, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.

verses.ar: الٓمٓ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Meem.
verses.tr: al-m
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Mim
verses.pickthall: Alim. Lam. Mim.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ
verses.en: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining.
verses.tr: Allāh lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa al-ḥāu al-qayyūmu
verses.abdelhaleem: God: there is no god but Him, the Ever Living, the Ever Watchful.
verses.pickthall: Allah! There is no god save Him, the Alive, the Eternal.

verses.ar: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ
verses.en: He has sent down upon you, [O Muḥammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel
verses.tr: nazzala ʿalayka al-kitāba bi-l-ḥaqqi muṣaddiqan llimā bayna yadayhi wa-anzala at-tawrāha wa-l-ʾinjīla
verses.abdelhaleem: Step by step, He has sent the Scripture down to you [Prophet] with the Truth, confirming what went before: He sent down the Torah and the Gospel
verses.pickthall: He hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture with truth, confirming that which was (revealed) before it, even as He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.

verses.ar: مِن قَبْلُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
verses.en: Before, as guidance for the people. And He revealed the Criterion [i.e., the Qur’ān]. Indeed, those who disbelieve in the verses of Allāh will have a severe punishment, and Allāh is Exalted in Might, the Owner of Retribution.
verses.tr: min qablu hudanā llilnnāsi wa-anzala al-furqāna ۗ ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā bāyāti Allāh lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun ۗ wallāh ʿazīzun dhū āntiqāmin
verses.abdelhaleem: earlier as a guide for people and He has sent down the distinction [between right and wrong]. Those who deny God’s revelations will suffer severe torment: God is almighty and capable of retribution.
verses.pickthall: Aforetime, for a guidance to mankind; and hath revealed the Criterion (of right and wrong). Lo! those who disbelieve the revelations of Allah, theirs will be a heavy doom. Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
verses.en: Indeed, from Allāh nothing is hidden in the earth nor in the heaven.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh lā yakhfā ʿalayhi shāʾun fā al-ʾarḍi walā fā as-samāʾi
verses.abdelhaleem: Nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden from God:
verses.pickthall: Lo! nothing in the earth or in the heavens is hidden from Allah.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wills. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā yuṣawwirukum fā al-ʾarḥāmi kayfa yashāʾu ۚ lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who shapes you all in the womb as He pleases. There is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Wise:
verses.pickthall: He it is Who fashioneth you in the wombs as pleaseth Him. There is no Allah save Him, the Almighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَـٰتٌ مُّحْكَمَـٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَـٰبِهَـٰتٌ ۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَـٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific. As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific, seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them]. And no one knows its [true] interpretation except Allāh. But those firm in knowledge say, "We believe in it. All [of it] is from our Lord." And no one will be reminded except those of understanding.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā ʾanzala ʿalayka al-kitāba minhu āyātun mmuḥkamātun hunna ʾummu al-kitābi wa-ukharu mutashābihātun ۖ fa-ammā adh-dhīna fā qulūbihim zayghun fayattabiʿūna mā tashābaha minhu ābtighāʾa al-fitnahi wābtighāʾa taʾwīlihi ۗ wamā yaʿlamu taʾwīlahu ʾillā Allāh ۗ wa-ar-rāsikhūna fā al-ʿilmi yaqūlūna āmannā bihi kullun mmin ʿindi rabbinā ۗ wamā yadhakkaru ʾillā ʾūlūā al-ʾalbābi
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who has sent this Scripture down to you [Prophet]. Some of its verses are definite in meaning- these are the cornerstone of the Scripture- and others are ambiguous. The perverse at heart eagerly pursue the ambiguities in their attempt to make trouble and to pin down a specific meaning of their own: only God knows the true meaning. Those firmly grounded in knowledge say, ‘We believe in it: it is all from our Lord’- only those with real perception will take heed-
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture wherein are clear revelations - they are the substance of the Book - and others (which are) allegorical. But those in whose hearts is doubt pursue, forsooth, that which is allegorical seeking (to cause) dissension by seeking to explain it. None knoweth its explanation save Allah. And those who are of sound instruction say: We believe therein; the whole is from our Lord; but only men of understanding really heed.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.en: [Who say], "Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
verses.tr: rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā baʿda ʾidh hadaytanā wahab lanā min lladunka raḥmahan ۚ ʾinnaka ʾanta al-wahhābu
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us. Grant us Your mercy: You are the Ever Giving.
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Bestower.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
verses.en: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in His promise."
verses.tr: rabbanā ʾinnaka jāmiʿu an-nāsi liyawmin llā rayba fīhi ۚ ʾinna Allāh lā yukhlifu al-mīʿāda
verses.abdelhaleem: Our Lord, You will gather all people on the Day of which there is no doubt: God never breaks His promise.’
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! it is Thou Who gatherest mankind together to a Day of which there is no doubt. Lo! Allah faileth not to keep the tryst.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ وَقُودُ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allāh at all. And it is they who are fuel for the Fire.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā lan tughnāa ʿanhum ʾamwāluhum walā ʾawlāduhum mmina Allāh shayā ۖ wa-ūlāʾika hum waqūdu an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: Neither their possessions nor their children will be any use to the disbelievers against God. The disbelievers will be fuel for the Fire,
verses.pickthall: (On that Day) neither the riches nor the progeny of those who disbelieve will aught avail them with Allah. They will be fuel for Fire.

verses.ar: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.en: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied Our signs, so Allāh seized them for their sins. And Allāh is severe in penalty.
verses.tr: kadaʾbi āli firʿawna wa-adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ kadhabūā bāyātinā fa-akhadhahumu Allāh bidhunūbihim ۗ wallāh shadīdu al-ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: just as Pharaoh’s people and their predecessors denied Our revelations, and God punished them for their sins: God is severe in punishing.
verses.pickthall: Like Pharaoh's folk and those who were before them, they disbelieved Our revelations and so Allah seized them for their sins. And Allah is severe in punishment.

verses.ar: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَتُغْلَبُونَ وَتُحْشَرُونَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.en: Say to those who disbelieve, "You will be overcome and gathered together to Hell, and wretched is the resting place."
verses.tr: qul llilladhīna kafarūā satughlabūna watuḥsharūna ʾilā jahannama ۚ wabiʾsa al-mihādu
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say to the disbelievers, ‘You will be defeated and driven together into Hell, a foul resting place.
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad) unto those who disbelieve: Ye shall be overcome and gathered unto Hell, an evil resting-place.

verses.ar: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ ءَايَةٌ فِى فِئَتَيْنِ ٱلْتَقَتَا ۖ فِئَةٌ تُقَـٰتِلُ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُخْرَىٰ كَافِرَةٌ يَرَوْنَهُم مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَأْىَ ٱلْعَيْنِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
verses.en: Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met [in combat at Badr] - one fighting in the cause of Allāh and another of disbelievers. They saw them [to be] twice their [own] number by [their] eyesight. But Allāh supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed in that is a lesson for those of vision.
verses.tr: qad kāna lakum āyahun fā fiʾatayni at-taqatā ۖ fiʾahun tuqātilu fā sabīli Allāh wa-ukhrā kāfirahun yarawnahum mmithlayhim raāa al-ʿayni ۚ wallāh yuʾayyidu binaṣrihi man yashāʾu ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika laʿibrahan lliʾūlā al-ʾabṣāri
verses.abdelhaleem: You have already seen a sign in the two armies that met in battle, one fighting for God’s cause and the other made up of disbelievers. With their own eyes [the former] saw [the latter] to be twice their number, but God helps whoever He will. There truly is a lesson in this for all with eyes to see.’
verses.pickthall: There was a token for you in two hosts which met: one army fighting in the way of Allah, and another disbelieving, whom they saw as twice their number, clearly, with their very eyes. Thus Allah strengtheneth with His succour whom He will. Lo! herein verily is a lesson for those who have eyes.

verses.ar: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱلْقَنَـٰطِيرِ ٱلْمُقَنطَرَةِ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلْخَيْلِ ٱلْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ وَٱلْحَرْثِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلْمَـَٔابِ
verses.en: Beautified for people is the love of that which they desire - of women and sons, heaped-up sums of gold and silver, fine branded horses, and cattle and tilled land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, but Allāh has with Him the best return [i.e., Paradise].
verses.tr: zuyyina lilnnāsi ḥubbu ash-shahawāti mina an-nisāʾi wa-l-banīna wa-l-qanāṭīri al-muqanṭarahi mina adh-dhahabi wa-l-fiḍḍahi wa-l-khayli al-musawwamahi wa-l-ʾanʿāmi wa-l-ḥarthi ۗ dhālika matāʿu al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۖ wallāh ʿindahu ḥusnu al-mābi
verses.abdelhaleem: The love of desirable things is made alluring for men- women, children, gold and silver treasures piled up high, horses with fine markings, livestock, and farmland- these may be the joys of this life, but God has the best place to return to.
verses.pickthall: Beautified for mankind is love of the joys (that come) from women and offspring; and stored-up heaps of gold and silver, and horses branded (with their mark), and cattle and land. That is comfort of the life of the world. Allah! With Him is a more excellent abode.

verses.ar: ۞ قُلْ أَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيْرٍ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَأَزْوَٰجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.en: Say, "Shall I inform you of [something] better than that? For those who fear Allāh will be gardens in the presence of their Lord beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally, and purified spouses and approval from Allāh. And Allāh is Seeing [i.e., aware] of [His] servants -
verses.tr: ۞ qul ʾaʾunabbiʾukum bikhayrin mmin dhālikum ۚ lilladhīna āttaqawā ʿinda rabbihim jannātun tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā wa-azwājun mmuṭahharahun wariḍwānun mmina Allāh ۗ wallāh baṣīrun bi-l-ʿibādi
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say, ‘Would you like me to tell you of things that are better than all of these? Their Lord will give those who are mindful of God Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will stay with pure spouses and God’s good pleasure- God is fully aware of His servants-
verses.pickthall: Say: Shall I inform you of something better than that? For those who keep from evil, with their Lord, are Gardens underneath which rivers flow wherein they will abide, and pure companions, and contentment from Allah. Allah is Seer of His bondmen,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: Those who say, "Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire,"
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā ʾinnanā āmannā fāghfir lanā dhunūbanā waqinā ʿadhāba an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: those who say, “Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us our sins and protect us from suffering in the Fire,”
verses.pickthall: Those who say: Our Lord! Lo! we believe. So forgive us our sins and guard us from the punishment of Fire;

verses.ar: ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِٱلْأَسْحَارِ
verses.en: The patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of Allāh], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.
verses.tr: aṣ-ṣābirīna wa-aṣ-ṣādiqīna wa-l-qānitīna wa-l-munfiqīna wa-l-mustaghfirīna bi-l-ʾasḥāri
verses.abdelhaleem: those who are steadfast, truthful, truly devout, who give [in God’s cause] and pray before dawn for forgiveness.’
verses.pickthall: The steadfast, and the truthful, and the obedient, those who spend (and hoard not), those who pray for pardon in the watches of the night.

verses.ar: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Allāh witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: shahida Allāh ʾannahu lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa wa-l-malāʾikahu wa-ūlūā al-ʿilmi qāʾimanā bi-l-qisṭi ۚ lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: God bears witness that there is no god but Him, as do the angels and those who have knowledge. He upholds justice. There is no god but Him, the Almighty, the All Wise.
verses.pickthall: Allah (Himself) is Witness that there is no Allah save Him. And the angels and the men of learning (too are witness). Maintaining His creation in justice, there is no Allah save Him the Almighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمُ ۗ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allāh is Islām. And those who were given the Scripture did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of Allāh, then indeed, Allāh is swift in [taking] account.
verses.tr: ʾinna ad-dīna ʿinda Allāh al-ʾislāmu ۗ wamā ākhtalafa adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-kitāba ʾillā min baʿdi mā jāʾahumu al-ʿilmu baghyanā baynahum ۗ waman yakfur bāyāti Allāh fa-inna Allāh sarīʿu al-ḥisābi
verses.abdelhaleem: True Religion, in God’s eyes, is islam: [devotion to Him alone]. Those who were given the Scripture disagreed out of rivalry, only after they had been given knowledge- if anyone denies God’s revelations, God is swift to take account-
verses.pickthall: Lo! religion with Allah (is) the Surrender (to His Will and Guidance). Those who (formerly) received the Scripture differed only after knowledge came unto them, through transgression among themselves. Whoso disbelieveth the revelations of Allah (will find that) lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.

verses.ar: فَإِنْ حَآجُّوكَ فَقُلْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّهِ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِ ۗ وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ ءَأَسْلَمْتُمْ ۚ فَإِنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟ ۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.en: So if they argue with you, say, "I have submitted myself to Allāh [in Islām], and [so have] those who follow me." And say to those who were given the Scripture and [to] the unlearned, "Have you submitted yourselves?" And if they submit [in Islām], they are rightly guided; but if they turn away - then upon you is only the [duty of] notification. And Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants.
verses.tr: fa-in ḥājjūka faqul ʾaslamtu wajhāa lillāh wamani āttabaʿani ۗ waqul llilladhīna ʾūtūā al-kitāba wa-l-ʾummiyyina ʾaʾaslamtum ۚ fa-in ʾaslamūā faqadi āhtadawā ۖ wwaʾin tawallawā fa-innamā ʿalayka al-balāghu ۗ wallāh baṣīrun bi-l-ʿibādi
verses.abdelhaleem: if they argue with you [Prophet], say, ‘I have devoted myself to God alone and so have my followers.’ Ask those who were given the Scripture, as well as those without one, ‘Do you too devote yourselves to Him alone?’ If they do, they will be guided, but if they turn away, your only duty is to convey the message. God is aware of His servants.
verses.pickthall: And if they argue with thee, (O Muhammad), say: I have surrendered my purpose to Allah and (so have) those who follow me. And say unto those who have received the Scripture and those who read not: Have ye (too) surrendered? If they surrender, then truly they are rightly guided, and if they turn away, then it is thy duty only to convey the message (unto them). Allah is Seer of (His) bondmen.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: Those who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and kill the prophets without right and kill those who order justice from among the people - give them tidings of a painful punishment.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yakfurūna bāyāti Allāh wayaqtulūna an-nabiyyina bighayri ḥaqqin wayaqtulūna adh-dhīna yaʾmurūna bi-l-qisṭi mina an-nāsi fabashirhum biʿadhābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Give news of agonizing torment to those who ignore God’s revelations, who unjustifiably kill prophets, who kill those who command that justice is done:
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve the revelations of Allah, and slay the prophets wrongfully, and slay those of mankind who enjoin equity: promise them a painful doom.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.en: They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna ḥabiṭat ʾaʿmāluhum fā ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhirahi wamā lahum mmin nnāṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: the deeds of such people will come to nothing in this world and in the next and no one will help them.
verses.pickthall: Those are they whose works have failed in the world and the Hereafter; and they have no helpers.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ نَصِيبًا مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: Do you not consider, [O Muḥammad], those who were given a portion of the Scripture? They are invited to the Scripture of Allāh that it should arbitrate between them; then a party of them turns away, and they are refusing.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾilā adh-dhīna ʾūtūā naṣīban mmina al-kitābi yudʿawna ʾilā kitābi Allāh liyaḥkuma baynahum thumma yatawallā farīqun mminhum wahum mmuʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you considered those who were given a share of the Scripture? When they are asked to accept judgement from God’s Scripture, some of them turn their backs and walk away, all because they declare,
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how those who have received a portion of the Scripture invoke the Scripture of Allah (in their disputes) that it may judge between them; then a faction of them turn away, being opposed (to it)?

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍ ۖ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِى دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: That is because they say, "Never will the Fire touch us except for [a few] numbered days," and [because] they were deluded in their religion by what they were inventing.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾannahum qālūā lan tamassanā an-nāru ʾillā ʾayyāman mmaʿdūdātin ۖ wagharrahum fā dīnihim mmā kānūā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘The Fire will only touch us for a limited number of days.’ The lies they have invented have led them astray in their own religion.
verses.pickthall: That is because they say: The Fire will not touch us save for a certain number of days. That which they used to invent hath deceived them regarding their religion.

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جَمَعْنَـٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So how will it be when We assemble them for a Day about which there is no doubt? And each soul will be compensated [in full for] what it earned, and they will not be wronged.
verses.tr: fakayfa ʾidhā jamaʿnāhum liyawmin llā rayba fīhi wawuffiyat kullu nafsin mmā kasabat wahum lā yuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How will they fare when We gather them together for a Day of which there is no doubt, when every soul will be paid in full for what it has done, and they will not be wronged?
verses.pickthall: How (will it be with them) when We have brought them all together to a Day of which there is no doubt, when every soul will be paid in full what it hath earned, and they will not be wronged.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَـٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Say, "O Allāh, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
verses.tr: quli Allāhumma mālika al-mulki tuʾtā al-mulka man tashāʾu watanziʿu al-mulka mimman tashāʾu watuʿizzu man tashāʾu watudhillu man tashāʾu ۖ biyadika al-khayru ۖ ʾinnaka ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘God, holder of all control, You give control to whoever You will and remove it from whoever You will; You elevate whoever You will and humble whoever You will. All that is good lies in Your hand: You have power over everything.
verses.pickthall: Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.

verses.ar: تُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ۖ وَتَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.en: You cause the night to enter the day, and You cause the day to enter the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give provision to whom You will without account [i.e., limit or measure]."
verses.tr: tūliju al-yla fā an-nahāri watūliju an-nahāra fā al-yli ۖ watukhriju al-ḥāa mina al-mayyiti watukhriju al-mayyita mina al-ḥāi ۖ watarzuqu man tashāʾu bighayri ḥisābin
verses.abdelhaleem: You merge night into day and day into night; You bring the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living; You provide limitlessly for whoever You will.’
verses.pickthall: Thou causest the night to pass into the day, and Thou causest the day to pass into the night. And Thou bringest forth the living from the dead, and Thou bringest forth the dead from the living. And Thou givest sustenance to whom Thou choosest, without stint.

verses.ar: لَّا يَتَّخِذِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فِى شَىْءٍ إِلَّآ أَن تَتَّقُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ تُقَىٰةً ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: Let not believers take disbelievers as allies [i.e., supporters or protectors] rather than believers. And whoever [of you] does that has nothing [i.e., no association] with Allāh, except when taking precaution against them in prudence. And Allāh warns you of Himself, and to Allāh is the [final] destination.
verses.tr: llā yattakhidhi al-muʾminūna al-kāfirīna ʾawliyāʾa min dūni al-muʾminīna ۖ waman yafʿal dhālika falaysa mina Allāh fā shāʾin ʾillā ʾan tattaqūā minhum tuqāhan ۗ wayuḥadhirukumu Allāh nafsahu ۗ wa-ʾilā Allāh al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: The believers should not make the disbelievers their allies rather than other believers- anyone who does such a thing will isolate himself completely from God- except when you need to protect yourselves from them. God warns you to beware of Him: the Final Return is to God.
verses.pickthall: Let not the believers take disbelievers for their friends in preference to believers. Whoso doeth that hath no connection with Allah unless (it be) that ye but guard yourselves against them, taking (as it were) security. Allah biddeth you beware (only) of Himself. Unto Allah is the journeying.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِن تُخْفُوا۟ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ أَوْ تُبْدُوهُ يَعْلَمْهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Say, "Whether you conceal what is in your breasts or reveal it, Allāh knows it. And He knows that which is in the heavens and that which is on the earth. And Allāh is over all things competent.
verses.tr: qul ʾin tukhfūā mā fā ṣudūrikum ʾaw tubdūhu yaʿlamhu Allāh ۗ wayaʿlamu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۗ wallāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘God knows everything that is in your hearts, whether you conceal or reveal it; He knows everything in the heavens and earth; God has power over all things.’
verses.pickthall: Say, (O Muhammad): Whether ye hide that which is in your breasts or reveal it, Allah knoweth it. He knoweth that which is in the heavens and that which is in the earth, and Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُّحْضَرًا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوٓءٍ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُۥٓ أَمَدًۢا بَعِيدًا ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.en: The Day every soul will find what it has done of good present [before it] and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between itself and that [evil] was a great distance. And Allāh warns you of Himself, and Allāh is Kind to [His] servants."
verses.tr: yawma tajidu kullu nafsin mmā ʿamilat min khayrin mmuḥḍaran wamā ʿamilat min sūʾin tawaddu law ʾanna baynahā wabaynahu ʾamadanā baʿīdan ۗ wayuḥadhirukumu Allāh nafsahu ۗ wallāh raʾūfun bi-l-ʿibādi
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when every soul finds all the good it has done present before it, it will wish all the bad it has done to be far, far away. God warns you to beware of Him, but God is compassionate towards His servants.
verses.pickthall: On the Day when every soul will find itself confronted with all that it hath done of good and all that it hath done of evil (every soul) will long that there might be a mighty space of distance between it and that (evil). Allah biddeth you beware of Him. And Allah is Full of Pity for (His) bondmen.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى يُحْبِبْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If you should love Allāh, then follow me, [so] Allāh will love you and forgive you your sins. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.tr: qul ʾin kuntum tuḥibbūna Allāh fāttabiʿūnā yuḥbibkumu Allāh wayaghfir lakum dhunūbakum ۗ wallāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘If you love God, follow me, and God will love you and forgive you your sins; God is most forgiving, most merciful.’
verses.pickthall: Say, (O Muhammad, to mankind): If ye love Allah, follow me; Allah will love you and forgive you your sins. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Obey Allāh and the Messenger. But if you turn away - then indeed, Allāh does not like the disbelievers."
verses.tr: qul ʾaṭīʿūā Allāh wa-ar-rasūla ۖ fa-in tawallawā fa-inna Allāh lā yuḥibbu al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Obey God and the Messenger,’ but if they turn away, [know that] God does not love those who ignore [His commands].
verses.pickthall: Say: Obey Allah and the messenger. But if they turn away, lo! Allah loveth not the disbelievers (in His guidance).

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ وَنُوحًا وَءَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَءَالَ عِمْرَٰنَ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of ʿImrān over the worlds -
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinna Allāh āṣṭafā ādama wanūḥan wala ʾibrāhīma wala ʿimrāna ʿalā al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God chose Adam, Noah, Abraham’s family, and the family of Imran, over all other people,
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah preferred Adam and Noah and the Family of Abraham and the Family of 'Imran above (all His) creatures.

verses.ar: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Descendants, some of them from others. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.tr: dhurriyyahan baʿḍuhā min baʿḍin ۗ wallāh samīʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: in one line of descent- God hears and knows all.
verses.pickthall: They were descendants one of another. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing."
verses.tr: ʾidh qālati āmraʾatu ʿimrāna rabbi ʾinnā nadhartu laka mā fā baṭnā muḥarraran fataqabbal minnā ۖ ʾinnaka ʾanta as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Imran’s wife said, ‘Lord, I have dedicated what is growing in my womb entirely to You; so accept this from me. You are the One who hears and knows all,’
verses.pickthall: (Remember) when the wife of 'Imran said: My Lord! I have vowed unto Thee that which is in my belly as a consecrated (offering). Accept it from me. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower!

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَضَعْتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۖ وَإِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّىٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
verses.en: But when she delivered her, she said, "My Lord, I have delivered a female." And Allāh was most knowing of what she delivered, and the male is not like the female. "And I have named her Mary, and I seek refuge for her in You and [for] her descendants from Satan, the expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]."
verses.tr: falammā waḍaʿathā qālat rabbi ʾinnā waḍaʿtuhā ʾunthā wallāh ʾaʿlamu bimā waḍaʿat walaysa adh-dhakaru ka-l-ʾunthā ۖ wa-innā sammaytuhā maryama wa-innā ʾuʿīdhuhā bika wadhurriyyatahā mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: but when she gave birth, she said, ‘My Lord! I have given birth to a girl’- God knew best what she had given birth to: the male is not like the female- ‘ I name her Mary and I commend her and her offspring to Your protection from the rejected Satan.’
verses.pickthall: And when she was delivered she said: My Lord! Lo! I am delivered of a female - Allah knew best of what she was delivered - the male is not as the female; and lo! I have named her Mary, and lo! I crave Thy protection for her and for her offspring from Satan the outcast.

verses.ar: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.en: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account."
verses.tr: fataqabbalahā rabbuhā biqabūlin ḥasanin wa-anbatahā nabātan ḥasanan wakaffalahā zakariyyā ۖ kullamā dakhala ʿalayhā zakariyyā al-miḥrāba wajada ʿindahā rizqan ۖ qāla yāmaryamu ʾannā laki hādhā ۖ qālat huwa min ʿindi Allāh ۖ ʾinna Allāh yarzuqu man yashāʾu bighayri ḥisābin
verses.abdelhaleem: Her Lord graciously accepted her and made her grow in goodness, and entrusted her to the charge of Zachariah. Whenever Zachariah went in to see her in her sanctuary, he found her supplied with provisions. He said, ‘Mary, how is it you have these provisions?’ and she said, ‘They are from God: God provides limitlessly for whoever He will.’
verses.pickthall: And her Lord accepted her with full acceptance and vouchsafed to her a goodly growth; and made Zachariah her guardian. Whenever Zachariah went into the sanctuary where she was, he found that she had food. He said: O Mary! Whence cometh unto thee this (food)? She answered: It is from Allah. Allah giveth without stint to whom He will.

verses.ar: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verses.en: At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication."
verses.tr: hunālika daʿā zakariyyā rabbahu ۖ qāla rabbi hab lā min lladunka dhurriyyahan ṭayyibahan ۖ ʾinnaka samīʿu ad-duʿāʾi
verses.abdelhaleem: There and then Zachariah prayed to his Lord, saying, ‘Lord, from Your grace grant me virtuous offspring: You hear every prayer.’
verses.pickthall: Then Zachariah prayed unto his Lord and said: My Lord! Bestow upon me of Thy bounty goodly offspring. Lo! Thou art the Hearer of Prayer.

verses.ar: فَنَادَتْهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌ يُصَلِّى فِى ٱلْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۢا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: So the angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, "Indeed, Allāh gives you good tidings of John, confirming a word from Allāh and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous."
verses.tr: fanādathu al-malāʾikahu wahuwa qāʾimun yuṣallā fā al-miḥrābi ʾanna Allāh yubashiruka biyaḥyā muṣaddiqanā bikalimahin mmina Allāh wasayyidan waḥaṣūran wanabiyyan mmina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The angels called out to him, while he stood praying in the sanctuary, ‘God gives you news of John, confirming a Word from God. He will be noble and chaste, a prophet, one of the righteous.’
verses.pickthall: And the angels called to him as he stood praying in the sanctuary: Allah giveth thee glad tidings of (a son whose name is) John, (who cometh) to confirm a word from Allah lordly, chaste, a prophet of the righteous.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ʾannā yakūnu lā ghulāmun waqad balaghanāa al-kibaru wāmraʾatā ʿāqirun ۖ qāla kadhālika Allāh yafʿalu mā yashāʾu
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My Lord, how can I have a son when I am so old and my wife is barren?’ [An angel] said, ‘It will be so: God does whatever He will.’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when age hath overtaken me already and my wife is barren? (The angel) answered: So (it will be). Allah doeth what He will.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً ۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًا ۗ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَـٰرِ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt [Him with praise] in the evening and the morning."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ājʿal llā āyahan ۖ qāla āyatuka ʾallā tukallima an-nāsa thalāthaha ʾayyāmin ʾillā ramzan ۗ wādhkur rrabbaka kathīran wasabbiḥ bi-l-ʿashāi wa-l-ʾibkāri
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My Lord, give me a sign.’ ‘Your sign,’ [the angel] said, ‘is that you will not communicate with anyone for three days, except by gestures. Remember your Lord often; celebrate His glory in the evening and at dawn.’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Appoint a token for me. (The angel) said: The token unto thee (shall be) that thou shalt not speak unto mankind three days except by signs. Remember thy Lord much, and praise (Him) in the early hours of night and morning.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds.
verses.tr: wa-idh qālati al-malāʾikahu yāmaryamu ʾinna Allāh āṣṭafāki waṭahharaki wāṣṭafāki ʿalā nisāʾi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The angels said to Mary: ‘Mary, God has chosen you and made you pure: He has truly chosen you above all women.
verses.pickthall: And when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah hath chosen thee and made thee pure, and hath preferred thee above (all) the women of creation.

verses.ar: يَـٰمَرْيَمُ ٱقْنُتِى لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسْجُدِى وَٱرْكَعِى مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
verses.en: O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]."
verses.tr: yāmaryamu āqnutā lirabbiki wāsjudā wārkaʿā maʿa ar-rākiʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Mary, be devout to your Lord, prostrate yourself in worship, bow down with those who pray.’
verses.pickthall: O Mary! Be obedient to thy Lord, prostrate thyself and bow with those who bow (in worship).

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَـٰمَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.en: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muḥammad]. And you were not with them when they cast their pens as to which of them should be responsible for Mary. Nor were you with them when they disputed.
verses.tr: dhālika min ʾanbāʾi al-ghaybi nūḥīhi ʾilayka ۚ wamā kunta ladayhim ʾidh yulqūna ʾaqlāmahum ʾayyuhum yakfulu maryama wamā kunta ladayhim ʾidh yakhtaṣimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is an account of things beyond your knowledge that We reveal to you [Muhammad]: you were not present among them when they cast lots to see which of them should take charge of Mary, you were not present with them when they argued [about her].
verses.pickthall: This is of the tidings of things hidden. We reveal it unto thee (Muhammad). Thou wast not present with them when they threw their pens (to know) which of them should be the guardian of Mary, nor wast thou present with them when they quarrelled (thereupon).

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُ ٱسْمُهُ ٱلْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.en: [And mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allāh gives you good tidings of a word from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary - distinguished in this world and the Hereafter and among those brought near [to Allāh].
verses.tr: ʾidh qālati al-malāʾikahu yāmaryamu ʾinna Allāh yubashiruki bikalimahin mminhu āsmuhu al-masīḥu ʿīsā ābnu maryama wajīhan fā ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhirahi wamina al-muqarrabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The angels said, ‘Mary, God gives you news of a Word from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, who will be held in honour in this world and the next, who will be one of those brought near to God.
verses.pickthall: (And remember) when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah giveth thee glad tidings of a word from him, whose name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, illustrious in the world and the Hereafter, and one of those brought near (unto Allah).

verses.ar: وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: He will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous."
verses.tr: wayukallimu an-nāsa fā al-mahdi wakahlan wamina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He will speak to people in his infancyand in his adulthood. He will be one of the righteous.’
verses.pickthall: He will speak unto mankind in his cradle and in his manhood, and he is of the righteous.

verses.ar: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.en: She said, "My Lord, how will I have a child when no man has touched me?" [The angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He creates what He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is.
verses.tr: qālat rabbi ʾannā yakūnu lā waladun walam yamsasnā basharun ۖ qāla kadhāliki Allāh yakhluqu mā yashāʾu ۚ ʾidhā qaḍā ʾamran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu
verses.abdelhaleem: She said, ‘My Lord, how can I have a son when no man has touched me?’ [The angel] said, ‘This is how God creates what He will: when He has ordained something, He only says, “Be”, and it is.
verses.pickthall: She said: My Lord! How can I have a child when no mortal hath touched me? He said: So (it will be). Allah createth what He will. If He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.

verses.ar: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ
verses.en: And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel
verses.tr: wayuʿallimuhu al-kitāba wa-l-ḥikmaha wa-at-tawrāha wa-l-ʾinjīla
verses.abdelhaleem: He will teach him the Scripture and wisdom, the Torah and the Gospel,
verses.pickthall: And He will teach him the Scripture and wisdom, and the Torah and the Gospel,

verses.ar: وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنِّى قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ أَنِّىٓ أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And [make him] a messenger to the Children of Israel, [who will say], 'Indeed I have come to you with a sign from your Lord in that I design for you from clay [that which is] like the form of a bird, then I breathe into it and it becomes a bird by permission of Allāh. And I cure the blind [from birth] and the leper, and I give life to the dead - by permission of Allāh. And I inform you of what you eat and what you store in your houses. Indeed in that is a sign for you, if you are believers.
verses.tr: warasūlan ʾilā banā ʾisrāʾīla ʾannā qad jiʾtukum bāyahin mmin rrabbikum ۖ ʾannā ʾakhluqu lakum mmina aṭ-ṭīni kahayhi aṭ-ṭayri fa-anfukhu fīhi fayakūnu ṭayranā biʾidhni Allāh ۖ wa-ubriʾu al-ʾakmaha wa-l-ʾabraṣa wa-uḥāi al-mawtā biʾidhni Allāh ۖ wa-unabbiʾukum bimā taʾkulūna wamā taddakhirūna fā buyūtikum ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan llakum ʾin kuntum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He will send him as a messenger to the Children of Israel: “I have come to you with a sign from your Lord: I will make the shape of a bird for you out of clay, then breathe into it and, with God’s permission, it will become a real bird; I will heal the blind and the leper, and bring the dead back to life with God’s permission; I will tell you what you may eat and what you may store up in your houses. There truly is a sign for you in this, if you are believers.
verses.pickthall: And will make him a messenger unto the Children of Israel, (saying): Lo! I come unto you with a sign from your Lord. Lo! I fashion for you out of clay the likeness of a bird, and I breathe into it and it is a bird, by Allah's leave. I heal him who was born blind, and the leper, and I raise the dead, by Allah's leave. And I announce unto you what ye eat and what ye store up in your houses. Lo! herein verily is a portent for you, if ye are to be believers.

verses.ar: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَجِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: And [I have come] confirming what was before me of the Torah and to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you. And I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, so fear Allāh and obey me.
verses.tr: wamuṣaddiqan llimā bayna yadāa mina at-tawrāhi waliʾuḥilla lakum baʿḍa adh-dhā ḥurrima ʿalaykum ۚ wajiʾtukum bāyahin mmin rrabbikum fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: I have come to confirm the truth of the Torah which preceded me, and to make some things lawful to you which used to be forbidden. I have come to you with a sign from your Lord. Be mindful of God, obey me:
verses.pickthall: And (I come) confirming that which was before me of the Torah, and to make lawful some of that which was forbidden unto you. I come unto you with a sign from your Lord, so keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۗ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is the straight path.'"
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh rabbā warabbukum fāʿbudūhu ۗ hādhā ṣirāṭun mmustaqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: God is my Lord and your Lord, so serve Him- that is a straight path.”’
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path.

verses.ar: ۞ فَلَمَّآ أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: But when Jesus felt [persistence in] disbelief from them, he said, "Who are my supporters for [the cause of] Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters for Allāh. We have believed in Allāh and testify that we are Muslims [submitting to Him].
verses.tr: ۞ falammā ʾaḥassa ʿīsā minhumu al-kufra qāla man ʾanṣārā ʾilā Allāh ۖ qāla al-ḥawāriyyūna naḥnu ʾanṣāru Allāh āmannā billāh wāshhad biʾannā muslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When Jesus realized they [still] did not believe, he said, ‘Who will help me in God’s cause?’ The disciples said, ‘We will be God’s helpers; we believe in God- witness our devotion to Him.
verses.pickthall: But when Jesus became conscious of their disbelief, he cried: Who will be my helpers in the cause of Allah? The disciples said: We will be Allah's helpers. We believe in Allah, and bear thou witness that we have surrendered (unto Him).

verses.ar: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
verses.en: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger [i.e., Jesus], so register us among the witnesses [to truth]."
verses.tr: rabbanā āmannā bimā ʾanzalta wāttabaʿnā ar-rasūla fāktubnā maʿa ash-shāhidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord, we believe in what You have revealed and we follow the messenger: record us among those who bear witness [to the Truth].’
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! We believe in that which Thou hast revealed and we follow him whom Thou hast sent. Enrol us among those who witness (to the truth).

verses.ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَـٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: And they [i.e., the disbelievers] planned, but Allāh planned. And Allāh is the best of planners.
verses.tr: wamakarūā wamakara Allāh ۖ wallāh khayru al-mākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The [disbelievers] schemed but God also schemed; God is the Best of Schemers.
verses.pickthall: And they (the disbelievers) schemed, and Allah schemed (against them): and Allah is the best of schemers.

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَـٰعِيسَىٰٓ إِنِّى مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَىَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَجَاعِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: [Mention] when Allāh said, "O Jesus, indeed I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify [i.e., free] you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you [in submission to Allāh alone] superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that in which you used to differ.
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla Allāh yāʿīsā ʾinnā mutawaffīka warāfiʿuka ʾilāa wamuṭahhiruka mina adh-dhīna kafarūā wajāʿilu adh-dhīna āttabaʿūka fawqa adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾilā yawmi al-qiyāmahi ۖ thumma ʾilāa marjiʿukum fa-aḥkumu baynakum fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Jesus, I will take you back and raise you up to Me: I will purify you of the disbelievers. To the Day of Resurrection I will make those who follow you superior to those who disbelieved. Then you will all return to Me and I will judge between you regarding your differences.
verses.pickthall: (And remember) when Allah said: O Jesus! Lo! I am gathering thee and causing thee to ascend unto Me, and am cleansing thee of those who disbelieve and am setting those who follow thee above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then unto Me ye will (all) return, and I shall judge between you as to that wherein ye used to differ.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.en: And as for those who disbelieved, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers."
verses.tr: fa-ammā adh-dhīna kafarūā fa-uʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban shadīdan fā ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhirahi wamā lahum mmin nnāṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I will make the disbelievers suffer severely in this world and the next; no one will help them.’
verses.pickthall: As for those who disbelieve I shall chastise them with a heavy chastisement in the world and the Hereafter; and they will have no helpers.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: But as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, He will give them in full their rewards, and Allāh does not like the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: wa-ammā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti fayuwaffīhim ʾujūrahum ۗ wallāh lā yuḥibbu aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God will pay those who believe and do good deeds their reward in full; God does not love evildoers.
verses.pickthall: And as for those who believe and do good works, He will pay them their wages in full. Allah loveth not wrong-doers.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَٱلذِّكْرِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.en: This is what We recite to you, [O Muḥammad], of [Our] verses and the precise [and wise] message [i.e., the Qur’ān].
verses.tr: dhālika natlūhu ʿalayka mina al-āyāti wa-adh-dhikri al-ḥakīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: We relate to you [Muhammad] this revelation, a decisive statement.
verses.pickthall: This (which) We recite unto thee is a revelation and a wise reminder.

verses.ar: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَ ۖ خَلَقَهُۥ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.en: Indeed, the example of Jesus to Allāh is like that of Adam. He created him from dust; then He said to him, "Be," and he was.
verses.tr: ʾinna mathala ʿīsā ʿinda Allāh kamathali ādama ۖ khalaqahu min turābin thumma qāla lahu kun fayakūnu
verses.abdelhaleem: In God’s eyes Jesus is just like Adam: He created him from dust, said to him, ‘Be’, and he was.
verses.pickthall: Lo! the likeness of Jesus with Allah is as the likeness of Adam. He created him of dust, then He said unto him: Be! and he is.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
verses.en: The truth is from your Lord, so do not be among the doubters.
verses.tr: al-ḥaqqu min rrabbika falā takun mmina al-mumtarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is the truth from your Lord, so do not be one of those who doubt.
verses.pickthall: (This is) the truth from thy Lord (O Muhammad), so be not thou of those who waver.

verses.ar: فَمَنْ حَآجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ نَدْعُ أَبْنَآءَنَا وَأَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمْ وَأَنفُسَنَا وَأَنفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَل لَّعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: Then whoever argues with you about it after [this] knowledge has come to you - say, "Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then supplicate earnestly [together] and invoke the curse of Allāh upon the liars [among us]."
verses.tr: faman ḥājjaka fīhi min baʿdi mā jāʾaka mina al-ʿilmi faqul taʿālawā nadʿu ʾabnāʾanā wa-abnāʾakum wanisāʾanā wanisāʾakum wa-anfusanā wa-anfusakum thumma nabtahil fanajʿal llaʿnata Allāh ʿalā al-kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If anyone disputes this with you now that you have been given this knowledge, say, ‘Come, let us gather our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, and let us pray earnestly and invoke God’s rejection on those of us who are lying.
verses.pickthall: And whoso disputeth with thee concerning him, after the knowledge which hath come unto thee, say (unto him): Come! We will summon our sons and your sons, and our women and your women, and ourselves and yourselves, then we will pray humbly (to our Lord) and (solemnly) invoke the curse of Allah upon those who lie.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْقَصَصُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Indeed, this is the true narration. And there is no deity except Allāh. And indeed, Allāh is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā lahuwa al-qaṣaṣu al-ḥaqqu ۚ wamā min ʾilāhin ʾillā Allāh ۚ wa-inna Allāh lahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: This is the truth of the matter: there is no god but God; God is the Exalted, the Decider.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! This verily is the true narrative. There is no Allah save Allah, and lo! Allah, He verily is, is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: But if they turn away, then indeed - Allāh is Knowing of the corrupters.
verses.tr: fa-in tawallawā fa-inna Allāh ʿalīmun bi-l-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they turn away, [know that] God is well aware of anyone who causes corruption.
verses.pickthall: And if they turn away, then lo! Allah is Aware of (who are) the corrupters.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍ سَوَآءٍۭ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُولُوا۟ ٱشْهَدُوا۟ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you - that we will not worship except Allāh and not associate anything with Him and not take one another as lords instead of Allāh." But if they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]."
verses.tr: qul yāʾahla al-kitābi taʿālawā ʾilā kalimahin sawāʾin baynanā wabaynakum ʾallā naʿbuda ʾillā Allāh walā nushrika bihi shayā walā yattakhidha baʿḍunā baʿḍan ʾarbāban mmin dūni Allāh ۚ fa-in tawallawā faqūlūā āshhadūā biʾannā muslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘People of the Book, let us arrive at a statement that is common to us all: we worship God alone, we ascribe no partner to Him, and none of us takes others beside God as lords.’ If they turn away, say, ‘Witness our devotion to Him.’
verses.pickthall: Say: O People of the Scripture! Come to an agreement between us and you: that we shall worship none but Allah, and that we shall ascribe no partner unto Him, and that none of us shall take others for lords beside Allah. And if they turn away, then say: Bear witness that we are they who have surrendered (unto Him).

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَتِ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ وَٱلْإِنجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Abraham while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Then will you not reason?
verses.tr: yāʾahla al-kitābi lima tuḥājjūna fā ʾibrāhīma wamā ʾunzilati at-tawrāhu wa-l-ʾinjīlu ʾillā min baʿdihi ۚ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: People of the Book, why do you argue about Abraham when the Torah and the Gospels were not revealed until after his time? Do you not understand?
verses.pickthall: O People of the Scripture! Why will ye argue about Abraham, when the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed till after him? Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَـٰجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Here you are - those who have argued about that of which you have [some] knowledge, but why do you argue about that of which you have no knowledge? And Allāh knows, while you know not.
verses.tr: hāʾantum hāʾulāʾi ḥājajtum fīmā lakum bihi ʿilmun falima tuḥājjūna fīmā laysa lakum bihi ʿilmun ۚ wallāh yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You argue about some things of which you have some knowledge, but why do you argue about things of which you know nothing? God knows and you do not.
verses.pickthall: Lo! ye are those who argue about that whereof ye have some knowledge: Why then argue ye concerning that whereof ye have no knowledge? Allah knoweth. Ye know not.

verses.ar: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُّسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was one inclining toward truth, a Muslim [submitting to Allāh]. And he was not of the polytheists.
verses.tr: mā kāna ʾibrāhīmu yahūdiyyan walā naṣrāniyyan walākin kāna ḥanīfan mmusliman wamā kāna mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian. He was upright and devoted to God, never an idolater,
verses.pickthall: Abraham was not a Jew, nor yet a Christian; but he was an upright man who had surrendered (to Allah), and he was not of the idolaters.

verses.ar: إِنَّ أَوْلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَـٰذَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, the most worthy of Abraham among the people are those who followed him [in submission to Allāh] and this prophet [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] and those who believe [in his message]. And Allāh is the Ally of the believers.
verses.tr: ʾinna ʾawlā an-nāsi biʾibrāhīma lalladhīna āttabaʿūhu wahādhā an-nabāu wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā ۗ wallāh walāu al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and the people who are closest to him are those who truly follow his ways, this Prophet, and [true] believers- God is close to [true] believers.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those of mankind who have the best claim to Abraham are those who followed him, and this Prophet and those who believe (with him); and Allah is the Protecting Guardian of the believers.

verses.ar: وَدَّت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: A faction of the People of the Scripture wish they could mislead you. But they do not mislead except themselves, and they perceive [it] not.
verses.tr: waddat ṭṭāʾifahun mmin ʾahli al-kitābi law yuḍillūnakum wamā yuḍillūna ʾillā ʾanfusahum wamā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Some of the People of the Book would dearly love to lead you [believers] astray, but they only lead themselves astray, though they do not realize it.
verses.pickthall: A party of the People of the Scripture long to make you go astray; and they make none to go astray except themselves, but they perceive not.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
verses.en: O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allāh while you witness [to their truth]?
verses.tr: yāʾahla al-kitābi lima takfurūna bāyāti Allāh wa-antum tashhadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: People of the Book, why do you deny God’s revelations when you can see they are true?
verses.pickthall: O People of the Scripture! Why disbelieve ye in the revelations of Allah, when ye (yourselves) bear witness (to their truth)?

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: O People of the Scripture, why do you mix [i.e., confuse] the truth with falsehood and conceal the truth while you know [it]?
verses.tr: yāʾahla al-kitābi lima talbisūna al-ḥaqqa bi-l-bāṭili wataktumūna al-ḥaqqa wa-antum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: People of the Book, why do you mix truth with falsehood? Why do you hide the truth when you recognize it?
verses.pickthall: O People of the Scripture! Why confound ye truth with falsehood and knowingly conceal the truth?

verses.ar: وَقَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَجْهَ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱكْفُرُوٓا۟ ءَاخِرَهُۥ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And a faction of the People of the Scripture say [to each other], "Believe in that which was revealed to the believers at the beginning of the day and reject it at its end that perhaps they will return [i.e., abandon their religion],
verses.tr: waqālat ṭṭāʾifahun mmin ʾahli al-kitābi āminūā bi-adh-dhā ʾunzila ʿalā adh-dhīna āmanūā wajha an-nahāri wākfurūā ākhirahu laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Some of the People of the Book say, ‘At the beginning of the day, believe in what has been revealed to these believers [the Muslims], then at the end of the day reject it, so that they too may turn back,
verses.pickthall: And a party of the People of the Scripture say: Believe in that which hath been revealed unto those who believe at the opening of the day, and disbelieve at the end thereof, in order that they may return;

verses.ar: وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِمَن تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْهُدَىٰ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ أَن يُؤْتَىٰٓ أَحَدٌ مِّثْلَ مَآ أُوتِيتُمْ أَوْ يُحَآجُّوكُمْ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And do not trust except those who follow your religion." Say, "Indeed, the [true] guidance is the guidance of Allāh. [Do you fear] lest someone be given [knowledge] like you were given or that they would [thereby] argue with you before your Lord?" Say, "Indeed, [all] bounty is in the hand of Allāh - He grants it to whom He wills. And Allāh is all-Encompassing and Wise."
verses.tr: walā tuʾminūā ʾillā liman tabiʿa dīnakum qul ʾinna al-hudā hudā Allāh ʾan yuʾtā ʾaḥadun mmithla mā ʾūtītum ʾaw yuḥājjūkum ʿinda rabbikum ۗ qul ʾinna al-faḍla biyadi Allāh yuʾtīhi man yashāʾu ۗ wallāh wāsiʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: but do not sincerely believe in anyone unless he follows your own religion’- [Prophet], tell them, ‘True guidance is the guidance of God’- [they say], ‘Do not believe that anyone else could be given a revelation similar to what you were given, or that they could use it to argue against you in your Lord’s presence.’ [Prophet], tell them, ‘All grace is in God’s hands: He grants it to whoever He will- He is all embracing, all knowing-
verses.pickthall: And believe not save in one who followeth your religion - Say (O Muhammad): Lo! the guidance is Allah's Guidance - that anyone is given the like of that which was given unto you or that they may argue with you in the presence of their Lord. Say (O Muhammad): Lo! the bounty is in Allah's hand. He bestoweth it on whom He will. Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.

verses.ar: يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: He selects for His mercy whom He wills. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
verses.tr: yakhtaṣṣu biraḥmatihi man yashāʾu ۗ wallāh dhū al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: and He singles out for His mercy whoever He will. His grace is infinite.’
verses.pickthall: He selecteth for His mercy whom He will. Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

verses.ar: ۞ وَمِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنطَارٍ يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍ لَّا يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَآئِمًا ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ سَبِيلٌ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And among the People of the Scripture is he who, if you entrust him with a great amount [of wealth], he will return it to you. And among them is he who, if you entrust him with a [single] coin, he will not return it to you unless you are constantly standing over him [demanding it]. That is because they say, "There is no blame upon us concerning the unlearned." And they speak untruth about Allāh while they know [it].
verses.tr: ۞ wamin ʾahli al-kitābi man ʾin taʾmanhu biqinṭārin yuʾaddihi ʾilayka waminhum mman ʾin taʾmanhu bidīnārin llā yuʾaddihi ʾilayka ʾillā mā dumta ʿalayhi qāʾiman ۗ dhālika biʾannahum qālūā laysa ʿalaynā fā al-ʾummiyyina sabīlun wayaqūlūna ʿalā Allāh al-kadhiba wahum yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There are People of the Book who, if you [Prophet] entrust them with a heap of gold, will return it to you intact, but there are others of them who, if you entrust them with a single dinar, will not return it to you unless you keep standing over them, because they say, ‘We are under no obligation towards the gentiles.’ They tell a lie against God and they know it.
verses.pickthall: Among the People of the Scripture there is he who, if thou trust him with a weight of treasure, will return it to thee. And among them there is he who, if thou trust him with a piece of gold, will not return it to thee unless thou keep standing over him. That is because they say: We have no duty to the Gentiles. They speak a lie concerning Allah knowingly.

verses.ar: بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِعَهْدِهِۦ وَٱتَّقَىٰ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: But yes, whoever fulfills his commitment and fears Allāh - then indeed, Allāh loves those who fear Him.
verses.tr: balā man ʾawfā biʿahdihi wāttaqā fa-inna Allāh yuḥibbu al-muttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! God loves those who keep their pledges and are mindful of Him,
verses.pickthall: Nay, but (the chosen of Allah is) he who fulfilleth his pledge and wardeth off (evil); for lo! Allah loveth those who ward off (evil).

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَـٰقَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا يَنظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allāh and their [own] oaths for a small price will have no share in the Hereafter, and Allāh will not speak to them or look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them; and they will have a painful punishment.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yashtarūna biʿahdi Allāh wa-aymānihim thamanan qalīlan ʾūlāʾika lā khalāqa lahum fā al-ākhirahi walā yukallimuhumu Allāh walā yanẓuru ʾilayhim yawma al-qiyāmahi walā yuzakkīhim walahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: but those who sell out God’s covenant and their own oaths for a small price will have no share in the life to come. God will neither speak to them nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection- He will not cleanse them [of their sins]- agonizing torment awaits them.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's covenant and their oaths, they have no portion in the Hereafter. Allah will neither speak to them nor look upon them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He make them grow. Theirs will be a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ مِنْهُمْ لَفَرِيقًا يَلْوُۥنَ أَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِتَحْسَبُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, there is among them a party who alter the Scripture with their tongues so you may think it is from the Scripture, but it is not from the Scripture. And they say, "This is from Allāh," but it is not from Allāh. And they speak untruth about Allāh while they know.
verses.tr: wa-inna minhum lafarīqan yalwuna ʾalsinatahum bi-l-kitābi litaḥsabūhu mina al-kitābi wamā huwa mina al-kitābi wayaqūlūna huwa min ʿindi Allāh wamā huwa min ʿindi Allāh wayaqūlūna ʿalā Allāh al-kadhiba wahum yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There are some who twist the Scripture with their tongues to make you [people] think that what they say is part of the Scripture when it is not; they say it is from God when it is not; they attribute lies to God and they know it.
verses.pickthall: And lo! there is a party of them who distort the Scripture with their tongues, that ye may think that what they say is from the Scripture, when it is not from the Scripture. And they say: It is from Allah, when it is not from Allah; and they speak a lie concerning Allah knowingly.

verses.ar: مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُؤْتِيَهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ ثُمَّ يَقُولَ لِلنَّاسِ كُونُوا۟ عِبَادًا لِّى مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَـٰكِن كُونُوا۟ رَبَّـٰنِيِّـۧنَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَدْرُسُونَ
verses.en: It is not for a human [prophet] that Allāh should give him the Scripture and authority and prophethood and then he would say to the people, "Be servants to me rather than Allāh," but [instead, he would say], "Be pious scholars of the Lord because of what you have taught of the Scripture and because of what you have studied."
verses.tr: mā kāna libasharin ʾan yuʾtiyahu Allāh al-kitāba wa-l-ḥukma wa-an-nubuwwaha thumma yaqūla lilnnāsi kūnūā ʿibādan llā min dūni Allāh walākin kūnūā rabbāniyyina bimā kuntum tuʿallimūna al-kitāba wabimā kuntum tadrusūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No person to whom God had given the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood would ever say to people, ‘Be my servants, not God’s.’ [He would say], ‘You should be devoted to God because you have taught the Scripture and studied it closely.’
verses.pickthall: It is not (possible) for any human being unto whom Allah had given the Scripture and wisdom and the prophethood that he should afterwards have said unto mankind: Be slaves of me instead of Allah; but (what he said was): Be ye faithful servants of the Lord by virtue of your constant teaching of the Scripture and of your constant study thereof.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَأْمُرَكُمْ أَن تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ وَٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ أَرْبَابًا ۗ أَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: Nor could he order you to take the angels and prophets as lords. Would he order you to disbelief after you had been Muslims?
verses.tr: walā yaʾmurakum ʾan tattakhidhūā al-malāʾikaha wa-an-nabiyyina ʾarbāban ۗ ʾayaʾmurukum bi-l-kufri baʿda ʾidh ʾantum mmuslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He would never command you to take angels and prophets as lords. How could he command you to be disbelievers after you had devoted yourselves to God?
verses.pickthall: And he commanded you not that ye should take the angels and the prophets for lords. Would he command you to disbelieve after ye had surrendered (to Allah)?

verses.ar: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَـٰقَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ لَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُكُم مِّن كِتَـٰبٍ وَحِكْمَةٍ ثُمَّ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهِۦ وَلَتَنصُرُنَّهُۥ ۚ قَالَ ءَأَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَخَذْتُمْ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُمْ إِصْرِى ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَقْرَرْنَا ۚ قَالَ فَٱشْهَدُوا۟ وَأَنَا۠ مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
verses.en: And [recall, O People of the Scripture], when Allāh took the covenant of the prophets, [saying], "Whatever I give you of the Scripture and wisdom and then there comes to you a messenger confirming what is with you, you [must] believe in him and support him." [Allāh] said, "Have you acknowledged and taken upon that My commitment?" They said, "We have acknowledged it." He said, "Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses."
