verses.tr: wa-idh ʾakhadha Allāh mīthāqa an-nabiyyina lamā ātaytukum mmin kitābin waḥikmahin thumma jāʾakum rasūlun mmuṣaddiqun llimā maʿakum latuʾminunna bihi walatanṣurunnahu ۚ qāla ʾaʾaqrartum wa-akhadhtum ʿalā dhālikum ʾiṣrā ۖ qālūā ʾaqrarnā ۚ qāla fāshhadūā wa-anā maʿakum mmina ash-shāhidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God took a pledge from the prophets, saying, ‘If, after I have bestowed Scripture and wisdom upon you, a messenger comes confirming what you have been given, you must believe in him and support him. Do you affirm this and accept My pledge as binding on you?’ They said, ‘We do.’ He said, ‘Then bear witness and I too will bear witness.’
verses.pickthall: When Allah made (His) covenant with the prophets, (He said): Behold that which I have given you of the Scripture and knowledge. And afterward there will come unto you a messenger, confirming that which ye possess. Ye shall believe in him and ye shall help him. He said: Do ye agree, and will ye take up My burden (which I lay upon you) in this (matter)? They answered: We agree. He said: Then bear ye witness. I will be a witness with you.

verses.ar: فَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: And whoever turned away after that - they were the defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: faman tawallā baʿda dhālika fa-ūlāʾika humu al-fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who turn away after this are the ones who break pledges.
verses.pickthall: Then whosoever after this shall turn away: they will be miscreants.

verses.ar: أَفَغَيْرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ يَبْغُونَ وَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلَمَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَكَرْهًا وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: So is it other than the religion of Allāh they desire, while to Him have submitted [all] those within the heavens and earth, willingly or by compulsion, and to Him they will be returned?
verses.tr: ʾafaghayra dīni Allāh yabghūna walahu ʾaslama man fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ṭawʿan wakarhan wa-ʾilayhi yurjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they seek anything other than submission to God? Everyone in the heavens and earth submits to Him, willingly or unwillingly; they will all be returned to Him.
verses.pickthall: Seek they other than the religion of Allah, when unto Him submitteth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, and unto Him they will be returned.

verses.ar: قُلْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "We have believed in Allāh and in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Descendants [al-Asbāṭ], and in what was given to Moses and Jesus and to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [submitting] to Him."
verses.tr: qul āmannā billāh wamā ʾunzila ʿalaynā wamā ʾunzila ʿalā ʾibrāhīma wa-ismāʿīla wa-isḥāqa wayaʿqūba wa-l-ʾasbāṭi wamā ʾūtāa mūsā waʿīsā wa-an-nabiyyūna min rrabbihim lā nufarriqu bayna ʾaḥadin mminhum wanaḥnu lahu muslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Muhammad], ‘We [Muslims] believe in God and in what has been sent down to us and to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Tribes. We believe in what has been given to Moses, Jesus, and the prophets from their Lord. We do not make a distinction between any of the [prophets]. It is to Him that we devote ourselves.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): We believe in Allah and that which is revealed unto us and that which was revealed unto Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the tribes, and that which was vouchsafed unto Moses and Jesus and the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and unto Him we have surrendered.

verses.ar: وَمَن يَبْتَغِ غَيْرَ ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمِ دِينًا فَلَن يُقْبَلَ مِنْهُ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: And whoever desires other than Islām as religion - never will it be accepted from him, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers.
verses.tr: waman yabtaghi ghayra al-ʾislāmi dīnan falan yuqbala minhu wahuwa fā al-ākhirahi mina al-khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If anyone seeks a religion other than [islam] complete devotion to God, it will not be accepted from him: he will be one of the losers in the Hereafter.
verses.pickthall: And whoso seeketh as religion other than the Surrender (to Allah) it will not be accepted from him, and he will be a loser in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: كَيْفَ يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ قَوْمًا كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِهِمْ وَشَهِدُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلرَّسُولَ حَقٌّ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: How shall Allāh guide a people who disbelieved after their belief and had witnessed that the Messenger is true and clear signs had come to them? And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
verses.tr: kayfa yahdā Allāh qawman kafarūā baʿda ʾīmānihim washahidūā ʾanna ar-rasūla ḥaqqun wajāʾahumu al-bayyinātu ۚ wallāh lā yahdā al-qawma aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why would God guide people who deny the truth, after they have believed and acknowledged that the Messenger is true, and after they have been shown clear proof? God does not guide evildoers:
verses.pickthall: How shall Allah guide a people who disbelieved after their belief and (after) they bore witness that the messenger is true and after clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) had come unto them. And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ أَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: Those - their recompense will be that upon them is the curse of Allāh and the angels and the people, all together,
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika jazāʾuhum ʾanna ʿalayhim laʿnaha Allāh wa-l-malāʾikahi wa-an-nāsi ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: such people will be rewarded with rejection by God, by the angels, by all people,
verses.pickthall: As for such, their guerdon is that on them rests the curse of Allah and of angels and of men combined.

verses.ar: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.en: Abiding eternally therein. The punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved,
verses.tr: khālidīna fīhā lā yukhaffafu ʿanhumu al-ʿadhābu walā hum yunẓarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and so they will remain, with no relief or respite for their suffering.
verses.pickthall: They will abide therein. Their doom will not be lightened, neither will they be reprieved;

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Except for those who repent after that and correct themselves. For indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: ʾillā adh-dhīna tābūā min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥūā fa-inna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Not so those who afterwards repent and mend their ways- God is most forgiving and merciful-
verses.pickthall: Save those who afterward repent and do right. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِهِمْ ثُمَّ ٱزْدَادُوا۟ كُفْرًا لَّن تُقْبَلَ تَوْبَتُهُمْ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve [i.e., reject the message] after their belief and then increase in disbelief - never will their [claimed] repentance be accepted, and they are the ones astray.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā baʿda ʾīmānihim thumma āzdādūā kufran llan tuqbala tawbatuhum wa-ūlāʾika humu aḍ-ḍāllūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [although] the repentance of those who, having believed, then increase in their disbelief, will not be accepted. They are the ones who have gone [far] astray:
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve after their (profession of) belief, and afterward grow violent in disbelief: their repentance will not be accepted. And such are those who are astray.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَن يُقْبَلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِم مِّلْءُ ٱلْأَرْضِ ذَهَبًا وَلَوِ ٱفْتَدَىٰ بِهِۦٓ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve and die while they are disbelievers - never would the [whole] capacity of the earth in gold be accepted from one of them if he would [seek to] ransom himself with it. For those there will be a painful punishment, and they will have no helpers.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā wamātūā wahum kuffārun falan yuqbala min ʾaḥadihim mmilʾu al-ʾarḍi dhahaban walawi āftadā bihi ۗ ʾūlāʾika lahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun wamā lahum mmin nnāṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who disbelieve and die disbelievers will not be saved even if they offer enough gold to fill the entire earth. Agonizing torment is in store for them, and there will be no one to help them.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve, and die in disbelief, the (whole) earth full of gold would not be accepted from such an one if it were offered as a ransom (for his soul). Theirs will be a painful doom and they will have no helpers.

verses.ar: لَن تَنَالُوا۟ ٱلْبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of Allāh] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allāh is Knowing of it.
verses.tr: lan tanālūā al-birra ḥattā tunfiqūā mimmā tuḥibbūna ۚ wamā tunfiqūā min shāʾin fa-inna Allāh bihi ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: None of you [believers] will attain true piety unless you give out of what you cherish: whatever you give, God knows about it very well.
verses.pickthall: Ye will not attain unto piety until ye spend of that which ye love. And whatsoever ye spend, Allah is Aware thereof.

verses.ar: ۞ كُلُّ ٱلطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تُنَزَّلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ ۗ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ فَٱتْلُوهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel [i.e., Jacob] had made unlawful to himself before the Torah was revealed. Say, [O Muḥammad], "So bring the Torah and recite it, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: ۞ kullu aṭ-ṭaʿāmi kāna ḥillan llibanā ʾisrāʾīla ʾillā mā ḥarrama ʾisrāʾīlu ʿalā nafsihi min qabli ʾan tunazzala at-tawrāhu ۗ qul fa-tūā bi-at-tawrāhi fātlūhā ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Except for what Israel made unlawful for himself, all food was lawful to the Children of Israel before the Torah was revealed. Say, ‘Bring the Torah and read out [the relevant passage] if you are telling the truth.
verses.pickthall: All food was lawful unto the Children of Israel, save that which Israel forbade himself, (in days) before the Torah was revealed. Say: Produce the Torah and read it (unto us) if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: فَمَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: And whoever invents about Allāh untruth after that - then those are [truly] the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: famani āftarā ʿalā Allāh al-kadhiba min baʿdi dhālika fa-ūlāʾika humu aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who persist in making up lies and attributing them to God after this are the wrongdoers.’
verses.pickthall: And whoever shall invent a falsehood after that concerning Allah, such will be wrong-doers.

verses.ar: قُلْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ ۗ فَٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Allāh has told the truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of the polytheists."
verses.tr: qul ṣadaqa Allāh ۗ fāttabiʿūā millaha ʾibrāhīma ḥanīfan wamā kāna mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say, ‘God speaks the truth, so follow Abraham’s religion: he had true faith and he was never an idolater.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Allah speaketh truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, the upright. He was not of the idolaters.

verses.ar: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِى بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكًا وَهُدًى لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Bakkah [i.e., Makkah] - blessed and a guidance for the worlds.
verses.tr: ʾinna ʾawwala baytin wuḍiʿa lilnnāsi lalladhā bibakkaha mubārakan wahudanā llilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The first House [of worship] to be established for people was the one at Mecca. It is a blessed place; a source of guidance for all people;
verses.pickthall: Lo! the first Sanctuary appointed for mankind was that at Becca, a blessed place, a guidance to the peoples;

verses.ar: فِيهِ ءَايَـٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَـٰتٌ مَّقَامُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۖ وَمَن دَخَلَهُۥ كَانَ ءَامِنًا ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ حِجُّ ٱلْبَيْتِ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا ۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: In it are clear signs [such as] the standing place of Abraham. And whoever enters it [i.e., the Ḥaram] shall be safe. And [due] to Allāh from the people is a pilgrimage to the House - for whoever is able to find thereto a way. But whoever disbelieves [i.e., refuses] - then indeed, Allāh is free from need of the worlds.
verses.tr: fīhi āyātun bayyinātun mmaqāmu ʾibrāhīma ۖ waman dakhalahu kāna āminan ۗ wa-lillāh ʿalā an-nāsi ḥijju al-bayti mani āstaṭāʿa ʾilayhi sabīlan ۚ waman kafara fa-inna Allāh ghanāun ʿani al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: there are clear signs in it; it is the place where Abraham stood to pray; whoever enters it is safe. Pilgrimage to the House is a duty owed to God by people who are able to undertake it. Those who reject this [should know that] God has no need of anyone.
verses.pickthall: Wherein are plain memorials (of Allah's guidance); the place where Abraham stood up to pray; and whosoever entereth it is safe. And pilgrimage to the House is a duty unto Allah for mankind, for him who can find a way thither. As for him who disbelieveth, (let him know that) lo! Allah is Independent of (all) creatures.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allāh while Allāh is Witness over what you do?"
verses.tr: qul yāʾahla al-kitābi lima takfurūna bāyāti Allāh wallāh shahīdun ʿalā mā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘People of the Book, why do you reject God’s revelations? God witnesses everything you do.’
verses.pickthall: Say: O People of the Scripture! Why disbelieve ye in the revelations of Allah, when Allah (Himself) is Witness of what ye do?

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ تَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَأَنتُمْ شُهَدَآءُ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you avert from the way of Allāh those who believe, seeking to make it [seem] deviant, while you are witnesses [to the truth]? And Allāh is not unaware of what you do."
verses.tr: qul yāʾahla al-kitābi lima taṣuddūna ʿan sabīli Allāh man āmana tabghūnahā ʿiwajan wa-antum shuhadāʾu ۗ wamā Allāh bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘People of the Book, why do you turn the believers away from God’s path and try to make it crooked, when you yourselves [should be] witnesses to the [truth]? God is not heedless of anything you do.’
verses.pickthall: Say: O People of the Scripture! Why drive ye back believers from the way of Allah, seeking to make it crooked, when ye are witnesses (to Allah's guidance)? Allah is not unaware of what ye do.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تُطِيعُوا۟ فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يَرُدُّوكُم بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِكُمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, if you obey a party of those who were given the Scripture, they would turn you back, after your belief, [to being] unbelievers.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾin tuṭīʿūā farīqan mmina adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-kitāba yaruddūkum baʿda ʾīmānikum kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, some of those who were given the Scripture would turn you into disbelievers if you were to yield to them.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! If ye obey a party of those who have received the Scripture they will make you disbelievers after your belief.

verses.ar: وَكَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ وَأَنتُمْ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ وَفِيكُمْ رَسُولُهُۥ ۗ وَمَن يَعْتَصِم بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ هُدِىَ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: And how could you disbelieve while to you are being recited the verses of Allāh and among you is His Messenger? And whoever holds firmly to Allāh has [indeed] been guided to a straight path.
verses.tr: wakayfa takfurūna wa-antum tutlā ʿalaykum āyātu Allāh wafīkum rasūluhu ۗ waman yaʿtaṣim billāh faqad hudāa ʾilā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: How can you disbelieve when God’s revelations are being recited to you and His Messenger is living among you? Whoever holds fast to God will be guided to the straight path.
verses.pickthall: How can ye disbelieve, when it is ye unto whom Allah's revelations are recited, and His messenger is in your midst? He who holdeth fast to Allah, he indeed is guided unto a right path.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِۦ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, fear Allāh as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims [in submission to Him].
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā āttaqūā Allāh ḥaqqa tuqātihi walā tamūtunna ʾillā wa-antum mmuslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, be mindful of God, as is His due, and make sure you devote yourselves to Him, to your dying moment.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah with right observance, and die not save as those who have surrendered (unto Him)

verses.ar: وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِحَبْلِ ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا۟ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ كُنتُمْ أَعْدَآءً فَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم بِنِعْمَتِهِۦٓ إِخْوَٰنًا وَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَفَا حُفْرَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ فَأَنقَذَكُم مِّنْهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And hold firmly to the rope of Allāh all together and do not become divided. And remember the favor of Allāh upon you - when you were enemies and He brought your hearts together and you became, by His favor, brothers. And you were on the edge of a pit of the Fire, and He saved you from it. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses that you may be guided.
verses.tr: wāʿtaṣimūā biḥabli Allāh jamīʿan walā tafarraqūā ۚ wādhkurūā niʿmata Allāh ʿalaykum ʾidh kuntum ʾaʿdāʾan fa-ʾallafa bayna qulūbikum fa-aṣbaḥtum biniʿmatihi ʾikhwānan wakuntum ʿalā shafā ḥufrahin mmina an-nāri fa-anqadhakum mminhā ۗ kadhālika yubayyinu Allāh lakum āyātihi laʿallakum tahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Hold fast to God’s rope all together; do not split into factions. Remember God’s favour to you: you were enemies and then He brought your hearts together and you became brothers by His grace; you were about to fall into a pit of Fire and He saved you from it- in this way God makes His revelations clear to you so that you may be rightly guided.
verses.pickthall: And hold fast, all of you together, to the cable of Allah, and do not separate. And remember Allah's favour unto you: How ye were enemies and He made friendship between your hearts so that ye became as brothers by His grace; and (how) ye were upon the brink of an abyss of fire, and He did save you from it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations unto you, that haply ye may be guided,

verses.ar: وَلْتَكُن مِّنكُمْ أُمَّةٌ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْخَيْرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: And let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful.
verses.tr: waltakun mminkum ʾummahun yadʿūna ʾilā al-khayri wayaʾmurūna bi-l-maʿrūfi wayanhawna ʿani al-munkari ۚ wa-ūlāʾika humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Be a community that calls for what is good, urges what is right, and forbids what is wrong: those who do this are the successful ones.
verses.pickthall: And there may spring from you a nation who invite to goodness, and enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency. Such are they who are successful.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ تَفَرَّقُوا۟ وَٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And do not be like the ones who became divided and differed after the clear proofs had come to them. And those will have a great punishment
verses.tr: walā takūnūā ka-adh-dhīna tafarraqūā wākhtalafūā min baʿdi mā jāʾahumu al-bayyinātu ۚ wa-ūlāʾika lahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not be like those who, after they have been given clear revelation, split into factions and fall into disputes: a terrible punishment awaits such people.
verses.pickthall: And be ye not as those who separated and disputed after the clear proofs had come unto them. For such there is an awful doom,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوهٌ وَتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهٌ ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْوَدَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ أَكَفَرْتُم بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِكُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: On the Day [some] faces will turn white and [some] faces will turn black. As for those whose faces turn black, [to them it will be said], "Did you disbelieve [i.e., reject faith] after your belief? Then taste the punishment for what you used to reject."
verses.tr: yawma tabyaḍḍu wujūhun wataswaddu wujūhun ۚ fa-ammā adh-dhīna āswaddat wujūhuhum ʾakafartum baʿda ʾīmānikum fadhūqūā al-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when some faces brighten and others darken, it will be said to those with darkened faces, ‘How could you reject your faith after believing? Taste the torment for doing so,’
verses.pickthall: On the Day when (some) faces will be whitened and (some) faces will be blackened; and as for those whose faces have been blackened, it will be said unto them: Disbelieved ye after your (profession of) belief? Then taste the punishment for that ye disbelieved.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱبْيَضَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فَفِى رَحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: But as for those whose faces turn white, [they will be] within the mercy of Allāh. They will abide therein eternally.
verses.tr: wa-ammā adh-dhīna ābyaḍḍat wujūhuhum fafā raḥmahi Allāh hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but those with brightened faces will be in God’s grace, there to remain.
verses.pickthall: And as for those whose faces have been whitened, in the mercy of Allah they dwell for ever.

verses.ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: These are the verses of Allāh. We recite them to you, [O Muḥammad], in truth; and Allāh wants no injustice to the worlds [i.e., His creatures].
verses.tr: tilka āyātu Allāh natlūhā ʿalayka bi-l-ḥaqqi ۗ wamā Allāh yurīdu ẓulman llilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: These are God’s revelations: We recite them to you [Prophet] with the Truth. God does not will injustice for His creatures.
verses.pickthall: These are revelations of Allah. We recite them unto thee in truth. Allah willeth no injustice to (His) creatures.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.en: To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And to Allāh will [all] matters be returned.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۚ wa-ʾilā Allāh turjaʿu al-ʾumūru
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God; it is to Him that all things return.
verses.pickthall: Unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; and unto Allah all things are returned.

verses.ar: كُنتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ تَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَتَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۗ وَلَوْ ءَامَنَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُم ۚ مِّنْهُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: You are the best nation produced [as an example] for mankind. You enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and believe in Allāh. If only the People of the Scripture had believed, it would have been better for them. Among them are believers, but most of them are defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: kuntum khayra ʾummahin ʾukhrijat lilnnāsi taʾmurūna bi-l-maʿrūfi watanhawna ʿani al-munkari watuʾminūna billāh ۗ walaw āmana ʾahlu al-kitābi lakāna khayran llahum ۚ mminhumu al-muʾminūna wa-aktharuhumu al-fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Believers], you are the best community singled out for people: you order what is right, forbid what is wrong, and believe in God. If the People of the Book had also believed, it would have been better for them. For although some of them do believe, most of them are lawbreakers-
verses.pickthall: Ye are the best community that hath been raised up for mankind. Ye enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency; and ye believe in Allah. And if the People of the Scripture had believed it had been better for them. Some of them are believers; but most of them are evil-livers.

verses.ar: لَن يَضُرُّوكُمْ إِلَّآ أَذًى ۖ وَإِن يُقَـٰتِلُوكُمْ يُوَلُّوكُمُ ٱلْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: They will not harm you except for [some] annoyance. And if they fight you, they will show you their backs [i.e., retreat]; then they will not be aided.
verses.tr: lan yaḍurrūkum ʾillā ʾadhanā ۖ wa-in yuqātilūkum yuwallūkumu al-ʾadbāra thumma lā yunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they will not do you much harm: even if they come out to fight you, they will soon turn tail; they will get no help-
verses.pickthall: They will not harm you save a trifling hurt, and if they fight against you they will turn and flee. And afterward they will not be helped.

verses.ar: ضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ أَيْنَ مَا ثُقِفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا بِحَبْلٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَحَبْلٍ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَسْكَنَةُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلْأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
verses.en: They have been put under humiliation [by Allāh] wherever they are overtaken, except for a rope [i.e., covenant] from Allāh and a rope [i.e., treaty] from the people [i.e., the Muslims]. And they have drawn upon themselves anger from Allāh and have been put under destitution. That is because they disbelieved in [i.e., rejected] the verses of Allāh and killed the prophets without right. That is because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed.
verses.tr: ḍuribat ʿalayhimu adh-dhillahu ʾayna mā thuqifūā ʾillā biḥablin mmina Allāh waḥablin mmina an-nāsi wabāʾū bighaḍabin mmina Allāh waḍuribat ʿalayhimu al-maskanahu ۚ dhālika biʾannahum kānūā yakfurūna bāyāti Allāh wayaqtulūna al-ʾanbiyāʾa bighayri ḥaqqin ۚ dhālika bimā ʿaṣawā wwakānūā yaʿtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and, unless they hold fast to a lifeline from God and from mankind, they are overshadowed by vulnerability wherever they are found. They have drawn God’s wrath upon themselves. They are overshadowed by weakness, too, because they have persistently disbelieved in God’s revelation and killed prophets without any right, all because of their disobedience and boundless transgression.
verses.pickthall: Ignominy shall be their portion wheresoever they are found save (where they grasp) a rope from Allah and a rope from men. They have incurred anger from their Lord, and wretchedness is laid upon them. That is because they used to disbelieve the revelations of Allah, and slew the prophets wrongfully. That is because they were rebellious and used to transgress.

verses.ar: ۞ لَيْسُوا۟ سَوَآءً ۗ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أُمَّةٌ قَآئِمَةٌ يَتْلُونَ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَهُمْ يَسْجُدُونَ
verses.en: They are not [all] the same; among the People of the Scripture is a community standing [in obedience], reciting the verses of Allāh during periods of the night and prostrating [in prayer].
verses.tr: ۞ laysūā sawāʾan ۗ mmin ʾahli al-kitābi ʾummahun qāʾimahun yatlūna āyāti Allāh ānāʾa al-yli wahum yasjudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But they are not all alike. There are some among the People of the Book who are upright, who recite God’s revelations during the night, who bow down in worship,
verses.pickthall: They are not all alike. Of the People of the Scripture there is a staunch community who recite the revelations of Allah in the night season, falling prostrate (before Him).

verses.ar: يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: They believe in Allāh and the Last Day, and they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten to good deeds. And those are among the righteous.
verses.tr: yuʾminūna billāh wa-l-yawmi al-ākhiri wayaʾmurūna bi-l-maʿrūfi wayanhawna ʿani al-munkari wayusāriʿūna fā al-khayrāti wa-ūlāʾika mina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: who believe in God and the Last Day, who order what is right and forbid what is wrong, who are quick to do good deeds. These people are among the righteous
verses.pickthall: They believe in Allah and the Last Day, and enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency, and vie one with another in good works. These are of the righteous.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَفْعَلُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَن يُكْفَرُوهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And whatever good they do - never will it be denied them. And Allāh is Knowing of the righteous.
verses.tr: wamā yafʿalūā min khayrin falan yukfarūhu ۗ wallāh ʿalīmun bi-l-muttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will not be denied [the reward] for whatever good deeds they do: God knows exactly who is conscious of Him.
verses.pickthall: And whatever good they do, they will not be denied the meed thereof. Allah is Aware of those who ward off (evil).

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allāh at all, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā lan tughnāa ʿanhum ʾamwāluhum walā ʾawlāduhum mmina Allāh shayā ۖ wa-ūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri ۚ hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who disbelieve, neither their possessions nor their children will help them against God- they will be companions in the Fire, there to remain-
verses.pickthall: Lo! the riches and the progeny of those who disbelieve will not avail them aught against Allah; and such are rightful owners of the Fire. They will abide therein.

verses.ar: مَثَلُ مَا يُنفِقُونَ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيحٍ فِيهَا صِرٌّ أَصَابَتْ حَرْثَ قَوْمٍ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَأَهْلَكَتْهُ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَـٰكِنْ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: The example of what they spend in this worldly life is like that of a wind containing frost which strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves [i.e., sinned] and destroys it. And Allāh has not wronged them, but they wrong themselves.
verses.tr: mathalu mā yunfiqūna fā hādhihi al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā kamathali rīḥin fīhā ṣirrun ʾaṣābat ḥartha qawmin ẓalamūā ʾanfusahum fa-ahlakathu ۚ wamā ẓalamahumu Allāh walākin ʾanfusahum yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and whatever they give away in this life will be nullified: a frosty wind strikes and destroys the harvest of people who have wronged themselves. It was not God who wronged them; they wronged themselves.
verses.pickthall: The likeness of that which they spend in this life of the world is as the likeness of a biting, icy wind which smiteth the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves, and devastateth it. Allah wronged them not, but they do wrong themselves.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ بِطَانَةً مِّن دُونِكُمْ لَا يَأْلُونَكُمْ خَبَالًا وَدُّوا۟ مَا عَنِتُّمْ قَدْ بَدَتِ ٱلْبَغْضَآءُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَمَا تُخْفِى صُدُورُهُمْ أَكْبَرُ ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not take as intimates those other than yourselves [i.e., believers], for they will not spare you [any] ruin. They wish you would have hardship. Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, and what their breasts conceal is greater. We have certainly made clear to you the signs, if you will use reason.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā tattakhidhūā biṭānahan mmin dūnikum lā yaʾlūnakum khabālan waddūā mā ʿanittum qad badati al-baghḍāʾu min ʾafwāhihim wamā tukhfā ṣudūruhum ʾakbaru ۚ qad bayyannā lakumu al-āyāti ۖ ʾin kuntum taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, do not take for your intimates such outsiders as spare no effort to ruin you and want to see you suffer: their hatred is evident from their mouths, but what their hearts conceal is far worse. We have made Our revelations clear for you; will you not use your reason?
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Take not for intimates others than your own folk, who would spare no pains to ruin you; they love to hamper you. Hatred is revealed by (the utterance of) their mouths, but that which their breasts hide is greater. We have made plain for you the revelations if ye will understand.

verses.ar: هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِبُّونَكُمْ وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ كُلِّهِۦ وَإِذَا لَقُوكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ عَضُّوا۟ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْأَنَامِلَ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۚ قُلْ مُوتُوا۟ بِغَيْظِكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: Here you are loving them but they are not loving you, while you believe in the Scripture - all of it. And when they meet you, they say, "We believe." But when they are alone, they bite their fingertips at you in rage. Say, "Die in your rage. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts."
verses.tr: hāʾantum ʾūlāʾi tuḥibbūnahum walā yuḥibbūnakum watuʾminūna bi-l-kitābi kullihi wa-idhā laqūkum qālūā āmannā wa-idhā khalawā ʿaḍḍūā ʿalaykumu al-ʾanāmila mina al-ghayẓi ۚ qul mūtūā bighayẓikum ۗ ʾinna Allāh ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: This is how it is: here you are, you love them, but they do not love you; you believe in all the Scriptures and when they meet you, they say, ‘We believe,’ but when they are alone, they bite their fingertips in rage at you. [Prophet], say, ‘Die of rage [if you wish]!’ God knows exactly what is in everyone’s hearts.
verses.pickthall: Lo! ye are those who love them though they love you not, and ye believe in all the Scripture. When they fall in with you they say: We believe; but when they go apart they bite their finger-tips at you, for rage. Say: Perish in your rage! Lo! Allah is Aware of what is hidden in (your) breasts.

verses.ar: إِن تَمْسَسْكُمْ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ وَإِن تُصِبْكُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَفْرَحُوا۟ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تَصْبِرُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
verses.en: If good touches you, it distresses them; but if harm strikes you, they rejoice at it. And if you are patient and fear Allāh, their plot will not harm you at all. Indeed, Allāh is encompassing of what they do.
verses.tr: ʾin tamsaskum ḥasanahun tasuʾhum wa-in tuṣibkum sayyiʾahun yafraḥūā bihā ۖ wa-in taṣbirūā watattaqūā lā yaḍurrukum kayduhum shayā ۗ ʾinna Allāh bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭun
verses.abdelhaleem: They grieve at any good that befalls you [believers] and rejoice at your misfortunes. But if you are steadfast and conscious of God, their scheming will not harm you in the least: God encircles everything they do.
verses.pickthall: If a lucky chance befall you, it is evil unto them, and if disaster strike you they rejoice thereat. But if ye persevere and keep from evil their guile will never harm you. Lo! Allah is Surrounding what they do.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And [remember] when you, [O Muḥammad], left your family in the morning to post the believers at their stations for the battle [of Uḥud] - and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing -
verses.tr: wa-idh ghadawta min ʾahlika tubawwiʾu al-muʾminīna maqāʿida lilqitāli ۗ wallāh samīʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], remember when you left your home at dawn to assign battle positions to the believers: God hears and knows everything.
verses.pickthall: And when thou settedst forth at daybreak from thy housefolk to assign to the believers their positions for the battle, Allah was Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: إِذْ هَمَّت طَّآئِفَتَانِ مِنكُمْ أَن تَفْشَلَا وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا ۗ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: When two parties among you were about to lose courage, but Allāh was their ally; and upon Allāh the believers should rely.
verses.tr: ʾidh hammat ṭṭāʾifatāni minkum ʾan tafshalā wallāh waliyyuhumā ۗ waʿalā Allāh falyatawakkali al-muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when two groups of you were about to lose heart and God protected them- let the believers put their trust in God-
verses.pickthall: When two parties of you almost fell away, and Allah was their Protecting Friend. In Allah let believers put their trust.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَأَنتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And already had Allāh given you victory at [the battle of] Badr while you were weak [i.e., few in number]. Then fear Allāh; perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.tr: walaqad naṣarakumu Allāh bibadrin wa-antum ʾadhillahun ۖ fāttaqūā Allāh laʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God helped you at Badr when you were very weak. Be mindful of God, so that you may be grateful.
verses.pickthall: Allah had already given you the victory at Badr, when ye were contemptible. So observe your duty to Allah in order that ye may be thankful.

verses.ar: إِذْ تَقُولُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَلَن يَكْفِيَكُمْ أَن يُمِدَّكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِثَلَـٰثَةِ ءَالَـٰفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُنزَلِينَ
verses.en: [Remember] when you said to the believers, "Is it not sufficient for you that your Lord should reinforce you with three thousand angels sent down?
verses.tr: ʾidh taqūlu lilmuʾminīna ʾalan yakfiyakum ʾan yumiddakum rabbukum bithalāthahi ālāfin mmina al-malāʾikahi munzalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when you said to the believers, ‘Will you be satisfied if your Lord reinforces you by send-ing down three thousand angels?
verses.pickthall: When thou didst say unto the believers: Is it not sufficient for you that your Lord should support you with three thousand angels sent down (to your help)?

verses.ar: بَلَىٰٓ ۚ إِن تَصْبِرُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ وَيَأْتُوكُم مِّن فَوْرِهِمْ هَـٰذَا يُمْدِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِخَمْسَةِ ءَالَـٰفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ
verses.en: Yes, if you remain patient and conscious of Allāh and they [i.e., the enemy] come upon you [attacking] in rage, your Lord will reinforce you with five thousand angels having marks [of distinction]."
verses.tr: balā ۚ ʾin taṣbirūā watattaqūā wayaʾtūkum mmin fawrihim hādhā yumdidkum rabbukum bikhamsahi ālāfin mmina al-malāʾikahi musawwimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Well, if you are steadfast and mindful of God, your Lord will reinforce you with five thousand swooping angels if the enemy should suddenly attack you!’ and God arranged it so,
verses.pickthall: Nay, but if ye persevere, and keep from evil, and (the enemy) attack you suddenly, your Lord will help you with five thousand angels sweeping on.

verses.ar: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ لَكُمْ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُكُم بِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.en: And Allāh made it not except as [a sign of] good tidings for you and to reassure your hearts thereby. And victory is not except from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise -
verses.tr: wamā jaʿalahu Allāh ʾillā bushrā lakum walitaṭmaʾinna qulūbukum bihi ۗ wamā an-naṣru ʾillā min ʿindi Allāh al-ʿazīzi al-ḥakīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: as a message of hope for you [believers] to put your hearts at rest- help comes only from God, the Mighty, the Wise-
verses.pickthall: Allah ordained this only as a message of good cheer for you, and that thereby your hearts might be at rest - Victory cometh only from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise -

verses.ar: لِيَقْطَعَ طَرَفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَوْ يَكْبِتَهُمْ فَيَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَآئِبِينَ
verses.en: That He might cut down a section of the disbelievers or suppress them so that they turn back disappointed.
verses.tr: liyaqṭaʿa ṭarafan mmina adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾaw yakbitahum fayanqalibūā khāʾibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and in order to cut off the flanks of the disbelievers’ army and frustrate them, to make them withdraw in total defeat.
verses.pickthall: That He may cut off a part of those who disbelieve, or overwhelm them so that they retire, frustrated.

verses.ar: لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَوْ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: Not for you, [O Muḥammad, but for Allāh], is the decision whether He should [cut them down] or forgive them or punish them, for indeed, they are wrongdoers.
verses.tr: laysa laka mina al-ʾamri shāʾun ʾaw yatūba ʿalayhim ʾaw yuʿadhibahum fa-innahum ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whether God relents towards them or punishes them is not for you [Prophet] to decide: they are wrongdoers.
verses.pickthall: It is no concern at all of thee (Muhammad) whether He relent toward them or punish them; for they are evil-doers.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۚ yaghfiru liman yashāʾu wayuʿadhibu man yashāʾu ۚ wallāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God. He forgives whoever He will and punishes whoever He will: God is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: Unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. He forgiveth whom He will, and punisheth whom He will. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَأْكُلُوا۟ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓا۟ أَضْعَـٰفًا مُّضَـٰعَفَةً ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not consume usury, doubled and multiplied, but fear Allāh that you may be successful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā taʾkulūā ar-ribawā ʾaḍʿāfan mmuḍāʿafahan ۖ wāttaqūā Allāh laʿallakum tufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, do not consume usurious interest, doubled and redoubled. Be mindful of God so that you may prosper-
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Devour not usury, doubling and quadrupling (the sum lent). Observe your duty to Allah, that ye may be successful.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And fear the Fire, which has been prepared for the disbelievers.
verses.tr: wāttaqūā an-nāra at-tā ʾuʿiddat lilkāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: beware of the Fire prepared for those who ignore [Him]-
verses.pickthall: And ward off (from yourselves) the Fire prepared for disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.en: And obey Allāh and the Messenger that you may obtain mercy.
verses.tr: wa-aṭīʿūā Allāh wa-ar-rasūla laʿallakum turḥamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and obey God and the Prophet so that you may be given mercy.
verses.pickthall: And obey Allah and the messenger, that ye may find mercy.

verses.ar: ۞ وَسَارِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and a garden [i.e., Paradise] as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous
verses.tr: ۞ wasāriʿūā ʾilā maghfirahin mmin rrabbikum wajannahin ʿarḍuhā as-samāwātu wa-l-ʾarḍu ʾuʿiddat lilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Hurry towards your Lord’s forgiveness and a Garden as wide as the heavens and earth prepared for the righteous,
verses.pickthall: And vie one with another for forgiveness from your Lord, and for a paradise as wide as are the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who ward off (evil);

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِى ٱلسَّرَّآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَٱلْكَـٰظِمِينَ ٱلْغَيْظَ وَٱلْعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Who spend [in the cause of Allāh] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allāh loves the doers of good;
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yunfiqūna fā as-sarrāʾi wa-aḍ-ḍarrāʾi wa-l-kāẓimīna al-ghayẓa wa-l-ʿāfīna ʿani an-nāsi ۗ wallāh yuḥibbu al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: who give, both in prosperity and adversity, who restrain their anger and pardon people- God loves those who do good-
verses.pickthall: Those who spend (of that which Allah hath given them) in ease and in adversity, those who control their wrath and are forgiving toward mankind; Allah loveth the good;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا۟ فَـٰحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَٱسْتَغْفَرُوا۟ لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَن يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allāh and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allāh? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna ʾidhā faʿalūā fāḥishahan ʾaw ẓalamūā ʾanfusahum dhakarūā Allāh fāstaghfarūā lidhunūbihim waman yaghfiru adh-dhunūba ʾillā Allāh walam yuṣirrūā ʿalā mā faʿalūā wahum yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who remember God and implore forgiveness for their sins if they do something shameful or wrong themselves- who forgives sins but God?- and who never knowingly persist in doing wrong.
verses.pickthall: And those who, when they do an evil thing or wrong themselves, remember Allah and implore forgiveness for their sins - Who forgiveth sins save Allah only? - and will not knowingly repeat (the wrong) they did.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَـٰمِلِينَ
verses.en: Those - their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens beneath which rivers flow [in Paradise], wherein they will abide eternally; and excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika jazāʾuhum mmaghfirahun mmin rrabbihim wajannātun tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ۚ waniʿma ʾajru al-ʿāmilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The reward for such people is forgiveness from their Lord, and Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will remain. How excellent is the reward of those who labour!
verses.pickthall: The reward of such will be forgiveness from their Lord, and Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever - a bountiful reward for workers!

verses.ar: قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ سُنَنٌ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Similar situations [as yours] have passed on before you, so proceed throughout the earth and observe how was the end of those who denied.
verses.tr: qad khalat min qablikum sunanun fasīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fānẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God’s ways have operated before your time: travel through the land, and see what was the end of those who disbelieved.
verses.pickthall: Systems have passed away before you. Do but travel in the land and see the nature of the consequence for those who did deny (the messengers).

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا بَيَانٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَمَوْعِظَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: This [Qur’ān] is a clear statement to [all] the people and a guidance and instruction for those conscious of Allāh.
verses.tr: hādhā bayānun llilnnāsi wahudanā wamawʿiẓahun llilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a clear lesson to people, and guidance and teaching for those who are mindful of God.
verses.pickthall: This is a declaration for mankind, a guidance and an admonition unto those who ward off (evil)

verses.ar: وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
verses.tr: walā tahinūā walā taḥzanūā wa-antumu al-ʾaʿlawna ʾin kuntum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not lose heart or despair- if you are true believers you have the upper hand-
verses.pickthall: Faint not nor grieve, for ye will overcome them if ye are (indeed) believers.

verses.ar: إِن يَمْسَسْكُمْ قَرْحٌ فَقَدْ مَسَّ ٱلْقَوْمَ قَرْحٌ مِّثْلُهُۥ ۚ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنكُمْ شُهَدَآءَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: If a wound should touch you - there has already touched the [opposing] people a wound similar to it. And these days [of varying conditions] We alternate among the people so that Allāh may make evident those who believe and [may] take to Himself from among you martyrs - and Allāh does not like the wrongdoers -
verses.tr: ʾin yamsaskum qarḥun faqad massa al-qawma qarḥun mmithluhu ۚ watilka al-ʾayyāmu nudāwiluhā bayna an-nāsi waliyaʿlama Allāh adh-dhīna āmanūā wayattakhidha minkum shuhadāʾa ۗ wallāh lā yuḥibbu aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: if you have suffered a blow, they too have suffered one like it. We deal out such days among people in turn, for God to find out who truly believes, for Him to choose martyrs from among you- God does not love evildoers-
verses.pickthall: If ye have received a blow, the (disbelieving) people have received a blow the like thereof. These are (only) the vicissitudes which We cause to follow one another for mankind, to the end that Allah may know those who believe and may choose witnesses from among you; and Allah loveth not wrong-doers.

verses.ar: وَلِيُمَحِّصَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَيَمْحَقَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And that Allāh may purify the believers [through trials] and destroy the disbelievers.
verses.tr: waliyumaḥḥiṣa Allāh adh-dhīna āmanūā wayamḥaqa al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: for Him to cleanse those who believe and for Him to destroy the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: And that Allah may prove those who believe, and may blight the disbelievers.

verses.ar: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while Allāh has not yet made evident those of you who fight in His cause and made evident those who are steadfast?
verses.tr: ʾam ḥasibtum ʾan tadkhulūā al-jannaha walammā yaʿlami Allāh adh-dhīna jāhadūā minkum wayaʿlama aṣ-ṣābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Did you think you would enter the Garden without God first proving which of you would struggle for His cause and remain steadfast?
verses.pickthall: Or deemed ye that ye would enter paradise while yet Allah knoweth not those of you who really strive, nor knoweth those (of you) who are steadfast?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ كُنتُمْ تَمَنَّوْنَ ٱلْمَوْتَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَلْقَوْهُ فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُمُوهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: And you had certainly wished for death [i.e., martyrdom] before you encountered it, and you have [now] seen it [before you] while you were looking on.
verses.tr: walaqad kuntum tamannawna al-mawta min qabli ʾan talqawhu faqad raʾaytumūhu wa-antum tanẓurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Before you encountered death, you were hoping for it. Well, now you have seen it with your own eyes.
verses.pickthall: And verily ye used to wish for death before ye met it (in the field). Now ye have seen it with your eyes!

verses.ar: وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ ٱلرُّسُلُ ۚ أَفَإِي۟ن مَّاتَ أَوْ قُتِلَ ٱنقَلَبْتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَنقَلِبْ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ فَلَن يَضُرَّ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًٔا ۗ وَسَيَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: Muḥammad is not but a messenger. [Other] messengers have passed on before him. So if he was to die or be killed, would you turn back on your heels [to unbelief]? And he who turns back on his heels will never harm Allāh at all; but Allāh will reward the grateful.
verses.tr: wamā muḥammadun ʾillā rasūlun qad khalat min qablihi ar-rusulu ۚ ʾafaʾīn mmāta ʾaw qutila ānqalabtum ʿalā ʾaʿqābikum ۚ waman yanqalib ʿalā ʿaqibayhi falan yaḍurra Allāh shayā ۗ wasayajzā Allāh ash-shākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Muhammad is only a messenger before whom many messengers have been and gone. If he died or was killed, would you revert to your old ways? If anyone did so, he would not harm God in the least. God will reward the grateful.
verses.pickthall: Muhammad is but a messenger, messengers (the like of whom) have passed away before him. Will it be that, when he dieth or is slain, ye will turn back on your heels? He who turneth back on his heels doth no hurt to Allah, and Allah will reward the thankful.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَن تَمُوتَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ كِتَـٰبًا مُّؤَجَّلًا ۗ وَمَن يُرِدْ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَن يُرِدْ ثَوَابَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا ۚ وَسَنَجْزِى ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: And it is not [possible] for one to die except by permission of Allāh at a decree determined. And whoever desires the reward of this world - We will give him thereof; and whoever desires the reward of the Hereafter - We will give him thereof. And We will reward the grateful.
verses.tr: wamā kāna linafsin ʾan tamūta ʾillā biʾidhni Allāh kitāban mmuʾajjalan ۗ waman yurid thawāba ad-dunyā nuʾtihi minhā waman yurid thawāba al-ākhirahi nuʾtihi minhā ۚ wasanajzā ash-shākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: No soul may die except with God’s permission at a predestined time. If anyone strives for the rewards of this world, We will give him some of them. If anyone strives for the rewards of the Hereafter, We will give him some of them: We will reward the grateful.
verses.pickthall: No soul can ever die except by Allah's leave and at a term appointed. Whoso desireth the reward of the world, We bestow on him thereof; and whoso desireth the reward of the Hereafter, We bestow on him thereof. We shall reward the thankful.

verses.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن نَّبِىٍّ قَـٰتَلَ مَعَهُۥ رِبِّيُّونَ كَثِيرٌ فَمَا وَهَنُوا۟ لِمَآ أَصَابَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ضَعُفُوا۟ وَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: And how many a prophet [fought in battle and] with him fought many religious scholars. But they never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in the cause of Allāh, nor did they weaken or submit. And Allāh loves the steadfast.
verses.tr: wakaʾayyin mmin nnabāin qātala maʿahu ribbiyyūna kathīrun famā wahanūā limā ʾaṣābahum fā sabīli Allāh wamā ḍaʿufūā wamā āstakānūā ۗ wallāh yuḥibbu aṣ-ṣābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Many prophets have fought, with large bands of godly men alongside them who, in the face of their sufferings for God’s cause, did not lose heart or weaken or surrender: God loves those who are steadfast.
verses.pickthall: And with how many a prophet have there been a number of devoted men who fought (beside him). They quailed not for aught that befell them in the way of Allah, nor did they weaken, nor were they brought low. Allah loveth the steadfast.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِىٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And their words were not but that they said, "Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people."
verses.tr: wamā kāna qawlahum ʾillā ʾan qālūā rabbanā āghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa-isrāfanā fā ʾamrinā wathabbit ʾaqdāmanā wānṣurnā ʿalā al-qawmi al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: All they said was, ‘Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses. Make our feet firm, and give us help against the disbelievers,’
verses.pickthall: Their cry was only that they said: Our Lord! forgive us for our sins and wasted efforts, make our foothold sure, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.

verses.ar: فَـَٔاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَحُسْنَ ثَوَابِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: So Allāh gave them the reward of this world and the good reward of the Hereafter. And Allāh loves the doers of good.
verses.tr: fātāhumu Allāh thawāba ad-dunyā waḥusna thawābi al-ākhirahi ۗ wallāh yuḥibbu al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and so God gave them both the rewards of this world and the excellent rewards of the Hereafter: God loves those who do good.
verses.pickthall: So Allah gave them the reward of the world and the good reward of the Hereafter. Allah loveth those whose deeds are good.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَرُدُّوكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, if you obey those who disbelieve, they will turn you back on your heels, and you will [then] become losers.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾin tuṭīʿūā adh-dhīna kafarūā yaruddūkum ʿalā ʾaʿqābikum fatanqalibūā khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, if you obey the disbelievers, they will make you revert to your old ways and you will turn into losers.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! if ye obey those who disbelieve, they will make you turn back on your heels, and ye turn back as losers.

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلنَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.en: But Allāh is your protector, and He is the best of helpers.
verses.tr: bali Allāh mawlākum ۖ wahuwa khayru an-nāṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! It is God who is your protector: He is the best of helpers.
verses.pickthall: But Allah is your Protector, and He is the Best of Helpers.

verses.ar: سَنُلْقِى فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلرُّعْبَ بِمَآ أَشْرَكُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَـٰنًا ۖ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: We will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve for what they have associated with Allāh of which He had not sent down [any] authority. And their refuge will be the Fire, and wretched is the residence of the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: sanulqā fā qulūbi adh-dhīna kafarūā ar-ruʿba bimā ʾashrakūā billāh mā lam yunazzil bihi sulṭānan ۖ wamaʾwāhumu an-nāru ۚ wabiʾsa mathwā aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We will strike panic into the disbelievers’ hearts because they attribute partners to God although He has sent no authority for this: their shelter will be the Fire- how miserable is the home of the evildoers!
verses.pickthall: We shall cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve because they ascribe unto Allah partners, for which no warrant hath been revealed. Their habitation is the Fire, and hapless the abode of the wrong-doers.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَدَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥٓ إِذْ تَحُسُّونَهُم بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَشِلْتُمْ وَتَنَـٰزَعْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَعَصَيْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ أَرَىٰكُم مَّا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ مِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۚ ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ لِيَبْتَلِيَكُمْ ۖ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا عَنكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And Allāh had certainly fulfilled His promise to you when you were killing them [i.e., the enemy] by His permission until [the time] when you lost courage and fell to disputing about the order [given by the Prophet (ﷺ)] and disobeyed after He had shown you that which you love. Among you are some who desire this world, and among you are some who desire the Hereafter. Then He turned you back from them [defeated] that He might test you. And He has already forgiven you, and Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the believers.
verses.tr: walaqad ṣadaqakumu Allāh waʿdahu ʾidh taḥussūnahum biʾidhnihi ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā fashiltum watanāzaʿtum fā al-ʾamri waʿaṣaytum mmin baʿdi mā ʾarākum mmā tuḥibbūna ۚ minkum mman yurīdu ad-dunyā waminkum mman yurīdu al-ākhiraha ۚ thumma ṣarafakum ʿanhum liyabtaliyakum ۖ walaqad ʿafā ʿankum ۗ wallāh dhū faḍlin ʿalā al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God fulfilled His promise to you: you were routing them, with His permission, but then you faltered, disputed the order, and disobeyed, once He had brought you within sight of your goal- some of you desire the gains of this world and others desire the world to come- and then He prevented you from [defeating] them as a punishment. He has now forgiven you: God is most gracious to the believers.
verses.pickthall: Allah verily made good His promise unto you when ye routed them by His leave, until (the moment) when your courage failed you, and ye disagreed about the order and ye disobeyed, after He had shown you that for which ye long. Some of you desired the world, and some of you desired the Hereafter. Therefore He made you flee from them, that He might try you. Yet now He hath forgiven you. Allah is a Lord of Kindness to believers.

verses.ar: ۞ إِذْ تُصْعِدُونَ وَلَا تَلْوُۥنَ عَلَىٰٓ أَحَدٍ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ فِىٓ أُخْرَىٰكُمْ فَأَثَـٰبَكُمْ غَمًّۢا بِغَمٍّ لِّكَيْلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا مَآ أَصَـٰبَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: [Remember] when you [fled and] climbed [the mountain] without looking aside at anyone while the Messenger was calling you from behind. So Allāh repaid you with distress upon distress so you would not grieve for that which had escaped you [of victory and spoils of war] or [for] that which had befallen you [of injury and death]. And Allāh is [fully] Aware of what you do.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾidh tuṣʿidūna walā talwuna ʿalā ʾaḥadin wa-ar-rasūlu yadʿūkum fā ʾukhrākum fa-athābakum ghammanā bighammin llikaylā taḥzanūā ʿalā mā fātakum walā mā ʾaṣābakum ۗ wallāh khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You fled without looking back while the Messenger was calling out to you from behind, and God rewarded you with sorrow for sorrow. [He has now forgiven you] so that you may not grieve for what you missed or for what happened to you. God is well aware of everything you do.
verses.pickthall: When ye climbed (the hill) and paid no heed to anyone, while the messenger, in your rear, was calling you (to fight). Therefor He rewarded you grief for (his) grief, that (He might teach) you not to sorrow either for that which ye missed or for that which befell you. Allah is Informed of what ye do.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْغَمِّ أَمَنَةً نُّعَاسًا يَغْشَىٰ طَآئِفَةً مِّنكُمْ ۖ وَطَآئِفَةٌ قَدْ أَهَمَّتْهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ يَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ ظَنَّ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ ۖ يَقُولُونَ هَل لَّنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَمْرَ كُلَّهُۥ لِلَّهِ ۗ يُخْفُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم مَّا لَا يُبْدُونَ لَكَ ۖ يَقُولُونَ لَوْ كَانَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ مَّا قُتِلْنَا هَـٰهُنَا ۗ قُل لَّوْ كُنتُمْ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ لَبَرَزَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَتْلُ إِلَىٰ مَضَاجِعِهِمْ ۖ وَلِيَبْتَلِىَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَلِيُمَحِّصَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: Then after distress, He sent down upon you security [in the form of] drowsiness, overcoming a faction of you, while another faction worried about themselves, thinking of Allāh other than the truth - the thought of ignorance, saying, "Is there anything for us [to have done] in this matter?" Say, "Indeed, the matter belongs completely to Allāh." They conceal within themselves what they will not reveal to you. They say, "If there was anything we could have done in the matter, we [i.e., some of us] would not have been killed right here." Say, "Even if you had been inside your houses, those decreed to be killed would have come out to their death beds." [It was] so that Allāh might test what is in your breasts and purify what is in your hearts. And Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.tr: thumma ʾanzala ʿalaykum mmin baʿdi al-ghammi ʾamanahan nnuʿāsan yaghshā ṭāʾifahan mminkum ۖ waṭāʾifahun qad ʾahammathum ʾanfusuhum yaẓunnūna billāh ghayra al-ḥaqqi ẓanna al-jāhiliyyahi ۖ yaqūlūna hal llanā mina al-ʾamri min shāʾin ۗ qul ʾinna al-ʾamra kullahu lillāh ۗ yukhfūna fā ʾanfusihim mmā lā yubdūna laka ۖ yaqūlūna law kāna lanā mina al-ʾamri shāʾun mmā qutilnā hāhunā ۗ qul llaw kuntum fā buyūtikum labaraza adh-dhīna kutiba ʿalayhimu al-qatlu ʾilā maḍājiʿihim ۖ waliyabtalāa Allāh mā fā ṣudūrikum waliyumaḥḥiṣa mā fā qulūbikum ۗ wallāh ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: After sorrow, He caused calm to descend upon you, a sleep that overtook some of you. Another group, caring only for themselves, entertained false thoughts about God, thoughts more appropriate to pagan ignorance, and said, ‘Do we get a say in any of this?’ [Prophet], tell them, ‘Everything to do with this affair is in God’s hands.’ They conceal in their hearts things they will not reveal to you. They say, ‘If we had had our say in this, none of us would have been killed here.’ Tell them, ‘Even if you had resolved to stay at home, those who were destined to be killed would still have gone out to meet their deaths.’ God did this in order to test everything within you and in order to prove what is in your hearts. God knows your innermost thoughts very well.
verses.pickthall: Then, after grief, He sent down security for you. As slumber did it overcome a party of you, while (the other) party, who were anxious on their own account, thought wrongly of Allah, the thought of ignorance. They said: Have we any part in the cause? Say (O Muhammad): The cause belongeth wholly to Allah. They hide within themselves (a thought) which they reveal not unto thee, saying: Had we had any part in the cause we should not have been slain here. Say: Even though ye had been in your houses, those appointed to be slain would have gone forth to the places where they were to lie. (All this hath been) in order that Allah might try what is in your breasts and prove what is in your hearts. Allah is Aware of what is hidden in the breasts (of men).

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا۟ مِنكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ إِنَّمَا ٱسْتَزَلَّهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِبَعْضِ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۖ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those of you who turned back on the day the two armies met [at Uḥud] - it was Satan who caused them to slip because of some [blame] they had earned. But Allāh has already forgiven them. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Forbearing.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna tawallawā minkum yawma at-taqā al-jamʿāni ʾinnamā āstazallahumu ash-shayṭānu bibaʿḍi mā kasabūā ۖ walaqad ʿafā Allāh ʿanhum ۗ ʾinna Allāh ghafūrun ḥalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those of you who turned away on the day the two armies met in battle, it was Satan who caused them to slip, through some of their actions. God has now pardoned them: God is most forgiving and forbearing.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those of you who turned back on the day when the two hosts met, Satan alone it was who caused them to backslide, because of some of that which they have earned. Now Allah hath forgiven them. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Clement.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقَالُوا۟ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ إِذَا ضَرَبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ كَانُوا۟ غُزًّى لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ عِندَنَا مَا مَاتُوا۟ وَمَا قُتِلُوا۟ لِيَجْعَلَ ٱللَّهُ ذَٰلِكَ حَسْرَةً فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not be like those who disbelieved and said about their brothers when they traveled through the land or went out to fight, "If they had been with us, they would not have died or have been killed," so Allāh makes that [misconception] a regret within their hearts. And it is Allāh who gives life and causes death, and Allāh is Seeing of what you do.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā takūnūā ka-adh-dhīna kafarūā waqālūā liʾikhwānihim ʾidhā ḍarabūā fā al-ʾarḍi ʾaw kānūā ghuzzanā llaw kānūā ʿindanā mā mātūā wamā qutilūā liyajʿala Allāh dhālika ḥasrahan fā qulūbihim ۗ wallāh yuḥāi wayumītu ۗ wallāh bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, do not be like those who disbelieved and said of their brothers who went out on a journey or a raid, ‘If only they had stayed with us they would not have died or been killed,’ for God will make such thoughts a source of anguish in their hearts. It is God who gives life and death; God sees everything you do.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Be not as those who disbelieved and said of their brethren who went abroad in the land or were fighting in the field: If they had been (here) with us they would not have died or been killed: that Allah may make it anguish in their hearts. Allah giveth life and causeth death; and Allah is Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: وَلَئِن قُتِلْتُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ مُتُّمْ لَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
verses.en: And if you are killed in the cause of Allāh or die - then forgiveness from Allāh and mercy are better than whatever they accumulate [in this world].
verses.tr: walaʾin qutiltum fā sabīli Allāh ʾaw muttum lamaghfirahun mmina Allāh waraḥmahun khayrun mmimmā yajmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whether you are killed for God’s cause or die, God’s forgiveness and mercy are better than anything people amass.
verses.pickthall: And what though ye be slain in Allah's way or die therein? Surely pardon from Allah and mercy are better than all that they amass.

verses.ar: وَلَئِن مُّتُّمْ أَوْ قُتِلْتُمْ لَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: And whether you die or are killed, unto Allāh you will be gathered.
verses.tr: walaʾin mmuttum ʾaw qutiltum li-ʾilā Allāh tuḥsharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whether you die or are killed, it is to God that you will be gathered.
verses.pickthall: What though ye be slain or die, when unto Allah ye are gathered?

verses.ar: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كُنتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ ٱلْقَلْبِ لَٱنفَضُّوا۟ مِنْ حَوْلِكَ ۖ فَٱعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
verses.en: So by mercy from Allāh, [O Muḥammad], you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. And when you have decided, then rely upon Allāh. Indeed, Allāh loves those who rely [upon Him].
verses.tr: fabimā raḥmahin mmina Allāh linta lahum ۖ walaw kunta faẓẓan ghalīẓa al-qalbi lānfaḍḍūā min ḥawlika ۖ fāʿfu ʿanhum wāstaghfir lahum washāwirhum fā al-ʾamri ۖ fa-idhā ʿazamta fatawakkal ʿalā Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh yuḥibbu al-mutawakkilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: By an act of mercy from God, you [Prophet] were gentle in your dealings with them- had you been harsh, or hard-hearted, they would have dispersed and left you- so pardon them and ask forgiveness for them. Consult with them about matters, then, when you have decided on a course of action, put your trust in God: God loves those who put their trust in Him.
verses.pickthall: It was by the mercy of Allah that thou wast lenient with them (O Muhammad), for if thou hadst been stern and fierce of heart they would have dispersed from round about thee. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult with them upon the conduct of affairs. And when thou art resolved, then put thy trust in Allah. Lo! Allah loveth those who put their trust (in Him).

verses.ar: إِن يَنصُرْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَنصُرُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۗ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: If Allāh should aid you, no one can overcome you; but if He should forsake you, who is there that can aid you after Him? And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
verses.tr: ʾin yanṣurkumu Allāh falā ghāliba lakum ۖ wa-in yakhdhulkum faman dhā adh-dhā yanṣurukum mmin baʿdihi ۗ waʿalā Allāh falyatawakkali al-muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If God helps you [believers], no one can overcome you; if He forsakes you, who else can help you? Believers should put their trust in God.
verses.pickthall: If Allah is your helper none can overcome you, and if He withdraw His help from you, who is there who can help you after Him? In Allah let believers put their trust.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَبِىٍّ أَن يَغُلَّ ۚ وَمَن يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: It is not [attributable] to any prophet that he would act unfaithfully [in regard to war booty]. And whoever betrays, [taking unlawfully], will come with what he took on the Day of Resurrection. Then will every soul be [fully] compensated for what it earned, and they will not be wronged.
verses.tr: wamā kāna linabāin ʾan yaghulla ۚ waman yaghlul yaʾti bimā ghalla yawma al-qiyāmahi ۚ thumma tuwaffā kullu nafsin mmā kasabat wahum lā yuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is inconceivable that a prophet would ever dishonestly take something from the battle gains. Anyone who does so will carry it with him on the Day of Resurrection, when each soul will be fully repaid for what it has done: no one will be wronged.
verses.pickthall: It is not for any prophet to embezzle. Whoso embezzleth will bring what he embezzled with him on the Day of Resurrection. Then every soul will be paid in full what it hath earned; and they will not be wronged.

verses.ar: أَفَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ رِضْوَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَنۢ بَآءَ بِسَخَطٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: So is one who pursues the pleasure of Allāh like one who brings upon himself the anger of Allāh and whose refuge is Hell? And wretched is the destination.
verses.tr: ʾafamani āttabaʿa riḍwāna Allāh kaman bāʾa bisakhaṭin mmina Allāh wamaʾwāhu jahannamu ۚ wabiʾsa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Can the man who pursues God’s good pleasure be like the man who has brought God’s wrath upon himself and whose home will be Hell- a foul destination?
verses.pickthall: Is one who followeth the pleasure of Allah as one who hath earned condemnation from Allah, whose habitation is the Fire, a hapless journey's end?

verses.ar: هُمْ دَرَجَـٰتٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: They are [varying] degrees in the sight of Allāh, and Allāh is Seeing of whatever they do.
verses.tr: hum darajātun ʿinda Allāh ۗ wallāh baṣīrun bimā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They are in a different class in God’s eyes; God sees exactly what they do.
verses.pickthall: There are degrees (of grace and reprobation) with Allah, and Allah is Seer of what they do.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Certainly did Allāh confer [great] favor upon the believers when He sent among them a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and wisdom, although they had been before in manifest error.
verses.tr: laqad manna Allāh ʿalā al-muʾminīna ʾidh baʿatha fīhim rasūlan mmin ʾanfusihim yatlūā ʿalayhim āyātihi wayuzakkīhim wayuʿallimuhumu al-kitāba wa-l-ḥikmaha wa-in kānūā min qablu lafā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: God has been truly gracious to the believers in sending them a Messenger from among their own, to recite His revelations to them, to make them grow in purity, and to teach them the Scripture and wisdom- before that they were clearly astray.
verses.pickthall: Allah verily hath shown grace to the believers by sending unto them a messenger of their own who reciteth unto them His revelations, and causeth them to grow, and teacheth them the Scripture and wisdom; although before (he came to them) they were in flagrant error.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمَّآ أَصَـٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَدْ أَصَبْتُم مِّثْلَيْهَا قُلْتُمْ أَنَّىٰ هَـٰذَا ۖ قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Why [is it that] when a [single] disaster struck you [on the day of Uḥud], although you had struck [the enemy in the battle of Badr] with one twice as great, you said, "From where is this?" Say, "It is from yourselves [i.e., due to your sin]." Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
verses.tr: ʾawalammā ʾaṣābatkum mmuṣībahun qad ʾaṣabtum mmithlayhā qultum ʾannā hādhā ۖ qul huwa min ʿindi ʾanfusikum ۗ ʾinna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Why do you [believers] say, when a calamity befalls you, even after you have inflicted twice as much damage [on your enemy], ‘How did this happen?’? [Prophet], say, ‘You brought it upon yourselves.’ God has power over everything:
verses.pickthall: And was it so, when a disaster smote you, though ye had smitten (them with a disaster) twice (as great), that ye said: How is this? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): It is from yourselves. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَصَـٰبَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And what struck you on the day the two armies met [at Uḥud] was by permission of Allāh that He might make evident the [true] believers
verses.tr: wamā ʾaṣābakum yawma at-taqā al-jamʿāni fabiʾidhni Allāh waliyaʿlama al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: what befell you on the day the two armies met in battle happened with God’s permission and in order for Him to see who were the true believers and who were the hypocrites who,
verses.pickthall: That which befell you, on the day when the two armies met, was by permission of Allah; that He might know the true believers;

verses.ar: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا۟ ۚ وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ قَـٰتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَوِ ٱدْفَعُوا۟ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ نَعْلَمُ قِتَالًا لَّٱتَّبَعْنَـٰكُمْ ۗ هُمْ لِلْكُفْرِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَقْرَبُ مِنْهُمْ لِلْإِيمَـٰنِ ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَكْتُمُونَ
verses.en: And that He might make evident those who are hypocrites. For it was said to them, "Come, fight in the way of Allāh or [at least] defend." They said, "If we had known [there would be] battle, we would have followed you." They were nearer to disbelief that day than to faith, saying with their mouths what was not in their hearts. And Allāh is most knowing of what they conceal -
verses.tr: waliyaʿlama adh-dhīna nāfaqūā ۚ waqīla lahum taʿālawā qātilūā fā sabīli Allāh ʾawi ādfaʿūā ۖ qālūā law naʿlamu qitālan llāttabaʿnākum ۗ hum lilkufri yawmaʾidhin ʾaqrabu minhum lilʾīmāni ۚ yaqūlūna biʾafwāhihim mmā laysa fā qulūbihim ۗ wallāh ʾaʿlamu bimā yaktumūna
