verses.pickthall: They thought no harm would come of it, so they were wilfully blind and deaf. And afterward Allah turned (in mercy) toward them. Now (even after that) are many of them wilfully blind and deaf. Allah is Seer of what they do.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
verses.en: They have certainly disbelieved who say, "Allāh is the Messiah, the son of Mary" while the Messiah has said, "O Children of Israel, worship Allāh, my Lord and your Lord." Indeed, he who associates others with Allāh - Allāh has forbidden him Paradise, and his refuge is the Fire. And there are not for the wrongdoers any helpers.
verses.tr: laqad kafara adh-dhīna qālūā ʾinna Allāh huwa al-masīḥu ābnu maryama ۖ waqāla al-masīḥu yābanā ʾisrāʾīla āʿbudūā Allāh rabbā warabbakum ۖ ʾinnahu man yushrik billāh faqad ḥarrama Allāh ʿalayhi al-jannaha wamaʾwāhu an-nāru ۖ wamā lilẓẓālimīna min ʾanṣārin
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who say, ‘God is the Messiah, son of Mary,’ have defied God. The Messiah himself said, ‘Children of Israel, worship God, my Lord and your Lord.’ If anyone associates others with God, God will forbid him from the Garden, and Hell will be his home. No one will help such evildoers.
verses.pickthall: They surely disbelieve who say: Lo! Allah is the Messiah, son of Mary. The Messiah (himself) said: O Children of Israel, worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord. Lo! whoso ascribeth partners unto Allah, for him Allah hath forbidden paradise. His abode is the Fire. For evil-doers there will be no helpers.

verses.ar: لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ثَالِثُ ثَلَـٰثَةٍ ۘ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّآ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۚ وَإِن لَّمْ يَنتَهُوا۟ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَيَمَسَّنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: They have certainly disbelieved who say, "Allāh is the third of three." And there is no god except one God. And if they do not desist from what they are saying, there will surely afflict the disbelievers among them a painful punishment.
verses.tr: llaqad kafara adh-dhīna qālūā ʾinna Allāh thālithu thalāthahin ۘ wamā min ʾilāhin ʾillā ʾilāhun wāḥidun ۚ wa-in llam yantahūā ʿammā yaqūlūna layamassanna adh-dhīna kafarūā minhum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those people who say that God is the third of three are defying [the truth]: there is only One God. If they persist in what they are saying, a painful punishment will afflict those of them who persist.
verses.pickthall: They surely disbelieve who say: Lo! Allah is the third of three; when there is no Allah save the One Allah. If they desist not from so saying a painful doom will fall on those of them who disbelieve.

verses.ar: أَفَلَا يَتُوبُونَ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: So will they not repent to Allāh and seek His forgiveness? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: ʾafalā yatūbūna ʾilā Allāh wayastaghfirūnahu ۚ wallāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Why do they not turn to God and ask His forgiveness, when God is most forgiving, most merciful?
verses.pickthall: Will they not rather turn unto Allah and seek forgiveness of Him? For Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: مَّا ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَأُمُّهُۥ صِدِّيقَةٌ ۖ كَانَا يَأْكُلَانِ ٱلطَّعَامَ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُبَيِّنُ لَهُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرْ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.en: The Messiah, son of Mary, was not but a messenger; [other] messengers have passed on before him. And his mother was a supporter of truth. They both used to eat food. Look how We make clear to them the signs; then look how they are deluded.
verses.tr: mmā al-masīḥu ābnu maryama ʾillā rasūlun qad khalat min qablihi ar-rusulu wa-ummuhu ṣiddīqahun ۖ kānā yaʾkulāni aṭ-ṭaʿāma ۗ ānẓur kayfa nubayyinu lahumu al-āyāti thumma ānẓur ʾannā yuʾfakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Messiah, son of Mary, was only a messenger; other messengers had come and gone before him; his mother was a virtuous woman; both ate food [like other mortals]. See how clear We make these signs for them; see how deluded they are.
verses.pickthall: The Messiah, son of Mary, was no other than a messenger, messengers (the like of whom) had passed away before him. And his mother was a saintly woman. And they both used to eat (earthly) food. See how We make the revelations clear for them, and see how they are turned away!

verses.ar: قُلْ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: Say, "Do you worship besides Allāh that which holds for you no [power of] harm or benefit while it is Allāh who is the Hearing, the Knowing?"
verses.tr: qul ʾataʿbudūna min dūni Allāh mā lā yamliku lakum ḍarran walā nafʿan ۚ wallāh huwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘How can you worship something other than God, that has no power to do you harm or good? God alone is the All Hearing and All Knowing.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Serve ye in place of Allah that which possesseth for you neither hurt nor use? Allah it is Who is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا تَغْلُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَ قَوْمٍ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ وَأَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا وَضَلُّوا۟ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
verses.en: Say, "O People of the Scripture, do not exceed limits in your religion beyond the truth and do not follow the inclinations of a people who had gone astray before and misled many and have strayed from the soundness of the way."
verses.tr: qul yāʾahla al-kitābi lā taghlūā fā dīnikum ghayra al-ḥaqqi walā tattabiʿūā ʾahwāʾa qawmin qad ḍallūā min qablu wa-aḍallūā kathīran waḍallūā ʿan sawāʾi as-sabīli
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘People of the Book, do not overstep the bounds of truth in your religion and do not follow the whims of those who went astray before you- they led many others astray and themselves continue to stray from the even path.’
verses.pickthall: Say: O People of the Scripture! Stress not in your religion other than the truth, and follow not the vain desires of folk who erred of old and led many astray, and erred from a plain road.

verses.ar: لُعِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ لِسَانِ دَاوُۥدَ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
verses.en: Cursed were those who disbelieved among the Children of Israel by the tongue of David and of Jesus, the son of Mary. That was because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed.
verses.tr: luʿina adh-dhīna kafarūā min banā ʾisrāʾīla ʿalā lisāni dāwuda waʿīsā ābni maryama ۚ dhālika bimā ʿaṣawā wwakānūā yaʿtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those Children of Israel who defied [God] were rejected through the words of David, and Jesus, son of Mary, because they disobeyed, they persistently overstepped the limits,
verses.pickthall: Those of the Children of Israel who went astray were cursed by the tongue of David, and of Jesus, son of Mary. That was because they rebelled and used to transgress.

verses.ar: كَانُوا۟ لَا يَتَنَاهَوْنَ عَن مُّنكَرٍ فَعَلُوهُ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: They used not to prevent one another from wrongdoing that they did. How wretched was that which they were doing.
verses.tr: kānūā lā yatanāhawna ʿan mmunkarin faʿalūhu ۚ labiʾsa mā kānūā yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they did not forbid each other to do wrong. How vile their deeds were!
verses.pickthall: They restrained not one another from the wickedness they did. Verily evil was that they used to do!

verses.ar: تَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لَهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ أَن سَخِطَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَفِى ٱلْعَذَابِ هُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: You see many of them becoming allies of those who disbelieved [i.e., the polytheists]. How wretched is that which they have put forth for themselves in that Allāh has become angry with them, and in the punishment they will abide eternally.
verses.tr: tarā kathīran mminhum yatawallawna adh-dhīna kafarūā ۚ labiʾsa mā qaddamat lahum ʾanfusuhum ʾan sakhiṭa Allāh ʿalayhim wafā al-ʿadhābi hum khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You [Prophet] see many of them allying themselves with the disbelievers. How terrible is what their souls have stored up for them: God is angry with them and they will remain tormented.
verses.pickthall: Thou seest many of them making friends with those who disbelieve. Surely ill for them is that which they themselves send on before them: that Allah will be wroth with them and in the doom they will abide.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلنَّبِىِّ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَا ٱتَّخَذُوهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: And if they had believed in Allāh and the Prophet and in what was revealed to him, they would not have taken them as allies; but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: walaw kānūā yuʾminūna billāh wa-an-nabāi wamā ʾunzila ʾilayhi mā āttakhadhūhum ʾawliyāʾa walākinna kathīran mminhum fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they had believed in God, in the Prophet, and in what was sent down to him, they would never have allied themselves with the disbelievers, but most of them are rebels.
verses.pickthall: If they believed in Allah and the Prophet and that which is revealed unto him, they would not choose them for their friends. But many of them are of evil conduct.

verses.ar: ۞ لَتَجِدَنَّ أَشَدَّ ٱلنَّاسِ عَدَٰوَةً لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ ۖ وَلَتَجِدَنَّ أَقْرَبَهُم مَّوَدَّةً لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا نَصَـٰرَىٰ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ مِنْهُمْ قِسِّيسِينَ وَرُهْبَانًا وَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.en: You will surely find the most intense of the people in animosity toward the believers [to be] the Jews and those who associate others with Allāh; and you will find the nearest of them in affection to the believers those who say, "We are Christians." That is because among them are priests and monks and because they are not arrogant.
verses.tr: ۞ latajidanna ʾashadda an-nāsi ʿadāwahan llilladhīna āmanūā al-yahūda wa-adh-dhīna ʾashrakūā ۖ walatajidanna ʾaqrabahum mmawaddahan llilladhīna āmanūā adh-dhīna qālūā ʾinnā naṣārā ۚ dhālika biʾanna minhum qissīsīna waruhbānan wa-annahum lā yastakbirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You [Prophet] are sure to find that the most hostile to the believers are the Jews and those who associate other deities with God; you are sure to find that the closest in affection towards the believers are those who say, ‘We are Christians,’ for there are among them people devoted to learning and ascetics. These people are not given to arrogance,
verses.pickthall: Thou wilt find the most vehement of mankind in hostility to those who believe (to be) the Jews and the idolaters. And thou wilt find the nearest of them in affection to those who believe (to be) those who say: Lo! We are Christians. That is because there are among them priests and monks, and because they are not proud.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ تَرَىٰٓ أَعْيُنَهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعِ مِمَّا عَرَفُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
verses.en: And when they hear what has been revealed to the Messenger, you see their eyes overflowing with tears because of what they have recognized of the truth. They say, "Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.
verses.tr: wa-idhā samiʿūā mā ʾunzila ʾilā ar-rasūli tarā ʾaʿyunahum tafīḍu mina ad-damʿi mimmā ʿarafūā mina al-ḥaqqi ۖ yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fāktubnā maʿa ash-shāhidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and when they listen to what has been sent down to the Messenger, you will see their eyes overflowing with tears because they recognize the Truth [in it]. They say, ‘Our Lord, we believe, so count us amongst the witnesses.
verses.pickthall: When they listen to that which hath been revealed unto the messengers, thou seest their eyes overflow with tears because of their recognition of the Truth. They say: Our Lord, we believe. Inscribe us as among the witnesses.

verses.ar: وَمَا لَنَا لَا نُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَنَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And why should we not believe in Allāh and what has come to us of the truth? And we aspire that our Lord will admit us [to Paradise] with the righteous people."
verses.tr: wamā lanā lā nuʾminu billāh wamā jāʾanā mina al-ḥaqqi wanaṭmaʿu ʾan yudkhilanā rabbunā maʿa al-qawmi aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why should we not believe in God and in the Truth that has come down to us, when we long for our Lord to include us in the company of the righteous?’
verses.pickthall: How should we not believe in Allah and that which hath come unto us of the Truth. And (how should we not) hope that our Lord will bring us in along with righteous folk?

verses.ar: فَأَثَـٰبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا قَالُوا۟ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: So Allāh rewarded them for what they said with gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of doers of good.
verses.tr: fa-athābahumu Allāh bimā qālūā jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ۚ wadhālika jazāʾu al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: For saying this, God has rewarded them with Gardens graced with flowing streams, and there they will stay: that is the reward of those who do good.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath rewarded them for that their saying - Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of the good.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: But those who disbelieved and denied Our signs - they are the companions of Hellfire.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā wakadhabūā bāyātinā ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who reject the truth and deny Our messages will be the inhabitants of Hellfire.
verses.pickthall: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُحَرِّمُوا۟ طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not prohibit the good things which Allāh has made lawful to you and do not transgress. Indeed, Allāh does not like transgressors.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā tuḥarrimūā ṭayyibāti mā ʾaḥalla Allāh lakum walā taʿtadūā ۚ ʾinna Allāh lā yuḥibbu al-muʿtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, do not forbid the good things God has made lawful to you- do not exceed the limits: God does not love those who exceed the limits-
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Forbid not the good things which Allah hath made lawful for you, and transgress not, Lo! Allah loveth not transgressors.

verses.ar: وَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَـٰلًا طَيِّبًا ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنتُم بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And eat of what Allāh has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And fear Allāh, in whom you are believers.
verses.tr: wakulūā mimmā razaqakumu Allāh ḥalālan ṭayyiban ۚ wāttaqūā Allāh adh-dhā ʾantum bihi muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but eat the lawful and good things that God provides for you. Be mindful of God, in whom you believe.
verses.pickthall: Eat of that which Allah hath bestowed on you as food lawful and good, and keep your duty to Allah in Whom ye are believers.

verses.ar: لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِٱللَّغْوِ فِىٓ أَيْمَـٰنِكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا عَقَّدتُّمُ ٱلْأَيْمَـٰنَ ۖ فَكَفَّـٰرَتُهُۥٓ إِطْعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسَـٰكِينَ مِنْ أَوْسَطِ مَا تُطْعِمُونَ أَهْلِيكُمْ أَوْ كِسْوَتُهُمْ أَوْ تَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَـٰثَةِ أَيَّامٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ كَفَّـٰرَةُ أَيْمَـٰنِكُمْ إِذَا حَلَفْتُمْ ۚ وَٱحْفَظُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: Allāh will not impose blame upon you for what is meaningless in your oaths, but He will impose blame upon you for [breaking] what you intended of oaths. So its expiation is the feeding of ten needy people from the average of that which you feed your [own] families or clothing them or the freeing of a slave. But whoever cannot find [or afford it] - then a fast of three days [is required]. That is the expiation for oaths when you have sworn. But guard your oaths. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses [i.e., revealed law] that you may be grateful.
verses.tr: lā yuākhidhukumu Allāh bi-l-laghwi fā ʾaymānikum walākin yuākhidhukum bimā ʿaqqadttumu al-ʾaymāna ۖ fakaffāratuhu ʾiṭʿāmu ʿasharahi masākīna min ʾawsaṭi mā tuṭʿimūna ʾahlīkum ʾaw kiswatuhum ʾaw taḥrīru raqabahin ۖ faman llam yajid faṣiyāmu thalāthahi ʾayyāmin ۚ dhālika kaffārahu ʾaymānikum ʾidhā ḥalaftum ۚ wāḥfaẓūā ʾaymānakum ۚ kadhālika yubayyinu Allāh lakum āyātihi laʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God does not take you [to task] for what is thoughtless in your oaths, only for your binding oaths: the atonement for breaking an oath is to feed ten poor people with food equivalent to what you would normally give your own families, or to clothe them, or to set free a slave- if a person cannot find the means, he should fast for three days. This is the atonement for breaking your oaths- keep your oaths. In this way God makes clear His revelations to you, so that you may be thankful.
verses.pickthall: Allah will not take you to task for that which is unintentional in your oaths, but He will take you to task for the oaths which ye swear in earnest. The expiation thereof is the feeding of ten of the needy with the average of that wherewith ye feed your own folk, or the clothing of them, or the liberation of a slave, and for him who findeth not (the wherewithal to do so) then a three days' fast. This is the expiation of your oaths when ye have sworn; and keep your oaths. Thus Allah expoundeth unto you His revelations in order that ye may give thanks.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْخَمْرُ وَٱلْمَيْسِرُ وَٱلْأَنصَابُ وَٱلْأَزْلَـٰمُ رِجْسٌ مِّنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ فَٱجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, indeed, intoxicants, gambling, [sacrificing on] stone alters [to other than Allāh], and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan, so avoid it that you may be successful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾinnamā al-khamru wa-l-maysiru wa-l-ʾanṣābu wa-l-ʾazlāmu rijsun mmin ʿamali ash-shayṭāni fājtanibūhu laʿallakum tufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, intoxicants and gambling, idolatrous practices, and [divining with] arrows are repugnant acts- Satan’s doing- shun them so that you may prosper.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Strong drink and games of chance and idols and divining arrows are only an infamy of Satan's handiwork. Leave it aside in order that ye may succeed.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَن يُوقِعَ بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ فِى ٱلْخَمْرِ وَٱلْمَيْسِرِ وَيَصُدَّكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَنِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّنتَهُونَ
verses.en: Satan only wants to cause between you animosity and hatred through intoxicants and gambling and to avert you from the remembrance of Allāh and from prayer. So will you not desist?
verses.tr: ʾinnamā yurīdu ash-shayṭānu ʾan yūqiʿa baynakumu al-ʿadāwaha wa-l-baghḍāʾa fā al-khamri wa-l-maysiri wayaṣuddakum ʿan dhikri Allāh waʿani aṣ-ṣalawāhi ۖ fahal ʾantum mmuntahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: With intoxicants and gambling, Satan seeks only to incite enmity and hatred among you, and to stop you remembering God and prayer. Will you not give them up?
verses.pickthall: Satan seeketh only to cast among you enmity and hatred by means of strong drink and games of chance, and to turn you from remembrance of Allah and from (His) worship. Will ye then have done?

verses.ar: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَٱحْذَرُوا۟ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger and beware. And if you turn away - then know that upon Our Messenger is only [the responsibility for] clear notification.
verses.tr: wa-aṭīʿūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūā ar-rasūla wāḥdharūā ۚ fa-in tawallaytum fāʿlamūā ʾannamā ʿalā rasūlinā al-balāghu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: Obey God, obey the Messenger, and always be on your guard: if you pay no heed, bear in mind that the sole duty of Our Messenger is to deliver the message clearly.
verses.pickthall: Obey Allah and obey the messenger, and beware! But if ye turn away, then know that the duty of Our messenger is only plain conveyance (of the message).

verses.ar: لَيْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوٓا۟ إِذَا مَا ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّأَحْسَنُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: There is not upon those who believe and do righteousness [any] blame concerning what they have eaten [in the past] if they [now] fear Allāh and believe and do righteous deeds, and then fear Allāh and believe, and then fear Allāh and do good; and Allāh loves the doers of good.
verses.tr: laysa ʿalā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti junāḥun fīmā ṭaʿimūā ʾidhā mā āttaqawā wwaāmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti thumma āttaqawā wwaāmanūā thumma āttaqawā wwaʾaḥsanūā ۗ wallāh yuḥibbu al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who believe and do good deeds will not be blamed for what they may have consumed [in the past] as long as they are mindful of God, believe and do good deeds, then are mindful of God and believe, then are mindful of God and do good deeds: God loves those who do good deeds.
verses.pickthall: There shall be no sin (imputed) unto those who believe and do good works for what they may have eaten (in the past). So be mindful of your duty (to Allah), and believe, and do good works; and again: be mindful of your duty, and believe; and once again: be mindful of your duty, and do right. Allah loveth the good.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَيَبْلُوَنَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنَ ٱلصَّيْدِ تَنَالُهُۥٓ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَرِمَاحُكُمْ لِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَخَافُهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ فَمَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُۥ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, Allāh will surely test you through something of the game that your hands and spears [can] reach, that Allāh may make evident those who fear Him unseen. And whoever transgresses after that - for him is a painful punishment.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā layabluwannakumu Allāh bishāʾin mmina aṣ-ṣaydi tanāluhu ʾaydīkum warimāḥukum liyaʿlama Allāh man yakhāfuhu bi-l-ghaybi ۚ famani āʿtadā baʿda dhālika falahu ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, God is sure to test you with game within reach of your hands and spears, to find out who fears Him even though they cannot see Him: from now on, anyone who transgresses will have a painful punishment.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Allah will surely try you somewhat (in the matter) of the game which ye take with your hands and your spears, that Allah may know him who feareth Him in secret. Whoso transgresseth after this, for him there is a painful doom.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْدَ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ ۚ وَمَن قَتَلَهُۥ مِنكُم مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَآءٌ مِّثْلُ مَا قَتَلَ مِنَ ٱلنَّعَمِ يَحْكُمُ بِهِۦ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ هَدْيًۢا بَـٰلِغَ ٱلْكَعْبَةِ أَوْ كَفَّـٰرَةٌ طَعَامُ مَسَـٰكِينَ أَوْ عَدْلُ ذَٰلِكَ صِيَامًا لِّيَذُوقَ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِۦ ۗ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا سَلَفَ ۚ وَمَنْ عَادَ فَيَنتَقِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنْهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not kill game while you are in the state of iḥrām. And whoever of you kills it intentionally - the penalty is an equivalent from sacrificial animals to what he killed, as judged by two just men among you as an offering [to Allāh] delivered to the Kaʿbah, or an expiation: the feeding of needy people or the equivalent of that in fasting, that he may taste the consequence of his matter [i.e., deed]. Allāh has pardoned what is past; but whoever returns [to violation], then Allāh will take retribution from him. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā taqtulūā aṣ-ṣayda wa-antum ḥurumun ۚ waman qatalahu minkum mmutaʿammidan fajazāʾun mmithlu mā qatala mina an-naʿami yaḥkumu bihi dhawā ʿadlin mminkum hadyanā bāligha al-kaʿbahi ʾaw kaffārahun ṭaʿāmu masākīna ʾaw ʿadlu dhālika ṣiyāman lliyadhūqa wabāla ʾamrihi ۗ ʿafā Allāh ʿammā salafa ۚ waman ʿāda fayantaqimu Allāh minhu ۗ wallāh ʿazīzun dhū āntiqāmin
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, do not kill game while you are in the state of consecration [for pilgrimage]. If someone does so intentionally the penalty is an offering of a domestic animal brought to the Kaba, equivalent- as judged by two just men among you- to the one he has killed; alternatively, he may atone by feeding the needy or by fasting an equivalent number of days, so that he may taste the full gravity of his deed. God forgives what is past, but if anyone re-offends, God will exact the penalty from him: God is mighty, and capable of exacting the penalty.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Kill no wild game while ye are on the pilgrimage. Whoso of you killeth it of set purpose he shall pay its forfeit in the equivalent of that which he hath killed, of domestic animals, the judge to be two men among you known for justice, (the forfeit) to be brought as an offering to the Ka'bah; or, for expiation, he shall feed poor persons, or the equivalent thereof in fasting, that he may taste the evil consequences of his deed. Allah forgiveth whatever (of this kind) may have happened in the past, but whoso relapseth, Allah will take retribution from him. Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).

verses.ar: أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ صَيْدُ ٱلْبَحْرِ وَطَعَامُهُۥ مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِلسَّيَّارَةِ ۖ وَحُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَيْدُ ٱلْبَرِّ مَا دُمْتُمْ حُرُمًا ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: Lawful to you is game from the sea and its food as provision for you and the travelers, but forbidden to you is game from the land as long as you are in the state of iḥrām. And fear Allāh to whom you will be gathered.
verses.tr: ʾuḥilla lakum ṣaydu al-baḥri waṭaʿāmuhu matāʿan llakum walilssayyārahi ۖ waḥurrima ʿalaykum ṣaydu al-barri mā dumtum ḥuruman ۗ wāttaqūā Allāh adh-dhā ʾilayhi tuḥsharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is permitted for you to catch and eat seafood- an enjoyment for you and the traveller- but hunting game is forbidden while you are in the state of consecration [for pilgrimage]. Be mindful of God to whom you will be gathered.
verses.pickthall: To hunt and to eat the fish of the sea is made lawful for you, a provision for you and for seafarers; but to hunt on land is forbidden you so long as ye are on the pilgrimage. Be mindful of your duty to Allah, unto Whom ye will be gathered.

verses.ar: ۞ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَعْبَةَ ٱلْبَيْتَ ٱلْحَرَامَ قِيَـٰمًا لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّهْرَ ٱلْحَرَامَ وَٱلْهَدْىَ وَٱلْقَلَـٰٓئِدَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Allāh has made the Kaʿbah, the Sacred House, standing for the people and [has sanctified] the sacred months and the sacrificial animals and the garlands [by which they are identified]. That is so you may know that Allāh knows what is in the heavens and what is in the earth and that Allāh is Knowing of all things.
verses.tr: ۞ jaʿala Allāh al-kaʿbaha al-bayta al-ḥarāma qiyāman llilnnāsi wa-ash-shahra al-ḥarāma wa-l-hadāa wa-l-qalāʾida ۚ dhālika litaʿlamūā ʾanna Allāh yaʿlamu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi wa-anna Allāh bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: God has made the Ka'ba- the Sacred House- a means of support for people, and the Sacred Months, the animals for sacrifice and their garlands: all this. Know that God has knowledge of all that is in the heavens and earth and that He is fully aware of all things.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath appointed the Ka'bah, the Sacred House, a standard for mankind, and the Sacred Month and the offerings and the garlands. That is so that ye may know that Allah knoweth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and that Allah is Knower of all things.

verses.ar: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Know that Allāh is severe in penalty and that Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: āʿlamūā ʾanna Allāh shadīdu al-ʿiqābi wa-anna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Know too that God is severe in punishment yet most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: Know that Allah is severe in punishment, but that Allah (also) is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: مَّا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
verses.en: Not upon the Messenger is [responsibility] except [for] notification. And Allāh knows whatever you reveal and whatever you conceal.
verses.tr: mmā ʿalā ar-rasūli ʾillā al-balāghu ۗ wallāh yaʿlamu mā tubdūna wamā taktumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Messenger’s duty is only to deliver the message: God knows what you reveal and what you conceal.
verses.pickthall: The duty of the messenger is only to convey (the message). Allah knoweth what ye proclaim and what ye hide.

verses.ar: قُل لَّا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْخَبِيثُ وَٱلطَّيِّبُ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ كَثْرَةُ ٱلْخَبِيثِ ۚ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَـٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Not equal are the evil and the good, although the abundance of evil might impress you." So fear Allāh, O you of understanding, that you may be successful.
verses.tr: qul llā yastawā al-khabīthu wa-aṭ-ṭayyibu walaw ʾaʿjabaka kathrahu al-khabīthi ۚ fāttaqūā Allāh yāʾūlā al-ʾalbābi laʿallakum tufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Bad cannot be likened to good, though you may be dazzled by how abundant the bad is. Be mindful of God, people of understanding, so that you may prosper.’
verses.pickthall: Say: The evil and the good are not alike even though the plenty of the evil attract thee. So be mindful of your duty to Allah, O men of understanding, that ye may succeed.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْ أَشْيَآءَ إِن تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ وَإِن تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ عَنْهَا حِينَ يُنَزَّلُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهَا ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not ask about things which, if they are shown to you, will distress you. But if you ask about them while the Qur’ān is being revealed, they will be shown to you. Allāh has pardoned it [i.e., that which is past]; and Allāh is Forgiving and Forbearing.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā taslūā ʿan ʾashyāʾa ʾin tubda lakum tasuʾkum wa-in taslūā ʿanhā ḥīna yunazzalu al-qurānu tubda lakum ʿafā Allāh ʿanhā ۗ wallāh ghafūrun ḥalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, do not ask about matters which, if made known to you, might make things difficult for you- if you ask about them while the Quran is being revealed, they will be made known to you- for God has kept silent about them: God is most forgiving and forbearing.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Ask not of things which, if they were made unto you, would trouble you; but if ye ask of them when the Qur'an is being revealed, they will be made known unto you. Allah pardoneth this, for Allah is Forgiving, Clement.

verses.ar: قَدْ سَأَلَهَا قَوْمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحُوا۟ بِهَا كَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: A people asked such [questions] before you; then they became thereby disbelievers.
verses.tr: qad saʾalahā qawmun mmin qablikum thumma ʾaṣbaḥūā bihā kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Before you, some people asked about things, then ignored [the answers].
verses.pickthall: A folk before you asked (for such disclosures) and then disbelieved therein.

verses.ar: مَا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَحِيرَةٍ وَلَا سَآئِبَةٍ وَلَا وَصِيلَةٍ وَلَا حَامٍ ۙ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ ۖ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Allāh has not appointed [such innovations as] baḥīrah or sā’ibah or waṣīlah or ḥām. But those who disbelieve invent falsehood about Allāh, and most of them do not reason.
verses.tr: mā jaʿala Allāh min baḥīrahin walā sāʾibahin walā waṣīlahin walā ḥāmin ۙ walākinna adh-dhīna kafarūā yaftarūna ʿalā Allāh al-kadhiba ۖ wa-aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God did not institute the dedication of such things as bahira, saiba, wasila, or ham to idols; but the disbelievers invent lies about God. Most of them do not use reason:
verses.pickthall: Allah hath not appointed anything in the nature of a Bahirah or a Sa'ibah or a Wasilah or a Hami, but those who disbelieve invent a lie against Allah. Most of them have no sense.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ قَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "Come to what Allāh has revealed and to the Messenger," they say, "Sufficient for us is that upon which we found our fathers." Even though their fathers knew nothing, nor were they guided?
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla lahum taʿālawā ʾilā mā ʾanzala Allāh wa-ʾilā ar-rasūli qālūā ḥasbunā mā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāʾanā ۚ ʾawalaw kāna ābāʾuhum lā yaʿlamūna shayā walā yahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: when it is said to them, ‘Come to what God has sent down, and to the Messenger,’ they say, ‘What we inherited from our forefathers is good enough for us,’ even though their forefathers knew nothing and were not guided.
verses.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Come unto that which Allah hath revealed and unto the messenger, they say: Enough for us is that wherein we found our fathers. What! Even though their fathers had no knowledge whatsoever, and no guidance?

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ لَا يَضُرُّكُم مَّن ضَلَّ إِذَا ٱهْتَدَيْتُمْ ۚ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, upon you is [responsibility for] yourselves. Those who have gone astray will not harm you when you have been guided. To Allāh is your return all together; then He will inform you of what you used to do.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʿalaykum ʾanfusakum ۖ lā yaḍurrukum mman ḍalla ʾidhā āhtadaytum ۚ ʾilā Allāh marjiʿukum jamīʿan fayunabbiʾukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, you are responsible for your own souls; if anyone else goes astray it will not harm you so long as you follow the guidance; you will all return to God, and He will make you realize what you have done.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Ye have charge of your own souls. He who erreth cannot injure you if ye are rightly guided. Unto Allah ye will all return; and then He will inform you of what ye used to do.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ شَهَـٰدَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ حِينَ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ ٱثْنَانِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ أَوْ ءَاخَرَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ إِنْ أَنتُمْ ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصَـٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ تَحْبِسُونَهُمَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ لَا نَشْتَرِى بِهِۦ ثَمَنًا وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ ۙ وَلَا نَكْتُمُ شَهَـٰدَةَ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْـَٔاثِمِينَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, testimony [should be taken] among you when death approaches one of you at the time of bequest - [that of] two just men from among you or two others from outside if you are traveling through the land and the disaster of death should strike you. Detain them after the prayer and let them both swear by Allāh if you doubt [their testimony, saying], "We will not exchange it [i.e., our oath] for a price [i.e., worldly gain], even if he should be a near relative, and we will not withhold the testimony of [i.e., ordained by] Allāh. Indeed, we would then be of the sinful."
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā shahādahu baynikum ʾidhā ḥaḍara ʾaḥadakumu al-mawtu ḥīna al-waṣiyyahi āthnāni dhawā ʿadlin mminkum ʾaw ākharāni min ghayrikum ʾin ʾantum ḍarabtum fā al-ʾarḍi fa-aṣābatkum mmuṣībahu al-mawti ۚ taḥbisūnahumā min baʿdi aṣ-ṣalawāhi fayuqsimāni billāh ʾini ārtabtum lā nashtarā bihi thamanan walaw kāna dhā qurbā ۙ walā naktumu shahādaha Allāh ʾinnā ʾidhan llamina al-āthimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, when death approaches any of you, let two just men from among you act as witnesses to the making of a bequest, or two men from another people if you are journeying in the land when death approaches. Keep the two witnesses back after prayer, if you have any doubts, and make them both swear by God, ‘We will not sell our testimony for any price, even if a close relative is involved. We will not hide God’s testimony, for then we should be doing wrong.’
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Let there be witnesses between you when death draweth nigh unto one of you, at the time of bequest - two witnesses, just men from among you, or two others from another tribe, in case ye are campaigning in the land and the calamity of death befall you. Ye shall empanel them both after the prayer, and, if ye doubt, they shall be made to swear by Allah (saying): We will not take a bribe, even though it were (on behalf of) a near kinsman nor will we hide the testimony of Allah, for then indeed we should be of the sinful.

verses.ar: فَإِنْ عُثِرَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنَّهُمَا ٱسْتَحَقَّآ إِثْمًا فَـَٔاخَرَانِ يَقُومَانِ مَقَامَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَوْلَيَـٰنِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِٱللَّهِ لَشَهَـٰدَتُنَآ أَحَقُّ مِن شَهَـٰدَتِهِمَا وَمَا ٱعْتَدَيْنَآ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: But if it is found that those two were guilty of sin [i.e., perjury], let two others stand in their place [who are] foremost [in claim] from those who have a lawful right. And let them swear by Allāh, "Our testimony is truer than their testimony, and we have not transgressed. Indeed, we would then be of the wrongdoers."
verses.tr: fa-in ʿuthira ʿalā ʾannahumā āstaḥaqqā ʾithman fākharāni yaqūmāni maqāmahumā mina adh-dhīna āstaḥaqqa ʿalayhimu al-ʾawlayāni fayuqsimāni billāh lashahādatunā ʾaḥaqqu min shahādatihimā wamā āʿtadaynā ʾinnā ʾidhan llamina aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If it is discovered that these two are guilty [of perjury], two of those whose rights have been usurped have a better right to bear witness in their place. Let them swear by God, ‘Our testimony is truer than theirs. We have said nothing but the truth, for that would make us wrongdoers’:
verses.pickthall: But then, if it is afterwards ascertained that both of them merit (the suspicion of) sin, let two others take their place of those nearly concerned, and let them swear by Allah, (saying): Verily our testimony is truer than their testimony and we have not transgressed (the bounds of duty), for then indeed we should be of the evil-doers.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهَآ أَوْ يَخَافُوٓا۟ أَن تُرَدَّ أَيْمَـٰنٌۢ بَعْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: That is more likely that they will give testimony according to its [true] objective, or [at least] they would fear that [other] oaths might be taken after their oaths. And fear Allāh and listen [i.e., obey Him]; and Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
verses.tr: dhālika ʾadnā ʾan yaʾtūā bi-ash-shahādahi ʿalā wajhihā ʾaw yakhāfūā ʾan turadda ʾaymānun baʿda ʾaymānihim ۗ wāttaqūā Allāh wāsmaʿūā ۗ wallāh lā yahdā al-qawma al-fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: that will make it more likely they will give true and proper testimony, or fear that their oaths might be refuted by others afterwards. Be mindful of God and listen; God does not guide those who break His laws.
verses.pickthall: Thus it is more likely that they will bear true witness or fear that after their oaths the oaths (of others) will be taken. So be mindful of your duty (to Allah) and hearken. Allah guideth not the froward folk.

verses.ar: ۞ يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أُجِبْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
verses.en: [Be warned of] the Day when Allāh will assemble the messengers and say, "What was the response you received?" They will say, "We have no knowledge. Indeed, it is You who is Knower of the unseen" -
verses.tr: ۞ yawma yajmaʿu Allāh ar-rusula fayaqūlu mādhā ʾujibtum ۖ qālūā lā ʿilma lanā ۖ ʾinnaka ʾanta ʿallāmu al-ghuyūbi
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when God assembles all the messengers and asks, ‘What response did you receive?’ they will say, ‘We do not have that knowledge: You alone know things that cannot be seen.’
verses.pickthall: In the day when Allah gathereth together the messengers, and saith: What was your response (from mankind)? they say: We have no knowledge. Lo! Thou, only Thou art the Knower of Things Hidden,

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَـٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱذْكُرْ نِعْمَتِى عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَتِكَ إِذْ أَيَّدتُّكَ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ تُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا ۖ وَإِذْ عَلَّمْتُكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ ۖ وَإِذْ تَخْلُقُ مِنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ بِإِذْنِى فَتَنفُخُ فِيهَا فَتَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِى ۖ وَتُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ بِإِذْنِى ۖ وَإِذْ تُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِى ۖ وَإِذْ كَفَفْتُ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَنكَ إِذْ جِئْتَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: [The Day] when Allāh will say, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, remember My favor upon you and upon your mother when I supported you with the Pure Spirit [i.e., the angel Gabriel] and you spoke to the people in the cradle and in maturity; and [remember] when I taught you writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel; and when you designed from clay [what was] like the form of a bird with My permission, then you breathed into it, and it became a bird with My permission; and you healed the blind [from birth] and the leper with My permission; and when you brought forth the dead with My permission; and when I restrained the Children of Israel from [killing] you when you came to them with clear proofs and those who disbelieved among them said, "This is not but obvious magic."
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla Allāh yāʿīsā ābna maryama ādhkur niʿmatā ʿalayka waʿalā wālidatika ʾidh ʾayyadttuka birūḥi al-qudusi tukallimu an-nāsa fā al-mahdi wakahlan ۖ wa-idh ʿallamtuka al-kitāba wa-l-ḥikmaha wa-at-tawrāha wa-l-ʾinjīla ۖ wa-idh takhluqu mina aṭ-ṭīni kahayhi aṭ-ṭayri biʾidhnā fatanfukhu fīhā fatakūnu ṭayranā biʾidhnā ۖ watubriʾu al-ʾakmaha wa-l-ʾabraṣa biʾidhnā ۖ wa-idh tukhriju al-mawtā biʾidhnā ۖ wa-idh kafaftu banā ʾisrāʾīla ʿanka ʾidh jiʾtahum bi-l-bayyināti faqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā minhum ʾin hādhā ʾillā siḥrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Then God will say, ‘Jesus, son of Mary! Remember My favour to you and to your mother: how I strengthened you with the holy spirit, so that you spoke to people in your infancy and as a grown man; how I taught you the Scripture and wisdom, the Torah and the Gospel; how, by My leave, you fashioned the shape of a bird out of clay, breathed into it, and it became, by My leave, a bird; how, by My leave, you healed the blind person and the leper; how, by My leave, you brought the dead back to life; how I restrained the Children of Israel from [harming] you when you brought them clear signs, and those of them who disbelieved said, “This is clearly nothing but sorcery”;
verses.pickthall: When Allah saith: O Jesus, son of Mary! Remember My favour unto thee and unto thy mother; how I strengthened thee with the holy Spirit, so that thou spakest unto mankind in the cradle as in maturity; and how I taught thee the Scripture and Wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel; and how thou didst shape of clay as it were the likeness of a bird by My permission, and didst blow upon it and it was a bird by My permission, and thou didst heal him who was born blind and the leper by My permission; and how thou didst raise the dead by My permission; and how I restrained the Children of Israel from (harming) thee when thou camest unto them with clear proofs, and those of them who disbelieved exclaimed: This is naught else than mere magic;

verses.ar: وَإِذْ أَوْحَيْتُ إِلَى ٱلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِى وَبِرَسُولِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّنَا مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And [remember] when I inspired to the disciples, "Believe in Me and in My messenger [i.e., Jesus]." They said, "We have believed, so bear witness that indeed we are Muslims [in submission to Allāh]."
verses.tr: wa-idh ʾawḥaytu ʾilā al-ḥawāriyyina ʾan āminūā bā wabirasūlā qālūā āmannā wāshhad biʾannanā muslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and how I inspired the disciples to believe in Me and My messengers- they said, “We believe and bear witness that we devote ourselves [to God].”’
verses.pickthall: And when I inspired the disciples, (saying): Believe in Me and in My messenger, they said: We believe. Bear witness that we have surrendered (unto Thee) "we are muslims".

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ يَـٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَن يُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ قَالَ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: [And remember] when the disciples said, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, can your Lord send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven?" [Jesus] said, "Fear Allāh, if you should be believers."
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla al-ḥawāriyyūna yāʿīsā ābna maryama hal yastaṭīʿu rabbuka ʾan yunazzila ʿalaynā māʾidahan mmina as-samāʾi ۖ qāla āttaqūā Allāh ʾin kuntum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the disciples said, ‘Jesus, son of Mary, can your Lord send down a feast to us from heaven?’ he said, ‘Beware of God if you are true believers.’
verses.pickthall: When the disciples said: O Jesus, son of Mary! Is thy Lord able to send down for us a table spread with food from heaven? He said: Observe your duty to Allah, if ye are true believers.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ نُرِيدُ أَن نَّأْكُلَ مِنْهَا وَتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُنَا وَنَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ صَدَقْتَنَا وَنَكُونَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
verses.en: They said, "We wish to eat from it and let our hearts be reassured and know that you have been truthful to us and be among its witnesses."
verses.tr: qālūā nurīdu ʾan nnaʾkula minhā wataṭmaʾinna qulūbunā wanaʿlama ʾan qad ṣadaqtanā wanakūna ʿalayhā mina ash-shāhidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We wish to eat from it; to have our hearts reassured; to know that you have told us the truth; and to be witnesses of it.’
verses.pickthall: (They said:) We wish to eat thereof, that we may satisfy our hearts and know that thou hast spoken truth to us, and that thereof we may be witnesses.

verses.ar: قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةً مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.en: Said Jesus, the son of Mary, "O Allāh, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers."
verses.tr: qāla ʿīsā ābnu maryama Allāhumma rabbanā ʾanzil ʿalaynā māʾidahan mmina as-samāʾi takūnu lanā ʿīdan lliʾawwalinā wakhirinā wayahan mminka ۖ wārzuqnā wa-anta khayru ar-rāziqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Jesus, son of Mary, said, ‘Lord, send down to us a feast from heaven so that we can have a festival- the first and last of us- and a sign from You. Provide for us: You are the best provider.’
verses.pickthall: Jesus, son of Mary, said: O Allah, Lord of us! Send down for us a table spread with food from heaven, that it may be a feast for us, for the first of us and for the last of us, and a sign from Thee. Give us sustenance, for Thou art the Best of Sustainers.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّى مُنَزِّلُهَا عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بَعْدُ مِنكُمْ فَإِنِّىٓ أُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًا لَّآ أُعَذِّبُهُۥٓ أَحَدًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Allāh said, "Indeed, I will send it down to you, but whoever disbelieves afterwards from among you - then indeed will I punish him with a punishment by which I have not punished anyone among the worlds."
verses.tr: qāla Allāh ʾinnā munazziluhā ʿalaykum ۖ faman yakfur baʿdu minkum fa-innā ʾuʿadhibuhu ʿadhāban llā ʾuʿadhibuhu ʾaḥadan mmina al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘I will send it down to you, but anyone who disbelieves after this will be punished with a punishment that I will not inflict on anyone else in the world.’
verses.pickthall: Allah said: Lo! I send it down for you. And whoso disbelieveth of you afterward, him surely will I punish with a punishment wherewith I have not punished any of (My) creatures.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَـٰعِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ءَأَنتَ قُلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ ٱتَّخِذُونِى وَأُمِّىَ إِلَـٰهَيْنِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا يَكُونُ لِىٓ أَنْ أَقُولَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِحَقٍّ ۚ إِن كُنتُ قُلْتُهُۥ فَقَدْ عَلِمْتَهُۥ ۚ تَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِى وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ مَا فِى نَفْسِكَ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
verses.en: And [beware the Day] when Allāh will say, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, did you say to the people, 'Take me and my mother as deities besides Allāh?'" He will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for me to say that to which I have no right. If I had said it, You would have known it. You know what is within myself, and I do not know what is within Yourself. Indeed, it is You who is Knower of the unseen.
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla Allāh yāʿīsā ābna maryama ʾaʾanta qulta lilnnāsi āttakhidhūnā wa-ummāa ʾilāhayni min dūni Allāh ۖ qāla subḥānaka mā yakūnu lā ʾan ʾaqūla mā laysa lā biḥaqqin ۚ ʾin kuntu qultuhu faqad ʿalimtahu ۚ taʿlamu mā fā nafsā walā ʾaʿlamu mā fā nafsika ۚ ʾinnaka ʾanta ʿallāmu al-ghuyūbi
verses.abdelhaleem: When God says, ‘Jesus, son of Mary, did you say to people, “Take me and my mother as two gods alongside God”?’ he will say, ‘May You be exalted! I would never say what I had no right to say- if I had said such a thing You would have known it: You know all that is within me, though I do not know what is within You, You alone have full knowledge of things unseen-
verses.pickthall: And when Allah saith: O Jesus, son of Mary! Didst thou say unto mankind: Take me and my mother for two gods beside Allah? he saith: Be glorified! It was not mine to utter that to which I had no right. If I used to say it, then Thou knewest it. Thou knowest what is in my mind, and I know not what is in Thy Mind. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower of Things Hidden?

verses.ar: مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَمَرْتَنِى بِهِۦٓ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ ۚ وَكُنتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَّا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِى كُنتَ أَنتَ ٱلرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَأَنتَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.en: I said not to them except what You commanded me - to worship Allāh, my Lord and your Lord. And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them; but when You took me up, You were the Observer over them, and You are, over all things, Witness.
verses.tr: mā qultu lahum ʾillā mā ʾamartanā bihi ʾani āʿbudūā Allāh rabbā warabbakum ۚ wakuntu ʿalayhim shahīdan mmā dumtu fīhim ۖ falammā tawaffaytanā kunta ʾanta ar-raqība ʿalayhim ۚ wa-anta ʿalā kulli shāʾin shahīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: I told them only what You commanded me to: “Worship God, my Lord and your Lord.” I was a witness over them during my time among them. Ever since You took my soul, You alone have been the watcher over them: You are witness to all things
verses.pickthall: I spake unto them only that which Thou commandedst me, (saying): Worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord. I was a witness of them while I dwelt among them, and when Thou tookest me Thou wast the Watcher over them. Thou art Witness over all things.

verses.ar: إِن تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ ۖ وَإِن تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: If You should punish them - indeed they are Your servants; but if You forgive them - indeed it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
verses.tr: ʾin tuʿadhibhum fa-innahum ʿibāduka ۖ wa-in taghfir lahum fa-innaka ʾanta al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: and if You punish them, they are Your servants; if You forgive them, You are the Almighty, the Wise.’
verses.pickthall: If Thou punish them, lo! they are Thy slaves, and if Thou forgive them (lo! they are Thy slaves). Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱللَّهُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ يَنفَعُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ صِدْقُهُمْ ۚ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۚ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.en: Allāh will say, "This is the Day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness." For them are gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them, and they with Him. That is the great attainment.
verses.tr: qāla Allāh hādhā yawmu yanfaʿu aṣ-ṣādiqīna ṣidquhum ۚ lahum jannātun tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ʾabadan ۚ rraḍāa Allāh ʿanhum waraḍūā ʿanhu ۚ dhālika al-fawzu al-ʿaẓīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: God will say, ‘This is a Day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness. They will have Gardens graced with flowing streams, there to remain for ever. God is pleased with them and they with Him: that is the supreme triumph.’
verses.pickthall: Allah saith: This is a day in which their truthfulness profiteth the truthful, for theirs are Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they are secure for ever, Allah taking pleasure in them and they in Him. That is the great triumph.

verses.ar: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌۢ
verses.en: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is within them. And He is over all things competent.
verses.tr: lillāh mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā fīhinna ۚ wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Control of the heavens and earth and everything in them belongs to God: He has power over all things.
verses.pickthall: Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is therein, and He is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ وَٱلنُّورَ ۖ ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.en: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light. Then those who disbelieve equate [others] with their Lord.
verses.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wajaʿala aẓ-ẓulumāti wa-an-nūra ۖ thumma adh-dhīna kafarūā birabbihim yaʿdilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Praise belongs to God who created the heavens and the earth and made darkness and light; yet the disbelievers set up equals to their Lord!
verses.pickthall: Praise be to Allah, Who hath created the heavens and the earth, and hath appointed darkness and light. Yet those who disbelieve ascribe rivals unto their Lord.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٍ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰٓ أَجَلًا ۖ وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُۥ ۖ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.en: It is He who created you from clay and then decreed a term and a specified time [known] to Him; then [still] you are in dispute.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā khalaqakum mmin ṭīnin thumma qaḍā ʾajalan ۖ wa-ajalun mmusammanā ʿindahu ۖ thumma ʾantum tamtarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He is the one who created you from clay and specified a term [for you] and another fixed time, known only to Him; yet still you doubt!
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath created you from clay, and hath decreed a term for you. A term is fixed with Him. Yet still ye doubt!

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَجَهْرَكُمْ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: And He is Allāh, [the only deity] in the heavens and the earth. He knows your secret and what you make public, and He knows that which you earn.
verses.tr: wahuwa Allāh fā as-samāwāti wafā al-ʾarḍi ۖ yaʿlamu sirrakum wajahrakum wayaʿlamu mā taksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He is God in the heavens and on earth, He knows your secrets and what you reveal, and He knows what you do;
verses.pickthall: He is Allah in the heavens and in the earth. He knoweth both your secret and your utterance, and He knoweth what ye earn.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.en: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom.
verses.tr: wamā taʾtīhim mmin āyahin mmin āyāti rabbihim ʾillā kānūā ʿanhā muʿriḍīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but every time revelation comes to them from their Lord, they turn their backs on it.
verses.pickthall: Never came there unto them a revelation of the revelations of Allah but they did turn away from it.

verses.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: For they had denied the truth when it came to them, but there is going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule.
verses.tr: faqad kadhabūā bi-l-ḥaqqi lammā jāʾahum ۖ fasawfa yaʾtīhim ʾanbā mā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So they denied the truth when it came to them, but the very thing they laughed at will be brought home to them.
verses.pickthall: And they denied the truth when it came unto them. But there will come unto them the tidings of that which they used to deride.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them which We had established upon the earth as We have not established you? And We sent [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then We destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them a generation of others.
verses.tr: ʾalam yarawā kam ʾahlaknā min qablihim mmin qarnin mmakkannāhum fā al-ʾarḍi mā lam numakkin llakum wa-arsalnā as-samāʾa ʿalayhim mmidrāran wajaʿalnā al-ʾanhāra tajrā min taḥtihim fa-ahlaknāhum bidhunūbihim wa-anshaʾnā min baʿdihim qarnan ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not realize how many generations We destroyed before them? We established them in the earth more firmly than you, sent down abundant rain on them from the sky and made running rivers flow at their feet, yet We destroyed them for their misdeeds and raised other generations after them.
verses.pickthall: See they not how many a generation We destroyed before them, whom We had established in the earth more firmly than We have established you, and We shed on them abundant showers from the sky, and made the rivers flow beneath them. Yet we destroyed them for their sins, and created after them another generation.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَـٰبًا فِى قِرْطَاسٍ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And even if We had sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands, the disbelievers would say, "This is not but obvious magic."
verses.tr: walaw nazzalnā ʿalayka kitāban fā qirṭāsin falamasūhu biʾaydīhim laqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾin hādhā ʾillā siḥrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Even if We had sent down to you [Prophet] a book inscribed on parchment, and they had touched it with their own hands, the disbelievers would still say, ‘This is nothing but blatant sorcery.’
verses.pickthall: Had we sent down unto thee (Muhammad) (actual) writing upon parchment, so that they could feel it with their hands, those who disbelieve would have said: This is naught else than mere magic.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ ۖ وَلَوْ أَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًا لَّقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ
verses.en: And they say, "Why was there not sent down to him an angel?" But if We had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided; then they would not be reprieved.
verses.tr: waqālūā lawlā ʾunzila ʿalayhi malakun ۖ walaw ʾanzalnā malakan llaquḍāa al-ʾamru thumma lā yunẓarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘Why was no angel sent down to [support] him?’ But had We sent down an angel, their judgement would have come at once with no respite given.
verses.pickthall: They say: Why hath not an angel been sent down unto him? If We sent down an angel, then the matter would be judged; no further time would be allowed them (for reflection).

verses.ar: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَلَكًا لَّجَعَلْنَـٰهُ رَجُلًا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ
verses.en: And if We had made him [i.e., the messenger] an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves [i.e., confusion and doubt].
verses.tr: walaw jaʿalnāhu malakan llajaʿalnāhu rajulan walalabasnā ʿalayhim mmā yalbisūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Indeed, if We had sent an angel as messenger, We would still have sent him in the form of a man, so increasing their confusion.
verses.pickthall: Had we appointed him (Our messenger) an angel, We assuredly had made him (as) a man (that he might speak to men); and (thus) obscured for them (the truth) they (now) obscure.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule.
verses.tr: walaqadi āstuhziʾa birusulin mmin qablika faḥāqa bi-adh-dhīna sakhirūā minhum mmā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Messengers have been mocked before you [Muhammad], and those who mocked them were engulfed by the very punishment they had mocked.
verses.pickthall: Messengers (of Allah) have been derided before thee, but that whereat they scoffed surrounded such of them as did deride.

verses.ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Travel through the land; then observe how was the end of the deniers."
verses.tr: qul sīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi thumma ānẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Travel throughout the earth and see what fate befell those who rejected the truth.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto the disbelievers): Travel in the land, and see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!

verses.ar: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قُل لِّلَّهِ ۚ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ ۚ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Say, "To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth?" Say, "To Allāh." He has decreed upon Himself mercy. He will surely assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. Those who will lose themselves [that Day] do not believe.
verses.tr: qul lliman mmā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ qul lillāh ۚ kataba ʿalā nafsihi ar-raḥmaha ۚ layajmaʿannakum ʾilā yawmi al-qiyāmahi lā rayba fīhi ۚ adh-dhīna khasirūā ʾanfusahum fahum lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘To whom belongs all that is in the heavens and earth?’ Say, ‘To God. He has taken it upon Himself to be merciful. He will certainly gather you on the Day of Resurrection, which is beyond all doubt. Those who deceive themselves will not believe.
verses.pickthall: Say: Unto whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth? Say: Unto Allah. He hath prescribed for Himself mercy, that He may bring you all together to the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. Those who ruin their souls will not believe.

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَهُۥ مَا سَكَنَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: And to Him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.tr: ۞ walahu mā sakana fā al-yli wa-an-nahāri ۚ wahuwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: All that rests by night or by day belongs to Him. He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.’
verses.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever resteth in the night and the day. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ يُطْعِمُ وَلَا يُطْعَمُ ۗ قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Is it other than Allāh I should take as a protector, Creator of the heavens and earth, while it is He who feeds and is not fed?" Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to be the first [among you] who submit [to Allāh] and [was commanded], 'Do not ever be of the polytheists."
verses.tr: qul ʾaghayra Allāh ʾattakhidhu waliyyan fāṭiri as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wahuwa yuṭʿimu walā yuṭʿamu ۗ qul ʾinnā ʾumirtu ʾan ʾakūna ʾawwala man ʾaslama ۖ walā takūnanna mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Shall I take for myself a protector other than God, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, who feeds but is not fed?’ Say, ‘I am commanded to be the first [of you] to devote myself [to Him].’ Do not be one of the idolaters.
verses.pickthall: Say: Shall I choose for a protecting friend other than Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, Who feedeth and is never fed? Say: I am ordered to be the first to surrender (unto Him). And be not thou (O Muhammad) of the idolaters.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
verses.tr: qul ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʾin ʿaṣaytu rabbā ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I fear the punishment of a dreadful Day if I disobey my Lord.
verses.pickthall: Say: I fear, if I rebel against my Lord, the retribution of an Awful Day.

verses.ar: مَّن يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُۥ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allāh] has granted him mercy. And that is the clear attainment.
verses.tr: mman yuṣraf ʿanhu yawmaʾidhin faqad raḥimahu ۚ wadhālika al-fawzu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: God will have been truly merciful to whoever is spared on that Day: that is the clearest triumph.’
verses.pickthall: He from whom (such retribution) is averted on that day, (Allah) hath in truth had mercy on him. That will be the signal triumph.

verses.ar: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: And if Allāh should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent.
verses.tr: wa-in yamsaska Allāh biḍurrin falā kāshifa lahu ʾillā huwa ۖ wa-in yamsaska bikhayrin fahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: If God touches you [Prophet] with affliction, no one can remove it except Him, and if He touches you with good, He has power over all things:
verses.pickthall: If Allah touch thee with affliction, there is none that can relieve therefrom save Him, and if He touch thee with good fortune (there is none that can impair it); for He is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.en: And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Aware.
verses.tr: wahuwa al-qāhiru fawqa ʿibādihi ۚ wahuwa al-ḥakīmu al-khabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: He is the Supreme Master over His creatures, the All Wise, the All Aware.
verses.pickthall: He is the Omnipotent over His slaves, and He is the Wise, the Knower.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَـٰدَةً ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ شَهِيدٌۢ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِۦ وَمَنۢ بَلَغَ ۚ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً أُخْرَىٰ ۚ قُل لَّآ أَشْهَدُ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ وَإِنَّنِى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: Say, "What thing is greatest in testimony?" Say, "Allāh is witness between me and you. And this Qur’ān was revealed to me that I may warn you thereby and whomever it reaches. Do you [truly] testify that with Allāh there are other deities?" Say, "I will not testify [with you]." Say, "Indeed, He is but one God, and indeed, I am free of what you associate [with Him]."
verses.tr: qul āu shāʾin ʾakbaru shahādahan ۖ quli Allāh ۖ shahīdun baynā wabaynakum ۚ wa-ūḥāa ʾilāa hādhā al-qurānu liʾundhirakum bihi waman balagha ۚ ʾaʾinnakum latashhadūna ʾanna maʿa Allāh ālihahan ʾukhrā ۚ qul llā ʾashhadu ۚ qul ʾinnamā huwa ʾilāhun wāḥidun wa-innanā barāʾun mmimmā tushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘What counts most as a witness?’ Say, ‘God is witness between you and me. This Quran was revealed for me to warn you [people] and everyone it reaches. Do you really bear witness that there are other gods beside God?’ Say, ‘I myself do not bear witness [to any such thing].’ Say, ‘He is only one God, and I disown whatever you join with Him.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): What thing is of most weight in testimony? Say: Allah is Witness between me and you. And this Qur'an hath been inspired in me, that I may warn therewith you and whomsoever it may reach. Do ye in sooth bear witness that there are gods beside Allah? Say: I bear no such witness. Say: He is only One Allah. Lo! I am innocent of that which ye associate (with Him).

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يَعْرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَآءَهُمُ ۘ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize their [own] sons. Those who will lose themselves [in the Hereafter] do not believe.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ātaynāhumu al-kitāba yaʿrifūnahu kamā yaʿrifūna ʾabnāʾahumu ۘ adh-dhīna khasirūā ʾanfusahum fahum lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those to whom We have given the Scripture know this as well as they know their own sons. Those who have lost their souls will not believe.
verses.pickthall: Those unto whom We gave the Scripture recognise (this revelation) as they recognise their sons. Those who ruin their own souls will not believe.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh a lie or denies His verses? Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed.
verses.tr: waman ʾaẓlamu mimmani āftarā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban ʾaw kadhaba bāyātihi ۗ ʾinnahu lā yufliḥu aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who does greater wrong than someone who fabricates a lie against God or denies His revelation? Those who do such wrong will not prosper.
verses.pickthall: Who doth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie against Allah or denieth His revelations? Lo! the wrongdoers will not be successful.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day We will gather them all together; then We will say to those who associated others with Allāh, "Where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with Him]?"
verses.tr: wayawma naḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma naqūlu lilladhīna ʾashrakūā ʾayna shurakāʾukumu adh-dhīna kuntum tazʿumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When We gather them all together and say to the polytheists, ‘Where are those you claimed were partners with God?’ in their utter dismay
verses.pickthall: And on the day We gather them together We shall say unto those who ascribed partners (unto Allah): Where are (now) those partners of your make-believe?

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُن فِتْنَتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Then there will be no [excuse upon] examination except they will say, "By Allāh, our Lord, we were not those who associated."
verses.tr: thumma lam takun fitnatuhum ʾillā ʾan qālūā wallāh rabbinā mā kunnā mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: they will only say, ‘By God, our Lord, we have not set up partners beside Him!’
verses.pickthall: Then will they have no contention save that they will say: By Allah, our Lord, we never were idolaters.

verses.ar: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۚ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: See how they will lie about themselves. And lost from them will be what they used to invent.
verses.tr: ānẓur kayfa kadhabūā ʿalā ʾanfusihim ۚ waḍalla ʿanhum mmā kānūā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: See how they lie against themselves and how those they invented have deserted them.
verses.pickthall: See how they lie against themselves, and (how) the thing which they devised hath failed them!

verses.ar: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا ۚ وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: And among them are those who listen to you, but We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. Even when they come to you arguing with you, those who disbelieve say, "This is not but legends of the former peoples."
verses.tr: waminhum mman yastamiʿu ʾilayka ۖ wajaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim ʾakinnahan ʾan yafqahūhu wafā ādhānihim waqran ۚ wa-in yarawā kulla āyahin llā yuʾminūā bihā ۚ ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾūka yujādilūnaka yaqūlu adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾin hādhā ʾillā ʾasāṭīru al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Among them are some who [appear to] listen to you, but we have placed covers over their hearts- so they do not understand the Quran- and deafness in their ears. Even if they saw every sign they would not believe in them. So, when they come to you, they argue with you: the disbelievers say, ‘These are nothing but ancient fables,’
verses.pickthall: Of them are some who listen unto thee, but We have placed upon their hearts veils, lest they should understand, and in their ears a deafness. If they saw every token they would not believe therein; to the point that, when they come unto thee to argue with thee, the disbelievers say: This is naught else than fables of the men of old.

verses.ar: وَهُمْ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَيَنْـَٔوْنَ عَنْهُ ۖ وَإِن يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: And they prevent [others] from him and are [themselves] remote from him. And they do not destroy except themselves, but they perceive [it] not.
verses.tr: wahum yanhawna ʿanhu wayanwna ʿanhu ۖ wa-in yuhlikūna ʾillā ʾanfusahum wamā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and tell others not to listen [to the Quran], while they themselves keep away from it. But they ruin no one but themselves, though they fail to realize this.
verses.pickthall: And they forbid (men) from it and avoid it, and they ruin none save themselves, though they perceive not.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰلَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: If you could but see when they are made to stand before the Fire and will say, "Oh, would that we could be returned [to life on earth] and not deny the signs of our Lord and be among the believers."
verses.tr: walaw tarā ʾidh wuqifūā ʿalā an-nāri faqālūā yālaytanā nuraddu walā nukadhiba bāyāti rabbinā wanakūna mina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you could only see, when they are made to stand before the Fire, how they will say, ‘If only we could be sent back, we would not reject the revelations of our Lord, but be among the believers.’
verses.pickthall: If thou couldst see when they are set before the Fire and say: Oh, would that we might return! Then would we not deny the revelations of our Lord but we would be of the believers!

verses.ar: بَلْ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُخْفُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَوْ رُدُّوا۟ لَعَادُوا۟ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: But what they concealed before has [now] appeared to them. And even if they were returned, they would return to that which they were forbidden; and indeed, they are liars.
verses.tr: bal badā lahum mmā kānūā yukhfūna min qablu ۖ walaw ruddūā laʿādūā limā nuhūā ʿanhu wa-innahum lakādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No! The truth they used to hide will become all too clear to them. Even if they were brought back, they would only return to the very thing that was forbidden to them- they are such liars!
verses.pickthall: Nay, but that hath become clear unto them which before they used to hide. And if they were sent back they would return unto that which they are forbidden. Lo! they are liars.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
verses.en: And they say, "There is none but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected."
verses.tr: waqālūā ʾin hāa ʾillā ḥayātunā ad-dunyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘There is nothing beyond our life in this world: we shall not be raised from the dead.’
verses.pickthall: And they say: There is naught save our life of the world, and we shall not be raised (again).

verses.ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَـٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: If you could but see when they will be made to stand before their Lord. He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will [then] say, "So taste the punishment for what you used to deny."
verses.tr: walaw tarā ʾidh wuqifūā ʿalā rabbihim ۚ qāla ʾalaysa hādhā bi-l-ḥaqqi ۚ qālūā balā warabbinā ۚ qāla fadhūqūā al-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you could only see, when they are made to stand before their Lord, how He will say, ‘Is this not real?’ They will say, ‘Yes indeed, by our Lord.’ He will say, ‘Then taste the torment for having disbelieved.’
verses.pickthall: If thou couldst see when they are set before their Lord! He will say: Is not this real? They will say: Yea, verily, by our Lord! He will say: Taste now the retribution for that ye used to disbelieve.

verses.ar: قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً قَالُوا۟ يَـٰحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمْ ۚ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
