verses.en: Those will have lost who deny the meeting with Allāh, until when the Hour [of resurrection] comes upon them unexpectedly, they will say, "Oh, [how great is] our regret over what we neglected concerning it [i.e., the Hour]," while they bear their burdens [i.e., sins] on their backs. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
verses.tr: qad khasira adh-dhīna kadhabūā biliqāʾi Allāh ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾathumu as-sāʿahu baghtahan qālūā yāḥasratanā ʿalā mā farraṭnā fīhā wahum yaḥmilūna ʾawzārahum ʿalā ẓuhūrihim ۚ ʾalā sāʾa mā yazirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Lost indeed are those who deny the meeting with their Lord until, when the Hour suddenly arrives, they say, ‘Alas for us that we disregarded this!’ They will bear their burdens on their backs. How terrible those burdens will be!
verses.pickthall: They indeed are losers who deny their meeting with Allah until, when the Hour cometh on them suddenly, they cry: Alas for us, that we neglected it! They bear upon their backs their burdens. Ah, evil is that which they bear!

verses.ar: وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ ۖ وَلَلدَّارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh, so will you not reason?
verses.tr: wamā al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā ʾillā laʿibun walahwun ۖ walalddāru al-ākhirahu khayrun llilladhīna yattaqūna ۗ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The life of this world is nothing but a game and a distraction; the Home in the Hereafter is best for those who are aware of God. Why will you [people] not understand?
verses.pickthall: Naught is the life of the world save a pastime and a sport. Better far is the abode of the Hereafter for those who keep their duty (to Allah). Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَحْزُنُكَ ٱلَّذِى يَقُولُونَ ۖ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.en: We know that you, [O Muḥammad], are saddened by what they say. And indeed, they do not call you untruthful, but it is the verses of Allāh that the wrongdoers reject.
verses.tr: qad naʿlamu ʾinnahu layaḥzunuka adh-dhā yaqūlūna ۖ fa-innahum lā yukadhibūnaka walākinna aẓ-ẓālimīna bāyāti Allāh yajḥadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We know well that what they say grieves you [Prophet]. It is not you they disbelieve: the evildoers reject God’s revelation.
verses.pickthall: We know well how their talk grieveth thee, though in truth they deny not thee (Muhammad) but evil-doers flout the revelations of Allah.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا كُذِّبُوا۟ وَأُوذُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰهُمْ نَصْرُنَا ۚ وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكَ مِن نَّبَإِى۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And certainly were messengers denied before you, but they were patient over the denial, and they were harmed until Our victory came to them. And none can alter the words [i.e., decrees] of Allāh. And there has certainly come to you some information about the [previous] messengers.
verses.tr: walaqad kudhibat rusulun mmin qablika faṣabarūā ʿalā mā kudhibūā wa-ūdhūā ḥattā ʾatāhum naṣrunā ۚ walā mubaddila likalimāti Allāh ۚ walaqad jāʾaka min nnabaā al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Other messengers were disbelieved before you, and they bore their rejection and persecution steadfastly until Our aid arrived- no one can alter God’s promises. You have already received accounts of these messengers.
verses.pickthall: Messengers indeed have been denied before thee, and they were patient under the denial and the persecution till Our succour reached them. There is none to alter the decisions of Allah. Already there hath reached thee (somewhat) of the tidings of the messengers (We sent before).

verses.ar: وَإِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَإِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ أَن تَبْتَغِىَ نَفَقًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّمًا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَأْتِيَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ ۚ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
verses.en: And if their evasion is difficult for you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the sky to bring them a sign, [then do so]. But if Allāh had willed, He would have united them upon guidance. So never be of the ignorant.
verses.tr: wa-in kāna kabura ʿalayka ʾiʿrāḍuhum fa-ini āstaṭaʿta ʾan tabtaghāa nafaqan fā al-ʾarḍi ʾaw sullaman fā as-samāʾi fataʾtiyahum bāyahin ۚ walaw shāʾa Allāh lajamaʿahum ʿalā al-hudā ۚ falā takūnanna mina al-jāhilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you find rejection by the disbelievers so hard to bear, then seek a tunnel into the ground or a ladder into the sky, if you can, and bring them a sign: God could bring them all to guidance if it were His will, so do not join the ignorant.
verses.pickthall: And if their aversion is grievous unto thee, then, if thou canst, seek a way down into the earth or a ladder unto the sky that thou mayst bring unto them a portent (to convince them all)! - If Allah willed, He could have brought them all together to the guidance - So be not thou among the foolish ones.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ ۘ وَٱلْمَوْتَىٰ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: Only those who hear will respond. But the dead - Allāh will resurrect them; then to Him they will be returned.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinnamā yastajību adh-dhīna yasmaʿūna ۘ wa-l-mawtā yabʿathuhumu Allāh thumma ʾilayhi yurjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Only those who can hear will respond; as for the dead, God will raise them up, and to Him they will all be returned.
verses.pickthall: Only those can accept who hear. As for the dead, Allah will raise them up; then unto Him they will be returned.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُنَزِّلَ ءَايَةً وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And they say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "Indeed, Allāh is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know."
verses.tr: waqālūā lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi āyahun mmin rrabbihi ۚ qul ʾinna Allāh qādirun ʿalā ʾan yunazzila āyahan walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They also say, ‘Why has no sign been sent down to him from his Lord?’ Say, ‘God certainly has the power to send down a sign,’ though most of them do not know:
verses.pickthall: They say: Why hath no portent been sent down upon him from his Lord? Say: Lo! Allah is Able to send down a portent. But most of them know not.

verses.ar: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا طَـٰٓئِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمْثَالُكُم ۚ مَّا فَرَّطْنَا فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: And there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.
verses.tr: wamā min dābbahin fā al-ʾarḍi walā ṭāʾirin yaṭīru bijanāḥayhi ʾillā ʾumamun ʾamthālukum ۚ mmā farraṭnā fā al-kitābi min shāʾin ۚ thumma ʾilā rabbihim yuḥsharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: all the creatures that crawl on the earth and those that fly with their wings are communities like yourselves. We have missed nothing out of the Record- in the end they will be gathered to their Lord.
verses.pickthall: There is not an animal in the earth, nor a flying creature flying on two wings, but they are peoples like unto you. We have neglected nothing in the Book (of Our decrees). Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ ۗ مَن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَمَن يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: But those who deny Our verses are deaf and dumb within darknesses. Whomever Allāh wills - He sends astray; and whomever He wills - He puts him on a straight path.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā ṣummun wabukmun fā aẓ-ẓulumāti ۗ man yashaʾi Allāh yuḍlilhu waman yashaʾ yajʿalhu ʿalā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who reject Our signs are deaf, dumb, and in total darkness. God leaves whoever He will to stray, and sets whoever He will on a straight path.
verses.pickthall: Those who deny Our revelations are deaf and dumb in darkness. Whom Allah will sendeth astray, and whom He will He placeth on a straight path.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Have you considered: if there came to you the punishment of Allāh or there came to you the Hour - is it other than Allāh you would invoke, if you should be truthful?"
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytakum ʾin ʾatākum ʿadhābu Allāh ʾaw ʾatatkumu as-sāʿahu ʾaghayra Allāh tadʿūna ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Think: if the punishment of God or the Hour should come to you, would you call on anyone other than God, if you are being truthful?’
verses.pickthall: Say: Can ye see yourselves, if the punishment of Allah come upon you or the Hour come upon you, (calling upon other than Allah)? Do ye then call (for help) to any other than Allah? (Answer that) if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: بَلْ إِيَّاهُ تَدْعُونَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ إِن شَآءَ وَتَنسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: No, it is Him [alone] you would invoke, and He would remove that for which you invoked Him if He willed, and you would forget what you associate [with Him].
verses.tr: bal ʾiyyāhu tadʿūna fayakshifu mā tadʿūna ʾilayhi ʾin shāʾa watansawna mā tushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed, it is on Him that you would call. If it were His will, He could remove whatever harm made you call on Him, and then you would forget what you now associate with Him.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but unto Him ye call, and He removeth that because of which ye call unto Him, if He will, and ye forget whatever partners ye ascribed unto Him.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
verses.en: And We have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [O Muḥammad]; then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to Us].
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā ʾilā ʾumamin mmin qablika fa-akhadhnāhum bi-l-baʾsāʾi wa-aḍ-ḍarrāʾi laʿallahum yataḍarraʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent messengers before you [Prophet] to many communities and afflicted their people with suffering and hardships, so that they could learn humility.
verses.pickthall: We have sent already unto peoples that were before thee, and We visited them with tribulation and adversity, in order that they might grow humble.

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَآ إِذْ جَآءَهُم بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا۟ وَلَـٰكِن قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Then why, when Our punishment came to them, did they not humble themselves? But their hearts became hardened, and Satan made attractive to them that which they were doing.
verses.tr: falawlā ʾidh jāʾahum baʾsunā taḍarraʿūā walākin qasat qulūbuhum wazayyana lahumu ash-shayṭānu mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If only they had learned humility when suffering came from Us! But no, their hearts became hard and Satan made their foul deeds alluring to them.
verses.pickthall: If only, when Our disaster came on them, they had been humble! But their hearts were hardened and the devil made all that they used to do seem fair unto them!

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا نَسُوا۟ مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَٰبَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَآ أُوتُوٓا۟ أَخَذْنَـٰهُم بَغْتَةً فَإِذَا هُم مُّبْلِسُونَ
verses.en: So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, We opened to them the doors of every [good] thing until, when they rejoiced in that which they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were [then] in despair.
verses.tr: falammā nasūā mā dhukkirūā bihi fataḥnā ʿalayhim ʾabwāba kulli shāʾin ḥattā ʾidhā fariḥūā bimā ʾūtūā ʾakhadhnāhum baghtahan fa-idhā hum mmublisūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So, when they had forgotten the warning they had received, We opened the gates to everything for them. Then, as they revelled in what they had been given, We struck them suddenly and they were dumbfounded.
verses.pickthall: Then, when they forgot that whereof they had been reminded, We opened unto them the gates of all things till, even as they were rejoicing in that which they were given, We seized them unawares, and lo! they were dumbfounded.

verses.ar: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ۚ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: faquṭiʿa dābiru al-qawmi adh-dhīna ẓalamūā ۚ wa-l-ḥamdu lillāh rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The evildoers were wiped out: praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds!
verses.pickthall: So of the people who did wrong the last remnant was cut off. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرَكُمْ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُم مَّنْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Have you considered: if Allāh should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts, which deity other than Allāh could bring them [back] to you?" Look how We diversify the verses; then they [still] turn away.
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum ʾin ʾakhadha Allāh samʿakum wa-abṣārakum wakhatama ʿalā qulūbikum mman ʾilāhun ghayru Allāh yaʾtīkum bihi ۗ ānẓur kayfa nuṣarrifu al-āyāti thumma hum yaṣdifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Think: if God were to take away your hearing and your sight and seal up your hearts, what god other than He could restore them?’ See how We explain Our revelations in various ways, yet still they turn away.
verses.pickthall: Say: Have ye imagined, if Allah should take away your hearing and your sight and seal your hearts, Who is the Allah Who could restore it to you save Allah? See how We display the revelations unto them! Yet still they turn away.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Have you considered: if the punishment of Allāh should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly, will any be destroyed but the wrongdoing people?"
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytakum ʾin ʾatākum ʿadhābu Allāh baghtahan ʾaw jahrahan hal yuhlaku ʾillā al-qawmu aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Think: if the punishment of God should come to you, by surprise or openly, would anyone but the evildoers be destroyed?’
verses.pickthall: Say: Can ye see yourselves, if the punishment of Allah come upon you unawares or openly? Would any perish save wrongdoing folk?

verses.ar: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۖ فَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.en: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
verses.tr: wamā nursilu al-mursalīna ʾillā mubashirīna wamundhirīna ۖ faman āmana wa-aṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We send messengers only to give good news and to warn, so for those who believe and do good deeds there will be no fear, nor will they grieve.
verses.pickthall: We send not the messengers save as bearers of good news and warners. Whoso believeth and doeth right, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verses.en: But those who deny Our verses - the punishment will touch them for their defiant disobedience.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā yamassuhumu al-ʿadhābu bimā kānūā yafsuqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who rejected Our signs, torment will afflict them as a result of their defiance.
verses.pickthall: But as for those who deny Our revelations, torment will afflict them for that they used to disobey.

verses.ar: قُل لَّآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ إِنِّى مَلَكٌ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allāh or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Then will you not give thought?"
verses.tr: qul llā ʾaqūlu lakum ʿindā khazāʾinu Allāh walā ʾaʿlamu al-ghayba walā ʾaqūlu lakum ʾinnā malakun ۖ ʾin ʾattabiʿu ʾillā mā yūḥā ʾilāa ۚ qul hal yastawā al-ʾaʿmā wa-l-baṣīru ۚ ʾafalā tatafakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I do not have the treasures of God, nor do I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me.’ Say, ‘Is a blind person like one who can see? Why will you not reflect?’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): I say not unto you (that) I possess the treasures of Allah, nor that I have knowledge of the Unseen; and I say not unto you: Lo! I am an angel. I follow only that which is inspired in me. Say: Are the blind man and the seer equal? Will ye not then take thought?

verses.ar: وَأَنذِرْ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَن يُحْشَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۙ لَيْسَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ وَلِىٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And warn by it [i.e., the Qur’ān] those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord - for them besides Him will be no protector and no intercessor - that they might become righteous.
verses.tr: wa-andhir bihi adh-dhīna yakhāfūna ʾan yuḥsharūā ʾilā rabbihim ۙ laysa lahum mmin dūnihi walāun walā shafīʿun llaʿallahum yattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Use the Quran to warn those who fear being gathered before their Lord- they will have no one but Him to protect them and no one to intercede- so that they may beware.
verses.pickthall: Warn hereby those who fear (because they know) that they will be gathered unto their Lord, for whom there is no protecting ally nor intercessor beside Him, that they may ward off (evil).

verses.ar: وَلَا تَطْرُدِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ ۖ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And do not send away those who call upon their Lord morning and afternoon, seeking His face [i.e., favor]. Not upon you is anything of their account and not upon them is anything of your account. So were you to send them away, you would [then] be of the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: walā taṭrudi adh-dhīna yadʿūna rabbahum bi-l-ghadawāhi wa-l-ʿashāi yurīdūna wajhahu ۖ mā ʿalayka min ḥisābihim mmin shāʾin wamā min ḥisābika ʿalayhim mmin shāʾin fataṭrudahum fatakūna mina aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not drive away those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking nothing but His Face. You are in no way accountable for them, nor they for you; if you drove the believers away, you would become one of the evildoers.
verses.pickthall: Repel not those who call upon their Lord at morn and evening, seeking His Countenance. Thou art not accountable for them in aught, nor are they accountable for thee in aught, that thou shouldst repel them and be of the wrong-doers.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُولُوٓا۟ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنۢ بَيْنِنَآ ۗ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: And thus We have tried some of them through others that they [i.e., the disbelievers] might say, "Is it these whom Allāh has favored among us?" Is not Allāh most knowing of those who are grateful?
verses.tr: wakadhālika fatannā baʿḍahum bibaʿḍin lliyaqūlūā ʾahāʾulāʾi manna Allāh ʿalayhim mmin bayninā ۗ ʾalaysa Allāh biʾaʿlama bi-ash-shākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have made some of them a test for others, to make the disbelievers say, ‘Is it these men that God has favoured among us?’ Does God not know best who are the grateful ones?
verses.pickthall: And even so do We try some of them by others, that they say: Are these they whom Allah favoureth among us? Is not Allah best Aware of the thanksgivers?

verses.ar: وَإِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ ۖ أَنَّهُۥ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنكُمْ سُوٓءًۢا بِجَهَـٰلَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And when those come to you who believe in Our verses, say, "Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed upon Himself mercy: that any of you who does wrong out of ignorance and then repents after that and corrects himself - indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.tr: wa-idhā jāʾaka adh-dhīna yuʾminūna bāyātinā faqul salāmun ʿalaykum ۖ kataba rabbukum ʿalā nafsihi ar-raḥmaha ۖ ʾannahu man ʿamila minkum sūʾanā bijahālahin thumma tāba min baʿdihi wa-aṣlaḥa fa-annahu ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When those who believe in Our revelations come to you [Prophet], say, ‘Peace be upon you. Your Lord has taken it on Himself to be merciful: if any of you has foolishly done a bad deed, and afterwards repented and mended his ways, God is most forgiving and most merciful.’
verses.pickthall: And when those who believe in Our revelations come unto thee, say: Peace be unto you! Your Lord hath prescribed for Himself mercy, that whoso of you doeth evil through ignorance and repenteth afterward thereof and doeth right, (for him) lo! He is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident.
verses.tr: wakadhālika nufaṣṣilu al-āyāti walitastabīna sabīlu al-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way We explain the revelations, so that the way for sinners may be made clear.
verses.pickthall: Thus do We expound the revelations that the way of the unrighteous may be manifest.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُل لَّآ أَتَّبِعُ أَهْوَآءَكُمْ ۙ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you invoke besides Allāh." Say, "I will not follow your desires, for I would then have gone astray, and I would not be of the [rightly] guided."
verses.tr: qul ʾinnā nuhītu ʾan ʾaʿbuda adh-dhīna tadʿūna min dūni Allāh ۚ qul llā ʾattabiʿu ʾahwāʾakum ۙ qad ḍalaltu ʾidhan wamā ʾanā mina al-muhtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I am forbidden to worship those you call on other than God.’ Say, ‘I will not follow your vain desires, for if I did, I would stray from the path and cease to be rightly guided.’
verses.pickthall: Say: I am forbidden to worship those on whom ye call instead of Allah. Say: I will not follow your desires, for then should I go astray and I should not be of the rightly guided.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّى عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَكَذَّبْتُم بِهِۦ ۚ مَا عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ ۖ يَقُصُّ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَـٰصِلِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, I am on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have that for which you are impatient. The decision is only for Allāh. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders."
verses.tr: qul ʾinnā ʿalā bayyinahin mmin rrabbā wakadhabtum bihi ۚ mā ʿindā mā tastaʿjilūna bihi ۚ ʾini al-ḥukmu ʾillā lillāh ۖ yaquṣṣu al-ḥaqqa ۖ wahuwa khayru al-fāṣilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I stand on clear proof from my Lord, though you deny it. What you seek to hasten is not within my power. Judgement is for God alone: He tells the truth, and He is the best of judges.’
verses.pickthall: Say: I am (relying) on clear proof from my Lord, while ye deny Him. I have not that for which ye are impatient. The decision is for Allah only. He telleth the truth and He is the Best of Deciders.

verses.ar: قُل لَّوْ أَنَّ عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦ لَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: Say, "If I had that for which you are impatient, the matter would have been decided between me and you, but Allāh is most knowing of the wrongdoers."
verses.tr: qul llaw ʾanna ʿindā mā tastaʿjilūna bihi laquḍāa al-ʾamru baynā wabaynakum ۗ wallāh ʾaʿlamu bi-aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘If what you seek to hasten were within my power, the matter would be settled between you and me, but God knows best who does wrong.’
verses.pickthall: Say: If I had that for which ye are impatient, then would the case (ere this) have been decided between me and you. Allah is Best Aware of the wrong-doers.

verses.ar: ۞ وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ ۚ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتِ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record.
verses.tr: ۞ waʿindahu mafātiḥu al-ghaybi lā yaʿlamuhā ʾillā huwa ۚ wayaʿlamu mā fā al-barri wa-l-baḥri ۚ wamā tasquṭu min waraqahin ʾillā yaʿlamuhā walā ḥabbahin fā ẓulumāti al-ʾarḍi walā raṭbin walā yābisin ʾillā fā kitābin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: He has the keys to the unseen: no one knows them but Him. He knows all that is in the land and sea. No leaf falls without His knowledge, nor is there a single grain in the darkness of the earth, or anything, fresh or withered, that is not written in a clear Record.
verses.pickthall: And with Him are the keys of the Invisible. None but He knoweth them. And He knoweth what is in the land and the sea. Not a leaf falleth but He knoweth it, not a grain amid the darkness of the earth, naught of wet or dry but (it is noted) in a clear record.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُم بِٱلنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ لِيُقْضَىٰٓ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day. Then He revives you therein [i.e., by day] that a specified term may be fulfilled. Then to Him will be your return; then He will inform you about what you used to do.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā yatawaffākum bi-l-yli wayaʿlamu mā jaraḥtum bi-an-nahāri thumma yabʿathukum fīhi liyuqḍā ʾajalun mmusammanā ۖ thumma ʾilayhi marjiʿukum thumma yunabbiʾukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who calls your souls back by night, knowing what you have done by day, then raises you up again in the daytime until your fixed term is fulfilled. It is to Him that you will return in the end, and He will tell you what you have done.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who gathereth you at night and knoweth that which ye commit by day. Then He raiseth you again to life therein, that the term appointed (for you) may be accomplished. And afterward unto Him is your return. Then He will proclaim unto you what ye used to do.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمْ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ
verses.en: And He is the subjugator over His servants, and He sends over you guardian-angels until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers [i.e., angels of death] take him, and they do not fail [in their duties].
verses.tr: wahuwa al-qāhiru fawqa ʿibādihi ۖ wayursilu ʿalaykum ḥafaẓahan ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾa ʾaḥadakumu al-mawtu tawaffathu rusulunā wahum lā yufarriṭūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He is the Supreme Master over His subjects. He sends out recorders to watch over you until, when death overtakes any of you, those sent by Us take his soul- they never fail in their duty.
verses.pickthall: He is the Omnipotent over His slaves. He sendeth guardians over you until, when death cometh unto one of you, Our messengers receive him, and they neglect not.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ رُدُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوْلَىٰهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ ٱلْحَـٰسِبِينَ
verses.en: Then they [i.e., His servants] are returned to Allāh, their true Lord. Unquestionably, His is the judgement, and He is the swiftest of accountants.
verses.tr: thumma ruddūā ʾilā Allāh mawlāhumu al-ḥaqqi ۚ ʾalā lahu al-ḥukmu wahuwa ʾasraʿu al-ḥāsibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then they will all be returned to God, their true Lord. The Judgement truly belongs to Him, and He is the swiftest of reckoners.
verses.pickthall: Then are they restored unto Allah, their Lord, the Just. Surely His is the judgment. And He is the most swift of reckoners.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَن يُنَجِّيكُم مِّن ظُلُمَـٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُۥ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً لَّئِنْ أَنجَىٰنَا مِنْ هَـٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Who rescues you from the darknesses of the land and sea [when] you call upon Him imploring [aloud] and privately, 'If He should save us from this [crisis], we will surely be among the thankful.'"
verses.tr: qul man yunajjīkum mmin ẓulumāti al-barri wa-l-baḥri tadʿūnahu taḍarruʿan wakhufyahan llaʾin ʾanjānā min hādhihi lanakūnanna mina ash-shākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Who is it that saves you from the dark depths of land and sea when you humbly and secretly call to Him [and say], “If He rescues us from this, We shall truly be thankful”?’
verses.pickthall: Say: Who delivereth you from the darkness of the land and the sea? Ye call upon Him humbly and in secret, (saying): If we are delivered from this (fear) we truly will be of the thankful.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُم مِّنْهَا وَمِن كُلِّ كَرْبٍ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: Say, "It is Allāh who saves you from it and from every distress; then you [still] associate others with Him."
verses.tr: quli Allāh yunajjīkum mminhā wamin kulli karbin thumma ʾantum tushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘God rescues you from this and every distress; yet still you worship others beside Him.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Allah delivereth you from this and from all affliction. Yet ye attribute partners unto Him.

verses.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُم بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.en: Say, "He is the [one] Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you [so you become] sects and make you taste the violence of one another." Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand.
verses.tr: qul huwa al-qādiru ʿalā ʾan yabʿatha ʿalaykum ʿadhāban mmin fawqikum ʾaw min taḥti ʾarjulikum ʾaw yalbisakum shiyaʿan wayudhīqa baʿḍakum baʾsa baʿḍin ۗ ānẓur kayfa nuṣarrifu al-āyāti laʿallahum yafqahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘He has power to send punishment on you from above or from under your very feet, or to divide you into discordant factions and make some taste the violence of others.’ See how We explain Our revelation in various ways, so that they may understand,
verses.pickthall: Say: He is able to send punishment upon you from above you or from beneath your feet, or to bewilder you with dissension and make you taste the tyranny one of another. See how We display the revelations so that they may understand.

verses.ar: وَكَذَّبَ بِهِۦ قَوْمُكَ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ قُل لَّسْتُ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍ
verses.en: But your people have denied it while it is the truth. Say, "I am not over you a manager [i.e., authority]."
verses.tr: wakadhaba bihi qawmuka wahuwa al-ḥaqqu ۚ qul llastu ʿalaykum biwakīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: yet your people still reject it even though it is the truth. Say, ‘I have not been put in charge of you.
verses.pickthall: Thy people (O Muhammad) have denied it, though it is the Truth. Say: I am not put in charge of you.

verses.ar: لِّكُلِّ نَبَإٍ مُّسْتَقَرٌّ ۚ وَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: For every news [i.e., happening] is a finality; and you are going to know.
verses.tr: llikulli nabaʾin mmustaqarrun ۚ wasawfa taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Every prophecy has its fixed time to be fulfilled: you will come to realize this.’
verses.pickthall: For every announcement there is a term, and ye will come to know.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُوا۟ فِى حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِۦ ۚ وَإِمَّا يُنسِيَنَّكَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And when you see those who engage in [offensive] discourse concerning Our verses, then turn away from them until they enter into another conversation. And if Satan should cause you to forget, then do not remain after the reminder with the wrongdoing people.
verses.tr: wa-idhā raʾayta adh-dhīna yakhūḍūna fā āyātinā fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum ḥattā yakhūḍūā fā ḥadīthin ghayrihi ۚ wa-immā yunsiyannaka ash-shayṭānu falā taqʿud baʿda adh-dhikrā maʿa al-qawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When you come across people who speak with scorn about Our revelations, turn away from them until they move on to another topic. If Satan should make you forget, then, when you have remembered, do not sit with those who are doing wrong.
verses.pickthall: And when thou seest those who meddle with Our revelations, withdraw from them until they meddle with another topic. And if the devil cause thee to forget, sit not, after the remembrance, with the congregation of wrong-doers.

verses.ar: وَمَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَلَـٰكِن ذِكْرَىٰ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And those who fear Allāh are not held accountable for them [i.e., the disbelievers] at all, but [only for] a reminder - that perhaps they will fear Him.
verses.tr: wamā ʿalā adh-dhīna yattaqūna min ḥisābihim mmin shāʾin walākin dhikrā laʿallahum yattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The righteous are not in any way held accountable for the wrongdoers; their only duty is to remind them, so that they may be mindful of God.
verses.pickthall: Those who ward off (evil) are not accountable for them in aught, but the Reminder (must be given them) that haply they (too) may ward off (evil).

verses.ar: وَذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًا وَلَهْوًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَذَكِّرْ بِهِۦٓ أَن تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِىٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ وَإِن تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍ لَّا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَآ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُبْسِلُوا۟ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۖ لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: And leave those who take their religion as amusement and diversion and whom the worldly life has deluded. But remind with it [i.e., the Qur’ān], lest a soul be given up to destruction for what it earned; it will have other than Allāh no protector and no intercessor. And if it should offer every compensation, it would not be taken from it [i.e., that soul]. Those are the ones who are given to destruction for what they have earned. For them will be a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment because they used to disbelieve.
verses.tr: wadhari adh-dhīna āttakhadhūā dīnahum laʿiban walahwan wagharrathumu al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā ۚ wadhakkir bihi ʾan tubsala nafsun bimā kasabat laysa lahā min dūni Allāh walāun walā shafīʿun wa-in taʿdil kulla ʿadlin llā yuʾkhadh minhā ۗ ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna ʾubsilūā bimā kasabūā ۖ lahum sharābun mmin ḥamīmin waʿadhābun ʾalīmun bimā kānūā yakfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Leave to themselves those who take their religion for a mere game and distraction and are deceived by the life of this world, but continue to remind them with the [Quran], lest any soul be damned by what it has done- it will have no one to protect it from God and no one to intercede; whatever ransom it may offer will not be accepted. Such are those who are damned by their own actions: they will have boil-ing water to drink and a painful punishment, because they used to defy [God].
verses.pickthall: And forsake those who take their religion for a pastime and a jest, and whom the life of the world beguileth. Remind (mankind) hereby lest a soul be destroyed by what it earneth. It hath beside Allah no protecting ally nor intercessor, and though it offer every compensation it will not be accepted from it. Those are they who perish by their own deserts. For them is drink of boiling water and a painful doom, because they disbelieved.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَنَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُنَا وَلَا يَضُرُّنَا وَنُرَدُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَابِنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ كَٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَهْوَتْهُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ حَيْرَانَ لَهُۥٓ أَصْحَـٰبٌ يَدْعُونَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَى ٱئْتِنَا ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ هُوَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ ۖ وَأُمِرْنَا لِنُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Shall we invoke instead of Allāh that which neither benefits us nor harms us and be turned back on our heels after Allāh has guided us? [We would then be] like one whom the devils enticed [to wander] upon the earth confused, [while] he has companions inviting him to guidance, [calling], 'Come to us.'" Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allāh is the [only] guidance; and we have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: qul ʾanadʿūā min dūni Allāh mā lā yanfaʿunā walā yaḍurrunā wanuraddu ʿalā ʾaʿqābinā baʿda ʾidh hadānā Allāh ka-adh-dhā āstahwathu ash-shayāṭīnu fā al-ʾarḍi ḥayrāna lahu ʾaṣḥābun yadʿūnahu ʾilā al-hudā āʾtinā ۗ qul ʾinna hudā Allāh huwa al-hudā ۖ wa-umirnā linuslima lirabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Instead of God, are we to call on what neither profits nor harms us? [Are we to] turn on our heels after God has guided us, like someone bewildered, having been tempted by devils into a desert ravine, though his companions call him to guidance [saying], “Come to us”?’ Say, ‘God’s guidance is the true guidance. We are commanded to devote ourselves to the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.pickthall: Say: Shall we cry, instead of unto Allah, unto that which neither profiteth us nor hurteth us, and shall we turn back after Allah hath guided us, like one bewildered whom the devils have infatuated in the earth, who hath companions who invite him to the guidance (saying): Come unto us? Say: Lo! the guidance of Allah is Guidance, and we are ordered to surrender to the Lord of the Worlds,

verses.ar: وَأَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: And to establish prayer and fear Him." And it is He to whom you will be gathered.
verses.tr: wa-an ʾaqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha wāttaqūhu ۚ wahuwa adh-dhā ʾilayhi tuḥsharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: to establish regular prayers and be mindful of Him.’ It is to Him that you will all be gathered.
verses.pickthall: And to establish worship and be dutiful to Him, and He it is unto Whom ye will be gathered.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ كُن فَيَكُونُ ۚ قَوْلُهُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.en: And it is He who created the heavens and earth in truth. And the day [i.e., whenever] He says, "Be," and it is, His word is the truth. And His is the dominion [on] the Day the Horn is blown. [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed; and He is the Wise, the Aware.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa bi-l-ḥaqqi ۖ wayawma yaqūlu kun fayakūnu ۚ qawluhu al-ḥaqqu ۚ walahu al-mulku yawma yunfakhu fā aṣ-ṣūri ۚ ʿālimu al-ghaybi wa-ash-shahādahi ۚ wahuwa al-ḥakīmu al-khabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who created the heavens and the earth for a true purpose. On the Day when He says, ‘Be,’ it will be: His word is the truth. All control on the Day the Trumpet is blown belongs to Him. He knows the seen and the unseen: He is the All Wise, the All Aware.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in truth. In the day when He saith: Be! it is. His Word is the Truth, and His will be the Sovereignty on the day when the trumpet is blown. Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, He is the Wise, the Aware.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ ءَازَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصْنَامًا ءَالِهَةً ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father Āzar, "Do you take idols as deities? Indeed, I see you and your people to be in manifest error."
verses.tr: ۞ wa-idh qāla ʾibrāhīmu liʾabīhi āzara ʾatattakhidhu ʾaṣnāman ālihahan ۖ ʾinnā ʾarāka waqawmaka fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when Abraham said to his father, Azar, ‘How can you take idols as gods? I see that you and your people have clearly gone astray.’
verses.pickthall: (Remember) when Abraham said unto his father Azar: Takest thou idols for gods? Lo! I see thee and thy folk in error manifest.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.en: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith].
verses.tr: wakadhālika nurā ʾibrāhīma malakūta as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi waliyakūna mina al-mūqinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way We showed Abraham [God’s] mighty dominion over the heavens and the earth, so that he might be a firm believer.
verses.pickthall: Thus did We show Abraham the kingdom of the heavens and the earth that he might be of those possessing certainty:

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلَّيْلُ رَءَا كَوْكَبًا ۖ قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَبِّى ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَآ أُحِبُّ ٱلْـَٔافِلِينَ
verses.en: So when the night covered him [with darkness], he saw a star. He said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "I like not those that set [i.e., disappear]."
verses.tr: falammā janna ʿalayhi al-ylu raā kawkaban ۖ qāla hādhā rabbā ۖ falammā ʾafala qāla lā ʾuḥibbu al-āfilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the night grew dark over him he saw a star and said, ‘This is my Lord,’ but when it set, he said, ‘I do not like things that set.’
verses.pickthall: When the night grew dark upon him he beheld a star. He said: This is my Lord. But when it set, he said: I love not things that set.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْقَمَرَ بَازِغًا قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَبِّى ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمْ يَهْدِنِى رَبِّى لَأَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.en: And when he saw the moon rising, he said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "Unless my Lord guides me, I will surely be among the people gone astray."
verses.tr: falammā raā al-qamara bāzighan qāla hādhā rabbā ۖ falammā ʾafala qāla laʾin llam yahdinā rabbā laʾakūnanna mina al-qawmi aḍ-ḍāllīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And when he saw the moon rising he said, ‘This is my Lord,’ but when it too set, he said, ‘If my Lord does not guide me, I shall be one of those who go astray.’
verses.pickthall: And when he saw the moon uprising, he exclaimed: This is my Lord. But when it set, he said: Unless my Lord guide me, I surely shall become one of the folk who are astray.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلشَّمْسَ بَازِغَةً قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَبِّى هَـٰذَآ أَكْبَرُ ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَتْ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: And when he saw the sun rising, he said, "This is my lord; this is greater." But when it set, he said, "O my people, indeed I am free from what you associate with Allāh.
verses.tr: falammā raā ash-shamsa bāzighahan qāla hādhā rabbā hādhā ʾakbaru ۖ falammā ʾafalat qāla yāqawmi ʾinnā barāʾun mmimmā tushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then he saw the sun rising and cried, ‘This is my Lord! This is greater.’ But when the sun set, he said, ‘My people, I disown all that you worship beside God.
verses.pickthall: And when he saw the sun uprising, he cried: This is my Lord! This is greater! And when it set he exclaimed: O my people! Lo! I am free from all that ye associate (with Him).

verses.ar: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh."
verses.tr: ʾinnā wajjahtu wajhāa lilladhā faṭara as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa ḥanīfan ۖ wamā ʾanā mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I have turned my face as a true believer towards Him who created the heavens and the earth. I am not one of the polytheists.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! I have turned my face toward Him Who created the heavens and the earth, as one by nature upright, and I am not of the idolaters.

verses.ar: وَحَآجَّهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ ۚ قَالَ أَتُحَـٰٓجُّوٓنِّى فِى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنِ ۚ وَلَآ أَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ رَبِّى شَيْـًٔا ۗ وَسِعَ رَبِّى كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا ۗ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And his people argued with him. He said, "Do you argue with me concerning Allāh while He has guided me? And I fear not what you associate with Him [and will not be harmed] unless my Lord should will something. My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge; then will you not remember?
verses.tr: waḥājjahu qawmuhu ۚ qāla ʾatuḥājjūnnā fā Allāh waqad hadāni ۚ walā ʾakhāfu mā tushrikūna bihi ʾillā ʾan yashāʾa rabbā shayā ۗ wasiʿa rabbā kulla shāʾin ʿilman ۗ ʾafalā tatadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: His people argued with him, and he said, ‘How can you argue with me about God when He has guided me? I do not fear anything you associate with Him: unless my Lord wills [nothing can happen]. My Lord encompasses everything in His knowledge. How can you not take heed?
verses.pickthall: His people argued with him. He said: Dispute ye with me concerning Allah when He hath guided me? I fear not at all that which ye set up beside Him unless my Lord willeth aught. My Lord includeth all things in His knowledge. Will ye not then remember?

verses.ar: وَكَيْفَ أَخَافُ مَآ أَشْرَكْتُمْ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُم بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنًا ۚ فَأَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِٱلْأَمْنِ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And how should I fear what you associate while you do not fear that you have associated with Allāh that for which He has not sent down to you any authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you should know?"
verses.tr: wakayfa ʾakhāfu mā ʾashraktum walā takhāfūna ʾannakum ʾashraktum billāh mā lam yunazzil bihi ʿalaykum sulṭānan ۚ fau al-farīqayni ʾaḥaqqu bi-l-ʾamni ۖ ʾin kuntum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why should I fear what you associate with Him? Why do you not fear to associate with Him things for which He has sent you no authority? Tell me, if you know the answer, which side has more right to feel secure?
verses.pickthall: How should I fear that which ye set up beside Him, when ye fear not to set up beside Allah that for which He hath revealed unto you no warrant? Which of the two factions hath more right to safety? (Answer me that) if ye have knowledge.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنَهُم بِظُلْمٍ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلْأَمْنُ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: They who believe and do not mix their belief with injustice - those will have security, and they are [rightly] guided.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna āmanūā walam yalbisūā ʾīmānahum biẓulmin ʾūlāʾika lahumu al-ʾamnu wahum mmuhtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is those who have faith, and do not mix their faith with idolatry, who will be secure, and it is they who are rightly guided.’
verses.pickthall: Those who believe and obscure not their belief by wrongdoing, theirs is safety; and they are rightly guided.

verses.ar: وَتِلْكَ حُجَّتُنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَـٰتٍ مَّن نَّشَآءُ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And that was Our [conclusive] argument which We gave Abraham against his people. We raise by degrees whom We will. Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing.
verses.tr: watilka ḥujjatunā ātaynāhā ʾibrāhīma ʿalā qawmihi ۚ narfaʿu darajātin mman nnashāʾu ۗ ʾinna rabbaka ḥakīmun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Such was the argument We gave to Abraham against his people- We raise in rank whoever We will- your Lord is all wise, all knowing.
verses.pickthall: That is Our argument. We gave it unto Abraham against his folk. We raise unto degrees of wisdom whom We will. Lo! thy Lord is Wise, Aware.

verses.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۚ كُلًّا هَدَيْنَا ۚ وَنُوحًا هَدَيْنَا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِۦ دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُوسُفَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And We gave to him [i.e., Abraham] Isaac and Jacob - all [of them] We guided. And Noah, We guided before; and among his descendants, David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus do We reward the doers of good.
verses.tr: wawahabnā lahu ʾisḥāqa wayaʿqūba ۚ kullan hadaynā ۚ wanūḥan hadaynā min qablu ۖ wamin dhurriyyatihi dāwuda wasulaymāna wa-ayyūba wayūsufa wamūsā wahārūna ۚ wakadhālika najzā al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave him Isaac and Jacob, each of whom We guided, as We had guided Noah before, and among his descendants were David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses, and Aaron- in this way We reward those who do good-
verses.pickthall: And We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob; each of them We guided; and Noah did We guide aforetime; and of his seed (We guided) David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus do We reward the good.

verses.ar: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous.
verses.tr: wazakariyyā wayaḥyā waʿīsā wa-āsa ۖ kullun mmina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Zachariah, John, Jesus, and Elijah- every one of them was righteous-
verses.pickthall: And Zachariah and John and Jesus and Elias. Each one (of them) was of the righteous.

verses.ar: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطًا ۚ وَكُلًّا فَضَّلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds.
verses.tr: wa-ismāʿīla wa-l-yasaʿa wayūnusa walūṭan ۚ wakullan faḍḍalnā ʿalā al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah, and Lot. We favoured each one of them over other people,
verses.pickthall: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot. Each one (of them) did We prefer above (Our) creatures,

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمْ وَإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ ۖ وَٱجْتَبَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: And [some] among their fathers and their descendants and their brothers - and We chose them and We guided them to a straight path.
verses.tr: wamin ābāʾihim wadhurriyyātihim wa-ikhwānihim ۖ wājtabaynāhum wahadaynāhum ʾilā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: and also some of their forefathers, their offspring, and their brothers: We chose them and guided them on a straight path.
verses.pickthall: With some of their forefathers and their offspring and their brethren; and We chose them and guided them unto a straight path.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَلَوْ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whomever He wills of His servants. But if they had associated others with Allāh, then worthless for them would be whatever they were doing.
verses.tr: dhālika hudā Allāh yahdā bihi man yashāʾu min ʿibādihi ۚ walaw ʾashrakūā laḥabiṭa ʿanhum mmā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Such is God’s guidance, with which He guides whichever of His servants He will. If they had associated other gods with Him, all their deeds would have come to nothing.
verses.pickthall: Such is the guidance of Allah wherewith He guideth whom He will of His bondmen. But if they had set up (for worship) aught beside Him, (all) that they did would have been vain.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ ۚ فَإِن يَكْفُرْ بِهَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ فَقَدْ وَكَّلْنَا بِهَا قَوْمًا لَّيْسُوا۟ بِهَا بِكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: Those are the ones to whom We gave the Scripture and authority and prophethood. But if they [i.e., the disbelievers] deny it, then We have entrusted it to a people who are not therein disbelievers.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna ātaynāhumu al-kitāba wa-l-ḥukma wa-an-nubuwwaha ۚ fa-in yakfur bihā hāʾulāʾi faqad wakkalnā bihā qawman llaysūā bihā bikāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those are the ones to whom We gave the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood. Even if these people now disbelieve in them, We have entrusted them to others who do not disbelieve.
verses.pickthall: Those are they unto whom We gave the Scripture and command and prophethood. But if these disbelieve therein, then indeed We shall entrust it to a people who will not be disbelievers therein.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقْتَدِهْ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Those are the ones whom Allāh has guided, so from their guidance take an example. Say, "I ask of you for it [i.e., this message] no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds."
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna hadā Allāh ۖ fabihudāhumu āqtadih ۗ qul llā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi ʾajran ۖ ʾin huwa ʾillā dhikrā lilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those were the people God guided, ‘[Prophet], follow the guidance they received.’ Say, ‘I ask no reward for it from you: it is a lesson for all people.’
verses.pickthall: Those are they whom Allah guideth, so follow their guidance. Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for it. Lo! it is naught but a Reminder to (His) creatures.

verses.ar: وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ بَشَرٍ مِّن شَىْءٍ ۗ قُلْ مَنْ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِهِۦ مُوسَىٰ نُورًا وَهُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ ۖ تَجْعَلُونَهُۥ قَرَاطِيسَ تُبْدُونَهَا وَتُخْفُونَ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَعُلِّمْتُم مَّا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنتُمْ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ ذَرْهُمْ فِى خَوْضِهِمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.en: And they did not appraise Allāh with true appraisal when they said, "Allāh did not reveal to a human being anything." Say, "Who revealed the Scripture that Moses brought as light and guidance to the people? You [Jews] make it into pages, disclosing [some of] it and concealing much. And you were taught that which you knew not - neither you nor your fathers." Say, "Allāh [revealed it]." Then leave them in their [empty] discourse, amusing themselves.
verses.tr: wamā qadarūā Allāh ḥaqqa qadrihi ʾidh qālūā mā ʾanzala Allāh ʿalā basharin mmin shāʾin ۗ qul man ʾanzala al-kitāba adh-dhā jāʾa bihi mūsā nūran wahudanā llilnnāsi ۖ tajʿalūnahu qarāṭīsa tubdūnahā watukhfūna kathīran ۖ waʿullimtum mmā lam taʿlamūā ʾantum walā ābāʾukum ۖ quli Allāh ۖ thumma dharhum fā khawḍihim yalʿabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They have no grasp of God’s true measure when they say, ‘God has sent nothing down to a mere mortal.’ Say, ‘Who was it who sent down the Scripture, which Moses brought as a light and a guide to people, which you made into separate sheets, showing some but hiding many? You were taught things that neither you nor your forefathers had known.’ Say, ‘God [sent it down],’ then leave them engrossed in their vain talk.
verses.pickthall: And they measure not the power of Allah its true measure when they say: Allah hath naught revealed unto a human being. Say (unto the Jews who speak thus): Who revealed the Book which Moses brought, a light and guidance for mankind, which ye have put on parchments which ye show, but ye hide much (thereof), and (by which) ye were taught that which ye knew not yourselves nor (did) your fathers (know it)? Say: Allah. Then leave them to their play of cavilling.

verses.ar: وَهَـٰذَا كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ مُبَارَكٌ مُّصَدِّقُ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلِتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.en: And this is a Book which We have sent down, blessed and confirming what was before it, that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and they are maintaining their prayers.
verses.tr: wahādhā kitābun ʾanzalnāhu mubārakun mmuṣaddiqu adh-dhā bayna yadayhi walitundhira ʾumma al-qurā waman ḥawlahā ۚ wa-adh-dhīna yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi yuʾminūna bihi ۖ wahum ʿalā ṣalātihim yuḥāfiẓūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a blessed Scripture that We have sent down to confirm what came before it and for you to warn the Mother of Cities and all around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter believe in this Scripture, and do not neglect their prayers.
verses.pickthall: And this is a blessed Scripture which We have revealed, confirming that which (was revealed) before it, that thou mayst warn the Mother of Villages and those around her. Those who believe in the Hereafter believe herein, and they are careful of their worship.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ قَالَ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثْلَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ فِى غَمَرَٰتِ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ بَاسِطُوٓا۟ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمُ ۖ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَكُنتُمْ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.en: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh or says, "It has been inspired to me," while nothing has been inspired to him, and one who says, "I will reveal [something] like what Allāh revealed." And if you could but see when the wrongdoers are in the overwhelming pangs of death while the angels extend their hands, [saying], "Discharge your souls! Today you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation for what you used to say against Allāh other than the truth and [that] you were, toward His verses, being arrogant."
verses.tr: waman ʾaẓlamu mimmani āftarā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban ʾaw qāla ʾūḥāa ʾilāa walam yūḥa ʾilayhi shāʾun waman qāla saʾunzilu mithla mā ʾanzala Allāh ۗ walaw tarā ʾidhi aẓ-ẓālimūna fā ghamarāti al-mawti wa-l-malāʾikahu bāsiṭūā ʾaydīhim ʾakhrijūā ʾanfusakumu ۖ al-yawma tujzawna ʿadhāba al-hūni bimā kuntum taqūlūna ʿalā Allāh ghayra al-ḥaqqi wakuntum ʿan āyātihi tastakbirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who could be more wicked than someone who invents a lie against God, or claims, ‘A revelation has come to me,’ when no revelation has been sent to him, or says, ‘I too can reveal something equal to God’s revelation’? If you could only see the wicked in their death agonies, as the angels stretch out their hands [to them], saying, ‘Give up your souls. Today you will be repaid with a humiliating punishment for saying false things about God and for arrogantly rejecting His revelations.’
verses.pickthall: Who is guilty of more wrong than he who forgeth a lie against Allah, or saith: I am inspired, when he is not inspired in aught; and who saith: I will reveal the like of that which Allah hath revealed? If thou couldst see, when the wrong-doers reach the pangs of death and the angels stretch their hands out (saying): Deliver up your souls. This day ye are awarded doom of degradation for that ye spake concerning Allah other than the truth, and used to scorn His portents.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا فُرَٰدَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَتَرَكْتُم مَّا خَوَّلْنَـٰكُمْ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِكُمْ ۖ وَمَا نَرَىٰ مَعَكُمْ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّهُمْ فِيكُمْ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۚ لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنكُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
verses.en: [It will be said to them], "And you have certainly come to Us alone [i.e., individually] as We created you the first time, and you have left whatever We bestowed upon you behind you. And We do not see with you your 'intercessors' which you claimed that they were among you associates [of Allāh]. It has [all] been severed between you, and lost from you is what you used to claim."
verses.tr: walaqad jiʾtumūnā furādā kamā khalaqnākum ʾawwala marrahin wataraktum mmā khawwalnākum warāʾa ẓuhūrikum ۖ wamā narā maʿakum shufaʿāʾakumu adh-dhīna zaʿamtum ʾannahum fīkum shurakā ۚ laqad ttaqaṭṭaʿa baynakum waḍalla ʿankum mmā kuntum tazʿumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [God will say], ‘Now you return to Us, alone, as We first created you: you have left behind everything We gave you, nor do We see those intercessors of yours that you claimed were partners of God. All the bonds between you have been severed, and those about whom you made such claims have deserted you.’
verses.pickthall: Now have ye come unto Us solitary as We did create you at the first, and ye have left behind you all that We bestowed upon you, and We behold not with you those your intercessors, of whom ye claimed that they possessed a share in you. Now is the bond between you severed, and that which ye presumed hath failed you.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَالِقُ ٱلْحَبِّ وَٱلنَّوَىٰ ۖ يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَمُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتِ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh is the cleaver of grain and date seeds. He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living. That is Allāh; so how are you deluded?
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinna Allāh fa-l-qu al-ḥabbi wa-an-nawā ۖ yukhriju al-ḥāa mina al-mayyiti wamukhriju al-mayyiti mina al-ḥāi ۚ dhālikumu Allāh ۖ fa-annā tuʾfakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who splits open the seed and the fruit stone: He brings out the living from the dead and the dead from the living- that is God- so how can you turn away from the truth?
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah (it is) Who splitteth the grain of corn and the date-stone (for sprouting). He bringeth forth the living from the dead, and is the bringer-forth of the dead from the living. Such is Allah. How then are ye perverted?

verses.ar: فَالِقُ ٱلْإِصْبَاحِ وَجَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ سَكَنًا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.en: [He is] the cleaver of daybreak and has made the night for rest and the sun and moon for calculation. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.tr: fa-l-qu al-ʾiṣbāḥi wajaʿala al-yla sakanan wa-ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara ḥusbānan ۚ dhālika taqdīru al-ʿazīzi al-ʿalīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: He makes the dawn break; He makes the night for rest; and He made the sun and the moon to a precise measure. That is the design of the Almighty, the All Knowing.
verses.pickthall: He is the Cleaver of the Daybreak, and He hath appointed the night for stillness, and the sun and the moon for reckoning. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلنُّجُومَ لِتَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهَا فِى ظُلُمَـٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ ۗ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who placed for you the stars that you may be guided by them through the darknesses of the land and sea. We have detailed the signs for a people who know.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā jaʿala lakumu an-nujūma litahtadūā bihā fā ẓulumāti al-barri wa-l-baḥri ۗ qad faṣṣalnā al-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who made the stars, so that they can guide you when land and sea are dark: We have made the signs clear for those who have knowledge.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who hath set for you the stars that ye may guide your course by them amid the darkness of the land and the sea. We have detailed Our revelations for a people who have knowledge.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ فَمُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمُسْتَوْدَعٌ ۗ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who produced you from one soul and [gave you] a place of dwelling and of storage. We have detailed the signs for a people who understand.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā ʾanshaʾakum mmin nnafsin wāḥidahin famustaqarrun wamustawdaʿun ۗ qad faṣṣalnā al-āyāti liqawmin yafqahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who first produced you from a single soul, then gave you a place to stay [in life] and a resting place [after death]. We have made Our revelations clear to those who understand.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who hath produced you from a single being, and (hath given you) a habitation and a repository. We have detailed Our revelations for a people who have understanding.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ نَبَاتَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهُ خَضِرًا نُّخْرِجُ مِنْهُ حَبًّا مُّتَرَاكِبًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّخْلِ مِن طَلْعِهَا قِنْوَانٌ دَانِيَةٌ وَجَنَّـٰتٍ مِّنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُشْتَبِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَـٰبِهٍ ۗ ٱنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَيَنْعِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكُمْ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby the growth of all things. We produce from it greenery from which We produce grains arranged in layers. And from the palm trees - of its emerging fruit are clusters hanging low. And [We produce] gardens of grapevines and olives and pomegranates, similar yet varied. Look at [each of] its fruit when it yields and [at] its ripening. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā ʾanzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan fa-akhrajnā bihi nabāta kulli shāʾin fa-akhrajnā minhu khaḍiran nnukhriju minhu ḥabban mmutarākiban wamina an-nakhli min ṭalʿihā qinwānun dāniyahun wajannātin mmin ʾaʿnābin wa-az-zaytūna wa-ar-rummāna mushtabihan waghayra mutashābihin ۗ ānẓurūā ʾilā thamarihi ʾidhā ʾathmara wayanʿihi ۚ ʾinna fā dhālikum lāyātin lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who sends down water from the sky. With it We produce the shoots of each plant, then bring greenery from it, and from that We bring out grains, one riding on the other in close-packed rows. From the date palm come clusters of low-hanging dates, and there are gardens of vines, olives, and pomegranates, alike yet different. Watch their fruits as they grow and ripen! In all this there are signs for those who would believe.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, and therewith We bring forth buds of every kind; We bring forth the green blade from which We bring forth the thick-clustered grain; and from the date-palm, from the pollen thereof, spring pendant bunches; and (We bring forth) gardens of grapes, and the olive and the pomegranate, alike and unlike. Look upon the fruit thereof, when they bear fruit, and upon its ripening. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who believe.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ٱلْجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمْ ۖ وَخَرَقُوا۟ لَهُۥ بَنِينَ وَبَنَـٰتٍۭ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.en: But they have attributed to Allāh partners - the jinn, while He has created them - and have fabricated for Him sons and daughters without knowledge. Exalted is He and high above what they describe.
verses.tr: wajaʿalūā lillāh shurakāʾa al-jinna wakhalaqahum ۖ wakharaqūā lahu banīna wabanātin bighayri ʿilmin ۚ subḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yaṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet they made the jinn partners with God, though He created them, and without any true knowledge they attribute sons and daughters to Him. Glory be to Him! He is far higher than what they ascribe to Him,
verses.pickthall: Yet they ascribe as partners unto Him the jinn, although He did create them, and impute falsely, without knowledge, sons and daughters unto Him. Glorified be He and High Exalted above (all) that they ascribe (unto Him).

verses.ar: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُۥ صَـٰحِبَةٌ ۖ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: [He is] Originator of the heavens and the earth. How could He have a son when He does not have a companion [i.e., wife] and He created all things? And He is, of all things, Knowing.
verses.tr: badīʿu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ ʾannā yakūnu lahu waladun walam takun llahu ṣāḥibahun ۖ wakhalaqa kulla shāʾin ۖ wahuwa bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: the Creator of the heavens and earth! How could He have children when He has no spouse, when He created all things, and has full knowledge of all things?
verses.pickthall: The Originator of the heavens and the earth! How can He have a child, when there is for Him no consort, when He created all things and is Aware of all things?

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
verses.en: That is Allāh, your Lord; there is no deity except Him, the Creator of all things, so worship Him. And He is Disposer of all things.
verses.tr: dhālikumu Allāh rabbukum ۖ lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۖ khāliqu kulli shāʾin fāʿbudūhu ۚ wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin wakīlun
verses.abdelhaleem: This is God, your Lord, there is no God but Him, the Creator of all things, so worship Him; He is in charge of everything.
verses.pickthall: Such is Allah, your Lord. There is no Allah save Him, the Creator of all things, so worship Him. And He taketh care of all things.

verses.ar: لَّا تُدْرِكُهُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.en: Vision perceives Him not, but He perceives [all] vision; and He is the Subtle, the Aware.
verses.tr: llā tudrikuhu al-ʾabṣāru wahuwa yudriku al-ʾabṣāra ۖ wahuwa al-laṭīfu al-khabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: No vision can take Him in, but He takes in all vision. He is the All Subtle, the All Aware.
verses.pickthall: Vision comprehendeth Him not, but He comprehendeth (all) vision. He is the Subtile, the Aware.

verses.ar: قَدْ جَآءَكُم بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَنْ أَبْصَرَ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِىَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ
verses.en: There has come to you enlightenment from your Lord. So whoever will see does so for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever is blind [does harm] against it. And [say], "I am not a guardian over you."
verses.tr: qad jāʾakum baṣāʾiru min rrabbikum ۖ faman ʾabṣara falinafsihi ۖ waman ʿamāa faʿalayhā ۚ wamā ʾanā ʿalaykum biḥafīẓin
verses.abdelhaleem: Now clear proof has come to you from your Lord: if anyone sees it, that will be to his advantage; if anyone is blind to it, that will be to his loss- [Say], ‘I am not your guardian.’
verses.pickthall: Proofs have come unto you from your Lord, so whoso seeth, it is for his own good, and whoso is blind is blind to his own hurt. And I am not a keeper over you.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَلِيَقُولُوا۟ دَرَسْتَ وَلِنُبَيِّنَهُۥ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And thus do We diversify the verses so they [i.e., the disbelievers] will say, "You have studied," and so We may make it [i.e., the Qur’ān] clear for a people who know.
verses.tr: wakadhālika nuṣarrifu al-āyāti waliyaqūlūā darasta walinubayyinahu liqawmin yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is how We explain Our revelations in various ways- though they will say, ‘You [Muhammad] have been studying’- to make them clear for those who know.
verses.pickthall: Thus do We display Our revelations that they may say (unto thee, Muhammad): "Thou hast studied," and that We may make (it) clear for people who have knowledge.

verses.ar: ٱتَّبِعْ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Follow, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you from your Lord - there is no deity except Him - and turn away from those who associate others with Allāh.
verses.tr: āttabiʿ mā ʾūḥāa ʾilayka min rrabbika ۖ lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۖ wa-aʿriḍ ʿani al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Follow what has been revealed to you from your Lord, there is no God but Him. Turn away from those who join other gods with Him.
verses.pickthall: Follow that which is inspired in thee from thy Lord; there is no Allah save Him; and turn away from the idolaters.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشْرَكُوا۟ ۗ وَمَا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
verses.en: But if Allāh had willed, they would not have associated. And We have not appointed you over them as a guardian, nor are you a manager over them.
verses.tr: walaw shāʾa Allāh mā ʾashrakūā ۗ wamā jaʿalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓan ۖ wamā ʾanta ʿalayhim biwakīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: If it had been God’s will, they would not have done so, but We have not made you their guardian, nor are you their keeper.
verses.pickthall: Had Allah willed, they had not been idolatrous. We have not set thee as a keeper over them, nor art thou responsible for them.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَسُبُّوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَسُبُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَدْوًۢا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَّا لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ عَمَلَهُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِم مَّرْجِعُهُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And do not insult those they invoke other than Allāh, lest they insult Allāh in enmity without knowledge. Thus We have made pleasing to every community their deeds. Then to their Lord is their return, and He will inform them about what they used to do.
verses.tr: walā tasubbūā adh-dhīna yadʿūna min dūni Allāh fayasubbūā Allāh ʿadwanā bighayri ʿilmin ۗ kadhālika zayyannā likulli ʾummahin ʿamalahum thumma ʾilā rabbihim mmarjiʿuhum fayunabbiʾuhum bimā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Believers], do not revile those they call on beside God in case they, in their hostility and ignorance, revile God. To each community We make their own actions seem alluring, but in the end they will return to their Lord and He will inform them of all they did.
verses.pickthall: Revile not those unto whom they pray beside Allah lest they wrongfully revile Allah through ignorance. Thus unto every nation have We made their deed seem fair. Then unto their Lord is their return, and He will tell them what they used to do.

verses.ar: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَةٌ لَّيُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهَا ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَا يُشْعِرُكُمْ أَنَّهَآ إِذَا جَآءَتْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths that if a sign came to them, they would surely believe in it. Say, "The signs are only with [i.e., from] Allāh." And what will make you perceive that even if it [i.e., a sign] came, they would not believe.
verses.tr: wa-aqsamūā billāh jahda ʾaymānihim laʾin jāʾathum āyahun llayuʾminunna bihā ۚ qul ʾinnamā al-āyātu ʿinda Allāh ۖ wamā yushʿirukum ʾannahā ʾidhā jāʾat lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They swear by God with their most solemn oaths that if a miraculous sign came to them they would believe in it. Say [Prophet], ‘Signs are in the power of God alone.’ What will make you [believers] realize that even if a sign came to them they still would not believe?
verses.pickthall: And they swear a solemn oath by Allah that if there come unto them a portent they will believe therein. Say; Portents are with Allah and (so is) that which telleth you that if such came unto them they would not believe.

verses.ar: وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْـِٔدَتَهُمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَنَذَرُهُمْ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.en: And We will turn away their hearts and their eyes just as they refused to believe in it [i.e., the revelation] the first time. And We will leave them in their transgression, wandering blindly.
verses.tr: wanuqallibu ʾafdatahum wa-abṣārahum kamā lam yuʾminūā bihi ʾawwala marrahin wanadharuhum fā ṭughyānihim yaʿmahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We would make their hearts and their eyes turn away, just as they did not believe the first time, and leave them to flounder in their obstinacy.
verses.pickthall: We confound their hearts and their eyes. As they believed not therein at the first, We let them wander blindly on in their contumacy.

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَوْ أَنَّنَا نَزَّلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ وَكَلَّمَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَحَشَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ قُبُلًا مَّا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَجْهَلُونَ
verses.en: And even if We had sent down to them the angels [with the message] and the dead spoke to them [of it] and We gathered together every [created] thing in front of them, they would not believe unless Allāh should will. But most of them, [of that], are ignorant.
verses.tr: ۞ walaw ʾannanā nazzalnā ʾilayhimu al-malāʾikaha wakallamahumu al-mawtā waḥasharnā ʿalayhim kulla shāʾin qubulan mmā kānūā liyuʾminūā ʾillā ʾan yashāʾa Allāh walākinna ʾaktharahum yajhalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Even if We sent the angels down to them, and the dead spoke to them, and We gathered all things right in front of them, they still would not believe, unless God so willed, but most of them are ignorant [of this].
verses.pickthall: And though We should send down the angels unto them, and the dead should speak unto them, and We should gather against them all things in array, they would not believe unless Allah so willed. Howbeit, most of them are ignorant.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا شَيَـٰطِينَ ٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلْجِنِّ يُوحِى بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ زُخْرُفَ ٱلْقَوْلِ غُرُورًا ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوهُ ۖ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy - devils from mankind and jinn, inspiring to one another decorative speech in delusion. But if your Lord had willed, they would not have done it, so leave them and that which they invent.
verses.tr: wakadhālika jaʿalnā likulli nabāin ʿaduwwan shayāṭīna al-ʾinsi wa-l-jinni yūḥā baʿḍuhum ʾilā baʿḍin zukhrufa al-qawli ghurūran ۚ walaw shāʾa rabbuka mā faʿalūhu ۖ fadharhum wamā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In the same way We assigned to each prophet an enemy, evil humans and evil jinn. They suggest alluring words to one another in order to deceive- if it had been your Lord’s will, [Prophet], they would not have done this: leave them to their inventions-
verses.pickthall: Thus have We appointed unto every prophet an adversary - devils of humankind and jinn who inspire in one another plausible discourse through guile. If thy Lord willed, they would not do so; so leave them alone with their devising;

verses.ar: وَلِتَصْغَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَفْـِٔدَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلِيَرْضَوْهُ وَلِيَقْتَرِفُوا۟ مَا هُم مُّقْتَرِفُونَ
verses.en: And [it is] so the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Hereafter will incline toward it [i.e., deceptive speech] and that they will be satisfied with it and that they will commit that which they are committing.
verses.tr: walitaṣghā ʾilayhi ʾafdahu adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi waliyarḍawhu waliyaqtarifūā mā hum mmuqtarifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so that the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter may incline towards their deceit, be pleased with it, and so perpetrate whatever they perpetrate.
