verses.pickthall: That the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter may incline thereto, and that they may take pleasure therein, and that they may earn what they are earning.

verses.ar: أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبْتَغِى حَكَمًا وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مُفَصَّلًا ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُۥ مُنَزَّلٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
verses.en: [Say], "Then is it other than Allāh I should seek as judge while it is He who has revealed to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] explained in detail?" And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture know that it is sent down from your Lord in truth, so never be among the doubters.
verses.tr: ʾafaghayra Allāh ʾabtaghā ḥakaman wahuwa adh-dhā ʾanzala ʾilaykumu al-kitāba mufaṣṣalan ۚ wa-adh-dhīna ātaynāhumu al-kitāba yaʿlamūna ʾannahu munazzalun mmin rrabbika bi-l-ḥaqqi ۖ falā takūnanna mina al-mumtarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Say], ‘Shall I seek any judge other than God, when it is He who has sent down for you [people] the Scripture, clearly explained?’ Those to whom We gave the Scripture know that this [Quran] is revealed by your Lord [Prophet] with the truth, so do not be one of those who doubt.
verses.pickthall: Shall I seek other than Allah for judge, when He it is Who hath revealed unto you (this) Scripture, fully explained? Those unto whom We gave the Scripture (aforetime) know that it is revealed from thy Lord in truth. So be not thou (O Muhammad) of the waverers.

verses.ar: وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلًا ۚ لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. None can alter His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.tr: watammat kalimatu rabbika ṣidqan waʿadlan ۚ llā mubaddila likalimātihi ۚ wahuwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: The word of your Lord is complete in its truth and justice. No one can change His words: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
verses.pickthall: Perfected is the Word of thy Lord in truth and justice. There is naught that can change His words. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.ar: وَإِن تُطِعْ أَكْثَرَ مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يُضِلُّوكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
verses.en: And if you obey most of those upon the earth, they will mislead you from the way of Allāh. They follow not except assumption, and they are not but misjudging.
verses.tr: wa-in tuṭiʿ ʾakthara man fā al-ʾarḍi yuḍillūka ʿan sabīli Allāh ۚ ʾin yattabiʿūna ʾillā aẓ-ẓanna wa-in hum ʾillā yakhruṣūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you obeyed most of those on earth, they would lead you away from the path of God. They follow nothing but speculation; they are merely guessing.
verses.pickthall: If thou obeyedst most of those on earth they would mislead thee far from Allah's way. They follow naught but an opinion, and they do but guess.

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ مَن يَضِلُّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۖ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
verses.tr: ʾinna rabbaka huwa ʾaʿlamu man yaḍillu ʿan sabīlihi ۖ wahuwa ʾaʿlamu bi-l-muhtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is rightly guided.
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord, He knoweth best who erreth from His way; and He knoweth best (who are) the rightly guided.

verses.ar: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: So eat of that [meat] upon which the name of Allāh has been mentioned, if you are believers in His verses [i.e., revealed law].
verses.tr: fakulūā mimmā dhukira āsmu Allāh ʿalayhi ʾin kuntum bāyātihi muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So [believers] eat any [animal] over which God’s name has been pronounced, if you believe in His revelations.
verses.pickthall: Eat of that over which the name of Allah hath been mentioned, if ye are believers in His revelations.

verses.ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَقَدْ فَصَّلَ لَكُم مَّا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِلَّا مَا ٱضْطُرِرْتُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا لَّيُضِلُّونَ بِأَهْوَآئِهِم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
verses.en: And why should you not eat of that upon which the name of Allāh has been mentioned while He has explained in detail to you what He has forbidden you, excepting that to which you are compelled. And indeed do many lead [others] astray through their [own] inclinations without knowledge. Indeed, your Lord - He is most knowing of the transgressors.
verses.tr: wamā lakum ʾallā taʾkulūā mimmā dhukira āsmu Allāh ʿalayhi waqad faṣṣala lakum mmā ḥarrama ʿalaykum ʾillā mā āḍṭurirtum ʾilayhi ۗ wa-inna kathīran llayuḍillūna biʾahwāʾihim bighayri ʿilmin ۗ ʾinna rabbaka huwa ʾaʿlamu bi-l-muʿtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why should you not eat such animals when God has already fully explained what He has forbidden you, except when forced by hunger? But many lead others astray by their desires, without any true knowledge: your Lord knows best who oversteps the limit.
verses.pickthall: How should ye not eat of that over which the name of Allah hath been mentioned, when He hath explained unto you that which is forbidden unto you unless ye are compelled thereto. But lo! many are led astray by their own lusts through ignorance. Lo! thy Lord, He is Best Aware of the transgressors.

verses.ar: وَذَرُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَبَاطِنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْسِبُونَ ٱلْإِثْمَ سَيُجْزَوْنَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَقْتَرِفُونَ
verses.en: And leave [i.e., desist from] what is apparent of sin and what is concealed thereof. Indeed, those who earn [blame for] sin will be recompensed for that which they used to commit.
verses.tr: wadharūā ẓāhira al-ʾithmi wabāṭinahu ۚ ʾinna adh-dhīna yaksibūna al-ʾithma sayujzawna bimā kānūā yaqtarifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Avoid committing sin, whether openly or in secret, for those who commit sin will be repaid for what they do,
verses.pickthall: Forsake the outwardness of sin and the inwardness thereof. Lo! those who garner sin will be awarded that which they have earned.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِسْقٌ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ لَيُوحُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآئِهِمْ لِيُجَـٰدِلُوكُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ أَطَعْتُمُوهُمْ إِنَّكُمْ لَمُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: And do not eat of that upon which the name of Allāh has not been mentioned, for indeed, it is grave disobedience. And indeed do the devils inspire their allies [among men] to dispute with you. And if you were to obey them, indeed, you would be associators [of others with Him].
verses.tr: walā taʾkulūā mimmā lam yudhkari āsmu Allāh ʿalayhi wa-innahu lafisqun ۗ wa-inna ash-shayāṭīna layūḥūna ʾilā ʾawliyāʾihim liyujādilūkum ۖ wa-in ʾaṭaʿtumūhum ʾinnakum lamushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and do not eat anything over which God’s name has not been pronounced, for that is breaking the law. The evil ones incite their followers to argue with you: if you listen to them, you too will become idolaters.
verses.pickthall: And eat not of that whereon Allah's name hath not been mentioned, for lo! it is abomination. Lo! the devils do inspire their minions to dispute with you. But if ye obey them, ye will be in truth idolaters.

verses.ar: أَوَمَن كَانَ مَيْتًا فَأَحْيَيْنَـٰهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ نُورًا يَمْشِى بِهِۦ فِى ٱلنَّاسِ كَمَن مَّثَلُهُۥ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ لَيْسَ بِخَارِجٍ مِّنْهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And is one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him light by which to walk among the people like one who is in darkness, never to emerge therefrom? Thus it has been made pleasing to the disbelievers that which they were doing.
verses.tr: ʾawaman kāna maytan fa-aḥyaynāhu wajaʿalnā lahu nūran yamshā bihi fā an-nāsi kaman mmathaluhu fā aẓ-ẓulumāti laysa bikhārijin mminhā ۚ kadhālika zuyyina lilkāfirīna mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Is a dead person brought back to life by Us, and given light with which to walk among people, comparable to someone trapped in deep darkness who cannot escape? In this way the evil deeds of the disbelievers are made to seem alluring to them.
verses.pickthall: Is he who was dead and We have raised him unto life, and set for him a light wherein he walketh among men, as him whose similitude is in utter darkness whence he cannot emerge? Thus is their conduct made fairseeming for the disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ أَكَـٰبِرَ مُجْرِمِيهَا لِيَمْكُرُوا۟ فِيهَا ۖ وَمَا يَمْكُرُونَ إِلَّا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: And thus We have placed within every city the greatest of its criminals to conspire therein. But they conspire not except against themselves, and they perceive [it] not.
verses.tr: wakadhālika jaʿalnā fā kulli qaryahin ʾakābira mujrimīhā liyamkurūā fīhā ۖ wamā yamkurūna ʾillā biʾanfusihim wamā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And so We have put chief evildoers in every city to perpetrate their schemes there- but they scheme only against themselves, without realizing it.
verses.pickthall: And thus have We made in every city great ones of its wicked ones, that they should plot therein. They do but plot against themselves, though they perceive not.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَةٌ قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ حَتَّىٰ نُؤْتَىٰ مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ رُسُلُ ٱللَّهِ ۘ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ يَجْعَلُ رِسَالَتَهُۥ ۗ سَيُصِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ صَغَارٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَمْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And when a sign comes to them, they say, "Never will we believe until we are given like that which was given to the messengers of Allāh." Allāh is most knowing of where [i.e., with whom] He places His message. There will afflict those who committed crimes debasement before Allāh and severe punishment for what they used to conspire.
verses.tr: wa-idhā jāʾathum āyahun qālūā lan nnuʾmina ḥattā nuʾtā mithla mā ʾūtāa rusulu Allāh ۘ Allāh ʾaʿlamu ḥaythu yajʿalu risālatahu ۗ sayuṣību adh-dhīna ʾajramūā ṣaghārun ʿinda Allāh waʿadhābun shadīdun bimā kānūā yamkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When a revelation is brought before them they say, ‘We shall not believe unless we ourselves are given a revelation as God’s messengers were.’ But God knows best where to place His messages: humiliation before God and severe torment will befall the evildoers for their scheming.
verses.pickthall: And when a token cometh unto them, they say: We will not believe till we are given that which Allah's messengers are given. Allah knoweth best with whom to place His message. Humiliation from Allah and heavy punishment will smite the guilty for their scheming.

verses.ar: فَمَن يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَهْدِيَهُۥ يَشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَـٰمِ ۖ وَمَن يُرِدْ أَن يُضِلَّهُۥ يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُۥ ضَيِّقًا حَرَجًا كَأَنَّمَا يَصَّعَّدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّجْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: So whoever Allāh wants to guide - He expands his breast to [contain] Islām; and whoever He wants to send astray - He makes his breast tight and constricted as though he were climbing into the sky. Thus does Allāh place defilement upon those who do not believe.
verses.tr: faman yuridi Allāh ʾan yahdiyahu yashraḥ ṣadrahu lilʾislāmi ۖ waman yurid ʾan yuḍillahu yajʿal ṣadrahu ḍayyiqan ḥarajan kaʾannamā yaṣṣaʿʿadu fā as-samāʾi ۚ kadhālika yajʿalu Allāh ar-rijsa ʿalā adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When God wishes to guide someone, He opens their breast to islam; when He wishes to lead them astray, He closes and constricts their breast as if they were climbing up to the skies. That is how God makes the foulness of those who do not believe rebound against them.
verses.pickthall: And whomsoever it is Allah's will to guide, He expandeth his bosom unto the Surrender, and whomsoever it is His Will to send astray, He maketh his bosom close and narrow as if he were engaged in sheer ascent. Thus Allah layeth ignominy upon those who believe not.

verses.ar: وَهَـٰذَا صِرَٰطُ رَبِّكَ مُسْتَقِيمًا ۗ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And this is the path of your Lord, [leading] straight. We have detailed the verses for a people who remember.
verses.tr: wahādhā ṣirāṭu rabbika mustaqīman ۗ qad faṣṣalnā al-āyāti liqawmin yadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], this is the path of your Lord, made perfectly straight. We have explained Our revelations to those who take heed.
verses.pickthall: This is the path of thy Lord, a straight path. We have detailed Our revelations for a people who take heed.

verses.ar: ۞ لَهُمْ دَارُ ٱلسَّلَـٰمِ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: For them will be the Home of Peace [i.e., Paradise] with their Lord. And He will be their protecting friend because of what they used to do.
verses.tr: ۞ lahum dāru as-salāmi ʿinda rabbihim ۖ wahuwa waliyyuhum bimā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They shall have the Home of Peace with their Lord, and He will take care of them as a reward for their deeds.
verses.pickthall: For them is the abode of peace with their Lord. He will be their Protecting Friend because of what they used to do.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ قَدِ ٱسْتَكْثَرْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ ۖ وَقَالَ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ رَبَّنَا ٱسْتَمْتَعَ بَعْضُنَا بِبَعْضٍ وَبَلَغْنَآ أَجَلَنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَجَّلْتَ لَنَا ۚ قَالَ ٱلنَّارُ مَثْوَىٰكُمْ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day when He will gather them together [and say], "O company of jinn, you have [misled] many of mankind." And their allies among mankind will say, "Our Lord, some of us made use of others, and we have [now] reached our term which You appointed for us." He will say, "The Fire is your residence, wherein you will abide eternally, except for what Allāh wills. Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing."
verses.tr: wayawma yaḥshuruhum jamīʿan yāmaʿshara al-jinni qadi āstakthartum mmina al-ʾinsi ۖ waqāla ʾawliyāʾuhum mmina al-ʾinsi rabbanā āstamtaʿa baʿḍunā bibaʿḍin wabalaghnā ʾajalanā adh-dhā ʾajjalta lanā ۚ qāla an-nāru mathwākum khālidīna fīhā ʾillā mā shāʾa Allāh ۗ ʾinna rabbaka ḥakīmun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: On the day He gathers everyone together [saying], ‘Company of jinn! You have seduced a great many humans,’ their adherents among mankind will say, ‘Lord, we have profited from one another, but now we have reached the appointed time You decreed for us.’ He will say, ‘Your home is the Fire, and there you shall remain’- unless God wills otherwise: [Prophet], your Lord is all wise, all knowing.
verses.pickthall: In the day when He will gather them together (He will say): O ye assembly of the jinn! Many of humankind did ye seduce. And their adherents among humankind will say: Our Lord! We enjoyed one another, but now we have arrived at the appointed term which Thou appointedst for us. He will say: Fire is your home. Abide therein for ever, save him whom Allah willeth (to deliver). Lo! thy Lord is Wise, Aware.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُوَلِّى بَعْضَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بَعْضًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: And thus will We make some of the wrongdoers allies of others for what they used to earn.
verses.tr: wakadhālika nuwallā baʿḍa aẓ-ẓālimīna baʿḍanā bimā kānūā yaksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way, We make some evildoers have power over others through their misdeeds.
verses.pickthall: Thus We let some of the wrong-doers have power over others because of what they are wont to earn.

verses.ar: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا ۚ قَالُوا۟ شَهِدْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِنَا ۖ وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَشَهِدُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: "O company of jinn and mankind, did there not come to you messengers from among you, relating to you My verses and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "We bear witness against ourselves"; and the worldly life had deluded them, and they will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.
verses.tr: yāmaʿshara al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi ʾalam yaʾtikum rusulun mminkum yaquṣṣūna ʿalaykum āyātā wayundhirūnakum liqāʾa yawmikum hādhā ۚ qālūā shahidnā ʿalā ʾanfusinā ۖ wagharrathumu al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā washahidūā ʿalā ʾanfusihim ʾannahum kānūā kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Company of jinn and mankind! Did messengers not come from among you to recite My revelations to you and warn that you would meet this Day?’ They will say, ‘We testify against ourselves.’ The life of this world seduced them, but they will testify against themselves that they rejected the truth:
verses.pickthall: O ye assembly of the jinn and humankind! Came there not unto you messengers of your own who recounted unto you My tokens and warned you of the meeting of this your Day? They will say: We testify against ourselves. And the life of the world beguiled them. And they testify against themselves that they were disbelievers.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ أَن لَّمْ يَكُن رَّبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا غَـٰفِلُونَ
verses.en: That is because your Lord would not destroy the cities for wrongdoing while their people were unaware.
verses.tr: dhālika ʾan llam yakun rrabbuka muhlika al-qurā biẓulmin wa-ahluhā ghāfilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord would not destroy towns for their wrongdoing if they had not been warned.
verses.pickthall: This is because thy Lord destroyeth not the townships arbitrarily while their people are unconscious (of the wrong they do).

verses.ar: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَـٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And for all are degrees [i.e., positions resulting] from what they have done. And your Lord is not unaware of what they do.
verses.tr: walikullin darajātun mmimmā ʿamilūā ۚ wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Everyone is assigned a rank according to their deeds; your Lord is not unaware of anything they do.
verses.pickthall: For all there will be ranks from what they did. Thy Lord is not unaware of what they do.

verses.ar: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ۚ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفْ مِنۢ بَعْدِكُم مَّا يَشَآءُ كَمَآ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن ذُرِّيَّةِ قَوْمٍ ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.en: And your Lord is the Free of need, the possessor of mercy. If He wills, He can do away with you and give succession after you to whomever He wills, just as He produced you from the descendants of another people.
verses.tr: warabbuka al-ghanāu dhū ar-raḥmahi ۚ ʾin yashaʾ yudhhibkum wayastakhlif min baʿdikum mmā yashāʾu kamā ʾanshaʾakum mmin dhurriyyahi qawmin ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord is self-sufficient and full of mercy. If He pleased, He could remove you and put others in your place, just as He produced you from the offspring of other people.
verses.pickthall: Thy Lord is the Absolute, the Lord of Mercy. If He will, He can remove you and can cause what He will to follow after you, even as He raised you from the seed of other folk.

verses.ar: إِنَّ مَا تُوعَدُونَ لَـَٔاتٍ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, what you are promised is coming, and you will not cause failure [to Allāh].
verses.tr: ʾinna mā tūʿadūna lātin ۖ wamā ʾantum bimuʿjizīna
verses.abdelhaleem: What you are promised is sure to come, and you cannot escape.
verses.pickthall: Lo! that which ye are promised will surely come to pass, and ye cannot escape.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَامِلٌ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن تَكُونُ لَهُۥ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلدَّارِ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "O my people, work according to your position; [for] indeed, I am working. And you are going to know who will have succession in the home. Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed."
verses.tr: qul yāqawmi āʿmalūā ʿalā makānatikum ʾinnā ʿāmilun ۖ fasawfa taʿlamūna man takūnu lahu ʿāqibahu ad-dāri ۗ ʾinnahu lā yufliḥu aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say, ‘My people, you carry on as you are, and so will I: you will come to realize who will have a happy homecoming in the Hereafter.’ The evildoers will not prosper.
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): O my people! Work according to your power. Lo! I too am working. Thus ye will come to know for which of us will be the happy sequel. Lo! the wrong-doers will not be successful.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مِمَّا ذَرَأَ مِنَ ٱلْحَرْثِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ نَصِيبًا فَقَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا لِلَّهِ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَهَـٰذَا لِشُرَكَآئِنَا ۖ فَمَا كَانَ لِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ فَلَا يَصِلُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ فَهُوَ يَصِلُ إِلَىٰ شُرَكَآئِهِمْ ۗ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
verses.en: And they [i.e., the polytheists] assign to Allāh from that which He created of crops and livestock a share and say, "This is for Allāh," by their claim, "and this is for our 'partners' [associated with Him]." But what is for their "partners" does not reach Allāh, while what is for Allāh - this reaches their "partners." Evil is that which they rule.
verses.tr: wajaʿalūā lillāh mimmā dharaʾa mina al-ḥarthi wa-l-ʾanʿāmi naṣīban faqālūā hādhā lillāh bizaʿmihim wahādhā lishurakāʾinā ۖ famā kāna lishurakāʾihim falā yaṣilu ʾilā Allāh ۖ wamā kāna lillāh fahuwa yaṣilu ʾilā shurakāʾihim ۗ sāʾa mā yaḥkumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They apportion to God a share of the produce and the livestock He created, saying, ‘This is for God’- so they claim!- ‘ and this is for our idols.’ Their idols’ share does not reach God, but God’s share does reach their idols: how badly they judge!
verses.pickthall: They assign unto Allah, of the crops and cattle which He created, a portion, and they say: "This is Allah's" - in their make-believe - "and this is for (His) partners in regard to us." Thus that which (they assign) unto His partners in them reacheth not Allah and that which (they assign) unto Allah goeth to their (so-called) partners. Evil is their ordinance.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ قَتْلَ أَوْلَـٰدِهِمْ شُرَكَآؤُهُمْ لِيُرْدُوهُمْ وَلِيَلْبِسُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ دِينَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُ ۖ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: And likewise, to many of the polytheists their partners have made [to seem] pleasing the killing of their children in order to bring about their destruction and to cover them with confusion in their religion. And if Allāh had willed, they would not have done so. So leave them and that which they invent.
verses.tr: wakadhālika zayyana likathīrin mmina al-mushrikīna qatla ʾawlādihim shurakāʾuhum liyurdūhum waliyalbisūā ʿalayhim dīnahum ۖ walaw shāʾa Allāh mā faʿalūhu ۖ fadharhum wamā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In the same way, their idols have induced many of the pagans to kill their own children, bringing them ruin and confusion in their faith: if God had willed otherwise they would not have done this, so [Prophet] leave them to their own devices.
verses.pickthall: Thus have their (so-called) partners (of Allah) made the killing of their children to seem fair unto many of the idolaters, that they may ruin them and make their faith obscure for them. Had Allah willed (it otherwise), they had not done so. So leave them alone with their devices.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أَنْعَـٰمٌ وَحَرْثٌ حِجْرٌ لَّا يَطْعَمُهَآ إِلَّا مَن نَّشَآءُ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَأَنْعَـٰمٌ حُرِّمَتْ ظُهُورُهَا وَأَنْعَـٰمٌ لَّا يَذْكُرُونَ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا ٱفْتِرَآءً عَلَيْهِ ۚ سَيَجْزِيهِم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: And they say, "These animals and crops are forbidden; no one may eat from them except whom we will," by their claim. And there are those [camels] whose backs are forbidden [by them] and those upon which the name of Allāh is not mentioned - [all of this] an invention of untruth about Him. He will punish them for what they were inventing.
verses.tr: waqālūā hādhihi ʾanʿāmun waḥarthun ḥijrun llā yaṭʿamuhā ʾillā man nnashāʾu bizaʿmihim wa-anʿāmun ḥurrimat ẓuhūruhā wa-anʿāmun llā yadhkurūna āsma Allāh ʿalayhā āftirāʾan ʿalayhi ۚ sayajzīhim bimā kānūā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They also say, ‘These cattle and crops are reserved, and only those we allow may eat them’- so they claim! There are some animals they exempt from labour and some over which they do not pronounce God’s name [during slaughter], falsely attributing these [regulations] to Him: He will repay them for the falsehoods they invent.
verses.pickthall: And they say: Such cattle and crops are forbidden. No-one is to eat of them save whom we will - in their make-believe - cattle whose backs are forbidden, cattle over which they mention not the name of Allah. (All that is) a lie against Him. He will repay them for that which they invent.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا فِى بُطُونِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ خَالِصَةٌ لِّذُكُورِنَا وَمُحَرَّمٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِنَا ۖ وَإِن يَكُن مَّيْتَةً فَهُمْ فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ ۚ سَيَجْزِيهِمْ وَصْفَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And they say, "What is in the bellies of these animals is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our females. But if it is [born] dead, then all of them have shares therein." He will punish them for their description. Indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
verses.tr: waqālūā mā fā buṭūni hādhihi al-ʾanʿāmi khāliṣahun llidhukūrinā wamuḥarramun ʿalā ʾazwājinā ۖ wa-in yakun mmaytahan fahum fīhi shurakāʾu ۚ sayajzīhim waṣfahum ۚ ʾinnahu ḥakīmun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: They also say, ‘The contents of these animals’ wombs will be reserved solely for our men and forbidden to our women, though if the offspring is stillborn they may have a share of it.’ He will punish them for what they attribute to Him: He is all wise, all aware.
verses.pickthall: And they say: That which is in the bellies of such cattle is reserved for our males and is forbidden to our wives; but if it be born dead, then they (all) may be partakers thereof. He will reward them for their attribution (of such ordinances unto Him). Lo, He is Wise, Aware.

verses.ar: قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَتَلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَـٰدَهُمْ سَفَهًۢا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَحَرَّمُوا۟ مَا رَزَقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱفْتِرَآءً عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
verses.en: They will have lost who killed their children in foolishness without knowledge and prohibited what Allāh had provided for them, inventing untruth about Allāh. They have gone astray and were not [rightly] guided.
verses.tr: qad khasira adh-dhīna qatalūā ʾawlādahum safahanā bighayri ʿilmin waḥarramūā mā razaqahumu Allāh āftirāʾan ʿalā Allāh ۚ qad ḍallūā wamā kānūā muhtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Lost indeed are those who kill their own children out of folly, with no basis in knowledge, forbidding what God has provided for them, fabricating lies against Him: they have gone far astray and have heeded no guidance.
verses.pickthall: They are losers who besottedly have slain their children without knowledge, and have forbidden that which Allah bestowed upon them, inventing a lie against Allah. They indeed have gone astray and are not guided.

verses.ar: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ جَنَّـٰتٍ مَّعْرُوشَـٰتٍ وَغَيْرَ مَعْرُوشَـٰتٍ وَٱلنَّخْلَ وَٱلزَّرْعَ مُخْتَلِفًا أُكُلُهُۥ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَـٰبِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَـٰبِهٍ ۚ كُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَءَاتُوا۟ حَقَّهُۥ يَوْمَ حَصَادِهِۦ ۖ وَلَا تُسْرِفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.en: And He it is who causes gardens to grow, [both] trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [kinds of] food and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of [each of] its fruit when it yields and give its due [zakāh] on the day of its harvest. And be not excessive. Indeed, He does not like those who commit excess.
verses.tr: ۞ wahuwa adh-dhā ʾanshaʾa jannātin mmaʿrūshātin waghayra maʿrūshātin wa-an-nakhla wa-az-zarʿa mukhtalifan ʾukuluhu wa-az-zaytūna wa-ar-rummāna mutashābihan waghayra mutashābihin ۚ kulūā min thamarihi ʾidhā ʾathmara watūā ḥaqqahu yawma ḥaṣādihi ۖ walā tusrifūā ۚ ʾinnahu lā yuḥibbu al-musrifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who produces both trellised and untrellised gardens, date palms, crops of diverse flavours, the olive, the pomegranate, alike yet different. So when they bear fruit, eat some of it, paying what is due on the day of harvest, but do not be wasteful: God does not like wasteful people.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who produceth gardens trellised and untrellised, and the date-palm, and crops of divers flavour, and the olive and the pomegranate, like and unlike. Eat ye of the fruit thereof when it fruiteth, and pay the due thereof upon the harvest day, and be not prodigal. Lo! Allah loveth not the prodigals.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ حَمُولَةً وَفَرْشًا ۚ كُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And of the grazing livestock are carriers [of burdens] and those [too] small. Eat of what Allāh has provided for you and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
verses.tr: wamina al-ʾanʿāmi ḥamūlahan wafarshan ۚ kulūā mimmā razaqakumu Allāh walā tattabiʿūā khuṭuwāti ash-shayṭāni ۚ ʾinnahu lakum ʿaduwwun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: [He gave you] livestock, as beasts of burden and as food. So eat what God has provided for you and do not follow in Satan’s footsteps: he is your sworn enemy.
verses.pickthall: And of the cattle (He produceth) some for burdens, some for food. Eat of that which Allah hath bestowed upon you, and follow not the footsteps of the devil, for lo! he is an open foe to you.

verses.ar: ثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ ۖ مِّنَ ٱلضَّأْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمَعْزِ ٱثْنَيْنِ ۗ قُلْ ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ ۖ نَبِّـُٔونِى بِعِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: [They are] eight mates - of the sheep, two and of the goats, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: thamāniyaha ʾazwājin ۖ mmina aḍ-ḍaʾni āthnayni wamina al-maʿzi āthnayni ۗ qul āldhakarayni ḥarrama ʾami al-ʾunthayayni ʾammā āshtamalat ʿalayhi ʾarḥāmu al-ʾunthayayni ۖ nabbiwnā biʿilmin ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [God gave you] eight animals, in [four] pairs: a pair of sheep and a pair of goats- ask them [Prophet], ‘Has He forbidden the two males, the two females, or the young in the wombs of the two females? Tell me based on knowledge if you are telling the truth.’
verses.pickthall: Eight pairs: Of the sheep twain, and of the goats twain. Say: Hath He forbidden the two males or the two females, or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Expound to me (the case) with knowledge, if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلْإِبِلِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ ٱثْنَيْنِ ۗ قُلْ ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ ۖ أَمْ كُنتُمْ شُهَدَآءَ إِذْ وَصَّىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا ۚ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا لِّيُضِلَّ ٱلنَّاسَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And of the camels, two and of the cattle, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Or were you witnesses when Allāh charged you with this? Then who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh to mislead the people by [something] other than knowledge? Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people."
verses.tr: wamina al-ʾibili āthnayni wamina al-baqari āthnayni ۗ qul āldhakarayni ḥarrama ʾami al-ʾunthayayni ʾammā āshtamalat ʿalayhi ʾarḥāmu al-ʾunthayayni ۖ ʾam kuntum shuhadāʾa ʾidh waṣṣākumu Allāh bihādhā ۚ faman ʾaẓlamu mimmani āftarā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban lliyuḍilla an-nāsa bighayri ʿilmin ۗ ʾinna Allāh lā yahdā al-qawma aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And a pair of camels and a pair of cattle- ask them [Prophet], ‘Has He forbidden the two males, the two females, or the young in the wombs of the two females? Were you present when God gave you these commands?’ So who is more wicked than he who fabricates lies against God with no basis in knowledge in order to lead people astray? God does not guide the evildoers.
verses.pickthall: And of the camels twain and of the oxen twain. Say: Hath He forbidden the two males or the two females, or that which the wombs of the two females contain; or were ye by to witness when Allah commanded you (all) this? Then who doth greater wrong than he who deviseth a lie concerning Allah, that he may lead mankind astray without knowledge. Lo! Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

verses.ar: قُل لَّآ أَجِدُ فِى مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ مُحَرَّمًا عَلَىٰ طَاعِمٍ يَطْعَمُهُۥٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَكُونَ مَيْتَةً أَوْ دَمًا مَّسْفُوحًا أَوْ لَحْمَ خِنزِيرٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ رِجْسٌ أَوْ فِسْقًا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ ۚ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Say, "I do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it unless it be a dead animal or blood spilled out or the flesh of swine - for indeed, it is impure - or it be [that slaughtered in] disobedience, dedicated to other than Allāh. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit], then indeed, your Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.tr: qul llā ʾajidu fā mā ʾūḥāa ʾilāa muḥarraman ʿalā ṭāʿimin yaṭʿamuhu ʾillā ʾan yakūna maytahan ʾaw daman mmasfūḥan ʾaw laḥma khinzīrin fa-innahu rijsun ʾaw fisqan ʾuhilla lighayri Allāh bihi ۚ famani āḍṭurra ghayra bāghin walā ʿādin fa-inna rabbaka ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say, ‘In all that has been revealed to me, I find nothing forbidden for people to eat, except for carrion, flowing blood, pig’s meat- it is loathsome- or a sinful offering over which any name other than God’s has been invoked.’ But if someone is forced by hunger, rather than desire or excess, then God is most forgiving and most merciful.
verses.pickthall: Say: I find not in that which is revealed unto me aught prohibited to an eater that he eat thereof, except it be carrion, or blood poured forth, or swineflesh - for that verily is foul - or the abomination which was immolated to the name of other than Allah. But whoso is compelled (thereto), neither craving nor transgressing, (for him) lo! thy Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا كُلَّ ذِى ظُفُرٍ ۖ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ وَٱلْغَنَمِ حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ شُحُومَهُمَآ إِلَّا مَا حَمَلَتْ ظُهُورُهُمَآ أَوِ ٱلْحَوَايَآ أَوْ مَا ٱخْتَلَطَ بِعَظْمٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَـٰهُم بِبَغْيِهِمْ ۖ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
verses.en: And to those who are Jews We prohibited every animal of uncloven hoof; and of the cattle and the sheep We prohibited to them their fat, except what adheres to their backs or the entrails or what is joined with bone. [By] that We repaid them for their transgression. And indeed, We are truthful.
verses.tr: waʿalā adh-dhīna hādūā ḥarramnā kulla dhā ẓufurin ۖ wamina al-baqari wa-l-ghanami ḥarramnā ʿalayhim shuḥūmahumā ʾillā mā ḥamalat ẓuhūruhumā ʾawi al-ḥawāyā ʾaw mā ākhtalaṭa biʿaẓmin ۚ dhālika jazaynāhum bibaghyihim ۖ wa-innā laṣādiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We forbade for the Jews every animal with claws, and the fat of cattle and sheep, except what is on their backs and in their intestines, or that which sticks to their bones. This is how We penalized them for their disobedience: We are true to Our word.
verses.pickthall: Unto those who are Jews We forbade every animal with claws. And of the oxen and the sheep forbade We unto them the fat thereof save that upon the backs or the entrails, or that which is mixed with the bone. That we awarded them for their rebellion. And lo! we verily are truthful.

verses.ar: فَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل رَّبُّكُمْ ذُو رَحْمَةٍ وَٰسِعَةٍ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: So if they deny you, [O Muḥammad], say, "Your Lord is the possessor of vast mercy; but His punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals."
verses.tr: fa-in kadhabūka faqul rrabbukum dhū raḥmahin wāsiʿahin walā yuraddu baʾsuhu ʿani al-qawmi al-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they [the disbelievers] accuse you [Prophet] of lying, say, ‘Your Lord has all-encompassing mercy, but His punishment cannot be diverted from the evildoers.’
verses.pickthall: So if they give the lie to thee (Muhammad), say: Your Lord is a Lord of All-Embracing Mercy, and His wrath will never be withdrawn from guilty folk.

verses.ar: سَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشْرَكْنَا وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن شَىْءٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ ذَاقُوا۟ بَأْسَنَا ۗ قُلْ هَلْ عِندَكُم مِّنْ عِلْمٍ فَتُخْرِجُوهُ لَنَآ ۖ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَخْرُصُونَ
verses.en: Those who associated [others] with Allāh will say, "If Allāh had willed, we would not have associated [anything] and neither would our fathers, nor would we have prohibited anything." Likewise did those before deny until they tasted Our punishment. Say, "Do you have any knowledge that you can produce for us? You follow not except assumption, and you are not but misjudging."
verses.tr: sayaqūlu adh-dhīna ʾashrakūā law shāʾa Allāh mā ʾashraknā walā ābāʾunā walā ḥarramnā min shāʾin ۚ kadhālika kadhaba adh-dhīna min qablihim ḥattā dhāqūā baʾsanā ۗ qul hal ʿindakum mmin ʿilmin fatukhrijūhu lanā ۖ ʾin tattabiʿūna ʾillā aẓ-ẓanna wa-in ʾantum ʾillā takhruṣūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The idolaters will say, ‘If God had willed, we would not have ascribed partners to Him- nor would our fathers- or have declared anything forbidden.’ In the same way, those before them continually denied [the truth] until they tasted Our punishment. Say, ‘Have you any knowledge that you can show us? You follow only supposition and tell only lies.’
verses.pickthall: They who are idolaters will say: Had Allah willed, we had not ascribed (unto Him) partners neither had our fathers, nor had we forbidden aught. Thus did those who were before them give the lie (to Allah's messengers) till they tasted of the fear of Us. Say: Have ye any knowledge that ye can adduce for Us? Lo! ye follow naught but an opinion, Lo! ye do but guess.

verses.ar: قُلْ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحُجَّةُ ٱلْبَـٰلِغَةُ ۖ فَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: Say, "With Allāh is the far-reaching [i.e., conclusive] argument. If He had willed, He would have guided you all."
verses.tr: qul fa-lillāh al-ḥujjahu al-bālighahu ۖ falaw shāʾa lahadākum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘The conclusive argument belongs to God alone. Had He so willed He would have guided you all.’
verses.pickthall: Say - For Allah's is the final argument - Had He willed He could indeed have guided all of you.

verses.ar: قُلْ هَلُمَّ شُهَدَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَرَّمَ هَـٰذَا ۖ فَإِن شَهِدُوا۟ فَلَا تَشْهَدْ مَعَهُمْ ۚ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Bring forward your witnesses who will testify that Allāh has prohibited this." And if they testify, do not testify with them. And do not follow the desires of those who deny Our verses and those who do not believe in the Hereafter, while they equate [others] with their Lord.
verses.tr: qul halumma shuhadāʾakumu adh-dhīna yashhadūna ʾanna Allāh ḥarrama hādhā ۖ fa-in shahidūā falā tashhad maʿahum ۚ walā tattabiʿ ʾahwāʾa adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā wa-adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi wahum birabbihim yaʿdilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Bring your witnesses to testify that God has forbidden all this.’ If they do testify, do not bear witness with them. Do not follow the whims of those who have denied Our revelation, who do not believe in the Hereafter, and who set up equals with their Lord.
verses.pickthall: Say: Come, bring your witnesses who can bear witness that Allah forbade (all) this. And if they bear witness, do not thou bear witness with them. Follow thou not the whims of those who deny Our revelations, those who believe not in the Hereafter and deem (others) equal with their Lord.

verses.ar: ۞ قُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ أَتْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا۟ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَـٰنًا ۖ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَـٰدَكُم مِّنْ إِمْلَـٰقٍ ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكُمْ وَإِيَّاهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ ۖ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you. [He commands] that you not associate anything with Him, and to parents, good treatment, and do not kill your children out of poverty; We will provide for you and them. And do not approach immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed. And do not kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed] except by [legal] right. This has He instructed you that you may use reason."
verses.tr: ۞ qul taʿālawā ʾatlu mā ḥarrama rabbukum ʿalaykum ۖ ʾallā tushrikūā bihi shayā ۖ wabālwālidayni ʾiḥsānan ۖ walā taqtulūā ʾawlādakum mmin ʾimlāqin ۖ nnaḥnu narzuqukum wa-iyyāhum ۖ walā taqrabūā al-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara minhā wamā baṭana ۖ walā taqtulūā an-nafsa at-tā ḥarrama Allāh ʾillā bi-l-ḥaqqi ۚ dhālikum waṣṣākum bihi laʿallakum taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Come! I will tell you what your Lord has really forbidden you. Do not ascribe anything as a partner to Him; be good to your parents; do not kill your children in fear of poverty’- We will provide for you and for them- ‘ stay well away from committing obscenities, whether openly or in secret; do not take the life God has made sacred, except by right. This is what He commands you to do: perhaps you will use your reason.
verses.pickthall: Say: Come, I will recite unto you that which your Lord hath made a sacred duty for you: That ye ascribe no thing as partner unto Him and that ye do good to parents, and that ye slay not your children because of penury - We provide for you and for them - and that ye draw not nigh to lewd things whether open or concealed. And that ye slay not the life which Allah hath made sacred, save in the course of justice. This He hath command you, in order that ye may discern.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ ۖ وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَإِذَا قُلْتُمْ فَٱعْدِلُوا۟ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ ۖ وَبِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْفُوا۟ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And do not approach the orphan's property except in a way that is best [i.e., intending improvement] until he reaches maturity. And give full measure and weight in justice. We do not charge any soul except [with that within] its capacity. And when you speak [i.e., testify], be just, even if [it concerns] a near relative. And the covenant of Allāh fulfill. This has He instructed you that you may remember.
verses.tr: walā taqrabūā māla al-yatīmi ʾillā bi-at-tā hāa ʾaḥsanu ḥattā yablugha ʾashuddahu ۖ wa-awfūā al-kayla wa-l-mīzāna bi-l-qisṭi ۖ lā nukallifu nafsan ʾillā wusʿahā ۖ wa-idhā qultum fāʿdilūā walaw kāna dhā qurbā ۖ wabiʿahdi Allāh ʾawfūā ۚ dhālikum waṣṣākum bihi laʿallakum tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Stay well away from the property of orphans, except with the best [intentions], until they come of age; give full measure and weight, according to justice’- We do not burden any soul with more than it can bear- ‘ when you speak, be just, even if it concerns a relative; keep any promises you make in God’s name. This is what He commands you to do, so that you may take heed’-
verses.pickthall: And approach not the wealth of the orphan save with that which is better, till he reach maturity. Give full measure and full weight, in justice. We task not any soul beyond its scope. And if ye give your word, do justice thereunto, even though it be (against) a kinsman; and fulfil the covenant of Allah. This He commandeth you that haply ye may remember.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطِى مُسْتَقِيمًا فَٱتَّبِعُوهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلسُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ وَصَّىٰكُم بِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And, [moreover], this is My path, which is straight, so follow it; and do not follow [other] ways, for you will be separated from His way. This has He instructed you that you may become righteous.
verses.tr: wa-anna hādhā ṣirāṭā mustaqīman fāttabiʿūhu ۖ walā tattabiʿūā as-subula fatafarraqa bikum ʿan sabīlihi ۚ dhālikum waṣṣākum bihi laʿallakum tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: this is My path, leading straight, so follow it, and do not follow other ways: they will lead you away from it- ‘ This is what He commands you to do, so that you may refrain from wrongdoing.’
verses.pickthall: And (He commandeth you, saying): This is My straight path, so follow it. Follow not other ways, lest ye be parted from His way. This hath He ordained for you, that ye may ward off (evil).

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ تَمَامًا عَلَى ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ وَتَفْصِيلًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لَّعَلَّهُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Then We gave Moses the Scripture, making complete [Our favor] upon the one who did good [i.e., Moses] and as a detailed explanation of all things and as guidance and mercy that perhaps in the meeting with their Lord they would believe.
verses.tr: thumma ātaynā mūsā al-kitāba tamāman ʿalā adh-dhā ʾaḥsana watafṣīlan llikulli shāʾin wahudanā waraḥmahan llaʿallahum biliqāʾi rabbihim yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Once again, We gave Moses the Scripture, perfecting [Our favour] for those who do good, explaining everything clearly, as guidance and mercy, so that they might believe in the meeting with their Lord.
verses.pickthall: Again, We gave the Scripture unto Moses, complete for him who would do good, an explanation of all things, a guidance and a mercy, that they might believe in the meeting with their Lord.

verses.ar: وَهَـٰذَا كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ مُبَارَكٌ فَٱتَّبِعُوهُ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.en: And this [Qur’ān] is a Book We have revealed [which is] blessed, so follow it and fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.
verses.tr: wahādhā kitābun ʾanzalnāhu mubārakun fāttabiʿūhu wāttaqūā laʿallakum turḥamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This, too, is a blessed Scripture which We have sent down- follow it and be conscious of your Lord, so that you may receive mercy-
verses.pickthall: And this is a blessed Scripture which We have revealed. So follow it and ward off (evil), that ye may find mercy.

verses.ar: أَن تَقُولُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ عَلَىٰ طَآئِفَتَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِنَا وَإِن كُنَّا عَن دِرَاسَتِهِمْ لَغَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.en: [We revealed it] lest you say, "The Scripture was only sent down to two groups before us, but we were of their study unaware,"
verses.tr: ʾan taqūlūā ʾinnamā ʾunzila al-kitābu ʿalā ṭāʾifatayni min qablinā wa-in kunnā ʿan dirāsatihim laghāfilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: lest you say, ‘Scriptures were only sent down to two communities before us: we were not aware of what they studied,’
verses.pickthall: Lest ye should say: The Scripture was revealed only to two sects before us, and we in sooth were unaware of what they read;

verses.ar: أَوْ تَقُولُوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ لَكُنَّآ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْهُمْ ۚ فَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ ۚ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَصَدَفَ عَنْهَا ۗ سَنَجْزِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَصْدِفُونَ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْدِفُونَ
verses.en: Or lest you say, "If only the Scripture had been revealed to us, we would have been better guided than they." So there has [now] come to you a clear evidence from your Lord and a guidance and mercy. Then who is more unjust than one who denies the verses of Allāh and turns away from them? We will recompense those who turn away from Our verses with the worst of punishment for their having turned away.
verses.tr: ʾaw taqūlūā law ʾannā ʾunzila ʿalaynā al-kitābu lakunnā ʾahdā minhum ۚ faqad jāʾakum bayyinahun mmin rrabbikum wahudanā waraḥmahun ۚ faman ʾaẓlamu mimman kadhaba bāyāti Allāh waṣadafa ʿanhā ۗ sanajzā adh-dhīna yaṣdifūna ʿan āyātinā sūʾa al-ʿadhābi bimā kānūā yaṣdifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: or ‘If only the Scripture had been sent down to us, we would have been better guided than them.’ Now clear evidence, guidance, and mercy have come to you from your Lord. Who could be more wrong than someone who rejects God’s revelations and turns away from them? We shall repay those who turn away with a painful punishment.
verses.pickthall: Or lest ye should say: If the Scripture had been revealed unto us, we surely had been better guided than are they. Now hath there come unto you a clear proof from your Lord, a guidance and mercy; and who doeth greater wrong than he who denieth the revelations of Allah, and turneth away from them? We award unto those who turn away from Our revelations an evil doom because of their aversion.

verses.ar: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ رَبُّكَ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ بَعْضُ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّكَ ۗ يَوْمَ يَأْتِى بَعْضُ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّكَ لَا يَنفَعُ نَفْسًا إِيمَـٰنُهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ ءَامَنَتْ مِن قَبْلُ أَوْ كَسَبَتْ فِىٓ إِيمَـٰنِهَا خَيْرًا ۗ قُلِ ٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
verses.en: Do they [then] wait for anything except that the angels should come to them or your Lord should come or that there come some of the signs of your Lord? The Day that some of the signs of your Lord will come no soul will benefit from its faith as long as it had not believed before or had earned through its faith some good. Say, "Wait. Indeed, we [also] are waiting."
verses.tr: hal yanẓurūna ʾillā ʾan taʾtiyahumu al-malāʾikahu ʾaw yaʾtāa rabbuka ʾaw yaʾtāa baʿḍu āyāti rabbika ۗ yawma yaʾtā baʿḍu āyāti rabbika lā yanfaʿu nafsan ʾīmānuhā lam takun āmanat min qablu ʾaw kasabat fā ʾīmānihā khayran ۗ quli āntaẓirūā ʾinnā muntaẓirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Are they waiting for the very angels to come to them, or your Lord Himself, or maybe some of His signs? But on the Day some of your Lord’s signs come, no soul will profit from faith if it had none before, or has not already earned some good through its faith. Say, ‘Wait if you wish: we too are waiting.’
verses.pickthall: Wait they, indeed, for nothing less than that the angels should come unto them, or thy Lord should come, or there should come one of the portents from thy Lord? In the day when one of the portents from thy Lord cometh, its belief availeth naught a soul which theretofore believed not, nor in its belief earned good (by works). Say: Wait ye! Lo! We (too) are waiting.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًا لَّسْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِى شَىْءٍ ۚ إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُمْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who have divided their religion and become sects - you, [O Muḥammad], are not [associated] with them in anything. Their affair is only [left] to Allāh; then He will inform them about what they used to do.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna farraqūā dīnahum wakānūā shiyaʿan llasta minhum fā shāʾin ۚ ʾinnamā ʾamruhum ʾilā Allāh thumma yunabbiʾuhum bimā kānūā yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who have divided their religion and broken up into factions, have nothing to do with them [Prophet]. Their case rests with God: in time He will tell them about their deeds.
verses.pickthall: Lo! As for those who sunder their religion and become schismatics, no concern at all hast thou with them. Their case will go to Allah, Who then will tell them what they used to do.

verses.ar: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا ۖ وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof [to his credit], and whoever comes with an evil deed will not be recompensed except the like thereof; and they will not be wronged.
verses.tr: man jāʾa bi-l-ḥasanahi falahu ʿashru ʾamthālihā ۖ waman jāʾa bi-as-sayyiʾahi falā yujzā ʾillā mithlahā wahum lā yuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whoever has done a good deed will have it ten times to his credit, but whoever has done a bad deed will be repaid only with its equivalent- they will not be wronged.
verses.pickthall: Whoso bringeth a good deed will receive tenfold the like thereof, while whoso bringeth an ill-deed will be awarded but the like thereof; and they will not be wronged.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّنِى هَدَىٰنِى رَبِّىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ دِينًا قِيَمًا مِّلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord has guided me to a straight path - a correct religion - the way of Abraham, inclining toward truth. And he was not among those who associated others with Allāh."
verses.tr: qul ʾinnanā hadānā rabbā ʾilā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin dīnan qiyaman mmillaha ʾibrāhīma ḥanīfan ۚ wamā kāna mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘My Lord has guided me to a straight path, an upright religion, the faith of Abraham, a man of pure faith. He was not a polytheist.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Lo! As for me, my Lord hath guided me unto a straight path, a right religion, the community of Abraham, the upright, who was no idolater.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِى وَنُسُكِى وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِى لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: qul ʾinna ṣalātā wanusukā wamaḥyāa wamamātā lillāh rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘My prayers and sacrifice, my life and death, are all for God, Lord of all the Worlds;
verses.pickthall: Say: Lo! my worship and my sacrifice and my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَبِذَٰلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first [among you] of the Muslims."
verses.tr: lā sharīka lahu ۖ wabidhālika ʾumirtu wa-anā ʾawwalu al-muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He has no partner. This is what I am commanded, and I am the first to devote myself to Him.’
verses.pickthall: He hath no partner. This am I commanded, and I am first of those who surrender (unto Him).

verses.ar: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبْغِى رَبًّا وَهُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۚ وَلَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ إِلَّا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Is it other than Allāh I should desire as a lord while He is the Lord of all things? And every soul earns not [blame] except against itself, and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you concerning that over which you used to differ."
verses.tr: qul ʾaghayra Allāh ʾabghā rabban wahuwa rabbu kulli shāʾin ۚ walā taksibu kullu nafsin ʾillā ʿalayhā ۚ walā taziru wāzirahun wizra ʾukhrā ۚ thumma ʾilā rabbikum mmarjiʿukum fayunabbiʾukum bimā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Should I seek a Lord other than God, when He is the Lord of all things?’ Each soul is responsible for its own actions; no soul will bear the burden of another. You will all return to your Lord in the end, and He will tell you the truth about your differences.
verses.pickthall: Say: Shall I seek another than Allah for Lord, when He is Lord of all things? Each soul earneth only on its own account, nor doth any laden bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return and He will tell you that wherein ye differed.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَكُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْعِقَابِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
verses.en: And it is He who has made you successors upon the earth and has raised some of you above others in degrees [of rank] that He may try you through what He has given you. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā jaʿalakum khalāʾifa al-ʾarḍi warafaʿa baʿḍakum fawqa baʿḍin darajātin lliyabluwakum fā mā ātākum ۗ ʾinna rabbaka sarīʿu al-ʿiqābi wa-innahu laghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who made you successors on the earth and raises some of you above others in rank, to test you through what He gives you. [Prophet], your Lord is swift in punishment, yet He is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath placed you as viceroys of the earth and hath exalted some of you in rank above others, that He may try you by (the test of) that which He hath given you. Lo! Thy Lord is swift in prosecution, and Lo! He verily is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: الٓمٓصٓ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Meem, Ṣād.
verses.tr: al-mṣ
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Mim Sad
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Mim. Sad.

verses.ar: كِتَـٰبٌ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ فَلَا يَكُن فِى صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِّنْهُ لِتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: [This is] a Book revealed to you, [O Muḥammad] - so let there not be in your breast distress therefrom - that you may warn thereby and as a reminder to the believers.
verses.tr: kitābun ʾunzila ʾilayka falā yakun fā ṣadrika ḥarajun mminhu litundhira bihi wadhikrā lilmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This Book has been sent down to you [Prophet]––let there be no anxiety in your heart because of it––so that you may use it to give warning and to remind the believers:
verses.pickthall: (It is) a Scripture that is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) - so let there be no heaviness in thy heart therefrom - that thou mayst warn thereby, and (it is) a Reminder unto believers.

verses.ar: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۗ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Follow, [O mankind], what has been revealed to you from your Lord and do not follow other than Him any allies. Little do you remember.
verses.tr: āttabiʿūā mā ʾunzila ʾilaykum mmin rrabbikum walā tattabiʿūā min dūnihi ʾawliyāʾa ۗ qalīlan mmā tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Follow what has been sent down to you from your Lord; do not follow other masters beside Him. How seldom you take heed!’
verses.pickthall: (Saying): Follow that which is sent down unto you from your Lord, and follow no protecting friends beside Him. Little do ye recollect!

verses.ar: وَكَم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَا فَجَآءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَـٰتًا أَوْ هُمْ قَآئِلُونَ
verses.en: And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon.
verses.tr: wakam mmin qaryahin ʾahlaknāhā fajāʾahā baʾsunā bayātan ʾaw hum qāʾilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How many towns We have destroyed! Our punishment came to them by night or while they slept in the afternoon:
verses.pickthall: How many a township have We destroyed! As a raid by night, or while they slept at noon, Our terror came unto them.

verses.ar: فَمَا كَانَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ إِذْ جَآءَهُم بَأْسُنَآ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And their declaration when Our punishment came to them was only that they said, "Indeed, we were wrongdoers!"
verses.tr: famā kāna daʿwāhum ʾidh jāʾahum baʾsunā ʾillā ʾan qālūā ʾinnā kunnā ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: their only cry when Our punishment came to them was, ‘How wrong we were!’
verses.pickthall: No plea had they, when Our terror came unto them, save that they said: Lo! We were wrong-doers.

verses.ar: فَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: Then We will surely question those to whom [a message] was sent, and We will surely question the messengers.
verses.tr: falanaslanna adh-dhīna ʾursila ʾilayhim walanaslanna al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall certainly question those to whom messengers were sent–– and We shall question the messengers themselves––
verses.pickthall: Then verily We shall question those unto whom (Our message) hath been sent, and verily We shall question the messengers.

verses.ar: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيْهِم بِعِلْمٍ ۖ وَمَا كُنَّا غَآئِبِينَ
verses.en: Then We will surely relate [their deeds] to them with knowledge, and We were not [at all] absent.
verses.tr: falanaquṣṣanna ʿalayhim biʿilmin ۖ wamā kunnā ghāʾibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and, with full knowledge, for We were never far from them, We shall tell them what they did.
verses.pickthall: Then verily We shall narrate unto them (the event) with knowledge, for We were not absent (when it came to pass).

verses.ar: وَٱلْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: And the weighing [of deeds] that Day will be the truth. So those whose scales are heavy - it is they who will be the successful.
verses.tr: wa-l-waznu yawmaʾidhin al-ḥaqqu ۚ faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ūlāʾika humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day the weighing of deeds will be true and just: those whose good deeds are heavy on the scales will be the ones to prosper,
verses.pickthall: The weighing on that day is the true (weighing). As for those whose scale is heavy, they are the successful.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And those whose scales are light - they are the ones who will lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses.
verses.tr: waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ūlāʾika adh-dhīna khasirūā ʾanfusahum bimā kānūā bāyātinā yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and those whose good deeds are light will be the ones who have lost their souls through their wrongful rejection of Our messages.
verses.pickthall: And as for those whose scale is light: those are they who lose their souls because they used to wrong Our revelations.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ ۗ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood. Little are you grateful.
verses.tr: walaqad makkannākum fā al-ʾarḍi wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha ۗ qalīlan mmā tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We established you [people] on the earth and provided you with a means of livelihood there––small thanks you give!
verses.pickthall: And We have given you (mankind) power in the earth, and appointed for you therein livelihoods. Little give ye thanks!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنَـٰكُمْ ثُمَّ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ لَمْ يَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: And We have certainly created you, [O mankind], and given you [human] form. Then We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was not of those who prostrated.
verses.tr: walaqad khalaqnākum thumma ṣawwarnākum thumma qulnā lilmalāʾikahi āsjudūā lādama fasajadūā ʾillā ʾiblīsa lam yakun mmina as-sājidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We created you, We gave you shape, and then We said to the angels, ‘Bow down before Adam,’ and they did. But not Iblis: he was not one of those who bowed down.
verses.pickthall: And We created you, then fashioned you, then told the angels: Fall ye prostrate before Adam! And they fell prostrate, all save Iblis, who was not of those who make prostration.

verses.ar: قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ ۖ قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "What prevented you from prostrating when I commanded you?" [Satan] said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay [i.e., earth]."
verses.tr: qāla mā manaʿaka ʾallā tasjuda ʾidh ʾamartuka ۖ qāla ʾanā khayrun mminhu khalaqtanā min nnārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘What prevented you from bowing down as I commanded you?’ and he said, ‘I am better than him: You created me from fire and him from clay.’
verses.pickthall: He said: What hindered thee that thou didst not fall prostrate when I bade thee? (Iblis) said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire while him Thou didst create of mud.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَٱهْبِطْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُونُ لَكَ أَن تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيهَا فَٱخْرُجْ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰغِرِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Descend from it [i.e., Paradise], for it is not for you to be arrogant therein. So get out; indeed, you are of the debased."
verses.tr: qāla fāhbiṭ minhā famā yakūnu laka ʾan tatakabbara fīhā fākhruj ʾinnaka mina aṣ-ṣāghirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Get down from here! This is no place for your arrogance. Get out! You are contemptible!’
verses.pickthall: He said: Then go down hence! It is not for thee to show pride here, so go forth! Lo! thou art of those degraded.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: [Satan] said, "Reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
verses.tr: qāla ʾanẓirnā ʾilā yawmi yubʿathūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but Iblis said, ‘Give me respite until the Day people are raised from the dead,’
verses.pickthall: He said: Reprieve me till the day when they are raised (from the dead).

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Indeed, you are of those reprieved."
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnaka mina al-munẓarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and God replied, ‘You have respite.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَبِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَٰطَكَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
verses.en: [Satan] said, "Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them [i.e., mankind] on Your straight path.
verses.tr: qāla fabimā ʾaghwaytanā laʾaqʿudanna lahum ṣirāṭaka al-mustaqīma
verses.abdelhaleem: And then Iblis said, ‘Because You have put me in the wrong, I will lie in wait for them all on Your straight path:
verses.pickthall: He said: Now, because Thou hast sent me astray, verily I shall lurk in ambush for them on Thy Right Path.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَـَٔاتِيَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ وَعَن شَمَآئِلِهِمْ ۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ أَكْثَرَهُمْ شَـٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: Then I will come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left, and You will not find most of them grateful [to You]."
verses.tr: thumma lātiyannahum mmin bayni ʾaydīhim wamin khalfihim waʿan ʾaymānihim waʿan shamāʾilihim ۖ walā tajidu ʾaktharahum shākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I will come at them- from their front and their back, from their right and their left- and You will find that most of them are ungrateful.’
verses.pickthall: Then I shall come upon them from before them and from behind them and from their right hands and from their left hands, and Thou wilt not find most of them beholden (unto Thee).

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مَذْءُومًا مَّدْحُورًا ۖ لَّمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Depart from it [i.e., Paradise], reproached and expelled. Whoever follows you among them - I will surely fill Hell with you, all together."
verses.tr: qāla ākhruj minhā madhʾūman mmadḥūran ۖ llaman tabiʿaka minhum laʾamlaʾanna jahannama minkum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Get out! You are disgraced and banished! I swear I shall fill Hell with you and all who follow you!
verses.pickthall: He said: Go forth from hence, degraded, banished. As for such of them as follow thee, surely I will fill hell with all of you.

verses.ar: وَيَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ فَكُلَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat from wherever you will but do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."
verses.tr: wayādamu āskun ʾanta wazawjuka al-jannaha fakulā min ḥaythu shiʾtumā walā taqrabā hādhihi ash-shajaraha fatakūnā mina aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But you and your wife, Adam, live in the Garden. Both of you eat whatever you like, but do not go near this tree or you will become wrongdoers.’
verses.pickthall: And (unto man): O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden and eat from whence ye will, but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers.

verses.ar: فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِيُبْدِىَ لَهُمَا مَا وُۥرِىَ عَنْهُمَا مِن سَوْءَٰتِهِمَا وَقَالَ مَا نَهَىٰكُمَا رَبُّكُمَا عَنْ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَا مَلَكَيْنِ أَوْ تَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِدِينَ
verses.en: But Satan whispered to them to make apparent to them that which was concealed from them of their private parts. He said, "Your Lord did not forbid you this tree except that you become angels or become of the immortal."
verses.tr: fawaswasa lahumā ash-shayṭānu liyubdāa lahumā mā wurāa ʿanhumā min sawātihimā waqāla mā nahākumā rabbukumā ʿan hādhihi ash-shajarahi ʾillā ʾan takūnā malakayni ʾaw takūnā mina al-khālidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Satan whispered to them so as to expose their nakedness, which had been hidden from them: he said, ‘Your Lord only forbade you this tree to prevent you becoming angels or immortals,’
verses.pickthall: Then Satan whispered to them that he might manifest unto them that which was hidden from them of their shame, and he said: Your Lord forbade you from this tree only lest ye should become angels or become of the immortals.

verses.ar: وَقَاسَمَهُمَآ إِنِّى لَكُمَا لَمِنَ ٱلنَّـٰصِحِينَ
verses.en: And he swore [by Allāh] to them, "Indeed, I am to you from among the sincere advisors."
verses.tr: waqāsamahumā ʾinnā lakumā lamina an-nāṣiḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and he swore to them, ‘I am giving you sincere advice’-
verses.pickthall: And he swore unto them (saying): Lo! I am a sincere adviser unto you.

verses.ar: فَدَلَّىٰهُمَا بِغُرُورٍ ۚ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا ٱلشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَنَادَىٰهُمَا رَبُّهُمَآ أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمَا عَن تِلْكُمَا ٱلشَّجَرَةِ وَأَقُل لَّكُمَآ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ لَكُمَا عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: So he made them fall, through deception. And when they tasted of the tree, their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?"
verses.tr: fadallāhumā bighurūrin ۚ falammā dhāqā ash-shajaraha badat lahumā sawātuhumā waṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ʿalayhimā min waraqi al-jannahi ۖ wanādāhumā rabbuhumā ʾalam ʾanhakumā ʿan tilkumā ash-shajarahi wa-aqul llakumā ʾinna ash-shayṭāna lakumā ʿaduwwun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: he lured them with lies. Their nakedness became exposed to them when they had eaten from the tree: they began to put together leaves from the Garden to cover themselves. Their Lord called to them, ‘Did I not forbid you to approach that tree? Did I not warn you that Satan was your sworn enemy?’
verses.pickthall: Thus did he lead them on with guile. And when they tasted of the tree their shame was manifest to them and they began to hide (by heaping) on themselves some of the leaves of the Garden. And their Lord called them, (saying): Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you: Lo! Satan is an open enemy to you?

verses.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."
verses.tr: qālā rabbanā ẓalamnā ʾanfusanā wa-in llam taghfir lanā watarḥamnā lanakūnanna mina al-khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They replied, ‘Our Lord, we have wronged our souls: if You do not forgive us and have mercy, we shall be lost.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves. If thou forgive us not and have not mercy on us, surely we are of the lost!

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱهْبِطُوا۟ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Descend, being to one another enemies. And for you on the earth is a place of settlement and enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time."
verses.tr: qāla āhbiṭūā baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun ۖ walakum fā al-ʾarḍi mustaqarrun wamatāʿun ʾilā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘All of you get out! You are each other’s enemies. On earth you will have a place to stay and livelihood- for a time.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Go down (from hence), one of you a foe unto the other. There will be for you on earth a habitation and provision for a while.

verses.ar: قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Therein you will live, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth."
verses.tr: qāla fīhā taḥyawna wafīhā tamūtūna waminhā tukhrajūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘There you will live; there you will die; from there you will be brought out.’
verses.pickthall: He said: There shall ye live, and there shall ye die, and thence shall ye be brought forth.

verses.ar: يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ قَدْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَٰرِى سَوْءَٰتِكُمْ وَرِيشًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.en: O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness - that is best. That is from the signs of Allāh that perhaps they will remember.
verses.tr: yābanā ādama qad ʾanzalnā ʿalaykum libāsan yuwārā sawātikum warīshan ۖ walibāsu at-taqwā dhālika khayrun ۚ dhālika min āyāti Allāh laʿallahum yadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Children of Adam, We have given you garments to cover your nakedness and as adornment for you; the garment of God-consciousness is the best of all garments- this is one of God’s signs, so that people may take heed.
verses.pickthall: O Children of Adam! We have revealed unto you raiment to conceal your shame, and splendid vesture, but the raiment of restraint from evil, that is best. This is of the revelations of Allah, that they may remember.

verses.ar: يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ لَا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ كَمَآ أَخْرَجَ أَبَوَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَنزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا لِيُرِيَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتِهِمَآ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ يَرَىٰكُمْ هُوَ وَقَبِيلُهُۥ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا تَرَوْنَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: O children of Adam, let not Satan tempt you as he removed your parents from Paradise, stripping them of their clothing to show them their private parts. Indeed, he sees you, he and his tribe, from where you do not see them. Indeed, We have made the devils allies to those who do not believe.
verses.tr: yābanā ādama lā yaftinannakumu ash-shayṭānu kamā ʾakhraja ʾabawaykum mmina al-jannahi yanziʿu ʿanhumā libāsahumā liyuriyahumā sawātihimā ۗ ʾinnahu yarākum huwa waqabīluhu min ḥaythu lā tarawnahum ۗ ʾinnā jaʿalnā ash-shayāṭīna ʾawliyāʾa lilladhīna lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Children of Adam, do not let Satan seduce you, as he did your parents, causing them to leave the Garden, stripping them of their garments to expose their nakedness to them: he and his forces can see you from where you cannot see them: We have made evil ones allies to those who do not believe.
verses.pickthall: O Children of Adam! Let not Satan seduce you as he caused your (first) parents to go forth from the Garden and tore off from them their robe (of innocence) that he might manifest their shame to them. Lo! he seeth you, he and his tribe, from whence ye see him not. Lo! We have made the devils protecting friends for those who believe not.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا فَعَلُوا۟ فَـٰحِشَةً قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهَآ ءَابَآءَنَا وَٱللَّهُ أَمَرَنَا بِهَا ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ ۖ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And when they commit an immorality, they say, "We found our fathers doing it, and Allāh has ordered us to do it." Say, "Indeed, Allāh does not order immorality. Do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?"
verses.tr: wa-idhā faʿalūā fāḥishahan qālūā wajadnā ʿalayhā ābāʾanā wallāh ʾamaranā bihā ۗ qul ʾinna Allāh lā yaʾmuru bi-l-faḥshāʾi ۖ ʾataqūlūna ʿalā Allāh mā lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet when [these people] do something disgraceful, they say, ‘We found our forefathers doing this,’ and, ‘God has commanded us to do this.’ Say [Prophet], ‘God does not command disgraceful deeds. How can you say about God things that you do not know [to be true]?’
verses.pickthall: And when they do some lewdness they say: We found our fathers doing it and Allah hath enjoined it on us. Say: Allah, verily, enjoineth not lewdness. Tell ye concerning Allah that which ye know not?

verses.ar: قُلْ أَمَرَ رَبِّى بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ عِندَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَٱدْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأَكُمْ تَعُودُونَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord has ordered justice and that you direct yourselves [to the Qiblah] at every place [or time] of prostration, and invoke Him, sincere to Him in religion." Just as He originated you, you will return [to life] -
verses.tr: qul ʾamara rabbā bi-l-qisṭi ۖ wa-aqīmūā wujūhakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wādʿūhu mukhliṣīna lahu ad-dīna ۚ kamā badaʾakum taʿūdūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘My Lord commands righteousness. Direct your worship straight to Him wherever you pray; call on Him; devote your religion entirely to Him. Just as He first created you, so you will come back [to life] again.’
verses.pickthall: Say: My Lord enjoineth justice. And set your faces upright (toward Him) at every place of worship and call upon Him, making religion pure for Him (only). As He brought you into being, so return ye (unto Him).

verses.ar: فَرِيقًا هَدَىٰ وَفَرِيقًا حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةُ ۗ إِنَّهُمُ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: A group [of you] He guided, and a group deserved [to be in] error. Indeed, they [i.e., the latter] had taken the devils as allies instead of Allāh while they thought that they were guided.
verses.tr: farīqan hadā wafarīqan ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu aḍ-ḍalālahu ۗ ʾinnahumu āttakhadhūā ash-shayāṭīna ʾawliyāʾa min dūni Allāh wayaḥsabūna ʾannahum mmuhtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Some He has guided and some are doomed to stray: they have taken evil ones rather than God as their masters, thinking that they are rightly guided.
verses.pickthall: A party hath He led aright, while error hath just hold over (another) party, for lo! they choose the devils for protecting supporters instead of Allah and deem that they are rightly guided.

verses.ar: ۞ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ خُذُوا۟ زِينَتَكُمْ عِندَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ وَكُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ وَلَا تُسْرِفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.en: O children of Adam, take your adornment [i.e., wear your clothing] at every masjid, and eat and drink, but be not excessive. Indeed, He likes not those who commit excess.
