verses.tr: ۞ yābanā ādama khudhūā zīnatakum ʿinda kulli masjidin wakulūā wāshrabūā walā tusrifūā ۚ ʾinnahu lā yuḥibbu al-musrifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Children of Adam, dress well whenever you are at worship, and eat and drink [as We have permitted] but do not be extravagant: God does not like extravagant people.
verses.pickthall: O Children of Adam! Look to your adornment at every place of worship, and eat and drink, but be not prodigal. Lo! He loveth not the prodigals.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَنْ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَخْرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ وَٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ مِنَ ٱلرِّزْقِ ۚ قُلْ هِىَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا خَالِصَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Who has forbidden the adornment of [i.e., from] Allāh which He has produced for His servants and the good [lawful] things of provision?" Say, "They are for those who believed during the life of this world, exclusively [for them] on the Day of Resurrection." Thus do We detail the verses for a people who know.
verses.tr: qul man ḥarrama zīnaha Allāh at-tā ʾakhraja liʿibādihi wa-aṭ-ṭayyibāti mina ar-rizqi ۚ qul hāa lilladhīna āmanūā fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā khāliṣahan yawma al-qiyāmahi ۗ kadhālika nufaṣṣilu al-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Who has forbidden the adornment and the nourishment God has provided for His servants?’ Say, ‘They are [allowed] for those who believe during the life of this world: they will be theirs alone on the Day of Resurrection.’ This is how We make Our revelation clear for those who understand.
verses.pickthall: Say: Who hath forbidden the adornment of Allah which He hath brought forth for His bondmen, and the good things of His providing? Say: Such, on the Day of Resurrection, will be only for those who believed during the life of the world. Thus do we detail Our revelations for people who have knowledge.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّىَ ٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَٱلْإِثْمَ وَٱلْبَغْىَ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَأَن تُشْرِكُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَـٰنًا وَأَن تَقُولُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "My Lord has only forbidden immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed - and sin, and oppression without right, and that you associate with Allāh that for which He has not sent down authority, and that you say about Allāh that which you do not know."
verses.tr: qul ʾinnamā ḥarrama rabbāa al-fawāḥisha mā ẓahara minhā wamā baṭana wa-l-ʾithma wa-l-baghāa bighayri al-ḥaqqi wa-an tushrikūā billāh mā lam yunazzil bihi sulṭānan wa-an taqūlūā ʿalā Allāh mā lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘My Lord only forbids disgraceful deeds- whether they be open or hidden- and sin and unjustified aggression, and that you, without His sanction, associate things with Him, and that you say things about Him without knowledge.’
verses.pickthall: Say: My Lord forbiddeth only indecencies, such of them as are apparent and such as are within, and sin and wrongful oppression, and that ye associate with Allah that for which no warrant hath been revealed, and that ye tell concerning Allah that which ye know not.

verses.ar: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
verses.en: And for every nation is a [specified] term. So when their time has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
verses.tr: walikulli ʾummahin ʾajalun ۖ fa-idhā jāʾa ʾajaluhum lā yastaʾkhirūna sāʿahan ۖ walā yastaqdimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There is a time set for every people: they cannot hasten it, nor, when it comes, will they be able to delay it for a single moment.
verses.pickthall: And every nation hath its term, and when its term cometh, they cannot put it off an hour nor yet advance (it).

verses.ar: يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ إِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى ۙ فَمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.en: O children of Adam, if there come to you messengers from among you relating to you My verses [i.e., scriptures and laws], then whoever fears Allāh and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
verses.tr: yābanā ādama ʾimmā yaʾtiyannakum rusulun mminkum yaquṣṣūna ʿalaykum āyātā ۙ famani āttaqā wa-aṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Children of Adam, when messengers come to you from among yourselves, reciting My revelations to you, for those who are conscious of God and live righteously, there will be no fear, nor will they grieve.
verses.pickthall: O Children of Adam! When messengers of your own come unto you who narrate unto you My revelations, then whosoever refraineth from evil and amendeth - there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ عَنْهَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: But the ones who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā wāstakbarūā ʿanhā ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri ۖ hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who reject Our revelations and arrogantly scorn them are the people of the Fire and there they will remain.
verses.pickthall: But they who deny Our revelations and scorn them - each are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein.

verses.ar: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِهِۦٓ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَنَالُهُمْ نَصِيبُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا يَتَوَفَّوْنَهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنَّا وَشَهِدُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh a lie or denies His verses? Those will attain their portion of the decree until, when Our messengers [i.e., angels] come to them to take them in death, they will say, "Where are those you used to invoke besides Allāh?" They will say, "They have departed from us," and will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.
verses.tr: faman ʾaẓlamu mimmani āftarā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban ʾaw kadhaba bāyātihi ۚ ʾūlāʾika yanāluhum naṣībuhum mmina al-kitābi ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾathum rusulunā yatawaffawnahum qālūā ʾayna mā kuntum tadʿūna min dūni Allāh ۖ qālūā ḍallūā ʿannā washahidūā ʿalā ʾanfusihim ʾannahum kānūā kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who is more wrong than the person who invents lies against God or rejects His revelations? Such people will have their preordained share [in this world], but then, when Our angels arrive to take them back, saying, ‘Where are those you used to call on beside God?’ they will say, ‘They have deserted us.’ They will confess that they were disbelievers and
verses.pickthall: Who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah or denieth Our tokens. (For such) their appointed portion of the Book (of destiny) reacheth them till, when Our messengers come to gather them, they say: Where (now) is that to which ye cried beside Allah? They say: They have departed from us. And they testify against themselves that they were disbelievers.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ فِى ٱلنَّارِ ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَتْ أُمَّةٌ لَّعَنَتْ أُخْتَهَا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ٱدَّارَكُوا۟ فِيهَا جَمِيعًا قَالَتْ أُخْرَىٰهُمْ لِأُولَىٰهُمْ رَبَّنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَضَلُّونَا فَـَٔاتِهِمْ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ قَالَ لِكُلٍّ ضِعْفٌ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: [Allāh] will say, "Enter among nations which had passed on before you of jinn and mankind into the Fire." Every time a nation enters, it will curse its sister until, when they have all overtaken one another therein, the last of them will say about the first of them, "Our Lord, these had misled us, so give them a double punishment of the Fire." He will say, "For each is double, but you do not know."
verses.tr: qāla ādkhulūā fā ʾumamin qad khalat min qablikum mmina al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi fā an-nāri ۖ kullamā dakhalat ʾummahun llaʿanat ʾukhtahā ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā āddārakūā fīhā jamīʿan qālat ʾukhrāhum liʾūlāhum rabbanā hāʾulāʾi ʾaḍallūnā fātihim ʿadhāban ḍiʿfan mmina an-nāri ۖ qāla likullin ḍiʿfun walākin llā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God will say, ‘Join the crowds of jinn and humans who have gone before you into the Fire.’ Every crowd curses its fellow crowd as it enters, then, when they are all gathered inside, the last of them will say of the first, ‘Our Lord, it was they who led us astray: give them double punishment in the Fire’- God says, ‘Every one of you will have double punishment, though you do not know it’-
verses.pickthall: He saith: Enter into the Fire among nations of the jinn and humankind who passed away before you. Every time a nation entereth, it curseth its sister (nation) till, when they have all been made to follow one another thither, the last of them saith unto the first of them: Our Lord! These led us astray, so give them double torment of the Fire. He saith: For each one there is double (torment), but ye know not.

verses.ar: وَقَالَتْ أُولَىٰهُمْ لِأُخْرَىٰهُمْ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: And the first of them will say to the last of them, "Then you had not any favor over us, so taste the punishment for what you used to earn."
verses.tr: waqālat ʾūlāhum liʾukhrāhum famā kāna lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin fadhūqūā al-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum taksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and the first of them will say to the last, ‘You were no better than us: taste the punishment you have earned.’
verses.pickthall: And the first of them saith unto the last of them: Ye were no whit better than us, so taste the doom for what ye used to earn.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ أَبْوَٰبُ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَا يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ حَتَّىٰ يَلِجَ ٱلْجَمَلُ فِى سَمِّ ٱلْخِيَاطِ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - the gates of Heaven will not be opened for them, nor will they enter Paradise until a camel enters into the eye of a needle [i.e., never]. And thus do We recompense the criminals.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā wāstakbarūā ʿanhā lā tufattaḥu lahum ʾabwābu as-samāʾi walā yadkhulūna al-jannaha ḥattā yalija al-jamalu fā sammi al-khiyāṭi ۚ wakadhālika najzā al-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The gates of Heaven will not be open to those who rejected Our revelations and arrogantly spurned them; even if a thick rope were to pass through the eye of a needle they would not enter the Garden. This is how We punish the guilty-
verses.pickthall: Lo! they who deny Our revelations and scorn them, for them the gates of heaven will nor be opened not will they enter the Garden until the camel goeth through the needle's eye. Thus do We requite the guilty.

verses.ar: لَهُم مِّن جَهَنَّمَ مِهَادٌ وَمِن فَوْقِهِمْ غَوَاشٍ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: They will have from Hell a bed and over them coverings [of fire]. And thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: lahum mmin jahannama mihādun wamin fawqihim ghawāshin ۚ wakadhālika najzā aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Hell will be their resting place and their covering, layer upon layer- this is how We punish those who do evil.
verses.pickthall: Theirs will be a bed of hell, and over them coverings (of hell). Thus do We requite wrong-doers.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: But those who believed and did righteous deeds - We charge no soul except [within] its capacity. Those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti lā nukallifu nafsan ʾillā wusʿahā ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu al-jannahi ۖ hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who believe and do good deeds- and We do not burden any soul with more than it can bear- are the people of the Garden and there they will remain.
verses.pickthall: But (as for) those who believe and do good works - We tax not any soul beyond its scope - Such are rightful owners of the Garden. They abide therein.

verses.ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمُ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى هَدَىٰنَا لِهَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِىَ لَوْلَآ أَنْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ ۖ لَقَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَنُودُوٓا۟ أَن تِلْكُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And We will have removed whatever is within their breasts of resentment, [while] flowing beneath them are rivers. And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allāh had not guided us. Certainly the messengers of our Lord had come with the truth." And they will be called, "This is Paradise, which you have been made to inherit for what you used to do."
verses.tr: wanazaʿnā mā fā ṣudūrihim mmin ghillin tajrā min taḥtihimu al-ʾanhāru ۖ waqālūā al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhā hadānā lihādhā wamā kunnā linahtadāa lawlā ʾan hadānā Allāh ۖ laqad jāʾat rusulu rabbinā bi-l-ḥaqqi ۖ wanūdūā ʾan tilkumu al-jannahu ʾūrithtumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall have removed all ill feeling from their hearts; streams will flow at their feet. They will say, ‘Praise be to God, who guided us to this: had God not guided us, We would never have found the way. The messengers of our Lord brought the Truth.’ A voice will call out to them, ‘This is the Garden you have been given as your own on account of your deeds.’
verses.pickthall: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their hearts. Rivers flow beneath them. And they say: The praise to Allah, Who hath guided us to this. We could not truly have been led aright if Allah had not guided us. Verily the messengers of our Lord did bring the Truth. And it is cried unto them: This is the Garden. Ye inherit it for what ye used to do.

verses.ar: وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ أَن قَدْ وَجَدْنَا مَا وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا حَقًّا فَهَلْ وَجَدتُّم مَّا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا ۖ قَالُوا۟ نَعَمْ ۚ فَأَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن لَّعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And the companions of Paradise will call out to the companions of the Fire, "We have already found what our Lord promised us to be true. Have you found what your Lord promised to be true?" They will say, "Yes." Then an announcer will announce among them, "The curse of Allāh shall be upon the wrongdoers
verses.tr: wanādā ʾaṣḥābu al-jannahi ʾaṣḥāba an-nāri ʾan qad wajadnā mā waʿadanā rabbunā ḥaqqan fahal wajadttum mmā waʿada rabbukum ḥaqqan ۖ qālūā naʿam ۚ fa-adhana muʾadhinun baynahum ʾan llaʿnahu Allāh ʿalā aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of the Garden will cry out to the people of the Fire, ‘We have found what our Lord promised us to be true. Have you found what your Lord promised you to be true?’ and they will answer, ‘Yes’. A voice will proclaim from their midst, ‘God’s rejection [hangs] over the evildoers:
verses.pickthall: And the dwellers of the Garden cry unto the dwellers of the Fire: We have found that which our Lord promised us (to be) the Truth. Have ye (too) found that which your Lord promised the Truth? They say: Yea, verily. And a crier in between them crieth: The curse of Allah is on evil-doers,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: Who averted [people] from the way of Allāh and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they were, concerning the Hereafter, disbelievers."
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli Allāh wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bi-l-ākhirahi kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who turned others away from God’s path and tried to make it crooked, those who denied the Hereafter.’
verses.pickthall: Who debar (men) from the path of Allah and would have it crooked, and who are disbelievers in the Last Day.

verses.ar: وَبَيْنَهُمَا حِجَابٌ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالٌ يَعْرِفُونَ كُلًّۢا بِسِيمَىٰهُمْ ۚ وَنَادَوْا۟ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ أَن سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ لَمْ يَدْخُلُوهَا وَهُمْ يَطْمَعُونَ
verses.en: And between them will be a partition [i.e., wall], and on [its] elevations are men who recognize all by their mark. And they call out to the companions of Paradise, "Peace be upon you." They have not [yet] entered it, but they long intensely.
verses.tr: wabaynahumā ḥijābun ۚ waʿalā al-ʾaʿrāfi rijālun yaʿrifūna kullanā bisīmāhum ۚ wanādawā ʾaṣḥāba al-jannahi ʾan salāmun ʿalaykum ۚ lam yadkhulūhā wahum yaṭmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: A barrier divides the two groups with men on its heights recognizing each group by their marks: they will call out to the people of the Garden, ‘Peace be with you!’- they will not have entered, but they will be hoping,
verses.pickthall: Between them is a veil. And on the Heights are men who know them all by their marks. And they call unto the dwellers of the Garden: Peace be unto you! They enter it not although they hope (to enter).

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِذَا صُرِفَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تِلْقَآءَ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And when their eyes are turned toward the companions of the Fire, they say, "Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people."
verses.tr: ۞ wa-idhā ṣurifat ʾabṣāruhum tilqāʾa ʾaṣḥābi an-nāri qālūā rabbanā lā tajʿalnā maʿa al-qawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and when their glance falls upon the people of the Fire, they will say, ‘Our Lord, do not let us join the evildoers!’-
verses.pickthall: And when their eyes are turned toward the dwellers of the Fire, they say: Our Lord! Place us not with the wrong-doing folk.

verses.ar: وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالًا يَعْرِفُونَهُم بِسِيمَىٰهُمْ قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنكُمْ جَمْعُكُمْ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.en: And the companions of the Elevations will call to men [within Hell] whom they recognize by their mark, saying, "Of no avail to you was your gathering and [the fact] that you were arrogant."
verses.tr: wanādā ʾaṣḥābu al-ʾaʿrāfi rijālan yaʿrifūnahum bisīmāhum qālūā mā ʾaghnā ʿankum jamʿukum wamā kuntum tastakbirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and the people of the heights will call out to certain men they recognize by their marks, ‘What use were your great numbers and your false pride?
verses.pickthall: And the dwellers on the Heights call unto men whom they know by their marks, (saying): What did your multitude and that in which ye took your pride avail you?

verses.ar: أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَقْسَمْتُمْ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ ۚ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
verses.en: [Allāh will say], "Are these the ones whom you [inhabitants of Hell] swore that Allāh would never offer them mercy? Enter Paradise, [O people of the Elevations]. No fear will there be concerning you, nor will you grieve."
verses.tr: ʾahāʾulāʾi adh-dhīna ʾaqsamtum lā yanāluhumu Allāh biraḥmahin ۚ ādkhulūā al-jannaha lā khawfun ʿalaykum walā ʾantum taḥzanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And are these the people you swore God would never bless? [Now these people are being told], “Enter the Garden! No fear for you, nor shall you grieve.”’
verses.pickthall: Are these they of whom ye swore that Allah would not show them mercy? (Unto them it hath been said): Enter the Garden. No fear shall come upon you nor is it ye who will grieve.

verses.ar: وَنَادَىٰٓ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ أَنْ أَفِيضُوا۟ عَلَيْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ أَوْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَرَّمَهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And the companions of the Fire will call to the companions of Paradise, "Pour upon us some water or from whatever Allāh has provided you." They will say, "Indeed, Allāh has forbidden them both to the disbelievers
verses.tr: wanādā ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri ʾaṣḥāba al-jannahi ʾan ʾafīḍūā ʿalaynā mina al-māʾi ʾaw mimmā razaqakumu Allāh ۚ qālūā ʾinna Allāh ḥarramahumā ʿalā al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of the Fire will call to the people of Paradise, ‘Give us some water, or any of the sustenance God has granted you!’ and they will reply, ‘God has forbidden both to the disbelievers-
verses.pickthall: And the dwellers of the Fire cry out unto the dwellers of the Garden: Pour on us some water or some wherewith Allah hath provided you. They say: Lo! Allah hath forbidden both to disbelievers (in His guidance),

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لَهْوًا وَلَعِبًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ فَٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰهُمْ كَمَا نَسُوا۟ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِهِمْ هَـٰذَا وَمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.en: Who took their religion as distraction and amusement and whom the worldly life deluded." So today We will forget them just as they forgot the meeting of this Day of theirs and for having rejected Our verses.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna āttakhadhūā dīnahum lahwan walaʿiban wagharrathumu al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā ۚ fa-l-yawma nansāhum kamā nasūā liqāʾa yawmihim hādhā wamā kānūā bāyātinā yajḥadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who took their religion for distraction, a mere game, and were deluded by worldly life.’ Today We shall ignore them, just as they have ignored their meeting with this Day and denied Our Revelations.
verses.pickthall: Who took their religion for a sport and pastime, and whom the life of the world beguiled. So this day We have forgotten them even as they forgot the meeting of this their Day and as they used to deny Our tokens.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰهُم بِكِتَـٰبٍ فَصَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And We had certainly brought them a Book which We detailed by knowledge - as guidance and mercy to a people who believe.
verses.tr: walaqad jiʾnāhum bikitābin faṣṣalnāhu ʿalā ʿilmin hudanā waraḥmahan lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have brought people a Scripture- We have explained it on the basis of true knowledge- as guidance and mercy for those who believe.
verses.pickthall: Verily We have brought them a Scripture which We expounded with knowledge, a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.

verses.ar: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا تَأْوِيلَهُۥ ۚ يَوْمَ يَأْتِى تَأْوِيلُهُۥ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوهُ مِن قَبْلُ قَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُ رَبِّنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ فَهَل لَّنَا مِن شُفَعَآءَ فَيَشْفَعُوا۟ لَنَآ أَوْ نُرَدُّ فَنَعْمَلَ غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ قَدْ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: Do they await except its result? The Day its result comes, those who had ignored it before will say, "The messengers of our Lord had come with the truth, so are there [now] any intercessors to intercede for us or could we be sent back to do other than what we used to do?" They will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
verses.tr: hal yanẓurūna ʾillā taʾwīlahu ۚ yawma yaʾtā taʾwīluhu yaqūlu adh-dhīna nasūhu min qablu qad jāʾat rusulu rabbinā bi-l-ḥaqqi fahal llanā min shufaʿāʾa fayashfaʿūā lanā ʾaw nuraddu fanaʿmala ghayra adh-dhā kunnā naʿmalu ۚ qad khasirūā ʾanfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mmā kānūā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What are they waiting for but the fulfilment of its [final prophecy]? On the Day it is fulfilled, those who had ignored it will say, ‘Our Lord’s messenger spoke the truth. Is there anyone to intercede for us now? Or can we be sent back to behave differently from the way we behaved before?’ They will really have squandered their souls, and all [the idols] they invented will have deserted them.
verses.pickthall: Await they aught save the fulfilment thereof? On the day when the fulfilment thereof cometh, those who were before forgetful thereof will say: The messengers of our Lord did bring the Truth! Have we any intercessors, that they may intercede for us? Or can we be returned (to life on earth), that we may act otherwise than we used to act? They have lost their souls, and that which they devised hath failed them.

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ يُغْشِى ٱلَّيْلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُۥ حَثِيثًا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍۭ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ ۗ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْخَلْقُ وَٱلْأَمْرُ ۗ تَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord is Allāh, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: ʾinna rabbakumu Allāh adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa fā sittahi ʾayyāmin thumma āstawā ʿalā al-ʿarshi yughshā al-yla an-nahāra yaṭlubuhu ḥathīthan wa-ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara wa-an-nujūma musakharātin biʾamrihi ۗ ʾalā lahu al-khalqu wa-l-ʾamru ۗ tabāraka Allāh rabbu al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord is God, who created the heavens and earth in six Days, then established Himself on the throne; He makes the night cover the day in swift pursuit; He created the sun, moon, and stars to be subservient to His command; all creation and command belong to Him. Exalted be God, Lord of all the worlds!
verses.pickthall: Lo! your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then mounted He the Throne. He covereth the night with the day, which is in haste to follow it, and hath made the sun and the moon and the stars subservient by His command. His verily is all creation and commandment. Blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!

verses.ar: ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
verses.en: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.
verses.tr: ādʿūā rabbakum taḍarruʿan wakhufyahan ۚ ʾinnahu lā yuḥibbu al-muʿtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Call on your Lord humbly and privately- He does not like those who transgress His bounds:
verses.pickthall: (O mankind!) Call upon your Lord humbly and in secret. Lo! He loveth not aggressors.

verses.ar: وَلَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَـٰحِهَا وَٱدْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا ۚ إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allāh is near to the doers of good.
verses.tr: walā tufsidūā fā al-ʾarḍi baʿda ʾiṣlāḥihā wādʿūhu khawfan waṭamaʿan ۚ ʾinna raḥmata Allāh qarībun mmina al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: do not corrupt the earth after it has been set right- call on Him fearing and hoping. The mercy of God is close to those who do good.
verses.pickthall: Work not confusion in the earth after the fair ordering (thereof). and call on Him in fear and hope. Lo! the mercy of Allah is nigh unto the good.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَقَلَّتْ سَحَابًا ثِقَالًا سُقْنَـٰهُ لِبَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَأَنزَلْنَا بِهِ ٱلْمَآءَ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall] until, when they have carried heavy rainclouds, We drive them to a dead land and We send down rain therein and bring forth thereby [some] of all the fruits. Thus will We bring forth the dead; perhaps you may be reminded.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā yursilu ar-riyāḥa bushranā bayna yadā raḥmatihi ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā ʾaqallat saḥāban thiqālan suqnāhu libaladin mmayyitin fa-anzalnā bihi al-māʾa fa-akhrajnā bihi min kulli ath-thamarāti ۚ kadhālika nukhriju al-mawtā laʿallakum tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who sends the winds, bearing good news of His coming grace, and when they have gathered up the heavy clouds, We drive them to a dead land where We cause rain to fall, bringing out all kinds of crops, just as We shall bring out the dead. Will you not reflect?
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who sendeth the winds as tidings heralding His mercy, till, when they bear a cloud heavy (with rain), We lead it to a dead land, and then cause water to descend thereon and thereby bring forth fruits of every kind. Thus bring We forth the dead. Haply ye may remember.

verses.ar: وَٱلْبَلَدُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ يَخْرُجُ نَبَاتُهُۥ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِۦ ۖ وَٱلَّذِى خَبُثَ لَا يَخْرُجُ إِلَّا نَكِدًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And the good land - its vegetation emerges by permission of its Lord; but that which is bad - nothing emerges except sparsely, with difficulty. Thus do We diversify the signs for a people who are grateful.
verses.tr: wa-l-baladu aṭ-ṭayyibu yakhruju nabātuhu biʾidhni rabbihi ۖ wa-adh-dhā khabutha lā yakhruju ʾillā nakidan ۚ kadhālika nuṣarrifu al-āyāti liqawmin yashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Vegetation comes out of good land in abundance, by the will of its Lord, but out of bad land only scantily: We explain Our Revelations in various ways to those who give thanks.
verses.pickthall: As for the good land, its vegetation cometh forth by permission of its Lord; while as for that which is bad, only the useless cometh forth (from it). Thus do We recount the tokens for people who give thanks.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day."
verses.tr: laqad ʾarsalnā nūḥan ʾilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi āʿbudūā Allāh mā lakum mmin ʾilāhin ghayruhu ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Noah to his people. He said, ‘My people, serve God: you have no god other than Him. I fear for you the punishment of a fearsome Day!’
verses.pickthall: We sent Noah (of old) unto his people, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an Awful Day.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Said the eminent among his people, "Indeed, we see you in clear error."
verses.tr: qāla al-malaʾu min qawmihi ʾinnā lanarāka fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: but the prominent leaders of his people said, ‘We believe you are far astray.’
verses.pickthall: The chieftains of his people said: Lo! we see thee surely in plain error.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِى ضَلَـٰلَةٌ وَلَـٰكِنِّى رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: [Noah] said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: qāla yāqawmi laysa bā ḍalālahun walākinnā rasūlun mmin rrabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He replied, ‘My people, there is nothing astray about me! On the contrary, I am a messenger from the Lord of all the Worlds:
verses.pickthall: He said: O my people! There is no error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّى وَأَنصَحُ لَكُمْ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: I convey to you the messages of my Lord and advise you; and I know from Allāh what you do not know.
verses.tr: ʾuballighukum risālāti rabbā wa-anṣaḥu lakum wa-aʿlamu mina Allāh mā lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: I am delivering my Lord’s messages to you and giving you sincere advice. I know things from God that you do not.
verses.pickthall: I convey unto you the messages of my Lord and give good counsel unto you, and know from Allah that which ye know not.

verses.ar: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ وَلِتَتَّقُوا۟ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.en: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you and that you may fear Allāh so you might receive mercy?"
verses.tr: ʾawaʿajibtum ʾan jāʾakum dhikrun mmin rrabbikum ʿalā rajulin mminkum liyundhirakum walitattaqūā walaʿallakum turḥamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you find it so strange that a message should come from your Lord- through a man in your midst- to warn you and make you aware of God so that you may be given mercy?’
verses.pickthall: Marvel ye that there should come unto you a Reminder from your Lord by means of a man among you, that he may warn you, and that ye may keep from evil, and that haply ye may find mercy.

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ وَأَغْرَقْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَمِينَ
verses.en: But they denied him, so We saved him and those who were with him in the ship. And We drowned those who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a blind people.
verses.tr: fakadhabūhu fa-anjaynāhu wa-adh-dhīna maʿahu fā al-fulki wa-aghraqnā adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā ۚ ʾinnahum kānūā qawman ʿamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but they called him a liar. We saved him, and those who were with him, on the Ark and We drowned those who rejected Our revelations- they were wilfully blind.
verses.pickthall: But they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and We drowned those who denied Our tokens. Lo! they were blind folk.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا ۗ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And to the ʿAad [We sent] their brother Hūd. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. Then will you not fear Him?"
verses.tr: ۞ wa-ʾilā ʿādin ʾakhāhum hūdan ۗ qāla yāqawmi āʿbudūā Allāh mā lakum mmin ʾilāhin ghayruhu ۚ ʾafalā tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: To the people of 'Ad We sent their brother, Hud. He said, ‘My people, serve God: you have no god other than Him. Will you not take heed?’
verses.pickthall: And unto (the tribe of) A'ad (We sent) their brother, Hud. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِى سَفَاهَةٍ وَإِنَّا لَنَظُنُّكَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "Indeed, we see you in foolishness, and indeed, we think you are of the liars."
verses.tr: qāla al-malaʾu adh-dhīna kafarūā min qawmihi ʾinnā lanarāka fā safāhahin wa-innā lanaẓunnuka mina al-kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but the disbelieving leaders of his people said, ‘We believe you are a fool,’ and ‘We think you are a liar.’
verses.pickthall: The chieftains of his people, who were disbelieving, said: Lo! we surely see thee in foolishness, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِى سَفَاهَةٌ وَلَـٰكِنِّى رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: [Hūd] said, "O my people, there is not foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: qāla yāqawmi laysa bā safāhahun walākinnā rasūlun mmin rrabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My people, there is nothing foolish about me! On the contrary, I am a messenger from the Lord of all the Worlds:
verses.pickthall: He said: O my people! There is no foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّى وَأَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser.
verses.tr: ʾuballighukum risālāti rabbā wa-anā lakum nāṣiḥun ʾamīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: I am delivering my Lord’s messages to you. I am your sincere and honest adviser.
verses.pickthall: I convey unto you the messages of my Lord and am for you a true adviser.

verses.ar: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةً ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed."
verses.tr: ʾawaʿajibtum ʾan jāʾakum dhikrun mmin rrabbikum ʿalā rajulin mminkum liyundhirakum ۚ wādhkurūā ʾidh jaʿalakum khulafāʾa min baʿdi qawmi nūḥin wazādakum fā al-khalqi baṣṭahan ۖ fādhkurūā ālāʾa Allāh laʿallakum tufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you find it so strange that a message should come from your Lord, through a man in your midst, to warn you? Remember how He made you heirs after Noah’s people, and increased your stature: remember God’s bounties, so that you may prosper.’
verses.pickthall: Marvel ye that there should come unto you a Reminder from your Lord by means of a man among you, that he may warn you? Remember how He made you viceroys after Noah's folk, and gave you growth of stature. Remember (all) the bounties of your Lord, that haply ye may be successful.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِنَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ وَحْدَهُۥ وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا ۖ فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Have you come to us that we should worship Allāh alone and leave what our fathers have worshipped? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.tr: qālūā ʾajiʾtanā linaʿbuda Allāh waḥdahu wanadhara mā kāna yaʿbudu ābāʾunā ۖ fa-tinā bimā taʿidunā ʾin kunta mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Have you really come to tell us to serve God alone and to forsake what our forefathers served? If what you say is true, bring us the punishment you threaten.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Hast come unto us that we should serve Allah alone, and forsake what our fathers worshipped? Then bring upon us that wherewith thou threatenest us if thou art of the truthful!

verses.ar: قَالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ رِجْسٌ وَغَضَبٌ ۖ أَتُجَـٰدِلُونَنِى فِىٓ أَسْمَآءٍ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ فَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُنتَظِرِينَ
verses.en: [Hūd] said, "Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord. Do you dispute with me concerning [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allāh has not sent down any authority? Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."
verses.tr: qāla qad waqaʿa ʿalaykum mmin rrabbikum rijsun waghaḍabun ۖ ʾatujādilūnanā fā ʾasmāʾin sammaytumūhā ʾantum wabāʾukum mmā nazzala Allāh bihā min sulṭānin ۚ fāntaẓirūā ʾinnā maʿakum mmina al-muntaẓirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘You are already set to receive your Lord’s loathing and anger. Are you arguing with me about mere names you and your forefathers invented, names for which God has given no sanction? Just wait; I too am waiting.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Terror and wrath from your Lord have already fallen on you. Would ye wrangle with me over names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which no warrant from Allah hath been revealed? Then await (the consequence), lo! I (also) am of those awaiting (it).

verses.ar: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers.
verses.tr: fa-anjaynāhu wa-adh-dhīna maʿahu biraḥmahin mminnā waqaṭaʿnā dābira adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā ۖ wamā kānūā muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved him, and those who were with him, through Our mercy; We destroyed those who denied Our revelations and would not believe.
verses.pickthall: And We saved him and those with him by a mercy from Us, and We cut the root of those who denied Our revelations and were not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا ۗ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ ءَايَةً ۖ فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِىٓ أَرْضِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And to the Thamūd [We sent] their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. This is the she-camel of Allāh [sent] to you as a sign. So leave her to eat within Allāh's land and do not touch her with harm, lest there seize you a painful punishment.
verses.tr: wa-ʾilā thamūda ʾakhāhum ṣāliḥan ۗ qāla yāqawmi āʿbudūā Allāh mā lakum mmin ʾilāhin ghayruhu ۖ qad jāʾatkum bayyinahun mmin rrabbikum ۖ hādhihi nāqahu Allāh lakum āyahan ۖ fadharūhā taʾkul fā ʾarḍi Allāh ۖ walā tamassūhā bisūʾin fayaʾkhudhakum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: To the people of Thamud We sent their brother, Salih. He said, ‘My people, serve God: you have no god other than Him. A clear sign has come to you now from your Lord: this is God’s she-camel- a sign for you- so let her graze in God’s land and do not harm her in any way, or you will be struck by a painful torment.
verses.pickthall: And to (the tribe of) Thamud (We sent) their brother Salih. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. A wonder from your Lord hath come unto you. Lo! this is the camel of Allah, a token unto you; so let her feed in Allah's earth, and touch her not with hurt lest painful torment seize you.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عَادٍ وَبَوَّأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِن سُهُولِهَا قُصُورًا وَتَنْحِتُونَ ٱلْجِبَالَ بُيُوتًا ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: And remember when He made you successors after the ʿAad and settled you in the land, [and] you take for yourselves palaces from its plains and carve from the mountains, homes. Then remember the favors of Allāh and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
verses.tr: wādhkurūā ʾidh jaʿalakum khulafāʾa min baʿdi ʿādin wabawwaʾakum fā al-ʾarḍi tattakhidhūna min suhūlihā quṣūran watanḥitūna al-jibāla buyūtan ۖ fādhkurūā ālāʾa Allāh walā taʿthawā fā al-ʾarḍi mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember how He made you heirs after 'Ad and settled you in the land to build yourselves castles on its plains and carve houses out of the mountains: remember God’s blessings and do not spread corruption in the land,’
verses.pickthall: And remember how He made you viceroys after A'ad and gave you station in the earth. Ye choose castles in the plains and hew the mountains into dwellings. So remember (all) the bounties of Allah and do not evil, making mischief in the earth.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِمَنْ ءَامَنَ مِنْهُمْ أَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ صَـٰلِحًا مُّرْسَلٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلَ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people to those who were oppressed - to those who believed among them, "Do you [actually] know that Ṣāliḥ is sent from his Lord?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which he was sent, are believers."
verses.tr: qāla al-malaʾu adh-dhīna āstakbarūā min qawmihi lilladhīna āstuḍʿifūā liman āmana minhum ʾataʿlamūna ʾanna ṣāliḥan mmursalun mmin rrabbihi ۚ qālūā ʾinnā bimā ʾursila bihi muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but the arrogant leaders among his people said to the believers they thought to be of no account, ‘Do you honestly think that Salih is a messenger from his Lord?’ They said, ‘Yes. We believe in the message sent through him,’
verses.pickthall: The chieftains of his people, who were scornful, said unto those whom they despised, unto such of them as believed: Know ye that Salih is one sent from his Lord? They said: Lo! In that wherewith he hath been sent we are believers.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: Said those who were arrogant, "Indeed we, in that which you have believed, are disbelievers."
verses.tr: qāla adh-dhīna āstakbarūā ʾinnā bi-adh-dhā āmantum bihi kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but the arrogant leaders said, ‘We reject what you believe in,’
verses.pickthall: Those who were scornful said: Lo! in that which ye believe we are disbelievers.

verses.ar: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers."
verses.tr: faʿaqarūā an-nāqaha waʿatawā ʿan ʾamri rabbihim waqālūā yāṣāliḥu āʾtinā bimā taʿidunā ʾin kunta mina al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then they hamstrung the camel. They defied their Lord’s commandment and said, ‘Salih, bring down the punishment you threaten, if you really are a messenger!’
verses.pickthall: So they hamstrung the she-camel, and they flouted the commandment of their Lord, and they said: O Salih! Bring upon us that thou threatenest if thou art indeed of those sent (from Allah).

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verses.en: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
verses.tr: fa-akhadhathumu ar-rajfahu fa-aṣbaḥūā fā dārihim jāthimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: An earthquake seized them: by the next morning they were lying dead in their homes.
verses.pickthall: So the earthquake seized them, and morning found them prostrate in their dwelling-place.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَةَ رَبِّى وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُحِبُّونَ ٱلنَّـٰصِحِينَ
verses.en: And he [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the message of my Lord and advised you, but you do not like advisors."
verses.tr: fatawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāqawmi laqad ʾablaghtukum risālaha rabbā wanaṣaḥtu lakum walākin llā tuḥibbūna an-nāṣiḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So he turned away from them, saying, ‘My people, I delivered my Lord’s messages to you and gave you sincere advice, but you did not like those who gave sincere advice.’
verses.pickthall: And (Salih) turned from them and said: O my people! I delivered my Lord's message unto you and gave you good advice, but ye love not good advisers.

verses.ar: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And [We had sent] Lot when he said to his people, "Do you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds [i.e., peoples]?
verses.tr: walūṭan ʾidh qāla liqawmihi ʾataʾtūna al-fāḥishaha mā sabaqakum bihā min ʾaḥadin mmina al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Lot and he said to his people, ‘How can you practise this outrage? No one in the world has outdone you in this.
verses.pickthall: And Lot! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Will ye commit abomination such as no creature ever did before you?

verses.ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, you approach men with desire, instead of women. Rather, you are a transgressing people."
verses.tr: ʾinnakum lataʾtūna ar-rijāla shahwahan mmin dūni an-nisāʾi ۚ bal ʾantum qawmun mmusrifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You lust after men rather than women! You transgress all bounds!’
verses.pickthall: Lo! ye come with lust unto men instead of women. Nay, but ye are wanton folk.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوهُم مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
verses.en: But the answer of his people was only that they said, "Evict them from your city! Indeed, they are men who keep themselves pure."
verses.tr: wamā kāna jawāba qawmihi ʾillā ʾan qālūā ʾakhrijūhum mmin qaryatikum ۖ ʾinnahum ʾunāsun yataṭahharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The only response his people gave was to say [to one another], ‘Drive them out of your town! These men want to keep themselves chaste!’
verses.pickthall: And the answer of his people was only that they said (one to another): Turn them out of your township. They are folk, forsooth, who keep pure.

verses.ar: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; she was of those who remained [with the evildoers].
verses.tr: fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ʾillā āmraʾatahu kānat mina al-ghābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved him and his kinsfolk- apart from his wife who stayed behind-
verses.pickthall: And We rescued him and his household, save his wife, who was of those who stayed behind.

verses.ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones]. Then see how was the end of the criminals.
verses.tr: wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim mmaṭaran ۖ fānẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We showered upon [the rest of] them a rain [of destruction]. See the fate of the evildoers.
verses.pickthall: And We rained a rain upon them. See now the nature of the consequence of evil-doers!

verses.ar: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا ۗ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَـٰحِهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And to [the people of] Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. So fulfill the measure and weight and do not deprive people of their due and cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. That is better for you, if you should be believers.
verses.tr: wa-ʾilā madyana ʾakhāhum shuʿayban ۗ qāla yāqawmi āʿbudūā Allāh mā lakum mmin ʾilāhin ghayruhu ۖ qad jāʾatkum bayyinahun mmin rrabbikum ۖ fa-awfūā al-kayla wa-l-mīzāna walā tabkhasūā an-nāsa ʾashyāʾahum walā tufsidūā fā al-ʾarḍi baʿda ʾiṣlāḥihā ۚ dhālikum khayrun llakum ʾin kuntum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: To the people of Midian We sent their brother, Shuayb. He said, ‘My people, serve God: you have no god other than Him. A clear sign has come to you from your Lord. Give full measure and weight and do not undervalue people’s goods; do not cause corruption in the land after it has been set in order: this is better for you, if you are believers.
verses.pickthall: And unto Midian (We sent) their brother, Shu'eyb. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Lo! a clear proof hath come unto you from your Lord; so give full measure and full weight and wrong not mankind in their goods, and work not confusion in the earth after the fair ordering thereof. That will be better for you, if ye are believers.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقْعُدُوا۟ بِكُلِّ صِرَٰطٍ تُوعِدُونَ وَتَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِهِۦ وَتَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ كُنتُمْ قَلِيلًا فَكَثَّرَكُمْ ۖ وَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: And do not sit on every path, threatening and averting from the way of Allāh those who believe in Him, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. And remember when you were few and He increased you. And see how was the end of the corrupters.
verses.tr: walā taqʿudūā bikulli ṣirāṭin tūʿidūna wataṣuddūna ʿan sabīli Allāh man āmana bihi watabghūnahā ʿiwajan ۚ wādhkurūā ʾidh kuntum qalīlan fakatharakum ۖ wānẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not sit in every pathway, threatening and barring those who believe in God from His way, trying to make it crooked. Remember how you used to be few and He made you multiply. Think about the fate of those who used to spread corruption.
verses.pickthall: Lurk not on every road to threaten (wayfarers), and to turn away from Allah's path him who believeth in Him, and to seek to make it crooked. And remember, when ye were but few, how He did multiply you. And see the nature of the consequence for the corrupters!

verses.ar: وَإِن كَانَ طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنكُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦ وَطَآئِفَةٌ لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَٱصْبِرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا ۚ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verses.en: And if there should be a group among you who has believed in that with which I have been sent and a group that has not believed, then be patient until Allāh judges between us. And He is the best of judges."
verses.tr: wa-in kāna ṭāʾifahun mminkum āmanūā bi-adh-dhā ʾursiltu bihi waṭāʾifahun llam yuʾminūā fāṣbirūā ḥattā yaḥkuma Allāh baynanā ۚ wahuwa khayru al-ḥākimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If some of you believe the message I bring and others do not, then be patient till God judges between us. He is the best of all judges.’
verses.pickthall: And if there is a party of you which believeth in that wherewith I have been sent, and there is a party which believeth not, then have patience until Allah judge between us. He is the Best of all who deal in judgment.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكَ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَكَ مِن قَرْيَتِنَآ أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِى مِلَّتِنَا ۚ قَالَ أَوَلَوْ كُنَّا كَـٰرِهِينَ
verses.en: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people, "We will surely evict you, O Shuʿayb, and those who have believed with you from our city, or you must return to our religion." He said, "Even if we were unwilling?
verses.tr: ۞ qāla al-malaʾu adh-dhīna āstakbarūā min qawmihi lanukhrijannaka yāshuʿaybu wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā maʿaka min qaryatinā ʾaw lataʿūdunna fā millatinā ۚ qāla ʾawalaw kunnā kārihīna
verses.abdelhaleem: His people’s arrogant leaders said, ‘Shuayb, we will expel you and your fellow believers from our town unless you return to our religion.’ He said, ‘What! Even if we detest it?
verses.pickthall: The chieftains of his people, who were scornful, said: Surely we will drive thee out, O Shu'eyb, and those who believe with thee, from our township, unless ye return to our religion. He said: Even though we hate it?

verses.ar: قَدِ ٱفْتَرَيْنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا إِنْ عُدْنَا فِى مِلَّتِكُم بَعْدَ إِذْ نَجَّىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَمَا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّعُودَ فِيهَآ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا ۚ وَسِعَ رَبُّنَا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا ۚ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا ٱفْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَـٰتِحِينَ
verses.en: We would have invented against Allāh a lie if we returned to your religion after Allāh had saved us from it. And it is not for us to return to it except that Allāh, our Lord, should will. Our Lord has encompassed all things in knowledge. Upon Allāh we have relied. Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision."
verses.tr: qadi āftaraynā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban ʾin ʿudnā fā millatikum baʿda ʾidh najjānā Allāh minhā ۚ wamā yakūnu lanā ʾan nnaʿūda fīhā ʾillā ʾan yashāʾa Allāh rabbunā ۚ wasiʿa rabbunā kulla shāʾin ʿilman ۚ ʿalā Allāh tawakkalnā ۚ rabbanā āftaḥ baynanā wabayna qawminā bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-anta khayru al-fātiḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If we were to return to your religion after God has saved us from it, we would be inventing lies about Him: there is no way we could return to it- unless by the will of God our Lord: in His knowledge He comprehends everything. We put our trust in God. Our Lord, expose the truth [and judge] between us and our people, for You are the best judge.’
verses.pickthall: We should have invented a lie against Allah if we returned to your religion after Allah hath rescued us from it. It is not for us to return to it unless Allah our Lord should (so) will. Our Lord comprehendeth all things in knowledge. In Allah do we put our trust. Our Lord! Decide with truth between us and our folk, for Thou art the best of those who make decision.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ لَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْبًا إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "If you should follow Shuʿayb, indeed, you would then be losers."
verses.tr: waqāla al-malaʾu adh-dhīna kafarūā min qawmihi laʾini āttabaʿtum shuʿayban ʾinnakum ʾidhan llakhāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelieving leaders among his people said, ‘You will certainly be losers if you follow Shuayb’-
verses.pickthall: But the chieftains of his people, who were disbelieving, said: If ye follow Shu'eyb, then truly ye shall be the losers.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verses.en: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
verses.tr: fa-akhadhathumu ar-rajfahu fa-aṣbaḥūā fā dārihim jāthimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: an earthquake seized them: by the next morning they were lying dead in their homes;
verses.pickthall: So the earthquake seized them and morning found them prostrate in their dwelling-place.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ شُعَيْبًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَا ۚ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ شُعَيْبًا كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was as though they had never resided there. Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was they who were the losers.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna kadhabūā shuʿayban kaʾan llam yaghnawā fīhā ۚ adh-dhīna kadhabūā shuʿayban kānūā humu al-khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: it was as if those who had rejected Shuayb had never lived there; it was those who had rejected Shuayb who were the losers-
verses.pickthall: Those who denied Shu'eyb became as though they had not dwelt there. Those who denied Shu'eyb, they were the losers.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّى وَنَصَحْتُ لَكُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ ءَاسَىٰ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ كَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And he [i.e., Shuʿayb] turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the messages of my Lord and advised you, so how could I grieve for a disbelieving people?"
verses.tr: fatawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāqawmi laqad ʾablaghtukum risālāti rabbā wanaṣaḥtu lakum ۖ fakayfa āsā ʿalā qawmin kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: so he turned away from them, saying, ‘My people, I delivered my Lord’s messages to you and gave you sincere advice, so why should I grieve for people who refused to believe?’
verses.pickthall: So he turned from them and said: O my people! I delivered my Lord's messages unto you and gave you good advice; then how can I sorrow for a people that rejected (truth)?

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّآ أَخَذْنَآ أَهْلَهَا بِٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَضَّرَّعُونَ
verses.en: And We sent to no city a prophet [who was denied] except that We seized its people with poverty and hardship that they might humble themselves [to Allāh].
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnā fā qaryahin mmin nnabāin ʾillā ʾakhadhnā ʾahlahā bi-l-baʾsāʾi wa-aḍ-ḍarrāʾi laʿallahum yaḍḍarraʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever We sent a prophet to a town, We afflicted its [disbelieving] people with suffering and hardships, so that they might humble themselves [before God],
verses.pickthall: And We sent no prophet unto any township but We did afflict its folk with tribulation and adversity that haply they might grow humble.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَ ٱلسَّيِّئَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّىٰ عَفَوا۟ وَّقَالُوا۟ قَدْ مَسَّ ءَابَآءَنَا ٱلضَّرَّآءُ وَٱلسَّرَّآءُ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Then We exchanged in place of the bad [condition], good, until they increased [and prospered] and said, "Our fathers [also] were touched with hardship and ease." So We seized them suddenly while they did not perceive.
verses.tr: thumma baddalnā makāna as-sayyiʾahi al-ḥasanaha ḥattā ʿafawā wwaqālūā qad massa ābāʾanā aḍ-ḍarrāʾu wa-as-sarrāʾu fa-akhadhnāhum baghtahan wahum lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then We changed their hardship into prosperity, until they multiplied. But then they said, ‘Hardship and affluence also befell our forefathers,’ and so We took them suddenly, unawares.
verses.pickthall: Then changed We the evil plight for good till they grew affluent and said: Tribulation and distress did touch our fathers. Then We seized them unawares, when they perceived not.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَفَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَرَكَـٰتٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبُوا۟ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: And if only the people of the cities had believed and feared Allāh, We would have opened [i.e., bestowed] upon them blessings from the heaven and the earth; but they denied [the messengers], so We seized them for what they were earning.
verses.tr: walaw ʾanna ʾahla al-qurā āmanūā wāttaqawā lafataḥnā ʿalayhim barakātin mmina as-samāʾi wa-l-ʾarḍi walākin kadhabūā fa-akhadhnāhum bimā kānūā yaksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If the people of those towns had believed and been mindful of God, We would have showered them with blessings from the heavens and earth, but they rejected the truth and so We punished them for their misdeeds.
verses.pickthall: And if the people of the townships had believed and kept from evil, surely We should have opened for them blessings from the sky and from the earth. But (unto every messenger) they gave the lie, and so We seized them on account of what they used to earn.

verses.ar: أَفَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتِيَهُم بَأْسُنَا بَيَـٰتًا وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
verses.en: Then, did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them at night while they were asleep?
verses.tr: ʾafaʾamina ʾahlu al-qurā ʾan yaʾtiyahum baʾsunā bayātan wahum nāʾimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do the people of these towns feel secure that Our punishment will not come upon them by night, while they are asleep?
verses.pickthall: Are the people of the townships then secure from the coming of Our wrath upon them as a night-raid while they sleep?

verses.ar: أَوَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتِيَهُم بَأْسُنَا ضُحًى وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.en: Or did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them in the morning while they were at play?
verses.tr: ʾawaʾamina ʾahlu al-qurā ʾan yaʾtiyahum baʾsunā ḍuḥanā wahum yalʿabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do the people of these towns feel secure that Our punishment will not come upon them by day, while they are at play?
verses.pickthall: Or are the people of the townships then secure from the coming of Our wrath upon them in the daytime while they play?

verses.ar: أَفَأَمِنُوا۟ مَكْرَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَلَا يَأْمَنُ مَكْرَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: Then, did they feel secure from the plan of Allāh? But no one feels secure from the plan of Allāh except the losing people.
verses.tr: ʾafaʾaminūā makra Allāh ۚ falā yaʾmanu makra Allāh ʾillā al-qawmu al-khāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they feel secure against God’s plan? Only the losers feel secure against God’s plan.
verses.pickthall: Are they then secure from Allah's scheme? None deemeth himself secure from Allah's scheme save folk that perish.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَهْلِهَآ أَن لَّوْ نَشَآءُ أَصَبْنَـٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ ۚ وَنَطْبَعُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.en: Has it not become clear to those who inherited the earth after its [previous] people that if We willed, We could afflict them for their sins? But We seal over their hearts so they do not hear.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yahdi lilladhīna yarithūna al-ʾarḍa min baʿdi ʾahlihā ʾan llaw nashāʾu ʾaṣabnāhum bidhunūbihim ۚ wanaṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yasmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Is it not clear to those who inherit the land from former generations that We can punish them too for their sins if We will? And seal up their hearts so that they cannot hear?
verses.pickthall: Is it not an indication to those who inherit the land after its people (who thus reaped the consequence of evil-doing) that, if We will, We can smite them for their sins and print upon their hearts so that they hear not?

verses.ar: تِلْكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآئِهَا ۚ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِمَا كَذَّبُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: Those cities - We relate to you, [O Muḥammad], some of their news. And certainly did their messengers come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus does Allāh seal over the hearts of the disbelievers.
verses.tr: tilka al-qurā naquṣṣu ʿalayka min ʾanbāʾihā ۚ walaqad jāʾathum rusuluhum bi-l-bayyināti famā kānūā liyuʾminūā bimā kadhabūā min qablu ۚ kadhālika yaṭbaʿu Allāh ʿalā qulūbi al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have told you [Prophet] the stories of those towns: messengers came to them, and clear signs, but they would not believe in what they had already rejected- in this way God seals the hearts of disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: Such were the townships. We relate some tidings of them unto thee (Muhammad). Their messengers verily came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they could not believe because they had before denied. Thus doth Allah print upon the hearts of disbelievers (that they hear not).

verses.ar: وَمَا وَجَدْنَا لِأَكْثَرِهِم مِّنْ عَهْدٍ ۖ وَإِن وَجَدْنَآ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: And We did not find for most of them any covenant; but indeed, We found most of them defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: wamā wajadnā liʾaktharihim mmin ʿahdin ۖ wa-in wajadnā ʾaktharahum lafāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We found that most of them did not honour their commitments; We found that most of them were defiant.
verses.pickthall: We found no (loyalty to any) covenant in most of them. Nay, most of them We found wrong-doers.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَظَلَمُوا۟ بِهَا ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: Then We sent after them Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were unjust toward them. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
verses.tr: thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mmūsā bāyātinā ʾilā firʿawna wamalaʾīhi faẓalamūā bihā ۖ fānẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: After these, We sent Moses to Pharaoh and his leading supporters with Our signs, but they rejected them. See the fate of those who used to spread corruption.
verses.pickthall: Then, after them, We sent Moses with our tokens unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they repelled them. Now, see the nature of the consequence for the corrupters!

verses.ar: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَـٰفِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And Moses said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds
verses.tr: waqāla mūsā yāfirʿawnu ʾinnā rasūlun mmin rrabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of all the Worlds,
verses.pickthall: Moses said: O Pharaoh! Lo! I am a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds,

verses.ar: حَقِيقٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن لَّآ أَقُولَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْحَقَّ ۚ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِبَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعِىَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: [Who is] obligated not to say about Allāh except the truth. I have come to you with clear evidence from your Lord, so send with me the Children of Israel."
verses.tr: ḥaqīqun ʿalā ʾan llā ʾaqūla ʿalā Allāh ʾillā al-ḥaqqa ۚ qad jiʾtukum bibayyinahin mmin rrabbikum fa-arsil maʿāa banā ʾisrāʾīla
verses.abdelhaleem: duty-bound to say nothing about God but the truth, and I have brought you a clear sign from your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go with me.’
verses.pickthall: Approved upon condition that I speak concerning Allah nothing but the truth. I come unto you (lords of Egypt) with a clear proof from your Lord. So let the Children of Israel go with me.

verses.ar: قَالَ إِن كُنتَ جِئْتَ بِـَٔايَةٍ فَأْتِ بِهَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "If you have come with a sign, then bring it forth, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.tr: qāla ʾin kunta jiʾta bāyahin fa-ti bihā ʾin kunta mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Produce this sign you have brought, if you are telling the truth.’
verses.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: If thou comest with a token, then produce it, if thou art of those who speak the truth.

verses.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: So he [i.e., Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent, manifest.
verses.tr: fa-ʾalqā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hāa thuʿbānun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: So Moses threw his staff and- lo and behold!- it was a snake, clear to all,
verses.pickthall: Then he flung down his staff and lo! it was a serpent manifest;

verses.ar: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
verses.en: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white [with radiance] for the observers.
verses.tr: wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hāa bayḍāʾu lilnnāẓirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then he pulled out his hand and- lo and behold!- it was white for all to see.
verses.pickthall: And he drew forth his hand (from his bosom), and lo! it was white for the beholders.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Said the eminent among the people of Pharaoh, "Indeed, this is a learned magician
verses.tr: qāla al-malaʾu min qawmi firʿawna ʾinna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: The leaders among Pharaoh’s people said, ‘This man is a learned sorcerer!
verses.pickthall: The chiefs of Pharaoh's people said: Lo! this is some knowing wizard,

verses.ar: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُمْ ۖ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
verses.en: Who wants to expel you from your land [through magic], so what do you instruct?"
verses.tr: yurīdu ʾan yukhrijakum mmin ʾarḍikum ۖ famādhā taʾmurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He means to drive you out of your land!’ Pharaoh said, ‘What do you suggest?’
verses.pickthall: Who would expel you from your land. Now what do ye advise?

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَأَرْسِلْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
verses.tr: qālūā ʾarjih wa-akhāhu wa-arsil fā al-madāʾini ḥāshirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Delay him and his brother for a while, and send messengers to all the cities
verses.pickthall: They said (unto Pharaoh): Put him off (a while) - him and his brother - and send into the cities summoners,

verses.ar: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَـٰحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.en: Who will bring you every learned magician."
verses.tr: yaʾtūka bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: to summon every learned sorcerer to you.’
verses.pickthall: To bring each knowing wizard unto thee.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.en: And the magicians came to Pharaoh. They said, "Indeed for us is a reward if we are the predominant."
verses.tr: wajāʾa as-saḥarahu firʿawna qālūā ʾinna lanā laʾajran ʾin kunnā naḥnu al-ghālibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The sorcerers came to Pharaoh and said, ‘Shall we be rewarded if we win?’
verses.pickthall: And the wizards came to Pharaoh, saying: Surely there will be a reward for us if we are victors.

verses.ar: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.en: He said, "Yes, and, [moreover], you will be among those made near [to me]."
verses.tr: qāla naʿam wa-innakum lamina al-muqarrabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and he replied, ‘Yes, and you will join my inner court.’
verses.pickthall: He answered: Yes, and surely ye shall be of those brought near (to me).

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُلْقِينَ
verses.en: They said, "O Moses, either you throw [your staff], or we will be the ones to throw [first]."
verses.tr: qālūā yāmūsā ʾimmā ʾan tulqāa wa-immā ʾan nnakūna naḥnu al-mulqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So they said, ‘Moses, will you throw first or shall we?’
verses.pickthall: They said: O Moses! Either throw (first) or let us be the first throwers?

verses.ar: قَالَ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَلْقَوْا۟ سَحَرُوٓا۟ أَعْيُنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ وَجَآءُو بِسِحْرٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: He said, "Throw," and when they threw, they bewitched the eyes of the people and struck terror into them, and they presented a great [feat of] magic.
verses.tr: qāla ʾalqūā ۖ falammā ʾalqawā saḥarūā ʾaʿyuna an-nāsi wāstarhabūhum wajāʾū bisiḥrin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘You throw,’ and they did, casting a spell on people’s eyes, striking fear into them, and bringing about great sorcery.
verses.pickthall: He said: Throw! And when they threw they cast a spell upon the people's eyes, and overawed them, and produced a mighty spell.

verses.ar: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
verses.en: And We inspired to Moses, "Throw your staff," and at once it devoured what they were falsifying.
verses.tr: ۞ wa-awḥaynā ʾilā mūsā ʾan ʾalqi ʿaṣāka ۖ fa-idhā hāa talqafu mā yaʾfikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then We inspired Moses, ‘Throw your staff,’ and- lo and behold!––it devoured their fakery.
verses.pickthall: And We inspired Moses (saying): Throw thy staff! And lo! it swallowed up their lying show.

verses.ar: فَوَقَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: So the truth was established, and abolished was what they were doing.
verses.tr: fawaqaʿa al-ḥaqqu wabaṭala mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The truth was confirmed and what they had produced came to nothing:
verses.pickthall: Thus was the Truth vindicated and that which they were doing was made vain.

verses.ar: فَغُلِبُوا۟ هُنَالِكَ وَٱنقَلَبُوا۟ صَـٰغِرِينَ
verses.en: And they [i.e., Pharaoh and his people] were overcome right there and became debased.
verses.tr: faghulibūā hunālika wānqalabūā ṣāghirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: they were defeated there and utterly humiliated.
verses.pickthall: Thus were they there defeated and brought low.

verses.ar: وَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: And the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
verses.tr: wa-ʾulqāa as-saḥarahu sājidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The sorcerers fell to their knees
verses.pickthall: And the wizards fell down prostrate,

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
verses.tr: qālūā āmannā birabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and said, ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.pickthall: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,

verses.ar: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
verses.en: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
verses.tr: rabbi mūsā wahārūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the Lord of Moses and Aaron!’
verses.pickthall: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.

verses.ar: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَمَكْرٌ مَّكَرْتُمُوهُ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لِتُخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أَهْلَهَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Said Pharaoh, "You believed in him before I gave you permission. Indeed, this is a conspiracy which you conspired in the city to expel therefrom its people. But you are going to know.
verses.tr: qāla firʿawnu āmantum bihi qabla ʾan ādhana lakum ۖ ʾinna hādhā lamakrun mmakartumūhu fā al-madīnahi litukhrijūā minhā ʾahlahā ۖ fasawfa taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in Him before I have given you permission? This is a plot you have hatched to drive the people out of this city! Soon you will see:
verses.pickthall: Pharaoh said: Ye believe in Him before I give you leave! Lo! this is the plot that ye have plotted in the city that ye may drive its people hence. But ye shall come to know!

verses.ar: لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ ثُمَّ لَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all."
verses.tr: laʾuqaṭṭiʿanna ʾaydiyakum wa-arjulakum mmin khilāfin thumma laʾuṣallibannakum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I will cut off your alternate hands and feet and then crucify you all!’
verses.pickthall: Surely I shall have your hands and feet cut off upon alternate sides. Then I shall crucify you every one.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.en: They said, "Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
verses.tr: qālūā ʾinnā ʾilā rabbinā munqalibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘And so we shall return to our Lord-
verses.pickthall: They said: Lo! We are about to return unto our Lord!

verses.ar: وَمَا تَنقِمُ مِنَّآ إِلَّآ أَنْ ءَامَنَّا بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّنَا لَمَّا جَآءَتْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And you do not resent us except because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You]."
verses.tr: wamā tanqimu minnā ʾillā ʾan āmannā bāyāti rabbinā lammā jāʾatnā ۚ rabbanā ʾafrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran watawaffanā muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your only grievance against us is that we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. Our Lord, pour steadfastness upon us and let us die in devotion to You.’
verses.pickthall: Thou takest vengeance on us only forasmuch as we believed the tokens of our Lord when they came unto us. Our Lord! Vouchsafe unto us steadfastness and make us die as men who have surrendered (unto Thee).

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ أَتَذَرُ مُوسَىٰ وَقَوْمَهُۥ لِيُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَذَرَكَ وَءَالِهَتَكَ ۚ قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَنَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ وَإِنَّا فَوْقَهُمْ قَـٰهِرُونَ
verses.en: And the eminent among the people of Pharaoh said, "Will you leave Moses and his people to cause corruption in the land and abandon you and your gods?" [Pharaoh] said, "We will kill their sons and keep their women alive; and indeed, we are subjugators over them."
verses.tr: waqāla al-malaʾu min qawmi firʿawna ʾatadharu mūsā waqawmahu liyufsidūā fā al-ʾarḍi wayadharaka walihataka ۚ qāla sanuqattilu ʾabnāʾahum wanastaḥāi nisāʾahum wa-innā fawqahum qāhirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The leaders among Pharaoh’s people said to him, ‘But are you going to leave Moses and his people to spread corruption in the land and forsake you and your gods?’ He replied, ‘We shall kill their male children, sparing only the females: We have complete power over them.’
verses.pickthall: The chiefs of Pharaoh's people said: (O King), wilt thou suffer Moses and his people to make mischief in the land, and flout thee and thy gods? He said: We will slay their sons and spare their women, for lo! we are in power over them.

verses.ar: قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ لِلَّهِ يُورِثُهَا مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَٱلْعَـٰقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
