verses.en: Said Moses to his people, "Seek help through Allāh and be patient. Indeed, the earth belongs to Allāh. He causes to inherit it whom He wills of His servants. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous."
verses.tr: qāla mūsā liqawmihi āstaʿīnūā billāh wāṣbirūā ۖ ʾinna al-ʾarḍa lillāh yūrithuhā man yashāʾu min ʿibādihi ۖ wa-l-ʿāqibahu lilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said to his people, ‘Turn to God for help and be steadfast: the earth belongs to God- He gives it as their own to whichever of His servants He chooses- and the happy future belongs to those who are mindful of Him,’
verses.pickthall: And Moses said unto his people: Seek help in Allah and endure. Lo! the earth is Allah's. He giveth it for an inheritance to whom He will. And lo! the sequel is for those who keep their duty (unto Him).

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أُوذِينَا مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا ۚ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُهْلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: They said, "We have been harmed before you came to us and after you have come to us." He said, "Perhaps your Lord will destroy your enemy and grant you succession in the land and see how you will do."
verses.tr: qālūā ʾūdhīnā min qabli ʾan taʾtiyanā wamin baʿdi mā jiʾtanā ۚ qāla ʿasā rabbukum ʾan yuhlika ʿaduwwakum wayastakhlifakum fā al-ʾarḍi fayanẓura kayfa taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they replied, ‘We were being persecuted long before you came to us, and since then too.’ He said, ‘Your Lord may well destroy your enemy and make you successors to the land to see how you behave.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We suffered hurt before thou camest unto us, and since thou hast come unto us. He said: It may be that your Lord is going to destroy your adversary and make you viceroys in the earth, that He may see how ye behave.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِٱلسِّنِينَ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And We certainly seized the people of Pharaoh with years of famine and a deficiency in fruits that perhaps they would be reminded.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾakhadhnā āla firʿawna bi-as-sinīna wanaqṣin mmina ath-thamarāti laʿallahum yadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We inflicted years of drought and crop failure on Pharaoh’s people, so that they might take heed,
verses.pickthall: And we straitened Pharaoh's folk with famine and dearth of fruits, that peradventure they might heed.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْحَسَنَةُ قَالُوا۟ لَنَا هَـٰذِهِۦ ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَطَّيَّرُوا۟ بِمُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّمَا طَـٰٓئِرُهُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: But when good [i.e., provision] came to them, they said, "This is ours [by right]." And if a bad [condition] struck them, they saw an evil omen in Moses and those with him. Unquestionably, their fortune is with Allāh, but most of them do not know.
verses.tr: fa-idhā jāʾathumu al-ḥasanahu qālūā lanā hādhihi ۖ wa-in tuṣibhum sayyiʾahun yaṭṭayyarūā bimūsā waman mmaʿahu ۗ ʾalā ʾinnamā ṭāʾiruhum ʿinda Allāh walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: then, when something good came their way, they said, ‘This is our due!’. When something bad came, they ascribed it to the evil omen of Moses and those with him, but their ‘evil omen’ was really from God, though most of them did not realize it.
verses.pickthall: But whenever good befell them, they said: This is ours; and whenever evil smote them they ascribed it to the evil auspices of Moses and those with him. Surely their evil auspice was only with Allah. But most of them knew not.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَهْمَا تَأْتِنَا بِهِۦ مِنْ ءَايَةٍ لِّتَسْحَرَنَا بِهَا فَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And they said, "No matter what sign you bring us with which to bewitch us, we will not be believers in you."
verses.tr: waqālūā mahmā taʾtinā bihi min āyahin llitasḥaranā bihā famā naḥnu laka bimuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We will not believe in you, no matter what signs you produce to cast a spell on us,’
verses.pickthall: And they said: Whatever portent thou bringest wherewith to bewitch us, we shall not put faith in thee.

verses.ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلطُّوفَانَ وَٱلْجَرَادَ وَٱلْقُمَّلَ وَٱلضَّفَادِعَ وَٱلدَّمَ ءَايَـٰتٍ مُّفَصَّلَـٰتٍ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: So We sent upon them the flood and locusts and lice and frogs and blood as distinct signs, but they were arrogant and were a criminal people.
verses.tr: fa-arsalnā ʿalayhimu aṭ-ṭūfāna wa-l-jarāda wa-l-qummala wa-aḍ-ḍafādiʿa wa-ad-dama āyātin mmufaṣṣalātin fāstakbarūā wakānūā qawman mmujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and so We let loose on them the flood, locusts, lice, frogs, blood- all clear signs. They were arrogant, wicked people.
verses.pickthall: So We sent against them the flood and the locusts and the vermin and the frogs and the blood - a succession of clear signs. But they were arrogant and became a guilty folk.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّجْزُ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمُوسَى ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ ۖ لَئِن كَشَفْتَ عَنَّا ٱلرِّجْزَ لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ لَكَ وَلَنُرْسِلَنَّ مَعَكَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: And when the punishment descended upon them, they said, "O Moses, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. If you [can] remove the punishment from us, we will surely believe you, and we will send with you the Children of Israel."
verses.tr: walammā waqaʿa ʿalayhimu ar-rijzu qālūā yāmūsā ādʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka ۖ laʾin kashafta ʿannā ar-rijza lanuʾminanna laka walanursilanna maʿaka banā ʾisrāʾīla
verses.abdelhaleem: They would say, whenever a plague struck them, ‘Moses, pray to your Lord for us by virtue of the promise He has made to you: if you relieve us of the plague, we will believe you and let the Children of Israel go with you,’
verses.pickthall: And when the terror fell on them they cried: O Moses! Pray for us unto thy Lord, because He hath a covenant with thee. If thou removest the terror from us we verily will trust thee and will let the Children of Israel go with thee.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلرِّجْزَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ هُم بَـٰلِغُوهُ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
verses.en: But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach, then at once they broke their word.
verses.tr: falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu ar-rijza ʾilā ʾajalin hum bālighūhu ʾidhā hum yankuthūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but when We relieved them of the plague and gave them a fixed period [in which to fulfil their promise]- lo and behold!- they broke it.
verses.pickthall: But when We did remove from them the terror for a term which they must reach, behold! they broke their covenant.

verses.ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.en: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them.
verses.tr: fāntaqamnā minhum fa-aghraqnāhum fā al-yammi biʾannahum kadhabūā bāyātinā wakānūā ʿanhā ghāfilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And so, because they rejected Our signs and paid them no heed, We exacted retribution from them: We drowned them in the sea
verses.pickthall: Therefore We took retribution from them; therefore We drowned them in the sea: because they denied Our revelations and were heedless of them.

verses.ar: وَأَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ يُسْتَضْعَفُونَ مَشَـٰرِقَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَغَـٰرِبَهَا ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۖ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ ۖ وَدَمَّرْنَا مَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ فِرْعَوْنُ وَقَوْمُهُۥ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْرِشُونَ
verses.en: And We caused the people who had been oppressed to inherit the eastern regions of the land and the western ones, which We had blessed. And the good word [i.e., decree] of your Lord was fulfilled for the Children of Israel because of what they had patiently endured. And We destroyed [all] that Pharaoh and his people were producing and what they had been building.
verses.tr: wa-awrathnā al-qawma adh-dhīna kānūā yustaḍʿafūna mashāriqa al-ʾarḍi wamaghāribahā at-tā bāraknā fīhā ۖ watammat kalimatu rabbika al-ḥusnā ʿalā banā ʾisrāʾīla bimā ṣabarūā ۖ wadammarnā mā kāna yaṣnaʿu firʿawnu waqawmuhu wamā kānūā yaʿrishūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We made those who had been oppressed succeed to both the east and the west of the land that We had blessed. Your Lord’s good promise to the Children of Israel was fulfilled, because of their patience, and We destroyed what Pharaoh and his people were making and what they were building.
verses.pickthall: And We caused the folk who were despised to inherit the eastern parts of the land and the western parts thereof which We had blessed. And the fair word of thy Lord was fulfilled for the Children of Israel because of their endurance; and We annihilated (all) that Pharaoh and his folk had done and that they had contrived.

verses.ar: وَجَـٰوَزْنَا بِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ يَعْكُفُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَصْنَامٍ لَّهُمْ ۚ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمُوسَى ٱجْعَل لَّنَآ إِلَـٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ ۚ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ
verses.en: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea; then they came upon a people intent in devotion to [some] idols of theirs. They [the Children of Israel] said, "O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods." He said, "Indeed, you are a people behaving ignorantly.
verses.tr: wajāwaznā bibanā ʾisrāʾīla al-baḥra fa-atawā ʿalā qawmin yaʿkufūna ʿalā ʾaṣnāmin llahum ۚ qālūā yāmūsā ājʿal llanā ʾilāhan kamā lahum ālihahun ۚ qāla ʾinnakum qawmun tajhalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We took the Children of Israel across the sea, but when they came upon a people who worshipped idols, they said, ‘Moses, make a god for us like theirs.’ He said, ‘You really are foolish people:
verses.pickthall: And We brought the Children of Israel across the sea, and they came unto a people who were given up to idols which they had. They said: O Moses! Make for us a god even as they have gods. He said: Lo! ye are a folk who know not.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَّا هُمْ فِيهِ وَبَـٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those [worshippers] - destroyed is that in which they are [engaged], and worthless is whatever they were doing."
verses.tr: ʾinna hāʾulāʾi mutabbarun mmā hum fīhi wabāṭilun mmā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [the cult] these people practise is doomed to destruction, and what they have been doing is useless.
verses.pickthall: Lo! as for these, their way will be destroyed and all that they are doing is in vain.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبْغِيكُمْ إِلَـٰهًا وَهُوَ فَضَّلَكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: He said, "Is it other than Allāh I should desire for you as a god while He has preferred you over the worlds?"
verses.tr: qāla ʾaghayra Allāh ʾabghīkum ʾilāhan wahuwa faḍḍalakum ʿalā al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why should I seek any god other than God for you, when He has favoured you over all other people?’
verses.pickthall: He said: Shall I seek for you a god other than Allah when He hath favoured you above (all) creatures?

verses.ar: وَإِذْ أَنجَيْنَـٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ۖ يُقَتِّلُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when We saved you from the people of Pharaoh, [who were] afflicting you with the worst torment - killing your sons and keeping your women alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
verses.tr: wa-idh ʾanjaynākum mmin āli firʿawna yasūmūnakum sūʾa al-ʿadhābi ۖ yuqattilūna ʾabnāʾakum wayastaḥyūna nisāʾakum ۚ wafā dhālikum balāʾun mmin rrabbikum ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember how We saved you from Pharaoh’s people, who were subjecting you to the worst of sufferings, killing your male children, sparing only your females- that was a mighty ordeal from your Lord.
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaughtering your sons and sparing your women. That was a tremendous trial from your Lord.

verses.ar: ۞ وَوَٰعَدْنَا مُوسَىٰ ثَلَـٰثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتْمَمْنَـٰهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيقَـٰتُ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ۚ وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَخِيهِ هَـٰرُونَ ٱخْلُفْنِى فِى قَوْمِى وَأَصْلِحْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: And We made an appointment with Moses for thirty nights and perfected them by [the addition of] ten; so the term of his Lord was completed as forty nights. And Moses said to his brother Aaron, "Take my place among my people, do right [by them], and do not follow the way of the corrupters."
verses.tr: ۞ wawāʿadnā mūsā thalāthīna laylahan wa-atmamnāhā biʿashrin fatamma mīqātu rabbihi ʾarbaʿīna laylahan ۚ waqāla mūsā liʾakhīhi hārūna ākhlufnā fā qawmā wa-aṣliḥ walā tattabiʿ sabīla al-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We appointed thirty nights for Moses, then added ten more: the term set by his Lord was completed in forty nights. Moses said to his brother Aaron, ‘Take my place among my people: act rightly and do not follow the way of those who spread corruption.’
verses.pickthall: And when We did appoint for Moses thirty nights (of solitude), and added to them ten, and he completed the whole time appointed by his Lord of forty nights; and Moses said unto his brother, Aaron: Take my place among the people. Do right, and follow not the way of mischief-makers.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَـٰتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِىٓ أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ ۚ قَالَ لَن تَرَىٰنِى وَلَـٰكِنِ ٱنظُرْ إِلَى ٱلْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ ٱسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُۥ فَسَوْفَ تَرَىٰنِى ۚ فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُۥ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُۥ دَكًّا وَخَرَّ مُوسَىٰ صَعِقًا ۚ فَلَمَّآ أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And when Moses arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You." [Allāh] said, "You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me." But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level, and Moses fell unconscious. And when he awoke, he said, "Exalted are You! I have repented to You, and I am the first [among my people] of the believers."
verses.tr: walammā jāʾa mūsā limīqātinā wakallamahu rabbuhu qāla rabbi ʾarinā ʾanẓur ʾilayka ۚ qāla lan tarānā walākini ānẓur ʾilā al-jabali fa-ini āstaqarra makānahu fasawfa tarānā ۚ falammā tajallā rabbuhu liljabali jaʿalahu dakkan wakharra mūsā ṣaʿiqan ۚ falammā ʾafāqa qāla subḥānaka tubtu ʾilayka wa-anā ʾawwalu al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When Moses came for the appointment, and his Lord spoke to him, he said, ‘My Lord, show Yourself to me: let me see You!’ He said, ‘You will never see Me, but look at that mountain: if it remains standing firm, you will see Me,’ and when his Lord revealed Himself to the mountain, He made it crumble: Moses fell down unconscious. When he recovered, he said, ‘Glory be to You! To You I turn in repentance! I am the first to believe!’
verses.pickthall: And when Moses came to Our appointed tryst and his Lord had spoken unto him, he said: My Lord! Show me (Thy Self), that I may gaze upon Thee. He said: Thou wilt not see Me, but gaze upon the mountain! If it stand still in its place, then thou wilt see Me. And when his Lord revealed (His) glory to the mountain He sent it crashing down. And Moses fell down senseless. And when he woke he said: Glory unto Thee! I turn unto Thee repentant, and I am the first of (true) believers.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّى ٱصْطَفَيْتُكَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِرِسَـٰلَـٰتِى وَبِكَلَـٰمِى فَخُذْ مَآ ءَاتَيْتُكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "O Moses, I have chosen you over the people with My messages and My words [to you]. So take what I have given you and be among the grateful."
verses.tr: qāla yāmūsā ʾinnā āṣṭafaytuka ʿalā an-nāsi birisālātā wabikalāmā fakhudh mā ātaytuka wakun mmina ash-shākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Moses, I have raised you above other people by [giving you] My messages and speaking to you: hold on to what I have given you; be one of those who give thanks.’
verses.pickthall: He said: O Moses! I have preferred thee above mankind by My messages and by My speaking (unto thee). So hold that which I have given thee, and be among the thankful.

verses.ar: وَكَتَبْنَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَلْوَاحِ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْعِظَةً وَتَفْصِيلًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَخُذْهَا بِقُوَّةٍ وَأْمُرْ قَوْمَكَ يَأْخُذُوا۟ بِأَحْسَنِهَا ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ دَارَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: And We wrote for him on the tablets [something] of all things - instruction and explanation for all things, [saying], "Take them with determination and order your people to take the best of it. I will show you the home of the defiantly disobedient."
verses.tr: wakatabnā lahu fā al-ʾalwāḥi min kulli shāʾin mmawʿiẓahan watafṣīlan llikulli shāʾin fakhudhhā biquwwahin wa-mur qawmaka yaʾkhudhūā biʾaḥsanihā ۚ saʾūrīkum dāra al-fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We inscribed everything for him in the Tablets which taught and explained everything, saying, ‘Hold on to them firmly and urge your people to hold fast to their excellent teachings. I will show you the end of those who rebel.
verses.pickthall: And We wrote for him, upon the tablets, the lesson to be drawn from all things and the explanation of all things, then (bade him): Hold it fast; and command thy people (saying): Take the better (course made clear) therein. I shall show thee the abode of evil-livers.

verses.ar: سَأَصْرِفُ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَكَبَّرُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ سَبِيلَ ٱلرُّشْدِ لَا يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ سَبِيلَ ٱلْغَىِّ يَتَّخِذُوهُ سَبِيلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.en: I will turn away from My signs those who are arrogant upon the earth without right; and if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. And if they see the way of consciousness, they will not adopt it as a way; but if they see the way of error, they will adopt it as a way. That is because they have denied Our signs and they were heedless of them.
verses.tr: saʾaṣrifu ʿan āyātāa adh-dhīna yatakabbarūna fā al-ʾarḍi bighayri al-ḥaqqi wa-in yarawā kulla āyahin llā yuʾminūā bihā wa-in yarawā sabīla ar-rushdi lā yattakhidhūhu sabīlan wa-in yarawā sabīla al-ghāi yattakhidhūhu sabīlan ۚ dhālika biʾannahum kadhabūā bāyātinā wakānūā ʿanhā ghāfilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I will keep distracted from My signs those who behave arrogantly on Earth without any right, and who, even if they see every sign, will not believe in them; they will not take the way of right guidance if they see it, but will take the way of error if they see that. This is because they denied Our signs and paid them no heed:
verses.pickthall: I shall turn away from My revelations those who magnify themselves wrongfully in the earth, and if they see each token believe it not, and if they see the way of righteousness choose it nor for (their) way, and if they see the way of error choose if for (their) way. That is because they deny Our revelations and are used to disregard them.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَلِقَآءِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Those who denied Our signs and the meeting of the Hereafter - their deeds have become worthless. Are they recompensed except for what they used to do?
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā waliqāʾi al-ākhirahi ḥabiṭat ʾaʿmāluhum ۚ hal yujzawna ʾillā mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the deeds of those who denied Our signs and the Meeting of the Hereafter will come to nothing- why should they be repaid for anything other than what they have done?’
verses.pickthall: Those who deny Our revelations and the meeting of the Hereafter, their works are fruitless. Are they requited aught save what they used to do?

verses.ar: وَٱتَّخَذَ قَوْمُ مُوسَىٰ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِنْ حُلِيِّهِمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌ ۚ أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمْ وَلَا يَهْدِيهِمْ سَبِيلًا ۘ ٱتَّخَذُوهُ وَكَانُوا۟ ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And the people of Moses made, after [his departure], from their ornaments a calf - an image having a lowing sound. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to a way? They took it [for worship], and they were wrongdoers.
verses.tr: wāttakhadha qawmu mūsā min baʿdihi min ḥuliyyihim ʿijlan jasadan llahu khuwārun ۚ ʾalam yarawā ʾannahu lā yukallimuhum walā yahdīhim sabīlan ۘ āttakhadhūhu wakānūā ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: In his absence, Moses’ people took to worshipping a mere shape that made sounds like a cow- a calf made from their jewellery. Could they not see that it did not speak to them or guide them in any way? Yet they took it for worship: they were evildoers.
verses.pickthall: And the folk of Moses, after (he left them), chose a calf (for worship), (made) out of their ornaments, of saffron hue, which gave a lowing sound. Saw they not that it spake not unto them nor guided them to any way? They chose it, and became wrong-doers.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا سُقِطَ فِىٓ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَرَأَوْا۟ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ يَرْحَمْنَا رَبُّنَا وَيَغْفِرْ لَنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: And when regret overcame them and they saw that they had gone astray, they said, "If our Lord does not have mercy upon us and forgive us, we will surely be among the losers."
verses.tr: walammā suqiṭa fā ʾaydīhim waraʾawā ʾannahum qad ḍallūā qālūā laʾin llam yarḥamnā rabbunā wayaghfir lanā lanakūnanna mina al-khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When, with much wringing of hands, they perceived that they were doing wrong, they said, ‘If our Lord does not have mercy and forgive us, we shall be the losers.’
verses.pickthall: And when they feared the consequences thereof and saw that they had gone astray, they said: Unless our Lord have mercy on us and forgive us, we verily are of the lost.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَـٰنَ أَسِفًا قَالَ بِئْسَمَا خَلَفْتُمُونِى مِنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ أَعَجِلْتُمْ أَمْرَ رَبِّكُمْ ۖ وَأَلْقَى ٱلْأَلْوَاحَ وَأَخَذَ بِرَأْسِ أَخِيهِ يَجُرُّهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِ ۚ قَالَ ٱبْنَ أُمَّ إِنَّ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱسْتَضْعَفُونِى وَكَادُوا۟ يَقْتُلُونَنِى فَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِىَ ٱلْأَعْدَآءَ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And when Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved, he said, "How wretched is that by which you have replaced me after [my departure]. Were you impatient over the matter of your Lord?" And he threw down the tablets and seized his brother by [the hair of] his head, pulling him toward him. [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, indeed the people overpowered me and were about to kill me, so let not the enemies rejoice over me and do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
verses.tr: walammā rajaʿa mūsā ʾilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna ʾasifan qāla biʾsamā khalaftumūnā min baʿdā ۖ ʾaʿajiltum ʾamra rabbikum ۖ wa-ʾalqā al-ʾalwāḥa wa-akhadha biraʾsi ʾakhīhi yajurruhu ʾilayhi ۚ qāla ābna ʾumma ʾinna al-qawma āstaḍʿafūnā wakādūā yaqtulūnanā falā tushmit bāa al-ʾaʿdāʾa walā tajʿalnā maʿa al-qawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: On his return to his people, angry and aggrieved, Moses said, ‘How foul and evil is what you have done in my absence! Were you so keen to bring your Lord’s judgement forward?’ He threw the tablets down and seized his brother by the hair, pulling him towards him. Aaron said, ‘Son of my mother, these people overpowered me! They almost killed me! Do not give my enemies reason to rejoice! Do not include me with these evildoers!’
verses.pickthall: And when Moses returned unto his people, angry and grieved, he said: Evil is that (course) which ye took after I had left you. Would ye hasten on the judgment of your Lord? And he cast down the tablets, and he seized his brother by the head, dragging him toward him. He said: Son of my mother! Lo! the folk did judge me weak and almost killed me. Oh, make not mine enemies to triumph over me and place me not among the evil-doers.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِأَخِى وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِى رَحْمَتِكَ ۖ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi āghfir lā waliʾakhā wa-adkhilnā fā raḥmatika ۖ wa-anta ʾarḥamu ar-rāḥimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘My Lord, forgive me and my brother; accept us into Your mercy: You are the Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Have mercy on me and on my brother; bring us into Thy mercy, Thou the Most Merciful of all who show mercy.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ ٱلْعِجْلَ سَيَنَالُهُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَذِلَّةٌ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُفْتَرِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who took the calf [for worship] will obtain anger from their Lord and humiliation in the life of this world, and thus do We recompense the inventors [of falsehood].
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āttakhadhūā al-ʿijla sayanāluhum ghaḍabun mmin rrabbihim wadhillahun fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۚ wakadhālika najzā al-muftarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who took to worshipping the calf will be afflicted by their Lord’s wrath, and by disgrace in this life.’ This is the way We repay those who invent such falsehoods,
verses.pickthall: Lo! Those who chose the calf (for worship), terror from their Lord and humiliation will come upon them in the life of the world. Thus do We requite those who invent a lie.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ثُمَّ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا وَءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: But those who committed misdeeds and then repented after them and believed - indeed your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna ʿamilūā as-sayyāti thumma tābūā min baʿdihā wamanūā ʾinna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: but your Lord is most forgiving and most merciful towards those who do wrong, then repent afterwards and truly believe.
verses.pickthall: But those who do ill-deeds and afterward repent and believe - lo! for them, afterward, Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَن مُّوسَى ٱلْغَضَبُ أَخَذَ ٱلْأَلْوَاحَ ۖ وَفِى نُسْخَتِهَا هُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ
verses.en: And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord.
verses.tr: walammā sakata ʿan mmūsā al-ghaḍabu ʾakhadha al-ʾalwāḥa ۖ wafā nuskhatihā hudanā waraḥmahun llilladhīna hum lirabbihim yarhabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When Moses’ anger abated, he picked up the Tablets, on which were inscribed guidance and mercy for those who stood in awe of their Lord.
verses.pickthall: Then, when the anger of Moses abated, he took up the tablets, and in their inscription there was guidance and mercy for all those who fear their Lord.

verses.ar: وَٱخْتَارَ مُوسَىٰ قَوْمَهُۥ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًا لِّمِيقَـٰتِنَا ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُم مِّن قَبْلُ وَإِيَّـٰىَ ۖ أَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَّآ ۖ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَهْدِى مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا ۖ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْغَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment. And when the earthquake seized them, he said, "My Lord, if You had willed, You could have destroyed them before and me [as well]. Would You destroy us for what the foolish among us have done? This is not but Your trial by which You send astray whom You will and guide whom You will. You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers.
verses.tr: wākhtāra mūsā qawmahu sabʿīna rajulan llimīqātinā ۖ falammā ʾakhadhathumu ar-rajfahu qāla rabbi law shiʾta ʾahlaktahum mmin qablu wa-iyyāa ۖ ʾatuhlikunā bimā faʿala as-sufahāʾu minnā ۖ ʾin hāa ʾillā fitnatuka tuḍillu bihā man tashāʾu watahdā man tashāʾu ۖ ʾanta waliyyunā fāghfir lanā wārḥamnā ۖ wa-anta khayru al-ghāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment, and when they were seized by trembling, he prayed, ‘My Lord, if You had chosen to do so, You could have destroyed them long before this, and me too, so will You now destroy us for what the foolish among us have done? This is only a trial from You- through it, You cause whoever You will to stray and guide whoever You will- and You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy on us. You are the best of those who forgive.
verses.pickthall: And Moses chose of his people seventy men for Our appointed tryst and, when the trembling came on them, he said: My Lord! If Thou hadst willed Thou hadst destroyed them long before, and me with them. Wilt thou destroy us for that which the ignorant among us did? It is but Thy trial (of us). Thou sendest whom Thou wilt astray and guidest whom Thou wilt: Thou art our Protecting Friend, therefore forgive us and have mercy on us, Thou, the Best of all who show forgiveness.

verses.ar: ۞ وَٱكْتُبْ لَنَا فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنَّا هُدْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ۚ قَالَ عَذَابِىٓ أُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَنْ أَشَآءُ ۖ وَرَحْمَتِى وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۚ فَسَأَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And decree for us in this world [that which is] good and [also] in the Hereafter; indeed, we have turned back to You." [Allāh] said, "My punishment - I afflict with it whom I will, but My mercy encompasses all things." So I will decree it [especially] for those who fear Me and give zakāh and those who believe in Our verses-
verses.tr: ۞ wāktub lanā fā hādhihi ad-dunyā ḥasanahan wafā al-ākhirahi ʾinnā hudnā ʾilayka ۚ qāla ʿadhābā ʾuṣību bihi man ʾashāʾu ۖ waraḥmatā wasiʿat kulla shāʾin ۚ fasaʾaktubuhā lilladhīna yattaqūna wayuʾtūna az-zakawāha wa-adh-dhīna hum bāyātinā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Grant us good things in this world and in the life to come. We turn to You.’ God said, ‘I bring My punishment on whoever I will, but My mercy encompasses all things. ‘I shall ordain My mercy for those who are conscious of God and pay the prescribed alms; who believe in Our Revelations;
verses.pickthall: And ordain for us in this world that which is good, and in the Hereafter (that which is good), Lo! We have turned unto Thee. He said: I smite with My punishment whom I will, and My mercy embraceth all things, therefore I shall ordain it for those who ward off (evil) and pay the poor-due, and those who believe Our revelations;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ ٱلنَّبِىَّ ٱلْأُمِّىَّ ٱلَّذِى يَجِدُونَهُۥ مَكْتُوبًا عِندَهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَٱلْإِنجِيلِ يَأْمُرُهُم بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَىٰهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ وَيَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ إِصْرَهُمْ وَٱلْأَغْلَـٰلَ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَعَزَّرُوهُ وَنَصَرُوهُ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلنُّورَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ مَعَهُۥٓ ۙ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered prophet, whom they find written [i.e., described] in what they have of the Torah and the Gospel, who enjoins upon them what is right and prohibits them from what is wrong and makes lawful for them what is good and forbids them from what is evil and relieves them of their burden and the shackles which were upon them. So they who have believed in him, honored him, supported him and followed the light which was sent down with him - it is those who will be the successful.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yattabiʿūna ar-rasūla an-nabāa al-ʾummāa adh-dhā yajidūnahu maktūban ʿindahum fā at-tawrāhi wa-l-ʾinjīli yaʾmuruhum bi-l-maʿrūfi wayanhāhum ʿani al-munkari wayuḥillu lahumu aṭ-ṭayyibāti wayuḥarrimu ʿalayhimu al-khabāʾitha wayaḍaʿu ʿanhum ʾiṣrahum wa-l-ʾaghlāla at-tā kānat ʿalayhim ۚ fa-adh-dhīna āmanūā bihi waʿazzarūhu wanaṣarūhu wāttabaʿūā an-nūra adh-dhā ʾunzila maʿahu ۙ ʾūlāʾika humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who follow the Messenger- the unlettered prophet they find described in the Torah that is with them, and in the Gospel- who commands them to do right and forbids them to do wrong, who makes good things lawful to them and bad things unlawful, and relieves them of their burdens, and the iron collars that were on them. So it is those who believe him, honour and help him, and who follow the light which has been sent down with him, who will succeed.’
verses.pickthall: Those who follow the messenger, the Prophet who can neither read nor write, whom they will find described in the Torah and the Gospel (which are) with them. He will enjoin on them that which is right and forbid them that which is wrong. He will make lawful for them all good things and prohibit for them only the foul; and he will relieve them of their burden and the fetters that they used to wear. Then those who believe in him, and honour him, and help him, and follow the light which is sent down with him: they are the successful.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعًا ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ ٱلْأُمِّىِّ ٱلَّذِى يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَكَلِمَـٰتِهِۦ وَٱتَّبِعُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "O mankind, indeed I am the Messenger of Allāh to you all, [from Him] to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death." So believe in Allāh and His Messenger, the unlettered prophet, who believes in Allāh and His words, and follow him that you may be guided.
verses.tr: qul yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu ʾinnā rasūlu Allāh ʾilaykum jamīʿan adh-dhā lahu mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa yuḥāi wayumītu ۖ fāminūā billāh warasūlihi an-nabāi al-ʾummāi adh-dhā yuʾminu billāh wakalimātihi wāttabiʿūhu laʿallakum tahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Muhammad], ‘People, I am the Messenger of God to you all, from Him who has control over the heavens and the earth. There is no God but Him; He gives life and death, so believe in God and His Messenger, the unlettered prophet who believes in God and His words, and follow him so that you may find guidance.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): O mankind! Lo! I am the messenger of Allah to you all - (the messenger of) Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and He giveth death. So believe in Allah and His messenger, the Prophet who can neither read nor write, who believeth in Allah and in His Words, and follow him that haply ye may be led aright.

verses.ar: وَمِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰٓ أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَبِهِۦ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.en: And among the people of Moses is a community which guides by truth and by it establishes justice.
verses.tr: wamin qawmi mūsā ʾummahun yahdūna bi-l-ḥaqqi wabihi yaʿdilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There is a group among the people of Moses who guide with truth, and who act justly according to it.
verses.pickthall: And of Moses' folk there is a community who lead with truth and establish justice therewith.

verses.ar: وَقَطَّعْنَـٰهُمُ ٱثْنَتَىْ عَشْرَةَ أَسْبَاطًا أُمَمًا ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱسْتَسْقَىٰهُ قَوْمُهُۥٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْحَجَرَ ۖ فَٱنۢبَجَسَتْ مِنْهُ ٱثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا ۖ قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ ۚ وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْغَمَـٰمَ وَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ ۖ كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And We divided them into twelve descendant tribes [as distinct] nations. And We inspired to Moses when his people implored him for water, "Strike with your staff the stone," and there gushed forth from it twelve springs. Every people [i.e., tribe] knew its watering place. And We shaded them with clouds and sent down upon them manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not, but they were [only] wronging themselves.
verses.tr: waqaṭṭaʿnāhumu āthnatā ʿashraha ʾasbāṭan ʾumaman ۚ wa-awḥaynā ʾilā mūsā ʾidhi āstasqāhu qawmuhu ʾani āḍrib bbiʿaṣāka al-ḥajara ۖ fānbajasat minhu āthnatā ʿashraha ʿaynan ۖ qad ʿalima kullu ʾunāsin mmashrabahum ۚ waẓallalnā ʿalayhimu al-ghamāma wa-anzalnā ʿalayhimu al-manna wa-as-salwā ۖ kulūā min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum ۚ wamā ẓalamūnā walākin kānūā ʾanfusahum yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We divided them into twelve tribes [as distinct] communities, and, when his people asked him for water, inspired Moses to strike the rock with his staff [so that] twelve springs gushed out. Each tribe knew its own drinking place; We gave them the shade of clouds and sent down to them manna and quails [saying], ‘Eat the good things We have provided for you.’ They did not wrong Us; it was themselves they wronged.
verses.pickthall: We divided them into twelve tribes, nations; and We inspired Moses, when his people asked him for water, saying: Smite with thy staff the rock! And there gushed forth therefrom twelve springs, so that each tribe knew their drinking-place. And we caused the white cloud to overshadow them and sent down for them the manna and the quails (saying): Eat of the good things wherewith we have provided you. They wronged Us not, but they were wont to wrong themselves.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ وَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ وَقُولُوا۟ حِطَّةٌ وَٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْبَابَ سُجَّدًا نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِكُمْ ۚ سَنَزِيدُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when it was said to them, "Dwell in this city [i.e., Jerusalem] and eat from it wherever you will and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens [i.e., sins],' and enter the gate bowing humbly; We will [then] forgive you your sins. We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."
verses.tr: wa-idh qīla lahumu āskunūā hādhihi al-qaryaha wakulūā minhā ḥaythu shiʾtum waqūlūā ḥiṭṭahun wādkhulūā al-bāba sujjadan nnaghfir lakum khaṭītikum ۚ sanazīdu al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they were told, ‘Enter this town and eat freely there as you will, but say, “Relieve us!” and enter its gate humbly: then We shall forgive you your sins, and increase the reward of those who do good,’
verses.pickthall: And when it was said unto them: Dwell in this township and eat therefrom whence ye will, and say "Repentance," and enter the gate prostrate; We shall forgive you your sins; We shall increase (reward) for the right-doers.

verses.ar: فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: But those who wronged among them changed [the words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them. So We sent upon them a punishment from the sky for the wrong that they were doing.
verses.tr: fabaddala adh-dhīna ẓalamūā minhum qawlan ghayra adh-dhā qīla lahum fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rijzan mmina as-samāʾi bimā kānūā yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the wrongdoers among them substituted another saying for that which had been given them, so We sent them a punishment from heaven for their wrongdoing.
verses.pickthall: But those of them who did wrong changed the word which had been told them for another saying, and We sent down upon them wrath from heaven for their wrongdoing.

verses.ar: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verses.en: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: waslhum ʿani al-qaryahi at-tā kānat ḥāḍiraha al-baḥri ʾidh yaʿdūna fā as-sabti ʾidh taʾtīhim ḥītānuhum yawma sabtihim shurraʿan wayawma lā yasbitūna ۙ lā taʾtīhim ۚ kadhālika nablūhum bimā kānūā yafsuqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], ask them about the town by the sea; how its people broke the Sabbath when their fish surfaced for them only on that day, never on weekdays- We tested them in this way: because of their disobedience-
verses.pickthall: Ask them (O Muhammad) of the township that was by the sea, how they did break the Sabbath, how their big fish came unto them visibly upon their Sabbath day and on a day when they did not keep Sabbath came they not unto them. Thus did We try them for that they were evil-livers.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَتْ أُمَّةٌ مِّنْهُمْ لِمَ تَعِظُونَ قَوْمًا ۙ ٱللَّهُ مُهْلِكُهُمْ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ قَالُوا۟ مَعْذِرَةً إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And when a community among them said, "Why do you advise [or warn] a people whom Allāh is [about] to destroy or to punish with a severe punishment?" they [the advisors] said, "To be absolved before your Lord and perhaps they may fear Him."
verses.tr: wa-idh qālat ʾummahun mminhum lima taʿiẓūna qawman ۙ Allāh muhlikuhum ʾaw muʿadhibuhum ʿadhāban shadīdan ۖ qālūā maʿdhirahan ʾilā rabbikum walaʿallahum yattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: how, when some of them asked [their preachers], ‘Why do you bother preaching to people God will destroy, or at least punish severely?’ [the preachers] answered, ‘In order to be free from your Lord’s blame, and so that they may perhaps take heed.’
verses.pickthall: And when a community among them said: Why preach ye to a folk whom Allah is about to destroy or punish with an awful doom, they said: In order to be free from guilt before your Lord, and that haply they may ward off (evil).

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا نَسُوا۟ مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلسُّوٓءِ وَأَخَذْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ بِعَذَابٍۭ بَـِٔيسٍۭ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verses.en: And when they [i.e., those advised] forgot that by which they had been reminded, We saved those who had forbidden evil and seized those who wronged, with a wretched punishment, because they were defiantly disobeying.
verses.tr: falammā nasūā mā dhukkirūā bihi ʾanjaynā adh-dhīna yanhawna ʿani as-sūʾi wa-akhadhnā adh-dhīna ẓalamūā biʿadhābin baysin bimā kānūā yafsuqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they ignored [the warning] they were given, We saved those who forbade evil, and punished the wrongdoers severely because of their disobedience.
verses.pickthall: And when they forgot that whereof they had been reminded, We rescued those who forbade wrong, and visited those who did wrong with dreadful punishment because they were evil-livers.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا عَتَوْا۟ عَن مَّا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ قُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verses.en: So when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
verses.tr: falammā ʿatawā ʿan mmā nuhūā ʿanhu qulnā lahum kūnūā qiradahan khāsīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When, in their arrogance, they persisted in doing what they had been forbidden to do, We said to them, ‘Be like apes! Be outcasts!’
verses.pickthall: So when they took pride in that which they had been forbidden, We said unto them: Be ye apes despised and loathed!

verses.ar: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ لَيَبْعَثَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَن يَسُومُهُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ ٱلْعِقَابِ ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And [mention] when your Lord declared that He would surely [continue to] send upon them until the Day of Resurrection those who would afflict them with the worst torment. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-idh taʾadhana rabbuka layabʿathanna ʿalayhim ʾilā yawmi al-qiyāmahi man yasūmuhum sūʾa al-ʿadhābi ۗ ʾinna rabbaka lasarīʿu al-ʿiqābi ۖ wa-innahu laghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: And then your Lord declared that, until the Day of Resurrection, He would send people against them to inflict terrible suffering on them. Your Lord is swift in punishment but He is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when thy Lord proclaimed that He would raise against them till the Day of Resurrection those who would lay on them a cruel torment. Lo! verily thy Lord is swift in prosecution and lo! verily He is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَقَطَّعْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أُمَمًا ۖ مِّنْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنْهُمْ دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَبَلَوْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْحَسَنَـٰتِ وَٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And We divided them throughout the earth into nations. Of them some were righteous, and of them some were otherwise. And We tested them with good [times] and bad that perhaps they would return [to obedience].
verses.tr: waqaṭṭaʿnāhum fā al-ʾarḍi ʾumaman ۖ mminhumu aṣ-ṣāliḥūna waminhum dūna dhālika ۖ wabalawnāhum bi-l-ḥasanāti wa-as-sayyāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We dispersed them over the earth in separate communities- some are righteous and some less so: We tested them with blessings and misfortunes, so that they might all return [to righteousness]-
verses.pickthall: And We have sundered them in the earth as (separate) nations. Some of them are righteous, and some far from that. And We have tried them with good things and evil things that haply they might return.

verses.ar: فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ وَرِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يَأْخُذُونَ عَرَضَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ وَيَقُولُونَ سَيُغْفَرُ لَنَا وَإِن يَأْتِهِمْ عَرَضٌ مِّثْلُهُۥ يَأْخُذُوهُ ۚ أَلَمْ يُؤْخَذْ عَلَيْهِم مِّيثَـٰقُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَن لَّا يَقُولُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْحَقَّ وَدَرَسُوا۟ مَا فِيهِ ۗ وَٱلدَّارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And there followed them successors who inherited the Scripture [while] taking the commodities of this lower life and saying, "It will be forgiven for us." And if an offer like it comes to them, they will [again] take it. Was not the covenant of the Scripture [i.e., the Torah] taken from them that they would not say about Allāh except the truth, and they studied what was in it? And the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allāh, so will you not use reason?
verses.tr: fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun warithūā al-kitāba yaʾkhudhūna ʿaraḍa hādhā al-ʾadnā wayaqūlūna sayughfaru lanā wa-in yaʾtihim ʿaraḍun mmithluhu yaʾkhudhūhu ۚ ʾalam yuʾkhadh ʿalayhim mmīthāqu al-kitābi ʾan llā yaqūlūā ʿalā Allāh ʾillā al-ḥaqqa wadarasūā mā fīhi ۗ wa-ad-dāru al-ākhirahu khayrun llilladhīna yattaqūna ۗ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they were succeeded by generations who, although they inherited the Scripture, took the fleeting gains of this lower world, saying, ‘We shall be forgiven,’ and indeed taking them again if other such gains came their way. Was a pledge not taken from them, writ-ten in the Scripture, to say nothing but the truth about God? And they have studied its contents well. For those who are mindful of God, the Hereafter is better. ‘Why do you not use your reason?’
verses.pickthall: And a generation hath succeeded them who inherited the scriptures. They grasp the goods of this low life (as the price of evil-doing) and say: It will be forgiven us. And if there came to them (again) the offer of the like, they would accept it (and would sin again). Hath not the covenant of the Scripture been taken on their behalf that they should not speak aught concerning Allah save the truth? And they have studied that which is therein. And the abode of the Hereafter is better, for those who ward off (evil). Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُمَسِّكُونَ بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُصْلِحِينَ
verses.en: But those who hold fast to the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and establish prayer - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yumassikūna bi-l-kitābi wa-aqāmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha ʾinnā lā nuḍīʿu ʾajra al-muṣliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But as for those who hold fast to the Scripture and keep up the prayer, We do not deny righteous people their rewards.
verses.pickthall: And as for those who make (men) keep the Scripture, and establish worship - lo! We squander not the wages of reformers.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِذْ نَتَقْنَا ٱلْجَبَلَ فَوْقَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُۥ ظُلَّةٌ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ خُذُوا۟ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And [mention] when We raised the mountain above them as if it was a dark cloud and they were certain that it would fall upon them, [and Allāh said], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that you might fear Allāh."
verses.tr: ۞ wa-idh nataqnā al-jabala fawqahum kaʾannahu ẓullahun waẓannūā ʾannahu wāqiʿun bihim khudhūā mā ātaynākum biquwwahin wādhkurūā mā fīhi laʿallakum tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When We made the mountain loom high above them like a shadow, and they thought it would fall on them, We said, ‘Hold fast to what We have given you, and remember what it contains, so that you may remain conscious of God.’
verses.pickthall: And when We shook the Mount above them as it were a covering, and they supposed that it was going to fall upon them (and We said): Hold fast that which We have given you, and remember that which is therein, that ye may ward off (evil).

verses.ar: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ رَبُّكَ مِنۢ بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ مِن ظُهُورِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَأَشْهَدَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ ۛ شَهِدْنَآ ۛ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ إِنَّا كُنَّا عَنْ هَـٰذَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] when your Lord took from the children of Adam - from their loins - their descendants and made them testify of themselves, [saying to them], "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes, we have testified." [This] - lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection, "Indeed, we were of this unaware."
verses.tr: wa-idh ʾakhadha rabbuka min banā ādama min ẓuhūrihim dhurriyyatahum wa-ashhadahum ʿalā ʾanfusihim ʾalastu birabbikum ۖ qālūā balā ۛ shahidnā ۛ ʾan taqūlūā yawma al-qiyāmahi ʾinnā kunnā ʿan hādhā ghāfilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], when your Lord took out the offspring from the loins of the Children of Adam and made them bear witness about themselves, He said, ‘Am I not your Lord?’ and they replied, ‘Yes, we bear witness.’ So you cannot say on the Day of Resurrection, ‘We were not aware of this,’
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when thy Lord brought forth from the Children of Adam, from their reins, their seed, and made them testify of themselves, (saying): Am I not your Lord? They said: Yea, verily. We testify. (That was) lest ye should say at the Day of Resurrection: Lo! of this we were unaware;

verses.ar: أَوْ تَقُولُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَشْرَكَ ءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا ذُرِّيَّةً مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ أَفَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verses.en: Or [lest] you say, "It was only that our fathers associated [others in worship] with Allāh before, and we were but descendants after them. Then would You destroy us for what the falsifiers have done?"
verses.tr: ʾaw taqūlūā ʾinnamā ʾashraka ābāʾunā min qablu wakunnā dhurriyyahan mmin baʿdihim ۖ ʾafatuhlikunā bimā faʿala al-mubṭilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: or, ‘It was our forefathers who, before us, ascribed partners to God, and we are only the descendants who came after them: will you destroy us because of falsehoods they invented?’
verses.pickthall: Or lest ye should say: (It is) only (that) our fathers ascribed partners to Allah of old and we were (their) seed after them. Wilt Thou destroy us on account of that which those who follow falsehood did?

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And thus do We [explain in] detail the verses, and perhaps they will return.
verses.tr: wakadhālika nufaṣṣilu al-āyāti walaʿallahum yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way We explain the messages, so that they may turn [to the right path].
verses.pickthall: Thus we detail the revelations, that haply they may return.

verses.ar: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَٱنسَلَخَ مِنْهَا فَأَتْبَعَهُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
verses.en: And recite to them, [O Muḥammad], the news of him to whom We gave [knowledge of] Our signs, but he detached himself from them; so Satan pursued him, and he became of the deviators.
verses.tr: wātlu ʿalayhim nabaʾa adh-dhā ātaynāhu āyātinā fānsalakha minhā fa-atbaʿahu ash-shayṭānu fakāna mina al-ghāwīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], tell them the story of the man to whom We gave Our messages: he sloughed them off, so Satan took him as his follower and he went astray-
verses.pickthall: Recite unto them the tale of him to whom We gave Our revelations, but he sloughed them off, so Satan overtook him and he became of those who lead astray.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَرَفَعْنَـٰهُ بِهَا وَلَـٰكِنَّهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ ۚ فَمَثَلُهُۥ كَمَثَلِ ٱلْكَلْبِ إِن تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْهِ يَلْهَثْ أَوْ تَتْرُكْهُ يَلْهَث ۚ ذَّٰلِكَ مَثَلُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۚ فَٱقْصُصِ ٱلْقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And if We had willed, We could have elevated him thereby, but he adhered [instead] to the earth and followed his own desire. So his example is like that of the dog: if you chase him, he pants, or if you leave him, he [still] pants. That is the example of the people who denied Our signs. So relate the stories that perhaps they will give thought.
verses.tr: walaw shiʾnā larafaʿnāhu bihā walākinnahu ʾakhlada ʾilā al-ʾarḍi wāttabaʿa hawāhu ۚ famathaluhu kamathali al-kalbi ʾin taḥmil ʿalayhi yalhath ʾaw tatrukhu yalhath ۚ dhālika mathalu al-qawmi adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā ۚ fāqṣuṣi al-qaṣaṣa laʿallahum yatafakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: if it had been Our will, We could have used these signs to raise him high, but instead he clung to the earth and followed his own desires- he was like a dog that pants with a lolling tongue whether you drive it away or leave it alone. Such is the image of those who reject Our signs. Tell them the story so that they may reflect.
verses.pickthall: And had We willed We could have raised him by their means, but he clung to the earth and followed his own lust. Therefor his likeness is as the likeness of a dog: if thou attackest him he panteth with his tongue out, and if thou leavest him he panteth with his tongue out. Such is the likeness of the people who deny Our revelations. Narrate unto them the history (of the men of old), that haply they may take thought.

verses.ar: سَآءَ مَثَلًا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَأَنفُسَهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: How evil an example [is that of] the people who denied Our signs and used to wrong themselves.
verses.tr: sāʾa mathalan al-qawmu adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā wa-anfusahum kānūā yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How foul is the image of those who reject Our signs! It is themselves they wrong:
verses.pickthall: Evil as an example are the folk who denied Our revelations, and were wont to wrong themselves.

verses.ar: مَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِى ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: Whoever Allāh guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - it is those who are the losers.
verses.tr: man yahdi Allāh fahuwa al-muhtadā ۖ waman yuḍlil fa-ūlāʾika humu al-khāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: whoever God guides is truly guided, and whoever God allows to stray is a loser.
verses.pickthall: He whom Allah leadeth, he indeed is led aright, while he whom Allah sendeth astray - they indeed are losers.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ ۖ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَا وَلَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌ لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰفِلُونَ
verses.en: And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray. It is they who are the heedless.
verses.tr: walaqad dharaʾnā lijahannama kathīran mmina al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi ۖ lahum qulūbun llā yafqahūna bihā walahum ʾaʿyunun llā yubṣirūna bihā walahum ādhānun llā yasmaʿūna bihā ۚ ʾūlāʾika ka-l-ʾanʿāmi bal hum ʾaḍallu ۚ ʾūlāʾika humu al-ghāfilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have created many jinn and people who are destined for Hell, with hearts they do not use for comprehension, eyes they do not use for sight, ears they do not use for hearing. They are like cattle, no, even further astray: these are the ones who are entirely heedless.
verses.pickthall: Already have We urged unto hell many of the jinn and humankind, having hearts wherewith they understand not, and having eyes wherewith they see not, and having ears wherewith they hear not. These are as the cattle - nay, but they are worse! These are the neglectful.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ فَٱدْعُوهُ بِهَا ۖ وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ أَسْمَـٰٓئِهِۦ ۚ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And to Allāh belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh al-ʾasmāʾu al-ḥusnā fādʿūhu bihā ۖ wadharūā adh-dhīna yulḥidūna fā ʾasmāʾihi ۚ sayujzawna mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Most Excellent Names belong to God: use them to call on Him, and keep away from those who abuse them- they will be requited for what they do.
verses.pickthall: Allah's are the fairest names. Invoke Him by them. And leave the company of those who blaspheme His names. They will be requited what they do.

verses.ar: وَمِمَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَبِهِۦ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.en: And among those We created is a community which guides by truth and thereby establishes justice.
verses.tr: wamimman khalaqnā ʾummahun yahdūna bi-l-ḥaqqi wabihi yaʿdilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Among those We created are a group of people who guide with truth and act justly according to it.
verses.pickthall: And of those whom We created there is a nation who guide with the Truth and establish justice therewith.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā sanastadrijuhum mmin ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But We lead on those who reject Our messages, step by step, without them realizing it:
verses.pickthall: And those who deny Our revelations - step by step We lead them on from whence they know not.

verses.ar: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
verses.en: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
verses.tr: wa-umlā lahum ۚ ʾinna kaydā matīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: I will give them respite, but My plan is sure.
verses.pickthall: I give them rein (for) lo! My scheme is strong.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ ۗ مَا بِصَاحِبِهِم مِّن جِنَّةٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Then do they not give thought? There is in their companion [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] no madness. He is not but a clear warner.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yatafakkarūā ۗ mā biṣāḥibihim mmin jinnahin ۚ ʾin huwa ʾillā nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Has it not occurred to them that their companion is not mad but is giving clear warning?
verses.pickthall: Have they not bethought them (that) there is no madness in their comrade? He is but a plain warner.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَنظُرُوا۟ فِى مَلَكُوتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ وَأَنْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَدِ ٱقْتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُمْ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Do they not look into the realm of the heavens and the earth and everything that Allāh has created and [think] that perhaps their appointed time has come near? So in what statement [i.e., message] hereafter will they believe?
verses.tr: ʾawalam yanẓurūā fā malakūti as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā khalaqa Allāh min shāʾin wa-an ʿasā ʾan yakūna qadi āqtaraba ʾajaluhum ۖ fabiāi ḥadīthin baʿdahu yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have they not contemplated the realm of the heavens and earth and all that God created, and that the end of their time might be near? What [other revelation] will they believe in if they do not believe in this?
verses.pickthall: Have they not considered the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and what things Allah hath created, and that it may be that their own term draweth nigh? In what fact after this will they believe?

verses.ar: مَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا هَادِىَ لَهُۥ ۚ وَيَذَرُهُمْ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.en: Whoever Allāh sends astray - there is no guide for him. And He leaves them in their transgression, wandering blindly.
verses.tr: man yuḍlili Allāh falā hādāa lahu ۚ wayadharuhum fā ṭughyānihim yaʿmahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No one can guide those God allows to stray: He leaves them blundering about in their insolence.
verses.pickthall: Those whom Allah sendeth astray, there is no guide for them. He leaveth them to wander blindly on in their contumacy.

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى ۖ لَا يُجَلِّيهَا لِوَقْتِهَآ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ ثَقُلَتْ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا تَأْتِيكُمْ إِلَّا بَغْتَةً ۗ يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِىٌّ عَنْهَا ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival? Say, "Its knowledge is only with my Lord. None will reveal its time except Him. It lays heavily upon the heavens and the earth. It will not come upon you except unexpectedly." They ask you as if you are familiar with it. Say, "Its knowledge is only with Allāh, but most of the people do not know."
verses.tr: yaslūnaka ʿani as-sāʿahi ʾayyāna mursāhā ۖ qul ʾinnamā ʿilmuhā ʿinda rabbā ۖ lā yujallīhā liwaqtihā ʾillā huwa ۚ thaqulat fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ lā taʾtīkum ʾillā baghtahan ۗ yaslūnaka kaʾannaka ḥafāun ʿanhā ۖ qul ʾinnamā ʿilmuhā ʿinda Allāh walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They ask you [Prophet] about the Hour, ‘When will it happen?’ Say, ‘My Lord alone has knowledge of it: He alone will reveal when its time will come, a time that is momentous in both the heavens and earth. All too suddenly it will come upon you.’ They ask you about it as if you were eager [to find out]. Say, ‘God alone has knowledge of [when it will come], though most people do not realize it.’
verses.pickthall: They ask thee of the (destined) Hour, when will it come to port. Say: Knowledge thereof is with my Lord only. He alone will manifest it at its proper time. It is heavy in the heavens and the earth. It cometh not to you save unawares. They question thee as if thou couldst be well informed thereof. Say: Knowledge thereof is with Allah only, but most of mankind know not.

verses.ar: قُل لَّآ أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِى نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْ كُنتُ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ لَٱسْتَكْثَرْتُ مِنَ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَمَا مَسَّنِىَ ٱلسُّوٓءُ ۚ إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Say, "I hold not for myself [the power of] benefit or harm, except what Allāh has willed. And if I knew the unseen, I could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. I am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe."
verses.tr: qul llā ʾamliku linafsā nafʿan walā ḍarran ʾillā mā shāʾa Allāh ۚ walaw kuntu ʾaʿlamu al-ghayba lāstakthartu mina al-khayri wamā massanāa as-sūʾu ۚ ʾin ʾanā ʾillā nadhīrun wabashīrun lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘I have no control over benefit or harm, [even] to myself, except as God may please: if I had knowledge of what is hidden, I would have abundant good things and no harm could touch me. I am no more than a bearer of warning, and good news to those who believe.’
verses.pickthall: Say: For myself I have no power to benefit, nor power to hurt, save that which Allah willeth. Had I knowledge of the Unseen, I should have abundance of wealth, and adversity would not touch me. I am but a warner, and a bearer of good tidings unto folk who believe.

verses.ar: ۞ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا لِيَسْكُنَ إِلَيْهَا ۖ فَلَمَّا تَغَشَّىٰهَا حَمَلَتْ حَمْلًا خَفِيفًا فَمَرَّتْ بِهِۦ ۖ فَلَمَّآ أَثْقَلَت دَّعَوَا ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُمَا لَئِنْ ءَاتَيْتَنَا صَـٰلِحًا لَّنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: It is He who created you from one soul and created from it its mate that he might dwell in security with her. And when he [i.e., man] covers her, she carries a light burden [i.e., a pregnancy] and continues therein. And when it becomes heavy, they both invoke Allāh, their Lord, "If You should give us a good [child], we will surely be among the grateful."
verses.tr: ۞ huwa adh-dhā khalaqakum mmin nnafsin wāḥidahin wajaʿala minhā zawjahā liyaskuna ʾilayhā ۖ falammā taghashāhā ḥamalat ḥamlan khafīfan famarrat bihi ۖ falammā ʾathqalat ddaʿawā Allāh rabbahumā laʾin ātaytanā ṣāliḥan llanakūnanna mina ash-shākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who created you all from one soul, and from it made its mate so that he might find comfort in her: when one [of them] lies with his wife and she conceives a light burden, going about freely, then grows heavy, they both pray to God, their Lord, ‘If You give us a good child we shall certainly be grateful,’
verses.pickthall: He it is Who did create you from a single soul, and therefrom did make his mate that he might take rest in her. And when he covered her she bore a light burden, and she passed (unnoticed) with it, but when it became heavy they cried unto Allah, their Lord, saying: If thou givest unto us aright we shall be of the thankful.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُمَا صَـٰلِحًا جَعَلَا لَهُۥ شُرَكَآءَ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمَا ۚ فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: But when He gives them a good [child], they ascribe partners to Him concerning that which He has given them. Exalted is Allāh above what they associate with Him.
verses.tr: falammā ātāhumā ṣāliḥan jaʿalā lahu shurakāʾa fīmā ātāhumā ۚ fataʿālā Allāh ʿammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and yet when He gives them a good child they ascribe some of what He has granted them to others.
verses.pickthall: But when He gave unto them aright, they ascribed unto Him partners in respect of that which He had given them. High is He Exalted above all that they associate (with Him).

verses.ar: أَيُشْرِكُونَ مَا لَا يَخْلُقُ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
verses.en: Do they associate with Him those who create nothing and they are [themselves] created?
verses.tr: ʾayushrikūna mā lā yakhluqu shayā wahum yukhlaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God is far above the partners they set up alongside Him! How can they set up with Him these partners that create nothing and are themselves created,
verses.pickthall: Attribute they as partners to Allah those who created naught, but are themselves created,

verses.ar: وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ لَهُمْ نَصْرًا وَلَآ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَنصُرُونَ
verses.en: And they [i.e., the false deities] are unable to [give] them help, nor can they help themselves.
verses.tr: walā yastaṭīʿūna lahum naṣran walā ʾanfusahum yanṣurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: that cannot help them at all, or even help themselves?
verses.pickthall: And cannot give them help, nor can they help themselves?

verses.ar: وَإِن تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَا يَتَّبِعُوكُمْ ۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ أَدَعَوْتُمُوهُمْ أَمْ أَنتُمْ صَـٰمِتُونَ
verses.en: And if you [believers] invite them to guidance, they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you invite them or you are silent.
verses.tr: wa-in tadʿūhum ʾilā al-hudā lā yattabiʿūkum ۚ sawāʾun ʿalaykum ʾadaʿawtumūhum ʾam ʾantum ṣāmitūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you [believers] call such people to guidance, they do not fol-low you: it makes no difference whether you call them or remain silent.
verses.pickthall: And if ye call them to the Guidance, they follow you not. Whether ye call them or are silent is all one for you.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ عِبَادٌ أَمْثَالُكُمْ ۖ فَٱدْعُوهُمْ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, those you [polytheists] call upon besides Allāh are servants [i.e., creations] like you. So call upon them and let them respond to you, if you should be truthful.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna tadʿūna min dūni Allāh ʿibādun ʾamthālukum ۖ fādʿūhum falyastajībūā lakum ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those you [idolaters] call upon instead of God are created beings like you. Call upon them, then, and let them respond to you if what you say is true.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah are slaves like unto you. Call on them now, and let them answer you, if ye are truthful!

verses.ar: أَلَهُمْ أَرْجُلٌ يَمْشُونَ بِهَآ ۖ أَمْ لَهُمْ أَيْدٍ يَبْطِشُونَ بِهَآ ۖ أَمْ لَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ يُبْصِرُونَ بِهَآ ۖ أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا ۗ قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَكُمْ ثُمَّ كِيدُونِ فَلَا تُنظِرُونِ
verses.en: Do they have feet by which they walk? Or do they have hands by which they strike? Or do they have eyes by which they see? Or do they have ears by which they hear? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Call your 'partners' and then conspire against me and give me no respite.
verses.tr: ʾalahum ʾarjulun yamshūna bihā ۖ ʾam lahum ʾaydin yabṭishūna bihā ۖ ʾam lahum ʾaʿyunun yubṣirūna bihā ۖ ʾam lahum ādhānun yasmaʿūna bihā ۗ quli ādʿūā shurakāʾakum thumma kīdūni falā tunẓirūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they have feet to walk, hands to strike, eyes to see, or ears to hear? Say [Prophet], ‘Call on your “partners”! Scheme against me! Do not spare me!
verses.pickthall: Have they feet wherewith they walk, or have they hands wherewith they hold, or have they eyes wherewith they see, or have they ears wherewith they hear? Say: Call upon your (so-called) partners (of Allah), and then contrive against me, spare me not!

verses.ar: إِنَّ وَلِـِّۧىَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۖ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, my protector is Allāh, who has sent down the Book; and He is an ally to the righteous.
verses.tr: ʾinna walāa Allāh adh-dhā nazzala al-kitāba ۖ wahuwa yatawallā aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: My protector is God: He has revealed the Scripture, and it is He who protects the righteous,
verses.pickthall: Lo! my Protecting Friend is Allah Who revealeth the Scripture. He befriendeth the righteous.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَكُمْ وَلَآ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَنصُرُونَ
verses.en: And those you call upon besides Him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves."
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrakum walā ʾanfusahum yanṣurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but those you call on instead of Him cannot help you or even help themselves.’
verses.pickthall: They on whom ye call beside Him have no power to help you, nor can they help you, nor can they help themselves.

verses.ar: وَإِن تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَا يَسْمَعُوا۟ ۖ وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And if you invite them to guidance, they do not hear; and you see them looking at you while they do not see.
verses.tr: wa-in tadʿūhum ʾilā al-hudā lā yasmaʿūā ۖ watarāhum yanẓurūna ʾilayka wahum lā yubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you [believers] call such people to guidance, they do not hear. You [Prophet] may observe them looking at you, but they can-not see.
verses.pickthall: And if ye (Muslims) call them to the guidance they hear not; and thou (Muhammad) seest them looking toward thee, but they see not.

verses.ar: خُذِ ٱلْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
verses.en: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
verses.tr: khudhi al-ʿafwa wa-mur bi-l-ʿurfi wa-aʿriḍ ʿani al-jāhilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Be tolerant and command what is right: pay no attention to foolish people.
verses.pickthall: Keep to forgiveness (O Muhammad), and enjoin kindness, and turn away from the ignorant.

verses.ar: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.tr: wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina ash-shayṭāni nazghun fāstaʿidh billāh ۚ ʾinnahu samīʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: If Satan should prompt you to do something, seek refuge with God- He is all hearing, all knowing-
verses.pickthall: And if a slander from the devil wound thee, then seek refuge in Allah. Lo! He is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ طَـٰٓئِفٌ مِّنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ تَذَكَّرُوا۟ فَإِذَا هُم مُّبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who fear Allāh - when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember [Him] and at once they have insight.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āttaqawā ʾidhā massahum ṭāʾifun mmina ash-shayṭāni tadhakkarūā fa-idhā hum mmubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who are aware of God think of Him when Satan prompts them to do something and immediately they can see [straight];
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who ward off (evil), when a glamour from the devil troubleth them, they do but remember (Allah's Guidance) and behold them seers!

verses.ar: وَإِخْوَٰنُهُمْ يَمُدُّونَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغَىِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقْصِرُونَ
verses.en: But their brothers - they [i.e., the devils] increase them in error; then they do not stop short.
verses.tr: wa-ikhwānuhum yamuddūnahum fā al-ghāi thumma lā yuqṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the followers of devils are led relentlessly into error by them and cannot stop.
verses.pickthall: Their brethren plunge them further into error and cease not.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا لَمْ تَأْتِهِم بِـَٔايَةٍ قَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا ٱجْتَبَيْتَهَا ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ مِن رَّبِّى ۚ هَـٰذَا بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And when you, [O Muḥammad], do not bring them a sign [i.e., miracle], they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe."
verses.tr: wa-idhā lam taʾtihim bāyahin qālūā lawlā ājtabaytahā ۚ qul ʾinnamā ʾattabiʿu mā yūḥā ʾilāa min rrabbā ۚ hādhā baṣāʾiru min rrabbikum wahudanā waraḥmahun lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When you do not bring them a fresh revelation, they say, ‘But can you not just ask for one?’ Say, ‘I merely repeat what is revealed to me from my Lord: this revelation brings you insights from your Lord, and guidance and mercy for those who believe,
verses.pickthall: And when thou bringest not a verse for them they say: Why hast thou not chosen it? Say: I follow only that which is inspired in me from my Lord. This (Qur'an) is insight from your Lord, and a guidance and a mercy for a people that believe.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥ وَأَنصِتُوا۟ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.en: So when the Qur’ān is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy.
verses.tr: wa-idhā quriʾa al-qurānu fāstamiʿūā lahu wa-anṣitūā laʿallakum turḥamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so pay attention and listen quietly when the Quran is recited, so that you may be given mercy.’
verses.pickthall: And when the Qur'an is recited, give ear to it and pay heed, that ye may obtain mercy.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ فِى نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَخِيفَةً وَدُونَ ٱلْجَهْرِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْـَٔاصَالِ وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْغَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.en: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.
verses.tr: wādhkur rrabbaka fā nafsika taḍarruʿan wakhīfahan wadūna al-jahri mina al-qawli bi-l-ghuduwwi wa-l-āṣāli walā takun mmina al-ghāfilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], remember your Lord inwardly, in all humility and awe, without raising your voice, in the mornings and in the evenings- do not be one of the heedless-
verses.pickthall: And do thou (O Muhammad) remember thy Lord within thyself humbly and with awe, below thy breath, at morn and evening. And be not thou of the neglectful.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَيُسَبِّحُونَهُۥ وَلَهُۥ يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
verses.en: Indeed, those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna ʿinda rabbika lā yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatihi wayusabbiḥūnahu walahu yasjudūna ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: [even] those who live in the presence of your Lord are not too proud to worship Him: they glorify Him and bow down before Him.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who are with thy Lord are not too proud to do Him service, but they praise Him and prostrate before Him.

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْأَنفَالِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلْأَنفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا۟ ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ ۖ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the bounties [of war]. Say, "The [decision concerning] bounties is for Allāh and the Messenger." So fear Allāh and amend that which is between you and obey Allāh and His Messenger, if you should be believers.
verses.tr: yaslūnaka ʿani al-ʾanfāli ۖ quli al-ʾanfālu lillāh wa-ar-rasūli ۖ fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṣliḥūā dhāta baynikum ۖ wa-aṭīʿūā Allāh warasūlahu ʾin kuntum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They ask you [Prophet] about [distributing] the battle gains. Say, ‘That is a matter for God and His Messenger, so be mindful of God and make things right between you. Obey God and His Messenger if you are true believers:
verses.pickthall: They ask thee (O Muhammad) of the spoils of war. Say: The spoils of war belong to Allah and the messenger, so keep your duty to Allah, and adjust the matter of your difference, and obey Allah and His messenger, if ye are (true) believers.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَـٰنًا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verses.en: The believers are only those who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their Lord they rely -
verses.tr: ʾinnamā al-muʾminūna adh-dhīna ʾidhā dhukira Allāh wajilat qulūbuhum wa-idhā tuliyat ʿalayhim āyātuhu zādathum ʾīmānan waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna
