verses.abdelhaleem: true believers are those whose hearts tremble with awe when God is mentioned, whose faith increases when His revelations are recited to them, who put their trust in their Lord,
verses.pickthall: They only are the (true) believers whose hearts feel fear when Allah is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited unto them they increase their faith, and who trust in their Lord;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.en: The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yuqīmūna aṣ-ṣalawāha wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who keep up the prayer and give to others out of what We provide for them.
verses.pickthall: Who establish worship and spend of that We have bestowed on them.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا ۚ لَّهُمْ دَرَجَـٰتٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: Those are the believers, truly. For them are degrees [of high position] with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika humu al-muʾminūna ḥaqqan ۚ llahum darajātun ʿinda rabbihim wamaghfirahun warizqun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those are the ones who truly believe. They have high standing with their Lord, forgiveness, and generous provision.’
verses.pickthall: Those are they who are in truth believers. For them are grades (of honour) with their Lord, and pardon, and a bountiful provision.

verses.ar: كَمَآ أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنۢ بَيْتِكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَكَـٰرِهُونَ
verses.en: [It is] just as when your Lord brought you out of your home [for the battle of Badr] in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling,
verses.tr: kamā ʾakhrajaka rabbuka min baytika bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-inna farīqan mmina al-muʾminīna lakārihūna
verses.abdelhaleem: For it was your Lord who made you [Prophet] venture from your home for a true purpose––though a group of the believers disliked it
verses.pickthall: Even as thy Lord caused thee (Muhammad) to go forth from thy home with the Truth, and lo! a party of the believers were averse (to it).

verses.ar: يُجَـٰدِلُونَكَ فِى ٱلْحَقِّ بَعْدَ مَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on.
verses.tr: yujādilūnaka fā al-ḥaqqi baʿda mā tabayyana kaʾannamā yusāqūna ʾilā al-mawti wahum yanẓurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and argued with you about the truth after it had been made clear, as if they were being driven towards a death they could see with their own eyes.
verses.pickthall: Disputing with thee of the Truth after it had been made manifest, as if they were being driven to death visible.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِحْدَى ٱلطَّآئِفَتَيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ ٱلشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَـٰتِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: [Remember, O believers], when Allāh promised you one of the two groups - that it would be yours - and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours. But Allāh intended to establish the truth by His words and to eliminate the disbelievers
verses.tr: wa-idh yaʿidukumu Allāh ʾiḥdā aṭ-ṭāʾifatayni ʾannahā lakum watawaddūna ʾanna ghayra dhāti ash-shawkahi takūnu lakum wayurīdu Allāh ʾan yuḥiqqa al-ḥaqqa bikalimātihi wayaqṭaʿa dābira al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember how God promised you [believers] that one of the two enemy groups would fall to you: you wanted the unarmed group to be yours, but it was God’s will to establish the truth according to His Word and to finish off the disbelievers––
verses.pickthall: And when Allah promised you one of the two bands (of the enemy) that it should be yours, and ye longed that other than the armed one might be yours. And Allah willed that He should cause the Truth to triumph by His words, and cut the root of the disbelievers;

verses.ar: لِيُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيُبْطِلَ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.
verses.tr: liyuḥiqqa al-ḥaqqa wayubṭila al-bāṭila walaw kariha al-mujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: to prove the Truth to be true, and the false to be false, much as the guilty might dislike it.
verses.pickthall: That He might cause the Truth to triumph and bring vanity to naught, however much the guilty might oppose;

verses.ar: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّى مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ
verses.en: [Remember] when you were asking help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another."
verses.tr: ʾidh tastaghīthūna rabbakum fāstajāba lakum ʾannā mumiddukum bi-ʾalfin mmina al-malāʾikahi murdifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When you begged your Lord for help, He answered you, ‘I will reinforce you with a thousand angels in succession.’
verses.pickthall: When ye sought help of your Lord and He answered you (saying): I will help you with a thousand of the angels, rank on rank.

verses.ar: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِۦ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ وَمَا ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And Allāh made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. And victory is not but from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.tr: wamā jaʿalahu Allāh ʾillā bushrā walitaṭmaʾinna bihi qulūbukum ۚ wamā an-naṣru ʾillā min ʿindi Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿazīzun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: God made this a message of hope to reassure your hearts: help comes only from God, He is mighty and wise.
verses.pickthall: Allah appointed it only as good tidings, and that your hearts thereby might be at rest. Victory cometh only by the help of Allah. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.

verses.ar: إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ ٱلنُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةً مِّنْهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً لِّيُطَهِّرَكُم بِهِۦ وَيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمْ رِجْزَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ ٱلْأَقْدَامَ
verses.en: [Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet.
verses.tr: ʾidh yughashīkumu an-nuʿāsa ʾamanahan mminhu wayunazzilu ʿalaykum mmina as-samāʾi māʾan lliyuṭahhirakum bihi wayudhhiba ʿankum rijza ash-shayṭāni waliyarbiṭa ʿalā qulūbikum wayuthabbita bihi al-ʾaqdāma
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when He gave you sleep as a reassurance from Him, and sent down water from the sky to cleanse you, to remove Satan’s pollution from you, to make your hearts strong and your feet firm.
verses.pickthall: When He made the slumber fall upon you as a reassurance from him and sent down water from the sky upon you, that thereby He might purify you, and remove from you the fear of Satan, and make strong your hearts and firm (your) feet thereby.

verses.ar: إِذْ يُوحِى رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ أَنِّى مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ سَأُلْقِى فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلرُّعْبَ فَٱضْرِبُوا۟ فَوْقَ ٱلْأَعْنَاقِ وَٱضْرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ
verses.en: [Remember] when your Lord inspired to the angels, "I am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip."
verses.tr: ʾidh yūḥā rabbuka ʾilā al-malāʾikahi ʾannā maʿakum fathabbitūā adh-dhīna āmanūā ۚ saʾulqā fā qulūbi adh-dhīna kafarūā ar-ruʿba fāḍribūā fawqa al-ʾaʿnāqi wāḍribūā minhum kulla banānin
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord revealed to the angels: ‘I am with you: give the believers firmness; I shall put terror into the hearts of the disbelievers- strike above their necks and strike all their fingertips.’
verses.pickthall: When thy Lord inspired the angels, (saying): I am with you. So make those who believe stand firm. I will throw fear into the hearts of those who disbelieve. Then smite the necks and smite of them each finger.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ ۚ وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.en: That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh and His Messenger - indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾannahum shāqqūā Allāh warasūlahu ۚ waman yushāqiqi Allāh warasūlahu fa-inna Allāh shadīdu al-ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: That was because they opposed God and His Messenger, and if anyone opposes God and His Messenger, God punishes them severely-
verses.pickthall: That is because they opposed Allah and His messenger. Whoso opposeth Allah and His messenger, (for him) lo! Allah is severe in punishment.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: "That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire.
verses.tr: dhālikum fadhūqūhu wa-anna lilkāfirīna ʿadhāba an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘That is what you get! Taste that!’––and the torment of the Fire awaits the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: That (is the award), so taste it, and (know) that for disbelievers is the torment of the Fire.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ زَحْفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ ٱلْأَدْبَارَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [in battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight].
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾidhā laqītumu adh-dhīna kafarūā zaḥfan falā tuwallūhumu al-ʾadbāra
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, when you meet the disbelievers in battle, never turn your backs on them:
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! When ye meet those who disbelieve in battle, turn not your backs to them.

verses.ar: وَمَن يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهُۥٓ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِّقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَىٰ فِئَةٍ فَقَدْ بَآءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: And whoever turns his back to them on such a day, unless swerving [as a strategy] for war or joining [another] company, has certainly returned with anger [upon him] from Allāh, and his refuge is Hell - and wretched is the destination.
verses.tr: waman yuwallihim yawmaʾidhin duburahu ʾillā mutaḥarrifan lliqitālin ʾaw mutaḥayyizan ʾilā fiʾahin faqad bāʾa bighaḍabin mmina Allāh wamaʾwāhu jahannamu ۖ wabiʾsa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: if anyone does so on such a day- unless maneuvring to fight or to join a fighting group- he incurs the wrath of God, and Hell will be his home, a wretched destination!
verses.pickthall: Whoso on that day turneth his back to them, unless manoeuvring for battle or intent to join a company, he truly hath incurred wrath from Allah, and his habitation will be hell, a hapless journey's end.

verses.ar: فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَمَىٰ ۚ وَلِيُبْلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلَآءً حَسَنًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And you did not kill them, but it was Allāh who killed them. And you threw not, [O Muḥammad], when you threw, but it was Allāh who threw that He might test the believers with a good test. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.tr: falam taqtulūhum walākinna Allāh qatalahum ۚ wamā ramayta ʾidh ramayta walākinna Allāh ramā ۚ waliyublāa al-muʾminīna minhu balāʾan ḥasanan ۚ ʾinna Allāh samīʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It was not you who killed them but God, and when you [Prophet] threw [sand at them] it was not your throw [that defeated them] but God’s, to do the believers a favour: God is all seeing and all knowing-
verses.pickthall: Ye (Muslims) slew them not, but Allah slew them. And thou (Muhammad) threwest not when thou didst throw, but Allah threw, that He might test the believers by a fair test from Him. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: That [is so], and [also] that Allāh will weaken the plot of the disbelievers.
verses.tr: dhālikum wa-anna Allāh mūhinu kaydi al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘That is what you get!’––and God will weaken the disbelievers’ designs.
verses.pickthall: That (is the case); and (know) that Allah (it is) Who maketh weak the plan of disbelievers.

verses.ar: إِن تَسْتَفْتِحُوا۟ فَقَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْفَتْحُ ۖ وَإِن تَنتَهُوا۟ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تَعُودُوا۟ نَعُدْ وَلَن تُغْنِىَ عَنكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: If you [disbelievers] seek the decision [i.e., victory] - the decision [i.e., defeat] has come to you. And if you desist [from hostilities], it is best for you; but if you return [to war], We will return, and never will you be availed by your [large] company at all, even if it should increase; and [that is] because Allāh is with the believers.
verses.tr: ʾin tastaftiḥūā faqad jāʾakumu al-fatḥu ۖ wa-in tantahūā fahuwa khayrun llakum ۖ wa-in taʿūdūā naʿud walan tughnāa ʿankum fiʾatukum shayā walaw kathurat wa-anna Allāh maʿa al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Disbelievers], if you were seeking a decision, now you have witnessed one: if you stop here, it will be better for you. If you return, so shall We, and your forces, though greater in number, will be of no use to you. God is with the believers.
verses.pickthall: (O Qureysh!) If ye sought a judgment, now hath the judgment come unto you. And if ye cease (from persecuting the believers) it will be better for you, but if ye return (to the attack) We also shall return. And your host will avail you naught, however numerous it be, and (know) that Allah is with the believers (in His Guidance).

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear [his order].
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾaṭīʿūā Allāh warasūlahu walā tawallawā ʿanhu wa-antum tasmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, obey God and His Messenger: do not turn away when you are listening to him;
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Obey Allah and His messenger, and turn not away from him when ye hear (him speak).

verses.ar: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.en: And do not be like those who say, "We have heard," while they do not hear.
verses.tr: walā takūnūā ka-adh-dhīna qālūā samiʿnā wahum lā yasmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: do not be like those who say, ‘We heard,’ though in fact they were not listening-
verses.pickthall: Be not as those who say, we hear, and they hear not.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلْبُكْمُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason [i.e., the disbelievers].
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinna sharra ad-dawābbi ʿinda Allāh aṣ-ṣummu al-bukmu adh-dhīna lā yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the worst creatures in God’s eyes are those who are [wilfully] deaf and dumb, who do not reason.
verses.pickthall: Lo! the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are the deaf, the dumb, who have no sense.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لَّأَسْمَعَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: Had Allāh known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would [still] have turned away, while they were refusing.
verses.tr: walaw ʿalima Allāh fīhim khayran llaʾasmaʿahum ۖ walaw ʾasmaʿahum latawallawā wwahum mmuʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If God had known there was any good in them, He would have made them hear, but even if He had, they would still have turned away and taken no notice.
verses.pickthall: Had Allah known of any good in them He would have made them hear, but had He made them hear they would have turned away, averse.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَأَنَّهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, respond to Allāh and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allāh intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā āstajībūā lillāh walilrrasūli ʾidhā daʿākum limā yuḥyīkum ۖ wāʿlamūā ʾanna Allāh yaḥūlu bayna al-marʾi waqalbihi wa-annahu ʾilayhi tuḥsharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, respond to God and His Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. Know that God comes between a man and his heart, and that you will be gathered to Him.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Obey Allah, and the messenger when He calleth you to that which quickeneth you, and know that Allah cometh in between the man and his own heart, and that He it is unto Whom ye will be gathered.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ فِتْنَةً لَّا تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنكُمْ خَآصَّةً ۖ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.en: And fear a trial which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allāh is severe in penalty.
verses.tr: wāttaqūā fitnahan llā tuṣībanna adh-dhīna ẓalamūā minkum khāṣṣahan ۖ wāʿlamūā ʾanna Allāh shadīdu al-ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Beware of discord that harms not only the wrongdoers among you: know that God is severe in His punishment.
verses.pickthall: And guard yourselves against a chastisement which cannot fall exclusively on those of you who are wrong-doers, and know that Allah is severe in punishment.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ أَنتُمْ قَلِيلٌ مُّسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَن يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ فَـَٔاوَىٰكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُم بِنَصْرِهِۦ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things - that you might be grateful.
verses.tr: wādhkurūā ʾidh ʾantum qalīlun mmustaḍʿafūna fā al-ʾarḍi takhāfūna ʾan yatakhaṭṭafakumu an-nāsu fāwākum wa-ayyadakum binaṣrihi warazaqakum mmina aṭ-ṭayyibāti laʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when you were few, victimized in the land, afraid that people might catch you, but God sheltered you and strengthened you with His help, and provided you with good things so that you might be grateful.
verses.pickthall: And remember, when ye were few and reckoned feeble in the land, and were in fear lest men should extirpate you, how He gave you refuge, and strengthened you with His help, and made provision of good things for you, that haply ye might be thankful.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَخُونُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوٓا۟ أَمَـٰنَـٰتِكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not betray Allāh and the Messenger or betray your trusts while you know [the consequence].
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā takhūnūā Allāh wa-ar-rasūla watakhūnūā ʾamānātikum wa-antum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, do not betray God and the Messenger, or knowingly betray [other people’s] trust in you.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Betray not Allah and His messenger, nor knowingly betray your trusts.

verses.ar: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And know that your properties and your children are but a trial and that Allāh has with Him a great reward.
verses.tr: wāʿlamūā ʾannamā ʾamwālukum wa-awlādukum fitnahun wa-anna Allāh ʿindahu ʾajrun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Be aware that your possessions and your children are only a test, and that there is a tremendous reward with God.
verses.pickthall: And know that your possessions and your children are a test, and that with Allah is immense reward.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّكُمْ فُرْقَانًا وَيُكَفِّرْ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: O you who have believed, if you fear Allāh, He will grant you a criterion and will remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾin tattaqūā Allāh yajʿal llakum furqānan wayukaffir ʿankum sayyātikum wayaghfir lakum ۗ wallāh dhū al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, if you remain mindful of God, He will give you a criterion [to tell right from wrong] and wipe out your bad deeds, and forgive you: God’s favour is great indeed.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! If ye keep your duty to Allah, He will give you discrimination (between right and wrong) and will rid you of your evil thoughts and deeds, and will forgive you. Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ ۚ وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَـٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allāh plans. And Allāh is the best of planners.
verses.tr: wa-idh yamkuru bika adh-dhīna kafarūā liyuthbitūka ʾaw yaqtulūka ʾaw yukhrijūka ۚ wayamkurūna wayamkuru Allāh ۖ wallāh khayru al-mākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember [Prophet] when the disbelievers plotted to take you captive, kill, or expel you. They schemed and so did God: He is the best of schemers.
verses.pickthall: And when those who disbelieve plot against thee (O Muhammad) to wound thee fatally, or to kill thee or to drive thee forth; they plot, but Allah (also) plotteth; and Allah is the best of plotters.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالُوا۟ قَدْ سَمِعْنَا لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَقُلْنَا مِثْلَ هَـٰذَآ ۙ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: And when Our verses are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we willed, we could say [something] like this. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
verses.tr: wa-idhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā qālūā qad samiʿnā law nashāʾu laqulnā mithla hādhā ۙ ʾin hādhā ʾillā ʾasāṭīru al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever Our Revelation is recited to them they say, ‘We have heard all this before- we could say something like this if we wanted- this is nothing but ancient fables.’
verses.pickthall: And when Our revelations are recited unto them they say: We have heard. If we wish we can speak the like of this. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالُوا۟ ٱللَّهُمَّ إِن كَانَ هَـٰذَا هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ مِنْ عِندِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَوِ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: And [remember] when they said, "O Allāh, if this should be the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment."
verses.tr: wa-idh qālūā Allāhumma ʾin kāna hādhā huwa al-ḥaqqa min ʿindika fa-amṭir ʿalaynā ḥijārahan mmina as-samāʾi ʾawi āʾtinā biʿadhābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: They also said, ‘God, if this really is the truth from You, then rain stones on us from the heavens, or send us some other painful punishment.’
verses.pickthall: And when they said: O Allah! If this be indeed the truth from Thee, then rain down stones on us or bring on us some painful doom!

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنتَ فِيهِمْ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.en: But Allāh would not punish them while you, [O Muḥammad], are among them, and Allāh would not punish them while they seek forgiveness.
verses.tr: wamā kāna Allāh liyuʿadhibahum wa-anta fīhim ۚ wamā kāna Allāh muʿadhibahum wahum yastaghfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But God would not send them punishment while you [Prophet] are in their midst, nor would He punish them if they sought forgiveness,
verses.pickthall: But Allah would not punish them while thou wast with them, nor will He punish them while they seek forgiveness.

verses.ar: وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: But why should Allāh not punish them while they obstruct [people] from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and they were not [fit to be] its guardians? Its [true] guardians are not but the righteous, but most of them do not know.
verses.tr: wamā lahum ʾallā yuʿadhibahumu Allāh wahum yaṣuddūna ʿani al-masjidi al-ḥarāmi wamā kānūā ʾawliyāʾahu ۚ ʾin ʾawliyāʾuhu ʾillā al-muttaqūna walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: yet why should God not punish them when they debar people from the Sacred Mosque, although they are not its [rightful] guardians? Only those mindful of God are its rightful guardians, but most of the disbelievers do not realize this.
verses.pickthall: What (plea) have they that Allah should not punish them, when they debar (His servants) from the Inviolable Place of Worship, though they are not its fitting guardians. Its fitting guardians are those only who keep their duty to Allah. But most of them know not.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمْ عِندَ ٱلْبَيْتِ إِلَّا مُكَآءً وَتَصْدِيَةً ۚ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: And their prayer at the House [i.e., the Kaʿbah] was not except whistling and handclapping. So taste the punishment for what you disbelieved [i.e., practiced of deviations].
verses.tr: wamā kāna ṣalātuhum ʿinda al-bayti ʾillā mukāʾan wataṣdiyahan ۚ fadhūqūā al-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Their prayers before the House are nothing but whistling and clapping. ‘So taste the punishment for your disbelief.’
verses.pickthall: And their worship at the (holy) House is naught but whistling and hand-clapping. Therefore (it is said unto them): Taste of the doom because ye disbelieve.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ لِيَصُدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَسَيُنفِقُونَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةً ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ يُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve spend their wealth to avert [people] from the way of Allāh. So they will spend it; then it will be for them a [source of] regret; then they will be overcome. And those who have disbelieved - unto Hell they will be gathered.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā yunfiqūna ʾamwālahum liyaṣuddūā ʿan sabīli Allāh ۚ fasayunfiqūnahā thumma takūnu ʿalayhim ḥasrahan thumma yughlabūna ۗ wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾilā jahannama yuḥsharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They use their wealth to bar people from the path of God, and they will go on doing so. In the end this will be a source of intense regret for them: they will be overcome and herded towards Hell.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve spend their wealth in order that they may debar (men) from the way of Allah. They will spend it, then it will become an anguish for them, then they will be conquered. And those who disbelieve will be gathered unto hell,

verses.ar: لِيَمِيزَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِ وَيَجْعَلَ ٱلْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُۥ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَيَرْكُمَهُۥ جَمِيعًا فَيَجْعَلَهُۥ فِى جَهَنَّمَ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: [It is] so that Allāh may distinguish the wicked from the good and place the wicked some of them upon others and heap them all together and put them into Hell. It is those who are the losers.
verses.tr: liyamīza Allāh al-khabītha mina aṭ-ṭayyibi wayajʿala al-khabītha baʿḍahu ʿalā baʿḍin fayarkumahu jamīʿan fayajʿalahu fā jahannama ۚ ʾūlāʾika humu al-khāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God will separate the bad from the good, place the bad on top of one another- heaping them all up together- and put them in Hell. They will be the losers.
verses.pickthall: That Allah may separate the wicked from the good, The wicked will He place piece upon piece, and heap them all together, and consign them unto hell. Such verily are the losers.

verses.ar: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَنتَهُوا۟ يُغْفَرْ لَهُم مَّا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَإِن يَعُودُوا۟ فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: Say to those who have disbelieved [that] if they cease, what has previously occurred will be forgiven for them. But if they return [to hostility] - then the precedent of the former [rebellious] peoples has already taken place.
verses.tr: qul llilladhīna kafarūā ʾin yantahūā yughfar lahum mmā qad salafa wa-in yaʿūdūā faqad maḍat sunnatu al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], tell the disbelievers that if they desist their past will be forgiven, but if they persist, they have an example in the fate of those who went before.
verses.pickthall: Tell those who disbelieve that if they cease (from persecution of believers) that which is past will be forgiven them; but if they return (thereto) then the example of the men of old hath already gone (before them, for a warning).

verses.ar: وَقَـٰتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ ٱلدِّينُ كُلُّهُۥ لِلَّهِ ۚ فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: And fight against them until there is no fitnah and [until] the religion [i.e., worship], all of it, is for Allāh. And if they cease - then indeed, Allāh is Seeing of what they do.
verses.tr: waqātilūhum ḥattā lā takūna fitnahun wayakūna ad-dīnu kulluhu lillāh ۚ fa-ini āntahawā fa-inna Allāh bimā yaʿmalūna baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Believers], fight them until there is no more persecution, and all worship is devoted to God alone: if they desist, then God sees all that they do,
verses.pickthall: And fight them until persecution is no more, and religion is all for Allah. But if they cease, then lo! Allah is Seer of what they do.

verses.ar: وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
verses.en: But if they turn away - then know that Allāh is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
verses.tr: wa-in tawallawā fāʿlamūā ʾanna Allāh mawlākum ۚ niʿma al-mawlā waniʿma an-naṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: but if they pay no heed, be sure that God is your protector, the best protector and the best helper.
verses.pickthall: And if they turn away, then know that Allah is your Befriender - a Transcendent Patron, a Transcendent Helper!

verses.ar: ۞ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُۥ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: And know that anything you obtain of war booty - then indeed, for Allāh is one fifth of it and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and the orphans, the needy, and the [stranded] traveler, if you have believed in Allāh and in that which We sent down to Our Servant on the day of criterion [i.e., decisive encounter] - the day when the two armies met [at Badr]. And Allāh, over all things, is competent.
verses.tr: ۞ wāʿlamūā ʾannamā ghanimtum mmin shāʾin fa-anna lillāh khumusahu walilrrasūli walidhā al-qurbā wa-l-yatāmā wa-l-masākīni wābni as-sabīli ʾin kuntum āmantum billāh wamā ʾanzalnā ʿalā ʿabdinā yawma al-furqāni yawma at-taqā al-jamʿāni ۗ wallāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Know that one-fifth of your battle gains belongs to God and the Messenger, to close relatives and orphans, to the needy and travellers, if you believe in God and the revelation We sent down to Our servant on the day of the decision, the day when the two forces met in battle. God has power over all things.
verses.pickthall: And know that whatever ye take as spoils of war, lo! a fifth thereof is for Allah, and for the messenger and for the kinsman (who hath need) and orphans and the needy and the wayfarer, if ye believe in Allah and that which We revealed unto Our slave on the Day of Discrimination, the day when the two armies met. And Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: إِذْ أَنتُم بِٱلْعُدْوَةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُم بِٱلْعُدْوَةِ ٱلْقُصْوَىٰ وَٱلرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدتُّمْ لَٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْمِيعَـٰدِ ۙ وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا لِّيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٍ وَيَحْيَىٰ مَنْ حَىَّ عَنۢ بَيِّنَةٍ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: [Remember] when you were on the near side of the valley, and they were on the farther side, and the caravan was lower [in position] than you. If you had made an appointment [to meet], you would have missed the appointment. But [it was] so that Allāh might accomplish a matter already destined - that those who perished [through disbelief] would perish upon evidence and those who lived [in faith] would live upon evidence; and indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.tr: ʾidh ʾantum bi-l-ʿudwahi ad-dunyā wahum bi-l-ʿudwahi al-quṣwā wa-ar-rakbu ʾasfala minkum ۚ walaw tawāʿadttum lākhtalaftum fā al-mīʿādi ۙ walākin lliyaqḍāa Allāh ʾamran kāna mafʿūlan lliyahlika man halaka ʿan bayyinahin wayaḥyā man ḥāa ʿan bayyinahin ۗ wa-inna Allāh lasamīʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when you were on the near side of the valley, and they were on the far side and the caravan was below you. If you had made an appointment to fight, you would have failed to keep it [but the battle took place] so that God might bring about something already ordained, so that those who were to die might die after seeing a clear proof, and so that those who were to live might live after seeing a clear proof- God is all hearing and all seeing.
verses.pickthall: When ye were on the near bank (of the valley) and they were on the yonder bank, and the caravan was below you (on the coast plain). And had ye trysted to meet one another ye surely would have failed to keep the tryst, but (it happened, as it did, without the forethought of either of you) that Allah might conclude a thing that must be done; that he who perished (on that day) might perish by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty) and he who survived might survive by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty). Lo! Allah in truth is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ وَلَوْ أَرَىٰكَهُمْ كَثِيرًا لَّفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَـٰزَعْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَلَّمَ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: [Remember, O Muḥammad], when Allāh showed them to you in your dream as few; and if He had shown them to you as many, you [believers] would have lost courage and would have disputed in the matter [of whether to fight], but Allāh saved [you from that]. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.tr: ʾidh yurīkahumu Allāh fā manāmika qalīlan ۖ walaw ʾarākahum kathīran llafashiltum walatanāzaʿtum fā al-ʾamri walākinna Allāh sallama ۗ ʾinnahu ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], remember when God made you see them in your sleep as few: if He had shown them to you [believers] as many, you would certainly have lost heart and argued about it, but God saved you. He knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.pickthall: When Allah showed them unto thee (O Muhammad) in thy dream as few in number, and if He had shown them to thee as many, ye (Muslims) would have faltered and would have quarrelled over the affair. But Allah saved (you). Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men).

verses.ar: وَإِذْ يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ إِذِ ٱلْتَقَيْتُمْ فِىٓ أَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيلًا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِىٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ لِيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.en: And [remember] when He showed them to you, when you met, as few in your eyes, and He made you [appear] as few in their eyes so that Allāh might accomplish a matter already destined. And to Allāh are [all] matters returned.
verses.tr: wa-idh yurīkumūhum ʾidhi at-taqaytum fā ʾaʿyunikum qalīlan wayuqallilukum fā ʾaʿyunihim liyaqḍāa Allāh ʾamran kāna mafʿūlan ۗ wa-ʾilā Allāh turjaʿu al-ʾumūru
verses.abdelhaleem: When you met He showed them to you as few, and He made you few in their eyes, so that He might bring about what has been ordained: everything goes back to God.
verses.pickthall: And when He made you (Muslims), when ye met (them), see them with your eyes as few, and lessened you in their eyes, (it was) that Allah might conclude a thing that must be done. Unto Allah all things are brought back.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَٱثْبُتُوا۟ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, when you encounter a company [from the enemy forces], stand firm and remember Allāh much that you may be successful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾidhā laqītum fiʾahan fāthbutūā wādhkurūā Allāh kathīran llaʿallakum tufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, when you meet a force in battle, stand firm and keep God firmly in mind, so that you may prosper.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! When ye meet an army, hold firm and think of Allah much, that ye may be successful.

verses.ar: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَا تَنَـٰزَعُوا۟ فَتَفْشَلُوا۟ وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ ۖ وَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: And obey Allāh and His Messenger, and do not dispute and [thus] lose courage and [then] your strength would depart; and be patient. Indeed, Allāh is with the patient.
verses.tr: wa-aṭīʿūā Allāh warasūlahu walā tanāzaʿūā fatafshalūā watadhhaba rīḥukum ۖ wāṣbirūā ۚ ʾinna Allāh maʿa aṣ-ṣābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Obey God and His Messenger, and do not quarrel with one another, or you may lose heart and your spirit may desert you. Be steadfast: God is with the steadfast.
verses.pickthall: And obey Allah and His messenger, and dispute not one with another lest ye falter and your strength depart from you; but be steadfast! Lo! Allah is with the steadfast.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِم بَطَرًا وَرِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
verses.en: And do not be like those who came forth from their homes insolently and to be seen by people and avert [them] from the way of Allāh. And Allāh is encompassing of what they do.
verses.tr: walā takūnūā ka-adh-dhīna kharajūā min diyārihim baṭaran wariāʾa an-nāsi wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli Allāh ۚ wallāh bimā yaʿmalūna muḥīṭun
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not be like those who came out of their homes full of conceit, showing off to people, and barring others from the way of God- God has full knowledge of all that they do.
verses.pickthall: Be not as those who came forth from their dwellings boastfully and to be seen of men, and debar (men) from the way of Allah, while Allah is surrounding all they do.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَإِنِّى جَارٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَتِ ٱلْفِئَتَانِ نَكَصَ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.en: And [remember] when Satan made their deeds pleasing to them and said, "No one can overcome you today from among the people, and indeed, I am your protector." But when the two armies sighted each other, he turned on his heels and said, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I see what you do not see; indeed, I fear Allāh. And Allāh is severe in penalty."
verses.tr: wa-idh zayyana lahumu ash-shayṭānu ʾaʿmālahum waqāla lā ghāliba lakumu al-yawma mina an-nāsi wa-innā jārun llakum ۖ falammā tarāʾati al-fiʾatāni nakaṣa ʿalā ʿaqibayhi waqāla ʾinnā barāʾun mminkum ʾinnā ʾarā mā lā tarawna ʾinnā ʾakhāfu Allāh ۚ wallāh shadīdu al-ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Satan made their foul deeds seem fair to them, and said, ‘No one will conquer you today, for I will be right beside you,’ but when the armies came within sight of one another he turned on his heels, saying, ‘This is where I leave you: I see what you do not, and I fear God- God is severe in His punishment.’
verses.pickthall: And when Satan made their deeds seem fair to them and said: No-one of mankind can conquer you this day, for I am your protector. But when the armies came in sight of one another, he took flight, saying: Lo! I am guiltless of you. Lo! I see that which ye see not. Lo! I fear Allah. And Allah is severe in punishment.

verses.ar: إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ غَرَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ دِينُهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: [Remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease [i.e., arrogance and disbelief] said, "Their religion has deluded those [Muslims]." But whoever relies upon Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.tr: ʾidh yaqūlu al-munāfiqūna wa-adh-dhīna fā qulūbihim mmaraḍun gharra hāʾulāʾi dīnuhum ۗ waman yatawakkal ʿalā Allāh fa-inna Allāh ʿazīzun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: The hypocrites and those who have sickness in their hearts said, ‘These people [the believers] must be deluded by their religion,’ but if anyone puts his trust in God, God is mighty and wise.
verses.pickthall: When the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is a disease said: Their religion hath deluded these. Whoso putteth his trust in Allah (will find that) lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۙ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.en: And if you could but see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved... They are striking their faces and their backs and [saying], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire.
verses.tr: walaw tarā ʾidh yatawaffā adh-dhīna kafarūā ۙ al-malāʾikahu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahum wadhūqūā ʿadhāba al-ḥarīqi
verses.abdelhaleem: If only you [Prophet] could see, when the angels take the souls of the disbelievers, how they strike their faces and backs: it will be said, ‘Taste the punishment of the Fire.
verses.pickthall: If thou couldst see how the angels receive those who disbelieve, smiting faces and their backs and (saying): Taste the punishment of burning!

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.en: That is for what your hands have put forth [of evil] and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
verses.tr: dhālika bimā qaddamat ʾaydīkum wa-anna Allāh laysa biẓallāmin llilʿabīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: This is caused by what your own hands have stored up for you: God is never unjust to His creatures.’
verses.pickthall: This is for that which your own hands have sent before (to the Judgment), and (know) that Allah is not a tyrant to His slaves.

verses.ar: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ ۙ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.en: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They disbelieved in the signs of Allāh, so Allāh seized them for their sins. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and severe in penalty.
verses.tr: kadaʾbi āli firʿawna ۙ wa-adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ kafarūā bāyāti Allāh fa-akhadhahumu Allāh bidhunūbihim ۗ ʾinna Allāh qawāun shadīdu al-ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: They are like Pharaoh’s people and those before them who ignored God’s signs, so God punished them for their sins: God is strong and severe in His punishment.
verses.pickthall: (Their way is) as the way of Pharaoh's folk and those before them; they disbelieved the revelations of Allah, and Allah took them in their sins. Lo! Allah is Strong, severe in punishment.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِّعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا۟ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: That is because Allāh would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾanna Allāh lam yaku mughayyiran nniʿmahan ʾanʿamahā ʿalā qawmin ḥattā yughayyirūā mā biʾanfusihim ۙ wa-anna Allāh samīʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: [He did] this because God would never change a favour He had conferred on a people unless they changed what was within themselves. God is all hearing, all knowing.
verses.pickthall: That is because Allah never changeth the grace He hath bestowed on any people until they first change that which is in their hearts, and (that is) because Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ ۙ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ وَكُلٌّ كَانُوا۟ ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They denied the signs of their Lord, so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned the people of Pharaoh. And all [of them] were wrongdoers.
verses.tr: kadaʾbi āli firʿawna ۙ wa-adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ kadhabūā bāyāti rabbihim fa-ahlaknāhum bidhunūbihim wa-aghraqnā āla firʿawna ۚ wakullun kānūā ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They are indeed like Pharaoh’s people and those before them, who denied the signs of their Lord: We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned Pharaoh’s people- they were all evildoers.
verses.pickthall: (Their way is) as the way of Pharaoh's folk and those before them; they denied the revelations of their Lord, so We destroyed them in their sins. And We drowned the folk of Pharaoh. All were evil-doers.

verses.ar: إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are those who have disbelieved, and they will not [ever] believe-
verses.tr: ʾinna sharra ad-dawābbi ʿinda Allāh adh-dhīna kafarūā fahum lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The worst creatures in the sight of God are those who reject Him and will not believe;
verses.pickthall: Lo! the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are the ungrateful who will not believe.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ عَـٰهَدتَّ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَهُمْ فِى كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: The ones with whom you made a treaty but then they break their pledge every time, and they do not fear Allāh.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ʿāhadtta minhum thumma yanquḍūna ʿahdahum fā kulli marrahin wahum lā yattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who, whenever you [Prophet] make a treaty with them, break it, for they have no fear of God.
verses.pickthall: Those of them with whom thou madest a treaty, and then at every opportunity they break their treaty, and they keep not duty (to Allah).

verses.ar: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِم مَّنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.en: So if you, [O Muḥammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.
verses.tr: fa-immā tathqafannahum fā al-ḥarbi fasharrid bihim mman khalfahum laʿallahum yadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you meet them in battle, make a fearsome example of them to those who come after them, so that they may take heed.
verses.pickthall: If thou comest on them in the war, deal with them so as to strike fear in those who are behind them, that haply they may remember.

verses.ar: وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِن قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَٱنۢبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْخَآئِنِينَ
verses.en: If you [have reason to] fear from a people betrayal, throw [their treaty] back to them, [putting you] on equal terms. Indeed, Allāh does not like traitors.
verses.tr: wa-immā takhāfanna min qawmin khiyānahan fānbidh ʾilayhim ʿalā sawāʾin ۚ ʾinna Allāh lā yuḥibbu al-khāʾinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And if you learn of treachery on the part of any people, throw their treaty back at them, for God does not love the treacherous.
verses.pickthall: And if thou fearest treachery from any folk, then throw back to them (their treaty) fairly. Lo! Allah loveth not the treacherous.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَبَقُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ لَا يُعْجِزُونَ
verses.en: And let not those who disbelieve think they will escape. Indeed, they will not cause failure [to Allāh].
verses.tr: walā yaḥsabanna adh-dhīna kafarūā sabaqūā ۚ ʾinnahum lā yuʿjizūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers should not think they have won; they cannot escape.
verses.pickthall: And let not those who disbelieve suppose that they can outstrip (Allah's Purpose). Lo! they cannot escape.

verses.ar: وَأَعِدُّوا۟ لَهُم مَّا ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن قُوَّةٍ وَمِن رِّبَاطِ ٱلْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِۦ عَدُوَّ ٱللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَءَاخَرِينَ مِن دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steeds of war by which you may terrify the enemy of Allāh and your enemy and others besides them whom you do not know [but] whom Allāh knows. And whatever you spend in the cause of Allāh will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged.
verses.tr: wa-aʿiddūā lahum mmā āstaṭaʿtum mmin quwwahin wamin rribāṭi al-khayli turhibūna bihi ʿaduwwa Allāh waʿaduwwakum wakharīna min dūnihim lā taʿlamūnahumu Allāh yaʿlamuhum ۚ wamā tunfiqūā min shāʾin fā sabīli Allāh yuwaffa ʾilaykum wa-antum lā tuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Prepare whatever forces you [believers] can muster, including warhorses, to frighten off God’s enemies and yours, and warn others unknown to you but known to God. Whatever you give in God’s cause will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged.
verses.pickthall: Make ready for them all thou canst of (armed) force and of horses tethered, that thereby ye may dismay the enemy of Allah and your enemy, and others beside them whom ye know not. Allah knoweth them. Whatsoever ye spend in the way of Allah it will be repaid to you in full, and ye will not be wronged.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِن جَنَحُوا۟ لِلسَّلْمِ فَٱجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: And if they incline to peace, then incline to it [also] and rely upon Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.tr: ۞ wa-in janaḥūā lilssalmi fājnaḥ lahā watawakkal ʿalā Allāh ۚ ʾinnahu huwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: But if they incline towards peace, you [Prophet] must also incline towards it, and put your trust in God: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
verses.pickthall: And if they incline to peace, incline thou also to it, and trust in Allah. Lo! He, even He, is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.ar: وَإِن يُرِيدُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِۦ وَبِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: But if they intend to deceive you - then sufficient for you is Allāh. It is He who supported you with His help and with the believers
verses.tr: wa-in yurīdūā ʾan yakhdaʿūka fa-inna ḥasbaka Allāh ۚ huwa adh-dhā ʾayyadaka binaṣrihi wabālmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they intend to deceive you, God is enough for you: it was He who strengthened you with His help,
verses.pickthall: And if they would deceive thee, then lo! Allah is Sufficient for thee. He it is Who supporteth thee with His help and with the believers,

verses.ar: وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّآ أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together; but Allāh brought them together. Indeed, He is Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.tr: wa-ʾallafa bayna qulūbihim ۚ law ʾanfaqta mā fā al-ʾarḍi jamīʿan mmā ʾallafta bayna qulūbihim walākinna Allāh ʾallafa baynahum ۚ ʾinnahu ʿazīzun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: and with the believers, and brought their hearts together. Even if you had given away everything in the earth you could not have done this, but God brought them together: God is mighty and wise.
verses.pickthall: And (as for the believers) hath attuned their hearts. If thou hadst spent all that is in the earth thou couldst not have attuned their hearts, but Allah hath attuned them. Lo! He is Mighty, Wise.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَسْبُكَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allāh and for whoever follows you of the believers.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu ḥasbuka Allāh wamani āttabaʿaka mina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, God is enough for you, and for the believers who follow you.
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Allah is Sufficient for thee and those who follow thee of the believers.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَرِّضِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى ٱلْقِتَالِ ۚ إِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَـٰبِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا۟ مِا۟ئَتَيْنِ ۚ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّا۟ئَةٌ يَغْلِبُوٓا۟ أَلْفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.en: O Prophet, urge the believers to battle. If there are among you twenty [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you one hundred [who are steadfast], they will overcome a thousand of those who have disbelieved because they are a people who do not understand.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu ḥarriḍi al-muʾminīna ʿalā al-qitāli ۚ ʾin yakun mminkum ʿishrūna ṣābirūna yaghlibūā māʾatayni ۚ wa-in yakun mminkum mmāʾahun yaghlibūā ʾalfan mmina adh-dhīna kafarūā biʾannahum qawmun llā yafqahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, urge the believers to fight: if there are twenty of you who are steadfast, they will overcome two hundred, and a hundred of you, if steadfast, will overcome a thousand of the disbelievers, for they are people who do not understand.
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Exhort the believers to fight. If there be of you twenty steadfast they shall overcome two hundred, and if there be of you a hundred (steadfast) they shall overcome a thousand of those who disbelieve, because they (the disbelievers) are a folk without intelligence.

verses.ar: ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ خَفَّفَ ٱللَّهُ عَنكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا ۚ فَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّا۟ئَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَغْلِبُوا۟ مِا۟ئَتَيْنِ ۚ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ أَلْفٌ يَغْلِبُوٓا۟ أَلْفَيْنِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: Now, Allāh has lightened [the hardship] for you, and He knows that among you is weakness. So if there are from you one hundred [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you a thousand, they will overcome two thousand by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the steadfast.
verses.tr: al-na khaffafa Allāh ʿankum waʿalima ʾanna fīkum ḍaʿfan ۚ fa-in yakun mminkum mmāʾahun ṣābirahun yaghlibūā māʾatayni ۚ wa-in yakun mminkum ʾalfun yaghlibūā ʾalfayni biʾidhni Allāh ۗ wallāh maʿa aṣ-ṣābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But God has lightened your burden for now, knowing that there is weakness in you––a steadfast hundred of you will defeat two hundred and a steadfast thousand of you will defeat two thousand, by God’s permission: God is with the steadfast.
verses.pickthall: Now hath Allah lightened your burden, for He knoweth that there is weakness in you. So if there be of you a steadfast hundred they shall overcome two hundred, and if there be of you a thousand (steadfast) they shall overcome two thousand by permission of Allah. Allah is with the steadfast.

verses.ar: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِىٍّ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: It is not for a prophet to have captives [of war] until he inflicts a massacre [upon Allāh's enemies] in the land. You [i.e., some Muslims] desire the commodities of this world, but Allāh desires [for you] the Hereafter. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.tr: mā kāna linabāin ʾan yakūna lahu ʾasrā ḥattā yuthkhina fā al-ʾarḍi ۚ turīdūna ʿaraḍa ad-dunyā wallāh yurīdu al-ākhiraha ۗ wallāh ʿazīzun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is not right for a prophet to take captives before he has conquered the battlefield. You [people] desire the transient goods of this world, but God desires the Hereafter [for you]- God is mighty and wise-
verses.pickthall: It is not for any prophet to have captives until he hath made slaughter in the land. Ye desire the lure of this world and Allah desireth (for you) the Hereafter, and Allah is Mighty, Wise.

verses.ar: لَّوْلَا كِتَـٰبٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَآ أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: If not for a decree from Allāh that preceded, you would have been touched for what you took by a great punishment.
verses.tr: llawlā kitābun mmina Allāh sabaqa lamassakum fīmā ʾakhadhtum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: and had it not been preordained by God, a severe punishment would have come upon you for what you have taken.
verses.pickthall: Had it not been for an ordinance of Allah which had gone before, an awful doom had come upon you on account of what ye took.

verses.ar: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَـٰلًا طَيِّبًا ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: fakulūā mimmā ghanimtum ḥalālan ṭayyiban ۚ wāttaqūā Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: So enjoy in a good and lawful manner the things you have gained in war and be mindful of God: He is forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: Now enjoy what ye have won, as lawful and good, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّمَن فِىٓ أَيْدِيكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَسْرَىٰٓ إِن يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ خَيْرًا يُؤْتِكُمْ خَيْرًا مِّمَّآ أُخِذَ مِنكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: O Prophet, say to whoever is in your hands of the captives, "If Allāh knows [any] good in your hearts, He will give you [something] better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu qul lliman fā ʾaydīkum mmina al-ʾasrā ʾin yaʿlami Allāh fā qulūbikum khayran yuʾtikum khayran mmimmā ʾukhidha minkum wayaghfir lakum ۗ wallāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, tell those you have taken captive, ‘If God knows of any good in your hearts, He will give you something better than what has been taken from you, and He will forgive you: God is forgiving and merciful.’
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Say unto those captives who are in your hands: If Allah knoweth any good in your hearts He will give you better than that which hath been taken from you, and will forgive you. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَإِن يُرِيدُوا۟ خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدْ خَانُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: But if they intend to betray you - then they have already betrayed Allāh before, and He empowered [you] over them. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: wa-in yurīdūā khiyānataka faqad khānūā Allāh min qablu fa-amkana minhum ۗ wallāh ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: But if they mean to betray you, they have betrayed God before, and He has given you mastery over them: He is all knowing, all wise.
verses.pickthall: And if they would betray thee, they betrayed Allah before, and He gave (thee) power over them. Allah is Knower, Wise.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوا۟ مَا لَكُم مِّن وَلَـٰيَتِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُوا۟ ۚ وَإِنِ ٱسْتَنصَرُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۭ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَـٰقٌ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who have believed and emigrated and fought with their wealth and lives in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - they are allies of one another. But those who believed and did not emigrate - for you there is no support of them until they emigrate. And if they seek help of you for the religion, then you must help, except against a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā wahājarūā wajāhadūā biʾamwālihim wa-anfusihim fā sabīli Allāh wa-adh-dhīna āwawā wwanaṣarūā ʾūlāʾika baʿḍuhum ʾawliyāʾu baʿḍin ۚ wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā walam yuhājirūā mā lakum mmin walāyatihim mmin shāʾin ḥattā yuhājirūā ۚ wa-ini āstanṣarūkum fā ad-dīni faʿalaykumu an-naṣru ʾillā ʿalā qawmin baynakum wabaynahum mmīthāqun ۗ wallāh bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who believed and emigrated [to Medina] and struggled for God’s cause with their possessions and persons, and those who gave refuge and help, are all allies of one another. As for those who believed but did not emigrate, you are not responsible for their protection until they have done so. But if they seek help from you against persecution, it is your duty to assist them, except against people with whom you have a treaty: God sees all that you do.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who believed and left their homes and strove with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah, and those who took them in and helped them: these are protecting friends one of another. And those who believed but did not leave their homes, ye have no duty to protect them till they leave their homes; but if they seek help from you in the matter of religion then it is your duty to help (them) except against a folk between whom and you there is a treaty. Allah is Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتْنَةٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.en: And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so [i.e., ally yourselves with other believers], there will be fitnah [i.e., disbelief and oppression] on earth and great corruption.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā baʿḍuhum ʾawliyāʾu baʿḍin ۚ ʾillā tafʿalūhu takun fitnahun fā al-ʾarḍi wafasādun kabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers support one another. If you do not do the same, there will be persecution in the land and great corruption.
verses.pickthall: And those who disbelieve are protectors one of another - If ye do not so, there will be confusion in the land, and great corruption.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا ۚ لَّهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: But those who have believed and emigrated and fought in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - it is they who are the believers, truly. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā wahājarūā wajāhadūā fā sabīli Allāh wa-adh-dhīna āwawā wwanaṣarūā ʾūlāʾika humu al-muʾminūna ḥaqqan ۚ llahum mmaghfirahun warizqun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who believed and emigrated, and struggled for God’s cause, and those who gave refuge and help- they are the true believers and they will have forgiveness and generous provision.
verses.pickthall: Those who believed and left their homes and strove for the cause of Allah, and those who took them in and helped them - these are the believers in truth. For them is pardon, and bountiful provision.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ مَعَكُمْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
verses.en: And those who believed after [the initial emigration] and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of all things.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā min baʿdu wahājarūā wajāhadūā maʿakum fa-ūlāʾika minkum ۚ wa-ūlūā al-ʾarḥāmi baʿḍuhum ʾawlā bibaʿḍin fā kitābi Allāh ۗ ʾinna Allāh bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: And those who came to believe afterwards, and emigrated and struggled alongside you, they are part of you, but relatives still have prior claim over one another in God’s Scripture: God has full knowledge of all things.
verses.pickthall: And those who afterwards believed and left their homes and strove along with you, they are of you; and those who are akin are nearer one to another in the ordinance of Allah. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things.

verses.ar: بَرَآءَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَـٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: [This is a declaration of] disassociation, from Allāh and His Messenger, to those with whom you had made a treaty among the polytheists.
verses.tr: barāʾahun mmina Allāh warasūlihi ʾilā adh-dhīna ʿāhadttum mmina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: A release by God and His Messenger from the treaty you [believers] made with the idolaters [is announced]––
verses.pickthall: Freedom from obligation (is proclaimed) from Allah and His messenger toward those of the idolaters with whom ye made a treaty.

verses.ar: فَسِيحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْزِى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: So travel freely, [O disbelievers], throughout the land [during] four months but know that you cannot cause failure to Allāh and that Allāh will disgrace the disbelievers.
verses.tr: fasīḥūā fā al-ʾarḍi ʾarbaʿaha ʾashhurin wāʿlamūā ʾannakum ghayru muʿjizā Allāh ۙ wa-anna Allāh mukhzā al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: you [idolaters] may move freely about the land for four months, but you should bear in mind both that you will not escape God, and that God will disgrace those who defy [Him].
verses.pickthall: Travel freely in the land four months, and know that ye cannot escape Allah and that Allah will confound the disbelievers (in His Guidance).

verses.ar: وَأَذَٰنٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَجِّ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ۙ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ فَإِن تُبْتُمْ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِى ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: And [it is] an announcement from Allāh and His Messenger to the people on the day of the greater pilgrimage that Allāh is disassociated from the disbelievers, and [so is] His Messenger. So if you repent, that is best for you; but if you turn away - then know that you will not cause failure to Allāh. And give tidings to those who disbelieve of a painful punishment.
verses.tr: wa-adhānun mmina Allāh warasūlihi ʾilā an-nāsi yawma al-ḥajji al-ʾakbari ʾanna Allāh barāʾun mmina al-mushrikīna ۙ warasūluhu ۚ fa-in tubtum fahuwa khayrun llakum ۖ wa-in tawallaytum fāʿlamūā ʾannakum ghayru muʿjizā Allāh ۗ wabashiri adh-dhīna kafarūā biʿadhābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day of the Great Pilgrimage [there will be] a proclamation from God and His Messenger to all people: ‘God and His Messenger are released from [treaty] obligations to the idolaters. It will be better for you [idolaters] if you repent; know that you cannot escape God if you turn away.’ [Prophet], warn those who ignore [God] that they will have a painful punishment.
verses.pickthall: And a proclamation from Allah and His messenger to all men on the day of the Greater Pilgrimage that Allah is free from obligation to the idolaters, and (so is) His messenger. So, if ye repent, it will be better for you; but if ye are averse, then know that ye cannot escape Allah. Give tidings (O Muhammad) of a painful doom to those who disbelieve,

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ عَـٰهَدتُّم مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنقُصُوكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَمْ يُظَـٰهِرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ أَحَدًا فَأَتِمُّوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ عَهْدَهُمْ إِلَىٰ مُدَّتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: Excepted are those with whom you made a treaty among the polytheists and then they have not been deficient toward you in anything or supported anyone against you; so complete for them their treaty until their term [has ended]. Indeed, Allāh loves the righteous [who fear Him].
verses.tr: ʾillā adh-dhīna ʿāhadttum mmina al-mushrikīna thumma lam yanquṣūkum shayā walam yuẓāhirūā ʿalaykum ʾaḥadan fa-atimmūā ʾilayhim ʿahdahum ʾilā muddatihim ۚ ʾinna Allāh yuḥibbu al-muttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who have honoured the treaty you made with them and who have not supported anyone against you: fulfil your agreement with them to the end of their term. God loves those who are mindful of Him.
verses.pickthall: Excepting those of the idolaters with whom ye (Muslims) have a treaty, and who have since abated nothing of your right nor have supported anyone against you. (As for these), fulfil their treaty to them till their term. Lo! Allah loveth those who keep their duty (unto Him).

verses.ar: فَإِذَا ٱنسَلَخَ ٱلْأَشْهُرُ ٱلْحُرُمُ فَٱقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ حَيْثُ وَجَدتُّمُوهُمْ وَخُذُوهُمْ وَٱحْصُرُوهُمْ وَٱقْعُدُوا۟ لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ ۚ فَإِن تَابُوا۟ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَخَلُّوا۟ سَبِيلَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And when the inviolable months have passed, then kill the polytheists wherever you find them and capture them and besiege them and sit in wait for them at every place of ambush. But if they should repent, establish prayer, and give zakāh, let them [go] on their way. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: fa-idhā ānsalakha al-ʾashhuru al-ḥurumu fāqtulūā al-mushrikīna ḥaythu wajadttumūhum wakhudhūhum wāḥṣurūhum wāqʿudūā lahum kulla marṣadin ۚ fa-in tābūā wa-aqāmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha watawā az-zakawāha fakhallūā sabīlahum ۚ ʾinna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When the [four] forbidden months are over, wherever you encounter the idolaters, kill them, seize them, besiege them, wait for them at every lookout post; but if they turn [to God], maintain the prayer, and pay the prescribed alms, let them go on their way, for God is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: Then, when the sacred months have passed, slay the idolaters wherever ye find them, and take them (captive), and besiege them, and prepare for them each ambush. But if they repent and establish worship and pay the poor-due, then leave their way free. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَإِنْ أَحَدٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ٱسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ حَتَّىٰ يَسْمَعَ كَلَـٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مَأْمَنَهُۥ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And if any one of the polytheists seeks your protection, then grant him protection so that he may hear the words of Allāh [i.e., the Qur’ān]. Then deliver him to his place of safety. That is because they are a people who do not know.
verses.tr: wa-in ʾaḥadun mmina al-mushrikīna āstajāraka fa-ajirhu ḥattā yasmaʿa kalāma Allāh thumma ʾablighhu maʾmanahu ۚ dhālika biʾannahum qawmun llā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If any one of the idolaters should seek your protection [Prophet], grant it to him so that he may hear the word of God, then take him to a place safe for him, for they are people with no knowledge [of it].
verses.pickthall: And if anyone of the idolaters seeketh thy protection (O Muhammad), then protect him so that he may hear the Word of Allah, and afterward convey him to his place of safety. That is because they are a folk who know not.

verses.ar: كَيْفَ يَكُونُ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَهْدٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ رَسُولِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ عَـٰهَدتُّمْ عِندَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ۖ فَمَا ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوا۟ لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: How can there be for the polytheists a treaty in the sight of Allāh and with His Messenger, except for those with whom you made a treaty at al-Masjid al-Ḥarām? So as long as they are upright toward you, be upright toward them. Indeed, Allāh loves the righteous [who fear Him].
verses.tr: kayfa yakūnu lilmushrikīna ʿahdun ʿinda Allāh waʿinda rasūlihi ʾillā adh-dhīna ʿāhadttum ʿinda al-masjidi al-ḥarāmi ۖ famā āstaqāmūā lakum fāstaqīmūā lahum ۚ ʾinna Allāh yuḥibbu al-muttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: How could there be a treaty with God and His Messenger for such idolaters? But as for those with whom you made a treaty at the Sacred Mosque, so long as they remain true to you, be true to them; God loves those who are mindful of Him.
verses.pickthall: How can there be a treaty with Allah and with His messenger for the idolaters save those with whom ye made a treaty at the Inviolable Place of Worship? So long as they are true to you, be true to them. Lo! Allah loveth those who keep their duty.

verses.ar: كَيْفَ وَإِن يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا يَرْقُبُوا۟ فِيكُمْ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً ۚ يُرْضُونَكُم بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتَأْبَىٰ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: How [can there be a treaty] while, if they gain dominance over you, they do not observe concerning you any pact of kinship or covenant of protection? They satisfy you with their mouths, but their hearts refuse [compliance], and most of them are defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: kayfa wa-in yaẓharūā ʿalaykum lā yarqubūā fīkum ʾillan walā dhimmahan ۚ yurḍūnakum biʾafwāhihim wataʾbā qulūbuhum wa-aktharuhum fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [How,] when, if they were to get the upper hand over you, they would not respect any tie with you, of kinship or of treaty? They please you with their tongues, but their hearts are against you and most of them are lawbreakers.
verses.pickthall: How (can there be any treaty for the others) when, if they have the upper hand of you, they regard not pact nor honour in respect of you? They satisfy you with their mouths the while their hearts refuse. And most of them are wrongdoers.

verses.ar: ٱشْتَرَوْا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: They have exchanged the signs of Allāh for a small price and averted [people] from His way. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.
verses.tr: āshtarawā bāyāti Allāh thamanan qalīlan faṣaddūā ʿan sabīlihi ۚ ʾinnahum sāʾa mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They have sold God’s message for a trifling gain, and barred others from His path. How evil their actions are!
verses.pickthall: They have purchased with the revelations of Allah a little gain, so they debar (men) from His way. Lo! evil is that which they are wont to do.

verses.ar: لَا يَرْقُبُونَ فِى مُؤْمِنٍ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُعْتَدُونَ
verses.en: They do not observe toward a believer any pact of kinship or covenant of protection. And it is they who are the transgressors.
verses.tr: lā yarqubūna fā muʾminin ʾillan walā dhimmahan ۚ wa-ūlāʾika humu al-muʿtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Where believers are concerned, they respect no tie of kinship or treaty. They are the ones who are committing aggression.
verses.pickthall: And they observe toward a believer neither pact nor honour. These are they who are transgressors.

verses.ar: فَإِن تَابُوا۟ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ ۗ وَنُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: But if they repent, establish prayer, and give zakāh, then they are your brothers in religion; and We detail the verses for a people who know.
verses.tr: fa-in tābūā wa-aqāmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha watawā az-zakawāha fa-ikhwānukum fā ad-dīni ۗ wanufaṣṣilu al-āyāti liqawmin yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they turn to God, keep up the prayer, and pay the prescribed alms, then they are your brothers in faith: We make the messages clear for people who are willing to learn.
verses.pickthall: But if they repent and establish worship and pay the poor-due, then are they your brethren in religion. We detail Our revelations for a people who have knowledge.

verses.ar: وَإِن نَّكَثُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَطَعَنُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ فَقَـٰتِلُوٓا۟ أَئِمَّةَ ٱلْكُفْرِ ۙ إِنَّهُمْ لَآ أَيْمَـٰنَ لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَنتَهُونَ
verses.en: And if they break their oaths after their treaty and defame your religion, then combat the leaders of disbelief, for indeed, there are no oaths [sacred] to them; [fight them that] they might cease.
verses.tr: wa-in nnakathūā ʾaymānahum mmin baʿdi ʿahdihim waṭaʿanūā fā dīnikum faqātilūā ʾaʾimmaha al-kufri ۙ ʾinnahum lā ʾaymāna lahum laʿallahum yantahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But if they break their oath after having made an agreement with you, if they revile your religion, then fight the leaders of disbelief- oaths mean nothing to them- so that they may stop.
verses.pickthall: And if they break their pledges after their treaty (hath been made with you) and assail your religion, then fight the heads of disbelief - Lo! they have no binding oaths - in order that they may desist.

verses.ar: أَلَا تُقَـٰتِلُونَ قَوْمًا نَّكَثُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ وَهَمُّوا۟ بِإِخْرَاجِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَهُم بَدَءُوكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۚ أَتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ ۚ فَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَوْهُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Would you not fight against a people who broke their oaths and determined to expel the Messenger, and they had begun [the attack upon] you the first time? Do you fear them? But Allāh has more right that you should fear Him, if you are [truly] believers.
verses.tr: ʾalā tuqātilūna qawman nnakathūā ʾaymānahum wahammūā biʾikhrāji ar-rasūli wahum badaʾūkum ʾawwala marrahin ۚ ʾatakhshawnahum ۚ fa-Allāh ʾaḥaqqu ʾan takhshawhu ʾin kuntum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: How could you not fight a people who have broken their oaths, who tried to drive the Messenger out, who attacked you first? Do you fear them? It is God you should fear if you are true believers.
verses.pickthall: Will ye not fight a folk who broke their solemn pledges, and purposed to drive out the messenger and did attack you first? What! Fear ye them? Now Allah hath more right that ye should fear Him, if ye are believers

verses.ar: قَـٰتِلُوهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Fight them; Allāh will punish them by your hands and will disgrace them and give you victory over them and satisfy the breasts [i.e., desires] of a believing people
verses.tr: qātilūhum yuʿadhibhumu Allāh biʾaydīkum wayukhzihim wayanṣurkum ʿalayhim wayashfi ṣudūra qawmin mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Fight them: God will punish them at your hands, He will disgrace them, He will help you to conquer them, He will heal the believers’ feelings
verses.pickthall: Fight them! Allah will chastise them at your hands, and He will lay them low and give you victory over them, and He will heal the breasts of folk who are believers.

verses.ar: وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَيَتُوبُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And remove the fury in their [i.e., the believers'] hearts. And Allāh turns in forgiveness to whom He wills; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: wayudhhib ghayẓa qulūbihim ۗ wayatūbu Allāh ʿalā man yashāʾu ۗ wallāh ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: and remove the rage from their hearts. God turns to whoever He will in His mercy; God is all knowing and wise.
