verses.pickthall: And this Qur'an is not such as could ever be invented in despite of Allah; but it is a confirmation of that which was before it and an exposition of that which is decreed for mankind - Therein is no doubt - from the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍ مِّثْلِهِۦ وَٱدْعُوا۟ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Or do they say [about the Prophet (ﷺ)], "He invented it?" Say, "Then bring forth a sūrah like it and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allāh, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: ʾam yaqūlūna āftarāhu ۖ qul fa-tūā bisūrahin mmithlihi wādʿūā mani āstaṭaʿtum mmin dūni Allāh ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Or do they say, ‘He has devised it’? Say, ‘Then produce a sura like it, and call on anyone you can beside God if you are telling the truth.’
verses.pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented it? Say: Then bring a surah like unto it, and call (for help) on all ye can besides Allah, if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِمَا لَمْ يُحِيطُوا۟ بِعِلْمِهِۦ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِهِمْ تَأْوِيلُهُۥ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: Rather, they have denied that which they encompass not in knowledge and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. Thus did those before them deny. Then observe how was the end of the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: bal kadhabūā bimā lam yuḥīṭūā biʿilmihi walammā yaʾtihim taʾwīluhu ۚ kadhālika kadhaba adh-dhīna min qablihim ۖ fānẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But they are denying what they cannot comprehend- its prophecy has yet to be fulfilled for them. In the same way, those before them refused to believe- see what was the end of those evildoers!
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they denied that, the knowledge whereof they could not compass, and whereof the interpretation (in events) hath not yet come unto them. Even so did those before them deny. Then see what was the consequence for the wrong-doers!

verses.ar: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: And of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. And your Lord is most knowing of the corrupters.
verses.tr: waminhum mman yuʾminu bihi waminhum mman llā yuʾminu bihi ۚ warabbuka ʾaʿlamu bi-l-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Some of them believe in it, and some do not: your Lord knows best those who cause corruption.
verses.pickthall: And of them is he who believeth therein, and of them is he who believeth not therein, and thy Lord is Best Aware of the corrupters.

verses.ar: وَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل لِّى عَمَلِى وَلَكُمْ عَمَلُكُمْ ۖ أَنتُم بَرِيٓـُٔونَ مِمَّآ أَعْمَلُ وَأَنَا۠ بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad], then say, "For me are my deeds, and for you are your deeds. You are disassociated from what I do, and I am disassociated from what you do."
verses.tr: wa-in kadhabūka faqul llā ʿamalā walakum ʿamalukum ۖ ʾantum barīwna mimmā ʾaʿmalu wa-anā barāʾun mmimmā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they do not believe you, [Prophet], say, ‘I act for myself, and you for yourselves. You are not responsible for my actions nor am I responsible for yours.’
verses.pickthall: And if they deny thee, say: Unto me my work, and unto you your work. Ye are innocent of what I do, and I am innocent of what ye do.

verses.ar: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And among them are those who listen to you. But can you cause the deaf to hear [i.e., benefit from this hearing], although they will not use reason?
verses.tr: waminhum mman yastamiʿūna ʾilayka ۚ ʾafaʾanta tusmiʿu aṣ-ṣumma walaw kānūā lā yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Some of them do listen to you: but can you make the deaf hear if they will not use their minds?
verses.pickthall: And of them are some who listen unto thee. But canst thou make the deaf to hear even though they apprehend not?

verses.ar: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنظُرُ إِلَيْكَ ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And among them are those who look at you. But can you guide the blind although they will not [attempt to] see?
verses.tr: waminhum mman yanẓuru ʾilayka ۚ ʾafaʾanta tahdā al-ʿumāa walaw kānūā lā yubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Some of them look at you: but can you guide the blind if they will not see?
verses.pickthall: And of them is he who looketh toward thee. But canst thou guide the blind even though they see not?

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ ٱلنَّاسَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh does not wrong the people at all, but it is the people who are wronging themselves.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh lā yaẓlimu an-nāsa shayā walākinna an-nāsa ʾanfusahum yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God does not wrong people at all- it is they who wrong themselves.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah wrongeth not mankind in aught; but mankind wrong themselves.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ كَأَن لَّمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
verses.en: And on the Day when He will gather them, [it will be] as if they had not remained [in the world] but an hour of the day, [and] they will know each other. Those will have lost who denied the meeting with Allāh and were not guided.
verses.tr: wayawma yaḥshuruhum kaʾan llam yalbathūā ʾillā sāʿahan mmina an-nahāri yataʿārafūna baynahum ۚ qad khasira adh-dhīna kadhabūā biliqāʾi Allāh wamā kānūā muhtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day He gathers them together, it will be as if they have stayed [in the world] no longer than a single hour, and they will recognize one another. Those who denied the meeting with God will be the losers, for they did not follow the right guidance.
verses.pickthall: And on the day when He shall gather them together, (when it will seem) as though they had tarried but an hour of the day, recognising one another, those will verily have perished who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided.

verses.ar: وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: And whether We show you some of what We promise them, [O Muḥammad], or We take you in death, to Us is their return; then, [either way], Allāh is a witness concerning what they are doing.
verses.tr: wa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa adh-dhā naʿiduhum ʾaw natawaffayannaka fa-ā marjiʿuhum thumma Allāh shahīdun ʿalā mā yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whether We let you [Prophet] see some of the punishment We have threatened them with, or cause you to die [first], they will return to Us: God is witness to what they do.
verses.pickthall: Whether We let thee (O Muhammad) behold something of that which We promise them or (whether We) cause thee to die, still unto Us is their return, and Allah, moreover, is Witness over what they do.

verses.ar: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولٌ ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes, it will be judged between them in justice, and they will not be wronged.
verses.tr: walikulli ʾummahin rrasūlun ۖ fa-idhā jāʾa rasūluhum quḍāa baynahum bi-l-qisṭi wahum lā yuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Every community is sent a mes-senger, and when their messenger comes, they will be judged justly; they will not be wronged.
verses.pickthall: And for every nation there is a messenger. And when their messenger cometh (on the Day of Judgment) it will be judged between them fairly, and they will not be wronged.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.tr: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā al-waʿdu ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They ask, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
verses.pickthall: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?

verses.ar: قُل لَّآ أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِى ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۗ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ ۚ إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةً ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "I possess not for myself any harm or benefit except what Allāh should will. For every nation is a [specified] term. When their time has come, then they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]."
verses.tr: qul llā ʾamliku linafsā ḍarran walā nafʿan ʾillā mā shāʾa Allāh ۗ likulli ʾummahin ʾajalun ۚ ʾidhā jāʾa ʾajaluhum falā yastakhirūna sāʿahan ۖ walā yastaqdimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘I cannot control any harm or benefit that comes to me, except as God wills. There is an appointed term for every community, and when it is reached they can neither delay nor hasten it, even for a moment.’
verses.pickthall: Say: I have no power to hurt or benefit myself, save that which Allah willeth. For every nation there is an appointed time. When their time cometh, then they cannot put it off an hour, nor hasten (it).

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُهُۥ بَيَـٰتًا أَوْ نَهَارًا مَّاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Have you considered: if His punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which [aspect] of it would the criminals be impatient?"
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum ʾin ʾatākum ʿadhābuhu bayātan ʾaw nahāran mmādhā yastaʿjilu minhu al-mujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Think: if His punishment were to come to you, during the night or day, what part of it would the guilty wish to hasten?
verses.pickthall: Say: Have ye thought: When His doom cometh unto you as a raid by night, or in the (busy) day; what is there of it that the guilty ones desire to hasten?

verses.ar: أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦٓ ۚ ءَآلْـَٔـٰنَ وَقَدْ كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.en: Then is it that when it has [actually] occurred you will believe in it? Now? And you were [once] for it impatient.
verses.tr: ʾathumma ʾidhā mā waqaʿa āmantum bihi ۚ ālna waqad kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Will you believe in it, when it actually happens?’ It will be said, ‘Now [you believe], when [before] you sought to hasten it?’
verses.pickthall: Is it (only) then, when it hath befallen you, that ye will believe? What! (Believe) now, when (until now) ye have been hastening it on (through disbelief)?

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: Then it will be said to those who had wronged, "Taste the punishment of eternity; are you being recompensed except for what you used to earn?"
verses.tr: thumma qīla lilladhīna ẓalamūā dhūqūā ʿadhāba al-khuldi hal tujzawna ʾillā bimā kuntum taksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It will be said to the evildoers, ‘Taste lasting punishment. Why should you be rewarded for anything but what you did?’
verses.pickthall: Then will it be said unto those who dealt unjustly Taste the torment of eternity. Are ye requited aught save what ye used to earn?

verses.ar: ۞ وَيَسْتَنۢبِـُٔونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ ۖ قُلْ إِى وَرَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verses.en: And they ask information of you, [O Muḥammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allāh]."
verses.tr: ۞ wayastanbiwnaka ʾaḥaqqun huwa ۖ qul ā warabbā ʾinnahu laḥaqqun ۖ wamā ʾantum bimuʿjizīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They ask you [Prophet], ‘Is it true?’ Say, ‘Yes, by my Lord, it is true, and you cannot escape it.’
verses.pickthall: And they ask thee to inform them (saying): Is it true? Say: Yea, by my Lord, verily it is true, and ye cannot escape.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفْسٍ ظَلَمَتْ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَٱفْتَدَتْ بِهِۦ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۖ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And if each soul that wronged had everything on earth, it would offer it in ransom. And they will confide regret when they see the punishment; and they will be judged in justice, and they will not be wronged.
verses.tr: walaw ʾanna likulli nafsin ẓalamat mā fā al-ʾarḍi lāftadat bihi ۗ wa-asarrūā an-nadāmaha lammā raʾawā al-ʿadhāba ۖ waquḍāa baynahum bi-l-qisṭi ۚ wahum lā yuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Every soul that has done evil, if it possessed all that is on the earth, would gladly offer it as ransom. When they see the punishment, they will repent in secret, but they will be judged with justice and will not be wronged.
verses.pickthall: And if each soul that doeth wrong had all that is in the earth it would seek to ransom itself therewith; and they will feel remorse within them, when they see the doom. But it hath been judged between them fairly and they are not wronged.

verses.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Unquestionably, the promise of Allāh is truth, but most of them do not know.
verses.tr: ʾalā ʾinna lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۗ ʾalā ʾinna waʿda Allāh ḥaqqun walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is to God that everything in the heavens and the earth truly belongs: God’s promise is true, but most people do not realize it.
verses.pickthall: Lo! verily all that is in the heavens and the earth is Allah's. Lo! verily Allah's promise is true. But most of them know not.

verses.ar: هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: He gives life and causes death, and to Him you will be returned.
verses.tr: huwa yuḥāi wayumītu wa-ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who gives life and takes it, and you will all be returned to Him.
verses.pickthall: He quickeneth and giveth death, and unto Him ye will be returned.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَآءٌ لِّمَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: O mankind, there has come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu qad jāʾatkum mmawʿiẓahun mmin rrabbikum washifāʾun llimā fā aṣ-ṣudūri wahudanā waraḥmahun llilmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: People, a teaching from your Lord has come to you, a healing for what is in [your] hearts, and guidance and mercy for the believers.
verses.pickthall: O mankind! There hath come unto you an exhortation from your Lord, a balm for that which is in the breasts, a guidance and a mercy for believers.

verses.ar: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِۦ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا۟ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
verses.en: Say, "In the bounty of Allāh and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate."
verses.tr: qul bifaḍli Allāh wabiraḥmatihi fabidhālika falyafraḥūā huwa khayrun mmimmā yajmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘In God’s grace and mercy let them rejoice: these are better than all they accumulate.’
verses.pickthall: Say: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy: therein let them rejoice. It is better than what they hoard.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ فَجَعَلْتُم مِّنْهُ حَرَامًا وَحَلَـٰلًا قُلْ ءَآللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ ۖ أَمْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Have you seen what Allāh has sent down to you of provision of which you have made [some] lawful and [some] unlawful?" Say, "Has Allāh permitted you [to do so], or do you invent [something] about Allāh?"
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum mmā ʾanzala Allāh lakum mmin rrizqin fajaʿaltum mminhu ḥarāman waḥalālan qul ālllahu ʾadhina lakum ۖ ʾam ʿalā Allāh taftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Think about the provision God has sent down for you, some of which you have made unlawful and some lawful.’ Say, ‘Has God given you permission [to do this], or are you inventing lies about God?’
verses.pickthall: Say: Have ye considered what provision Allah hath sent down for you, how ye have made of it lawful and unlawful? Hath Allah permitted you, or do ye invent a lie concerning Allah?

verses.ar: وَمَا ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And what will be the supposition of those who invent falsehood about Allāh on the Day of Resurrection? Indeed, Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful.
verses.tr: wamā ẓannu adh-dhīna yaftarūna ʿalā Allāh al-kadhiba yawma al-qiyāmahi ۗ ʾinna Allāh ladhū faḍlin ʿalā an-nāsi walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What will those people who invent lies about Him think on the Day of Resurrection? God is bountiful towards people, but most of them do not give thanks.
verses.pickthall: And what think those who invent a lie concerning Allah (will be their plight) upon the Day of Resurrection? Lo! Allah truly is Bountiful toward mankind, but most of them give not thanks.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَكُونُ فِى شَأْنٍ وَمَا تَتْلُوا۟ مِنْهُ مِن قُرْءَانٍ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُودًا إِذْ تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَا يَعْزُبُ عَن رَّبِّكَ مِن مِّثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرَ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And, [O Muḥammad], you are not [engaged] in any matter and do not recite any of the Qur’ān and you [people] do not do any deed except that We are witness over you when you are involved in it. And not absent from your Lord is any [part] of an atom's weight within the earth or within the heaven or [anything] smaller than that or greater but that it is in a clear register.
verses.tr: wamā takūnu fā shaʾnin wamā tatlūā minhu min qurānin walā taʿmalūna min ʿamalin ʾillā kunnā ʿalaykum shuhūdan ʾidh tufīḍūna fīhi ۚ wamā yaʿzubu ʿan rrabbika min mmithqāli dharrahin fā al-ʾarḍi walā fā as-samāʾi walā ʾaṣghara min dhālika walā ʾakbara ʾillā fā kitābin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: In whatever matter you [Prophet] may be engaged and whatever part of the Quran you are reciting, whatever work you [people] are doing, We witness you when you are engaged in it. Not even the weight of a speck of dust in the earth or sky escapes your Lord, nor anything lesser or greater: it is all written in a clear record.
verses.pickthall: And thou (Muhammad) art not occupied with any business and thou recitest not a Lecture from this (Scripture), and ye (mankind) perform no act, but We are Witness of you when ye are engaged therein. And not an atom's weight in the earth or in the sky escapeth your Lord, nor what is less than that or greater than that, but it is (written) in a clear Book.

verses.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.en: Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allāh there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve -
verses.tr: ʾalā ʾinna ʾawliyāʾa Allāh lā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But for those who are on God’s side there is no fear, nor shall they grieve.
verses.pickthall: Lo! verily the friends of Allah are (those) on whom fear (cometh) not, nor do they grieve?

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: Those who believed and were fearing Allāh.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna āmanūā wakānūā yattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: For those who believe and are conscious of God,
verses.pickthall: Those who believe and keep their duty (to Allah).

verses.ar: لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.en: For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words [i.e., decrees] of Allāh. That is what is the great attainment.
verses.tr: lahumu al-bushrā fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā wafā al-ākhirahi ۚ lā tabdīla likalimāti Allāh ۚ dhālika huwa al-fawzu al-ʿaẓīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: for them there is good news in this life and in the Hereafter- there is no changing the promises of God- that is truly the supreme triumph.
verses.pickthall: Theirs are good tidings in the life of the world and in the Hereafter - There is no changing the Words of Allah - that is the Supreme Triumph.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّ ٱلْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا ۚ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allāh entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.tr: walā yaḥzunka qawluhum ۘ ʾinna al-ʿizzaha lillāh jamīʿan ۚ huwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not let their words grieve you [Prophet]. Power belongs entirely to God; He hears all and knows all;
verses.pickthall: And let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! power belongeth wholly to Allah. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
verses.en: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And those who invoke other than Allāh do not [actually] follow [His] "partners." They follow not except assumption, and they are not but misjudging.
verses.tr: ʾalā ʾinna lillāh man fā as-samāwāti waman fā al-ʾarḍi ۗ wamā yattabiʿu adh-dhīna yadʿūna min dūni Allāh shurakāʾa ۚ ʾin yattabiʿūna ʾillā aẓ-ẓanna wa-in hum ʾillā yakhruṣūna
verses.abdelhaleem: indeed, all who are in the heavens and on the earth belong to Him. Those who call upon others beside God are not really following partner-gods; they are only following assumptions and telling lies.
verses.pickthall: Lo! is it not unto Allah that belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is in the earth? Those who follow aught instead of Allah follow not (His) partners. They follow only a conjecture, and they do but guess.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.en: It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā jaʿala lakumu al-yla litaskunūā fīhi wa-an-nahāra mubṣiran ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yasmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who made the night so that you can rest in it and the daylight so that you can see- there truly are signs in this for those who hear.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath appointed for you the night that ye should rest therein and the day giving sight. Lo! herein verily are portents for a folk that heed.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنْ عِندَكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: They have said, "Allāh has taken a son." Exalted is He; He is the [one] Free of need. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority for this [claim]. Do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?
verses.tr: qālūā āttakhadha Allāh waladan ۗ subḥānahu ۖ huwa al-ghanāu ۖ lahu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۚ ʾin ʿindakum mmin sulṭānin bihādhā ۚ ʾataqūlūna ʿalā Allāh mā lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘God has children!’ May He be exalted! He is the Self-Sufficient One; everything in the heavens and the earth belongs to Him. You have no authority to say this. How dare you say things about God without any knowledge?
verses.pickthall: They say: Allah hath taken (unto Him) a son - Glorified be He! He hath no needs! His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Ye have no warrant for this. Tell ye concerning Allah that which ye know not?

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allāh will not succeed."
verses.tr: qul ʾinna adh-dhīna yaftarūna ʿalā Allāh al-kadhiba lā yufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Those who invent lies about God will not prosper.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Verily those who invent a lie concerning Allah will not succeed.

verses.ar: مَتَـٰعٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ نُذِيقُهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلشَّدِيدَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: [For them is brief] enjoyment in this world; then to Us is their return; then We will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve.
verses.tr: matāʿun fā ad-dunyā thumma ʾilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma nudhīquhumu al-ʿadhāba ash-shadīda bimā kānūā yakfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They may have a little enjoyment in this world, but then they will return to Us. Then We shall make them taste severe punishment for persisting in blasphemy.
verses.pickthall: This world's portion (will be theirs), then unto Us is their return. Then We make them taste a dreadful doom because they used to disbelieve.

verses.ar: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكُم مَّقَامِى وَتَذْكِيرِى بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَأَجْمِعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَكُمْ وَشُرَكَآءَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنْ أَمْرُكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ غُمَّةً ثُمَّ ٱقْضُوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ وَلَا تُنظِرُونِ
verses.en: And recite to them the news of Noah, when he said to his people, "O my people, if my residence and my reminding of the signs of Allāh has become burdensome upon you - then I have relied upon Allāh. So resolve upon your plan and [call upon] your associates. Then let not your plan be obscure to you. Then carry it out upon me and do not give me respite.
verses.tr: ۞ wātlu ʿalayhim nabaʾa nūḥin ʾidh qāla liqawmihi yāqawmi ʾin kāna kabura ʿalaykum mmaqāmā watadhkīrā bāyāti Allāh faʿalā Allāh tawakkaltu fa-ajmiʿūā ʾamrakum washurakāʾakum thumma lā yakun ʾamrukum ʿalaykum ghummahan thumma āqḍūā ʾilāa walā tunẓirūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Tell them the story of Noah. He said to his people, ‘My people, if my presence among you and my reminding you of God’s signs is too much for you, then I put my trust in God. Agree on your course of action, you and your partner-gods- do not be hesitant or secretive about it- then carry out your decision on me and give me no respite.
verses.pickthall: Recite unto them the story of Noah, when he told his people: O my people! If my sojourn (here) and my reminding you by Allah's revelations are an offence unto you, in Allah have I put my trust, so decide upon your course of action you and your partners. Let not your course of action be in doubt for you. Then have at me, give me no respite.

verses.ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَمَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And if you turn away [from my advice] - then no payment have I asked of you. My reward is only from Allāh, and I have been commanded to be of the Muslims [i.e., those who submit to Allāh]."
verses.tr: fa-in tawallaytum famā saʾaltukum mmin ʾajrin ۖ ʾin ʾajrāa ʾillā ʿalā Allāh ۖ wa-umirtu ʾan ʾakūna mina al-muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But if you turn away, I have asked no reward from you; my reward is with God alone, and I am commanded to be one of those who devote themselves to Him.’
verses.pickthall: But if ye are averse I have asked of you no wage. My wage is the concern of Allah only, and I am commanded to be of those who surrender (unto Him).

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ وَأَغْرَقْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.en: And they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship and made them successors, and We drowned those who denied Our signs. Then see how was the end of those who were warned.
verses.tr: fakadhabūhu fanajjaynāhu waman mmaʿahu fā al-fulki wajaʿalnāhum khalāʾifa wa-aghraqnā adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā ۖ fānẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mundharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But they rejected him. We saved him and those with him on the Ark and let them survive; and We drowned those who denied Our revelations- see what was the end of those who were forewarned!
verses.pickthall: But they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and made them viceroys (in the earth), while We drowned those who denied Our revelations. See then the nature of the consequence for those who had been warned.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِمَا كَذَّبُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَطْبَعُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
verses.en: Then We sent after him messengers to their peoples, and they came to them with clear proofs. But they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus We seal over the hearts of the transgressors.
verses.tr: thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihi rusulan ʾilā qawmihim fajāʾūhum bi-l-bayyināti famā kānūā liyuʾminūā bimā kadhabūā bihi min qablu ۚ kadhālika naṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbi al-muʿtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then, after him, We sent messengers to their peoples bringing them clear signs. But they would not believe in anything they had already rejected: in this way We seal the hearts of those who are full of hostility.
verses.pickthall: Then, after him, We sent messengers unto their folk, and they brought them clear proofs. But they were not ready to believe in that which they before denied. Thus print We on the hearts of the transgressors.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people.
verses.tr: thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mmūsā wahārūna ʾilā firʿawna wamalaʾīhi bāyātinā fāstakbarūā wakānūā qawman mmujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: After them We sent Moses and Aaron with Our signs to Pharaoh and his leading supporters, but they acted arrogantly- they were wicked people.
verses.pickthall: Then, after them, We sent Moses and Aaron unto Pharaoh and his chiefs with Our revelations, but they were arrogant and were a guilty folk.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: So when there came to them the truth from Us, they said, "Indeed, this is obvious magic."
verses.tr: falammā jāʾahumu al-ḥaqqu min ʿindinā qālūā ʾinna hādhā lasiḥrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: When the truth came to them from Us, they said, ‘This is blatant sorcery.’
verses.pickthall: And when the Truth from Our presence came unto them, they said: Lo! this is mere magic.

verses.ar: قَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَكُمْ ۖ أَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَا وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّـٰحِرُونَ
verses.en: Moses said, "Do you say [thus] about the truth when it has come to you? Is this magic? But magicians will not succeed."
verses.tr: qāla mūsā ʾataqūlūna lilḥaqqi lammā jāʾakum ۖ ʾasiḥrun hādhā walā yufliḥu as-sāḥirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘Is this what you say about the Truth when it comes to you? Is this sorcery? Sorcerers never prosper.’
verses.pickthall: Moses said: Speak ye (so) of the Truth when it hath come unto you? Is this magic? Now magicians thrive not.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَلْفِتَنَا عَمَّا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَا وَتَكُونَ لَكُمَا ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكُمَا بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Have you come to us to turn us away from that upon which we found our fathers and so that you two may have grandeur in the land? And we are not believers in you."
verses.tr: qālūā ʾajiʾtanā litalfitanā ʿammā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāʾanā watakūna lakumā al-kibriyāʾu fā al-ʾarḍi wamā naḥnu lakumā bimuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Have you come to turn us away from the faith we found our fathers following, so that you and your brother can gain greatness in this land? We will never believe in you.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Hast thou come unto us to pervert us from that (faith) in which we found our fathers, and that you two may own the place of greatness in the land? We will not believe you two.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱئْتُونِى بِكُلِّ سَـٰحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.en: And Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every learned magician."
verses.tr: waqāla firʿawnu āʾtūnā bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: And Pharaoh said, ‘Bring me every learned sorcerer.’
verses.pickthall: And Pharaoh said: Bring every cunning wizard unto me.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
verses.en: So when the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw down whatever you will throw."
verses.tr: falammā jāʾa as-saḥarahu qāla lahum mmūsā ʾalqūā mā ʾantum mmulqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the sorcerers came, Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you have.’
verses.pickthall: And when the wizards came, Moses said unto them: Cast your cast!

verses.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَلْقَوْا۟ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ ٱلسِّحْرُ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُۥٓ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: And when they had thrown, Moses said, "What you have brought is [only] magic. Indeed, Allāh will expose its worthlessness. Indeed, Allāh does not amend the work of corrupters.
verses.tr: falammā ʾalqawā qāla mūsā mā jiʾtum bihi as-siḥru ۖ ʾinna Allāh sayubṭiluhu ۖ ʾinna Allāh lā yuṣliḥu ʿamala al-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they did so, Moses said, ‘Everything you have brought is sorcery and God will show it to be false. God does not make the work of mischief-makers right;
verses.pickthall: And when they had cast, Moses said: That which ye have brought is magic. Lo! Allah will make it vain. Lo! Allah upholdeth not the work of mischief-makers.

verses.ar: وَيُحِقُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَـٰتِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it."
verses.tr: wayuḥiqqu Allāh al-ḥaqqa bikalimātihi walaw kariha al-mujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He will uphold the Truth with His words, even if the evildoers hate it.’
verses.pickthall: And Allah will vindicate the Truth by His words, however much the guilty be averse.

verses.ar: فَمَآ ءَامَنَ لِمُوسَىٰٓ إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ عَلَىٰ خَوْفٍ مِّن فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِمْ أَن يَفْتِنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.en: But no one believed Moses, except [some] offspring [i.e., youths] among his people, for fear of Pharaoh and his establishment that they would persecute them. And indeed, Pharaoh was haughty within the land, and indeed, he was of the transgressors.
verses.tr: famā āmana limūsā ʾillā dhurriyyahun mmin qawmihi ʿalā khawfin mmin firʿawna wamalaʾīhim ʾan yaftinahum ۚ wa-inna firʿawna laʿālin fā al-ʾarḍi wa-innahu lamina al-musrifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But no one believed in Moses except a few of his own people, for fear that Pharaoh and their leaders would persecute them: Pharaoh was domineering in the land and prone to excess.
verses.pickthall: But none trusted Moses, save some scions of his people, (and they were) in fear of Pharaoh and their chiefs, that he would persecute them. Lo! Pharaoh was verily a tyrant in the land, and lo! he verily was of the wanton.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And Moses said, "O my people, if you have believed in Allāh, then rely upon Him, if you should be Muslims [i.e., submitting to Him]."
verses.tr: waqāla mūsā yāqawmi ʾin kuntum āmantum billāh faʿalayhi tawakkalūā ʾin kuntum mmuslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘My people, if you have faith in God and are devoted to Him, put your trust in Him.’
verses.pickthall: And Moses said: O my people! If ye have believed in Allah then put trust in Him, if ye have indeed surrendered (unto Him)!

verses.ar: فَقَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: So they said, "Upon Allāh do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people
verses.tr: faqālūā ʿalā Allāh tawakkalnā rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fitnahan llilqawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We have put our trust in God. Lord! Do not make us an object of persecution for the oppressors.
verses.pickthall: They said: In Allah we put trust. Our Lord! Oh, make us not a lure for the wrongdoing folk;

verses.ar: وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people."
verses.tr: wanajjinā biraḥmatika mina al-qawmi al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Save us, in Your mercy, from those who reject [Your message].’
verses.pickthall: And, of Thy mercy, save us from the folk that disbelieve.

verses.ar: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَأَخِيهِ أَن تَبَوَّءَا لِقَوْمِكُمَا بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًا وَٱجْعَلُوا۟ بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةً وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And We inspired to Moses and his brother, "Settle your people in Egypt in houses and make your houses [facing the] qiblah and establish prayer and give good tidings to the believers."
verses.tr: wa-awḥaynā ʾilā mūsā wa-akhīhi ʾan tabawwaā liqawmikumā bimiṣra buyūtan wājʿalūā buyūtakum qiblahan wa-aqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha ۗ wabashiri al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We revealed to Moses and his brother: ‘House your people in Egypt and make these houses places of worship; keep up the prayer; give good news to the believers!’
verses.pickthall: And We inspired Moses and his brother, (saying): Appoint houses for your people in Egypt and make your houses oratories, and establish worship. And give good news to the believers.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ ءَاتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُۥ زِينَةً وَأَمْوَٰلًا فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِكَ ۖ رَبَّنَا ٱطْمِسْ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَٱشْدُدْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.en: And Moses said, "Our Lord, indeed You have given Pharaoh and his establishment splendor and wealth in the worldly life, our Lord, that they may lead [men] astray from Your way. Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts so that they will not believe until they see the painful punishment."
verses.tr: waqāla mūsā rabbanā ʾinnaka ātayta firʿawna wamalaʾahu zīnahan wa-amwālan fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā rabbanā liyuḍillūā ʿan sabīlika ۖ rabbanā āṭmis ʿalā ʾamwālihim wāshdud ʿalā qulūbihim falā yuʾminūā ḥattā yarawā al-ʿadhāba al-ʾalīma
verses.abdelhaleem: And Moses said, ‘Our Lord, You have given Pharaoh and his chiefs splendour and wealth in this present life and here they are, Lord, leading others astray from Your path. Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts so that they do not believe until they see the agonizing torment.’
verses.pickthall: And Moses said: Our Lord! Lo! Thou hast given Pharaoh and his chiefs splendour and riches in the life of the world, Our Lord! that they may lead men astray from Thy way. Our Lord! Destroy their riches and harden their hearts so that they believe not till they see the painful doom.

verses.ar: قَالَ قَدْ أُجِيبَت دَّعْوَتُكُمَا فَٱسْتَقِيمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعَآنِّ سَبِيلَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Your supplication has been answered." So remain on a right course and follow not the way of those who do not know."
verses.tr: qāla qad ʾujībat ddaʿwatukumā fāstaqīmā walā tattabiʿānni sabīla adh-dhīna lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Your prayers are answered, so stay on the right course, and do not follow the path of those who do not know.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Your prayer is heard. Do ye twain keep to the straight path, and follow not the road of those who have no knowledge.

verses.ar: ۞ وَجَـٰوَزْنَا بِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ بَغْيًا وَعَدْوًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَدْرَكَهُ ٱلْغَرَقُ قَالَ ءَامَنتُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَتْ بِهِۦ بَنُوٓا۟ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea, and Pharaoh and his soldiers pursued them in tyranny and enmity until, when drowning overtook him, he said, "I believe that there is no deity except that in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims."
verses.tr: ۞ wajāwaznā bibanā ʾisrāʾīla al-baḥra fa-atbaʿahum firʿawnu wajunūduhu baghyan waʿadwan ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā ʾadrakahu al-gharaqu qāla āmantu ʾannahu lā ʾilāha ʾillā adh-dhā āmanat bihi banūā ʾisrāʾīla wa-anā mina al-muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We took the Children of Israel across the sea. Pharaoh and his troops pursued them in arrogance and aggression. But as he was drowning he cried, ‘I believe there is no God except the one the Children of Israel believe in. I submit to Him.’
verses.pickthall: And We brought the Children of Israel across the sea, and Pharaoh with his hosts pursued them in rebellion and transgression, till, when the (fate of) drowning overtook him, he exclaimed: I believe that there is no Allah save Him in Whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of those who surrender (unto Him).

verses.ar: ءَآلْـَٔـٰنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters?
verses.tr: ālna waqad ʿaṣayta qablu wakunta mina al-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Now? When you had always been a rebel, and a troublemaker!
verses.pickthall: What! Now! When hitherto thou hast rebelled and been of the wrong-doers?

verses.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ ءَايَةً ۚ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا لَغَـٰفِلُونَ
verses.en: So today We will save you in body that you may be to those who succeed you a sign. And indeed, many among the people, of Our signs, are heedless.
verses.tr: fa-l-yawma nunajjīka bibadanika litakūna liman khalfaka āyahan ۚ wa-inna kathīran mmina an-nāsi ʿan āyātinā laghāfilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Today We shall save only your corpse as a sign to all posterity. A great many people fail to heed Our signs.’
verses.pickthall: But this day We save thee in thy body that thou mayst be a portent for those after thee. Lo! most of mankind are heedless of Our portents.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ بَوَّأْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: And We had certainly settled the Children of Israel in an agreeable settlement and provided them with good things. And they did not differ until [after] knowledge had come to them. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
verses.tr: walaqad bawwaʾnā banā ʾisrāʾīla mubawwaʾa ṣidqin warazaqnāhum mmina aṭ-ṭayyibāti famā ākhtalafūā ḥattā jāʾahumu al-ʿilmu ۚ ʾinna rabbaka yaqḍā baynahum yawma al-qiyāmahi fīmā kānūā fīhi yakhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We settled the Children of Israel in a good place and provided good things as sustenance for them. It was only after knowledge had come to them that they began to differ among themselves. Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding their differences.
verses.pickthall: And We verily did allot unto the Children of Israel a fixed abode, and did provide them with good things; and they differed not until the knowledge came unto them. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.

verses.ar: فَإِن كُنتَ فِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ لَقَدْ جَآءَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
verses.en: So if you are in doubt, [O Muḥammad], about that which We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord, so never be among the doubters.
verses.tr: fa-in kunta fā shakkin mmimmā ʾanzalnā ʾilayka fasli adh-dhīna yaqraʾūna al-kitāba min qablika ۚ laqad jāʾaka al-ḥaqqu min rrabbika falā takūnanna mina al-mumtarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So if you [Prophet] are in doubt about what We have revealed to you, ask those who have been reading the scriptures before you. The Truth has come to you from your Lord, so be in no doubt
verses.pickthall: And if thou (Muhammad) art in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto thee, then question those who read the Scripture (that was) before thee. Verily the Truth from thy Lord hath come unto thee. So be not thou of the waverers.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: And never be of those who deny the signs of Allāh and [thus] be among the losers.
verses.tr: walā takūnanna mina adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyāti Allāh fatakūna mina al-khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and do not deny God’s signs– then you would become one of the losers.
verses.pickthall: And be not thou of those who deny the revelations of Allah, for then wert thou of the losers.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those upon whom the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord has come into effect will not believe,
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna ḥaqqat ʿalayhim kalimatu rabbika lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those against whom your Lord’s sentence is passed will not believe,
verses.pickthall: Lo! those for whom the word of thy Lord (concerning sinners) hath effect will not believe,

verses.ar: وَلَوْ جَآءَتْهُمْ كُلُّ ءَايَةٍ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.en: Even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment.
verses.tr: walaw jāʾathum kullu āyahin ḥattā yarawā al-ʿadhāba al-ʾalīma
verses.abdelhaleem: even if every sign comes to them, until they see the agonizing torment.
verses.pickthall: Though every token come unto them, till they see the painful doom.

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time.
verses.tr: falawlā kānat qaryahun āmanat fanafaʿahā ʾīmānuhā ʾillā qawma yūnusa lammā āmanūā kashafnā ʿanhum ʿadhāba al-khizāi fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā wamattaʿnāhum ʾilā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: If only a single town had believed and benefited from its belief! Only Jonah’s people did so, and when they believed, We relieved them of the punishment of disgrace in the life of this world, and let them enjoy life for a time.
verses.pickthall: If only there had been a community (of all those that were destroyed of old) that believed and profited by its belief as did the folk of Jonah! When they believed We drew off from them the torment of disgrace in the life of the world and gave them comfort for a while.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَـَٔامَنَ مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تُكْرِهُ ٱلنَّاسَ حَتَّىٰ يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And had your Lord willed, those on earth would have believed - all of them entirely. Then, [O Muḥammad], would you compel the people in order that they become believers?
verses.tr: walaw shāʾa rabbuka lāmana man fā al-ʾarḍi kulluhum jamīʿan ۚ ʾafaʾanta tukrihu an-nāsa ḥattā yakūnūā muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Had your Lord willed, all the people on earth would have believed. So can you [Prophet] compel people to believe?
verses.pickthall: And if thy Lord willed, all who are in the earth would have believed together. Wouldst thou (Muhammad) compel men until they are believers?

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَن تُؤْمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَيَجْعَلُ ٱلرِّجْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And it is not for a soul [i.e., anyone] to believe except by permission of Allāh, and He will place defilement upon those who will not use reason.
verses.tr: wamā kāna linafsin ʾan tuʾmina ʾillā biʾidhni Allāh ۚ wayajʿalu ar-rijsa ʿalā adh-dhīna lā yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No soul can believe except by God’s will, and He brings disgrace on those who do not use their reason.
verses.pickthall: It is not for any soul to believe save by the permission of Allah. He hath set uncleanness upon those who have no sense.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱنظُرُوا۟ مَاذَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَا تُغْنِى ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتُ وَٱلنُّذُرُ عَن قَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Observe what is in the heavens and the earth." But of no avail will be signs or warners to a people who do not believe.
verses.tr: quli ānẓurūā mādhā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ wamā tughnā al-āyātu wa-an-nudhuru ʿan qawmin llā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Look at what is in the heavens and on the earth.’ But what use are signs and warnings to people who will not believe?
verses.pickthall: Say: Behold what is in the heavens and the earth! But revelations and warnings avail not folk who will not believe.

verses.ar: فَهَلْ يَنتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ فَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُنتَظِرِينَ
verses.en: So do they wait except for like [what occurred in] the days of those who passed on before them? Say, "Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."
verses.tr: fahal yantaẓirūna ʾillā mithla ʾayyāmi adh-dhīna khalawā min qablihim ۚ qul fāntaẓirūā ʾinnā maʿakum mmina al-muntaẓirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: What are they waiting for but the punishment that came to those before them? Say, ‘Wait then, I am waiting too.’
verses.pickthall: What expect they save the like of the days of those who passed away before them? Say: Expect then! I am with you among the expectant.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نُنجِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Then We will save Our messengers and those who have believed. Thus, it is an obligation upon Us that We save the believers.
verses.tr: thumma nunajjā rusulanā wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā ۚ kadhālika ḥaqqan ʿalaynā nunji al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: In the end We shall save Our messengers and the believers. We take it upon Ourself to save the believers.
verses.pickthall: Then shall We save Our messengers and the believers, in like manner (as of old). It is incumbent upon Us to save believers.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن دِينِى فَلَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَـٰكِنْ أَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "O people, if you are in doubt as to my religion - then I do not worship those which you worship besides Allāh; but I worship Allāh, who causes your death. And I have been commanded to be of the believers
verses.tr: qul yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu ʾin kuntum fā shakkin mmin dīnā falā ʾaʿbudu adh-dhīna taʿbudūna min dūni Allāh walākin ʾaʿbudu Allāh adh-dhā yatawaffākum ۖ wa-umirtu ʾan ʾakūna mina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet] say, ‘People, even if you are in doubt about my religion, I do not worship those you worship other than God, but I worship God who will cause you to die, and I am commanded to be a believer.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): O mankind! If ye are in doubt of my religion, then (know that) I worship not those whom ye worship instead of Allah, but I worship Allah Who causeth you to die, and I have been commanded to be of the believers.

verses.ar: وَأَنْ أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: And [commanded], 'Direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with Allāh;
verses.tr: wa-an ʾaqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan walā takūnanna mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], set your face towards religion as a man of pure faith. Do not be one of those who join partners with God;
verses.pickthall: And, (O Muhammad) set thy purpose resolutely for religion, as a man by nature upright, and be not of those who ascribe partners (to Allah).

verses.ar: وَلَا تَدْعُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ ۖ فَإِن فَعَلْتَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذًا مِّنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And do not invoke besides Allāh that which neither benefits you nor harms you, for if you did, then indeed you would be of the wrongdoers.'"
verses.tr: walā tadʿu min dūni Allāh mā lā yanfaʿuka walā yaḍurruka ۖ fa-in faʿalta fa-innaka ʾidhan mmina aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: do not pray to any other [god] that can neither benefit nor harm you: if you do, you will be one of the evildoers.
verses.pickthall: And cry not, beside Allah, unto that which cannot profit thee nor hurt thee, for if thou didst so then wert thou of the wrong-doers.

verses.ar: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَآدَّ لِفَضْلِهِۦ ۚ يُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And if Allāh should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him; and if He intends for you good, then there is no repeller of His bounty. He causes it to reach whom He wills of His servants. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-in yamsaska Allāh biḍurrin falā kāshifa lahu ʾillā huwa ۖ wa-in yuridka bikhayrin falā rādda lifaḍlihi ۚ yuṣību bihi man yashāʾu min ʿibādihi ۚ wahuwa al-ghafūru ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: If God inflicts harm on you, no one can remove it but Him, and if He intends good for you, no one can turn His bounty away; He grants His bounty to any of His servants He will. He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
verses.pickthall: If Allah afflicteth thee with some hurt, there is none who can remove it save Him; and if He desireth good for thee, there is none who can repel His bounty. He striketh with it whom He will of his bondmen. He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍ
verses.en: Say, "O mankind, the truth has come to you from your Lord, so whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray [in violation] against it. And I am not over you a manager."
verses.tr: qul yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu qad jāʾakumu al-ḥaqqu min rrabbikum ۖ famani āhtadā fa-innamā yahtadā linafsihi ۖ waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā ۖ wamā ʾanā ʿalaykum biwakīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘People, the Truth has come to you from your Lord. Whoever follows the right path follows it for his own good, and whoever strays does so to his own loss: I am not your guardian.’
verses.pickthall: Say: O mankind! Now hath the Truth from your Lord come unto you. So whosoever is guided, is guided only for (the good of) his soul, and whosoever erreth erreth only against it. And I am not a warder over you.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَٱصْبِرْ حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verses.en: And follow what is revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and be patient until Allāh will judge. And He is the best of judges.
verses.tr: wāttabiʿ mā yūḥā ʾilayka wāṣbir ḥattā yaḥkuma Allāh ۚ wahuwa khayru al-ḥākimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], follow what is being revealed to you, and be steadfast until God gives His judgement, for He is the Best of Judges.
verses.pickthall: And (O Muhammad) follow that which is inspired in thee, and forbear until Allah give judgment. And He is the Best of Judges.

verses.ar: الٓر ۚ كِتَـٰبٌ أُحْكِمَتْ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Rā. [This is] a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Aware
verses.tr: al-r ۚ kitābun ʾuḥkimat āyātuhu thumma fuṣṣilat min lladun ḥakīmin khabīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Ra [This is] a Scripture whose verses are perfected, then set out clearly, from One who is all wise, all aware.
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Ra. (This is) a Scripture the revelations whereof are perfected and then expounded. (It cometh) from One Wise, Informed,

verses.ar: أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّنِى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ
verses.en: [Through a messenger, saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings,"
verses.tr: ʾallā taʿbudūā ʾillā Allāh ۚ ʾinnanā lakum mminhu nadhīrun wabashīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Say, Prophet], ‘Worship no one but God. I am sent to you from Him to warn and to give good news.
verses.pickthall: (Saying): Serve none but Allah. Lo! I am unto you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings.

verses.ar: وَأَنِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُم مَّتَـٰعًا حَسَنًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِى فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ كَبِيرٍ
verses.en: And [saying], "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor [i.e., reward]. But if you turn away, then indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great Day.
verses.tr: wa-ani āstaghfirūā rabbakum thumma tūbūā ʾilayhi yumattiʿkum mmatāʿan ḥasanan ʾilā ʾajalin mmusammanā wayuʾti kulla dhā faḍlin faḍlahu ۖ wa-in tawallawā fa-innā ʾakhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin kabīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: Ask your Lord for forgiveness, then turn back to Him. He will grant you wholesome enjoyment until an appointed time, and give His grace to everyone who has merit. But if you turn away, I fear you will have torment on a terrible Day:
verses.pickthall: And (bidding you): Ask pardon of your Lord and turn to Him repentant. He will cause you to enjoy a fair estate until a time appointed. He giveth His bounty unto every bountiful one. But if ye turn away, lo! (then) I fear for you the retribution of an awful Day.

verses.ar: إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: To Allāh is your return, and He is over all things competent."
verses.tr: ʾilā Allāh marjiʿukum ۖ wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: it is to God that you will all return, and He has power over everything.’
verses.pickthall: Unto Allah is your return, and He is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُوا۟ مِنْهُ ۚ أَلَا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: Unquestionably, they [i.e., the disbelievers] turn away their breasts to hide themselves from him. Unquestionably, [even] when they cover themselves in their clothing, He [i.e., Allāh] knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.tr: ʾalā ʾinnahum yathnūna ṣudūrahum liyastakhfūā minhu ۚ ʾalā ḥīna yastaghshūna thiyābahum yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿlinūna ۚ ʾinnahu ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: See how they [the disbelievers] wrap themselves up, to hide their feelings from Him. But even when they cover themselves with their clothes, He knows what they conceal and what they reveal: He knows well the innermost secrets of the heart.
verses.pickthall: Lo! now they fold up their breasts that they may hide (their thoughts) from Him. At the very moment when they cover themselves with their clothing, Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men).

verses.ar: ۞ وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ كُلٌّ فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allāh is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.
verses.tr: ۞ wamā min dābbahin fā al-ʾarḍi ʾillā ʿalā Allāh rizquhā wayaʿlamu mustaqarrahā wamustawdaʿahā ۚ kullun fā kitābin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: There is not a creature that moves on earth whose provision is not His concern. He knows where it lives and its [final] resting place: it is all [there] in a clear record.
verses.pickthall: And there is not a beast in the earth but the sustenance thereof dependeth on Allah. He knoweth its habitation and its repository. All is in a clear Record.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْمَآءِ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۗ وَلَئِن قُلْتَ إِنَّكُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْمَوْتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and His Throne had been upon water - that He might test you as to which of you is best in deed. But if you say, "Indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "This is not but obvious magic."
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa fā sittahi ʾayyāmin wakāna ʿarshuhu ʿalā al-māʾi liyabluwakum ʾayyukum ʾaḥsanu ʿamalan ۗ walaʾin qulta ʾinnakum mmabʿūthūna min baʿdi al-mawti layaqūlanna adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾin hādhā ʾillā siḥrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six Days––His rule extends over the waters too––so as to test which of you does best. Yet [Prophet], if you say to them, ‘You will be resurrected after death,’ the disbelievers are sure to answer, ‘This is clearly nothing but sorcery.’
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days - and His Throne was upon the water - that He might try you, which of you is best in conduct. Yet if thou (O Muhammad) sayest: Lo! ye will be raised again after death! those who disbelieve will surely say: This is naught but mere magic.

verses.ar: وَلَئِنْ أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ مَّعْدُودَةٍ لَّيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحْبِسُهُۥٓ ۗ أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: And if We hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say, "What detains it?" Unquestionably, on the Day it comes to them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.tr: walaʾin ʾakharnā ʿanhumu al-ʿadhāba ʾilā ʾummahin mmaʿdūdahin llayaqūlunna mā yaḥbisuhu ۗ ʾalā yawma yaʾtīhim laysa maṣrūfan ʿanhum waḥāqa bihim mmā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If We defer their punishment for a determined time, they are sure to say, ‘What is holding it back?’ But on the Day it comes upon them, nothing will divert it from them; what they mocked will be all around them.
verses.pickthall: And if We delay for them the doom until a reckoned time, they will surely say: What withholdeth it? Verily on the day when it cometh unto them, it cannot be averted from them, and that which they derided will surround them.

verses.ar: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَـٰهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَـُٔوسٌ كَفُورٌ
verses.en: And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful.
verses.tr: walaʾin ʾadhaqnā al-ʾinsāna minnā raḥmahan thumma nazaʿnāhā minhu ʾinnahu layawsun kafūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: How desperate and ungrateful man becomes when We let him taste Our mercy and then withhold it!
verses.pickthall: And if we cause man to taste some mercy from Us and afterward withdraw it from him, lo! he is despairing, thankless.

verses.ar: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَـٰهُ نَعْمَآءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتُ عَنِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ
verses.en: But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful -
verses.tr: walaʾin ʾadhaqnāhu naʿmāʾa baʿda ḍarrāʾa massathu layaqūlanna dhahaba as-sayyātu ʿannā ۚ ʾinnahu lafariḥun fakhūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: And if We let him taste mercy after some harm has touched him, he is sure to say, ‘Misfortune has gone away from me.’ He becomes exultant and boastful.
verses.pickthall: And if We cause him to taste grace after some misfortune that had befallen him, he saith: The ills have gone from me. Lo! he is exultant, boastful;

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.en: Except for those who are patient and do righteous deeds; those will have forgiveness and great reward.
verses.tr: ʾillā adh-dhīna ṣabarūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ʾūlāʾika lahum mmaghfirahun wa-ajrun kabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Not so those who are steadfast and do good deeds: they will have forgiveness and a great reward.
verses.pickthall: Save those who persevere and do good works. Theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.

verses.ar: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَضَآئِقٌۢ بِهِۦ صَدْرُكَ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُۥ مَلَكٌ ۚ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ نَذِيرٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
verses.en: Then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?" But you are only a warner. And Allāh is Disposer of all things.
verses.tr: falaʿallaka tārikun baʿḍa mā yūḥā ʾilayka waḍāʾiqun bihi ṣadruka ʾan yaqūlūā lawlā ʾunzila ʿalayhi kanzun ʾaw jāʾa maʿahu malakun ۚ ʾinnamā ʾanta nadhīrun ۚ wallāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin wakīlun
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] are you going to abandon some part of what is revealed to you, and let your heart be oppressed by it, because they say, ‘Why is no treasure sent down to him? Why has no angel come with him?’? You are only there to warn; it is God who is in charge of everything.
verses.pickthall: A likely thing, that thou wouldst forsake aught of that which hath been revealed unto thee, and that thy breast should be straitened for it, because they say: Why hath not a treasure been sent down for him, or an angel come with him? Thou art but a warner, and Allah is in charge of all things.

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِّثْلِهِۦ مُفْتَرَيَـٰتٍ وَٱدْعُوا۟ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Say, "Then bring ten sūrahs like it that have been invented and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allāh, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: ʾam yaqūlūna āftarāhu ۖ qul fa-tūā biʿashri suwarin mmithlihi muftarayātin wādʿūā mani āstaṭaʿtum mmin dūni Allāh ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they say, ‘He has invented it himself,’ say, ‘Then produce ten invented suras like it, and call in whoever you can beside God, if you are truthful.’
verses.pickthall: Or they say: He hath invented it. Say: Then bring ten surahs, the like thereof, invented, and call on everyone ye can beside Allah, if ye are truthful!

verses.ar: فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ بِعِلْمِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And if they do not respond to you - then know that it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was revealed with the knowledge of Allāh and that there is no deity except Him. Then, would you [not] be Muslims?
verses.tr: fa-ʾillam yastajībūā lakum fāʿlamūā ʾannamā ʾunzila biʿilmi Allāh wa-an llā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۖ fahal ʾantum mmuslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they do not answer you, then you will all know that it is sent down containing knowledge from God, and that there is no god but Him. Then will you submit to Him?
verses.pickthall: And if they answer not your prayer, then know that it is revealed only in the knowledge of Allah; and that there is no Allah save Him. Will ye then be (of) those who surrender?

verses.ar: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فِيهَا وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يُبْخَسُونَ
verses.en: Whoever desires the life of this world and its adornments - We fully repay them for their deeds therein, and they therein will not be deprived.
verses.tr: man kāna yurīdu al-ḥayawāha ad-dunyā wazīnatahā nuwaffi ʾilayhim ʾaʿmālahum fīhā wahum fīhā lā yubkhasūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If any desire [only] the life of this world with all its finery, We shall repay them in full in this life for their deeds- they will be given no less-
verses.pickthall: Whoso desireth the life of the world and its pomp, We shall repay them their deeds herein, and therein they will not be wronged.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِلَّا ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوا۟ فِيهَا وَبَـٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Those are the ones for whom there is not in the Hereafter but the Fire. And lost is what they did therein, and worthless is what they used to do.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna laysa lahum fā al-ākhirahi ʾillā an-nāru ۖ waḥabiṭa mā ṣanaʿūā fīhā wabāṭilun mmā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but such people will have nothing in the Hereafter but the Fire: their work here will be fruitless and their deeds futile.
verses.pickthall: Those are they for whom is naught in the Hereafter save the Fire. (All) that they contrive here is vain and (all) that they are wont to do is fruitless.

verses.ar: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْهُ وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ فَٱلنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُۥ ۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: So is one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his Lord [like the aforementioned]? And a witness from Him follows it, and before it was the Scripture of Moses to lead and as mercy. Those [believers in the former revelations] believe in it [i.e., the Qur’ān]. But whoever disbelieves in it from the [various] factions - the Fire is his promised destination. So be not in doubt about it. Indeed, it is the truth from your Lord, but most of the people do not believe.
verses.tr: ʾafaman kāna ʿalā bayyinahin mmin rrabbihi wayatlūhu shāhidun mminhu wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā ʾimāman waraḥmahan ۚ ʾūlāʾika yuʾminūna bihi ۚ waman yakfur bihi mina al-ʾaḥzābi fa-an-nāru mawʿiduhu ۚ falā taku fā miryahin mminhu ۚ ʾinnahu al-ḥaqqu min rrabbika walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Can they be compared to those who have clear proof from their Lord, recited by a witness from Him, and before it the Book of Moses, as a guide and mercy? These people believe in it, whereas those groups that deny its truth are promised the Fire. So have no doubt about it [Prophet]: it is the Truth from your Lord, though most people do not believe so.
verses.pickthall: Is he (to be counted equal with them) who relieth on a clear proof from his Lord, and a witness from Him reciteth it, and before it was the Book of Moses, an example and a mercy? Such believe therein, and whoso disbelieveth therein of the clans, the Fire is his appointed place. So be not thou in doubt concerning it. Lo! it is the Truth from thy Lord; but most of mankind believe not.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْأَشْهَـٰدُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allāh? Those will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied against their Lord." Unquestionably, the curse of Allāh is upon the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: waman ʾaẓlamu mimmani āftarā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban ۚ ʾūlāʾika yuʿraḍūna ʿalā rabbihim wayaqūlu al-ʾashhādu hāʾulāʾi adh-dhīna kadhabūā ʿalā rabbihim ۚ ʾalā laʿnahu Allāh ʿalā aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who could do more wrong than someone who invents lies about God? Such people will be brought before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, ‘These are the ones that lied about their Lord.’ God’s rejection is the due of those who do such wrong,
verses.pickthall: Who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah? Such will be brought before their Lord, and the witnesses will say: These are they who lied concerning their Lord. Now the curse of Allah is upon wrong-doers,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: Who averted [people] from the way of Allāh and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they, concerning the Hereafter, were disbelievers.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli Allāh wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bi-l-ākhirahi hum kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who hinder others from God’s path, trying to make it crooked, and deny the life to come.
verses.pickthall: Who debar (men) from the way of Allah and would have it crooked, and who are disbelievers in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ مُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۘ يُضَـٰعَفُ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۚ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: Those were not causing failure [to Allāh] on earth, nor did they have besides Allāh any protectors. For them the punishment will be multiplied. They were not able to hear, nor did they see.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika lam yakūnūā muʿjizīna fā al-ʾarḍi wamā kāna lahum mmin dūni Allāh min ʾawliyāʾa ۘ yuḍāʿafu lahumu al-ʿadhābu ۚ mā kānūā yastaṭīʿūna as-samʿa wamā kānūā yubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will not escape on earth, and there will be no one other than God to protect them. Their punishment will be doubled. They could not hear, and they did not see.
verses.pickthall: Such will not escape in the earth, nor have they any protecting friends beside Allah. For them the torment will be double. They could not bear to hear, and they used not to see.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna khasirūā ʾanfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mmā kānūā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is they who will have lost their souls, and what they invented will have deserted them.
verses.pickthall: Such are they who have lost their souls, and that which they used to invent hath failed them.

verses.ar: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
verses.en: Assuredly, it is they in the Hereafter who will be the greatest losers.
verses.tr: lā jarama ʾannahum fā al-ākhirahi humu al-ʾakhsarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There is no doubt they will be the ones to lose most in the life to come.
verses.pickthall: Assuredly in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَأَخْبَتُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds and humbled themselves to their Lord - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide eternally therein.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti wa-akhbatūā ʾilā rabbihim ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu al-jannahi ۖ hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who believed, did good deeds, and humbled themselves before their Lord will be companions in Paradise and there they will stay.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works and humble themselves before their Lord: such are rightful owners of the Garden; they will abide therein.

verses.ar: ۞ مَثَلُ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْأَصَمِّ وَٱلْبَصِيرِ وَٱلسَّمِيعِ ۚ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: The example of the two parties is like the blind and deaf, and the seeing and hearing. Are they equal in comparison? Then, will you not remember?
verses.tr: ۞ mathalu al-farīqayni ka-l-ʾaʿmā wa-l-ʾaṣammi wa-l-baṣīri wa-as-samīʿi ۚ hal yastawiyāni mathalan ۚ ʾafalā tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: These two groups are like the blind and the deaf as compared with those who can see and hear well: can they be alike? How can you not take heed?
verses.pickthall: The similitude of the two parties is as the blind and the deaf and the seer and the hearer. Are they equal in similitude? Will ye not then be admonished?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā nūḥan ʾilā qawmihi ʾinnā lakum nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Noah to his people to say, ‘I have come to you to give a clear warning:
verses.pickthall: And We sent Noah unto his folk (and he said): Lo! I am a plain warner unto you.

verses.ar: أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: That you not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful day."
verses.tr: ʾan llā taʿbudūā ʾillā Allāh ۖ ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: worship no one but God. I fear you will have torment on a painful Day.’
verses.pickthall: That ye serve none, save Allah. Lo! I fear for you the retribution of a painful Day.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا نَرَىٰكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًا مِّثْلَنَا وَمَا نَرَىٰكَ ٱتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِىَ ٱلرَّأْىِ وَمَا نَرَىٰ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍۭ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: So the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "We do not see you but as a man like ourselves, and we do not see you followed except by those who are the lowest of us [and] at first suggestion. And we do not see in you over us any merit; rather, we think you are liars."
verses.tr: faqāla al-malaʾu adh-dhīna kafarūā min qawmihi mā narāka ʾillā basharan mmithlanā wamā narāka āttabaʿaka ʾillā adh-dhīna hum ʾarādhilunā bādāa ar-raāi wamā narā lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin bal naẓunnukum kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But the prominent disbelievers among his people said, ‘We can see that you are nothing but a mortal like ourselves, and it is clear to see that only the vilest among us follow you. We cannot see how you are any better than we are. In fact, we think you are a liar.’
verses.pickthall: The chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: We see thee but a mortal like us, and we see not that any follow thee save the most abject among us, without reflection. We behold in you no merit above us - nay, we deem you liars.
