verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَءَاتَىٰنِى رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِهِۦ فَعُمِّيَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا وَأَنتُمْ لَهَا كَـٰرِهُونَ
verses.en: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it?
verses.tr: qāla yāqawmi ʾaraʾaytum ʾin kuntu ʿalā bayyinahin mmin rrabbā watānā raḥmahan mmin ʿindihi faʿummiyat ʿalaykum ʾanulzimukumūhā wa-antum lahā kārihūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My people, think: if I did have a clear sign from my Lord, and He had given me grace of His own, though it was hidden from you, could we force you to accept it against your will?
verses.pickthall: He said: O my people! Bethink you, if I rely on a clear proof from my Lord and there hath come unto me a mercy from His presence, and it hath been made obscure to you, can we compel you to accept it when ye are averse thereto?

verses.ar: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ لَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَالًا ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَـٰكِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ
verses.en: And O my people, I ask not of you for it any wealth. My reward is not but from Allāh. And I am not one to drive away those who have believed. Indeed, they will meet their Lord, but I see that you are a people behaving ignorantly.
verses.tr: wayāqawmi lā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi mālan ۖ ʾin ʾajrāa ʾillā ʿalā Allāh ۚ wamā ʾanā biṭāridi adh-dhīna āmanūā ۚ ʾinnahum mmulāqūā rabbihim walākinnā ʾarākum qawman tajhalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, I ask no reward for it from you; my reward comes only from God. I will not drive away the faithful: they are sure to meet their Lord. I can see you are foolish.
verses.pickthall: And O my people! I ask of you no wealth therefor. My reward is the concern only of Allah, and I am not going to thrust away those who believe - Lo! they have to meet their Lord! - but I see you a folk that are ignorant.

verses.ar: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ مَن يَنصُرُنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِن طَرَدتُّهُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And O my people, who would protect me from Allāh if I drove them away? Then will you not be reminded?
verses.tr: wayāqawmi man yanṣurunā mina Allāh ʾin ṭaradttuhum ۚ ʾafalā tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, who could help me against God if I drove the faithful away? Will you not take heed?
verses.pickthall: And, O my people! who would deliver me from Allah if I thrust them away? Will ye not then reflect?

verses.ar: وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ إِنِّى مَلَكٌ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِىٓ أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَن يُؤْتِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرًا ۖ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allāh or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel, nor do I say of those upon whom your eyes look down that Allāh will never grant them any good. Allāh is most knowing of what is within their souls. Indeed, I would then be among the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust]."
verses.tr: walā ʾaqūlu lakum ʿindā khazāʾinu Allāh walā ʾaʿlamu al-ghayba walā ʾaqūlu ʾinnā malakun walā ʾaqūlu lilladhīna tazdarā ʾaʿyunukum lan yuʾtiyahumu Allāh khayran ۖ Allāh ʾaʿlamu bimā fā ʾanfusihim ۖ ʾinnā ʾidhan llamina aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I am not telling you that I hold God’s treasures, or have any knowledge of what is hidden, or that I am an angel. Nor do I say that God will not grant any good to those who are despised in your eyes: God Himself knows best what is in their souls. If I did this I would be one of the wrongdoers.’
verses.pickthall: I say not unto you: "I have the treasures of Allah" nor "I have knowledge of the Unseen," nor say I: "Lo! I am an angel!" Nor say I unto those whom your eyes scorn that Allah will not give them good - Allah knoweth best what is in their hearts - Lo! then indeed I should be of the wrong-doers.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰنُوحُ قَدْ جَـٰدَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَٰلَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: They said, "O Noah, you have disputed [i.e., opposed] us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.tr: qālūā yānūḥu qad jādaltanā fa-aktharta jidālanā fa-tinā bimā taʿidunā ʾin kunta mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Noah! You have argued with us for too long. Bring down on us the punishment you threaten us with, if you are telling the truth.’
verses.pickthall: They said: O Noah! Thou hast disputed with us and multiplied disputation with us; now bring upon us that wherewith thou threatenest us, if thou art of the truthful.

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ إِن شَآءَ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verses.en: He said, "Allāh will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure.
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnamā yaʾtīkum bihi Allāh ʾin shāʾa wamā ʾantum bimuʿjizīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘It is God who will bring it down, if He wishes, and you will not be able to escape.
verses.pickthall: He said: Only Allah will bring it upon you if He will, and ye can by no means escape.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَنفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِىٓ إِنْ أَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَنصَحَ لَكُمْ إِن كَانَ ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَن يُغْوِيَكُمْ ۚ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: And my advice will not benefit you - although I wished to advise you - if Allāh should intend to put you in error. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned."
verses.tr: walā yanfaʿukum nuṣḥā ʾin ʾaradttu ʾan ʾanṣaḥa lakum ʾin kāna Allāh yurīdu ʾan yughwiyakum ۚ huwa rabbukum wa-ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: My advice will be no use to you if God wishes to leave you to your delusions: He is your Lord and to Him you will be returned.’
verses.pickthall: My counsel will not profit you if I were minded to advise you, if Allah's will is to keep you astray. He is your Lord and unto Him ye will be brought back.

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَعَلَىَّ إِجْرَامِى وَأَنَا۠ بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: Or do they say [about Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit."
verses.tr: ʾam yaqūlūna āftarāhu ۖ qul ʾini āftaraytuhu faʿalāa ʾijrāmā wa-anā barāʾun mmimmā tujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If [these disbelievers] say, ‘He has made this up,’ say [Muhammad], ‘If I have made this up, I am responsible for my own crime, but I am innocent of the crimes you commit.’
verses.pickthall: Or say they (again): He hath invented it? Say: If I have invented it, upon me be my crimes, but I am innocent of (all) that ye commit.

verses.ar: وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ أَنَّهُۥ لَن يُؤْمِنَ مِن قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَن قَدْ ءَامَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: And it was revealed to Noah that, "No one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing.
verses.tr: wa-ūḥāa ʾilā nūḥin ʾannahu lan yuʾmina min qawmika ʾillā man qad āmana falā tabtaʾis bimā kānūā yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It was revealed to Noah, ‘None of your people will believe, other than those who have already done so, so do not be distressed by, what they do.
verses.pickthall: And it was inspired in Noah, (saying): No-one of thy folk will believe save him who hath believed already. Be not distressed because of what they do.

verses.ar: وَٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَـٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.en: And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned."
verses.tr: wāṣnaʿi al-fulka biʾaʿyuninā wawaḥyinā walā tukhāṭibnā fā adh-dhīna ẓalamūā ۚ ʾinnahum mmughraqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Build the Ark under Our [watchful] eyes and with Our inspiration. Do not plead with Me for those who have done evil- they will be drowned.’
verses.pickthall: Build the ship under Our eyes and by Our inspiration, and speak not unto Me on behalf of those who do wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.

verses.ar: وَيَصْنَعُ ٱلْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُ ۚ قَالَ إِن تَسْخَرُوا۟ مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ
verses.en: And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule.
verses.tr: wayaṣnaʿu al-fulka wakullamā marra ʿalayhi malaʾun mmin qawmihi sakhirūā minhu ۚ qāla ʾin taskharūā minnā fa-innā naskharu minkum kamā taskharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So he began to build the Ark, and whenever leaders of his people passed by, they laughed at him. He said, ‘You may scorn us now, but we will come to scorn you:
verses.pickthall: And he was building the ship, and every time that chieftains of his people passed him, they made mock of him. He said: Though ye make mock of Us, yet We mock at you even as ye mock;

verses.ar: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
verses.en: And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]."
verses.tr: fasawfa taʿlamūna man yaʾtīhi ʿadhābun yukhzīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun mmuqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: you will find out who will receive a humiliating punishment, and on whom a lasting suffering will descend.’
verses.pickthall: And ye shall know to whom a punishment that will confound him cometh, and upon whom a lasting doom will fall.

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا ٱحْمِلْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ ءَامَنَ ۚ وَمَآ ءَامَنَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ
verses.en: [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, "Load upon it [i.e., the ship] of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word [i.e., decree] has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few.
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾa ʾamrunā wafāra at-tannūru qulnā āḥmil fīhā min kullin zawjayni āthnayni wa-ahlaka ʾillā man sabaqa ʿalayhi al-qawlu waman āmana ۚ wamā āmana maʿahu ʾillā qalīlun
verses.abdelhaleem: When Our command came, and water gushed up out of the earth, We said, ‘Place on board this Ark a pair of each species, and your own family- except those against whom the sentence has already been passed- and those who have believed,’ though only a few believed with him.
verses.pickthall: (Thus it was) till, when Our commandment came to pass and the oven gushed forth water, We said: Load therein two of every kind, a pair (the male and female), and thy household, save him against whom the word hath gone forth already, and those who believe. And but a few were they who believed with him.

verses.ar: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱرْكَبُوا۟ فِيهَا بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ مَجْر۪ىٰهَا وَمُرْسَىٰهَآ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And [Noah] said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allāh [are] its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.tr: ۞ waqāla ārkabūā fīhā bismi Allāh majrāhā wamursāhā ۚ ʾinna rabbā laghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Board the Ark. In the name of God it shall sail and anchor. My God is most forgiving and merciful.’
verses.pickthall: And he said: Embark therein! In the name of Allah be its course and its mooring. Lo! my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَهِىَ تَجْرِى بِهِمْ فِى مَوْجٍ كَٱلْجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ٱبْنَهُۥ وَكَانَ فِى مَعْزِلٍ يَـٰبُنَىَّ ٱرْكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers."
verses.tr: wahāa tajrā bihim fā mawjin ka-l-jibāli wanādā nūḥun ābnahu wakāna fā maʿzilin yābunāa ārkab mmaʿanā walā takun mmaʿa al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It sailed with them on waves like mountains, and Noah called out to his son, who stayed behind, ‘Come aboard with us, my son, do not stay with the disbelievers.’
verses.pickthall: And it sailed with them amid waves like mountains, and Noah cried unto his son - and he was standing aloof - O my son! Come ride with us, and be not with the disbelievers.

verses.ar: قَالَ سَـَٔاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِى مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ ۚ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ۚ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُغْرَقِينَ
verses.en: [But] he said, "I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [Noah] said, "There is no protector today from the decree of Allāh, except for whom He gives mercy." And the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned.
verses.tr: qāla sāwā ʾilā jabalin yaʿṣimunā mina al-māʾi ۚ qāla lā ʿāṣima al-yawma min ʾamri Allāh ʾillā man rraḥima ۚ waḥāla baynahumā al-mawju fakāna mina al-mughraqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But he replied, ‘I will seek refuge on a mountain to save me from the water.’ Noah said, ‘Today there is no refuge from God’s command, except for those on whom He has mercy.’ The waves cut them off from each other and he was among the drowned.
verses.pickthall: He said: I shall betake me to some mountain that will save me from the water. (Noah) said: This day there is none that saveth from the commandment of Allah save him on whom He hath had mercy. And the wave came in between them, so he was among the drowned.

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."
verses.tr: waqīla yāʾarḍu āblaʿā māʾaki wayāsamāʾu ʾaqliʿā waghīḍa al-māʾu waquḍāa al-ʾamru wāstawat ʿalā al-jūdāi ۖ waqīla buʿdan llilqawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then it was said, ‘Earth, swallow up your water, and sky, hold back,’ and the water subsided, the command was fulfilled. The Ark settled on Mount Judi, and it was said, ‘Gone are those evildoing people!’
verses.pickthall: And it was said: O earth! Swallow thy water and, O sky! be cleared of clouds! And the water was made to subside. And the commandment was fulfilled. And it (the ship) came to rest upon (the mount) Al-Judi and it was said: A far removal for wrongdoing folk!

verses.ar: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verses.en: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!"
verses.tr: wanādā nūḥun rrabbahu faqāla rabbi ʾinna ābnā min ʾahlā wa-inna waʿdaka al-ḥaqqu wa-anta ʾaḥkamu al-ḥākimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Noah called out to his Lord, saying, ‘My Lord, my son was one of my family, though Your promise is true, and You are the most just of all judges.’
verses.pickthall: And Noah cried unto his Lord and said: My Lord! Lo! my son is of my household! Surely Thy promise is the truth and Thou are the Most Just of Judges.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰنُوحُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَـٰلِحٍ ۖ فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَعِظُكَ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
verses.en: He said, "O Noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [one whose] work was other than righteous, so ask Me not for that about which you have no knowledge. Indeed, I advise you, lest you be among the ignorant."
verses.tr: qāla yānūḥu ʾinnahu laysa min ʾahlika ۖ ʾinnahu ʿamalun ghayru ṣāliḥin ۖ falā taslni mā laysa laka bihi ʿilmun ۖ ʾinnā ʾaʿiẓuka ʾan takūna mina al-jāhilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Noah, he was not one of your family. What he did was not right. Do not ask Me for things you know nothing about. I am warning you not to be foolish.’
verses.pickthall: He said: O Noah! Lo! he is not of thy household; lo! he is of evil conduct, so ask not of Me that whereof thou hast no knowledge. I admonish thee lest thou be among the ignorant.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِى وَتَرْحَمْنِىٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: [Noah] said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ʾinnā ʾaʿūdhu bika ʾan ʾaslaka mā laysa lā bihi ʿilmun ۖ wa-ā taghfir lā watarḥamnā ʾakun mmina al-khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My Lord, I take refuge with You from asking for things I know nothing about. If You do not forgive me, and have mercy on me, I shall be one of the losers.’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! in Thee do I seek refuge (from the sin) that I should ask of Thee that whereof I have no knowledge. Unless Thou forgive me and have mercy on me I shall be among the lost.

verses.ar: قِيلَ يَـٰنُوحُ ٱهْبِطْ بِسَلَـٰمٍ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكَـٰتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّمَّن مَّعَكَ ۚ وَأُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: It was said, "O Noah, disembark in security from Us and blessings upon you and upon nations [descending] from those with you. But other nations [of them] We will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from Us a painful punishment."
verses.tr: qīla yānūḥu āhbiṭ bisalāmin mminnā wabarakātin ʿalayka waʿalā ʾumamin mmimman mmaʿaka ۚ wa-umamun sanumattiʿuhum thumma yamassuhum mminnā ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: And it was said, ‘Noah, descend in peace from Us, with blessings on you and on some of the communities that will spring from those who are with you. There will be others We will allow to enjoy life for a time, but then a painful punishment from Us will afflict them.’
verses.pickthall: It was said (unto him): O Noah! Go thou down (from the mountain) with peace from Us and blessings upon thee and some nations (that will spring) from those with thee. (There will be other) nations unto whom We shall give enjoyment a long while and then a painful doom from Us will overtake them.

verses.ar: تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَآ إِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كُنتَ تَعْلَمُهَآ أَنتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِن قَبْلِ هَـٰذَا ۖ فَٱصْبِرْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلْعَـٰقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muḥammad]. You knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. So be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous.
verses.tr: tilka min ʾanbāʾi al-ghaybi nūḥīhā ʾilayka ۖ mā kunta taʿlamuhā ʾanta walā qawmuka min qabli hādhā ۖ fāṣbir ۖ ʾinna al-ʿāqibaha lilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: These accounts are part of what was beyond your knowledge [Muhammad]. We revealed them to you. Neither you nor your people knew them before now, so be patient: the future belongs to those who are aware of God.
verses.pickthall: This is of the tidings of the Unseen which We inspire in thee (Muhammad). Thou thyself knewest it not, nor did thy folk (know it) before this. Then have patience. Lo! the sequel is for those who ward off (evil).

verses.ar: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: And to ʿAad [We sent] their brother Hūd. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors [of falsehood].
verses.tr: wa-ʾilā ʿādin ʾakhāhum hūdan ۚ qāla yāqawmi āʿbudūā Allāh mā lakum mmin ʾilāhin ghayruhu ۖ ʾin ʾantum ʾillā muftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: To the Ad, We sent their brother, Hud. He said, ‘My people, worship God. You have no god other than Him; you are only making up lies.
verses.pickthall: And unto (the tribe of) A'ad (We sent) their brother, Hud. He said: O my people! Serve Allah! Ye have no other Allah save Him. Lo! ye do but invent.

verses.ar: يَـٰقَوْمِ لَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِىٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: O my people, I do not ask you for it [i.e., my advice] any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason?
verses.tr: yāqawmi lā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi ʾajran ۖ ʾin ʾajrāa ʾillā ʿalā adh-dhā faṭaranā ۚ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: I ask no reward from you, my people; my reward comes only from Him who created me. Why do you not use your reason?
verses.pickthall: O my people! I ask of you no reward for it. Lo! my reward is the concern only of Him Who made me. Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. And do not turn away, [being] criminals."
verses.tr: wayāqawmi āstaghfirūā rabbakum thumma tūbūā ʾilayhi yursili as-samāʾa ʿalaykum mmidrāran wayazidkum quwwahan ʾilā quwwatikum walā tatawallawā mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, ask forgiveness from your Lord, and return to Him. He will send down for you rain in abundance from the sky, and give you extra strength. Do not turn away and be lost in your sins.’
verses.pickthall: And, O my people! Ask forgiveness of your Lord, then turn unto Him repentant; He will cause the sky to rain abundance on you and will add unto you strength to your strength. Turn not away, guilty!

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰهُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِىٓ ءَالِهَتِنَا عَن قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: They said, "O Hūd, you have not brought us clear evidence, and we are not ones to leave our gods on your say-so. Nor are we believers in you.
verses.tr: qālūā yāhūdu mā jiʾtanā bibayyinahin wamā naḥnu bitārikā ālihatinā ʿan qawlika wamā naḥnu laka bimuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They replied, ‘Hud, you have not brought us any clear evidence. We will not forsake our gods on the strength of your word alone, nor will we believe in you.
verses.pickthall: They said: O Hud! Thou hast brought us no clear proof and we are not going to forsake our gods on thy (mere) saying, and we are not believers in thee.

verses.ar: إِن نَّقُولُ إِلَّا ٱعْتَرَىٰكَ بَعْضُ ءَالِهَتِنَا بِسُوٓءٍ ۗ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ وَٱشْهَدُوٓا۟ أَنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil [i.e., insanity]." He said, "Indeed, I call Allāh to witness, and witness [yourselves] that I am free from whatever you associate with Allāh
verses.tr: ʾin nnaqūlu ʾillā āʿtarāka baʿḍu ālihatinā bisūʾin ۗ qāla ʾinnā ʾushhidu Allāh wāshhadūā ʾannā barāʾun mmimmā tushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: All we can say is that one of our gods may have inflicted some harm on you.’ He said, ‘I call God to witness, and you too are my witnesses, that I disown those you set up as partners with God.
verses.pickthall: We say naught save that one of our gods hath possessed thee in an evil way. He said: I call Allah to witness, and do ye (too) bear witness, that I am innocent of (all) that ye ascribe as partners (to Allah)

verses.ar: مِن دُونِهِۦ ۖ فَكِيدُونِى جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ
verses.en: Other than Him. So plot against me all together; then do not give me respite.
verses.tr: min dūnihi ۖ fakīdūnā jamīʿan thumma lā tunẓirūni
verses.abdelhaleem: So plot against me, all of you, and give me no respite.
verses.pickthall: Beside Him. So (try to) circumvent me, all of you, give me no respite.

verses.ar: إِنِّى تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم ۚ مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, I have relied upon Allāh, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds it by its forelock [i.e., controls it]. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight.
verses.tr: ʾinnā tawakkaltu ʿalā Allāh rabbā warabbikum ۚ mmā min dābbahin ʾillā huwa ākhidhun bināṣiyatihā ۚ ʾinna rabbā ʿalā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: I put my trust in God, my Lord and your Lord. There is no moving creature which He does not control. My Lord’s way is straight.
verses.pickthall: Lo! I have put my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord. Not an animal but He doth grasp it by the forelock! Lo! my Lord is on a straight path.

verses.ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّى قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُۥ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
verses.en: But if you turn away, then I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian."
verses.tr: fa-in tawallawā faqad ʾablaghtukum mmā ʾursiltu bihi ʾilaykum ۚ wayastakhlifu rabbā qawman ghayrakum walā taḍurrūnahu shayā ۚ ʾinna rabbā ʿalā kulli shāʾin ḥafīẓun
verses.abdelhaleem: But if you turn away, then I have conveyed the message with which I was sent to you, and my Lord will bring along another people in your place. You cannot do Him any harm: it is my Lord who protects everything.’
verses.pickthall: And if ye turn away, still I have conveyed unto you that wherewith I was sent unto you, and my Lord will set in place of you a folk other than you. Ye cannot injure Him at all. Lo! my Lord is Guardian over all things.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
verses.en: And when Our command came, We saved Hūd and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us; and We saved them from a harsh punishment.
verses.tr: walammā jāʾa ʾamrunā najjaynā hūdan wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā maʿahu biraḥmahin mminnā wanajjaynāhum mmin ʿadhābin ghalīẓin
verses.abdelhaleem: And so, when Our judgement came to pass, by Our grace We saved Hud and his fellow believers. We saved them from a severe punishment.
verses.pickthall: And when Our commandment came to pass We saved Hud and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us; We saved them from a harsh doom.

verses.ar: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ ۖ جَحَدُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا۟ رُسُلَهُۥ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
verses.en: And that was ʿAad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant.
verses.tr: watilka ʿādun ۖ jaḥadūā bāyāti rabbihim waʿaṣawā rusulahu wāttabaʿūā ʾamra kulli jabbārin ʿanīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: These were the Ad: they rejected their Lord’s signs, disobeyed His messengers, and followed the command of every obstinate tyrant.
verses.pickthall: And such were A'ad. They denied the revelations of their Lord and flouted His messengers and followed the command of every froward potentate.

verses.ar: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ
verses.en: And they were [therefore] followed in this world with a curse and [as well] on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, ʿAad denied their Lord; then away with ʿAad, the people of Hūd.
verses.tr: wa-utbiʿūā fā hādhihi ad-dunyā laʿnahan wayawma al-qiyāmahi ۗ ʾalā ʾinna ʿādan kafarūā rabbahum ۗ ʾalā buʿdan lliʿādin qawmi hūdin
verses.abdelhaleem: They were rejected in this life and so they shall be on the Day of Judgement. Yes, the 'Ad denied their Lord- so away with the Ad, the people of Hud!
verses.pickthall: And a curse was made to follow them in the world and on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! A'ad disbelieved in their Lord. A far removal for A'ad, the folk of Hud!

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ
verses.en: And to Thamūd [We sent] their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."
verses.tr: ۞ wa-ʾilā thamūda ʾakhāhum ṣāliḥan ۚ qāla yāqawmi āʿbudūā Allāh mā lakum mmin ʾilāhin ghayruhu ۖ huwa ʾanshaʾakum mmina al-ʾarḍi wāstaʿmarakum fīhā fāstaghfirūhu thumma tūbūā ʾilayhi ۚ ʾinna rabbā qarībun mmujībun
verses.abdelhaleem: To the Thamud, We sent their brother, Salih. He said, ‘My people, worship God. You have no god other than Him. It was He who brought you into being from the earth and made you inhabit it, so ask forgiveness from Him, and turn back to Him: my Lord is near, and ready to answer.’
verses.pickthall: And unto (the tribe of) Thamud (We sent) their brother Salih. He said: O my people! Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. He brought you forth from the earth and hath made you husband it. So ask forgiveness of Him and turn unto Him repentant. Lo! my Lord is Nigh, Responsive.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ قَدْ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَـٰذَآ ۖ أَتَنْهَىٰنَآ أَن نَّعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ
verses.en: They said, "O Ṣāliḥ, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."
verses.tr: qālūā yāṣāliḥu qad kunta fīnā marjuwwan qabla hādhā ۖ ʾatanhānā ʾan nnaʿbuda mā yaʿbudu ābāʾunā wa-innanā lafā shakkin mmimmā tadʿūnā ʾilayhi murībin
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Salih, We used to have such great hope in you. Will you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? We are in grave doubt about what you are asking us to do.’
verses.pickthall: They said: O Salih! Thou hast been among us hitherto as that wherein our hope was placed. Dost thou ask us not to worship what our fathers worshipped? Lo! we verily are in grave doubt concerning that to which thou callest us.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَءَاتَىٰنِى مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَن يَنصُرُنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُۥ ۖ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِى غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ
verses.en: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has given me mercy from Himself, who would protect me from Allāh if I disobeyed Him? So you would not increase me except in loss.
verses.tr: qāla yāqawmi ʾaraʾaytum ʾin kuntu ʿalā bayyinahin mmin rrabbā watānā minhu raḥmahan faman yanṣurunā mina Allāh ʾin ʿaṣaytuhu ۖ famā tazīdūnanā ghayra takhsīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My people, just think: if I did have clear proof from my Lord, and if He had given me mercy of His own, who could protect me from God if I disobeyed Him? You would only make my loss greater.
verses.pickthall: He said: O my people! Bethink you: if I am (acting) on clear proof from my Lord and there hath come unto me a mercy from Him, who will save me from Allah if I disobey Him? Ye would add to me naught save perdition.

verses.ar: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ ءَايَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِىٓ أَرْضِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ
verses.en: And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allāh - [she is] to you a sign. So let her feed upon Allāh's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment."
verses.tr: wayāqawmi hādhihi nāqahu Allāh lakum āyahan fadharūhā taʾkul fā ʾarḍi Allāh walā tamassūhā bisūʾin fayaʾkhudhakum ʿadhābun qarībun
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, this camel belongs to God, a sign for you, so leave it to pasture on God’s earth and do not harm it, or you will soon be punished.’
verses.pickthall: O my people! This is the camel of Allah, a token unto you, so suffer her to feed in Allah's earth, and touch her not with harm lest a near torment seize you.

verses.ar: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فِى دَارِكُمْ ثَلَـٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ
verses.en: But they hamstrung her, so he said, "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied [i.e., unfailing]."
verses.tr: faʿaqarūhā faqāla tamattaʿūā fā dārikum thalāthaha ʾayyāmin ۖ dhālika waʿdun ghayru makdhūbin
verses.abdelhaleem: But they hamstrung it, so he said, ‘Enjoy life for another three days:
verses.pickthall: But they hamstrung her, and then he said: Enjoy life in your dwelling-place three days! This is a threat that will not be belied.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَـٰلِحًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْىِ يَوْمِئِذٍ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
verses.en: So when Our command came, We saved Ṣāliḥ and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and [saved them] from the disgrace of that day. Indeed, it is your Lord who is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
verses.tr: falammā jāʾa ʾamrunā najjaynā ṣāliḥan wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā maʿahu biraḥmahin mminnā wamin khizāi yawmiʾidhin ۗ ʾinna rabbaka huwa al-qawāu al-ʿazīzu
verses.abdelhaleem: this warning will not prove false.’ And so, when Our command was fulfilled, by Our mercy We saved Salih and his fellow believers from the disgrace of that day. [Prophet], it is your Lord who is the Strong, the Mighty One.
verses.pickthall: So, when Our commandment came to pass, We saved Salih, and those who believed with him, by a mercy from Us, from the ignominy of that day. Lo, thy Lord! He is the Strong, the Mighty.

verses.ar: وَأَخَذَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verses.en: And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
verses.tr: wa-akhadha adh-dhīna ẓalamūā aṣ-ṣayḥahu fa-aṣbaḥūā fā diyārihim jāthimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The blast struck the evildoers and they lay dead in their homes,
verses.pickthall: And the (awful) Cry overtook those who did wrong, so that morning found them prostrate in their dwellings,

verses.ar: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ثَمُودَا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّثَمُودَ
verses.en: As if they had never prospered therein. Unquestionably, Thamūd denied their Lord; then, away with Thamūd.
verses.tr: kaʾan llam yaghnawā fīhā ۗ ʾalā ʾinna thamūdā kafarūā rabbahum ۗ ʾalā buʿdan llithamūda
verses.abdelhaleem: as though they had never lived and flourished there. Yes, the Thamud denied their Lord- so away with the Thamud!
verses.pickthall: As though they had not dwelt there. Lo! Thamud disbelieved in their Lord. A far removal for Thamud!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ ۖ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَن جَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ
verses.en: And certainly did Our messengers [i.e., angels] come to Abraham with good tidings; they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and did not delay in bringing [them] a roasted calf.
verses.tr: walaqad jāʾat rusulunā ʾibrāhīma bi-l-bushrā qālūā salāman ۖ qāla salāmun ۖ famā labitha ʾan jāʾa biʿijlin ḥanīdhin
verses.abdelhaleem: To Abraham Our messengers brought good news. They said, ‘Peace.’ He answered, ‘Peace,’ and without delay he brought in a roasted calf.
verses.pickthall: And Our messengers cam unto Abraham with good news. They said: Peace! He answered: Peace! and delayed not to bring a roasted calf.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَءَآ أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۚ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
verses.en: But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lot."
verses.tr: falammā raā ʾaydiyahum lā taṣilu ʾilayhi nakirahum wa-awjasa minhum khīfahan ۚ qālūā lā takhaf ʾinnā ʾursilnā ʾilā qawmi lūṭin
verses.abdelhaleem: When he saw that their hands did not reach towards the meal, he found this strange and became afraid of them. But they said, ‘Do not be afraid. We have been sent against the people of Lot.’
verses.pickthall: And when he saw their hands reached not to it, he mistrusted them and conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! Lo! we are sent unto the folk of Lot.

verses.ar: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهَا بِإِسْحَـٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسْحَـٰقَ يَعْقُوبَ
verses.en: And his wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.
verses.tr: wāmraʾatuhu qāʾimahun faḍaḥikat fabasharnāhā biʾisḥāqa wamin warāʾi ʾisḥāqa yaʿqūba
verses.abdelhaleem: His wife was standing [nearby] and laughed. We gave her good news of Isaac and, after him, of Jacob.
verses.pickthall: And his wife, standing by laughed when We gave her good tidings (of the birth) of Isaac, and, after Isaac, of Jacob.

verses.ar: قَالَتْ يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزٌ وَهَـٰذَا بَعْلِى شَيْخًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.en: She said, "Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!"
verses.tr: qālat yāwaylatā ʾaʾalidu wa-anā ʿajūzun wahādhā baʿlā shaykhan ۖ ʾinna hādhā lashāʾun ʿajībun
verses.abdelhaleem: She said, ‘Alas for me! How am I to bear a child when I am an old woman, and my husband here is an old man? That would be a strange thing!’
verses.pickthall: She said: Oh woe is me! Shall I bear a child when I am an old woman, and this my husband is an old man? Lo! this is a strange thing!

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ رَحْمَتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَـٰتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.en: They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allāh? May the mercy of Allāh and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."
verses.tr: qālūā ʾataʿjabīna min ʾamri Allāh ۖ raḥmatu Allāh wabarakātuhu ʿalaykum ʾahla al-bayti ۚ ʾinnahu ḥamīdun mmajīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Are you astonished at what God ordains? The grace of God and His blessings be upon you, people of this house! For He is worthy of all praise and glory.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Wonderest thou at the commandment of Allah? The mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, O people of the house! Lo! He is Owner of Praise, Owner of Glory!

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلرَّوْعُ وَجَآءَتْهُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ يُجَـٰدِلُنَا فِى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
verses.en: And when the fright had left Abraham and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue [i.e., plead] with Us concerning the people of Lot.
verses.tr: falammā dhahaba ʿan ʾibrāhīma ar-rawʿu wajāʾathu al-bushrā yujādilunā fā qawmi lūṭin
verses.abdelhaleem: Then, when the fear left Abraham and the good news came to him, he pleaded with Us for Lot’s people,
verses.pickthall: And when the awe departed from Abraham, and the glad news reached him, he pleaded with Us on behalf of the folk of Lot.

verses.ar: إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّٰهٌ مُّنِيبٌ
verses.en: Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allāh].
verses.tr: ʾinna ʾibrāhīma laḥalīmun ʾawwāhun mmunībun
verses.abdelhaleem: for Abraham was forbearing, tender-hearted, and devout.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Abraham was mild, imploring, penitent.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَـٰذَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ قَدْ جَآءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَإِنَّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ
verses.en: [The angels said], "O Abraham, give up this [plea]. Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled."
verses.tr: yāʾibrāhīmu ʾaʿriḍ ʿan hādhā ۖ ʾinnahu qad jāʾa ʾamru rabbika ۖ wa-innahum ātīhim ʿadhābun ghayru mardūdin
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Abraham, cease your pleading: what your Lord has ordained has come about; punishment is coming to them, which cannot be turned back.’
verses.pickthall: (It was said) O Abraham! Forsake this! Lo! thy Lord's commandment hath gone forth, and lo! there cometh unto them a doom which cannot be repelled.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ
verses.en: And when Our messengers, [the angels], came to Lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort and said, "This is a trying day."
verses.tr: walammā jāʾat rusulunā lūṭan sāʾa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqāla hādhā yawmun ʿaṣībun
verses.abdelhaleem: And when Our messengers came to Lot, he was anxious for them, feeling powerless to protect them, and said, ‘This is a truly terrible day!’
verses.pickthall: And when Our messengers came unto Lot, he was distressed and knew not how to protect them. He said: This is a distressful day.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِى هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِى ضَيْفِىٓ ۖ أَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيدٌ
verses.en: And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds. He said, "O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear Allāh and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?"
verses.tr: wajāʾahu qawmuhu yuhraʿūna ʾilayhi wamin qablu kānūā yaʿmalūna as-sayyāti ۚ qāla yāqawmi hāʾulāʾi banātā hunna ʾaṭharu lakum ۖ fāttaqūā Allāh walā tukhzūni fā ḍayfā ۖ ʾalaysa minkum rajulun rrashīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: His people came rushing towards him; they used to commit foul deeds. He said, ‘My people, here are my daughters.They are more wholesome for you, so have some fear of God and do not disgrace me with my guests. Is there not a single right-minded man among you?’
verses.pickthall: And his people came unto him, running towards him - and before then they used to commit abominations - He said: O my people! Here are my daughters! They are purer for you. Beware of Allah, and degrade me not in (the person of) my guests. Is there not among you any upright man?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِى بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ
verses.en: They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters [i.e., women] any claim [i.e., desire], and indeed, you know what we want."
verses.tr: qālūā laqad ʿalimta mā lanā fā banātika min ḥaqqin wa-innaka lataʿlamu mā nurīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘You know very well that we have no right to your daughters. You know very well what we want.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Well thou knowest that we have no right to thy daughters, and well thou knowest what we want.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ
verses.en: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support."
verses.tr: qāla law ʾanna lā bikum quwwahan ʾaw āwā ʾilā ruknin shadīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘If only I had the strength to stop you or could rely on strong support!’
verses.pickthall: He said: Would that I had strength to resist you or had some strong support (among you)!

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰلُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكَ ۖ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مُصِيبُهَا مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ ٱلصُّبْحُ ۚ أَلَيْسَ ٱلصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ
verses.en: They [the angels] said, "O Lot, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; [therefore], they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. Is not the morning near?"
verses.tr: qālūā yālūṭu ʾinnā rusulu rabbika lan yaṣilūā ʾilayka ۖ fa-asri biʾahlika biqiṭʿin mmina al-yli walā yaltafit minkum ʾaḥadun ʾillā āmraʾataka ۖ ʾinnahu muṣībuhā mā ʾaṣābahum ۚ ʾinna mawʿidahumu aṣ-ṣubḥu ۚ ʾalaysa aṣ-ṣubḥu biqarībin
verses.abdelhaleem: They [the messengers] said, ‘Lot, we are your Lord’s messengers. They will not reach you. Leave with your household in the dead of night, and let none of you turn back. Only your wife will suffer the fate that befalls the others. Their appointed time is the morning: is the morning not near?’
verses.pickthall: (The messengers) said: O Lot! Lo! we are messengers of thy Lord; they shall not reach thee. So travel with thy people in a part of the night, and let not one of you turn round - (all) save thy wife. Lo! that which smiteth them will smite her (also). Lo! their tryst is (for) the morning. Is not the morning nigh?

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ مَّنضُودٍ
verses.en: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]
verses.tr: falammā jāʾa ʾamrunā jaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhā ḥijārahan mmin sijjīlin mmanḍūdin
verses.abdelhaleem: And so when what We had ordained came about, We turned their town upside down and rained down stones of baked clay on it, layer upon layer,
verses.pickthall: So when Our commandment came to pass We overthrew (that township) and rained upon it stones of clay, one after another,

verses.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَمَا هِىَ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ
verses.en: Marked from your Lord. And it [i.e., Allāh's punishment] is not from the wrongdoers [very] far.
verses.tr: mmusawwamahan ʿinda rabbika ۖ wamā hāa mina aẓ-ẓālimīna bibaʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: marked from your Lord. It is not far from the evildoers.
verses.pickthall: Marked with fire in the providence of thy Lord (for the destruction of the wicked). And they are never far from the wrong-doers.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ ۚ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُم بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُّحِيطٍ
verses.en: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day.
verses.tr: ۞ wa-ʾilā madyana ʾakhāhum shuʿayban ۚ qāla yāqawmi āʿbudūā Allāh mā lakum mmin ʾilāhin ghayruhu ۖ walā tanquṣūā al-mikyāla wa-l-mīzāna ۚ ʾinnā ʾarākum bikhayrin wa-innā ʾakhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin mmuḥīṭin
verses.abdelhaleem: And to Midian, We sent their brother Shuayb. He said, ‘My people, worship God. You have no god other than Him. Do not give short measure nor short weight. I see you are prospering, but I fear you will have torment on an overwhelming Day.
verses.pickthall: And unto Midian (We sent) their brother Shu'eyb. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him! And give not short measure and short weight. Lo! I see you well-to-do, and lo! I fear for you the doom of a besetting Day.

verses.ar: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.
verses.tr: wayāqawmi ʾawfūā al-mikyāla wa-l-mīzāna bi-l-qisṭi ۖ walā tabkhasūā an-nāsa ʾashyāʾahum walā taʿthawā fā al-ʾarḍi mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, in fairness, give full measure and weight. Do not withhold from people things that are rightly theirs, and do not spread corruption in the land.
verses.pickthall: O my people! Give full measure and full weight in justice, and wrong not people in respect of their goods. And do not evil in the earth, causing corruption.

verses.ar: بَقِيَّتُ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ
verses.en: What remains [lawful] from Allāh is best for you, if you would be believers. But I am not a guardian over you."
verses.tr: baqiyyatu Allāh khayrun llakum ʾin kuntum mmuʾminīna ۚ wamā ʾanā ʿalaykum biḥafīẓin
verses.abdelhaleem: What lasts with God is best for you, if you are believers: I am not your keeper.’
verses.pickthall: That which Allah leaveth with you is better for you if ye are believers; and I am not a keeper over you.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verses.en: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!"
verses.tr: qālūā yāshuʿaybu ʾaṣalawātuka taʾmuruka ʾan nnatruka mā yaʿbudu ābāʾunā ʾaw ʾan nnafʿala fā ʾamwālinā mā nashā ۖ ʾinnaka laʾanta al-ḥalīmu ar-rashīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Shuayb, does your prayer tell you that we should abandon what our forefathers worshipped and refrain from doing whatever we please with our own property? Indeed you are a tolerant and sensible man.’
verses.pickthall: They said: O Shu'eyb! Doth thy way of prayer command thee that we should forsake that which our fathers (used to) worship, or that we (should leave off) doing what we will with our own property. Lo! thou art the mild, the guide to right behaviour.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَرَزَقَنِى مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ ۚ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلْإِصْلَـٰحَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ ۚ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِىٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
verses.en: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...? And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allāh. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.
verses.tr: qāla yāqawmi ʾaraʾaytum ʾin kuntu ʿalā bayyinahin mmin rrabbā warazaqanā minhu rizqan ḥasanan ۚ wamā ʾurīdu ʾan ʾukhālifakum ʾilā mā ʾanhākum ʿanhu ۚ ʾin ʾurīdu ʾillā al-ʾiṣlāḥa mā āstaṭaʿtu ۚ wamā tawfīqā ʾillā billāh ۚ ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ʾilayhi ʾunību
verses.abdelhaleem: He answered, ‘My people, can you not see? What if I am acting on clear evidence from my Lord? He Himself has given me good provision: I do not want to do what I am forbidding you to do, I only want to put things right as far as I can. I cannot succeed without God’s help: I trust in Him, and always turn to Him.
verses.pickthall: He said: O my people! Bethink you: if I am (acting) on a clear proof from my Lord and He sustaineth me with fair sustenance from Him (how can I concede aught to you)? I desire not to do behind your backs that which I ask you not to do. I desire naught save reform so far as I am able. My welfare is only in Allah. In Him I trust and unto Him I turn (repentant).

verses.ar: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِىٓ أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثْلُ مَآ أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَـٰلِحٍ ۚ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٍ
verses.en: And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hūd or the people of Ṣāliḥ. And the people of Lot are not from you far away.
verses.tr: wayāqawmi lā yajrimannakum shiqāqā ʾan yuṣībakum mmithlu mā ʾaṣāba qawma nūḥin ʾaw qawma hūdin ʾaw qawma ṣāliḥin ۚ wamā qawmu lūṭin mminkum bibaʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, do not let your opposition to me bring upon you a similar fate to the peoples of Noah or Hud or Salih; the people of Lot are not far away from you.
verses.pickthall: And, O my people! Let not the schism with me cause you to sin so that there befall you that which befell the folk of Noah and the folk of Hud, and the folk of Salih; and the folk of Lot are not far off from you.

verses.ar: وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ
verses.en: And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate."
verses.tr: wāstaghfirūā rabbakum thumma tūbūā ʾilayhi ۚ ʾinna rabbā raḥīmun wadūdun
verses.abdelhaleem: Ask forgiveness from your Lord, and turn to Him in repentance: my Lord is merciful and most loving.’
verses.pickthall: Ask pardon of your Lord and then turn unto Him (repentant). Lo! my Lord is Merciful, Loving.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا ۖ وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَـٰكَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ
verses.en: They said, "O Shuʿayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected."
verses.tr: qālūā yāshuʿaybu mā nafqahu kathīran mmimmā taqūlu wa-innā lanarāka fīnā ḍaʿīfan ۖ walawlā rahṭuka larajamnāka ۖ wamā ʾanta ʿalaynā biʿazīzin
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Shuayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and we find you very weak in our midst. But for your family, we would have stoned you, for you have no great status among us.’
verses.pickthall: They said: O Shu'eyb! We understand not much of that thou tellest, and lo! we do behold thee weak among us. But for thy family, we should have stoned thee, for thou art not strong against us.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَرَهْطِىٓ أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَآءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا ۖ إِنَّ رَبِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
verses.en: He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allāh? But you put Him behind your backs [in neglect]. Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do.
verses.tr: qāla yāqawmi ʾarahṭā ʾaʿazzu ʿalaykum mmina Allāh wāttakhadhtumūhu warāʾakum ẓihriyyan ۖ ʾinna rabbā bimā taʿmalūna muḥīṭun
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My people, is my family stronger in your estimation than God? And have you put Him behind you? My Lord surrounds everything you do.
verses.pickthall: He said: O my people! Is my family more to be honoured by you than Allah? and ye put Him behind you, neglected! Lo! my Lord surroundeth what ye do.

verses.ar: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَـٰمِلٌ ۖ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَـٰذِبٌ ۖ وَٱرْتَقِبُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ
verses.en: And O my people, work according to your position; indeed, I am working. You are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. So watch; indeed, I am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]."
verses.tr: wayāqawmi āʿmalūā ʿalā makānatikum ʾinnā ʿāmilun ۖ sawfa taʿlamūna man yaʾtīhi ʿadhābun yukhzīhi waman huwa kādhibun ۖ wārtaqibūā ʾinnā maʿakum raqībun
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, do whatever is within your power, and I will do likewise. Soon you will know who will receive a disgraceful punishment and who is a liar. Watch out, and so will I.’
verses.pickthall: And, O my people! Act according to your power, lo! I (too) am acting. Ye will soon know on whom there cometh a doom that will abase him, and who it is that lieth. And watch! Lo! I am a watcher with you.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verses.en: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
verses.tr: walammā jāʾa ʾamrunā najjaynā shuʿayban wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā maʿahu biraḥmahin mminnā wa-akhadhati adh-dhīna ẓalamūā aṣ-ṣayḥahu fa-aṣbaḥūā fā diyārihim jāthimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When what We had ordained came about, in Our mercy We saved Shuayb and his fellow believers, but a mighty blast struck the wrongdoers. By morning they lay dead in their homes,
verses.pickthall: And when Our commandment came to pass We saved Shu'eyb and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us; and the (Awful) Cry seized those who did injustice, and morning found them prostrate in their dwellings,

verses.ar: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ
verses.en: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamūd was taken away.
verses.tr: kaʾan llam yaghnawā fīhā ۗ ʾalā buʿdan llimadyana kamā baʿidat thamūdu
verses.abdelhaleem: as if they had never lived and flourished there. Yes, away with the people of Midian, just like the Thamud!
verses.pickthall: As though they had not dwelt there. A far removal for Midian, even as Thamud had been removed afar!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā mūsā bāyātinā wasulṭānin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: We also sent Moses, with Our signs and clear authority,
verses.pickthall: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations and a clear warrant

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۖ وَمَآ أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ
verses.en: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not [at all] discerning.
verses.tr: ʾilā firʿawna wamalaʾīhi fāttabaʿūā ʾamra firʿawna ۖ wamā ʾamru firʿawna birashīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: to Pharaoh and his supporters, but they followed Pharaoh’s orders, and Pharaoh’s orders were misguided.
verses.pickthall: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they did follow the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was no right guide.

verses.ar: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْوِرْدُ ٱلْمَوْرُودُ
verses.en: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them into the Fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led.
verses.tr: yaqdumu qawmahu yawma al-qiyāmahi fa-awradahumu an-nāra ۖ wabiʾsa al-wirdu al-mawrūdu
verses.abdelhaleem: He will be at the forefront of his people on the Day of Resurrection, leading them down towards the Fire. What a foul drinking place to be led to!
verses.pickthall: He will go before his people on the Day of Resurrection and will lead them to the Fire for watering-place. Ah, hapless is the watering-place (whither they are) led.

verses.ar: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِۦ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلرِّفْدُ ٱلْمَرْفُودُ
verses.en: And they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift which is given.
verses.tr: wa-utbiʿūā fā hādhihi laʿnahan wayawma al-qiyāmahi ۚ biʾsa ar-rifdu al-marfūdu
verses.abdelhaleem: They were pursued by God’s rejection in this life and will be on the Day of Resurrection, too. What a foul gift to be given!
verses.pickthall: A curse is made to follow them in the world and on the Day of Resurrection. Hapless is the gift (that will be) given (them).

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّهُۥ عَلَيْكَ ۖ مِنْهَا قَآئِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ
verses.en: That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down].
verses.tr: dhālika min ʾanbāʾi al-qurā naquṣṣuhu ʿalayka ۖ minhā qāʾimun waḥaṣīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: We relate to you [Muhammad] such accounts of earlier towns: some of them are still standing; some have been mown down;
verses.pickthall: That is (something) of the tidings of the townships (which were destroyed of old). We relate it unto thee (Muhammad). Some of them are standing and some (already) reaped.

verses.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۖ فَمَآ أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ ءَالِهَتُهُمُ ٱلَّتِى يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ لَّمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ
verses.en: And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. And they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than Allāh when there came the command of your Lord. And they did not increase them in other than ruin.
verses.tr: wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin ẓalamūā ʾanfusahum ۖ famā ʾaghnat ʿanhum ālihatuhumu at-tā yadʿūna min dūni Allāh min shāʾin llammā jāʾa ʾamru rabbika ۖ wamā zādūhum ghayra tatbībin
verses.abdelhaleem: We did not wrong them; they wronged themselves. Their gods, which they called on beside God, were no use to them when what your Lord had ordained came about; they only increased their ruin.
verses.pickthall: We wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves; and their gods on whom they call beside Allah availed them naught when came thy Lord's command; they added to them naught save ruin.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَآ أَخَذَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَهِىَ ظَـٰلِمَةٌ ۚ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُۥٓ أَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ
verses.en: And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe.
verses.tr: wakadhālika ʾakhdhu rabbika ʾidhā ʾakhadha al-qurā wahāa ẓālimahun ۚ ʾinna ʾakhdhahu ʾalīmun shadīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: Such is the punishment of your Lord for towns in the midst of their sins: His punishment is terrible and severe.
verses.pickthall: Even thus is the grasp of thy Lord when He graspeth the townships while they are doing wrong. Lo! His grasp is painful, very strong.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّجْمُوعٌ لَّهُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّشْهُودٌ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day [which will be] witnessed.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan lliman khāfa ʿadhāba al-ākhirahi ۚ dhālika yawmun mmajmūʿun llahu an-nāsu wadhālika yawmun mmashhūdun
verses.abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this for anyone who fears the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day in which all people will be gathered together, a Day for all to see.
verses.pickthall: Lo! herein verily there is a portent for those who fear the doom of the Hereafter. That is a day unto which mankind will be gathered, and that is a day that will be witnessed.

verses.ar: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَّعْدُودٍ
verses.en: And We do not delay it except for a limited term.
verses.tr: wamā nuʾakhiruhu ʾillā liʾajalin mmaʿdūdin
verses.abdelhaleem: We are delaying it only for a specified period,
verses.pickthall: And We defer it only to a term already reckoned.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِىٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ
verses.en: The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous.
verses.tr: yawma yaʾti lā takallamu nafsun ʾillā biʾidhnihi ۚ faminhum shaqāun wasaʿīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: and when that Day comes, no soul will speak except by His permission, and some of them will be wretched and some happy.
verses.pickthall: On the day when it cometh no soul will speak except by His permission; some among them will be wretched, (others) glad.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ شَقُوا۟ فَفِى ٱلنَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ
verses.en: As for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling.
verses.tr: fa-ammā adh-dhīna shaqūā fafā an-nāri lahum fīhā zafīrun washahīqun
verses.abdelhaleem: The wretched ones will be in the Fire, sighing and groaning,
verses.pickthall: As for those who will be wretched (on that day) they will be in the Fire; sighing and wailing will be their portion therein,

verses.ar: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
verses.en: [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends.
verses.tr: khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati as-samāwātu wa-l-ʾarḍu ʾillā mā shāʾa rabbuka ۚ ʾinna rabbaka faʿʿālun llimā yurīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: there to remain for as long as the heavens and earth endure, unless your Lord wills otherwise: your Lord carries out whatever He wills.
verses.pickthall: Abiding there so long as the heavens and the earth endure save for that which thy Lord willeth. Lo! thy Lord is Doer of what He will.

verses.ar: ۞ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا۟ فَفِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ ۖ عَطَآءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ
verses.en: And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted.
verses.tr: ۞ wa-ammā adh-dhīna suʿidūā fafā al-jannahi khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati as-samāwātu wa-l-ʾarḍu ʾillā mā shāʾa rabbuka ۖ ʿaṭāʾan ghayra majdhūdhin
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who have been blessed, they will be in Paradise, there to remain as long as the heavens and earth endure, unless your Lord wills otherwise- an unceasing gift.
verses.pickthall: And as for those who will be glad (that day) they will be in the Garden, abiding there so long as the heavens and the earth endure save for that which thy Lord willeth: a gift unfailing.

verses.ar: فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ۚ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُهُم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنقُوصٍ
verses.en: So do not be in doubt, [O Muḥammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished.
verses.tr: falā taku fā miryahin mmimmā yaʿbudu hāʾulāʾi ۚ mā yaʿbudūna ʾillā kamā yaʿbudu ābāʾuhum mmin qablu ۚ wa-innā lamuwaffūhum naṣībahum ghayra manqūṣin
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], have no doubt about what these people worship: it is merely what their fathers worshipped before them, and We shall certainly give them their share in full, without any reduction.
verses.pickthall: So be not thou in doubt concerning that which these (folk) worship. They worship only as their fathers worshipped aforetime. Lo! we shall pay them their whole due unabated.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
verses.en: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā mūsā al-kitāba fākhtulifa fīhi ۚ walawlā kalimahun sabaqat min rrabbika laquḍāa baynahum ۚ wa-innahum lafā shakkin mminhu murībin
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave Moses the Scripture before you, but differences arose about it and if it had not been for a prior word from your Lord, a decision would already have been made between them, though they are in grave doubt about it.
verses.pickthall: And we verily gave unto Moses the Scripture, and there was strife thereupon; and had it not been for a Word that had already gone forth from thy Lord, the case would have been judged between them, and lo! they are in grave doubt concerning it.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: And indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Aware of what they do.
verses.tr: wa-inna kullan llammā layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka ʾaʿmālahum ۚ ʾinnahu bimā yaʿmalūna khabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord will give everyone full due for whatever they have done: He is aware of everything they do.
verses.pickthall: And lo! unto each thy Lord will verily repay his works in full. Lo! He is Informed of what they do.

verses.ar: فَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allāh], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
verses.tr: fāstaqim kamā ʾumirta waman tāba maʿaka walā taṭghawā ۚ ʾinnahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: So keep to the right course as you have been commanded, together with those who have turned to God with you. Do not overstep the limits, for He sees everything you do.
verses.pickthall: So tread thou the straight path as thou art commanded, and those who turn (unto Allah) with thee, and transgress not. Lo! He is Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ فَتَمَسَّكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allāh any protectors; then you would not be helped.
verses.tr: walā tarkanūā ʾilā adh-dhīna ẓalamūā fatamassakumu an-nāru wamā lakum mmin dūni Allāh min ʾawliyāʾa thumma lā tunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not rely on those who do evil, or the Fire may touch you, and then you will have no one to protect you from God, nor will you be helped.
verses.pickthall: And incline not toward those who do wrong lest the Fire touch you, and ye have no protecting friends against Allah, and afterward ye would not be helped.

verses.ar: وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَىِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْحَسَنَـٰتِ يُذْهِبْنَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلذَّٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.
verses.tr: wa-aqimi aṣ-ṣalawāha ṭarafāi an-nahāri wazulafan mmina al-yli ۚ ʾinna al-ḥasanāti yudhhibna as-sayyāti ۚ dhālika dhikrā lildhākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], keep up the prayer at both ends of the day, and during parts of the night, for good things drive bad away- this is a reminder for those who are aware.
verses.pickthall: Establish worship at the two ends of the day and in some watches of the night. Lo! good deeds annul ill-deeds. This is reminder for the mindful.

verses.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And be patient, for indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
verses.tr: wāṣbir fa-inna Allāh lā yuḍīʿu ʾajra al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Be steadfast: God does not let the rewards of those who do good go to waste.
verses.pickthall: And have patience, (O Muhammad), for lo! Allah loseth not the wages of the good.

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْفَسَادِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّنْ أَنجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَآ أُتْرِفُوا۟ فِيهِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: So why were there not among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals.
verses.tr: falawlā kāna mina al-qurūni min qablikum ʾūlūā baqiyyahin yanhawna ʿani al-fasādi fā al-ʾarḍi ʾillā qalīlan mmimman ʾanjaynā minhum ۗ wāttabaʿa adh-dhīna ẓalamūā mā ʾutrifūā fīhi wakānūā mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If only there had been, among the generations before your time, people with a rem-nant of good sense, to forbid corruption on the earth! We saved only a few of them, while the unjust pursued the enjoyment of plenty, and persisted in sin.
verses.pickthall: If only there had been among the generations before you men possessing a remnant (of good sense) to warn (their people) from corruption in the earth, as did a few of those whom We saved from them! The wrong-doers followed that by which they were made sapless, and were guilty.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ
verses.en: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.
verses.tr: wamā kāna rabbuka liyuhlika al-qurā biẓulmin wa-ahluhā muṣliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord would not destroy any town without cause if its people were acting righteously.
verses.pickthall: In truth thy Lord destroyed not the townships tyrannously while their folk were doing right.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً ۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ
verses.en: And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ,
verses.tr: walaw shāʾa rabbuka lajaʿala an-nāsa ʾummahan wāḥidahan ۖ walā yazālūna mukhtalifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If your Lord had pleased, He would have made all people a single community, but they continue to have their differences-
verses.pickthall: And if thy Lord had willed, He verily would have made mankind one nation, yet they cease not differing,

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ ۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ ۗ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together."
verses.tr: ʾillā man rraḥima rabbuka ۚ walidhālika khalaqahum ۗ watammat kalimahu rabbika laʾamlaʾanna jahannama mina al-jinnahi wa-an-nāsi ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: except those on whom your Lord has mercy- for He created them to be this way, and the word of your Lord is final: ‘I shall definitely fill Hell with both jinn and men.’
verses.pickthall: Save him on whom thy Lord hath mercy; and for that He did create them. And the Word of thy Lord hath been fulfilled: Verily I shall fill hell with the jinn and mankind together.

verses.ar: وَكُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۚ وَجَآءَكَ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers.
verses.tr: wakullan nnaquṣṣu ʿalayka min ʾanbāʾi ar-rusuli mā nuthabbitu bihi fuādaka ۚ wajāʾaka fā hādhihi al-ḥaqqu wamawʿiẓahun wadhikrā lilmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Muhammad], We have told you the stories of the prophets to make your heart firm and in these accounts truth has come to you, as well as lessons and reminders for the believers.
verses.pickthall: And all that We relate unto thee of the story of the messengers is in order that thereby We may make firm thy heart. And herein hath come unto thee the Truth and an exhortation and a reminder for believers.

verses.ar: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَـٰمِلُونَ
verses.en: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.
verses.tr: waqul llilladhīna lā yuʾminūna āʿmalūā ʿalā makānatikum ʾinnā ʿāmilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say to those who do not believe, ‘Do whatever you can: we too are doing what we can,’
verses.pickthall: And say unto those who believe not: Act according to your power. Lo! We (too) are acting.

verses.ar: وَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
verses.en: And wait; indeed, we are waiting."
verses.tr: wāntaẓirūā ʾinnā muntaẓirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and ‘Wait: we too are waiting.’
verses.pickthall: And wait! Lo! We (too) are waiting.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ ٱلْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُۥ فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And to Allāh belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh ghaybu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wa-ʾilayhi yurjaʿu al-ʾamru kulluhu fāʿbudhu watawakkal ʿalayhi ۚ wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: All that is hidden in the heavens and earth belongs to God, and all authority goes back to Him. So [Prophet], worship Him, and put your trust in Him: your Lord is never unaware of what you [people] are doing.
verses.pickthall: And Allah's is the Invisible of the heavens and the earth, and unto Him the whole matter will be returned. So worship Him and put thy trust in Him. Lo! thy Lord is not unaware of what ye (mortals) do.

verses.ar: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the verses of the clear Book.
verses.tr: al-r ۚ tilka āyātu al-kitābi al-mubīni
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Ra These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear––
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verse of the Scripture that maketh plain.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾanzalnāhu qurānan ʿarabiyyan llaʿallakum taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent it down as an Arabic Quran so that you [people] may understand.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have revealed it, a Lecture in Arabic, that ye may understand.

verses.ar: نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْقَصَصِ بِمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ وَإِن كُنتَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.en: We relate to you, [O Muḥammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur’ān although you were, before it, among the unaware.
verses.tr: naḥnu naquṣṣu ʿalayka ʾaḥsana al-qaṣaṣi bimā ʾawḥaynā ʾilayka hādhā al-qurāna wa-in kunta min qablihi lamina al-ghāfilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We tell you [Prophet] the best of stories in revealing this Quran to you. Before this you were one of those who knew nothing about them.
verses.pickthall: We narrate unto thee (Muhammad) the best of narratives in that We have inspired in thee this Qur'an, though aforetime thou wast of the heedless.

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me."
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla yūsufu liʾabīhi yāʾabati ʾinnā raʾaytu ʾaḥada ʿashara kawkaban wa-ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara raʾaytuhum lā sājidīna
