verses.abdelhaleem: Joseph said to his father, ‘Father, I dreamed of eleven stars and the sun and the moon: I saw them all bow down before me,’
verses.pickthall: When Joseph said unto his father: O my father! Lo! I saw in a dream eleven planets and the sun and the moon, I saw them prostrating themselves unto me.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُءْيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا۟ لَكَ كَيْدًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy.
verses.tr: qāla yābunāa lā taqṣuṣ ruʾyāka ʿalā ʾikhwatika fayakīdūā laka kaydan ۖ ʾinna ash-shayṭāna lilʾinsāni ʿaduwwun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: and he replied, ‘My son, tell your brothers nothing of this dream, or they may plot to harm you––Satan is man’s sworn enemy.
verses.pickthall: He said: O my dear son! Tell not thy brethren of thy vision, lest they plot a plot against thee. Lo! Satan is for man an open foe.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَآ أَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰٓ أَبَوَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives [i.e., events or dreams] and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise."
verses.tr: wakadhālika yajtabīka rabbuka wayuʿallimuka min taʾwīli al-ʾaḥādīthi wayutimmu niʿmatahu ʿalayka waʿalā āli yaʿqūba kamā ʾatammahā ʿalā ʾabawayka min qablu ʾibrāhīma wa-isḥāqa ۚ ʾinna rabbaka ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: This is about how your Lord will choose you, teach you to interpret dreams, and perfect His blessing on you and the House of Jacob, just as He perfected it earlier on your forefathers Abraham and Isaac: your Lord is all knowing and wise.’
verses.pickthall: Thus thy Lord will prefer thee and will teach thee the interpretation of events, and will perfect His grace upon thee and upon the family of Jacob as He perfected it upon thy forefathers, Abraham and Isaac. Lo! thy Lord is Knower, Wise.

verses.ar: ۞ لَّقَدْ كَانَ فِى يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِۦٓ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
verses.en: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask, [such as]
verses.tr: ۞ llaqad kāna fā yūsufa wa-ikhwatihi āyātun llilssāʾilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There are lessons in the story of Joseph and his brothers for all who seek them.
verses.pickthall: Verily in Joseph and his brethren are signs (of Allah's Sovereignty) for the inquiring.

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: When they said, "Joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. Indeed, our father is in clear error.
verses.tr: ʾidh qālūā layūsufu wa-akhūhu ʾaḥabbu ʾilā ʾabīnā minnā wanaḥnu ʿuṣbahun ʾinna ʾabānā lafā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: The brothers said [to each other], ‘Although we are many, Joseph and his brother are dearer to our father than we are–– our father is clearly in the wrong.’
verses.pickthall: When they said: Verily Joseph and his brother are dearer to our father than we are, many though we be. Lo! our father is in plain aberration.

verses.ar: ٱقْتُلُوا۟ يُوسُفَ أَوِ ٱطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ قَوْمًا صَـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: Kill Joseph or cast him out to [another] land; the countenance [i.e., attention] of your father will [then] be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people."
verses.tr: āqtulūā yūsufa ʾawi āṭraḥūhu ʾarḍan yakhlu lakum wajhu ʾabīkum watakūnūā min baʿdihi qawman ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [One of them said], ‘Kill Joseph or banish him to another land, and your father’s attention will be free to turn to you. After that you can be righteous.’
verses.pickthall: (One said): Kill Joseph or cast him to some (other) land, so that your father's favour may be all for you, and (that) ye may afterward be righteous folk.

verses.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِى غَيَـٰبَتِ ٱلْجُبِّ يَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ ٱلسَّيَّارَةِ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.en: Said a speaker among them, "Do not kill Joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do [something]."
verses.tr: qāla qāʾilun mminhum lā taqtulūā yūsufa wa-ʾalqūhu fā ghayābati al-jubbi yaltaqiṭhu baʿḍu as-sayyārahi ʾin kuntum fāʿilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Another of them] said, ‘Do not kill Joseph, but, if you must, throw him into the hidden depths of a well where some caravan may pick him up.’
verses.pickthall: One among them said: Kill not Joseph but, if ye must be doing, fling him into the depth of the pit; some caravan will find him.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأْمَ۫نَّا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَنَـٰصِحُونَ
verses.en: They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors?
verses.tr: qālūā yāʾabānā mā laka lā taʾmannā ʿalā yūsufa wa-innā lahu lanāṣiḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said to their father, ‘Why do you not trust us with Joseph? We wish him well.
verses.pickthall: They said: O our father! Why wilt thou not trust us with Joseph, when lo! we are good friends to him?

verses.ar: أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
verses.en: Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians."
verses.tr: ʾarsilhu maʿanā ghadan yartaʿ wayalʿab wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Send him with us tomorrow and he will enjoy himself and play- we will take good care of him.’
verses.pickthall: Send him with us to-morrow that he may enjoy himself and play. And lo! we shall take good care of him.

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنِّى لَيَحْزُنُنِىٓ أَن تَذْهَبُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَأَخَافُ أَن يَأْكُلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ وَأَنتُمْ عَنْهُ غَـٰفِلُونَ
verses.en: [Jacob] said, "Indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware."
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnā layaḥzununā ʾan tadhhabūā bihi wa-akhāfu ʾan yaʾkulahu adh-dhiʾbu wa-antum ʿanhu ghāfilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He replied, ‘The thought of you taking him away with you worries me: I am afraid a wolf may eat him when you are not paying attention.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Lo! in truth it saddens me that ye should take him with you, and I fear less the wolf devour him while ye are heedless of him.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِنْ أَكَلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: They said, "If a wolf should eat him while we are a [strong] clan, indeed, we would then be losers."
verses.tr: qālūā laʾin ʾakalahu adh-dhiʾbu wanaḥnu ʿuṣbahun ʾinnā ʾidhan llakhāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘If a wolf were to eat him when there are so many of us, we would truly be losers!’
verses.pickthall: They said: If the wolf should devour him when we are (so strong) a band, then surely we should have already perished.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَأَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَن يَجْعَلُوهُ فِى غَيَـٰبَتِ ٱلْجُبِّ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَـٰذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well... But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]."
verses.tr: falammā dhahabūā bihi wa-ajmaʿūā ʾan yajʿalūhu fā ghayābati al-jubbi ۚ wa-awḥaynā ʾilayhi latunabbiʾannahum biʾamrihim hādhā wahum lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then they took him away with them, resolved upon throwing him into the hidden depths of a well- We inspired him, saying, ‘You will tell them of all this [at a time] when they do not realize [who you are]!’-
verses.pickthall: Then, when they led him off, and were of one mind that they should place him in the depth of the pit, We inspired in him: Thou wilt tell them of this deed of theirs when they know (thee) not.

verses.ar: وَجَآءُوٓ أَبَاهُمْ عِشَآءً يَبْكُونَ
verses.en: And they came to their father at night, weeping.
verses.tr: wajāʾū ʾabāhum ʿishāʾan yabkūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and at nightfall they returned to their father weeping.
verses.pickthall: And they came weeping to their father in the evening.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَبَانَآ إِنَّا ذَهَبْنَا نَسْتَبِقُ وَتَرَكْنَا يُوسُفَ عِندَ مَتَـٰعِنَا فَأَكَلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُؤْمِنٍ لَّنَا وَلَوْ كُنَّا صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: They said, "O our father, indeed we went racing each other and left Joseph with our possessions, and a wolf ate him. But you would not believe us, even if we were truthful."
verses.tr: qālūā yāʾabānā ʾinnā dhahabnā nastabiqu wataraknā yūsufa ʿinda matāʿinā fa-akalahu adh-dhiʾbu ۖ wamā ʾanta bimuʾminin llanā walaw kunnā ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We went off racing one another, leaving Joseph behind with our things, and a wolf ate him. You will not believe us, though we are telling the truth!’
verses.pickthall: Saying: O our father! We went racing one with another, and left Joseph by our things, and the wolf devoured him, and thou believest not our saying even when we speak the truth.

verses.ar: وَجَآءُو عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِۦ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ ۚ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا ۖ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
verses.en: And they brought upon his shirt false blood. [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. And Allāh is the one sought for help against that which you describe."
verses.tr: wajāʾū ʿalā qamīṣihi bidamin kadhibin ۚ qāla bal sawwalat lakum ʾanfusukum ʾamran ۖ faṣabrun jamīlun ۖ wallāh al-mustaʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they showed him his shirt, deceptively stained with blood. He cried, ‘No! Your souls have prompted you to do wrong! But it is best to be patient: from God alone I seek help to bear what you are saying.’
verses.pickthall: And they came with false blood on his shirt. He said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ فَأَرْسَلُوا۟ وَارِدَهُمْ فَأَدْلَىٰ دَلْوَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰبُشْرَىٰ هَـٰذَا غُلَـٰمٌ ۚ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَـٰعَةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And there came a company of travelers; then they sent their water drawer, and he let down his bucket. He said, "Good news! Here is a boy." And they concealed him, [taking him] as merchandise; and Allāh was Knowing of what they did.
verses.tr: wajāʾat sayyārahun fa-arsalūā wāridahum fa-adlā dalwahu ۖ qāla yābushrā hādhā ghulāmun ۚ wa-asarrūhu biḍāʿahan ۚ wallāh ʿalīmun bimā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Some travellers came by. They sent someone to draw water and he let down his bucket. ‘Good news!’ he exclaimed. ‘Here is a boy!’ They hid him like a piece of merchandise- God was well aware of what they did-
verses.pickthall: And there came a caravan, and they sent their waterdrawer. He let down his pail (into the pit). He said: Good luck! Here is a youth. And they hid him as a treasure, and Allah was Aware of what they did.

verses.ar: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍۭ بَخْسٍ دَرَٰهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوا۟ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلزَّٰهِدِينَ
verses.en: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.
verses.tr: washarawhu bithamanin bakhsin darāhima maʿdūdahin wakānūā fīhi mina az-zāhidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then sold him for a small price, for a few pieces of silver: so little did they value him.
verses.pickthall: And they sold him for a low price, a number of silver coins; and they attached no value to him.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know.
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhā āshtarāhu min mmiṣra lāmraʾatihi ʾakrimā mathwāhu ʿasā ʾan yanfaʿanā ʾaw nattakhidhahu waladan ۚ wakadhālika makkannā liyūsufa fā al-ʾarḍi walinuʿallimahu min taʾwīli al-ʾaḥādīthi ۚ wallāh ghālibun ʿalā ʾamrihi walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Egyptian who bought him said to his wife, ‘Look after him well! He may be useful to us, or we may adopt him as a son.’ In this way We settled Joseph in that land and later taught him how to interpret dreams: God always prevails in His purpose, though most people do not realize it.
verses.pickthall: And he of Egypt who purchased him said unto his wife: Receive him honourably. Perchance he may prove useful to us or we may adopt him as a son. Thus we established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events. And Allah was predominant in His career, but most of mankind know not.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥٓ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And when he [i.e., Joseph] reached maturity, We gave him judgement and knowledge. And thus We reward the doers of good.
verses.tr: walammā balagha ʾashuddahu ātaynāhu ḥukman waʿilman ۚ wakadhālika najzā al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When he reached maturity, We gave him judgement and knowledge: this is how We reward those who do good.
verses.pickthall: And And when he reached his prime We gave him wisdom and knowledge. Thus We reward the good.

verses.ar: وَرَٰوَدَتْهُ ٱلَّتِى هُوَ فِى بَيْتِهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَغَلَّقَتِ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبَ وَقَالَتْ هَيْتَ لَكَ ۚ قَالَ مَعَاذَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَاىَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. She closed the doors and said, "Come, you." He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allāh. Indeed, he is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed."
verses.tr: warāwadathu at-tā huwa fā baytihā ʿan nnafsihi waghallaqati al-ʾabwāba waqālat hayta laka ۚ qāla maʿādha Allāh ۖ ʾinnahu rabbā ʾaḥsana mathwāa ۖ ʾinnahu lā yufliḥu aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The woman in whose house he was living tried to seduce him: she bolted the doors and said, ‘Come to me,’ and he replied, ‘God forbid! My master has been good to me; wrongdoers never prosper.’
verses.pickthall: And she, in whose house he was, asked of him an evil act. She bolted the doors and said: Come! He said: I seek refuge in Allah! Lo! he is my lord, who hath treated me honourably. Lo! wrong-doers never prosper.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِۦ ۖ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَآ أَن رَّءَا بُرْهَـٰنَ رَبِّهِۦ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَٱلْفَحْشَآءَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: And she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof [i.e., sign] of his Lord. And thus [it was] that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants.
verses.tr: walaqad hammat bihi ۖ wahamma bihā lawlā ʾan rraā burhāna rabbihi ۚ kadhālika linaṣrifa ʿanhu as-sūʾa wa-l-faḥshāʾa ۚ ʾinnahu min ʿibādinā al-mukhlaṣīna
verses.abdelhaleem: She made for him, and he would have succumbed to her if he had not seen evidence of his Lord- We did this in order to keep evil and indecency away from him, for he was truly one of Our chosen servants.
verses.pickthall: She verily desired him, and he would have desired her if it had not been that he saw the argument of his Lord. Thus it was, that We might ward off from him evil and lewdness. Lo! he was of Our chosen slaves.

verses.ar: وَٱسْتَبَقَا ٱلْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُۥ مِن دُبُرٍ وَأَلْفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا ٱلْبَابِ ۚ قَالَتْ مَا جَزَآءُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوٓءًا إِلَّآ أَن يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And they both raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back, and they found her husband at the door. She said, "What is the recompense of one who intended evil for your wife but that he be imprisoned or a painful punishment?"
verses.tr: wāstabaqā al-bāba waqaddat qamīṣahu min duburin wa-ā sayyidahā ladā al-bābi ۚ qālat mā jazāʾu man ʾarāda biʾahlika sūʾan ʾillā ʾan yusjana ʾaw ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: They raced for the door- she tore his shirt from behind- and at the door they met her husband. She said, ‘What, other than prison or painful punishment, should be the reward of someone who tried to dishonour your wife?’
verses.pickthall: And they raced with one another to the door, and she tore his shirt from behind, and they met her lord and master at the door. She said: What shall be his reward, who wisheth evil to thy folk, save prison or a painful doom?

verses.ar: قَالَ هِىَ رَٰوَدَتْنِى عَن نَّفْسِى ۚ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَآ إِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُۥ قُدَّ مِن قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: [Joseph] said, "It was she who sought to seduce me." And a witness from her family testified, "If his shirt is torn from the front, then she has told the truth, and he is of the liars.
verses.tr: qāla hāa rāwadatnā ʿan nnafsā ۚ washahida shāhidun mmin ʾahlihā ʾin kāna qamīṣuhu qudda min qubulin faṣadaqat wahuwa mina al-kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but he said, ‘She tried to seduce me.’ A member of her household suggested, ‘If his shirt is torn at the front, then it is she who is telling the truth and he who is lying,
verses.pickthall: (Joseph) said: She it was who asked of me an evil act. And a witness of her own folk testified: If his shirt is torn from before, then she speaketh truth and he is of the liars.

verses.ar: وَإِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُۥ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful."
verses.tr: wa-in kāna qamīṣuhu qudda min duburin fakadhabat wahuwa mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but if it is torn at the back, then she is lying and he is telling the truth.’
verses.pickthall: And if his shirt is torn from behind, then she hath lied and he is of the truthful.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَءَا قَمِيصَهُۥ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ مِن كَيْدِكُنَّ ۖ إِنَّ كَيْدَكُنَّ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: So when he [i.e., her husband] saw his shirt torn from the back, he said, "Indeed, it is of your [i.e., women's] plan. Indeed, your plan is great [i.e., vehement].
verses.tr: falammā raā qamīṣahu qudda min duburin qāla ʾinnahu min kaydikunna ۖ ʾinna kaydakunna ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When the husband saw that the shirt was torn at the back, he said, ‘This is another instance of women’s treachery: your treachery is truly great.
verses.pickthall: So when he saw his shirt torn from behind, he said: Lo! this is of the guile of you women. Lo! the guile of you is very great.

verses.ar: يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَـٰذَا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرِى لِذَنۢبِكِ ۖ إِنَّكِ كُنتِ مِنَ ٱلْخَاطِـِٔينَ
verses.en: Joseph, ignore this. And, [my wife], ask forgiveness for your sin. Indeed, you were of the sinful."
verses.tr: yūsufu ʾaʿriḍ ʿan hādhā ۚ wāstaghfirā lidhanbiki ۖ ʾinnaki kunti mina al-khāṭīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Joseph, overlook this; but you [wife], ask forgiveness for your sin- you have done wrong.’
verses.pickthall: O Joseph! Turn away from this, and thou, (O woman), ask forgiveness for thy sin. Lo! thou art of the faulty.

verses.ar: ۞ وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ تُرَٰوِدُ فَتَىٰهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۖ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا ۖ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰهَا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And women in the city said, "The wife of al-ʿAzeez is seeking to seduce her slave boy; he has impassioned her with love. Indeed, we see her [to be] in clear error."
verses.tr: ۞ waqāla niswahun fā al-madīnahi āmraʾatu al-ʿazīzi turāwidu fatāhā ʿan nnafsihi ۖ qad shaghafahā ḥubban ۖ ʾinnā lanarāhā fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Some women of the city said, ‘The governor’s wife is trying to seduce her slave! Love for him consumes her heart! It is clear to us that she has gone astray.’
verses.pickthall: And women in the city said: The ruler's wife is asking of her slave-boy an ill-deed. Indeed he has smitten her to the heart with love. We behold her in plain aberration.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِمَكْرِهِنَّ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَعْتَدَتْ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَـًٔا وَءَاتَتْ كُلَّ وَٰحِدَةٍ مِّنْهُنَّ سِكِّينًا وَقَالَتِ ٱخْرُجْ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْنَهُۥٓ أَكْبَرْنَهُۥ وَقَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ وَقُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا هَـٰذَا بَشَرًا إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا مَلَكٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: So when she heard of their scheming, she sent for them and prepared for them a banquet and gave each one of them a knife and said [to Joseph], "Come out before them." And when they saw him, they greatly admired him and cut their hands and said, "Perfect is Allāh! This is not a man; this is none but a noble angel."
verses.tr: falammā samiʿat bimakrihinna ʾarsalat ʾilayhinna wa-aʿtadat lahunna muttakā watat kulla wāḥidahin mminhunna sikkīnan waqālati ākhruj ʿalayhinna ۖ falammā raʾaynahu ʾakbarnahu waqaṭṭaʿna ʾaydiyahunna waqulna ḥāsha lillāh mā hādhā basharan ʾin hādhā ʾillā malakun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When she heard their malicious talk, she prepared a banquet and sent for them, giving each of them a knife. She said to Joseph, ‘Come out and show yourself to them!’ and when the women saw him, they were stunned by his beauty, and cut their hands, exclaiming, ‘Great God! He cannot be mortal! He must be a precious angel!’
verses.pickthall: And when she heard of their sly talk, she sent to them and prepared for them a cushioned couch (to lie on at the feast) and gave to every one of them a knife and said (to Joseph): Come out unto them! And when they saw him they exalted him and cut their hands, exclaiming: Allah Blameless! This is no a human being. This is not other than some gracious angel.

verses.ar: قَالَتْ فَذَٰلِكُنَّ ٱلَّذِى لُمْتُنَّنِى فِيهِ ۖ وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ فَٱسْتَعْصَمَ ۖ وَلَئِن لَّمْ يَفْعَلْ مَآ ءَامُرُهُۥ لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُونًا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰغِرِينَ
verses.en: She said, "That is the one about whom you blamed me. And I certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what I order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased."
verses.tr: qālat fadhālikunna adh-dhā lumtunnanā fīhi ۖ walaqad rāwadttuhu ʿan nnafsihi fāstaʿṣama ۖ walaʾin llam yafʿal mā āmuruhu layusjananna walayakūnan mmina aṣ-ṣāghirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: She said, ‘This is the one you blamed me for. I tried to seduce him and he wanted to remain chaste, but if he does not do what I command now, he will be put in prison and degraded.’
verses.pickthall: She said: This is he on whose account ye blamed me. I asked of him an evil act, but he proved continent, but if he do not my behest he verily shall be imprisoned, and verily shall be of those brought low.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱلسِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّى كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi as-sijnu ʾaḥabbu ʾilāa mimmā yadʿūnanā ʾilayhi ۖ wa-ā taṣrif ʿannā kaydahunna ʾaṣbu ʾilayhinna wa-akun mmina al-jāhilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Joseph said, ‘My Lord! I would prefer prison to what these women are calling me to do. If You do not protect me from their treachery, I shall yield to them and do wrong,’
verses.pickthall: He said: O my Lord! Prison is more dear than that unto which they urge me, and if Thou fend not off their wiles from me I shall incline unto them and become of the foolish.

verses.ar: فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥ فَصَرَفَ عَنْهُ كَيْدَهُنَّ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: So his Lord responded to him and averted from him their plan. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.tr: fāstajāba lahu rabbuhu faṣarafa ʿanhu kaydahunna ۚ ʾinnahu huwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: and his Lord answered his prayer and protected him from their treachery- He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
verses.pickthall: So his Lord heard his prayer and fended off their wiles from him. Lo! He is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُۥ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: Then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs that he [i.e., al-ʿAzeez] should surely imprison him for a time.
verses.tr: thumma badā lahum mmin baʿdi mā raʾawā al-āyāti layasjununnahu ḥattā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: In the end they thought it best, after seeing all the signs of his innocence, that they should imprison him for a while.
verses.pickthall: And it seemed good to them (the men-folk) after they had seen the signs (of his innocence) to imprison him for a time.

verses.ar: وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ ٱلسِّجْنَ فَتَيَانِ ۖ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَآ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰنِىٓ أَعْصِرُ خَمْرًا ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرُ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰنِىٓ أَحْمِلُ فَوْقَ رَأْسِى خُبْزًا تَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّيْرُ مِنْهُ ۖ نَبِّئْنَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّا نَرَىٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And there entered the prison with him two young men. One of them said, "Indeed, I have seen myself [in a dream] pressing [grapes for] wine." The other said, "Indeed, I have seen myself carrying upon my head [some] bread, from which the birds were eating. Inform us of its interpretation; indeed, we see you to be of those who do good."
verses.tr: wadakhala maʿahu as-sijna fatayāni ۖ qāla ʾaḥaduhumā ʾinnā ʾarānā ʾaʿṣiru khamran ۖ waqāla al-ākharu ʾinnā ʾarānā ʾaḥmilu fawqa raʾsā khubzan taʾkulu aṭ-ṭayru minhu ۖ nabbiʾnā bitaʾwīlihi ۖ ʾinnā narāka mina al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Two young men went into prison alongside him. One of them said, ‘I dreamed that I was pressing grapes’; the other said, ‘I dreamed that I was carrying bread on my head and that the birds were eating it.’ [They said], ‘Tell us what this means- we can see that you are a knowledgeable man.’
verses.pickthall: And two young men went to prison with him. One of them said: I dreamed that I was pressing wine. The other said: I dreamed that I was carrying upon my head bread whereof the birds were eating. Announce unto us the interpretation, for we see thee of those good (at interpretation).

verses.ar: قَالَ لَا يَأْتِيكُمَا طَعَامٌ تُرْزَقَانِهِۦٓ إِلَّا نَبَّأْتُكُمَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِى رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنِّى تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: He said, "You will not receive food that is provided to you except that I will inform you of its interpretation before it comes to you. That is from what my Lord has taught me. Indeed, I have left the religion of a people who do not believe in Allāh, and they, in the Hereafter, are disbelievers.
verses.tr: qāla lā yaʾtīkumā ṭaʿāmun turzaqānihi ʾillā nabbaʾtukumā bitaʾwīlihi qabla ʾan yaʾtiyakumā ۚ dhālikumā mimmā ʿallamanā rabbā ۚ ʾinnā taraktu millaha qawmin llā yuʾminūna billāh wahum bi-l-ākhirahi hum kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘I can tell you what this means before any meal arrives: this is part of what my Lord has taught me. I reject the faith of those who disbelieve in God and deny the life to come,
verses.pickthall: He said: The food which ye are given (daily) shall not come unto you but I shall tell you the interpretation ere it cometh unto you. This is of that which my Lord hath taught me. Lo! I have forsaken the religion of folk who believe not in Allah and are disbelievers in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّبَعْتُ مِلَّةَ ءَابَآءِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۚ مَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نُّشْرِكَ بِٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And I have followed the religion of my fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. And it was not for us to associate anything with Allāh. That is from the favor of Allāh upon us and upon the people, but most of the people are not grateful.
verses.tr: wāttabaʿtu millaha ābā ʾibrāhīma wa-isḥāqa wayaʿqūba ۚ mā kāna lanā ʾan nnushrika billāh min shāʾin ۚ dhālika min faḍli Allāh ʿalaynā waʿalā an-nāsi walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and I follow the faith of my forefathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Because of God’s grace to us and to all mankind, we would never worship anything beside God, but most people are ungrateful.
verses.pickthall: And I have followed the religion of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob. It never was for us to attribute aught as partner to Allah. This is of the bounty of Allah unto us (the seed of Abraham) and unto mankind; but most men give not thanks.

verses.ar: يَـٰصَـٰحِبَىِ ٱلسِّجْنِ ءَأَرْبَابٌ مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيْرٌ أَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.en: O [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or Allāh, the One, the Prevailing?
verses.tr: yāṣāḥibāi as-sijni ʾaʾarbābun mmutafarriqūna khayrun ʾami Allāh al-wāḥidu al-qahhāru
verses.abdelhaleem: Fellow prisoners, would many diverse gods be better than God the One, the All Powerful? [No indeed!]
verses.pickthall: O my fellow-prisoners! Are divers lords better, or Allah the One, Almighty?

verses.ar: مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءً سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ ۚ أَمَرَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: You worship not besides Him except [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allāh has sent down no evidence. Legislation is not but for Allāh. He has commanded that you worship not except Him. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.
verses.tr: mā taʿbudūna min dūnihi ʾillā ʾasmāʾan sammaytumūhā ʾantum wabāʾukum mmā ʾanzala Allāh bihā min sulṭānin ۚ ʾini al-ḥukmu ʾillā lillāh ۚ ʾamara ʾallā taʿbudūā ʾillā ʾiyyāhu ۚ dhālika ad-dīnu al-qayyimu walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: All those you worship instead of Him are mere names you and your forefathers have invented, names for which God has sent down no sanction. Authority belongs to God alone, and He orders you to worship none but Him: this is the true faith, though most people do not realize it.
verses.pickthall: Those whom ye worship beside Him are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers. Allah hath revealed no sanction for them. The decision rests with Allah only, Who hath commanded you that ye worship none save Him. This is the right religion, but most men know not.

verses.ar: يَـٰصَـٰحِبَىِ ٱلسِّجْنِ أَمَّآ أَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسْقِى رَبَّهُۥ خَمْرًا ۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلْـَٔاخَرُ فَيُصْلَبُ فَتَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّيْرُ مِن رَّأْسِهِۦ ۚ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ تَسْتَفْتِيَانِ
verses.en: O two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine; but as for the other, he will be crucified, and the birds will eat from his head. The matter has been decreed about which you both inquire."
verses.tr: yāṣāḥibāi as-sijni ʾammā ʾaḥadukumā fayasqā rabbahu khamran ۖ wa-ammā al-ākharu fayuṣlabu fataʾkulu aṭ-ṭayru min rraʾsihi ۚ quḍāa al-ʾamru adh-dhā fīhi tastaftiyāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Fellow prisoners, one of you will serve his master with wine; the other will be crucified and the birds will peck at his head. That is the end of the matter on which you asked my opinion.’
verses.pickthall: O my two fellow-prisoners! As for one of you, he will pour out wine for his lord to drink; and as for the other, he will be crucified so that the birds will eat from his head. Thus is the case judged concerning which ye did inquire.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ لِلَّذِى ظَنَّ أَنَّهُۥ نَاجٍ مِّنْهُمَا ٱذْكُرْنِى عِندَ رَبِّكَ فَأَنسَىٰهُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ذِكْرَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِى ٱلسِّجْنِ بِضْعَ سِنِينَ
verses.en: And he said to the one whom he knew would go free, "Mention me before your master." But Satan made him forget the mention [to] his master, and he [i.e., Joseph] remained in prison several years.
verses.tr: waqāla lilladhā ẓanna ʾannahu nājin mminhumā ādhkurnā ʿinda rabbika fa-ansāhu ash-shayṭānu dhikra rabbihi falabitha fā as-sijni biḍʿa sinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Joseph said to the one he knew would be saved, ‘Mention me to your master,’ but Satan made him forget to do this, and so Joseph remained in prison for a number of years.
verses.pickthall: And he said unto him of the twain who he knew would be released: Mention me in the presence of thy lord. But Satan caused him to forget to mention it to his lord, so he (Joseph) stayed in prison for some years.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلِكُ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ سَبْعَ بَقَرَٰتٍ سِمَانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ وَسَبْعَ سُنۢبُلَـٰتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَـٰتٍ ۖ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِى فِى رُءْيَـٰىَ إِن كُنتُمْ لِلرُّءْيَا تَعْبُرُونَ
verses.en: And [subsequently] the king said, "Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry. O eminent ones, explain to me my vision, if you should interpret visions."
verses.tr: waqāla al-maliku ʾinnā ʾarā sabʿa baqarātin simānin yaʾkuluhunna sabʿun ʿijāfun wasabʿa sunbulātin khuḍrin wa-ukhara yābisātin ۖ yāʾayyuhā al-malaʾu ʾaftūnā fā ruʾyāa ʾin kuntum lilrruʾyā taʿburūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The king said, ‘I dreamed about seven fat cows being eaten by seven lean ones; seven green ears of corn and [seven] others withered. Counsellors, if you can interpret dreams, tell me the meaning of my dream.’
verses.pickthall: And the king said: Lo! I saw in a dream seven fat kine which seven lean were eating, and seven green ears of corn and other (seven) dry. O notables! Expound for me my vision, if ye can interpret dreams.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَـٰثُ أَحْلَـٰمٍ ۖ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحْلَـٰمِ بِعَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "[It is but] a mixture of false dreams, and we are not learned in the interpretation of dreams."
verses.tr: qālūā ʾaḍghāthu ʾaḥlāmin ۖ wamā naḥnu bitaʾwīli al-ʾaḥlāmi biʿālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘These are confusing dreams and we are not skilled at dream-interpretation,’
verses.pickthall: They answered: Jumbled dreams! And we are not knowing in the interpretation of dreams.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى نَجَا مِنْهُمَا وَٱدَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ أَنَا۠ أُنَبِّئُكُم بِتَأْوِيلِهِۦ فَأَرْسِلُونِ
verses.en: But the one who was freed and remembered after a time said, "I will inform you of its interpretation, so send me forth."
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhā najā minhumā wāddakara baʿda ʾummahin ʾanā ʾunabbiʾukum bitaʾwīlihi fa-arsilūni
verses.abdelhaleem: but the prisoner who had been freed at last remembered [Joseph] and said, ‘I shall tell you what this means. Give me leave to go.’
verses.pickthall: And he of the two who was released, and (now) at length remembered, said: I am going to announce unto you the interpretation, therefore send me forth.

verses.ar: يُوسُفُ أَيُّهَا ٱلصِّدِّيقُ أَفْتِنَا فِى سَبْعِ بَقَرَٰتٍ سِمَانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ وَسَبْعِ سُنۢبُلَـٰتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَـٰتٍ لَّعَلِّىٓ أَرْجِعُ إِلَى ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: [He said], "Joseph, O man of truth, explain to us about seven fat cows eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry - that I may return to the people [i.e., the king and his court]; perhaps they will know [about you]."
verses.tr: yūsufu ʾayyuhā aṣ-ṣiddīqu ʾaftinā fā sabʿi baqarātin simānin yaʾkuluhunna sabʿun ʿijāfun wasabʿi sunbulātin khuḍrin wa-ukhara yābisātin llaʿallā ʾarjiʿu ʾilā an-nāsi laʿallahum yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Truthful Joseph! Tell us the meaning of seven fat cows being eaten by seven lean ones, seven green ears of corn and [seven] others withered,
verses.pickthall: (And when he came to Joseph in the prison, he exclaimed): Joseph! O thou truthful one! Expound for us the seven fat kine which seven lean were eating and the seven green ears of corn and other (seven) dry, that I may return unto the people, so that they may know.

verses.ar: قَالَ تَزْرَعُونَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ دَأَبًا فَمَا حَصَدتُّمْ فَذَرُوهُ فِى سُنۢبُلِهِۦٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: [Joseph] said, "You will plant for seven years consecutively; and what you harvest leave in its spikes, except a little from which you will eat.
verses.tr: qāla tazraʿūna sabʿa sinīna daʾaban famā ḥaṣadttum fadharūhu fā sunbulihi ʾillā qalīlan mmimmā taʾkulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: then I can return to the people to inform them.’ Joseph said, ‘You will sow for seven consecutive years as usual. Store all that you reap, left in the ear, apart from the little you eat.
verses.pickthall: He said: Ye shall sow seven years as usual, but that which ye reap, leave it in the ear, all save a little which ye eat.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ سَبْعٌ شِدَادٌ يَأْكُلْنَ مَا قَدَّمْتُمْ لَهُنَّ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّا تُحْصِنُونَ
verses.en: Then will come after that seven difficult [years] which will consume what you advanced [i.e., saved] for them, except a little from which you will store.
verses.tr: thumma yaʾtā min baʿdi dhālika sabʿun shidādun yaʾkulna mā qaddamtum lahunna ʾillā qalīlan mmimmā tuḥṣinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: After that will come seven years of hardship which will consume all but a little of what you stored up for them;
verses.pickthall: Then after that will come seven hard years which will devour all that ye have prepared for them, save a little of that which ye have stored.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَامٌ فِيهِ يُغَاثُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعْصِرُونَ
verses.en: Then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press [olives and grapes]."
verses.tr: thumma yaʾtā min baʿdi dhālika ʿāmun fīhi yughāthu an-nāsu wafīhi yaʿṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: after that will come a year when the people will have abundant rain and will press grapes.’
verses.pickthall: Then, after that, will come a year when the people will have plenteous crops and when they will press (wine and oil).

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱئْتُونِى بِهِۦ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُ ٱلرَّسُولُ قَالَ ٱرْجِعْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَسْـَٔلْهُ مَا بَالُ ٱلنِّسْوَةِ ٱلَّـٰتِى قَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى بِكَيْدِهِنَّ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And the king said, "Bring him to me." But when the messenger came to him, [Joseph] said, "Return to your master and ask him what is the case of the women who cut their hands. Indeed, my Lord is Knowing of their plan."
verses.tr: waqāla al-maliku āʾtūnā bihi ۖ falammā jāʾahu ar-rasūlu qāla ārjiʿ ʾilā rabbika faslhu mā bālu an-niswahi at-tā qaṭṭaʿna ʾaydiyahunna ۚ ʾinna rabbā bikaydihinna ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: The king said, ‘Bring him to me,’ but when the messenger came to fetch Joseph, he said, ‘Go back to your master and ask him about what happened to those women who cut their hands- my Lord knows all about their treachery.’
verses.pickthall: And the king said: Bring him unto me. And when the messenger came unto him, he (Joseph) said: Return unto thy lord and ask him what was the case of the women who cut their hands. Lo! my Lord knoweth their guile.

verses.ar: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful.
verses.tr: qāla mā khaṭbukunna ʾidh rāwadttunna yūsufa ʿan nnafsihi ۚ qulna ḥāsha lillāh mā ʿalimnā ʿalayhi min sūʾin ۚ qālati āmraʾatu al-ʿazīzi al-na ḥaṣḥaṣa al-ḥaqqu ʾanā rāwadttuhu ʿan nnafsihi wa-innahu lamina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The king asked the women, ‘What happened when you tried to seduce Joseph?’ They said, ‘God forbid! We know nothing bad of him!’ and the governor’s wife said, ‘Now the truth is out: it was I who tried to seduce him- he is an honest man.’
verses.pickthall: He (the king) (then sent for those women and) said: What happened when ye asked an evil act of Joseph? They answered: Allah Blameless! We know no evil of him. Said the wife of the ruler: Now the truth is out. I asked of him an evil act, and he is surely of the truthful.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ لِيَعْلَمَ أَنِّى لَمْ أَخُنْهُ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى كَيْدَ ٱلْخَآئِنِينَ
verses.en: That is so he [i.e., al-ʿAzeez] will know that I did not betray him in [his] absence and that Allāh does not guide the plan of betrayers.
verses.tr: dhālika liyaʿlama ʾannā lam ʾakhunhu bi-l-ghaybi wa-anna Allāh lā yahdā kayda al-khāʾinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Joseph said, ‘This was] for my master to know that I did not betray him behind his back: God does not guide the mischief of the treacherous.
verses.pickthall: (Then Joseph said: I asked for) this, that he (my lord) may know that I betrayed him not in secret, and that surely Allah guideth not the snare of the betrayers.

verses.ar: ۞ وَمَآ أُبَرِّئُ نَفْسِىٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلنَّفْسَ لَأَمَّارَةٌۢ بِٱلسُّوٓءِ إِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And I do not acquit myself. Indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon which my Lord has mercy. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.tr: ۞ wamā ʾubarriʾu nafsā ۚ ʾinna an-nafsa laʾammārahun bi-as-sūʾi ʾillā mā raḥima rabbā ۚ ʾinna rabbā ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: I do not pretend to be blameless, for man’s very soul incites him to evil unless my Lord shows mercy: He is most forgiving, most merciful.’
verses.pickthall: I do not exculpate myself. Lo! the (human) soul enjoineth unto evil, save that whereon my Lord hath mercy. Lo! my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱئْتُونِى بِهِۦٓ أَسْتَخْلِصْهُ لِنَفْسِى ۖ فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهُۥ قَالَ إِنَّكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ لَدَيْنَا مَكِينٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: And the king said, "Bring him to me; I will appoint him exclusively for myself." And when he spoke to him, he said, "Indeed, you are today established [in position] and trusted."
verses.tr: waqāla al-maliku āʾtūnā bihi ʾastakhliṣhu linafsā ۖ falammā kallamahu qāla ʾinnaka al-yawma ladaynā makīnun ʾamīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: The king said, ‘Bring him to me: I will have him serve me personally,’ and then, once he had spoken with him, ‘From now on you will have our trust and favour.’
verses.pickthall: And the king said: Bring him unto me that I may attach him to my person. And when he had talked with him he said: Lo! thou art to-day in our presence established and trusted.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱجْعَلْنِى عَلَىٰ خَزَآئِنِ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنِّى حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: [Joseph] said, "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian."
verses.tr: qāla ājʿalnā ʿalā khazāʾini al-ʾarḍi ۖ ʾinnā ḥafīẓun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Joseph said, ‘Put me in charge of the nation’s storehouses: I shall manage them prudently and carefully.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Set me over the storehouses of the land. Lo! I am a skilled custodian.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَتَبَوَّأُ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ يَشَآءُ ۚ نُصِيبُ بِرَحْمَتِنَا مَن نَّشَآءُ ۖ وَلَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And thus We established Joseph in the land to settle therein wherever he willed. We touch with Our mercy whom We will, and We do not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
verses.tr: wakadhālika makkannā liyūsufa fā al-ʾarḍi yatabawwaʾu minhā ḥaythu yashāʾu ۚ nuṣību biraḥmatinā man nnashāʾu ۖ walā nuḍīʿu ʾajra al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way We settled Joseph in that land to live wherever he wished: We grant Our mercy to whoever We will and do not fail to reward those who do good.
verses.pickthall: Thus gave We power to Joseph in the land. He was the owner of it where he pleased. We reach with Our mercy whom We will. We lose not the reward of the good.

verses.ar: وَلَأَجْرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And the reward of the Hereafter is better for those who believed and were fearing Allāh.
verses.tr: walaʾajru al-ākhirahi khayrun llilladhīna āmanūā wakānūā yattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The reward of the Hereafter is best for those who believe and are mindful of God.
verses.pickthall: And the reward of the Hereafter is better, for those who believe and ward off (evil).

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ فَدَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَعَرَفَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.en: And the brothers of Joseph came [seeking food], and they entered upon him; and he recognized them, but he was to them unknown.
verses.tr: wajāʾa ʾikhwahu yūsufa fadakhalūā ʿalayhi faʿarafahum wahum lahu munkirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Joseph’s brothers came and presented themselves before him. He recognized them- though they did not recognize him-
verses.pickthall: And Joseph's brethren came and presented themselves before him, and he knew them but they knew him not.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ قَالَ ٱئْتُونِى بِأَخٍ لَّكُم مِّنْ أَبِيكُمْ ۚ أَلَا تَرَوْنَ أَنِّىٓ أُوفِى ٱلْكَيْلَ وَأَنَا۠ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
verses.en: And when he had furnished them with their supplies, he said, "Bring me a brother of yours from your father. Do you not see that I give full measure and that I am the best of accommodators?
verses.tr: walammā jahhazahum bijahāzihim qāla āʾtūnā biʾakhin llakum mmin ʾabīkum ۚ ʾalā tarawna ʾannā ʾūfā al-kayla wa-anā khayru al-munzilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and once he had given them their provisions, he said, ‘Bring me the brother [you left with] your father! Have you not seen me giving generous measure and being the best of hosts?
verses.pickthall: And when he provided them with their provision he said: Bring unto me a brother of yours from your father. See ye not that I fill up the measure and I am the best of hosts?

verses.ar: فَإِن لَّمْ تَأْتُونِى بِهِۦ فَلَا كَيْلَ لَكُمْ عِندِى وَلَا تَقْرَبُونِ
verses.en: But if you do not bring him to me, no measure will there be [hereafter] for you from me, nor will you approach me."
verses.tr: fa-in llam taʾtūnā bihi falā kayla lakum ʿindā walā taqrabūni
verses.abdelhaleem: You will have no more corn from me if you do not bring him to me, and you will not be permitted to approach me.’
verses.pickthall: And if ye bring him not unto me, then there shall be no measure for you with me, nor shall ye draw near.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سَنُرَٰوِدُ عَنْهُ أَبَاهُ وَإِنَّا لَفَـٰعِلُونَ
verses.en: They said, "We will attempt to dissuade his father from [keeping] him, and indeed, we will do [it]."
verses.tr: qālūā sanurāwidu ʿanhu ʾabāhu wa-innā lafāʿilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We shall do all we can to persuade his father to send him with us, indeed we shall.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We will try to win him from his father: that we will surely do.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ لِفِتْيَـٰنِهِ ٱجْعَلُوا۟ بِضَـٰعَتَهُمْ فِى رِحَالِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْرِفُونَهَآ إِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And [Joseph] said to his servants, "Put their merchandise into their saddlebags so they might recognize it when they have gone back to their people that perhaps they will [again] return."
verses.tr: waqāla lifityānihi ājʿalūā biḍāʿatahum fā riḥālihim laʿallahum yaʿrifūnahā ʾidhā ānqalabūā ʾilā ʾahlihim laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Joseph said to his servants, ‘Put their [traded] goods back into their saddlebags, so that they may recognize them when they go back to their family, and [be eager to] return.’
verses.pickthall: He said unto his young men: Place their merchandise in their saddlebags, so that they may know it when they go back to their folk, and so will come again.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِيهِمْ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَبَانَا مُنِعَ مِنَّا ٱلْكَيْلُ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَآ أَخَانَا نَكْتَلْ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
verses.en: So when they returned to their father, they said, "O our father, [further] measure has been denied to us, so send with us our brother [that] we will be given measure. And indeed, we will be his guardians."
verses.tr: falammā rajaʿūā ʾilā ʾabīhim qālūā yāʾabānā muniʿa minnā al-kaylu fa-arsil maʿanā ʾakhānā naktal wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they returned to their father, they said, ‘Father, we have been denied any more corn, but send our brother back with us and we shall be given another measure. We shall guard him carefully.’
verses.pickthall: So when they went back to their father they said: O our father! The measure is denied us, so send with us our brother that we may obtain the measure, surely we will guard him well.

verses.ar: قَالَ هَلْ ءَامَنُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا كَمَآ أَمِنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَخِيهِ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَـٰفِظًا ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.en: He said, "Should I entrust you with him except [under coercion] as I entrusted you with his brother before? But Allāh is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful."
verses.tr: qāla hal āmanukum ʿalayhi ʾillā kamā ʾamintukum ʿalā ʾakhīhi min qablu ۖ fa-Allāh khayrun ḥāfiẓan ۖ wahuwa ʾarḥamu ar-rāḥimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Am I to entrust him to you as I did his brother before? God is the best guardian and the Most Merciful of the merciful.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Can I entrust him to you save as I entrusted his brother to you aforetime? Allah is better at guarding, and He is the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوا۟ مَتَـٰعَهُمْ وَجَدُوا۟ بِضَـٰعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَبَانَا مَا نَبْغِى ۖ هَـٰذِهِۦ بِضَـٰعَتُنَا رُدَّتْ إِلَيْنَا ۖ وَنَمِيرُ أَهْلَنَا وَنَحْفَظُ أَخَانَا وَنَزْدَادُ كَيْلَ بَعِيرٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ كَيْلٌ يَسِيرٌ
verses.en: And when they opened their baggage, they found their merchandise returned to them. They said, "O our father, what [more] could we desire? This is our merchandise returned to us. And we will obtain supplies [i.e., food] for our family and protect our brother and obtain an increase of a camel's load; that is an easy measurement."
verses.tr: walammā fataḥūā matāʿahum wajadūā biḍāʿatahum ruddat ʾilayhim ۖ qālūā yāʾabānā mā nabghā ۖ hādhihi biḍāʿatunā ruddat ʾilaynā ۖ wanamīru ʾahlanā wanaḥfaẓu ʾakhānā wanazdādu kayla baʿīrin ۖ dhālika kaylun yasīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Then, when they opened their packs, they discovered that their goods had been returned to them and they said, ‘Father! We need no more [goods to barter]: look, our goods have been returned to us. We shall get corn for our household; we shall keep our brother safe; we shall be entitled to another camel-load of grain- an extra measure so easily achieved!’
verses.pickthall: And when they opened their belongings they discovered that their merchandise had been returned to them. They said: O our father! What (more) can we ask? Here is our merchandise returned to us. We shall get provision for our folk and guard our brother, and we shall have the extra measure of a camel (load). This (that we bring now) is a light measure.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَنْ أُرْسِلَهُۥ مَعَكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تُؤْتُونِ مَوْثِقًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لَتَأْتُنَّنِى بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يُحَاطَ بِكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَوْهُ مَوْثِقَهُمْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ
verses.en: [Jacob] said, "Never will I send him with you until you give me a promise [i.e., oath] by Allāh that you will bring him [back] to me, unless you should be surrounded [i.e., overcome by enemies]." And when they had given their promise, he said, "Allāh, over what we say, is Entrusted."
verses.tr: qāla lan ʾursilahu maʿakum ḥattā tuʾtūni mawthiqan mmina Allāh lataʾtunnanā bihi ʾillā ʾan yuḥāṭa bikum ۖ falammā ātawhu mawthiqahum qāla Allāh ʿalā mā naqūlu wakīlun
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘I will never send him with you, not unless you swear by God that you will bring him back to me if that is humanly possible.’ Then, when they had given him their pledge, he said, ‘Our words are entrusted to God.’
verses.pickthall: He said: I will not send him with you till ye give me an undertaking in the name of Allah that ye will bring him back to me, unless ye are surrounded. And when they gave him their undertaking he said: Allah is the Warden over what we say.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ يَـٰبَنِىَّ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ مِنۢ بَابٍ وَٰحِدٍ وَٱدْخُلُوا۟ مِنْ أَبْوَٰبٍ مُّتَفَرِّقَةٍ ۖ وَمَآ أُغْنِى عَنكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَعَلَيْهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
verses.en: And he said, "O my sons, do not enter from one gate but enter from different gates; and I cannot avail you against [the decree of] Allāh at all. The decision is only for Allāh; upon Him I have relied, and upon Him let those who would rely [indeed] rely."
verses.tr: waqāla yābanāa lā tadkhulūā min bābin wāḥidin wādkhulūā min ʾabwābin mmutafarriqahin ۖ wamā ʾughnā ʿankum mmina Allāh min shāʾin ۖ ʾini al-ḥukmu ʾillā lillāh ۖ ʿalayhi tawakkaltu ۖ waʿalayhi falyatawakkali al-mutawakkilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My sons, do not enter all by one gate- use different gates. But I cannot help you against the will of God: all power is in God’s hands. I trust in Him; let everyone put their trust in Him,’
verses.pickthall: And he said: O my sons! Go not in by one gate; go in by different gates. I can naught avail you as against Allah. Lo! the decision rests with Allah only. In Him do I put my trust, and in Him let all the trusting put their trust.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَهُمْ أَبُوهُم مَّا كَانَ يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا حَاجَةً فِى نَفْسِ يَعْقُوبَ قَضَىٰهَا ۚ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذُو عِلْمٍ لِّمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And when they entered from where their father had ordered them, it did not avail them against Allāh at all except [it was] a need [i.e., concern] within the soul of Jacob, which he satisfied. And indeed, he was a possessor of knowledge because of what We had taught him, but most of the people do not know.
verses.tr: walammā dakhalūā min ḥaythu ʾamarahum ʾabūhum mmā kāna yughnā ʿanhum mmina Allāh min shāʾin ʾillā ḥājahan fā nafsi yaʿqūba qaḍāhā ۚ wa-innahu ladhū ʿilmin llimā ʿallamnāhu walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and, when they entered as their father had told them, it did not help them against the will of God, it merely satisfied a wish of Jacob’s. He knew well what We had taught him, though most people do not.
verses.pickthall: And when they entered in the manner which their father had enjoined, it would have naught availed them as against Allah; it was but a need of Jacob's soul which he thus satisfied; and lo! he was a lord of knowledge because We had taught him; but most of mankind know not.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَخَاهُ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ أَخُوكَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his brother to himself; he said, "Indeed, I am your brother, so do not despair over what they used to do [to me]."
verses.tr: walammā dakhalūā ʿalā yūsufa āwā ʾilayhi ʾakhāhu ۖ qāla ʾinnā ʾanā ʾakhūka falā tabtaʾis bimā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then, when they presented themselves before Joseph, he drew his brother apart and said, ‘I am your brother, so do not be saddened by their past actions,’
verses.pickthall: And when they went in before Joseph, he took his brother unto him, saying: Lo! I, even I, am thy brother, therefore sorrow not for what they did.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ جَعَلَ ٱلسِّقَايَةَ فِى رَحْلِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ أَيَّتُهَا ٱلْعِيرُ إِنَّكُمْ لَسَـٰرِقُونَ
verses.en: So when he had furnished them with their supplies, he put the [gold measuring] bowl into the bag of his brother. Then an announcer called out, "O caravan, indeed you are thieves."
verses.tr: falammā jahhazahum bijahāzihim jaʿala as-siqāyaha fā raḥli ʾakhīhi thumma ʾadhana muʾadhinun ʾayyatuhā al-ʿīru ʾinnakum lasāriqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and, once he had given them their provisions, he placed the drinking-cup in his brother’s pack. A man called out, ‘People of the caravan! You are thieves!’
verses.pickthall: And when he provided them with their provision, he put the drinking-cup in his brother's saddlebag, and then a crier cried: O camel-riders! Lo! ye are surely thieves!

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ وَأَقْبَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِم مَّاذَا تَفْقِدُونَ
verses.en: They said while approaching them, "What is it you are missing?"
verses.tr: qālūā wa-aqbalūā ʿalayhim mmādhā tafqidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they turned and said, ‘What have you lost?’
verses.pickthall: They cried, coming toward them: What is it ye have lost?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ نَفْقِدُ صُوَاعَ ٱلْمَلِكِ وَلِمَن جَآءَ بِهِۦ حِمْلُ بَعِيرٍ وَأَنَا۠ بِهِۦ زَعِيمٌ
verses.en: They said, "We are missing the measure of the king. And for he who produces it is [the reward of] a camel's load, and I am responsible for it."
verses.tr: qālūā nafqidu ṣuwāʿa al-maliki waliman jāʾa bihi ḥimlu baʿīrin wa-anā bihi zaʿīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: They replied, ‘The king’s drinking-cup is missing,’ and, ‘Whoever returns it will get a camel-load [of grain],’ and, ‘I give you my word.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We have lost the king's cup, and he who bringeth it shall have a camel-load, and I (said Joseph) am answerable for it.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا جِئْنَا لِنُفْسِدَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كُنَّا سَـٰرِقِينَ
verses.en: They said, "By Allāh, you have certainly known that we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we have not been thieves."
verses.tr: qālūā tallāh laqad ʿalimtum mmā jiʾnā linufsida fā al-ʾarḍi wamā kunnā sāriqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘By God! You must know that we did not come to make mischief in your land: we are no thieves.’
verses.pickthall: They said: By Allah, well ye know we came not to do evil in the land, and are no thieves.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ فَمَا جَزَٰٓؤُهُۥٓ إِن كُنتُمْ كَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: They [the accusers] said, "Then what would be its recompense if you should be liars?"
verses.tr: qālūā famā jazāʾuhu ʾin kuntum kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They asked them, ‘And if we find that you are lying, what penalty shall we apply to you?’
verses.pickthall: They said: And what shall be the penalty for it, if ye prove liars?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ جَزَٰٓؤُهُۥ مَن وُجِدَ فِى رَحْلِهِۦ فَهُوَ جَزَٰٓؤُهُۥ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: [The brothers] said, "Its recompense is that he in whose bag it is found - he [himself] will be its recompense. Thus do we recompense the wrongdoers."
verses.tr: qālūā jazāʾuhu man wujida fā raḥlihi fahuwa jazāʾuhu ۚ kadhālika najzā aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they answered, ‘The penalty will be [the enslavement of] the person in whose bag the cup is found: this is how we punish wrongdoers.’
verses.pickthall: They said: The penalty for it! He in whose bag (the cup) is found, he is the penalty for it. Thus we requite wrong-doers.

verses.ar: فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَآءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِن وِعَآءِ أَخِيهِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ ۖ مَا كَانَ لِيَأْخُذَ أَخَاهُ فِى دِينِ ٱلْمَلِكِ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَـٰتٍ مَّن نَّشَآءُ ۗ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِى عِلْمٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: So he began [the search] with their bags before the bag of his brother; then he extracted it from the bag of his brother. Thus did We plan for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother within the religion [i.e., law] of the king except that Allāh willed. We raise in degrees whom We will, but over every possessor of knowledge is one [more] knowing.
verses.tr: fabadaʾa biʾawʿiyatihim qabla wiʿāʾi ʾakhīhi thumma āstakhrajahā min wiʿāʾi ʾakhīhi ۚ kadhālika kidnā liyūsufa ۖ mā kāna liyaʾkhudha ʾakhāhu fā dīni al-maliki ʾillā ʾan yashāʾa Allāh ۚ narfaʿu darajātin mman nnashāʾu ۗ wafawqa kulli dhā ʿilmin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Joseph] began by searching their bags, then his brother’s, and he pulled it out from his brother’s bag. In this way We devised a plan for Joseph- if God had not willed it so, he could not have detained his brother as a penalty under the king’s law- We raise the rank of whoever We will. Above everyone who has knowledge there is the One who is all knowing.
verses.pickthall: Then he (Joseph) began the search with their bags before his brother's bag, then he produced it from his brother's bag. Thus did We contrive for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother according to the king's law unless Allah willed. We raise by grades (of mercy) whom We will, and over every lord of knowledge there is one more knowing.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ إِن يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ فَأَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ أَنتُمْ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ
verses.en: They said, "If he steals - a brother of his has stolen before." But Joseph kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them. He said, "You are worse in position, and Allāh is most knowing of what you describe."
verses.tr: ۞ qālūā ʾin yasriq faqad saraqa ʾakhun llahu min qablu ۚ fa-asarrahā yūsufu fā nafsihi walam yubdihā lahum ۚ qāla ʾantum sharrun mmakānan ۖ wallāh ʾaʿlamu bimā taṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [His brothers] said, ‘If he is a thief then his brother was a thief before him,’ but Joseph kept his secrets and did not reveal anything to them. He said, ‘You are in a far worse situation. God knows best the truth of what you claim.’
verses.pickthall: They said: If he stealeth, a brother of his stole before. But Joseph kept it secret in his soul and revealed it not unto them. He said (within himself): Ye are in worse case, and Allah knoweth best (the truth of) that which ye allege.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُۥٓ أَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا فَخُذْ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُۥٓ ۖ إِنَّا نَرَىٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: They said, "O ʿAzeez, indeed he has a father [who is] an old man, so take one of us in place of him. Indeed, we see you as a doer of good."
verses.tr: qālūā yāʾayyuhā al-ʿazīzu ʾinna lahu ʾaban shaykhan kabīran fakhudh ʾaḥadanā makānahu ۖ ʾinnā narāka mina al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Mighty governor, he has an elderly father. Take one of us in his place. We can see that you are a very good man.’
verses.pickthall: They said: O ruler of the land! Lo! he hath a very aged father, so take one of us instead of him. Lo! we behold thee of those who do kindness.

verses.ar: قَالَ مَعَاذَ ٱللَّهِ أَن نَّأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَن وَجَدْنَا مَتَـٰعَنَا عِندَهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allāh [to prevent] that we take except him with whom we found our possession. Indeed, we would then be unjust."
verses.tr: qāla maʿādha Allāh ʾan nnaʾkhudha ʾillā man wajadnā matāʿanā ʿindahu ʾinnā ʾidhan llaẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He replied, ‘God forbid that we should take anyone other than the person on whom we found our property: that would be unjust of us.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Allah forbid that we should seize save him with whom we found our property; then truly we should be wrong-doers.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا ٱسْتَيْـَٔسُوا۟ مِنْهُ خَلَصُوا۟ نَجِيًّا ۖ قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ أَبَاكُمْ قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْكُم مَّوْثِقًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطتُمْ فِى يُوسُفَ ۖ فَلَنْ أَبْرَحَ ٱلْأَرْضَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْذَنَ لِىٓ أَبِىٓ أَوْ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ لِى ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verses.en: So when they had despaired of him, they secluded themselves in private consultation. The eldest of them said, "Do you not know that your father has taken upon you an oath by Allāh and [that] before you failed in [your duty to] Joseph? So I will never leave [this] land until my father permits me or Allāh decides for me, and He is the best of judges.
verses.tr: falammā āstaysūā minhu khalaṣūā najiyyan ۖ qāla kabīruhum ʾalam taʿlamūā ʾanna ʾabākum qad ʾakhadha ʿalaykum mmawthiqan mmina Allāh wamin qablu mā farraṭtum fā yūsufa ۖ falan ʾabraḥa al-ʾarḍa ḥattā yaʾdhana lā ʾabā ʾaw yaḥkuma Allāh lā ۖ wahuwa khayru al-ḥākimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they lost hope of [persuading] him, they withdrew to confer with each other: the eldest of them said, ‘Do you not remember that your father took a solemn pledge from you in the name of God and before that you failed in your duty with regard to Joseph? I will not leave this land until my father gives me leave or God decides for me- He is the best decider-
verses.pickthall: So, When they despaired of (moving) him, they conferred together apart. The eldest of them said: Know ye not how your father took an undertaking from you in Allah's name and how ye failed in the case of Joseph aforetime? Therefore I shall not go forth from the land until my father giveth leave or Allah judgeth for me. He is the Best of Judges.

verses.ar: ٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَبَانَآ إِنَّ ٱبْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَمَا شَهِدْنَآ إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَـٰفِظِينَ
verses.en: Return to your father and say, 'O our father, indeed your son has stolen, and we did not testify except to what we knew. And we were not witnesses of the unseen.
verses.tr: ārjiʿūā ʾilā ʾabīkum faqūlūā yāʾabānā ʾinna ābnaka saraqa wamā shahidnā ʾillā bimā ʿalimnā wamā kunnā lilghaybi ḥāfiẓīna
verses.abdelhaleem: so go back to your father and say, “Your son stole. We can only tell you what we saw. How could we guard against the unforeseen?
verses.pickthall: Return unto your father and say: O our father! Lo! thy son hath stolen. We testify only to that which we know; we are not guardians of the Unseen.

verses.ar: وَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ ٱلَّتِى كُنَّا فِيهَا وَٱلْعِيرَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا ۖ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
verses.en: And ask the city in which we were and the caravan in which we came - and indeed, we are truthful.'"
verses.tr: wasli al-qaryaha at-tā kunnā fīhā wa-l-ʿīra at-tā ʾaqbalnā fīhā ۖ wa-innā laṣādiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Ask in the town where we have been; ask the people of the caravan we travelled with: we are telling the truth.”’
verses.pickthall: Ask the township where we were, and the caravan with which we travelled hither. Lo! we speak the truth.

verses.ar: قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا ۖ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ ۖ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِيَنِى بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. Perhaps Allāh will bring them to me all together. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise."
verses.tr: qāla bal sawwalat lakum ʾanfusukum ʾamran ۖ faṣabrun jamīlun ۖ ʿasā Allāh ʾan yaʾtiyanā bihim jamīʿan ۚ ʾinnahu huwa al-ʿalīmu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Their father said, ‘No! Your souls have prompted you to do wrong! But it is best to be patient: may God bring all of them back to me- He alone is the All Knowing, the All Wise,’
verses.pickthall: (And when they came unto their father and had spoken thus to him) he said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience! It may be that Allah will bring them all unto me. Lo! He, only He, is the Knower, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.
verses.tr: watawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāʾasafā ʿalā yūsufa wābyaḍḍat ʿaynāhu mina al-ḥuzni fahuwa kaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: and he turned away from them, saying, ‘Alas for Joseph!’ His eyes went white with grief and he was filled with sorrow.
verses.pickthall: And he turned away from them and said: Alas, my grief for Joseph! And his eyes were whitened with the sorrow that he was suppressing.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا۟ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْهَـٰلِكِينَ
verses.en: They said, "By Allāh, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish."
verses.tr: qālūā tallāh taftaā tadhkuru yūsufa ḥattā takūna ḥaraḍan ʾaw takūna mina al-hālikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘By God! You will ruin your health if you do not stop thinking of Joseph, or even die.’
verses.pickthall: They said: By Allah, thou wilt never cease remembering Joseph till thy health is ruined or thou art of those who perish!

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnamā ʾashkūā bathā waḥuznā ʾilā Allāh wa-aʿlamu mina Allāh mā lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘I plead my grief and sorrow before God. I have knowledge from God that you do not have.
verses.pickthall: He said: I expose my distress and anguish only unto Allah, and I know from Allah that which ye know not.

verses.ar: يَـٰبَنِىَّ ٱذْهَبُوا۟ فَتَحَسَّسُوا۟ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allāh. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allāh except the disbelieving people."
verses.tr: yābanāa ādhhabūā fataḥassasūā min yūsufa wa-akhīhi walā tāysūā min rrawḥi Allāh ۖ ʾinnahu lā yāysu min rrawḥi Allāh ʾillā al-qawmu al-kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: My sons, go and seek news of Joseph and his brother and do not despair of God’s mercy- only disbelievers despair of God’s mercy.’
verses.pickthall: Go, O my sons, and ascertain concerning Joseph and his brother, and despair not of the Spirit of Allah. Lo! none despaireth of the Spirit of Allah save disbelieving folk.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا ٱلضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَـٰعَةٍ مُّزْجَىٰةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا ٱلْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَجْزِى ٱلْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ
verses.en: So when they entered upon him [i.e., Joseph], they said, "O ʿAzeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. Indeed, Allāh rewards the charitable."
verses.tr: falammā dakhalūā ʿalayhi qālūā yāʾayyuhā al-ʿazīzu massanā wa-ahlanā aḍ-ḍurru wajiʾnā bibiḍāʿahin mmuzjāhin fa-awfi lanā al-kayla wataṣaddaq ʿalaynā ۖ ʾinna Allāh yajzā al-mutaṣaddiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then, when they presented themselves before Joseph, they said, ‘Mighty governor, misfortune has afflicted us and our family. We have brought only a little merchandise, but give us full measure. Be charitable to us: God rewards the charitable.’
verses.pickthall: And when they came (again) before him (Joseph) they said: O ruler! Misfortune hath touched us and our folk, and we bring but poor merchandise, so fill for us the measure and be charitable unto us. Lo! Allah will requite the charitable,

verses.ar: قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا فَعَلْتُم بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنتُمْ جَـٰهِلُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?"
verses.tr: qāla hal ʿalimtum mmā faʿaltum biyūsufa wa-akhīhi ʾidh ʾantum jāhilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Do you now realize what you did to Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?’
verses.pickthall: He said: Know ye what ye did unto Joseph and his brother in your ignorance?

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ يُوسُفُ ۖ قَالَ أَنَا۠ يُوسُفُ وَهَـٰذَآ أَخِى ۖ قَدْ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Are you indeed Joseph?" He said, "I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allāh has certainly favored us. Indeed, he who fears Allāh and is patient, then indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good."
verses.tr: qālūā ʾaʾinnaka laʾanta yūsufu ۖ qāla ʾanā yūsufu wahādhā ʾakhā ۖ qad manna Allāh ʿalaynā ۖ ʾinnahu man yattaqi wayaṣbir fa-inna Allāh lā yuḍīʿu ʾajra al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they cried, ‘Could it be that you are Joseph?’ He said, ‘I am Joseph. This is my brother. God has been gracious to us: God does not deny anyone who is mindful of God and steadfast in adversity the rewards of those who do good.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Is it indeed thou who art Joseph? He said: I am Joseph and this is my brother. Allah hath shown us favour. Lo! he who wardeth off (evil) and endureth (findeth favour); for lo! Allah loseth not the wages of the kindly.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَـٰطِـِٔينَ
verses.en: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners."
verses.tr: qālūā tallāh laqad ātharaka Allāh ʿalaynā wa-in kunnā lakhāṭīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘By God! God really did favour you over all of us and we were in the wrong!’
verses.pickthall: They said: By Allah, verily Allah hath preferred thee above us, and we were indeed sinful.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ يَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.en: He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. May Allāh forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful.
verses.tr: qāla lā tathrība ʿalaykumu al-yawma ۖ yaghfiru Allāh lakum ۖ wahuwa ʾarḥamu ar-rāḥimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but he said, ‘You will hear no reproaches today. May God forgive you: He is the Most Merciful of the merciful.
verses.pickthall: He said: Have no fear this day! May Allah forgive you, and He is the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.

verses.ar: ٱذْهَبُوا۟ بِقَمِيصِى هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ أَبِى يَأْتِ بَصِيرًا وَأْتُونِى بِأَهْلِكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. And bring me your family, all together."
verses.tr: ādhhabūā biqamīṣā hādhā fa-ʾalqūhu ʿalā wajhi ʾabā yaʾti baṣīran wa-tūnā biʾahlikum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Take my shirt and lay it over my father’s face: he will recover his sight. Then bring your whole family back to me.’
verses.pickthall: Go with this shirt of mine and lay it on my father's face, he will become (again) a seer; and come to me with all your folk.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ ٱلْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ إِنِّى لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ ۖ لَوْلَآ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ
verses.en: And when the caravan departed [from Egypt], their father said, "Indeed, I find the smell of Joseph [and would say that he was alive] if you did not think me weakened in mind."
verses.tr: walammā faṣalati al-ʿīru qāla ʾabūhum ʾinnā laʾajidu rīḥa yūsufa ۖ lawlā ʾan tufannidūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Later, when the caravan departed, their father said, ‘You may think I am senile but I can smell Joseph,’
verses.pickthall: When the caravan departed their father had said: Truly I am conscious of the breath of Joseph, though ye call me dotard.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلِكَ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
verses.en: They said, "By Allāh, indeed you are in your [same] old error."
verses.tr: qālūā tallāh ʾinnaka lafā ḍalālika al-qadīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: but [people] said, ‘By God! You are still lost in that old illusion of yours!’
verses.pickthall: (Those around him) said: By Allah, lo! thou art in thine old aberration.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?"
verses.tr: falammā ʾan jāʾa al-bashīru ʾalqāhu ʿalā wajhihi fārtadda baṣīran ۖ qāla ʾalam ʾaqul llakum ʾinnā ʾaʿlamu mina Allāh mā lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then, when the bearer of good news came and placed the shirt on to Jacob’s face, his eyesight returned and he said, ‘Did I not tell you that I have knowledge from God that you do not have?’
verses.pickthall: Then, when the bearer of glad tidings came, he laid it on his face and he became a seer once more. He said: Said I not unto you that I know from Allah that which ye know not?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَبَانَا ٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا خَـٰطِـِٔينَ
verses.en: They said, "O our father, ask for us forgiveness of our sins; indeed, we have been sinners."
verses.tr: qālūā yāʾabānā āstaghfir lanā dhunūbanā ʾinnā kunnā khāṭīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The [brothers] said, ‘Father, ask God to forgive our sins- we were truly in the wrong.’
verses.pickthall: They said: O our father! Ask forgiveness of our sins for us, for lo! we were sinful.

verses.ar: قَالَ سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: He said, "I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
verses.tr: qāla sawfa ʾastaghfiru lakum rabbā ۖ ʾinnahu huwa al-ghafūru ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: He replied, ‘I shall ask my Lord to forgive you: He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.’
verses.pickthall: He said: I shall ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مِصْرَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.en: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his parents to himself [i.e., embraced them] and said, "Enter Egypt, Allāh willing, safe [and secure]."
verses.tr: falammā dakhalūā ʿalā yūsufa āwā ʾilayhi ʾabawayhi waqāla ādkhulūā miṣra ʾin shāʾa Allāh āminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Later, when they presented themselves before Joseph, he drew his parents to him- he said, ‘Welcome to Egypt: you will all be safe here, God willing’-
verses.pickthall: And when they came in before Joseph, he took his parents unto him, and said: Come into Egypt safe, if Allah will!

verses.ar: وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوا۟ لَهُۥ سُجَّدًا ۖ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ هَـٰذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُءْيَـٰىَ مِن قَبْلُ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّى حَقًّا ۖ وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِىٓ إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِى مِنَ ٱلسِّجْنِ وَجَآءَ بِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْبَدْوِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن نَّزَغَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِىٓ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَطِيفٌ لِّمَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
