verses.en: And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration. And he said, "O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality. And He was certainly good to me when He took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after Satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. Indeed, my Lord is Subtle in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise.
verses.tr: warafaʿa ʾabawayhi ʿalā al-ʿarshi wakharrūā lahu sujjadan ۖ waqāla yāʾabati hādhā taʾwīlu ruʾyāa min qablu qad jaʿalahā rabbā ḥaqqan ۖ waqad ʾaḥsana bā ʾidh ʾakhrajanā mina as-sijni wajāʾa bikum mmina al-badwi min baʿdi ʾan nnazagha ash-shayṭānu baynā wabayna ʾikhwatā ۚ ʾinna rabbā laṭīfun llimā yashāʾu ۚ ʾinnahu huwa al-ʿalīmu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: and took them up to [his] throne. They all bowed down before him and he said, ‘Father, this is the fulfilment of that dream I had long ago. My Lord has made it come true and has been gracious to me- He released me from prison and He brought you here from the desert- after Satan sowed discord between me and my brothers. My Lord is most subtle in achieving what He will; He is the All Knowing, the Truly Wise.
verses.pickthall: And he placed his parents on the dais and they fell down before him prostrate, and he said: O my father! This is the interpretation of my dream of old. My Lord hath made it true, and He hath shown me kindness, since He took me out of the prison and hath brought you from the desert after Satan had made strife between me and my brethren. Lo! my Lord is tender unto whom He will. He is the Knower, the Wise.

verses.ar: ۞ رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِى مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."
verses.tr: ۞ rabbi qad ātaytanā mina al-mulki waʿallamtanā min taʾwīli al-ʾaḥādīthi ۚ fāṭira as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ʾanta walāi fā ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhirahi ۖ tawaffanā musliman wa-ʾalḥiqnā bi-aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: My Lord! You have given me authority; You have taught me something about the interpretation of dreams; Creator of the heavens and the earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Let me die in true devotion to You. Join me with the righteous.’
verses.pickthall: O my Lord! Thou hast given me (something) of sovereignty and hast taught me (something) of the interpretation of events - Creator of the heavens and the earth! Thou art my Protecting Guardian in the world and the Hereafter. Make me to die muslim (unto Thee), and join me to the righteous.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ
verses.en: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muḥammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired.
verses.tr: dhālika min ʾanbāʾi al-ghaybi nūḥīhi ʾilayka ۖ wamā kunta ladayhim ʾidh ʾajmaʿūā ʾamrahum wahum yamkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This account is part of what was beyond your knowledge [Muhammad]. We revealed it to you: you were not present with Joseph’s brothers when they made their treacherous plans.
verses.pickthall: This is of the tidings of the Unseen which We inspire in thee (Muhammad). Thou wast not present with them when they fixed their plan and they were scheming.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers.
verses.tr: wamā ʾaktharu an-nāsi walaw ḥaraṣta bimuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: However eagerly you may want them to, most men will not believe.
verses.pickthall: And though thou try much, most men will not believe.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And you do not ask of them for it any payment. It is not except a reminder to the worlds.
verses.tr: wamā tasluhum ʿalayhi min ʾajrin ۚ ʾin huwa ʾillā dhikrun llilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You ask no reward from them for this: it is a reminder for all people
verses.pickthall: Thou askest them no fee for it. It is naught else than a reminder unto the peoples.

verses.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away.
verses.tr: wakaʾayyin mmin āyahin fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi yamurrūna ʿalayhā wahum ʿanhā muʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and there are many signs in the heavens and the earth that they pass by and give no heed to-
verses.pickthall: How many a portent is there in the heavens and the earth which they pass by with face averted!

verses.ar: وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُم بِٱللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: And most of them believe not in Allāh except while they associate others with Him.
verses.tr: wamā yuʾminu ʾaktharuhum billāh ʾillā wahum mmushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: most of them will only believe in God while also joining others with Him.
verses.pickthall: And most of them believe not in Allah except that they attribute partners (unto Him).

verses.ar: أَفَأَمِنُوٓا۟ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ غَـٰشِيَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of Allāh or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive?
verses.tr: ʾafaʾaminūā ʾan taʾtiyahum ghāshiyahun mmin ʿadhābi Allāh ʾaw taʾtiyahumu as-sāʿahu baghtahan wahum lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Are they so sure that an overwhelming punishment from God will not fall on them, or that the Last Hour will not come upon them suddenly when they least expect it?
verses.pickthall: Deem they themselves secure from the coming on them of a pall of Allah's punishment, or the coming of the Hour suddenly while they are unaware?

verses.ar: قُلْ هَـٰذِهِۦ سَبِيلِىٓ أَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا۠ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِى ۖ وَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allāh with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allāh; and I am not of those who associate others with Him."
verses.tr: qul hādhihi sabīlā ʾadʿūā ʾilā Allāh ۚ ʿalā baṣīrahin ʾanā wamani āttabaʿanā ۖ wasubḥāna Allāh wamā ʾanā mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘This is my way: based on clear evidence, I, and all who follow me, call [people] to God- glory be to God!- I do not join others with Him.’
verses.pickthall: Say: This is my Way: I call on Allah with sure knowledge. I and whosoever followeth me - Glory be to Allah! - and I am not of the idolaters.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۗ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And We sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom We revealed from among the people of cities. So have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh; then will you not reason?
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnā min qablika ʾillā rijālan nnūḥā ʾilayhim mmin ʾahli al-qurā ۗ ʾafalam yasīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fayanẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu adh-dhīna min qablihim ۗ waladāru al-ākhirahi khayrun llilladhīna āttaqawā ۗ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: All the messengers We sent before you [Muhammad] were men to whom We made revelations, men chosen from the people of their towns. Have the [disbelievers] not travelled through the land and seen the end of those who went before them? For those who are mindful of God, the Home in the Hereafter is better. Do you [people] not use your reason?
verses.pickthall: We sent not before thee (any messengers) save men whom We inspired from among the folk of the townships - Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them? And verily the abode of the Hereafter, for those who ward off (evil), is best. Have ye then no sense? -

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ٱسْتَيْـَٔسَ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوا۟ جَآءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّىَ مَن نَّشَآءُ ۖ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُنَا عَنِ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: [They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals.
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā āstaysa ar-rusulu waẓannūā ʾannahum qad kudhibūā jāʾahum naṣrunā fanujjāa man nnashāʾu ۖ walā yuraddu baʾsunā ʿani al-qawmi al-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the messengers lost all hope and realized that they had been dismissed as liars, Our help came to them: We saved whoever We pleased, but Our punishment will not be turned away from guilty people.
verses.pickthall: Till, when the messengers despaired and thought that they were denied, then came unto them Our help, and whom We would was saved. And Our wrath cannot be warded from the guilty.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِى قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ ۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
verses.tr: laqad kāna fā qaṣaṣihim ʿibrahun lliʾūlā al-ʾalbābi ۗ mā kāna ḥadīthan yuftarā walākin taṣdīqa adh-dhā bayna yadayhi watafṣīla kulli shāʾin wahudanā waraḥmahan lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There is a lesson in the stories of such people for those who understand. This revelation is no fabrication: it is a confirmation of the truth of what was sent before it; an explanation of everything; a guide and a blessing for those who believe.
verses.pickthall: In their history verily there is a lesson for men of understanding. It is no invented story but a confirmation of the existing (Scripture) and a detailed explanation of everything, and a guidance and a mercy for folk who believe.

verses.ar: الٓمٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Meem, Rā. These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe.
verses.tr: al-mr ۚ tilka āyātu al-kitābi ۗ wa-adh-dhā ʾunzila ʾilayka min rrabbika al-ḥaqqu walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Mim Ra These are the signs of the Scripture. What your Lord has sent down to you [Prophet] is the truth, yet most people do not believe.
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the Truth, but most of mankind believe not.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى رَفَعَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّكُمْ تُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: It is Allāh who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then He established Himself above the Throne and made subject the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. He arranges [each] matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain.
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā rafaʿa as-samāwāti bighayri ʿamadin tarawnahā ۖ thumma āstawā ʿalā al-ʿarshi ۖ wasakhara ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara ۖ kullun yajrā liʾajalin mmusammanā ۚ yudabbiru al-ʾamra yufaṣṣilu al-āyāti laʿallakum biliqāʾi rabbikum tūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who raised up the heavens with no visible supports and then established Himself on the throne; He has subjected the sun and the moon each to pursue its course for an appointed time; He regulates all things, and makes the revelations clear so that you may be certain of meeting your Lord;
verses.pickthall: Allah it is Who raised up the heavens without visible supports, then mounted the Throne, and compelled the sun and the moon to be of service, each runneth unto an appointed term; He ordereth the course; He detaileth the revelations, that haply ye may be certain of the meeting with your Lord.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَدَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنْهَـٰرًا ۖ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ جَعَلَ فِيهَا زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ ۖ يُغْشِى ٱلَّيْلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits He made therein two mates; He causes the night to cover the day. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā madda al-ʾarḍa wajaʿala fīhā rawāsāa wa-anhāran ۖ wamin kulli ath-thamarāti jaʿala fīhā zawjayni āthnayni ۖ yughshā al-yla an-nahāra ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yatafakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who spread out the earth, placed firm mountains and rivers on it, and made two of every kind of fruit; He draws the veil of night over the day. There truly are signs in this for people who reflect.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who spread out the earth and placed therein firm hills and flowing streams, and of all fruits He placed therein two spouses (male and female). He covereth the night with the day. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought.

verses.ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قِطَعٌ مُّتَجَـٰوِرَٰتٌ وَجَنَّـٰتٌ مِّنْ أَعْنَـٰبٍ وَزَرْعٌ وَنَخِيلٌ صِنْوَانٌ وَغَيْرُ صِنْوَانٍ يُسْقَىٰ بِمَآءٍ وَٰحِدٍ وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعْضَهَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِى ٱلْأُكُلِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise, watered with one water; but We make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
verses.tr: wafā al-ʾarḍi qiṭaʿun mmutajāwirātun wajannātun mmin ʾaʿnābin wazarʿun wanakhīlun ṣinwānun waghayru ṣinwānin yusqā bimāʾin wāḥidin wanufaḍḍilu baʿḍahā ʿalā baʿḍin fā al-ʾukuli ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There are, in the land, neighbouring plots, gardens of vineyards, cornfields, palm trees in clusters or otherwise, all watered with the same water, yet We make some of them taste better than others: there truly are signs in this for people who reason.
verses.pickthall: And in the Earth are neighbouring tracts, vineyards and ploughed lands, and date-palms, like and unlike, which are watered with one water. And we have made some of them to excel others in fruit. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who have sense.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِن تَعْجَبْ فَعَجَبٌ قَوْلُهُمْ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَغْلَـٰلُ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: And if you are astonished, [O Muḥammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "When we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" Those are the ones who have disbelieved in their Lord, and those will have shackles upon their necks, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
verses.tr: ۞ wa-in taʿjab faʿajabun qawluhum ʾaʾidhā kunnā turāban ʾaʾinnā lafā khalqin jadīdin ۗ ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna kafarūā birabbihim ۖ wa-ūlāʾika al-ʾaghlālu fā ʾaʿnāqihim ۖ wa-ūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri ۖ hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If anything can amaze you [Prophet], then you should surely be amazed at their asking, ‘What? When we become dust, shall we be created anew?’ These are the ones who deny their Lord, who will wear iron collars around their necks and be the inhabitants of the Fire, there to remain.
verses.pickthall: And if thou wonderest, then wondrous is their saying: When we are dust, are we then forsooth (to be raised) in a new creation? Such are they who disbelieve in their Lord; such have carcans on their necks; such are rightful owners of the Fire, they will abide therein.

verses.ar: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِمُ ٱلْمَثُلَـٰتُ ۗ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلْمِهِمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.en: They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.
verses.tr: wayastaʿjilūnaka bi-as-sayyiʾahi qabla al-ḥasanahi waqad khalat min qablihimu al-mathulātu ۗ wa-inna rabbaka ladhū maghfirahin llilnnāsi ʿalā ẓulmihim ۖ wa-inna rabbaka lashadīdu al-ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: They ask you to bring on the punishment rather than any promised rewards, though there have been many examples before them––your Lord is full of forgiveness for people, despite their wrongdoing, but He is truly severe in punishment.
verses.pickthall: And they bid thee hasten on the evil rather than the good, when exemplary punishments have indeed occurred before them. But lo! thy Lord is rich in pardon for mankind despite their wrong, and lo! thy Lord is strong in punishment.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ
verses.en: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and for every people is a guide.
verses.tr: wayaqūlu adh-dhīna kafarūā lawlā ʾunzila ʿalayhi āyahun mmin rrabbihi ۗ ʾinnamā ʾanta mundhirun ۖ walikulli qawmin hādin
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers say, ‘Why has no miracle been sent down to him from his Lord?’ But you are only there to give warning: [earlier] communities each had their guide.
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve say: If only some portent were sent down upon him from his Lord! Thou art a warner only, and for every folk a guide.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنثَىٰ وَمَا تَغِيضُ ٱلْأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ ۖ وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ عِندَهُۥ بِمِقْدَارٍ
verses.en: Allāh knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. And everything with Him is by due measure.
verses.tr: Allāh yaʿlamu mā taḥmilu kullu ʾunthā wamā taghīḍu al-ʾarḥāmu wamā tazdādu ۖ wakullu shāʾin ʿindahu bimiqdārin
verses.abdelhaleem: God knows what every female bears and how much their wombs shrink or swell- everything has its measure with Him;
verses.pickthall: Allah knoweth that which every female beareth and that which the wombs absorb and that which they grow. And everything with Him is measured.

verses.ar: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ٱلْمُتَعَالِ
verses.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
verses.tr: ʿālimu al-ghaybi wa-ash-shahādahi al-kabīru al-mutaʿāli
verses.abdelhaleem: He knows what is not seen as well as what is seen; He is the Great, the Most High.
verses.pickthall: He is the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Great, the High Exalted.

verses.ar: سَوَآءٌ مِّنكُم مَّنْ أَسَرَّ ٱلْقَوْلَ وَمَن جَهَرَ بِهِۦ وَمَنْ هُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍۭ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَسَارِبٌۢ بِٱلنَّهَارِ
verses.en: It is the same [to Him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day.
verses.tr: sawāʾun mminkum mman ʾasarra al-qawla waman jahara bihi waman huwa mustakhfin bi-l-yli wasāribun bi-an-nahāri
verses.abdelhaleem: It makes no difference whether any of you speak secretly or aloud, whether you are hiding under cover of night or walking about in the day:
verses.pickthall: Alike of you is he who hideth the saying and he who noiseth it abroad, he who lurketh in the night and he who goeth freely in the daytime.

verses.ar: لَهُۥ مُعَقِّبَـٰتٌ مِّنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ يَحْفَظُونَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا۟ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ۗ وَإِذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ سُوٓءًا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَالٍ
verses.en: For him [i.e., each one] are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allāh intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.
verses.tr: lahu muʿaqqibātun mmin bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi yaḥfaẓūnahu min ʾamri Allāh ۗ ʾinna Allāh lā yughayyiru mā biqawmin ḥattā yughayyirūā mā biʾanfusihim ۗ wa-idhā ʾarāda Allāh biqawmin sūʾan falā maradda lahu ۚ wamā lahum mmin dūnihi min wālin
verses.abdelhaleem: each person has guardian angels before him and behind, watching over him by God’s command. God does not change the condition of a people [for the worse] unless they change what is in themselves, but if He wills harm on a people, no one can ward it off–– apart from Him, they have no protector.
verses.pickthall: For him are angels ranged before him and behind him, who guard him by Allah's command. Lo! Allah changeth not the condition of a folk until they (first) change that which is in their hearts; and if Allah willeth misfortune for a folk there is none that can repel it, nor have they a defender beside Him.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنشِئُ ٱلسَّحَابَ ٱلثِّقَالَ
verses.en: It is He who shows you lightning, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā yurīkumu al-barqa khawfan waṭamaʿan wayunshiʾu as-saḥāba ath-thiqāla
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who shows you the lightning, inspiring fear and hope; He builds up the clouds heavy with rain;
verses.pickthall: He it is Who showeth you the lightning, a fear and a hope, and raiseth the heavy clouds.

verses.ar: وَيُسَبِّحُ ٱلرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِۦ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُمْ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْمِحَالِ
verses.en: And the thunder exalts [Allāh] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allāh; and He is severe in assault.
verses.tr: wayusabbiḥu ar-raʿdu biḥamdihi wa-l-malāʾikahu min khīfatihi wayursilu aṣ-ṣawāʿiqa fayuṣību bihā man yashāʾu wahum yujādilūna fā Allāh wahuwa shadīdu al-miḥāli
verses.abdelhaleem: the thunder sounds His praises, as do the angels in awe of Him; He sends thunderbolts to strike whoever He will. Yet still they dispute about God- He has mighty plans.
verses.pickthall: The thunder hymneth His praise and (so do) the angels for awe of Him. He launcheth the thunderbolts and smiteth with them whom He will while they dispute (in doubt) concerning Allah, and He is mighty in wrath.

verses.ar: لَهُۥ دَعْوَةُ ٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُونَ لَهُم بِشَىْءٍ إِلَّا كَبَـٰسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ إِلَى ٱلْمَآءِ لِيَبْلُغَ فَاهُ وَمَا هُوَ بِبَـٰلِغِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا دُعَآءُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ
verses.en: To Him [alone] is the supplication of truth. And those they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus]. And the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e., futility].
verses.tr: lahu daʿwahu al-ḥaqqi ۖ wa-adh-dhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi lā yastajībūna lahum bishāʾin ʾillā kabāsiṭi kaffayhi ʾilā al-māʾi liyablugha fāhu wamā huwa bibālighihi ۚ wamā duʿāʾu al-kāfirīna ʾillā fā ḍalālin
verses.abdelhaleem: The only true prayer is to Him: those they pray to besides Him give them no answer any more than water reaches the mouth of someone who simply stretches out his hands for it- it cannot do so: the prayers of the disbelievers are all in vain.
verses.pickthall: Unto Him is the real prayer. Those unto whom they pray beside Allah respond to them not at all, save as (is the response to) one who stretcheth forth his hands toward water (asking) that it may come unto his mouth, and it will never reach it. The prayer of disbelievers goeth (far) astray.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَكَرْهًا وَظِلَـٰلُهُم بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْـَٔاصَالِ ۩
verses.en: And to Allāh prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh yasjudu man fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ṭawʿan wakarhan waẓilāluhum bi-l-ghuduwwi wa-l-āṣāli ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: All that are in heaven and earth submit to God alone, willingly or unwillingly, as do their shadows in the mornings and in the evenings.
verses.pickthall: And unto Allah falleth prostrate whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, as do their shadows in the morning and the evening hours.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ أَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتُ وَٱلنُّورُ ۗ أَمْ جَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ خَلَقُوا۟ كَخَلْقِهِۦ فَتَشَـٰبَهَ ٱلْخَلْقُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّـٰرُ
verses.en: Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allāh." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allāh partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" Say, "Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing."
verses.tr: qul man rrabbu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi quli Allāh ۚ qul ʾafāttakhadhtum mmin dūnihi ʾawliyāʾa lā yamlikūna liʾanfusihim nafʿan walā ḍarran ۚ qul hal yastawā al-ʾaʿmā wa-l-baṣīru ʾam hal tastawā aẓ-ẓulumātu wa-an-nūru ۗ ʾam jaʿalūā lillāh shurakāʾa khalaqūā kakhalqihi fatashābaha al-khalqu ʿalayhim ۚ quli Allāh khāliqu kulli shāʾin wahuwa al-wāḥidu al-qahhāru
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Who is Lord of the heavens and the earth?’ Say, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Why do you take protectors other than Him, who can neither benefit nor harm even themselves?’ Say, ‘Are the blind equal to those who can see? And are the depths of darkness equal to the light?’ Have the partners they assign to God created anything like His creation so that their creation is indistinguishable from His? Say, ‘God is the Creator of all things: He is the One, the All Compelling.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Who is Lord of the heavens and the earth? Say: Allah. Say: Take ye then (others) beside Him for protectors, which, even for themselves, have neither benefit nor hurt? Say: Is the blind man equal to the seer, or is darkness equal to light? Or assign they unto Allah partners who created the like of His creation so that the creation (which they made and His creation) seemed alike to them? Say: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Almighty.

verses.ar: أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌۢ بِقَدَرِهَا فَٱحْتَمَلَ ٱلسَّيْلُ زَبَدًا رَّابِيًا ۚ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلنَّارِ ٱبْتِغَآءَ حِلْيَةٍ أَوْ مَتَـٰعٍ زَبَدٌ مِّثْلُهُۥ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَٱلْبَـٰطِلَ ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلزَّبَدُ فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَآءً ۖ وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ ٱلنَّاسَ فَيَمْكُثُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ
verses.en: He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allāh presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allāh present examples.
verses.tr: ʾanzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan fasālat ʾawdiyahun biqadarihā fāḥtamala as-saylu zabadan rrābiyan ۚ wamimmā yūqidūna ʿalayhi fā an-nāri ābtighāʾa ḥilyahin ʾaw matāʿin zabadun mmithluhu ۚ kadhālika yaḍribu Allāh al-ḥaqqa wa-l-bāṭila ۚ fa-ammā az-zabadu fayadhhabu jufāʾan ۖ wa-ammā mā yanfaʿu an-nāsa fayamkuthu fā al-ʾarḍi ۚ kadhālika yaḍribu Allāh al-ʾamthāla
verses.abdelhaleem: He sends water from the sky that fills riverbeds to overflowing, each according to its measure. The stream carries on its surface a growing layer of froth, like the froth that appears when people melt metals in the fire to make ornaments and tools: in this way God illustrates truth and falsehood- the froth disappears, but what is of benefit to man stays behind- this is how God makes illustrations.
verses.pickthall: He sendeth down water from the sky, so that valleys flow according to their measure, and the flood beareth (on its surface) swelling foam - from that which they smelt in the fire in order to make ornaments and tools riseth a foam like unto it - thus Allah coineth (the similitude of) the true and the false. Then, as for the foam, it passeth away as scum upon the banks, while, as for that which is of use to mankind, it remaineth in the earth. Thus Allah coineth the similitudes.

verses.ar: لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُۥ لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْحِسَابِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.en: For those who have responded to their Lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to Him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. Those will have the worst account, and their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.
verses.tr: lilladhīna āstajābūā lirabbihimu al-ḥusnā ۚ wa-adh-dhīna lam yastajībūā lahu law ʾanna lahum mmā fā al-ʾarḍi jamīʿan wamithlahu maʿahu lāftadawā bihi ۚ ʾūlāʾika lahum sūʾu al-ḥisābi wamaʾwāhum jahannamu ۖ wabiʾsa al-mihādu
verses.abdelhaleem: There will be the best of rewards for those who respond to their Lord; those who do not respond would willingly give away the earth’s contents twice over, if they had it, in order to ransom themselves, so terrible will be their reckoning. Hell will be their home, and their bed wretched.
verses.pickthall: For those who answered Allah's call is bliss; and for those who answered not His call, if they had all that is in the earth, and therewith the like thereof, they would proffer it as ransom. Such will have a woeful reckoning, and their habitation will be hell, a dire abode.

verses.ar: ۞ أَفَمَن يَعْلَمُ أَنَّمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ٱلْحَقُّ كَمَنْ هُوَ أَعْمَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: Then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth like one who is blind? They will only be reminded who are people of understanding -
verses.tr: ۞ ʾafaman yaʿlamu ʾannamā ʾunzila ʾilayka min rrabbika al-ḥaqqu kaman huwa ʾaʿmā ۚ ʾinnamā yatadhakkaru ʾūlūā al-ʾalbābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Can someone who knows that the revelation from your Lord is the Truth be equal to someone who is blind? Only those with understanding will take it to heart;
verses.pickthall: Is he who knoweth that what is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the truth like him who is blind? But only men of understanding heed;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَنقُضُونَ ٱلْمِيثَـٰقَ
verses.en: Those who fulfill the covenant of Allāh and do not break the contract,
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yūfūna biʿahdi Allāh walā yanquḍūna al-mīthāqa
verses.abdelhaleem: those who fulfil the agreements they make in God’s name and do not break their pledges;
verses.pickthall: Such as keep the pact of Allah, and break not the covenant;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ وَيَخَافُونَ سُوٓءَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: And those who join that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and fear their Lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account,
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yaṣilūna mā ʾamara Allāh bihi ʾan yūṣala wayakhshawna rabbahum wayakhāfūna sūʾa al-ḥisābi
verses.abdelhaleem: who join together what God commands to be joined; who are in awe of their Lord and fear the harshness of the Reckoning;
verses.pickthall: Such as unite that which Allah hath commandeth should be joined, and fear their Lord, and dread a woeful reckoning;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.en: And those who are patient, seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of their Lord, and establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of [this] home -
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna ṣabarūā ābtighāʾa wajhi rabbihim wa-aqāmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha wa-anfaqūā mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyahan wayadraʾūna bi-l-ḥasanahi as-sayyiʾaha ʾūlāʾika lahum ʿuqbā ad-dāri
verses.abdelhaleem: who remain steadfast through their desire for the face of their Lord; who keep up the prayer; who give secretly and openly from what We have provided for them; who repel evil with good. These will have the reward of the [true] home:
verses.pickthall: Such as persevere in seeking their Lord's Countenance and are regular in prayer and spend of that which We bestow upon them secretly and openly, and overcome evil with good. Theirs will be the sequel of the (heavenly) Home,

verses.ar: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمْ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن كُلِّ بَابٍ
verses.en: Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying],
verses.tr: jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā waman ṣalaḥa min ābāʾihim wa-azwājihim wadhurriyyātihim ۖ wa-l-malāʾikahu yadkhulūna ʿalayhim mmin kulli bābin
verses.abdelhaleem: they will enter perpetual Gardens, along with their righteous ancestors, spouses, and descendants; the angels will go in to them from every gate,
verses.pickthall: Gardens of Eden which they enter, along with all who do right of their fathers and their helpmeets and their seed. The angels enter unto them from every gate,

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.en: "Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."
verses.tr: salāmun ʿalaykum bimā ṣabartum ۚ faniʿma ʿuqbā ad-dāri
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Peace be with you, because you have remained steadfast. What an excellent reward is this home of yours!’
verses.pickthall: (Saying): Peace be unto you because ye persevered. Ah, passing sweet will be the sequel of the (heavenly) Home.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مِيثَـٰقِهِۦ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۙ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ
verses.en: But those who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yanquḍūna ʿahda Allāh min baʿdi mīthāqihi wayaqṭaʿūna mā ʾamara Allāh bihi ʾan yūṣala wayufsidūna fā al-ʾarḍi ۙ ʾūlāʾika lahumu al-laʿnahu walahum sūʾu ad-dāri
verses.abdelhaleem: But there will be rejection for those who break their confirmed agreements made in God’s name, who break apart what God has commanded to be joined and who spread corruption on earth: theirs is the dreadful home-
verses.pickthall: And those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah hath commanded should be joined, and make mischief in the earth: theirs is the curse and theirs the ill abode.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ وَفَرِحُوا۟ بِٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَـٰعٌ
verses.en: Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment.
verses.tr: Allāh yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yashāʾu wayaqdiru ۚ wafariḥūā bi-l-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā wamā al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā fā al-ākhirahi ʾillā matāʿun
verses.abdelhaleem: God gives abundantly to whoever He will, and sparingly to whoever He will- and though they may revel in the life of this world, it is but a fleeting comfort compared with the Life to come.
verses.pickthall: Allah enlargeth livelihood for whom He will, and straiteneth (it for whom He will); and they rejoice in the life of the world, whereas the life of the world is but brief comfort as compared with the Hereafter.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَنْ أَنَابَ
verses.en: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, Allāh leaves astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him] -
verses.tr: wayaqūlu adh-dhīna kafarūā lawlā ʾunzila ʿalayhi āyahun mmin rrabbihi ۗ qul ʾinna Allāh yuḍillu man yashāʾu wayahdā ʾilayhi man ʾanāba
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers say, ‘Why has no miracle been sent down to him from his Lord?’ [Prophet], say, ‘God leaves whoever He will to stray, and guides to Himself those who turn towards Him,
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve say: If only a portent were sent down upon him from his Lord! Say: Lo! Allah sendeth whom He will astray, and guideth unto Himself all who turn (unto Him),

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
verses.en: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured."
verses.tr: adh-dhīna āmanūā wataṭmaʾinnu qulūbuhum bidhikri Allāh ۗ ʾalā bidhikri Allāh taṭmaʾinnu al-qulūbu
verses.abdelhaleem: those who have faith and whose hearts find peace in the remembrance of God- truly it is in the remembrance of God that hearts find peace-
verses.pickthall: Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.en: Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ṭūbā lahum waḥusnu mābin
verses.abdelhaleem: those who believe and do righteous deeds: joy awaits these, and their final homecoming will be excellent.’
verses.pickthall: Those who believe and do right: Joy is for them, and bliss (their) journey's end.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ فِىٓ أُمَّةٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهَآ أُمَمٌ لِّتَتْلُوَا۟ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ قُلْ هُوَ رَبِّى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ
verses.en: Thus have We sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which We revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the Most Merciful. Say, "He is my Lord; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and to Him is my return."
verses.tr: kadhālika ʾarsalnāka fā ʾummahin qad khalat min qablihā ʾumamun llitatluwā ʿalayhimu adh-dhā ʾawḥaynā ʾilayka wahum yakfurūna bi-ar-raḥmāni ۚ qul huwa rabbā lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ʾilayhi matābi
verses.abdelhaleem: So We have sent you [Prophet] to a community- other communities passed away long before them- to recite to them what We reveal to you. Yet they disbelieve in the Lord of Mercy. Say, ‘He is my Lord: there is no god but Him. I put my trust in Him and to Him is my return.’
verses.pickthall: Thus We send thee (O Muhammad) unto a nation, before whom other nations have passed away, that thou mayst recite unto them that which We have inspired in thee, while they are disbelievers in the Beneficent. Say: He is my Lord; there is no Allah save Him. In Him do I put my trust and unto Him is my recourse.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْءَانًا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ ٱلْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُوا۟ قَارِعَةٌ أَوْ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبًا مِّن دَارِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ وَعْدُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
verses.en: And if there was any Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak, [it would be this Qur’ān], but to Allāh belongs the affair entirely. Then have those who believed not accepted that had Allāh willed, He would have guided the people, all of them? And those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.
verses.tr: walaw ʾanna qurānan suyyirat bihi al-jibālu ʾaw quṭṭiʿat bihi al-ʾarḍu ʾaw kullima bihi al-mawtā ۗ bal lillāh al-ʾamru jamīʿan ۗ ʾafalam yāysi adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾan llaw yashāʾu Allāh lahadā an-nāsa jamīʿan ۗ walā yazālu adh-dhīna kafarūā tuṣībuhum bimā ṣanaʿūā qāriʿahun ʾaw taḥullu qarīban mmin dārihim ḥattā yaʾtāa waʿdu Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh lā yukhlifu al-mīʿāda
verses.abdelhaleem: If there were ever to be a Quran with which mountains could be moved, the earth shattered, or the dead made to speak [it would have been this one], but everything is truly in God’s hands. Do the believers not realize that if God had so willed, He could have guided all mankind? As for the disbelievers, because of their misdeeds, disaster will not cease to afflict them or fall close to their homes until God’s promise is fulfilled: God never fails to keep His promise.
verses.pickthall: Had it been possible for a Lecture to cause the mountains to move, or the earth to be torn asunder, or the dead to speak, (this Qur'an would have done so). Nay, but Allah's is the whole command. Do not those who believe know that, had Allah willed, He could have guided all mankind? As for those who disbelieve, disaster ceaseth not to strike them because of what they do, or it dwelleth near their home until the threat of Allah come to pass. Lo! Allah faileth not to keep the tryst.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
verses.en: And already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and I extended the time of those who disbelieved; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
verses.tr: walaqadi āstuhziʾa birusulin mmin qablika fa-amlaytu lilladhīna kafarūā thumma ʾakhadhtuhum ۖ fakayfa kāna ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Many messengers before you [Muhammad] were mocked, but I granted respite to the disbelievers: in the end, I took them to task- how terrible My punishment was!
verses.pickthall: And verily messengers (of Allah) were mocked before thee, but long I bore with those who disbelieved. At length I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment!

verses.ar: أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۗ وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ قُلْ سَمُّوهُمْ ۚ أَمْ تُنَبِّـُٔونَهُۥ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَم بِظَـٰهِرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ ۗ بَلْ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مَكْرُهُمْ وَصُدُّوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
verses.en: Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allāh they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent [i.e., alleged] of speech?" Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allāh sends astray - there will be for him no guide.
verses.tr: ʾafaman huwa qāʾimun ʿalā kulli nafsin bimā kasabat ۗ wajaʿalūā lillāh shurakāʾa qul sammūhum ۚ ʾam tunabbiwnahu bimā lā yaʿlamu fā al-ʾarḍi ʾam biẓāhirin mmina al-qawli ۗ bal zuyyina lilladhīna kafarūā makruhum waṣuddūā ʿani as-sabīli ۗ waman yuḍlili Allāh famā lahu min hādin
verses.abdelhaleem: Is He who stands over every soul marking its action [in need of any partner]? Yet they ascribe partners to God. Say, ‘Name them,’ or, ‘Can you tell Him about something on the earth He does not know to exist, or is this just a display of words?’ But the things they devise are made alluring to the disbelievers and they are barred from the [right] path: no one can guide those God leaves to stray.
verses.pickthall: Is He Who is aware of the deserts of every soul (as he who is aware of nothing)? Yet they ascribe unto Allah partners. Say: Name them. Is it that ye would inform Him of something which He knoweth not in the earth? Or is it but a way of speaking? Nay but their contrivance is made seeming fair for those who disbelieve and they are kept from the right road. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.

verses.ar: لَّهُمْ عَذَابٌ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَشَقُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍ
verses.en: For them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe. And they will not have from Allāh any protector.
verses.tr: llahum ʿadhābun fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۖ walaʿadhābu al-ākhirahi ʾashaqqu ۖ wamā lahum mmina Allāh min wāqin
verses.abdelhaleem: There is a punishment for them in this world, but the punishment of the Hereafter will be harder- no one will defend them against God.
verses.pickthall: For them is torment in the life of the world, and verily the doom of the Hereafter is more painful, and they have no defender from Allah.

verses.ar: ۞ مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ أُكُلُهَا دَآئِمٌ وَظِلُّهَا ۚ تِلْكَ عُقْبَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ ۖ وَّعُقْبَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ٱلنَّارُ
verses.en: The example [i.e., description] of Paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. Its fruit is lasting, and its shade. That is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the Fire.
verses.tr: ۞ mmathalu al-jannahi at-tā wuʿida al-muttaqūna ۖ tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru ۖ ʾukuluhā dāʾimun waẓilluhā ۚ tilka ʿuqbā adh-dhīna āttaqawā ۖ wwaʿuqbā al-kāfirīna an-nāru
verses.abdelhaleem: Here is a picture of the Garden that those mindful of God have been promised: flowing streams and perpetual food and shade. This is the reward that awaits those who are mindful of God; the disbelievers’ reward is the Fire.
verses.pickthall: A similitude of the Garden which is promised unto those who keep their duty (to Allah): Underneath it rivers flow; its food is everlasting, and its shade; this is the reward of those who keep their duty, while the reward of disbelievers is the Fire.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ مَن يُنكِرُ بَعْضَهُۥ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ وَلَآ أُشْرِكَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ إِلَيْهِ أَدْعُوا۟ وَإِلَيْهِ مَـَٔابِ
verses.en: And [the believers among] those to whom We have given the [previous] Scripture rejoice at what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], but among the [opposing] factions are those who deny part of it [i.e., the Qur’ān]. Say, "I have only been commanded to worship Allāh and not associate [anything] with Him. To Him I invite, and to Him is my return."
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna ātaynāhumu al-kitāba yafraḥūna bimā ʾunzila ʾilayka ۖ wamina al-ʾaḥzābi man yunkiru baʿḍahu ۚ qul ʾinnamā ʾumirtu ʾan ʾaʿbuda Allāh walā ʾushrika bihi ۚ ʾilayhi ʾadʿūā wa-ʾilayhi mābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Those to whom We sent the Scripture rejoice in what has been revealed to you [Prophet]; some factions deny parts of it. Say, ‘I am commanded to worship God, and not join anything with Him in worship: to Him I call [others] and to Him I shall return.’
verses.pickthall: Those unto whom We gave the Scripture rejoice in that which is revealed unto thee. And of the clans there are who deny some of it. Say: I am commanded only that I serve Allah and ascribe unto Him no partner. Unto Him I cry, and unto Him is my return.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا عَرَبِيًّا ۚ وَلَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَآءَهُم بَعْدَ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا وَاقٍ
verses.en: And thus We have revealed it as an Arabic legislation. And if you should follow their inclinations after what has come to you of knowledge, you would not have against Allāh any ally or any protector.
verses.tr: wakadhālika ʾanzalnāhu ḥukman ʿarabiyyan ۚ walaʾini āttabaʿta ʾahwāʾahum baʿda mā jāʾaka mina al-ʿilmi mā laka mina Allāh min walāin walā wāqin
verses.abdelhaleem: So We have sent down the Quran to give judgement in the Arabic language. If you were to follow their desires, after the knowledge that has come to you, you would have no one to guard you or protect you from God.
verses.pickthall: Thus have We revealed it, a decisive utterance in Arabic; and if thou shouldst follow their desires after that which hath come unto thee of knowledge, then truly wouldst thou have from Allah no protecting friend nor defender.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَذُرِّيَّةً ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍ كِتَابٌ
verses.en: And We have already sent messengers before you and assigned to them wives and descendants. And it was not for a messenger to come with a sign except by permission of Allāh. For every term is a decree.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā rusulan mmin qablika wajaʿalnā lahum ʾazwājan wadhurriyyahan ۚ wamā kāna lirasūlin ʾan yaʾtāa bāyahin ʾillā biʾidhni Allāh ۗ likulli ʾajalin kitābun
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent messengers before you and gave them wives and offspring; no messenger was given the power to produce a miracle except with God’s permission. There was a Scripture for every age:
verses.pickthall: And verily We sent messengers (to mankind) before thee, and We appointed for them wives and offspring, and it was not (given) to any messenger that he should bring a portent save by Allah's leave. For everything there is a time prescribed.

verses.ar: يَمْحُوا۟ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثْبِتُ ۖ وَعِندَهُۥٓ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ
verses.en: Allāh eliminates what He wills or confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.
verses.tr: yamḥūā Allāh mā yashāʾu wayuthbitu ۖ waʿindahu ʾummu al-kitābi
verses.abdelhaleem: God erases or confirms whatever He will, and the source of Scripture is with Him.
verses.pickthall: Allah effaceth what He will, and establisheth (what He will), and with Him is the source of ordinance.

verses.ar: وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ وَعَلَيْنَا ٱلْحِسَابُ
verses.en: And whether We show you part of what We promise them or take you in death, upon you is only the [duty of] notification, and upon Us is the account.
verses.tr: wa-in mmā nuriyannaka baʿḍa adh-dhā naʿiduhum ʾaw natawaffayannaka fa-innamā ʿalayka al-balāghu waʿalaynā al-ḥisābu
verses.abdelhaleem: Whether We let you [Prophet] see part of what We threaten them with, or cause you to die [before that], your duty is only to deliver the message: the Reckoning is Ours.
verses.pickthall: Whether We let thee see something of that which We have promised them, or make thee die (before its happening), thine is but conveyance (of the message). Ours the reckoning.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكْمِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: Have they not seen that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? And Allāh decides; there is no adjuster of His decision. And He is swift in account.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yarawā ʾannā naʾtā al-ʾarḍa nanquṣuhā min ʾaṭrāfihā ۚ wallāh yaḥkumu lā muʿaqqiba liḥukmihi ۚ wahuwa sarīʿu al-ḥisābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not see how We come to [their] land and shrink its borders? God decides- no one can reverse His decision- and He is swift in reckoning.
verses.pickthall: See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? (When) Allah doometh there is none that can postpone His doom, and He is swift at reckoning.

verses.ar: وَقَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَكْرُ جَمِيعًا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلْكُفَّـٰرُ لِمَنْ عُقْبَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.en: And those before them had plotted, but to Allāh belongs the plan entirely. He knows what every soul earns, and the disbelievers will know for whom is the final home.
verses.tr: waqad makara adh-dhīna min qablihim fa-lillāh al-makru jamīʿan ۖ yaʿlamu mā taksibu kullu nafsin ۗ wasayaʿlamu al-kuffāru liman ʿuqbā ad-dāri
verses.abdelhaleem: Those before them also schemed, but the overall scheme belongs to God: He knows what each soul does. In the end, the disbelievers will find out who will have the excellent home.
verses.pickthall: Those who were before them plotted; but all plotting is Allah's. He knoweth that which each soul earneth. The disbelievers will come to know for whom will be the sequel of the (heavenly) Home.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَسْتَ مُرْسَلًا ۚ قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ
verses.en: And those who have disbelieved say, "You are not a messenger." Say, [O Muḥammad], "Sufficient is Allāh as Witness between me and you, and [the witness of] whoever has knowledge of the Scripture."
verses.tr: wayaqūlu adh-dhīna kafarūā lasta mursalan ۚ qul kafā billāh shahīdanā baynā wabaynakum waman ʿindahu ʿilmu al-kitābi
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘You have not been sent.’ Say, ‘God is sufficient witness between me and you: all knowledge of the Scripture comes from Him.’
verses.pickthall: They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.

verses.ar: الٓر ۚ كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Rā. [This is] a Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord - to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy -
verses.tr: al-r ۚ kitābun ʾanzalnāhu ʾilayka litukhrija an-nāsa mina aẓ-ẓulumāti ʾilā an-nūri biʾidhni rabbihim ʾilā ṣirāṭi al-ʿazīzi al-ḥamīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Ra This is a Scripture which We have sent down to you [Prophet] so that, with their Lord’s permission, you may bring people from the depths of darkness into light, to the path of the Almighty, the Praiseworthy One,
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Ra. (This is) a Scripture which We have revealed unto thee (Muhammad) that thereby thou mayst bring forth mankind from darkness unto light, by the permission of their Lord, unto the path of the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,

verses.ar: ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
verses.en: Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe [i.e., destruction] to the disbelievers from a severe punishment -
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā lahu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۗ wawaylun llilkāfirīna min ʿadhābin shadīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: God, to whom everything in the heavens and earth belongs. How terrible will be the torment of those who ignore [Him],
verses.pickthall: Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. and woe unto the disbelievers from an awful doom;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.en: The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allāh, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. Those are in extreme error.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yastaḥibbūna al-ḥayawāha ad-dunyā ʿalā al-ākhirahi wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli Allāh wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan ۚ ʾūlāʾika fā ḍalālin baʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: those who prefer the life of this world over the life to come, who turn others from God’s way, trying to make it crooked: such people have gone far astray.
verses.pickthall: Those who love the life of the world more than the Hereafter, and debar (men) from the way of Allah and would have it crooked: such are far astray.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ ۖ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allāh sends astray [thereby] whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnā min rrasūlin ʾillā bilisāni qawmihi liyubayyina lahum ۖ fayuḍillu Allāh man yashāʾu wayahdā man yashāʾu ۚ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: We have never sent a messenger who did not use his own people’s language to make things clear for them. But still God leaves whoever He will to stray, and guides whoever He will: He is the Almighty, the All Wise.
verses.pickthall: And We never sent a messenger save with the language of his folk, that he might make (the message) clear for them. Then Allah sendeth whom He will astray, and guideth whom He will. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُم بِأَيَّىٰمِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
verses.en: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs, [saying], "Bring out your people from darknesses into the light and remind them of the days of Allāh." Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā mūsā bāyātinā ʾan ʾakhrij qawmaka mina aẓ-ẓulumāti ʾilā an-nūri wadhakkirhum biʾayyāmi Allāh ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin llikulli ṣabbārin shakūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Moses with Our signs: ‘Bring out your people from the depths of darkness into light. Remind them of the Days of God:there truly are signs in this for every steadfast, thankful person.’
verses.pickthall: We verily sent Moses with Our revelations, saying: Bring thy people forth from darkness unto light. And remind them of the days of Allah. Lo! therein are revelations for each steadfast, thankful (heart).

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ أَنجَىٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when Moses said to his people, "Remember the favor of Allāh upon you when He saved you from the people of Pharaoh, who were afflicting you with the worst torment and were slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi ādhkurūā niʿmaha Allāh ʿalaykum ʾidh ʾanjākum mmin āli firʿawna yasūmūnakum sūʾa al-ʿadhābi wayudhabbiḥūna ʾabnāʾakum wayastaḥyūna nisāʾakum ۚ wafā dhālikum balāʾun mmin rrabbikum ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: And so Moses said to his people, ‘Remember God’s blessing on you when He saved you from Pharaoh’s people, who were inflicting terrible suffering on you, slaughtering your sons and sparing only your women––that was a severe test from your Lord!
verses.pickthall: And (remind them) how Moses said unto his people: Remember Allah's favour unto you when He delivered you from Pharaoh's folk who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, and were slaying your sons and sparing your women; that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌ
verses.en: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.'"
verses.tr: wa-idh taʾadhana rabbukum laʾin shakartum laʾazīdannakum ۖ walaʾin kafartum ʾinna ʿadhābā lashadīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember that He promised, “If you are thankful, I will give you more, but if you are thankless, My punishment is terrible indeed.” ’
verses.pickthall: And when your Lord proclaimed: If ye give thanks, I will give you more; but if ye are thankless, lo! My punishment is dire.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِن تَكْفُرُوٓا۟ أَنتُمْ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
verses.en: And Moses said, "If you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy."
verses.tr: waqāla mūsā ʾin takfurūā ʾantum waman fā al-ʾarḍi jamīʿan fa-inna Allāh laghanāun ḥamīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: And Moses said, ‘Even if you, together with everybody else on earth, are thankless, God is self-sufficient, worthy of all praise.’
verses.pickthall: And Moses said: Though ye and all who are in the earth prove thankless, lo! Allah verily is Absolute, Owner of Praise.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ ۛ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۛ لَا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَرَدُّوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِىٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كَفَرْنَا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَنَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ
verses.en: Has there not reached you the news of those before you - the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them? No one knows them [i.e., their number] but Allāh. Their messengers brought them clear proofs, but they returned their hands to their mouths and said, "Indeed, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent, and indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."
verses.tr: ʾalam yaʾtikum nabaā adh-dhīna min qablikum qawmi nūḥin waʿādin wathamūda ۛ wa-adh-dhīna min baʿdihim ۛ lā yaʿlamuhum ʾillā Allāh ۚ jāʾathum rusuluhum bi-l-bayyināti faraddūā ʾaydiyahum fā ʾafwāhihim waqālūā ʾinnā kafarnā bimā ʾursiltum bihi wa-innā lafā shakkin mmimmā tadʿūnanā ʾilayhi murībin
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you not heard about those who went before you, the people of Noah, Ad, Thamud, and those who lived after them, known only to God? Their messengers came to them with clear proof, but they tried to silence them, saying, ‘We do not believe the message with which you were sent. We have disturbing doubts about what you are asking us to do.’
verses.pickthall: Hath not the history of those before you reached you: the folk of Noah, and (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, and those after them? None save Allah knoweth them. Their messengers came unto them with clear proofs, but they thrust their hands into their mouths, and said: Lo! we disbelieve in that wherewith ye have been sent, and lo! we are in grave doubt concerning that to which ye call us.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ أَفِى ٱللَّهِ شَكٌّ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِيَغْفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَأْتُونَا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Their messengers said, "Can there be doubt about Allāh, Creator of the heavens and earth? He invites you that He may forgive you of your sins, and He delays you [i.e., your death] for a specified term." They said, "You are not but men like us who wish to avert us from what our fathers were worshipping. So bring us a clear authority [i.e., evidence]."
verses.tr: ۞ qālat rusuluhum ʾafā Allāh shakkun fāṭiri as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ yadʿūkum liyaghfira lakum mmin dhunūbikum wayuʾakhirakum ʾilā ʾajalin mmusammanā ۚ qālūā ʾin ʾantum ʾillā basharun mmithlunā turīdūna ʾan taṣuddūnā ʿammā kāna yaʿbudu ābāʾunā fa-tūnā bisulṭānin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Their messengers answered, ‘Can there be any doubt about God, the Creator of the heavens and earth? He calls you to Him in order to forgive you your sins and let you enjoy your life until the appointed hour.’ But they said, ‘You are only men like us. You want to turn us away from what our forefathers used to worship. Bring us clear proof then, [if you can].’
verses.pickthall: Their messengers said: Can there be doubt concerning Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He calleth you that He may forgive you your sins and reprieve you unto an appointed term. They said: Ye are but mortals like us, who would fain turn us away from what our fathers used to worship. Then bring some clear warrant.

verses.ar: قَالَتْ لَهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ إِن نَّحْنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نَّأْتِيَكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Their messengers said to them, "We are only men like you, but Allāh confers favor upon whom He wills of His servants. It has never been for us to bring you evidence except by permission of Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
verses.tr: qālat lahum rusuluhum ʾin nnaḥnu ʾillā basharun mmithlukum walākinna Allāh yamunnu ʿalā man yashāʾu min ʿibādihi ۖ wamā kāna lanā ʾan nnaʾtiyakum bisulṭānin ʾillā biʾidhni Allāh ۚ waʿalā Allāh falyatawakkali al-muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Their messengers answered, ‘True, we are only men like you, but God favours whichever of His servants He chooses. We cannot bring you any proof unless God permits it, so let the believers put all their trust in Him-
verses.pickthall: Their messengers said unto them: We are but mortals like you, but Allah giveth grace unto whom He will of His slaves. It is not ours to bring you a warrant unless by the permission of Allah. In Allah let believers put their trust!

verses.ar: وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنَا سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاذَيْتُمُونَا ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
verses.en: And why should we not rely upon Allāh while He has guided us to our [good] ways. And we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. And upon Allāh let those who would rely [indeed] rely."
verses.tr: wamā lanā ʾallā natawakkala ʿalā Allāh waqad hadānā subulanā ۚ walanaṣbiranna ʿalā mā ādhaytumūnā ۚ waʿalā Allāh falyatawakkali al-mutawakkilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: why should we not put our trust in God when it is He who has guided us to this way we follow? We shall certainly bear steadfastly whatever harm you do to us. Let anyone who trusts, trust in God.’
verses.pickthall: How should we not put our trust in Allah when He hath shown us our ways? We surely will endure the hurt ye do us. In Allah let the trusting put their trust.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِرُسُلِهِمْ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِنَآ أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِى مِلَّتِنَا ۖ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ لَنُهْلِكَنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." So their Lord inspired to them, "We will surely destroy the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lirusulihim lanukhrijannakum mmin ʾarḍinā ʾaw lataʿūdunna fā millatinā ۖ fa-awḥā ʾilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikanna aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers said to their messengers, ‘We shall expel you from our land unless you return to our religion.’ But their Lord inspired the messengers: ‘We shall destroy the evildoers,
verses.pickthall: And those who disbelieved said unto their messengers: Verily we will drive you out from our land, unless ye return to our religion. Then their Lord inspired them, (saying): Verily we shall destroy the wrong-doers,

verses.ar: وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِى وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ
verses.en: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position and fears My threat."
verses.tr: walanuskinannakumu al-ʾarḍa min baʿdihim ۚ dhālika liman khāfa maqāmā wakhāfa waʿīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: and leave you to dwell in the land after them. This reward is for those who are in awe of meeting Me, and of My warnings.’
verses.pickthall: And verily We shall make you to dwell in the land after them. This is for him who feareth My Majesty and feareth My threats.

verses.ar: وَٱسْتَفْتَحُوا۟ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
verses.en: And they requested decision [i.e., victory from Allāh], and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.
verses.tr: wāstaftaḥūā wakhāba kullu jabbārin ʿanīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: They asked God to decide, and every obstinate tyrant failed-
verses.pickthall: And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught;

verses.ar: مِّن وَرَآئِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٍ صَدِيدٍ
verses.en: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.
verses.tr: mmin warāʾihi jahannamu wayusqā min mmāʾin ṣadīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: Hell awaits each one; he will be given foul water to drink,
verses.pickthall: Hell is before him, and he is made to drink a festering water,

verses.ar: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأْتِيهِ ٱلْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌ
verses.en: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment.
verses.tr: yatajarraʿuhu walā yakādu yusīghuhu wayaʾtīhi al-mawtu min kulli makānin wamā huwa bimayyitin ۖ wamin warāʾihi ʿadhābun ghalīẓun
verses.abdelhaleem: which he will try to gulp but scarcely be able to swallow; death will encroach on him from every side, but he will not die; more intense suffering will lie ahead of him.
verses.pickthall: Which he sippeth but can hardly swallow, and death cometh unto him from every side while yet he cannot die, and before him is a harsh doom.

verses.ar: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍ ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَـٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ
verses.en: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error.
verses.tr: mmathalu adh-dhīna kafarūā birabbihim ۖ ʾaʿmāluhum karamādin āshtaddat bihi ar-rīḥu fā yawmin ʿāṣifin ۖ llā yaqdirūna mimmā kasabūā ʿalā shāʾin ۚ dhālika huwa aḍ-ḍalālu al-baʿīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: The deeds of those who reject their Lord are like ashes that the wind blows furiously on a stormy day: they have no power over anything they have gained. This is to stray far, far away.
verses.pickthall: A similitude of those who disbelieve in their Lord: Their works are as ashes which the wind bloweth hard upon a stormy day. They have no control of aught that they have earned. That is the extreme failure.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.en: Have you not seen [i.e., considered] that Allāh created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and produce a new creation.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna Allāh khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa bi-l-ḥaqqi ۚ ʾin yashaʾ yudhhibkum wayaʾti bikhalqin jadīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do you not see that God created the heavens and the earth for a purpose? He could remove all of you and replace you with a new creation if He wished to:
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen that Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth? If He will, He can remove you and bring (in) some new creation;

verses.ar: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ
verses.en: And that is not difficult for Allāh.
verses.tr: wamā dhālika ʿalā Allāh biʿazīzin
verses.abdelhaleem: that is not difficult for God.
verses.pickthall: And that is no great matter for Allah.

verses.ar: وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَـٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۚ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيْنَـٰكُمْ ۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَجَزِعْنَآ أَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.en: And they will come out [for judgement] before Allāh all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, "Indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allāh?" They will say, "If Allāh had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape."
verses.tr: wabarazūā lillāh jamīʿan faqāla aḍ-ḍuʿafā lilladhīna āstakbarūā ʾinnā kunnā lakum tabaʿan fahal ʾantum mmughnūna ʿannā min ʿadhābi Allāh min shāʾin ۚ qālūā law hadānā Allāh lahadaynākum ۖ sawāʾun ʿalaynā ʾajaziʿnā ʾam ṣabarnā mā lanā min mmaḥīṣin
verses.abdelhaleem: When they all appear before Him, the weak will say to the powerseekers, ‘We were your followers. Can you protect us from any of God’s punishment?’ They will reply, ‘If God had guided us, we would have guided you. It makes no difference now whether we rage or endure with patience: there is no escape.’
verses.pickthall: They all come forth unto their Lord. Then those who were despised say unto those who were scornful: We were unto you a following, can ye then avert from us aught of Allah's doom? They say: Had Allah guided us, we should have guided you. Whether we rage or patiently endure is (now) all one for us; we have no place of refuge.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى ۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِى وَلُومُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُم ۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِىَّ ۖ إِنِّى كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allāh had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allāh] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."
verses.tr: waqāla ash-shayṭānu lammā quḍāa al-ʾamru ʾinna Allāh waʿadakum waʿda al-ḥaqqi wawaʿadttukum fa-akhlaftukum ۖ wamā kāna lāa ʿalaykum mmin sulṭānin ʾillā ʾan daʿawtukum fāstajabtum lā ۖ falā talūmūnā walūmūā ʾanfusakum ۖ mmā ʾanā bimuṣrikhikum wamā ʾantum bimuṣrikhāa ۖ ʾinnā kafartu bimā ʾashraktumūni min qablu ۗ ʾinna aẓ-ẓālimīna lahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When everything has been decided, Satan will say, ‘God gave you a true promise. I too made promises but they were false ones: I had no power over you except to call you, and you responded to my call, so do not blame me; blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can you help me. I reject the way you associated me with God before.’ A bitter torment awaits such wrongdoers,
verses.pickthall: And Satan saith, when the matter hath been decided: Lo! Allah promised you a promise of truth; and I promised you, then failed you. And I had no power over you save that I called unto you and ye obeyed me. So blame not, but blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can ye help me, Lo! I disbelieved in that which ye before ascribed to me. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَأُدْخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَـٰمٌ
verses.en: And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, "Peace!"
verses.tr: wa-udkhila adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā biʾidhni rabbihim ۖ taḥiyyatuhum fīhā salāmun
verses.abdelhaleem: but those who believed and did good deeds will be brought into Gardens graced with flowing streams, there to remain with their Lord’s permission: their greeting there is ‘Peace’.
verses.pickthall: And those who believed and did good works are made to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein abiding by permission of their Lord, their greeting therein: Peace!

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَفَرْعُهَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
verses.en: Have you not considered how Allāh presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?
verses.tr: ʾalam tara kayfa ḍaraba Allāh mathalan kalimahan ṭayyibahan kashajarahin ṭayyibahin ʾaṣluhā thābitun wafarʿuhā fā as-samāʾi
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do you not see how God makes comparisons? A good word is like a good tree whose root is firm and whose branches are high in the sky,
verses.pickthall: Seest thou not how Allah coineth a similitude: A goodly saying, as a goodly tree, its root set firm, its branches reaching into heaven,
