verses.ar: تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا ۗ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allāh presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.
verses.tr: tuʾtā ʾukulahā kulla ḥīnin biʾidhni rabbihā ۗ wayaḍribu Allāh al-ʾamthāla lilnnāsi laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: yielding constant fruit by its Lord’s leave- God makes such comparisons for people so that they may reflect-
verses.pickthall: Giving its fruit at every season by permission of its Lord? Allah coineth the similitudes for mankind in order that they may reflect.

verses.ar: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجْتُثَّتْ مِن فَوْقِ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٍ
verses.en: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.
verses.tr: wamathalu kalimahin khabīthahin kashajarahin khabīthahin ājtuthat min fawqi al-ʾarḍi mā lahā min qarārin
verses.abdelhaleem: but an evil word is like a rotten tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, with no power to endure.
verses.pickthall: And the similitude of a bad saying is as a bad tree, uprooted from upon the earth, possessing no stability.

verses.ar: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْقَوْلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ۚ وَيَفْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verses.en: Allāh keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And Allāh sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allāh does what He wills.
verses.tr: yuthabbitu Allāh adh-dhīna āmanūā bi-l-qawli ath-thābiti fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā wafā al-ākhirahi ۖ wayuḍillu Allāh aẓ-ẓālimīna ۚ wayafʿalu Allāh mā yashāʾu
verses.abdelhaleem: God will give firmness to those who believe in the firmly rooted word, both in this world and the Hereafter, but the evildoers He leaves to stray: God does whatever He will.
verses.pickthall: Allah confirmeth those who believe by a firm saying in the life of the world and in the Hereafter, and Allah sendeth wrong-doers astray. And Allah doeth what He will.

verses.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفْرًا وَأَحَلُّوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ ٱلْبَوَارِ
verses.en: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allāh for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?
verses.tr: ۞ ʾalam tara ʾilā adh-dhīna baddalūā niʿmata Allāh kufran wa-aḥallūā qawmahum dāra al-bawāri
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do you not see those who, in exchange for God’s favour, offer only ingratitude and make their people end up in the home of ruin, Hell,
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen those who gave the grace of Allah in exchange for thanklessness and led their people down to the Abode of Loss,

verses.ar: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verses.en: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.
verses.tr: jahannama yaṣlawnahā ۖ wabiʾsa al-qarāru
verses.abdelhaleem: where they burn? What an evil place to stay!
verses.pickthall: (Even to) hell? They are exposed thereto. A hapless end!

verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: And they have attributed to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."
verses.tr: wajaʿalūā lillāh ʾandādan lliyuḍillūā ʿan sabīlihi ۗ qul tamattaʿūā fa-inna maṣīrakum ʾilā an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: They set up [false deities] as God’s equals to lead people astray from His path. Say, ‘Take your pleasure now, for your destination is the Fire.’
verses.pickthall: And they set up rivals to Allah that they may mislead (men) from His way. Say: Enjoy life (while ye may) for lo! your journey's end will be the Fire.

verses.ar: قُل لِّعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا بَيْعٌ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَـٰلٌ
verses.en: [O Muḥammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange [i.e., ransom], nor any friendships.
verses.tr: qul lliʿibādāa adh-dhīna āmanūā yuqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha wayunfiqūā mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyahan mmin qabli ʾan yaʾtāa yawmun llā bayʿun fīhi walā khilālun
verses.abdelhaleem: Tell My servants who have believed to keep up the prayer and give, secretly and in public, out of what We have provided them, before a Day comes when there will be no trading or friendship.
verses.pickthall: Tell My bondmen who believe to establish worship and spend of that which We have given them, secretly and publicly, before a day cometh wherein there will be neither traffick nor befriending.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِىَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرَ
verses.en: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wa-anzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan fa-akhraja bihi mina ath-thamarāti rizqan llakum ۖ wasakhara lakumu al-fulka litajrāa fā al-baḥri biʾamrihi ۖ wasakhara lakumu al-ʾanhāra
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who created the heavens and earth, who has sent down water from the sky and with it brought forth produce to nourish you; He has made ships useful to you, sailing the sea by His command, and the rivers too;
verses.pickthall: Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth, and causeth water to descend from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you, and maketh the ships to be of service unto you, that they may run upon the sea at His command, and hath made of service unto you the rivers;

verses.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيْنِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ
verses.en: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.
verses.tr: wasakhara lakumu ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara dāʾibayni ۖ wasakhara lakumu al-yla wa-an-nahāra
verses.abdelhaleem: He has made the sun and the moon useful to you, steady on their paths; He has made the night and day useful to you
verses.pickthall: And maketh the sun and the moon, constant in their courses, to be of service unto you, and hath made of service unto you the night and the day.

verses.ar: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَظَلُومٌ كَفَّارٌ
verses.en: And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor [i.e., blessings] of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.
verses.tr: watākum mmin kulli mā saʾaltumūhu ۚ wa-in taʿuddūā niʿmata Allāh lā tuḥṣūhā ۗ ʾinna al-ʾinsāna laẓalūmun kaffārun
verses.abdelhaleem: and given you some of everything you asked Him for. If you tried to count God’s favours you could never calculate them: man is truly unjust and ungrateful.
verses.pickthall: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [i.e., Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla ʾibrāhīmu rabbi ājʿal hādhā al-balada āminan wājnubnā wabanāa ʾan nnaʿbuda al-ʾaṣnāma
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember when Abraham said, ‘Lord, make this town safe! Preserve me and my offspring from idolatry,
verses.pickthall: And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols.

verses.ar: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى ۖ وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: rabbi ʾinnahunna ʾaḍlalna kathīran mmina an-nāsi ۖ faman tabiʿanā fa-innahu minnā ۖ waman ʿaṣānā fa-innaka ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord, the [idols] have led many people astray! Anyone who follows me is with me, but as for anyone who disobeys me- You are surely forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: My Lord! Lo! they have led many of mankind astray. But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me. And whoso disobeyeth me - Still Thou art Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.
verses.tr: rrabbanā ʾinnā ʾaskantu min dhurriyyatā biwādin ghayri dhā zarʿin ʿinda baytika al-muḥarrami rabbanā liyuqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha fājʿal ʾafdahan mmina an-nāsi tahwā ʾilayhim wārzuqhum mmina ath-thamarāti laʿallahum yashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Our Lord, I have established some of my offspring in an uncultivated valley, close to Your Sacred House, Lord, so that they may keep up the prayer. Make people’s hearts turn to them, and provide them with produce, so that they may be thankful.
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ ۗ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
verses.en: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allāh on the earth or in the heaven.
verses.tr: rabbanā ʾinnaka taʿlamu mā nukhfā wamā nuʿlinu ۗ wamā yakhfā ʿalā Allāh min shāʾin fā al-ʾarḍi walā fā as-samāʾi
verses.abdelhaleem: Our Lord, You know well what we conceal and what we reveal: nothing at all is hidden from God, on earth or in heaven.
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verses.en: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.
verses.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhā wahaba lā ʿalā al-kibari ʾismāʿīla wa-isḥāqa ۚ ʾinna rabbā lasamīʿu ad-duʿāʾi
verses.abdelhaleem: Praise be to God, who has granted me Ishmael and Isaac in my old age: my Lord hears all requests!
verses.pickthall: Praise be to Allah Who hath given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac! Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of Prayer.

verses.ar: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
verses.en: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
verses.tr: rabbi ājʿalnā muqīma aṣ-ṣalawāhi wamin dhurriyyatā ۚ rabbanā wataqabbal duʿāʾi
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord, grant that I and my offspring may keep up the prayer. Our Lord, accept my request.
verses.pickthall: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
verses.en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."
verses.tr: rabbanā āghfir lā waliwālidāa walilmuʾminīna yawma yaqūmu al-ḥisābu
verses.abdelhaleem: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day of Reckoning.’
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَـٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
verses.en: And never think that Allāh is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them [i.e., their account] for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].
verses.tr: walā taḥsabanna Allāh ghāfilan ʿammā yaʿmalu aẓ-ẓālimūna ۚ ʾinnamā yuʾakhiruhum liyawmin tashkhaṣu fīhi al-ʾabṣāru
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not think [Prophet] that God is unaware of what the disbelievers do: He only gives them respite until a Day when their eyes will stare in terror.
verses.pickthall: Deem not that Allah is unaware of what the wicked do. He but giveth them a respite till a day when eyes will stare (in terror),

verses.ar: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۖ وَأَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌ
verses.en: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.
verses.tr: muhṭiʿīna muqniʿā ruʾūsihim lā yartaddu ʾilayhim ṭarfuhum ۖ wa-afdatuhum hawāʾun
verses.abdelhaleem: They will rush forward, craning their necks, unable to divert their eyes, a gaping void in their hearts.
verses.pickthall: As they come hurrying on in fear, their heads upraised, their gaze returning not to them, and their hearts as air.

verses.ar: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ ۗ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍ
verses.en: And, [O Muḥammad], warn the people of a Day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "Our Lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer Your call and follow the messengers." [But it will be said], "Had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation?
verses.tr: wa-andhiri an-nāsa yawma yaʾtīhimu al-ʿadhābu fayaqūlu adh-dhīna ẓalamūā rabbanā ʾakhirnā ʾilā ʾajalin qarībin nnujib daʿwataka wanattabiʿi ar-rusula ۗ ʾawalam takūnūā ʾaqsamtum mmin qablu mā lakum mmin zawālin
verses.abdelhaleem: So warn people of the Day when punishment will come to them, and when the disbelievers will say, ‘Our Lord, give us a little more time: we shall answer Your call and follow the messengers.’ Did you [disbelievers] not swear in the past that your power would have no end?
verses.pickthall: And warn mankind of a day when the doom will come upon them, and those who did wrong will say: Our Lord! Reprieve us for a little while. We will obey Thy call and will follow the messengers. (It will be answered): Did ye not swear before that there would be no end for you?

verses.ar: وَسَكَنتُمْ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ
verses.en: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."
verses.tr: wasakantum fā masākini adh-dhīna ẓalamūā ʾanfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa faʿalnā bihim waḍarabnā lakumu al-ʾamthāla
verses.abdelhaleem: You lived in the same places as others who wronged themselves before, and you were clearly shown how We dealt with them––We gave you many examples.
verses.pickthall: And (have ye not) dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves (of old) and (hath it not) become plain to you how We dealt with them and made examples for you?

verses.ar: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ
verses.en: And they had planned their plan, but with Allāh is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.
verses.tr: waqad makarūā makrahum waʿinda Allāh makruhum wa-in kāna makruhum litazūla minhu al-jibālu
verses.abdelhaleem: They made their plots, but, even if their plots had been able to move mountains, God had the answer.
verses.pickthall: Verily they have plotted their plot, and their plot is with Allah, though their plot were one whereby the mountains should be moved.

verses.ar: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
verses.en: So never think that Allāh will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.
verses.tr: falā taḥsabanna Allāh mukhlifa waʿdihi rusulahu ۗ ʾinna Allāh ʿazīzun dhū āntiqāmin
verses.abdelhaleem: So do not think [Prophet] that God will break His promise to His messengers: He is mighty, and capable of retribution.
verses.pickthall: So think not that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ ۖ وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
verses.en: [It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and they [i.e., all creatures] will come out before Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,
verses.tr: yawma tubaddalu al-ʾarḍu ghayra al-ʾarḍi wa-as-samāwātu ۖ wabarazūā lillāh al-wāḥidi al-qahhāri
verses.abdelhaleem: One Day- when the earth is turned into another earth, the heavens into another heaven, and people all appear before God, the One, the Overpowering-
verses.pickthall: On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens (also will be changed) and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty,

verses.ar: وَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verses.en: And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in irons,
verses.tr: watarā al-mujrimīna yawmaʾidhin mmuqarranīna fā al-ʾaṣfādi
verses.abdelhaleem: you [Prophet] will see the guilty on that Day, bound together in fetters,
verses.pickthall: Thou wilt see the guilty on that day linked together in chains,

verses.ar: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
verses.en: Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire
verses.tr: sarābīluhum mmin qaṭirānin wataghshā wujūhahumu an-nāru
verses.abdelhaleem: in garments of pitch, faces covered in fire.
verses.pickthall: Their raiment of pitch, and the Fire covering their faces,

verses.ar: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: So that Allāh will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.
verses.tr: liyajzāa Allāh kulla nafsin mmā kasabat ۚ ʾinna Allāh sarīʿu al-ḥisābi
verses.abdelhaleem: [All will be judged] so that God may reward each soul as it deserves: God is swift in His reckoning.
verses.pickthall: That Allah may repay each soul what it hath earned. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا بَلَـٰغٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: This [Qur’ān] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.
verses.tr: hādhā balāghun llilnnāsi waliyundharūā bihi waliyaʿlamūā ʾannamā huwa ʾilāhun wāḥidun waliyadhakkara ʾūlūā al-ʾalbābi
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a message to all people, so that they may be warned by it, and know that He is the only God, and so that those who have minds may take heed.
verses.pickthall: This is a clear message for mankind in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is only One Allah, and that men of understanding may take heed.

verses.ar: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
verses.tr: al-r ۚ tilka āyātu al-kitābi waqurānin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Ra These are the verses of the Scripture, a Quran that makes things clear.
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.

verses.ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
verses.tr: rrubamā yawaddu adh-dhīna kafarūā law kānūā muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers may well come to wish they had submitted to God,
verses.pickthall: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.

verses.ar: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
verses.tr: dharhum yaʾkulūā wayatamattaʿūā wayulhihimu al-ʾamalu ۖ fasawfa yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so [Prophet] leave them to eat and enjoy themselves. Let [false] hopes distract them: they will come to know.
verses.pickthall: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
verses.en: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
verses.tr: wamā ʾahlaknā min qaryahin ʾillā walahā kitābun mmaʿlūmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Never have We destroyed a community that did not have a set time;
verses.pickthall: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it.

verses.ar: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.en: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
verses.tr: mmā tasbiqu min ʾummahin ʾajalahā wamā yastakhirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: no community can bring its time forward, nor delay it.
verses.pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verses.en: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
verses.tr: waqālūā yāʾayyuhā adh-dhā nuzzila ʿalayhi adh-dhikru ʾinnaka lamajnūnun
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘Receiver of this Quran! You are definitely mad.
verses.pickthall: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!

verses.ar: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
verses.tr: llaw mā taʾtīnā bi-l-malāʾikahi ʾin kunta mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are telling the truth?’
verses.pickthall: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful?

verses.ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
verses.en: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.
verses.tr: mā nunazzilu al-malāʾikaha ʾillā bi-l-ḥaqqi wamā kānūā ʾidhan mmunẓarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But We send down the angels only to bring justice and then these people will not be reprieved.
verses.pickthall: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated.

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.
verses.tr: ʾinnā naḥnu nazzalnā adh-dhikra wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent down the Quran Ourself, and We Ourself will guard it. Even before you [Prophet],
verses.pickthall: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muḥammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā min qablika fā shiyaʿi al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent messengers among the various communities of old,
verses.pickthall: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
verses.tr: wamā yaʾtīhim mmin rrasūlin ʾillā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but they mocked every single messenger that came to them:
verses.pickthall: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.
verses.tr: kadhālika naslukuhu fā qulūbi al-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: in this way We make the message slip through the hearts of evildoers.
verses.pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:

verses.ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
verses.tr: lā yuʾminūna bihi ۖ waqad khalat sunnahu al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will not believe in it. That was what happened with the peoples of long ago,
verses.pickthall: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
verses.en: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
verses.tr: walaw fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban mmina as-samāʾi faẓallūā fīhi yaʿrujūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and even if We opened a gateway into Heaven for them and they rose through it, higher and higher,
verses.pickthall: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,

verses.ar: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
verses.en: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
verses.tr: laqālūā ʾinnamā sukkirat ʾabṣārunā bal naḥnu qawmun mmasḥūrūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they would still say, ‘Our eyes are hallucinating. We are bewitched.’
verses.pickthall: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
verses.en: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
verses.tr: walaqad jaʿalnā fā as-samāʾi burūjan wazayyannāhā lilnnāẓirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have set constellations up in the sky and made it beautiful for all to see,
verses.pickthall: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.

verses.ar: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
verses.en: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]
verses.tr: waḥafiẓnāhā min kulli shayṭānin rrajīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: and guarded it from every stoned satan:
verses.pickthall: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
verses.tr: ʾillā mani āstaraqa as-samʿa fa-atbaʿahu shihābun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: any eavesdropper will be pursued by a clearly visible flame.
verses.pickthall: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
verses.en: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
verses.tr: wa-l-ʾarḍa madadnāhā wa-ā fīhā rawāsāa wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli shāʾin mmawzūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: As for the earth, We have spread it out, set firm mountains on it, and made everything grow there in due balance.
verses.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
verses.en: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha waman llastum lahu birāziqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have provided sustenance in it for you and for all those creatures for whom you do not provide.
verses.pickthall: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.

verses.ar: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.en: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.
verses.tr: wa-in mmin shāʾin ʾillā ʿindanā khazāʾinuhu wamā nunazziluhu ʾillā biqadarin mmaʿlūmin
verses.abdelhaleem: There is not a thing whose storehouses are not with Us. We send it down only according to a well-defined measure:
verses.pickthall: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure.

verses.ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ
verses.en: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
verses.tr: wa-arsalnā ar-riyāḥa lawāqiḥa fa-anzalnā mina as-samāʾi māʾan fa-asqaynākumūhu wamā ʾantum lahu bikhāzinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We send the winds to fertilize, and We bring down water from the sky for you to drink- you do not control its sources.
verses.pickthall: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
verses.tr: wa-innā lanaḥnu nuḥāi wanumītu wanaḥnu al-wārithūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is We who give life and death; it is We who inherit [everything].
verses.pickthall: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
verses.en: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
verses.tr: walaqad ʿalimnā al-mustaqdimīna minkum walaqad ʿalimnā al-mustakhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We know exactly those of you who come first and those who come later.
verses.pickthall: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka huwa yaḥshuruhum ۚ ʾinnahu ḥakīmun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], it is your Lord who will gather them all together: He is all wise, all knowing.
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
verses.en: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
verses.tr: walaqad khalaqnā al-ʾinsāna min ṣalṣālin mmin ḥamaʾin mmasnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: We created man out of dried clay formed from dark mud-
verses.pickthall: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,

verses.ar: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.en: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
verses.tr: wa-l-jānna khalaqnāhu min qablu min nnāri as-samūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: the jinn We created before, from the fire of scorching wind.
verses.pickthall: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla rabbuka lilmalāʾikahi ʾinnā khāliqun basharan mmin ṣalṣālin mmin ḥamaʾin mmasnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a mortal out of dried clay, formed from dark mud.
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,

verses.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
verses.tr: fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rrūḥā faqaʿūā lahu sājidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When I have fashioned him and breathed My spirit into him, bow down before him,’
verses.pickthall: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.

verses.ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
verses.tr: fasajada al-malāʾikahu kulluhum ʾajmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and the angels all did so.
verses.pickthall: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together

verses.ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: Except Iblees; he refused to be with those who prostrated.
verses.tr: ʾillā ʾiblīsa ʾabā ʾan yakūna maʿa as-sājidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But not Iblis: he refused to bow down like the others.
verses.pickthall: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
verses.tr: qāla yāʾiblīsu mā laka ʾallā takūna maʿa as-sājidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Iblis, why did you not bow down like the others?’
verses.pickthall: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate?

verses.ar: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
verses.en: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
verses.tr: qāla lam ʾakun lliʾasjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min ṣalṣālin mmin ḥamaʾin mmasnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: and he answered, ‘I will not bow to a mortal You created from dried clay, formed from dark mud.’
verses.pickthall: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered!

verses.ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it, for indeed, you are expelled.
verses.tr: qāla fākhruj minhā fa-innaka rajīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Get out of here!’ said God. ‘You are an outcast,
verses.pickthall: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
verses.tr: wa-inna ʿalayka al-laʿnaha ʾilā yawmi ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: rejected until the Day of Judgement.’
verses.pickthall: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi fa-anẓirnā ʾilā yawmi yubʿathūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Iblis said, ‘My Lord, give me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead.’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
verses.tr: qāla fa-innaka mina al-munẓarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘You have respite,’ said God,
verses.pickthall: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.en: Until the Day of the time well-known."
verses.tr: ʾilā yawmi al-waqti al-maʿlūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘until the Day of the Appointed Time.’
verses.pickthall: Till the Day of appointed time.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
verses.tr: qāla rabbi bimā ʾaghwaytanā laʾuzayyinanna lahum fā al-ʾarḍi walaʾughwiyannahum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Iblis then said to God, ‘Because You have put me in the wrong, I will lure mankind on earth and put them in the wrong,
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,

verses.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
verses.tr: ʾillā ʿibādaka minhumu al-mukhlaṣīna
verses.abdelhaleem: all except Your devoted servants.’
verses.pickthall: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves.

verses.ar: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
verses.tr: qāla hādhā ṣirāṭun ʿalāa mustaqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘[Devotion] is a straight path to Me:
verses.pickthall: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me:

verses.ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
verses.tr: ʾinna ʿibādā laysa laka ʿalayhim sulṭānun ʾillā mani āttabaʿaka mina al-ghāwīna
verses.abdelhaleem: you will have no power over My servants, only over the ones who go astray and follow you.
verses.pickthall: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee,

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
verses.tr: wa-inna jahannama lamawʿiduhum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Hell is the promised place for all these,
verses.pickthall: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place.

verses.ar: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
verses.en: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."
verses.tr: lahā sabʿahu ʾabwābin llikulli bābin mminhum juzʾun mmaqsūmun
verses.abdelhaleem: with seven gates, each gate having its allotted share of them.
verses.pickthall: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,
verses.tr: ʾinna al-muttaqīna fā jannātin waʿuyūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: But the righteous will be in Gardens with springs-
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings.

verses.ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.en: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
verses.tr: ādkhulūhā bisalāmin āminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: “Enter them in peace and safety!”––
verses.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.

verses.ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.en: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
verses.tr: wanazaʿnā mā fā ṣudūrihim mmin ghillin ʾikhwānan ʿalā sururin mmutaqābilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We shall remove any bitterness from their hearts: [they will be like] brothers, sitting on couches, face to face.
verses.pickthall: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.

verses.ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.en: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
verses.tr: lā yamassuhum fīhā naṣabun wamā hum mminhā bimukhrajīna
verses.abdelhaleem: No weariness will ever touch them there, nor will they ever be expelled.’
verses.pickthall: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.

verses.ar: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: [O Muḥammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
verses.tr: ۞ nabbiʾ ʿibādā ʾannā ʾanā al-ghafūru ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], tell My servants that I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
verses.pickthall: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
verses.en: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
verses.tr: wa-anna ʿadhābā huwa al-ʿadhābu al-ʾalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: but My torment is the truly painful one.
verses.pickthall: And that My doom is the dolorous doom.

verses.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.en: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
verses.tr: wanabbiʾhum ʿan ḍayfi ʾibrāhīma
verses.abdelhaleem: Tell them too about Abraham’s guests:
verses.pickthall: And tell them of Abraham's guests,

verses.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
verses.en: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."
verses.tr: ʾidh dakhalūā ʿalayhi faqālūā salāman qāla ʾinnā minkum wajilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: when they came to him and said, ‘Peace,’ he said, ‘We are afraid of you.’
verses.pickthall: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.en: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
verses.tr: qālūā lā tawjal ʾinnā nubashiruka bighulāmin ʿalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Do not be afraid,’ they said, ‘We bring you good news of a son who will have great knowledge.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
verses.tr: qāla ʾabashartumūnā ʿalā ʾan mmassanāa al-kibaru fabima tubashirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘How can you give me such news when old age has come to me? What sort of news is this?’
verses.pickthall: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ
verses.en: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
verses.tr: qālūā basharnāka bi-l-ḥaqqi falā takun mmina al-qāniṭīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We have told you the truth, so do not despair.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing.

verses.ar: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
verses.en: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
verses.tr: qāla waman yaqnaṭu min rraḥmahi rabbihi ʾillā aḍ-ḍāllūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Who but the misguided despair of the mercy of their Lord?’
verses.pickthall: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray?

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
verses.tr: qāla famā khaṭbukum ʾayyuhā al-mursalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then asked, ‘Messengers, what is your errand?’
verses.pickthall: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)?

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
verses.tr: qālūā ʾinnā ʾursilnā ʾilā qawmin mmujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They replied, ‘We have been sent to a people who are guilty.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk,

verses.ar: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
verses.tr: ʾillā āla lūṭin ʾinnā lamunajjūhum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But We shall save the household of Lot,
verses.pickthall: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one,

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
verses.tr: ʾillā āmraʾatahu qaddarnā ۙ ʾinnahā lamina al-ghābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: all except his wife: We have decreed that she will be one of those who stay behind.
verses.pickthall: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.en: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
verses.tr: falammā jāʾa āla lūṭin al-mursalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the messengers came to the household of Lot,
verses.pickthall: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnakum qawmun mmunkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: he said, ‘You are strangers.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me).

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.en: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
verses.tr: qālūā bal jiʾnāka bimā kānūā fīhi yamtarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We have brought you what they said would never happen:
verses.pickthall: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing,

verses.ar: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
verses.en: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
verses.tr: wa-ataynāka bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-innā laṣādiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: we have brought you the Truth. We speak truly,
verses.pickthall: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers.

verses.ar: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.en: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
verses.tr: fa-asri biʾahlika biqiṭʿin mmina al-yli wāttabiʿ ʾadbārahum walā yaltafit minkum ʾaḥadun wāmḍūā ḥaythu tuʾmarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so leave in the dead of the night with your household, and walk behind them. Let none of you look back. Go where you are commanded.’
verses.pickthall: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.

verses.ar: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
verses.en: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
verses.tr: waqaḍaynā ʾilayhi dhālika al-ʾamra ʾanna dābira hāʾulāʾi maqṭūʿun mmuṣbiḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We made this decree known to him: the last remnants of those people would be wiped out in the morning.
verses.pickthall: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.en: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
verses.tr: wajāʾa ʾahlu al-madīnahi yastabshirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of the town came along, revelling,
verses.pickthall: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals).

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
verses.en: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
verses.tr: qāla ʾinna hāʾulāʾi ḍayfā falā tafḍaḥūni
verses.abdelhaleem: and he told them, ‘These are my guests, do not disgrace me.
verses.pickthall: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!

verses.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
verses.en: And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."
verses.tr: wāttaqūā Allāh walā tukhzūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Fear God, and do not shame me.’
verses.pickthall: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not!

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
verses.tr: qālūā ʾawalam nanhaka ʿani al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They answered, ‘Have we not told you not to interfere [between us and] anyone else?’
verses.pickthall: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone?

verses.ar: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.en: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
verses.tr: qāla hāʾulāʾi banātā ʾin kuntum fāʿilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My daughters are here, if you must.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so).

verses.ar: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.en: By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
verses.tr: laʿamruka ʾinnahum lafā sakratihim yaʿmahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: By your life [Prophet], they wandered on in their wild intoxication
verses.pickthall: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
verses.en: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
verses.tr: fa-akhadhathumu aṣ-ṣayḥahu mushriqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and the blast overtook them at sunrise:
verses.pickthall: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.

verses.ar: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
verses.en: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
verses.tr: fajaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim ḥijārahan mmin sijjīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: We turned their city upside down and rained on them a shower of clay stones.
verses.pickthall: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin llilmutawassimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this for those who can learn-
verses.pickthall: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
verses.en: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
verses.tr: wa-innahā labisabīlin mmuqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: it is still there on the highway-
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan llilmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: there truly is a sign in this for those who believe.
verses.pickthall: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.

verses.ar: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
verses.tr: wa-in kāna ʾaṣḥābu al-ʾaykahi laẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The forest-dwellers, too, were wrongdoers
verses.pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers.

verses.ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
verses.tr: fāntaqamnā minhum wa-innahumā labiʾimāmin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: and We took retribution on them; both are still there on the highway, plain for all to see.
verses.pickthall: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.
verses.tr: walaqad kadhaba ʾaṣḥābu al-ḥijri al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of al-Hijr also rejected Our messengers:
verses.pickthall: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.

verses.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.en: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
verses.tr: wataynāhum āyātinā fakānūā ʿanhā muʿriḍīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave them Our signs, but they turned their backs.
verses.pickthall: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them.

verses.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
verses.en: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
verses.tr: wakānūā yanḥitūna mina al-jibāli buyūtan āminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They carved out dwellings in the mountains, and lived in security-
verses.pickthall: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.en: But the shriek seized them at early morning,
verses.tr: fa-akhadhathumu aṣ-ṣayḥahu muṣbiḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: the blast overwhelmed them early in the morning.
verses.pickthall: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour,

verses.ar: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
verses.tr: famā ʾaghnā ʿanhum mmā kānūā yaksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What they had gained was of no use to them.
verses.pickthall: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
verses.en: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
verses.tr: wamā khalaqnā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wamā baynahumā ʾillā bi-l-ḥaqqi ۗ wa-inna as-sāʿaha lātiyahun ۖ fāṣfaḥi aṣ-ṣafḥa al-jamīla
verses.abdelhaleem: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them without a true purpose: the Hour will certainly come, so [Prophet] bear with them graciously.
verses.pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
verses.tr: ʾinna rabbaka huwa al-khallāqu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord is the All Knowing Creator.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
verses.en: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynāka sabʿan mmina al-mathānā wa-l-qurāna al-ʿaẓīma
verses.abdelhaleem: We have given you the seven oft-recited versesand the whole glorious Quran.
verses.pickthall: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.

verses.ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.
verses.tr: lā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ʾilā mā mattaʿnā bihi ʾazwājan mminhum walā taḥzan ʿalayhim wākhfiḍ janāḥaka lilmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not look longingly at the good things We have given some to enjoy. Do not grieve over the [disbelievers], but lower your wings over the believers
verses.pickthall: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.

verses.ar: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
verses.tr: waqul ʾinnā ʾanā an-nadhīru al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: and say, ‘I am here to give plain warning,’
verses.pickthall: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,

verses.ar: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
verses.en: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
verses.tr: kamā ʾanzalnā ʿalā al-muqtasimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: like the [warning] We have sent down for those who divide themselves into bands
verses.pickthall: Such as We send down for those who make division,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
verses.en: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna jaʿalūā al-qurāna ʿiḍīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and abuse the Quran––
verses.pickthall: Those who break the Qur'an into parts.

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
verses.tr: fawarabbika lanaslannahum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: by your Lord, We will question them all
verses.pickthall: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,

verses.ar: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: About what they used to do.
verses.tr: ʿammā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: about their deeds.
verses.pickthall: Of what they used to do.

verses.ar: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
verses.tr: fāṣdaʿ bimā tuʾmaru wa-aʿriḍ ʿani al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So proclaim openly what you have been commanded [to say], and ignore the idolaters.
verses.pickthall: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
verses.tr: ʾinnā kafaynāka al-mustahziʾīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We are enough for you against all those who ridicule your message,
verses.pickthall: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yajʿalūna maʿa Allāh ʾilāhan ākhara ۚ fasawfa yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who set up another god beside God- they will come to know.
verses.pickthall: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
verses.en: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
verses.tr: walaqad naʿlamu ʾannaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We are well aware that your heart is weighed down by what they say.
verses.pickthall: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
verses.tr: fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wakun mmina as-sājidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Celebrate the glory of your Lord and be among those who bow down to Him:
verses.pickthall: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).

verses.ar: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
verses.en: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
verses.tr: wāʿbud rabbaka ḥattā yaʾtiyaka al-yaqīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: worship your Lord until what is certain comes to you.
verses.pickthall: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.

verses.ar: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: The command of Allāh is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
verses.tr: ʾatā ʾamru Allāh falā tastaʿjilūhu ۚ subḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God’s Judgement is coming, so do not ask to bring it on sooner. Glory be to Him! He is far above anything they join with Him!
verses.pickthall: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him).

verses.ar: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.en: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration [i.e., revelation] of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
verses.tr: yunazzilu al-malāʾikaha bi-ar-rūḥi min ʾamrihi ʿalā man yashāʾu min ʿibādihi ʾan ʾandhirūā ʾannahu lā ʾilāha ʾillā ʾanā fāttaqūni
verses.abdelhaleem: He sends down angels with inspiration at His command, to whichever of His servants He chooses, to give [His] warning: ‘There is no god but Me, so beware of Me.’
verses.pickthall: He sendeth down the angels with the Spirit of His command unto whom He will of His bondmen, (saying): Warn mankind that there is no Allah save Me, so keep your duty unto Me.

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
verses.tr: khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa bi-l-ḥaqqi ۚ taʿālā ʿammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose, and He is far above whatever they join with Him!
verses.pickthall: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. High be He Exalted above all that they associate (with Him).

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once he is a clear adversary.
verses.tr: khalaqa al-ʾinsāna min nnuṭfahin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: He created man from a drop of fluid, and yet man openly challenges Him.
verses.pickthall: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
verses.tr: wa-l-ʾanʿāma khalaqahā ۗ lakum fīhā difʾun wamanāfiʿu waminhā taʾkulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And livestock––He created them too. You derive warmth and other benefits from them: you get food from them;
verses.pickthall: And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat;

verses.ar: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
verses.en: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
verses.tr: walakum fīhā jamālun ḥīna turīḥūna waḥīna tasraḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: you find beauty in them when you bring them home to rest and when you drive them out to pasture.
verses.pickthall: And wherein is beauty for you, when ye bring them home, and when ye take them out to pasture.

verses.ar: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَـٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
verses.tr: wataḥmilu ʾathqālakum ʾilā baladin llam takūnūā bālighīhi ʾillā bishiqqi al-ʾanfusi ۚ ʾinna rabbakum laraʾūfun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: They carry your loads to lands you yourselves could not reach without great hardship––truly your Lord is kind and merciful––
verses.pickthall: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
verses.tr: wa-l-khayla wa-l-bighāla wa-l-ḥamīra litarkabūhā wazīnahan ۚ wayakhluqu mā lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: horses, mules, and donkeys for you to ride and use for show, and other things you know nothing about.
verses.pickthall: And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not.

verses.ar: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: And upon Allāh is the direction of the [right] way, and among them [i.e., the various paths] are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
verses.tr: waʿalā Allāh qaṣdu as-sabīli waminhā jāʾirun ۚ walaw shāʾa lahadākum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God points out the right path, for some paths lead the wrong way: if He wished, He could guide you all.
verses.pickthall: And Allah's is the direction of the way, and some (roads) go not straight. And had He willed He would have led you all aright.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
verses.en: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā ʾanzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan ۖ llakum mminhu sharābun waminhu shajarun fīhi tusīmūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who sends down water for you from the sky, from which comes a drink for you, and the shrubs that you feed to your animals.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, whence ye have drink, and whence are trees on which ye send your beasts to pasture.

verses.ar: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَـٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and of all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
verses.tr: yunbitu lakum bihi az-zarʿa wa-az-zaytūna wa-an-nakhīla wa-l-ʾaʿnāba wamin kulli ath-thamarāti ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan lliqawmin yatafakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: With it He grows for you grain, olives, palms, vines, and all kinds of other crops. There truly is a sign in this for those who reflect.
verses.pickthall: Therewith He causeth crops to grow for you, and the olive and the date-palm and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.

verses.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
verses.tr: wasakhara lakumu al-yla wa-an-nahāra wa-ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara ۖ wa-an-nujūmu musakharātun biʾamrihi ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: By His command He has made the night and day, the sun, moon, and stars all of benefit to you. There truly are signs in this for those who use their reason.
verses.pickthall: And He hath constrained the night and the day and the sun and the moon to be of service unto you, and the stars are made subservient by His command. Lo! herein indeed are portents for people who have sense.

verses.ar: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
verses.tr: wamā dharaʾa lakum fā al-ʾarḍi mukhtalifan ʾalwānuhu ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan lliqawmin yadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He has made of benefit to you the many-coloured things He has multiplied on the earth. There truly are signs in this for those who take it to heart.
verses.pickthall: And whatsoever He hath created for you in the earth of divers hues, lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who take heed.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā sakhara al-baḥra litaʾkulūā minhu laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijūā minhu ḥilyahan talbasūnahā watarā al-fulka mawākhira fīhi walitabtaghūā min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who made the sea of benefit to you: you eat fresh fish from it and bring out jewellery to wear; you see the ships cutting through its waves so that you may go in search of His bounty and give thanks.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who hath constrained the sea to be of service that ye eat fresh meat from thence, and bring forth from thence ornaments which ye wear. And thou seest the ships ploughing it that ye (mankind) may seek of His bounty and that haply ye may give thanks.

verses.ar: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَـٰرًا وَسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
verses.tr: wa-ʾalqā fā al-ʾarḍi rawāsāa ʾan tamīda bikum wa-anhāran wasubulan llaʿallakum tahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He has made mountains stand firm on the earth, to prevent it shaking under you, and rivers and paths so that you may find your way,
verses.pickthall: And He hath cast into the earth firm hills that it quake not with you, and streams and roads that ye may find a way.

verses.ar: وَعَلَـٰمَـٰتٍ ۚ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
verses.tr: waʿalāmātin ۚ wabālnnajmi hum yahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and landmarks and stars to guide people.
verses.pickthall: And landmarks (too), and by the star they find a way.

verses.ar: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ ۗ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?
verses.tr: ʾafaman yakhluqu kaman llā yakhluqu ۗ ʾafalā tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Can He who creates be compared to one who cannot create? Why do you not take heed?
verses.pickthall: Is He then Who createth as him who createth not? Will ye not then remember?

verses.ar: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And if you should count the favors of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-in taʿuddūā niʿmaha Allāh lā tuḥṣūhā ۗ ʾinna Allāh laghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: If you tried to count God’s blessings, you could never take them all in: He is truly most forgiving and most merciful.
verses.pickthall: And if ye would count the favour of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! Allah is indeed Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh knows what you conceal and what you declare.
verses.tr: wallāh yaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿlinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He knows what you conceal and what you reveal.
verses.pickthall: And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden and that which ye proclaim.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
verses.en: And those they invoke other than Allāh create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yadʿūna min dūni Allāh lā yakhluqūna shayā wahum yukhlaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those they invoke beside God create nothing; they are themselves created.
verses.pickthall: Those unto whom they cry beside Allah created naught, but are themselves created.

verses.ar: أَمْوَٰتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍ ۖ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: They are [in fact] dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.
verses.tr: ʾamwātun ghayru ʾaḥyāʾin ۖ wamā yashʿurūna ʾayyāna yubʿathūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They are dead, not living. They do not know when they will be raised up.
verses.pickthall: (They are) dead, not living. And they know not when they will be raised.

verses.ar: إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.en: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.
verses.tr: ʾilāhukum ʾilāhun wāḥidun ۚ fa-adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi qulūbuhum mmunkirahun wahum mmustakbirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your God is the One God. As for those who deny the life to come, their hearts refuse to admit the truth and they are arrogant.
verses.pickthall: Your Allah is One Allah. But as for those who believe not in the Hereafter their hearts refuse to know, for they are proud.

verses.ar: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ
verses.en: Assuredly, Allāh knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.
verses.tr: lā jarama ʾanna Allāh yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿlinūna ۚ ʾinnahu lā yuḥibbu al-mustakbirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There is no doubt that God knows what they conceal and what they reveal. He does not love the arrogant.
verses.pickthall: Assuredly Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He loveth not the proud.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۙ قَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" they say, "Legends of the former peoples,"
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla lahum mmādhā ʾanzala rabbukum ۙ qālūā ʾasāṭīru al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they are asked, ‘What has your Lord sent down?’ they say, ‘Ancient fables.’
verses.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: What hath your Lord revealed? they say: (Mere) fables of the men of old,

verses.ar: لِيَحْمِلُوٓا۟ أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
verses.en: That they may bear their own burdens [i.e., sins] in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without [i.e., by lack of] knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
verses.tr: liyaḥmilūā ʾawzārahum kāmilahan yawma al-qiyāmahi ۙ wamin ʾawzāri adh-dhīna yuḍillūnahum bighayri ʿilmin ۗ ʾalā sāʾa mā yazirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day of Resurrection they will bear the full weight of their own burden, as well as some of the burden of those they misled with no true knowledge. How terrible their burden will be!
verses.pickthall: That they may bear their burdens undiminished on the Day of Resurrection, with somewhat of the burdens of those whom they mislead without knowledge. Ah! evil is that which they bear!

verses.ar: قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَـٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Those before them had already plotted, but Allāh came at [i.e., uprooted] their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.
verses.tr: qad makara adh-dhīna min qablihim fa-atā Allāh bunyānahum mmina al-qawāʿidi fakharra ʿalayhimu as-saqfu min fawqihim wa-atāhumu al-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who went before them also schemed, but God attacked the very foundations of what they built. The roof fell down on them: punishment came on them from unimagined directions.
verses.pickthall: Those before them plotted, so Allah struck at the foundations of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them from above them, and the doom came on them whence they knew not;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَـٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمْ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ إِنَّ ٱلْخِزْىَ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -
verses.tr: thumma yawma al-qiyāmahi yukhzīhim wayaqūlu ʾayna shurakāa adh-dhīna kuntum tushāqqūna fīhim ۚ qāla adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-ʿilma ʾinna al-khizāa al-yawma wa-as-sūʾa ʿalā al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: In the end, on the Day of Resurrection, He will shame them, saying, ‘Where are these “partners” of Mine on whose account you opposed [Me]?’ Those given knowledge will say, ‘Shame and misery on the disbelievers today!’
verses.pickthall: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and will say: Where are My partners, for whose sake ye opposed (My guidance)? Those who have been given knowledge will say: Disgrace this day and evil are upon the disbelievers,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ فَأَلْقَوُا۟ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوٓءٍۭ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of what you used to do.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna tatawaffāhumu al-malāʾikahu ẓālimā ʾanfusihim ۖ fa-ā as-salama mā kunnā naʿmalu min sūʾin ۚ balā ʾinna Allāh ʿalīmun bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those whose lives the angels take while they are wronging themselves will show submission: ‘We were doing no evil.’ ‘Yes you were: God knows fully everything that you have done,
verses.pickthall: Whom the angels cause to die while they are wronging themselves. Then will they make full submission (saying): We used not to do any wrong. Nay! Surely Allah is Knower of what ye used to do.

verses.ar: فَٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
verses.en: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
