verses.tr: fādkhulūā ʾabwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā ۖ falabiʾsa mathwā al-mutakabbirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: so enter the gates of Hell. There you will remain- the home of the arrogant is evil indeed.’
verses.pickthall: So enter the gates of hell, to dwell therein for ever. Woeful indeed will be the lodging of the arrogant.

verses.ar: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا۟ خَيْرًا ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And it will be said to those who feared Allāh, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
verses.tr: ۞ waqīla lilladhīna āttaqawā mādhā ʾanzala rabbukum ۚ qālūā khayran ۗ llilladhīna ʾaḥsanūā fā hādhihi ad-dunyā ḥasanahun ۚ waladāru al-ākhirahi khayrun ۚ walaniʿma dāru al-muttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But when the righteous are asked, ‘What has your Lord sent down?’ they will say, ‘All that is good.’ There is a reward in this present world for those who do good, but their home in the Hereafter is far better: the home of the righteous is excellent.
verses.pickthall: And it is said unto those who ward off (evil): What hath your Lord revealed? They say: Good. For those who do good in this world there is a good (reward) and the home of the Hereafter will be better. Pleasant indeed will be the home of those who ward off (evil) -

verses.ar: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allāh reward the righteous -
verses.tr: jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru ۖ lahum fīhā mā yashāʾūna ۚ kadhālika yajzā Allāh al-muttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will enter perpetual Gardens graced with flowing streams. There they will have everything they wish. This is the way God rewards the righteous,
verses.pickthall: Gardens of Eden which they enter, underneath which rivers flow, wherein they have what they will. Thus Allah repayeth those who ward off (evil),

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ ۙ يَقُولُونَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do."
verses.tr: adh-dhīna tatawaffāhumu al-malāʾikahu ṭayyibīna ۙ yaqūlūna salāmun ʿalaykumu ādkhulūā al-jannaha bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those whose lives the angels take in a state of goodness. They will say to them, ‘Peace be upon you. Enter the Garden as a reward for what you have done.’
verses.pickthall: Those whom the angels cause to die (when they are) good. They say: Peace be unto you! Enter the Garden because of what ye used to do.

verses.ar: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: Do they [i.e., the disbelievers] await except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allāh wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.
verses.tr: hal yanẓurūna ʾillā ʾan taʾtiyahumu al-malāʾikahu ʾaw yaʾtāa ʾamru rabbika ۚ kadhālika faʿala adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ wamā ẓalamahumu Allāh walākin kānūā ʾanfusahum yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Are the disbelievers waiting for the angels to come to them, or your Lord’s Judgement? Those who went before them did the same. God did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.
verses.pickthall: Await they aught say that the angels should come unto them or thy Lord's command should come to pass? Even so did those before them. Allah wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves,

verses.ar: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.tr: fa-aṣābahum sayyātu mā ʿamilūā waḥāqa bihim mmā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So the evil they had done hit them and they were surrounded by the very thing they had mocked.
verses.pickthall: So that the evils of what they did smote them, and that which they used to mock surrounded them.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ نَّحْنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ فَهَلْ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: And those who associate others with Allāh say, "If Allāh had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna ʾashrakūā law shāʾa Allāh mā ʿabadnā min dūnihi min shāʾin nnaḥnu walā ābāʾunā walā ḥarramnā min dūnihi min shāʾin ۚ kadhālika faʿala adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ fahal ʿalā ar-rusuli ʾillā al-balāghu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who worshipped others alongside God say, ‘If God had willed, we would not have worshipped anything but Him, nor would our fathers. We would not have declared anything forbidden without His sanction.’ Those before them said the same. Are the messengers obliged to do anything other than deliver [their message] clearly?
verses.pickthall: And the idolaters say: Had Allah willed, we had not worshipped aught beside Him, we and our fathers, nor had we forbidden aught without (command from) Him. Even so did those before them. Are the messengers charged with aught save plain conveyance (of the message)?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allāh and avoid ṭāghūt." And among them were those whom Allāh guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed [i.e., travel] through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.
verses.tr: walaqad baʿathnā fā kulli ʾummahin rrasūlan ʾani āʿbudūā Allāh wājtanibūā aṭ-ṭāghūta ۖ faminhum mman hadā Allāh waminhum mman ḥaqqat ʿalayhi aḍ-ḍalālahu ۚ fasīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fānẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent a messenger to every community, saying, ‘Worship God and shun false gods.’ Among them were some God guided; misguidance took hold of others. So travel through the earth and see what was the fate of those who denied the truth.
verses.pickthall: And verily We have raised in every nation a messenger, (proclaiming): Serve Allah and shun false gods. Then some of them (there were) whom Allah guided, and some of them (there were) upon whom error had just hold. Do but travel in the land and see the nature of the consequence for the deniers!

verses.ar: إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَن يُضِلُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.en: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muḥammad], indeed, Allāh does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.
verses.tr: ʾin taḥriṣ ʿalā hudāhum fa-inna Allāh lā yahdā man yuḍillu ۖ wamā lahum mmin nnāṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Though you [Prophet] may be eager to guide them, God does not guide those who misguide [others], nor will they have anyone to help them.
verses.pickthall: Even if thou (O Muhammad) desirest their right guidance, still Allah assuredly will not guide him who misleadeth. Such have no helpers.

verses.ar: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ ۙ لَا يَبْعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُ ۚ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths [that] Allāh will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.
verses.tr: wa-aqsamūā billāh jahda ʾaymānihim ۙ lā yabʿathu Allāh man yamūtu ۚ balā waʿdan ʿalayhi ḥaqqan walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They have sworn by God with their strongest oaths that He will not raise the dead to life. But He will- it is His binding promise, though most people do not realize it-
verses.pickthall: And they swear by Allah their most binding oaths (that) Allah will not raise up him who dieth. Nay, but it is a promise (binding) upon Him in truth, but most of mankind know not,

verses.ar: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.
verses.tr: liyubayyina lahumu adh-dhā yakhtalifūna fīhi waliyaʿlama adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾannahum kānūā kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: in order to make clear for them what they have differed about and so that the disbelievers may realize that what they said was false.
verses.pickthall: That He may explain unto them that wherein they differ, and that those who disbelieved may know that they were liars.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدْنَـٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.en: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā qawlunā lishāʾin ʾidhā ʾaradnāhu ʾan nnaqūla lahu kun fayakūnu
verses.abdelhaleem: When We will something to happen, all that We say is, ‘Be,’ and it is.
verses.pickthall: And Our word unto a thing, when We intend it, is only that We say unto it: Be! and it is.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً ۖ وَلَأَجْرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allāh after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hājarūā fā Allāh min baʿdi mā ẓulimūā lanubawwiʾannahum fā ad-dunyā ḥasanahan ۖ walaʾajru al-ākhirahi ʾakbaru ۚ law kānūā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who emi-grated in God’s cause after being wronged, We shall give them a good home in this world, but the reward of the Hereafter will be far greater, if they only knew it.
verses.pickthall: And those who became fugitives for the cause of Allah after they had been oppressed, We verily shall give them goodly lodging in the world, and surely the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if they but knew;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verses.en: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ṣabarūā waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They are the ones who are steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.
verses.pickthall: Such as are steadfast and put their trust in Allah.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnā min qablika ʾillā rijālan nnūḥā ʾilayhim ۚ faslūā ʾahla adh-dhikri ʾin kuntum lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], all the messengers We sent before you were simply men to whom We had given the Revelation: you [people] can ask those who have knowledge if you do not know.
verses.pickthall: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men whom We inspired - Ask the followers of the Remembrance if ye know not! -

verses.ar: بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ ۗ وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.
verses.tr: bi-l-bayyināti wa-az-zuburi ۗ wa-anzalnā ʾilayka adh-dhikra litubayyina lilnnāsi mā nuzzila ʾilayhim walaʿallahum yatafakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent them with clear signs and scriptures. We have sent down the message to you too [Prophet], so that you can explain to people what was sent for them, so that they may reflect.
verses.pickthall: With clear proofs and writings; and We have revealed unto thee the Remembrance that thou mayst explain to mankind that which hath been revealed for them, and that haply they may reflect.

verses.ar: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخْسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allāh will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?
verses.tr: ʾafaʾamina adh-dhīna makarūā as-sayyāti ʾan yakhsifa Allāh bihimu al-ʾarḍa ʾaw yaʾtiyahumu al-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Are those who plan evil so sure that God will not make the earth swallow them up, that punishment will not come on them from some unimagined direction,
verses.pickthall: Are they who plan ill-deeds then secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the doom will not come on them whence they know not?

verses.ar: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِى تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verses.en: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure [i.e., escape from Him]?
verses.tr: ʾaw yaʾkhudhahum fā taqallubihim famā hum bimuʿjizīna
verses.abdelhaleem: that it will not catch them suddenly in the midst of their comings and goings- for they cannot frustrate God-
verses.pickthall: Or that He will not seize them in their going to and fro so that there be no escape for them?

verses.ar: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
verses.tr: ʾaw yaʾkhudhahum ʿalā takhawwufin fa-inna rabbakum laraʾūfun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: or that it will not catch up with them gradually? Indeed your Lord is kind and merciful.
verses.pickthall: Or that He will not seize them with a gradual wasting? Lo! thy Lord is indeed Full of Pity, Merciful.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ يَتَفَيَّؤُا۟ ظِلَـٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
verses.en: Have they not considered what things Allāh has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allāh, while they [i.e., those creations] are humble.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yarawā ʾilā mā khalaqa Allāh min shāʾin yatafayyaā ẓilāluhu ʿani al-yamīni wa-ash-shamāʾili sujjadan lillāh wahum dākhirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do the [disbelievers] not observe the things that God has created, casting their shadows right and left, submitting themselves to God obediently?
verses.pickthall: Have they not observed all things that Allah hath created, how their shadows incline to the right and to the left, making prostration unto Allah, and they are lowly?

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.en: And to Allāh prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh yasjudu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi min dābbahin wa-l-malāʾikahu wahum lā yastakbirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is to God that everything in the heavens and earth submits, every beast that moves, even the angels- they are free from arrogance:
verses.pickthall: And unto Allah maketh prostration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth of living creatures, and the angels (also) and they are not proud.

verses.ar: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ ۩
verses.en: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.
verses.tr: yakhāfūna rabbahum mmin fawqihim wayafʿalūna mā yuʾmarūna ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: they fear their Lord above them, and they do as they are commanded.
verses.pickthall: They fear their Lord above them, and do what they are bidden.

verses.ar: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ إِلَـٰهَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ ۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
verses.en: And Allāh has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He [i.e., Allāh] is but one God, so fear only Me."
verses.tr: ۞ waqāla Allāh lā tattakhidhūā ʾilāhayni āthnayni ۖ ʾinnamā huwa ʾilāhun wāḥidun ۖ fa-iyyāa fārhabūni
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Do not take two gods’- for He is the One God––‘ I alone am the One that you should hold in awe.’
verses.pickthall: Allah hath said: Choose not two gods. There is only One Allah. So of Me, Me only, be in awe.

verses.ar: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا ۚ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allāh that you fear?
verses.tr: walahu mā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi walahu ad-dīnu wāṣiban ۚ ʾafaghayra Allāh tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Him: everlasting obedience is His right. Will you heed anyone other than God?
verses.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth, and religion is His for ever. Will ye then fear any other than Allah?

verses.ar: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ
verses.en: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allāh. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
verses.tr: wamā bikum mmin nniʿmahin famina Allāh ۖ thumma ʾidhā massakumu aḍ-ḍurru fa-ʾilayhi tajrūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whatever good things you possess come from God, and when hardship afflicts you, it is to Him alone you cry out for help,
verses.pickthall: And whatever of comfort ye enjoy, it is from Allah. Then, when misfortune reacheth you, unto Him ye cry for help.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord
verses.tr: thumma ʾidhā kashafa aḍ-ḍurra ʿankum ʾidhā farīqun mminkum birabbihim yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: yet when He has relieved you of your hardship- lo and behold!- some of you attribute partners to your Lord.
verses.pickthall: And afterward, when He hath rid you of the misfortune, behold! a set of you attribute partners to their Lord,

verses.ar: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
verses.tr: liyakfurūā bimā ātaynāhum ۚ fatamattaʿūā ۖ fasawfa taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Let them show ingratitude for the favours We have shown them; ‘Enjoy your brief time- soon you will know.’
verses.pickthall: So as to deny that which We have given them. Then enjoy life (while ye may), for ye will come to know.

verses.ar: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: And they assign to what they do not know [i.e., false deities] a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allāh, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.
verses.tr: wayajʿalūna limā lā yaʿlamūna naṣīban mmimmā razaqnāhum ۗ tallāh latuslunna ʿammā kuntum taftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They set aside part of the sustenance We give them, for [idols] about which they have no true knowledge. By God! You will be questioned about your false inventions.
verses.pickthall: And they assign a portion of that which We have given them unto what they know not. By Allah! but ye will indeed be asked concerning (all) that ye used to invent.

verses.ar: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْبَنَـٰتِ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.en: And they attribute to Allāh daughters - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire [i.e., sons].
verses.tr: wayajʿalūna lillāh al-banāti subḥānahu ۙ walahum mmā yashtahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They assign daughters to God––may He be exalted!––and the [sons] they desire to themselves.
verses.pickthall: And they assign unto Allah daughters - Be He Glorified! - and unto themselves what they desire;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
verses.tr: wa-idhā bushira ʾaḥaduhum bi-l-ʾunthā ẓalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa kaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When one of them is given news of the birth of a baby girl, his face darkens and he is filled with gloom.
verses.pickthall: When if one of them receiveth tidings of the birth of a female, his face remaineth darkened, and he is wroth inwardly.

verses.ar: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ أَيُمْسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِى ٱلتُّرَابِ ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
verses.en: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide.
verses.tr: yatawārā mina al-qawmi min sūʾi mā bushira bihi ۚ ʾayumsikuhu ʿalā hūnin ʾam yadussuhu fā at-turābi ۗ ʾalā sāʾa mā yaḥkumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In his shame he hides himself away from his people because of the bad news he has been given. Should he keep her and suffer contempt or bury her in the dust? How ill they judge!
verses.pickthall: He hideth himself from the folk because of the evil of that whereof he hath had tidings, (asking himself): Shall he keep it in contempt, or bury it beneath the dust. Verily evil is their judgment.

verses.ar: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۖ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description [i.e., an attribute] of evil; and for Allāh is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: lilladhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi mathalu as-sawʾi ۖ wa-lillāh al-mathalu al-ʾaʿlā ۚ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter should have the contemptible image, and God should have the highest one: He is the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: For those who believe not in the Hereafter is an evil similitude, and Allah's is the Sublime Similitude. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةً ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
verses.en: And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
verses.tr: walaw yuākhidhu Allāh an-nāsa biẓulmihim mmā taraka ʿalayhā min dābbahin walākin yuʾakhiruhum ʾilā ʾajalin mmusammanā ۖ fa-idhā jāʾa ʾajaluhum lā yastakhirūna sāʿahan ۖ walā yastaqdimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If God took people to task for the evil they do, He would not leave one living creature on earth, but He reprieves them until an appointed time: when their time comes they cannot delay it for a moment nor can they bring it forward.
verses.pickthall: If Allah were to take mankind to task for their wrong-doing, he would not leave hereon a living creature, but He reprieveth them to an appointed term, and when their term cometh they cannot put (it) off an hour nor (yet) advance (it).

verses.ar: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ
verses.en: And they attribute to Allāh that which they dislike [i.e., daughters], and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.
verses.tr: wayajʿalūna lillāh mā yakrahūna wataṣifu ʾalsinatuhumu al-kadhiba ʾanna lahumu al-ḥusnā ۖ lā jarama ʾanna lahumu an-nāra wa-annahum mmufraṭūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They attribute to God what they themselves dislike while their own tongues utter the lie that the best belongs to them. Without doubt it is the Fire that belongs to them: they will be given priority there!
verses.pickthall: And they assign unto Allah that which they (themselves) dislike, and their tongues expound the lie that the better portion will be theirs. Assuredly theirs will be the Fire, and they will be abandoned.

verses.ar: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: By Allāh, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is their [i.e., the disbelievers] ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.
verses.tr: tallāh laqad ʾarsalnā ʾilā ʾumamin mmin qablika fazayyana lahumu ash-shayṭānu ʾaʿmālahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu al-yawma walahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: By God, We have sent messengers before you [Muhammad] to other communities, but Satan made their foul deeds seem alluring to them. He is the patron of these present disbelievers too, and a painful punishment awaits them all.
verses.pickthall: By Allah, We verily sent messengers unto the nations before thee, but the devil made their deeds fairseeming unto them. So he is their patron this day, and theirs will be a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۙ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muḥammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
verses.tr: wamā ʾanzalnā ʿalayka al-kitāba ʾillā litubayyina lahumu adh-dhā ākhtalafūā fīhi ۙ wahudanā waraḥmahan lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent down the Scripture to you only to make clear to them what they differ about, and as guidance and mercy to those who believe.
verses.pickthall: And We have revealed the Scripture unto thee only that thou mayst explain unto them that wherein they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.
verses.tr: wallāh ʾanzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan fa-aḥyā bihi al-ʾarḍa baʿda mawtihā ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan lliqawmin yasmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who sends water down from the sky and with it revives the earth when it is dead. There truly is a sign in this for people who listen.
verses.pickthall: Allah sendeth down water from the sky and therewith reviveth the earth after her death. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a folk who hear.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَآئِغًا لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.
verses.tr: wa-inna lakum fā al-ʾanʿāmi laʿibrahan ۖ nnusqīkum mmimmā fā buṭūnihi min bayni farthin wadamin llabanan khāliṣan sāʾighan llilshāribīna
verses.abdelhaleem: In livestock, too, you have a lesson- We give you a drink from the contents of their bellies, between waste matter and blood, pure milk, sweet to the drinker.
verses.pickthall: And lo! in the cattle there is a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, from betwixt the refuse and the blood, pure milk palatable to the drinkers.

verses.ar: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلْأَعْنَـٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
verses.tr: wamin thamarāti an-nakhīli wa-l-ʾaʿnābi tattakhidhūna minhu sakaran warizqan ḥasanan ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan lliqawmin yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: From the fruits of date palms and grapes you take sweet juice and wholesome provisions. There truly is a sign in this for people who use their reason.
verses.pickthall: And of the fruits of the date-palm, and grapes, whence ye derive strong drink and (also) good nourishment. Lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who have sense.

verses.ar: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحْلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِى مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ
verses.en: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses [i.e., hives], and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
verses.tr: wa-awḥā rabbuka ʾilā an-naḥli ʾani āttakhidhā mina al-jibāli buyūtan wamina ash-shajari wamimmā yaʿrishūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And your Lord inspired the bee, saying, ‘Build yourselves houses in the mountains and trees and what people construct.
verses.pickthall: And thy Lord inspired the bee, saying: Choose thou habitations in the hills and in the trees and in that which they thatch;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
verses.tr: thumma kulā min kulli ath-thamarāti fāslukā subula rabbiki dhululan ۚ yakhruju min buṭūnihā sharābun mmukhtalifun ʾalwānuhu fīhi shifāʾun llilnnāsi ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan lliqawmin yatafakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then feed on all kinds of fruit and follow the ways made easy for you by your Lord.’ From their bellies comes a drink of different colours in which there is healing for people. There truly is a sign in this for those who think.
verses.pickthall: Then eat of all fruits, and follow the ways of thy Lord, made smooth (for thee). There cometh forth from their bellies a drink divers of hues, wherein is healing for mankind. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَىْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: And Allāh created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Competent.
verses.tr: wallāh khalaqakum thumma yatawaffākum ۚ waminkum mman yuraddu ʾilā ʾardhali al-ʿumuri likā lā yaʿlama baʿda ʿilmin shayā ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalīmun qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who has created you and in time will cause you to die. Some of you will be reduced, in old age, to a most abject state, so that, after having knowledge, they will know nothing at all: God is truly all knowing and all powerful.
verses.pickthall: And Allah createth you, then causeth you to die, and among you is he who is brought back to the most abject stage of life, so that he knoweth nothing after (having had) knowledge. Lo! Allah is Knower, Powerful.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِى ٱلرِّزْقِ ۚ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا۟ بِرَآدِّى رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ ۚ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored [i.e., given more] would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess [i.e., slaves] so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allāh they reject?
verses.tr: wallāh faḍḍala baʿḍakum ʿalā baʿḍin fā ar-rizqi ۚ famā adh-dhīna fuḍḍilūā birāddā rizqihim ʿalā mā malakat ʾaymānuhum fahum fīhi sawāʾun ۚ ʾafabiniʿmahi Allāh yajḥadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God has given some of you more provision than others. Those who have been given more are unwilling to pass their provision on to the slaves they possess so that they become their equals. How can they refuse to acknowledge God’s blessings?
verses.pickthall: And Allah hath favoured some of you above others in provision. Now those who are more favoured will by no means hand over their provision to those (slaves) whom their right hands possess, so that they may be equal with them in respect thereof. Is it then the grace of Allah that they deny?

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allāh they disbelieve?
verses.tr: wallāh jaʿala lakum mmin ʾanfusikum ʾazwājan wajaʿala lakum mmin ʾazwājikum banīna waḥafadahan warazaqakum mmina aṭ-ṭayyibāti ۚ ʾafabālbāṭili yuʾminūna wabiniʿmati Allāh hum yakfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And it is God who has given you spouses from amongst yourselves and through them He has given you children and grandchildren and provided you with good things. How can they believe in falsehood and deny God’s blessings?
verses.pickthall: And Allah hath given you wives of your own kind, and hath given you, from your wives, sons and grandsons, and hath made provision of good things for you. Is it then in vanity that they believe and in the grace of Allah that they disbelieve?

verses.ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verses.en: And they worship besides Allāh that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.
verses.tr: wayaʿbudūna min dūni Allāh mā lā yamliku lahum rizqan mmina as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi shayā walā yastaṭīʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those they worship beside God have no power to provide anything for them from the heavens or the earth: they can do nothing.
verses.pickthall: And they worship beside Allah that which owneth no provision whatsoever for them from the heavens or the earth, nor have they (whom they worship) any power.

verses.ar: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So do not assert similarities to Allāh. Indeed, Allāh knows and you do not know.
verses.tr: falā taḍribūā lillāh al-ʾamthāla ۚ ʾinna Allāh yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So do not make up images about God: God knows and you do not.
verses.pickthall: So coin not similitudes for Allah. Lo! Allah knoweth; ye know not.

verses.ar: ۞ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَـٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوُۥنَ ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Allāh presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allāh! But most of them do not know.
verses.tr: ۞ ḍaraba Allāh mathalan ʿabdan mmamlūkan llā yaqdiru ʿalā shāʾin waman rrazaqnāhu minnā rizqan ḥasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirran wajahran ۖ hal yastawuna ۚ al-ḥamdu lillāh ۚ bal ʾaktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God presents this illustration: a slave controlled by his master, with no power over anything, and another man We have supplied with good provision, from which he gives alms privately and openly. Can they be considered equal? All praise belongs to God, but most of them do not recognize this.
verses.pickthall: Allah coineth a similitude: (on the one hand) a (mere) chattel slave, who hath control of nothing, and (on the other hand) one on whom we have bestowed a fair provision from Us, and he spendeth thereof secretly and openly. Are they equal? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not.

verses.ar: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَىٰهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۙ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: And Allāh presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?
verses.tr: waḍaraba Allāh mathalan rrajulayni ʾaḥaduhumā ʾabkamu lā yaqdiru ʿalā shāʾin wahuwa kallun ʿalā mawlāhu ʾaynamā yuwajjihhhu lā yaʾti bikhayrin ۖ hal yastawā huwa waman yaʾmuru bi-l-ʿadli ۙ wahuwa ʿalā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: God presents another illustration: two men, one of them dumb, unable to do anything, a burden to his carer- whatever task he directs him to, he achieves nothing good- can he be considered equal to one who commands justice and is on the straight path?
verses.pickthall: And Allah coineth a similitude: Two men, one of them dumb, having control of nothing, and he is a burden on his owner; whithersoever he directeth him to go, he bringeth no good. Is he equal with one who enjoineth justice and followeth a straight path (of conduct)?

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَآ أَمْرُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ ٱلْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: And to Allāh belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh ghaybu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ wamā ʾamru as-sāʿahi ʾillā kalamḥi al-baṣari ʾaw huwa ʾaqrabu ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: All that is hidden from view in the heavens and earth belongs to God. The coming of the Hour of Judgement is like the blink of an eye, or even quicker: God has power over everything.
verses.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and the matter of the Hour (of Doom) is but as a twinkling of the eye, or it is nearer still. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect] that perhaps you would be grateful.
verses.tr: wallāh ʾakhrajakum mmin buṭūni ʾummahātikum lā taʿlamūna shayā wajaʿala lakumu as-samʿa wa-l-ʾabṣāra wa-l-ʾafdaha ۙ laʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who brought you out of your mothers’ wombs knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and minds, so that you might be thankful.
verses.pickthall: And Allah brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and hearts that haply ye might give thanks.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍ فِى جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allāh. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
verses.tr: ʾalam yarawā ʾilā aṭ-ṭayri musakharātin fā jawwi as-samāʾi mā yumsikuhunna ʾillā Allāh ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not see the birds made to fly through the air in the sky? Nothing holds them up except God. There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
verses.pickthall: Have they not seen the birds obedient in mid-air? None holdeth them save Allah. Lo! herein, verily, are portents for a people who believe.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَآ أَثَـٰثًا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: And Allāh has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time.
verses.tr: wallāh jaʿala lakum mmin buyūtikum sakanan wajaʿala lakum mmin julūdi al-ʾanʿāmi buyūtan tastakhiffūnahā yawma ẓaʿnikum wayawma ʾiqāmatikum ۙ wamin ʾaṣwāfihā wa-awbārihā wa-ashʿārihā ʾathāthan wamatāʿan ʾilā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who has given you a place of rest in your homes and from the skins of animals made you homes that you find light [to handle] when you travel and when you set up camp; furnishings and comfort for a while from their wool, fur, and hair.
verses.pickthall: And Allah hath given you in your houses an abode, and hath given you (also), of the hides of cattle, houses which ye find light (to carry) on the day of migration and on the day of pitching camp; and of their wool and their fur and their hair, caparison and comfort for a while.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَـٰلًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ أَكْنَـٰنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلْحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows [i.e., shade] and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments [i.e., coats of mail] which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him].
verses.tr: wallāh jaʿala lakum mmimmā khalaqa ẓilālan wajaʿala lakum mmina al-jibāli ʾaknānan wajaʿala lakum sarābīla taqīkumu al-ḥarra wasarābīla taqīkum baʾsakum ۚ kadhālika yutimmu niʿmatahu ʿalaykum laʿallakum tuslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who has given you shade from what He has created, and places of shelter in the mountains; garments to protect you from the heat, and garments to protect you in your wars. In this way He perfects His blessings on you, so that you may devote yourselves to Him.
verses.pickthall: And Allah hath given you, of that which He hath created, shelter from the sun; and hath given you places of refuge in the mountains, and hath given you coats to ward off the heat from you, and coats (of armour) to save you from your own foolhardiness. Thus doth He perfect His favour unto you, in order that ye may surrender (unto Him).

verses.ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: But if they turn away, [O Muḥammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.
verses.tr: fa-in tawallawā fa-innamā ʿalayka al-balāghu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: But if they turn away [Prophet], your only duty is to deliver the message clearly.
verses.pickthall: Then, if they turn away, thy duty (O Muhammad) is but plain conveyance (of the message).

verses.ar: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: They recognize the favor of Allāh; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.
verses.tr: yaʿrifūna niʿmata Allāh thumma yunkirūnahā wa-aktharuhumu al-kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They know God’s blessings, but refuse to recognize them: most of them are ungrateful.
verses.pickthall: They know the favour of Allah and then deny it. Most of them are ingrates.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
verses.en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness [i.e., their prophet]. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
verses.tr: wayawma nabʿathu min kulli ʾummahin shahīdan thumma lā yuʾdhanu lilladhīna kafarūā walā hum yustaʿtabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The day will come when We raise up a witness from every community, when the disbelievers will not be allowed to make excuses or amends.
verses.pickthall: And (bethink you of) the day when we raise up of every nation a witness, then there is no leave for disbelievers, nor are they allowed to make amends.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.en: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
verses.tr: wa-idhā raā adh-dhīna ẓalamūā al-ʿadhāba falā yukhaffafu ʿanhum walā hum yunẓarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the evildoers face punishment it will not be lightened for them nor will they be given any respite.
verses.pickthall: And when those who did wrong behold the doom, it will not be made light for them, nor will they be reprieved.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَهُمْ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِكَ ۖ فَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: And when those who associated others with Allāh see their "partners," they will say, "Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke [in worship] besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars."
verses.tr: wa-idhā raā adh-dhīna ʾashrakūā shurakāʾahum qālūā rabbanā hāʾulāʾi shurakāʾunā adh-dhīna kunnā nadʿūā min dūnika ۖ fa-ā ʾilayhimu al-qawla ʾinnakum lakādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the idolaters see the partners they joined with God they will say, ‘Our Lord, these are the partners we used to invoke beside You,’ but the partners will retort, ‘You are liars,’
verses.pickthall: And when those who ascribed partners to Allah behold those partners of theirs, they will say: Our Lord! these are our partners unto whom we used to cry instead of Thee. But they will fling to them the saying: Lo! ye verily are liars!

verses.ar: وَأَلْقَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلسَّلَمَ ۖ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: And they will impart to Allāh that Day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
verses.tr: wa-ā ʾilā Allāh yawmaʾidhin as-salama ۖ waḍalla ʿanhum mmā kānūā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and on that Day they will offer total submission to God: their false deities will desert them.
verses.pickthall: And they proffer unto Allah submission on that day, and all that they used to invent hath failed them.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ زِدْنَـٰهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ ٱلْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يُفْسِدُونَ
verses.en: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allāh - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna kafarūā waṣaddūā ʿan sabīli Allāh zidnāhum ʿadhāban fawqa al-ʿadhābi bimā kānūā yufsidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Because of the corruption they spread, We shall add torment upon torment for those who disbelieved and barred others from the path of God.
verses.pickthall: For those who disbelieve and debar (men) from the way of Allah, We add doom to doom because they wrought corruption,

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ۚ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ تِبْيَـٰنًا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves [i.e., their prophet]. And We will bring you, [O Muḥammad], as a witness over these [i.e., your nation]. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.
verses.tr: wayawma nabʿathu fā kulli ʾummahin shahīdan ʿalayhim mmin ʾanfusihim ۖ wajiʾnā bika shahīdan ʿalā hāʾulāʾi ۚ wanazzalnā ʿalayka al-kitāba tibyānan llikulli shāʾin wahudanā waraḥmahan wabushrā lilmuslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The day will come when We raise up in each community a witness against them, and We shall bring you [Prophet] as a witness against these people, for We have sent the Scripture down to you explaining everything, and as guidance and mercy and good news to those who devote themselves to God.
verses.pickthall: And (bethink you of) the day when We raise in every nation a witness against them of their own folk, and We bring thee (Muhammad) as a witness against these. And We reveal the Scripture unto thee as an exposition of all things, and a guidance and a mercy and good tidings for those who have surrendered (to Allah).

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْإِحْسَـٰنِ وَإِيتَآئِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْبَغْىِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh orders justice and good conduct and giving [help] to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinna Allāh yaʾmuru bi-l-ʿadli wa-l-ʾiḥsāni wa-ītāʾi dhā al-qurbā wayanhā ʿani al-faḥshāʾi wa-l-munkari wa-l-baghāi ۚ yaʿiẓukum laʿallakum tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God commands justice, doing good, and generosity towards relatives and He forbids what is shameful, blameworthy, and oppressive. He teaches you, so that you may take heed.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed.

verses.ar: وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا عَـٰهَدتُّمْ وَلَا تَنقُضُوا۟ ٱلْأَيْمَـٰنَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: And fulfill the covenant of Allāh when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allāh, over you, a security [i.e., witness]. Indeed, Allāh knows what you do.
verses.tr: wa-awfūā biʿahdi Allāh ʾidhā ʿāhadttum walā tanquḍūā al-ʾaymāna baʿda tawkīdihā waqad jaʿaltumu Allāh ʿalaykum kafīlan ۚ ʾinna Allāh yaʿlamu mā tafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Fulfil any pledge you make in God’s name and do not break oaths after you have sworn them, for you have made God your surety: God knows everything you do.
verses.pickthall: Fulfil the covenant of Allah when ye have covenanted, and break not your oaths after the asseveration of them, and after ye have made Allah surety over you. Lo! Allah knoweth what ye do.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّتِى نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَـٰثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَـٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِىَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allāh only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.
verses.tr: walā takūnūā ka-at-tā naqaḍat ghazlahā min baʿdi quwwahin ʾankāthan tattakhidhūna ʾaymānakum dakhalanā baynakum ʾan takūna ʾummahun hāa ʾarbā min ʾummahin ۚ ʾinnamā yablūkumu Allāh bihi ۚ walayubayyinanna lakum yawma al-qiyāmahi mā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not use your oaths to deceive each other- like a woman who unravels the thread she has firmly spun- just because one party may be more numerous than another. God tests you with this, and on the Day of the Resurrection He will make clear to you those things you differed about.
verses.pickthall: And be not like unto her who unravelleth the thread, after she hath made it strong, to thin filaments, making your oaths a deceit between you because of a nation being more numerous than (another) nation. Allah only trieth you thereby, and He verily will explain to you on the Day of Resurrection that wherein ye differed.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَلَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And if Allāh had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.
verses.tr: walaw shāʾa Allāh lajaʿalakum ʾummahan wāḥidahan walākin yuḍillu man yashāʾu wayahdā man yashāʾu ۚ walatuslunna ʿammā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If God so willed, He would have made you all one people, but He leaves to stray whoever He will and guides whoever He will. You will be questioned about your deeds.
verses.pickthall: Had Allah willed He could have made you (all) one nation, but He sendeth whom He will astray and guideth whom He will, and ye will indeed be asked of what ye used to do.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَكُمْ دَخَلًۢا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌۢ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allāh, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.
verses.tr: walā tattakhidhūā ʾaymānakum dakhalanā baynakum fatazilla qadamun baʿda thubūtihā watadhūqūā as-sūʾa bimā ṣadadttum ʿan sabīli Allāh ۖ walakum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not use your oaths to deceive each other lest any foot should slip after being firmly placed and lest you should taste the penalty for having hindered others from the path of God, and suffer terrible torment.
verses.pickthall: Make not your oaths a deceit between you, lest a foot should slip after being firmly planted and ye should taste evil forasmuch as ye debarred (men) from the way of Allah, and yours should be an awful doom.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And do not exchange the covenant of Allāh for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allāh is best for you, if only you could know.
verses.tr: walā tashtarūā biʿahdi Allāh thamanan qalīlan ۚ ʾinnamā ʿinda Allāh huwa khayrun llakum ʾin kuntum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not sell for a small price any pledge made in God’s name: what God has [to give] is better for you, if you only knew.
verses.pickthall: And purchase not a small gain at the price of Allah's covenant. Lo! that which Allah hath is better for you, if ye did but know.

verses.ar: مَا عِندَكُمْ يَنفَدُ ۖ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ بَاقٍ ۗ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Whatever you have will end, but what Allāh has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.
verses.tr: mā ʿindakum yanfadu ۖ wamā ʿinda Allāh bāqin ۗ walanajziyanna adh-dhīna ṣabarūā ʾajrahum biʾaḥsani mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What you have runs out but what God has endures, and We shall certainly reward those who remain steadfast according to the best of their actions.
verses.pickthall: That which ye have wasteth away, and that which Allah hath remaineth. And verily We shall pay those who are steadfast a recompense in proportion to the best of what they used to do.

verses.ar: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.
verses.tr: man ʿamila ṣāliḥan mmin dhakarin ʾaw ʾunthā wahuwa muʾminun falanuḥyiyannahu ḥayawāhan ṭayyibahan ۖ walanajziyannahum ʾajrahum biʾaḥsani mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: To whoever, male or female, does good deeds and has faith, We shall give a good life and reward them according to the best of their actions.
verses.pickthall: Whosoever doeth right, whether male or female, and is a believer, him verily we shall quicken with good life, and We shall pay them a recompense in proportion to the best of what they used to do.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
verses.en: So when you recite the Qur’ān, [first] seek refuge in Allāh from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].
verses.tr: fa-idhā qaraʾta al-qurāna fāstaʿidh billāh mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], when you recite the Quran, seek God’s protection from the outcast, Satan.
verses.pickthall: And when thou recitest the Qur'an, seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَـٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu laysa lahu sulṭānun ʿalā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He has no power over those who believe and trust in their Lord;
verses.pickthall: Lo! he hath no power over those who believe and put trust in their Lord.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا سُلْطَـٰنُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُۥ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِهِۦ مُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allāh.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā sulṭānuhu ʿalā adh-dhīna yatawallawnahu wa-adh-dhīna hum bihi mushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: his power is only over those who ally themselves with him and those who, because of him, join partners with God.
verses.pickthall: His power is only over those who make a friend of him, and those who ascribe partners unto Him (Allah).

verses.ar: وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَآ ءَايَةً مَّكَانَ ءَايَةٍ ۙ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُفْتَرٍۭ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and Allāh is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, "You, [O Muḥammad], are but an inventor [of lies]." But most of them do not know.
verses.tr: wa-idhā baddalnā āyahan mmakāna āyahin ۙ wallāh ʾaʿlamu bimā yunazzilu qālūā ʾinnamā ʾanta muftarin ۚ bal ʾaktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When We substitute one revelation for another- and God knows best what He reveals- they say, ‘You are just making it up,’ but most of them have no knowledge.
verses.pickthall: And when We put a revelation in place of (another) revelation, - and Allah knoweth best what He revealeth - they say: Lo! thou art but inventing. Most of them know not.

verses.ar: قُلْ نَزَّلَهُۥ رُوحُ ٱلْقُدُسِ مِن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "The Pure Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down from your Lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the Muslims."
verses.tr: qul nazzalahu rūḥu al-qudusi min rrabbika bi-l-ḥaqqi liyuthabbita adh-dhīna āmanūā wahudanā wabushrā lilmuslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say that the Holy Spirit has brought the Revelation with the Truth step by step from your Lord, to strengthen the believers and as guidance and good news to the devout.
verses.pickthall: Say: The holy Spirit hath delivered it from thy Lord with truth, that it may confirm (the faith of) those who believe, and as guidance and good tidings for those who have surrendered (to Allah).

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُۥ بَشَرٌ ۗ لِّسَانُ ٱلَّذِى يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِىٌّ وَهَـٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِىٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches him [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)]." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this [recitation, i.e., Qur’ān] is [in] a clear Arabic language.
verses.tr: walaqad naʿlamu ʾannahum yaqūlūna ʾinnamā yuʿallimuhu basharun ۗ llisānu adh-dhā yulḥidūna ʾilayhi ʾaʿjamāun wahādhā lisānun ʿarabāun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: We know very well that they say, ‘It is a man who teaches him,’ but the language of the person they allude to is foreign, while this revelation is in clear Arabic.
verses.pickthall: And We know well that they say: Only a man teacheth him. The speech of him at whom they falsely hint is outlandish, and this is clear Arabic speech.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of Allāh - Allāh will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bāyāti Allāh lā yahdīhimu Allāh walahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: If people do not believe in God’s revelation, God does not guide them, and a painful punishment awaits them.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve the revelations of Allah, Allah guideth them not and theirs will be a painful doom.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِى ٱلْكَذِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: They only invent falsehood who do not believe in the verses of Allāh, and it is those who are the liars.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā yaftarā al-kadhiba adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bāyāti Allāh ۖ wa-ūlāʾika humu al-kādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Falsehood is fabricated only by those who do not believe in God’s revelation: they are the liars.
verses.pickthall: Only they invent falsehood who believe not Allah's revelations, and (only) they are the liars.

verses.ar: مَن كَفَرَ بِٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِيمَـٰنِهِۦٓ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُۥ مُطْمَئِنٌّۢ بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ وَلَـٰكِن مَّن شَرَحَ بِٱلْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: Whoever disbelieves in [i.e., denies] Allāh after his belief... except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. But those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allāh, and for them is a great punishment;
verses.tr: man kafara billāh min baʿdi ʾīmānihi ʾillā man ʾukriha waqalbuhu muṭmaʾinnun bi-l-ʾīmāni walākin mman sharaḥa bi-l-kufri ṣadran faʿalayhim ghaḍabun mmina Allāh walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: With the exception of those who are forced to say they do not believe, although their hearts remain firm in faith, those who reject God after believing in Him and open their hearts to disbelief will have the wrath of God upon them and a grievous punishment awaiting them.
verses.pickthall: Whoso disbelieveth in Allah after his belief - save him who is forced thereto and whose heart is still content with the Faith - but whoso findeth ease in disbelief: On them is wrath from Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: That is because they preferred the worldly life over the Hereafter and that Allāh does not guide the disbelieving people.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾannahumu āstaḥabbūā al-ḥayawāha ad-dunyā ʿalā al-ākhirahi wa-anna Allāh lā yahdā al-qawma al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is because they love the life of this world more than the one to come, and God does not guide those who reject Him.
verses.pickthall: That is because they have chosen the life of the world rather than the Hereafter, and because Allah guideth not the disbelieving folk.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰفِلُونَ
verses.en: Those are the ones over whose hearts and hearing and vision Allāh has sealed, and it is those who are the heedless.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna ṭabaʿa Allāh ʿalā qulūbihim wasamʿihim wa-abṣārihim ۖ wa-ūlāʾika humu al-ghāfilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: These are people whose hearts, hearing, and sight have been closed off by God: they are heedless,
verses.pickthall: Such are they whose hearts and ears and eyes Allah hath sealed. And such are the heedless.

verses.ar: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: Assuredly, it is they, in the Hereafter, who will be the losers.
verses.tr: lā jarama ʾannahum fā al-ākhirahi humu al-khāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and there is no doubt that they will be the losers in the Hereafter.
verses.pickthall: Assuredly in the Hereafter they are the losers.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوا۟ ثُمَّ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ وَصَبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to say words of disbelief] and thereafter fought [for the cause of Allāh] and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful
verses.tr: thumma ʾinna rabbaka lilladhīna hājarūā min baʿdi mā futinūā thumma jāhadūā waṣabarūā ʾinna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: But your Lord will be most forgiving and most merciful to those who leave their homes after persecution, then strive and remain steadfast.
verses.pickthall: Then lo! thy Lord - for those who became fugitives after they had been persecuted, and then fought and were steadfast - lo! thy Lord afterward is (for them) indeed Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: ۞ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَـٰدِلُ عَن نَّفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: On the Day when every soul will come disputing [i.e., pleading] for itself, and every soul will be fully compensated for what it did, and they will not be wronged [i.e., treated unjustly].
verses.tr: ۞ yawma taʾtā kullu nafsin tujādilu ʿan nnafsihā watuwaffā kullu nafsin mmā ʿamilat wahum lā yuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when every soul will come pleading for itself, every soul will be paid in full for all its actions- they will not be wronged.
verses.pickthall: On the Day when every soul will come pleading for itself, and every soul will be repaid what it did, and they will not be wronged.

verses.ar: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ ءَامِنَةً مُّطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَذَٰقَهَا ٱللَّهُ لِبَاسَ ٱلْجُوعِ وَٱلْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh presents an example: a city [i.e., Makkah] which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favors of Allāh. So Allāh made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing.
verses.tr: waḍaraba Allāh mathalan qaryahan kānat āminahan mmuṭmaʾinnahan yaʾtīhā rizquhā raghadan mmin kulli makānin fakafarat biʾanʿumi Allāh fa-adhāqahā Allāh libāsa al-jūʿi wa-l-khawfi bimā kānūā yaṣnaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God presents the example of a town that was secure and at ease, with provisions coming to it abundantly from all places. Then it became ungrateful for God’s blessings, so God afflicted it with the garment of famine and fear, for what its people had done.
verses.pickthall: Allah coineth a similitude: a township that dwelt secure and well content, its provision coming to it in abundance from every side, but it disbelieved in Allah's favours, so Allah made it experience the garb of dearth and fear because of what they used to do.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers.
verses.tr: walaqad jāʾahum rasūlun mminhum fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahumu al-ʿadhābu wahum ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: A messenger who was one of them came to them, but they called him a liar. So punishment overwhelmed them in the midst of their evildoing.
verses.pickthall: And verily there had come unto them a messenger from among them, but they had denied him, and so the torment seized them while they were wrong-doers.

verses.ar: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَـٰلًا طَيِّبًا وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: Then eat of what Allāh has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And be grateful for the favor of Allāh, if it is [indeed] Him that you worship.
verses.tr: fakulūā mimmā razaqakumu Allāh ḥalālan ṭayyiban wāshkurūā niʿmata Allāh ʾin kuntum ʾiyyāhu taʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So eat of the good and lawful things God has provided for you and be thankful for His blessings, if it is Him that you worship.
verses.pickthall: So eat of the lawful and good food which Allah hath provided for you, and thank the bounty of your Lord if it is Him ye serve.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةَ وَٱلدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allāh. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā ḥarrama ʿalaykumu al-maytaha wa-ad-dama walaḥma al-khinzīri wamā ʾuhilla lighayri Allāh bihi ۖ famani āḍṭurra ghayra bāghin walā ʿādin fa-inna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: He has forbidden you only these things: carrion, blood, pig’s meat, and animals over which any name other than God’s has been invoked. But if anyone is forced by hunger, not desiring it nor exceeding their immediate need, God is forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: He hath forbidden for you only carrion and blood and swineflesh and that which hath been immolated in the name of any other than Allah; but he who is driven thereto, neither craving nor transgressing, lo! then Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ هَـٰذَا حَلَـٰلٌ وَهَـٰذَا حَرَامٌ لِّتَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: And do not say about what your tongues assert of untruth, "This is lawful and this is unlawful," to invent falsehood about Allāh. Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allāh will not succeed.
verses.tr: walā taqūlūā limā taṣifu ʾalsinatukumu al-kadhiba hādhā ḥalālun wahādhā ḥarāmun llitaftarūā ʿalā Allāh al-kadhiba ۚ ʾinna adh-dhīna yaftarūna ʿalā Allāh al-kadhiba lā yufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not say falsely, ‘This is lawful and that is forbidden,’ inventing a lie about God: those who invent lies about God will not prosper-
verses.pickthall: And speak not, concerning that which your own tongues qualify (as clean or unclean), the falsehood: "This is lawful, and this is forbidden," so that ye invent a lie against Allah. Lo! those who invent a lie against Allah will not succeed.

verses.ar: مَتَـٰعٌ قَلِيلٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: [It is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment.
verses.tr: matāʿun qalīlun walahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: they may have a little enjoyment, but painful punishment awaits them.
verses.pickthall: A brief enjoyment (will be theirs); and theirs a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَعَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before. And We did not wrong them [thereby], but they were wronging themselves.
verses.tr: waʿalā adh-dhīna hādūā ḥarramnā mā qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka min qablu ۖ wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānūā ʾanfusahum yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], We forbade the Jews what We told you about. We did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.
verses.pickthall: And unto those who are Jews We have forbidden that which We have already related unto thee. And We wronged them not, but they were wont to wrong themselves.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓءَ بِجَهَـٰلَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوٓا۟ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who have done wrong out of ignorance and then repent after that and correct themselves - indeed, your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: thumma ʾinna rabbaka lilladhīna ʿamilūā as-sūʾa bijahālahin thumma tābūā min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥūā ʾinna rabbaka min baʿdihā laghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: But towards those who do wrong out of ignorance, and afterwards repent and make amends, your Lord is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: Then lo! thy Lord - for those who do evil in ignorance and afterward repent and amend - lo! (for them) thy Lord is afterward indeed Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيفًا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, Abraham was a [comprehensive] leader, devoutly obedient to Allāh, inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with Allāh.
verses.tr: ʾinna ʾibrāhīma kāna ʾummahan qānitan lillāh ḥanīfan walam yaku mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham was truly an example: devoutly obedient to God and true in faith. He was not an idolater;
verses.pickthall: Lo! Abraham was a nation obedient to Allah, by nature upright, and he was not of the idolaters;

verses.ar: شَاكِرًا لِّأَنْعُمِهِ ۚ ٱجْتَبَىٰهُ وَهَدَىٰهُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: [He was] grateful for His favors. He [i.e., Allāh] chose him and guided him to a straight path.
verses.tr: shākiran lliʾanʿumihi ۚ ājtabāhu wahadāhu ʾilā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: he was thankful for the blessings of God who chose him and guided him to a straight path.
verses.pickthall: Thankful for His bounties; He chose him and He guided him unto a straight path.

verses.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.
verses.tr: wataynāhu fā ad-dunyā ḥasanahan ۖ wa-innahu fā al-ākhirahi lamina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave him blessings in this world, and he is among the right-eous in the Hereafter.
verses.pickthall: And We gave him good in the world, and in the Hereafter he is among the righteous.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ أَنِ ٱتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا ۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Then We revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with Allāh.
verses.tr: thumma ʾawḥaynā ʾilayka ʾani āttabiʿ millaha ʾibrāhīma ḥanīfan ۖ wamā kāna mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then We revealed to you [Muhammad], ‘Follow the creed of Abraham, a man of pure faith who was not an idolater.’
verses.pickthall: And afterward We inspired thee (Muhammad, saying): Follow the religion of Abraham, as one by nature upright. He was not of the idolaters.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ ٱلسَّبْتُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: The sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. And indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā juʿila as-sabtu ʿalā adh-dhīna ākhtalafūā fīhi ۚ wa-inna rabbaka layaḥkumu baynahum yawma al-qiyāmahi fīmā kānūā fīhi yakhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Sabbath was made obligatory only for those who differed about it. On the Day of Resurrection your Lord will judge between them as to their differences.
verses.pickthall: The Sabbath was appointed only for those who differed concerning it, and lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.

verses.ar: ٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ۖ وَجَـٰدِلْهُم بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۖ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.en: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has strayed from His way, and He is most knowing of who is [rightly] guided.
verses.tr: ādʿu ʾilā sabīli rabbika bi-l-ḥikmahi wa-l-mawʿiẓahi al-ḥasanahi ۖ wajādilhum bi-at-tā hāa ʾaḥsanu ۚ ʾinna rabbaka huwa ʾaʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi ۖ wahuwa ʾaʿlamu bi-l-muhtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], call [people] to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good teaching. Argue with them in the most courteous way, for your Lord knows best who has strayed from His way and who is rightly guided.
verses.pickthall: Call unto the way of thy Lord with wisdom and fair exhortation, and reason with them in the better way. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who go aright.

verses.ar: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِّلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient.
