verses.tr: wa-in ʿāqabtum faʿāqibūā bimithli mā ʿūqibtum bihi ۖ walaʾin ṣabartum lahuwa khayrun llilṣṣābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you [believers] have to respond to an attack, make your response proportionate, but it is best to stand fast.
verses.pickthall: If ye punish, then punish with the like of that wherewith ye were afflicted. But if ye endure patiently, verily it is better for the patient.

verses.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِى ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], and your patience is not but through Allāh. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.
verses.tr: wāṣbir wamā ṣabruka ʾillā billāh ۚ walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā taku fā ḍayqin mmimmā yamkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] be steadfast: your steadfastness comes only from God. Do not grieve over them; do not be distressed by their scheming,
verses.pickthall: Endure thou patiently (O Muhammad). Thine endurance is only by (the help of) Allah. Grieve not for them, and be not in distress because of that which they devise.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh maʿa adh-dhīna āttaqawā wa-adh-dhīna hum mmuḥsinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: for God is with those who are mindful of Him and who do good.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah is with those who keep their duty unto Him and those who are doers of good.

verses.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَـٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.en: Exalted is He who took His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] by night from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām to al-Masjid al-Aqṣā, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
verses.tr: subḥāna adh-dhā ʾasrā biʿabdihi laylan mmina al-masjidi al-ḥarāmi ʾilā al-masjidi al-ʾaqṣā adh-dhā bāraknā ḥawlahu linuriyahu min āyātinā ۚ ʾinnahu huwa as-samīʿu al-baṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Glory to Him who made His servant travel by night from the sacred place of worship to the furthest place of worship, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him some of Our signs: He alone is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
verses.pickthall: Glorified be He Who carried His servant by night from the Inviolable Place of Worship to the Far distant place of worship the neighbourhood whereof We have blessed, that We might show him of Our tokens! Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Seer.

verses.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن دُونِى وَكِيلًا
verses.en: And We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs,
verses.tr: wataynā mūsā al-kitāba wajaʿalnāhu hudanā llibanā ʾisrāʾīla ʾallā tattakhidhūā min dūnā wakīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: We also gave Moses the Scripture, and made it a guide for the Children of Israel. ‘Entrust yourselves to no one but Me,
verses.pickthall: We gave unto Moses the Scripture, and We appointed it a guidance for the children of Israel, saying: Choose no guardian beside Me.

verses.ar: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا
verses.en: O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant.
verses.tr: dhurriyyaha man ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥin ۚ ʾinnahu kāna ʿabdan shakūran
verses.abdelhaleem: you descendants of those We carried with Noah: he was truly a thankful servant.’
verses.pickthall: (They were) the seed of those whom We carried (in the ship) along with Noah. Lo! he was a grateful slave.

verses.ar: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, "You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness."
verses.tr: waqaḍaynā ʾilā banā ʾisrāʾīla fā al-kitābi latufsidunna fā al-ʾarḍi marratayni walataʿlunna ʿuluwwan kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: We declared to the Children of Israel in the Scripture, ‘Twice you will spread corruption in the land and become highly arrogant.’
verses.pickthall: And We decreed for the Children of Israel in the Scripture: Ye verily will work corruption in the earth twice, and ye will become great tyrants.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ أُولَىٰهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًا لَّنَآ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ فَجَاسُوا۟ خِلَـٰلَ ٱلدِّيَارِ ۚ وَكَانَ وَعْدًا مَّفْعُولًا
verses.en: So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled.
verses.tr: fa-idhā jāʾa waʿdu ʾūlāhumā baʿathnā ʿalaykum ʿibādan llanā ʾūlā baʾsin shadīdin fajāsūā khilāla ad-diyāri ۚ wakāna waʿdan mmafʿūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: When the first of these warnings was fulfilled, We sent against you servants of Ours with great force, and they ravaged your homes. That warning was fulfilled,
verses.pickthall: So when the time for the first of the two came, We roused against you slaves of Ours of great might who ravaged (your) country, and it was a threat performed.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ أَكْثَرَ نَفِيرًا
verses.en: Then We gave back to you a return victory over them. And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower.
verses.tr: thumma radadnā lakumu al-karraha ʿalayhim wa-amdadnākum biʾamwālin wabanīna wajaʿalnākum ʾakthara nafīran
verses.abdelhaleem: but then We allowed you to prevail against your enemy. We increased your wealth and offspring and made you more numerous––
verses.pickthall: Then we gave you once again your turn against them, and We aided you with wealth and children and made you more in soldiery.

verses.ar: إِنْ أَحْسَنتُمْ أَحْسَنتُمْ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ أَسَأْتُمْ فَلَهَا ۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لِيَسُـۥٓـُٔوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ وَلِيَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَلِيُتَبِّرُوا۟ مَا عَلَوْا۟ تَتْبِيرًا
verses.en: [And said], "If you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to them [i.e., yourselves]." Then when the final [i.e., second] promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the masjid [i.e., the temple in Jerusalem], as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction.
verses.tr: ʾin ʾaḥsantum ʾaḥsantum liʾanfusikum ۖ wa-in ʾasaʾtum falahā ۚ fa-idhā jāʾa waʿdu al-ākhirahi liyasūā wujūhakum waliyadkhulūā al-masjida kamā dakhalūhu ʾawwala marrahin waliyutabbirūā mā ʿalawā tatbīran
verses.abdelhaleem: whether you do good or evil it is to your own souls––and when the second warning was fulfilled [We sent them] to shame your faces and enter the place of worship as they did the first time, and utterly destroy whatever fell into their power.
verses.pickthall: (Saying): If ye do good, ye do good for your own souls, and if ye do evil, it is for them (in like manner). So, when the time for the second (of the judgments) came (We roused against you others of Our slaves) to ravage you, and to enter the Temple even as they entered it the first time, and to lay waste all that they conquered with an utter wasting.

verses.ar: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ ۚ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا ۘ وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا
verses.en: [Then Allāh said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you. But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment]. And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed."
verses.tr: ʿasā rabbukum ʾan yarḥamakum ۚ wa-in ʿudttum ʿudnā ۘ wajaʿalnā jahannama lilkāfirīna ḥaṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord may yet have mercy on you, but if you do the same again, so shall We: We have made Hell a prison for those who defy [Our warning].
verses.pickthall: It may be that your Lord will have mercy on you, but if ye repeat (the crime) We shall repeat (the punishment), and We have appointed hell a dungeon for the disbelievers.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَهْدِى لِلَّتِى هِىَ أَقْوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, this Qur’ān guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā al-qurāna yahdā lillatā hāa ʾaqwamu wayubashiru al-muʾminīna adh-dhīna yaʿmalūna aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ʾanna lahum ʾajran kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: This Quran does indeed show the straightest way. It gives the faithful who do right the good news that they will have a great reward and
verses.pickthall: Lo! this Qur'an guideth unto that which is straightest, and giveth tidings unto the believers who do good works that theirs will be a great reward.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.en: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment.
verses.tr: wa-anna adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi ʾaʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāban ʾalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: warns that We have prepared an agonizing punishment for those who do not believe in the world to come.
verses.pickthall: And that those who believe not in the Hereafter, for them We have prepared a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَيَدْعُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلْخَيْرِ ۖ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَجُولًا
verses.en: And man supplicates for evil [when angry] as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty.
verses.tr: wayadʿu al-ʾinsānu bi-ash-sharri duʿāʾahu bi-l-khayri ۖ wakāna al-ʾinsānu ʿajūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet man prays for harm, just as he prays for good: man is ever hasty.
verses.pickthall: Man prayeth for evil as he prayeth for good; for man was ever hasty.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيْنِ ۖ فَمَحَوْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةً لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُوا۟ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلْحِسَابَ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَصَّلْنَـٰهُ تَفْصِيلًا
verses.en: And We have made the night and day two signs, and We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]. And everything We have set out in detail.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā al-yla wa-an-nahāra āyatayni ۖ famaḥawnā āyaha al-yli wajaʿalnā āyaha an-nahāri mubṣirahan llitabtaghūā faḍlan mmin rrabbikum walitaʿlamūā ʿadada as-sinīna wa-l-ḥisāba ۚ wakulla shāʾin faṣṣalnāhu tafṣīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: We made the night and the day as two signs, then darkened the night and made the daylight for seeing, for you to seek your Lord’s bounty and to know how to count the years and calculate. We have explained everything in detail.
verses.pickthall: And We appoint the night and the day two portents. Then We make dark the portent of the night, and We make the portent of the day sight-giving, that ye may seek bounty from your Lord, and that ye may know the computation of the years, and the reckoning; and everything have We expounded with a clear expounding.

verses.ar: وَكُلَّ إِنسَـٰنٍ أَلْزَمْنَـٰهُ طَـٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِى عُنُقِهِۦ ۖ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ كِتَـٰبًا يَلْقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا
verses.en: And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.
verses.tr: wakulla ʾinsānin ʾalzamnāhu ṭāʾirahu fā ʿunuqihi ۖ wanukhriju lahu yawma al-qiyāmahi kitāban yalqāhu manshūran
verses.abdelhaleem: We have bound each human being’s destiny to his neck. On the Day of Resurrection, We shall bring out a record for each of them, which they will find spread wide open,
verses.pickthall: And every man's augury have We fastened to his own neck, and We shall bring forth for him on the Day of Resurrection a book which he will find wide open.

verses.ar: ٱقْرَأْ كِتَـٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًا
verses.en: [It will be said], "Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant."
verses.tr: āqraʾ kitābaka kafā binafsika al-yawma ʿalayka ḥasīban
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Read your record. Today your own soul is enough to calculate your account.’
verses.pickthall: (And it will be said unto him): Read thy Book. Thy soul sufficeth as reckoner against thee this day.

verses.ar: مَّنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًا
verses.en: Whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. And whoever errs only errs against it. And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And never would We punish until We sent a messenger.
verses.tr: mmani āhtadā fa-innamā yahtadā linafsihi ۖ waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā ۚ walā taziru wāzirahun wizra ʾukhrā ۗ wamā kunnā muʿadhibīna ḥattā nabʿatha rasūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Whoever accepts guidance does so for his own good; whoever strays does so at his own peril. No soul will bear another’s burden, nor do We punish until We have sent a messenger.
verses.pickthall: Whosoever goeth right, it is only for (the good of) his own soul that he goeth right, and whosoever erreth, erreth only to its hurt. No laden soul can bear another's load, We never punish until we have sent a messenger.

verses.ar: وَإِذَآ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُوا۟ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهَا تَدْمِيرًا
verses.en: And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word [i.e., deserved decree] comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction.
verses.tr: wa-idhā ʾaradnā ʾan nnuhlika qaryahan ʾamarnā mutrafīhā fafasaqūā fīhā faḥaqqa ʿalayhā al-qawlu fadammarnāhā tadmīran
verses.abdelhaleem: When We decide to destroy a town, We command those corrupted by wealth [to reform], but they [persist in their] disobedience; Our sentence is passed, and We destroy them utterly.
verses.pickthall: And when We would destroy a township We send commandment to its folk who live at ease, and afterward they commit abomination therein, and so the Word (of doom) hath effect for it, and we annihilate it with complete annihilation.

verses.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ نُوحٍ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.en: And how many have We destroyed from the generations after Noah. And sufficient is your Lord, concerning the sins of His servants, as Aware and Seeing.
verses.tr: wakam ʾahlaknā mina al-qurūni min baʿdi nūḥin ۗ wakafā birabbika bidhunūbi ʿibādihi khabīranā baṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: How many generations We have destroyed since Noah! Your Lord knows and observes the sins of His servants well enough.
verses.pickthall: How many generations have We destroyed since Noah! And Allah sufficeth as Knower and Beholder of the sins of His slaves.

verses.ar: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُۥ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَىٰهَا مَذْمُومًا مَّدْحُورًا
verses.en: Whoever should desire the immediate - We hasten for him from it what We will to whom We intend. Then We have made for him Hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished.
verses.tr: mman kāna yurīdu al-ʿājilaha ʿajjalnā lahu fīhā mā nashāʾu liman nnurīdu thumma jaʿalnā lahu jahannama yaṣlāhā madhmūman mmadḥūran
verses.abdelhaleem: If anyone desires [only] the fleeting life, We speed up whatever We will in it, for whoever We wish; in the end We have prepared Hell for him in which to burn, disgraced and rejected.
verses.pickthall: Whoso desireth that (life) which hasteneth away, We hasten for him therein what We will for whom We please. And afterward We have appointed for him hell; he will endure the heat thereof, condemned, rejected.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَرَادَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.en: But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allāh].
verses.tr: waman ʾarāda al-ākhiraha wasaʿā lahā saʿyahā wahuwa muʾminun fa-ūlāʾika kāna saʿyuhum mmashkūran
verses.abdelhaleem: But if anyone desires the life to come and strives after it as he should, as a true believer, his striving will be thanked.
verses.pickthall: And whoso desireth the Hereafter and striveth for it with the effort necessary, being a believer; for such, their effort findeth favour (with their Lord).

verses.ar: كُلًّا نُّمِدُّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مِنْ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحْظُورًا
verses.en: To each [category] We extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord. And never has the gift of your Lord been restricted.
verses.tr: kullan nnumiddu hāʾulāʾi wahāʾulāʾi min ʿaṭāʾi rabbika ۚ wamā kāna ʿaṭāʾu rabbika maḥẓūran
verses.abdelhaleem: To both the latter and the former, We give some of your Lord’s bounty. [Prophet], your Lord’s bounty is not restricted-
verses.pickthall: Each do We supply, both these and those, from the bounty of thy Lord. And the bounty of thy Lord can never be walled up.

verses.ar: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ دَرَجَـٰتٍ وَأَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيلًا
verses.en: Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.
verses.tr: ānẓur kayfa faḍḍalnā baʿḍahum ʿalā baʿḍin ۚ walalākhirahu ʾakbaru darajātin wa-akbaru tafḍīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: see how We have given some more than others- but the Hereafter holds greater ranks and greater favours.
verses.pickthall: See how We prefer one of them above another, and verily the Hereafter will be greater in degrees and greater in preferment.

verses.ar: لَّا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًا مَّخْذُولًا
verses.en: Do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken.
verses.tr: llā tajʿal maʿa Allāh ʾilāhan ākhara fataqʿuda madhmūman mmakhdhūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Set up no other god beside God, or you will end up disgraced and forsaken.
verses.pickthall: Set not up with Allah any other god (O man) lest thou sit down reproved, forsaken.

verses.ar: ۞ وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَـٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا
verses.en: And your Lord has decreed that you worship not except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff," and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.
verses.tr: ۞ waqaḍā rabbuka ʾallā taʿbudūā ʾillā ʾiyyāhu wabālwālidayni ʾiḥsānan ۚ ʾimmā yablughanna ʿindaka al-kibara ʾaḥaduhumā ʾaw kilāhumā falā taqul llahumā ʾuffin walā tanharhumā waqul llahumā qawlan karīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord has commanded that you should worship none but Him, and that you be kind to your parents. If either or both of them reach old age with you, say no word that shows impatience with them, and do not be harsh with them, but speak to them respectfully
verses.pickthall: Thy Lord hath decreed, that ye worship none save Him, and (that ye show) kindness to parents. If one of them or both of them attain old age with thee, say not "Fie" unto them nor repulse them, but speak unto them a gracious word.

verses.ar: وَٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًا
verses.en: And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small."
verses.tr: wākhfiḍ lahumā janāḥa adh-dhulli mina ar-raḥmahi waqul rrabbi ārḥamhumā kamā rabbayānā ṣaghīran
verses.abdelhaleem: and lower your wing in humility towards them in kindness and say, ‘Lord, have mercy on them, just as they cared for me when I was little.’
verses.pickthall: And lower unto them the wing of submission through mercy, and say: My Lord! Have mercy on them both as they did care for me when I was little.

verses.ar: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِى نُفُوسِكُمْ ۚ إِن تَكُونُوا۟ صَـٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورًا
verses.en: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving.
verses.tr: rrabbukum ʾaʿlamu bimā fā nufūsikum ۚ ʾin takūnūā ṣāliḥīna fa-innahu kāna lilʾawwābīna ghafūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord knows best what is in your heart. If you are good, He is most forgiving to those who return to Him.
verses.pickthall: Your Lord is Best Aware of what is in your minds. If ye are righteous, then lo! He was ever Forgiving unto those who turn (unto Him).

verses.ar: وَءَاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا
verses.en: And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully.
verses.tr: wati dhā al-qurbā ḥaqqahu wa-l-miskīna wābna as-sabīli walā tubadhir tabdhīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Give relatives their due, and the needy, and travellers- do not squander your wealth wastefully:
verses.pickthall: Give the kinsman his due, and the needy, and the wayfarer, and squander not (thy wealth) in wantonness.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓا۟ إِخْوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورًا
verses.en: Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has Satan been to his Lord ungrateful.
verses.tr: ʾinna al-mubadhirīna kānūā ʾikhwāna ash-shayāṭīni ۖ wakāna ash-shayṭānu lirabbihi kafūran
verses.abdelhaleem: those who squander are the brothers of Satan, and Satan is most ungrateful to his Lord-
verses.pickthall: Lo! the squanderers were ever brothers of the devils, and the devil was ever an ingrate to his Lord.

verses.ar: وَإِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ رَحْمَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّيْسُورًا
verses.en: And if you [must] turn away from them [i.e., the needy] awaiting mercy from your Lord which you expect, then speak to them a gentle word.
verses.tr: wa-immā tuʿriḍanna ʿanhumu ābtighāʾa raḥmahin mmin rrabbika tarjūhā faqul llahum qawlan mmaysūran
verses.abdelhaleem: but if, while seeking some bounty that you expect from your Lord, you turn them down, then at least speak some word of comfort to them.
verses.pickthall: But if thou turn away from them, seeking mercy from thy Lord, for which thou hopest, then speak unto them a reasonable word.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ ٱلْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًا مَّحْسُورًا
verses.en: And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent.
verses.tr: walā tajʿal yadaka maghlūlahan ʾilā ʿunuqika walā tabsuṭhā kulla al-basṭi fataqʿuda malūman mmaḥsūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not be tight-fisted, nor so open-handed that you end up blamed and overwhelmed with regret.
verses.pickthall: And let not thy hand be chained to thy neck nor open it with a complete opening, lest thou sit down rebuked, denuded.

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Aware and Seeing.
verses.tr: ʾinna rabbaka yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yashāʾu wayaqdiru ۚ ʾinnahu kāna biʿibādihi khabīranā baṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord gives abundantly to whoever He will, and sparingly to whoever He will: He knows and observes His servants thoroughly.
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will, and straiteneth (it for whom He will). Lo, He was ever Knower, Seer of His slaves.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَـٰدَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلَـٰقٍ ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْـًٔا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.
verses.tr: walā taqtulūā ʾawlādakum khashyaha ʾimlāqin ۖ nnaḥnu narzuquhum wa-iyyākum ۚ ʾinna qatlahum kāna khiṭā kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not kill your children for fear of poverty––We shall provide for them and for you––killing them is a great sin.
verses.pickthall: Slay not your children, fearing a fall to poverty, We shall provide for them and for you. Lo! the slaying of them is great sin.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَـٰحِشَةً وَسَآءَ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
verses.tr: walā taqrabūā az-zinā ۖ ʾinnahu kāna fāḥishahan wasāʾa sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: And do not go anywhere near adultery: it is an outrage, and an evil path.
verses.pickthall: And come not near unto adultery. Lo! it is an abomination and an evil way.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِۦ سُلْطَـٰنًا فَلَا يُسْرِف فِّى ٱلْقَتْلِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مَنصُورًا
verses.en: And do not kill the soul [i.e., person] which Allāh has forbidden, except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law].
verses.tr: walā taqtulūā an-nafsa at-tā ḥarrama Allāh ʾillā bi-l-ḥaqqi ۗ waman qutila maẓlūman faqad jaʿalnā liwaliyyihi sulṭānan falā yusrif ffā al-qatli ۖ ʾinnahu kāna manṣūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not take life, which God has made sacred, except by right: if anyone is killed wrongfully, We have given authority to the defender of his rights, but he should not be excessive in taking life, for he is already aided [by God].
verses.pickthall: And slay not the life which Allah hath forbidden save with right. Whoso is slain wrongfully, We have given power unto his heir, but let him not commit excess in slaying. Lo! he will be helped.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعَهْدِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْـُٔولًا
verses.en: And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.
verses.tr: walā taqrabūā māla al-yatīmi ʾillā bi-at-tā hāa ʾaḥsanu ḥattā yablugha ʾashuddahu ۚ wa-awfūā bi-l-ʿahdi ۖ ʾinna al-ʿahda kāna maswlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not go near the orphan’s property, except with the best [intentions], until he reaches the age of maturity. Honour your pledges: you will be questioned about your pledges.
verses.pickthall: Come not near the wealth of the orphan save with that which is better till he come to strength; and keep the covenant. Lo! of the covenant it will be asked.

verses.ar: وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ إِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًا
verses.en: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.
verses.tr: wa-awfūā al-kayla ʾidhā kiltum wazinūā bi-l-qisṭāsi al-mustaqīmi ۚ dhālika khayrun wa-aḥsanu taʾwīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Give full measure when you measure, and weigh with accurate scales: that is better and fairer in the end.
verses.pickthall: Fill the measure when ye measure, and weigh with a right balance; that is meet, and better in the end.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًا
verses.en: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
verses.tr: walā taqfu mā laysa laka bihi ʿilmun ۚ ʾinna as-samʿa wa-l-baṣara wa-l-fuāda kullu ʾūlāʾika kāna ʿanhu maswlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not follow blindly what you do not know to be true: ears, eyes, and heart, you will be questioned about all these.
verses.pickthall: (O man), follow not that whereof thou hast no knowledge. Lo! the hearing and the sight and the heart - of each of these it will be asked.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّكَ لَن تَخْرِقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَن تَبْلُغَ ٱلْجِبَالَ طُولًا
verses.en: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
verses.tr: walā tamshi fā al-ʾarḍi maraḥan ۖ ʾinnaka lan takhriqa al-ʾarḍa walan tablugha al-jibāla ṭūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not strut arrogantly about the earth: you cannot break it open, nor match the mountains in height.
verses.pickthall: And walk not in the earth exultant. Lo! thou canst not rend the earth, nor canst thou stretch to the height of the hills.

verses.ar: كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوهًا
verses.en: All that [i.e., the aforementioned] - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.
verses.tr: kullu dhālika kāna sayyiʾuhu ʿinda rabbika makrūhan
verses.abdelhaleem: The evil of all these actions is hateful to your Lord.
verses.pickthall: The evil of all that is hateful in the sight of thy Lord.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّآ أَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ ۗ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتُلْقَىٰ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومًا مَّدْحُورًا
verses.en: That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished.
verses.tr: dhālika mimmā ʾawḥā ʾilayka rabbuka mina al-ḥikmahi ۗ walā tajʿal maʿa Allāh ʾilāhan ākhara fatulqā fā jahannama malūman mmadḥūran
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], this is some of the wisdom your Lord has revealed to you: do not set up another god beside God, or you will be thrown into Hell, blamed and rejected.
verses.pickthall: This is (part) of that wisdom wherewith thy Lord hath inspired thee (O Muhammad). And set not up with Allah any other god, lest thou be cast into hell, reproved, abandoned.

verses.ar: أَفَأَصْفَىٰكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱتَّخَذَ مِنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنَـٰثًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوْلًا عَظِيمًا
verses.en: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken [i.e., adopted] from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.
verses.tr: ʾafaʾaṣfākum rabbukum bi-l-banīna wāttakhadha mina al-malāʾikahi ʾināthan ۚ ʾinnakum lataqūlūna qawlan ʿaẓīman
verses.abdelhaleem: What? Has your Lord favoured you people with sons and taken daughters for Himself from the angels?What a monstrous thing for you to say!
verses.pickthall: Hath your Lord then distinguished you (O men of Makka) by giving you sons, and hath chosen for Himself females from among the angels? Lo! verily ye speak an awful word!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ وَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
verses.en: And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur’ān that they [i.e., mankind] may be reminded, but it does not increase them [i.e., the disbelievers] except in aversion.
verses.tr: walaqad ṣarrafnā fā hādhā al-qurāni liyadhakkarūā wamā yazīduhum ʾillā nufūran
verses.abdelhaleem: We have explained things in various ways in this Quran, so that such people might take notice, but it has only turned them further away.
verses.pickthall: We verily have displayed (Our warnings) in this Qur'an that they may take heed, but it increaseth them in naught save aversion.

verses.ar: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَهُۥٓ ءَالِهَةٌ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذًا لَّٱبْتَغَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way."
verses.tr: qul llaw kāna maʿahu ālihahun kamā yaqūlūna ʾidhan llābtaghawā ʾilā dhā al-ʿarshi sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘If there were other gods along with Him, as they say there are, then they would have tried to find a way to the Lord of the Throne.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): If there were other gods along with Him, as they say, then had they sought a way against the Lord of the Throne.

verses.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.
verses.tr: subḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yaqūlūna ʿuluwwan kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Glory to Him! He is far above what they say!
verses.pickthall: Glorified is He, and High Exalted above what they say!

verses.ar: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبْعُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا
verses.en: The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [Allāh] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving.
verses.tr: tusabbiḥu lahu as-samāwātu as-sabʿu wa-l-ʾarḍu waman fīhinna ۚ wa-in mmin shāʾin ʾillā yusabbiḥu biḥamdihi walākin llā tafqahūna tasbīḥahum ۗ ʾinnahu kāna ḥalīman ghafūran
verses.abdelhaleem: The seven heavens and the earth and everyone in them glorify Him. There is not a single thing that does not celebrate His praise, though you do not understand their praise: He is most forbearing, most forgiving.
verses.pickthall: The seven heavens and the earth and all that is therein praise Him, and there is not a thing but hymneth His praise; but ye understand not their praise. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حِجَابًا مَّسْتُورًا
verses.en: And when you recite the Qur’ān, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition.
verses.tr: wa-idhā qaraʾta al-qurāna jaʿalnā baynaka wabayna adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi ḥijāban mmastūran
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], when you recite the Quran, We put an invisible barrier between you and those who do not believe in the life to come.
verses.pickthall: And when thou recitest the Qur'an we place between thee and those who believe not in the Hereafter a hidden barrier;

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا ۚ وَإِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَلَّوْا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَـٰرِهِمْ نُفُورًا
verses.en: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur’ān, they turn back in aversion.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim ʾakinnahan ʾan yafqahūhu wafā ādhānihim waqran ۚ wa-idhā dhakarta rabbaka fā al-qurāni waḥdahu wallawā ʿalā ʾadbārihim nufūran
verses.abdelhaleem: We have put covers on their hearts that prevent them from understanding it, and heaviness in their ears. When you mention your Lord in the Quran, and Him alone, they turn their backs and run away.
verses.pickthall: And We place upon their hearts veils lest they should understand it, and in their ears a deafness; and when thou makest mention of thy Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn their backs in aversion.

verses.ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰٓ إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
verses.en: We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
verses.tr: nnaḥnu ʾaʿlamu bimā yastamiʿūna bihi ʾidh yastamiʿūna ʾilayka wa-idh hum najwā ʾidh yaqūlu aẓ-ẓālimūna ʾin tattabiʿūna ʾillā rajulan mmasḥūran
verses.abdelhaleem: We know best the way they listen, when they listen to you and when they confer in secret, and these wrongdoers say, ‘You are only following a man who is bewitched.’
verses.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they wish to hear when they give ear to thee and when they take secret counsel, when the evil-doers say: Ye follow but a man bewitched.

verses.ar: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
verses.tr: ānẓur kayfa ḍarabūā laka al-ʾamthāla faḍallūā falā yastaṭīʿūna sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: See what they think you are like! But they are lost and cannot find the right way.
verses.pickthall: See what similitudes they coin for thee, and thus are all astray, and cannot find a road!

verses.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا وَرُفَـٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا
verses.en: And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
verses.tr: waqālūā ʾaʾidhā kunnā ʿiẓāman warufātan ʾaʾinnā lamabʿūthūna khalqan jadīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: They also say, ‘What? When we are turned to bones and dust, shall we really be raised up in a new act of creation?’
verses.pickthall: And they say: When we are bones and fragments, shall we forsooth, be raised up as a new creation?

verses.ar: ۞ قُلْ كُونُوا۟ حِجَارَةً أَوْ حَدِيدًا
verses.en: Say, "Be you stones or iron
verses.tr: ۞ qul kūnūā ḥijārahan ʾaw ḥadīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘[Yes] even if you were [as hard as] stone, or iron,
verses.pickthall: Say: Be ye stones or iron

verses.ar: أَوْ خَلْقًا مِّمَّا يَكْبُرُ فِى صُدُورِكُمْ ۚ فَسَيَقُولُونَ مَن يُعِيدُنَا ۖ قُلِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۚ فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ إِلَيْكَ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هُوَ ۖ قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَرِيبًا
verses.en: Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." And they will say, "Who will restore us?" Say, "He who brought you forth the first time." Then they will nod their heads toward you and say, "When is that?" Say, "Perhaps it will be soon -
verses.tr: ʾaw khalqan mmimmā yakburu fā ṣudūrikum ۚ fasayaqūlūna man yuʿīdunā ۖ quli adh-dhā faṭarakum ʾawwala marrahin ۚ fasayunghiḍūna ʾilayka ruʾūsahum wayaqūlūna matā huwa ۖ qul ʿasā ʾan yakūna qarīban
verses.abdelhaleem: or any other substance you think hard to bring to life.’ Then they will say, ‘Who will bring us back?’ Say, ‘The One who created you the first time.’ Then they will shake their heads at you and say, ‘When will that be?’ Say, ‘It may well be very soon:
verses.pickthall: Or some created thing that is yet greater in your thoughts! Then they will say: Who shall bring us back (to life). Say: He Who created you at the first. Then will they shake their heads at thee, and say: When will it be? Say: It will perhaps be soon;

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."
verses.tr: yawma yadʿūkum fatastajībūna biḥamdihi wataẓunnūna ʾin llabithtum ʾillā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: it will be the Day when He calls you, and you answer by praising Him, and you think you have stayed [on earth] only a little while.’
verses.pickthall: A day when He will call you and ye will answer with His praise, and ye will think that ye have tarried but a little while.

verses.ar: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
verses.en: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.
verses.tr: waqul lliʿibādā yaqūlūā at-tā hāa ʾaḥsanu ۚ ʾinna ash-shayṭāna yanzaghu baynahum ۚ ʾinna ash-shayṭāna kāna lilʾinsāni ʿaduwwan mmubīnan
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], tell My servants to say what is best. Satan sows discord among them: Satan is a sworn enemy of man.
verses.pickthall: Tell My bondmen to speak that which is kindlier. Lo! the devil soweth discord among them. Lo! the devil is for man an open foe.

verses.ar: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ ۖ إِن يَشَأْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَوْ إِن يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ ۚ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًا
verses.en: Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a manager.
verses.tr: rrabbukum ʾaʿlamu bikum ۖ ʾin yashaʾ yarḥamkum ʾaw ʾin yashaʾ yuʿadhibkum ۚ wamā ʾarsalnāka ʿalayhim wakīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord has the most knowledge about all of you: if He pleases He will have mercy on you, and if He pleases He will punish you. [Prophet], We did not send you to take charge of them.
verses.pickthall: Your Lord is Best Aware of you. If He will, He will have mercy on you, or if He will, He will punish you. We have not sent thee (O Muhammad) as a warden over them.

verses.ar: وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَلَقَدْ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورًا
verses.en: And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].
verses.tr: warabbuka ʾaʿlamu biman fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۗ walaqad faḍḍalnā baʿḍa an-nabiyyina ʿalā baʿḍin ۖ wataynā dāwuda zabūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord knows best about everyone in the heavens and the earth. We gave some prophets more than others: We gave David a book [of Psalms].
verses.pickthall: And thy Lord is Best Aware of all who are in the heavens and the earth. And we preferred some of the prophets above others, and unto David We gave the Psalms.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ ٱلضُّرِّ عَنكُمْ وَلَا تَحْوِيلًا
verses.en: Say, "Invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides Him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else]."
verses.tr: quli ādʿūā adh-dhīna zaʿamtum mmin dūnihi falā yamlikūna kashfa aḍ-ḍurri ʿankum walā taḥwīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Call upon those you claim to be deities beside God: they have no power to remove or avert any harm from you.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Cry unto those (saints and angels) whom ye assume (to be gods) beside Him, yet they have no power to rid you of misfortune nor to change.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُۥ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحْذُورًا
verses.en: Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna yadʿūna yabtaghūna ʾilā rabbihimu al-wasīlaha ʾayyuhum ʾaqrabu wayarjūna raḥmatahu wayakhāfūna ʿadhābahu ۚ ʾinna ʿadhāba rabbika kāna maḥdhūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Those [angels] they pray to are themselves seeking a way to their Lord, even those who are closest to Him. They hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. The punishment of your Lord is much to be feared:
verses.pickthall: Those unto whom they cry seek the way of approach to their Lord, which of them shall be the nearest; they hope for His mercy and they fear His doom. Lo! the doom of thy Lord is to be shunned.

verses.ar: وَإِن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَسْطُورًا
verses.en: And there is no city but that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. That has ever been in the Register inscribed.
verses.tr: wa-in mmin qaryahin ʾillā naḥnu muhlikūhā qabla yawmi al-qiyāmahi ʾaw muʿadhibūhā ʿadhāban shadīdan ۚ kāna dhālika fā al-kitābi masṭūran
verses.abdelhaleem: there is no community We shall not destroy, or punish severely, before the Day of Resurrection- this is written in the Book.
verses.pickthall: There is not a township but We shall destroy it ere the Day of Resurrection, or punish it with dire punishment. That is set forth in the Book (of Our decrees).

verses.ar: وَمَا مَنَعَنَآ أَن نُّرْسِلَ بِٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ إِلَّآ أَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ ۚ وَءَاتَيْنَا ثَمُودَ ٱلنَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةً فَظَلَمُوا۟ بِهَا ۚ وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ إِلَّا تَخْوِيفًا
verses.en: And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs [i.e., miracles] except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamūd the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning.
verses.tr: wamā manaʿanā ʾan nnursila bi-l-āyāti ʾillā ʾan kadhaba bihā al-ʾawwalūna ۚ wataynā thamūda an-nāqaha mubṣirahan faẓalamūā bihā ۚ wamā nursilu bi-l-āyāti ʾillā takhwīfan
verses.abdelhaleem: Nothing prevents Us from sending miraculous signs, except the fact that previous peoples denied them. We gave the people of Thamud the she-camel as a clear sign, yet they maltreated it. We send signs only to give warning.
verses.pickthall: Naught hindereth Us from sending portents save that the folk of old denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel - a clear portent save to warn.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلرُّءْيَا ٱلَّتِىٓ أَرَيْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَـٰنًا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people." And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur’ān. And We threaten [i.e., warn] them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.
verses.tr: wa-idh qulnā laka ʾinna rabbaka ʾaḥāṭa bi-an-nāsi ۚ wamā jaʿalnā ar-ruʾyā at-tā ʾaraynāka ʾillā fitnahan llilnnāsi wa-ash-shajaraha al-malʿūnaha fā al-qurāni ۚ wanukhawwifuhum famā yazīduhum ʾillā ṭughyānan kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], We have told you that your Lord knows all about human beings. The vision We showed you was only a test for people, as was the cursed tree [mentioned] in the Quran. We warn them, but this only increases their insolence.
verses.pickthall: And (it was a warning) when we told thee: Lo! thy Lord encompasseth mankind, and We appointed the sight which We showed thee as an ordeal for mankind, and (likewise) the Accursed Tree in the Qur'an. We warn them, but it increaseth them in naught save gross impiety.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ قَالَ ءَأَسْجُدُ لِمَنْ خَلَقْتَ طِينًا
verses.en: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He said, "Should I prostrate to one You created from clay?"
verses.tr: wa-idh qulnā lilmalāʾikahi āsjudūā lādama fasajadūā ʾillā ʾiblīsa qāla ʾaʾasjudu liman khalaqta ṭīnan
verses.abdelhaleem: When We said to the angels, ‘Bow down before Adam,’ they all bowed down, but not Iblis. He retorted, ‘Why should I bow down to someone You have created out of clay?’
verses.pickthall: And when We said unto the angels: Fall down prostrate before Adam and they fell prostrate all save Iblis, he said: Shall I fall prostrate before that which Thou hast created of clay?

verses.ar: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."
verses.tr: qāla ʾaraʾaytaka hādhā adh-dhā karramta ʿalāa laʾin ʾakhartani ʾilā yawmi al-qiyāmahi laʾaḥtanikanna dhurriyyatahu ʾillā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: and [then] said, ‘You see this being You have honoured above me? If You reprieve me until the Day of Resurrection, I will lead all but a few of his descendants by the nose.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Seest Thou this (creature) whom Thou hast honoured above me, if Thou give me grace until the Day of Resurrection I verily will seize his seed, save but a few.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱذْهَبْ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمْ جَزَآءً مَّوْفُورًا
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of [all of] you - an ample recompense.
verses.tr: qāla ādhhab faman tabiʿaka minhum fa-inna jahannama jazāʾukum jazāʾan mmawfūran
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Go away! Hell will be your reward, and the reward of any of them who follow you- an ample reward.
verses.pickthall: He said: Go, and whosoever of them followeth thee - lo! hell will be your payment, ample payment.

verses.ar: وَٱسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُم بِصَوْتِكَ وَأَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِم بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَـٰدِ وَعِدْهُمْ ۚ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verses.en: And incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
verses.tr: wāstafziz mani āstaṭaʿta minhum biṣawtika wa-ajlib ʿalayhim bikhaylika warajilika washārikhum fā al-ʾamwāli wa-l-ʾawlādi waʿidhum ۚ wamā yaʿiduhumu ash-shayṭānu ʾillā ghurūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Rouse whichever of them you can with your voice, muster your cavalry and infantry against them, share their wealth and their children with them, and make promises to them- Satan promises them nothing but delusion-
verses.pickthall: And excite any of them whom thou canst with thy voice, and urge thy horse and foot against them, and be a partner in their wealth and children, and promise them. Satan promiseth them only to deceive.

verses.ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.
verses.tr: ʾinna ʿibādā laysa laka ʿalayhim sulṭānun ۚ wakafā birabbika wakīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: but you will have no authority over My [true] servants: Your Lord can take care of them well enough.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! My (faithful) bondmen - over them thou hast no power, and thy Lord sufficeth as (their) guardian.

verses.ar: رَّبُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُزْجِى لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا
verses.en: It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful.
verses.tr: rrabbukumu adh-dhā yuzjā lakumu al-fulka fā al-baḥri litabtaghūā min faḍlihi ۚ ʾinnahu kāna bikum raḥīman
verses.abdelhaleem: [People], it is your Lord who makes ships go smoothly for you on the sea so that you can seek His bounty: He is most merciful towards you.
verses.pickthall: (O mankind), your Lord is He Who driveth for you the ship upon the sea that ye may seek of His bounty. Lo! He was ever Merciful toward you.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَن تَدْعُونَ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ أَعْرَضْتُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ كَفُورًا
verses.en: And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is man ungrateful.
verses.tr: wa-idhā massakumu aḍ-ḍurru fā al-baḥri ḍalla man tadʿūna ʾillā ʾiyyāhu ۖ falammā najjākum ʾilā al-barri ʾaʿraḍtum ۚ wakāna al-ʾinsānu kafūran
verses.abdelhaleem: When you get into distress at sea, those you pray to besides Him desert you, but when He brings you back safe to land you turn away: man is ever ungrateful.
verses.pickthall: And when harm toucheth you upon the sea, all unto whom ye cry (for succour) fail save Him (alone), but when He bringeth you safe to land, ye turn away, for man was ever thankless.

verses.ar: أَفَأَمِنتُمْ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلْبَرِّ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَكِيلًا
verses.en: Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.
verses.tr: ʾafaʾamintum ʾan yakhsifa bikum jāniba al-barri ʾaw yursila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban thumma lā tajidūā lakum wakīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Can you be sure that God will not have you swallowed up into the earth when you are back on land, or that He will not send a sandstorm against you? Then you will find no one to protect you.
verses.pickthall: Feel ye then secure that He will not cause a slope of the land to engulf you, or send a sand-storm upon you, and then ye will find that ye have no protector?

verses.ar: أَمْ أَمِنتُمْ أَن يُعِيدَكُمْ فِيهِ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ فَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ قَاصِفًا مِّنَ ٱلرِّيحِ فَيُغْرِقَكُم بِمَا كَفَرْتُمْ ۙ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِهِۦ تَبِيعًا
verses.en: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into it [i.e., the sea] another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied? Then you would not find for yourselves against Us an avenger.
verses.tr: ʾam ʾamintum ʾan yuʿīdakum fīhi tārahan ʾukhrā fayursila ʿalaykum qāṣifan mmina ar-rīḥi fayughriqakum bimā kafartum ۙ thumma lā tajidūā lakum ʿalaynā bihi tabīʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: Or can you be sure that He will not send you back out to sea, and send a violent storm against you to drown you for being so ungrateful? You will find no helper against Us there.
verses.pickthall: Or feel ye secure that He will not return you to that (plight) a second time, and send against you a hurricane of wind and drown you for your thanklessness, and then ye will not find therein that ye have any avenger against Us?

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا
verses.en: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.
verses.tr: ۞ walaqad karramnā banā ādama waḥamalnāhum fā al-barri wa-l-baḥri warazaqnāhum mmina aṭ-ṭayyibāti wafaḍḍalnāhum ʿalā kathīrin mmimman khalaqnā tafḍīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: We have honoured the children of Adam and carried them by land and sea; We have provided good sustenance for them and favoured them specially above many of those We have created.
verses.pickthall: Verily we have honoured the Children of Adam. We carry them on the land and the sea, and have made provision of good things for them, and have preferred them above many of those whom We created with a marked preferment.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ نَدْعُوا۟ كُلَّ أُنَاسٍۭ بِإِمَـٰمِهِمْ ۖ فَمَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَقْرَءُونَ كِتَـٰبَهُمْ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا
verses.en: [Mention, O Muḥammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].
verses.tr: yawma nadʿūā kulla ʾunāsin biʾimāmihim ۖ faman ʾūtāa kitābahu biyamīnihi fa-ūlāʾika yaqraʾūna kitābahum walā yuẓlamūna fatīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when We summon each community, along with its leader, those who are given their record in their right hand will read it [with pleasure]. But no one will be wronged in the least:
verses.pickthall: On the day when We shall summon all men with their record, whoso is given his book in his right hand - such will read their book and they will not be wronged a shred.

verses.ar: وَمَن كَانَ فِى هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أَعْمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَعْمَىٰ وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: And whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way.
verses.tr: waman kāna fā hādhihi ʾaʿmā fahuwa fā al-ākhirahi ʾaʿmā wa-aḍallu sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: those who were blind in this life will be blind in the Hereafter, and even further off the path.
verses.pickthall: Whoso is blind here will be blind in the Hereafter, and yet further from the road.

verses.ar: وَإِن كَادُوا۟ لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ لِتَفْتَرِىَ عَلَيْنَا غَيْرَهُۥ ۖ وَإِذًا لَّٱتَّخَذُوكَ خَلِيلًا
verses.en: And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend.
verses.tr: wa-in kādūā layaftinūnaka ʿani adh-dhā ʾawḥaynā ʾilayka litaftarāa ʿalaynā ghayrahu ۖ wa-idhan llāttakhadhūka khalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], the disbelievers tried to tempt you away from what We revealed to you, so that you would invent some other revelation and attribute it to Us and then they would have taken you as a friend.
verses.pickthall: And they indeed strove hard to beguile thee (Muhammad) away from that wherewith We have inspired thee, that thou shouldst invent other than it against Us; and then would they have accepted thee as a friend.

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَآ أَن ثَبَّتْنَـٰكَ لَقَدْ كِدتَّ تَرْكَنُ إِلَيْهِمْ شَيْـًٔا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
verses.tr: walawlā ʾan thabbatnāka laqad kidtta tarkanu ʾilayhim shayā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: If We had not made you stand firm, you would almost have inclined a little towards them.
verses.pickthall: And if We had not made thee wholly firm thou mightest almost have inclined unto them a little.

verses.ar: إِذًا لَّأَذَقْنَـٰكَ ضِعْفَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ وَضِعْفَ ٱلْمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيْنَا نَصِيرًا
verses.en: Then [if you had], We would have made you taste double [punishment in] life and double [after] death. Then you would not find for yourself against Us a helper.
verses.tr: ʾidhan llaʾadhaqnāka ḍiʿfa al-ḥayawāhi waḍiʿfa al-mamāti thumma lā tajidu laka ʿalaynā naṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: In that case, We would have made you taste a double punishment in this life, and a double punishment after death and then you would have found no one to help you against Us.
verses.pickthall: Then had we made thee taste a double (punishment) of living and a double (punishment) of dying, then hadst thou found no helper against Us.

verses.ar: وَإِن كَادُوا۟ لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوكَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَإِذًا لَّا يَلْبَثُونَ خِلَـٰفَكَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: And indeed, they were about to provoke [i.e., drive] you from the land [i.e., Makkah] to evict you therefrom. And then [when they do], they will not remain [there] after you, except for a little.
verses.tr: wa-in kādūā layastafizzūnaka mina al-ʾarḍi liyukhrijūka minhā ۖ wa-idhan llā yalbathūna khilāfaka ʾillā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: They planned to scare you off the land, but they would not have lasted for more than a little while after you.
verses.pickthall: And they indeed wished to scare thee from the land that they might drive thee forth from thence, and then they would have stayed (there) but a little after thee.

verses.ar: سُنَّةَ مَن قَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا ۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيلًا
verses.en: [That is Our] established way for those We had sent before you of Our messengers; and you will not find in Our way any alteration.
verses.tr: sunnaha man qad ʾarsalnā qablaka min rrusulinā ۖ walā tajidu lisunnatinā taḥwīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Such was Our way with the messengers We sent before you, and you will find no change in Our ways.
verses.pickthall: (Such was Our) method in the case of those whom We sent before thee (to mankind), and thou wilt not find for Our method aught of power to change.

verses.ar: أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمْسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَقُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ ۖ إِنَّ قُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا
verses.en: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
verses.tr: ʾaqimi aṣ-ṣalawāha lidulūki ash-shamsi ʾilā ghasaqi al-yli waqurāna al-fajri ۖ ʾinna qurāna al-fajri kāna mashhūdan
verses.abdelhaleem: So perform the regular prayers in the period from the time the sun is past its zenith till the darkness of the night, and [recite] the Quran at dawn- dawn recitation is always witnessed––
verses.pickthall: Establish worship at the going down of the sun until the dark of night, and (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn. Lo! (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn is ever witnessed.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا
verses.en: And from [part of] the night, pray with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān] as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
verses.tr: wamina al-yli fatahajjad bihi nāfilahan llaka ʿasā ʾan yabʿathaka rabbuka maqāman mmaḥmūdan
verses.abdelhaleem: and dur-ing the night wake up and pray, as an extra offering of your own, so that your Lord may raise you to a [highly] praised status.
verses.pickthall: And some part of the night awake for it, a largess for thee. It may be that thy Lord will raise thee to a praised estate.

verses.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَـٰنًا نَّصِيرًا
verses.en: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."
verses.tr: waqul rrabbi ʾadkhilnā mudkhala ṣidqin wa-akhrijnā mukhraja ṣidqin wājʿal llā min lladunka sulṭānan nnaṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘My Lord, make me go in truthfully, and come out truthfully, and grant me supporting authority from You.’
verses.pickthall: And say: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power.

verses.ar: وَقُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا
verses.en: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
verses.tr: waqul jāʾa al-ḥaqqu wazahaqa al-bāṭilu ۚ ʾinna al-bāṭila kāna zahūqan
verses.abdelhaleem: And say, ‘The truth has come, and falsehood has passed away: falsehood is bound to pass away.’
verses.pickthall: And say: Truth hath come and falsehood hath vanished away. Lo! falsehood is ever bound to vanish.

verses.ar: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.en: And We send down of the Qur’ān that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
verses.tr: wanunazzilu mina al-qurāni mā huwa shifāʾun waraḥmahun llilmuʾminīna ۙ walā yazīdu aẓ-ẓālimīna ʾillā khasāran
verses.abdelhaleem: We send down the Quran as healing and mercy to those who believe; as for those who disbelieve, it only increases their loss.
verses.pickthall: And We reveal of the Qur'an that which is a healing and a mercy for believers though it increase the evil-doers in naught save ruin.

verses.ar: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ ۖ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوسًا
verses.en: And when We bestow favor upon man [i.e., the disbeliever], he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
verses.tr: wa-idhā ʾanʿamnā ʿalā al-ʾinsāni ʾaʿraḍa wanā bijānibihi ۖ wa-idhā massahu ash-sharru kāna yawsan
verses.abdelhaleem: When We favour man he turns arrogantly to one side, but when harm touches him, he falls into despair.
verses.pickthall: And when We make life pleasant unto man, he turneth away and is averse; and when ill toucheth him he is in despair.

verses.ar: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِۦ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
verses.tr: qul kullun yaʿmalu ʿalā shākilatihi farabbukum ʾaʿlamu biman huwa ʾahdā sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Everyone does things their own way, but your Lord is fully aware of who follows the best-guided path.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Each one doth according to his rule of conduct, and thy Lord is Best Aware of him whose way is right.

verses.ar: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair [i.e., concern] of my Lord. And you [i.e., mankind] have not been given of knowledge except a little."
verses.tr: wayaslūnaka ʿani ar-rūḥi ۖ quli ar-rūḥu min ʾamri rabbā wamā ʾūtītum mmina al-ʿilmi ʾillā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], they ask you about the Spirit. Say, ‘The Spirit is part of my Lord’s domain. You have only been given a little knowledge.’
verses.pickthall: They are asking thee concerning the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is by command of my Lord, and of knowledge ye have been vouchsafed but little.

verses.ar: وَلَئِن شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِۦ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا
verses.en: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
verses.tr: walaʾin shiʾnā lanadhhabanna bi-adh-dhā ʾawḥaynā ʾilayka thumma lā tajidu laka bihi ʿalaynā wakīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: If We pleased, We could take away what We have revealed to you- then you would find no one to plead for you against Us-
verses.pickthall: And if We willed We could withdraw that which We have revealed unto thee, then wouldst thou find no guardian for thee against Us in respect thereof.

verses.ar: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُۥ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا
verses.en: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.
verses.tr: ʾillā raḥmahan mmin rrabbika ۚ ʾinna faḍlahu kāna ʿalayka kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: if it were not for your Lord’s mercy: His favour to you has been truly great.
verses.pickthall: (It is naught) save mercy from thy Lord. Lo! His kindness unto thee was ever great.

verses.ar: قُل لَّئِنِ ٱجْتَمَعَتِ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا
verses.en: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur’ān, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."
verses.tr: qul llaʾini ājtamaʿati al-ʾinsu wa-l-jinnu ʿalā ʾan yaʾtūā bimithli hādhā al-qurāni lā yaʾtūna bimithlihi walaw kāna baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ẓahīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Even if all mankind and jinn came together to produce something like this Quran, they could not produce anything like it, however much they helped each other.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Verily, though mankind and the jinn should assemble to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like thereof though they were helpers one of another.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
verses.en: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example, but most of the people refused except disbelief.
verses.tr: walaqad ṣarrafnā lilnnāsi fā hādhā al-qurāni min kulli mathalin fa-abā ʾaktharu an-nāsi ʾillā kufūran
verses.abdelhaleem: In this Quran, We have set out all kinds of examples for people, yet most of them persist in disbelieving.
verses.pickthall: And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all kind of similitudes, but most of mankind refuse aught save disbelief.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ يَنۢبُوعًا
verses.en: And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring
verses.tr: waqālūā lan nnuʾmina laka ḥattā tafjura lanā mina al-ʾarḍi yanbūʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘We will not believe for you [Muhammad] until you make a spring gush out of the ground for us;
verses.pickthall: And they say: We will not put faith in thee till thou cause a spring to gush forth from the earth for us;

verses.ar: أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرَ خِلَـٰلَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
verses.en: Or [until] you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
verses.tr: ʾaw takūna laka jannahun mmin nnakhīlin waʿinabin fatufajjira al-ʾanhāra khilālahā tafjīran
verses.abdelhaleem: or until you have a garden of date palms and vines, and make rivers pour through them;
verses.pickthall: Or thou have a garden of date-palms and grapes, and cause rivers to gush forth therein abundantly;

verses.ar: أَوْ تُسْقِطَ ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِىَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ قَبِيلًا
verses.en: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allāh and the angels before [us]
verses.tr: ʾaw tusqiṭa as-samāʾa kamā zaʿamta ʿalaynā kisafan ʾaw taʾtāa billāh wa-l-malāʾikahi qabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: or make the sky fall on us in pieces, as you claimed will happen; or bring God and the angels before us face to face;
verses.pickthall: Or thou cause the heaven to fall upon us piecemeal, as thou hast pretended, or bring Allah and the angels as a warrant;

verses.ar: أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَـٰبًا نَّقْرَؤُهُۥ ۗ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّى هَلْ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا
verses.en: Or you have a house of ornament [i.e., gold] or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"
verses.tr: ʾaw yakūna laka baytun mmin zukhrufin ʾaw tarqā fā as-samāʾi walan nnuʾmina liruqiyyika ḥattā tunazzila ʿalaynā kitāban nnaqraʾuhu ۗ qul subḥāna rabbā hal kuntu ʾillā basharan rrasūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: or have a house made of gold; or ascend into the sky- even then, we will not believe in your ascension until you send a real book down for us to read.’ Say, ‘Glory be to my Lord! Am I anything but a mortal, a messenger?’
verses.pickthall: Or thou have a house of gold; or thou ascend up into heaven, and even then we will put no faith in thine ascension till thou bring down for us a book that we can read. Say (O Muhammad): My Lord be Glorified! Am I aught save a mortal messenger?

verses.ar: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا
verses.en: And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allāh sent a human messenger?"
verses.tr: wamā manaʿa an-nāsa ʾan yuʾminūā ʾidh jāʾahumu al-hudā ʾillā ʾan qālūā ʾabaʿatha Allāh basharan rrasūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: The only thing that kept these people from believing, when guidance came to them, was that they said, ‘How could God have sent a human being as a messenger?’
verses.pickthall: And naught prevented mankind from believing when the guidance came unto them save that they said: Hath Allah sent a mortal as (His) messenger?

verses.ar: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَلَكًا رَّسُولًا
verses.en: Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."
verses.tr: qul llaw kāna fā al-ʾarḍi malāʾikahun yamshūna muṭmaʾinnīna lanazzalnā ʿalayhim mmina as-samāʾi malakan rrasūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘If there were angels walking about on earth, feeling at home, We would have sent them an angel from Heaven as a messenger.’
verses.pickthall: Say: If there were in the earth angels walking secure, We had sent down for them from heaven an angel as messenger.

verses.ar: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.en: Say, "Sufficient is Allāh as Witness between me and you. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Aware and Seeing."
verses.tr: qul kafā billāh shahīdanā baynā wabaynakum ۚ ʾinnahu kāna biʿibādihi khabīranā baṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘God is witness enough between me and you. He knows and observes His servants well.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Allah sufficeth for a witness between me and you. Lo! He is Knower, Seer of His slaves.

verses.ar: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۖ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَبُكْمًا وَصُمًّا ۖ مَّأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَـٰهُمْ سَعِيرًا
verses.en: And whoever Allāh guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides, We increase [for] them blazing fire.
verses.tr: waman yahdi Allāh fahuwa al-muhtadi ۖ waman yuḍlil falan tajida lahum ʾawliyāʾa min dūnihi ۖ wanaḥshuruhum yawma al-qiyāmahi ʿalā wujūhihim ʿumyan wabukman waṣumman ۖ mmaʾwāhum jahannamu ۖ kullamā khabat zidnāhum saʿīran
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], anyone God guides is truly guided, and you will find no protector other than Him for anyone He leaves astray. On the Day of Resurrection We shall gather them, lying on their faces, blind, dumb, and deaf. Hell will be their Home. Whenever the Fire goes down, We shall make it blaze more fiercely for them.
verses.pickthall: And he whom Allah guideth, he is led aright; while, as for him whom He sendeth astray, for them thou wilt find no protecting friends beside Him, and We shall assemble them on the Day of Resurrection on their faces, blind, dumb and deaf; their habitation will be hell; whenever it abateth, We increase the flame for them.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا وَرُفَـٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا
verses.en: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?"
verses.tr: dhālika jazāʾuhum biʾannahum kafarūā bāyātinā waqālūā ʾaʾidhā kunnā ʿiẓāman warufātan ʾaʾinnā lamabʿūthūna khalqan jadīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: This is what they will get for rejecting Our signs and saying, ‘What? When we are turned to bones and dust, how can we be raised in a new act of creation?’
verses.pickthall: That is their reward because they disbelieved Our revelations and said: When we are bones and fragments shall we, forsooth, be raised up as a new creation?

verses.ar: ۞ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَأَبَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
verses.en: Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse except disbelief.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾawalam yarawā ʾanna Allāh adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa qādirun ʿalā ʾan yakhluqa mithlahum wajaʿala lahum ʾajalan llā rayba fīhi fa-abā aẓ-ẓālimūna ʾillā kufūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not see that God, who created the heavens and earth, can create the likes of them [anew]? He has ordained a time for them- there is no doubt about that- but the evildoers refuse everything except disbelief.
verses.pickthall: Have they not seen that Allah Who created the heavens and the earth is Able to create the like of them, and hath appointed for them an end whereof there is no doubt? But the wrong-doers refuse aught save disbelief.

verses.ar: قُل لَّوْ أَنتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَآئِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّىٓ إِذًا لَّأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ ٱلْإِنفَاقِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ قَتُورًا
verses.en: Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy.
verses.tr: qul llaw ʾantum tamlikūna khazāʾina raḥmahi rabbā ʾidhan llaʾamsaktum khashyaha al-ʾinfāqi ۚ wakāna al-ʾinsānu qatūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘If you possessed the very stores of my Lord’s bounty, you would hold them back in your fear of spending: man is ever grudging.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them): If ye possessed the treasures of the mercy of my Lord, ye would surely hold them back for fear of spending, for man was ever grudging.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًا
verses.en: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā mūsā tisʿa āyātin bayyinātin ۖ fasl banā ʾisrāʾīla ʾidh jāʾahum faqāla lahu firʿawnu ʾinnā laʾaẓunnuka yāmūsā masḥūran
verses.abdelhaleem: In the past, We gave Moses nine clear signs- ask the Children of Israel. When Moses came to [the Egyptians], Pharaoh said to him, ‘Moses, I think you are bewitched.’
verses.pickthall: And verily We gave unto Moses nine tokens, clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty). Do but ask the Children of Israel how he came unto them, then Pharaoh said unto him: Lo! I deem thee one bewitched, O Moses.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَآ أَنزَلَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ بَصَآئِرَ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًا
verses.en: [Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think, O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
verses.tr: qāla laqad ʿalimta mā ʾanzala hāʾulāʾi ʾillā rabbu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi baṣāʾira wa-innā laʾaẓunnuka yāfirʿawnu mathbūran
