verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘You know very well that only the Lord of the heavens and earth could have sent these signs as clear proof. I think that you, Pharaoh, are doomed.’
verses.pickthall: He said: In truth thou knowest that none sent down these (portents) save the Lord of the heavens and the earth as proofs, and lo! (for my part) I deem thee lost, O Pharaoh.

verses.ar: فَأَرَادَ أَن يَسْتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ جَمِيعًا
verses.en: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
verses.tr: fa-arāda ʾan yastafizzahum mmina al-ʾarḍi fa-aghraqnāhu waman mmaʿahu jamīʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: So he wanted to wipe them off the [face of the] earth, but We drowned him and those with him.
verses.pickthall: And he wished to scare them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him, all together.

verses.ar: وَقُلْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ لِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا
verses.en: And We said after him [i.e., Pharaoh] to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise [i.e., appointment] of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
verses.tr: waqulnā min baʿdihi libanā ʾisrāʾīla āskunūā al-ʾarḍa fa-idhā jāʾa waʿdu al-ākhirahi jiʾnā bikum lafīfan
verses.abdelhaleem: After his death, We told the Children of Israel, ‘Live in the land, and when the promise of the Hereafter is fulfilled, We shall bring you to the assembly of all people.’
verses.pickthall: And We said unto the Children of Israel after him: Dwell in the land; but when the promise of the Hereafter cometh to pass We shall bring you as a crowd gathered out of various nations.

verses.ar: وَبِٱلْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ وَبِٱلْحَقِّ نَزَلَ ۗ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
verses.en: And with the truth We have sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
verses.tr: wabālḥaqqi ʾanzalnāhu wabālḥaqqi nazala ۗ wamā ʾarsalnāka ʾillā mubashiran wanadhīran
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent down the Quran with the truth, and with the truth it has come down- [Prophet], We sent you only to give good news and warning-
verses.pickthall: With truth have We sent it down, and with truth hath it descended. And We have sent thee as naught else save a bearer of good tidings and a warner.

verses.ar: وَقُرْءَانًا فَرَقْنَـٰهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَـٰهُ تَنزِيلًا
verses.en: And [it is] a Qur’ān which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
verses.tr: waqurānan faraqnāhu litaqraʾahu ʿalā an-nāsi ʿalā mukthin wanazzalnāhu tanzīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: it is a recitation that We have revealed in parts, so that you can recite it to people at intervals; We have sent it down little by little.
verses.pickthall: And (it is) a Qur'an that We have divided, that thou mayst recite it unto mankind at intervals, and We have revealed it by (successive) revelation.

verses.ar: قُلْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦٓ إِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا
verses.en: Say, "Believe in it or do not believe." Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,
verses.tr: qul āminūā bihi ʾaw lā tuʾminūā ۚ ʾinna adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-ʿilma min qablihi ʾidhā yutlā ʿalayhim yakhirrūna lilʾadhqāni sujjadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Whether you believe it or not, those who were given knowledge earlier fall down on their faces when it is recited to them,
verses.pickthall: Say: Believe therein or believe not, lo! those who were given knowledge before it, when it is read unto them, fall down prostrate on their faces, adoring,

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا
verses.en: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."
verses.tr: wayaqūlūna subḥāna rabbinā ʾin kāna waʿdu rabbinā lamafʿūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: and say, “Glory to our Lord! Our Lord’s promise has been fulfilled.”
verses.pickthall: Saying: Glory to our Lord! Verily the promise of our Lord must be fulfilled.

verses.ar: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًا ۩
verses.en: And they fall upon their faces weeping, and it [i.e., the Qur’ān] increases them in humble submission.
verses.tr: wayakhirrūna lilʾadhqāni yabkūna wayazīduhum khushūʿan ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: They fall down on their faces, weeping, and [the Quran] increases their humility.’
verses.pickthall: They fall down on their faces, weeping, and it increaseth humility in them.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ ۖ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Say, "Call upon Allāh or call upon the Most Merciful [ar-Raḥmān]. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
verses.tr: quli ādʿūā Allāh ʾawi ādʿūā ar-raḥmāna ۖ ʾayyan mmā tadʿūā falahu al-ʾasmāʾu al-ḥusnā ۚ walā tajhar biṣalātika walā tukhāfit bihā wābtaghi bayna dhālika sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [to them], ‘Call on God, or on the Lord of Mercy- whatever names you call Him, the best names belong to Him.’ [Prophet], do not be too loud in your prayer, or too quiet, but seek a middle way
verses.pickthall: Say (unto mankind): Cry unto Allah, or cry unto the Beneficent, unto whichsoever ye cry (it is the same). His are the most beautiful names. And thou (Muhammad), be not loud-voiced in thy worship nor yet silent therein, but follow a way between.

verses.ar: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ مِّنَ ٱلذُّلِّ ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًۢا
verses.en: And say, "Praise to Allāh, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."
verses.tr: waquli al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhā lam yattakhidh waladan walam yakun llahu sharīkun fā al-mulki walam yakun llahu walāun mmina adh-dhulli ۖ wakabbirhu takbīranā
verses.abdelhaleem: and say, ‘Praise belongs to God, who has no child nor partner in His rule. He is not so weak as to need a protector. Proclaim His limitless greatness!’
verses.pickthall: And say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath not taken unto Himself a son, and Who hath no partner in the Sovereignty, nor hath He any protecting friend through dependence. And magnify Him with all magnificence.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَا ۜ
verses.en: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, who has sent down upon His Servant [Muḥammad (ﷺ)] the Book and has not made therein any deviance.
verses.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhā ʾanzala ʿalā ʿabdihi al-kitāba walam yajʿal llahu ʿiwajā ۜ
verses.abdelhaleem: Praise be to God, who sent down the Scripture to His servant and made it unerringly straight,
verses.pickthall: Praise be to Allah Who hath revealed the Scripture unto His slave, and hath not placed therein any crookedness,

verses.ar: قَيِّمًا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًا شَدِيدًا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا
verses.en: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward [i.e., Paradise].
verses.tr: qayyiman lliyundhira baʾsan shadīdan mmin lladunhu wayubashira al-muʾminīna adh-dhīna yaʿmalūna aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ʾanna lahum ʾajran ḥasanan
verses.abdelhaleem: warning of severe punishment from Him, and [giving] glad news to the believers who do good deeds––an excellent reward
verses.pickthall: (But hath made it) straight, to give warning of stern punishment from Him, and to bring unto the believers who do good works the news that theirs will be a fair reward,

verses.ar: مَّـٰكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَدًا
verses.en: In which they will remain forever
verses.tr: mmākithīna fīhi ʾabadan
verses.abdelhaleem: that they will always enjoy.
verses.pickthall: Wherein they will abide for ever;

verses.ar: وَيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًا
verses.en: And to warn those who say, "Allāh has taken a son".
verses.tr: wayundhira adh-dhīna qālūā āttakhadha Allāh waladan
verses.abdelhaleem: It warns those people who assert, ‘God has offspring.’
verses.pickthall: And to warn those who say: Allah hath chosen a son,

verses.ar: مَّا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ وَلَا لِـَٔابَآئِهِمْ ۚ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ ۚ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًا
verses.en: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.
verses.tr: mmā lahum bihi min ʿilmin walā lābāʾihim ۚ kaburat kalimahan takhruju min ʾafwāhihim ۚ ʾin yaqūlūna ʾillā kadhiban
verses.abdelhaleem: They have no knowledge about this, nor did their forefathers––it is a monstrous assertion that comes out of their mouths: what they say is nothing but lies.
verses.pickthall: (A thing) whereof they have no knowledge, nor (had) their fathers, Dreadful is the word that cometh out of their mouths. They speak naught but a lie.

verses.ar: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا
verses.en: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muḥammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.
verses.tr: falaʿallaka bākhiʿun nnafsaka ʿalā āthārihim ʾin llam yuʾminūā bihādhā al-ḥadīthi ʾasafan
verses.abdelhaleem: But [Prophet] are you going to worry yourself to death over them if they do not believe in this message?
verses.pickthall: Yet it may be, if they believe not in this statement, that thou (Muhammad) wilt torment thy soul with grief over their footsteps.

verses.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
verses.en: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.
verses.tr: ʾinnā jaʿalnā mā ʿalā al-ʾarḍi zīnahan llahā linabluwahum ʾayyuhum ʾaḥsanu ʿamalan
verses.abdelhaleem: We have adorned the earth with attractive things so that We may test people to find out which of them do best,
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have placed all that is on the earth as an ornament thereof that We may try them: which of them is best in conduct.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا لَجَـٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًا جُرُزًا
verses.en: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.
verses.tr: wa-innā lajāʿilūna mā ʿalayhā ṣaʿīdan juruzan
verses.abdelhaleem: but We shall reduce all this to barren dust.
verses.pickthall: And lo! We shall make all that is thereon a barren mound.

verses.ar: أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْكَهْفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا۟ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا عَجَبًا
verses.en: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?
verses.tr: ʾam ḥasibta ʾanna ʾaṣḥāba al-kahfi wa-ar-raqīmi kānūā min āyātinā ʿajaban
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do you find the Companions in the Cave and al-Raqim so wondrous, among all Our other signs?
verses.pickthall: Or deemest thou that the People of the Cave and the Inscription are a wonder among Our portents?

verses.ar: إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
verses.en: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."
verses.tr: ʾidh ʾawā al-fityahu ʾilā al-kahfi faqālūā rabbanā ātinā min lladunka raḥmahan wahayyiʾ lanā min ʾamrinā rashadan
verses.abdelhaleem: When the young men sought refuge in the cave and said, ‘Our Lord, grant us Your mercy, and find us a good way out of our ordeal,’
verses.pickthall: When the young men fled for refuge to the Cave and said: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight.

verses.ar: فَضَرَبْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ فِى ٱلْكَهْفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدًا
verses.en: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.
verses.tr: faḍarabnā ʿalā ādhānihim fā al-kahfi sinīna ʿadadan
verses.abdelhaleem: We sealed their ears [with sleep] in the cave for years.
verses.pickthall: Then We sealed up their hearing in the Cave for a number of years.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَـٰهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ أَىُّ ٱلْحِزْبَيْنِ أَحْصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوٓا۟ أَمَدًا
verses.en: Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time.
verses.tr: thumma baʿathnāhum linaʿlama āu al-ḥizbayni ʾaḥṣā limā labithūā ʾamadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Then We woke them so that We could make clear which of the two parties was better able to work out how long they had been there.
verses.pickthall: And afterward We raised them up that We might know which of the two parties would best calculate the time that they had tarried.

verses.ar: نَّحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنَـٰهُمْ هُدًى
verses.en: It is We who relate to you, [O Muḥammad], their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.
verses.tr: nnaḥnu naquṣṣu ʿalayka nabaʾahum bi-l-ḥaqqi ۚ ʾinnahum fityahun āmanūā birabbihim wazidnāhum hudanā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], We shall tell you their story as it really was. They were young men who believed in their Lord, and We gave them more and more guidance.
verses.pickthall: We narrate unto thee their story with truth. Lo! they were young men who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.

verses.ar: وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا۟ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَـٰهًا ۖ لَّقَدْ قُلْنَآ إِذًا شَطَطًا
verses.en: And We bound [i.e., made firm] their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression.
verses.tr: warabaṭnā ʿalā qulūbihim ʾidh qāmūā faqālūā rabbunā rabbu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi lan nnadʿuwā min dūnihi ʾilāhan ۖ llaqad qulnā ʾidhan shaṭaṭan
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave strength to their hearts when they stood up and said, ‘Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and earth. We shall never call upon any god other than Him, for that would be an outrageous thing to do.
verses.pickthall: And We made firm their hearts when they stood forth and said: Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We cry unto no Allah beside Him, for then should we utter an enormity.

verses.ar: هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمُنَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً ۖ لَّوْلَا يَأْتُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۭ بَيِّنٍ ۖ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
verses.en: These, our people, have taken besides Him deities. Why do they not bring for [worship of] them a clear evidence? And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh a lie?"
verses.tr: hāʾulāʾi qawmunā āttakhadhūā min dūnihi ālihahan ۖ llawlā yaʾtūna ʿalayhim bisulṭānin bayyinin ۖ faman ʾaẓlamu mimmani āftarā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban
verses.abdelhaleem: These people of ours have taken gods other than Him. Why do they not produce clear evidence about them? Who could be more unjust than someone who makes up lies about God?
verses.pickthall: These, our people, have chosen (other) gods beside Him though they bring no clear warrant (vouchsafed) to them. And who doth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah?

verses.ar: وَإِذِ ٱعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ فَأْوُۥٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُم مِّنْ أَمْرِكُم مِّرْفَقًا
verses.en: [The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allāh, retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility."
verses.tr: wa-idhi āʿtazaltumūhum wamā yaʿbudūna ʾillā Allāh fa-wā ʾilā al-kahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum mmin rraḥmatihi wayuhayyiʾ lakum mmin ʾamrikum mmirfaqan
verses.abdelhaleem: Now that you have left such people, and what they worshipped instead of God, take refuge in the cave. God will shower His mercy on you and make you an easy way out of your ordeal.’
verses.pickthall: And when ye withdraw from them and that which they worship except Allah, then seek refuge in the Cave; your Lord will spread for you of His mercy and will prepare for you a pillow in your plight.

verses.ar: ۞ وَتَرَى ٱلشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَٰوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِى فَجْوَةٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ مَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ وَلِيًّا مُّرْشِدًا
verses.en: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [lying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of Allāh. He whom Allāh guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He sends astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide.
verses.tr: ۞ watarā ash-shamsa ʾidhā ṭalaʿat ttazāwaru ʿan kahfihim dhāta al-yamīni wa-idhā gharabat ttaqriḍuhum dhāta ash-shimāli wahum fā fajwahin mminhu ۚ dhālika min āyāti Allāh ۗ man yahdi Allāh fahuwa al-muhtadi ۖ waman yuḍlil falan tajida lahu waliyyan mmurshidan
verses.abdelhaleem: You could have seen the [light of the] sun as it rose, moving away to the right of their cave, and when it set, moving away to the left of them, while they lay in the wide space inside the cave. (This is one of God’s signs: those people God guides are rightly guided, but you will find no protector to lead to the right path those He leaves to stray.)
verses.pickthall: And thou mightest have seen the sun when it rose move away from their cave to the right, and when it set go past them on the left, and they were in the cleft thereof. That was (one) of the portents of Allah. He whom Allah guideth, he indeed is led aright, and he whom He sendeth astray, for him thou wilt not find a guiding friend.

verses.ar: وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ ۖ وَكَلْبُهُم بَـٰسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِٱلْوَصِيدِ ۚ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًا
verses.en: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.
verses.tr: wataḥsabuhum ʾayqāẓan wahum ruqūdun ۚ wanuqallibuhum dhāta al-yamīni wadhāta ash-shimāli ۖ wakalbuhum bāsiṭun dhirāʿayhi bi-l-waṣīdi ۚ lawi āṭṭalaʿta ʿalayhim lawallayta minhum firāran walamuliʾta minhum ruʿban
verses.abdelhaleem: You would have thought they were awake, though they lay asleep. We turned them over, to the right and the left, with their dog stretching out its forelegs at the entrance. If you had seen them, you would have turned and run away, filled with fear of them.
verses.pickthall: And thou wouldst have deemed them waking though they were asleep, and We caused them to turn over to the right and the left, and their dog stretching out his paws on the threshold. If thou hadst observed them closely thou hadst assuredly turned away from them in flight, and hadst been filled with awe of them.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَـٰهُمْ لِيَتَسَآءَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ ۚ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ فَٱبْعَثُوٓا۟ أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ أَيُّهَآ أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًا فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا
verses.en: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?" They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day." They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you.
verses.tr: wakadhālika baʿathnāhum liyatasāʾalūā baynahum ۚ qāla qāʾilun mminhum kam labithtum ۖ qālūā labithnā yawman ʾaw baʿḍa yawmin ۚ qālūā rabbukum ʾaʿlamu bimā labithtum fābʿathūā ʾaḥadakum biwariqikum hādhihi ʾilā al-madīnahi falyanẓur ʾayyuhā ʾazkā ṭaʿāman falyaʾtikum birizqin mminhu walyatalaṭṭaf walā yushʿiranna bikum ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: In time We woke them, and they began to question one another. One of them asked, ‘How long have you been here?’ and [some] answered, ‘A day or part of a day,’ but then [others] said, ‘Your Lord knows best how long you have been here. One of you go to the city with your silver coins, find out where the best food is there, and bring some back. But be careful not to let anyone know about you:
verses.pickthall: And in like manner We awakened them that they might question one another. A speaker from among them said: How long have ye tarried? They said: We have tarried a day or some part of a day, (Others) said: Your Lord best knoweth what ye have tarried. Now send one of you with this your silver coin unto the city, and let him see what food is purest there and bring you a supply thereof. Let him be courteous and let no man know of you.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ إِن يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِى مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَن تُفْلِحُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًا
verses.en: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion. And never would you succeed, then - ever."
verses.tr: ʾinnahum ʾin yaẓharūā ʿalaykum yarjumūkum ʾaw yuʿīdūkum fā millatihim walan tufliḥūā ʾidhan ʾabadan
verses.abdelhaleem: if they found you out, they would stone you or force you to return to their religion, where you would never come to any good.’
verses.pickthall: For they, if they should come to know of you, will stone you or turn you back to their religion; then ye will never prosper.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَآ إِذْ يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ ۖ فَقَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ عَلَيْهِم بُنْيَـٰنًا ۖ رَّبُّهُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ غَلَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِمْ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيْهِم مَّسْجِدًا
verses.en: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allāh is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt. [That was] when they disputed among themselves about their affair and [then] said, "Construct over them a structure. Their Lord is most knowing about them." Said those who prevailed in the matter, "We will surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid."
verses.tr: wakadhālika ʾaʿtharnā ʿalayhim liyaʿlamūā ʾanna waʿda Allāh ḥaqqun wa-anna as-sāʿaha lā rayba fīhā ʾidh yatanāzaʿūna baynahum ʾamrahum ۖ faqālūā ābnūā ʿalayhim bunyānan ۖ rrabbuhum ʾaʿlamu bihim ۚ qāla adh-dhīna ghalabūā ʿalā ʾamrihim lanattakhidhanna ʿalayhim mmasjidan
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way We brought them to people’s attention so that they might know that God’s promise [of resurrection] is true and that there is no doubt about the Last Hour, [though] people argue among themselves. [Some] said, ‘Construct a building over them: their Lord knows best about them.’ Those who prevailed said, ‘We shall build a place of worship over them.’
verses.pickthall: And in like manner We disclosed them (to the people of the city) that they might know that the promise of Allah is true, and that, as for the Hour, there is no doubt concerning it. When (the people of the city) disputed of their case among themselves, they said: Build over them a building; their Lord knoweth best concerning them. Those who won their point said: We verily shall build a place of worship over them.

verses.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَـٰثَةٌ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًۢا بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ وَيَقُولُونَ سَبْعَةٌ وَثَامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ ۚ قُل رَّبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِم مَّا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ ۗ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيهِمْ إِلَّا مِرَآءً ظَـٰهِرًا وَلَا تَسْتَفْتِ فِيهِم مِّنْهُمْ أَحَدًا
verses.en: They [i.e., people] will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog. Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord is most knowing of their number. None knows them except a few. So do not argue about them except with an obvious argument and do not inquire about them among [the speculators] from anyone."
verses.tr: sayaqūlūna thalāthahun rrābiʿuhum kalbuhum wayaqūlūna khamsahun sādisuhum kalbuhum rajmanā bi-l-ghaybi ۖ wayaqūlūna sabʿahun wathāminuhum kalbuhum ۚ qul rrabbā ʾaʿlamu biʿiddatihim mmā yaʿlamuhum ʾillā qalīlun ۗ falā tumāri fīhim ʾillā mirāʾan ẓāhiran walā tastafti fīhim mminhum ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: [Some] say, ‘The sleepers were three, and their dog made four,’ others say, ‘They were five, and the dog made six’- guessing in the dark- and some say, ‘They were seven, and their dog made eight.’ Say [Prophet], ‘My Lord knows best how many they were.’ Only a few have real knowledge about them, so do not argue, but stick to what is clear, and do not ask any of these people about them;
verses.pickthall: (Some) will say: They were three, their dog the fourth, and (some) say: Five, their dog the sixth, guessing at random; and (some) say: Seven, and their dog the eighth. Say (O Muhammad): My Lord is Best Aware of their number. None knoweth them save a few. So contend not concerning them except with an outward contending, and ask not any of them to pronounce concerning them.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَا۟ىْءٍ إِنِّى فَاعِلٌ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا
verses.en: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow,"
verses.tr: walā taqūlanna lishāʾin ʾinnā fāʿilun dhālika ghadan
verses.abdelhaleem: do not say of anything, ‘I will do that tomorrow,’
verses.pickthall: And say not of anything: Lo! I shall do that tomorrow,

verses.ar: إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّى لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَـٰذَا رَشَدًا
verses.en: Except [when adding], "If Allāh wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."
verses.tr: ʾillā ʾan yashāʾa Allāh ۚ wādhkur rrabbaka ʾidhā nasīta waqul ʿasā ʾan yahdiyani rabbā liʾaqraba min hādhā rashadan
verses.abdelhaleem: without adding, ‘God willing,’ and, whenever you forget, remember your Lord and say, ‘May my Lord guide me closer to what is right.’
verses.pickthall: Except if Allah will. And remember thy Lord when thou forgettest, and say: It may be that my Lord guideth me unto a nearer way of truth than this.

verses.ar: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًا
verses.en: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.
verses.tr: walabithūā fā kahfihim thalātha māʾahin sinīna wāzdādūā tisʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: [Some say], ‘The sleepers stayed in their cave for three hundred years,’ some added nine more.
verses.pickthall: And (it is said) they tarried in their Cave three hundred years and add nine.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوا۟ ۖ لَهُۥ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ أَبْصِرْ بِهِۦ وَأَسْمِعْ ۚ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِى حُكْمِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.en: Say, "Allāh is most knowing of how long they remained. He has [knowledge of] the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. How Seeing is He and how Hearing! They have not besides Him any protector, and He shares not His legislation with anyone."
verses.tr: quli Allāh ʾaʿlamu bimā labithūā ۖ lahu ghaybu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ ʾabṣir bihi wa-asmiʿ ۚ mā lahum mmin dūnihi min walāin walā yushriku fā ḥukmihi ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘God knows best how long they stayed.’ His is the knowledge of all that is hidden in the heavens and earth- How well He sees! How well He hears!- and they have no one to protect them other than Him; He does not allow anyone to share His rule.
verses.pickthall: Say: Allah is Best Aware how long they tarried. His is the Invisible of the heavens and the earth. How clear of sight is He and keen of hearing! They have no protecting friend beside Him, and He maketh none to share in His government.

verses.ar: وَٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن كِتَابِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَـٰتِهِۦ وَلَن تَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
verses.en: And recite, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no changer of His words, and never will you find in other than Him a refuge.
verses.tr: wātlu mā ʾūḥāa ʾilayka min kitābi rabbika ۖ lā mubaddila likalimātihi walan tajida min dūnihi multaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], follow what has been revealed to you of your Lord’s Scripture: there is no changing His words, nor can you find any refuge except with Him.
verses.pickthall: And recite that which hath been revealed unto thee of the Scripture of thy Lord. There is none who can change His words, and thou wilt find no refuge beside Him.

verses.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ ۖ وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا تُطِعْ مَنْ أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُۥ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُۥ فُرُطًا
verses.en: And keep yourself patient [by being] with those who call upon their Lord in the morning and the evening, seeking His face [i.e., acceptance]. And let not your eyes pass beyond them, desiring adornments of the worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire and whose affair is ever [in] neglect.
verses.tr: wāṣbir nafsaka maʿa adh-dhīna yadʿūna rabbahum bi-l-ghadawāhi wa-l-ʿashāi yurīdūna wajhahu ۖ walā taʿdu ʿaynāka ʿanhum turīdu zīnaha al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۖ walā tuṭiʿ man ʾaghfalnā qalbahu ʿan dhikrinā wāttabaʿa hawāhu wakāna ʾamruhu furuṭan
verses.abdelhaleem: Content yourself with those who pray to their Lord morning and evening, seeking His approval, and do not let your eyes turn away from them out of desire for the attractions of this worldly life: do not yield to those whose hearts We have made heedless of Our Quran, those who follow their own low desires, those whose ways are unbridled.
verses.pickthall: Restrain thyself along with those who cry unto their Lord at morn and evening, seeking His Countenance; and let not thine eyes overlook them, desiring the pomp of the life of the world; and obey not him whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance, who followeth his own lust and whose case hath been abandoned.

verses.ar: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيُؤْمِن وَمَن شَآءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ نَارًا أَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا ۚ وَإِن يَسْتَغِيثُوا۟ يُغَاثُوا۟ بِمَآءٍ كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَشْوِى ٱلْوُجُوهَ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلشَّرَابُ وَسَآءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا
verses.en: And say, "The truth is from your Lord, so whoever wills - let him believe; and whoever wills - let him disbelieve." Indeed, We have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire whose walls will surround them. And if they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like murky oil, which scalds [their] faces. Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place.
verses.tr: waquli al-ḥaqqu min rrabbikum ۖ faman shāʾa falyuʾmin waman shāʾa falyakfur ۚ ʾinnā ʾaʿtadnā lilẓẓālimīna nāran ʾaḥāṭa bihim surādiquhā ۚ wa-in yastaghīthūā yughāthūā bimāʾin ka-l-muhli yashwā al-wujūha ۚ biʾsa ash-sharābu wasāʾat murtafaqan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Now the truth has come from your Lord: let those who wish to believe in it do so, and let those who wish to reject it do so.’ We have prepared a Fire for the wrongdoers that will envelop them from all sides. If they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like molten metal, scalding their faces. What a terrible drink! What a painful resting place!
verses.pickthall: Say: (It is) the truth from the Lord of you (all). Then whosoever will, let him believe, and whosoever will, let him disbelieve. Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers Fire. Its tent encloseth them. If they ask for showers, they will be showered with water like to molten lead which burneth the faces. Calamitous the drink and ill the resting-place!

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا
verses.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of any who did well in deeds.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ʾinnā lā nuḍīʿu ʾajra man ʾaḥsana ʿamalan
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who believe and do good deeds- We do not let the reward of anyone who does a good deed go to waste-
verses.pickthall: Lo! as for those who believe and do good works - Lo! We suffer not the reward of one whose work is goodly to be lost.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمُ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِّن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا
verses.en: Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika lahum jannātu ʿadnin tajrā min taḥtihimu al-ʾanhāru yuḥallawna fīhā min ʾasāwira min dhahabin wayalbasūna thiyāban khuḍran mmin sundusin wa-istabraqin mmuttakīna fīhā ʿalā al-ʾarāʾiki ۚ niʿma ath-thawābu waḥasunat murtafaqan
verses.abdelhaleem: they will have Gardens of lasting bliss graced with flowing streams. There they will be adorned with bracelets of gold. There they will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade. There they will be comfortably seated on soft chairs. What a blessed reward! What a pleasant resting place!
verses.pickthall: As for such, theirs will be Gardens of Eden, wherein rivers flow beneath them; therein they will be given armlets of gold and will wear green robes of finest silk and gold embroidery, reclining upon throne therein. Blest the reward, and fair the resting-place!

verses.ar: ۞ وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَعْنَـٰبٍ وَحَفَفْنَـٰهُمَا بِنَخْلٍ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًا
verses.en: And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them [fields of] crops.
verses.tr: ۞ wāḍrib lahum mmathalan rrajulayni jaʿalnā liʾaḥadihimā jannatayni min ʾaʿnābin waḥafafnāhumā binakhlin wajaʿalnā baynahumā zarʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: Tell them the parable of two men: for one of them We made two gardens of grape vines, surrounded them with date palms, and put corn fields in between;
verses.pickthall: Coin for them a similitude: Two men, unto one of whom We had assigned two gardens of grapes, and We had surrounded both with date-palms and had put between them tillage.

verses.ar: كِلْتَا ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ ءَاتَتْ أُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِم مِّنْهُ شَيْـًٔا ۚ وَفَجَّرْنَا خِلَـٰلَهُمَا نَهَرًا
verses.en: Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river.
verses.tr: kiltā al-jannatayni ātat ʾukulahā walam taẓlim mminhu shayā ۚ wafajjarnā khilālahumā naharan
verses.abdelhaleem: both gardens yielded fruit and did not fail in any way; We made a stream flow through them,
verses.pickthall: Each of the gardens gave its fruit and withheld naught thereof. And We caused a river to gush forth therein.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ لَهُۥ ثَمَرٌ فَقَالَ لِصَـٰحِبِهِۦ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَنَا۠ أَكْثَرُ مِنكَ مَالًا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرًا
verses.en: And he had fruit, so he said to his companion while he was conversing with him, "I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in [numbers of] men."
verses.tr: wakāna lahu thamarun faqāla liṣāḥibihi wahuwa yuḥāwiruhu ʾanā ʾaktharu minka mālan wa-aʿazzu nafaran
verses.abdelhaleem: and so he had abundant fruit. One day, while talking to his friend, he said, ‘I have more wealth and a larger following than you.’
verses.pickthall: And he had fruit. And he said unto his comrade, when he spake with him: I am more than thee in wealth, and stronger in respect of men.

verses.ar: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ قَالَ مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا
verses.en: And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself. He said, "I do not think that this will perish - ever.
verses.tr: wadakhala jannatahu wahuwa ẓālimun llinafsihi qāla mā ʾaẓunnu ʾan tabīda hādhihi ʾabadan
verses.abdelhaleem: He went into his garden and wronged himself by saying, ‘I do not think this will ever perish,
verses.pickthall: And he went into his garden, while he (thus) wronged himself. He said: I think not that all this will ever perish.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّدِدتُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا مُنقَلَبًا
verses.en: And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return."
verses.tr: wamā ʾaẓunnu as-sāʿaha qāʾimahan walaʾin rrudidttu ʾilā rabbā laʾajidanna khayran mminhā munqalaban
verses.abdelhaleem: or that the Last Hour will ever come- even if I were to be taken back to my Lord, I would certainly find something even better there.’
verses.pickthall: I think not that the Hour will ever come, and if indeed I am brought back unto my Lord I surely shall find better than this as a resort.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُۥ صَاحِبُهُۥ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَكَفَرْتَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰكَ رَجُلًا
verses.en: His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, "Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you [as] a man?
verses.tr: qāla lahu ṣāḥibuhu wahuwa yuḥāwiruhu ʾakafarta bi-adh-dhā khalaqaka min turābin thumma min nnuṭfahin thumma sawwāka rajulan
verses.abdelhaleem: His companion retorted, ‘Have you no faith in Him who created you from dust, from a small drop of fluid, then shaped you into a man?
verses.pickthall: His comrade, when he (thus) spake with him, exclaimed: Disbelievest thou in Him Who created thee of dust, then of a drop (of seed), and then fashioned thee a man?

verses.ar: لَّـٰكِنَّا۠ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّىٓ أَحَدًا
verses.en: But as for me, He is Allāh, my Lord, and I do not associate with my Lord anyone.
verses.tr: llākinnā huwa Allāh rabbā walā ʾushriku birabbā ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: But, for me, He is God, my Lord, and I will never set up any partner with Him.
verses.pickthall: But He is Allah, my Lord, and I ascribe unto my Lord no partner.

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ إِن تَرَنِ أَنَا۠ أَقَلَّ مِنكَ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
verses.en: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allāh willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allāh'? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children,
verses.tr: walawlā ʾidh dakhalta jannataka qulta mā shāʾa Allāh lā quwwaha ʾillā billāh ۚ ʾin tarani ʾanā ʾaqalla minka mālan wawaladan
verses.abdelhaleem: If only, when you entered your garden, you had said, “This is God’s will. There is no power not [given] by God.” Although you see I have less wealth and offspring than you,
verses.pickthall: If only, when thou enteredst thy garden, thou hadst said: That which Allah willeth (will come to pass)! There is no strength save in Allah! Though thou seest me as less than thee in wealth and children,

verses.ar: فَعَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًا مِّن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًا زَلَقًا
verses.en: It may be that my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden and will send upon it a [disastrous] penalty from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground,
verses.tr: faʿasā rabbā ʾan yuʾtiyani khayran mmin jannatika wayursila ʿalayhā ḥusbānan mmina as-samāʾi fatuṣbiḥa ṣaʿīdan zalaqan
verses.abdelhaleem: my Lord may well give me something better than your garden, and send thunderbolts on your garden from the sky, so that it becomes a heap of barren dust;
verses.pickthall: Yet it may be that my Lord will give me better than thy garden, and will send on it a bolt from heaven, and some morning it will be a smooth hillside,

verses.ar: أَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوْرًا فَلَن تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُۥ طَلَبًا
verses.en: Or its water will become sunken [into the earth], so you would never be able to seek it."
verses.tr: ʾaw yuṣbiḥa māʾuhā ghawran falan tastaṭīʿa lahu ṭalaban
verses.abdelhaleem: or its water may sink so deep into the ground that you will never be able to reach it again.’
verses.pickthall: Or some morning the water thereof will be lost in the earth so that thou canst not make search for it.

verses.ar: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِۦ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّىٓ أَحَدًا
verses.en: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone."
verses.tr: wa-uḥīṭa bithamarihi fa-aṣbaḥa yuqallibu kaffayhi ʿalā mā ʾanfaqa fīhā wahāa khāwiyahun ʿalā ʿurūshihā wayaqūlu yālaytanā lam ʾushrik birabbā ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: And so it was: his fruit was completely destroyed, and there he was, wringing his hands over what he had invested in it, as it drooped on its trellises, and saying, ‘I wish I had not set up any partner to my Lord.’
verses.pickthall: And his fruit was beset (with destruction). Then began he to wring his hands for all that he had spent upon it, when (now) it was all ruined on its trellises, and to say: Would that I had ascribed no partner to my Lord!

verses.ar: وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُۥ فِئَةٌ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا
verses.en: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor could he defend himself.
verses.tr: walam takun llahu fiʾahun yanṣurūnahu min dūni Allāh wamā kāna muntaṣiran
verses.abdelhaleem: He had no forces to help him other than God- he could not even help himself.
verses.pickthall: And he had no troop of men to help him as against Allah, nor could he save himself.

verses.ar: هُنَالِكَ ٱلْوَلَـٰيَةُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًا
verses.en: There the authority is [completely] for Allāh, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.
verses.tr: hunālika al-walāyahu lillāh al-ḥaqqi ۚ huwa khayrun thawāban wakhayrun ʿuqban
verses.abdelhaleem: In that situation, the only protection is that of God, the True God: He gives the best rewards and the best outcome.
verses.pickthall: In this case is protection only from Allah, the True, He is Best for reward, and best for consequence.

verses.ar: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحُ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّقْتَدِرًا
verses.en: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allāh is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.
verses.tr: wāḍrib lahum mmathala al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā kamāʾin ʾanzalnāhu mina as-samāʾi fākhtalaṭa bihi nabātu al-ʾarḍi fa-aṣbaḥa hashīman tadhrūhu ar-riyāḥu ۗ wakāna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin mmuqtadiran
verses.abdelhaleem: Tell them, too, what the life of this world is like: We send water down from the skies and the earth’s vegetation absorbs it, but soon the plants turn to dry stubble scattered about by the wind: God has power over everything.
verses.pickthall: And coin for them the similitude of the life of the world as water which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingleth with it and then becometh dry twigs that the winds scatter. Allah is able to do all things.

verses.ar: ٱلْمَالُ وَٱلْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَٱلْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا
verses.en: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.
verses.tr: al-mālu wa-l-banūna zīnahu al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۖ wa-l-bāqiyātu aṣ-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun ʾamalan
verses.abdelhaleem: Wealth and children are the attractions of this worldly life, but lasting good works have a better reward with your Lord and give better grounds for hope.
verses.pickthall: Wealth and children are an ornament of the life of the world. But the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better in respect of hope.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ ٱلْجِبَالَ وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ بَارِزَةً وَحَشَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًا
verses.en: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth exposed, and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone.
verses.tr: wayawma nusayyiru al-jibāla watarā al-ʾarḍa bārizahan waḥasharnāhum falam nughādir minhum ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: One day We shall make the mountains move, and you will see the earth as an open plain. We shall gather all people together, leaving no one.
verses.pickthall: And (bethink you of) the Day when we remove the hills and ye see the earth emerging, and We gather them together so as to leave not one of them behind.

verses.ar: وَعُرِضُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفًّا لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۭ ۚ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَلَّن نَّجْعَلَ لَكُم مَّوْعِدًا
verses.en: And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, [and He will say], "You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment."
verses.tr: waʿuriḍūā ʿalā rabbika ṣaffan llaqad jiʾtumūnā kamā khalaqnākum ʾawwala marrahin ۚ bal zaʿamtum ʾallan nnajʿala lakum mmawʿidan
verses.abdelhaleem: They will be lined up before your Lord: ‘Now you have come to Us as We first created you, although you claimed We had not made any such appointment for you.’
verses.pickthall: And they are set before thy Lord in ranks (and it is said unto them): Now verily have ye come unto Us as We created you at the first. But ye thought that We had set no tryst for you.

verses.ar: وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ فَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَـٰوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَـٰذَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّآ أَحْصَىٰهَا ۚ وَوَجَدُوا۟ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ حَاضِرًا ۗ وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًا
verses.en: And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open], and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, "Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?" And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one.
verses.tr: wawuḍiʿa al-kitābu fatarā al-mujrimīna mushfiqīna mimmā fīhi wayaqūlūna yāwaylatanā māli hādhā al-kitābi lā yughādiru ṣaghīrahan walā kabīrahan ʾillā ʾaḥṣāhā ۚ wawajadūā mā ʿamilūā ḥāḍiran ۗ walā yaẓlimu rabbuka ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: The record of their deeds will be laid open and you will see the guilty, dismayed at what they contain, saying, ‘Woe to us! What a record this is! It does not leave any deed, small or large, unaccounted for!’ They will find everything they ever did laid in front of them: your Lord will not be unjust to anyone.
verses.pickthall: And the Book is placed, and thou seest the guilty fearful of that which is therein, and they say: What kind of a Book is this that leaveth not a small thing nor a great thing but hath counted it! And they find all that they did confronting them, and thy Lord wrongeth no-one.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۗ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُۥ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِى وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۢ ۚ بِئْسَ لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بَدَلًا
verses.en: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from [i.e., disobeyed] the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange.
verses.tr: wa-idh qulnā lilmalāʾikahi āsjudūā lādama fasajadūā ʾillā ʾiblīsa kāna mina al-jinni fafasaqa ʿan ʾamri rabbihi ۗ ʾafatattakhidhūnahu wadhurriyyatahu ʾawliyāʾa min dūnā wahum lakum ʿaduwwun ۚ biʾsa lilẓẓālimīna badalan
verses.abdelhaleem: We said to the angels, ‘Bow down before Adam,’ and they all bowed down, but not Iblis: he was one of the jinn and he disobeyed his Lord’s command. Are you [people] going to take him and his offspring as your masters instead of Me, even though they are your enemies? What a bad bargain for the evildoers!
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, and they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He was of the jinn, so he rebelled against his Lord's command. Will ye choose him and his seed for your protecting friends instead of Me, when they are an enemy unto you? Calamitous is the exchange for evil-doers.

verses.ar: ۞ مَّآ أَشْهَدتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ ٱلْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًا
verses.en: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants.
verses.tr: ۞ mmā ʾashhadttuhum khalqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi walā khalqa ʾanfusihim wamā kuntu muttakhidha al-muḍillīna ʿaḍudan
verses.abdelhaleem: I did not make them witnesses to the creation of the heavens and earth, nor to their own creation; I do not take as My supporters those who lead others astray.
verses.pickthall: I made them not to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor their own creation; nor choose I misleaders for (My) helpers.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوا۟ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّوْبِقًا
verses.en: And [warn of] the Day when He will say, "Call My 'partners' whom you claimed," and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them [a valley of] destruction.
verses.tr: wayawma yaqūlu nādūā shurakāa adh-dhīna zaʿamtum fadaʿawhum falam yastajībūā lahum wajaʿalnā baynahum mmawbiqan
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day God will say, ‘Call on those you claimed were My partners,’ they will call them but they will not answer; We shall set a deadly gulf between them.
verses.pickthall: And (be mindful of) the Day when He will say: Call those partners of Mine whom ye pretended. Then they will cry unto them, but they will not hear their prayer, and We shall set a gulf of doom between them.

verses.ar: وَرَءَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا
verses.en: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere.
verses.tr: waraā al-mujrimūna an-nāra faẓannūā ʾannahum mmuwāqiʿūhā walam yajidūā ʿanhā maṣrifan
verses.abdelhaleem: The evildoers will see the Fire and they will realize that they are about to fall into it: they will find no escape from it.
verses.pickthall: And the guilty behold the Fire and know that they are about to fall therein, and they find no way of escape thence.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَكْثَرَ شَىْءٍ جَدَلًا
verses.en: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur’ān for the people from every [kind of] example; but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.
verses.tr: walaqad ṣarrafnā fā hādhā al-qurāni lilnnāsi min kulli mathalin ۚ wakāna al-ʾinsānu ʾakthara shāʾin jadalan
verses.abdelhaleem: In this Quran We have presented every kind of description for people but man is more contentious than any other creature.
verses.pickthall: And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all manner of similitudes, but man is more than anything contentious.

verses.ar: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ قُبُلًا
verses.en: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples or that the punishment should come [directly] before them.
verses.tr: wamā manaʿa an-nāsa ʾan yuʾminūā ʾidh jāʾahumu al-hudā wayastaghfirūā rabbahum ʾillā ʾan taʾtiyahum sunnahu al-ʾawwalīna ʾaw yaʾtiyahumu al-ʿadhābu qubulan
verses.abdelhaleem: Now that guidance has come to them, what stops these people believing and asking forgiveness from their Lord before the fate of earlier peoples annihilates them or their torment confronts them?
verses.pickthall: And naught hindereth mankind from believing when the guidance cometh unto them, and from asking forgiveness of their Lord unless (it be that they wish) that the judgment of the men of old should come upon them or (that) they should be confronted with the Doom.

verses.ar: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۚ وَيُجَـٰدِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِى وَمَآ أُنذِرُوا۟ هُزُوًا
verses.en: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule.
verses.tr: wamā nursilu al-mursalīna ʾillā mubashirīna wamundhirīna ۚ wayujādilu adh-dhīna kafarūā bi-l-bāṭili liyudḥiḍūā bihi al-ḥaqqa ۖ wāttakhadhūā āyātā wamā ʾundhirūā huzuwan
verses.abdelhaleem: We only send messengers to bring good news and to deliver warning, yet the disbelievers seek to refute the truth with false arguments and make fun of My messages and warnings.
verses.pickthall: We send not the messengers save as bearers of good news and warners. Those who disbelieve contend with falsehood in order to refute the Truth thereby. And they take Our revelations and that wherewith they are threatened as a jest.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ ۚ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا ۖ وَإِن تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهْتَدُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًا
verses.en: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.
verses.tr: waman ʾaẓlamu mimman dhukkira bāyāti rabbihi fa-aʿraḍa ʿanhā wanasāa mā qaddamat yadāhu ۚ ʾinnā jaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim ʾakinnahan ʾan yafqahūhu wafā ādhānihim waqran ۖ wa-in tadʿuhum ʾilā al-hudā falan yahtadūā ʾidhan ʾabadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Who could be more wrong than the person who is reminded of his Lord’s messages and turns his back on them, ignoring what his hands are storing up for him [in the Hereafter]? We have put covers over their hearts, so they cannot understand the Quran, and We put heaviness in their ears: although you call them to guidance [Prophet] they will never accept it.
verses.pickthall: And who doth greater wrong than he who hath been reminded of the revelations of his Lord, yet turneth away from them and forgetteth what his hands send forward (to the Judgment)? Lo! on their hearts We have placed coverings so that they understand not, and in their ears a deafness. And though thou call them to the guidance, in that case they can never be led aright.

verses.ar: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ۖ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوْعِدٌ لَّن يَجِدُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَوْئِلًا
verses.en: And your Lord is the Forgiving, the possessor of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.
verses.tr: warabbuka al-ghafūru dhū ar-raḥmahi ۖ law yuākhidhuhum bimā kasabūā laʿajjala lahumu al-ʿadhāba ۚ bal llahum mmawʿidun llan yajidūā min dūnihi mawʾilan
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord is the Most Forgiving, and full of mercy: if He took them to task for the wrongs they have done, He would hasten their punishment on. They have an appointed time from which they will have no escape,
verses.pickthall: Thy Lord is the Forgiver, Full of Mercy. If He took them to task (now) for what they earn, He would hasten on the doom for them; but theirs is an appointed term from which they will find no escape.

verses.ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا۟ وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِم مَّوْعِدًا
verses.en: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.
verses.tr: watilka al-qurā ʾahlaknāhum lammā ẓalamūā wajaʿalnā limahlikihim mmawʿidan
verses.abdelhaleem: [just like] the former communities We destroyed for doing wrong: We set an appointed time for their destruction.
verses.pickthall: And (all) those townships! We destroyed them when they did wrong, and We appointed a fixed time for their destruction.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِىَ حُقُبًا
verses.en: And [mention] when Moses said to his boy [i.e., servant], "I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period."
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla mūsā lifatāhu lā ʾabraḥu ḥattā ʾablugha majmaʿa al-baḥrayni ʾaw ʾamḍāa ḥuquban
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said to his servant, ‘I will not rest until I reach the place where the two seas meet, even if it takes me years!’
verses.pickthall: And when Moses said unto his servant: I will not give up until I reach the point where the two rivers meet, though I march on for ages.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا
verses.en: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.
verses.tr: falammā balaghā majmaʿa baynihimā nasiyā ḥūtahumā fāttakhadha sabīlahu fā al-baḥri saraban
verses.abdelhaleem: but when they reached the place where the two seas meet, they had forgotten all about their fish, which made its way into the sea and swam away.
verses.pickthall: And when they reached the point where the two met, they forgot their fish, and it took its way into the waters, being free.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَـٰذَا نَصَبًا
verses.en: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."
verses.tr: falammā jāwazā qāla lifatāhu ātinā ghadāʾanā laqad laqīnā min safarinā hādhā naṣaban
verses.abdelhaleem: They journeyed on, and then Moses said to his servant, ‘Give us our lunch! This journey of ours is very tiring,’
verses.pickthall: And when they had gone further, he said unto his servant: Bring us our breakfast. Verily we have found fatigue in this our journey.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَآ إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّى نَسِيتُ ٱلْحُوتَ وَمَآ أَنسَىٰنِيهُ إِلَّا ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُۥ ۚ وَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا
verses.en: He said, "Did you see when we retired to the rock? Indeed, I forgot [there] the fish. And none made me forget it except Satan - that I should mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly."
verses.tr: qāla ʾaraʾayta ʾidh ʾawaynā ʾilā aṣ-ṣakhrahi fa-innā nasītu al-ḥūta wamā ʾansānīhu ʾillā ash-shayṭānu ʾan ʾadhkurahu ۚ wāttakhadha sabīlahu fā al-baḥri ʿajaban
verses.abdelhaleem: and [the servant] said, ‘Remember when we were resting by the rock? I forgot the fish- Satan made me forget to pay attention to it- and it [must have] made its way into the sea.’ ‘How strange!’
verses.pickthall: He said: Didst thou see, when we took refuge on the rock, and I forgot the fish - and none but Satan caused me to forget to mention it - it took its way into the waters by a marvel.

verses.ar: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ فَٱرْتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا
verses.en: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.
verses.tr: qāla dhālika mā kunnā nabghi ۚ fārtaddā ʿalā āthārihimā qaṣaṣan
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘Then that was the place we were looking for.’ So the two turned back, retraced their footsteps,
verses.pickthall: He said: This is that which we have been seeking. So they retraced their steps again.

verses.ar: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًا
verses.en: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.
verses.tr: fawajadā ʿabdan mmin ʿibādinā ātaynāhu raḥmahan mmin ʿindinā waʿallamnāhu min lladunnā ʿilman
verses.abdelhaleem: and found one of Our servants- a man to whom We had granted Our mercy and whom We had given knowledge of Our own.
verses.pickthall: Then found they one of Our slaves, unto whom We had given mercy from Us, and had taught him knowledge from Our presence.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًا
verses.en: Moses said to him, "May I follow you on [the condition] that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement?"
verses.tr: qāla lahu mūsā hal ʾattabiʿuka ʿalā ʾan tuʿallimani mimmā ʿullimta rushdan
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said to him, ‘May I follow you so that you can teach me some of the right guidance you have been taught?’
verses.pickthall: Moses said unto him: May I follow thee, to the end that thou mayst teach me right conduct of that which thou hast been taught?

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا
verses.en: He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿāa ṣabran
verses.abdelhaleem: The man said, ‘You will not be able to bear with me patiently.
verses.pickthall: He said: Lo! thou canst not bear with me.

verses.ar: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ خُبْرًا
verses.en: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?"
verses.tr: wakayfa taṣbiru ʿalā mā lam tuḥiṭ bihi khubran
verses.abdelhaleem: How could you be patient in matters beyond your knowledge?’
verses.pickthall: How canst thou bear with that whereof thou canst not compass any knowledge?

verses.ar: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرًا وَلَآ أَعْصِى لَكَ أَمْرًا
verses.en: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allāh wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."
verses.tr: qāla satajidunā ʾin shāʾa Allāh ṣābiran walā ʾaʿṣā laka ʾamran
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘God willing, you will find me patient. I will not disobey you in any way.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Allah willing, thou shalt find me patient and I shall not in aught gainsay thee.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَإِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَنِى فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِى عَن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا
verses.en: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention [i.e., explanation]."
verses.tr: qāla fa-ini āttabaʿtanā falā taslnā ʿan shāʾin ḥattā ʾuḥditha laka minhu dhikran
verses.abdelhaleem: The man said, ‘If you follow me then, do not query anything I do before I mention it to you myself.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Well, if thou go with me, ask me not concerning aught till I myself make mention of it unto thee.

verses.ar: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا إِمْرًا
verses.en: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."
verses.tr: fānṭalaqā ḥattā ʾidhā rakibā fā as-safīnahi kharaqahā ۖ qāla ʾakharaqtahā litughriqa ʾahlahā laqad jiʾta shayā ʾimran
verses.abdelhaleem: They travelled on. Later, when they got into a boat, and the man made a hole in it, Moses said, ‘How could you make a hole in it? Do you want to drown its passengers? What a strange thing to do!’
verses.pickthall: So they twain set out till, when they were in the ship, he made a hole therein. (Moses) said: Hast thou made a hole therein to drown the folk thereof? Thou verily hast done a dreadful thing.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا
verses.en: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
verses.tr: qāla ʾalam ʾaqul ʾinnaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿāa ṣabran
verses.abdelhaleem: He replied, ‘Did I not tell you that you would never be able to bear with me patiently?’
verses.pickthall: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?

verses.ar: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِى مِنْ أَمْرِى عُسْرًا
verses.en: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not overwhelm me in my matter with difficulty."
verses.tr: qāla lā tuākhidhnā bimā nasītu walā turhiqnā min ʾamrā ʿusran
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘Forgive me for forgetting. Do not make it too hard for me to follow you.’
verses.pickthall: (Moses) said: Be not wroth with me that I forgot, and be not hard upon me for my fault.

verses.ar: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَـٰمًا فَقَتَلَهُۥ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةًۢ بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ لَّقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا نُّكْرًا
verses.en: So they set out, until when they met a boy, he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."
verses.tr: fānṭalaqā ḥattā ʾidhā laqiyā ghulāman faqatalahu qāla ʾaqatalta nafsan zakiyyahan bighayri nafsin llaqad jiʾta shayā nnukran
verses.abdelhaleem: And so they travelled on. Then, when they met a young boy and the man killed him, Moses said, ‘How could you kill an innocent person? He has not killed anyone! What a terrible thing to do!’
verses.pickthall: So they twain journeyed on till, when they met a lad, he slew him. (Moses) said: What! Hast thou slain an innocent soul who hath slain no man? Verily thou hast done a horrid thing.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا
verses.en: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
verses.tr: ۞ qāla ʾalam ʾaqul llaka ʾinnaka lan tastaṭīʿa maʿāa ṣabran
verses.abdelhaleem: He replied, ‘Did I not tell you that you would never be able to bear with me patiently?’
verses.pickthall: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?

verses.ar: قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍۭ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَـٰحِبْنِى ۖ قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّى عُذْرًا
verses.en: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse."
verses.tr: qāla ʾin saʾaltuka ʿan shāʾin baʿdahā falā tuṣāḥibnā ۖ qad balaghta min lladunnā ʿudhran
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘From now on, if I query anything you do, banish me from your company- you have put up with enough from me.’
verses.pickthall: (Moses) said: If I ask thee after this concerning aught, keep not company with me. Thou hast received an excuse from me.

verses.ar: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ ٱسْتَطْعَمَآ أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا۟ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا
verses.en: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so he [i.e., al-Khiḍr] restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."
verses.tr: fānṭalaqā ḥattā ʾidhā ʾatayā ʾahla qaryahin āstaṭʿamā ʾahlahā fa-abawā ʾan yuḍayyifūhumā fawajadā fīhā jidāran yurīdu ʾan yanqaḍḍa fa-aqāmahu ۖ qāla law shiʾta lattakhadhta ʿalayhi ʾajran
verses.abdelhaleem: And so they travelled on. Then, when they came to a town and asked the inhabitants for food but were refused hospitality, they saw a wall there that was on the point of falling down and the man repaired it. Moses said, ‘But if you had wished you could have taken payment for doing that.’
verses.pickthall: So they twain journeyed on till, when they came unto the folk of a certain township, they asked its folk for food, but they refused to make them guests. And they found therein a wall upon the point of falling into ruin, and he repaired it. (Moses) said: If thou hadst wished, thou couldst have taken payment for it.

verses.ar: قَالَ هَـٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنِكَ ۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا
verses.en: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.
verses.tr: qāla hādhā firāqu baynā wabaynika ۚ saʾunabbiʾuka bitaʾwīli mā lam tastaṭiʿ ʿʿalayhi ṣabran
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘This is where you and I part company. I will tell you the meaning of the things you could not bear with patiently:
verses.pickthall: He said: This is the parting between thee and me! I will announce unto thee the interpretation of that thou couldst not bear with patience.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَـٰكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا
verses.en: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
verses.tr: ʾammā as-safīnahu fakānat limasākīna yaʿmalūna fā al-baḥri fa-aradttu ʾan ʾaʿībahā wakāna warāʾahum mmalikun yaʾkhudhu kulla safīnahin ghaṣban
verses.abdelhaleem: the boat belonged to some needy people who made their living from the sea and I damaged it because I knew that coming after them was a king who was seizing every [serviceable] boat by force.
verses.pickthall: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working on the river, and I wished to mar it, for there was a king behind them who is taking every ship by force.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْغُلَـٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَـٰنًا وَكُفْرًا
verses.en: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
verses.tr: wa-ammā al-ghulāmu fakāna ʾabawāhu muʾminayni fakhashīnā ʾan yurhiqahumā ṭughyānan wakufran
verses.abdelhaleem: The young boy had parents who were people of faith, and so, fearing he would trouble them through wickedness and disbelief,
verses.pickthall: And as for the lad, his parents were believers and we feared lest he should oppress them by rebellion and disbelief.

verses.ar: فَأَرَدْنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهُ زَكَوٰةً وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًا
verses.en: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.
verses.tr: fa-aradnā ʾan yubdilahumā rabbuhumā khayran mminhu zakawāhan wa-aqraba ruḥman
verses.abdelhaleem: we wished that their Lord should give them another child- purer and more compassionate- in his place.
verses.pickthall: And we intended that their Lord should change him for them for one better in purity and nearer to mercy.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَـٰمَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُۥ كَنزٌ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَـٰلِحًا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَآ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُۥ عَنْ أَمْرِى ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا
verses.en: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
verses.tr: wa-ammā al-jidāru fakāna lighulāmayni yatīmayni fā al-madīnahi wakāna taḥtahu kanzun llahumā wakāna ʾabūhumā ṣāliḥan fa-arāda rabbuka ʾan yablughā ʾashuddahumā wayastakhrijā kanzahumā raḥmahan mmin rrabbika ۚ wamā faʿaltuhu ʿan ʾamrā ۚ dhālika taʾwīlu mā lam tasṭiʿ ʿʿalayhi ṣabran
verses.abdelhaleem: The wall belonged to two young orphans in the town and there was buried treasure beneath it belonging to them. Their father had been a righteous man, so your Lord intended them to reach maturity and then dig up their treasure as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do [these things] of my own accord: these are the explanations for those things you could not bear with patience.’
verses.pickthall: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them, and their father had been righteous, and thy Lord intended that they should come to their full strength and should bring forth their treasure as a mercy from their Lord; and I did it not upon my own command. Such is the interpretation of that wherewith thou couldst not bear.

verses.ar: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ ۖ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا
verses.en: And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."
verses.tr: wayaslūnaka ʿan dhā al-qarnayni ۖ qul saʾatlūā ʿalaykum mminhu dhikran
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], they ask you about Dhu ’l-Qarnayn. Say, ‘I will tell you something about him.’
verses.pickthall: They will ask thee of Dhu'l-Qarneyn. Say: I shall recite unto you a remembrance of him.

verses.ar: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ سَبَبًا
verses.en: Indeed, We established him upon the earth, and We gave him from everything a way [i.e., means].
verses.tr: ʾinnā makkannā lahu fā al-ʾarḍi wataynāhu min kulli shāʾin sababan
verses.abdelhaleem: We established his power in the land, and gave him the means to achieve everything.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We made him strong in the land and gave him unto every thing a road.

verses.ar: فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
verses.en: So he followed a way
verses.tr: fa-atbaʿa sababan
verses.abdelhaleem: He travelled on a certain road;
verses.pickthall: And he followed a road

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِى عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوْمًا ۗ قُلْنَا يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًا
verses.en: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun [i.e., the west], he found it [as if] setting in a body of dark water, and he found near it a people. We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā balagha maghriba ash-shamsi wajadahā taghrubu fā ʿaynin ḥamiʾahin wawajada ʿindahā qawman ۗ qulnā yādhā al-qarnayni ʾimmā ʾan tuʿadhiba wa-immā ʾan tattakhidha fīhim ḥusnan
verses.abdelhaleem: then, when he came to the setting of the sun, he found it [seemed to be] setting into a muddy spring. Nearby he found some people and We said, ‘Dhu ’l-Qarnayn, you may choose [which of them] to punish or show kindness to.’
verses.pickthall: Till, when he reached the setting-place of the sun, he found it setting in a muddy spring, and found a people thereabout. We said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Either punish or show them kindness.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا
verses.en: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
verses.tr: qāla ʾammā man ẓalama fasawfa nuʿadhibuhu thumma yuraddu ʾilā rabbihi fayuʿadhibuhu ʿadhāban nnukran
verses.abdelhaleem: He answered, ‘We shall punish those who have done evil, and when they are returned to their Lord He will punish them [even more] severely,
verses.pickthall: He said: As for him who doeth wrong, we shall punish him, and then he will be brought back unto his Lord, Who will punish him with awful punishment!

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًا
verses.en: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of the best [i.e., Paradise], and we [i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn] will speak to him from our command with ease."
verses.tr: wa-ammā man āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan falahu jazāʾan al-ḥusnā ۖ wasanaqūlu lahu min ʾamrinā yusran
verses.abdelhaleem: while those who believed and did good deeds will have the best of rewards: we shall command them to do what is easy for them.’
verses.pickthall: But as for him who believeth and doeth right, good will be his reward, and We shall speak unto him a mild command.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
verses.en: Then he followed a way
verses.tr: thumma ʾatbaʿa sababan
verses.abdelhaleem: He travelled on;
verses.pickthall: Then he followed a road

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًا
verses.en: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun [i.e., the east], he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.
