verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā balagha maṭliʿa ash-shamsi wajadahā taṭluʿu ʿalā qawmin llam najʿal llahum mmin dūnihā sitran
verses.abdelhaleem: then, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no shelter from it.
verses.pickthall: Till, when he reached the rising-place of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had appointed no shelter therefrom.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًا
verses.en: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
verses.tr: kadhālika waqad ʾaḥaṭnā bimā ladayhi khubran
verses.abdelhaleem: And so it was: We knew all about him.
verses.pickthall: So (it was). And We knew all concerning him.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
verses.en: Then he followed a way.
verses.tr: thumma ʾatbaʿa sababan
verses.abdelhaleem: He travelled on;
verses.pickthall: Then he followed a road

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا
verses.en: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā balagha bayna as-saddayni wajada min dūnihimā qawman llā yakādūna yafqahūna qawlan
verses.abdelhaleem: then, when he reached a place between two mountain barriers, he found beside them a people who could barely understand him.
verses.pickthall: Till, when he came between the two mountains, he found upon their hither side a folk that scarce could understand a saying.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا
verses.en: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
verses.tr: qālūā yādhā al-qarnayni ʾinna yaʾjūja wamaʾjūja mufsidūna fā al-ʾarḍi fahal najʿalu laka kharjan ʿalā ʾan tajʿala baynanā wabaynahum saddan
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Dhu ’l-Qarnayn, Gog and Magog are ruining this land. Will you build a barrier between them and us if we pay you a tribute?’
verses.pickthall: They said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Lo! Gog and Magog are spoiling the land. So may we pay thee tribute on condition that thou set a barrier between us and them?

verses.ar: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verses.en: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam.
verses.tr: qāla mā makkannā fīhi rabbā khayrun fa-aʿīnūnā biquwwahin ʾajʿal baynakum wabaynahum radman
verses.abdelhaleem: He answered, ‘The power my Lord has given me is better than any tribute, but if you lend me your strength, I will put up a fortification between you and them:
verses.pickthall: He said: That wherein my Lord hath established me is better (than your tribute). Do but help me with strength (of men), I will set between you and them a bank.

verses.ar: ءَاتُونِى زُبَرَ ٱلْحَدِيدِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُوا۟ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارًا قَالَ ءَاتُونِىٓ أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا
verses.en: Bring me bars of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
verses.tr: ātūnā zubara al-ḥadīdi ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā sāwā bayna aṣ-ṣadafayni qāla ānfukhūā ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā jaʿalahu nāran qāla ātūnā ʾufrigh ʿalayhi qiṭran
verses.abdelhaleem: bring me lumps of iron!’ and then, when he had filled the gap between the two mountainsides [he said], ‘Work your bellows!’ and then, when he had made it glow like fire, he said, ‘Bring me molten metal to pour over it!’
verses.pickthall: Give me pieces of iron - till, when he had levelled up (the gap) between the cliffs, he said: Blow! - till, when he had made it a fire, he said: Bring me molten copper to pour thereon.

verses.ar: فَمَا ٱسْطَـٰعُوٓا۟ أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًا
verses.en: So they [i.e., Gog and Magog] were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
verses.tr: famā āsṭāʿūā ʾan yaẓharūhu wamā āstaṭāʿūā lahu naqban
verses.abdelhaleem: Their enemies could not scale the barrier, nor could they pierce it,
verses.pickthall: And (Gog and Magog) were not able to surmount, nor could they pierce (it).

verses.ar: قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَ ۖ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى حَقًّا
verses.en: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes [i.e., approaches], He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
verses.tr: qāla hādhā raḥmahun mmin rrabbā ۖ fa-idhā jāʾa waʿdu rabbā jaʿalahu dakkāʾa ۖ wakāna waʿdu rabbā ḥaqqan
verses.abdelhaleem: and he said, ‘This is a mercy from my Lord. But when my Lord’s promise is fulfilled, He will raze this barrier to the ground: my Lord’s promise always comes true.’
verses.pickthall: He said: This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord cometh to pass, He will lay it low, for the promise of my Lord is true.

verses.ar: ۞ وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَمُوجُ فِى بَعْضٍ ۖ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَـٰهُمْ جَمْعًا
verses.en: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
verses.tr: ۞ wataraknā baʿḍahum yawmaʾidhin yamūju fā baʿḍin ۖ wanufikha fā aṣ-ṣūri fajamaʿnāhum jamʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day, We shall let them surge against each other like waves and then the Trumpet will be blown and We shall gather them all together.
verses.pickthall: And on that day we shall let some of them surge against others, and the Trumpet will be blown. Then We shall gather them together in one gathering.

verses.ar: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَرْضًا
verses.en: And We will present Hell that Day to the disbelievers, on display -
verses.tr: waʿaraḍnā jahannama yawmaʾidhin llilkāfirīna ʿarḍan
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall show Hell to the disbelievers,
verses.pickthall: On that day we shall present hell to the disbelievers, plain to view,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكْرِى وَكَانُوا۟ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا
verses.en: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna kānat ʾaʿyunuhum fā ghiṭāʾin ʿan dhikrā wakānūā lā yastaṭīʿūna samʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: those whose eyes were blind to My signs, those who were unable to hear.
verses.pickthall: Those whose eyes were hoodwinked from My reminder, and who could not bear to hear.

verses.ar: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًا
verses.en: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
verses.tr: ʾafaḥasiba adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾan yattakhidhūā ʿibādā min dūnā ʾawliyāʾa ۚ ʾinnā ʾaʿtadnā jahannama lilkāfirīna nuzulan
verses.abdelhaleem: Did they think that they could take My servants as masters instead of Me? We have prepared Hell as the disbelievers’ resting place.
verses.pickthall: Do the disbelievers reckon that they can choose My bondmen as protecting friends beside Me? Lo! We have prepared hell as a welcome for the disbelievers.

verses.ar: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَـٰلًا
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
verses.tr: qul hal nunabbiʾukum bi-l-ʾakhsarīna ʾaʿmālan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Shall we tell you who has the most to lose by their actions,
verses.pickthall: Say: Shall We inform you who will be the greatest losers by their works?

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا
verses.en: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ḍalla saʿyuhum fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā wahum yaḥsabūna ʾannahum yuḥsinūna ṣunʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: whose efforts in this world are misguided, even when they think they are doing good work?
verses.pickthall: Those whose effort goeth astray in the life of the world, and yet they reckon that they do good work.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَزْنًا
verses.en: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any weight [i.e., importance].
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna kafarūā bāyāti rabbihim waliqāʾihi faḥabiṭat ʾaʿmāluhum falā nuqīmu lahum yawma al-qiyāmahi waznan
verses.abdelhaleem: It is those who disbelieve in their Lord’s messages and deny that they will meet Him.’ Their deeds come to nothing: on the Day of Resurrection We shall give them no weight.
verses.pickthall: Those are they who disbelieve in the revelations of their Lord and in the meeting with Him. Therefor their works are vain, and on the Day of Resurrection We assign no weight to them.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا
verses.en: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
verses.tr: dhālika jazāʾuhum jahannamu bimā kafarūā wāttakhadhūā āyātā warusulā huzuwan
verses.abdelhaleem: Their recompense for having disbelieved and made fun of My messages and My messengers will be Hell.
verses.pickthall: That is their reward: hell, because they disbelieved, and made a jest of Our revelations and Our messengers.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا
verses.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti kānat lahum jannātu al-firdawsi nuzulan
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who believe and do good deeds will be given the Gardens of Paradise.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs are the Gardens of Paradise for welcome,

verses.ar: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا
verses.en: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
verses.tr: khālidīna fīhā lā yabghūna ʿanhā ḥiwalan
verses.abdelhaleem: There they will remain, never wishing to leave.
verses.pickthall: Wherein they will abide, with no desire to be removed from thence.

verses.ar: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَـٰتُ رَبِّى وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِۦ مَدَدًا
verses.en: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it in [continual] supplement."
verses.tr: qul llaw kāna al-baḥru midādan llikalimāti rabbā lanafida al-baḥru qabla ʾan tanfada kalimātu rabbā walaw jiʾnā bimithlihi madadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘If the whole ocean were ink for writing the words of my Lord, it would run dry before those words were exhausted’- even if We were to add another ocean to it.
verses.pickthall: Say: Though the sea became ink for the Words of my Lord, verily the sea would be used up before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even though We brought the like thereof to help.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا
verses.en: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
verses.tr: qul ʾinnamā ʾanā basharun mmithlukum yūḥā ʾilāa ʾannamā ʾilāhukum ʾilāhun wāḥidun ۖ faman kāna yarjūā liqāʾa rabbihi falyaʿmal ʿamalan ṣāliḥan walā yushrik biʿibādahi rabbihi ʾaḥadanā
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I am only a human being, like you, to whom it has been revealed that your God is One. Anyone who fears to meet his Lord should do good deeds and give no one a share in the worship due to his Lord.
verses.pickthall: Say: I am only a mortal like you. My Lord inspireth in me that your Allah is only One Allah. And whoever hopeth for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work, and make none sharer of the worship due unto his Lord.

verses.ar: كٓهيعٓصٓ
verses.en: Kāf, Hā, Yā, ʿAyn, Ṣād.
verses.tr: khyʿṣ
verses.abdelhaleem: Kaf Ha Ya 'Ayn Sad
verses.pickthall: Kaf. Ha. Ya. A'in. Sad.

verses.ar: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
verses.en: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
verses.tr: dhikru raḥmati rabbika ʿabdahu zakariyyā
verses.abdelhaleem: This is an account of your Lord’s grace towards His servant, Zachariah,
verses.pickthall: A mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah.

verses.ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا
verses.en: When he called to his Lord a private call [i.e., supplication].
verses.tr: ʾidh nādā rabbahu nidāʾan khafiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: when he called to his Lord secretly, saying,
verses.pickthall: When he cried unto his Lord a cry in secret,

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ʾinnā wahana al-ʿaẓmu minnā wāshtaʿala ar-raʾsu shayban walam ʾakun biduʿāʾika rabbi shaqiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Lord, my bones have weakened and my hair is ashen grey, but never, Lord, have I ever prayed to You in vain:
verses.pickthall: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.

verses.ar: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا
verses.en: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
verses.tr: wa-innā khiftu al-mawālāa min warā wakānati āmraʾatā ʿāqiran fahab lā min lladunka waliyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: I fear [what] my kinsmen [will do] when I am gone, for my wife is barren, so grant me a successor––a gift from You––
verses.pickthall: Lo! I fear my kinsfolk after me, since my wife is barren. Oh, give me from Thy presence a successor

verses.ar: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
verses.en: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
verses.tr: yarithunā wayarithu min āli yaʿqūba ۖ wājʿalhu rabbi raḍiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: to be my heir and the heir of the family of Jacob. Lord, make him well pleasing [to You].’
verses.pickthall: Who shall inherit of me and inherit (also) of the house of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, acceptable (unto Thee).

verses.ar: يَـٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا
verses.en: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
verses.tr: yāzakariyyā ʾinnā nubashiruka bighulāmin āsmuhu yaḥyā lam najʿal llahu min qablu samiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Zachariah, We bring you good news of a son whose name will be John––We have chosen this name for no one before him.’
verses.pickthall: (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him).

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ʾannā yakūnu lā ghulāmun wakānati āmraʾatā ʿāqiran waqad balaghtu mina al-kibari ʿitiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I am old and frail?’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age?

verses.ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًٔا
verses.en: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'"
verses.tr: qāla kadhālika qāla rabbuka huwa ʿalāa hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayā
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘This is what your Lord has said: “It is easy for Me: I created you, though you were nothing before.” ’
verses.pickthall: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
verses.en: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ājʿal llā āyahan ۚ qāla āyatuka ʾallā tukallima an-nāsa thalātha layālin sawiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Give me a sign, Lord.’ He said, ‘Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to anyone for three full [days and] nights.’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Appoint for me some token. He said: Thy token is that thou, with no bodily defect, shalt not speak unto mankind three nights.

verses.ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
verses.en: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allāh] in the morning and afternoon.
verses.tr: fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi mina al-miḥrābi fa-awḥā ʾilayhim ʾan sabbiḥūā bukrahan waʿashiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: He went out of the sanctuary to his people and signalled to them to praise God morning and evening.
verses.pickthall: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.

verses.ar: يَـٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا
verses.en: [Allāh said], "O John, take the Scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
verses.tr: yāyaḥyā khudhi al-kitāba biquwwahin ۖ wataynāhu al-ḥukma ṣabiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: [We said], ‘John, hold on to the Scripture firmly.’ While he was still a boy, We granted him wisdom,
verses.pickthall: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child,

verses.ar: وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةً ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
verses.en: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh
verses.tr: waḥanānan mmin lladunnā wazakawāhan ۖ wakāna taqiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: tenderness from Us, and purity. He was devout,
verses.pickthall: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout,

verses.ar: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
verses.en: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
verses.tr: wabarranā biwālidayhi walam yakun jabbāran ʿaṣiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: kind to his parents, not domineering or rebellious.
verses.pickthall: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious.

verses.ar: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
verses.en: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
verses.tr: wasalāmun ʿalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamūtu wayawma yubʿathu ḥayyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Peace was on him the day he was born, the day he died, and it will be on him the day he is raised to life again.
verses.pickthall: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive!

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
verses.en: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
verses.tr: wādhkur fā al-kitābi maryama ʾidhi āntabadhat min ʾahlihā makānan sharqiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Mention in the Quran the story of Mary. She withdrew from her family to a place to the east
verses.pickthall: And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East,

verses.ar: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
verses.en: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
verses.tr: fāttakhadhat min dūnihim ḥijāban fa-arsalnā ʾilayhā rūḥanā fatamathala lahā basharan sawiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: and secluded herself away; We sent Our Spirit to appear before her in the form of a perfected man.
verses.pickthall: And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man.

verses.ar: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا
verses.en: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allāh."
verses.tr: qālat ʾinnā ʾaʿūdhu bi-ar-raḥmāni minka ʾin kunta taqiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: She said, ‘I seek the Lord of Mercy’s protection against you: if you have any fear of Him [do not approach]!’
verses.pickthall: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَـٰمًا زَكِيًّا
verses.en: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnamā ʾanā rasūlu rabbiki liʾahaba laki ghulāman zakiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: but he said, ‘I am but a Mes-senger from your Lord, [come] to announce to you the gift of a pure son.’
verses.pickthall: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son.

verses.ar: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
verses.en: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
verses.tr: qālat ʾannā yakūnu lā ghulāmun walam yamsasnā basharun walam ʾaku baghiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: She said, ‘How can I have a son when no man has touched me? I have not been unchaste,’
verses.pickthall: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste?

verses.ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا
verses.en: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.'"
verses.tr: qāla kadhāliki qāla rabbuki huwa ʿalāa hayyinun ۖ walinajʿalahu āyahan llilnnāsi waraḥmahan mminnā ۚ wakāna ʾamran mmaqḍiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: and he said, ‘This is what your Lord said: “It is easy for Me- We shall make him a sign to all people, a blessing from Us.”’
verses.pickthall: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained.

verses.ar: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
verses.en: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
verses.tr: ۞ faḥamalathu fāntabadhat bihi makānan qaṣiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: And so it was ordained: she conceived him. She withdrew to a distant place
verses.pickthall: And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place.

verses.ar: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَـٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا
verses.en: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
verses.tr: fa-ajāʾahā al-makhāḍu ʾilā jidhʿi an-nakhlahi qālat yālaytanā mittu qabla hādhā wakuntu nasyan mmansiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: and, when the pains of childbirth drove her to [cling to] the trunk of a palm tree, she exclaimed, ‘I wish I had been dead and forgotten long before all this!’
verses.pickthall: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!

verses.ar: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
verses.en: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
verses.tr: fanādāhā min taḥtihā ʾallā taḥzanā qad jaʿala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: but a voice cried to her from below, ‘Do not worry: your Lord has provided a stream at your feet
verses.pickthall: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee,

verses.ar: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَـٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
verses.en: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
verses.tr: wahuzzā ʾilayki bijidhʿi an-nakhlahi tusāqiṭ ʿalayki ruṭaban janiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: and, if you shake the trunk of the palm tree towards you, it will deliver fresh ripe dates for you,
verses.pickthall: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee.

verses.ar: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا
verses.en: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"
verses.tr: fakulā wāshrabā waqarrā ʿaynan ۖ fa-immā tarayinna mina al-bashari ʾaḥadan faqūlā ʾinnā nadhartu lilrraḥmāni ṣawman falan ʾukallima al-yawma ʾinsiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: so eat, drink, be glad, and say to anyone you may see: “I have vowed to the Lord of Mercy to abstain from conversation, and I will not talk to anyone today.”’
verses.pickthall: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal.

verses.ar: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًٔا فَرِيًّا
verses.en: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
verses.tr: fa-atat bihi qawmahā taḥmiluhu ۖ qālūā yāmaryamu laqad jiʾti shayā fariyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: She went back to her people carrying the child, and they said, ‘Mary! You have done something terrible!
verses.pickthall: Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأُخْتَ هَـٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
verses.en: O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
verses.tr: yāʾukhta hārūna mā kāna ʾabūki āmraʾa sawʾin wamā kānat ʾummuki baghiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Sister of Aaron! Your father was not an evil man; your mother was not unchaste!’
verses.pickthall: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot.

verses.ar: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
verses.en: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
verses.tr: fa-ashārat ʾilayhi ۖ qālūā kayfa nukallimu man kāna fā al-mahdi ṣabiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: She pointed at him. They said, ‘How can we converse with an infant?’
verses.pickthall: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّا
verses.en: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allāh. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnā ʿabdu Allāh ātānāa al-kitāba wajaʿalanā nabiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: [But] he said: ‘I am a servant of God. He has granted me the Scripture; made me a prophet;
verses.pickthall: He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet,

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَـٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
verses.en: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive
verses.tr: wajaʿalanā mubārakan ʾayna mā kuntu wa-awṣānā bi-aṣ-ṣalawāhi wa-az-zakawāhi mā dumtu ḥayyan
verses.abdelhaleem: made me blessed wherever I may be. He commanded me to pray, to give alms as long as I live,
verses.pickthall: And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive,

verses.ar: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
verses.en: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
verses.tr: wabarranā biwālidatā walam yajʿalnā jabbāran shaqiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: to cherish my mother. He did not make me domineering or graceless.
verses.pickthall: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
verses.en: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
verses.tr: wa-as-salāmu ʿalāa yawma wulidttu wayawma ʾamūtu wayawma ʾubʿathu ḥayyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Peace was on me the day I was born, and will be on me the day I die and the day I am raised to life again.’
verses.pickthall: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.en: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
verses.tr: dhālika ʿīsā ābnu maryama ۚ qawla al-ḥaqqi adh-dhā fīhi yamtarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Such was Jesus, son of Mary. [This is] a statement of the Truth about which they are in doubt:
verses.pickthall: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.

verses.ar: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ ۖ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.en: It is not [befitting] for Allāh to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.tr: mā kāna lillāh ʾan yattakhidha min waladin ۖ subḥānahu ۚ ʾidhā qaḍā ʾamran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu
verses.abdelhaleem: it would not befit God to have a child. He is far above that: when He decrees something, He says only, ‘Be,’ and it is.
verses.pickthall: It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.en: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
verses.tr: wa-inna Allāh rabbā warabbukum fāʿbudūhu ۚ hādhā ṣirāṭun mmustaqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘God is my Lord and your Lord, so serve Him: that is a straight path.’
verses.pickthall: And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path.

verses.ar: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
verses.tr: fākhtalafa al-ʾaḥzābu min baynihim ۖ fawaylun llilladhīna kafarūā min mmashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: But factions have differed among themselves. What suffering will come to those who obscure the truth when a dreadful Day arrives!
verses.pickthall: The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day.

verses.ar: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَـٰكِنِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
verses.tr: ʾasmiʿ bihim wa-abṣir yawma yaʾtūnanā ۖ lākini aẓ-ẓālimūna al-yawma fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: How sharp of hearing, how sharp of sight they will be when they come to Us, although now they are clearly off course! Warn them [Muhammad] of the Day of Remorse when the matter will be decided,
verses.pickthall: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.

verses.ar: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
verses.tr: wa-andhirhum yawma al-ḥasrahi ʾidh quḍāa al-ʾamru wahum fā ghaflahin wahum lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: for they are heedless and do not believe.
verses.pickthall: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
verses.tr: ʾinnā naḥnu narithu al-ʾarḍa waman ʿalayhā wa-ā yurjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is We who will inherit the earth and all who are on it: they will all be returned to Us.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
verses.tr: wādhkur fā al-kitābi ʾibrāhīma ۚ ʾinnahu kāna ṣiddīqan nnabiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Abraham. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
verses.pickthall: And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet.

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا
verses.en: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla liʾabīhi yāʾabati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yubṣiru walā yughnā ʿanka shayā
verses.abdelhaleem: He said to his father, ‘Father, why do you worship something that can neither hear nor see nor benefit you in any way?
verses.pickthall: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee?

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا
verses.en: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
verses.tr: yāʾabati ʾinnā qad jāʾanā mina al-ʿilmi mā lam yaʾtika fāttabiʿnā ʾahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Father, knowledge that has not reached you has come to me, so follow me: I will guide you to an even path.
verses.pickthall: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَصِيًّا
verses.en: O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
verses.tr: yāʾabati lā taʿbudi ash-shayṭāna ۖ ʾinna ash-shayṭāna kāna lilrraḥmāni ʿaṣiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Father, do not worship Satan- Satan has rebelled against the Lord of Mercy.
verses.pickthall: O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَـٰنِ وَلِيًّا
verses.en: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
verses.tr: yāʾabati ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʾan yamassaka ʿadhābun mmina ar-raḥmāni fatakūna lilshayṭāni waliyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Father, I fear that a punishment from the Lord of Mercy may afflict you and that you may become Satan’s companion [in Hell].’
verses.pickthall: O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا
verses.en: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
verses.tr: qāla ʾarāghibun ʾanta ʿan ālihatā yāʾibrāhīmu ۖ laʾin llam tantahi laʾarjumannaka ۖ wāhjurnā maliyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: His father answered, ‘Abraham, do you reject my gods? I will stone you if you do not stop this. Keep out of my way!’
verses.pickthall: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!

verses.ar: قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا
verses.en: [Abraham] said, "Peace [i.e., safety] will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
verses.tr: qāla salāmun ʿalayka ۖ saʾastaghfiru laka rabbā ۖ ʾinnahu kāna bā ḥafiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham said, ‘Peace be with you: I will beg my Lord to forgive you- He is always gracious to me-
verses.pickthall: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me.

verses.ar: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا
verses.en: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allāh and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy [i.e., disappointed]."
verses.tr: wa-aʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūni Allāh wa-adʿūā rabbā ʿasā ʾallā ʾakūna biduʿāʾi rabbā shaqiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: but for now I will leave you, and the idols you all pray to, and I will pray to my Lord and trust that my prayer will not be in vain.’
verses.pickthall: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
verses.en: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allāh, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
verses.tr: falammā āʿtazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni Allāh wahabnā lahu ʾisḥāqa wayaʿqūba ۖ wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: When he left his people and those they served beside God, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made them both prophets:
verses.pickthall: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.

verses.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
verses.en: And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honor.
verses.tr: wawahabnā lahum mmin rraḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣidqin ʿaliyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: We granted Our grace to all of them, and gave them a noble reputation.
verses.pickthall: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.en: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
verses.tr: wādhkur fā al-kitābi mūsā ۚ ʾinnahu kāna mukhlaṣan wakāna rasūlan nnabiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Moses. He was specially chosen, a messenger and a prophet:
verses.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.

verses.ar: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَـٰهُ نَجِيًّا
verses.en: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
verses.tr: wanādaynāhu min jānibi aṭ-ṭūri al-ʾaymani waqarrabnāhu najiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: We called to him from the right-hand side of the mountain and brought him close to Us in secret communion;
verses.pickthall: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion.

verses.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا
verses.en: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
verses.tr: wawahabnā lahu min rraḥmatinā ʾakhāhu hārūna nabiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: out of Our grace We granted him his brother Aaron as a prophet.
verses.pickthall: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise).

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.en: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
verses.tr: wādhkur fā al-kitābi ʾismāʿīla ۚ ʾinnahu kāna ṣādiqa al-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan nnabiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Ishmael. He was true to his promise, a messenger and a prophet.
verses.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا
verses.en: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].
verses.tr: wakāna yaʾmuru ʾahlahu bi-aṣ-ṣalawāhi wa-az-zakawāhi wakāna ʿinda rabbihi marḍiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: He commanded his household to pray and give alms, and his Lord was well pleased with him.
verses.pickthall: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
verses.en: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
verses.tr: wādhkur fā al-kitābi ʾidrīsa ۚ ʾinnahu kāna ṣiddīqan nnabiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Idris. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
verses.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet;

verses.ar: وَرَفَعْنَـٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
verses.en: And We raised him to a high station.
verses.tr: warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: We raised him to a high position.
verses.pickthall: And We raised him to high station.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ۩
verses.en: Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna ʾanʿama Allāh ʿalayhim mmina an-nabiyyina min dhurriyyahi ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥin wamin dhurriyyahi ʾibrāhīma wa-isrāʾīla wamimman hadaynā wājtabaynā ۚ ʾidhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātu ar-raḥmāni kharrūā sujjadan wabukiyyan ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: These were the prophets God blessed- from the seed of Adam, of those We carried in the Ark with Noah, from the seed of Abraham and Israel- and those We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Lord of Mercy were recited to them, they fell to their knees and wept,
verses.pickthall: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping.

verses.ar: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
verses.en: But there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
verses.tr: ۞ fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun ʾaḍāʿūā aṣ-ṣalawāha wāttabaʿūā ash-shahawāti ۖ fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan
verses.abdelhaleem: but there came after them generations who neglected prayer and were driven by their own desires. These will come face to face with their evil,
verses.pickthall: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا
verses.en: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
verses.tr: ʾillā man tāba wamana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ūlāʾika yadkhulūna al-jannaha walā yuẓlamūna shayā
verses.abdelhaleem: but those who repent, who believe, who do righteous deeds, will enter Paradise. They will not be wronged in the least:
verses.pickthall: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught -

verses.ar: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّا
verses.en: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.
verses.tr: jannāti ʿadnin at-tā waʿada ar-raḥmānu ʿibādahu bi-l-ghaybi ۚ ʾinnahu kāna waʿduhu maʾtiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: they will enter the Gardens of Lasting Bliss, promised by the Lord of Mercy to His servants- it is not yet seen but truly His promise will be fulfilled.
verses.pickthall: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment -

verses.ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَـٰمًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
verses.en: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
verses.tr: llā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan ʾillā salāman ۖ walahum rizquhum fīhā bukrahan waʿashiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: There they will hear only peaceful talk, nothing bad; there they will be given provision morning and evening.
verses.pickthall: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.

verses.ar: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا
verses.en: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allāh.
verses.tr: tilka al-jannahu at-tā nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: That is the Garden We shall give as their own to those of Our servants who were devout.
verses.pickthall: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.

verses.ar: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
verses.en: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
verses.tr: wamā natanazzalu ʾillā biʾamri rabbika ۖ lahu mā bayna ʾaydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika ۚ wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: [Gabriel said],‘We only descend [with revelation] at your Lord’s command––everything before us, everything behind us, everything in between, all belongs to Him––your Lord is never forgetful.
verses.pickthall: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -

verses.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَـٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا
verses.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
verses.tr: rrabbu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā fāʿbudhu wāṣṭabir liʿibādatihi ۚ hal taʿlamu lahu samiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: He is Lord of the heavens and earth and everything in between so worship Him: be steadfast in worshipping Him. Do you know of anyone equal to Him?’
verses.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him?

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
verses.en: And man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
verses.tr: wayaqūlu al-ʾinsānu ʾaʾidhā mā mittu lasawfa ʾukhraju ḥayyan
verses.abdelhaleem: Man says, ‘What? Once I am dead, will I be brought back to life?’
verses.pickthall: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?

verses.ar: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا
verses.en: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
verses.tr: ʾawalā yadhkuru al-ʾinsānu ʾannā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shayā
verses.abdelhaleem: but does man not remember that We created him when he was nothing before?
verses.pickthall: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
verses.en: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
verses.tr: fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wa-ash-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: By your Lord [Prophet] We shall gather them and the devils together and set them on their knees around Hell;
verses.pickthall: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عِتِيًّا
verses.en: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
verses.tr: thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿahin ʾayyuhum ʾashaddu ʿalā ar-raḥmāni ʿitiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall seize out of each group those who were most disobedient towards the Lord of Mercy-
verses.pickthall: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا
verses.en: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
verses.tr: thumma lanaḥnu ʾaʿlamu bi-adh-dhīna hum ʾawlā bihā ṣiliyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: We know best who most deserves to burn in Hell-
verses.pickthall: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein.

verses.ar: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا
verses.en: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
verses.tr: wa-in mminkum ʾillā wāriduhā ۚ kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatman mmaqḍiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: but every single one of you will approach it, a decree from your Lord which must be fulfilled.
verses.pickthall: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
verses.en: Then We will save those who feared Allāh and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
verses.tr: thumma nunajjā adh-dhīna āttaqawā wwanadharu aẓ-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall save the devout and leave the evildoers there on their knees.
verses.pickthall: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
verses.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
verses.tr: wa-idhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lilladhīna āmanūā āu al-farīqayni khayrun mmaqāman wa-aḥsanu nadiyyan
verses.abdelhaleem: When Our revelations are recited to them in all their clarity, [all that] the disbelievers say to the believers [is], ‘Which side is better situated? Which side has the better following?’
verses.pickthall: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army?

verses.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَـٰثًا وَرِءْيًا
verses.en: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
verses.tr: wakam ʾahlaknā qablahum mmin qarnin hum ʾaḥsanu ʾathāthan wariʾyan
verses.abdelhaleem: We have destroyed many a generation before them who surpassed them in riches and outward glitter!
verses.pickthall: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming!

verses.ar: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا
verses.en: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
verses.tr: qul man kāna fā aḍ-ḍalālahi falyamdud lahu ar-raḥmānu maddan ۚ ḥattā ʾidhā raʾawā mā yūʿadūna ʾimmā al-ʿadhāba wa-immā as-sāʿaha fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrun mmakānan wa-aḍʿafu jundan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘The Lord of Mercy lengthens [the lives] of the misguided, until, when they are confronted with what they have been warned about- either the punishment [in this life] or the Hour [of Judgement]- they realize who is worse situated and who has the weakest forces.’
verses.pickthall: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army.

verses.ar: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى ۗ وَٱلْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
verses.en: And Allāh increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
verses.tr: wayazīdu Allāh adh-dhīna āhtadawā hudanā ۗ wa-l-bāqiyātu aṣ-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun mmaraddan
verses.abdelhaleem: But God gives more guidance to those who are guided, and good deeds of lasting merit are best and most rewarding in your Lord’s sight.
verses.pickthall: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
verses.en: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]"?
verses.tr: ʾafaraʾayta adh-dhā kafara bāyātinā waqāla laʾūtayanna mālan wawaladan
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you considered the man who rejects Our revelation, who says, ‘I will certainly be given wealth and children’?
verses.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children?

verses.ar: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا
verses.en: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
verses.tr: ʾaṭṭalaʿa al-ghayba ʾami āttakhadha ʿinda ar-raḥmāni ʿahdan
verses.abdelhaleem: Has he penetrated the unknown or received a pledge to that effect from the Lord of Mercy?
verses.pickthall: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent?

verses.ar: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
verses.en: No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.
verses.tr: kallā ۚ sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahu mina al-ʿadhābi maddan
verses.abdelhaleem: No! We shall certainly record what he says and prolong his punishment:
verses.pickthall: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.

verses.ar: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا
verses.en: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
verses.tr: wanarithuhu mā yaqūlu wayaʾtīnā fardan
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall inherit from him all that he speaks of and he will come to Us all alone.
verses.pickthall: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children).

verses.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا
verses.en: And they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
verses.tr: wāttakhadhūā min dūni Allāh ālihahan lliyakūnūā lahum ʿizzan
verses.abdelhaleem: They have taken other gods beside God to give them strength,
verses.pickthall: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them.

verses.ar: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
verses.en: No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
verses.tr: kallā ۚ sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍiddan
verses.abdelhaleem: but these gods will reject their worship and will even turn against them.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
verses.en: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾannā ʾarsalnā ash-shayāṭīna ʿalā al-kāfirīna taʾuzzuhum ʾazzan
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you [Prophet] not seen how We send devils to incite the disbelievers to sin?
verses.pickthall: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion?

verses.ar: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا
verses.en: So be not impatient over them. We only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.
verses.tr: falā taʿjal ʿalayhim ۖ ʾinnamā naʿuddu lahum ʿaddan
verses.abdelhaleem: There is no need for you to be impatient concerning them: We are counting down their [allotted] time.
verses.pickthall: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).

verses.ar: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَفْدًا
verses.en: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
verses.tr: yawma naḥshuru al-muttaqīna ʾilā ar-raḥmāni wafdan
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day We gather the righteous as an honoured company before the Lord of Mercy
verses.pickthall: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company.

verses.ar: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
verses.en: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
verses.tr: wanasūqu al-mujrimīna ʾilā jahannama wirdan
verses.abdelhaleem: and drive the sinful like a thirsty herd into Hell,
verses.pickthall: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,

verses.ar: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا
verses.en: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
verses.tr: llā yamlikūna ash-shafāʿaha ʾillā mani āttakhadha ʿinda ar-raḥmāni ʿahdan
verses.abdelhaleem: no one will have power to intercede except for those who have permission from the Lord of Mercy.
verses.pickthall: They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا
verses.en: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
verses.tr: waqālūā āttakhadha ar-raḥmānu waladan
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has offspring.’
verses.pickthall: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son.

verses.ar: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّا
verses.en: You have done an atrocious thing.
verses.tr: llaqad jiʾtum shayā ʾiddan
verses.abdelhaleem: How terrible is this thing you assert:
verses.pickthall: Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing

verses.ar: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
verses.en: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
verses.tr: takādu as-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna minhu watanshaqqu al-ʾarḍu watakhirru al-jibālu haddan
verses.abdelhaleem: it almost causes the heavens to be torn apart, the earth to split asunder, the mountains to crumble to pieces,
verses.pickthall: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins,

verses.ar: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدًا
verses.en: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
verses.tr: ʾan daʿawā lilrraḥmāni waladan
verses.abdelhaleem: that they attribute offspring to the Lord of Mercy.
verses.pickthall: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son,

verses.ar: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
verses.en: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
verses.tr: wamā yanbaghā lilrraḥmāni ʾan yattakhidha waladan
verses.abdelhaleem: It does not befit the Lord of Mercy [to have offspring]:
verses.pickthall: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.

verses.ar: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَبْدًا
verses.en: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
verses.tr: ʾin kullu man fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ʾillā ātā ar-raḥmāni ʿabdan
verses.abdelhaleem: there is no one in the heavens or earth who will not come to the Lord of Mercy as a servant-
verses.pickthall: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave.

verses.ar: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا
verses.en: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
verses.tr: llaqad ʾaḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿaddan
verses.abdelhaleem: He has counted them all: He has numbered them exactly-
verses.pickthall: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.

verses.ar: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
verses.en: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
verses.tr: wakulluhum ātīhi yawma al-qiyāmahi fardan
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will each return to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.
verses.pickthall: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّا
verses.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumu ar-raḥmānu wuddan
verses.abdelhaleem: But the Lord of Mercy will give love to those who believe and do righteous deeds:
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا
verses.en: So, [O Muḥammad], We have only made it [i.e., the Qur’ān] easy in your tongue [i.e., the Arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
verses.tr: fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashira bihi al-muttaqīna watundhira bihi qawman lluddan
verses.abdelhaleem: We have made it easy, in your own language [Prophet], so that you may bring glad news to the righteous and warnings to a stubborn people.
verses.pickthall: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk.

verses.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
verses.en: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
verses.tr: wakam ʾahlaknā qablahum mmin qarnin hal tuḥissu minhum mmin ʾaḥadin ʾaw tasmaʿu lahum rikzanā
verses.abdelhaleem: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you perceive a single one of them now, or hear as much as a whisper?
verses.pickthall: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound?

verses.ar: طه
verses.en: Ṭā, Hā.
verses.tr: ṭh
verses.abdelhaleem: Ta Ha
verses.pickthall: Ta. Ha.

verses.ar: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.en: We have not sent down to you the Qur’ān that you be distressed
verses.tr: mā ʾanzalnā ʿalayka al-qurāna litashqā
verses.abdelhaleem: It was not to distress you [Prophet] that We sent down the Quran to you,
verses.pickthall: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed,

verses.ar: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
verses.en: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allāh] -
verses.tr: ʾillā tadhkirahan lliman yakhshā
verses.abdelhaleem: but as a reminder for those who hold God in awe,
verses.pickthall: But as a reminder unto him who feareth,

verses.ar: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
verses.en: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
verses.tr: tanzīlan mmimman khalaqa al-ʾarḍa wa-as-samāwāti al-ʿulā
verses.abdelhaleem: a revelation from the One who created the earth and the high heaven,
verses.pickthall: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens,

verses.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.en: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
verses.tr: ar-raḥmānu ʿalā al-ʿarshi āstawā
verses.abdelhaleem: the Lord of Mercy, established on the throne.
verses.pickthall: The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne.

verses.ar: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
verses.en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
verses.tr: lahu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā wamā taḥta ath-tharā
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and on earth, everything between them, everything beneath the soil, belongs to Him.
verses.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod.

verses.ar: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
verses.en: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
verses.tr: wa-in tajhar bi-l-qawli fa-innahu yaʿlamu as-sirra wa-akhfā
verses.abdelhaleem: Whatever you may say aloud, He knows what you keep secret and what is even more hidden.
verses.pickthall: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verses.en: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
verses.tr: Allāh lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۖ lahu al-ʾasmāʾu al-ḥusnā
verses.abdelhaleem: God––there is no god but Him––the most excellent names belong to Him.
verses.pickthall: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names.

verses.ar: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.en: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
verses.tr: wahal ʾatāka ḥadīthu mūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: Has the story of Moses come to you [Prophet]?
verses.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?

verses.ar: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًى
verses.en: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
verses.tr: ʾidh raā nāran faqāla liʾahlihi āmkuthūā ʾinnā ānastu nāran llaʿallā ātīkum mminhā biqabasin ʾaw ʾajidu ʿalā an-nāri hudanā
verses.abdelhaleem: He saw a fire and said to his people, ‘Stay here––I can see a fire. Maybe I can bring you a flaming brand from it or find some guidance there.’
verses.pickthall: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ
verses.en: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
verses.tr: falammā ʾatāhā nūdāa yāmūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: When he came to the fire, he was summoned, ‘Moses!
verses.pickthall: And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses!

verses.ar: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verses.en: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the blessed valley of Ṭuwā.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾanā rabbuka fākhlaʿ naʿlayka ۖ ʾinnaka bi-l-wādi al-muqaddasi ṭuwanā
verses.abdelhaleem: I am your Lord. Take off your shoes: you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
verses.pickthall: Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa.

verses.ar: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.en: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
verses.tr: wa-anā ākhtartuka fāstamiʿ limā yūḥā
verses.abdelhaleem: I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed.
verses.pickthall: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.

verses.ar: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
verses.en: Indeed, I am Allāh. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
verses.tr: ʾinnanā ʾanā Allāh lā ʾilāha ʾillā ʾanā fāʿbudnā wa-aqimi aṣ-ṣalawāha lidhikrā
verses.abdelhaleem: I am God; there is no god but Me. So worship Me and keep up the prayer so that you remember Me.
verses.pickthall: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.en: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
verses.tr: ʾinna as-sāʿaha ātiyahun ʾakādu ʾukhfīhā litujzā kullu nafsin bimā tasʿā
verses.abdelhaleem: The Hour is coming––though I choose to keep it hidden––for each soul to be rewarded for its labour.
verses.pickthall: Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve).

verses.ar: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
verses.en: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
verses.tr: falā yaṣuddannaka ʿanhā man llā yuʾminu bihā wāttabaʿa hawāhu fatardā
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not let anyone who does not believe in it and follows his own desires distract you from it, and so bring you to ruin.’
verses.pickthall: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish.

verses.ar: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.en: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
verses.tr: wamā tilka biyamīnika yāmūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Moses, what is that in your right hand?’
verses.pickthall: And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses?

verses.ar: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.en: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
verses.tr: qāla hāa ʿaṣāa ʾatawakkaā ʿalayhā wa-ahushu bihā ʿalā ghanamā walāa fīhā māribu ʾukhrā
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘It is my staff,’ he said, ‘I lean on it; restrain my sheep with it; I also have other uses for it.’
verses.pickthall: He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
verses.tr: qāla ʾalqihā yāmūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Throw it down, Moses.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Cast it down, O Moses!

verses.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ
verses.en: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
verses.tr: fa-ā fa-idhā hāa ḥayyahun tasʿā
verses.abdelhaleem: He threw it down and- lo and behold!- it became a fast-moving snake.
verses.pickthall: So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding.

verses.ar: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
verses.tr: qāla khudhhā walā takhaf ۖ sanuʿīduhā sīratahā al-ʾūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Pick it up without fear: We shall turn it back into its former state.
verses.pickthall: He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state.

verses.ar: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.en: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
verses.tr: wāḍmum yadaka ʾilā janāḥika takhruj bayḍāʾa min ghayri sūʾin āyahan ʾukhrā
verses.abdelhaleem: Now place your hand under your armpit and it will come out white, though unharmed: that is another sign.
verses.pickthall: And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token.

verses.ar: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
verses.en: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
verses.tr: linuriyaka min āyātinā al-kubrā
verses.abdelhaleem: We do this to show you some of Our greatest signs.
verses.pickthall: That We may show thee (some) of Our greater portents,

verses.ar: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.en: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed [i.e., tyrannized]."
verses.tr: ādhhab ʾilā firʿawna ʾinnahu ṭaghā
verses.abdelhaleem: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly become a tyrant.’
verses.pickthall: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
verses.en: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand [i.e., relax] for me my breast [with assurance]
verses.tr: qāla rabbi āshraḥ lā ṣadrā
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘Lord, lift up my heart
verses.pickthall: (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind

verses.ar: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.en: And ease for me my task
verses.tr: wayassir lā ʾamrā
verses.abdelhaleem: and ease my task for me.
verses.pickthall: And ease my task for me;

verses.ar: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى
verses.en: And untie the knot from my tongue
verses.tr: wāḥlul ʿuqdahan mmin llisānā
verses.abdelhaleem: Untie my tongue,
verses.pickthall: And loose a knot from my tongue,

verses.ar: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
verses.en: That they may understand my speech.
verses.tr: yafqahūā qawlā
verses.abdelhaleem: so that they may understand my words,
verses.pickthall: That they may understand my saying.

verses.ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
verses.en: And appoint for me a minister [i.e., assistant] from my family -
verses.tr: wājʿal llā wazīran mmin ʾahlā
verses.abdelhaleem: and give me a helper from my family,
verses.pickthall: Appoint for me a henchman from my folk,

verses.ar: هَـٰرُونَ أَخِى
verses.en: Aaron, my brother.
verses.tr: hārūna ʾakhā
verses.abdelhaleem: my brother Aaron-
verses.pickthall: Aaron, my brother.

verses.ar: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
verses.en: Increase through him my strength
verses.tr: āshdud bihi ʾazrā
verses.abdelhaleem: augment my strength through him.
verses.pickthall: Confirm my strength with him

verses.ar: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.en: And let him share my task
verses.tr: wa-ashrikhu fā ʾamrā
verses.abdelhaleem: Let him share my task
verses.pickthall: And let him share my task,

verses.ar: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.en: That we may exalt You much
verses.tr: kā nusabbiḥaka kathīran
verses.abdelhaleem: so that we can glorify You much
verses.pickthall: That we may glorify Thee much

verses.ar: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.en: And remember You much.
verses.tr: wanadhkuraka kathīran
verses.abdelhaleem: and remember You often:
verses.pickthall: And much remember Thee.

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
verses.tr: ʾinnaka kunta binā baṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: You are always watching over us.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! Thou art ever Seeing us.

verses.ar: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
