verses.en: [Allāh] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
verses.tr: qāla qad ʾūtīta suʾlaka yāmūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Moses, your request is granted.
verses.pickthall: He said: Thou art granted thy request, O Moses.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
verses.en: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
verses.tr: walaqad manannā ʿalayka marrahan ʾukhrā
verses.abdelhaleem: Indeed We showed you favour before.
verses.pickthall: And indeed, another time, already We have shown thee favour,

verses.ar: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.en: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
verses.tr: ʾidh ʾawḥaynā ʾilā ʾummika mā yūḥā
verses.abdelhaleem: We inspired your mother, saying,
verses.pickthall: When we inspired in thy mother that which is inspired,

verses.ar: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
verses.en: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye [i.e., observation and care].
verses.tr: ʾani āqdhifīhi fā at-tābūti fāqdhifīhi fā al-yammi falyulqihi al-yammu bi-as-sāḥili yaʾkhudhhu ʿaduwwun llā waʿaduwwun llahu ۚ wa-ʾalqaytu ʿalayka maḥabbahan mminnā walituṣnaʿa ʿalā ʿaynā
verses.abdelhaleem: “Put your child into the chest, then place him in the river. Let the river wash him on to its bank, and he will be taken in by an enemy of Mine and his.” I showered you with My love and planned that you should be reared under My watchful eye.
verses.pickthall: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will,

verses.ar: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَـٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَـٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّـٰكَ فُتُونًا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.en: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
verses.tr: ʾidh tamshā ʾukhtuka fataqūlu hal ʾadullukum ʿalā man yakfuluhu ۖ farajaʿnāka ʾilā ʾummika kā taqarra ʿaynuhā walā taḥzana ۚ waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynāka mina al-ghammi wafatannāka futūnan ۚ falabithta sinīna fā ʾahli madyana thumma jiʾta ʿalā qadarin yāmūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: Your sister went out, saying, “I will tell you someone who will nurse him,” then We returned you to your mother so that she could rejoice and not grieve. Later you killed a man, but We saved you from distress and tried you with other tests. You stayed among the people of Midian for years, then you came here as I ordained.
verses.pickthall: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses,

verses.ar: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
verses.en: And I produced you for Myself.
verses.tr: wāṣṭanaʿtuka linafsā
verses.abdelhaleem: I have chosen you for Myself.
verses.pickthall: And I have attached thee to Myself.

verses.ar: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
verses.en: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
verses.tr: ādhhab ʾanta wa-akhūka bāyātā walā taniyā fā dhikrā
verses.abdelhaleem: Go, you and your brother, with My signs, and make sure that you remember Me.
verses.pickthall: Go, thou and thy brother, with My tokens, and be not faint in remembrance of Me.

verses.ar: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.en: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
verses.tr: ādhhabā ʾilā firʿawna ʾinnahu ṭaghā
verses.abdelhaleem: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds.
verses.pickthall: Go, both of you, unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).

verses.ar: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
verses.en: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allāh]."
verses.tr: faqūlā lahu qawlan llayyinan llaʿallahu yatadhakkaru ʾaw yakhshā
verses.abdelhaleem: Speak to him gently so that he may take heed, or show respect.’
verses.pickthall: And speak unto him a gentle word, that peradventure he may heed or fear.

verses.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
verses.en: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
verses.tr: qālā rabbanā ʾinnanā nakhāfu ʾan yafruṭa ʿalaynā ʾaw ʾan yaṭghā
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Lord, we fear he will do us great harm or exceed all bounds.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Our Lord! Lo! we fear that he may be beforehand with us or that he may play the tyrant.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
verses.tr: qāla lā takhāfā ۖ ʾinnanā maʿakumā ʾasmaʿu wa-arā
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Do not be afraid, I am with you both, hearing and seeing everything.
verses.pickthall: He said: Fear not. Lo! I am with you twain, Hearing and Seeing.

verses.ar: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.en: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.
verses.tr: fa-tiyāhu faqūlā ʾinnā rasūlā rabbika fa-arsil maʿanā banā ʾisrāʾīla walā tuʿadhibhum ۖ qad jiʾnāka bāyahin mmin rrabbika ۖ wa-as-salāmu ʿalā mani āttabaʿa al-hudā
verses.abdelhaleem: Go and tell him, “We are your Lord’s mes-sengers, so send the Children of Israel with us and do not oppress them. We have brought you a sign from your Lord. Peace be upon whoever follows the right guidance;
verses.pickthall: So go ye unto him and say: Lo! we are two messengers of thy Lord. So let the children of Israel go with us, and torment them not. We bring thee a token from thy Lord. And peace will be for him who followeth right guidance.

verses.ar: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.en: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.'"
verses.tr: ʾinnā qad ʾūḥāa ʾilaynā ʾanna al-ʿadhāba ʿalā man kadhaba watawallā
verses.abdelhaleem: it has been revealed to us that punishment falls on whoever rejects the truth and turns his back on it.”’
verses.pickthall: Lo! it hath been revealed unto us that the doom will be for him who denieth and turneth away.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
verses.tr: qāla faman rrabbukumā yāmūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Pharaoh] said, ‘Moses, who is this Lord of yours?’
verses.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Who then is the Lord of you twain, O Moses?

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
verses.en: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
verses.tr: qāla rabbunā adh-dhā ʾaʿṭā kulla shāʾin khalqahu thumma hadā
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘Our Lord is He who gave everything its form, then gave it guidance.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
verses.tr: qāla famā bālu al-qurūni al-ʾūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘What about former generations?’
verses.pickthall: He said: What then is the state of the generations of old?

verses.ar: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَـٰبٍ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
verses.en: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."
verses.tr: qāla ʿilmuhā ʿinda rabbā fā kitābin ۖ llā yaḍillu rabbā walā yansā
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘My Lord alone has knowledge of them, all in a record; my Lord does not err or forget.’
verses.pickthall: He said: The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither erreth nor forgetteth,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّن نَّبَاتٍ شَتَّىٰ
verses.en: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
verses.tr: adh-dhā jaʿala lakumu al-ʾarḍa mahdan wasalaka lakum fīhā subulan wa-anzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan fa-akhrajnā bihi ʾazwājan mmin nnabātin shattā
verses.abdelhaleem: It was He who spread out the earth for you and traced routes in it. He sent down water from the sky. With that water We bring forth every kind of plant,
verses.pickthall: Who hath appointed the earth as a bed and hath threaded roads for you therein and hath sent down water from the sky and thereby We have brought forth divers kinds of vegetation,

verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَـٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.en: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
verses.tr: kulūā wārʿawā ʾanʿāmakum ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliʾūlā an-nuhā
verses.abdelhaleem: so eat, and graze your cattle. There are truly signs in all this for people of understand-ing.
verses.pickthall: (Saying): Eat ye and feed your cattle. Lo! herein verily are portents for men of thought.

verses.ar: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.en: From it [i.e., the earth] We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.
verses.tr: ۞ minhā khalaqnākum wafīhā nuʿīdukum waminhā nukhrijukum tārahan ʾukhrā
verses.abdelhaleem: From the earth We created you, into it We shall return you, and from it We shall raise you a second time.
verses.pickthall: Thereof We created you, and thereunto We return you, and thence We bring you forth a second time.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَـٰهُ ءَايَـٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
verses.en: And We certainly showed him [i.e., Pharaoh] Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾaraynāhu āyātinā kullahā fakadhaba wa-abā
verses.abdelhaleem: We showed Pharaoh all Our signs, but he denied them and refused [to change].
verses.pickthall: And We verily did show him all Our tokens, but he denied them and refused.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.en: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
verses.tr: qāla ʾajiʾtanā litukhrijanā min ʾarḍinā bisiḥrika yāmūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Have you come to drive us from our land with your sorcery, Moses?
verses.pickthall: He said: Hast come to drive us out from our land by thy magic, O Moses?

verses.ar: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى
verses.en: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."
verses.tr: falanaʾtiyannaka bisiḥrin mmithlihi fājʿal baynanā wabaynaka mawʿidan llā nukhlifuhu naḥnu walā ʾanta makānan suwanā
verses.abdelhaleem: We will confront you with sorcery to match your own: make an appointment between us which neither of us will fail to keep, in a mutually agreeable place.’
verses.pickthall: But we surely can produce for thee magic the like thereof; so appoint a tryst between us and you, which neither we nor thou shall fail to keep, at a place convenient (to us both).

verses.ar: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًى
verses.en: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."
verses.tr: qāla mawʿidukum yawmu az-zīnahi wa-an yuḥshara an-nāsu ḍuḥanā
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Your meeting will be on the day of the feast, so let the people be assembled when the sun has risen high.’
verses.pickthall: (Moses) said: Your tryst shall be the day of the feast, and let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
verses.en: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
verses.tr: fatawallā firʿawnu fajamaʿa kaydahu thumma ʾatā
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh withdrew and gathered his resources, then he returned.
verses.pickthall: Then Pharaoh went and gathered his strength, then came (to the appointed tryst).

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
verses.en: Moses said to them [i.e., the magicians summoned by Pharaoh], "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allāh or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."
verses.tr: qāla lahum mmūsā waylakum lā taftarūā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban fayusḥitakum biʿadhābin ۖ waqad khāba mani āftarā
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said to them, ‘Beware, do not invent lies against God or He will destroy you with His punishment. Whoever invents lies will fail.’
verses.pickthall: Moses said unto them: Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He extirpate you by some punishment. He who lieth faileth miserably.

verses.ar: فَتَنَـٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
verses.en: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
verses.tr: fatanāzaʿūā ʾamrahum baynahum wa-asarrūā an-najwā
verses.abdelhaleem: So they discussed their plan among themselves, talking secretly,
verses.pickthall: Then they debated one with another what they must do, and they kept their counsel secret.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَٰنِ لَسَـٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
verses.en: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way [i.e., religion or tradition].
verses.tr: qālūā ʾin hādhāni lasāḥirāni yurīdāni ʾan yukhrijākum mmin ʾarḍikum bisiḥrihimā wayadhhabā biṭarīqatikumu al-muthlā
verses.abdelhaleem: saying, ‘These two men are sorcerers. Their purpose is to drive you out of your land with their sorcery and put an end to your time-honoured way of life.
verses.pickthall: They said: Lo! these are two wizards who would drive you out from your country by their magic, and destroy your best traditions;

verses.ar: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
verses.en: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."
verses.tr: fa-ajmiʿūā kaydakum thumma āʾtūā ṣaffan ۚ waqad ʾaflaḥa al-yawma mani āstaʿlā
verses.abdelhaleem: So gather your resources and line up for the contest. Whoever wins today is sure to prosper.’
verses.pickthall: So arrange your plan, and come in battle line. Whoso is uppermost this day will be indeed successful.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
verses.en: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."
verses.tr: qālūā yāmūsā ʾimmā ʾan tulqāa wa-immā ʾan nnakūna ʾawwala man ʾalqā
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Moses, will you throw first or shall we?’
verses.pickthall: They said: O Moses! Either throw first, or let us be the first to throw?

verses.ar: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.en: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
verses.tr: qāla bal ʾalqūā ۖ fa-idhā ḥibāluhum waʿiṣiyyuhum yukhayyalu ʾilayhi min siḥrihim ʾannahā tasʿā
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘You throw,’ said Moses, and––lo and behold!––through their sorcery, their ropes and staffs seemed to him to be moving.
verses.pickthall: He said: Nay, do ye throw! Then lo! their cords and their staves, by their magic, appeared to him as though they ran.

verses.ar: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةً مُّوسَىٰ
verses.en: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
verses.tr: fa-awjasa fā nafsihi khīfahan mmūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses was inwardly alarmed,
verses.pickthall: And Moses conceived a fear in his mind.

verses.ar: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.en: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
verses.tr: qulnā lā takhaf ʾinnaka ʾanta al-ʾaʿlā
verses.abdelhaleem: but We said, ‘Do not be afraid, you have the upper hand.
verses.pickthall: We said: Fear not! Lo! thou art the higher.

verses.ar: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَـٰحِرٍ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
verses.en: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."
verses.tr: wa-ʾalqi mā fā yamīnika talqaf mā ṣanaʿūā ۖ ʾinnamā ṣanaʿūā kaydu sāḥirin ۖ walā yufliḥu as-sāḥiru ḥaythu ʾatā
verses.abdelhaleem: Throw down what is in your right hand: it will swallow up what they have produced. They have only produced the tricks of a sorcerer, and a sorcerer will not prosper, wherever he goes.’
verses.pickthall: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain.

verses.ar: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.en: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
verses.tr: fa-ʾulqāa as-saḥarahu sujjadan qālūā āmannā birabbi hārūna wamūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: [So it was, and] the sorcerers threw themselves down in submission. ‘We believe,’ they said, ‘in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.’
verses.pickthall: Then the wizards were (all) flung down prostrate, crying: We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.

verses.ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."
verses.tr: qāla āmantum lahu qabla ʾan ādhana lakum ۖ ʾinnahu lakabīrukumu adh-dhā ʿallamakumu as-siḥra ۖ falaʾuqaṭṭiʿanna ʾaydiyakum wa-arjulakum mmin khilāfin walaʾuṣallibannakum fā judhūʿi an-nakhli walataʿlamunna ʾayyunā ʾashaddu ʿadhāban wa-abqā
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? This must be your master, the man who taught you witchcraft. I shall certainly cut off your alternate hands and feet, then crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. You will know for certain which of us has the fiercer and more lasting punishment.’
verses.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he is your chief who taught you magic. Now surely I shall cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and I shall crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and ye shall know for certain which of us hath sterner and more lasting punishment.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
verses.en: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
verses.tr: qālūā lan nnuʾthiraka ʿalā mā jāʾanā mina al-bayyināti wa-adh-dhā faṭaranā ۖ fāqḍi mā ʾanta qāḍin ۖ ʾinnamā taqḍā hādhihi al-ḥayawāha ad-dunyā
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We shall never prefer you to the clear sign that has come to us, nor to Him who created us. So decide whatever you will: you can only decide matters of this present life-
verses.pickthall: They said: We choose thee not above the clear proofs that have come unto us, and above Him Who created us. So decree what thou wilt decree. Thou wilt end for us only this life of the world.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.en: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allāh is better and more enduring."
verses.tr: ʾinnā āmannā birabbinā liyaghfira lanā khaṭāyānā wamā ʾakrahtanā ʿalayhi mina as-siḥri ۗ wallāh khayrun wa-abqā
verses.abdelhaleem: we believe in our Lord, [hoping] He may forgive us our sins and the sorcery that you forced us to practise- God is better and more lasting.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! we believe in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins and the magic unto which thou didst force us. Allah is better and more lasting.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.en: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu man yaʾti rabbahu mujriman fa-inna lahu jahannama lā yamūtu fīhā walā yaḥyā
verses.abdelhaleem: Hell will be the reward of those who return to their Lord as evildoers: there they will stay, neither living nor dying.
verses.pickthall: Lo! whoso cometh guilty unto his Lord, verily for him is hell. There he will neither die nor live.

verses.ar: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَـٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
verses.en: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:
verses.tr: waman yaʾtihi muʾminan qad ʿamila aṣ-ṣāliḥāti fa-ūlāʾika lahumu ad-darajātu al-ʿulā
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who return to their Lord as believers with righteous deeds will be rewarded with the highest of ranks,
verses.pickthall: But whoso cometh unto Him a believer, having done good works, for such are the high stations;

verses.ar: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.en: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
verses.tr: jannātu ʿadnin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ۚ wadhālika jazāʾu man tazakkā
verses.abdelhaleem: Gardens of lasting bliss graced with flowing streams, and there they will stay. Such is the reward of those who purify themselves.
verses.pickthall: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of him who groweth.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verses.en: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."
verses.tr: walaqad ʾawḥaynā ʾilā mūsā ʾan ʾasri biʿibādā fāḍrib lahum ṭarīqan fā al-baḥri yabasan llā takhāfu darakan walā takhshā
verses.abdelhaleem: We revealed to Moses, ‘Go out at night with My servants and strike a dry path for them across the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken and do not be dismayed.’
verses.pickthall: And verily We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night and strike for them a dry path in the sea, fearing not to be overtaken, neither being afraid (of the sea).

verses.ar: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verses.en: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,
verses.tr: fa-atbaʿahum firʿawnu bijunūdihi faghashiyahum mmina al-yammi mā ghashiyahum
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh pursued them with his armies and was overwhelmed by the sea.
verses.pickthall: Then Pharaoh followed them with his hosts and there covered them that which did cover them of the sea.

verses.ar: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
verses.en: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].
verses.tr: wa-aḍalla firʿawnu qawmahu wamā hadā
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh truly led his people astray; he did not guide them.
verses.pickthall: And Pharaoh led his folk astray, he did not guide them.

verses.ar: يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَـٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَـٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ
verses.en: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
verses.tr: yābanā ʾisrāʾīla qad ʾanjaynākum mmin ʿaduwwikum wawāʿadnākum jāniba aṭ-ṭūri al-ʾaymana wanazzalnā ʿalaykumu al-manna wa-as-salwā
verses.abdelhaleem: Children of Israel, We rescued you from your enemies. We made a pledge with you on the right-hand side of the mountain. We sent down manna and quails for you,
verses.pickthall: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and we made a covenant with you on the holy mountain's side, and sent down on you the manna and the quails,

verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ
verses.en: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen [i.e., perished]."
verses.tr: kulūā min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum walā taṭghawā fīhi fayaḥilla ʿalaykum ghaḍabā ۖ waman yaḥlil ʿalayhi ghaḍabā faqad hawā
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Eat from the good things We have provided for you, but do not overstep the bounds, or My wrath will descend on you. Anyone on whom My wrath descends has truly fallen.
verses.pickthall: (Saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and transgress not in respect thereof lest My wrath come upon you: and he on whom My wrath cometh, he is lost indeed.

verses.ar: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.en: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
verses.tr: wa-innā laghaffārun lliman tāba wamana waʿamila ṣāliḥan thumma āhtadā
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet I am most forgiving towards those who repent, believe, do righteous deeds, and stay on the right path.’
verses.pickthall: And lo! verily I am Forgiving toward him who repenteth and believeth and doeth good, and afterward walketh aright.

verses.ar: ۞ وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.en: [Allāh said], "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"
verses.tr: ۞ wamā ʾaʿjalaka ʿan qawmika yāmūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: [God said], ‘Moses, what has made you come ahead of your people in such haste?’
verses.pickthall: And (it was said): What hath made thee hasten from thy folk, O Moses?

verses.ar: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ
verses.en: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."
verses.tr: qāla hum ʾūlāʾi ʿalā ʾatharā waʿajiltu ʾilayka rabbi litarḍā
verses.abdelhaleem: and he said, ‘They are following in my footsteps. I rushed to You, Lord, to please You,’
verses.pickthall: He said: They are close upon my track. I hastened unto Thee, my Lord, that Thou mightest be well pleased.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray."
verses.tr: qāla fa-innā qad fatannā qawmaka min baʿdika wa-aḍallahumu as-sāmirāu
verses.abdelhaleem: but God said, ‘We have tested your people in your absence: the Samiri has led them astray.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Lo! We have tried thy folk in thine absence, and As-Samiri hath misled them.

verses.ar: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَـٰنَ أَسِفًا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى
verses.en: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"
verses.tr: farajaʿa mūsā ʾilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna ʾasifan ۚ qāla yāqawmi ʾalam yaʿidkum rabbukum waʿdan ḥasanan ۚ ʾafaṭāla ʿalaykumu al-ʿahdu ʾam ʾaradttum ʾan yaḥilla ʿalaykum ghaḍabun mmin rrabbikum fa-akhlaftum mmawʿidā
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses returned to his people, angry and aggrieved. He said, ‘My people, did your Lord not make you a gracious promise? Was my absence too long for you? Did you want anger to fall on you from your Lord and so broke your word to me?’
verses.pickthall: Then Moses went back unto his folk, angry and sad. He said: O my people! Hath not your Lord promised you a fair promise? Did the time appointed then appear too long for you, or did ye wish that wrath from your Lord should come upon you, that ye broke tryst with me?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ أَوْزَارًا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَـٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.en: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Sāmirī throw."
verses.tr: qālūā mā ʾakhlafnā mawʿidaka bimalkinā walākinnā ḥummilnā ʾawzāran mmin zīnahi al-qawmi faqadhafnāhā fakadhālika ʾalqā as-sāmirāu
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We did not break our word to you deliberately. We were burdened with the weight of people’s jewellery, so we threw it [into the fire], and the Samiri did the same,’
verses.pickthall: They said: We broke not tryst with thee of our own will, but we were laden with burdens of ornaments of the folk, then cast them (in the fire), for thus As-Samiri proposed.

verses.ar: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَـٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ
verses.en: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."
verses.tr: fa-akhraja lahum ʿijlan jasadan llahu khuwārun faqālūā hādhā ʾilāhukum wa-ʾilāhu mūsā fanasāa
verses.abdelhaleem: but he [used the molten jewellery to] produce an image of a calf which made a lowing sound, and they said, ‘This is your god and Moses’ god, but he has forgotten.’
verses.pickthall: Then he produced for them a calf, of saffron hue, which gave forth a lowing sound. And they cried: This is your god and the god of Moses, but he hath forgotten.

verses.ar: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا
verses.en: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech [i.e., response] and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
verses.tr: ʾafalā yarawna ʾallā yarjiʿu ʾilayhim qawlan walā yamliku lahum ḍarran walā nafʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: Did they not see that [the calf] gave them no answer, that it had no power to harm or benefit them?
verses.pickthall: See they not, then, that it returneth no saying unto them and possesseth for them neither hurt nor use?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَـٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى وَأَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرِى
verses.en: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."
verses.tr: walaqad qāla lahum hārūnu min qablu yāqawmi ʾinnamā futintum bihi ۖ wa-inna rabbakumu ar-raḥmānu fāttabiʿūnā wa-aṭīʿūā ʾamrā
verses.abdelhaleem: Aaron did say to them, ‘My people, this calf is a test for you. Your true Lord is the Lord of Mercy, so follow me and obey my orders,’
verses.pickthall: And Aaron indeed had told them beforehand: O my people! Ye are but being seduced therewith, for lo! your Lord is the Beneficent, so follow me and obey my order.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَـٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ
verses.en: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to it [i.e., the calf] until Moses returns to us."
verses.tr: qālūā lan nnabraḥa ʿalayhi ʿākifīna ḥattā yarjiʿa ʾilaynā mūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: but they replied, ‘We shall not give up our devotion to it until Moses returns to us.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We shall by no means cease to be its votaries till Moses return unto us.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰهَـٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓا۟
verses.en: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
verses.tr: qāla yāhārūnu mā manaʿaka ʾidh raʾaytahum ḍallūā
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘When you realized they had gone astray, what prevented you, Aaron,
verses.pickthall: He (Moses) said: O Aaron! What held thee back when thou didst see them gone astray,

verses.ar: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِى
verses.en: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"
verses.tr: ʾallā tattabiʿani ۖ ʾafaʿaṣayta ʾamrā
verses.abdelhaleem: from coming after me? How could you disobey my orders?’
verses.pickthall: That thou followedst me not? Hast thou then disobeyed my order?

verses.ar: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى
verses.en: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.'"
verses.tr: qāla yabnaʾumma lā taʾkhudh biliḥyatā walā biraʾsā ۖ ʾinnā khashītu ʾan taqūla farraqta bayna banā ʾisrāʾīla walam tarqub qawlā
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Son of my mother- let go of my beard and my hair!- I was afraid you would say, “You have caused division among the children of Israel and have not heeded what I said.”’
verses.pickthall: He said: O son of my mother! Clutch not my beard nor my head! I feared lest thou shouldst say: Thou hast caused division among the Children of Israel, and hast not waited for my word.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَـٰسَـٰمِرِىُّ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Sāmirī?"
verses.tr: qāla famā khaṭbuka yāsāmirāu
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘And what was the matter with you, Samiri?’
verses.pickthall: (Moses) said: And what hast thou to say, O Samiri?

verses.ar: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى
verses.en: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."
verses.tr: qāla baṣurtu bimā lam yabṣurūā bihi faqabaḍtu qabḍahan mmin ʾathari ar-rasūli fanabadhtuhā wakadhālika sawwalat lā nafsā
verses.abdelhaleem: He replied, ‘I saw something they did not; I took in some of the teachings of the Messenger but tossed them aside: my soul prompted me to do what I did.’
verses.pickthall: He said: I perceived what they perceive not, so I seized a handful from the footsteps of the messenger, and then threw it in. Thus my soul commended to me.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verses.en: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast.
verses.tr: qāla fādhhab fa-inna laka fā al-ḥayawāhi ʾan taqūla lā misāsa ۖ wa-inna laka mawʿidan llan tukhlafahu ۖ wānẓur ʾilā ʾilāhika adh-dhā ẓalta ʿalayhi ʿākifan ۖ llanuḥarriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fā al-yammi nasfan
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘Get away from here! Your lot in this life is to say, “Do not touch me,” but you have an appointment from which there is no escape. Look at your god which you have kept on worshipping- we shall grind it down and scatter it into the sea.
verses.pickthall: (Moses) said: Then go! and lo! in this life it is for thee to say: Touch me not! and lo! there is for thee a tryst thou canst not break. Now look upon thy god of which thou hast remained a votary. Verily we will burn it and will scatter its dust over the sea.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا
verses.en: Your god is only Allāh, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."
verses.tr: ʾinnamā ʾilāhukumu Allāh adh-dhā lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۚ wasiʿa kulla shāʾin ʿilman
verses.abdelhaleem: [People], your true god is the One God- there is no god but Him- whose knowledge embraces everything.’
verses.pickthall: Your Allah is only Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah. He embraceth all things in His knowledge.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا
verses.en: Thus, [O Muḥammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].
verses.tr: kadhālika naquṣṣu ʿalayka min ʾanbāʾi mā qad sabaqa ۚ waqad ātaynāka min lladunnā dhikran
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way We relate to you [Prophet] stories of what happened before. We have given you a Quran from Us.
verses.pickthall: Thus relate We unto thee (Muhammad) some tidings of that which happened of old, and We have given thee from Our presence a reminder.

verses.ar: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وِزْرًا
verses.en: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden [i.e., great sin],
verses.tr: mman ʾaʿraḍa ʿanhu fa-innahu yaḥmilu yawma al-qiyāmahi wizran
verses.abdelhaleem: Whoever turns away from it will bear on the Day of Resurrection a heavy burden
verses.pickthall: Whoso turneth away from it, he verily will bear a burden on the Day of Resurrection,

verses.ar: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ حِمْلًا
verses.en: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
verses.tr: khālidīna fīhi ۖ wasāʾa lahum yawma al-qiyāmahi ḥimlan
verses.abdelhaleem: and will remain under it. What a terrible burden to carry on that Day!
verses.pickthall: Abiding under it - an evil burden for them on the Day of Resurrection,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًا
verses.en: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
verses.tr: yawma yunfakhu fā aṣ-ṣūri ۚ wanaḥshuru al-mujrimīna yawmaʾidhin zurqan
verses.abdelhaleem: When the trumpet is sounded and We gather the sinful, sightless,
verses.pickthall: The day when the Trumpet is blown. On that day we assemble the guilty white-eyed (with terror),

verses.ar: يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا
verses.en: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
verses.tr: yatakhāfatūna baynahum ʾin llabithtum ʾillā ʿashran
verses.abdelhaleem: they will murmur to one another, ‘You stayed only ten days [on earth]’-
verses.pickthall: Murmuring among themselves: Ye have tarried but ten (days).

verses.ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا
verses.en: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner [i.e., wisdom or speech] will say, "You remained not but one day."
verses.tr: nnaḥnu ʾaʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna ʾidh yaqūlu ʾamthaluhum ṭarīqahan ʾin llabithtum ʾillā yawman
verses.abdelhaleem: We know best what they say- but the more perceptive of them will say, ‘Your stay [on earth] was only a single day.’
verses.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they utter when their best in conduct say: Ye have tarried but a day.

verses.ar: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًا
verses.en: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.
verses.tr: wayaslūnaka ʿani al-jibāli faqul yansifuhā rabbā nasfan
verses.abdelhaleem: They ask you [Prophet] about the mountains: say, ‘[On that Day] my Lord will blast them into dust
verses.pickthall: They will ask thee of the mountains (on that day). Say: My Lord will break them into scattered dust.

verses.ar: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا
verses.en: And He will leave it [i.e., the earth] a level plain;
verses.tr: fayadharuhā qāʿan ṣafṣafan
verses.abdelhaleem: and leave a flat plain,
verses.pickthall: And leave it as an empty plain,

verses.ar: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَآ أَمْتًا
verses.en: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
verses.tr: llā tarā fīhā ʿiwajan walā ʾamtan
verses.abdelhaleem: with no peak or trough to be seen.
verses.pickthall: Wherein thou seest neither curve nor ruggedness.

verses.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًا
verses.en: That Day, they [i.e., everyone] will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
verses.tr: yawmaʾidhin yattabiʿūna ad-dāʿāa lā ʿiwaja lahu ۖ wakhashaʿati al-ʾaṣwātu lilrraḥmāni falā tasmaʿu ʾillā hamsan
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day, people will follow the summoner from whom there is no escape; every voice will be hushed for the Lord of Mercy; only whispers will be heard.
verses.pickthall: On that day they follow the summoner who deceiveth not, and voices are hushed for the Beneficent, and thou hearest but a faint murmur.

verses.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًا
verses.en: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.
verses.tr: yawmaʾidhin llā tanfaʿu ash-shafāʿahu ʾillā man ʾadhina lahu ar-raḥmānu waraḍāa lahu qawlan
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day, intercession will be useless except from those to whom the Lord of Mercy has granted permission and whose words He approves-
verses.pickthall: On that day no intercession availeth save (that of) him unto whom the Beneficent hath given leave and whose word He accepteth.

verses.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًا
verses.en: He [i.e., Allāh] knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it [i.e., what He knows] in knowledge.
verses.tr: yaʿlamu mā bayna ʾaydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bihi ʿilman
verses.abdelhaleem: He knows what is before and behind them, though they do not comprehend Him-
verses.pickthall: He knoweth (all) that is before them and (all) that is behind them, while they cannot compass it in knowledge.

verses.ar: ۞ وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا
verses.en: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. And he will have failed who carries injustice.
verses.tr: ۞ waʿanati al-wujūhu lilḥāi al-qayyūmi ۖ waqad khāba man ḥamala ẓulman
verses.abdelhaleem: and [all] faces will be humbled before the Living, Ever Watchful One. Those burdened with evil deeds will despair,
verses.pickthall: And faces humble themselves before the Living, the Eternal. And he who beareth (a burden of) wrongdoing is indeed a failure (on that day).

verses.ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًا وَلَا هَضْمًا
verses.en: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.
verses.tr: waman yaʿmal mina aṣ-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa muʾminun falā yakhāfu ẓulman walā haḍman
verses.abdelhaleem: but whoever has done righteous deeds and believed need have no fear of injustice or deprivation.’
verses.pickthall: And he who hath done some good works, being a believer, he feareth not injustice nor begrudging (of his wage).

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا
verses.en: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
verses.tr: wakadhālika ʾanzalnāhu qurānan ʿarabiyyan waṣarrafnā fīhi mina al-waʿīdi laʿallahum yattaqūna ʾaw yuḥdithu lahum dhikran
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent the Quran down in the Arabic tongue and given all kinds of warnings in it, so that they may beware or take heed-
verses.pickthall: Thus we have revealed it as a Lecture in Arabic, and have displayed therein certain threats, that peradventure they may keep from evil or that it may cause them to take heed.

verses.ar: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
verses.en: So high [above all] is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muḥammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
verses.tr: fataʿālā Allāh al-maliku al-ḥaqqu ۗ walā taʿjal bi-l-qurāni min qabli ʾan yuqḍā ʾilayka waḥyuhu ۖ waqul rrabbi zidnā ʿilman
verses.abdelhaleem: exalted be God, the one who is truly in control. [Prophet], do not rush to recite before the revelation is fully complete but say, ‘Lord, increase me in knowledge!’
verses.pickthall: Then exalted be Allah, the True King! And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee, and say: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُۥ عَزْمًا
verses.en: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.
verses.tr: walaqad ʿahidnā ʾilā ādama min qablu fanasāa walam najid lahu ʿazman
verses.abdelhaleem: We also commanded Adam before you, but he forgot and We found him lacking in constancy.
verses.pickthall: And verily We made a covenant of old with Adam, but he forgot, and We found no constancy in him.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
verses.en: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.
verses.tr: wa-idh qulnā lilmalāʾikahi āsjudūā lādama fasajadūā ʾillā ʾiblīsa ʾabā
verses.abdelhaleem: When We said to the angels, ‘Bow down before Adam,’ they did. But Iblis refused,
verses.pickthall: And when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, they fell prostrate (all) save Iblis; he refused.

verses.ar: فَقُلْنَا يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.en: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.
verses.tr: faqulnā yādamu ʾinna hādhā ʿaduwwun llaka walizawjika falā yukhrijannakumā mina al-jannahi fatashqā
verses.abdelhaleem: so We said, ‘Adam, this is your enemy, yours and your wife’s: do not let him drive you out of the garden and make you miserable.
verses.pickthall: Therefor we said: O Adam! This is an enemy unto thee and unto thy wife, so let him not drive you both out of the Garden so that thou come to toil.

verses.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
verses.en: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.
verses.tr: ʾinna laka ʾallā tajūʿa fīhā walā taʿrā
verses.abdelhaleem: In the garden you will never go hungry, feel naked,
verses.pickthall: It is (vouchsafed) unto thee that thou hungerest not therein nor art naked,

verses.ar: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ
verses.en: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."
verses.tr: wa-annaka lā taẓmaā fīhā walā taḍḥā
verses.abdelhaleem: be thirsty, or suffer the heat of the sun.’
verses.pickthall: And that thou thirstest not therein nor art exposed to the sun's heat.

verses.ar: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ قَالَ يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ
verses.en: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"
verses.tr: fawaswasa ʾilayhi ash-shayṭānu qāla yādamu hal ʾadulluka ʿalā shajarahi al-khuldi wamulkin llā yablā
verses.abdelhaleem: But Satan whispered to Adam, saying, ‘Adam, shall I show you the tree of immortality and power that never decays?’
verses.pickthall: But the devil whispered to him, saying: O Adam! Shall I show thee the tree of immortality and power that wasteth not away?

verses.ar: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
verses.en: And they [i.e., Adam and his wife] ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.
verses.tr: fa-akalā minhā fabadat lahumā sawātuhumā waṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ʿalayhimā min waraqi al-jannahi ۚ waʿaṣā ādamu rabbahu faghawā
verses.abdelhaleem: and they both ate from it. They became conscious of their nakedness and began to cover themselves with leaves from the garden. Adam disobeyed his Lord and was led astray-
verses.pickthall: Then they twain ate thereof, so that their shame became apparent unto them, and they began to hide by heaping on themselves some of the leaves of the Garden. And Adam disobeyed his Lord, so went astray.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ
verses.en: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].
verses.tr: thumma ājtabāhu rabbuhu fatāba ʿalayhi wahadā
verses.abdelhaleem: later his Lord brought him close, accepted his repentance, and guided him-
verses.pickthall: Then his Lord chose him, and relented toward him, and guided him.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Descend from it [i.e., Paradise] - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].
verses.tr: qāla āhbiṭā minhā jamīʿanā ۖ baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun ۖ fa-immā yaʾtiyannakum mminnā hudanā famani āttabaʿa hudāa falā yaḍillu walā yashqā
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Get out of the garden as each other’s enemy.’ Whoever follows My guidance, when it comes to you [people], will not go astray nor fall into misery,
verses.pickthall: He said: Go down hence, both of you, one of you a foe unto the other. But when there come unto you from Me a guidance, then whoso followeth My guidance, he will not go astray nor come to grief.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
verses.en: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed [i.e., difficult] life, and We will gather [i.e., raise] him on the Day of Resurrection blind."
verses.tr: waman ʾaʿraḍa ʿan dhikrā fa-inna lahu maʿīshahan ḍankan wanaḥshuruhu yawma al-qiyāmahi ʾaʿmā
verses.abdelhaleem: but whoever turns away from it will have a life of great hardship. We shall bring him blind to the Assembly on the Day of Resurrection
verses.pickthall: But he who turneth away from remembrance of Me, his will be a narrow life, and I shall bring him blind to the assembly on the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِىٓ أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًا
verses.en: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"
verses.tr: qāla rabbi lima ḥashartanā ʾaʿmā waqad kuntu baṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: and he will say, ‘Lord, why did You bring me here blind? I was sighted before!’
verses.pickthall: He will say: My Lord! Wherefor hast Thou gathered me (hither) blind, when I was wont to see?

verses.ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ ءَايَـٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ
verses.en: [Allāh] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot [i.e., disregarded] them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."
verses.tr: qāla kadhālika ʾatatka āyātunā fanasītahā ۖ wakadhālika al-yawma tunsā
verses.abdelhaleem: God will say, ‘This is how it is: You ignored Our revelations when they came to you, so today you will be ignored.’
verses.pickthall: He will say: So (it must be). Our revelations came unto thee but thou didst forget them. In like manner thou art forgotten this Day.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.en: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.
verses.tr: wakadhālika najzā man ʾasrafa walam yuʾmin bāyāti rabbihi ۚ walaʿadhābu al-ākhirahi ʾashaddu wa-abqā
verses.abdelhaleem: This is how We reward those who go too far, and who do not believe in their Lord’s revelations. The greatest and most enduring punishment is in the Hereafter.
verses.pickthall: Thus do We reward him who is prodigal and believeth not the revelations of his Lord; and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be sterner and more lasting.

verses.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.en: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
verses.tr: ʾafalam yahdi lahum kam ʾahlaknā qablahum mmina al-qurūni yamshūna fā masākinihim ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliʾūlā an-nuhā
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not draw a lesson from the many generations We destroyed before them, through whose dwelling places they now walk? There truly are signs in this for anyone with understanding!
verses.pickthall: Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many a generation We destroyed before them, amid whose dwellings they walk? Lo! therein verily are signs for men of thought.

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى
verses.en: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it [i.e., punishment] would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
verses.tr: walawlā kalimahun sabaqat min rrabbika lakāna lizāman wa-ajalun mmusammanā
verses.abdelhaleem: If it were not for a preordained Word from your Lord [Prophet], they would already have been destroyed. Their time has been set,
verses.pickthall: And but for a decree that had already gone forth from thy Lord, and a term already fixed, the judgment would have been inevitable (in this world).

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ
verses.en: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.
verses.tr: fāṣbir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi ash-shamsi waqabla ghurūbihā ۖ wamin ānāʾi al-yli fasabbiḥ wa-aṭrāfa an-nahāri laʿallaka tarḍā
verses.abdelhaleem: so [Prophet] be patient with what they say- celebrate the praise of your Lord, before the rising and setting of the sun, celebrate His praise during the night, and at the beginning and end of the day, so that you may find contentment-
verses.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), bear with what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord ere the rising of the sun and ere the going down thereof. And glorify Him some hours of the night and at the two ends of the day, that thou mayst find acceptance.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.en: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.
verses.tr: walā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ʾilā mā mattaʿnā bihi ʾazwājan mminhum zahraha al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā linaftinahum fīhi ۚ warizqu rabbika khayrun wa-abqā
verses.abdelhaleem: and do not gaze longingly at what We have given some of them to enjoy, the finery of this present life: We test them through this, but the provision of your Lord is better and more lasting.
verses.pickthall: And strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoy, the flower of the life of the world, that We may try them thereby. The provision of thy Lord is better and more lasting.

verses.ar: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًا ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۗ وَٱلْعَـٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
verses.en: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
verses.tr: wa-mur ʾahlaka bi-aṣ-ṣalawāhi wāṣṭabir ʿalayhā ۖ lā nasluka rizqan ۖ nnaḥnu narzuquka ۗ wa-l-ʿāqibahu lilttaqwā
verses.abdelhaleem: Order your people to pray, and pray steadfastly yourself. We are not asking you to give Us provision;We provide for you, and the rewards of the Hereafter belong to the devout.
verses.pickthall: And enjoin upon thy people worship, and be constant therein. We ask not of thee a provision: We provided for thee. And the sequel is for righteousness.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?
verses.tr: waqālūā lawlā yaʾtīnā bāyahin mmin rrabbihi ۚ ʾawalam taʾtihim bayyinahu mā fā aṣ-ṣuḥufi al-ʾūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers say, ‘Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?’ Have they not been given clear proof confirming what was in the earlier scriptures?
verses.pickthall: And they say: If only he would bring us a miracle from his Lord! Hath there not come unto them the proof of what is in the former scriptures?

verses.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِعَذَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَـٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
verses.en: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses [i.e., teachings] before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
verses.tr: walaw ʾannā ʾahlaknāhum biʿadhābin mmin qablihi laqālūā rabbanā lawlā ʾarsalta ʾilaynā rasūlan fanattabiʿa āyātika min qabli ʾan nnadhilla wanakhzā
verses.abdelhaleem: If We had destroyed them through punishment before this Messenger came, they would have said, ‘Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we could have followed Your revelations before we suffered humiliation and disgrace!’
verses.pickthall: And if we had destroyed them with some punishment before it, they would assuredly have said: Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent unto us a messenger, so that we might have followed Thy revelations before we were (thus) humbled and disgraced!

verses.ar: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.en: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
verses.tr: qul kullun mmutarabbiṣun fatarabbaṣūā ۖ fasataʿlamūna man ʾaṣḥābu aṣ-ṣirāṭi as-sawāi wamani āhtadā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say, ‘We are all waiting, so you carry on waiting: you will come to learn who has followed the even path, and been rightly guided.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Each is awaiting; so await ye! Ye will come to know who are the owners of the path of equity, and who is right.

verses.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
verses.tr: āqtaraba lilnnāsi ḥisābuhum wahum fā ghaflahin mmuʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Ever closer to people draws their reckoning, while they turn away, heedless.
verses.pickthall: Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness.

verses.ar: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.en: No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
verses.tr: mā yaʾtīhim mmin dhikrin mmin rrabbihim mmuḥdathin ʾillā āstamaʿūhu wahum yalʿabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever any fresh revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it playfully
verses.pickthall: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play,

verses.ar: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
verses.tr: lāhiyahan qulūbuhum ۗ wa-asarrūā an-najwā adh-dhīna ẓalamūā hal hādhā ʾillā basharun mmithlukum ۖ ʾafataʾtūna as-siḥra wa-antum tubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: with frivolous hearts. The evildoers conferred in secret: ‘Is this man anything but a mortal like yourselves? Are you going to fall under his spell with your eyes wide open?’
verses.pickthall: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)?

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: He [the Prophet (ﷺ)] said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
verses.tr: qāla rabbā yaʿlamu al-qawla fā as-samāʾi wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ wahuwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My Lord knows everything that is said in the heavens and the earth: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.’
verses.pickthall: He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.ar: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَـٰثُ أَحْلَـٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.en: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
verses.tr: bal qālūā ʾaḍghāthu ʾaḥlāmin bali āftarāhu bal huwa shāʿirun falyaʾtinā bāyahin kamā ʾursila al-ʾawwalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Some say, ‘Muddled dreams’; others, ‘He made it up’; yet others, ‘He is just a poet, let him show us a sign as previous messengers did.’
verses.pickthall: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents).

verses.ar: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
verses.tr: mā āmanat qablahum mmin qaryahin ʾahlaknāhā ۖ ʾafahum yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But of the communities We destroyed before them not a single one believed. Will these now believe?
verses.pickthall: Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe?

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And We sent not before you, [O Muḥammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnā qablaka ʾillā rijālan nnūḥā ʾilayhim ۖ faslūā ʾahla adh-dhikri ʾin kuntum lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And even before your time [Prophet], all the messengers We sent were only men We inspired–– if you [disbelievers] do not know, ask people who know the Scripture––
verses.pickthall: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not?

verses.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰلِدِينَ
verses.en: And We did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
verses.tr: wamā jaʿalnāhum jasadan llā yaʾkulūna aṭ-ṭaʿāma wamā kānūā khālidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We did not give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they immortal.
verses.pickthall: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.en: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
verses.tr: thumma ṣadaqnāhumu al-waʿda fa-anjaynāhum waman nnashāʾu wa-ahlaknā al-musrifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We fulfilled Our promise to them in the end: We saved them and those We wished to save, and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.
verses.pickthall: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
verses.tr: laqad ʾanzalnā ʾilaykum kitāban fīhi dhikrukum ۖ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And now We have sent down to you [people] a Scripture to remind you. Will you not use your reason?
verses.pickthall: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.en: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
verses.tr: wakam qaṣamnā min qaryahin kānat ẓālimahan wa-anshaʾnā baʿdahā qawman ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: How many communities of evildoers We have destroyed! How many others We have raised up in their places!
verses.pickthall: How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk!

verses.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
verses.en: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
verses.tr: falammā ʾaḥassūā baʾsanā ʾidhā hum mminhā yarkuḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they felt Our might coming upon them, see how they tried to escape it!
verses.pickthall: And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it!

verses.ar: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.en: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
verses.tr: lā tarkuḍūā wārjiʿūā ʾilā mā ʾutriftum fīhi wamasākinikum laʿallakum tuslūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Do not try to escape. Go back to your homes and the pleasure you revelled in: you may be questioned.’
verses.pickthall: (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
verses.tr: qālūā yāwaylanā ʾinnā kunnā ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
verses.pickthall: They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers.

verses.ar: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ
verses.en: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
verses.tr: famā zālat ttilka daʿwāhum ḥattā jaʿalnāhum ḥaṣīdan khāmidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and that cry of theirs did not cease until We made them burnt-offstubble.
verses.pickthall: And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
verses.en: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
verses.tr: wamā khalaqnā as-samāʾa wa-l-ʾarḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them playfully.
verses.pickthall: We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play.

verses.ar: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.en: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
verses.tr: law ʾaradnā ʾan nnattakhidha lahwan llāttakhadhnāhu min lladunnā ʾin kunnā fāʿilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If We had wished for a pastime, We could have found it within Us- if We had wished for any such thing.
verses.pickthall: If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did.

verses.ar: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَـٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
verses.en: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
verses.tr: bal naqdhifu bi-l-ḥaqqi ʿalā al-bāṭili fayadmaghuhu fa-idhā huwa zāhiqun ۚ walakumu al-waylu mimmā taṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No! We hurl the truth against falsehood, and truth obliterates it- see how falsehood vanishes away! Woe to you [people] for the way you describe God!
verses.pickthall: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him).

verses.ar: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
verses.en: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
verses.tr: walahu man fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ waman ʿindahu lā yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatihi walā yastaḥsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him, and those that are with Him are never too proud to worship Him, nor do they grow weary;
verses.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary;

verses.ar: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
verses.en: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
verses.tr: yusabbiḥūna al-yla wa-an-nahāra lā yafturūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they glorify Him tirelessly night and day.
verses.pickthall: They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not.

verses.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
verses.en: Or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
verses.tr: ʾami āttakhadhūā ālihahan mmina al-ʾarḍi hum yunshirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have they chosen any gods from the earth who can give life to the dead?
verses.pickthall: Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead?

verses.ar: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.en: Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides Allāh, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allāh, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
verses.tr: law kāna fīhimā ālihahun ʾillā Allāh lafasadatā ۚ fasubḥāna Allāh rabbi al-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If there had been in the heavens or earth any gods but Him, both heavens and earth would be in ruins: God, Lord of the Throne, is far above the things they say:
verses.pickthall: If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him).

verses.ar: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.en: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
verses.tr: lā yuslu ʿammā yafʿalu wahum yuslūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He cannot be called to account for anything He does, whereas they will be called to account.
verses.pickthall: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned.

verses.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
verses.tr: ʾami āttakhadhūā min dūnihi ālihahan ۖ qul hātūā burhānakum ۖ hādhā dhikru man mmaʿāa wadhikru man qablā ۗ bal ʾaktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna al-ḥaqqa ۖ fahum mmuʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have they chosen to worship other gods instead of Him? Say, ‘Bring your proof. This is the Scripture for those who are with me and the Scripture for those who went before me.’ But most of them do not recognize the truth, so they pay no heed.
verses.pickthall: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verses.en: And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnā min qablika min rrasūlin ʾillā nūḥā ʾilayhi ʾannahu lā ʾilāha ʾillā ʾanā fāʿbudūni
verses.abdelhaleem: We never sent any messenger before you [Muhammad] without revealing to him: ‘There is no god but Me, so serve Me.’
verses.pickthall: And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
verses.en: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
verses.tr: waqālūā āttakhadha ar-raḥmānu waladan ۗ subḥānahu ۚ bal ʿibādun mmukramūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And they say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has taken offspring for Himself.’ May He be exalted! No! They are only His honoured servants:
verses.pickthall: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves;

verses.ar: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
verses.tr: lā yasbiqūnahu bi-l-qawli wahum biʾamrihi yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they do not speak before He speaks and they act by His command.
verses.pickthall: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command.

verses.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
verses.en: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
verses.tr: yaʿlamu mā bayna ʾaydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yashfaʿūna ʾillā limani ārtaḍā wahum mmin khashyatihi mushfiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede without His permission––indeed they themselves stand in awe of Him.
verses.pickthall: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him.
