verses.ar: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: ۞ waman yaqul minhum ʾinnā ʾilāhun mmin dūnihi fadhālika najzīhi jahannama ۚ kadhālika najzā aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If any of them were to claim, ‘I am a god beside Him,’ We would reward them with Hell: this is how We reward evildoers.
verses.pickthall: And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
verses.tr: ʾawalam yara adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾanna as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa kānatā ratqan fafataqnāhumā ۖ wajaʿalnā mina al-māʾi kulla shāʾin ḥāin ۖ ʾafalā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and the earth used to be joined together and that We ripped them apart, that We made every living thing from water? Will they not believe?
verses.pickthall: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe?

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā fā al-ʾarḍi rawāsāa ʾan tamīda bihim wajaʿalnā fīhā fijājan subulan llaʿallahum yahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And We put firm mountains on the earth, lest it should sway under them, and set broad paths on it, so that they might follow the right direction,
verses.pickthall: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā as-samāʾa saqfan mmaḥfūẓan ۖ wahum ʿan āyātihā muʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We made the sky a well-secured canopy- yet from its wonders they turn away.
verses.pickthall: And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā khalaqa al-yla wa-an-nahāra wa-ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara ۖ kullun fā falakin yasbaḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who created night and day, the sun and the moon, each floating in its orbit.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit.

verses.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
verses.tr: wamā jaʿalnā libasharin mmin qablika al-khulda ۖ ʾafaʾīn mmitta fahumu al-khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have not granted everlasting life to any other human being before you either [Muhammad]- if you die, will [the disbelievers] live for ever?
verses.pickthall: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal!

verses.ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
verses.tr: kullu nafsin dhāʾiqahu al-mawti ۗ wanablūkum bi-ash-sharri wa-l-khayri fitnahan ۖ wa-ā turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Every soul is certain to taste death: We test you all through the bad and the good, and to Us you will all return.
verses.pickthall: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
verses.tr: wa-idhā raāka adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾin yattakhidhūnaka ʾillā huzuwan ʾahādhā adh-dhā yadhkuru ālihatakum wahum bidhikri ar-raḥmāni hum kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the disbelievers see you, they laugh at you: ‘Is this the one who talks about your gods?’ They reject any talk of the Lord of Mercy.
verses.pickthall: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent.

verses.ar: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.en: Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.
verses.tr: khuliqa al-ʾinsānu min ʿajalin ۚ saʾūrīkum āyātā falā tastaʿjilūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Man was created hasty: I will show you My signs soon, so do not ask Me to hasten them.
verses.pickthall: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.tr: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā al-waʿdu ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
verses.pickthall: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?

verses.ar: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
verses.tr: law yaʿlamu adh-dhīna kafarūā ḥīna lā yakuffūna ʿan wujūhihimu an-nāra walā ʿan ẓuhūrihim walā hum yunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If the disbelievers only knew, the time will arrive when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces or their backs, and they will get no help.
verses.pickthall: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped!

verses.ar: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.en: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
verses.tr: bal taʾtīhim baghtahan fatabhatuhum falā yastaṭīʿūna raddahā walā hum yunẓarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It will come upon them suddenly and stupefy them; they will be powerless to push it away; they will not be reprieved.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.tr: walaqadi āstuhziʾa birusulin mmin qablika faḥāqa bi-adh-dhīna sakhirūā minhum mmā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Messengers before you [Muhammad] were also ridiculed, but those who mocked them were overwhelmed in the end by the very thing they had mocked.
verses.pickthall: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
verses.tr: qul man yaklaʾukum bi-l-yli wa-an-nahāri mina ar-raḥmāni ۗ bal hum ʿan dhikri rabbihim mmuʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Who could protect you night and day from the Lord of Mercy?’ Yet they turn away when their Lord is mentioned.
verses.pickthall: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
verses.en: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
verses.tr: ʾam lahum ālihahun tamnaʿuhum mmin dūninā ۚ lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣra ʾanfusihim walā hum mminnā yuṣḥabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? Their gods have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
verses.pickthall: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us.

verses.ar: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
verses.en: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? Is it they who will overcome?
verses.tr: bal mattaʿnā hāʾulāʾi wabāʾahum ḥattā ṭāla ʿalayhimu al-ʿumuru ۗ ʾafalā yarawna ʾannā naʾtā al-ʾarḍa nanquṣuhā min ʾaṭrāfihā ۚ ʾafahumu al-ghālibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have allowed these sinners and their forefathers to enjoy life for a long time. But do they not see how We are shrinking their borders? Is it they who will prevail?
verses.pickthall: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors?

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
verses.en: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
verses.tr: qul ʾinnamā ʾundhirukum bi-l-waḥāi ۚ walā yasmaʿu aṣ-ṣummu ad-duʿāʾa ʾidhā mā yundharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I warn you only through the Revelation.’ The deaf will not hear the warning call,
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned.

verses.ar: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
verses.tr: walaʾin mmassathum nafḥahun mmin ʿadhābi rabbika layaqūlunna yāwaylanā ʾinnā kunnā ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: yet if a mere breath of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they will be sure to cry, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
verses.pickthall: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.

verses.ar: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ
verses.en: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
verses.tr: wanaḍaʿu al-mawāzīna al-qisṭa liyawmi al-qiyāmahi falā tuẓlamu nafsun shayā ۖ wa-in kāna mithqāla ḥabbahin mmin khardalin ʾataynā bihā ۗ wakafā binā ḥāsibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We will set up scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection so that no one can be wronged in the least, and if there should be even the weight of a mustard seed, We shall bring it out- We take excellent account.
verses.pickthall: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā mūsā wahārūna al-furqāna waḍiyāʾan wadhikran llilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave Moses and Aaron [the Scripture] that distinguishes right from wrong, a light and a reminder for those who are mindful of God,
verses.pickthall: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
verses.en: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bi-l-ghaybi wahum mmina as-sāʿahi mushfiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who stand in awe of their Lord, though He is unseen, and who fear the Hour.
verses.pickthall: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom).

verses.ar: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.en: And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
verses.tr: wahādhā dhikrun mmubārakun ʾanzalnāhu ۚ ʾafaʾantum lahu munkirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This [Quran] too is a blessed message We have sent down- are you [people] going to deny it?
verses.pickthall: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it?

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
verses.tr: ۞ walaqad ātaynā ʾibrāhīma rushdahu min qablu wakunnā bihi ʿālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Long ago We bestowed right judgement on Abraham and We knew him well.
verses.pickthall: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him,

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ
verses.en: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla liʾabīhi waqawmihi mā hādhihi at-tamāthīlu at-tā ʾantum lahā ʿākifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are these images to which you are so devoted?’
verses.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
verses.en: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
verses.tr: qālūā wajadnā ābāʾanā lahā ʿābidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They replied, ‘We found our fathers worshipping them.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
verses.tr: qāla laqad kuntum ʾantum wabāʾukum fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘You and your fathers have clearly gone astray.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
verses.tr: qālūā ʾajiʾtanā bi-l-ḥaqqi ʾam ʾanta mina al-lāʿibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They asked, ‘Have you brought us the truth or are you just playing about?’
verses.pickthall: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester?

verses.ar: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
verses.en: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
verses.tr: qāla bal rrabbukum rabbu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi adh-dhā faṭarahunna wa-anā ʿalā dhālikum mmina ash-shāhidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Listen! Your true Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He who created them, and I am a witness to this.
verses.pickthall: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that.

verses.ar: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
verses.en: And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
verses.tr: wa-tallāh laʾakīdanna ʾaṣnāmakum baʿda ʾan tuwallūā mudbirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: By God I shall certainly plot against your idols as soon as you have turned your backs!’
verses.pickthall: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.

verses.ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
verses.tr: fajaʿalahum judhādhan ʾillā kabīran llahum laʿallahum ʾilayhi yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He broke them all into pieces, but left the biggest one for them to return to.
verses.pickthall: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
verses.tr: qālūā man faʿala hādhā bālihatinā ʾinnahu lamina aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Who has done this to our gods? How wicked he must be!’
verses.pickthall: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verses.en: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
verses.tr: qālūā samiʿnā fatanā yadhkuruhum yuqālu lahu ʾibrāhīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Some said, ‘We heard a youth called Abraham talking about them.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
verses.en: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."
verses.tr: qālūā fa-tūā bihi ʿalā ʾaʿyuni an-nāsi laʿallahum yashhadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial].’
verses.pickthall: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verses.en: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
verses.tr: qālūā ʾaʾanta faʿalta hādhā bālihatinā yāʾibrāhīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: They asked, ‘Was it you, Abraham, who did this to our gods?’
verses.pickthall: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?

verses.ar: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
verses.tr: qāla bal faʿalahu kabīruhum hādhā faslūhum ʾin kānūā yanṭiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘No, it was done by the biggest of them- this one. Ask them, if they can talk.’
verses.pickthall: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.

verses.ar: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
verses.tr: farajaʿūā ʾilā ʾanfusihim faqālūā ʾinnakum ʾantumu aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They turned to one another, saying, ‘It is you who are in the wrong,’
verses.pickthall: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
verses.en: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
verses.tr: thumma nukisūā ʿalā ruʾūsihim laqad ʿalimta mā hāʾulāʾi yanṭiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but then they lapsed again and said, ‘You know very well these gods cannot speak.’
verses.pickthall: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
verses.en: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
verses.tr: qāla ʾafataʿbudūna min dūni Allāh mā lā yanfaʿukum shayā walā yaḍurrukum
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham said, ‘How can you worship what can neither benefit nor harm you, instead of God?
verses.pickthall: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you?

verses.ar: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"
verses.tr: ʾuffin llakum walimā taʿbudūna min dūni Allāh ۖ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Shame on you and on the things you worship instead of God. Have you no sense?’
verses.pickthall: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
verses.tr: qālūā ḥarriqūhu wānṣurūā ālihatakum ʾin kuntum fāʿilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Burn him and avenge your gods, if you are going to do the right thing.’
verses.pickthall: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing.

verses.ar: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.en: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
verses.tr: qulnā yānāru kūnā bardan wasalāman ʿalā ʾibrāhīma
verses.abdelhaleem: But We said, ‘Fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.’
verses.pickthall: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,

verses.ar: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
verses.en: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.
verses.tr: wa-arādūā bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu al-ʾakhsarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They planned to harm him, but We made them suffer the greatest loss.
verses.pickthall: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.

verses.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].
verses.tr: wanajjaynāhu walūṭan ʾilā al-ʾarḍi at-tā bāraknā fīhā lilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved him and Lot [and sent them] to the land We blessed for all people,
verses.pickthall: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.

verses.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
verses.tr: wawahabnā lahu ʾisḥāqa wayaʿqūba nāfilahan ۖ wakullan jaʿalnā ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We gave him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, and made each of them righteous.
verses.pickthall: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
verses.en: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnāhum ʾaʾimmahan yahdūna biʾamrinā wa-awḥaynā ʾilayhim fiʿla al-khayrāti wa-iqāma aṣ-ṣalawāhi wa-ītāʾa az-zakawāhi ۖ wakānūā lanā ʿābidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We made all of them leaders, guiding others by Our command, and We inspired them to do good works, to keep up the prayer, and to give alms: they were Our true worshippers.
verses.pickthall: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone).

verses.ar: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: walūṭan ātaynāhu ḥukman waʿilman wanajjaynāhu mina al-qaryahi at-tā kānat ttaʿmalu al-khabāʾitha ۗ ʾinnahum kānūā qawma sawʾin fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave Lot sound judgement and knowledge and saved him from the community who practised obscenities- they were shameless people who broke God’s law!
verses.pickthall: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd.

verses.ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
verses.tr: wa-adkhalnāhu fā raḥmatinā ۖ ʾinnahu mina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We admitted him to Our mercy; he was a righteous man.
verses.pickthall: And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous.

verses.ar: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allāh] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].
verses.tr: wanūḥan ʾidh nādā min qablu fāstajabnā lahu fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina al-karbi al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Long before that, We answered Noah when he cried out to Us: We saved him and his family from the great calamity
verses.pickthall: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.

verses.ar: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
verses.tr: wanaṣarnāhu mina al-qawmi adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā ۚ ʾinnahum kānūā qawma sawʾin fa-aghraqnāhum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs- they were evil people, so We drowned them all.
verses.pickthall: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all.

verses.ar: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.
verses.tr: wadāwuda wasulaymāna ʾidh yaḥkumāni fā al-ḥarthi ʾidh nafashat fīhi ghanamu al-qawmi wakunnā liḥukmihim shāhidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgement regarding the field into which sheep strayed by night and grazed. We witnessed their judgement
verses.pickthall: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.

verses.ar: فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.en: And We gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].
verses.tr: fafahhamnāhā sulaymāna ۚ wakullan ātaynā ḥukman waʿilman ۚ wasakharnā maʿa dāwuda al-jibāla yusabbiḥna wa-aṭ-ṭayra ۚ wakunnā fāʿilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and made Solomon understand the case [better], though We gave sound judgement and knowledge to both of them. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate Our praises with David- We did all these things-
verses.pickthall: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof).

verses.ar: وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ
verses.en: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
verses.tr: waʿallamnāhu ṣanʿaha labūsin llakum lituḥṣinakum mmin baʾsikum ۖ fahal ʾantum shākirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We taught him how to make coats of mail for the benefit of you [people], to protect you in your wars, but are you grateful for this?
verses.pickthall: And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful?

verses.ar: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
verses.tr: walisulaymāna ar-rīḥa ʿāṣifahan tajrā biʾamrihi ʾilā al-ʾarḍi at-tā bāraknā fīhā ۚ wakunnā bikulli shāʾin ʿālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We harnessed the stormy wind for Solomon, so that it sped by his command to the land We had blessed- We have knowledge of all things-
verses.pickthall: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
verses.en: And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.
verses.tr: wamina ash-shayāṭīni man yaghūṣūna lahu wayaʿmalūna ʿamalan dūna dhālika ۖ wakunnā lahum ḥāfiẓīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We made some of the jinn subservient to him, to dive for him and do other works besides. We were watching over them.
verses.pickthall: And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them.

verses.ar: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."
verses.tr: ۞ wa-ayyūba ʾidh nādā rabbahu ʾannā massanāa aḍ-ḍurru wa-anta ʾarḥamu ar-rāḥimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember Job, when he cried to his Lord, ‘Suffering has truly afflicted me, but you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.’
verses.pickthall: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.

verses.ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
verses.en: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allāh].
verses.tr: fāstajabnā lahu fakashafnā mā bihi min ḍurrin ۖ wataynāhu ʾahlahu wamithlahum mmaʿahum raḥmahan mmin ʿindinā wadhikrā lilʿābidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We answered him, removed his suffering, and restored his family to him, along with more like them, as an act of grace from Us and a reminder for all who serve Us.
verses.pickthall: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers;

verses.ar: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
verses.tr: wa-ismāʿīla wa-idrīsa wadhā al-kifli ۖ kullun mmina aṣ-ṣābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And remember Ishmael, Idris, and Dhu’l-Kifl: they were all steadfast.
verses.pickthall: And (mention) Ishmael, and Idris, and Dhu'l-Kifl. All were of the steadfast.

verses.ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
verses.tr: wa-adkhalnāhum fā raḥmatinā ۖ ʾinnahum mmina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We admitted them to Our mercy; they were truly righteous.
verses.pickthall: And We brought them in unto Our mercy. Lo! they are among the righteous.

verses.ar: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
verses.tr: wadhā an-nūni ʾidh dhahaba mughāḍiban faẓanna ʾan llan nnaqdira ʿalayhi fanādā fā aẓ-ẓulumāti ʾan llā ʾilāha ʾillā ʾanta subḥānaka ʾinnā kuntu mina aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And remember the man with the whale,when he went off angrily, thinking We could not restrict him, but then he cried out in the deep darkness, ‘There is no God but You, glory be to You, I was wrong.’
verses.pickthall: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.

verses.ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
verses.tr: fāstajabnā lahu wanajjaynāhu mina al-ghammi ۚ wakadhālika nujā al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We answered him and saved him from distress: this is how We save the faithful.
verses.pickthall: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers.

verses.ar: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."
verses.tr: wazakariyyā ʾidh nādā rabbahu rabbi lā tadharnā fardan wa-anta khayru al-wārithīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember Zachariah, when he cried to his Lord, ‘My Lord, do not leave me childless, though You are the best of heirs.’
verses.pickthall: And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors.

verses.ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ
verses.en: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
verses.tr: fāstajabnā lahu wawahabnā lahu yaḥyā wa-aṣlaḥnā lahu zawjahu ۚ ʾinnahum kānūā yusāriʿūna fā al-khayrāti wayadʿūnanā raghaban warahaban ۖ wakānūā lanā khāshiʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We answered him––We gave him John, and cured his wife of barrenness- they were always keen to do good deeds. They called upon Us out of longing and awe, and humbled themselves before Us.
verses.pickthall: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., Mary], so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
verses.tr: wa-at-tā ʾaḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhā min rrūḥinā wajaʿalnāhā wābnahā āyahan llilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember the one who guarded her chastity. We breathed into her from Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign for all people.
verses.pickthall: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verses.en: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhihi ʾummatukum ʾummahan wāḥidahan wa-anā rabbukum fāʿbudūni
verses.abdelhaleem: [Messengers], this community of yours is one single community and I am your Lord, so serve Me.
verses.pickthall: Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.

verses.ar: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.en: And [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.
verses.tr: wataqaṭṭaʿūā ʾamrahum baynahum ۖ kullun ʾilaynā rājiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They have torn their unity apart, but they will all return to Us.
verses.pickthall: And they have broken their religion (into fragments) among them, (yet) all are returning unto Us.

verses.ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَـٰتِبُونَ
verses.en: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.
verses.tr: faman yaʿmal mina aṣ-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa muʾminun falā kufrāna lisaʿyihi wa-innā lahu kātibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If anyone does good deeds and is a believer, his efforts will not be ignored: We record them for him.
verses.pickthall: Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him.

verses.ar: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And it is prohibited to [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return
verses.tr: waḥarāmun ʿalā qaryahin ʾahlaknāhā ʾannahum lā yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No community destroyed by Us can escape its return,
verses.pickthall: And there is a ban upon any community which We have destroyed: that they shall not return.

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ
verses.en: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā futiḥat yaʾjūju wamaʾjūju wahum mmin kulli ḥadabin yansilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and when the peoples of Gog and Magog are let loose and swarm swiftly from every highland,
verses.pickthall: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they hasten out of every mound,

verses.ar: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَـٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَـٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And [when] the true promise [i.e., the resurrection] has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."
verses.tr: wāqtaraba al-waʿdu al-ḥaqqu fa-idhā hāa shākhiṣahun ʾabṣāru adh-dhīna kafarūā yāwaylanā qad kunnā fā ghaflahin mmin hādhā bal kunnā ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: when the True Promise draws near, the disbelievers’ eyes will stare in terror, and they will say, ‘Woe to us! We were not aware of this at all. We were wrong.’
verses.pickthall: And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers!

verses.ar: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allāh are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.
verses.tr: ʾinnakum wamā taʿbudūna min dūni Allāh ḥaṣabu jahannama ʾantum lahā wāridūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You [disbelievers] and what you worship instead of God will be fuel for Hell: that is where you will go-
verses.pickthall: Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come.

verses.ar: لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا ۖ وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
verses.tr: law kāna hāʾulāʾi ālihahan mmā waradūhā ۖ wakullun fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: if these [idols] had been real gods they would not have gone there- you will all stay there.
verses.pickthall: If these had been gods they would not have come thither, but all will abide therein.

verses.ar: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.en: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
verses.tr: lahum fīhā zafīrun wahum fīhā lā yasmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There the disbelievers will be groaning piteously, but the [idols] will hear nothing.
verses.pickthall: Therein wailing is their portion, and therein they hear not.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna sabaqat lahum mminnā al-ḥusnā ʾūlāʾika ʿanhā mubʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But those for whom We have decreed Paradise will be kept far from Hell-
verses.pickthall: Lo! those unto whom kindness hath gone forth before from Us, they will be far removed from thence.

verses.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
verses.tr: lā yasmaʿūna ḥasīsahā ۖ wahum fā mā āshtahat ʾanfusuhum khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they will not hear a murmur from it- and endlessly they will enjoy everything their souls desire.
verses.pickthall: They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire.

verses.ar: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -
verses.tr: lā yaḥzunuhumu al-fazaʿu al-ʾakbaru watatalaqqāhumu al-malāʾikahu hādhā yawmukumu adh-dhā kuntum tūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will have no fear of the great Terror: the angels will receive them with the words, ‘This is the Day you were promised!’
verses.pickthall: The Supreme Horror will not grieve them, and the angels will welcome them, (saying): This is your Day which ye were promised;

verses.ar: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
verses.en: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.
verses.tr: yawma naṭwā as-samāʾa kaṭāi as-sijilli lilkutubi ۚ kamā badaʾnā ʾawwala khalqin nnuʿīduhu ۚ waʿdan ʿalaynā ۚ ʾinnā kunnā fāʿilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day, We shall roll up the skies as a writer rolls up [his] scrolls. We shall reproduce creation just as We produced it the first time: this is Our binding promise. We shall certainly do all these things.
verses.pickthall: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ
verses.en: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
verses.tr: walaqad katabnā fā az-zabūri min baʿdi adh-dhikri ʾanna al-ʾarḍa yarithuhā ʿibādāa aṣ-ṣāliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We wrote in the Psalms, as We did in [earlier] Scripture: ‘My righteous servants will inherit the earth.’
verses.pickthall: And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth:

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى هَـٰذَا لَبَلَـٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَـٰبِدِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, in this [Qur’ān] is notification for a worshipping people.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā hādhā labalāghan lliqawmin ʿābidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There truly is a message in this for the servants of God!
verses.pickthall: Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnāka ʾillā raḥmahan llilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It was only as a mercy that We sent you [Prophet] to all people.
verses.pickthall: We sent thee not save as a mercy for the peoples.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"
verses.tr: qul ʾinnamā yūḥā ʾilāa ʾannamā ʾilāhukum ʾilāhun wāḥidun ۖ fahal ʾantum mmuslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘What is revealed to me is that your God is one God- will you submit to Him?’
verses.pickthall: Say: It is only inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah. Will ye then surrender (unto Him)?

verses.ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
verses.tr: fa-in tawallawā faqul ādhantukum ʿalā sawāʾin ۖ wa-in ʾadrā ʾaqarībun ʾam baʿīdun mmā tūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But if they turn away, say, ‘I have proclaimed the message fairly to you all. I do not know whether the judgement you are promised is near or far,
verses.pickthall: But if they are averse, then say: I have warned you all alike, although I know not whether nigh or far is that which ye are promised.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu yaʿlamu al-jahra mina al-qawli wayaʿlamu mā taktumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but He knows what you reveal and conceal.
verses.pickthall: Lo! He knoweth that which is said openly, and that which ye conceal.

verses.ar: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
verses.tr: wa-in ʾadrā laʿallahu fitnahun llakum wamatāʿun ʾilā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: I do not know: this [time] may well be a test for you, and enjoyment for a while.’
verses.pickthall: And I know not but that this may be a trial for you, and enjoyment for a while.

verses.ar: قَـٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
verses.en: [The Prophet (ﷺ)] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi āḥkum bi-l-ḥaqqi ۗ warabbunā ar-raḥmānu al-mustaʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said,‘My Lord, pass the true judgement.’ And, ‘Our Lord is the Lord of Mercy. We seek His assistance against what you [disbelievers] say.’
verses.pickthall: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him).

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَىْءٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu āttaqūā rabbakum ۚ ʾinna zalzalaha as-sāʿahi shāʾun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: People, be mindful of your Lord, for the earthquake of the Last Hour will be a mighty thing:
verses.pickthall: O mankind! Fear your Lord. Lo! the earthquake of the Hour (of Doom) is a tremendous thing.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلنَّاسَ سُكَـٰرَىٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَـٰرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ ٱللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ
verses.en: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allāh is severe.
verses.tr: yawma tarawnahā tadhhalu kullu murḍiʿahin ʿammā ʾarḍaʿat wataḍaʿu kullu dhāti ḥamlin ḥamlahā watarā an-nāsa sukārā wamā hum bisukārā walākinna ʿadhāba Allāh shadīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: on the Day you see it, every nursing mother will think no more of her baby, every pregnant female will miscarry, you will think people are drunk when they are not, so severe will be God’s torment.
verses.pickthall: On the day when ye behold it, every nursing mother will forget her nursling and every pregnant one will be delivered of her burden, and thou (Muhammad) wilt see mankind as drunken, yet they will not be drunken, but the Doom of Allah will be strong (upon them).

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّرِيدٍ
verses.en: And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.
verses.tr: wamina an-nāsi man yujādilu fā Allāh bighayri ʿilmin wayattabiʿu kulla shayṭānin mmarīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet still there are some who, with no knowledge, argue about God, who follow every devilish rebel
verses.pickthall: Among mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah without knowledge, and followeth each froward devil;

verses.ar: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُۥ يُضِلُّهُۥ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: It has been decreed for him [i.e., every devil] that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze.
verses.tr: kutiba ʿalayhi ʾannahu man tawallāhu fa-annahu yuḍilluhu wayahdīhi ʾilā ʿadhābi as-saʿīri
verses.abdelhaleem: fated to lead astray those who take his side, and guide them to the suffering of the blazing flame.
verses.pickthall: For him it is decreed that whoso taketh him for friend, he verily will mislead him and will guide him to the punishment of the Flame.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍ مِّنَ ٱلْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ ۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا ۚ وَتَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنۢبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
verses.en: O people, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu ʾin kuntum fā raybin mmina al-baʿthi fa-innā khalaqnākum mmin turābin thumma min nnuṭfahin thumma min ʿalaqahin thumma min mmuḍghahin mmukhallaqahin waghayri mukhallaqahin llinubayyina lakum ۚ wanuqirru fā al-ʾarḥāmi mā nashāʾu ʾilā ʾajalin mmusammanā thumma nukhrijukum ṭiflan thumma litablughūā ʾashuddakum ۖ waminkum mman yutawaffā waminkum mman yuraddu ʾilā ʾardhali al-ʿumuri likaylā yaʿlama min baʿdi ʿilmin shayā ۚ watarā al-ʾarḍa hāmidahan fa-idhā ʾanzalnā ʿalayhā al-māʾa āhtazzat warabat wa-anbatat min kulli zawjin bahījin
verses.abdelhaleem: People, [remember,] if you doubt the Resurrection, that We created you from dust, then a drop of fluid, then a clinging form, then a lump of flesh, both shaped and unshaped: We mean to make Our power clear to you. Whatever We choose We cause to remain in the womb for an appointed time, then We bring you forth as infants and then you grow and reach maturity. Some die young and some are left to live on to such an age that they forget all they once knew. You sometimes see the earth lifeless, yet when We send down water it stirs and swells and produces every kind of joyous growth:
verses.pickthall: O mankind! if ye are in doubt concerning the Resurrection, then lo! We have created you from dust, then from a drop of seed, then from a clot, then from a little lump of flesh shapely and shapeless, that We may make (it) clear for you. And We cause what We will to remain in the wombs for an appointed time, and afterward We bring you forth as infants, then (give you growth) that ye attain your full strength. And among you there is he who dieth (young), and among you there is he who is brought back to the most abject time of life, so that, after knowledge, he knoweth naught. And thou (Muhammad) seest the earth barren, but when We send down water thereon, it doth thrill and swell and put forth every lovely kind (of growth).

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: That is because Allāh is the True Reality and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent
verses.tr: dhālika biʾanna Allāh huwa al-ḥaqqu wa-annahu yuḥāi al-mawtā wa-annahu ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: this is because God is the Truth; He brings the dead back to life; He has power over everything.
verses.pickthall: That is because Allah, He is the Truth and because He quickeneth the dead, and because He is Able to do all things;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.en: And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allāh will resurrect those in the graves.
verses.tr: wa-anna as-sāʿaha ātiyahun llā rayba fīhā wa-anna Allāh yabʿathu man fā al-qubūri
verses.abdelhaleem: There is no doubt that the Last Hour is bound to come, nor that God will raise the dead from their graves,
verses.pickthall: And because the Hour will come, there is no doubt thereof; and because Allah will raise those who are in the graves.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَـٰبٍ مُّنِيرٍ
verses.en: And of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from Him],
verses.tr: wamina an-nāsi man yujādilu fā Allāh bighayri ʿilmin walā hudanā walā kitābin mmunīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: yet still there are some who, with no knowledge or guidance or any book of enlightenment, argue about God,
verses.pickthall: And among mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah without knowledge or guidance or a scripture giving light,

verses.ar: ثَانِىَ عِطْفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ ۖ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.en: Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allāh. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],
verses.tr: thānāa ʿiṭfihi liyuḍilla ʿan sabīli Allāh ۖ lahu fā ad-dunyā khizāun ۖ wanudhīquhu yawma al-qiyāmahi ʿadhāba al-ḥarīqi
verses.abdelhaleem: turning scornfully aside to lead others away from God’s path. Disgrace in this world awaits such a person and, on the Day of Resurrection, We shall make him taste the suffering of the Fire.
verses.pickthall: Turning away in pride to beguile (men) from the way of Allah. For him in this world is ignominy, and on the Day of Resurrection We make him taste the doom of burning.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.en: "That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
verses.tr: dhālika bimā qaddamat yadāka wa-anna Allāh laysa biẓallāmin llilʿabīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: [It will be said], ‘This is for what you have stored up with your own hands: God is never unjust to His creatures.’
verses.pickthall: (And unto him it will be said): This is for that which thy two hands have sent before, and because Allah is no oppressor of His slaves.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعْبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍ ۖ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيْرٌ ٱطْمَأَنَّ بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: And of the people is he who worships Allāh on an edge. If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to unbelief]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss.
verses.tr: wamina an-nāsi man yaʿbudu Allāh ʿalā ḥarfin ۖ fa-in ʾaṣābahu khayrun āṭmaʾanna bihi ۖ wa-in ʾaṣābathu fitnahun ānqalaba ʿalā wajhihi khasira ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhiraha ۚ dhālika huwa al-khusrānu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: There are also some who serve God with unsteady faith: if something good comes their way, they are satisfied, but if they are tested, they revert to their old ways, losing both this world and the next- that is the clearest loss.
verses.pickthall: And among mankind is he who worshippeth Allah upon a narrow marge so that if good befalleth him he is content therewith, but if a trial befalleth him, he falleth away utterly. He loseth both the world and the Hereafter. That is the sheer loss.

verses.ar: يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُۥ وَمَا لَا يَنفَعُهُۥ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَـٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ
verses.en: He invokes instead of Allāh that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error.
verses.tr: yadʿūā min dūni Allāh mā lā yaḍurruhu wamā lā yanfaʿuhu ۚ dhālika huwa aḍ-ḍalālu al-baʿīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: Instead of God, they call upon what can neither harm nor help them- that is straying far away-
verses.pickthall: He calleth, beside Allah, unto that which hurteth him not nor benefiteth him. That is the far error.

verses.ar: يَدْعُوا۟ لَمَن ضَرُّهُۥٓ أَقْرَبُ مِن نَّفْعِهِۦ ۚ لَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْعَشِيرُ
verses.en: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.
verses.tr: yadʿūā laman ḍarruhu ʾaqrabu min nnafʿihi ۚ labiʾsa al-mawlā walabiʾsa al-ʿashīru
verses.abdelhaleem: or invoke one whose harm is closer than his help: an evil master and an evil companion.
verses.pickthall: He calleth unto him whose harm is nearer than his benefit; verily an evil patron and verily an evil friend!

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, Allāh does what He intends.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh yudkhilu adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru ۚ ʾinna Allāh yafʿalu mā yurīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: But God will admit those who believe and do good deeds to Gardens graced with flowing streams. God does whatever He wishes.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah causeth those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow. Lo! Allah doth what He intendeth.

verses.ar: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُ
verses.en: Whoever should think that Allāh will not support him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] in this world and the Hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath], and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]?
verses.tr: man kāna yaẓunnu ʾan llan yanṣurahu Allāh fā ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhirahi falyamdud bisababin ʾilā as-samāʾi thumma lyaqṭaʿ falyanẓur hal yudhhibanna kayduhu mā yaghīẓu
verses.abdelhaleem: Anyone who thinks that God will not support him in this world and the next should stretch a rope up to the sky, climb all the way up it, and see whether this strategy removes the cause of his anger.
verses.pickthall: Whoso is wont to think (through envy) that Allah will not give him (Muhammad) victory in the world and the Hereafter (and is enraged at the thought of his victory), let him stretch a rope up to the roof (of his dwelling), and let him hang himself. Then let him see whether his strategy dispelleth that whereat he rageth!.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يُرِيدُ
verses.en: And thus have We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down as verses of clear evidence and because Allāh guides whom He intends.
verses.tr: wakadhālika ʾanzalnāhu āyātin bayyinātin wa-anna Allāh yahdā man yurīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way, We send the Quran down as clear messages, and God guides whoever He will.
verses.pickthall: Thus We reveal it as plain revelations, and verily Allah guideth whom He will.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّـٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ وَٱلْمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allāh - Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, over all things, Witness.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā wa-adh-dhīna hādūā wa-aṣ-ṣābīna wa-an-naṣārā wa-l-majūsa wa-adh-dhīna ʾashrakūā ʾinna Allāh yafṣilu baynahum yawma al-qiyāmahi ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin shahīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: As for the believers, those who follow the Jewish faith, the Sabians, the Christians, the Magians, and the idolaters, God will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection; God witnesses all things.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who believe (this revelation), and those who are Jews, and the Sabaeans and the Christians and the Magians and the idolaters - Lo! Allah will decide between them on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! Allah is Witness over all things.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ وَٱلنُّجُومُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ وَٱلدَّوَآبُّ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ وَمَن يُهِنِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّكْرِمٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۩
verses.en: Do you not see [i.e., know] that to Allāh prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified. And he whom Allāh humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allāh does what He wills.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna Allāh yasjudu lahu man fā as-samāwāti waman fā al-ʾarḍi wa-ash-shamsu wa-l-qamaru wa-an-nujūmu wa-l-jibālu wa-ash-shajaru wa-ad-dawābbu wakathīrun mmina an-nāsi ۖ wakathīrun ḥaqqa ʿalayhi al-ʿadhābu ۗ waman yuhini Allāh famā lahu min mmukrimin ۚ ʾinna Allāh yafʿalu mā yashāʾu ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you not realize [Prophet] that everything in the heavens and earth submits to God: the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, and the animals? So do many human beings, though for many others punishment is well deserved. Anyone disgraced by God will have no one to honour him: God does whatever He will.
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen that unto Allah payeth adoration whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is in the earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the hills, and the trees, and the beasts, and many of mankind, while there are many unto whom the doom is justly due. He whom Allah scorneth, there is none to give him honour. Lo! Allah doeth what He will.

verses.ar: ۞ هَـٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ ٱخْتَصَمُوا۟ فِى رَبِّهِمْ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِّن نَّارٍ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيمُ
verses.en: These are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water
verses.tr: ۞ hādhāni khaṣmāni ākhtaṣamūā fā rabbihim ۖ fa-adh-dhīna kafarūā quṭṭiʿat lahum thiyābun mmin nnārin yuṣabbu min fawqi ruʾūsihimu al-ḥamīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: These two kinds of people disagree about their Lord. Garments of fire will be tailored for those who disbelieve; scalding water will be poured over their heads,
verses.pickthall: These twain (the believers and the disbelievers) are two opponents who contend concerning their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, garments of fire will be cut out for them; boiling fluid will be poured down on their heads,

verses.ar: يُصْهَرُ بِهِۦ مَا فِى بُطُونِهِمْ وَٱلْجُلُودُ
verses.en: By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.
verses.tr: yuṣharu bihi mā fā buṭūnihim wa-l-julūdu
verses.abdelhaleem: melting their insides as well as their skins;
verses.pickthall: Whereby that which is in their bellies, and their skins too, will be melted;

verses.ar: وَلَهُم مَّقَـٰمِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ
verses.en: And for [striking] them are maces of iron.
verses.tr: walahum mmaqāmiʿu min ḥadīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: there will be iron crooks to restrain them;
verses.pickthall: And for them are hooked rods of iron.

verses.ar: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.en: Every time they want to get out of it [i.e., Hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"
verses.tr: kullamā ʾarādūā ʾan yakhrujūā minhā min ghammin ʾuʿīdūā fīhā wadhūqūā ʿadhāba al-ḥarīqi
verses.abdelhaleem: whenever, in their anguish, they try to escape, they will be pushed back in and told, ‘Taste the suffering of the Fire.’
verses.pickthall: Whenever, in their anguish, they would go forth from thence they are driven back therein and (it is said unto them): Taste the doom of burning.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh yudkhilu adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru yuḥallawna fīhā min ʾasāwira min dhahabin waluʾluʾan ۖ walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: But God will admit those who believe and do good deeds to Gardens graced with flowing streams; there they will be adorned with golden bracelets and pearls; there they will have silken garments.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah will cause those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will be allowed armlets of gold, and pearls, and their raiment therein will be silk.

verses.ar: وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verses.en: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: wahudūā ʾilā aṭ-ṭayyibi mina al-qawli wahudūā ʾilā ṣirāṭi al-ḥamīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: They were guided to good speech and to the path of the One Worthy of all Praise.
verses.pickthall: They are guided unto gentle speech; they are guided unto the path of the Glorious One.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلْنَـٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءً ٱلْعَـٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَٱلْبَادِ ۚ وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍۭ بِظُلْمٍ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allāh and [from] al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside - and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] by wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli Allāh wa-l-masjidi al-ḥarāmi adh-dhā jaʿalnāhu lilnnāsi sawāʾan al-ʿākifu fīhi wa-l-bādi ۚ waman yurid fīhi bi-ādin biẓulmin nnudhiqhu min ʿadhābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: As for the disbelievers, who bar others from God’s path and from the Sacred Mosque- which We made for all people, residents and visitors alike- and who try to violate it with wrongdoing, We shall make them taste a painful punishment.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve and bar (men) from the way of Allah and from the Inviolable Place of Worship, which We have appointed for mankind together, the dweller therein and the nomad: whosoever seeketh wrongful partiality therein, him We shall cause to taste a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ ٱلْبَيْتِ أَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِى شَيْـًٔا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْقَآئِمِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.
verses.tr: wa-idh bawwaʾnā liʾibrāhīma makāna al-bayti ʾan llā tushrik bā shayā waṭahhir baytāa lilṭṭāʾifīna wa-l-qāʾimīna wa-ar-rukkaʿi as-sujūdi
verses.abdelhaleem: We showed Abraham the site of the House, saying, ‘Do not assign partners to Me. Purify My House for those who circle around it, those who stand to pray, and those who bow and prostrate themselves.
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when We prepared for Abraham the place of the (holy) House, saying: Ascribe thou no thing as partner unto Me, and purify My House for those who make the round (thereof) and those who stand and those who bow and make prostration.

verses.ar: وَأَذِّن فِى ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ
verses.en: And proclaim to the people the ḥajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -
verses.tr: wa-adhin fā an-nāsi bi-l-ḥajji yaʾtūka rijālan waʿalā kulli ḍāmirin yaʾtīna min kulli fajjin ʿamīqin
verses.abdelhaleem: Proclaim the Pilgrimage to all people. They will come to you on foot and on every kind of swift mount, emerging from every deep mountain pass
verses.pickthall: And proclaim unto mankind the pilgrimage. They will come unto thee on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every deep ravine,

verses.ar: لِّيَشْهَدُوا۟ مَنَـٰفِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ مَّعْلُومَـٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْبَآئِسَ ٱلْفَقِيرَ
verses.en: That they may witness [i.e., attend] benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allāh on known [i.e., specific] days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.
verses.tr: lliyashhadūā manāfiʿa lahum wayadhkurūā āsma Allāh fā ʾayyāmin mmaʿlūmātin ʿalā mā razaqahum mmin bahīmahi al-ʾanʿāmi ۖ fakulūā minhā wa-aṭʿimūā al-bāʾisa al-faqīra
verses.abdelhaleem: to attain benefits and celebrate God’s name, on specified days, over the livestock He has provided for them- feed yourselves and the poor and unfortunate-
verses.pickthall: That they may witness things that are of benefit to them, and mention the name of Allah on appointed days over the beast of cattle that He hath bestowed upon them. Then eat thereof and feed therewith the poor unfortunate.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا۟ تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا۟ نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا۟ بِٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ
verses.en: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform ṭawāf around the ancient House."
verses.tr: thumma lyaqḍūā tafathahum walyūfūā nudhūrahum walyaṭṭawwafūā bi-l-bayti al-ʿatīqi
verses.abdelhaleem: so let the pilgrims perform their acts of cleansing, fulfil their vows, and circle around the Ancient House.’
verses.pickthall: Then let them make an end of their unkemptness and pay their vows and go around the ancient House.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ وَأُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلرِّجْسَ مِنَ ٱلْأَوْثَـٰنِ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ قَوْلَ ٱلزُّورِ
verses.en: That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allāh - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,
verses.tr: dhālika waman yuʿaẓẓim ḥurumāti Allāh fahuwa khayrun llahu ʿinda rabbihi ۗ wa-uḥillat lakumu al-ʾanʿāmu ʾillā mā yutlā ʿalaykum ۖ fājtanibūā ar-rijsa mina al-ʾawthāni wājtanibūā qawla az-zūri
verses.abdelhaleem: All this [is ordained by God]: anyone who honours the sacred ordinances of God will have good rewards from his Lord. Livestock have been made lawful to you, except for what has been explicitly forbidden. Shun the filth of idolatrous beliefs and practices and shun false utterances.
verses.pickthall: That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the sacred things of Allah, it will be well for him in the sight of his Lord. The cattle are lawful unto you save that which hath been told you. So shun the filth of idols, and shun lying speech,

verses.ar: حُنَفَآءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ ٱلطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِى بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ
verses.en: Inclining [only] to Allāh, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allāh - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.
verses.tr: ḥunafāʾa lillāh ghayra mushrikīna bihi ۚ waman yushrik billāh fakaʾannamā kharra mina as-samāʾi fatakhṭafuhu aṭ-ṭayru ʾaw tahwā bihi ar-rīḥu fā makānin saḥīqin
verses.abdelhaleem: Devote yourselves to God and assign Him no partners, for the person who does so is like someone who has been hurled down from the skies and snatched up by the birds or flung to a distant place by the wind.
verses.pickthall: Turning unto Allah (only), not ascribing partners unto Him; for whoso ascribeth partners unto Allah, it is as if he had fallen from the sky and the birds had snatched him or the wind had blown him to a far-off place.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَـٰٓئِرَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى ٱلْقُلُوبِ
verses.en: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.
verses.tr: dhālika waman yuʿaẓẓim shaʿāʾira Allāh fa-innahā min taqwā al-qulūbi
verses.abdelhaleem: All this [is ordained by God]: those who honour God’s rites show the piety of their hearts.
verses.pickthall: That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the offerings consecrated to Allah, it surely is from devotion of the hearts,

verses.ar: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَى ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ
verses.en: For you therein [i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice] are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.
verses.tr: lakum fīhā manāfiʿu ʾilā ʾajalin mmusammanā thumma maḥilluhā ʾilā al-bayti al-ʿatīqi
verses.abdelhaleem: Live-stock are useful to you until the set time. Then their place of sacrifice is near the Ancient House:
verses.pickthall: Therein are benefits for you for an appointed term; and afterward they are brought for sacrifice unto the ancient House.

verses.ar: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا لِّيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۗ فَإِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُخْبِتِينَ
verses.en: And for every [religious] community We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of Allāh over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muḥammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]
verses.tr: walikulli ʾummahin jaʿalnā mansakan lliyadhkurūā āsma Allāh ʿalā mā razaqahum mmin bahīmahi al-ʾanʿāmi ۗ fa-ʾilāhukum ʾilāhun wāḥidun falahu ʾaslimūā ۗ wabashiri al-mukhbitīna
