verses.abdelhaleem: We appointed acts of devotion for every community, for them to celebrate God’s name over the livestock He provided for them: your God is One, so devote yourselves to Him. [Prophet], give good news to the humble
verses.pickthall: And for every nation have We appointed a ritual, that they may mention the name of Allah over the beast of cattle that He hath given them for food; and your god is One God, therefor surrender unto Him. And give good tidings (O Muhammad) to the humble,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ وَٱلْمُقِيمِى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.en: Who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ʾidhā dhukira Allāh wajilat qulūbuhum wa-aṣ-ṣābirīna ʿalā mā ʾaṣābahum wa-l-muqīmā aṣ-ṣalawāhi wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: whose hearts fill with awe whenever God is mentioned, who endure whatever happens to them with patience, who keep up the prayer, who give to others out of Our provision to them.
verses.pickthall: Whose hearts fear when Allah is mentioned, and the patient of whatever may befall them, and those who establish worship and who spend of that We have bestowed on them.

verses.ar: وَٱلْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَـٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَـٰٓئِرِ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَآفَّ ۖ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْقَانِعَ وَٱلْمُعْتَرَّ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَـٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols [i.e., rites] of Allāh; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allāh upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy [who does not seek aid] and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful.
verses.tr: wa-l-budna jaʿalnāhā lakum mmin shaʿāʾiri Allāh lakum fīhā khayrun ۖ fādhkurūā āsma Allāh ʿalayhā ṣawāffa ۖ fa-idhā wajabat junūbuhā fakulūā minhā wa-aṭʿimūā al-qāniʿa wa-l-muʿtarra ۚ kadhālika sakharnāhā lakum laʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have made camels part of God’s sacred rites for you. There is much good in them for you, so invoke God’s name over them as they are lined up for sacrifice, then, when they have fallen down dead, feed yourselves and those who do not ask, as well as those who do. We have subjected them to you in this way so that you may be thankful.
verses.pickthall: And the camels! We have appointed them among the ceremonies of Allah. Therein ye have much good. So mention the name of Allah over them when they are drawn up in lines. Then when their flanks fall (dead), eat thereof and feed the beggar and the suppliant. Thus have We made them subject unto you, that haply ye may give thanks.

verses.ar: لَن يَنَالَ ٱللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَـٰكِن يَنَالُهُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Their meat will not reach Allāh, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allāh for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.
verses.tr: lan yanāla Allāh luḥūmuhā walā dimāʾuhā walākin yanāluhu at-taqwā minkum ۚ kadhālika sakharahā lakum litukabbirūā Allāh ʿalā mā hadākum ۗ wabashiri al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is neither their meat nor their blood that reaches God but your piety. He has subjected them to you in this way so that you may glorify God for having guided you. Give good news to those who do good:
verses.pickthall: Their flesh and their food reach not Allah, but the devotion from you reacheth Him. Thus have We made them subject unto you that ye may magnify Allah that He hath guided you. And give good tidings (O Muhammad) to the good.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinna Allāh yudāfiʿu ʿani adh-dhīna āmanūā ۗ ʾinna Allāh lā yuḥibbu kulla khawwānin kafūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: God will defend the believers; God does not love the unfaithful or the ungrateful.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah defendeth those who are true. Lo! Allah loveth not each treacherous ingrate.

verses.ar: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا۟ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allāh is competent to give them victory.
verses.tr: ʾudhina lilladhīna yuqātalūna biʾannahum ẓulimūā ۚ wa-inna Allāh ʿalā naṣrihim laqadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who have been attacked are permitted to take up arms because they have been wronged- God has the power to help them-
verses.pickthall: Sanction is given unto those who fight because they have been wronged; and Allah is indeed Able to give them victory;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوَٰتٌ وَمَسَـٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًا ۗ وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
verses.en: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allāh." And were it not that Allāh checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allāh is much mentioned [i.e., praised]. And Allāh will surely support those who support Him [i.e., His cause]. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ʾukhrijūā min diyārihim bighayri ḥaqqin ʾillā ʾan yaqūlūā rabbunā Allāh ۗ walawlā dafʿu Allāh an-nāsa baʿḍahum bibaʿḍin llahuddimat ṣawāmiʿu wabiyaʿun waṣalawātun wamasājidu yudhkaru fīhā āsmu Allāh kathīran ۗ walayanṣuranna Allāh man yanṣuruhu ۗ ʾinna Allāh laqawāun ʿazīzun
verses.abdelhaleem: those who have been driven unjustly from their homes only for saying, ‘Our Lord is God.’ If God did not repel some people by means of others, many monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques, where God’s name is much invoked, would have been destroyed. God is sure to help those who help His cause- God is strong and mighty-
verses.pickthall: Those who have been driven from their homes unjustly only because they said: Our Lord is Allah - For had it not been for Allah's repelling some men by means of others, cloisters and churches and oratories and mosques, wherein the name of Allah is oft mentioned, would assuredly have been pulled down. Verily Allah helpeth one who helpeth Him. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty -

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا۟ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا۟ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ
verses.en: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakāh and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allāh belongs the outcome of [all] matters.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ʾin mmakkannāhum fā al-ʾarḍi ʾaqāmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha watawā az-zakawāha wa-amarūā bi-l-maʿrūfi wanahawā ʿani al-munkari ۗ wa-lillāh ʿāqibahu al-ʾumūri
verses.abdelhaleem: those who, when We establish them in the land, keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, command what is right, and forbid what is wrong: God controls the outcome of all events.
verses.pickthall: Those who, if We give them power in the land, establish worship and pay the poor-due and enjoin kindness and forbid iniquity. And Allah's is the sequel of events.

verses.ar: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَثَمُودُ
verses.en: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets],
verses.tr: wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wathamūdu
verses.abdelhaleem: If they reject you [Prophet], so did the people of Noah before them, and those of Ad, Thamud,
verses.pickthall: If they deny thee (Muhammad), even so the folk of Noah, and (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, before thee, denied (Our messengers);

verses.ar: وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ
verses.en: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot.
verses.tr: waqawmu ʾibrāhīma waqawmu lūṭin
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham, Lot,
verses.pickthall: And the folk of Abraham and the folk of Lot;

verses.ar: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ مَدْيَنَ ۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.en: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
verses.tr: wa-aṣḥābu madyana ۖ wakudhiba mūsā fa-amlaytu lilkāfirīna thumma ʾakhadhtuhum ۖ fakayfa kāna nakīri
verses.abdelhaleem: Midian. Moses too was called a liar. I gave the disbelievers time, but in the end I punished them. How I condemned them!
verses.pickthall: (And) the dwellers in Midian. And Moses was denied; but I indulged the disbelievers a long while, then I seized them, and how (terrible) was My abhorrence!

verses.ar: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَّشِيدٍ
verses.en: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.
verses.tr: fakaʾayyin mmin qaryahin ʾahlaknāhā wahāa ẓālimahun fahāa khāwiyahun ʿalā ʿurūshihā wabiʾrin mmuʿaṭṭalahin waqaṣrin mmashīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: How many towns steeped in wrongdoing We have destroyed and left in total ruin; how many deserted wells; how many lofty palaces!
verses.pickthall: How many a township have We destroyed while it was sinful, so that it lieth (to this day) in ruins, and (how many) a deserted well and lofty tower!

verses.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا ۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ وَلَـٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.
verses.tr: ʾafalam yasīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fatakūna lahum qulūbun yaʿqilūna bihā ʾaw ādhānun yasmaʿūna bihā ۖ fa-innahā lā taʿmā al-ʾabṣāru walākin taʿmā al-qulūbu at-tā fā aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: Have these people [of Mecca] not travelled through the land with hearts to understand and ears to hear? It is not people’s eyes that are blind, but their hearts within their breasts.
verses.pickthall: Have they not travelled in the land, and have they hearts wherewith to feel and ears wherewith to hear? For indeed it is not the eyes that grow blind, but it is the hearts, which are within the bosoms, that grow blind.

verses.ar: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ ۚ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
verses.en: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allāh will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.
verses.tr: wayastaʿjilūnaka bi-l-ʿadhābi walan yukhlifa Allāh waʿdahu ۚ wa-inna yawman ʿinda rabbika ka-ʾalfi sanahin mmimmā taʿuddūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will challenge you [Prophet] to hasten the punishment. God will not fail in His promise- a Day with your Lord is like a thousand years by your reckoning.
verses.pickthall: And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon.

verses.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.
verses.tr: wakaʾayyin mmin qaryahin ʾamlaytu lahā wahāa ẓālimahun thumma ʾakhadhtuhā wa-ʾilāa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: To many a town steeped in wrongdoing I gave more time and then struck them down: they all return to Me in the end.
verses.pickthall: And how many a township did I suffer long though it was sinful! Then I grasped it. Unto Me is the return.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."
verses.tr: qul yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu ʾinnamā ʾanā lakum nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘People, I am sent only to give you clear warning.’
verses.pickthall: Say: O mankind! I am only a plain warner unto you.

verses.ar: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
verses.tr: fa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum mmaghfirahun warizqun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who believe and do good deeds will be forgiven and have a generous reward,
verses.pickthall: Those who believe and do good works, for them is pardon and a rich provision;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْا۟ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna saʿawā fā āyātinā muʿājizīna ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: but those who strive to oppose Our messages and try in vain to defeat Us are destined for the Blaze.
verses.pickthall: While those who strive to thwart Our revelations, such are rightful owners of the Fire.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allāh abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allāh makes precise His verses. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnā min qablika min rrasūlin walā nabāin ʾillā ʾidhā tamannā ʾalqā ash-shayṭānu fā ʾumniyyatihi fayansakhu Allāh mā yulqā ash-shayṭānu thumma yuḥkimu Allāh āyātihi ۗ wallāh ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: We have never sent any messenger or prophet before you [Muhammad] into whose wishes Satan did not insinuate something, but God removes what Satan insinuates and then God affirms His message. God is all knowing and wise:
verses.pickthall: Never sent We a messenger or a prophet before thee but when He recited (the message) Satan proposed (opposition) in respect of that which he recited thereof. But Allah abolisheth that which Satan proposeth. Then Allah establisheth His revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise;

verses.ar: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.en: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in [i.e., asserts] a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
verses.tr: lliyajʿala mā yulqā ash-shayṭānu fitnahan llilladhīna fā qulūbihim mmaraḍun wa-l-qāsiyahi qulūbuhum ۗ wa-inna aẓ-ẓālimīna lafā shiqāqin baʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: He makes Satan’s insinuations a temptation only for the sick at heart and those whose hearts are hardened- the evildoers are profoundly opposed [to the Truth]-
verses.pickthall: That He may make that which the devil proposeth a temptation for those in whose hearts is a disease, and those whose hearts are hardened - Lo! the evil-doers are in open schism -

verses.ar: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allāh the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.
verses.tr: waliyaʿlama adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-ʿilma ʾannahu al-ḥaqqu min rrabbika fayuʾminūā bihi fatukhbita lahu qulūbuhum ۗ wa-inna Allāh lahādi adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾilā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: and He causes those given knowledge to realize that this Revelation is your Lord’s Truth, so that they may believe in it and humble their hearts to Him: God guides the faithful to the straight path.
verses.pickthall: And that those who have been given knowledge may know that it is the truth from thy Lord, so that they may believe therein and their hearts may submit humbly unto Him. Lo! Allah verily is guiding those who believe unto a right path.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ
verses.en: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.
verses.tr: walā yazālu adh-dhīna kafarūā fā miryahin mminhu ḥattā taʾtiyahumu as-sāʿahu baghtahan ʾaw yaʾtiyahum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers will remain in doubt about it until the Hour suddenly overpowers them or until torment descends on them on a Day devoid of all hope.
verses.pickthall: And those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt thereof until the Hour come upon them unawares, or there come unto them the doom of a disastrous day.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allāh; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.
verses.tr: al-mulku yawmaʾidhin lillāh yaḥkumu baynahum ۚ fa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti fā jannāti an-naʿīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day control will belong to God: He will judge between them. Those who believe and do good deeds will be admitted to Gardens of Delight,
verses.pickthall: The Sovereignty on that day will be Allah's, He will judge between them. Then those who believed and did good works will be in Gardens of Delight,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.en: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā wakadhabūā bāyātinā fa-ūlāʾika lahum ʿadhābun mmuhīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: while those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations will receive a humiliating torment.
verses.pickthall: While those who disbelieved and denied Our revelations, for them will be a shameful doom.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓا۟ أَوْ مَاتُوا۟ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.en: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allāh and then were killed or died - Allāh will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allāh who is the best of providers.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hājarūā fā sabīli Allāh thumma qutilūā ʾaw mātūā layarzuqannahumu Allāh rizqan ḥasanan ۚ wa-inna Allāh lahuwa khayru ar-rāziqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He will give a generous provision to those who migrated in God’s way and were killed or died. He is the Best Provider.
verses.pickthall: Those who fled their homes for the cause of Allah and then were slain or died, Allah verily will provide for them a good provision. Lo! Allah, He verily is Best of all who make provision.

verses.ar: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًا يَرْضَوْنَهُۥ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.en: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.
verses.tr: layudkhilannahum mmudkhalan yarḍawnahu ۗ wa-inna Allāh laʿalīmun ḥalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: He will admit them to a place that will please them: God is all knowing and most forbearing.
verses.pickthall: Assuredly He will cause them to enter by an entry that they will love. Lo! Allah verily is Knower, Indulgent.

verses.ar: ۞ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
verses.en: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.
verses.tr: ۞ dhālika waman ʿāqaba bimithli mā ʿūqiba bihi thumma bughāa ʿalayhi layanṣurannahu Allāh ۗ ʾinna Allāh laʿafuwwun ghafūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: So it will be. God will help those who retaliate against an aggressive act merely with its like and are then wronged again: God is pardoning and most forgiving.
verses.pickthall: That (is so). And whoso hath retaliated with the like of that which he was made to suffer and then hath (again) been wronged, Allah will succour him. Lo! Allah verily is Mild, Forgiving.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: That is because Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾanna Allāh yūliju al-yla fā an-nahāri wayūliju an-nahāra fā al-yli wa-anna Allāh samīʿun baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: So it will be, because God makes night pass into day, and day into night, and He is all hearing and all seeing.
verses.pickthall: That is because Allah maketh the night to pass into the day and maketh the day to pass into the night, and because Allah is Hearer, Seer.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.en: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾanna Allāh huwa al-ḥaqqu wa-anna mā yadʿūna min dūnihi huwa al-bāṭilu wa-anna Allāh huwa al-ʿalāu al-kabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: So it will be, because it is God alone who is the Truth, and whatever else they invoke is sheer falsehood: it is God who is the Most High, the Most Great.
verses.pickthall: That is because Allah, He is the True, and that whereon they call instead of Him, it is the false, and because Allah, He is the High, the Great.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَتُصْبِحُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: Do you not see that Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allāh is Subtle and Aware.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna Allāh ʾanzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan fatuṣbiḥu al-ʾarḍu mukhḍarrahan ۗ ʾinna Allāh laṭīfun khabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you [Prophet] not considered how God sends water down from the sky and the next morning the earth becomes green? God is truly most subtle, all aware;
verses.pickthall: Seest thou not how Allah sendeth down water from the sky and then the earth becometh green upon the morrow? Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.

verses.ar: لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: llahu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۗ wa-inna Allāh lahuwa al-ghanāu al-ḥamīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Him; God alone is self-sufficient, worthy of all praise.
verses.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Lo! Allah, He verily is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَيُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Do you not see that Allāh has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allāh, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna Allāh sakhara lakum mmā fā al-ʾarḍi wa-l-fulka tajrā fā al-baḥri biʾamrihi wayumsiku as-samāʾa ʾan taqaʿa ʿalā al-ʾarḍi ʾillā biʾidhnihi ۗ ʾinna Allāh bi-an-nāsi laraʾūfun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you not considered how God has made everything on the earth of service to you? That ships sail the sea at His command? That He keeps the heavens from falling down on the earth without His permission? God is most compassionate and most merciful to mankind-
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath made all that is in the earth subservient unto you? And the ship runneth upon the sea by His command, and He holdeth back the heaven from falling on the earth unless by His leave. Lo! Allah is, for mankind, Full of Pity, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ
verses.en: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā ʾaḥyākum thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥyīkum ۗ ʾinna al-ʾinsāna lakafūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who gave you [people] life, will cause you to die, then will give you life again- but man is ungrateful.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who gave you life, then He will cause you to die, and then will give you life (again). Lo! man is verily an ingrate.

verses.ar: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ۖ فَلَا يُنَـٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۚ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: For every [religious] community We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muḥammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite [them] to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.
verses.tr: llikulli ʾummahin jaʿalnā mansakan hum nāsikūhu ۖ falā yunāziʿunnaka fā al-ʾamri ۚ wādʿu ʾilā rabbika ۖ ʾinnaka laʿalā hudanā mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have appointed acts of devotion for every community to observe, so do not let them argue with you [Prophet] about this matter. Call them to your Lord- you are on the right path-
verses.pickthall: Unto each nation have We given sacred rites which they are to perform; so let them not dispute with thee of the matter, but summon thou unto thy Lord. Lo! thou indeed followest right guidance.

verses.ar: وَإِن جَـٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allāh is most knowing of what you do.
verses.tr: wa-in jādalūka faquli Allāh ʾaʿlamu bimā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and if they argue with you, say, ‘God is well aware of what you are doing.’
verses.pickthall: And if they wrangle with thee, say: Allah is Best Aware of what ye do.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: Allāh will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
verses.tr: Allāh yaḥkumu baynakum yawma al-qiyāmahi fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day of Resurrection, God will judge between you regarding your differences.
verses.pickthall: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein ye used to differ.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَـٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verses.en: Do you not know that Allāh knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.
verses.tr: ʾalam taʿlam ʾanna Allāh yaʿlamu mā fā as-samāʾi wa-l-ʾarḍi ۗ ʾinna dhālika fā kitābin ۚ ʾinna dhālika ʿalā Allāh yasīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Are you [Prophet] not aware that God knows all that is in the heavens and earth? All this is written in a Record; this is easy for God.
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not known that Allah knoweth all that is in the heaven and the earth? Lo! it is in a record. Lo! that is easy for Allah.

verses.ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَـٰنًا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
verses.en: And they worship besides Allāh that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.
verses.tr: wayaʿbudūna min dūni Allāh mā lam yunazzil bihi sulṭānan wamā laysa lahum bihi ʿilmun ۗ wamā lilẓẓālimīna min nnaṣīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet beside God they serve that for which He has sent no authority and of which they have no knowledge: the evildoers will have no one to help them.
verses.pickthall: And they worship instead of Allah that for which He hath sent down no warrant, and that whereof they have no knowledge. For evil-doers there is no helper.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا ۗ قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ۗ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allāh has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."
verses.tr: wa-idhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin taʿrifu fā wujūhi adh-dhīna kafarūā al-munkara ۖ yakādūna yasṭūna bi-adh-dhīna yatlūna ʿalayhim āyātinā ۗ qul ʾafaʾunabbiʾukum bisharrin mmin dhālikumu ۗ an-nāru waʿadahā Allāh adh-dhīna kafarūā ۖ wabiʾsa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], you can see the hostility on the faces of the disbelievers when Our messages are recited clearly to them: it is almost as if they are going to attack those who recite Our messages to them. Say, ‘Shall I tell you what is far worse than what you feel now? The Fire that God has promised the disbelievers! What a dismal end!’
verses.pickthall: And when Our revelations are recited unto them, thou knowest the denial in the faces of those who disbelieve; they all but attack those who recite Our revelations unto them. Say: Shall I proclaim unto you worse than that? The Fire! Allah hath promised it for those who disbelieve. A hapless journey's end!

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ
verses.en: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allāh will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for it [i.e., that purpose]. And if the fly should steal from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu ḍuriba mathalun fāstamiʿūā lahu ۚ ʾinna adh-dhīna tadʿūna min dūni Allāh lan yakhluqūā dhubāban walawi ājtamaʿūā lahu ۖ wa-in yaslubhumu adh-dhubābu shayā llā yastanqidhūhu minhu ۚ ḍaʿufa aṭ-ṭālibu wa-l-maṭlūbu
verses.abdelhaleem: People, here is an illustration, so listen carefully: those you call on beside God could not, even if they combined all their forces, create a fly, and if a fly took something away from them, they would not be able to retrieve it. How feeble are the petitioners and how feeble are those they petition!
verses.pickthall: O mankind! A similitude is coined, so pay ye heed to it: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah will never create a fly though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly took something from them, they could not rescue it from it. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought!

verses.ar: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
verses.en: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
verses.tr: mā qadarūā Allāh ḥaqqa qadrihi ۗ ʾinna Allāh laqawāun ʿazīzun
verses.abdelhaleem: They have no grasp of God’s true measure: God is truly most strong and mighty.
verses.pickthall: They measure not Allah His rightful measure. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: Allāh chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
verses.tr: Allāh yaṣṭafā mina al-malāʾikahi rusulan wamina an-nāsi ۚ ʾinna Allāh samīʿun baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: God chooses messengers from among the angels and from among men. God is all hearing, all seeing:
verses.pickthall: Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Seer.

verses.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.en: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allāh will be returned [all] matters.
verses.tr: yaʿlamu mā bayna ʾaydīhim wamā khalfahum ۗ wa-ʾilā Allāh turjaʿu al-ʾumūru
verses.abdelhaleem: He knows what lies before and behind them. All matters return to Him.
verses.pickthall: He knoweth all that is before them and all that is behind them, and unto Allah all things are returned. $$A

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱفْعَلُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۩
verses.en: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ārkaʿūā wāsjudūā wāʿbudūā rabbakum wāfʿalūā al-khayra laʿallakum tufliḥūna ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, bow down, prostrate yourselves, worship your Lord, and do good so that you may succeed.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, that haply ye may prosper.

verses.ar: وَجَـٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ ۚ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَـٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
verses.en: And strive for Allāh with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. He [i.e., Allāh] named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakāh and hold fast to Allāh. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
verses.tr: wajāhidūā fā Allāh ḥaqqa jihādihi ۚ huwa ājtabākum wamā jaʿala ʿalaykum fā ad-dīni min ḥarajin ۚ mmillaha ʾabīkum ʾibrāhīma ۚ huwa sammākumu al-muslimīna min qablu wafā hādhā liyakūna ar-rasūlu shahīdan ʿalaykum watakūnūā shuhadāʾa ʿalā an-nāsi ۚ fa-aqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha watūā az-zakawāha wāʿtaṣimūā billāh huwa mawlākum ۖ faniʿma al-mawlā waniʿma an-naṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Strive hard for God as is His due: He has chosen you and placed no hardship in your religion, the faith of your forefather Abraham. God has called you Muslims––both in the past and in this [message]––so that the Messenger can bear witness about you and so that you can bear witness about other people. So keep up the prayer, give the prescribed alms, and seek refuge in God: He is your protector––an excellent protector and an excellent helper.
verses.pickthall: And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper!

verses.ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
verses.tr: qad ʾaflaḥa al-muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [How] prosperous are the believers!
verses.pickthall: Successful indeed are the believers

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَـٰشِعُونَ
verses.en: They who are during their prayer humbly intent
verses.tr: adh-dhīna hum fā ṣalātihim khāshiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who pray humbly,
verses.pickthall: Who are humble in their prayers,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: And they who turn away from ill speech
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum ʿani al-laghwi muʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who shun idle talk,
verses.pickthall: And who shun vain conversation,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَـٰعِلُونَ
verses.en: And they who are observant of zakāh
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum lilzzakawāhi fāʿilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who pay the prescribed alms,
verses.pickthall: And who are payers of the poor-due;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
verses.en: And they who guard their private parts
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who guard their chastity
verses.pickthall: And who guard their modesty -

verses.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
verses.tr: ʾillā ʿalā ʾazwājihim ʾaw mā malakat ʾaymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna
verses.abdelhaleem: except with their spouses or their slaves––with these they are not to blame,
verses.pickthall: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy,

verses.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
verses.tr: famani ābtaghā warāʾa dhālika fa-ūlāʾika humu al-ʿādūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but anyone who seeks more than this is exceeding the limits––
verses.pickthall: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors -

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
verses.en: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum liʾamānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who are faithful to their trusts and pledges
verses.pickthall: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.en: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum ʿalā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and who keep up their prayers,
verses.pickthall: And who pay heed to their prayers.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.en: Those are the inheritors
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika humu al-wārithūna
verses.abdelhaleem: will rightly be given
verses.pickthall: These are the heirs

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yarithūna al-firdawsa hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Paradise as their own, there to remain.
verses.pickthall: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ
verses.en: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
verses.tr: walaqad khalaqnā al-ʾinsāna min sulālahin mmin ṭīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: We created man from an essence of clay,
verses.pickthall: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
verses.en: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
verses.tr: thumma jaʿalnāhu nuṭfahan fā qarārin mmakīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: then We placed him as a drop of fluid in a safe place,
verses.pickthall: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَـٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
verses.en: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.
verses.tr: thumma khalaqnā an-nuṭfaha ʿalaqahan fakhalaqnā al-ʿalaqaha muḍghahan fakhalaqnā al-muḍghaha ʿiẓāman fakasawnā al-ʿiẓāma laḥman thumma ʾanshaʾnāhu khalqan ākhara ۚ fatabāraka Allāh ʾaḥsanu al-khāliqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: then We made that drop into a clinging form, and We made that form into a lump of flesh, and We made that lump into bones, and We clothed those bones with flesh, and later We made him into other forms––glory be to God, the best of creators!––
verses.pickthall: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
verses.en: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
verses.tr: thumma ʾinnakum baʿda dhālika lamayyitūna
verses.abdelhaleem: then you will die
verses.pickthall: Then lo! after that ye surely die.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
verses.tr: thumma ʾinnakum yawma al-qiyāmahi tubʿathūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be raised up again.
verses.pickthall: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again).

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.en: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
verses.tr: walaqad khalaqnā fawqakum sabʿa ṭarāʾiqa wamā kunnā ʿani al-khalqi ghāfilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We created seven levels above you: We are never unmindful of Our creation.
verses.pickthall: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.

verses.ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّـٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.en: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
verses.tr: wa-anzalnā mina as-samāʾi māʾan biqadarin fa-askannāhu fā al-ʾarḍi ۖ wa-innā ʿalā dhahābin bihi laqādirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent water down from the sky in due measure and lodged it in the earth––We have the power to take it all away if We so wish––
verses.pickthall: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.

verses.ar: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
verses.tr: fa-anshaʾnā lakum bihi jannātin mmin nnakhīlin wa-aʿnābin llakum fīhā fawākihu kathīrahun waminhā taʾkulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: with it We produced for you gardens of date palms and vines, with many fruits there for you to eat,
verses.pickthall: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat;

verses.ar: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْـَٔاكِلِينَ
verses.en: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.
verses.tr: washajarahan takhruju min ṭūri saynāʾa tanbutu bi-ad-duhni waṣibghin llilākilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and a tree, growing out of Mount Sinai, that produces oil and seasoning for your food.
verses.pickthall: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
verses.tr: wa-inna lakum fā al-ʾanʿāmi laʿibrahan ۖ nnusqīkum mmimmā fā buṭūnihā walakum fīhā manāfiʿu kathīrahun waminhā taʾkulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There is a lesson for you in livestock: We produce milk for you to drink from their bellies. And they have many other benefits: you eat them
verses.pickthall: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat;

verses.ar: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
verses.tr: waʿalayhā waʿalā al-fulki tuḥmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and you ride on them, as you do in ships.
verses.pickthall: And on them and on the ship ye are carried.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā nūḥan ʾilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi āʿbudūā Allāh mā lakum mmin ʾilāhin ghayruhu ۖ ʾafalā tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Noah to his people. He said, ‘My people, serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
verses.pickthall: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?

verses.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allāh had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
verses.tr: faqāla al-malaā adh-dhīna kafarūā min qawmihi mā hādhā ʾillā basharun mmithlukum yurīdu ʾan yatafaḍḍala ʿalaykum walaw shāʾa Allāh laʾanzala malāʾikahan mmā samiʿnā bihādhā fā ābāʾinā al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But the leading disbelievers among his people said, ‘He is merely a mortal like you, trying to gain some superiority over you. God would have sent down angels if He had wished; besides, we never heard of anything like this from our forefathers.
verses.pickthall: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.

verses.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
verses.tr: ʾin huwa ʾillā rajulun bihi jinnahun fatarabbaṣūā bihi ḥattā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: He is just a madman, so let’s wait and see what happens to him.’
verses.pickthall: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.en: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ānṣurnā bimā kadhabūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Noah said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.

verses.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَـٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.en: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
verses.tr: fa-awḥaynā ʾilayhi ʾani āṣnaʿi al-fulka biʾaʿyuninā wawaḥyinā fa-idhā jāʾa ʾamrunā wafāra at-tannūru ۙ fāsluk fīhā min kullin zawjayni āthnayni wa-ahlaka ʾillā man sabaqa ʿalayhi al-qawlu minhum ۖ walā tukhāṭibnā fā adh-dhīna ẓalamūā ۖ ʾinnahum mmughraqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and so We revealed to him: ‘Build the Ark under Our watchful eye and according to Our revelation. When Our command comes and water gushes up out of the earth,take pairs of every species on board, and your family, except for those on whom the sentence has already been passed- do not plead with me for the evildoers: they will be drowned-
verses.pickthall: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allāh who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
verses.tr: fa-idhā āstawayta ʾanta waman mmaʿaka ʿalā al-fulki faquli al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhā najjānā mina al-qawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and when you and your companions are settled on the Ark, say, “Praise be to God, who delivered us from the wicked people,”
verses.pickthall: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!

verses.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
verses.en: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"
verses.tr: waqul rrabbi ʾanzilnā munzalan mmubārakan wa-anta khayru al-munzilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and say, “My Lord, let me land with Your blessing: it is You who provide the best landings”.’
verses.pickthall: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin wa-in kunnā lamubtalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There are signs in all this: We have always put [people] to the test.
verses.pickthall: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
verses.tr: thumma ʾanshaʾnā min baʿdihim qarnan ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then We raised another generation after them,
verses.pickthall: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;

verses.ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
verses.tr: fa-arsalnā fīhim rasūlan mminhum ʾani āʿbudūā Allāh mā lakum mmin ʾilāhin ghayruhu ۖ ʾafalā tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and sent one of their own as a messenger: ‘Serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
verses.pickthall: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
verses.en: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
verses.tr: waqāla al-malaʾu min qawmihi adh-dhīna kafarūā wakadhabūā biliqāʾi al-ākhirahi wa-atrafnāhum fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā mā hādhā ʾillā basharun mmithlukum yaʾkulu mimmā taʾkulūna minhu wayashrabu mimmā tashrabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But the leading disbelievers among his people, who denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, to whom We had granted ease and plenty in this life, said, ‘He is just a mortal like you- he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink-
verses.pickthall: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.

verses.ar: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
verses.tr: walaʾin ʾaṭaʿtum basharan mmithlakum ʾinnakum ʾidhan llakhāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and you will really be losers if you obey a mortal like yourselves.
verses.pickthall: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers.

verses.ar: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
verses.en: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
verses.tr: ʾayaʿidukum ʾannakum ʾidhā mittum wakuntum turāban waʿiẓāman ʾannakum mmukhrajūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How can he promise you that after you die and become dust and bones you will be brought out alive?
verses.pickthall: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth?

verses.ar: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
verses.tr: ۞ hayhāta hayhāta limā tūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What you are promised is very farfetched.
verses.pickthall: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised!

verses.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
verses.en: It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
verses.tr: ʾin hāa ʾillā ḥayātunā ad-dunyā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There is only the life of this world: we die, we live, but we will never be resurrected.
verses.pickthall: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).

verses.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allāh, and we will not believe him."
verses.tr: ʾin huwa ʾillā rajulun āftarā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban wamā naḥnu lahu bimuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He is just a man making lies up about God. We will never believe in him.’
verses.pickthall: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ānṣurnā bimā kadhabūni
verses.abdelhaleem: The prophet said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.

verses.ar: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَـٰدِمِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
verses.tr: qāla ʿammā qalīlin llayuṣbiḥunna nādimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and so God said, ‘Soon they will be filled with regret.’
verses.pickthall: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ غُثَآءً ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
verses.tr: fa-akhadhathumu aṣ-ṣayḥahu bi-l-ḥaqqi fajaʿalnāhum ghuthāʾan ۚ fabuʿdan llilqawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The blast justly struck them and We swept them away like scum. Away with the evildoers!
verses.pickthall: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk!

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Then We produced after them other generations.
verses.tr: thumma ʾanshaʾnā min baʿdihim qurūnan ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We raised other generations after them-
verses.pickthall: Then after them We brought forth other generations.

verses.ar: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.en: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
verses.tr: mā tasbiqu min ʾummahin ʾajalahā wamā yastakhirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: no community can advance or delay its time-
verses.pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
verses.tr: thumma ʾarsalnā rusulanā tatrā ۖ kulla mā jāʾa ʾummahan rrasūluhā kadhabūhu ۚ fa-atbaʿnā baʿḍahum baʿḍan wajaʿalnāhum ʾaḥādītha ۚ fabuʿdan lliqawmin llā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to a community they invariably called him a liar, so We destroyed them one after the other and made them into cautionary tales. Away with the disbelievers!
verses.pickthall: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
verses.tr: thumma ʾarsalnā mūsā wa-akhāhu hārūna bāyātinā wasulṭānin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our signs and clear authority,
verses.pickthall: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
verses.en: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
verses.tr: ʾilā firʿawna wamalaʾīhi fāstakbarūā wakānūā qawman ʿālīna
verses.abdelhaleem: to Pharaoh and his prominent leaders, but they responded with arrogance: they were a haughty people.
verses.pickthall: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk.

verses.ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَـٰبِدُونَ
verses.en: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
verses.tr: faqālūā ʾanuʾminu libasharayni mithlinā waqawmuhumā lanā ʿābidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Are we to believe in two mortals like us? And their people are our servants?’
verses.pickthall: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us?

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
verses.en: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
verses.tr: fakadhabūhumā fakānūā mina al-muhlakīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and so they called them both liars: they became another ruined people.
verses.pickthall: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā mūsā al-kitāba laʿallahum yahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave Moses the Scripture, so that they might be rightly guided.
verses.pickthall: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةً وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
verses.en: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā ābna maryama wa-ummahu āyahan wawaynāhumā ʾilā rabwahin dhāti qarārin wamaʿīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign; We gave them shelter on a peaceful hillside with flowing water.
verses.pickthall: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: [Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā ar-rusulu kulūā mina aṭ-ṭayyibāti wāʿmalūā ṣāliḥan ۖ ʾinnā bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Messengers, eat good things and do good deeds: I am well aware of what you do.
verses.pickthall: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.en: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
verses.tr: wa-inna hādhihi ʾummatukum ʾummahan wāḥidahan wa-anā rabbukum fāttaqūni
verses.abdelhaleem: This community of yours is one- and I am your Lord: be mindful of Me-
verses.pickthall: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me.

verses.ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
verses.en: But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
verses.tr: fataqaṭṭaʿūā ʾamrahum baynahum zuburan ۖ kullu ḥizbin bimā ladayhim fariḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but they have split their community into sects, each rejoicing in their own.
verses.pickthall: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets.

verses.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
verses.tr: fadharhum fā ghamratihim ḥattā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Muhammad] leave them for a while steeped [in their ignorance].
verses.pickthall: So leave them in their error till a time.

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ
verses.en: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
verses.tr: ʾayaḥsabūna ʾannamā numidduhum bihi min mmālin wabanīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they reckon that, by giving them wealth and sons,
verses.pickthall: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them

verses.ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
verses.tr: nusāriʿu lahum fā al-khayrāti ۚ bal llā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We race to give them good things? They really have no idea!
verses.pickthall: We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna hum mmin khashyahi rabbihim mmushfiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who stand in awe of their Lord,
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum bāyāti rabbihim yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who believe in His messages,
verses.pickthall: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum birabbihim lā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who do not ascribe partners to Him,
verses.pickthall: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.en: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yuʾtūna mā ātawā wwaqulūbuhum wajilahun ʾannahum ʾilā rabbihim rājiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who always give with hearts that tremble at the thought that they must return to Him,
verses.pickthall: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord,

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَـٰبِقُونَ
verses.en: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika yusāriʿūna fā al-khayrāti wahum lahā sābiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: are the ones who race toward good things, and they will be the first to get them.
verses.pickthall: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.

verses.ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَـٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
verses.tr: walā nukallifu nafsan ʾillā wusʿahā ۖ waladaynā kitābun yanṭiqu bi-l-ḥaqqi ۚ wahum lā yuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We do not burden any soul with more than it can bear- We have a Record that tells the truth- they will not be wronged.
verses.pickthall: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.

verses.ar: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَـٰمِلُونَ
verses.en: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,
verses.tr: bal qulūbuhum fā ghamrahin mmin hādhā walahum ʾaʿmālun mmin dūni dhālika hum lahā ʿāmilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But the disbelievers’ hearts are steeped [in ignorance of ] all this; and there are other things besides this that they do.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing;

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
verses.en: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allāh] for help.
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā ʾakhadhnā mutrafīhim bi-l-ʿadhābi ʾidhā hum yajrūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When We bring Our punishment on those corrupted with wealth, they will cry for help:
verses.pickthall: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate.

verses.ar: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
verses.tr: lā tajrūā al-yawma ۖ ʾinnakum mminnā lā tunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Do not cry out today: you will get no help from Us.
verses.pickthall: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us.

verses.ar: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
verses.en: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels.
verses.tr: qad kānat āyātā tutlā ʿalaykum fakuntum ʿalā ʾaʿqābikum tankiṣūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Time and time again My messages were recited to you, but you turned arrogantly on your heels,
verses.pickthall: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,

verses.ar: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَـٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ
verses.en: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
verses.tr: mustakbirīna bihi sāmiran tahjurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and spent the evening making fun of [the Quran].’
verses.pickthall: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together.

verses.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
verses.tr: ʾafalam yaddabbarūā al-qawla ʾam jāʾahum mmā lam yaʾti ābāʾahumu al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have they not contemplated the Word of God? Has something come to them that did not come to their forefathers?
verses.pickthall: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.en: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
verses.tr: ʾam lam yaʿrifūā rasūlahum fahum lahu munkirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not recognize their Messenger? So why do they reject him?
verses.pickthall: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him?

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
verses.en: Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
verses.tr: ʾam yaqūlūna bihi jinnahun ۚ bal jāʾahum bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-aktharuhum lilḥaqqi kārihūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why do they say he is possessed? He has brought them the truth and most of them hate it,
verses.pickthall: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.

verses.ar: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: But if the Truth [i.e., Allāh] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
verses.tr: walawi āttabaʿa al-ḥaqqu ʾahwāʾahum lafasadati as-samāwātu wa-l-ʾarḍu waman fīhinna ۚ bal ʾataynāhum bidhikrihim fahum ʿan dhikrihim mmuʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but if the truth were in accordance with their desires, the heavens, the earth, and everyone in them would disintegrate. We have brought them their Reminder and they turn away from it.
verses.pickthall: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.

verses.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.en: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
verses.tr: ʾam tasluhum kharjan fakharāju rabbika khayrun ۖ wahuwa khayru ar-rāziqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you [Prophet] ask them for any payment? Your Lord’s is the best payment: He is the Best of Providers.
verses.pickthall: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
verses.tr: wa-innaka latadʿūhum ʾilā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: You call them to a straight path
verses.pickthall: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَـٰكِبُونَ
verses.en: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
verses.tr: wa-inna adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi ʿani aṣ-ṣirāṭi lanākibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and those who do not believe in the Hereafter turn away from that path.
verses.pickthall: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path.

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَـٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.en: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
verses.tr: ۞ walaw raḥimnāhum wakashafnā mā bihim mmin ḍurrin llalajjūā fā ṭughyānihim yaʿmahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Even if We were to show them mercy and relieve them of distress, they would blindly persist in their transgression.
verses.pickthall: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
verses.en: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
verses.tr: walaqad ʾakhadhnāhum bi-l-ʿadhābi famā āstakānūā lirabbihim wamā yataḍarraʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have already afflicted them, yet they did not submit to their Lord: they will not humble themselves
verses.pickthall: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray,

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
verses.en: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban dhā ʿadhābin shadīdin ʾidhā hum fīhi mublisūna
verses.abdelhaleem: until We open a gate to severe torment for them- then they will be plunged into utter despair.
verses.pickthall: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā ʾanshaʾa lakumu as-samʿa wa-l-ʾabṣāra wa-l-ʾafdaha ۚ qalīlan mmā tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who endowed you with hearing, sight, and hearts- how seldom you are grateful!
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā dharaʾakum fā al-ʾarḍi wa-ʾilayhi tuḥsharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who made you multiply on earth. It is to Him that you will be gathered:
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَـٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā yuḥāi wayumītu walahu ākhtilāfu al-yli wa-an-nahāri ۚ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who gives life and death; the alternation of night and day depends on Him; will you not use your minds?
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.en: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
verses.tr: bal qālūā mithla mā qāla al-ʾawwalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But, like others before them,
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.en: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
verses.tr: qālūā ʾaʾidhā mitnā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman ʾaʾinnā lamabʿūthūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they say, ‘What? When we die and turn to dust and bones, shall we really be resurrected?
verses.pickthall: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?

verses.ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
verses.tr: laqad wuʿidnā naḥnu wabāʾunā hādhā min qablu ʾin hādhā ʾillā ʾasāṭīru al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have heard such promises before, and so did our forefathers. These are just ancient fables.’
verses.pickthall: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.

verses.ar: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
verses.tr: qul llimani al-ʾarḍu waman fīhā ʾin kuntum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Who owns the earth and all who live in it, if you know [so much]?’
verses.pickthall: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge?

verses.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: They will say, "To Allāh." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
