verses.tr: sayaqūlūna lillāh ۚ qul ʾafalā tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Will you not take heed?’
verses.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember?

verses.ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
verses.tr: qul man rrabbu as-samāwāti as-sabʿi warabbu al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Who is the Lord of the seven heavens? Who is the Lord of the Mighty Throne?’
verses.pickthall: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne?

verses.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: They will say, "[They belong] to Allāh." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
verses.tr: sayaqūlūna lillāh ۚ qul ʾafalā tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Will you not be mindful?’
verses.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)?

verses.ar: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
verses.tr: qul man biyadihi malakūtu kulli shāʾin wahuwa yujīru walā yujāru ʿalayhi ʾin kuntum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Who holds control of everything in His hand? Who protects, while there is no protection against Him, if you know [so much]?’
verses.pickthall: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge?

verses.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
verses.en: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allāh." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
verses.tr: sayaqūlūna lillāh ۚ qul fa-annā tusḥarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Then how can you be so deluded?’
verses.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched?

verses.ar: بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
verses.tr: bal ʾataynāhum bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-innahum lakādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The fact is, We brought them the truth and they are lying.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars.

verses.ar: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ ۚ إِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.en: Allāh has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have [sought to] overcome others. Exalted is Allāh above what they describe [concerning Him].
verses.tr: mā āttakhadha Allāh min waladin wamā kāna maʿahu min ʾilāhin ۚ ʾidhan lladhahaba kullu ʾilāhin bimā khalaqa walaʿalā baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin ۚ subḥāna Allāh ʿammā yaṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God has never had a child. Nor is there any god beside Him- if there were, each god would have taken his creation aside and tried to overcome the others. May God be exalted above what they describe!
verses.pickthall: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege.

verses.ar: عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
verses.tr: ʿālimi al-ghaybi wa-ash-shahādahi fataʿālā ʿammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He knows what is not seen as well as what is seen; He is far above any partner they claim for Him.
verses.pickthall: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)!

verses.ar: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
verses.tr: qul rrabbi ʾimmā turiyannā mā yūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Lord, if You are going to show me the punishment You have promised them,
verses.pickthall: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised.

verses.ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
verses.tr: rabbi falā tajʿalnā fā al-qawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: then Lord, do not include me among the evildoers!’
verses.pickthall: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them.
verses.tr: wa-innā ʿalā ʾan nnuriyaka mā naʿiduhum laqādirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We certainly are able to show you the punishment We have promised them.
verses.pickthall: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them.

verses.ar: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
verses.en: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
verses.tr: ādfaʿ bi-at-tā hāa ʾaḥsanu as-sayyiʾaha ۚ naḥnu ʾaʿlamu bimā yaṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Repel evil with good- We are well aware of what they attribute to Us-
verses.pickthall: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege.

verses.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
verses.en: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
verses.tr: waqul rrabbi ʾaʿūdhu bika min hamazāti ash-shayāṭīni
verses.abdelhaleem: and say, ‘Lord, I take refuge with You from the goadings of the evil ones;
verses.pickthall: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones,

verses.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
verses.en: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
verses.tr: wa-aʿūdhu bika rabbi ʾan yaḥḍurūni
verses.abdelhaleem: I seek refuge with you, Lord, so that they may not come near me.’
verses.pickthall: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me,

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
verses.en: [For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾa ʾaḥadahumu al-mawtu qāla rabbi ārjiʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: When death comes to one of them, he cries, ‘My Lord, let me return
verses.pickthall: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back,

verses.ar: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَـٰلِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
verses.tr: laʿallā ʾaʿmalu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu ۚ kallā ۚ ʾinnahā kalimahun huwa qāʾiluhā ۖ wamin warāʾihim barzakhun ʾilā yawmi yubʿathūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so as to make amends for the things I neglected.’ Never! This will not go beyond his words: a barrier stands behind such people until the very Day they are resurrected.
verses.pickthall: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
verses.tr: fa-idhā nufikha fā aṣ-ṣūri falā ʾansāba baynahum yawmaʾidhin walā yatasāʾalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day when the Trumpet is blown, the ties between them will be as nothing and they will not ask about each other:
verses.pickthall: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another.

verses.ar: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
verses.tr: faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ūlāʾika humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those whose good deeds weigh heavy will be successful,
verses.pickthall: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
verses.tr: waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ūlāʾika adh-dhīna khasirūā ʾanfusahum fā jahannama khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but those whose balance is light will have lost their souls for ever and will stay in Hell-
verses.pickthall: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding.

verses.ar: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَـٰلِحُونَ
verses.en: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
verses.tr: talfaḥu wujūhahumu an-nāru wahum fīhā kāliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the Fire will scorch their faces and their lips will be twisted in pain.
verses.pickthall: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: [It will be said], "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
verses.tr: ʾalam takun āyātā tutlā ʿalaykum fakuntum bihā tukadhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Were My messages not recited over and over to you and still you rejected them?’
verses.pickthall: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّينَ
verses.en: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
verses.tr: qālūā rabbanā ghalabat ʿalaynā shiqwatunā wakunnā qawman ḍāllīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘Lord, our waywardness overcame us and we went astray.
verses.pickthall: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
verses.tr: rabbanā ʾakhrijnā minhā fa-in ʿudnā fa-innā ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord, take us away from this and if we go back to our old ways, then we shall really be evildoers.’
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
verses.en: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
verses.tr: qāla ākhsawā fīhā walā tukallimūni
verses.abdelhaleem: He will say, ‘Away with you! In you go! Do not speak to Me!
verses.pickthall: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
verses.tr: ʾinnahu kāna farīqun mmin ʿibādā yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fāghfir lanā wārḥamnā wa-anta khayru ar-rāḥimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Among My servants there were those who said, “Lord, We believe. Forgive us and have mercy on us: You are the most merciful of all.”
verses.pickthall: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy;

verses.ar: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
verses.en: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
verses.tr: fāttakhadhtumūhum sikhriyyan ḥattā ʾansawkum dhikrā wakuntum mminhum taḍḥakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But you kept on laughing at them: so intent were you on laughing at them that it made you forget My warning.
verses.pickthall: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.

verses.ar: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
verses.tr: ʾinnā jazaytuhumu al-yawma bimā ṣabarūā ʾannahum humu al-fāʾizūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Today I have rewarded them for their patience: it is they who will succeed.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant.

verses.ar: قَـٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
verses.tr: qāla kam labithtum fā al-ʾarḍi ʿadada sinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He will say, ‘How many years were you on earth?’
verses.pickthall: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
verses.en: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
verses.tr: qālūā labithnā yawman ʾaw baʿḍa yawmin fasli al-ʿāddīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will reply, ‘We stayed a day or a part of a day, but ask those who keep count.’
verses.pickthall: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count!

verses.ar: قَـٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
verses.tr: qāla ʾin llabithtum ʾillā qalīlan ۖ llaw ʾannakum kuntum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He will say, ‘You stayed but a little, if you had only known.
verses.pickthall: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew.

verses.ar: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
verses.tr: ʾafaḥasibtum ʾannamā khalaqnākum ʿabathan wa-annakum ʾilaynā lā turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Did you think We had created you in vain, and that you would not be brought back to Us?’
verses.pickthall: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us?

verses.ar: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.en: So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
verses.tr: fataʿālā Allāh al-maliku al-ḥaqqu ۖ lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa rabbu al-ʿarshi al-karīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Exalted be God, the true King, there is no god but Him, the Lord of the Glorious Throne!
verses.pickthall: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace.

verses.ar: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَـٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: And whoever invokes besides Allāh another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
verses.tr: waman yadʿu maʿa Allāh ʾilāhan ākhara lā burhāna lahu bihi fa-innamā ḥisābuhu ʿinda rabbihi ۚ ʾinnahu lā yufliḥu al-kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whoever prays to another god alongside Him- a god for whose existence he has no evidence- will face his reckoning with his Lord. Those who reject the truth will not prosper.
verses.pickthall: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful.

verses.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.en: And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
verses.tr: waqul rrabbi āghfir wārḥam wa-anta khayru ar-rāḥimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Lord, forgive and have mercy: You are the most merciful of all.’
verses.pickthall: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.

verses.ar: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَـٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
verses.tr: sūrahun ʾanzalnāhā wafaraḍnāhā wa-anzalnā fīhā āyātin bayyinātin llaʿallakum tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a sura We have sent down and made obligatory: We have sent down clear revelations in it, so that you may take heed.
verses.pickthall: (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed.

verses.ar: ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِى فَٱجْلِدُوا۟ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ ۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion [i.e., law] of Allāh, if you should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.
verses.tr: az-zāniyahu wa-az-zānā fājlidūā kulla wāḥidin mminhumā māʾaha jaldahin ۖ walā taʾkhudhkum bihimā raʾfahun fā dīni Allāh ʾin kuntum tuʾminūna billāh wa-l-yawmi al-ākhiri ۖ walyashhad ʿadhābahumā ṭāʾifahun mmina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Strike the adulteress and the adulterer one hundred times. Do not let compassion for them keep you from carrying out God’s law––if you believe in God and the Last Day––and ensure that a group of believers witnesses the punishment.
verses.pickthall: The adulterer and the adulteress, scourge ye each one of them (with) a hundred stripes. And let not pity for the twain withhold you from obedience to Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of believers witness their punishment.

verses.ar: ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the believers.
verses.tr: az-zānā lā yankiḥu ʾillā zāniyahan ʾaw mushrikahan wa-az-zāniyahu lā yankiḥuhā ʾillā zānin ʾaw mushrikun ۚ waḥurrima dhālika ʿalā al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The adulterer is only [fit] to marry an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress is only [fit] to marry an adulterer or an idolater: such behaviour is forbidden to believers.
verses.pickthall: The adulterer shall not marry save an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress none shall marry save an adulterer or an idolater. All that is forbidden unto believers.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَـٰنِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَـٰدَةً أَبَدًا ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yarmūna al-muḥṣanāti thumma lam yaʾtūā biʾarbaʿahi shuhadāʾa fājlidūhum thamānīna jaldahan walā taqbalūā lahum shahādahan ʾabadan ۚ wa-ūlāʾika humu al-fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who accuse chaste women of fornication, and then fail to provide four witnesses, strike them eighty times, and reject their testimony ever afterwards: they are the lawbreakers,
verses.pickthall: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers -

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: ʾillā adh-dhīna tābūā min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥūā fa-inna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: except for those who repent later and make amends––God is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: Save those who afterward repent and make amends. (For such) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَـٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَـٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the truthful.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yarmūna ʾazwājahum walam yakun llahum shuhadāʾu ʾillā ʾanfusuhum fashahādahu ʾaḥadihim ʾarbaʿu shahādātin billāh ۙ ʾinnahu lamina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who accuse their own wives of adultery, but have no other witnesses, let each one four times call God to witness that he is telling the truth,
verses.pickthall: As for those who accuse their wives but have no witnesses except themselves; let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies, (swearing) by Allah that he is of those who speak the truth;

verses.ar: وَٱلْخَـٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allāh be upon him if he should be of the liars.
verses.tr: wa-l-khāmisahu ʾanna laʿnata Allāh ʿalayhi ʾin kāna mina al-kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and, the fifth time, call God to reject him if he is lying;
verses.pickthall: And yet a fifth, invoking the curse of Allah on him if he is of those who lie.

verses.ar: وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَـٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the liars.
verses.tr: wayadraā ʿanhā al-ʿadhāba ʾan tashhada ʾarbaʿa shahādātin billāh ۙ ʾinnahu lamina al-kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: punishment shall be averted from his wife if she in turn four times calls God to witness that her husband is lying
verses.pickthall: And it shall avert the punishment from her if she bear witness before Allah four times that the thing he saith is indeed false,

verses.ar: وَٱلْخَـٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allāh be upon her if he was of the truthful.
verses.tr: wa-l-khāmisaha ʾanna ghaḍaba Allāh ʿalayhā ʾin kāna mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and, the fifth time, calls God to reject her if he is telling the truth.
verses.pickthall: And a fifth (time) that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he speaketh truth.

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Wise.
verses.tr: walawlā faḍlu Allāh ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu wa-anna Allāh tawwābun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you, if it were not that God accepts repentance and is wise . . .!
verses.pickthall: And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Wise, (ye had been undone).

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِٱلْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِّنكُمْ ۚ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَّكُم ۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۚ لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُم مَّا ٱكْتَسَبَ مِنَ ٱلْإِثْمِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُۥ مِنْهُمْ لَهُۥ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather, it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna jāʾū bi-l-ʾifki ʿuṣbahun mminkum ۚ lā taḥsabūhu sharran llakum ۖ bal huwa khayrun llakum ۚ likulli āmriʾin mminhum mmā āktasaba mina al-ʾithmi ۚ wa-adh-dhā tawallā kibrahu minhum lahu ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It was a group from among you that concocted the lie––do not consider it a bad thing for you [people]; it was a good thing––and every one of them will be charged with the sin he has earned. He who took the greatest part in it will have a painful punishment.
verses.pickthall: Lo! they who spread the slander are a gang among you. Deem it not a bad thing for you; nay, it is good for you. Unto every man of them (will be paid) that which he hath earned of the sin; and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be an awful doom.

verses.ar: لَّوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَآ إِفْكٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?
verses.tr: llawlā ʾidh samiʿtumūhu ẓanna al-muʾminūna wa-l-muʾminātu biʾanfusihim khayran waqālūā hādhā ʾifkun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: When you heard the lie, why did believing men and women not think well of their own people and declare, ‘This is obviously a lie’?
verses.pickthall: Why did not the believers, men and women, when ye heard it, think good of their own own folk, and say: It is a manifest untruth?

verses.ar: لَّوْلَا جَآءُو عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشُّهَدَآءِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allāh, who are the liars.
verses.tr: llawlā jāʾū ʿalayhi biʾarbaʿahi shuhadāʾa ۚ fa-idh lam yaʾtūā bi-ash-shuhadāʾi fa-ūlāʾika ʿinda Allāh humu al-kādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And why did the accusers not bring four witnesses to it? If they cannot produce such witnesses, they are the liars in God’s eyes.
verses.pickthall: Why did they not produce four witnesses? Since they produce not witnesses, they verily are liars in the sight of Allah.

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِى مَآ أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment
verses.tr: walawlā faḍlu Allāh ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu fā ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhirahi lamassakum fā mā ʾafaḍtum fīhi ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you in this world and the next, you would already have been afflicted by terrible suffering for indulging in such talk.
verses.pickthall: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you in the world and the Hereafter an awful doom had overtaken you for that whereof ye murmured.

verses.ar: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: When you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allāh, tremendous.
verses.tr: ʾidh talaqqawnahu bi-ʾalsinatikum wataqūlūna biʾafwāhikum mmā laysa lakum bihi ʿilmun wataḥsabūnahu hayyinan wahuwa ʿinda Allāh ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When you took it up with your tongues, and spoke with your mouths things you did not know [to be true], you thought it was trivial but to God it was very serious.
verses.pickthall: When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great.

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَـٰذَا سُبْحَـٰنَكَ هَـٰذَا بُهْتَـٰنٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allāh]; this is a great slander"?
verses.tr: walawlā ʾidh samiʿtumūhu qultum mmā yakūnu lanā ʾan nnatakallama bihādhā subḥānaka hādhā buhtānun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When you heard the lie, why did you not say, ‘We should not repeat this- God forbid!- It is a monstrous slander’?
verses.pickthall: Wherefor, when ye heard it, said ye not: It is not for us to speak of this. Glory be to Thee (O Allah)! This is awful calumny.

verses.ar: يَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُوا۟ لِمِثْلِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Allāh warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.
verses.tr: yaʿiẓukumu Allāh ʾan taʿūdūā limithlihi ʾabadan ʾin kuntum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God warns you never to do anything like this again, if you are true believers.
verses.pickthall: Allah admonisheth you that ye repeat not the like thereof ever, if ye are (in truth) believers.

verses.ar: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: wayubayyinu Allāh lakumu al-āyāti ۚ wallāh ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: God makes His messages clear to you: God is all knowing, all wise.
verses.pickthall: And He expoundeth unto you the revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةُ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allāh knows and you do not know.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yuḥibbūna ʾan tashīʿa al-fāḥishahu fā adh-dhīna āmanūā lahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun fā ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhirahi ۚ wallāh yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: A painful punishment waits in this world and the next for those who like indecency to spread among the believers: God knows and you do not.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who love that slander should be spread concerning those who believe, theirs will be a painful punishment in the world and the Hereafter. Allah knoweth. Ye know not.

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Kind and Merciful.
verses.tr: walawlā faḍlu Allāh ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu wa-anna Allāh raʾūfun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy and the fact that He is compassionate and merciful . . .!
verses.pickthall: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Merciful, (ye had been undone).

verses.ar: ۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّى مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allāh purifies whom He wills, and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.tr: ۞ yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā tattabiʿūā khuṭuwāti ash-shayṭāni ۚ waman yattabiʿ khuṭuwāti ash-shayṭāni fa-innahu yaʾmuru bi-l-faḥshāʾi wa-l-munkari ۚ walawlā faḍlu Allāh ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu mā zakā minkum mmin ʾaḥadin ʾabadan walākinna Allāh yuzakkā man yashāʾu ۗ wallāh samīʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, do not follow in Satan’s footsteps- if you do so, he will urge you to indecency and evil. If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you, not one of you would ever have attained purity. God purifies whoever He will: God is all hearing, all seeing.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Follow not the footsteps of the devil. Unto whomsoever followeth the footsteps of the devil, lo! he commandeth filthiness and wrong. Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, not one of you would ever have grown pure. But Allah causeth whom He will to grow. And Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: walā yaʾtali ʾūlūā al-faḍli minkum wa-as-saʿahi ʾan yuʾtūā ʾūlā al-qurbā wa-l-masākīna wa-l-muhājirīna fā sabīli Allāh ۖ walyaʿfūā walyaṣfaḥūā ۗ ʾalā tuḥibbūna ʾan yaghfira Allāh lakum ۗ wallāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who have been graced with bounty and plenty should not swear that they will [no longer] give to kinsmen, the poor, those who emigrated in God’s way: let them pardon and forgive. Do you not wish that God should forgive you? God is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: And let not those who possess dignity and ease among you swear not to give to the near of kin and to the needy, and to fugitives for the cause of Allah. Let them forgive and show indulgence. Yearn ye not that Allah may forgive you? Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَـٰتِ ٱلْغَـٰفِلَـٰتِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ لُعِنُوا۟ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yarmūna al-muḥṣanāti al-ghāfilāti al-muʾmināti luʿinūā fā ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhirahi walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who accuse honourable but unwary believing women are rejected by God, in this life and the next. A painful punishment awaits them
verses.pickthall: Lo! as for those who traduce virtuous, believing women (who are) careless, cursed are they in the world and the Hereafter. Theirs will be an awful doom

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.
verses.tr: yawma tashhadu ʿalayhim ʾalsinatuhum wa-aydīhim wa-arjuluhum bimā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: on the Day when their own tongues, hands, and feet will testify against them about what they have done-
verses.pickthall: On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet testify against them as to what they used to do,

verses.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: That Day, Allāh will pay them in full their true [i.e., deserved] recompense, and they will know that it is Allāh who is the manifest Truth [i.e., perfect in justice].
verses.tr: yawmaʾidhin yuwaffīhimu Allāh dīnahumu al-ḥaqqa wayaʿlamūna ʾanna Allāh huwa al-ḥaqqu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: on that Day, God will pay them their just due in full- and they will realize that God is the Truth that makes everything clear.
verses.pickthall: On that day Allah will pay them their just due, and they will know that Allah, He is the Manifest Truth.

verses.ar: ٱلْخَبِيثَـٰتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَٱلْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَـٰتِ ۖ وَٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَٱلطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ ۖ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. And good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words. Those [good people] are declared innocent of what they [i.e., slanderers] say. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.
verses.tr: al-khabīthātu lilkhabīthīna wa-l-khabīthūna lilkhabīthāti ۖ wa-aṭ-ṭayyibātu lilṭṭayyibīna wa-aṭ-ṭayyibūna lilṭṭayyibāti ۚ ʾūlāʾika mubarraʾūna mimmā yaqūlūna ۖ lahum mmaghfirahun warizqun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Corrupt women are for corrupt men, and corrupt men are for corrupt women; good women are for good men and good men are for good women. The good are innocent of what has been said against them; they will have forgiveness and a generous provision.
verses.pickthall: Vile women are for vile men, and vile men for vile women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women; such are innocent of that which people say: For them is pardon and a bountiful provision.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَأْنِسُوا۟ وَتُسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded [i.e., advised].
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā tadkhulūā buyūtan ghayra buyūtikum ḥattā tastaʾnisūā watusallimūā ʿalā ʾahlihā ۚ dhālikum khayrun llakum laʿallakum tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, do not enter other people’s houses until you have asked permission to do so and greeted those inside- that is best for you: perhaps you will bear this in mind.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Enter not houses other than your own without first announcing your presence and invoking peace upon the folk thereof. That is better for you, that ye may be heedful.

verses.ar: فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فِيهَآ أَحَدًا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ ۖ هُوَ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back," then go back; it is purer for you. And Allāh is Knowing of what you do.
verses.tr: fa-in llam tajidūā fīhā ʾaḥadan falā tadkhulūhā ḥattā yuʾdhana lakum ۖ wa-in qīla lakumu ārjiʿūā fārjiʿūā ۖ huwa ʾazkā lakum ۚ wallāh bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: If you find no one in, do not enter unless you have been given permission to do so. If you are told, ‘Go away’, then do so- that is more proper for you. God knows well what you do.
verses.pickthall: And if ye find no-one therein, still enter not until permission hath been given. And if it be said unto you: Go away again, then go away, for it is purer for you. Allah knoweth what ye do.

verses.ar: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ فِيهَا مَتَـٰعٌ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
verses.en: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience for you. And Allāh knows what you reveal and what you conceal.
verses.tr: llaysa ʿalaykum junāḥun ʾan tadkhulūā buyūtan ghayra maskūnahin fīhā matāʿun llakum ۚ wallāh yaʿlamu mā tubdūna wamā taktumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You will not be blamed for entering houses where no one lives, and which could provide you with some useful service. God knows everything you do openly and everything you conceal.
verses.pickthall: (It is) no sin for you to enter uninhabited houses wherein is comfort for you. Allah knoweth what ye proclaim and what ye hide.

verses.ar: قُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوا۟ مِنْ أَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا۟ فُرُوجَهُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
verses.en: Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what they do.
verses.tr: qul llilmuʾminīna yaghuḍḍūā min ʾabṣārihim wayaḥfaẓūā furūjahum ۚ dhālika ʾazkā lahum ۗ ʾinna Allāh khabīrun bimā yaṣnaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], tell believing men to lower their glances and guard their private parts: that is purer for them. God is well aware of everything they do.
verses.pickthall: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and be modest. That is purer for them. Lo! Allah is aware of what they do.

verses.ar: وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَـٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ ۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ ٱلتَّـٰبِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ أَوِ ٱلطِّفْلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَوْرَٰتِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۖ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّ ۚ وَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment [i.e., beauty] except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess [i.e., slaves], or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allāh in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.
verses.tr: waqul llilmuʾmināti yaghḍuḍna min ʾabṣārihinna wayaḥfaẓna furūjahunna walā yubdīna zīnatahunna ʾillā mā ẓahara minhā ۖ walyaḍribna bikhumurihinna ʿalā juyūbihinna ۖ walā yubdīna zīnatahunna ʾillā libuʿūlatihinna ʾaw ābāʾihinna ʾaw ābāʾi buʿūlatihinna ʾaw ʾabnāʾihinna ʾaw ʾabnāʾi buʿūlatihinna ʾaw ʾikhwānihinna ʾaw banā ʾikhwānihinna ʾaw banā ʾakhawātihinna ʾaw nisāʾihinna ʾaw mā malakat ʾaymānuhunna ʾawi at-tābiʿīna ghayri ʾūlā al-ʾirbahi mina ar-rijāli ʾawi aṭ-ṭifli adh-dhīna lam yaẓharūā ʿalā ʿawrāti an-nisāʾi ۖ walā yaḍribna biʾarjulihinna liyuʿlama mā yukhfīna min zīnatihinna ۚ watūbūā ʾilā Allāh jamīʿan ʾayyuha al-muʾminūna laʿallakum tufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And tell believing women that they should lower their glances, guard their private parts, and not display their charms beyond what [it is acceptable] to reveal; they should let their headscarves fall to cover their necklines and not reveal their charms except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands’ fathers, their sons, their husbands’ sons, their brothers, their brothers’ sons, their sisters’ sons, their womenfolk, their slaves, such men as attend them who have no sexual desire, or children who are not yet aware of women’s nakedness; they should not stamp their feet so as to draw attention to any hidden charms. Believers, all of you, turn to God so that you may prosper.
verses.pickthall: And tell the believing women to lower their gaze and be modest, and to display of their adornment only that which is apparent, and to draw their veils over their bosoms, and not to reveal their adornment save to their own husbands or fathers or husbands' fathers, or their sons or their husbands' sons, or their brothers or their brothers' sons or sisters' sons, or their women, or their slaves, or male attendants who lack vigour, or children who know naught of women's nakedness. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they hide of their adornment. And turn unto Allah together, O believers, in order that ye may succeed.

verses.ar: وَأَنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْأَيَـٰمَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَآئِكُمْ ۚ إِن يَكُونُوا۟ فُقَرَآءَ يُغْنِهِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allāh will enrich them from His bounty, and Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
verses.tr: wa-ankiḥūā al-ʾayāmā minkum wa-aṣ-ṣāliḥīna min ʿibādikum wa-imāʾikum ۚ ʾin yakūnūā fuqarāʾa yughnihimu Allāh min faḍlihi ۗ wallāh wāsiʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Marry off the single among you and those of your male and female slaves who are fit [for marriage]. If they are poor, God will provide for them from His bounty: God’s bounty is infinite and He is all knowing.
verses.pickthall: And marry such of you as are solitary and the pious of your slaves and maid-servants. If they be poor, Allah will enrich them of His bounty. Allah is of ample means, Aware.

verses.ar: وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا ۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۚ وَلَا تُكْرِهُوا۟ فَتَيَـٰتِكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْبِغَآءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ عَرَضَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَمَن يُكْرِههُّنَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِكْرَٰهِهِنَّ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until Allāh enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allāh which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allāh is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: walyastaʿfifi adh-dhīna lā yajidūna nikāḥan ḥattā yughniyahumu Allāh min faḍlihi ۗ wa-adh-dhīna yabtaghūna al-kitāba mimmā malakat ʾaymānukum fakātibūhum ʾin ʿalimtum fīhim khayran ۖ watūhum mmin mmāli Allāh adh-dhā ātākum ۚ walā tukrihūā fatayātikum ʿalā al-bighāʾi ʾin ʾaradna taḥaṣṣunan llitabtaghūā ʿaraḍa al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۚ waman yukrihhhunna fa-inna Allāh min baʿdi ʾikrāhihinna ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who are unable to marry should keep chaste until God gives them enough out of His bounty. If any of your slaves wish to pay for their freedom, make a contract with them accordingly, if you know they have good in them, and give them some of the wealth God has given you. Do not force your slave-girls into prostitution, when they themselves wish to remain honourable, in your quest for the short-term gains of this world, although, if they are forced, God will be forgiving and merciful to them.
verses.pickthall: And let those who cannot find a match keep chaste till Allah give them independence by His grace. And such of your slaves as seek a writing (of emancipation), write it for them if ye are aware of aught of good in them, and bestow upon them of the wealth of Allah which He hath bestowed upon you. Force not your slave-girls to whoredom that ye may seek enjoyment of the life of the world, if they would preserve their chastity. And if one force them, then (unto them), after their compulsion, lo! Allah will be Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتٍ مُّبَيِّنَـٰتٍ وَمَثَلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear Allāh.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾanzalnā ʾilaykum āyātin mmubayyinātin wamathalan mmina adh-dhīna khalawā min qablikum wamawʿiẓahan llilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent verses down to you [people] clarifying the right path, examples of those who passed away before you, and advice for those who are mindful of God.
verses.pickthall: And verily We have sent down for you revelations that make plain, and the example of those who passed away before you. An admonition unto those who ward off (evil).

verses.ar: ۞ ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِۦ كَمِشْكَوٰةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ ۖ ٱلْمِصْبَاحُ فِى زُجَاجَةٍ ۖ ٱلزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّىٌّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِىٓءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ ۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ ۗ يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ لِنُورِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ لِلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Allāh is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp; the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allāh guides to His light whom He wills. And Allāh presents examples for the people, and Allāh is Knowing of all things.
verses.tr: ۞ Allāh nūru as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ mathalu nūrihi kamishkawāhin fīhā miṣbāḥun ۖ al-miṣbāḥu fā zujājahin ۖ az-zujājahu kaʾannahā kawkabun durrāun yūqadu min shajarahin mmubārakahin zaytūnahin llā sharqiyyahin walā gharbiyyahin yakādu zaytuhā yuḍāʾu walaw lam tamsashu nārun ۚ nnūrun ʿalā nūrin ۗ yahdā Allāh linūrihi man yashāʾu ۚ wayaḍribu Allāh al-ʾamthāla lilnnāsi ۗ wallāh bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: God is the Light of the heavens and earth. His Light is like this: there is a niche, and in it a lamp, the lamp inside a glass, a glass like a glittering star, fuelled from a blessed olive tree from neither east nor west, whose oil almost gives light even when no fire touches it- light upon light- God guides whoever He will to his Light; God draws such comparisons for people; God has full knowledge of everything-
verses.pickthall: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things.

verses.ar: فِى بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ ٱللَّهُ أَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسْمُهُۥ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْـَٔاصَالِ
verses.en: [Such niches are] in houses [i.e., mosques] which Allāh has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned [i.e., praised] therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings
verses.tr: fā buyūtin ʾadhina Allāh ʾan turfaʿa wayudhkara fīhā āsmuhu yusabbiḥu lahu fīhā bi-l-ghuduwwi wa-l-āṣāli
verses.abdelhaleem: shining out in houses of worship. God has ordained that they be raised high and that His name be remembered in them, with men in them celebrating His glory morning and evening:
verses.pickthall: (This lamp is found) in houses which Allah hath allowed to be exalted and that His name shall be remembered therein. Therein do offer praise to Him at morn and evening.

verses.ar: رِجَالٌ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَـٰرَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءِ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۙ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
verses.en: [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allāh and performance of prayer and giving of zakāh. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about -
verses.tr: rijālun llā tulhīhim tijārahun walā bayʿun ʿan dhikri Allāh wa-iqāmi aṣ-ṣalawāhi wa-ītāʾi az-zakawāhi ۙ yakhāfūna yawman tataqallabu fīhi al-qulūbu wa-l-ʾabṣāru
verses.abdelhaleem: men who are not distracted, either by commerce or profit, from remembering God, keeping up the prayer, and paying the prescribed alms, fearing a day when hearts and eyes will turn over.
verses.pickthall: Men whom neither merchandise nor sale beguileth from remembrance of Allah and constancy in prayer and paying to the poor their due; who fear a day when hearts and eyeballs will be overturned;

verses.ar: لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.en: That Allāh may reward them [according to] the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And Allāh gives provision to whom He wills without account [i.e., limit].
verses.tr: liyajziyahumu Allāh ʾaḥsana mā ʿamilūā wayazīdahum mmin faḍlihi ۗ wallāh yarzuqu man yashāʾu bighayri ḥisābin
verses.abdelhaleem: God will reward such people according to the best of their actions, and He will give them more of His bounty: God provides limitlessly for anyone He will.
verses.pickthall: That Allah may reward them with the best of what they did, and increase reward for them of His bounty. Allah giveth blessings without stint to whom He will.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍۭ بِقِيعَةٍ يَحْسَبُهُ ٱلظَّمْـَٔانُ مَآءً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَهُۥ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْـًٔا وَوَجَدَ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ فَوَفَّىٰهُ حِسَابَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds Allāh before him, and He will pay him in full his due; and Allāh is swift in account.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾaʿmāluhum kasarābin biqīʿahin yaḥsabuhu aẓ-ẓamānu māʾan ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾahu lam yajidhu shayā wawajada Allāh ʿindahu fawaffāhu ḥisābahu ۗ wallāh sarīʿu al-ḥisābi
verses.abdelhaleem: But the deeds of those who disbelieve are like a mirage in a desert: the thirsty person thinks there will be water but, when he gets there, he finds only God, who pays him his account in full- God is swift in reckoning.
verses.pickthall: As for those who disbelieve, their deeds are as a mirage in a desert. The thirsty one supposeth it to be water till he cometh unto it and findeth it naught, and findeth, in the place thereof, Allah Who payeth him his due; and Allah is swift at reckoning.

verses.ar: أَوْ كَظُلُمَـٰتٍ فِى بَحْرٍ لُّجِّىٍّ يَغْشَىٰهُ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ سَحَابٌ ۚ ظُلُمَـٰتٌۢ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ إِذَآ أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَىٰهَا ۗ وَمَن لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ نُورًا فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن نُّورٍ
verses.en: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allāh has not granted light - for him there is no light.
verses.tr: ʾaw kaẓulumātin fā baḥrin llujjāin yaghshāhu mawjun mmin fawqihi mawjun mmin fawqihi saḥābun ۚ ẓulumātun baʿḍuhā fawqa baʿḍin ʾidhā ʾakhraja yadahu lam yakad yarāhā ۗ waman llam yajʿali Allāh lahu nūran famā lahu min nnūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: Or like shadows in a deep sea covered by wave upon wave, with clouds above- layer upon layer of darkness- if he holds out his hand, he is scarcely able to see it. The one to whom God gives no light has no light at all.
verses.pickthall: Or as darkness on a vast, abysmal sea. There covereth him a wave, above which is a wave, above which is a cloud. Layer upon layer of darkness. When he holdeth out his hand he scarce can see it. And he for whom Allah hath not appointed light, for him there is no light.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلطَّيْرُ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ ۖ كُلٌّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُۥ وَتَسْبِيحَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: Do you not see that Allāh is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and [by] the birds with wings spread [in flight]? Each [of them] has known his [means of] prayer and exalting [Him], and Allāh is Knowing of what they do.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna Allāh yusabbiḥu lahu man fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wa-aṭ-ṭayru ṣāffātin ۖ kullun qad ʿalima ṣalātahu watasbīḥahu ۗ wallāh ʿalīmun bimā yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do you not see that all those who are in the heavens and earth praise God, as do the birds with wings outstretched? Each knows its [own way] of prayer and glorification: God has full knowledge of what they do.
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen that Allah, He it is Whom all who are in the heavens and the earth praise, and the birds in their flight? Of each He knoweth verily the worship and the praise; and Allah is Aware of what they do.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allāh is the destination.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ wa-ʾilā Allāh al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Control of the heavens and earth belongs to God: and to God is the final return.
verses.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah is the journeying.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزْجِى سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ رُكَامًا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَـٰلِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالٍ فِيهَا مِنۢ بَرَدٍ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُۥ عَن مَّن يَشَآءُ ۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِۦ يَذْهَبُ بِٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
verses.en: Do you not see that Allāh drives clouds? Then He brings them together; then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightning almost takes away the eyesight.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna Allāh yuzjā saḥāban thumma yuʾallifu baynahu thumma yajʿaluhu rukāman fatarā al-wadqa yakhruju min khilālihi wayunazzilu mina as-samāʾi min jibālin fīhā min baradin fayuṣību bihi man yashāʾu wayaṣrifuhu ʿan mman yashāʾu ۖ yakādu sanā barqihi yadhhabu bi-l-ʾabṣāri
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you not see that God drives the clouds, then gathers them together and piles them up until you see rain pour from their midst? He sends hail down from [such] mountains in the sky, pouring it on whoever He wishes and diverting it from whoever He wishes- the flash of its lightning almost snatches sight away.
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how Allah wafteth the clouds, then gathereth them, then maketh them layers, and thou seest the rain come forth from between them; He sendeth down from the heaven mountains wherein is hail, and smiteth therewith whom He will, and averteth it from whom He will. The flashing of His lightning all but snatcheth away the sight.

verses.ar: يُقَلِّبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
verses.en: Allāh alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.
verses.tr: yuqallibu Allāh al-yla wa-an-nahāra ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika laʿibrahan lliʾūlā al-ʾabṣāri
verses.abdelhaleem: God alternates night and day- there truly is a lesson in [all] this for those who have eyes to see-
verses.pickthall: Allah causeth the revolution of the day and the night. Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for those who see.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰٓ أَرْبَعٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Allāh has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allāh creates what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
verses.tr: wallāh khalaqa kulla dābbahin mmin mmāʾin ۖ faminhum mman yamshā ʿalā baṭnihi waminhum mman yamshā ʿalā rijlayni waminhum mman yamshā ʿalā ʾarbaʿin ۚ yakhluqu Allāh mā yashāʾu ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: and God created each animal out of [its own] fluid: some of them crawl on their bellies, some walk on two legs, and some on four. God creates whatever He will; God has power over everything.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath created every animal of water. Of them is (a kind) that goeth upon its belly and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs and (a kind) that goeth upon four. Allah createth what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: لَّقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَـٰتٍ مُّبَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allāh guides whom He wills to a straight path.
verses.tr: llaqad ʾanzalnā āyātin mmubayyinātin ۚ wallāh yahdā man yashāʾu ʾilā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent verses that clarify the right path: God guides whoever He will to a straight path.
verses.pickthall: Verily We have sent down revelations and explained them. Allah guideth whom He will unto a straight path.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: But they [i.e., the hypocrites] say, "We have believed in Allāh and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers.
verses.tr: wayaqūlūna āmannā billāh wabālrrasūli wa-aṭaʿnā thumma yatawallā farīqun mminhum mmin baʿdi dhālika ۚ wamā ʾūlāʾika bi-l-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘We believe in God and the Messenger; we obey,’ but then some of them turn away: these people are not true believers
verses.pickthall: And they say: We believe in Allah and the messenger, and we obey; then after that a faction of them turn away. Such are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: And when they are called to [the words of] Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal].
verses.tr: wa-idhā duʿūā ʾilā Allāh warasūlihi liyaḥkuma baynahum ʾidhā farīqun mminhum mmuʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and when they are summoned to God and His Messenger in order for him to judge between them, some of them turn away.
verses.pickthall: And when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them, lo! a faction of them are averse;

verses.ar: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ يَأْتُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ
verses.en: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.
verses.tr: wa-in yakun llahumu al-ḥaqqu yaʾtūā ʾilayhi mudhʿinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they were claiming their right, they would come willingly [to the Prophet].
verses.pickthall: But if right had been with them they would have come unto him willingly.

verses.ar: أَفِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرْتَابُوٓا۟ أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ بَلْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allāh will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust].
verses.tr: ʾafā qulūbihim mmaraḍun ʾami ārtābūā ʾam yakhāfūna ʾan yaḥīfa Allāh ʿalayhim warasūluhu ۚ bal ʾūlāʾika humu aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they have sickness in their hearts? Are they full of doubts? Do they fear that God and His Messenger might deal with them unjustly? No, it is they who are the unjust ones.
verses.pickthall: Is there in their hearts a disease, or have they doubts, or fear they lest Allah and His messenger should wrong them in judgment? Nay, but such are evil-doers.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: The only statement of the [true] believers when they are called to Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā kāna qawla al-muʾminīna ʾidhā duʿūā ʾilā Allāh warasūlihi liyaḥkuma baynahum ʾan yaqūlūā samiʿnā wa-aṭaʿnā ۚ wa-ūlāʾika humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the true believers are summoned to God and His Messenger in order for him to judge between them, they say, ‘We hear and we obey.’ These are the ones who will prosper:
verses.pickthall: The saying of (all true) believers when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them is only that they say: We hear and we obey. And such are the successful.

verses.ar: وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَخْشَ ٱللَّهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
verses.en: And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger and fears Allāh and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers.
verses.tr: waman yuṭiʿi Allāh warasūlahu wayakhsha Allāh wayattaqhi fa-ūlāʾika humu al-fāʾizūna
verses.abdelhaleem: whoever obeys God and His Messenger, stands in awe of God, and keeps his duty to Him will be triumphant.
verses.pickthall: He who obeyeth Allah and His messenger, and feareth Allah, and keepeth duty (unto Him): such indeed are the victorious.

verses.ar: ۞ وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ لَئِنْ أَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ ۖ قُل لَّا تُقْسِمُوا۟ ۖ طَاعَةٌ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in Allāh's cause]. Say, "Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of that which you do."
verses.tr: ۞ wa-aqsamūā billāh jahda ʾaymānihim laʾin ʾamartahum layakhrujunna ۖ qul llā tuqsimūā ۖ ṭāʿahun mmaʿrūfahun ۚ ʾinna Allāh khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [The others] solemnly swear by God that if you [Prophet] commanded them, they would march out. Tell them, ‘Do not swear: it is reasonable obedience that is required, and God is aware of everything you do.’
verses.pickthall: They swear by Allah solemnly that, if thou order them, they will go forth. Say: Swear not; known obedience (is better). Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا۟ ۚ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: Say, "Obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility for] clear notification."
verses.tr: qul ʾaṭīʿūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūā ar-rasūla ۖ fa-in tawallawā fa-innamā ʿalayhi mā ḥummila waʿalaykum mmā ḥummiltum ۖ wa-in tuṭīʿūhu tahtadūā ۚ wamā ʿalā ar-rasūli ʾillā al-balāghu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Obey God; obey the Messenger. If you turn away, [know that] he is responsible for the duty placed upon him, and you are responsible for the duty placed upon you. If you obey him, you will be rightly guided, but the Messenger’s duty is only to deliver the message clearly.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Obey Allah and obey the messenger. But if ye turn away, then (it is) for him (to do) only that wherewith he hath been charged, and for you (to do) only that wherewith ye have been charged. If ye obey him, ye will go aright. But the messenger hath no other charge than to convey (the message) plainly.

verses.ar: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمَا ٱسْتَخْلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱرْتَضَىٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا ۚ يَعْبُدُونَنِى لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِى شَيْـًٔا ۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: Allāh has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: waʿada Allāh adh-dhīna āmanūā minkum waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti layastakhlifannahum fā al-ʾarḍi kamā āstakhlafa adh-dhīna min qablihim walayumakkinanna lahum dīnahumu adh-dhā ārtaḍā lahum walayubaddilannahum mmin baʿdi khawfihim ʾamnan ۚ yaʿbudūnanā lā yushrikūna bā shayā ۚ waman kafara baʿda dhālika fa-ūlāʾika humu al-fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God has made a promise to those among you who believe and do good deeds: He will make them successors to the land, as He did those who came before them; He will empower the religion He has chosen for them; He will grant them security to replace their fear. ‘They will worship Me and not join anything with Me.’ Those who are defiant after that will be the rebels.-
verses.pickthall: Allah hath promised such of you as believe and do good work that He will surely make them to succeed (the present rulers) in the earth even as He caused those who were before them to succeed (others); and that He will surely establish for them their religion which He hath approved for them, and will give them in exchange safety after their fear. They serve Me. They ascribe no thing as partner unto Me. Those who disbelieve henceforth, they are the miscreants.

verses.ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.en: And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.
verses.tr: wa-aqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha watūā az-zakawāha wa-aṭīʿūā ar-rasūla laʿallakum turḥamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [People], keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and obey the Messenger, so that you may be given mercy.
verses.pickthall: Establish worship and pay the poor-due and obey the messenger, that haply ye may find mercy.

verses.ar: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.
verses.tr: lā taḥsabanna adh-dhīna kafarūā muʿjizīna fā al-ʾarḍi ۚ wamaʾwāhumu an-nāru ۖ walabiʾsa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not think [Prophet] that the disbelievers can escape God on earth; the Fire will be their final home, an evil end.
verses.pickthall: Think not that the disbelievers can escape in the land. Fire will be their home - a hapless journey's end!

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِيَسْتَـْٔذِنكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا۟ ٱلْحُلُمَ مِنكُمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مَرَّٰتٍ ۚ مِّن قَبْلِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنۢ بَعْدِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلْعِشَآءِ ۚ ثَلَـٰثُ عَوْرَٰتٍ لَّكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌۢ بَعْدَهُنَّ ۚ طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيْكُم بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [i.e., His ordinances]; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā liyastadhinkumu adh-dhīna malakat ʾaymānukum wa-adh-dhīna lam yablughūā al-ḥuluma minkum thalātha marrātin ۚ mmin qabli ṣalawāhi al-fajri waḥīna taḍaʿūna thiyābakum mmina aẓ-ẓahīrahi wamin baʿdi ṣalawāhi al-ʿishāʾi ۚ thalāthu ʿawrātin llakum ۚ laysa ʿalaykum walā ʿalayhim junāḥun baʿdahunna ۚ ṭawwāfūna ʿalaykum baʿḍukum ʿalā baʿḍin ۚ kadhālika yubayyinu Allāh lakumu al-āyāti ۗ wallāh ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, your slaves and any who have not yet reached puberty should ask your permission to come in at three times of day: before the dawn prayer; when you lay your garments aside in the midday heat; and after the evening prayer. These are your three times for privacy; at other times, there is no blame on you or them if you move around each other freely. In this way God makes messages clear: God is all knowing, all wise.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Let your slaves, and those of you who have not come to puberty, ask leave of you at three times (before they come into your presence): Before the prayer of dawn, and when ye lay aside your raiment for the heat of noon, and after the prayer of night. Three times of privacy for you. It is no sin for them or for you at other times, when some of you go round attendant upon others (if they come into your presence without leave). Thus Allah maketh clear the revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا بَلَغَ ٱلْأَطْفَـٰلُ مِنكُمُ ٱلْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَـْٔذِنُوا۟ كَمَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: wa-idhā balagha al-ʾaṭfālu minkumu al-ḥuluma falyastadhinūā kamā āstadhana adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ kadhālika yubayyinu Allāh lakum āyātihi ۗ wallāh ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When your children reach puberty, they should [always] ask your permission to enter, like their elders do. This is how God makes His messages clear to you: God is all knowing, all wise.
verses.pickthall: And when the children among you come to puberty then let them ask leave even as those before them used to ask it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise.

verses.ar: وَٱلْقَوَٰعِدُ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّـٰتِى لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَن يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَـٰتٍۭ بِزِينَةٍ ۖ وَأَن يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُنَّ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.tr: wa-l-qawāʿidu mina an-nisāʾi at-tā lā yarjūna nikāḥan falaysa ʿalayhinna junāḥun ʾan yaḍaʿna thiyābahunna ghayra mutabarrijātin bizīnahin ۖ wa-an yastaʿfifna khayrun llahunna ۗ wallāh samīʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: No blame will be attached to elderly women who are not hoping for sex, if they take off their outer garments without flaunting their charms, but it is preferable for them not to do this: God is all hearing, all seeing.
verses.pickthall: As for women past child-bearing, who have no hope of marriage, it is no sin for them if they discard their (outer) clothing in such a way as not to show adornment. But to refrain is better for them. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَن تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَٰنِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمَـٰمِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّـٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَٰلِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَـٰلَـٰتِكُمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُۥٓ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَأْكُلُوا۟ جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًا ۚ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُم بُيُوتًا فَسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةً مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَـٰرَكَةً طَيِّبَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from Allāh, blessed and good. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.
verses.tr: llaysa ʿalā al-ʾaʿmā ḥarajun walā ʿalā al-ʾaʿraji ḥarajun walā ʿalā al-marīḍi ḥarajun walā ʿalā ʾanfusikum ʾan taʾkulūā min buyūtikum ʾaw buyūti ābāʾikum ʾaw buyūti ʾummahātikum ʾaw buyūti ʾikhwānikum ʾaw buyūti ʾakhawātikum ʾaw buyūti ʾaʿmāmikum ʾaw buyūti ʿammātikum ʾaw buyūti ʾakhwālikum ʾaw buyūti khālātikum ʾaw mā malaktum mmafātiḥahu ʾaw ṣadīqikum ۚ laysa ʿalaykum junāḥun ʾan taʾkulūā jamīʿan ʾaw ʾashtātan ۚ fa-idhā dakhaltum buyūtan fasallimūā ʿalā ʾanfusikum taḥiyyahan mmin ʿindi Allāh mubārakahan ṭayyibahan ۚ kadhālika yubayyinu Allāh lakumu al-āyāti laʿallakum taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No blame will be attached to the blind, the lame, the sick.Whether you eat in your own houses, or those of your fathers, your mothers, your brothers, your sisters, your paternal uncles, your paternal aunts, your maternal uncles, your maternal aunts, houses you have the keys for, or any of your friends’ houses, you will not be blamed: you will not be blamed whether you eat in company or separately. When you enter any house, greet one another with a greeting of blessing and goodness as enjoined by God. This is how God makes His messages clear to you so that you may understand.
