verses.pickthall: No blame is there upon the blind nor any blame upon the lame nor any blame upon the sick nor on yourselves if ye eat from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your fathers' brothers, or the houses of your fathers' sisters, or the houses of your mothers' brothers, or the houses of your mothers' sisters, or (from that) whereof ye hold the keys, or (from the house) of a friend. No sin shall it be for you whether ye eat together or apart. But when ye enter houses, salute one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and sweet. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَإِذَا كَانُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُوهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُونَكَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ فَإِذَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: The believers are only those who believe in Allāh and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muḥammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allāh and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission due to something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā al-muʾminūna adh-dhīna āmanūā billāh warasūlihi wa-idhā kānūā maʿahu ʿalā ʾamrin jāmiʿin llam yadhhabūā ḥattā yastadhinūhu ۚ ʾinna adh-dhīna yastadhinūnaka ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna yuʾminūna billāh warasūlihi ۚ fa-idhā āstadhanūka libaʿḍi shaʾnihim fa-dhan lliman shiʾta minhum wāstaghfir lahumu Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: The true believers are those who believe in God and His Mes-senger, who, when they are gathered with him on a communal matter, do not depart until they have asked his permission- those who ask your permission [Prophet] are the ones who truly believe in God and His Messenger. When they ask your permission to attend to their private affairs, allow whoever you see fit and ask God to forgive them. God is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: They only are the true believers who believe in Allah and His messenger and, when they are with him on some common errand, go not away until they have asked leave of him. Lo! those who ask leave of thee, those are they who believe in Allah and His messenger. So, if they ask thy leave for some affair of theirs, give leave to whom thou wilt of them, and ask for them forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: لَّا تَجْعَلُوا۟ دُعَآءَ ٱلرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَآءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًا ۚ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًا ۚ فَلْيَحْذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِۦٓ أَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allāh knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from his [i.e., the Prophet's] order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment.
verses.tr: llā tajʿalūā duʿāʾa ar-rasūli baynakum kaduʿāʾi baʿḍikum baʿḍan ۚ qad yaʿlamu Allāh adh-dhīna yatasallalūna minkum liwādhan ۚ falyaḥdhari adh-dhīna yukhālifūna ʿan ʾamrihi ʾan tuṣībahum fitnahun ʾaw yuṣībahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: [People], do not regard the Messenger’s summons to you like one of you summoning another- God is well aware of those of you who steal away surreptitiously- and those who go against his order should beware lest a trial afflict them or they receive a painful punishment.
verses.pickthall: Make not the calling of the messenger among you as your calling one of another. Allah knoweth those of you who steal away, hiding themselves. And let those who conspire to evade orders beware lest grief or painful punishment befall them.

verses.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
verses.en: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand] and [knows] the Day when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
verses.tr: ʾalā ʾinna lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ qad yaʿlamu mā ʾantum ʿalayhi wayawma yurjaʿūna ʾilayhi fayunabbiʾuhum bimā ʿamilūā ۗ wallāh bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God: He knows what state you are in- on the Day when all are returned to Him, He will tell them everything they have done- God has full knowledge of everything.
verses.pickthall: Lo! verily unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. He knoweth your condition. And (He knoweth) the Day when they are returned unto Him so that He may inform them of what they did. Allah is Knower of all things.

verses.ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
verses.en: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -
verses.tr: tabāraka adh-dhā nazzala al-furqāna ʿalā ʿabdihi liyakūna lilʿālamīna nadhīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Exalted is He who has sent the Differentiator down to His servant so that it may be a warning to all people.
verses.pickthall: Blessed is He Who hath revealed unto His slave the Criterion (of right and wrong), that he may be a warner to the peoples.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيرًا
verses.en: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.
verses.tr: adh-dhā lahu mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi walam yattakhidh waladan walam yakun llahu sharīkun fā al-mulki wakhalaqa kulla shāʾin faqaddarahu taqdīran
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who has control over the heavens and earth and has no offspring––no one shares control with Him––and who created all things and made them to an exact measure.
verses.pickthall: He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, He hath chosen no son nor hath He any partner in the Sovereignty. He hath created everything and hath meted out for it a measure.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوٰةً وَلَا نُشُورًا
verses.en: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.
verses.tr: wāttakhadhūā min dūnihi ālihahan llā yakhluqūna shayā wahum yukhlaqūna walā yamlikūna liʾanfusihim ḍarran walā nafʿan walā yamlikūna mawtan walā ḥayawāhan walā nushūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet the disbelievers take as their gods things beneath Him that create nothing, and are themselves created, that can neither harm nor help themselves, and have no control over death, life, or resurrection.
verses.pickthall: Yet they choose beside Him other gods who create naught but are themselves created, and possess not hurt nor profit for themselves, and possess not death nor life, nor power to raise the dead.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا
verses.en: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur’ān] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾin hādhā ʾillā ʾifkun āftarāhu wa-aʿānahu ʿalayhi qawmun ākharūna ۖ faqad jāʾū ẓulman wazūran
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers say, ‘This can only be a lie he has forged with the help of others’––they themselves have done great wrong and told lies––
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve say: This is naught but a lie that he hath invented, and other folk have helped him with it, so that they have produced a slander and a lie.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.en: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."
verses.tr: waqālūā ʾasāṭīru al-ʾawwalīna āktatabahā fahāa tumlā ʿalayhi bukrahan wa-aṣīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: and they say, ‘It is just ancient fables, which he has had written down: they are dictated to him morning and evening.’
verses.pickthall: And they say: Fables of the men of old which he hath had written down so that they are dictated to him morn and evening.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.tr: qul ʾanzalahu adh-dhā yaʿlamu as-sirra fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ ʾinnahu kāna ghafūran rraḥīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘It was sent down by Him who knows the secrets of the heavens and earth. He is all forgiving, all merciful.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He who knoweth the secret of the heavens and the earth hath revealed it. Lo! He ever is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَالِ هَـٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا
verses.en: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?
verses.tr: waqālūā māli hādhā ar-rasūli yaʾkulu aṭ-ṭaʿāma wayamshā fā al-ʾaswāqi ۙ lawlā ʾunzila ʾilayhi malakun fayakūna maʿahu nadhīran
verses.abdelhaleem: They also say, ‘What sort of messenger is this? He eats food and walks about in the marketplaces! Why has no angel been sent down to help him with his warnings?
verses.pickthall: And they say: What aileth this messenger (of Allah) that he eateth food and walketh in the markets? Why is not an angel sent down unto him, to be a warner with him.

verses.ar: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
verses.en: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
verses.tr: ʾaw yulqā ʾilayhi kanzun ʾaw takūnu lahu jannahun yaʾkulu minhā ۚ waqāla aẓ-ẓālimūna ʾin tattabiʿūna ʾillā rajulan mmasḥūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Why has he not been given treasure or a garden to supply his food?’ and the evildoers say, ‘The man you follow is simply under a spell.’
verses.pickthall: Or (why is not) treasure thrown down unto him, or why hath he not a paradise from whence to eat? And the evil-doers say: Ye are but following a man bewitched.

verses.ar: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
verses.tr: ānẓur kayfa ḍarabūā laka al-ʾamthāla faḍallūā falā yastaṭīʿūna sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: See what they think you are like! They have gone astray and cannot find the right way.
verses.pickthall: See how they coin similitudes for thee, so that they are all astray and cannot find a road!

verses.ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا
verses.en: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.
verses.tr: tabāraka adh-dhā ʾin shāʾa jaʿala laka khayran mmin dhālika jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru wayajʿal llaka quṣūranā
verses.abdelhaleem: Exalted is He who can, if He wishes, give you better things than these: Gardens graced with flowing streams, and palaces too.
verses.pickthall: Blessed is He Who, if He will, will assign thee better than (all) that - Gardens underneath which rivers flow - and will assign thee mansions.

verses.ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
verses.en: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
verses.tr: bal kadhabūā bi-as-sāʿahi ۖ wa-aʿtadnā liman kadhaba bi-as-sāʿahi saʿīran
verses.abdelhaleem: It is actually the coming of the Hour that they reject: We have prepared a blazing fire for those who reject the Hour.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they deny (the coming of) the Hour, and for those who deny (the coming of) the Hour We have prepared a flame.

verses.ar: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا
verses.en: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
verses.tr: ʾidhā raʾathum mmin mmakānin baʿīdin samiʿūā lahā taghayyuẓan wazafīran
verses.abdelhaleem: When it sees them from a distance, they will hear it raging and roaring,
verses.pickthall: When it seeth them from afar, they hear the crackling and the roar thereof.

verses.ar: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا
verses.en: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.
verses.tr: wa-idhā ʾulqūā minhā makānan ḍayyiqan mmuqarranīna daʿawā hunālika thubūran
verses.abdelhaleem: and when they are hurled into a narrow part of it, chained together, they will cry out for death.
verses.pickthall: And when they are flung into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they pray for destruction there.

verses.ar: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا
verses.en: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
verses.tr: llā tadʿūā al-yawma thubūran wāḥidan wādʿūā thubūran kathīran
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Do not cry out this day for one death, but for many.’
verses.pickthall: Pray not that day for one destruction, but pray for many destructions!

verses.ar: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَمَصِيرًا
verses.en: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.
verses.tr: qul ʾadhālika khayrun ʾam jannahu al-khuldi at-tā wuʿida al-muttaqūna ۚ kānat lahum jazāʾan wamaṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Which is better, this or the lasting Garden that those who are mindful of God have been promised as their reward and journey’s end?’
verses.pickthall: Say: Is that (doom) better or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)? It will be their reward and journey's end.

verses.ar: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـُٔولًا
verses.en: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.
verses.tr: llahum fīhā mā yashāʾūna khālidīna ۚ kāna ʿalā rabbika waʿdan mmaswlan
verses.abdelhaleem: There they will find everything they wish for, and there they will stay. [Prophet], this is a binding promise from your Lord.
verses.pickthall: Therein abiding, they have all that they desire. It is for thy Lord a promise that must be fulfilled.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
verses.en: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allāh and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"
verses.tr: wayawma yaḥshuruhum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni Allāh fayaqūlu ʾaʾantum ʾaḍlaltum ʿibādā hāʾulāʾi ʾam hum ḍallūā as-sabīla
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day He gathers them all together with those they worship beside Him, He will say, ‘Was it you [false gods] who led these creatures of Mine astray, or did they stray from the path by themselves?’
verses.pickthall: And on the day when He will assemble them and that which they worship instead of Allah and will say: Was it ye who misled these my slaves or did they (themselves) wander from the way?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا
verses.en: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."
verses.tr: qālūā subḥānaka mā kāna yanbaghā lanā ʾan nnattakhidha min dūnika min ʾawliyāʾa walākin mmattaʿtahum wabāʾahum ḥattā nasūā adh-dhikra wakānūā qawmanā būran
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘May You be exalted! We ourselves would never take masters other than You! But You granted them and their forefathers pleasures in this life, until they forgot Your Reminder and were ruined.’
verses.pickthall: They will say: Be Thou Glorified! it was not for us to choose any protecting friends beside thee; but Thou didst give them and their fathers ease till they forgot the warning and became lost folk.

verses.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
verses.tr: faqad kadhabūkum bimā taqūlūna famā tastaṭīʿūna ṣarfan walā naṣran ۚ waman yaẓlim mminkum nudhiqhu ʿadhāban kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: [God will say], ‘Now your gods have denounced what you say as lies: you cannot avoid the punishment; you will not get any help.’ If any of you commits such evil, We shall make him taste agonizing torment.
verses.pickthall: Thus they will give you the lie regarding what ye say, then ye can neither avert (the doom) nor obtain help. And whoso among you doeth wrong, We shall make him taste great torment.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا
verses.en: And We did not send before you, [O Muḥammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnā qablaka mina al-mursalīna ʾillā ʾinnahum layaʾkulūna aṭ-ṭaʿāma wayamshūna fā al-ʾaswāqi ۗ wajaʿalnā baʿḍakum libaʿḍin fitnahan ʾataṣbirūna ۗ wakāna rabbuka baṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: No messenger have We sent before you [Muhammad] who did not eat food and walk about in the marketplace. But We have made some of you a means of testing others- will you stand fast? Your Lord is always watching.
verses.pickthall: We never sent before thee any messengers but lo! they verily ate food and walked in the markets. And We have appointed some of you a test for others: Will ye be steadfast? And thy Lord is ever Seer.

verses.ar: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.
verses.tr: ۞ waqāla adh-dhīna lā yarjūna liqāʾanā lawlā ʾunzila ʿalaynā al-malāʾikahu ʾaw narā rabbanā ۗ laqadi āstakbarūā fā ʾanfusihim waʿataw ʿutuwwan kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who do not fear to meet Us say, ‘Why are the angels not sent down to us?’ or ‘Why can we not see our Lord?’ They are too proud of themselves and too insolent.
verses.pickthall: And those who look not for a meeting with Us say: Why are angels not sent down unto us and (Why) do we not see our Lord! Assuredly they think too highly of themselves and are scornful with great pride.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
verses.en: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
verses.tr: yawma yarawna al-malāʾikaha lā bushrā yawmaʾidhin llilmujrimīna wayaqūlūna ḥijran mmaḥjūran
verses.abdelhaleem: There will be no good news for the guilty on the Day they see the angels. The angels will say, ‘You cannot cross the forbidden barrier,’
verses.pickthall: On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban!

verses.ar: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنثُورًا
verses.en: And We will approach [i.e., regard] what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
verses.tr: waqadimnā ʾilā mā ʿamilūā min ʿamalin fajaʿalnāhu habāʾan mmanthūran
verses.abdelhaleem: and We shall turn to the deeds they have done and scatter them like dust.
verses.pickthall: And We shall turn unto the work they did and make it scattered motes.

verses.ar: أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
verses.en: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
verses.tr: ʾaṣḥābu al-jannahi yawmaʾidhin khayrun mmustaqarran wa-aḥsanu maqīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: But the companions in the Garden will have a better home on that Day, and a fairer place to rest.
verses.pickthall: Those who have earned the Garden on that day will be better in their home and happier in their place of noonday rest;

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
verses.en: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
verses.tr: wayawma tashaqqaqu as-samāʾu bi-l-ghamāmi wanuzzila al-malāʾikahu tanzīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when the sky and its clouds are split apart and the angels sent down in streams,
verses.pickthall: A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا
verses.en: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
verses.tr: al-mulku yawmaʾidhin al-ḥaqqu lilrraḥmāni ۚ wakāna yawman ʿalā al-kāfirīna ʿasīran
verses.abdelhaleem: on that Day, true authority belongs to the Lord of Mercy. It will be a grievous Day for the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: The Sovereignty on that day will be the True (Sovereignty) belonging to the Beneficent One, and it will be a hard day for disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
verses.tr: wayawma yaʿaḍḍu aẓ-ẓālimu ʿalā yadayhi yaqūlu yālaytanā āttakhadhtu maʿa ar-rasūli sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day the evildoer will bite his own hand and say, ‘If only I had taken the same path as the Messenger.
verses.pickthall: On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)!

verses.ar: يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا
verses.en: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
verses.tr: yāwaylatā laytanā lam ʾattakhidh fulānan khalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe is me! If only I had not taken so and so as a friend-
verses.pickthall: Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend!

verses.ar: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًا
verses.en: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
verses.tr: llaqad ʾaḍallanā ʿani adh-dhikri baʿda ʾidh jāʾanā ۗ wakāna ash-shayṭānu lilʾinsāni khadhūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: he led me away from the Revelation after it reached me. Satan has always betrayed mankind.’
verses.pickthall: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًا
verses.en: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."
verses.tr: waqāla ar-rasūlu yārabbi ʾinna qawmā āttakhadhūā hādhā al-qurāna mahjūran
verses.abdelhaleem: The Messenger has said, ‘Lord, my people treat this Quran as something to be shunned,’
verses.pickthall: And the messenger saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur'an of no account.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا
verses.en: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
verses.tr: wakadhālika jaʿalnā likulli nabāin ʿaduwwan mmina al-mujrimīna ۗ wakafā birabbika hādiyan wanaṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: but We have always appointed adversaries from the wicked, for every prophet: Your Lord is sufficient guide and helper.
verses.pickthall: Even so have We appointed unto every prophet an opponent from among the guilty; but Allah sufficeth for a Guide and Helper.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا
verses.en: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi al-qurānu jumlahan wāḥidahan ۚ kadhālika linuthabbita bihi fuādaka ۖ warattalnāhu tartīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers also say, ‘Why was the Quran not sent down to him all at once?’ We sent it in this way to strengthen your heart [Prophet]; We gave it to you in gradual revelation.
verses.pickthall: And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
verses.en: And they do not come to you with an example [i.e., argument] except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
verses.tr: walā yaʾtūnaka bimathalin ʾillā jiʾnāka bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-aḥsana tafsīran
verses.abdelhaleem: They cannot put any argument to you without Our bringing you the truth and the best explanation.
verses.pickthall: And they bring thee no similitude but We bring thee the Truth (as against it), and better (than their similitude) as argument.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yuḥsharūna ʿalā wujūhihim ʾilā jahannama ʾūlāʾika sharrun mmakānan wa-aḍallu sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: It is those driven [falling], on their faces,to Hell who will be in the worst place- they are the furthest from the right path.
verses.pickthall: Those who will be gathered on their faces unto hell: such are worse in plight and further from the right road.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا
verses.en: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā mūsā al-kitāba wajaʿalnā maʿahu ʾakhāhu hārūna wazīran
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron to help him.
verses.pickthall: We verily gave Moses the Scripture and placed with him his brother Aaron as henchman.

verses.ar: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا
verses.en: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
verses.tr: faqulnā ādhhabā ʾilā al-qawmi adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyātinā fadammarnāhum tadmīran
verses.abdelhaleem: We said, ‘Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs.’ Later We destroyed those people utterly.
verses.pickthall: Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction.

verses.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةً ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.en: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
verses.tr: waqawma nūḥin llammā kadhabūā ar-rusula ʾaghraqnāhum wajaʿalnāhum lilnnāsi āyahan ۖ wa-aʿtadnā lilẓẓālimīna ʿadhāban ʾalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Noah, too: when they rejected their messengers, We drowned them and made them an example to all people. We have prepared a painful torment for the evildoers,
verses.pickthall: And Noah's folk, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made of them a portent for mankind. We have prepared a painful doom for evil-doers.

verses.ar: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.en: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
verses.tr: waʿādan wathamūdā wa-aṣḥāba ar-rassi waqurūnanā bayna dhālika kathīran
verses.abdelhaleem: as We did for the people of Ad, Thamud, and al-Rass, and many generations in between.
verses.pickthall: And (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, and the dwellers in Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.

verses.ar: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا
verses.en: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
verses.tr: wakullan ḍarabnā lahu al-ʾamthāla ۖ wakullan tabbarnā tatbīran
verses.abdelhaleem: To each of them We gave warnings, and each of them We destroyed completely.
verses.pickthall: Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا
verses.en: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil [i.e., stones]. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾatawā ʿalā al-qaryahi at-tā ʾumṭirat maṭara as-sawʾi ۚ ʾafalam yakūnūā yarawnahā ۚ bal kānūā lā yarjūna nushūran
verses.abdelhaleem: These disbelievers must have passed by the town that was destroyed by the terrible rain––did they not see it? Yet they do not expect to be raised from the dead.
verses.pickthall: And indeed they have passed by the township whereon was rained the fatal rain. Can it be that they have not seen it? Nay, but they hope for no resurrection.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
verses.en: And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?
verses.tr: wa-idhā raʾawka ʾin yattakhidhūnaka ʾillā huzuwan ʾahādhā adh-dhā baʿatha Allāh rasūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever they see you [Prophet] they ridicule you: ‘Is this the one God has sent as a messenger?
verses.pickthall: And when they see thee (O Muhammad) they treat thee only as a jest (saying): Is this he whom Allah sendeth as a messenger?

verses.ar: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
verses.tr: ʾin kāda layuḍillunā ʿan ālihatinā lawlā ʾan ṣabarnā ʿalayhā ۚ wasawfa yaʿlamūna ḥīna yarawna al-ʿadhāba man ʾaḍallu sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: He might almost have led us astray from our gods if we had not stood so firmly by them.’ When they see the punishment, they will know who is furthest from the path.
verses.pickthall: He would have led us far away from our gods if we had not been staunch to them. They will know, when they behold the doom, who is more astray as to the road.

verses.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
verses.en: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
verses.tr: ʾaraʾayta mani āttakhadha ʾilāhahu hawāhu ʾafaʾanta takūnu ʿalayhi wakīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Think [Prophet] of the man who has taken his own passion as a god: are you to be his guardian?
verses.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who chooseth for his god his own lust? Wouldst thou then be guardian over him?

verses.ar: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
verses.tr: ʾam taḥsabu ʾanna ʾaktharahum yasmaʿūna ʾaw yaʿqilūna ۚ ʾin hum ʾillā ka-l-ʾanʿāmi ۖ bal hum ʾaḍallu sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are just like cattle- no, they are further from the path.
verses.pickthall: Or deemest thou that most of them hear or understand? They are but as the cattle - nay, but they are farther astray?

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا
verses.en: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾilā rabbika kayfa madda aẓ-ẓilla walaw shāʾa lajaʿalahu sākinan thumma jaʿalnā ash-shamsa ʿalayhi dalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you not see how your Lord lengthens the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it stand still- We made the sun its indicator-
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread the shade - And if He willed He could have made it still - then We have made the sun its pilot;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا
verses.en: Then We [retract and] hold it with Us for a brief grasp.
verses.tr: thumma qabaḍnāhu ʾilaynā qabḍan yasīran
verses.abdelhaleem: but We gradually draw it towards Us, little by little.
verses.pickthall: Then We withdraw it unto Us, a gradual withdrawal?

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًا
verses.en: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā jaʿala lakumu al-yla libāsan wa-an-nawma subātan wajaʿala an-nahāra nushūran
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who made the night a garment for you, and sleep a rest, and made the day like a resurrection.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose, and maketh day a resurrection.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُورًا
verses.en: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall], and We send down from the sky pure water
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā ʾarsala ar-riyāḥa bushranā bayna yadā raḥmatihi ۚ wa-anzalnā mina as-samāʾi māʾan ṭahūran
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who sends the winds as heralds of good news before His Mercy. We send down pure water from the sky,
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who sendeth the winds, glad tidings heralding His mercy, and We send down purifying water from the sky,

verses.ar: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا
verses.en: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
verses.tr: llinuḥāa bihi baldahan mmaytan wanusqiyahu mimmā khalaqnā ʾanʿāman wa-anāsāa kathīran
verses.abdelhaleem: so that We can revive a dead land with it, and We give it as a drink to many animals and people We have created.
verses.pickthall: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَـٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
verses.en: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
verses.tr: walaqad ṣarrafnāhu baynahum liyadhakkarūā fa-abā ʾaktharu an-nāsi ʾillā kufūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Many times We have repeated this to people so that they might take heed, but most persist in their ingratitude.
verses.pickthall: And verily We have repeated it among them that they may remember, but most of mankind begrudge aught save ingratitude.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا
verses.en: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
verses.tr: walaw shiʾnā labaʿathnā fā kulli qaryahin nnadhīran
verses.abdelhaleem: If it had been Our will, We would have sent a warner to every town,
verses.pickthall: If We willed, We could raise up a warner in every village.

verses.ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَجَـٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.
verses.tr: falā tuṭiʿi al-kāfirīna wajāhidhum bihi jihādan kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: so do not give in to the disbelievers: strive hard against them with this Quran.
verses.pickthall: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them herewith with a great endeavour.

verses.ar: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
verses.en: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas [i.e., bodies of water], one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
verses.tr: ۞ wahuwa adh-dhā maraja al-baḥrayni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun wahādhā milḥun ʾujājun wajaʿala baynahumā barzakhan waḥijran mmaḥjūran
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who released the two bodies of flowing water, one sweet and fresh and the other salty and bitter, and put an insurmountable barrier between them.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar and a forbidding ban between them.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا
verses.en: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā khalaqa mina al-māʾi basharan fajaʿalahu nasaban waṣihran ۗ wakāna rabbuka qadīran
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who creates human beings from fluid, then makes them kin by blood and marriage: your Lord is all powerful!
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who hath created man from water, and hath appointed for him kindred by blood and kindred by marriage; for thy Lord is ever Powerful.

verses.ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًا
verses.en: But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
verses.tr: wayaʿbudūna min dūni Allāh mā lā yanfaʿuhum walā yaḍurruhum ۗ wakāna al-kāfiru ʿalā rabbihi ẓahīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet instead of God they worship things that can neither benefit nor harm them: the disbeliever has always turned his back on his Lord.
verses.pickthall: Yet they worship instead of Allah that which can neither benefit them nor hurt them. The disbeliever was ever a partisan against his Lord.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
verses.en: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnāka ʾillā mubashiran wanadhīran
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent you only to give good news and warning.
verses.pickthall: And We have sent thee (O Muhammad) only as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
verses.tr: qul mā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi min ʾajrin ʾillā man shāʾa ʾan yattakhidha ʾilā rabbihi sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I am not asking for any reward for it, but anyone who wishes should take a path to his Lord.’
verses.pickthall: Say: I ask of you no reward for this, save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord.

verses.ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
verses.en: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allāh] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, [fully] Aware -
verses.tr: watawakkal ʿalā al-ḥāi adh-dhā lā yamūtu wasabbiḥ biḥamdihi ۚ wakafā bihi bidhunūbi ʿibādihi khabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Put your trust in the Living [God] who never dies, and celebrate His praise. He knows the sins of His servants well enough:
verses.pickthall: And trust thou in the Living One Who dieth not, and hymn His praise. He sufficeth as the Knower of His bondmen's sins,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
verses.en: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)].
verses.tr: adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wamā baynahumā fā sittahi ʾayyāmin thumma āstawā ʿalā al-ʿarshi ۚ ar-raḥmānu fasl bihi khabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who created the heavens and earth and what is between them in six Days, and then established Himself on the throne- He is the Lord of Mercy; He is the Best Informed.
verses.pickthall: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days, then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask anyone informed concerning Him!

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla lahumu āsjudūā lilrraḥmāni qālūā wamā ar-raḥmānu ʾanasjudu limā taʾmurunā wazādahum nufūran ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet when they are told, ‘Bow down before the Lord of Mercy,’ they say, ‘What is the Lord of Mercy? Should we bow down before anything you command?’ and they turn even further away.
verses.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Prostrate to the Beneficent! they say: And what is the Beneficent? Are we to prostrate to whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us? And it increaseth aversion in them.

verses.ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا
verses.en: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
verses.tr: tabāraka adh-dhā jaʿala fā as-samāʾi burūjan wajaʿala fīhā sirājan waqamaran mmunīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Exalted is He who put constellations in the heavens, a radiant light, and an illuminating moon-
verses.pickthall: Blessed be He Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars, and hath placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light!

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا
verses.en: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā jaʿala al-yla wa-an-nahāra khilfahan lliman ʾarāda ʾan yadhakkara ʾaw ʾarāda shukūran
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who made the night and day follow each other- so anyone who wishes may be mindful or show gratitude.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession, for him who desireth to remember, or desireth thankfulness.

verses.ar: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا
verses.en: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
verses.tr: waʿibādu ar-raḥmāni adh-dhīna yamshūna ʿalā al-ʾarḍi hawnan wa-idhā khāṭabahumu al-jāhilūna qālūā salāman
verses.abdelhaleem: The servants of the Lord of Mercy are those who walk humbly on the earth, and who, when the foolish address them, reply, ‘Peace’;
verses.pickthall: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَـٰمًا
verses.en: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yabītūna lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyāman
verses.abdelhaleem: those who spend the night bowed down or standing, worshipping their Lord,
verses.pickthall: And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
verses.en: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā āṣrif ʿannā ʿadhāba jahannama ۖ ʾinna ʿadhābahā kāna gharāman
verses.abdelhaleem: who plead, ‘Our Lord, turn away from us the suffering of Hell, for it is a dreadful torment to suffer!
verses.pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;

verses.ar: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
verses.en: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
verses.tr: ʾinnahā sāʾat mustaqarran wamuqāman
verses.abdelhaleem: It is an evil home, a foul resting place!’
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
verses.en: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna ʾidhā ʾanfaqūā lam yusrifūā walam yaqturūā wakāna bayna dhālika qawāman
verses.abdelhaleem: They are those who are neither wasteful nor niggardly when they spend, but keep to a just balance;
verses.pickthall: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا
verses.en: And those who do not invoke with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna lā yadʿūna maʿa Allāh ʾilāhan ākhara walā yaqtulūna an-nafsa at-tā ḥarrama Allāh ʾillā bi-l-ḥaqqi walā yaznūna ۚ waman yafʿal dhālika yalqa ʾathāman
verses.abdelhaleem: those who never invoke any other deity beside God, nor take a life, which God has made sacred, except in the pursuit of justice, nor commit adultery. (Whoever does these things will face the penalties:
verses.pickthall: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty;

verses.ar: يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
verses.en: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
verses.tr: yuḍāʿaf lahu al-ʿadhābu yawma al-qiyāmahi wayakhlud fīhi muhānan
verses.abdelhaleem: their torment will be doubled on the Day of Resurrection, and they will remain in torment, disgraced,
verses.pickthall: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever;

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.en: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: ʾillā man tāba wamana waʿamila ʿamalan ṣāliḥan fa-ūlāʾika yubaddilu Allāh sayyātihim ḥasanātin ۗ wakāna Allāh ghafūran rraḥīman
verses.abdelhaleem: except those who repent, believe, and do good deeds: God will change the evil deeds of such people into good ones. He is most forgiving, most merciful.
verses.pickthall: Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًا
verses.en: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.
verses.tr: waman tāba waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-innahu yatūbu ʾilā Allāh matāban
verses.abdelhaleem: People who repent and do good deeds truly return to God.)
verses.pickthall: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance -

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًا
verses.en: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna lā yashhadūna az-zūra wa-idhā marrūā bi-l-laghwi marrūā kirāman
verses.abdelhaleem: [The servants of the Lord of Mercy are] those who do not give false testimony, and who, when they see some frivolity, pass by with dignity;
verses.pickthall: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا
verses.en: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna ʾidhā dhukkirūā bāyāti rabbihim lam yakhirrūā ʿalayhā ṣumman waʿumyānan
verses.abdelhaleem: who, when reminded of their Lord’s signs, do not turn a deaf ear and a blind eye to them;
verses.pickthall: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
verses.en: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā hab lanā min ʾazwājinā wadhurriyyātinā qurraha ʾaʿyunin wājʿalnā lilmuttaqīna ʾimāman
verses.abdelhaleem: those who pray, ‘Our Lord, give us joy in our spouses and offspring. Make us good examples to those who are aware of You’.
verses.pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَـٰمًا
verses.en: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika yujzawna al-ghurfaha bimā ṣabarūā wayulaqqawna fīhā taḥiyyahan wasalāman
verses.abdelhaleem: These servants will be rewarded with the highest place in Paradise for their steadfastness. There they will be met with greetings and peace.
verses.pickthall: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,

verses.ar: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
verses.en: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
verses.tr: khālidīna fīhā ۚ ḥasunat mustaqarran wamuqāman
verses.abdelhaleem: There they will stay- a happy home and resting place!
verses.pickthall: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station!

verses.ar: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
verses.en: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.
verses.tr: qul mā yaʿbaā bikum rabbā lawlā duʿāʾukum ۖ faqad kadhabtum fasawfa yakūnu lizāmanā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet, tell the disbelievers], ‘What are you to my Lord without your supplication? But since you have written offthe truth as lies, the inevitable will happen.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.

verses.ar: طسٓمٓ
verses.en: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.
verses.tr: ṭsm
verses.abdelhaleem: Ta Sin Mim
verses.pickthall: Ta. Sin. Mim.

verses.ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.en: These are the verses of the clear Book.
verses.tr: tilka āyātu al-kitābi al-mubīni
verses.abdelhaleem: These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear:
verses.pickthall: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.

verses.ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
verses.tr: laʿallaka bākhiʿun nnafsaka ʾallā yakūnūā muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], are you going to worry yourself to death because they will not believe?
verses.pickthall: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.

verses.ar: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَـٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ
verses.en: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
verses.tr: ʾin nnashaʾ nunazzil ʿalayhim mmina as-samāʾi āyahan faẓallat ʾaʿnāquhum lahā khāḍiʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If We had wished, We could have sent them down a sign from heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in utter humility.
verses.pickthall: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.en: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
verses.tr: wamā yaʾtīhim mmin dhikrin mmina ar-raḥmāni muḥdathin ʾillā kānūā ʿanhu muʿriḍīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever they are brought a new revelation from the Lord of Mercy, they turn away:
verses.pickthall: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.

verses.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
verses.tr: faqad kadhabūā fasayaʾtīhim ʾanbā mā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they deny it, but the truth of what they scorned will soon hit them.
verses.pickthall: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
verses.tr: ʾawalam yarawā ʾilā al-ʾarḍi kam ʾanbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not see the earth, and what noble kinds of thing We grow in it?
verses.pickthall: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan ۖ wamā kāna ʾaktharuhum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
verses.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
verses.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
verses.tr: wa-idh nādā rabbuka mūsā ʾani āʾti al-qawma aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord called to Moses: ‘Go to those wrongdoers,
verses.pickthall: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,

verses.ar: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"
verses.tr: qawma firʿawna ۚ ʾalā yattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not take heed?’
verses.pickthall: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʾan yukadhibūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘My Lord, I fear they will call me a liar,
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,

verses.ar: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ
verses.en: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
verses.tr: wayaḍīqu ṣadrā walā yanṭaliqu lisānā fa-arsil ʾilā hārūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and I will feel stressed and tongue-tied, so send Aaron too;
verses.pickthall: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).

verses.ar: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
verses.en: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
verses.tr: walahum ʿalāa dhanbun fa-akhāfu ʾan yaqtulūni
verses.abdelhaleem: besides, they have a chargeagainst me, and I fear they may kill me.’
verses.pickthall: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.

verses.ar: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
verses.tr: qāla kallā ۖ fādhhabā bāyātinā ۖ ʾinnā maʿakum mmustamiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘No [they will not]. Go, both of you, with Our signs––We shall be with you, listen-ing.
verses.pickthall: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.

verses.ar: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
verses.tr: fa-tiyā firʿawna faqūlā ʾinnā rasūlu rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, “We bring a message from the Lord of the Worlds:
verses.pickthall: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,

verses.ar: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
verses.tr: ʾan ʾarsil maʿanā banā ʾisrāʾīla
verses.abdelhaleem: let the Children of Israel leave with us.” ’
verses.pickthall: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
verses.tr: qāla ʾalam nurabbika fīnā walīdan walabithta fīnā min ʿumurika sinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said, ‘Did we not bring you up as a child among us? Did you not stay with us for many years?
verses.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,

verses.ar: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
verses.tr: wafaʿalta faʿlataka at-tā faʿalta wa-anta mina al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And then you committed that crime of yours: you were so ungrateful.’
verses.pickthall: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].
verses.tr: qāla faʿaltuhā ʾidhan wa-anā mina aḍ-ḍāllīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses replied, ‘I was misguided when I did it
verses.pickthall: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.

verses.ar: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophet hood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
verses.tr: fafarartu minkum lammā khiftukum fawahaba lā rabbā ḥukman wajaʿalanā mina al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and I fled from you in fear; later my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of His messengers.
verses.pickthall: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).

verses.ar: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
verses.tr: watilka niʿmahun tamunnuhā ʿalāa ʾan ʿabbadtta banā ʾisrāʾīla
verses.abdelhaleem: And is this- that you have enslaved the Children of Israel- the favour with which you reproach me?’
verses.pickthall: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.

verses.ar: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
verses.tr: qāla firʿawnu wamā rabbu al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh asked, ‘What is this “Lord of the Worlds”?’
verses.pickthall: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
verses.tr: qāla rabbu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā ۖ ʾin kuntum mmūqinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses replied, ‘He is the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them. If you would only have faith!’
verses.pickthall: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.

verses.ar: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
verses.tr: qāla liman ḥawlahu ʾalā tastamiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said to those present, ‘Do you hear what he says?’
verses.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
verses.tr: qāla rabbukum warabbu ābāʾikumu al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
verses.tr: qāla ʾinna rasūlakumu adh-dhā ʾursila ʾilaykum lamajnūnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said, ‘This messenger who has been sent to you is truly possessed.’
verses.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
verses.tr: qāla rabbu al-mashriqi wa-l-maghribi wamā baynahumā ۖ ʾin kuntum taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses continued, ‘Lord of the East and West and everything between them. If you would only use your reason!’
verses.pickthall: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
verses.tr: qāla laʾini āttakhadhta ʾilāhan ghayrā laʾajʿalannaka mina al-masjūnīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But Pharaoh said [to him], ‘If you take any god other than me, I will throw you into prison,’
verses.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"
verses.tr: qāla ʾawalaw jiʾtuka bishāʾin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: and Moses asked, ‘Even if I show you something convincing?’
verses.pickthall: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?

verses.ar: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.tr: qāla fa-ti bihi ʾin kunta mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Show it then,’ said Pharaoh, ‘if you are telling the truth.’
verses.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!

verses.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
verses.tr: fa-ʾalqā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hāa thuʿbānun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: So Moses threw down his staff and- lo and behold!- it became a snake for everyone to see.
verses.pickthall: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,

verses.ar: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
verses.en: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
verses.tr: wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hāa bayḍāʾu lilnnāẓirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then he drew out his hand and- lo and behold!- it was white for the onlookers to see.
verses.pickthall: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.

verses.ar: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
verses.tr: qāla lilmalaʾi ḥawlahu ʾinna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said to the counsellors around him, ‘This man is a learned sorcerer!
verses.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,

verses.ar: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
verses.en: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
verses.tr: yurīdu ʾan yukhrijakum mmin ʾarḍikum bisiḥrihi famādhā taʾmurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He means to use his sorcery to drive you out of your land! What do you suggest?’
verses.pickthall: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
verses.tr: qālūā ʾarjih wa-akhāhu wābʿath fā al-madāʾini ḥāshirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They answered, ‘Delay him and his brother for a while, and send messengers to all the cities
verses.pickthall: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners

verses.ar: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.en: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
verses.tr: yaʾtūka bikulli saḥḥārin ʿalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: to bring every accomplished sorcerer to you.’
verses.pickthall: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.

verses.ar: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.en: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
verses.tr: fajumiʿa as-saḥarahu limīqāti yawmin mmaʿlūmin
verses.abdelhaleem: The sorcerers were [to be] assembled at the appointed time on a certain day
verses.pickthall: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
verses.en: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate.
verses.tr: waqīla lilnnāsi hal ʾantum mmujtamiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and the people were asked, "Are you all coming?
verses.pickthall: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?

verses.ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.en: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
verses.tr: laʿallanā nattabiʿu as-saḥaraha ʾin kānūā humu al-ghālibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We may follow the sorcerers if they win!"
verses.pickthall: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.en: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
verses.tr: falammā jāʾa as-saḥarahu qālūā lifirʿawna ʾaʾinna lanā laʾajran ʾin kunnā naḥnu al-ghālibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we be rewarded if we win?’
verses.pickthall: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?

verses.ar: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.en: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
verses.tr: qāla naʿam wa-innakum ʾidhan llamina al-muqarrabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and he said, ‘Yes, and you will join my inner court.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me).

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
verses.en: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
verses.tr: qāla lahum mmūsā ʾalqūā mā ʾantum mmulqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you will.’
verses.pickthall: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw!

verses.ar: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
verses.en: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
verses.tr: fa-ā ḥibālahum waʿiṣiyyahum waqālūā biʿizzahi firʿawna ʾinnā lanaḥnu al-ghālibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They threw their ropes and staffs, saying, ‘By Pharaoh’s might, we shall be victorious.’
verses.pickthall: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners.

verses.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
verses.en: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
verses.tr: fa-ʾalqā mūsā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hāa talqafu mā yaʾfikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But Moses threw his staff and- lo and behold!- it swallowed up their trickery
verses.pickthall: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show.

verses.ar: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
verses.tr: fa-ʾulqāa as-saḥarahu sājidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and the sorcerers fell down on their knees,
verses.pickthall: And the wizards were flung prostrate,

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
verses.tr: qālūā āmannā birabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: exclaiming, ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.pickthall: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,

verses.ar: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
verses.en: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
verses.tr: rabbi mūsā wahārūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.’
verses.pickthall: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.

verses.ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
verses.tr: qāla āmantum lahu qabla ʾan ādhana lakum ۖ ʾinnahu lakabīrukumu adh-dhā ʿallamakumu as-siḥra falasawfa taʿlamūna ۚ laʾuqaṭṭiʿanna ʾaydiyakum wa-arjulakum mmin khilāfin walaʾuṣallibannakum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? He must be the master who taught you sorcery! Soon you will see: I will cut off your alternate hands and feet and then crucify the lot of you!’
verses.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.en: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
verses.tr: qālūā lā ḍayra ۖ ʾinnā ʾilā rabbinā munqalibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘That will do us no harm,’ they said, ‘for we are sure to return to our Lord.
verses.pickthall: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
verses.tr: ʾinnā naṭmaʿu ʾan yaghfira lanā rabbunā khaṭāyānā ʾan kunnā ʾawwala al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we were the first to believe.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.

verses.ar: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.en: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
verses.tr: ۞ wa-awḥaynā ʾilā mūsā ʾan ʾasri biʿibādā ʾinnakum mmuttabaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then We revealed Our will to Moses, ‘Leave with My servants by night, for you will be pursued!’
verses.pickthall: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued.

verses.ar: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
verses.en: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
verses.tr: fa-arsala firʿawnu fā al-madāʾini ḥāshirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh sent messengers into the cities, proclaiming,
verses.pickthall: Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners,

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
verses.en: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
verses.tr: ʾinna hāʾulāʾi lashirdhimahun qalīlūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘These people are a puny band––
verses.pickthall: (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop,

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, they are enraging us,
verses.tr: wa-innahum lanā laghāʾiẓūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they have enraged us-
verses.pickthall: And lo! they are offenders against us.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."
verses.tr: wa-innā lajamīʿun ḥādhirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and we are a large army, on the alert.’
verses.pickthall: And lo! we are a ready host.

verses.ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: So We removed them from gardens and springs
verses.tr: fa-akhrajnāhum mmin jannātin waʿuyūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: So it was that We made them leave their gardens and their springs,
verses.pickthall: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,

verses.ar: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: And treasures and honorable station -
verses.tr: wakunūzin wamaqāmin karīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: their treasures and their noble dwellings-
verses.pickthall: And treasures and a fair estate.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
verses.tr: kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā banā ʾisrāʾīla
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave [such] things [later]to the Children of Israel.
verses.pickthall: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.

verses.ar: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
verses.en: So they pursued them at sunrise.
verses.tr: fa-atbaʿūhum mmushriqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh and his people pursued them at sunrise,
verses.pickthall: And they overtook them at sunrise.
