verses.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
verses.en: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
verses.tr: falammā tarā al-jamʿāni qāla ʾaṣḥābu mūsā ʾinnā lamudrakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and as soon as the two sides came within sight of one another, Moses’ followers said, ‘We shall definitely be caught.’
verses.pickthall: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.

verses.ar: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
verses.tr: qāla kallā ۖ ʾinna maʿāa rabbā sayahdīni
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘No, my Lord is with me: He will guide me,’
verses.pickthall: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.

verses.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
verses.tr: fa-awḥaynā ʾilā mūsā ʾani āḍrib bbiʿaṣāka al-baḥra ۖ fānfalaqa fakāna kullu firqin ka-aṭ-ṭawdi al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: and We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff.’ It parted- each side like a mighty mountain-
verses.pickthall: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.

verses.ar: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
verses.en: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].
verses.tr: wa-azlafnā thamma al-ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We brought the others to that place:
verses.pickthall: Then brought We near the others to that place.

verses.ar: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
verses.tr: wa-anjaynā mūsā waman mmaʿahu ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved Moses and all his companions,
verses.pickthall: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Then We drowned the others.
verses.tr: thumma ʾaghraqnā al-ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and drowned the rest.
verses.pickthall: And We drowned the others.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan ۖ wamā kāna ʾaktharuhum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
verses.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
verses.pickthall: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.en: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
verses.tr: wātlu ʿalayhim nabaʾa ʾibrāhīma
verses.abdelhaleem: Tell them the story of Abraham,
verses.pickthall: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla liʾabīhi waqawmihi mā taʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: when he asked his father and his people, ‘What do you worship?’
verses.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
verses.en: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
verses.tr: qālūā naʿbudu ʾaṣnāman fanaẓallu lahā ʿākifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constantly in attendance on them.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.

verses.ar: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
verses.tr: qāla hal yasmaʿūnakum ʾidh tadʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He asked, ‘Do they hear you when you call?
verses.pickthall: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?

verses.ar: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
verses.en: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
verses.tr: ʾaw yanfaʿūnakum ʾaw yaḍurrūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they help or harm you?’
verses.pickthall: Or do they benefit or harm you?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
verses.tr: qālūā bal wajadnā ābāʾanā kadhālika yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They replied, ‘No, but this is what we saw our fathers doing.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
verses.tr: qāla ʾafaraʾaytum mmā kuntum taʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham said, ‘Those idols you have worshipped,
verses.pickthall: He said: See now that which ye worship,

verses.ar: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
verses.en: You and your ancient forefathers?
verses.tr: ʾantum wabāʾukumu al-ʾaqdamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: you and your forefathers,
verses.pickthall: Ye and your forefathers!

verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
verses.tr: fa-innahum ʿaduwwun llā ʾillā rabba al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: are my enemies; not so the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.pickthall: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
verses.en: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
verses.tr: adh-dhā khalaqanā fahuwa yahdīni
verses.abdelhaleem: who created me. It is He who guides me;
verses.pickthall: Who created me, and He doth guide me,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
verses.en: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhā huwa yuṭʿimunā wayasqīni
verses.abdelhaleem: He who gives me food and drink;
verses.pickthall: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
verses.en: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
verses.tr: wa-idhā mariḍtu fahuwa yashfīni
verses.abdelhaleem: He who cures me when I am ill;
verses.pickthall: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
verses.en: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhā yumītunā thumma yuḥyīni
verses.abdelhaleem: He who will make me die and then give me life again;
verses.pickthall: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhā ʾaṭmaʿu ʾan yaghfira lā khaṭītā yawma ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: and He who will, I hope, forgive my faults on the Day of Judgement.
verses.pickthall: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.

verses.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
verses.tr: rabbi hab lā ḥukman wa-ʾalḥiqnā bi-aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: My Lord, grant me wisdom; join me with the righteous;
verses.pickthall: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.

verses.ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.
verses.tr: wājʿal llā lisāna ṣidqin fā al-ākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: give me a good name among later generations;
verses.pickthall: And give unto me a good report in later generations.

verses.ar: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
verses.tr: wājʿalnā min warathahi jannahi an-naʿīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: make me one of those given the Garden of Bliss-
verses.pickthall: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,

verses.ar: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.en: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
verses.tr: wāghfir liʾabā ʾinnahu kāna mina aḍ-ḍāllīna
verses.abdelhaleem: forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray-
verses.pickthall: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.

verses.ar: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
verses.tr: walā tukhzinā yawma yubʿathūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all people are resurrected:
verses.pickthall: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
verses.en: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
verses.tr: yawma lā yanfaʿu mālun walā banūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the Day when neither wealth nor children can help,
verses.pickthall: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
verses.en: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."
verses.tr: ʾillā man ʾatā Allāh biqalbin salīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: when the only one who will be saved is the one who comes before God with a heart devoted to Him.’
verses.pickthall: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.

verses.ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
verses.tr: wa-uzlifati al-jannahu lilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the Garden is brought near to the righteous
verses.pickthall: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).

verses.ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
verses.en: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
verses.tr: waburrizati al-jaḥīmu lilghāwīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and the Fire is placed in full view of the misguided,
verses.pickthall: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
verses.tr: waqīla lahum ʾayna mā kuntum taʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: it will be said to them, ‘Where are those you worshipped
verses.pickthall: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship

verses.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verses.en: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"
verses.tr: min dūni Allāh hal yanṣurūnakum ʾaw yantaṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: beside God? Can they help you now, or even help themselves?’
verses.pickthall: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?

verses.ar: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
verses.en: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators
verses.tr: fakubkibūā fīhā hum wa-l-ghāwuna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then they will all be hurled into Hell, together with those that misled them,
verses.pickthall: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers

verses.ar: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.en: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
verses.tr: wajunūdu ʾiblīsa ʾajmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and all Iblis’s supporters.
verses.pickthall: And the hosts of Iblis, together.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.en: They will say while they dispute therein,
verses.tr: qālūā wahum fīhā yakhtaṣimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There they will say to their gods, as they bicker among themselves,
verses.pickthall: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:

verses.ar: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error
verses.tr: tallāh ʾin kunnā lafā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘We were clearly misguided
verses.pickthall: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest

verses.ar: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: ʾidh nusawwīkum birabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: when we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
verses.tr: wamā ʾaḍallanā ʾillā al-mujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It was the evildoers who led us astray,
verses.pickthall: It was but the guilty who misled us.

verses.ar: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
verses.en: So now we have no intercessors
verses.tr: famā lanā min shāfiʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and now we have no intercessor
verses.pickthall: Now we have no intercessors

verses.ar: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
verses.en: And not a devoted friend.
verses.tr: walā ṣadīqin ḥamīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: and no true friend.
verses.pickthall: Nor any loving friend.

verses.ar: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."
verses.tr: falaw ʾanna lanā karrahan fanakūna mina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If only we could live our lives again, we would be true believers!’
verses.pickthall: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan ۖ wamā kāna ʾaktharuhum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
verses.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
verses.pickthall: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: The people of Noah denied the messengers
verses.tr: kadhabat qawmu nūḥin al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Noah, too, called the messengers liars.
verses.pickthall: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla lahum ʾakhūhum nūḥun ʾalā tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Their brother Noah said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
verses.pickthall: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

verses.ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.tr: ʾinnā lakum rasūlun ʾamīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
verses.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.
verses.tr: fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me.
verses.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: wamā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi min ʾajrin ۖ ʾin ʾajrāa ʾillā ʿalā rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds:
verses.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me."
verses.tr: fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me.’
verses.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
verses.en: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
verses.tr: ۞ qālūā ʾanuʾminu laka wāttabaʿaka al-ʾardhalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They answered, ‘Why should we believe you when the worst sort of people follow you?’
verses.pickthall: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?

verses.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
verses.tr: qāla wamā ʿilmā bimā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘What knowledge do I have of what they used to do?
verses.pickthall: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?

verses.ar: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
verses.tr: ʾin ḥisābuhum ʾillā ʿalā rabbā ۖ law tashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is for my Lord alone to bring them to account- if only you could see-
verses.pickthall: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew;

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
verses.tr: wamā ʾanā biṭāridi al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I will not drive believers away.
verses.pickthall: And I am not (here) to repulse believers.

verses.ar: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: I am only a clear warner."
verses.tr: ʾin ʾanā ʾillā nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: I am here only to give people a clear warning.’
verses.pickthall: I am only a plain warner.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
verses.en: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
verses.tr: qālūā laʾin llam tantahi yānūḥu latakūnanna mina al-marjūmīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So they said, ‘Noah, if you do not stop this, you will be stoned.’
verses.pickthall: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ʾinna qawmā kadhabūni
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My Lord, my people have rejected me,
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.

verses.ar: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
verses.tr: fāftaḥ baynā wabaynahum fatḥan wanajjinā waman mmaʿāa mina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: so make a firm judgement between me and them, and save me and my believing followers.’
verses.pickthall: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.

verses.ar: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.en: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
verses.tr: fa-anjaynāhu waman mmaʿahu fā al-fulki al-mashḥūni
verses.abdelhaleem: So We saved him and his followers in the fully laden ship,
verses.pickthall: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
verses.en: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
verses.tr: thumma ʾaghraqnā baʿdu al-bāqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and drowned the rest.
verses.pickthall: Then afterward We drowned the others.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan ۖ wamā kāna ʾaktharuhum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
verses.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
verses.pickthall: And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: ʿAad denied the messengers
verses.tr: kadhabat ʿādun al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Ad, too, called the messengers liars.
verses.pickthall: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah).

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla lahum ʾakhūhum hūdun ʾalā tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Their brother Hud said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
verses.pickthall: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

verses.ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.tr: ʾinnā lakum rasūlun ʾamīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
verses.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.
verses.tr: fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me.
verses.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: wamā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi min ʾajrin ۖ ʾin ʾajrāa ʾillā ʿalā rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
verses.en: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
verses.tr: ʾatabnūna bikulli rīʿin āyahan taʿbathūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How can you be so vain that you set up monuments on every high place?
verses.pickthall: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?

verses.ar: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
verses.en: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?
verses.tr: watattakhidhūna maṣāniʿa laʿallakum takhludūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you build fortresses because you hope to be immortal?
verses.pickthall: And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever?

verses.ar: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
verses.en: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
verses.tr: wa-idhā baṭashtum baṭashtum jabbārīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why do you act like tyrants whenever you attack someone?
verses.pickthall: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.
verses.tr: fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Be mindful of God and obey me;
verses.pickthall: Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
verses.tr: wāttaqūā adh-dhā ʾamaddakum bimā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: be mindful of Him who has provided you with everything you know-
verses.pickthall: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,

verses.ar: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
verses.en: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
verses.tr: ʾamaddakum biʾanʿāmin wabanīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He has given you livestock, sons,
verses.pickthall: Hath aided you with cattle and sons.

verses.ar: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: And gardens and springs.
verses.tr: wajannātin waʿuyūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: gardens, springs-
verses.pickthall: And gardens and watersprings.

verses.ar: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: for I truly fear that the torment of a grievous day will overtake you.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
verses.en: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
verses.tr: qālūā sawāʾun ʿalaynā ʾawaʿaẓta ʾam lam takun mmina al-wāʿiẓīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They replied, ‘It makes no difference to us whether you warn us or not,
verses.pickthall: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;

verses.ar: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
verses.tr: ʾin hādhā ʾillā khuluqu al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: for we only do what our forefathers used to do:
verses.pickthall: This is but a fable of the men of old,

verses.ar: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.en: And we are not to be punished."
verses.tr: wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: we shall not be punished.’
verses.pickthall: And we shall not be doomed.

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.tr: fakadhabūhu fa-ahlaknāhum ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan ۖ wamā kāna ʾaktharuhum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They denounced him as a liar, and so We destroyed them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
verses.pickthall: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
verses.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: Thamūd denied the messengers
verses.tr: kadhabat thamūdu al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Thamud, too, called the messengers liars.
verses.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla lahum ʾakhūhum ṣāliḥun ʾalā tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Their brother Salih said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
verses.pickthall: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

verses.ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.tr: ʾinnā lakum rasūlun ʾamīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: I am a faithful messenger to you:
verses.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.
verses.tr: fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me.
verses.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: wamā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi min ʾajrin ۖ ʾin ʾajrāa ʾillā ʿalā rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.en: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
verses.tr: ʾatutrakūna fā mā hāhunā āminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Do you think] you will be left secure for ever in what you have here-
verses.pickthall: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: Within gardens and springs
verses.tr: fā jannātin waʿuyūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: gardens, springs,
verses.pickthall: In gardens and watersprings.

verses.ar: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
verses.en: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
verses.tr: wazurūʿin wanakhlin ṭalʿuhā haḍīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: fields, palm trees laden with fruit-
verses.pickthall: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees,

verses.ar: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
verses.en: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
verses.tr: watanḥitūna mina al-jibāli buyūtan fārihīna
verses.abdelhaleem: carving your fine houses from the mountains?
verses.pickthall: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.
verses.tr: fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Be mindful of God and obey me:
verses.pickthall: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me,

verses.ar: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.en: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
verses.tr: walā tuṭīʿūā ʾamra al-musrifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: do not obey those who are given to excess
verses.pickthall: And obey not the command of the prodigal,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
verses.en: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yufsidūna fā al-ʾarḍi walā yuṣliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and who spread corruption in the land instead of doing what is right.’
verses.pickthall: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
verses.en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
verses.tr: qālūā ʾinnamā ʾanta mina al-musaḥḥarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘You are bewitched!
verses.pickthall: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;

verses.ar: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.tr: mā ʾanta ʾillā basharun mmithlunā fa-ti bāyahin ʾin kunta mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You are nothing but a man like us. Show us a sign, if you are telling the truth.’
verses.pickthall: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful.

verses.ar: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.en: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
verses.tr: qāla hādhihi nāqahun llahā shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin mmaʿlūmin
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Here is a camel. She should have her turn to drink and so should you, each on a specified day,
verses.pickthall: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.tr: walā tamassūhā bisūʾin fayaʾkhudhakum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: so do not harm her, or the punishment of a terrible day will befall you.’
verses.pickthall: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.

verses.ar: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
verses.en: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
verses.tr: faʿaqarūhā fa-aṣbaḥūā nādimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But they hamstrung her. In the morning they had cause to regret it:
verses.pickthall: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.tr: fa-akhadhahumu al-ʿadhābu ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan ۖ wamā kāna ʾaktharuhum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: the punishment fell upon them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
verses.pickthall: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
verses.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: The people of Lot denied the messengers
verses.tr: kadhabat qawmu lūṭin al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Lot, too, called the messengers liars.
verses.pickthall: The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah),

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla lahum ʾakhūhum lūṭun ʾalā tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Their brother Lot said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
verses.pickthall: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

verses.ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.tr: ʾinnā lakum rasūlun ʾamīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: I am a faithful messenger to you:
verses.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.
verses.tr: fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me.
verses.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: wamā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi min ʾajrin ۖ ʾin ʾajrāa ʾillā ʿalā rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Do you approach males among the worlds
verses.tr: ʾataʾtūna adh-dhukrāna mina al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Must you, unlike [other] people, lust after males
verses.pickthall: What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males,

verses.ar: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
verses.en: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
verses.tr: watadharūna mā khalaqa lakum rabbukum mmin ʾazwājikum ۚ bal ʾantum qawmun ʿādūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and abandon the wives that God has created for you? You are exceeding all bounds,’
verses.pickthall: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.en: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
verses.tr: qālūā laʾin llam tantahi yālūṭu latakūnanna mina al-mukhrajīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but they replied, ‘Lot! If you do not stop this, you will be driven away.’
verses.pickthall: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast.

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ
verses.en: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnā liʿamalikum mmina al-qālīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So he said, ‘I loathe what you do:
verses.pickthall: He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct.

verses.ar: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَأَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
verses.tr: rabbi najjinā wa-ahlā mimmā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord, save me and my family from what they are doing.’
verses.pickthall: My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do.

verses.ar: فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: So We saved him and his family, all,
verses.tr: fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved him and all his family,
verses.pickthall: So We saved him and his household, every one,

verses.ar: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
verses.tr: ʾillā ʿajūzan fā al-ghābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: except for an old woman who stayed behind,
verses.pickthall: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Then We destroyed the others.
verses.tr: thumma dammarnā al-ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: then We destroyed the others,
verses.pickthall: Then afterward We destroyed the others.

verses.ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.en: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
verses.tr: wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim mmaṭaran ۖ fasāʾa maṭaru al-mundharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and poured a rain of destruction down upon them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been forewarned!
verses.pickthall: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan ۖ wamā kāna ʾaktharuhum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
verses.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
verses.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers
verses.tr: kadhaba ʾaṣḥābu lykahi al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The forest-dwellers, too, called the messengers liars.
verses.pickthall: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah),

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla lahum shuʿaybun ʾalā tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Shuayb said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
verses.pickthall: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

verses.ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.tr: ʾinnā lakum rasūlun ʾamīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: I am a faithful messenger to you:
verses.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.
verses.tr: fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: be mindful of God and obey me.
verses.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: wamā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi min ʾajrin ۖ ʾin ʾajrāa ʾillā ʿalā rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
verses.en: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾawfūā al-kayla walā takūnūā mina al-mukhsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Give full measure: do not sell others short.
verses.pickthall: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due).

verses.ar: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
verses.en: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.
verses.tr: wazinūā bi-l-qisṭāsi al-mustaqīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Weigh with correct scales:
verses.pickthall: And weigh with the true balance.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
verses.tr: walā tabkhasūā an-nāsa ʾashyāʾahum walā taʿthawā fā al-ʾarḍi mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: do not deprive people of what is theirs. Do not spread corruption on earth.
verses.pickthall: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
verses.tr: wāttaqūā adh-dhā khalaqakum wa-l-jibillaha al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Be mindful of God who created you and former generations,’
verses.pickthall: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
verses.en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
verses.tr: qālūā ʾinnamā ʾanta mina al-musaḥḥarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but they replied, ‘You are bewitched!
verses.pickthall: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
verses.tr: wamā ʾanta ʾillā basharun mmithlunā wa-in nnaẓunnuka lamina al-kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You are nothing but a man like us. In fact we think you are a liar.
verses.pickthall: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.

verses.ar: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.tr: fa-asqiṭ ʿalaynā kisafan mmina as-samāʾi ʾin kunta mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Make bits of the heavens fall down on us, if you are telling the truth.’
verses.pickthall: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
verses.tr: qāla rabbā ʾaʿlamu bimā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you do.’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
verses.tr: fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahum ʿadhābu yawmi aẓ-ẓullahi ۚ ʾinnahu kāna ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: They called him a liar, and so the torment of the Day of Shadow came upon them- it was the torment of a terrible day.
verses.pickthall: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan ۖ wamā kāna ʾaktharuhum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
verses.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
verses.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: wa-innahu latanzīlu rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly, this Quran has been sent down by the Lord of the Worlds:
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,

verses.ar: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
verses.en: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down
verses.tr: nazala bihi ar-rūḥu al-ʾamīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: the Trustworthy Spirit brought it down
verses.pickthall: Which the True Spirit hath brought down

verses.ar: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
verses.en: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners -
verses.tr: ʿalā qalbika litakūna mina al-mundhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: to your heart [Prophet], so that you could bring warning
verses.pickthall: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,

verses.ar: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: In a clear Arabic language.
verses.tr: bilisānin ʿarabāin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: in a clear Arabic tongue.
verses.pickthall: In plain Arabic speech.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
verses.tr: wa-innahu lafā zuburi al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This was foretold in the scriptures of earlier religions.
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
verses.tr: ʾawalam yakun llahum āyahan ʾan yaʿlamahu ʿulamā banā ʾisrāʾīla
verses.abdelhaleem: Is it not proof enough for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel have recognized it?
verses.pickthall: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?

verses.ar: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
verses.en: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
verses.tr: walaw nazzalnāhu ʿalā baʿḍi al-ʾaʿjamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If We had sent it down to someone who was not an Arab,
verses.pickthall: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,

verses.ar: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
verses.tr: faqaraʾahu ʿalayhim mmā kānūā bihi muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.
verses.pickthall: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.
verses.tr: kadhālika salaknāhu fā qulūbi al-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So We make it pass straight through the hearts of the guilty:
verses.pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.

verses.ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.en: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
verses.tr: lā yuʾminūna bihi ḥattā yarawā al-ʿadhāba al-ʾalīma
verses.abdelhaleem: they will not believe in it until they see the grievous torment,
verses.pickthall: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,

verses.ar: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
verses.tr: fayaʾtiyahum baghtahan wahum lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: which will suddenly hit them when they are not expecting it,
verses.pickthall: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.

verses.ar: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
verses.en: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
verses.tr: fayaqūlūā hal naḥnu munẓarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then they will say, ‘Can we have more time?’
verses.pickthall: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?

verses.ar: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.en: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
verses.tr: ʾafabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How can they ask that Our punishment be brought to them sooner?
verses.pickthall: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
verses.en: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
verses.tr: ʾafaraʾayta ʾin mmattaʿnāhum sinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Think, if we let them enjoy this life for some years
verses.pickthall: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
verses.tr: thumma jāʾahum mmā kānūā yūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then the promised torment came upon them,
verses.pickthall: And then cometh that which they were promised,

verses.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
verses.en: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
verses.tr: mā ʾaghnā ʿanhum mmā kānūā yumattaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: what good would their past enjoyment be to them?
verses.pickthall: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
verses.en: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
verses.tr: wamā ʾahlaknā min qaryahin ʾillā lahā mundhirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Never have We destroyed a town without sending down messengers to warn it,
verses.pickthall: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners

verses.ar: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
verses.tr: dhikrā wamā kunnā ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: as a reminder from Us: We are never unjust.
verses.pickthall: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
verses.en: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.
verses.tr: wamā tanazzalat bihi ash-shayāṭīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: It was not the jinn who brought down this Quran:
verses.pickthall: The devils did not bring it down.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verses.en: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
verses.tr: wamā yanbaghā lahum wamā yastaṭīʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: it is neither in their interests nor in their power,
verses.pickthall: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
verses.en: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
verses.tr: ʾinnahum ʿani as-samʿi lamaʿzūlūna
verses.abdelhaleem: indeed they are prevented from overhearing it.
verses.pickthall: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.

verses.ar: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.en: So do not invoke with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
verses.tr: falā tadʿu maʿa Allāh ʾilāhan ākhara fatakūna mina al-muʿadhabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] do not invoke any gods beside God, or you will incur punishment.
verses.pickthall: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.

verses.ar: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
verses.en: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.
verses.tr: wa-andhir ʿashīrataka al-ʾaqrabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Warn your nearest kinsfolk
verses.pickthall: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,

verses.ar: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.
verses.tr: wākhfiḍ janāḥaka limani āttabaʿaka mina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and lower your wing tenderly over the believers who follow you.
verses.pickthall: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.

verses.ar: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
verses.tr: fa-in ʿaṣawka faqul ʾinnā barāʾun mmimmā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they disobey you, say, ‘I bear no responsibility for your actions.’
verses.pickthall: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.

verses.ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.en: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
verses.tr: watawakkal ʿalā al-ʿazīzi ar-raḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful,
verses.pickthall: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.en: Who sees you when you arise
verses.tr: adh-dhā yarāka ḥīna taqūmu
verses.abdelhaleem: who sees you when you stand up [for prayer]
verses.pickthall: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)

verses.ar: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: And your movement among those who prostrate.
verses.tr: wataqallubaka fā as-sājidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and sees your movements among the worshippers:
verses.pickthall: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu huwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
verses.pickthall: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.ar: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
verses.en: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
verses.tr: hal ʾunabbiʾukum ʿalā man tanazzalu ash-shayāṭīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: Shall I tell you who the jinn come down to?
verses.pickthall: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

verses.ar: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.en: They descend upon every sinful liar.
verses.tr: tanazzalu ʿalā kulli ʾaffākin ʾathīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: They come down to every lying sinner
verses.pickthall: They descend on every sinful, false one.

verses.ar: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
verses.tr: yulqūna as-samʿa wa-aktharuhum kādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who readily lends an ear to them, and most of them are liars:
verses.pickthall: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.

verses.ar: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
verses.en: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
verses.tr: wa-ash-shuʿarāʾu yattabiʿuhumu al-ghāwuna
verses.abdelhaleem: only those who are lost in error follow the poets.
verses.pickthall: As for poets, the erring follow them.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
verses.en: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾannahum fā kulli wādin yahīmūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you not see how they rove aimlessly in every valley;
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: And that they say what they do not do? -
verses.tr: wa-annahum yaqūlūna mā lā yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: how they say what they do not do?
verses.pickthall: And how they say that which they do not?

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
verses.en: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
verses.tr: ʾillā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti wadhakarūā Allāh kathīran wāntaṣarūā min baʿdi mā ẓulimūā ۗ wasayaʿlamu adh-dhīna ẓalamūā āa munqalabin yanqalibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Not so those [poets] who believe, do good deeds, remember God often, and defend themselves after they have been wronged. The evildoers will find out what they will return to.
verses.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!

verses.ar: طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Ṭā, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] and a clear Book
verses.tr: ṭs ۚ tilka āyātu al-qurāni wakitābin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Ta Sin These are the verses of the Quran––a scripture that makes things clear;
verses.pickthall: Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain;

verses.ar: هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
verses.tr: hudanā wabushrā lilmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: a guide and joyful news for the believers
verses.pickthall: A guidance and good tidings for believers

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yuqīmūna aṣ-ṣalawāha wayuʾtūna az-zakawāha wahum bi-l-ākhirahi hum yūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and believe firmly in the life to come.
verses.pickthall: Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi zayyannā lahum ʾaʿmālahum fahum yaʿmahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who do not believe in the life to come, We have made their deeds seem alluring to them, so they wander blindly:
verses.pickthall: Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their works fairseeming unto them so that they are all astray.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
verses.en: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna lahum sūʾu al-ʿadhābi wahum fā al-ākhirahi humu al-ʾakhsarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: it is they who will have the worst suffering, and will be the ones to lose most in the life to come.
verses.pickthall: Those are they for whom is the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.en: And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you receive the Qur’ān from one Wise and Knowing.
verses.tr: wa-innaka latulaqqā al-qurāna min lladun ḥakīmin ʿalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: You [Prophet] receive the Quran from One who is all wise, all knowing.
verses.pickthall: Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware.

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
verses.en: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla mūsā liʾahlihi ʾinnā ānastu nāran sātīkum mminhā bikhabarin ʾaw ātīkum bishihābin qabasin llaʿallakum taṣṭalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said to his family, ‘I have seen a fire. I will bring you news from there, or a burning stick for you to warm yourselves.’
verses.pickthall: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: falammā jāʾahā nūdāa ʾan būrika man fā an-nāri waman ḥawlahā wasubḥāna Allāh rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When he reached the fire, a voice called: ‘Blessed is the person near this fireand those around it; may God be exalted, the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire and Whosoever is round about it! And Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!

verses.ar: يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
verses.tr: yāmūsā ʾinnahu ʾanā Allāh al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses, I am God, the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: O Moses! Lo! it is I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.en: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allāh said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
verses.tr: wa-ʾalqi ʿaṣāka ۚ falammā raāhā tahtazzu kaʾannahā jānnun wallā mudbiran walam yuʿaqqib ۚ yāmūsā lā takhaf ʾinnā lā yakhāfu ladāa al-mursalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Throw down your staff,’ but when he saw it moving like a snake, he turned and fled. ‘Moses, do not be afraid! The messengers need have no fear in My presence,
verses.pickthall: And throw down thy staff! But when he saw it writhing as it were a demon, he turned to flee headlong; (but it was said unto him): O Moses! Fear not! the emissaries fear not in My presence,

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: ʾillā man ẓalama thumma baddala ḥusnanā baʿda sūʾin fa-innā ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: I am truly most forgiving and merciful to those who do wrong,and then replace their evil with good.
verses.pickthall: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ۖ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَـٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
verses.tr: wa-adkhil yadaka fā jaybika takhruj bayḍāʾa min ghayri sūʾin ۖ fā tisʿi āyātin ʾilā firʿawna waqawmihi ۚ ʾinnahum kānūā qawman fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Put your hand inside your cloak and it will come out white, but unharmed. These are among the nine signs that you will show Pharaoh and his people; they have really gone too far.’
verses.pickthall: And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe, it will come forth white but unhurt. (This will be one) among nine tokens unto Pharaoh and his people Lo! they were ever evil-living folk.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
verses.tr: falammā jāʾathum āyātunā mubṣirahan qālūā hādhā siḥrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: But when Our enlightening signs came to them, they said, ‘This is clearly [just] sorcery!’
verses.pickthall: But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic,

verses.ar: وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا ۚ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
verses.tr: wajaḥadūā bihā wāstayqanathā ʾanfusuhum ẓulman waʿuluwwan ۚ fānẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They denied them, in their wickedness and their pride, even though their souls acknowledged them as true. See how those who spread corruption met their end!
verses.pickthall: And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance. Then see the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ عِلْمًا ۖ وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allāh, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā dāwuda wasulaymāna ʿilman ۖ waqālā al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhā faḍḍalanā ʿalā kathīrin mmin ʿibādihi al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave knowledge to David and Solomon, and they both said, ‘Praise be to God, who has favoured us over many of His believing servants.’
verses.pickthall: And We verily gave knowledge unto David and Solomon, and they said: Praise be to Allah, Who hath preferred us above many of His believing slaves!

verses.ar: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
verses.tr: wawaritha sulaymānu dāwuda ۖ waqāla yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu ʿullimnā manṭiqa aṭ-ṭayri wa-ūtīnā min kulli shāʾin ۖ ʾinna hādhā lahuwa al-faḍlu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: Solomon succeeded David. He said, ‘People, we have been taught the speech of birds, and we have been given a share of everything: this is a clearly a great favour.’
verses.pickthall: And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour.

verses.ar: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
verses.en: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows
verses.tr: waḥushira lisulaymāna junūduhu mina al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi wa-aṭ-ṭayri fahum yūzaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Solomon’s hosts of jinn, men, and birds were marshalled in ordered ranks before him,
verses.pickthall: And there were gathered together unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order;

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَـٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā ʾatawā ʿalā wādi an-namli qālat namlahun yāʾayyuhā an-namlu ādkhulūā masākinakum lā yaḥṭimannakum sulaymānu wajunūduhu wahum lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and when they came to the Valley of the Ants, one ant said, ‘Ants! Go into your homes, in case Solomon and his hosts unwittingly crush you.’
verses.pickthall: Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you, unperceiving.

verses.ar: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."
verses.tr: fatabassama ḍāḥikan mmin qawlihā waqāla rabbi ʾawziʿnā ʾan ʾashkura niʿmataka at-tā ʾanʿamta ʿalāa waʿalā wālidāa wa-an ʾaʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-adkhilnā biraḥmatika fā ʿibādika aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Solomon smiled broadly at her words and said, ‘Lord, inspire me to be thankful for the blessings You have granted me and my parents, and to do good deeds that please You; admit me by Your grace into the ranks of Your righteous servants.’
verses.pickthall: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.

verses.ar: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
verses.en: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
verses.tr: watafaqqada aṭ-ṭayra faqāla mā lāa lā ʾarā al-hudhuda ʾam kāna mina al-ghāʾibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Solomon inspected the birds and said, ‘Why do I not see the hoopoe? Is he absent?
verses.pickthall: And he sought among the birds and said: How is it that I see not the hoopoe, or is he among the absent?

verses.ar: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
verses.tr: laʾuʿadhibannahu ʿadhāban shadīdan ʾaw laādhbaḥannahu ʾaw layaʾtiyannā bisulṭānin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: I will punish him severely, or kill him, unless he brings me a convincing excuse for his absence.’
verses.pickthall: I verily will punish him with hard punishment or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse.

verses.ar: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ
verses.en: But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
verses.tr: famakatha ghayra baʿīdin faqāla ʾaḥaṭtu bimā lam tuḥiṭ bihi wajiʾtuka min sabaʾin binabaʾin yaqīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: But the hoopoe did not stay away long: he came and said, ‘I have learned something you did not know: I come to you from Sheba with firm news.
verses.pickthall: But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not, and I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings.

verses.ar: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
verses.tr: ʾinnā wajadttu āmraʾahan tamlikuhum wa-ūtiyat min kulli shāʾin walahā ʿarshun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: I found a woman ruling over the people, who has been given a share of everything- she has a magnificent throne-
verses.pickthall: Lo! I found a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given (abundance) of all things, and hers is a mighty throne.

verses.ar: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allāh, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,
verses.tr: wajadttuhā waqawmahā yasjudūna lilshamsi min dūni Allāh wazayyana lahumu ash-shayṭānu ʾaʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani as-sabīli fahum lā yahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [but] I found that she and her people worshipped the sun instead of God. Satan has made their deeds seem alluring to them, and diverted them from the right path: they cannot find the right path.
verses.pickthall: I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works fairseeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth), so that they go not aright;

verses.ar: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
verses.en: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allāh, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
verses.tr: ʾallā yasjudūā lillāh adh-dhā yukhriju al-khabʾa fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wayaʿlamu mā tukhfūna wamā tuʿlinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Should they not worship God, who brings forth what is hidden in the heavens and earth and knows both what you people conceal and what you declare?
verses.pickthall: So that they worship not Allah, Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knoweth what ye hide and what ye proclaim,

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۩
verses.en: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
verses.tr: Allāh lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa rabbu al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīmi ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: He is God, there is no god but Him, the Lord of the mighty throne.’
verses.pickthall: Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Tremendous Throne.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
verses.tr: ۞ qāla sananẓuru ʾaṣadaqta ʾam kunta mina al-kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Solomon said, ‘We shall see whether you are telling the truth or lying.
verses.pickthall: (Solomon) said: We shall see whether thou speakest truth or whether thou art of the liars.

verses.ar: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَـٰبِى هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
verses.tr: ādhhab bbikitābā hādhā fa-ʾalqih ʾilayhim thumma tawalla ʿanhum fānẓur mādhā yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them, then withdraw and see what answer they send back.’
verses.pickthall: Go with this my letter and throw it down unto them; then turn away and see what (answer) they return,

verses.ar: قَالَتْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَـٰبٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
verses.tr: qālat yāʾayyuhā al-malaā ʾinnā ʾulqāa ʾilāa kitābun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: The Queen of Sheba said, ‘Counsellors, a gracious letter has been delivered to me.
verses.pickthall: (The Queen of Sheba) said (when she received the letter): O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.en: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
verses.tr: ʾinnahu min sulaymāna wa-innahu bismi Allāh ar-raḥmāni ar-raḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: It is from Solomon, and it says, “In the name of God, the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy,
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is from Solomon, and lo! it is: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful;

verses.ar: أَلَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"
verses.tr: ʾallā taʿlūā ʿalāa wa-tūnā muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: do not put yourselves above me, and come to me in submission to God.”’
verses.pickthall: Exalt not yourselves against me, but come unto me as those who surrender.

verses.ar: قَالَتْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَفْتُونِى فِىٓ أَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
verses.en: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
verses.tr: qālat yāʾayyuhā al-malaā ʾaftūnā fā ʾamrā mā kuntu qāṭiʿahan ʾamran ḥattā tashhadūni
verses.abdelhaleem: She said, ‘Counsellors, give me your counsel in the matter I now face: I only ever decide on matters in your presence.’
verses.pickthall: She said: O chieftains! Pronounce for me in my case. I decide no case till ye are present with me.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أُو۟لُوا۟ قُوَّةٍ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَٱلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِى مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
verses.en: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
verses.tr: qālūā naḥnu ʾūlūā quwwahin wa-ūlūā baʾsin shadīdin wa-l-ʾamru ʾilayki fānẓurā mādhā taʾmurīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They replied, ‘We possess great force and power in war, but you are in command, so consider what orders to give us.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We are lords of might and lords of great prowess, but it is for thee to command; so consider what thou wilt command.

verses.ar: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا۟ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓا۟ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةً ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.
verses.tr: qālat ʾinna al-mulūka ʾidhā dakhalūā qaryahan ʾafsadūhā wajaʿalūā ʾaʿizzaha ʾahlihā ʾadhillahan ۖ wakadhālika yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: She said, ‘Whenever kings go into a city, they ruin it and humiliate its leaders- that is what they do-
verses.pickthall: She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do.

verses.ar: وَإِنِّى مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.en: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."
verses.tr: wa-innā mursilahun ʾilayhim bihadiyyahin fanāẓirahun bima yarjiʿu al-mursalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but I am going to send them a gift, then see what answer my envoys bring back.’
verses.pickthall: But lo! I am going to send a present unto them, and to see with what (answer) the messengers return.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ
verses.en: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allāh has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
verses.tr: falammā jāʾa sulaymāna qāla ʾatumiddūnani bimālin famā ātāni Allāh khayrun mmimmā ātākum bal ʾantum bihadiyyatikum tafraḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When her envoy came to Solomon, Solomon said, ‘What! Are you offering me wealth? What God has given me is better than what He has given you, though you rejoice in this gift of yours.
verses.pickthall: So when (the envoy) came unto Solomon, (the King) said: What! Would ye help me with wealth? But that which Allah hath given me is better than that which He hath given you. Nay it is ye (and not I) who exult in your gift.

verses.ar: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَـٰغِرُونَ
