verses.en: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."
verses.tr: ārjiʿ ʾilayhim falanaʾtiyannahum bijunūdin llā qibala lahum bihā walanukhrijannahum mminhā ʾadhillahan wahum ṣāghirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Go back to your people: we shall certainly come upon them with irresistible forces, and drive them, disgraced and humbled, from their land.’
verses.pickthall: Return unto them. We verily shall come unto them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from thence with shame, and they will be abased.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
verses.tr: qāla yāʾayyuhā al-malaā ʾayyukum yaʾtīnā biʿarshihā qabla ʾan yaʾtūnā muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then he said, ‘Counsellors, which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?’
verses.pickthall: He said: O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come unto me, surrendering?

verses.ar: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ ۖ وَإِنِّى عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِىٌّ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."
verses.tr: qāla ʿifrītun mmina al-jinni ʾanā ātīka bihi qabla ʾan taqūma min mmaqāmika ۖ wa-innā ʿalayhi laqawāun ʾamīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: A powerful and crafty jinn replied, ‘I will bring it to you before you can even rise from your place. I am strong and trustworthy enough,’
verses.pickthall: A stalwart of the jinn said: I will bring it thee before thou canst rise from thy place. Lo! I verily am strong and trusty for such work.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."
verses.tr: qāla adh-dhā ʿindahu ʿilmun mmina al-kitābi ʾanā ātīka bihi qabla ʾan yartadda ʾilayka ṭarfuka ۚ falammā raāhu mustaqirran ʿindahu qāla hādhā min faḍli rabbā liyabluwanā ʾaʾashkuru ʾam ʾakfuru ۖ waman shakara fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi ۖ waman kafara fa-inna rabbā ghanāun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: but one of them who had some knowledge of the Scripture said, ‘I will bring it to you in the twinkling of an eye.’ When Solomon saw it set before him, he said, ‘This is a favour from my Lord, to test whether I am grateful or not: if anyone is grateful, it is for his own good, if anyone is ungrateful, then my Lord is self-sufficient and most generous.’
verses.pickthall: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: I will bring it thee before thy gaze returneth unto thee. And when he saw it set in his presence, (Solomon) said: This is of the bounty of my Lord, that He may try me whether I give thanks or am ungrateful. Whosoever giveth thanks he only giveth thanks for (the good of) his own soul; and whosoever is ungrateful (is ungrateful only to his own soul's hurt). For lo! my Lord is Absolute in independence, Bountiful.

verses.ar: قَالَ نَكِّرُوا۟ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِىٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."
verses.tr: qāla nakkirūā lahā ʿarshahā nanẓur ʾatahtadā ʾam takūnu mina adh-dhīna lā yahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then he said, ‘Disguise her throne, and we shall see whether or not she recognizes it.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will go aright or be of those not rightly guided.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
verses.tr: falammā jāʾat qīla ʾahākadhā ʿarshuki ۖ qālat kaʾannahu huwa ۚ wa-ūtīnā al-ʿilma min qablihā wakunnā muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When she arrived, she was asked, ‘Is this your throne?’ She replied, ‘It looks like it.’ [Solomon said], ‘We were given knowledge before her, and we devoted ourselves to God;
verses.pickthall: So, when she came, it was said (unto her): Is thy throne like this? She said: (It is) as though it were the very one. And (Solomon said): We were given the knowledge before her and we had surrendered (to Allah).

verses.ar: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍ كَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And that which she was worshipping other than Allāh had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."
verses.tr: waṣaddahā mā kānat ttaʿbudu min dūni Allāh ۖ ʾinnahā kānat min qawmin kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: she was prevented by what she worshipped instead of God, for she came from a disbelieving people.’
verses.pickthall: And (all) that she was wont to worship instead of Allah hindered her, for she came of disbelieving folk.

verses.ar: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
verses.tr: qīla lahā ādkhulā aṣ-ṣarḥa ۖ falammā raʾathu ḥasibathu lujjahan wakashafat ʿan sāqayhā ۚ qāla ʾinnahu ṣarḥun mmumarradun mmin qawārīra ۗ qālat rabbi ʾinnā ẓalamtu nafsā wa-aslamtu maʿa sulaymāna lillāh rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then it was said to her, ‘Enter the hall,’ but when she saw it, she thought it was a deep pool of water, and bared her legs. Solomon explained, ‘It is just a hall paved with glass,’ and she said, ‘My Lord, I have wronged myself: I devote myself, with Solomon, to God, the Lord of the Worlds.’
verses.pickthall: It was said unto her: Enter the hall. And when she saw it she deemed it a pool and bared her legs. (Solomon) said: Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass. She said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged myself, and I surrender with Solomon unto Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.en: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā ʾilā thamūda ʾakhāhum ṣāliḥan ʾani āʿbudūā Allāh fa-idhā hum farīqāni yakhtaṣimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: To the people of Thamud We sent their brother, Salih, saying, ‘Worship God alone,’ but they split into two rival factions.
verses.pickthall: And We verily sent unto Thamud their brother Salih, saying: Worship Allah. And lo! they (then became two parties quarrelling.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ۖ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.en: He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil before [i.e., instead of] good? Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allāh that you may receive mercy?"
verses.tr: qāla yāqawmi lima tastaʿjilūna bi-as-sayyiʾahi qabla al-ḥasanahi ۖ lawlā tastaghfirūna Allāh laʿallakum turḥamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Salih said, ‘My people, why do you rush to bring [forward] what is bad rather than good? Why do you not ask forgiveness of God, so that you may be given mercy?’
verses.pickthall: He said: O my people! Why will ye hasten on the evil rather than the good? Why will ye not ask pardon of Allah, that ye may receive mercy.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ ۚ قَالَ طَـٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ
verses.en: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with Allāh. Rather, you are a people being tested."
verses.tr: qālūā āṭṭayyarnā bika wabiman mmaʿaka ۚ qāla ṭāʾirukum ʿinda Allāh ۖ bal ʾantum qawmun tuftanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We see you and your fol-lowers as an evil omen.’ He replied, ‘God will decide on any omen you may see: you people are being put to the test.’
verses.pickthall: They said: We augur evil of thee and those with thee. He said: Your evil augury is with Allah. Nay, but ye are folk that are being tested.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
verses.en: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
verses.tr: wakāna fā al-madīnahi tisʿahu rahṭin yufsidūna fā al-ʾarḍi walā yuṣliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There were nine men in the city who spread corruption in the land without making amends.
verses.pickthall: And there were in the city nine persons who made mischief in the land and reformed not.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ تَقَاسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
verses.en: They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allāh that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor, 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.'"
verses.tr: qālūā taqāsamūā billāh lanubayyitannahu wa-ahlahu thumma lanaqūlanna liwaliyyihi mā shahidnā mahlika ʾahlihi wa-innā laṣādiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Swear by God: we shall attack this man and his household in the night, then say to his next of kin, “We did not witness the destruction of his household. We are telling the truth.”’
verses.pickthall: They said: Swear one to another by Allah that we verily will attack him and his household by night, and afterward we will surely say unto his friend: We witnessed not the destruction of his household. And lo! we are truthtellers.

verses.ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.
verses.tr: wamakarūā makran wamakarnā makran wahum lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So they devised their evil plan, but We too made a plan of which they were unaware.
verses.pickthall: So they plotted a plot: and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not.

verses.ar: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.
verses.tr: fānẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu makrihim ʾannā dammarnāhum waqawmahum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: See how their scheming ended: We destroyed them utterly, along with all their people.
verses.pickthall: Then see the nature of the consequence of their plotting, for lo! We destroyed them and their people, every one.

verses.ar: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.
verses.tr: fatilka buyūtuhum khāwiyahan bimā ẓalamūā ۗ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan lliqawmin yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As a result of their evil deeds, their homes are desolate ruins- there truly is a sign in this for those who know-
verses.pickthall: See, yonder are their dwellings empty and in ruins because they did wrong. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a people who have knowledge.

verses.ar: وَأَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.
verses.tr: wa-anjaynā adh-dhīna āmanūā wakānūā yattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but We saved those who believed and were mindful of God.
verses.pickthall: And we saved those who believed and used to ward off (evil).

verses.ar: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?
verses.tr: walūṭan ʾidh qāla liqawmihi ʾataʾtūna al-fāḥishaha wa-antum tubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We also sent Lot to his people. He said to them, ‘How can you commit this outrage with your eyes wide open?
verses.pickthall: And Lot! when he said unto his folk: Will ye commit abomination knowingly?

verses.ar: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ
verses.en: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."
verses.tr: ʾaʾinnakum lataʾtūna ar-rijāla shahwahan mmin dūni an-nisāʾi ۚ bal ʾantum qawmun tajhalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How can you lust after men instead of women? What fools you are!’
verses.pickthall: Must ye needs lust after men instead of women? Nay, but ye are folk who act senselessly.

verses.ar: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ ءَالَ لُوطٍ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
verses.en: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."
verses.tr: ۞ famā kāna jawāba qawmihi ʾillā ʾan qālūā ʾakhrijūā āla lūṭin mmin qaryatikum ۖ ʾinnahum ʾunāsun yataṭahharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The only answer his people gave was to say, ‘Expel Lot’s followers from your town! These men mean to stay chaste!’
verses.pickthall: But the answer of his folk was naught save that they said: Expel the household of Lot from your township, for they (forsooth) are folk who would keep clean!

verses.ar: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَـٰهَا مِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.
verses.tr: fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ʾillā āmraʾatahu qaddarnāhā mina al-ghābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved him and his family- except for his wife: We made her stay behind-
verses.pickthall: Then We saved him and his household save his wife; We destined her to be of those who stayed behind.

verses.ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.en: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
verses.tr: wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim mmaṭaran ۖ fasāʾa maṭaru al-mundharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We brought rain down on them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been warned!
verses.pickthall: And We rained a rain upon them. Dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Praise be to Allāh, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allāh better or what they associate with Him?"
verses.tr: quli al-ḥamdu lillāh wasalāmun ʿalā ʿibādihi adh-dhīna āṣṭafā ۗ ālllahu khayrun ʾammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Praise be to God and peace on the servants He has chosen. Who is better: God, or those they set up as partners with Him?
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Praise be to Allah, and peace be on His slaves whom He hath chosen! Is Allah best, or (all) that ye ascribe as partners (unto Him)?

verses.ar: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنۢبِتُوا۟ شَجَرَهَآ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ
verses.en: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].
verses.tr: ʾamman khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wa-anzala lakum mmina as-samāʾi māʾan fa-anbatnā bihi ḥadāʾiqa dhāta bahjahin mmā kāna lakum ʾan tunbitūā shajarahā ۗ ʾaʾilāhun mmaʿa Allāh ۚ bal hum qawmun yaʿdilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who created the heavens and earth? Who sends down water from the sky for you- with which We cause gardens of delight to grow: you have no power to make the trees grow in them- is it another god beside God? No! But they are people who take others to be equal with God.
verses.pickthall: Is not He (best) Who created the heavens and the earth, and sendeth down for you water from the sky wherewith We cause to spring forth joyous orchards, whose trees it never hath been yours to cause to grow. Is there any Allah beside Allah? Nay, but they are folk who ascribe equals (unto Him)!

verses.ar: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَـٰلَهَآ أَنْهَـٰرًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but most of them do not know.
verses.tr: ʾamman jaʿala al-ʾarḍa qarāran wajaʿala khilālahā ʾanhāran wajaʿala lahā rawāsāa wajaʿala bayna al-baḥrayni ḥājizan ۗ ʾaʾilāhun mmaʿa Allāh ۚ bal ʾaktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who is it that made the earth a stable place to live? Who made rivers flow through it? Who set immovable mountains on it and created a barrier between the fresh and salt water? Is it another god beside God? No! But most of them do not know.
verses.pickthall: Is not He (best) Who made the earth a fixed abode, and placed rivers in the folds thereof, and placed firm hills therein, and hath set a barrier between the two seas? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Nay, but most of them know not!

verses.ar: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.
verses.tr: ʾamman yujību al-muḍṭarra ʾidhā daʿāhu wayakshifu as-sūʾa wayajʿalukum khulafāʾa al-ʾarḍi ۗ ʾaʾilāhun mmaʿa Allāh ۚ qalīlan mmā tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who is it that answers the distressed when they call upon Him? Who removes their suffering? Who makes you successors in the earth? Is it another god beside God? Little notice you take!
verses.pickthall: Is not He (best) Who answereth the wronged one when he crieth unto Him and removeth the evil, and hath made you viceroys of the earth? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Little do they reflect!

verses.ar: أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦٓ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ تَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allāh? High is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
verses.tr: ʾamman yahdīkum fā ẓulumāti al-barri wa-l-baḥri waman yursilu ar-riyāḥa bushranā bayna yadā raḥmatihi ۗ ʾaʾilāhun mmaʿa Allāh ۚ taʿālā Allāh ʿammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who is it that guides you through the darkness on land and sea? Who sends the winds as heralds of good news before His mercy? Is it another god beside God? God is far above the partners they put beside him!
verses.pickthall: Is not He (best) Who guideth you in the darkness of the land and the sea, He Who sendeth the winds as heralds of His mercy? Is there any Allah beside Allah? High Exalted be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!

verses.ar: أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: ʾamman yabdaā al-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu waman yarzuqukum mmina as-samāʾi wa-l-ʾarḍi ۗ ʾaʾilāhun mmaʿa Allāh ۚ qul hātūā burhānakum ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who is it that creates life and reproduces it? Who is it that gives you provision from the heavens and earth? Is it another god beside God?’ Say, ‘Show me your evidence then, if what you say is true.’
verses.pickthall: Is not He (best) Who produceth creation, then reproduceth it, and Who provideth for you from the heaven and the earth? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Say: Bring your proof, if ye are truthful!

verses.ar: قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allāh, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."
verses.tr: qul llā yaʿlamu man fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi al-ghayba ʾillā Allāh ۚ wamā yashʿurūna ʾayyāna yubʿathūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘No one in the heavens or on earth knows the unseen except God.’ They do not know when they will be raised from the dead:
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): None in the heavens and the earth knoweth the Unseen save Allah; and they know not when they will be raised (again).

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهَا ۖ بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ
verses.en: Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.
verses.tr: bali āddāraka ʿilmuhum fā al-ākhirahi ۚ bal hum fā shakkin mminhā ۖ bal hum mminhā ʿamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: their knowledge cannot comprehend the Hereafter; they are in doubt about it; they are blind to it.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but doth their knowledge reach to the Hereafter? Nay, for they are in doubt concerning it. Nay, for they cannot see it.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ
verses.en: And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾaʾidhā kunnā turāban wabāʾunā ʾaʾinnā lamukhrajūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So the disbelievers say, ‘What! When we and our forefathers have become dust, shall we be brought back to life again?
verses.pickthall: Yet those who disbelieve say: When we have become dust like our fathers, shall we verily be brought forth (again)?

verses.ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَـٰذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
verses.tr: laqad wuʿidnā hādhā naḥnu wabāʾunā min qablu ʾin hādhā ʾillā ʾasāṭīru al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have heard such promises before, and so did our forefathers. These are just ancient fables.’
verses.pickthall: We were promised this, forsooth, we and our fathers. (All) this is naught but fables of the men of old.

verses.ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."
verses.tr: qul sīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fānẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say, ‘Travel through the earth and see how the evildoers ended up.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see the nature of the sequel for the guilty!

verses.ar: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُن فِى ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.
verses.tr: walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā takun fā ḍayqin mmimmā yamkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do not grieve over them; do not be distressed by their schemes.
verses.pickthall: And grieve thou not for them, nor be in distress because of what they plot (against thee).

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.tr: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā al-waʿdu ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They also say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled if what you say is true?’
verses.pickthall: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?

verses.ar: قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you are impatient.
verses.tr: qul ʿasā ʾan yakūna radifa lakum baʿḍu adh-dhā tastaʿjilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Maybe some of what you seek to hasten is near at hand.’
verses.pickthall: Say: It may be that a part of that which ye would hasten on is close behind you.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful."
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka ladhū faḍlin ʿalā an-nāsi walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord is bountiful to people, though most of them are ungrateful.
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is full of bounty for mankind, but most of them do not give thanks.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
verses.tr: wa-inna rabbaka layaʿlamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wamā yuʿlinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He knows everything their hearts conceal and everything they reveal:
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth surely all that their bosoms hide, and all that they proclaim.

verses.ar: وَمَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.
verses.tr: wamā min ghāʾibahin fā as-samāʾi wa-l-ʾarḍi ʾillā fā kitābin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: there is nothing hidden in the heavens or on earth that is not in a clear Record.
verses.pickthall: And there is nothing hidden in the heaven or the earth but it is in a clear Record.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, this Qur’ān relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā al-qurāna yaquṣṣu ʿalā banā ʾisrāʾīla ʾakthara adh-dhā hum fīhi yakhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly, this Quran explains to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about,
verses.pickthall: Lo! this Qur'an narrateth unto the Children of Israel most of that concerning which they differ.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
verses.tr: wa-innahu lahudanā waraḥmahun llilmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and it is guidance and grace for those who believe.
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is a guidance and a mercy for believers.

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُم بِحُكْمِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.tr: ʾinna rabbaka yaqḍā baynahum biḥukmihi ۚ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly, your Lord will judge between them in His wisdom- He is the Almighty, the All Knowing-
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord will judge between them of His wisdom, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَى ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.en: So rely upon Allāh; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.
verses.tr: fatawakkal ʿalā Allāh ۖ ʾinnaka ʿalā al-ḥaqqi al-mubīni
verses.abdelhaleem: so [Prophet], put your trust in God, you are on the path of clear truth.
verses.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) put thy trust in Allah, for thou (standest) on the plain Truth.

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.
verses.tr: ʾinnaka lā tusmiʿu al-mawtā walā tusmiʿu aṣ-ṣumma ad-duʿāʾa ʾidhā wallawā mudbirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You cannot make the dead hear, you cannot make the deaf listen to your call when they turn their backs and leave,
verses.pickthall: Lo! thou canst not make the dead to hear, nor canst thou make the deaf to hear the call when they have turned to flee;

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَـٰدِى ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَـٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [i.e., submitting to Allāh].
verses.tr: wamā ʾanta bihādā al-ʿumāi ʿan ḍalālatihim ۖ ʾin tusmiʿu ʾillā man yuʾminu bāyātinā fahum mmuslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: you cannot guide the blind out of their error: you cannot make anyone hear you except those who believe in Our signs and submit [to Us].
verses.pickthall: Nor canst thou lead the blind out of their error. Thou canst make none to hear, save those who believe Our revelations and who have surrendered.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَآبَّةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: And when the word [i.e., decree] befalls them, We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].
verses.tr: ۞ wa-idhā waqaʿa al-qawlu ʿalayhim ʾakhrajnā lahum dābbahan mmina al-ʾarḍi tukallimuhum ʾanna an-nāsa kānūā bāyātinā lā yūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the verdict is given against them, We shall bring a creature out of the earth, which will tell them that people had no faith in Our revelations.
verses.pickthall: And when the word is fulfilled concerning them, We shall bring forth a beast of the earth to speak unto them because mankind had not faith in Our revelations.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
verses.en: And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows
verses.tr: wayawma naḥshuru min kulli ʾummahin fawjan mmimman yukadhibu bāyātinā fahum yūzaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Day will come when We gather from every community a crowd of those who disbelieved in Our signs and they will be led in separate groups
verses.pickthall: And (remind them of) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a host of those who denied Our revelations, and they will be set in array;

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِى وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوا۟ بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾū qāla ʾakadhabtum bāyātā walam tuḥīṭūā bihā ʿilman ʾammādhā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: until, when they come before Him, He will say, ‘Did you deny My messages without even taking them in? Or what were you doing?’
verses.pickthall: Till, when they come (before their Lord), He will say: Did ye deny My revelations when ye could not compass them in knowledge, or what was it that ye did?

verses.ar: وَوَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
verses.en: And the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
verses.tr: wawaqaʿa al-qawlu ʿalayhim bimā ẓalamūā fahum lā yanṭiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The verdict will be given against them because of their wrongdoing: they will not speak.
verses.pickthall: And the Word will be fulfilled concerning them because they have done wrong, and they will not speak.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
verses.tr: ʾalam yarawā ʾannā jaʿalnā al-yla liyaskunūā fīhi wa-an-nahāra mubṣiran ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Did they not see that We gave them the night for rest, and the day for light? There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
verses.pickthall: Have they not seen how We have appointed the night that they may rest therein, and the day sight-giving? Lo! therein verily are portents for a people who believe.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَٰخِرِينَ
verses.en: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allāh wills. And all will come to Him humbled.
verses.tr: wayawma yunfakhu fā aṣ-ṣūri fafaziʿa man fā as-samāwāti waman fā al-ʾarḍi ʾillā man shāʾa Allāh ۚ wakullun ʾatawhu dākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day the Trumpet sounds, everyone in heaven and on earth will be terrified- except such as God wills- and all will come to Him in utter humility.
verses.pickthall: And (remind them of) the Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and all who are in the heavens and the earth will start in fear, save him whom Allah willeth. And all come unto Him, humbled.

verses.ar: وَتَرَى ٱلْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِ ۚ صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: And you see the mountains, thinking them motionless, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allāh, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Aware of that which you do.
verses.tr: watarā al-jibāla taḥsabuhā jāmidahan wahāa tamurru marra as-saḥābi ۚ ṣunʿa Allāh adh-dhā ʾatqana kulla shāʾin ۚ ʾinnahu khabīrun bimā tafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You will see the mountains and think they are firmly fixed, but they will float away like clouds: this is the handiwork of God who has perfected all things. He is fully aware of what you do:
verses.pickthall: And thou seest the hills thou deemest solid flying with the flight of clouds: the doing of Allah Who perfecteth all things. Lo! He is Informed of what ye do.

verses.ar: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ
verses.en: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.
verses.tr: man jāʾa bi-l-ḥasanahi falahu khayrun mminhā wahum mmin fazaʿin yawmaʾidhin āminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: whoever comes with a good deed will be rewarded with something better, and be secure from the terrors of that Day,
verses.pickthall: Whoso bringeth a good deed will have better than its worth; and such are safe from fear that Day.

verses.ar: وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"
verses.tr: waman jāʾa bi-as-sayyiʾahi fakubbat wujūhuhum fā an-nāri hal tujzawna ʾillā mā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but whoever comes with evil deeds will be cast face downwards into the Fire. ‘Are you rewarded for anything except what you have done?’
verses.pickthall: And whoso bringeth an ill-deed, such will be flung down on their faces in the Fire. Are ye rewarded aught save what ye did?

verses.ar: إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْبَلْدَةِ ٱلَّذِى حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: [Say, O Muḥammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [i.e., those who submit to Allāh].
verses.tr: ʾinnamā ʾumirtu ʾan ʾaʿbuda rabba hādhihi al-baldahi adh-dhā ḥarramahā walahu kullu shāʾin ۖ wa-umirtu ʾan ʾakūna mina al-muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Say Prophet], ‘What I am commanded to do is to serve the Sustainer of this town, which He has made inviolable. Everything belongs to Him; I am commanded to be one of those devoted to Him;
verses.pickthall: (Say): I (Muhammad) am commanded only to serve the Lord of this land which He hath hallowed, and unto Whom all things belong. And I am commanded to be of those who surrender (unto Him),

verses.ar: وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
verses.en: And to recite the Qur’ān." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."
verses.tr: wa-an ʾatluwā al-qurāna ۖ famani āhtadā fa-innamā yahtadā linafsihi ۖ waman ḍalla faqul ʾinnamā ʾanā mina al-mundhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I am commanded to recite the Quran.’ Whoever chooses to follow the right path does so for his own good. Say to whoever deviates from it, ‘I am only here to warn.’
verses.pickthall: And to recite the Qur'an. And whoso goeth right, goeth right only for (the good of) his own soul; and as for him who goeth astray - (Unto him) say: Lo! I am only a warner.

verses.ar: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
verses.tr: waquli al-ḥamdu lillāh sayurīkum āyātihi fataʿrifūnahā ۚ wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Praise belongs to God: He will show you His signs so that you will recognize them.’ Your Lord is never unmindful of what you all do.
verses.pickthall: And say: Praise be to Allah Who will show you His portents so that ye shall know them. And thy Lord is not unaware of what ye (mortals) do.

verses.ar: طسٓمٓ
verses.en: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.
verses.tr: ṭsm
verses.abdelhaleem: Ta Sin Mim
verses.pickthall: Ta. Sin. Mim.

verses.ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.en: These are verses of the clear Book.
verses.tr: tilka āyātu al-kitābi al-mubīni
verses.abdelhaleem: These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear:
verses.pickthall: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.

verses.ar: نَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.
verses.tr: natlūā ʿalayka min nnabaʾi mūsā wafirʿawna bi-l-ḥaqqi liqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We recount to you [Prophet] part of the story of Moses and Pharaoh, setting out the truth for people who believe.
verses.pickthall: We narrate unto thee (somewhat) of the story of Moses and Pharaoh with truth, for folk who believe.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَآئِفَةً مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.
verses.tr: ʾinna firʿawna ʿalā fā al-ʾarḍi wajaʿala ʾahlahā shiyaʿan yastaḍʿifu ṭāʾifahan mminhum yudhabbiḥu ʾabnāʾahum wayastaḥāi nisāʾahum ۚ ʾinnahu kāna mina al-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh made himself high and mighty in the land and divided the people into different groups: one group he oppressed, slaughtering their sons and sparing their women––he was one of those who spread corruption––
verses.pickthall: Lo! Pharaoh exalted himself in the earth and made its people castes. A tribe among them he oppressed, killing their sons and sparing their women. Lo! he was of those who work corruption.

verses.ar: وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةً وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
verses.en: And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors
verses.tr: wanurīdu ʾan nnamunna ʿalā adh-dhīna āstuḍʿifūā fā al-ʾarḍi wanajʿalahum ʾaʾimmahan wanajʿalahumu al-wārithīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but We wished to favour those who were oppressed in that land, to make them leaders, the ones to survive,
verses.pickthall: And We desired to show favour unto those who were oppressed in the earth, and to make them examples and to make them the inheritors,

verses.ar: وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنُرِىَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَحْذَرُونَ
verses.en: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Hāmān and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.
verses.tr: wanumakkina lahum fā al-ʾarḍi wanurāa firʿawna wahāmāna wajunūdahumā minhum mmā kānūā yaḥdharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: to establish them in the land, and through them show Pharaoh, Haman, and their armies the very thing they feared.
verses.pickthall: And to establish them in the earth, and to show Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts that which they feared from them.

verses.ar: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."
verses.tr: wa-awḥaynā ʾilā ʾummi mūsā ʾan ʾarḍiʿīhi ۖ fa-idhā khifti ʿalayhi fa-ʾalqīhi fā al-yammi walā takhāfā walā taḥzanā ۖ ʾinnā rāddūhu ʾilayki wajāʿilūhu mina al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We inspired Moses’ mother, saying, ‘Suckle him, and then, when you fear for his safety, put him in the river: do not be afraid, and do not grieve, for We shall return him to you and make him a messenger.’
verses.pickthall: And We inspired the mother of Moses, saying: Suckle him and, when thou fearest for him, then cast him into the river and fear not nor grieve. Lo! We shall bring him back unto thee and shall make him (one) of Our messengers.

verses.ar: فَٱلْتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّا وَحَزَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰطِـِٔينَ
verses.en: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. Indeed, Pharaoh and Hāmān and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.
verses.tr: fa-at-taqaṭahu ālu firʿawna liyakūna lahum ʿaduwwan waḥazanan ۗ ʾinna firʿawna wahāmāna wajunūdahumā kānūā khāṭīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh’s household picked him up––later to become an enemy and a source of grief for them: Pharaoh, Haman, and their armies were wrongdoers––
verses.pickthall: And the family of Pharaoh took him up, that he might become for them an enemy and a sorrow, Lo! Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts were ever sinning.

verses.ar: وَقَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍ لِّى وَلَكَ ۖ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: And the wife of Pharaoh said, "[He will be] a comfort of the eye [i.e., pleasure] for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son." And they perceived not.
verses.tr: waqālati āmraʾatu firʿawna qurratu ʿaynin llā walaka ۖ lā taqtulūhu ʿasā ʾan yanfaʿanā ʾaw nattakhidhahu waladan wahum lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and Pharaoh’s wife said, ‘Here is a joy to behold for me and for you! Do not kill him: he may be of use to us, or we may adopt him as a son.’ They did not realize what they were doing.
verses.pickthall: And the wife of Pharaoh said: (He will be) a consolation for me and for thee. Kill him not. Peradventure he may be of use to us, or we may choose him for a son. And they perceived not.

verses.ar: وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَـٰرِغًا ۖ إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِى بِهِۦ لَوْلَآ أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.
verses.tr: wa-aṣbaḥa fuādu ʾummi mūsā fārighan ۖ ʾin kādat latubdā bihi lawlā ʾan rrabaṭnā ʿalā qalbihā litakūna mina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The next day, Moses’ mother felt a void in her heart––if We had not strengthened it to make her one of those who believe, she would have revealed everything about him––
verses.pickthall: And the heart of the mother of Moses became void, and she would have betrayed him if We had not fortified her heart, that she might be of the believers.

verses.ar: وَقَالَتْ لِأُخْتِهِۦ قُصِّيهِ ۖ فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِۦ عَن جُنُبٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.
verses.tr: waqālat liʾukhtihi quṣṣīhi ۖ fabaṣurat bihi ʿan junubin wahum lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and she said to his sister, ‘Follow him.’ So she watched him from a distance, without them knowing.
verses.pickthall: And she said unto his sister: Trace him. So she observed him from afar, and they perceived not.

verses.ar: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verses.en: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"
verses.tr: ۞ waḥarramnā ʿalayhi al-marāḍiʿa min qablu faqālat hal ʾadullukum ʿalā ʾahli baytin yakfulūnahu lakum wahum lahu nāṣiḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We had ordained that he would refuse to feed from wet nurses. His sister approached them and said, ‘Shall I tell you about a household which could bring him up for you and take good care of him?’
verses.pickthall: And We had before forbidden foster-mothers for him, so she said: Shall I show you a household who will rear him for you and take care of him?

verses.ar: فَرَدَدْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّهِۦ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَلِتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allāh is true. But most of them [i.e., the people] do not know.
verses.tr: faradadnāhu ʾilā ʾummihi kā taqarra ʿaynuhā walā taḥzana walitaʿlama ʾanna waʿda Allāh ḥaqqun walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We restored him to his mother in this way, so that she might be comforted, not grieve, and know that God’s promise is true, though most of them do not know.
verses.pickthall: So We restored him to his mother that she might be comforted and not grieve, and that she might know that the promise of Allah is true. But most of them know not.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَٱسْتَوَىٰٓ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And when he attained his full strength and was [mentally] mature, We bestowed upon him judgement and knowledge. And thus do We reward the doers of good.
verses.tr: walammā balagha ʾashuddahu wāstawā ātaynāhu ḥukman waʿilman ۚ wakadhālika najzā al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When Moses reached full maturity and manhood, We gave him wisdom and knowledge: this is how We reward those who do good.
verses.pickthall: And when he reached his full strength and was ripe, We gave him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward the good.

verses.ar: وَدَخَلَ ٱلْمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتَتِلَانِ هَـٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ وَهَـٰذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ ۖ فَٱسْتَغَـٰثَهُ ٱلَّذِى مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ عَلَى ٱلَّذِى مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ فَوَكَزَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ۖ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَدُوٌّ مُّضِلٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people and found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy. And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him. [Moses] said, "This is from the work of Satan. Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy."
verses.tr: wadakhala al-madīnaha ʿalā ḥīni ghaflahin mmin ʾahlihā fawajada fīhā rajulayni yaqtatilāni hādhā min shīʿatihi wahādhā min ʿaduwwihi ۖ fāstaghāthahu adh-dhā min shīʿatihi ʿalā adh-dhā min ʿaduwwihi fawakazahu mūsā faqaḍā ʿalayhi ۖ qāla hādhā min ʿamali ash-shayṭāni ۖ ʾinnahu ʿaduwwun mmuḍillun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: He entered the city, unnoticed by its people, and found two men fighting: one from his own people, the other an enemy. The one from his own people cried out to him for help against the enemy. Moses struck him with his fist and killed him. He said, ‘This must be Satan’s work: clearly he is a misleading enemy.’
verses.pickthall: And he entered the city at a time of carelessness of its folk, and he found therein two men fighting, one of his own caste, and the other of his enemies; and he who was of his caste asked him for help against him who was of his enemies. So Moses struck him with his fist and killed him. He said: This is of the devil's doing. Lo! he is an enemy, a mere misleader.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ʾinnā ẓalamtu nafsā fāghfir lā faghafara lahu ۚ ʾinnahu huwa al-ghafūru ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Lord, I have wronged myself. Forgive me,’ so He forgave him; He is truly the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged my soul, so forgive me. Then He forgave him. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi bimā ʾanʿamta ʿalāa falan ʾakūna ẓahīran llilmujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My Lord, because of the blessings You have bestowed upon me, I shall never support those who do evil.’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Forasmuch as Thou hast favoured me, I will nevermore be a supporter of the guilty.

verses.ar: فَأَصْبَحَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ خَآئِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَنصَرَهُۥ بِٱلْأَمْسِ يَسْتَصْرِخُهُۥ ۚ قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّكَ لَغَوِىٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And he became inside the city fearful and anticipating [exposure], when suddenly the one who sought his help the previous day cried out to him [once again]. Moses said to him, "Indeed, you are an evident, [persistent] deviator."
verses.tr: fa-aṣbaḥa fā al-madīnahi khāʾifan yataraqqabu fa-idhā adh-dhā āstanṣarahu bi-l-ʾamsi yastaṣrikhuhu ۚ qāla lahu mūsā ʾinnaka laghawāun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Next morning, he was walking in the city, fearful and vigilant, when suddenly the man he had helped the day before cried out to him for help. Moses said, ‘You are clearly a troublemaker.’
verses.pickthall: And morning found him in the city, fearing, vigilant, when behold! he who had appealed to him the day before cried out to him for help. Moses said unto him: Lo! thou art indeed a mere hothead.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَبْطِشَ بِٱلَّذِى هُوَ عَدُوٌّ لَّهُمَا قَالَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ أَتُرِيدُ أَن تَقْتُلَنِى كَمَا قَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۢا بِٱلْأَمْسِ ۖ إِن تُرِيدُ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ جَبَّارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُرِيدُ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُصْلِحِينَ
verses.en: And when he wanted to strike the one who was an enemy to both of them, he said, "O Moses, do you intend to kill me as you killed someone yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land and do not want to be of the amenders."
verses.tr: falammā ʾan ʾarāda ʾan yabṭisha bi-adh-dhā huwa ʿaduwwun llahumā qāla yāmūsā ʾaturīdu ʾan taqtulanā kamā qatalta nafsanā bi-l-ʾamsi ۖ ʾin turīdu ʾillā ʾan takūna jabbāran fā al-ʾarḍi wamā turīdu ʾan takūna mina al-muṣliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: As he was about to attack the man who was an enemy to both of them, the man said, ‘Moses, are you going to kill me as you killed that person yesterday? You clearly want to be a tyrant in the land; you do not intend to put things right.’
verses.pickthall: And when he would have fallen upon the man who was an enemy unto them both, he said: O Moses! Wouldst thou kill me as thou didst kill a person yesterday. Thou wouldst be nothing but a tyrant in the land, thou wouldst not be of the reformers.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ رَجُلٌ مِّنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱلْمَلَأَ يَأْتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقْتُلُوكَ فَٱخْرُجْ إِنِّى لَكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّـٰصِحِينَ
verses.en: And a man came from the farthest end of the city, running. He said, "O Moses, indeed the eminent ones are conferring over you [intending] to kill you, so leave [the city]; indeed, I am to you of the sincere advisors."
verses.tr: wajāʾa rajulun mmin ʾaqṣā al-madīnahi yasʿā qāla yāmūsā ʾinna al-malaʾa yaʾtamirūna bika liyaqtulūka fākhruj ʾinnā laka mina an-nāṣiḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then a man came running from the furthest part of the city and said, ‘Moses, the authorities are talking about killing you, so leave- this is my sincere advice.’
verses.pickthall: And a man came from the uttermost part of the city, running. He said: O Moses! Lo! the chiefs take counsel against thee to slay thee; therefor escape. Lo! I am of those who give thee good advice.

verses.ar: فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَآئِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."
verses.tr: fakharaja minhā khāʾifan yataraqqabu ۖ qāla rabbi najjinā mina al-qawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So Moses left the city, fearful and wary, and prayed, ‘My Lord, save me from people who do wrong.’
verses.pickthall: So he escaped from thence, fearing, vigilant. He said: My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing folk.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلْقَآءَ مَدْيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِى سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
verses.en: And when he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way."
verses.tr: walammā tawajjaha tilqāʾa madyana qāla ʿasā rabbā ʾan yahdiyanā sawāʾa as-sabīli
verses.abdelhaleem: As he made his way towards Midian, he was saying, ‘May my Lord guide me to the right way.’
verses.pickthall: And when he turned his face toward Midian, he said: Peradventure my Lord will guide me in the right road.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَآءَ مَدْيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ أُمَّةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْقُونَ وَوَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمُ ٱمْرَأَتَيْنِ تَذُودَانِ ۖ قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُمَا ۖ قَالَتَا لَا نَسْقِى حَتَّىٰ يُصْدِرَ ٱلرِّعَآءُ ۖ وَأَبُونَا شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.en: And when he came to the water [i.e., well] of Madyan, he found there a crowd of people watering [their flocks], and he found aside from them two women holding back [their flocks]. He said, "What is your circumstance?" They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man."
verses.tr: walammā warada māʾa madyana wajada ʿalayhi ʾummahan mmina an-nāsi yasqūna wawajada min dūnihimu āmraʾatayni tadhūdāni ۖ qāla mā khaṭbukumā ۖ qālatā lā nasqā ḥattā yuṣdira ar-riʿāʾu ۖ wa-abūnā shaykhun kabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: When he arrived at Midian’s waters, he found a group of men watering [their flocks], and beside them two women keeping their flocks back, so he said, ‘What is the matter with you two?’ They said, ‘We cannot water [our flocks] until the shepherds take their sheep away: our father is a very old man.’
verses.pickthall: And when he came unto the water of Midian he found there a whole tribe of men, watering. And he found apart from them two women keeping back (their flocks). He said: What aileth you? The two said: We cannot give (our flocks) to drink till the shepherds return from the water; and our father is a very old man.

verses.ar: فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
verses.en: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."
verses.tr: fasaqā lahumā thumma tawallā ʾilā aẓ-ẓilli faqāla rabbi ʾinnā limā ʾanzalta ʾilāa min khayrin faqīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: He watered their flocks for them, withdrew into the shade, and prayed, ‘My Lord, I am in dire need of whatever good thing You may send me,’
verses.pickthall: So he watered (their flock) for them. Then he turned aside into the shade, and said: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me.

verses.ar: فَجَآءَتْهُ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا تَمْشِى عَلَى ٱسْتِحْيَآءٍ قَالَتْ إِنَّ أَبِى يَدْعُوكَ لِيَجْزِيَكَ أَجْرَ مَا سَقَيْتَ لَنَا ۚ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُۥ وَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَصَصَ قَالَ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ نَجَوْتَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: Then one of the two women came to him walking with shyness. She said, "Indeed, my father invites you that he may reward you for having watered for us." So when he came to him and related to him the story, he said, "Fear not. You have escaped from the wrongdoing people."
verses.tr: fajāʾathu ʾiḥdāhumā tamshā ʿalā āstiḥyāʾin qālat ʾinna ʾabā yadʿūka liyajziyaka ʾajra mā saqayta lanā ۚ falammā jāʾahu waqaṣṣa ʿalayhi al-qaṣaṣa qāla lā takhaf ۖ najawta mina al-qawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then one of the two women approached him, walking shyly, and said, ‘My father is asking for you: he wants to reward you for watering our flocks for us.’ When Moses came to him and told him his story, the old man said, ‘Do not be afraid, you are safe now from people who do wrong.’
verses.pickthall: Then there came unto him one of the two women, walking shyly. She said: Lo! my father biddeth thee, that he may reward thee with a payment for that thou didst water (the flock) for us. Then, when he came unto him and told him the (whole) story, he said: Fear not! Thou hast escaped from the wrongdoing folk.

verses.ar: قَالَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱسْتَـْٔجِرْهُ ۖ إِنَّ خَيْرَ مَنِ ٱسْتَـْٔجَرْتَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْأَمِينُ
verses.en: One of the women said, "O my father, hire him. Indeed, the best one you can hire is the strong and the trustworthy."
verses.tr: qālat ʾiḥdāhumā yāʾabati āstajirhu ۖ ʾinna khayra mani āstajarta al-qawāu al-ʾamīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: One of the women said, ‘Father, hire him: a strong, trustworthy man is the best to hire.’
verses.pickthall: One of the two women said: O my father! Hire him! For the best (man) that thou canst hire in the strong, the trustworthy.

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُنكِحَكَ إِحْدَى ٱبْنَتَىَّ هَـٰتَيْنِ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَأْجُرَنِى ثَمَـٰنِىَ حِجَجٍ ۖ فَإِنْ أَتْمَمْتَ عَشْرًا فَمِنْ عِندِكَ ۖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَيْكَ ۚ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: He said, "Indeed, I wish to wed you one of these, my two daughters, on [the condition] that you serve me for eight years; but if you complete ten, it will be [as a favor] from you. And I do not wish to put you in difficulty. You will find me, if Allāh wills, from among the righteous."
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnā ʾurīdu ʾan ʾunkiḥaka ʾiḥdā ābnatāa hātayni ʿalā ʾan taʾjuranā thamānāa ḥijajin ۖ fa-in ʾatmamta ʿashran famin ʿindika ۖ wamā ʾurīdu ʾan ʾashuqqa ʿalayka ۚ satajidunā ʾin shāʾa Allāh mina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The father said, ‘I would like to marry you to one of these daughters of mine, on condition that you serve me for eight years: if you complete ten, it will be of your own free will. I do not intend to make things difficult for you: God willing, you will find I am a fair man.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Lo! I fain would marry thee to one of these two daughters of mine on condition that thou hirest thyself to me for (the term of) eight pilgrimages. Then if thou completest ten it will be of thine own accord, for I would not make it hard for thee. Allah willing, thou wilt find me of the righteous.

verses.ar: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ ۖ أَيَّمَا ٱلْأَجَلَيْنِ قَضَيْتُ فَلَا عُدْوَٰنَ عَلَىَّ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "That is [established] between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I complete - there is no injustice to me, and Allāh, over what we say, is Witness."
verses.tr: qāla dhālika baynā wabaynaka ۖ ʾayyamā al-ʾajalayni qaḍaytu falā ʿudwāna ʿalāa ۖ wallāh ʿalā mā naqūlu wakīlun
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘Let that be the agreement between us- whichever of the two terms I fulfil, let there be no injustice to me- God is witness to what we say.’
verses.pickthall: He said: That (is settled) between thee and me. Whichever of the two terms I fulfil, there will be no injustice to me, and Allah is Surety over what we say.

verses.ar: ۞ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلْأَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِأَهْلِهِۦٓ ءَانَسَ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ نَارًا قَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ جَذْوَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
verses.en: And when Moses had completed the term and was traveling with his family, he perceived from the direction of the mount a fire. He said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire. Perhaps I will bring you from there [some] information or burning wood from the fire that you may warm yourselves."
verses.tr: ۞ falammā qaḍā mūsā al-ʾajala wasāra biʾahlihi ānasa min jānibi aṭ-ṭūri nāran qāla liʾahlihi āmkuthūā ʾinnā ānastu nāran llaʿallā ātīkum mminhā bikhabarin ʾaw jadhwahin mmina an-nāri laʿallakum taṣṭalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Once Moses had fulfilled the term and was travelling with his family, he caught sight of a fire on the side of the mountain and said to his family, ‘Wait! I have seen a fire. I will bring you news from there, or a burning stick for you to warm yourselves.’
verses.pickthall: Then, when Moses had fulfilled the term, and was travelling with his housefolk, he saw in the distance a fire and said unto his housefolk: Bide ye (here). Lo! I see in the distance a fire; peradventure I shall bring you tidings thence, or a brand from the fire that ye may warm yourselves.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ مِن شَـٰطِئِ ٱلْوَادِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ فِى ٱلْبُقْعَةِ ٱلْمُبَـٰرَكَةِ مِنَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ أَن يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: But when he came to it, he was called from the right side of the valley in a blessed spot - from the tree, "O Moses, indeed I am Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
verses.tr: falammā ʾatāhā nūdāa min shāṭiʾi al-wādi al-ʾaymani fā al-buqʿahi al-mubārakahi mina ash-shajarahi ʾan yāmūsā ʾinnā ʾanā Allāh rabbu al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But when he reached it, a voice called out to him from the right-hand side of the valley, from a tree on the blessed ground: ‘Moses, I am God, the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: And when he reached it, he was called from the right side of the valley in the blessed field, from the tree: O Moses! Lo! I, even I, am Allah, the Lord of the Worlds;

verses.ar: وَأَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ أَقْبِلْ وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔامِنِينَ
verses.en: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it was a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allāh said], "O Moses, approach and fear not. Indeed, you are of the secure.
verses.tr: wa-an ʾalqi ʿaṣāka ۖ falammā raāhā tahtazzu kaʾannahā jānnun wallā mudbiran walam yuʿaqqib ۚ yāmūsā ʾaqbil walā takhaf ۖ ʾinnaka mina al-āminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Throw down your staff.’ When he saw his staff moving like a snake, he fled in fear and would not return. Again [he was called]: ‘Moses! Draw near! Do not be afraid, for you are one of those who are safe.
verses.pickthall: Throw down thy staff. And when he saw it writhing as it had been a demon, he turned to flee headlong, (and it was said unto him): O Moses! Draw nigh and fear not. Lo! thou art of those who are secure.

verses.ar: ٱسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ وَٱضْمُمْ إِلَيْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ ٱلرَّهْبِ ۖ فَذَٰنِكَ بُرْهَـٰنَانِ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease. And draw in your arm close to you [as prevention] from fear, for those are two proofs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his establishment. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
verses.tr: āsluk yadaka fā jaybika takhruj bayḍāʾa min ghayri sūʾin wāḍmum ʾilayka janāḥaka mina ar-rahbi ۖ fadhānika burhānāni min rrabbika ʾilā firʿawna wamalaʾīhi ۚ ʾinnahum kānūā qawman fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Put your hand inside your shirt and it will come out white but unharmed- hold your arm close to your side, free from all fear. These shall be two signs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his chiefs; they are truly wicked people.’
verses.pickthall: Thrust thy hand into the bosom of thy robe it will come forth white without hurt. And guard thy heart from fear. Then these shall be two proofs from your Lord unto Pharaoh and his chiefs. Lo! they are evil-living folk.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى قَتَلْتُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسًا فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I killed from among them someone, and I fear they will kill me.
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ʾinnā qataltu minhum nafsan fa-akhāfu ʾan yaqtulūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘My Lord, I killed one of their men, and I fear that they may kill me.
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I killed a man among them and I fear that they will kill me.

verses.ar: وَأَخِى هَـٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفْصَحُ مِنِّى لِسَانًا فَأَرْسِلْهُ مَعِىَ رِدْءًا يُصَدِّقُنِىٓ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
verses.en: And my brother Aaron is more fluent than me in tongue, so send him with me as support, verifying me. Indeed, I fear that they will deny me."
verses.tr: wa-akhā hārūnu huwa ʾafṣaḥu minnā lisānan fa-arsilhu maʿāa ridʾan yuṣaddiqunā ۖ ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʾan yukadhibūni
verses.abdelhaleem: My brother Aaron is more eloquent than I: send him with me to help me and confirm my words- I fear they may call me a liar.’
verses.pickthall: My brother Aaron is more eloquent than me in speech. Therefor send him with me as a helper to confirm me. Lo! I fear that they will give the lie to me.

verses.ar: قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِأَخِيكَ وَنَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلْطَـٰنًا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيْكُمَا ۚ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أَنتُمَا وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكُمَا ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "We will strengthen your arm through your brother and grant you both supremacy so they will not reach you. [It will be] through Our signs; you and those who follow you will be the predominant."
verses.tr: qāla sanashuddu ʿaḍudaka biʾakhīka wanajʿalu lakumā sulṭānan falā yaṣilūna ʾilaykumā ۚ bāyātinā ʾantumā wamani āttabaʿakumā al-ghālibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘We shall strengthen you through your brother; We shall give you both power so that they cannot touch you. With Our signs you, and those who follow you, will triumph.’
verses.pickthall: He said: We will strengthen thine arm with thy brother, and We will give unto you both power so that they cannot reach you for Our portents. Ye twain, and those who follow you, will be the winners.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّفْتَرًى وَمَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: But when Moses came to them with Our signs as clear evidences, they said, "This is not except invented magic, and we have not heard of this [religion] among our forefathers."
verses.tr: falammā jāʾahum mmūsā bāyātinā bayyinātin qālūā mā hādhā ʾillā siḥrun mmuftaranā wamā samiʿnā bihādhā fā ābāʾinā al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But when Moses came to them with Our clear signs, they said, ‘These are mere conjuring tricks; we never heard this from our forefathers.’
verses.pickthall: But when Moses came unto them with Our clear tokens, they said: This is naught but invented magic. We never heard of this among our fathers of old.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن جَآءَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ مِنْ عِندِهِۦ وَمَن تَكُونُ لَهُۥ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلدَّارِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: And Moses said, "My Lord is more knowing [than we or you] of who has come with guidance from Him and to whom will be succession in the home. Indeed, wrongdoers do not succeed."
verses.tr: waqāla mūsā rabbā ʾaʿlamu biman jāʾa bi-l-hudā min ʿindihi waman takūnu lahu ʿāqibahu ad-dāri ۖ ʾinnahu lā yufliḥu aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘My Lord knows best who comes with guidance from Him and who will have the final Home: wrongdoers will never succeed.’
verses.pickthall: And Moses said: My Lord is Best Aware of him who bringeth guidance from His presence, and whose will be the sequel of the Home (of bliss). Lo! wrong-doers will not be successful.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَأُ مَا عَلِمْتُ لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرِى فَأَوْقِدْ لِى يَـٰهَـٰمَـٰنُ عَلَى ٱلطِّينِ فَٱجْعَل لِّى صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّىٓ أَطَّلِعُ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: And Pharaoh said, "O eminent ones, I have not known you to have a god other than me. Then ignite for me, O Hāmān, [a fire] upon the clay and make for me a tower that I may look at the God of Moses. And indeed, I do think he is among the liars."
verses.tr: waqāla firʿawnu yāʾayyuhā al-malaʾu mā ʿalimtu lakum mmin ʾilāhin ghayrā fa-awqid lā yāhāmānu ʿalā aṭ-ṭīni fājʿal llā ṣarḥan llaʿallā ʾaṭṭaliʿu ʾilā ʾilāhi mūsā wa-innā laʾaẓunnuhu mina al-kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said, ‘Counsellors, you have no other god that I know of except me. Haman, light me a fire to bake clay bricks, then build me a tall building so that I may climb up to Moses’ God: I am convinced that he is lying.’
verses.pickthall: And Pharaoh said: O chiefs! I know not that ye have a god other than me, so kindle for me (a fire), O Haman, to bake the mud; and set up for me a lofty tower in order that I may survey the god of Moses; and lo! I deem him of the liars.

verses.ar: وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ هُوَ وَجُنُودُهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: And he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to Us.
verses.tr: wāstakbara huwa wajunūduhu fā al-ʾarḍi bighayri al-ḥaqqi waẓannūā ʾannahum ʾilaynā lā yurjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh and his armies behaved arrogantly in the land with no right- they thought they would not be brought back to Us-
verses.pickthall: And he and his hosts were haughty in the land without right, and deemed that they would never be brought back to Us.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: So We took him and his soldiers and threw them into the sea. So see how was the end of the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fā al-yammi ۖ fānẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: so We seized him and his armies and threw them into the sea. See what became of the wrongdoers!
verses.pickthall: Therefor We seized him and his hosts, and abandoned them unto the sea. Behold the nature of the consequence for evil-doers!

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnāhum ʾaʾimmahan yadʿūna ʾilā an-nāri ۖ wayawma al-qiyāmahi lā yunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We made them leaders calling [others] only to the Fire: on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.
verses.pickthall: And We made them patterns that invite unto the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.

verses.ar: وَأَتْبَعْنَـٰهُمْ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمَقْبُوحِينَ
verses.en: And We caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised.
verses.tr: wa-atbaʿnāhum fā hādhihi ad-dunyā laʿnahan ۖ wayawma al-qiyāmahi hum mmina al-maqbūḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We made Our rejection pursue them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be among the despised.
verses.pickthall: And We made a curse to follow them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be among the hateful.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ أَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْقُرُونَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ بَصَآئِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And We gave Moses the Scripture, after We had destroyed the former generations, as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded.
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā mūsā al-kitāba min baʿdi mā ʾahlaknā al-qurūna al-ʾūlā baṣāʾira lilnnāsi wahudanā waraḥmahan llaʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: After We had destroyed the earlier generations, We gave Moses the Scripture to provide insight, guidance, and mercy for people, so that they might take heed.
verses.pickthall: And We verily gave the Scripture unto Moses after We had destroyed the generations of old: clear testimonies for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy, that haply they might reflect.

verses.ar: وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلْغَرْبِىِّ إِذْ قَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلْأَمْرَ وَمَا كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
verses.en: And you, [O Muḥammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].
verses.tr: wamā kunta bijānibi al-gharbāi ʾidh qaḍaynā ʾilā mūsā al-ʾamra wamā kunta mina ash-shāhidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You [Muhammad] were not present on the western side of the mountain when We gave Our command to Moses: you were not there-
verses.pickthall: And thou (Muhammad) wast not on the western side (of the Mount) when We expounded unto Moses the commandment, and thou wast not among those present;

verses.ar: وَلَـٰكِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَا قُرُونًا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ ثَاوِيًا فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ تَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
verses.en: But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration. And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message].
verses.tr: walākinnā ʾanshaʾnā qurūnan fataṭāwala ʿalayhimu al-ʿumuru ۚ wamā kunta thāwiyan fā ʾahli madyana tatlūā ʿalayhim āyātinā walākinnā kunnā mursilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have brought into being many generations who lived long lives- you did not live among the people of Midian or recite Our Revelation to them- We have always sent messengers to people-
verses.pickthall: But We brought forth generations, and their lives dragged on for them. And thou wast not a dweller in Midian, reciting unto them Our revelations, but We kept sending (messengers to men).

verses.ar: وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ إِذْ نَادَيْنَا وَلَـٰكِن رَّحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And you were not at the side of the mount when We called [Moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your Lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded.
verses.tr: wamā kunta bijānibi aṭ-ṭūri ʾidh nādaynā walākin rraḥmahan mmin rrabbika litundhira qawman mmā ʾatāhum mmin nnadhīrin mmin qablika laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: nor were you present on the side of Mount Sinai when We called out to Moses. But you too have been sent as an act of grace from your Lord, to give warning to a people to whom no warner has come before, so that they may take heed,
verses.pickthall: And thou was not beside the Mount when We did call; but (the knowledge of it is) a mercy from thy Lord that thou mayst warn a folk unto whom no warner came before thee, that haply they may give heed.

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَآ أَن تُصِيبَهُم مُّصِيبَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَـٰتِكَ وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, "Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses and been among the believers?"...
verses.tr: walawlā ʾan tuṣībahum mmuṣībahun bimā qaddamat ʾaydīhim fayaqūlūā rabbanā lawlā ʾarsalta ʾilaynā rasūlan fanattabiʿa āyātika wanakūna mina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and may not say, if a disaster should befall them as a result of what they have done with their own hands, ‘Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we might have followed Your message and become believers.’
verses.pickthall: Otherwise, if disaster should afflict them because of that which their own hands have sent before (them), they might say: Our Lord! Why sentest Thou no messenger unto us, that we might have followed Thy revelations and been of the believers?

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُوتِىَ مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ قَالُوا۟ سِحْرَانِ تَظَـٰهَرَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِكُلٍّ كَـٰفِرُونَ
