verses.en: But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, "Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?" Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Moses before? They said, "[They are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers."
verses.tr: falammā jāʾahumu al-ḥaqqu min ʿindinā qālūā lawlā ʾūtāa mithla mā ʾūtāa mūsā ۚ ʾawalam yakfurūā bimā ʾūtāa mūsā min qablu ۖ qālūā siḥrāni taẓāharā waqālūā ʾinnā bikullin kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Even now that Our truth has come to them, they say, ‘Why has he not been given signs like those given to Moses?’ Did they not also deny the truth that was given to Moses before? They say, ‘Two kinds of sor-cery, helping each other,’ and, ‘We refuse to accept either of them.’
verses.pickthall: But when there came unto them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Why is he not given the like of what was given unto Moses? Did they not disbelieve in that which was given unto Moses of old? They say: Two magics that support each other; and they say: Lo! in both we are disbelievers.

verses.ar: قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبٍ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْهُمَآ أَتَّبِعْهُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Then bring a scripture from Allāh which is more guiding than either of them that I may follow it, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: qul fa-tūā bikitābin mmin ʿindi Allāh huwa ʾahdā minhumā ʾattabiʿhu ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Muhammad], ‘Then produce a book from God that gives better guidance than these two and I will follow it, if you are telling the truth.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Then bring a scripture from the presence of Allah that giveth clearer guidance than these two (that) I may follow it, if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: فَإِن لَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكَ فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّمَا يَتَّبِعُونَ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ بِغَيْرِ هُدًى مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: But if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allāh? Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
verses.tr: fa-in llam yastajībūā laka fāʿlam ʾannamā yattabiʿūna ʾahwāʾahum ۚ waman ʾaḍallu mimmani āttabaʿa hawāhu bighayri hudanā mmina Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh lā yahdā al-qawma aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they do not respond to you, you will know that they follow only their own desires. Who is further astray than the one who follows his own desires with no guidance from God? Truly God does not guide those who do wrong.
verses.pickthall: And if they answer thee not, then know that what they follow is their lusts. And who goeth farther astray than he who followeth his lust without guidance from Allah. Lo! Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ وَصَّلْنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the word [i.e., the Qur’ān] that they might be reminded.
verses.tr: ۞ walaqad waṣṣalnā lahumu al-qawla laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have caused Our Word to come to them so that they may be mindful.
verses.pickthall: And now verily We have caused the Word to reach them, that haply they may give heed.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ هُم بِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it - they are believers in it.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ātaynāhumu al-kitāba min qablihi hum bihi yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before believe in it,
verses.pickthall: Those unto whom We gave the Scripture before it, they believe in it,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And when it is recited to them, they say, "We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were, [even] before it, Muslims [i.e., submitting to Allāh]."
verses.tr: wa-idhā yutlā ʿalayhim qālūā āmannā bihi ʾinnahu al-ḥaqqu min rrabbinā ʾinnā kunnā min qablihi muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and, when it is recited to them, say, ‘We believe in it, it is the truth from our Lord. Before it came we had already devoted ourselves to Him.’
verses.pickthall: And when it is recited unto them, they say: We believe in it. Lo! it is the Truth from our Lord. Lo! even before it we were of those who surrender (unto Him).

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُؤْتَوْنَ أَجْرَهُم مَّرَّتَيْنِ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.en: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika yuʾtawna ʾajrahum mmarratayni bimā ṣabarūā wayadraʾūna bi-l-ḥasanahi as-sayyiʾaha wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will be given their rewards twice over because they are steadfast, repel evil with good, give to others out of what We have provided for them,
verses.pickthall: These will be given their reward twice over, because they are steadfast and repel evil with good, and spend of that wherewith We have provided them,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱللَّغْوَ أَعْرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ لَنَآ أَعْمَـٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا نَبْتَغِى ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
verses.en: And when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, "For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. Peace will be upon you; we seek not the ignorant."
verses.tr: wa-idhā samiʿūā al-laghwa ʾaʿraḍūā ʿanhu waqālūā lanā ʾaʿmālunā walakum ʾaʿmālukum salāmun ʿalaykum lā nabtaghā al-jāhilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and turn away whenever they hear frivolous talk, saying, ‘We have our deeds and you have yours. Peace be with you! We do not seek the company of ignorant people.’
verses.pickthall: And when they hear vanity they withdraw from it and say: Unto us our works and unto you your works. Peace be unto you! We desire not the ignorant.

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِى مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, [O Muḥammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allāh guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
verses.tr: ʾinnaka lā tahdā man ʾaḥbabta walākinna Allāh yahdā man yashāʾu ۚ wahuwa ʾaʿlamu bi-l-muhtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You [Prophet] cannot guide everyone you love to the truth; it is God who guides whoever He will: He knows best those who will follow guidance.
verses.pickthall: Lo! thou (O Muhammad) guidest not whom thou lovest, but Allah guideth whom He will. And He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِن نَّتَّبِعِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفْ مِنْ أَرْضِنَآ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّهُمْ حَرَمًا ءَامِنًا يُجْبَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ ثَمَرَٰتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ رِّزْقًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And they [i.e., the Quraysh] say, "If we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept from our land." Have We not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us? But most of them do not know.
verses.tr: waqālūā ʾin nnattabiʿi al-hudā maʿaka nutakhaṭṭaf min ʾarḍinā ۚ ʾawalam numakkin llahum ḥaraman āminan yujbā ʾilayhi thamarātu kulli shāʾin rrizqan mmin lladunnā walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘If we were to follow guidance with you [Prophet], we would be swept from our land.’ Have We not established for them a secure sanctuary where every kind of produce is brought, as a provision from Us? But most of them do not comprehend.
verses.pickthall: And they say: If we were to follow the Guidance with thee we should be torn out of our land. Have We not established for them a sure sanctuary, whereunto the produce of all things is brought (in trade), a provision from Our presence? But most of them know not.

verses.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۭ بَطِرَتْ مَعِيشَتَهَا ۖ فَتِلْكَ مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ لَمْ تُسْكَن مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۖ وَكُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
verses.en: And how many a city have We destroyed that was insolent in its [way of] living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly. And it is We who were the inheritors.
verses.tr: wakam ʾahlaknā min qaryahin baṭirat maʿīshatahā ۖ fatilka masākinuhum lam tuskan mmin baʿdihim ʾillā qalīlan ۖ wakunnā naḥnu al-wārithīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have destroyed many a community that once revelled in its wanton wealth and easy living: since then their dwelling places have barely been inhabited- We are the only heir.
verses.pickthall: And how many a community have We destroyed that was thankless for its means of livelihood! And yonder are their dwellings, which have not been inhabited after them save a little. And We, even We, were the inheritors.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يَبْعَثَ فِىٓ أُمِّهَا رَسُولًا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا ۚ وَمَا كُنَّا مُهْلِكِى ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا وَأَهْلُهَا ظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: And never would your Lord have destroyed the cities until He had sent to their mother [i.e., principal city] a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers.
verses.tr: wamā kāna rabbuka muhlika al-qurā ḥattā yabʿatha fā ʾummihā rasūlan yatlūā ʿalayhim āyātinā ۚ wamā kunnā muhlikā al-qurā ʾillā wa-ahluhā ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord would never destroy towns without first raising a messenger in their midst to recite Our messages to them, nor would We destroy towns unless their inhabitants were evildoers.
verses.pickthall: And never did thy Lord destroy the townships, till He had raised up in their mother(-town) a messenger reciting unto them Our revelations. And never did We destroy the townships unless the folk thereof were evil-doers.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَمَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتُهَا ۚ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. And what is with Allāh is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason?
verses.tr: wamā ʾūtītum mmin shāʾin famatāʿu al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā wazīnatuhā ۚ wamā ʿinda Allāh khayrun wa-abqā ۚ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whatever things you have been given for the life of this world are merely [temporary] gratification and vanity: that which is with God is better and more lasting- will you not use your reason?
verses.pickthall: And whatsoever ye have been given is a comfort of the life of the world and an ornament thereof; and that which Allah hath is better and more lasting. Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: أَفَمَن وَعَدْنَـٰهُ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ لَـٰقِيهِ كَمَن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُ مَتَـٰعَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
verses.en: Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will meet [i.e., obtain] like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]?
verses.tr: ʾafaman waʿadnāhu waʿdan ḥasanan fahuwa lāqīhi kaman mmattaʿnāhu matāʿa al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā thumma huwa yawma al-qiyāmahi mina al-muḥḍarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Can the person who will see the fulfilment of the good promise We gave him be compared to someone We have given some enjoyments for this worldly life but who, on the Day of Resurrection, will be summoned?
verses.pickthall: Is he whom We have promised a fair promise which he will find (true) like him whom We suffer to enjoy awhile the comfort of the life of the world, then on the Day of Resurrection he will be of those arraigned?

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
verses.en: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"
verses.tr: wayawma yunādīhim fayaqūlu ʾayna shurakāa adh-dhīna kuntum tazʿumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Day will come when God will call them, saying, ‘Where now are those you allege are My partners?’
verses.pickthall: On the day when He will call unto them and say: Where are My partners whom ye imagined?

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ رَبَّنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَغْوَيْنَآ أَغْوَيْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا غَوَيْنَا ۖ تَبَرَّأْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِيَّانَا يَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: Those upon whom the word will have come into effect will say, "Our Lord, these are the ones we led to error. We led them to error just as we were in error. We declare our disassociation [from them] to You. They did not used to worship [i.e., obey] us."
verses.tr: qāla adh-dhīna ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu al-qawlu rabbanā hāʾulāʾi adh-dhīna ʾaghwaynā ʾaghwaynāhum kamā ghawaynā ۖ tabarraʾnā ʾilayka ۖ mā kānūā ʾiyyānā yaʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and those [ringleaders] against whom the verdict will be passed will say, ‘Our Lord, these are the ones we caused to deviate. We caused them to deviate as we ourselves deviated, but now we disown them before You: they did not really serve us.’
verses.pickthall: Those concerning whom the Word will have come true will say: Our Lord! These are they whom we led astray. We led them astray even as we ourselves were astray. We declare our innocence before Thee: us they never worshipped.

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ ٱدْعُوا۟ شُرَكَآءَكُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَرَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۚ لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And it will be said, "Invoke your 'partners,'" and they will invoke them; but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. If only they had followed guidance!
verses.tr: waqīla ādʿūā shurakāʾakum fadaʿawhum falam yastajībūā lahum waraʾawā al-ʿadhāba ۚ law ʾannahum kānūā yahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It will then be said to them, ‘Now call those you worshipped as partners,’ and they will call them but receive no answer. They will see the suffering and wish they had followed guidance.
verses.pickthall: And it will be said: Cry unto your (so-called) partners (of Allah). And they will cry unto them, and they will give no answer unto them, and they will see the Doom. Ah, if they had but been guided!

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أَجَبْتُمُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, "What did you answer the messengers?"
verses.tr: wayawma yunādīhim fayaqūlu mādhā ʾajabtumu al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day He will call them, saying, ‘How did you respond to My messengers?’
verses.pickthall: And on the Day when He will call unto them and say: What answer gave ye to the messengers?

verses.ar: فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَهُمْ لَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: But the information will be unapparent to them that Day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another.
verses.tr: faʿamiyat ʿalayhimu al-ʾanbāʾu yawmaʾidhin fahum lā yatasāʾalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: All arguments will seem obscure to them on that Day; they will not be able to consult one another.
verses.pickthall: On that day (all) tidings will be dimmed for them, nor will they ask one of another,

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَعَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْلِحِينَ
verses.en: But as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is expected [i.e., promised by Allāh] that he will be among the successful.
verses.tr: fa-ammā man tāba wamana waʿamila ṣāliḥan faʿasā ʾan yakūna mina al-mufliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet anyone who has repented, believed, and done good deeds can hope to find himself among the successful.
verses.pickthall: But as for him who shall repent and believe and do right, he haply may be one of the successful.

verses.ar: وَرَبُّكَ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخْتَارُ ۗ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ ٱلْخِيَرَةُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. Exalted is Allāh and high above what they associate with Him.
verses.tr: warabbuka yakhluqu mā yashāʾu wayakhtāru ۗ mā kāna lahumu al-khiyarahu ۚ subḥāna Allāh wataʿālā ʿammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord creates what He pleases and chooses those He will- they have no choice- so glory be to God, and may He be exalted above the partners they ascribe to Him!
verses.pickthall: Thy Lord bringeth to pass what He willeth and chooseth. They have never any choice. Glorified be Allah and Exalted above all that they associate (with Him)!

verses.ar: وَرَبُّكَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verses.en: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
verses.tr: warabbuka yaʿlamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wamā yuʿlinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord knows what their hearts conceal and what they reveal.
verses.pickthall: And thy Lord knoweth what their breasts conceal, and what they publish.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: And He is Allāh; there is no deity except Him. To Him is [due all] praise in the first [life] and the Hereafter. And His is the [final] decision, and to Him you will be returned.
verses.tr: wahuwa Allāh lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۖ lahu al-ḥamdu fā al-ʾūlā wa-l-ākhirahi ۖ walahu al-ḥukmu wa-ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He is God; there is no god but Him; all praise belongs to Him in this world and the next; His is the Judgement; and to Him you shall be returned.
verses.pickthall: And He is Allah; there is no Allah save Him. His is all praise in the former and the latter (state), and His is the command, and unto Him ye will be brought back.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَنْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِضِيَآءٍ ۖ أَفَلَا تَسْمَعُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Have you considered: if Allāh should make for you the night continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allāh could bring you light? Then will you not hear?"
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum ʾin jaʿala Allāh ʿalaykumu al-yla sarmadan ʾilā yawmi al-qiyāmahi man ʾilāhun ghayru Allāh yaʾtīkum biḍiyāʾin ۖ ʾafalā tasmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Just think, if God were to cast perpetual night over you until the Day of Resurrection, what god other than He could bring you light? Do you not listen?’
verses.pickthall: Say: Have ye thought, if Allah made night everlasting for you till the Day of Resurrection, who is a god beside Allah who could bring you light? Will ye not then hear?

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلنَّهَارَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَنْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِلَيْلٍ تَسْكُنُونَ فِيهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Have you considered: if Allāh should make for you the day continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allāh could bring you a night in which you may rest? Then will you not see?"
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum ʾin jaʿala Allāh ʿalaykumu an-nahāra sarmadan ʾilā yawmi al-qiyāmahi man ʾilāhun ghayru Allāh yaʾtīkum bilaylin taskunūna fīhi ۖ ʾafalā tubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Just think, if God were to cast perpetual day over you until the Day of Resurrection, what god other than He could give you night in which to rest? Do you not see?
verses.pickthall: Say: Have ye thought, if Allah made day everlasting for you till the Day of Resurrection, who is a god beside Allah who could bring you night wherein ye rest? Will ye not then see?

verses.ar: وَمِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And out of His mercy He made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein and [by day] seek from His bounty and [that] perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.tr: wamin rraḥmatihi jaʿala lakumu al-yla wa-an-nahāra litaskunūā fīhi walitabtaghūā min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In His mercy He has given you night and day, so that you may rest and seek His bounty and be grateful.’
verses.pickthall: Of His mercy hath He appointed for you night and day, that therein ye may rest, and that ye may seek His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
verses.en: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"
verses.tr: wayawma yunādīhim fayaqūlu ʾayna shurakāa adh-dhīna kuntum tazʿumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Day will come when He will call out to them, saying, ‘Where are the partners you claimed for Me?’
verses.pickthall: And on the Day when He shall call unto them and say: Where are My partners whom ye pretended?

verses.ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا فَقُلْنَا هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ فَعَلِمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلْحَقَّ لِلَّهِ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: And We will extract from every nation a witness and say, "Produce your proof," and they will know that the truth belongs to Allāh, and lost from them is that which they used to invent.
verses.tr: wanazaʿnā min kulli ʾummahin shahīdan faqulnā hātūā burhānakum faʿalimūā ʾanna al-ḥaqqa lillāh waḍalla ʿanhum mmā kānūā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall call a witness from every community, and say, ‘Produce your evidence,’ and then they will know that truth belongs to God alone; the gods they invented will forsake them.
verses.pickthall: And We shall take out from every nation a witness and We shall say: Bring your proof. Then they will know that Allah hath the Truth, and all that they invented will have failed them.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ قَـٰرُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ فَبَغَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْكُنُوزِ مَآ إِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهُۥ لَتَنُوٓأُ بِٱلْعُصْبَةِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُوَّةِ إِذْ قَالَ لَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ لَا تَفْرَحْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْفَرِحِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, Qārūn was from the people of Moses, but he tyrannized them. And We gave him of treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men; thereupon his people said to him, "Do not exult. Indeed, Allāh does not like the exultant.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinna qārūna kāna min qawmi mūsā fabaghā ʿalayhim ۖ wataynāhu mina al-kunūzi mā ʾinna mafātiḥahu latanūʾu bi-l-ʿuṣbahi ʾūlā al-quwwahi ʾidh qāla lahu qawmuhu lā tafraḥ ۖ ʾinna Allāh lā yuḥibbu al-fariḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Qarun was one of Moses’ people, but he oppressed them. We had given him such treasures that even their keys would have weighed down a whole company of strong men. His people said to him, ‘Do not gloat, for God does not like people who gloat.
verses.pickthall: Now Korah was of Moses' folk, but he oppressed them; and We gave him so much treasure that the stores thereof would verily have been a burden for a troop of mighty men. When his own folk said unto him: Exult not; lo! Allah loveth not the exultant;

verses.ar: وَٱبْتَغِ فِيمَآ ءَاتَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَأَحْسِن كَمَآ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَلَا تَبْغِ ٱلْفَسَادَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: But seek, through that which Allāh has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. And do good as Allāh has done good to you. And desire not corruption in the land. Indeed, Allāh does not like corrupters."
verses.tr: wābtaghi fīmā ātāka Allāh ad-dāra al-ākhiraha ۖ walā tansa naṣībaka mina ad-dunyā ۖ wa-aḥsin kamā ʾaḥsana Allāh ʾilayka ۖ walā tabghi al-fasāda fā al-ʾarḍi ۖ ʾinna Allāh lā yuḥibbu al-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Seek the life to come by means of what God has granted you, but do not neglect your rightful share in this world. Do good to others as God has done good to you. Do not seek to spread corruption in the land, for God does not love those who do this,’
verses.pickthall: But seek the abode of the Hereafter in that which Allah hath given thee and neglect not thy portion of the world, and be thou kind even as Allah hath been kind to thee, and seek not corruption in the earth; lo! Allah loveth not corrupters,

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عِندِىٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَهْلَكَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مَنْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ قُوَّةً وَأَكْثَرُ جَمْعًا ۚ وَلَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذُنُوبِهِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: He said, "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." Did he not know that Allāh had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked.
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnamā ʾūtītuhu ʿalā ʿilmin ʿindā ۚ ʾawalam yaʿlam ʾanna Allāh qad ʾahlaka min qablihi mina al-qurūni man huwa ʾashaddu minhu quwwahan wa-aktharu jamʿan ۚ walā yuslu ʿan dhunūbihimu al-mujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but he answered, ‘This wealth was given to me on account of the knowledge I possess.’ Did he not know that God had destroyed many generations before him, who had greater power than him and built up greater wealth? The guilty will not be questioned about their sins.
verses.pickthall: He said: I have been given it only on account of knowledge I possess. Knew he not that Allah had destroyed already of the generations before him men who were mightier than him in strength and greater in respect of following? The guilty are not questioned of their sins.

verses.ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune."
verses.tr: fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi fā zīnatihi ۖ qāla adh-dhīna yurīdūna al-ḥayawāha ad-dunyā yālayta lanā mithla mā ʾūtāa qārūnu ʾinnahu ladhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: He went out among his people in all his pomp, and those whose aim was the life of this world said, ‘If only we had been given something like what Qarun has been given: he really is a very fortunate man,’
verses.pickthall: Then went he forth before his people in his pomp. Those who were desirous of the life of the world said: Ah, would that we had the like of what hath been given unto Korah! Lo! he is lord of rare good fortune.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَيْلَكُمْ ثَوَابُ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا وَلَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ
verses.en: But those who had been given knowledge said, "Woe to you! The reward of Allāh is better for he who believes and does righteousness. And none are granted it except the patient."
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-ʿilma waylakum thawābu Allāh khayrun lliman āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan walā yulaqqāhā ʾillā aṣ-ṣābirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but those who were given knowledge said, ‘Alas for you! God’s reward is better for those who believe and do good deeds: only those who are steadfast will attain this.’
verses.pickthall: But those who had been given knowledge said: Woe unto you! The reward of Allah for him who believeth and doeth right is better, and only the steadfast will obtain it.

verses.ar: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.en: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves.
verses.tr: fakhasafnā bihi wabidārihi al-ʾarḍa famā kāna lahu min fiʾahin yanṣurūnahu min dūni Allāh wamā kāna mina al-muntaṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We caused the earth to swallow him and his home: he had no one to help him against God, nor could he defend himself.
verses.pickthall: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his dwelling-place. Then he had no host to help him against Allah, nor was he of those who can save themselves.

verses.ar: وَأَصْبَحَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَمَنَّوْا۟ مَكَانَهُۥ بِٱلْأَمْسِ يَقُولُونَ وَيْكَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ ۖ لَوْلَآ أَن مَّنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَا ۖ وَيْكَأَنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: And those who had wished for his position the previous day began to say, "Oh, how Allāh extends provision to whom He wills of His servants and restricts it! If not that Allāh had conferred favor on us, He would have caused it to swallow us. Oh, how the disbelievers do not succeed!"
verses.tr: wa-aṣbaḥa adh-dhīna tamannawā makānahu bi-l-ʾamsi yaqūlūna waykaʾanna Allāh yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yashāʾu min ʿibādihi wayaqdiru ۖ lawlā ʾan mmanna Allāh ʿalaynā lakhasafa binā ۖ waykaʾannahu lā yufliḥu al-kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The next day, those who had, the day before, wished to be in his place exclaimed, ‘Alas [for you, Qarun]! It is God alone who gives what He will, abundantly or sparingly, to whichever He will of His creatures: if God had not been gracious to us, He would have caused the earth to swallow us too.’ Alas indeed! Those who deny the truth will never prosper.
verses.pickthall: And morning found those who had coveted his place but yesterday crying: Ah, welladay! Allah enlargeth the provision for whom He will of His slaves and straiteneth it (for whom He will). If Allah had not been gracious unto us He would have caused it to swallow us (also). Ah, welladay! the disbelievers never prosper.

verses.ar: تِلْكَ ٱلدَّارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ نَجْعَلُهَا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُرِيدُونَ عُلُوًّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فَسَادًا ۚ وَٱلْعَـٰقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: That home of the Hereafter We assign to those who do not desire exaltedness upon the earth or corruption. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous.
verses.tr: tilka ad-dāru al-ākhirahu najʿaluhā lilladhīna lā yurīdūna ʿuluwwan fā al-ʾarḍi walā fasādan ۚ wa-l-ʿāqibahu lilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We grant the Home in the Hereafter to those who do not seek superiority on earth or spread corruption: the happy ending is awarded to those who are mindful of God.
verses.pickthall: As for that Abode of the Hereafter We assign it unto those who seek not oppression in the earth, nor yet corruption. The sequel is for those who ward off (evil).

verses.ar: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَا ۖ وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do.
verses.tr: man jāʾa bi-l-ḥasanahi falahu khayrun mminhā ۖ waman jāʾa bi-as-sayyiʾahi falā yujzā adh-dhīna ʿamilūā as-sayyāti ʾillā mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whoever comes before God with a good deed will receive a better reward; whoever comes with an evil deed will be punished only for what he has done.
verses.pickthall: Whoso bringeth a good deed, he will have better than the same; while as for him who bringeth an ill-deed, those who do ill-deeds will be requited only what they did.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِى فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لَرَآدُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٍ ۚ قُل رَّبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَمَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Indeed, [O Muḥammad], He who imposed upon you the Qur’ān will take you back to a place of return. Say, "My Lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error."
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhā faraḍa ʿalayka al-qurāna larādduka ʾilā maʿādin ۚ qul rrabbā ʾaʿlamu man jāʾa bi-l-hudā waman huwa fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: He who has made the Quran binding on you [Prophet] will bring you back home. So say, ‘My Lord knows best who has brought true guidance and who is blatantly astray.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! He Who hath given thee the Qur'an for a law will surely bring thee home again. Say: My Lord is Best Aware of him who bringeth guidance and him who is in error manifest.

verses.ar: وَمَا كُنتَ تَرْجُوٓا۟ أَن يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And you were not expecting that the Book would be conveyed to you, but [it is] a mercy from your Lord. So do not be an assistant to the disbelievers.
verses.tr: wamā kunta tarjūā ʾan yulqā ʾilayka al-kitābu ʾillā raḥmahan mmin rrabbika ۖ falā takūnanna ẓahīran llilkāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You yourself could not have expected the Scripture to be sent to you; it came only as a mercy from your Lord. So give no help to the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: Thou hadst no hope that the Scripture would be inspired in thee; but it is a mercy from thy Lord, so never be a helper to the disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أُنزِلَتْ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: And never let them avert you from the verses of Allāh after they have been revealed to you. And invite [people] to your Lord. And never be of those who associate others with Allāh.
verses.tr: walā yaṣuddunnaka ʿan āyāti Allāh baʿda ʾidh ʾunzilat ʾilayka ۖ wādʿu ʾilā rabbika ۖ walā takūnanna mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not let them turn you away from God’s revelations after they have been revealed to you. Call people to your Lord. Never become one of those who ascribe partners to God.
verses.pickthall: And let them not divert thee from the revelations of Allah after they have been sent down unto thee; but call (mankind) unto thy Lord, and be not of those who ascribe partners (unto Him).

verses.ar: وَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۘ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجْهَهُۥ ۚ لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: And do not invoke with Allāh another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned.
verses.tr: walā tadʿu maʿa Allāh ʾilāhan ākhara ۘ lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۚ kullu shāʾin hālikun ʾillā wajhahu ۚ lahu al-ḥukmu wa-ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not call out to any other god beside God, for there is no god but Him. Everything will perish except His Face. His is the Judgement and to Him you shall all be brought back.
verses.pickthall: And cry not unto any other god along with Allah. There is no Allah save Him. Everything will perish save His countenance. His is the command, and unto Him ye will be brought back.

verses.ar: الٓمٓ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Meem.
verses.tr: al-m
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Mim
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Mim.

verses.ar: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.en: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?
verses.tr: ʾaḥasiba an-nāsu ʾan yutrakūā ʾan yaqūlūā āmannā wahum lā yuftanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do people think they will be left alone after saying ‘We believe’ without being put to the test?
verses.pickthall: Do men imagine that they will be left (at ease) because they say, We believe, and will not be tested with affliction?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.en: But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allāh will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.
verses.tr: walaqad fatannā adh-dhīna min qablihim ۖ falayaʿlamanna Allāh adh-dhīna ṣadaqūā walayaʿlamanna al-kādhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We tested those who went before them: God will certainly mark out which ones are truthful and which are lying.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We tested those who were before you. Thus Allah knoweth those who are sincere, and knoweth those who feign.

verses.ar: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسْبِقُونَا ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
verses.en: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun [i.e., escape] Us? Evil is what they judge.
verses.tr: ʾam ḥasiba adh-dhīna yaʿmalūna as-sayyāti ʾan yasbiqūnā ۚ sāʾa mā yaḥkumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do the evildoers think they can escape us? How ill they judge!
verses.pickthall: Or do those who do ill-deeds imagine that they can outstrip Us? Evil (for them) is that which they decide.

verses.ar: مَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ لَـَٔاتٍ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allāh - indeed, the term [decreed by] Allāh is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.tr: man kāna yarjūā liqāʾa Allāh fa-inna ʾajala Allāh lātin ۚ wahuwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: But as for those who strive for their meeting with God, God’s appointed time is bound to come; He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
verses.pickthall: Whoso looketh forward to the meeting with Allah (let him know that) Allah's reckoning is surely nigh, and He is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.ar: وَمَن جَـٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَـٰهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allāh is Free from need of the worlds.
verses.tr: waman jāhada fa-innamā yujāhidu linafsihi ۚ ʾinna Allāh laghanāun ʿani al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who exert themselves do so for their own benefit––God does not need His creatures––
verses.pickthall: And whosoever striveth, striveth only for himself, for lo! Allah is altogether Independent of (His) creatures.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti lanukaffiranna ʿanhum sayyātihim walanajziyannahum ʾaḥsana adh-dhā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall certainly blot out the misdeeds of those who believe and do good deeds, and We shall reward them according to the best of their actions.
verses.pickthall: And as for those who believe and do good works, We shall remit from them their evil deeds and shall repay them the best that they did.

verses.ar: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا ۖ وَإِن جَـٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَآ ۚ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
verses.tr: wawaṣṣaynā al-ʾinsāna biwālidayhi ḥusnan ۖ wa-in jāhadāka litushrika bā mā laysa laka bihi ʿilmun falā tuṭiʿhumā ۚ ʾilāa marjiʿukum fa-unabbiʾukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have commanded people to be good to their parents, but do not obey them if they strive to make you serve, beside Me, anything of which you have no knowledge: you will all return to Me, and I shall inform you of what you have done.
verses.pickthall: We have enjoined on man kindness to parents; but if they strive to make thee join with Me that of which thou hast no knowledge, then obey them not. Unto Me is your return and I shall tell you what ye used to do.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti lanudkhilannahum fā aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall be sure to admit those who believe and do good deeds to the ranks of the righteous.
verses.pickthall: And as for those who believe and do good works, We verily shall make them enter in among the righteous.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ ۚ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allāh, he considers the trial [i.e., harm] of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allāh. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allāh most knowing of what is within the breasts of the worlds [i.e., all creatures]?
verses.tr: wamina an-nāsi man yaqūlu āmannā billāh fa-idhā ʾūdhāa fā Allāh jaʿala fitnaha an-nāsi kaʿadhābi Allāh walaʾin jāʾa naṣrun mmin rrabbika layaqūlunna ʾinnā kunnā maʿakum ۚ ʾawalaysa Allāh biʾaʿlama bimā fā ṣudūri al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There are some people who say, ‘We believe in God,’ but, when they suffer for His cause, they think that human persecution is as severe as God’s punishment––yet, if any help comes to you [Prophet] from your Lord, they will say, ‘We have always been with you’. Does God not know best what is in everyone’s hearts?
verses.pickthall: Of mankind is he who saith: We believe in Allah, but, if he be made to suffer for the sake of Allah, he mistaketh the persecution of mankind for Allah's punishment; and then, if victory cometh from thy Lord, will say: Lo! we were with you (all the while). Is not Allah Best Aware of what is in the bosoms of (His) creatures?

verses.ar: وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ
verses.en: And Allāh will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.
verses.tr: walayaʿlamanna Allāh adh-dhīna āmanūā walayaʿlamanna al-munāfiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God will be sure to mark out which ones are the believers, and which the hypocrites.
verses.pickthall: Verily Allah knoweth those who believe, and verily He knoweth the hypocrites.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَـٰيَـٰكُمْ وَمَا هُم بِحَـٰمِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَـٰيَـٰهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins." But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars.
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lilladhīna āmanūā āttabiʿūā sabīlanā walnaḥmil khaṭāyākum wamā hum biḥāmilīna min khaṭāyāhum mmin shāʾin ۖ ʾinnahum lakādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who disbelieve say to the believers, ‘Follow our path and we shall bear [the consequences for] your sins,’ yet they will not do so––they are liars.
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Follow our way (of religion) and we verily will bear your sins (for you). They cannot bear aught of their sins. Lo! they verily are liars.

verses.ar: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ ۖ وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent.
verses.tr: walayaḥmilunna ʾathqālahum wa-athqālan mmaʿa ʾathqālihim ۖ walayuslunna yawma al-qiyāmahi ʿammā kānūā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will bear their own burdens and others besides: they will be questioned about their false assertions on the Day of Resurrection.
verses.pickthall: But they verily will bear their own loads and other loads beside their own, and they verily will be questioned on the Day of Resurrection concerning that which they invented.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā nūḥan ʾilā qawmihi falabitha fīhim ʾalfa sanahin ʾillā khamsīna ʿāman fa-akhadhahumu aṭ-ṭūfānu wahum ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Noah out to his people. He lived among them for fifty years short of a thousand but when the Flood overwhelmed them they were still doing evil.
verses.pickthall: And verily we sent Noah (as Our messenger) unto his folk, and he continued with them for a thousand years save fifty years; and the flood engulfed them, for they were wrong-doers.

verses.ar: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلسَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds.
verses.tr: fa-anjaynāhu wa-aṣḥāba as-safīnahi wajaʿalnāhā āyahan llilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved him and those with him on the Ark. We made this a sign for all people.
verses.pickthall: And We rescued him and those with him in the ship, and made of it a portent for the peoples.

verses.ar: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allāh and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know.
verses.tr: wa-ibrāhīma ʾidh qāla liqawmihi āʿbudūā Allāh wāttaqūhu ۖ dhālikum khayrun llakum ʾin kuntum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We also sent Abraham. He said to his people, ‘Serve God and be mindful of Him: that is better for you, if only you knew.
verses.pickthall: And Abraham! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Serve Allah, and keep your duty unto Him; that is better for you if ye did but know.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَـٰنًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَٱبْتَغُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۖ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: You only worship, besides Allāh, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allāh do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from Allāh provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned."
verses.tr: ʾinnamā taʿbudūna min dūni Allāh ʾawthānan watakhluqūna ʾifkan ۚ ʾinna adh-dhīna taʿbudūna min dūni Allāh lā yamlikūna lakum rizqan fābtaghūā ʿinda Allāh ar-rizqa wāʿbudūhu wāshkurūā lahu ۖ ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What you worship instead of God are mere idols; what you invent is nothing but falsehood. Those you serve instead of God have no power to give you provisions, so seek provisions from God, serve Him, and give Him thanks: you will all be returned to Him.
verses.pickthall: Ye serve instead of Allah only idols, and ye only invent a lie. Lo! those whom ye serve instead of Allah own no provision for you. So seek your provision from Allah, and serve Him, and give thanks unto Him, (for) unto Him ye will be brought back.

verses.ar: وَإِن تُكَذِّبُوا۟ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ۖ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification.
verses.tr: wa-in tukadhibūā faqad kadhaba ʾumamun mmin qablikum ۖ wamā ʿalā ar-rasūli ʾillā al-balāghu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: If you say this is a lie, [be warned that] other communities before you said the same. The messenger’s only duty is to give clear warning.’
verses.pickthall: But if ye deny, then nations have denied before you. The messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verses.en: Have they not considered how Allāh begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yarawā kayfa yubdiʾu Allāh al-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu ۚ ʾinna dhālika ʿalā Allāh yasīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not see that God brings life into being and reproduces it? Truly this is easy for God.
verses.pickthall: See they not how Allah produceth creation, then reproduceth it? Lo! for Allah that is easy.

verses.ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ ۚ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allāh will produce the final creation [i.e., development]. Indeed Allāh, over all things, is competent."
verses.tr: qul sīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fānẓurūā kayfa badaʾa al-khalqa ۚ thumma Allāh yunshiʾu an-nashʾaha al-ākhiraha ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Travel throughout the earth and see how He brings life into being: and He will bring the next life into being. God has power over all things.
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see how He originated creation, then Allah bringeth forth the later growth. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ
verses.en: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.
verses.tr: yuʿadhibu man yashāʾu wayarḥamu man yashāʾu ۖ wa-ʾilayhi tuqlabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He punishes whoever He will and shows mercy to whoever He will. You will all be returned to Him.
verses.pickthall: He punisheth whom He will and showeth mercy unto whom He will, and unto Him ye will be turned.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verses.en: And you will not cause failure [to Allāh] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allāh any protector or any helper.
verses.tr: wamā ʾantum bimuʿjizīna fā al-ʾarḍi walā fā as-samāʾi ۖ wamā lakum mmin dūni Allāh min walāin walā naṣīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: You cannot escape Him on earth or in the heavens; you will have no one to protect or help you besides God.’
verses.pickthall: Ye cannot escape (from Him) in the earth or in the sky, and beside Allah there is for you no friend or helper.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَتِى وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā bāyāti Allāh waliqāʾihi ʾūlāʾika yaʾisūā min rraḥmatā wa-ūlāʾika lahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who deny God’s Revelation and their meeting with Him have no hope of receiving My grace: they will have a grievous torment.
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve in the revelations of Allah and in (their) Meeting with Him, such have no hope of My mercy. For such there is a painful doom.

verses.ar: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And the answer of his [i.e., Abraham's] people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allāh saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
verses.tr: famā kāna jawāba qawmihi ʾillā ʾan qālūā āqtulūhu ʾaw ḥarriqūhu fa-anjāhu Allāh mina an-nāri ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The only answer Abraham’s people gave was, ‘Kill him or burn him!’ but God saved him from the Fire: there truly are signs in this for people who believe.
verses.pickthall: But the answer of his folk was only that they said: "Kill him" or "Burn him." Then Allah saved him from the Fire. Lo! herein verily are portents for folk who believe.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَـٰنًا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.en: And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allāh, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."
verses.tr: waqāla ʾinnamā āttakhadhtum mmin dūni Allāh ʾawthānan mmawaddaha baynikum fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۖ thumma yawma al-qiyāmahi yakfuru baʿḍukum bibaʿḍin wayalʿanu baʿḍukum baʿḍan wamaʾwākumu an-nāru wamā lakum mmin nnāṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham said to them, ‘You have chosen idols instead of God but your love for them will only last for the present life: on the Day of Resurrection, you will disown and reject one another. Hell will be your home and no one will help you.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Ye have chosen only idols instead of Allah. The love between you is only in the life of the world. Then on the Day of Resurrection ye will deny each other and curse each other, and your abode will be the Fire, and ye will have no helpers.

verses.ar: ۞ فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُۥ لُوطٌ ۘ وَقَالَ إِنِّى مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
verses.tr: ۞ fāmana lahu lūṭun ۘ waqāla ʾinnā muhājirun ʾilā rabbā ۖ ʾinnahu huwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Lot believed him, and said, ‘I will flee to my Lord: He is the Almighty, the All Wise.’
verses.pickthall: And Lot believed him, and said: Lo! I am a fugitive unto my Lord. Lo! He, only He, is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَجْرَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And We gave to him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.
verses.tr: wawahabnā lahu ʾisḥāqa wayaʿqūba wajaʿalnā fā dhurriyyatihi an-nubuwwaha wa-l-kitāba wataynāhu ʾajrahu fā ad-dunyā ۖ wa-innahu fā al-ākhirahi lamina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave Isaac and Jacob to Abraham, and placed prophethood and Scripture among his offspring. We gave him his rewards in this world, and in the life to come he will be among the righteous.
verses.pickthall: And We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and We established the prophethood and the Scripture among his seed, and We gave him his reward in the world, and lo! in the Hereafter he verily is among the righteous.

verses.ar: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.
verses.tr: walūṭan ʾidh qāla liqawmihi ʾinnakum lataʾtūna al-fāḥishaha mā sabaqakum bihā min ʾaḥadin mmina al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And Lot: when He said to his people, ‘You practise outrageous acts that no people before you have ever committed.
verses.pickthall: And Lot! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Lo! ye commit lewdness such as no creature did before you.

verses.ar: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِى نَادِيكُمُ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but that they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allāh, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.tr: ʾaʾinnakum lataʾtūna ar-rijāla wataqṭaʿūna as-sabīla wataʾtūna fā nādīkumu al-munkara ۖ famā kāna jawāba qawmihi ʾillā ʾan qālūā āʾtinā biʿadhābi Allāh ʾin kunta mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: How can you lust after men, waylay travellers, and commit evil in your gatherings?’ the only answer his people gave was, ‘Bring God’s punishment down on us, if what you say is true.’
verses.pickthall: For come ye not in unto males, and cut ye not the road (for travellers), and commit ye not abomination in your meetings? But the answer of his folk was only that they said: Bring Allah's doom upon us if thou art a truthteller!

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ānṣurnā ʿalā al-qawmi al-mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So he prayed, ‘My Lord, help me against these people who spread corruption.’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Give me victory over folk who work corruption.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُهْلِكُوٓا۟ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ۖ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوا۟ ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that [i.e., Lot's] city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers."
verses.tr: walammā jāʾat rusulunā ʾibrāhīma bi-l-bushrā qālūā ʾinnā muhlikūā ʾahli hādhihi al-qaryahi ۖ ʾinna ʾahlahā kānūā ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When Our mes-sengers brought the good news [of the birth of a son] to Abraham,they told him, ‘We are about to destroy the people of that town. They are wrongdoers.’
verses.pickthall: And when Our messengers brought Abraham the good news, they said: Lo! we are about to destroy the people of that township, for its people are wrong-doers.

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًا ۚ قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَا ۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: [Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind."
verses.tr: qāla ʾinna fīhā lūṭan ۚ qālūā naḥnu ʾaʿlamu biman fīhā ۖ lanunajjiyannahu wa-ahlahu ʾillā āmraʾatahu kānat mina al-ghābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham said, ‘But Lot lives there.’ They answered, ‘We know who lives there better than you do. We shall save him and his household, except for his wife: she will be one of those who stay behind.’
verses.pickthall: He said: Lo! Lot is there. They said: We are best aware of who is there. We are to deliver him and his household, all save his wife, who is of those who stay behind.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ ۖ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind.
verses.tr: walammā ʾan jāʾat rusulunā lūṭan sāʾa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqālūā lā takhaf walā taḥzan ۖ ʾinnā munajjūka wa-ahlaka ʾillā āmraʾataka kānat mina al-ghābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When Our messengers came to Lot, he was troubled and distressed on their account. They said, ‘Have no fear or grief: we shall certainly save you and your household, except for your wife- she will be one of those who stay behind-
verses.pickthall: And when Our messengers came unto Lot, he was troubled upon their account, for he could not protect them; but they said: Fear not, nor grieve! Lo! we are to deliver thee and thy household, (all) save thy wife, who is of those who stay behind.

verses.ar: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient."
verses.tr: ʾinnā munzilūna ʿalā ʾahli hādhihi al-qaryahi rijzan mmina as-samāʾi bimā kānūā yafsuqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and we shall send a punishment from heaven down on the people of this town because they violate [God’s order].’
verses.pickthall: Lo! We are about to bring down upon the folk of this township a fury from the sky because they are evil-livers.

verses.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.
verses.tr: walaqad ttaraknā minhā āyahan bayyinahan lliqawmin yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We left some [of the town] there as a clear sign for those who use their reason.
verses.pickthall: And verily of that We have left a clear sign for people who have sense.

verses.ar: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.en: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
verses.tr: wa-ʾilā madyana ʾakhāhum shuʿayban faqāla yāqawmi āʿbudūā Allāh wārjūā al-yawma al-ākhira walā taʿthawā fā al-ʾarḍi mufsidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: To the people of Midian We sent their brother Shuayb. He said, ‘My people, serve God and think ahead to the Last Day. Do not commit evil and spread corruption in the land.’
verses.pickthall: And unto Midian We sent Shu'eyb, their brother. He said: O my people! Serve Allah, and look forward to the Last Day, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verses.en: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
verses.tr: fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhathumu ar-rajfahu fa-aṣbaḥūā fā dārihim jāthimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They rejected him and so the earthquake overtook them. When morning came, they were lying dead in their homes.
verses.pickthall: But they denied him, and the dreadful earthquake took them, and morning found them prostrate in their dwelling place.

verses.ar: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
verses.en: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.
verses.tr: waʿādan wathamūdā waqad ttabayyana lakum mmin mmasākinihim ۖ wazayyana lahumu ash-shayṭānu ʾaʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani as-sabīli wakānūā mustabṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Remember] the tribes of 'Ad and Thamud: their history is made clear to you by [what is left of] their dwelling places. Satan made their foul deeds seem alluring to them and barred them from the right way, though they were capable of seeing.
verses.pickthall: And (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud! (Their fate) is manifest unto you from their (ruined and deserted) dwellings. Satan made their deeds seem fair unto them and so debarred them from the Way, though they were keen observers.

verses.ar: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verses.en: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment].
verses.tr: waqārūna wafirʿawna wahāmāna ۖ walaqad jāʾahum mmūsā bi-l-bayyināti fāstakbarūā fā al-ʾarḍi wamā kānūā sābiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Remember] Qarun and Pharaoh and Haman: Moses brought them clear signs, but they behaved arrogantly on earth. They could not escape Us
verses.pickthall: And Korah, Pharaoh and Haman! Moses came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they were boastful in the land. And they were not winners (in the race).

verses.ar: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allāh would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves.
verses.tr: fakullan ʾakhadhnā bidhanbihi ۖ faminhum mman ʾarsalnā ʿalayhi ḥāṣiban waminhum mman ʾakhadhathu aṣ-ṣayḥahu waminhum mman khasafnā bihi al-ʾarḍa waminhum mman ʾaghraqnā ۚ wamā kāna Allāh liyaẓlimahum walākin kānūā ʾanfusahum yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We punished each one of them for their sins: some We struck with a violent storm; some were overcome by a sudden blast; some We made the earth swallow; and some We drowned. It was not God who wronged them; they wronged themselves.
verses.pickthall: So We took each one in his sin; of them was he on whom We sent a hurricane, and of them was he who was overtaken by the (Awful) Cry, and of them was he whom We caused the earth to swallow, and of them was he whom We drowned. It was not for Allah to wrong them, but they wronged themselves.

verses.ar: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا ۖ وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ ٱلْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ۖ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: The example of those who take allies other than Allāh is like that of the spider who takes [i.e., constructs] a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.
verses.tr: mathalu adh-dhīna āttakhadhūā min dūni Allāh ʾawliyāʾa kamathali al-ʿankabūti āttakhadhat baytan ۖ wa-inna ʾawhana al-buyūti labaytu al-ʿankabūti ۖ law kānūā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who take protectors other than God can be compared to spiders building themselves houses- the spider’s is the frailest of all houses- if only they could understand.
verses.pickthall: The likeness of those who choose other patrons than Allah is as the likeness of the spider when she taketh unto herself a house, and lo! the frailest of all houses is the spider's house, if they but knew.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh yaʿlamu mā yadʿūna min dūnihi min shāʾin ۚ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: God knows what things they call upon beside Him: He is the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah knoweth what thing they invoke instead of Him. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ ۖ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْعَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge.
verses.tr: watilka al-ʾamthālu naḍribuhā lilnnāsi ۖ wamā yaʿqiluhā ʾillā al-ʿālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Such are the comparisons We draw for people, though only the wise can grasp them.
verses.pickthall: As for these similitudes, We coin them for mankind, but none will grasp their meaning save the wise.

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Allāh created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
verses.tr: khalaqa Allāh as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa bi-l-ḥaqqi ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan llilmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God has created the heavens and earth for a true purpose. There truly is a sign in this for those who believe.
verses.pickthall: Allah created the heavens and the earth with truth. Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.

verses.ar: ٱتْلُ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ
verses.en: Recite, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allāh is greater. And Allāh knows that which you do.
verses.tr: ātlu mā ʾūḥāa ʾilayka mina al-kitābi wa-aqimi aṣ-ṣalawāha ۖ ʾinna aṣ-ṣalawāha tanhā ʿani al-faḥshāʾi wa-l-munkari ۗ waladhikru Allāh ʾakbaru ۗ wallāh yaʿlamu mā taṣnaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], recite what has been revealed to you of the Scripture; keep up the prayer: prayer restrains outrageous and unacceptable behaviour. Remembering God is greater: God knows everything you are doing.
verses.pickthall: Recite that which hath been inspired in thee of the Scripture, and establish worship. Lo! worship preserveth from lewdness and iniquity, but verily remembrance of Allah is more important. And Allah knoweth what ye do.

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَا تُجَـٰدِلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَـٰهُنَا وَإِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَٰحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."
verses.tr: ۞ walā tujādilūā ʾahla al-kitābi ʾillā bi-at-tā hāa ʾaḥsanu ʾillā adh-dhīna ẓalamūā minhum ۖ waqūlūā āmannā bi-adh-dhā ʾunzila ʾilaynā wa-unzila ʾilaykum wa-ā wa-ʾilāhukum wāḥidun wanaḥnu lahu muslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Believers], argue only in the best way with the People of the Book, except with those of them who act unjustly. Say, ‘We believe in what was revealed to us and in what was revealed to you; our God and your God are one [and the same]; we are devoted to Him.’
verses.pickthall: And argue not with the People of the Scripture unless it be in (a way) that is better, save with such of them as do wrong; and say: We believe in that which hath been revealed unto us and revealed unto you; our Allah and your Allah is One, and unto Him we surrender.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَمِنْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: And thus We have sent down to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān]. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers.
verses.tr: wakadhālika ʾanzalnā ʾilayka al-kitāba ۚ fa-adh-dhīna ātaynāhumu al-kitāba yuʾminūna bihi ۖ wamin hāʾulāʾi man yuʾminu bihi ۚ wamā yajḥadu bāyātinā ʾillā al-kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is the way We sent the Scripture to you [Muhammad]. Those to whom We had already given Scripture believe in [the Quran] and so do some of these people. No one refuses to acknowledge Our revelations but the defiant.
verses.pickthall: In like manner We have revealed unto thee the Scripture, and those unto whom We gave the Scripture aforetime will believe therein; and of these (also) there are some who believe therein. And none deny Our revelations save the disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verses.en: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.
verses.tr: wamā kunta tatlūā min qablihi min kitābin walā takhuṭṭuhu biyamīnika ۖ ʾidhan llārtāba al-mubṭilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You never recited any Scripture before We revealed this one to you; you never wrote one down with your hand. If you had done so, those who follow falsehood might have had cause to doubt.
verses.pickthall: And thou (O Muhammad) wast not a reader of any scripture before it, nor didst thou write it with thy right hand, for then might those have doubted, who follow falsehood.

verses.ar: بَلْ هُوَ ءَايَـٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَـٰتٌ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: Rather, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: bal huwa āyātun bayyinātun fā ṣudūri adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-ʿilma ۚ wamā yajḥadu bāyātinā ʾillā aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But no, [this Quran] is a revelation that is clear to the hearts of those endowed with knowledge. No one refuses to acknowledge Our revelations but the evildoers.
verses.pickthall: But it is clear revelations in the hearts of those who have been given knowledge, and none deny Our revelations save wrong-doers.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
verses.tr: waqālūā lawlā ʾunzila ʿalayhi āyātun mmin rrabbihi ۖ qul ʾinnamā al-āyātu ʿinda Allāh wa-innamā ʾanā nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘Why have no miracles been sent to him by his Lord?’ Say, ‘Miracles lie in God’s hands; I am simply here to warn you plainly.’
verses.pickthall: And they say: Why are not portents sent down upon him from his Lord? Say: Portents are with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yakfihim ʾannā ʾanzalnā ʿalayka al-kitāba yutlā ʿalayhim ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika laraḥmahan wadhikrā liqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not think it is enough that We have sent down to you the Scripture that is recited to them? There is a mercy in this and a lesson for believing people.
verses.pickthall: Is it not enough for them that We have sent down unto thee the Scripture which is read unto them? Lo! herein verily is mercy, and a reminder for folk who believe.

verses.ar: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَكَفَرُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Sufficient is Allāh between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allāh - it is those who are the losers."
verses.tr: qul kafā billāh baynā wabaynakum shahīdan ۖ yaʿlamu mā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۗ wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā bi-l-bāṭili wakafarūā billāh ʾūlāʾika humu al-khāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘God is sufficient witness between me and you: He knows what is in the heavens and earth. Those who believe in false deities and deny God will be the losers.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah sufficeth for witness between me and you. He knoweth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who believe in vanity and disbelieve in Allah, they it is who are the losers.

verses.ar: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ ۚ وَلَوْلَآ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى لَّجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.
verses.tr: wayastaʿjilūnaka bi-l-ʿadhābi ۚ walawlā ʾajalun mmusammanā llajāʾahumu al-ʿadhābu walayaʾtiyannahum baghtahan wahum lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They challenge you to hasten the punishment: they would already have received a punishment if God had not set a time for it, and indeed it will come to them suddenly and catch them unawares.
verses.pickthall: They bid thee hasten on the doom (of Allah). And if a term had not been appointed, the doom would assuredly have come unto them (ere now). And verily it will come upon them suddenly when they perceive not.

verses.ar: يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌۢ بِٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers
verses.tr: yastaʿjilūnaka bi-l-ʿadhābi wa-inna jahannama lamuḥīṭahun bi-l-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They challenge you to hasten the punishment: Hell will encompass all those who deny the truth,
verses.pickthall: They bid thee hasten on the doom, when lo! hell verily will encompass the disbelievers

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَغْشَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do."
verses.tr: yawma yaghshāhumu al-ʿadhābu min fawqihim wamin taḥti ʾarjulihim wayaqūlu dhūqūā mā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: on the Day when punishment overwhelms them from above and from below their very feet, and they will be told, ‘Now taste the punishment for what you used to do.’
verses.pickthall: On the day when the doom will overwhelm them from above them and from underneath their feet, and He will say: Taste what ye used to do!

verses.ar: يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَرْضِى وَٰسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
verses.en: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.
verses.tr: yāʿibādāa adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾinna ʾarḍā wāsiʿahun fa-iyyāa fāʿbudūni
verses.abdelhaleem: My believing servants! My earth is vast, so worship Me and Me alone.
verses.pickthall: O my bondmen who believe! Lo! My earth is spacious. Therefor serve Me only.

verses.ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.
verses.tr: kullu nafsin dhāʾiqahu al-mawti ۖ thumma ʾilaynā turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Every soul will taste death, then it is to Us that you will be returned.
verses.pickthall: Every soul will taste of death. Then unto Us ye will be returned.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ نِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَـٰمِلِينَ
