verses.en: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti lanubawwiʾannahum mmina al-jannahi ghurafan tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ۚ niʿma ʾajru al-ʿāmilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall lodge those who believed and did good deeds in lofty dwellings, in the Garden graced with flowing streams, there to remain. How excellent is the reward of those who labour,
verses.pickthall: Those who believe and do good works, them verily We shall house in lofty dwellings of the Garden underneath which rivers flow. There they will dwell secure. How sweet the guerdon of the toilers,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verses.en: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ṣabarūā waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who are steadfast, those who put their trust in their Lord!
verses.pickthall: Who persevere, and put their trust in their Lord!

verses.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَآبَّةٍ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا ٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allāh provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.tr: wakaʾayyin mmin dābbahin llā taḥmilu rizqahā Allāh yarzuquhā wa-iyyākum ۚ wahuwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: How many are the creatures who do not store their sustenance! God sustains them and you: He alone is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
verses.pickthall: And how many an animal there is that beareth not its own provision! Allah provideth for it and for you. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.en: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Then how are they deluded?
verses.tr: walaʾin saʾaltahum mman khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wasakhara ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara layaqūlunna Allāh ۖ fa-annā yuʾfakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you ask the disbelievers who created the heavens and earth and who harnessed the sun and moon, they are sure to say, ‘God.’ Then why do they turn away from Him?
verses.pickthall: And if thou wert to ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, and constrained the sun and the moon (to their appointed work)? they would say: Allah. How then are they turned away?

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Allāh extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.
verses.tr: Allāh yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yashāʾu min ʿibādihi wayaqdiru lahu ۚ ʾinna Allāh bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who gives abundantly to whichever of His servants He will, and sparingly to whichever He will: He has full knowledge of everything.
verses.pickthall: Allah maketh the provision wide for whom He will of His bondmen, and straiteneth it for whom (He will). Lo! Allah is Aware of all things.

verses.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "Praise to Allāh"; but most of them do not reason.
verses.tr: walaʾin saʾaltahum mman nnazzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan fa-aḥyā bihi al-ʾarḍa min baʿdi mawtihā layaqūlunna Allāh ۚ quli al-ḥamdu lillāh ۚ bal ʾaktharuhum lā yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you ask them, ‘Who sends water down from the sky and gives life with it to the earth after it has died?’ they are sure to say, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Praise belongs to God!’ Truly, most of them do not use their reason.
verses.pickthall: And if thou wert to ask them: Who causeth water to come down from the sky, and therewith reviveth the earth after its death? they verily would say: Allah. Say: Praise be to Allah! But most of them have no sense.

verses.ar: وَمَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلدَّارَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ لَهِىَ ٱلْحَيَوَانُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.
verses.tr: wamā hādhihi al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā ʾillā lahwun walaʿibun ۚ wa-inna ad-dāra al-ākhiraha lahāa al-ḥayawānu ۚ law kānūā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The life of this world is merely an amusement and a diversion; the true life is in the Hereafter, if only they knew.
verses.pickthall: This life of the world is but a pastime and a game. Lo! the home of the Hereafter - that is Life, if they but knew.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith and hope]. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him
verses.tr: fa-idhā rakibūā fā al-fulki daʿawā Allāh mukhliṣīna lahu ad-dīna falammā najjāhum ʾilā al-barri ʾidhā hum yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever they go on board a ship they call on God, and dedicate their faith to Him alone, but once He has delivered them safely back to land, see how they ascribe partners to Him!
verses.pickthall: And when they mount upon the ships they pray to Allah, making their faith pure for Him only, but when He bringeth them safe to land, behold! they ascribe partners (unto Him),

verses.ar: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.
verses.tr: liyakfurūā bimā ātaynāhum waliyatamattaʿūā ۖ fasawfa yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Let them show their ingratitude for what We have given them; let them take their enjoyment- soon they will know.
verses.pickthall: That they may disbelieve in that which We have given them, and that they may take their ease. But they will come to know.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنًا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allāh they disbelieve?
verses.tr: ʾawalam yarawā ʾannā jaʿalnā ḥaraman āminan wayutakhaṭṭafu an-nāsu min ḥawlihim ۚ ʾafabālbāṭili yuʾminūna wabiniʿmahi Allāh yakfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Can they not see that We have made [them] a secure sanctuary though all around them people are snatched away? Then how can they believe in what is false and deny God’s blessing?
verses.pickthall: Have they not seen that We have appointed a sanctuary immune (from violence), while mankind are ravaged all around them? Do they then believe in falsehood and disbelieve in the bounty of Allah?

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers?
verses.tr: waman ʾaẓlamu mimmani āftarā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban ʾaw kadhaba bi-l-ḥaqqi lammā jāʾahu ۚ ʾalaysa fā jahannama mathwanā llilkāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who could be more wicked than the person who invents lies about God, or denies the truth when it comes to him? Is Hell not the home for the disbelievers?
verses.pickthall: Who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah, or denieth the truth when it cometh unto him? Is not there a home in hell for disbelievers?

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allāh is with the doers of good.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna jāhadūā fīnā lanahdiyannahum subulanā ۚ wa-inna Allāh lamaʿa al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But We shall be sure to guide to Our ways those who strive hard for Our cause: God is with those who do good.
verses.pickthall: As for those who strive in Us, We surely guide them to Our paths, and lo! Allah is with the good.

verses.ar: الٓمٓ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Meem.
verses.tr: al-m
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Mim
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Mim.

verses.ar: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ
verses.en: The Byzantines have been defeated
verses.tr: ghulibati ar-rūmu
verses.abdelhaleem: The Byzantines have been defeated
verses.pickthall: The Romans have been defeated

verses.ar: فِىٓ أَدْنَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ
verses.en: In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome
verses.tr: fā ʾadnā al-ʾarḍi wahum mmin baʿdi ghalabihim sayaghlibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: in a nearby land. They will reverse their defeat with a victory
verses.pickthall: In the nearer land, and they, after their defeat will be victorious

verses.ar: فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ ۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ ۚ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Within three to nine years. To Allāh belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice
verses.tr: fā biḍʿi sinīna ۗ lillāh al-ʾamru min qablu wamin baʿdu ۚ wayawmaʾidhin yafraḥu al-muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: in a few years’ time––God is in command, first and last. On that day, the believers will rejoice
verses.pickthall: Within ten years - Allah's is the command in the former case and in the latter - and in that day believers will rejoice

verses.ar: بِنَصْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: In the victory of Allāh. He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.tr: binaṣri Allāh ۚ yanṣuru man yashāʾu ۖ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: at God’s help. He helps whoever He pleases: He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.pickthall: In Allah's help to victory. He helpeth to victory whom He will. He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: [It is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.
verses.tr: waʿda Allāh ۖ lā yukhlifu Allāh waʿdahu walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is God’s promise: God never breaks His promise, but most people do not know;
verses.pickthall: It is a promise of Allah. Allah faileth not His promise, but most of mankind know not.

verses.ar: يَعْلَمُونَ ظَـٰهِرًا مِّنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ
verses.en: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.
verses.tr: yaʿlamūna ẓāhiran mmina al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā wahum ʿani al-ākhirahi hum ghāfilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they only know the outer surface of this present life and are heedless of the life to come.
verses.pickthall: They know only some appearance of the life of the world, and are heedless of the Hereafter.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم ۗ مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: Do they not contemplate within themselves? Allāh has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yatafakkarūā fā ʾanfusihim ۗ mmā khalaqa Allāh as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wamā baynahumā ʾillā bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-ajalin mmusammanā ۗ wa-inna kathīran mmina an-nāsi biliqāʾi rabbihim lakāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have they not thought about their own selves? God did not create the heavens and earth and everything between them without a serious purpose and an appointed time, yet many people deny that they will meet their Lord.
verses.pickthall: Have they not pondered upon themselves? Allah created not the heavens and the earth, and that which is between them, save with truth and for a destined end. But truly many of mankind are disbelievers in the meeting with their Lord.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَثَارُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed [or excavated] the earth and built it up more than they [i.e., the Makkans] have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allāh would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yasīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fayanẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ kānūā ʾashadda minhum quwwahan wa-athārūā al-ʾarḍa waʿamarūhā ʾakthara mimmā ʿamarūhā wajāʾathum rusuluhum bi-l-bayyināti ۖ famā kāna Allāh liyaẓlimahum walākin kānūā ʾanfusahum yaẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how their predecessors met their end? They were mightier than them: they cultivated the earth more and built more upon it. Their own mes-sengers also came to them with clear signs: God did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.
verses.pickthall: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them? They were stronger than these in power, and they dug the earth and built upon it more than these have built. Messengers of their own came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty). Surely Allah wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allāh and used to ridicule them.
verses.tr: thumma kāna ʿāqibaha adh-dhīna ʾasāwā as-sūā ʾan kadhabūā bāyāti Allāh wakānūā bihā yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Later the evildoers met a terrible end for rejecting and [repeatedly] mocking God’s revelations.
verses.pickthall: Then evil was the consequence to those who dealt in evil, because they denied the revelations of Allah and made a mock of them.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: Allāh begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.
verses.tr: Allāh yabdaā al-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu thumma ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God brings creation into being; in the end He will reproduce it and it is to Him you will be recalled.
verses.pickthall: Allah produceth creation, then He reproduceth it, then unto Him ye will be returned.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.
verses.tr: wayawma taqūmu as-sāʿahu yublisu al-mujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day the Hour arrives, the guilty will despair
verses.pickthall: And in the day when the Hour riseth the unrighteous will despair.

verses.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَـٰٓؤُا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.
verses.tr: walam yakun llahum mmin shurakāʾihim shufaʿā wakānūā bishurakāʾihim kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will have no intercessors among those partners they ascribed to God- they will deny these partners.
verses.pickthall: There will be none to intercede for them of those whom they made equal with Allah. And they will reject their partners (whom they ascribed unto Him).

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ
verses.en: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.
verses.tr: wayawma taqūmu as-sāʿahu yawmaʾidhin yatafarraqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the Hour arrives, on that Day people will be separated:
verses.pickthall: In the day when the Hour cometh, in that day they will be sundered.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ
verses.en: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
verses.tr: fa-ammā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti fahum fā rawḍahin yuḥbarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who believed and did good deeds will delight in a Garden,
verses.pickthall: As for those who believed and did good works, they will be made happy in a Garden.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.en: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
verses.tr: wa-ammā adh-dhīna kafarūā wakadhabūā bāyātinā waliqāʾi al-ākhirahi fa-ūlāʾika fā al-ʿadhābi muḥḍarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: while those who disbelieved and denied Our messages and the meeting of the Hereafter will be brought for punishment.
verses.pickthall: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our revelations, and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, such will be brought to doom.

verses.ar: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
verses.en: So exalted is Allāh when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.
verses.tr: fasubḥāna Allāh ḥīna tumsūna waḥīna tuṣbiḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So celebrate God’s glory in the evening, in the morning-
verses.pickthall: So glory be to Allah when ye enter the night and when ye enter the morning -

verses.ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ
verses.en: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.
verses.tr: walahu al-ḥamdu fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi waʿashiyyan waḥīna tuẓhirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: praise is due to Him in the heavens and the earth- in the late afternoon, and at midday.
verses.pickthall: Unto Him be praise in the heavens and the earth! - and at the sun's decline and in the noonday.

verses.ar: يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
verses.en: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.
verses.tr: yukhriju al-ḥāa mina al-mayyiti wayukhriju al-mayyita mina al-ḥāi wayuḥāi al-ʾarḍa baʿda mawtihā ۚ wakadhālika tukhrajūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living. He gives life to the earth after death, and you will be brought out in the same way.
verses.pickthall: He bringeth forth the living from the dead, and He bringeth forth the dead from the living, and He reviveth the earth after her death. And even so will ye be brought forth.

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ تَنتَشِرُونَ
verses.en: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi ʾan khalaqakum mmin turābin thumma ʾidhā ʾantum basharun tantashirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: One of His signs is that He created you from dust and- lo and behold!- you became human and scattered far and wide.
verses.pickthall: And of His signs is this: He created you of dust, and behold you human beings, ranging widely!

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi ʾan khalaqa lakum mmin ʾanfusikum ʾazwājan llitaskunūā ʾilayhā wajaʿala baynakum mmawaddahan waraḥmahan ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yatafakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Another of His signs is that He created spouses from among yourselves for you to live with in tranquillity: He ordained love and kindness between you. There truly are signs in this for those who reflect.
verses.pickthall: And of His signs is this: He created for you helpmeets from yourselves that ye might find rest in them, and He ordained between you love and mercy. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who reflect.

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi khalqu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wākhtilāfu ʾalsinatikum wa-ʾalwānikum ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin llilʿālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Another of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth, and the diversity of your languages and colours. There truly are signs in this for those who know.
verses.pickthall: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of your languages and colours. Lo! herein indeed are portents for men of knowledge.

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.en: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi manāmukum bi-l-yli wa-an-nahāri wābtighāʾukum mmin faḍlihi ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yasmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Among His signs are your sleep, by night and by day, and your seeking His bounty. There truly are signs in this for those who can hear.
verses.pickthall: And of His signs is your slumber by night and by day, and your seeking of His bounty. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who heed.

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi yurīkumu al-barqa khawfan waṭamaʿan wayunazzilu mina as-samāʾi māʾan fayuḥāi bihi al-ʾarḍa baʿda mawtihā ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Among His signs, too, are that He shows you the lightning that terrifies and inspires hope; that He sends water down from the sky to restore the earth to life after death. There truly are signs in this for those who use their reason.
verses.pickthall: And of His signs is this: He showeth you the lightning for a fear and for a hope, and sendeth down water from the sky, and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who understand.

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ
verses.en: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi ʾan taqūma as-samāʾu wa-l-ʾarḍu biʾamrihi ۚ thumma ʾidhā daʿākum daʿwahan mmina al-ʾarḍi ʾidhā ʾantum takhrujūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Among His signs, too, is the fact that the heavens and the earth stand firm by His command. In the end, you will all emerge when He calls you from the earth.
verses.pickthall: And of His signs is this: The heavens and the earth stand fast by His command, and afterward, when He calleth you, lo! from the earth ye will emerge.

verses.ar: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَـٰنِتُونَ
verses.en: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.
verses.tr: walahu man fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ kullun llahu qānitūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him, and all are obedient to Him.
verses.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. All are obedient unto Him.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā yabdaā al-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu wahuwa ʾahwanu ʿalayhi ۚ walahu al-mathalu al-ʾaʿlā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: He is the One who originates creation and will do it again- this is even easier for Him. He is above all comparison in the heavens and earth; He is the Almighty, the All Wise.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who produceth creation, then reproduceth it, and it is easier for Him. His is the Sublime Similitude in the heavens and the earth. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِى مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ فَأَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.
verses.tr: ḍaraba lakum mmathalan mmin ʾanfusikum ۖ hal llakum mmin mmā malakat ʾaymānukum mmin shurakāʾa fā mā razaqnākum fa-antum fīhi sawāʾun takhāfūnahum kakhīfatikum ʾanfusakum ۚ kadhālika nufaṣṣilu al-āyāti liqawmin yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He gives you this example, drawn from your own lives: do you make your slaves full partners with an equal share in what We have given you? Do you fear them as you fear each other? This is how We make Our messages clear to those who use their reason.
verses.pickthall: He coineth for you a similitude of yourselves. Have ye, from among those whom your right hands possess, partners in the wealth We have bestowed upon you, equal with you in respect thereof, so that ye fear them as ye fear each other (that ye ascribe unto Us partners out of that which We created)? Thus We display the revelations for people who have sense.

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ فَمَن يَهْدِى مَنْ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.en: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allāh has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.
verses.tr: bali āttabaʿa adh-dhīna ẓalamūā ʾahwāʾahum bighayri ʿilmin ۖ faman yahdā man ʾaḍalla Allāh ۖ wamā lahum mmin nnāṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And still the idolaters follow their own desires without any knowledge. Who can guide those God leaves to stray, who have no one to help them?
verses.pickthall: Nay, but those who do wrong follow their own lusts without knowledge. Who is able to guide him whom Allah hath sent astray? For such there are no helpers.

verses.ar: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا ۚ فِطْرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fiṭrah of Allāh upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allāh. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.
verses.tr: fa-aqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan ۚ fiṭrata Allāh at-tā faṭara an-nāsa ʿalayhā ۚ lā tabdīla likhalqi Allāh ۚ dhālika ad-dīnu al-qayyimu walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] as a man of pure faith, stand firm and true in your devotion to the religion. This is the natural disposition God instilled in mankind- there is no altering God’s creation- and this is the right religion, though most people do not realize it.
verses.pickthall: So set thy purpose (O Muhammad) for religion as a man by nature upright - the nature (framed) of Allah, in which He hath created man. There is no altering (the laws of) Allah's creation. That is the right religion, but most men know not -

verses.ar: ۞ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allāh
verses.tr: ۞ munībīna ʾilayhi wāttaqūhu wa-aqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha walā takūnūā mina al-mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Turn to Him alone, all of you. Be mindful of Him; keep up the prayer; do not join those who ascribe partners to God,
verses.pickthall: Turning unto Him (only); and be careful of your duty unto Him and establish worship, and be not of those who ascribe partners (unto Him);

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
verses.en: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.
verses.tr: mina adh-dhīna farraqūā dīnahum wakānūā shiyaʿan ۖ kullu ḥizbin bimā ladayhim fariḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who divide their religion into sects, with each party rejoicing in their own.
verses.pickthall: Of those who split up their religion and became schismatics, each sect exulting in its tenets.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا۟ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,
verses.tr: wa-idhā massa an-nāsa ḍurrun daʿawā rabbahum mmunībīna ʾilayhi thumma ʾidhā ʾadhāqahum mminhu raḥmahan ʾidhā farīqun mminhum birabbihim yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When something bad happens to people, they cry to their Lord and turn to Him for help, but no sooner does He let them taste His blessing than- lo and behold!- some of them ascribe partners to their Lord,
verses.pickthall: And when harm toucheth men they cry unto their Lord, turning to Him in repentance; then, when they have tasted of His mercy, behold! some of them attribute partners to their Lord

verses.ar: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
verses.tr: liyakfurūā bimā ātaynāhum ۚ fatamattaʿūā fasawfa taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: showing no gratitude for what We have given them. ‘Take your pleasure! You will come to know.’
verses.pickthall: So as to disbelieve in that which We have given them. (Unto such it is said): Enjoy yourselves awhile, but ye will come to know.

verses.ar: أَمْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: Or have We sent down to them an authority [i.e., a proof or scripture], and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?
verses.tr: ʾam ʾanzalnā ʿalayhim sulṭānan fahuwa yatakallamu bimā kānūā bihi yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We send them down any authority that sanctions the partners they ascribe to God?
verses.pickthall: Or have We revealed unto them any warrant which speaketh of that which they associate with Him?

verses.ar: وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوا۟ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ
verses.en: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.
verses.tr: wa-idhā ʾadhaqnā an-nāsa raḥmahan fariḥūā bihā ۖ wa-in tuṣibhum sayyiʾahun bimā qaddamat ʾaydīhim ʾidhā hum yaqnaṭūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When We give people a taste of Our blessing, they rejoice, but when something bad happens to them- because of their own actions- they fall into utter despair.
verses.pickthall: And when We cause mankind to taste of mercy they rejoice therein; but if an evil thing befall them as the consequence of their own deeds, lo! they are in despair!

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Do they not see that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yarawā ʾanna Allāh yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yashāʾu wayaqdiru ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not see that God gives abundantly to whoever He will and sparingly [to whoever He will]? There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
verses.pickthall: See they not that Allah enlargeth the provision for whom He will, and straiteneth (it for whom He will). Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who believe.

verses.ar: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.
verses.tr: fāti dhā al-qurbā ḥaqqahu wa-l-miskīna wābna as-sabīli ۚ dhālika khayrun llilladhīna yurīdūna wajha Allāh ۖ wa-ūlāʾika humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So give their due to the near relative, the needy, and the wayfarer- that is best for those whose goal is God’s approval: these are the ones who will prosper.
verses.pickthall: So give to the kinsman his due, and to the needy, and to the wayfarer. That is best for those who seek Allah's Countenance. And such are they who are successful.

verses.ar: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَا۟ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُضْعِفُونَ
verses.en: And whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allāh. But what you give in zakāh, desiring the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh - those are the multipliers.
verses.tr: wamā ātaytum mmin rriban lliyarbuwā fā ʾamwāli an-nāsi falā yarbūā ʿinda Allāh ۖ wamā ātaytum mmin zakawāhin turīdūna wajha Allāh fa-ūlāʾika humu al-muḍʿifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whatever you lend out in usury to gain value through other people’s wealth will not increase in God’s eyes, but whatever you give in charity, in your desire for God’s approval, will earn multiple rewards.
verses.pickthall: That which ye give in usury in order that it may increase on (other) people's property hath no increase with Allah; but that which ye give in charity, seeking Allah's Countenance, hath increase manifold.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: Allāh is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥyīkum ۖ hal min shurakāʾikum mman yafʿalu min dhālikum mmin shāʾin ۚ subḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who created you and provided for you, who will cause you to die and then give you life again. Which of your ‘partners’ can do any one of these things? Glory be to God, and exalted be He above the partners they attribute to Him.
verses.pickthall: Allah is He Who created you and then sustained you, then causeth you to die, then giveth life to you again. Is there any of your (so-called) partners (of Allah) that doeth aught of that? Praised and Exalted be He above what they associate (with Him)!

verses.ar: ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِى ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., Allāh] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].
verses.tr: ẓahara al-fasādu fā al-barri wa-l-baḥri bimā kasabat ʾaydā an-nāsi liyudhīqahum baʿḍa adh-dhā ʿamilūā laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Corruption has flourished on land and sea as a result of people’s actions and He will make them taste the consequences of some of their own actions so that they may turn back.
verses.pickthall: Corruption doth appear on land and sea because of (the evil) which men's hands have done, that He may make them taste a part of that which they have done, in order that they may return.

verses.ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allāh].
verses.tr: qul sīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fānẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu adh-dhīna min qablu ۚ kāna ʾaktharuhum mmushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Travel through the land, and see how those before you met their end- most of them were idolaters.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): Travel in the land, and see the nature of the consequence for those who were before you! Most of them were idolaters.

verses.ar: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ
verses.en: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.
verses.tr: fa-aqim wajhaka lilddīni al-qayyimi min qabli ʾan yaʾtāa yawmun llā maradda lahu mina Allāh ۖ yawmaʾidhin yaṣṣaddaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], stand firm in your devotion to the upright religion, before an irresistible Day comes from God. On that Day, mankind will be divided:
verses.pickthall: So set thy purpose resolutely for the right religion, before the inevitable day cometh from Allah. On that day mankind will be sundered-

verses.ar: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ
verses.en: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,
verses.tr: man kafara faʿalayhi kufruhu ۖ waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan faliʾanfusihim yamhadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who rejected the truth will bear the burden of that rejection, and those who did good deeds will have made good provision for themselves.
verses.pickthall: Whoso disbelieveth must (then) bear the consequences of his disbelief, while those who do right make provision for themselves -

verses.ar: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.
verses.tr: liyajzāa adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti min faḍlihi ۚ ʾinnahu lā yuḥibbu al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: From His bounty God will reward those who believe and do good deeds; He does not like those who reject the truth.
verses.pickthall: That He may reward out of His bounty those who believe and do good works. Lo! He loveth not the disbelievers (in His guidance).

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرْسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi ʾan yursila ar-riyāḥa mubashirātin waliyudhīqakum mmin rraḥmatihi walitajrāa al-fulku biʾamrihi walitabtaghūā min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Another of His signs is that He sends out the winds bearing good news, giving you a taste of His grace, making the ships sail at His command, enabling you to [journey in] search of His bounty so that you may be grateful.
verses.pickthall: And of His signs is this: He sendeth herald winds to make you taste His mercy, and that the ships may sail at His command, and that ye may seek his favour, and that haply ye may be thankful.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ ۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support of the believers.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā min qablika rusulan ʾilā qawmihim fajāʾūhum bi-l-bayyināti fāntaqamnā mina adh-dhīna ʾajramūā ۖ wakāna ḥaqqan ʿalaynā naṣru al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Before you [Muhammad], We sent mes-sengers, each to their own people: they brought them clear proofs and then We punished the evildoers. We make it Our duty to help the believers.
verses.pickthall: Verily We sent before thee (Muhammad) messengers to their own folk. Then we took vengeance upon those who were guilty (in regard to them). To help believers is ever incumbent upon Us.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُۥ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُۥ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَـٰلِهِۦ ۖ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.en: It is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā yursilu ar-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fayabsuṭuhu fā as-samāʾi kayfa yashāʾu wayajʿaluhu kisafan fatarā al-wadqa yakhruju min khilālihi ۖ fa-idhā ʾaṣāba bihi man yashāʾu min ʿibādihi ʾidhā hum yastabshirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who sends out the winds; they stir up the clouds; He spreads them over the skies as He pleases; He makes them break up and you see the rain falling from them. See how they rejoice when He makes it fall upon whichever of His servants He wishes,
verses.pickthall: Allah is He Who sendeth the winds so that they raise clouds, and spreadeth them along the sky as pleaseth Him, and causeth them to break and thou seest the rain downpouring from within them. And when He maketh it to fall on whom He will of His bondmen, lo! they rejoice;

verses.ar: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمُبْلِسِينَ
verses.en: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.
verses.tr: wa-in kānūā min qabli ʾan yunazzala ʿalayhim mmin qablihi lamublisīna
verses.abdelhaleem: though before it is sent they may have lost all hope.
verses.pickthall: Though before that, even before it was sent down upon them, they were in despair.

verses.ar: فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِ رَحْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allāh - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
verses.tr: fānẓur ʾilā āthāri raḥmati Allāh kayfa yuḥāi al-ʾarḍa baʿda mawtihā ۚ ʾinna dhālika lamuḥāi al-mawtā ۖ wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Look, then, at the imprints of God’s mercy, how He restores the earth to life after death: this same God is the one who will return people to life after death- He has power over all things.
verses.pickthall: Look, therefore, at the prints of Allah's mercy (in creation): how He quickeneth the earth after her death. Lo! He verily is the Quickener of the Dead, and He is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ يَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.
verses.tr: walaʾin ʾarsalnā rīḥan faraʾawhu muṣfarran llaẓallūā min baʿdihi yakfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet they will continue in their disbelief, even if We send a [scorching] wind and they see their crops turn yellow.
verses.pickthall: And if We sent a wind and they beheld it yellow, they verily would still continue in their disbelief.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
verses.en: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.
verses.tr: fa-innaka lā tusmiʿu al-mawtā walā tusmiʿu aṣ-ṣumma ad-duʿāʾa ʾidhā wallawā mudbirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You [Prophet] cannot make the dead hear and you cannot make the deaf hear your call when they turn their backs and leave;
verses.pickthall: For verily thou (Muhammad) canst not make the dead to hear, nor canst thou make the deaf to hear the call when they have turned to flee.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَـٰدِ ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَـٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
verses.tr: wamā ʾanta bihādi al-ʿumāi ʿan ḍalālatihim ۖ ʾin tusmiʿu ʾillā man yuʾminu bāyātinā fahum mmuslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: you cannot lead the blind out of their error: the only ones you can make hear you are those who believe in Our revelations and devote themselves [to Us].
verses.pickthall: Nor canst thou guide the blind out of their error. Thou canst make none to hear save those who believe in Our revelations so that they surrender (unto Him).

verses.ar: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ
verses.en: Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.
verses.tr: ۞ Allāh adh-dhā khalaqakum mmin ḍaʿfin thumma jaʿala min baʿdi ḍaʿfin quwwahan thumma jaʿala min baʿdi quwwahin ḍaʿfan washaybahan ۚ yakhluqu mā yashāʾu ۖ wahuwa al-ʿalīmu al-qadīru
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who creates you weak, then gives you strength, then weakness after strength, together with your grey hair: He creates what He will; He is the All Knowing, the All Powerful.
verses.pickthall: Allah is He Who shaped you out of weakness, then appointed after weakness strength, then, after strength, appointed weakness and grey hair. He createth what He will. He is the Knower, the Mighty.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.en: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.
verses.tr: wayawma taqūmu as-sāʿahu yuqsimu al-mujrimūna mā labithūā ghayra sāʿahin ۚ kadhālika kānūā yuʾfakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day the Hour comes, the guilty will swear they lingered no more than an hour- they have always been deluded-
verses.pickthall: And on the day when the Hour riseth the guilty will vow that they did tarry but an hour - thus were they ever deceived.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْبَعْثِ ۖ فَهَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْبَعْثِ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allāh's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-ʿilma wa-l-ʾīmāna laqad labithtum fā kitābi Allāh ʾilā yawmi al-baʿthi ۖ fahādhā yawmu al-baʿthi walākinnakum kuntum lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but those endowed with knowledge and faith will say, ‘In accordance with God’s decree, you actually lingered till the Day of Resurrection: this is the Day of Resurrection, yet you did not know.’
verses.pickthall: But those to whom knowledge and faith are given will say: The truth is, ye have tarried, by Allah's decree, until the Day of Resurrection. This is the Day of Resurrection, but ye used not to know.

verses.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
verses.en: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
verses.tr: fayawmaʾidhin llā yanfaʿu adh-dhīna ẓalamūā maʿdhiratuhum walā hum yustaʿtabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day the evildoers’ excuses will be of no use to them: they will not be allowed to make amends.
verses.pickthall: In that day their excuses will not profit those who did injustice, nor will they be allowed to make amends.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ ۚ وَلَئِن جِئْتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ
verses.en: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muḥammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."
verses.tr: walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fā hādhā al-qurāni min kulli mathalin ۚ walaʾin jiʾtahum bāyahin llayaqūlanna adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾin ʾantum ʾillā mubṭilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In this Quran We have set every kind of illustration before people, yet if you [Prophet] brought them a miracle, the disbelievers would still say, ‘You [prophets] deal only in falsehood.’
verses.pickthall: Verily We have coined for mankind in this Qur'an all kinds of similitudes; and indeed if thou camest unto them with a miracle, those who disbelieve would verily exclaim: Ye are but tricksters!

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Thus does Allāh seal the hearts of those who do not know.
verses.tr: kadhālika yaṭbaʿu Allāh ʿalā qulūbi adh-dhīna lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way God seals the hearts of those who do not know,
verses.pickthall: Thus doth Allah seal the hearts of those who know not.

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
verses.tr: fāṣbir ʾinna waʿda Allāh ḥaqqun ۖ walā yastakhiffannaka adh-dhīna lā yūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so be patient, for God’s promise is true: do not let those with no firm beliefs discourage you.
verses.pickthall: So have patience (O Muhammad)! Allah's promise is the very truth, and let not those who have no certainty make thee impatient.

verses.ar: الٓمٓ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Meem.
verses.tr: al-m
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Mim
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Mim.

verses.ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.en: These are verses of the wise Book,
verses.tr: tilka āyātu al-kitābi al-ḥakīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: These are the verses of the wise Scripture,
verses.pickthall: These are revelations of the wise Scripture,

verses.ar: هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good
verses.tr: hudanā waraḥmahan llilmuḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [with] guidance and mercy for those who do good,
verses.pickthall: A guidance and a mercy for the good,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith].
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yuqīmūna aṣ-ṣalawāha wayuʾtūna az-zakawāha wahum bi-l-ākhirahi hum yūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and are certain of the Hereafter:
verses.pickthall: Those who establish worship and pay the poor-due and have sure faith in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika ʿalā hudanā mmin rrabbihim ۖ wa-ūlāʾika humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: these are rightly guided by their Lord, and it is they who will prosper.
verses.pickthall: Such have guidance from their Lord. Such are the successful.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِى لَهْوَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.en: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allāh without knowledge and who takes it [i.e., His way] in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
verses.tr: wamina an-nāsi man yashtarā lahwa al-ḥadīthi liyuḍilla ʿan sabīli Allāh bighayri ʿilmin wayattakhidhahā huzuwan ۚ ʾūlāʾika lahum ʿadhābun mmuhīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: But there is the sort of person who pays for distracting tales, intending, without any knowledge, to lead others from God’s way, and to hold it up to ridicule. There will be humiliating torment for him!
verses.pickthall: And of mankind is he who payeth for mere pastime of discourse, that he may mislead from Allah's way without knowledge, and maketh it the butt of mockery. For such there is a shameful doom.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِىٓ أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
verses.tr: wa-idhā tutlā ʿalayhi āyātunā wallā mustakbiran kaʾan llam yasmaʿhā kaʾanna fā ʾudhunayhi waqran ۖ fabashirhu biʿadhābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: When Our verses are recited to him, he turns away disdainfully as if he had not heard them, as if there were heaviness in his ears. Tell him that there will be a painful torment!
verses.pickthall: And when Our revelations are recited unto him he turneth away in pride as if he heard them not, as if there were a deafness in his ears. So give him tidings of a painful doom.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure,
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātu an-naʿīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: But for those who believe and do righteous deeds, there will be Gardens of bliss
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, for them are the gardens of delight,

verses.ar: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allāh [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: khālidīna fīhā ۖ waʿda Allāh ḥaqqan ۚ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: where they will stay: that is God’s true promise, and He is the Almighty, the All Wise.
verses.pickthall: Wherein they will abide. It is a promise of Allah in truth. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind.
verses.tr: khalaqa as-samāwāti bighayri ʿamadin tarawnahā ۖ wa-ʾalqā fā al-ʾarḍi rawāsāa ʾan tamīda bikum wabatha fīhā min kulli dābbahin ۚ wa-anzalnā mina as-samāʾi māʾan fa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: He created the heavens without any visible support, and He placed firm mountains on the earth––in case it should shake under you––and He spread all kinds of animals around it. We sent down water from the sky, with which We made every kind of good plant grow on earth:
verses.pickthall: He hath created the heavens without supports that ye can see, and hath cast into the earth firm hills, so that it quake not with you; and He hath dispersed therein all kinds of beasts. And We send down water from the sky and We cause (plants) of every goodly kind to grow therein.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا خَلْقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ بَلِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: This is the creation of Allāh. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.
verses.tr: hādhā khalqu Allāh fa-arūnā mādhā khalaqa adh-dhīna min dūnihi ۚ bali aẓ-ẓālimūna fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: all this is God’s creation. Now, show Me what your other gods have created. No, the disbelievers are clearly astray.
verses.pickthall: This is the Creation of Allah. Now show me that which those (ye worship) beside Him have created. Nay, but the wrong-doers are in error manifest!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
verses.en: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā luqmāna al-ḥikmaha ʾani āshkur lillāh ۚ waman yashkur fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi ۖ waman kafara fa-inna Allāh ghanāun ḥamīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: We endowed Luqman with wisdom: ‘Be thankful to God: whoever gives thanks benefits his own soul, and as for those who are thankless––God is self-sufficient, worthy of all praise.’
verses.pickthall: And verily We gave Luqman wisdom, saying: Give thanks unto Allah; and whosoever giveth thanks, he giveth thanks for (the good of) his soul. And whosoever refuseth - Lo! Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَـٰنُ لِٱبْنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَـٰبُنَىَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Luqmān said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allāh. Indeed, association [with Him] is great injustice."
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla luqmānu lābnihi wahuwa yaʿiẓuhu yābunāa lā tushrik billāh ۖ ʾinna ash-shirka laẓulmun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Luqman counselled his son, ‘My son, do not attribute any partners to God: attributing partners to Him is a terrible wrong.’
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when Luqman said unto his son, when he was exhorting him: O my dear son! Ascribe no partners unto Allah. Lo! to ascribe partners (unto Him) is a tremendous wrong -

verses.ar: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ وَفِصَـٰلُهُۥ فِى عَامَيْنِ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَيْكَ إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.
verses.tr: wawaṣṣaynā al-ʾinsāna biwālidayhi ḥamalathu ʾummuhu wahnan ʿalā wahnin wafiṣāluhu fā ʿāmayni ʾani āshkur lā waliwālidayka ʾilāa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: We have commanded people to be good to their parents: their mothers carried them, with strain upon strain, and it takes two years to wean them. Give thanks to Me and to your parents- all will return to Me.
verses.pickthall: And We have enjoined upon man concerning his parents - His mother beareth him in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years - Give thanks unto Me and unto thy parents. Unto Me is the journeying

verses.ar: وَإِن جَـٰهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ۖ وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا ۖ وَٱتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَىَّ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
verses.tr: wa-in jāhadāka ʿalā ʾan tushrika bā mā laysa laka bihi ʿilmun falā tuṭiʿhumā ۖ waṣāḥibhumā fā ad-dunyā maʿrūfan ۖ wāttabiʿ sabīla man ʾanāba ʾilāa ۚ thumma ʾilāa marjiʿukum fa-unabbiʾukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they strive to make you associate with Me anything about which you have no knowledge, then do not obey them. Yet keep their company in this life according to what is right, and follow the path of those who turn to Me. You will all return to Me in the end, and I will tell you everything that you have done.
verses.pickthall: But if they strive with thee to make thee ascribe unto Me as partner that of which thou hast no knowledge, then obey them not. Consort with them in the world kindly, and follow the path of him who repenteth unto Me. Then unto Me will be your return, and I shall tell you what ye used to do -

verses.ar: يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ فَتَكُن فِى صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ أَوْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: [And Luqmān said], "O my son, indeed if it [i.e., a wrong] should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allāh will bring it forth. Indeed, Allāh is Subtle and Aware.
verses.tr: yābunāa ʾinnahā ʾin taku mithqāla ḥabbahin mmin khardalin fatakun fā ṣakhrahin ʾaw fā as-samāwāti ʾaw fā al-ʾarḍi yaʾti bihā Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh laṭīfun khabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: [And Luqman continued], ‘My son, if even the weight of a mustard seed were hidden in a rock or anywhere in the heavens or earth, God would bring it [to light], for He is all subtle and all aware.
verses.pickthall: O my dear son! Lo! though it be but the weight of a grain of mustard-seed, and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens, or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.

verses.ar: يَـٰبُنَىَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱنْهَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَ ۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
verses.en: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.
verses.tr: yābunāa ʾaqimi aṣ-ṣalawāha wa-mur bi-l-maʿrūfi wānha ʿani al-munkari wāṣbir ʿalā mā ʾaṣābaka ۖ ʾinna dhālika min ʿazmi al-ʾumūri
verses.abdelhaleem: Keep up the prayer, my son; command what is right; forbid what is wrong; bear anything that happens to you steadfastly: these are things to be aspired to.
verses.pickthall: O my dear son! Establish worship and enjoin kindness and forbid iniquity, and persevere whatever may befall thee. Lo! that is of the steadfast heart of things.

verses.ar: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
verses.en: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.
verses.tr: walā tuṣaʿʿir khaddaka lilnnāsi walā tamshi fā al-ʾarḍi maraḥan ۖ ʾinna Allāh lā yuḥibbu kulla mukhtālin fakhūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not turn your nose up at people, nor walk about the place arrogantly, for God does not love arrogant or boastful people.
verses.pickthall: Turn not thy cheek in scorn toward folk, nor walk with pertness in the land. Lo! Allah loveth not each braggart boaster.

verses.ar: وَٱقْصِدْ فِى مَشْيِكَ وَٱغْضُضْ مِن صَوْتِكَ ۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلْأَصْوَٰتِ لَصَوْتُ ٱلْحَمِيرِ
verses.en: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."
verses.tr: wāqṣid fā mashyika wāghḍuḍ min ṣawtika ۚ ʾinna ʾankara al-ʾaṣwāti laṣawtu al-ḥamīri
verses.abdelhaleem: Go at a moderate pace and lower your voice, for the ugliest of all voices is the braying of asses.’
verses.pickthall: Be modest in thy bearing and subdue thy voice. Lo! the harshest of all voices is the voice of the ass.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَـٰهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً ۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَـٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَـٰبٍ مُّنِيرٍ
verses.en: Do you not see that Allāh has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him].
verses.tr: ʾalam tarawā ʾanna Allāh sakhara lakum mmā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi wa-asbagha ʿalaykum niʿamahu ẓāhirahan wabāṭinahan ۗ wamina an-nāsi man yujādilu fā Allāh bighayri ʿilmin walā hudanā walā kitābin mmunīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: [People], do you not see how God has made what is in the heavens and on the earth useful to you, and has lavished His bless-ings on you both outwardly and inwardly? Yet some people argue about God, without knowledge or guidance or an illuminating scripture.
verses.pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath made serviceable unto you whatsoever is in the skies and whatsoever is in the earth and hath loaded you with His favours both without and within? Yet of mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah, without knowledge or guidance or a scripture giving light.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allāh has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla lahumu āttabiʿūā mā ʾanzala Allāh qālūā bal nattabiʿu mā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāʾanā ۚ ʾawalaw kāna ash-shayṭānu yadʿūhum ʾilā ʿadhābi as-saʿīri
verses.abdelhaleem: When they are told, ‘Follow what God has sent down,’ they say: ‘We shall follow what we saw our forefathers following.’ What! Even if Satan is calling them to the suffering of the Blazing Flame?
verses.pickthall: And if it be said unto them: Follow that which Allah hath revealed, they say: Nay, but we follow that wherein we found our fathers. What! Even though the devil were inviting them unto the doom of flame?

verses.ar: ۞ وَمَن يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ
verses.en: And whoever submits his face [i.e., self] to Allāh while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allāh will be the outcome of [all] matters.
verses.tr: ۞ waman yuslim wajhahu ʾilā Allāh wahuwa muḥsinun faqadi āstamsaka bi-l-ʿurwahi al-wuthqā ۗ wa-ʾilā Allāh ʿāqibahu al-ʾumūri
verses.abdelhaleem: Whoever directs himself wholly to God and does good work has grasped the surest handhold, for the outcome of everything is with God.
verses.pickthall: Whosoever surrendereth his purpose to Allah while doing good, he verily hath grasped the firm hand-hold. Unto Allah belongeth the sequel of all things.

verses.ar: وَمَن كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ كُفْرُهُۥٓ ۚ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.tr: waman kafara falā yaḥzunka kufruhu ۚ ʾilaynā marjiʿuhum fanunabbiʾuhum bimā ʿamilūā ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who refuse to do this, do not let their refusal sadden you [Prophet]- they will return to Us and We shall tell them what they have done: God knows all that hearts contain-
verses.pickthall: And whosoever disbelieveth, let not his disbelief afflict thee (O Muhammad). Unto Us is their return, and We shall tell them what they did. Lo! Allah is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men).

verses.ar: نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
verses.en: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.
verses.tr: numattiʿuhum qalīlan thumma naḍṭarruhum ʾilā ʿadhābin ghalīẓin
verses.abdelhaleem: We let them enjoy themselves for a little while, but We shall drive them to a harsh torment.
verses.pickthall: We give them comfort for a little, and then We drive them to a heavy doom.

verses.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh"; but most of them do not know.
verses.tr: walaʾin saʾaltahum mman khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa layaqūlunna Allāh ۚ quli al-ḥamdu lillāh ۚ bal ʾaktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you ask them who created the heavens and earth, they are sure to say, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Praise belongs to God,’ but most of them do not understand.
verses.pickthall: If thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they would answer: Allah. Say: Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not.

verses.ar: لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.en: To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ ʾinna Allāh huwa al-ghanāu al-ḥamīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God. God is self-sufficient and worthy of all praise.
verses.pickthall: Unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. Lo! Allah, He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَـٰمٌ وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مَّا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allāh would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.tr: walaw ʾannamā fā al-ʾarḍi min shajarahin ʾaqlāmun wa-l-baḥru yamudduhu min baʿdihi sabʿahu ʾabḥurin mmā nafidat kalimātu Allāh ۗ ʾinna Allāh ʿazīzun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: If all the trees on earth were pens and all the seas, with seven more seas besides, [were ink,] still God’s words would not run out: God is almighty and all wise.
verses.pickthall: And if all the trees in the earth were pens, and the sea, with seven more seas to help it, (were ink), the words of Allah could not be exhausted. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.

verses.ar: مَّا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
verses.tr: mmā khalqukum walā baʿthukum ʾillā kanafsin wāḥidahin ۗ ʾinna Allāh samīʿun baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Creating and resurrecting all of you is only like creating or resurrecting a single soul: God is all hearing and all seeing.
verses.pickthall: Your creation and your raising (from the dead) are only as (the creation and the raising of) a single soul. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: Do you not see [i.e., know] that Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allāh, of whatever you do, is Aware?
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna Allāh yūliju al-yla fā an-nahāri wayūliju an-nahāra fā al-yli wasakhara ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara kullun yajrā ʾilā ʾajalin mmusammanā wa-anna Allāh bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do you not see that God causes the night to merge into day and the day to merge into night; that He has subjected the sun and the moon, each to run its course for a stated term; that He is aware of everything you [people] do?
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how Allah causeth the night to pass into the day and causeth the day to pass into the night, and hath subdued the sun and the moon (to do their work), each running unto an appointed term; and that Allah is Informed of what ye do?

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.en: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that what they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾanna Allāh huwa al-ḥaqqu wa-anna mā yadʿūna min dūnihi al-bāṭilu wa-anna Allāh huwa al-ʿalāu al-kabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: This is because God is the Truth, and what they invoke beside Him is false. He is the Most High, Most Great.
verses.pickthall: That (is so) because Allah, He is the True, and that which they invoke beside Him is the False, and because Allah, He is the Sublime, the Great.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُم مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
verses.en: Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allāh that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna al-fulka tajrā fā al-baḥri biniʿmati Allāh liyuriyakum mmin āyātihi ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin llikulli ṣabbārin shakūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do you not see that ships sail through the sea, by the grace of God, to show you [people] some of His wonders? Truly there are signs in this for every steadfast, thankful person.
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how the ships glide on the sea by Allah's grace, that He may show you of His wonders? Lo! therein indeed are portents for every steadfast, grateful (heart).

verses.ar: وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُم مَّوْجٌ كَٱلظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ كَفُورٍ
verses.en: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith]. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
verses.tr: wa-idhā ghashiyahum mmawjun ka-aẓ-ẓulali daʿawā Allāh mukhliṣīna lahu ad-dīna falammā najjāhum ʾilā al-barri faminhum mmuqtaṣidun ۚ wamā yajḥadu bāyātinā ʾillā kullu khattārin kafūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: When the waves loom over those on board like giant shadows they call out to God, devoting their religion entirely to Him. But, when He has delivered them safely to land, some of them waver- only a treacherous, thankless person refuses to acknowledge Our signs.
verses.pickthall: And if a wave enshroudeth them like awnings, they cry unto Allah, making their faith pure for Him only. But when He bringeth them safe to land, some of them compromise. None denieth Our signs save every traitor ingrate.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱخْشَوْا۟ يَوْمًا لَّا يَجْزِى وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِۦ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَن وَالِدِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
verses.en: O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu āttaqūā rabbakum wākhshawā yawman llā yajzā wa-ad-dun ʿan waladihi walā mawlūdun huwa jāzin ʿan wa-ad-dihi shayā ۚ ʾinna waʿda Allāh ḥaqqun ۖ falā taghurrannakumu al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā walā yaghurrannakum billāh al-gharūru
verses.abdelhaleem: People, be mindful of your Lord and fear a day when no parent will take the place of their child, nor a child take the place of their parent, in any way. God’s promise is true, so do not let the present life delude you, nor let the Deceiver delude you about God.
