verses.pickthall: O mankind! Keep your duty to your Lord and fear a Day when the parent will not be able to avail the child in aught, nor the child to avail the parent. Lo! Allah's promise is the very truth. Let not the life of the world beguile you, nor let the deceiver beguile you, in regard to Allah.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ ۖ وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌ مَّاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا ۖ وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌۢ بِأَىِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۢ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh ʿindahu ʿilmu as-sāʿahi wayunazzilu al-ghaytha wayaʿlamu mā fā al-ʾarḥāmi ۖ wamā tadrā nafsun mmādhā taksibu ghadan ۖ wamā tadrā nafsun bii ʾarḍin tamūtu ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalīmun khabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Knowledge of the Hour [of Resurrection] belongs to God; it is He who sends down the relieving rain and He who knows what is hidden in the womb. No soul knows what it will reap tomorrow, and no soul knows in what land it will die; it is God who is all knowing and all aware.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah! With Him is knowledge of the Hour. He sendeth down the rain, and knoweth that which is in the wombs. No soul knoweth what it will earn to-morrow, and no soul knoweth in what land it will die. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.

verses.ar: الٓمٓ
verses.en: Alif, Lām, Meem.
verses.tr: al-m
verses.abdelhaleem: Alif Lam Mim
verses.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Mim

verses.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: tanzīlu al-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rrabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This scripture, free from all doubt, has been sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: The revelation of the Scripture whereof there is no doubt is from the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muḥammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.
verses.tr: ʾam yaqūlūna āftarāhu ۚ bal huwa al-ḥaqqu min rrabbika litundhira qawman mmā ʾatāhum mmin nnadhīrin mmin qablika laʿallahum yahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet they say, ‘Muhammad has made it up.’ No indeed! It is the Truth from your Lord for you [Prophet], to warn a people who have had no one to warn them before, so that they may be guided.
verses.pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but it is the Truth from thy Lord, that thou mayst warn a folk to whom no warner came before thee, that haply they may walk aright.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wamā baynahumā fā sittahi ʾayyāmin thumma āstawā ʿalā al-ʿarshi ۖ mā lakum mmin dūnihi min walāin walā shafīʿin ۚ ʾafalā tatadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six Days. Then He established Himself on the Throne. You [people] have no one but Him to protect you and no one to intercede for you, so why do you not take heed?
verses.pickthall: Allah it is Who created the heavens and the earth, and that which is between them, in six Days. Then He mounted the Throne. Ye have not, beside Him, a protecting friend or mediator. Will ye not then remember?

verses.ar: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
verses.en: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.
verses.tr: yudabbiru al-ʾamra mina as-samāʾi ʾilā al-ʾarḍi thumma yaʿruju ʾilayhi fā yawmin kāna miqdāruhu ʾalfa sanahin mmimmā taʿuddūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He runs everything, from the heavens to the earth, and everything will ascend to Him in the end, on a Day that will measure a thousand years in your reckoning.
verses.pickthall: He directeth the ordinance from the heaven unto the earth; then it ascendeth unto Him in a Day, whereof the measure is a thousand years of that ye reckon.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
verses.tr: dhālika ʿālimu al-ghaybi wa-ash-shahādahi al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Such is He who knows all that is unseen as well as what is seen, the Almighty, the Merciful,
verses.pickthall: Such is the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Mighty, the Merciful,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ مِن طِينٍ
verses.en: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.
verses.tr: adh-dhā ʾaḥsana kulla shāʾin khalaqahu ۖ wabadaʾa khalqa al-ʾinsāni min ṭīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: who gave everything its perfect form. He first created man from clay,
verses.pickthall: Who made all things good which He created, and He began the creation of man from clay;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُۥ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
verses.en: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.
verses.tr: thumma jaʿala naslahu min sulālahin mmin mmāʾin mmahīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: then made his descendants from an extract of underrated fluid.
verses.pickthall: Then He made his seed from a draught of despised fluid;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
verses.tr: thumma sawwāhu wanafakha fīhi min rrūḥihi ۖ wajaʿala lakumu as-samʿa wa-l-ʾabṣāra wa-l-ʾafdaha ۚ qalīlan mmā tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then He moulded him; He breathed from His Spirit into him; He gave you hearing, sight, and minds. How seldom you are grateful!
verses.pickthall: Then He fashioned him and breathed into him of His Spirit; and appointed for you hearing and sight and hearts. Small thanks give ye!

verses.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: And they say, "When we are lost [i.e., disintegrated] within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.
verses.tr: waqālūā ʾaʾidhā ḍalalnā fā al-ʾarḍi ʾaʾinnā lafā khalqin jadīdin ۚ bal hum biliqāʾi rabbihim kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘What? When we have disappeared into the earth, shall we really be created anew?’ In fact, they deny the meeting with their Lord.
verses.pickthall: And they say: When we are lost in the earth, how can we then be re-created? Nay but they are disbelievers in the meeting with their Lord.

verses.ar: ۞ قُلْ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱلَّذِى وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."
verses.tr: ۞ qul yatawaffākum mmalaku al-mawti adh-dhā wukkila bikum thumma ʾilā rabbikum turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘The Angel of Death put in charge of you will reclaim you, and then you will be brought back to your Lord.’
verses.pickthall: Say: The angel of death, who hath charge concerning you, will gather you, and afterward unto your Lord ye will be returned.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."
verses.tr: walaw tarā ʾidhi al-mujrimūna nākisūā ruʾūsihim ʿinda rabbihim rabbanā ʾabṣarnā wasamiʿnā fārjiʿnā naʿmal ṣāliḥan ʾinnā mūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], if only you could see the wrongdoers hang their heads before their Lord: ‘Our Lord, now that we have seen and heard, send us back and we shall do good. [Now] we are convinced.’
verses.pickthall: Couldst thou but see when the guilty hang their heads before their Lord, (and say): Our Lord! We have now seen and heard, so send us back; we will do right, now we are sure.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَـَٔاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنِّى لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.
verses.tr: walaw shiʾnā lātaynā kulla nafsin hudāhā walākin ḥaqqa al-qawlu minnā laʾamlaʾanna jahannama mina al-jinnahi wa-an-nāsi ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘If it had been Our will, We could certainly have given every soul its true guidance, but My words have come true. “I shall be sure to fill Hell with jinn and men together.”
verses.pickthall: And if We had so willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me concerning evildoers took effect: that I will fill hell with the jinn and mankind together.

verses.ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَـٰكُمْ ۖ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."
verses.tr: fadhūqūā bimā nasītum liqāʾa yawmikum hādhā ʾinnā nasīnākum ۖ wadhūqūā ʿadhāba al-khuldi bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So since you ignored the meeting on this Day of yours, now We shall ignore you: taste the lasting suffering for all you have done.’
verses.pickthall: So taste (the evil of your deeds). Forasmuch as ye forgot the meeting of this your day, lo! We forget you. Taste the doom of immortality because of what ye used to do.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهَا خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا۟ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۩
verses.en: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā yuʾminu bāyātinā adh-dhīna ʾidhā dhukkirūā bihā kharrūā sujjadan wasabbaḥūā biḥamdi rabbihim wahum lā yastakbirūna ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: The only people who truly believe in Our messages are those who, when they are reminded of them, bow down in worship, cele-brate their Lord’s praises, and do not think themselves above this.
verses.pickthall: Only those believe in Our revelations who, when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrate and hymn the praise of their Lord, and they are not scornful,

verses.ar: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.en: Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
verses.tr: tatajāfā junūbuhum ʿani al-maḍājiʿi yadʿūna rabbahum khawfan waṭamaʿan wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Their sides shun their beds in order to pray to their Lord in fear and hope; they give to others some of what We have given them.
verses.pickthall: Who forsake their beds to cry unto their Lord in fear and hope, and spend of that We have bestowed on them.

verses.ar: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أُخْفِىَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.
verses.tr: falā taʿlamu nafsun mmā ʾukhfāa lahum mmin qurrahi ʾaʿyunin jazāʾan bimā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No soul knows what joy is kept hidden in store for them as a reward for what they have done.
verses.pickthall: No soul knoweth what is kept hid for them of joy, as a reward for what they used to do.

verses.ar: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُۥنَ
verses.en: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.
verses.tr: ʾafaman kāna muʾminan kaman kāna fāsiqan ۚ llā yastawuna
verses.abdelhaleem: So, is someone who believes equal to someone who defies God? No, they are not equal.
verses.pickthall: Is he who is a believer like unto him who is an evil-liver? They are not alike.

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.
verses.tr: ʾammā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti falahum jannātu al-maʾwā nuzulanā bimā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who believe and do good deeds will have Gardens awaiting them as their home and as a reward for what they have done.
verses.pickthall: But as for those who believe and do good works, for them are the Gardens of Retreat - a welcome (in reward) for what they used to do.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا۟ فَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."
verses.tr: wa-ammā adh-dhīna fasaqūā famaʾwāhumu an-nāru ۖ kullamā ʾarādūā ʾan yakhrujūā minhā ʾuʿīdūā fīhā waqīla lahum dhūqūā ʿadhāba an-nāri adh-dhā kuntum bihi tukadhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who defy God, their home will be the Fire. Whenever they try to escape it, they will be driven back into it, and they will be told, ‘Taste the torment of the Fire, which you persistently denied.’
verses.pickthall: And as for those who do evil, their retreat is the Fire. Whenever they desire to issue forth from thence, they are brought back thither. Unto them it is said: Taste the torment of the Fire which ye used to deny.

verses.ar: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].
verses.tr: walanudhīqannahum mmina al-ʿadhābi al-ʾadnā dūna al-ʿadhābi al-ʾakbari laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall certainly make them taste a nearer torment [in this life] prior to the greater torment, so that perhaps they may return [to the right path].
verses.pickthall: And verily We make them taste the lower punishment before the greater, that haply they may return.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَآ ۚ إِنَّا مِنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.en: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.
verses.tr: waman ʾaẓlamu mimman dhukkira bāyāti rabbihi thumma ʾaʿraḍa ʿanhā ۚ ʾinnā mina al-mujrimīna muntaqimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who does more wrong than someone who, when messages from his Lord are recited to him, turns away from them? We shall inflict retribution on the guilty.
verses.pickthall: And who doth greater wrong than he who is reminded of the revelations of his Lord, then turneth from them. Lo! We shall requite the guilty.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَلَا تَكُن فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And We made it [i.e., the Torah] guidance for the Children of Israel.
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā mūsā al-kitāba falā takun fā miryahin mmin lliqāʾihi ۖ wajaʿalnāhu hudanā llibanā ʾisrāʾīla
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave Moses the Scripture- so [Muhammad] do not doubt that you are receiving it- and We made it a guide for the Children of Israel.
verses.pickthall: We verily gave Moses the Scripture; so be not ye in doubt of his receiving it; and We appointed it a guidance for the Children of Israel.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا۟ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā minhum ʾaʾimmahan yahdūna biʾamrinā lammā ṣabarūā ۖ wakānūā bāyātinā yūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they became steadfast and believed firmly in Our messages, We raised leaders among them, guiding them according to Our command.
verses.pickthall: And when they became steadfast and believed firmly in Our revelations, We appointed from among them leaders who guided by Our command.

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
verses.tr: ʾinna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu baynahum yawma al-qiyāmahi fīmā kānūā fīhi yakhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], it is your Lord who will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning their differences.
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ ۖ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.en: Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?
verses.tr: ʾawalam yahdi lahum kam ʾahlaknā min qablihim mmina al-qurūni yamshūna fā masākinihim ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin ۖ ʾafalā yasmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Is it not a lesson for them [to see] how many generations We destroyed before them, in whose homes they now walk? There truly are signs in this- do they not hear?
verses.pickthall: Is it not a guidance for them (to observe) how many generations We destroyed before them, amid whose dwelling places they do walk? Lo! therein verily are portents! Will they not then heed?

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَـٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: Have they not seen that We drive water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see?
verses.tr: ʾawalam yarawā ʾannā nasūqu al-māʾa ʾilā al-ʾarḍi al-juruzi fanukhriju bihi zarʿan taʾkulu minhu ʾanʿāmuhum wa-anfusuhum ۖ ʾafalā yubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not consider how We drive rain to the barren land, and with it produce vegetation from which their cattle and they themselves eat? Do they not see?
verses.pickthall: Have they not seen how We lead the water to the barren land and therewith bring forth crops whereof their cattle eat, and they themselves? Will they not then see?

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"
verses.tr: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā al-fatḥu ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And they say, ‘When will this Decision be, if you are telling the truth?’
verses.pickthall: And they say: When cometh this victory (of yours) if ye are truthful?

verses.ar: قُلْ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."
verses.tr: qul yawma al-fatḥi lā yanfaʿu adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾīmānuhum walā hum yunẓarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘On the Day of Decision it will be no use for the disbelievers to believe; they will be granted no respite.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them): On the day of the victory the faith of those who disbelieve (and who then will believe) will not avail them, neither will they be reprieved.

verses.ar: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَٱنتَظِرْ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ
verses.en: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.
verses.tr: fa-aʿriḍ ʿanhum wāntaẓir ʾinnahum mmuntaẓirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet], turn away from them and wait: they too are waiting.
verses.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), and await (the event). Lo! they (also) are awaiting (it).

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.en: O Prophet, fear Allāh and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu āttaqi Allāh walā tuṭiʿi al-kāfirīna wa-l-munāfiqīna ۗ ʾinna Allāh kāna ʿalīman ḥakīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, be mindful of God and do not give in to the disbelievers and the hypocrites: God is all knowing, all wise.
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Keep thy duty to Allah and obey not the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
verses.en: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.
verses.tr: wāttabiʿ mā yūḥā ʾilayka min rrabbika ۚ ʾinna Allāh kāna bimā taʿmalūna khabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Follow what your Lord reveals to you: God is well aware of all your actions.
verses.pickthall: And follow that which is inspired in thee from thy Lord. Lo! Allah is Aware of what ye do.

verses.ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
verses.en: And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
verses.tr: watawakkal ʿalā Allāh ۚ wakafā billāh wakīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Put your trust in God: God is enough to trust.
verses.pickthall: And put thy trust in Allah, for Allah is sufficient as Trustee.

verses.ar: مَّا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِّن قَلْبَيْنِ فِى جَوْفِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَٰجَكُمُ ٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى تُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَآءَكُمْ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُم بِأَفْوَٰهِكُمْ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَقُولُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِى ٱلسَّبِيلَ
verses.en: Allāh has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. And He has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful your mothers. And He has not made your claimed [i.e., adopted] sons your [true] sons. That is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but Allāh says the truth, and He guides to the [right] way.
verses.tr: mmā jaʿala Allāh lirajulin mmin qalbayni fā jawfihi ۚ wamā jaʿala ʾazwājakumu al-ā tuẓāhirūna minhunna ʾummahātikum ۚ wamā jaʿala ʾadʿiyāʾakum ʾabnāʾakum ۚ dhālikum qawlukum biʾafwāhikum ۖ wallāh yaqūlu al-ḥaqqa wahuwa yahdā as-sabīla
verses.abdelhaleem: God does not put two hearts within a man’s breast. He does not turn the wives you reject and liken to your mothers’ backs into your real mothers; nor does He make your adopted sons into real sons. These are only words from your mouths, while God speaks the truth and guides people to the right path.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath not assigned unto any man two hearts within his body, nor hath He made your wives whom ye declare (to be your mothers) your mothers, nor hath He made those whom ye claim (to be your sons) your sons. This is but a saying of your mouths. But Allah saith the truth and He showeth the way.

verses.ar: ٱدْعُوهُمْ لِـَٔابَآئِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمْ ۚ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَآ أَخْطَأْتُم بِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.en: Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allāh. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: ādʿūhum lābāʾihim huwa ʾaqsaṭu ʿinda Allāh ۚ fa-in llam taʿlamūā ābāʾahum fa-ikhwānukum fā ad-dīni wamawālīkum ۚ walaysa ʿalaykum junāḥun fīmā ʾakhṭaʾtum bihi walākin mmā taʿammadat qulūbukum ۚ wakāna Allāh ghafūran rraḥīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Name your adopted sons after their real fathers: this is more equitable in God’s eyes––if you do not know who their fathers are [they are your] ‘brothers-in-religion’ and proteges. You will not be blamed if you make a mistake, only for what your hearts deliberately intend; God is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: Proclaim their real parentage. That will be more equitable in the sight of Allah. And if ye know not their fathers, then (they are) your brethren in the faith, and your clients. And there is no sin for you in the mistakes that ye make unintentionally, but what your hearts purpose (that will be a sin for you). Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: ٱلنَّبِىُّ أَوْلَىٰ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُۥٓ أُمَّهَـٰتُهُمْ ۗ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ إِلَّآ أَن تَفْعَلُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآئِكُم مَّعْرُوفًا ۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَسْطُورًا
verses.en: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book inscribed.
verses.tr: an-nabāu ʾawlā bi-l-muʾminīna min ʾanfusihim ۖ wa-azwājuhu ʾummahātuhum ۗ wa-ūlūā al-ʾarḥāmi baʿḍuhum ʾawlā bibaʿḍin fā kitābi Allāh mina al-muʾminīna wa-l-muhājirīna ʾillā ʾan tafʿalūā ʾilā ʾawliyāʾikum mmaʿrūfan ۚ kāna dhālika fā al-kitābi masṭūran
verses.abdelhaleem: The Prophet is more protective towards the believers than they are themselves, while his wives are their mothers. In God’s Scripture, blood-relatives have a stronger claim than other believers and emigrants, though you may still bestow gifts on your proteges. All this is written in the Scripture.
verses.pickthall: The Prophet is closer to the believers than their selves, and his wives are (as) their mothers. And the owners of kinship are closer one to another in the ordinance of Allah than (other) believers and the fugitives (who fled from Mecca), except that ye should do kindness to your friends. This is written in the Book (of nature).

verses.ar: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِيثَـٰقَهُمْ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٍ وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۖ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُم مِّيثَـٰقًا غَلِيظًا
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant
verses.tr: wa-idh ʾakhadhnā mina an-nabiyyina mīthāqahum waminka wamin nnūḥin wa-ibrāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā ābni maryama ۖ wa-akhadhnā minhum mmīthāqan ghalīẓan
verses.abdelhaleem: We took a solemn pledge from the prophets- from you [Muhammad], from Noah, from Abraham, from Moses, from Jesus, son of Mary- We took a solemn pledge from all of them:
verses.pickthall: And when We exacted a covenant from the prophets, and from thee (O Muhammad) and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus son of Mary. We took from them a solemn covenant;

verses.ar: لِّيَسْـَٔلَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ عَن صِدْقِهِمْ ۚ وَأَعَدَّ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.en: That He may question the truthful about their truth. And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment.
verses.tr: lliyasla aṣ-ṣādiqīna ʿan ṣidqihim ۚ wa-aʿadda lilkāfirīna ʿadhāban ʾalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: God will question [even] the truthful about their sincerity, and for those who reject the truth He has prepared a painful torment.
verses.pickthall: That He may ask the loyal of their loyalty. And He hath prepared a painful doom for the unfaithful.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَآءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
verses.en: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allāh upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ādhkurūā niʿmaha Allāh ʿalaykum ʾidh jāʾatkum junūdun fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan wajunūdan llam tarawhā ۚ wakāna Allāh bimā taʿmalūna baṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, remember God’s goodness to you when mighty armies massed against you: We sent a violent wind and invisible forces against them. God sees all that you do.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Remember Allah's favour unto you when there came against you hosts, and We sent against them a great wind and hosts ye could not see. And Allah is ever Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: إِذْ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ وَبَلَغَتِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلظُّنُونَا۠
verses.en: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats, and you assumed about Allāh [various] assumptions.
verses.tr: ʾidh jāʾūkum mmin fawqikum wamin ʾasfala minkum wa-idh zāghati al-ʾabṣāru wabalaghati al-qulūbu al-ḥanājira wataẓunnūna billāh aẓ-ẓunūnā
verses.abdelhaleem: They massed against you from above and below; your eyes rolled [with fear], your hearts rose into your throats, and you thought [ill] thoughts of God.
verses.pickthall: When they came upon you from above you and from below you, and when eyes grew wild and hearts reached to the throats, and ye were imagining vain thoughts concerning Allah.

verses.ar: هُنَالِكَ ٱبْتُلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا۟ زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا
verses.en: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.
verses.tr: hunālika ābtulāa al-muʾminūna wazulzilūā zilzālan shadīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: There the believers were sorely tested and deeply shaken:
verses.pickthall: There were the believers sorely tried, and shaken with a mighty shock.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verses.en: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allāh and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"
verses.tr: wa-idh yaqūlu al-munāfiqūna wa-adh-dhīna fā qulūbihim mmaraḍun mmā waʿadanā Allāh warasūluhu ʾillā ghurūran
verses.abdelhaleem: the hypocrites and the sick at heart said, ‘God and His Messenger promised us nothing but delusions!’
verses.pickthall: And when the hypocrites, and those in whose hearts is a disease, were saying: Allah and His messenger promised us naught but delusion.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ ۚ وَيَسْتَـْٔذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا هِىَ بِعَوْرَةٍ ۖ إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
verses.en: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are exposed [i.e., unprotected]," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee.
verses.tr: wa-idh qālat ṭṭāʾifahun mminhum yāʾahla yathriba lā muqāma lakum fārjiʿūā ۚ wayastadhinu farīqun mminhumu an-nabāa yaqūlūna ʾinna buyūtanā ʿawrahun wamā hāa biʿawrahin ۖ ʾin yurīdūna ʾillā firāran
verses.abdelhaleem: Some of them said, ‘People of Yathrib, you will not be able to withstand [the attack], so go back!’ Some of them asked the Prophet’s permission to leave, saying, ‘Our houses are exposed,’ even though they were not- they just wanted to run away:
verses.pickthall: And when a party of them said: O folk of Yathrib! There is no stand (possible) for you, therefor turn back. And certain of them (even) sought permission of the Prophet, saying: Our homes lie open (to the enemy). And they lay not open. They but wished to flee.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا۟ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ لَـَٔاتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا۟ بِهَآ إِلَّا يَسِيرًا
verses.en: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah [i.e., disbelief] had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly.
verses.tr: walaw dukhilat ʿalayhim mmin ʾaqṭārihā thumma suʾilūā al-fitnaha lātawhā wamā talabbathūā bihā ʾillā yasīran
verses.abdelhaleem: had the city been invaded from all sides, and the enemy invited them to rebel, they would have done so almost without hesitation.
verses.pickthall: If the enemy had entered from all sides and they had been exhorted to treachery, they would have committed it, and would have hesitated thereupon but little.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ عَـٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ ٱلْأَدْبَـٰرَ ۚ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ ٱللَّهِ مَسْـُٔولًا
verses.en: And they had already promised Allāh before not to turn their backs [i.e., flee]. And ever is the promise to Allāh [that about which one will be] questioned.
verses.tr: walaqad kānūā ʿāhadūā Allāh min qablu lā yuwallūna al-ʾadbāra ۚ wakāna ʿahdu Allāh maswlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet they had already promised God that they would not turn tail and flee, and a promise to God will be answered for.
verses.pickthall: And verily they had already sworn unto Allah that they would not turn their backs (to the foe). An oath to Allah must be answered for.

verses.ar: قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْفِرَارُ إِن فَرَرْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ أَوِ ٱلْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لَّا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then [if you did], you would not be given enjoyment [of life] except for a little."
verses.tr: qul llan yanfaʿakumu al-firāru ʾin farartum mmina al-mawti ʾawi al-qatli wa-idhan llā tumattaʿūna ʾillā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say, ‘Running away will not benefit you. If you manage to escape death or slaughter, you will only be permitted to enjoy [life] for a short while.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Flight will not avail you if ye flee from death or killing, and then ye dwell in comfort but a little while.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَعْصِمُكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً ۚ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
verses.en: Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allāh if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" And they will not find for themselves besides Allāh any protector or any helper.
verses.tr: qul man dhā adh-dhā yaʿṣimukum mmina Allāh ʾin ʾarāda bikum sūʾan ʾaw ʾarāda bikum raḥmahan ۚ walā yajidūna lahum mmin dūni Allāh waliyyan walā naṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘If God wishes to harm you, who can protect you? If God wishes to show you mercy, who can prevent Him?’ They will find no one but God to protect or help them.
verses.pickthall: Say: Who is he who can preserve you from Allah if He intendeth harm for you, or intendeth mercy for you. They will not find that they have any friend or helper other than Allah.

verses.ar: ۞ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلْقَآئِلِينَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا ۖ وَلَا يَأْتُونَ ٱلْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: Already Allāh knows the hinderers among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "Come to us," and do not go to battle, except for a few,
verses.tr: ۞ qad yaʿlamu Allāh al-muʿawwiqīna minkum wa-l-qāʾilīna liʾikhwānihim halumma ʾilaynā ۖ walā yaʾtūna al-baʾsa ʾillā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: God knows exactly who among you hinder others, who [secretly] say to their brothers, ‘Come and join us,’ who hardly ever come out to fight,
verses.pickthall: Allah already knoweth those of you who hinder, and those who say unto their brethren: "Come ye hither unto us!" and they come not to the stress of battle save a little,

verses.ar: أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ ٱلْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَٱلَّذِى يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ ٱلْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى ٱلْخَيْرِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَأَحْبَطَ ٱللَّهُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
verses.en: Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allāh has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.
verses.tr: ʾashiḥḥahan ʿalaykum ۖ fa-idhā jāʾa al-khawfu raʾaytahum yanẓurūna ʾilayka tadūru ʾaʿyunuhum ka-adh-dhā yughshā ʿalayhi mina al-mawti ۖ fa-idhā dhahaba al-khawfu salaqūkum bi-ʾalsinahin ḥidādin ʾashiḥḥahan ʿalā al-khayri ۚ ʾūlāʾika lam yuʾminūā fa-aḥbaṭa Allāh ʾaʿmālahum ۚ wakāna dhālika ʿalā Allāh yasīran
verses.abdelhaleem: who begrudge you [believers] any help. When fear comes, you [Prophet] see them looking at you with eyes rolling like someone in their death throes; when fear has passed, they attack you with sharp tongues and begrudge you any good. Such men do not believe, and God brings their deeds to nothing- that is all too easy for God.
verses.pickthall: Being sparing of their help to you (believers). But when the fear cometh, then thou (Muhammad) seest them regarding thee with rolling eyes like one who fainteth unto death. Then, when the fear departeth, they scald you with sharp tongues in their greed for wealth (from the spoil). Such have not believed. Therefor Allah maketh their deeds fruitless. And that is easy for Allah.

verses.ar: يَحْسَبُونَ ٱلْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ ۖ وَإِن يَأْتِ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِى ٱلْأَعْرَابِ يَسْـَٔلُونَ عَنْ أَنۢبَآئِكُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ فِيكُم مَّا قَـٰتَلُوٓا۟ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little.
verses.tr: yaḥsabūna al-ʾaḥzāba lam yadhhabūā ۖ wa-in yaʾti al-ʾaḥzābu yawaddūā law ʾannahum bādūna fā al-ʾaʿrābi yaslūna ʿan ʾanbāʾikum ۖ walaw kānūā fīkum mmā qātalūā ʾillā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: They think the joint forces have not gone, and if the joint forces did come again they would wish they were in the desert, wandering among the Bedouin and seeking news about you [from a safe distance]. Even if they were with you [believers], they would hardly fight at all.
verses.pickthall: They hold that the clans have not retired (for good); and if the clans should advance (again), they would fain be in the desert with the wandering Arabs, asking for the news of you; and if they were among you, they would not give battle, save a little.

verses.ar: لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا
verses.en: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allāh an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allāh often.
verses.tr: llaqad kāna lakum fā rasūli Allāh ʾuswahun ḥasanahun lliman kāna yarjūā Allāh wa-l-yawma al-ākhira wadhakara Allāh kathīran
verses.abdelhaleem: The Messenger of God is an excellent model for those of you who put your hope in God and the Last Day and remember Him often.
verses.pickthall: Verily in the messenger of Allah ye have a good example for him who looketh unto Allah and the Last Day, and remembereth Allah much.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْأَحْزَابَ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ وَصَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ وَمَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّآ إِيمَـٰنًا وَتَسْلِيمًا
verses.en: And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allāh and His Messenger had promised us, and Allāh and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance.
verses.tr: walammā raā al-muʾminūna al-ʾaḥzāba qālūā hādhā mā waʿadanā Allāh warasūluhu waṣadaqa Allāh warasūluhu ۚ wamā zādahum ʾillā ʾīmānan wataslīman
verses.abdelhaleem: When the believers saw the joint forces, they said, ‘This is what God and His Messenger promised us: the promise of God and His Messenger is true,’ and this only served to increase their faith and submission to God.
verses.pickthall: And when the true believers saw the clans, they said: This is that which Allah and His messenger promised us. Allah and His messenger are true. It did but confirm them in their faith and resignation.

verses.ar: مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا۟ مَا عَـٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُۥ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنتَظِرُ ۖ وَمَا بَدَّلُوا۟ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.en: Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allāh. Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow [to the death], and among them is he who awaits [his chance]. And they did not alter [the terms of their commitment] by any alteration -
verses.tr: mmina al-muʾminīna rijālun ṣadaqūā mā ʿāhadūā Allāh ʿalayhi ۖ faminhum mman qaḍā naḥbahu waminhum mman yantaẓiru ۖ wamā baddalūā tabdīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: There are men among the believers who honoured their pledge to God: some of them have fulfilled it by death, and some are still waiting. They have not changed in the least.
verses.pickthall: Of the believers are men who are true to that which they covenanted with Allah. Some of them have paid their vow by death (in battle), and some of them still are waiting; and they have not altered in the least;

verses.ar: لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ إِن شَآءَ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.en: That Allāh may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if He wills or accept their repentance. Indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: lliyajzāa Allāh aṣ-ṣādiqīna biṣidqihim wayuʿadhiba al-munāfiqīna ʾin shāʾa ʾaw yatūba ʿalayhim ۚ ʾinna Allāh kāna ghafūran rraḥīman
verses.abdelhaleem: [Such trials are ordained] so that God may reward the truthful for their honesty and punish the hypocrites, if He so wills, or He may relent towards them, for God is forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: That Allah may reward the true men for their truth, and punish the hypocrites if He will, or relent toward them (if He will). Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَرَدَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوا۟ خَيْرًا ۚ وَكَفَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلْقِتَالَ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًا
verses.en: And Allāh repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allāh for the believers in battle, and ever is Allāh Powerful and Exalted in Might.
verses.tr: waradda Allāh adh-dhīna kafarūā bighayẓihim lam yanālūā khayran ۚ wakafā Allāh al-muʾminīna al-qitāla ۚ wakāna Allāh qawiyyan ʿazīzan
verses.abdelhaleem: God sent back the disbelievers along with their rage- they gained no benefit–– and spared the believers from fighting. He is strong and mighty.
verses.pickthall: And Allah repulsed the disbelievers in their wrath; they gained no good. Allah averted their attack from the believers. Allah is ever Strong, Mighty.

verses.ar: وَأَنزَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَـٰهَرُوهُم مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعْبَ فَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًا
verses.en: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party [i.e., their men] you killed, and you took captive a party [i.e., the women and children].
verses.tr: wa-anzala adh-dhīna ẓāharūhum mmin ʾahli al-kitābi min ṣayāṣīhim waqadhafa fā qulūbihimu ar-ruʿba farīqan taqtulūna wataʾsirūna farīqan
verses.abdelhaleem: He brought those People of the Book who supported them down from their strongholds and put panic into their hearts. Some of them you [believers] killed and some you took captive.
verses.pickthall: And He brought those of the People of the Scripture who supported them down from their strongholds, and cast panic into their hearts. Some ye slew, and ye made captive some.

verses.ar: وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَـٰرَهُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَّمْ تَطَـُٔوهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرًا
verses.en: And He caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden. And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.
verses.tr: wa-awrathakum ʾarḍahum wadiyārahum wa-amwālahum wa-arḍan llam taṭawhā ۚ wakāna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīran
verses.abdelhaleem: He passed on to you their land, their houses, their possessions, and a land where you had not set foot: God has power over everything.
verses.pickthall: And He caused you to inherit their land and their houses and their wealth, and land ye have not trodden. Allah is ever Able to do all things.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَٰجِكَ إِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا
verses.en: O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu qul lliʾazwājika ʾin kuntunna turidna al-ḥayawāha ad-dunyā wazīnatahā fataʿālayna ʾumattiʿkunna wa-usarriḥkunna sarāḥan jamīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, say to your wives,‘If your desire is for the present life and its finery, then come, I will make provision for you and release you with kindness,
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Say unto thy wives: If ye desire the world's life and its adornment, come! I will content you and will release you with a fair release.

verses.ar: وَإِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَٱلدَّارَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَـٰتِ مِنكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.en: But if you should desire Allāh and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allāh has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward."
verses.tr: wa-in kuntunna turidna Allāh warasūlahu wa-ad-dāra al-ākhiraha fa-inna Allāh ʾaʿadda lilmuḥsināti minkunna ʾajran ʿaẓīman
verses.abdelhaleem: but if you desire God, His Messenger, and the Final Home, then remember that God has prepared great rewards for those of you who do good.’
verses.pickthall: But if ye desire Allah and His messenger and the abode of the Hereafter, then lo! Allah hath prepared for the good among you an immense reward.

verses.ar: يَـٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ مَن يَأْتِ مِنكُنَّ بِفَـٰحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهَا ٱلْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
verses.en: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.
verses.tr: yānisāʾa an-nabāi man yaʾti minkunna bifāḥishahin mmubayyinahin yuḍāʿaf lahā al-ʿadhābu ḍiʿfayni ۚ wakāna dhālika ʿalā Allāh yasīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Wives of the Prophet, if any of you does something clearly outrageous, she will be doubly punished- that is easy for God-
verses.pickthall: O ye wives of the Prophet! Whosoever of you committeth manifest lewdness, the punishment for her will be doubled, and that is easy for Allah.

verses.ar: ۞ وَمَن يَقْنُتْ مِنكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا نُّؤْتِهَآ أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًا كَرِيمًا
verses.en: And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allāh and His Messenger and does righteousness - We will give her her reward twice; and We have prepared for her a noble provision.
verses.tr: ۞ waman yaqnut minkunna lillāh warasūlihi wataʿmal ṣāliḥan nnuʾtihā ʾajrahā marratayni wa-aʿtadnā lahā rizqan karīman
verses.abdelhaleem: but if any of you is obedient to God and His Messenger and does good deeds, know that We shall give her a double reward and have prepared a generous provision for her.
verses.pickthall: And whosoever of you is submissive unto Allah and His messenger and doeth right, We shall give her her reward twice over, and We have prepared for her a rich provision.

verses.ar: يَـٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۚ إِنِ ٱتَّقَيْتُنَّ فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ ٱلَّذِى فِى قَلْبِهِۦ مَرَضٌ وَقُلْنَ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا
verses.en: O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women. If you fear Allāh, then do not be soft in speech [to men], lest he in whose heart is disease should covet, but speak with appropriate speech.
verses.tr: yānisāʾa an-nabāi lastunna kaʾaḥadin mmina an-nisāʾi ۚ ʾini āttaqaytunna falā takhḍaʿna bi-l-qawli fayaṭmaʿa adh-dhā fā qalbihi maraḍun waqulna qawlan mmaʿrūfan
verses.abdelhaleem: Wives of the Prophet, you are not like any other woman. If you are truly mindful of God, do not speak too softly in case the sick at heart should lust after you, but speak in an appropriate manner;
verses.pickthall: O ye wives of the Prophet! Ye are not like any other women. If ye keep your duty (to Allah), then be not soft of speech, lest he in whose heart is a disease aspire (to you), but utter customary speech.

verses.ar: وَقَرْنَ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَأَقِمْنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتِينَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِعْنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا
verses.en: And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. Allāh intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification.
verses.tr: waqarna fā buyūtikunna walā tabarrajna tabarruja al-jāhiliyyahi al-ʾūlā ۖ wa-aqimna aṣ-ṣalawāha watīna az-zakawāha wa-aṭiʿna Allāh warasūlahu ۚ ʾinnamā yurīdu Allāh liyudhhiba ʿankumu ar-rijsa ʾahla al-bayti wayuṭahhirakum taṭhīran
verses.abdelhaleem: stay at home, and do not flaunt your finery as they used to in the pagan past; keep up the prayer, give the prescribed alms, and obey God and His Messenger. God wishes to keep uncleanness away from you, people of the [Prophet’s] House, and to purify you thoroughly.
verses.pickthall: And stay in your houses. Bedizen not yourselves with the bedizenment of the Time of Ignorance. Be regular in prayer, and pay the poor-due, and obey Allah and His messenger. Allah's wish is but to remove uncleanness far from you, O Folk of the Household, and cleanse you with a thorough cleansing.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَىٰ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْحِكْمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا
verses.en: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allāh and wisdom. Indeed, Allāh is ever Subtle and Aware.
verses.tr: wādhkurna mā yutlā fā buyūtikunna min āyāti Allāh wa-l-ḥikmahi ۚ ʾinna Allāh kāna laṭīfan khabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember what is recited in your houses of God’s revelations and wisdom, for God is all subtle, all aware.
verses.pickthall: And bear in mind that which is recited in your houses of the revelations of Allah and wisdom. Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَٱلْمُسْلِمَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتَـٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقَـٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرَٰتِ وَٱلْخَـٰشِعِينَ وَٱلْخَـٰشِعَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُتَصَدِّقَـٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰٓئِمِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰٓئِمَـٰتِ وَٱلْحَـٰفِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَٱلْحَـٰفِظَـٰتِ وَٱلذَّٰكِرِينَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱلذَّٰكِرَٰتِ أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.en: Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember Allāh often and the women who do so - for them Allāh has prepared forgiveness and a great reward.
verses.tr: ʾinna al-muslimīna wa-l-muslimāti wa-l-muʾminīna wa-l-muʾmināti wa-l-qānitīna wa-l-qānitāti wa-aṣ-ṣādiqīna wa-aṣ-ṣādiqāti wa-aṣ-ṣābirīna wa-aṣ-ṣābirāti wa-l-khāshiʿīna wa-l-khāshiʿāti wa-l-mutaṣaddiqīna wa-l-mutaṣaddiqāti wa-aṣ-ṣāʾimīna wa-aṣ-ṣāʾimāti wa-l-ḥāfiẓīna furūjahum wa-l-ḥāfiẓāti wa-adh-dhākirīna Allāh kathīran wa-adh-dhākirāti ʾaʿadda Allāh lahum mmaghfirahan wa-ajran ʿaẓīman
verses.abdelhaleem: For men and women who are devoted to God- believing men and women, obedient men and women, truthful men and women, steadfast men and women, humble men and women, charitable men and women, fasting men and women, chaste men and women, men and women who remember God often- God has prepared forgiveness and a rich reward.
verses.pickthall: Lo! men who surrender unto Allah, and women who surrender, and men who believe and women who believe, and men who obey and women who obey, and men who speak the truth and women who speak the truth, and men who persevere (in righteousness) and women who persevere, and men who are humble and women who are humble, and men who give alms and women who give alms, and men who fast and women who fast, and men who guard their modesty and women who guard (their modesty), and men who remember Allah much and women who remember - Allah hath prepared for them forgiveness and a vast reward.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ أَمْرًا أَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ ٱلْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ ۗ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَـٰلًا مُّبِينًا
verses.en: It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allāh and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.
verses.tr: wamā kāna limuʾminin walā muʾminahin ʾidhā qaḍā Allāh warasūluhu ʾamran ʾan yakūna lahumu al-khiyarahu min ʾamrihim ۗ waman yaʿṣi Allāh warasūlahu faqad ḍalla ḍalālan mmubīnan
verses.abdelhaleem: When God and His Messenger have decided on a matter that concerns them, it is not fitting for any believing man or woman to claim freedom of choice in that matter: whoever disobeys God and His Messenger is far astray.
verses.pickthall: And it becometh not a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His messenger have decided an affair (for them), that they should (after that) claim any say in their affair; and whoso is rebellious to Allah and His messenger, he verily goeth astray in error manifest.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا
verses.en: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished.
verses.tr: wa-idh taqūlu lilladhā ʾanʿama Allāh ʿalayhi wa-anʿamta ʿalayhi ʾamsik ʿalayka zawjaka wāttaqi Allāh watukhfā fā nafsika mā Allāh mubdīhi watakhshā an-nāsa wallāh ʾaḥaqqu ʾan takhshāhu ۖ falammā qaḍā zaydun mminhā waṭaran zawwajnākahā likā lā yakūna ʿalā al-muʾminīna ḥarajun fā ʾazwāji ʾadʿiyāʾihim ʾidhā qaḍawā minhunna waṭaran ۚ wakāna ʾamru Allāh mafʿūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: When you [Prophet] said to the man who had been favoured by God and by you, ‘Keep your wife and be mindful of God,’ you hid in your heart what God would later reveal: you were afraid of people, but it is more fitting that you fear God. When Zayd no longer wanted her, We gave her to you in marriage so that there might be no fault in believers marrying the wives of their adopted sons after they no longer wanted them. God’s command must be carried out:
verses.pickthall: And when thou saidst unto him on whom Allah hath conferred favour and thou hast conferred favour: Keep thy wife to thyself, and fear Allah. And thou didst hide in thy mind that which Allah was to bring to light, and thou didst fear mankind whereas Allah hath a better right that thou shouldst fear Him. So when Zeyd had performed that necessary formality (of divorce) from her, We gave her unto thee in marriage, so that (henceforth) there may be no sin for believers in respect of wives of their adopted sons, when the latter have performed the necessary formality (of release) from them. The commandment of Allah must be fulfilled.

verses.ar: مَّا كَانَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ ۖ سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قَدَرًا مَّقْدُورًا
verses.en: There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allāh has imposed upon him. [This is] the established way of Allāh with those [prophets] who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allāh a destiny decreed.
verses.tr: mmā kāna ʿalā an-nabāi min ḥarajin fīmā faraḍa Allāh lahu ۖ sunnaha Allāh fā adh-dhīna khalawā min qablu ۚ wakāna ʾamru Allāh qadaran mmaqdūran
verses.abdelhaleem: the Prophet is not at fault for what God has ordained for him. This was God’s practice with those who went before- God’s command must be fulfilled-
verses.pickthall: There is no reproach for the Prophet in that which Allah maketh his due. That was Allah's way with those who passed away of old - and the commandment of Allah is certain destiny -

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُۥ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبًا
verses.en: [Allāh praises] those who convey the messages of Allāh and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Accountant.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yuballighūna risālāti Allāh wayakhshawnahu walā yakhshawna ʾaḥadan ʾillā Allāh ۗ wakafā billāh ḥasīban
verses.abdelhaleem: [and with all] those who deliver God’s messages and fear only Him and no other: God’s reckoning is enough.
verses.pickthall: Who delivered the messages of Allah and feared Him, and feared none save Allah. Allah keepeth good account.

verses.ar: مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَآ أَحَدٍ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن رَّسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا
verses.en: Muḥammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allāh and seal [i.e., last] of the prophets. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.
verses.tr: mmā kāna muḥammadun ʾabā ʾaḥadin mmin rrijālikum walākin rrasūla Allāh wakhātama an-nabiyyina ۗ wakāna Allāh bikulli shāʾin ʿalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Muhammad is not the father of any one of you men; he is God’s Messenger and the seal of the prophets: God knows everything.
verses.pickthall: Muhammad is not the father of any man among you, but he is the messenger of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets; and Allah is ever Aware of all things.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا
verses.en: O you who have believed, remember Allāh with much remembrance
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ādhkurūā Allāh dhikran kathīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, remember God often
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Remember Allah with much remembrance.

verses.ar: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.en: And exalt Him morning and afternoon.
verses.tr: wasabbiḥūhu bukrahan wa-aṣīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: and glorify Him morning and evening:
verses.pickthall: And glorify Him early and late.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَلِّى عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتُهُۥ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَكَانَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا
verses.en: It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā yuṣallā ʿalaykum wamalāʾikatuhu liyukhrijakum mmina aẓ-ẓulumāti ʾilā an-nūri ۚ wakāna bi-l-muʾminīna raḥīman
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who blesses you, as do His angels, in order to lead you out of the depths of darkness into the light. He is ever merciful towards the believers-
verses.pickthall: He it is Who blesseth you, and His angels (bless you), that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and He is ever Merciful to the believers.

verses.ar: تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُۥ سَلَـٰمٌ ۚ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَرِيمًا
verses.en: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward.
verses.tr: taḥiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salāmun ۚ wa-aʿadda lahum ʾajran karīman
verses.abdelhaleem: when they meet Him they will be greeted with ‘Peace’- and He has prepared a generous reward for them.
verses.pickthall: Their salutation on the day when they shall meet Him will be: Peace. And He hath prepared for them a goodly recompense.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ شَـٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
verses.en: O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu ʾinnā ʾarsalnāka shāhidan wamubashiran wanadhīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, We have sent you as a witness, as a bearer of good news and warning,
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Lo! We have sent thee as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

verses.ar: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى ٱللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِۦ وَسِرَاجًا مُّنِيرًا
verses.en: And one who invites to Allāh, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp.
verses.tr: wadāʿiyan ʾilā Allāh biʾidhnihi wasirājan mmunīran
verses.abdelhaleem: as one who calls people to God by His leave, as a light-giving lamp.
verses.pickthall: And as a summoner unto Allah by His permission, and as a lamp that giveth light.

verses.ar: وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allāh great bounty.
verses.tr: wabashiri al-muʾminīna biʾanna lahum mmina Allāh faḍlan kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Give the believers the good news that great bounty awaits them from God.
verses.pickthall: And announce unto the believers the good tidings that they will have great bounty from Allah.

verses.ar: وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَدَعْ أَذَىٰهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
verses.en: And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites and disregard their annoyance, and rely upon Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
verses.tr: walā tuṭiʿi al-kāfirīna wa-l-munāfiqīna wadaʿ ʾadhāhum watawakkal ʿalā Allāh ۚ wakafā billāh wakīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not give in to the disbelievers and the hypocrites: ignore the harm they cause you and put your trust in God. God is enough to trust.
verses.pickthall: And incline not to the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Disregard their noxious talk, and put thy trust in Allah. Allah is sufficient as Trustee.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا ۖ فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا
verses.en: O you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them [i.e., consummated the marriage], then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾidhā nakaḥtumu al-muʾmināti thumma ṭallaqtumūhunna min qabli ʾan tamassūhunna famā lakum ʿalayhinna min ʿiddahin taʿtaddūnahā ۖ famattiʿūhunna wasarriḥūhunna sarāḥan jamīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, you have no right to expect a waiting period when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them: make provision for them and release them in an honourable way.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! If ye wed believing women and divorce them before ye have touched them, then there is no period that ye should reckon. But content them and release them handsomely.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِنَّآ أَحْلَلْنَا لَكَ أَزْوَٰجَكَ ٱلَّـٰتِىٓ ءَاتَيْتَ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ مِمَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمَّـٰتِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَـٰلَـٰتِكَ ٱلَّـٰتِى هَاجَرْنَ مَعَكَ وَٱمْرَأَةً مُّؤْمِنَةً إِن وَهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلنَّبِىِّ إِنْ أَرَادَ ٱلنَّبِىُّ أَن يَسْتَنكِحَهَا خَالِصَةً لَّكَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۗ قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا فَرَضْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ لِكَيْلَا يَكُونَ عَلَيْكَ حَرَجٌ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.en: O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation and those your right hand possesses from what Allāh has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the Prophet [and] if the Prophet wishes to marry her; [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. We certainly know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort [i.e., difficulty]. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu ʾinnā ʾaḥlalnā laka ʾazwājaka at-tā ātayta ʾujūrahunna wamā malakat yamīnuka mimmā ʾafāʾa Allāh ʿalayka wabanāti ʿammika wabanāti ʿammātika wabanāti khālika wabanāti khālātika at-tā hājarna maʿaka wāmraʾahan mmuʾminahan ʾin wahabat nafsahā lilnnabāi ʾin ʾarāda an-nabāu ʾan yastankiḥahā khāliṣahan llaka min dūni al-muʾminīna ۗ qad ʿalimnā mā faraḍnā ʿalayhim fā ʾazwājihim wamā malakat ʾaymānuhum likaylā yakūna ʿalayka ḥarajun ۗ wakāna Allāh ghafūran rraḥīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, We have made lawful for you the wives whose bride gift you have paid, and any slaves God has assigned to you through war, and the daughters of your uncles and aunts on your father’s and mother’s sides, who migrated with you. Also any believing woman who has offered herself to the Prophet and whom the Prophet wishes to wed- this is only for you [Prophet] and not the rest of the believers: We know exactly what We have made obligatory for them concerning their wives and slave-girls- so you should not be blamed: God is most forgiving, most merciful.
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Lo! We have made lawful unto thee thy wives unto whom thou hast paid their dowries, and those whom thy right hand possesseth of those whom Allah hath given thee as spoils of war, and the daughters of thine uncle on the father's side and the daughters of thine aunts on the father's side, and the daughters of thine uncle on the mother's side and the daughters of thine aunts on the mother's side who emigrated with thee, and a believing woman if she give herself unto the Prophet and the Prophet desire to ask her in marriage - a privilege for thee only, not for the (rest of) believers - We are Aware of that which We enjoined upon them concerning their wives and those whom their right hands possess - that thou mayst be free from blame, for Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: ۞ تُرْجِى مَن تَشَآءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُـْٔوِىٓ إِلَيْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن تَقَرَّ أَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمًا
verses.en: You, [O Muḥammad], may put aside whom you will of them or take to yourself whom you will. And any that you desire of those [wives] from whom you had [temporarily] separated - there is no blame upon you [in returning her]. That is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them. And Allāh knows what is in your hearts. And ever is Allāh Knowing and Forbearing.
verses.tr: ۞ turjā man tashāʾu minhunna watuwā ʾilayka man tashāʾu ۖ wamani ābtaghayta mimman ʿazalta falā junāḥa ʿalayka ۚ dhālika ʾadnā ʾan taqarra ʾaʿyunuhunna walā yaḥzanna wayarḍayna bimā ātaytahunna kulluhunna ۚ wallāh yaʿlamu mā fā qulūbikum ۚ wakāna Allāh ʿalīman ḥalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: You may make any of [your women] wait and receive any of them as you wish, but you will not be at fault if you invite one whose turn you have previously set aside: this way it is more likely that they will be satisfied and will not be distressed and will all be content with what you have given them. God knows what is in your hearts: God is all knowing, forbearing.
verses.pickthall: Thou canst defer whom thou wilt of them and receive unto thee whom thou wilt, and whomsoever thou desirest of those whom thou hast set aside (temporarily), it is no sin for thee (to receive her again); that is better; that they may be comforted and not grieve, and may all be pleased with what thou givest them. Allah knoweth what is in your hearts (O men), and Allah is ever Forgiving, Clement.

verses.ar: لَّا يَحِلُّ لَكَ ٱلنِّسَآءُ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَلَآ أَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ رَّقِيبًا
verses.en: Not lawful to you, [O Muḥammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. And ever is Allāh, over all things, an Observer.
verses.tr: llā yaḥillu laka an-nisāʾu min baʿdu walā ʾan tabaddala bihinna min ʾazwājin walaw ʾaʿjabaka ḥusnuhunna ʾillā mā malakat yamīnuka ۗ wakāna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin rraqīban
verses.abdelhaleem: You [Prophet] are not permitted to take any further wives, nor to exchange the wives you have for others, even if these attract you with their beauty. But this does not apply to your slave-girls: God is watchful over all.
verses.pickthall: It is not allowed thee to take (other) women henceforth, nor that thou shouldst change them for other wives even though their beauty pleased thee, save those whom thy right hand possesseth. And Allah is ever Watcher over all things.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَـٰظِرِينَ إِنَىٰهُ وَلَـٰكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوا۟ فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ وَلَا مُسْتَـْٔنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِى ٱلنَّبِىَّ فَيَسْتَحْىِۦ مِنكُمْ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحْىِۦ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَـٰعًا فَسْـَٔلُوهُنَّ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُؤْذُوا۟ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَن تَنكِحُوٓا۟ أَزْوَٰجَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمًا
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. But when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. Indeed, that [behavior] was troubling the Prophet, and he is shy of [dismissing] you. But Allāh is not shy of the truth. And when you ask [his wives] for something, ask them from behind a partition. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts. And it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the Messenger of Allāh or to marry his wives after him, ever. Indeed, that would be in the sight of Allāh an enormity.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā tadkhulūā buyūta an-nabāi ʾillā ʾan yuʾdhana lakum ʾilā ṭaʿāmin ghayra nāẓirīna ʾināhu walākin ʾidhā duʿītum fādkhulūā fa-idhā ṭaʿimtum fāntashirūā walā mustanisīna liḥadīthin ۚ ʾinna dhālikum kāna yuʾdhā an-nabāa fayastaḥāi minkum ۖ wallāh lā yastaḥāi mina al-ḥaqqi ۚ wa-idhā saʾaltumūhunna matāʿan faslūhunna min warāʾi ḥijābin ۚ dhālikum ʾaṭharu liqulūbikum waqulūbihinna ۚ wamā kāna lakum ʾan tuʾdhūā rasūla Allāh walā ʾan tankiḥūā ʾazwājahu min baʿdihi ʾabadan ۚ ʾinna dhālikum kāna ʿinda Allāh ʿaẓīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, do not enter the Prophet’s apartments for a meal unless you are given permission to do so; do not linger until [a meal] is ready. When you are invited, go in; then, when you have taken your meal, leave. Do not stay on and talk, for that would offend the Prophet, though he would shrink from asking you to leave. God does not shrink from the truth. When you ask his wives for something, do so from behind a screen: this is purer both for your hearts and for theirs. It is not right for you to offend God’s Messenger, just as you should never marry his wives after him: that would be grievous in God’s eyes.
verses.pickthall: O Ye who believe! Enter not the dwellings of the Prophet for a meal without waiting for the proper time, unless permission be granted you. But if ye are invited, enter, and, when your meal is ended, then disperse. Linger not for conversation. Lo! that would cause annoyance to the Prophet, and he would be shy of (asking) you (to go); but Allah is not shy of the truth. And when ye ask of them (the wives of the Prophet) anything, ask it of them from behind a curtain. That is purer for your hearts and for their hearts. And it is not for you to cause annoyance to the messenger of Allah, nor that ye should ever marry his wives after him. Lo! that in Allah's sight would be an enormity.

verses.ar: إِن تُبْدُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا
verses.en: Whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed Allāh is ever, of all things, Knowing.
verses.tr: ʾin tubdūā shayā ʾaw tukhfūhu fa-inna Allāh kāna bikulli shāʾin ʿalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: God has full knowledge of all things, whether you reveal them or not.
verses.pickthall: Whether ye divulge a thing or keep it hidden, lo! Allah is ever Knower of all things.

verses.ar: لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِىٓ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآءِ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآءِ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَآئِهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُنَّ ۗ وَٱتَّقِينَ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدًا
verses.en: There is no blame upon them [i.e., women] concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess [i.e., slaves]. And fear Allāh. Indeed Allāh is ever, over all things, Witness.
verses.tr: llā junāḥa ʿalayhinna fā ābāʾihinna walā ʾabnāʾihinna walā ʾikhwānihinna walā ʾabnāʾi ʾikhwānihinna walā ʾabnāʾi ʾakhawātihinna walā nisāʾihinna walā mā malakat ʾaymānuhunna ۗ wāttaqīna Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh kāna ʿalā kulli shāʾin shahīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: The Prophet’s wives are not to blame [if they are seen by] their fathers, their sons, their brothers, their brothers’ sons, their sisters’ sons, their women, or their slaves. [Wives of the Prophet], be mindful of God. God observes everything.
verses.pickthall: It is no sin for them (thy wives) to converse freely) with their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or the sons of their sisters or of their own women, or their slaves. O women! Keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is ever Witness over all things.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ ۚ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ صَلُّوا۟ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا۟ تَسْلِيمًا
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [Allāh to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allāh to grant him] peace.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh wamalāʾikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalā an-nabāi ۚ yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ṣallūā ʿalayhi wasallimūā taslīman
verses.abdelhaleem: God and His angels bless the Prophet- so, you who believe, bless him too and give him greetings of peace.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah and His angels shower blessings on the Prophet. O ye who believe! Ask blessings on him and salute him with a worthy salutation.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا
verses.en: Indeed, those who abuse Allāh and His Messenger - Allāh has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter and prepared for them a humiliating punishment.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yuʾdhūna Allāh warasūlahu laʿanahumu Allāh fā ad-dunyā wa-l-ākhirahi wa-aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban mmuhīnan
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who insult God and His Messenger will be rejected by God in this world and the next- He has prepared a humiliating torment for them-
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who malign Allah and His messenger, Allah hath cursed them in the world and the Hereafter, and hath prepared for them the doom of the disdained.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا ٱكْتَسَبُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱحْتَمَلُوا۟ بُهْتَـٰنًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا
