verses.en: And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned [i.e., deserved] have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yuʾdhūna al-muʾminīna wa-l-muʾmināti bighayri mā āktasabūā faqadi āḥtamalūā buhtānan wa-ithman mmubīnan
verses.abdelhaleem: and those who undeservedly insult believing men and women will bear the guilt of slander and flagrant sin.
verses.pickthall: And those who malign believing men and believing women undeservedly, they bear the guilt of slander and manifest sin.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَٰجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَآءِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِن جَلَـٰبِيبِهِنَّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن يُعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.en: O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments. That is more suitable that they will be known and not be abused. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu qul lliʾazwājika wabanātika wanisāʾi al-muʾminīna yudnīna ʿalayhinna min jalābībihinna ۚ dhālika ʾadnā ʾan yuʿrafna falā yuʾdhayna ۗ wakāna Allāh ghafūran rraḥīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, tell your wives, your daughters, and women believers to make their outer garments hang low over them so as to be recog-nized and not insulted: God is most forgiving, most merciful.
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Tell thy wives and thy daughters and the women of the believers to draw their cloaks close round them (when they go abroad). That will be better, so that they may be recognised and not annoyed. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: ۞ لَّئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْمُرْجِفُونَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease and those who spread rumors in al-Madīnah do not cease, We will surely incite you against them; then they will not remain your neighbors therein except for a little,
verses.tr: ۞ llaʾin llam yantahi al-munāfiqūna wa-adh-dhīna fā qulūbihim mmaraḍun wa-l-murjifūna fā al-madīnahi lanughriyannaka bihim thumma lā yujāwirūnaka fīhā ʾillā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: If the hypocrites, the sick at heart, and those who spread lies in the city do not desist, We shall rouse you [Prophet] against them, and then they will only be your neighbours in this city for a short while.
verses.pickthall: If the hypocrites, and those in whose hearts is a disease, and the alarmists in the city do not cease, We verily shall urge thee on against them, then they will be your neighbours in it but a little while.

verses.ar: مَّلْعُونِينَ ۖ أَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوٓا۟ أُخِذُوا۟ وَقُتِّلُوا۟ تَقْتِيلًا
verses.en: Accursed wherever they are found, [being] seized and massacred completely.
verses.tr: mmalʿūnīna ۖ ʾaynamā thuqifūā ʾukhidhūā waquttilūā taqtīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: They will be rejected. Wherever they are found, they will be arrested and put to death.
verses.pickthall: Accursed, they will be seized wherever found and slain with a (fierce) slaughter.

verses.ar: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.en: [This is] the established way of Allāh with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allāh any change.
verses.tr: sunnaha Allāh fā adh-dhīna khalawā min qablu ۖ walan tajida lisunnahi Allāh tabdīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: This has been God’s practice with those who went before. You will find no change in God’s practices.
verses.pickthall: That was the way of Allah in the case of those who passed away of old; thou wilt not find for the way of Allah aught of power to change.

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُكَ ٱلنَّاسُ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا
verses.en: People ask you concerning the Hour. Say, "Knowledge of it is only with Allāh. And what may make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near."
verses.tr: yasluka an-nāsu ʿani as-sāʿahi ۖ qul ʾinnamā ʿilmuhā ʿinda Allāh ۚ wamā yudrīka laʿalla as-sāʿaha takūnu qarīban
verses.abdelhaleem: People ask you about the Hour. Say, ‘God alone has knowledge of it.’ How could you [Prophet] know? The Hour may well be near.
verses.pickthall: Men ask thee of the Hour. Say: The knowledge of it is with Allah only. What can convey (the knowledge) unto thee? It may be that the Hour is nigh.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh laʿana al-kāfirīna wa-aʿadda lahum saʿīran
verses.abdelhaleem: God has rejected the disbelievers and prepared a blazing fire for them.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah hath cursed the disbelievers, and hath prepared for them a flaming fire,

verses.ar: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ لَّا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
verses.en: Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper.
verses.tr: khālidīna fīhā ʾabadan ۖ llā yajidūna waliyyan walā naṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: There they will stay permanently, with no one to befriend or support them.
verses.pickthall: Wherein they will abide for ever. They will find (then) no protecting friend nor helper.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَـٰلَيْتَنَآ أَطَعْنَا ٱللَّهَ وَأَطَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَا۠
verses.en: The Day their faces will be turned about in the Fire, they will say, "How we wish we had obeyed Allāh and obeyed the Messenger."
verses.tr: yawma tuqallabu wujūhuhum fā an-nāri yaqūlūna yālaytanā ʾaṭaʿnā Allāh wa-aṭaʿnā ar-rasūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when their faces are being turned about in the Fire, they will say, ‘If only we had obeyed God and the Messenger,’
verses.pickthall: On the day when their faces are turned over in the Fire, they say: Oh, would that we had obeyed Allah and had obeyed His messenger!

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّآ أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَآءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا ٱلسَّبِيلَا۠
verses.en: And they will say, "Our Lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries, and they led us astray from the [right] way.
verses.tr: waqālūā rabbanā ʾinnā ʾaṭaʿnā sādatanā wakubarāʾanā fa-aḍallūnā as-sabīlā
verses.abdelhaleem: and ‘Lord! We obeyed our masters and our chiefs, and they led us astray.
verses.pickthall: And they say: Our Lord! Lo! we obeyed our princes and great men, and they misled us from the Way.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse."
verses.tr: rabbanā ātihim ḍiʿfayni mina al-ʿadhābi wa-l-ʿanhum laʿnan kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord! Give them a double punishment and reject them completely.’
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! Oh, give them double torment and curse them with a mighty curse.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاذَوْا۟ مُوسَىٰ فَبَرَّأَهُ ٱللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا۟ ۚ وَكَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَجِيهًا
verses.en: O you who have believed, be not like those who abused Moses; then Allāh cleared him of what they said. And he, in the sight of Allāh, was distinguished.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā takūnūā ka-adh-dhīna ādhawā mūsā fabarraʾahu Allāh mimmā qālūā ۚ wakāna ʿinda Allāh wajīhan
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, do not be like those who insulted Moses- God cleared him of their allegations and he was highly honoured in God’s eyes.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Be not as those who slandered Moses, but Allah proved his innocence of that which they alleged, and he was well esteemed in Allah's sight.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَقُولُوا۟ قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا
verses.en: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and speak words of appropriate justice.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā āttaqūā Allāh waqūlūā qawlan sadīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, be mindful of God, speak in a direct fashion and to good purpose,
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Guard your duty to Allah, and speak words straight to the point;

verses.ar: يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
verses.en: He will [then] amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment.
verses.tr: yuṣliḥ lakum ʾaʿmālakum wayaghfir lakum dhunūbakum ۗ waman yuṭiʿi Allāh warasūlahu faqad fāza fawzan ʿaẓīman
verses.abdelhaleem: and He will put your deeds right for you and forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys God and His Messenger will truly achieve a great triumph.
verses.pickthall: He will adjust your works for you and will forgive you your sins. Whosoever obeyeth Allah and His messenger, he verily hath gained a signal victory.

verses.ar: إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا ٱلْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَن يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا
verses.en: Indeed, We offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʿaraḍnā al-ʾamānaha ʿalā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wa-l-jibāli fa-abayna ʾan yaḥmilnahā wa-ashfaqna minhā waḥamalahā al-ʾinsānu ۖ ʾinnahu kāna ẓalūman jahūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: We offered the Trust to the heavens, the earth, and the mountains, yet they refused to undertake it and were afraid of it; mankind undertook it- they have always been inept and foolish.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We offered the trust unto the heavens and the earth and the hills, but they shrank from bearing it and were afraid of it. And man assumed it. Lo! he hath proved a tyrant and a fool.

verses.ar: لِّيُعَذِّبَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ وَيَتُوبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۢا
verses.en: [It was] so that Allāh may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with Him and that Allāh may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: lliyuʿadhiba Allāh al-munāfiqīna wa-l-munāfiqāti wa-l-mushrikīna wa-l-mushrikāti wayatūba Allāh ʿalā al-muʾminīna wa-l-muʾmināti ۗ wakāna Allāh ghafūran rraḥīmanā
verses.abdelhaleem: God will punish the hypocrites and the idolaters, both men and women, and turn with mercy to the believers, both men and women: God is most forgiving, most merciful.
verses.pickthall: So Allah punisheth hypocritical men and hypocritical women, and idolatrous men and idolatrous women. But Allah pardoneth believing men and believing women, and Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.en: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs [all] praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Aware.
verses.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhā lahu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi walahu al-ḥamdu fā al-ākhirahi ۚ wahuwa al-ḥakīmu al-khabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Praise be to God, to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and earth, and praise be to Him in the life to come. He is the All Wise, the All Aware.
verses.pickthall: Praise be to Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. His is the praise in the Hereafter, and He is the Wise, the Aware.

verses.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
verses.en: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
verses.tr: yaʿlamu mā yaliju fā al-ʾarḍi wamā yakhruju minhā wamā yanzilu mina as-samāʾi wamā yaʿruju fīhā ۚ wahuwa ar-raḥīmu al-ghafūru
verses.abdelhaleem: He knows all that goes into the earth and all that comes out of it; He knows all that comes down from the heavens and all that goes up to them. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
verses.pickthall: He knoweth that which goeth into the earth and that which cometh forth from it, and that descendeth from the heaven and that which ascendeth into it. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَأْتِينَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ ۖ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you. [Allāh is] the Knower of the unseen." Not absent from Him is an atom's weight within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register -
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lā taʾtīnā as-sāʿahu ۖ qul balā warabbā lataʾtiyannakum ʿālimi al-ghaybi ۖ lā yaʿzubu ʿanhu mithqālu dharrahin fā as-samāwāti walā fā al-ʾarḍi walā ʾaṣgharu min dhālika walā ʾakbaru ʾillā fā kitābin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Still, the disbelievers say, ‘The Last Hour will never come upon us.’ Say, ‘Yes, by my Lord, [it will], by Him who knows the unseen! Not even the weight of a speck of dust in the heavens or earth escapes His knowledge, nor anything smaller or greater. It is all recorded in a clear Record
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve say: The Hour will never come unto us. Say: Nay, by my Lord, but it is coming unto you surely. (He is) the Knower of the Unseen. Not an atom's weight, or less than that or greater, escapeth Him in the heavens or in the earth, but it is in a clear Record,

verses.ar: لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: That He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Those will have forgiveness and noble provision.
verses.tr: lliyajzāa adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ۚ ʾūlāʾika lahum mmaghfirahun warizqun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: so that He can reward those who believe and do good deeds: they will have forgiveness and generous provision.’
verses.pickthall: That He may reward those who believe and do good works. For them is pardon and a rich provision.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: But those who strive against Our verses [seeking] to cause failure - for them will be a painful punishment of foul nature.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna saʿaw fā āyātinā muʿājizīna ʾūlāʾika lahum ʿadhābun mmin rrijzin ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: But as for those who work against Our Revelations, seeking to undermine them, there will be a torment of painful suffering.
verses.pickthall: But those who strive against Our revelations, challenging (Us), theirs will be a painful doom of wrath.

verses.ar: وَيَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verses.en: And those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, and it guides to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: wayarā adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-ʿilma adh-dhā ʾunzila ʾilayka min rrabbika huwa al-ḥaqqa wayahdā ʾilā ṣirāṭi al-ʿazīzi al-ḥamīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], those who have been given knowledge can see that what has been sent to you from your Lord is the truth, and that it leads to the path of the Almighty, worthy of all praise.
verses.pickthall: Those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the truth and leadeth unto the path of the Mighty, the Owner of Praise.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.en: But those who disbelieve say, "Shall we direct you to a man who will inform you [that] when you have disintegrated in complete disintegration, you will [then] be [recreated] in a new creation?
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā hal nadullukum ʿalā rajulin yunabbiʾukum ʾidhā muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin ʾinnakum lafā khalqin jadīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: But the disbelievers say, ‘Shall we show you a man who claims that, when you have been utterly torn to pieces, you will be raised in a new creation?
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve say: Shall we show you a man who will tell you (that) when ye have become dispersed in dust with most complete dispersal still, even then, ye will be created anew?

verses.ar: أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۗ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلضَّلَـٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ
verses.en: Has he invented about Allāh a lie or is there in him madness?" Rather, they who do not believe in the Hereafter will be in the punishment and [are in] extreme error.
verses.tr: ʾaftarā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban ʾam bihi jinnahun ۗ bali adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi fā al-ʿadhābi wa-aḍ-ḍalāli al-baʿīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: Has he invented a lie about God? Is he mad?’ No! It is those who do not believe in the life to come who will suffer torment, for they are in gross error.
verses.pickthall: Hath he invented a lie concerning Allah, or is there in him a madness? Nay, but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are in torment and far error.

verses.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.en: Then, do they not look at what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and earth? If We should will, We could cause the earth to swallow them or [could] let fall upon them fragments from the sky. Indeed in that is a sign for every servant turning back [to Allāh].
verses.tr: ʾafalam yarawā ʾilā mā bayna ʾaydīhim wamā khalfahum mmina as-samāʾi wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ ʾin nnashaʾ nakhsif bihimu al-ʾarḍa ʾaw nusqiṭ ʿalayhim kisafan mmina as-samāʾi ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyahan llikulli ʿabdin mmunībin
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not think about what is in front of them and behind them in the heavens and earth? If We wished, We could make the earth swallow them, or make fragments from the heavens fall down upon them. There truly is a sign in this for every servant who turns back to God in repentance.
verses.pickthall: Have they not observed what is before them and what is behind them of the sky and the earth? If We will, We can make the earth swallow them, or cause obliteration from the sky to fall on them. Lo! herein surely is a portent for every slave who turneth (to Allah) repentant.

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا ۖ يَـٰجِبَالُ أَوِّبِى مَعَهُۥ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۖ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ ٱلْحَدِيدَ
verses.en: And We certainly gave David from Us bounty. [We said], "O mountains, repeat [Our] praises with him, and the birds [as well]." And We made pliable for him iron,
verses.tr: ۞ walaqad ātaynā dāwuda minnā faḍlan ۖ yājibālu ʾawwibā maʿahu wa-aṭ-ṭayra ۖ wa-ā lahu al-ḥadīda
verses.abdelhaleem: We graced David with Our favour. We said, ‘You mountains, echo God’s praises together with him, and you birds, too.’ We softened iron for him,
verses.pickthall: And assuredly We gave David grace from Us, (saying): O ye hills and birds, echo his psalms of praise! And We made the iron supple unto him,

verses.ar: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing."
verses.tr: ʾani āʿmal sābighātin waqaddir fā as-sardi ۖ wāʿmalūā ṣāliḥan ۖ ʾinnā bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: saying, ‘Make coats of chain mail and measure the links well.’ ‘Do good, all of you, for I see everything you do.’
verses.pickthall: Saying: Make thou long coats of mail and measure the links (thereof). And do ye right. Lo! I am Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌ ۖ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُۥ عَيْنَ ٱلْقِطْرِ ۖ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِۦ ۖ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind - its morning [journey was that of] a month - and its afternoon [journey was that of] a month, and We made flow for him a spring of [liquid] copper. And among the jinn were those who worked for him by the permission of his Lord. And whoever deviated among them from Our command - We will make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze.
verses.tr: walisulaymāna ar-rīḥa ghuduwwuhā shahrun warawāḥuhā shahrun ۖ wa-asalnā lahu ʿayna al-qiṭri ۖ wamina al-jinni man yaʿmalu bayna yadayhi biʾidhni rabbihi ۖ waman yazigh minhum ʿan ʾamrinā nudhiqhu min ʿadhābi as-saʿīri
verses.abdelhaleem: And [We subjected] the wind for Solomon. Its outward journey took a month, and its return journey likewise. We made a fountain of molten brass flow for him, and some of the jinn worked under his control with his Lord’s permission. If one of them deviated from Our command, We let him taste the suffering of the blazing flame.
verses.pickthall: And unto Solomon (We gave) the wind, whereof the morning course was a month's journey and the evening course a month's journey, and We caused the fount of copper to gush forth for him, and (We gave him) certain of the jinn who worked before him by permission of his Lord. And such of them as deviated from Our command, them We caused to taste the punishment of flaming Fire.

verses.ar: يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَـٰرِيبَ وَتَمَـٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَٱلْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَّاسِيَـٰتٍ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكْرًا ۚ وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِىَ ٱلشَّكُورُ
verses.en: They made for him what he willed of elevated chambers, statues, bowls like reservoirs, and stationary kettles. [We said], "Work, O family of David, in gratitude." And few of My servants are grateful.
verses.tr: yaʿmalūna lahu mā yashāʾu min mmaḥārība watamāthīla wajifānin ka-l-jawābi waqudūrin rrāsiyātin ۚ āʿmalūā āla dāwuda shukran ۚ waqalīlun mmin ʿibādāa ash-shakūru
verses.abdelhaleem: They made him whatever he wanted- palaces, statues, basins as large as water troughs, fixed cauldrons. We said, ‘Work thankfully, family of David, for few of my servants are truly thankful.’
verses.pickthall: They made for him what he willed: synagogues and statues, basins like wells and boilers built into the ground. Give thanks, O House of David! Few of My bondmen are thankful.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.en: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment.
verses.tr: falammā qaḍaynā ʿalayhi al-mawta mā dallahum ʿalā mawtihi ʾillā dābbahu al-ʾarḍi taʾkulu minsaʾatahu ۖ falammā kharra tabayyanati al-jinnu ʾan llaw kānūā yaʿlamūna al-ghayba mā labithūā fā al-ʿadhābi al-muhīni
verses.abdelhaleem: Then, when We decreed Solomon’s death, nothing showed the jinn he was dead, but a creature of the earth eating at his stick: when he fell down they realized- if they had known what was hidden they would not have continued their demeaning labour.
verses.pickthall: And when We decreed death for him, nothing showed his death to them save a creeping creature of the earth which gnawed away his staff. And when he fell the jinn saw clearly how, if they had known the Unseen, they would not have continued in despised toil.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِى مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌ ۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ ۖ كُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۚ بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌ
verses.en: There was for [the tribe of] Saba’ in their dwelling place a sign: two [fields of] gardens on the right and on the left. [They were told], "Eat from the provisions of your Lord and be grateful to Him. A good land [have you], and a forgiving Lord."
verses.tr: laqad kāna lisabaʾin fā maskanihim āyahun ۖ jannatāni ʿan yamīnin washimālin ۖ kulūā min rrizqi rabbikum wāshkurūā lahu ۚ baldahun ṭayyibahun warabbun ghafūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: There was a sign for the people of Sheba, too, in their dwelling place: two gardens, one on the right, one on the left: ‘Eat from what your Lord has provided for you and give Him thanks, for your land is good, and your Lord most forgiving.’
verses.pickthall: There was indeed a sign for Sheba in their dwelling-place: Two gardens on the right hand and the left (as who should say): Eat of the provision of your Lord and render thanks to Him. A fair land and an indulgent Lord!

verses.ar: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍ وَأَثْلٍ وَشَىْءٍ مِّن سِدْرٍ قَلِيلٍ
verses.en: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees.
verses.tr: fa-aʿraḍūā fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim sayla al-ʿarimi wabaddalnāhum bijannatayhim jannatayni dhawātā ʾukulin khamṭin wa-athlin washāʾin mmin sidrin qalīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: But they paid no heed, so We let loose on them a flood from the dam and replaced their two gardens with others that yielded bitter fruit, tamarisk bushes, and a few lote trees.
verses.pickthall: But they were froward, so We sent on them the flood of 'Iram, and in exchange for their two gardens gave them two gardens bearing bitter fruit, the tamarisk and here and there a lote-tree.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَـٰهُم بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَهَلْ نُجَـٰزِىٓ إِلَّا ٱلْكَفُورَ
verses.en: [By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?
verses.tr: dhālika jazaynāhum bimā kafarūā ۖ wahal nujāzā ʾillā al-kafūra
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way We punished them for their ingratitude- would We punish anyone but the ungrateful?
verses.pickthall: This We awarded them because of their ingratitude. Punish We ever any save the ingrates?

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقُرَى ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَـٰهِرَةً وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيْرَ ۖ سِيرُوا۟ فِيهَا لَيَالِىَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ
verses.en: And We placed between them and the cities which We had blessed [many] visible cities. And We determined between them the [distances of] journey, [saying], "Travel between them by night or by day in safety."
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā baynahum wabayna al-qurā at-tā bāraknā fīhā quranā ẓāhirahan waqaddarnā fīhā as-sayra ۖ sīrūā fīhā layālāa wa-ayyāman āminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Also, We had placed, between them and the towns We had blessed, other towns within sight of one another to which they could travel easily- ‘ Travel safely in this land by night and by day’-
verses.pickthall: And We set, between them and the towns which We had blessed, towns easy to be seen, and We made the stage between them easy, (saying): Travel in them safely both by night and day.

verses.ar: فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا بَـٰعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَـٰهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
verses.en: But [insolently] they said, "Our Lord, lengthen the distance between our journeys," and wronged themselves, so We made them narrations and dispersed them in total dispersion. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
verses.tr: faqālūā rabbanā bāʿid bayna ʾasfārinā waẓalamūā ʾanfusahum fajaʿalnāhum ʾaḥādītha wamazzaqnāhum kulla mumazzaqin ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin llikulli ṣabbārin shakūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: but [still] they complained, ‘Our Lord has made the distance between our staging posts so long!’They wronged themselves and, in the end, We made their fate a byword, and scattered them in countless fragments. There truly are signs in this for every patient, thankful person.
verses.pickthall: But they said: Our Lord! Make the stage between our journeys longer. And they wronged themselves, therefore We made them bywords (in the land) and scattered them abroad, a total scattering. Lo! herein verily are portents for each steadfast, grateful (heart).

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُۥ فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And Iblees had already confirmed through them his assumption, so they followed him, except for a party of believers.
verses.tr: walaqad ṣaddaqa ʿalayhim ʾiblīsu ẓannahu fāttabaʿūhu ʾillā farīqan mmina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Satan was proved right in his opinion of them, for they all followed him- except for a group of believers-
verses.pickthall: And Satan indeed found his calculation true concerning them, for they follow him, all save a group of true believers.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِى شَكٍّ ۗ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
verses.en: And he had over them no authority except [it was decreed] that We might make evident who believes in the Hereafter from who is thereof in doubt. And your Lord, over all things, is Guardian.
verses.tr: wamā kāna lahu ʿalayhim mmin sulṭānin ʾillā linaʿlama man yuʾminu bi-l-ākhirahi mimman huwa minhā fā shakkin ۗ warabbuka ʿalā kulli shāʾin ḥafīẓun
verses.abdelhaleem: even though he had no authority over them. But [We aim] to distinguish those who believe in the life to come from those who doubt it: [Prophet], your Lord observes everything.
verses.pickthall: And he had no warrant whatsoever against them, save that We would know him who believeth in the Hereafter from him who is in doubt thereof; and thy Lord (O Muhammad) taketh note of all things.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرْكٍ وَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٍ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Invoke those you claim [as deities] besides Allāh." They do not possess an atom's weight [of ability] in the heavens or on the earth, and they do not have therein any partnership [with Him], nor is there for Him from among them any assistant.
verses.tr: quli ādʿūā adh-dhīna zaʿamtum mmin dūni Allāh ۖ lā yamlikūna mithqāla dharrahin fā as-samāwāti walā fā al-ʾarḍi wamā lahum fīhimā min shirkin wamā lahu minhum mmin ẓahīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Pray to your so-called gods besides God: they do not control even the weight of a speck of dust in heaven or earth, nor do they have any share in them, nor are any of them any help to God.
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Call upon those whom ye set up beside Allah! They possess not an atom's weight either in the heavens or in the earth, nor have they any share in either, nor hath He an auxiliary among them.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُۥ ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.en: And intercession does not benefit with Him except for one whom He permits. [And those wait] until, when terror is removed from their hearts, they will say [to one another], "What has your Lord said?" They will say, "The truth." And He is the Most High, the Grand.
verses.tr: walā tanfaʿu ash-shafāʿahu ʿindahu ʾillā liman ʾadhina lahu ۚ ḥattā ʾidhā fuzziʿa ʿan qulūbihim qālūā mādhā qāla rabbukum ۖ qālūā al-ḥaqqa ۖ wahuwa al-ʿalāu al-kabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Intercession will not work with Him, except by those to whom He gives permission.’ They will be asked, after the terror is lifted from their hearts [on the Day of Judgement], ‘What did your Lord speak?’ and they will answer, ‘The Truth. He is the Most High, the Most Great.’
verses.pickthall: No intercession availeth with Him save for him whom He permitteth. Yet, when fear is banished from their hearts, they say: What was it that your Lord said? They say: The Truth. And He is the Sublime, the Great.

verses.ar: ۞ قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَإِنَّآ أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "Allāh. And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error."
verses.tr: ۞ qul man yarzuqukum mmina as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ quli Allāh ۖ wa-innā ʾaw ʾiyyākum laʿalā hudanā ʾaw fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Who gives you sustenance from the heavens and earth?’ Say, ‘God does,’ and ‘[One party of us] must be rightly guided and the other clearly astray.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Who giveth you provision from the sky and the earth? Say: Allah, Lo! we or you assuredly are rightly guided or in error manifest.

verses.ar: قُل لَّا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّآ أَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Say, "You will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do."
verses.tr: qul llā tuslūna ʿammā ʾajramnā walā nuslu ʿammā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘You will not be ques-tioned about our sins, nor will we be questioned about what you do.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Ye will not be asked of what we committed, nor shall we be asked of what ye do.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."
verses.tr: qul yajmaʿu baynanā rabbunā thumma yaftaḥu baynanā bi-l-ḥaqqi wahuwa al-fattāḥu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Our Lord will gather us together, then He will judge justly between us; He alone is the All Knowing Judge.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Our Lord will bring us all together, then He will judge between us with truth. He is the All-knowing Judge.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرُونِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَآءَ ۖ كَلَّا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Say, "Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. No! Rather, He [alone] is Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
verses.tr: qul ʾarūnāa adh-dhīna ʾalḥaqtum bihi shurakāʾa ۖ kallā ۚ bal huwa Allāh al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Show me those you joined to Him as partners. No indeed! He alone is God, the Almighty, the All Wise.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Show me those whom ye have joined unto Him as partners. Nay (ye dare not)! For He is Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And We have not sent you except comprehensively to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know.
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnāka ʾillā kāffahan llilnnāsi bashīran wanadhīran walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent you [Prophet] only to bring good news and warning to all people, but most of them do not understand.
verses.pickthall: And We have not sent thee (O Muhammad) save as a bringer of good tidings and a warner unto all mankind; but most of mankind know not.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.tr: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā al-waʿdu ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And they say, ‘If what you say is true, when will this promise be fulfilled?’
verses.pickthall: And they say: When is this promise (to be fulfilled) if ye are truthful?

verses.ar: قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَّا تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."
verses.tr: qul llakum mmīʿādu yawmin llā tastakhirūna ʿanhu sāʿahan walā tastaqdimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘You have an appointment for a Day which you cannot put off nor bring forward, even by a single moment.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Yours is the promise of a Day which ye cannot postpone nor hasten by an hour.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur’ān nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each others' words... Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lan nnuʾmina bihādhā al-qurāni walā bi-adh-dhā bayna yadayhi ۗ walaw tarā ʾidhi aẓ-ẓālimūna mawqūfūna ʿinda rabbihim yarjiʿu baʿḍuhum ʾilā baʿḍin al-qawla yaqūlu adh-dhīna āstuḍʿifūā lilladhīna āstakbarūā lawlā ʾantum lakunnā muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers say, ‘We will believe neither this Qur an nor the Scriptures that came before it.’ If only you could see [Prophet] how the wrongdoers will be made to stand before their Lord, hurling reproaches at one another. Those who were oppressed will say to the oppressors, ‘If it were not for you, we would have been believers.’
verses.pickthall: And those who disbelieve say: We believe not in this Qur'an nor in that which was before it; but oh, if thou couldst see, when the wrong-doers are brought up before their Lord, how they cast the blame one to another; how those who were despised (in the earth) say unto those who were proud: But for you, we should have been believers.

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَـٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم ۖ بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."
verses.tr: qāla adh-dhīna āstakbarūā lilladhīna āstuḍʿifūā ʾanaḥnu ṣadadnākum ʿani al-hudā baʿda ʾidh jāʾakum ۖ bal kuntum mmujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The oppressors will say to them, ‘Was it we who prevented you from following right guidance after it had reached you? No! You yourselves were sinners.’
verses.pickthall: Those who were proud say unto those who were despised: Did we drive you away from the guidance after it had come unto you? Nay, but ye were guilty.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ بَلْ مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا ۚ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَغْلَـٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allāh and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna āstuḍʿifūā lilladhīna āstakbarūā bal makru al-yli wa-an-nahāri ʾidh taʾmurūnanā ʾan nnakfura billāh wanajʿala lahu ʾandādan ۚ wa-asarrūā an-nadāmaha lammā raʾawā al-ʿadhāba wajaʿalnā al-ʾaghlāla fā ʾaʿnāqi adh-dhīna kafarūā ۚ hal yujzawna ʾillā mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The oppressed will say to them, ‘No, it was your scheming, night and day, ordering us to disbelieve in God and set up rivals to Him.’ When they see the punishment, they will fall silent with regret, and We shall put iron collars on the disbelievers’ necks. Why should they be rewarded for anything other than what they have done?
verses.pickthall: Those who were despised say unto those who were proud: Nay but (it was your) scheming night and day, when ye commanded us to disbelieve in Allah and set up rivals unto Him. And they are filled with remorse when they behold the doom; and We place carcans on the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they requited aught save what they used to do?

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
verses.tr: wamā ʾarsalnā fā qaryahin mmin nnadhīrin ʾillā qāla mutrafūhā ʾinnā bimā ʾursiltum bihi kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Never have We sent a warner to a community without those among them who were corrupted by wealth saying, ‘We do not believe in the message you have been sent with.’
verses.pickthall: And We sent not unto any township a warner, but its pampered ones declared: Lo! we are disbelievers in that wherewith ye have been sent.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًا وَأَوْلَـٰدًا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.en: And they said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."
verses.tr: waqālūā naḥnu ʾaktharu ʾamwālan wa-awlādan wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They would say, ‘We have greater wealth and more children than you, and we shall not be punished.’
verses.pickthall: And they say: We are more (than you) in wealth and children. We are not the punished!

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."
verses.tr: qul ʾinna rabbā yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yashāʾu wayaqdiru walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘My Lord gives in abundance to whoever He will and sparingly to whoever He will, though most people do not understand.
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will and narroweth it (for whom He will). But most of mankind know not.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَـٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ
verses.en: And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of Paradise], safe [and secure].
verses.tr: wamā ʾamwālukum walā ʾawlādukum bi-at-tā tuqarribukum ʿindanā zulfā ʾillā man āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ūlāʾika lahum jazāʾu aḍ-ḍiʿfi bimā ʿamilūā wahum fā al-ghurufāti āminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Neither wealth nor children will bring you nearer to Us, but those who believe and do good deeds will have multiple rewards for what they have done, and will live safely in the lofty dwellings of Paradise,
verses.pickthall: And it is not your wealth nor your children that will bring you near unto Us, but he who believeth and doeth good (he draweth near). As for such, theirs will be twofold reward for what they did and they will dwell secure in lofty halls.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.en: And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yasʿawna fā āyātinā muʿājizīna ʾūlāʾika fā al-ʿadhābi muḥḍarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: whereas those who work against Our messages, seeking to undermine them, will be summoned to punishment.’
verses.pickthall: And as for those who strive against Our revelations, challenging, they will be brought to the doom.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُۥ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."
verses.tr: qul ʾinna rabbā yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yashāʾu min ʿibādihi wayaqdiru lahu ۚ wamā ʾanfaqtum mmin shāʾin fahuwa yukhlifuhu ۖ wahuwa khayru ar-rāziqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘My Lord gives in abundance to whichever of His servants He will, and sparingly to whichever He will; He will replace whatever you give in alms; He is the best of providers.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will of His bondmen, and narroweth (it) for him. And whatsoever ye spend (for good) He replaceth it. And He is the Best of Providers.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"
verses.tr: wayawma yaḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma yaqūlu lilmalāʾikahi ʾahāʾulāʾi ʾiyyākum kānūā yaʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day He gathers them all together, He will say to the angels, ‘Was it you these people worshipped?’
verses.pickthall: And on the day when He will gather them all together, He will say unto the angels: Did these worship you?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم ۖ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ ۖ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allāh], are our benefactor excluding [i.e., not] them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."
verses.tr: qālūā subḥānaka ʾanta waliyyunā min dūnihim ۖ bal kānūā yaʿbudūna al-jinna ۖ ʾaktharuhum bihim mmuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will reply, ‘May You be exalted! You are our supporter against them! Really, they worshipped the jinn- most of them believed in them.’
verses.pickthall: They will say: Be Thou Glorified. Thou (alone) art our Guardian, not them! Nay, but they worshipped the jinn; most of them were believers in them.

verses.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَّفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: But today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny."
verses.tr: fa-l-yawma lā yamliku baʿḍukum libaʿḍin nnafʿan walā ḍarran wanaqūlu lilladhīna ẓalamūā dhūqūā ʿadhāba an-nāri at-tā kuntum bihā tukadhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘So today neither of you has any power to benefit or harm the other,’ We shall tell the evildoers, ‘Taste the torment of the fire which you called a lie.’
verses.pickthall: That day ye will possess no use nor hurt one for another. And We shall say unto those who did wrong: Taste the doom of the Fire which ye used to deny.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ مُّفْتَرًى ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."
verses.tr: wa-idhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qālūā mā hādhā ʾillā rajulun yurīdu ʾan yaṣuddakum ʿammā kāna yaʿbudu ābāʾukum waqālūā mā hādhā ʾillā ʾifkun mmuftaranā ۚ waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lilḥaqqi lammā jāʾahum ʾin hādhā ʾillā siḥrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: When Our messages are recited to them, clear as they are, they say, ‘This is only a man who wants to turn you away from what your forefathers worshipped,’ and, ‘This [Quran] is nothing but lies he has made up.’ When the Truth comes to the disbelievers, they say, ‘This is just plain sorcery,’
verses.pickthall: And if Our revelations are recited unto them in plain terms, they say: This is naught else than a man who would turn you away from what your fathers used to worship; and they say: This is naught else than an invented lie. Those who disbelieve say of the truth when it reacheth them: This is naught else than mere magic.

verses.ar: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍ
verses.en: And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, [O Muḥammad], any warner.
verses.tr: wamā ātaynāhum mmin kutubin yadrusūnahā ۖ wamā ʾarsalnā ʾilayhim qablaka min nnadhīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: though We have not given them any books to study nor sent any warner before you.
verses.pickthall: And We have given them no scriptures which they study, nor sent We unto them, before thee, any warner.

verses.ar: وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا۟ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ رُسُلِى ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.en: And those before them denied, and they [i.e., the people of Makkah] have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But they [i.e., the former peoples] denied My messengers, so how [terrible] was My reproach.
verses.tr: wakadhaba adh-dhīna min qablihim wamā balaghūā miʿshāra mā ātaynāhum fakadhabūā rusulā ۖ fakayfa kāna nakīri
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who lived before them also denied the truth- these people have not attained even a tenth of what We gave their predecessors- they, too, rejected My messengers, and how terrible My condemnation was!
verses.pickthall: Those before them denied, and these have not attained a tithe of that which We bestowed on them (of old); yet they denied My messengers. How intense then was My abhorrence (of them)!

verses.ar: ۞ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ ۖ أَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ ۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
verses.en: Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allāh, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.
verses.tr: ۞ qul ʾinnamā ʾaʿiẓukum biwāḥidahin ۖ ʾan taqūmūā lillāh mathnā wafurādā thumma tatafakkarūā ۚ mā biṣāḥibikum mmin jinnahin ۚ ʾin huwa ʾillā nadhīrun llakum bayna yadā ʿadhābin shadīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘I advise you to do one thing only: stand before God, in pairs or singly, and think: there is no sign of madness in your companion [the Prophet]- he is only warning you before severe suffering arrives.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I exhort you unto one thing only: that ye awake, for Allah's sake, by twos and singly, and then reflect: There is no madness in your comrade. He is naught else than a warner unto you in face of a terrific doom.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.en: Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allāh, and He is, over all things, Witness."
verses.tr: qul mā saʾaltukum mmin ʾajrin fahuwa lakum ۖ ʾin ʾajrāa ʾillā ʿalā Allāh ۖ wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin shahīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘If I have asked you for any reward, you can keep it. It is God alone who will reward me: He is witness to everything.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Whatever reward I might have asked of you is yours. My reward is the affair of Allah only. He is Witness over all things.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen."
verses.tr: qul ʾinna rabbā yaqdhifu bi-l-ḥaqqi ʿallāmu al-ghuyūbi
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘My Lord hurls the Truth down [before you]. He has full knowledge of all that is unseen.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Lo! my Lord hurleth the truth. (He is) the Knower of Things Hidden.

verses.ar: قُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ
verses.en: Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."
verses.tr: qul jāʾa al-ḥaqqu wamā yubdiʾu al-bāṭilu wamā yuʿīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘The Truth has come; falsehood is powerless.’
verses.pickthall: Say: The Truth hath come, and falsehood showeth not its face and will not return.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى ۖ وَإِنِ ٱهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ
verses.en: Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."
verses.tr: qul ʾin ḍalaltu fa-innamā ʾaḍillu ʿalā nafsā ۖ wa-ini āhtadaytu fabimā yūḥā ʾilāa rabbā ۚ ʾinnahu samīʿun qarībun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘If I go astray, that is my loss, and if I am rightly guided, it is through what my Lord has revealed to me. He is all hearing, and ever near.’
verses.pickthall: Say: If I err, I err only to my own loss, and if I am rightly guided it is because of that which my Lord hath revealed unto me. Lo! He is Hearer, Nigh.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ فَزِعُوا۟ فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
verses.en: And if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.
verses.tr: walaw tarā ʾidh faziʿūā falā fawta wa-ukhidhūā min mmakānin qarībin
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], if you could only see their terror! There will be no escape when they are seized from a nearby place;
verses.pickthall: Couldst thou but see when they are terrified with no escape, and are seized from near at hand,

verses.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.en: And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking [of faith] from a place far away?
verses.tr: waqālūā āmannā bihi wa-annā lahumu at-tanāwushu min mmakānin baʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: they will say, ‘Now we believe in it,’ but how can they reach it from such a distant place-
verses.pickthall: And say: We (now) believe therein. But how can they reach (faith) from afar off,

verses.ar: وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.en: And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault the unseen from a place far away.
verses.tr: waqad kafarūā bihi min qablu ۖ wayaqdhifūna bi-l-ghaybi min mmakānin baʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: they denied it all in the past, and threw conjecture from a faroff place-
verses.pickthall: When they disbelieved in it of yore. They aim at the unseen from afar off.

verses.ar: وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ فِى شَكٍّ مُّرِيبٍۭ
verses.en: And prevention will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with their kind before. Indeed, they were in disquieting doubt [i.e., denial].
verses.tr: waḥīla baynahum wabayna mā yashtahūna kamā fuʿila biʾashyāʿihim mmin qablu ۚ ʾinnahum kānūā fā shakkin mmurībin
verses.abdelhaleem: when a barrier has been placed between them and what they desire, just as was done with their kind before? They were deep in doubt and suspicion.
verses.pickthall: And a gulf is set between them and that which they desire, as was done for people of their kind of old. Lo! they were in hopeless doubt.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَـٰثَ وَرُبَـٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. He increases in creation what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
verses.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh fāṭiri as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi jāʿili al-malāʾikahi rusulan ʾūlā ʾajniḥahin mmathnā wathulātha warubāʿa ۚ yazīdu fā al-khalqi mā yashāʾu ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Praise be to God, Creator of the heavens and earth, who made angels messengers with two, three, four [pairs of] wings. He adds to creation as He will: God has power over everything.
verses.pickthall: Praise be to Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who appointeth the angels messengers having wings two, three and four. He multiplieth in creation what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Whatever Allāh grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: mmā yaftaḥi Allāh lilnnāsi min rraḥmahin falā mumsika lahā ۖ wamā yumsik falā mursila lahu min baʿdihi ۚ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: No one can withhold the blessing God opens up for people, nor can anyone but Him release whatever He withholds: He is the Almighty, the All Wise.
verses.pickthall: That which Allah openeth unto mankind of mercy none can withhold it; and that which He withholdeth none can release thereafter. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَـٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.en: O mankind, remember the favor of Allāh upon you. Is there any creator other than Allāh who provides for you from the heaven and earth? There is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu ādhkurūā niʿmata Allāh ʿalaykum ۚ hal min khāliqin ghayru Allāh yarzuqukum mmina as-samāʾi wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۖ fa-annā tuʾfakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: People, remember God’s grace towards you. Is there any creator other than God to give you sustenance from the heavens and earth? There is no god but Him. How can you be so deluded?
verses.pickthall: O mankind! Remember Allah's grace toward you! Is there any creator other than Allah who provideth for you from the sky and the earth? There is no Allah save Him. Whither then are ye turned?

verses.ar: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.en: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - already were messengers denied before you. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.
verses.tr: wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kudhibat rusulun mmin qablika ۚ wa-ʾilā Allāh turjaʿu al-ʾumūru
verses.abdelhaleem: If they call you a liar [Prophet], many messengers before you were also called liars: it is to God that all things will be returned.
verses.pickthall: And if they deny thee, (O Muhammad), messengers (of Allah) were denied before thee. Unto Allah all things are brought back.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
verses.en: O mankind, indeed the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu ʾinna waʿda Allāh ḥaqqun ۖ falā taghurrannakumu al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā ۖ walā yaghurrannakum billāh al-gharūru
verses.abdelhaleem: People! God’s promise is true, so do not let the present life deceive you. Do not let the Deceiver deceive you about God:
verses.pickthall: O mankind! Lo! the promise of Allah is true. So let not the life of the world beguile you, and let not the (avowed) beguiler beguile you with regard to Allah.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَٱتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوا۟ حِزْبَهُۥ لِيَكُونُوا۟ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: Indeed, Satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be among the companions of the Blaze.
verses.tr: ʾinna ash-shayṭāna lakum ʿaduwwun fāttakhidhūhu ʿaduwwan ۚ ʾinnamā yadʿūā ḥizbahu liyakūnūā min ʾaṣḥābi as-saʿīri
verses.abdelhaleem: Satan is your enemy––so treat him as an enemy––and invites his followers only to enter the blazing fire.
verses.pickthall: Lo! the devil is an enemy for you, so treat him as an enemy. He only summoneth his faction to be owners of the flaming Fire.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.en: Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna kafarūā lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun ۖ wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum mmaghfirahun wa-ajrun kabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who disbelieve will be punished severely; those who believe and do good deeds will be forgiven, and richly rewarded.
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve, theirs will be an awful doom; and those who believe and do good works, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.

verses.ar: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًا ۖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
verses.en: Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? For indeed, Allāh sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So do not let yourself perish over them in regret. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of what they do.
verses.tr: ʾafaman zuyyina lahu sūʾu ʿamalihi faraāhu ḥasanan ۖ fa-inna Allāh yuḍillu man yashāʾu wayahdā man yashāʾu ۖ falā tadhhab nafsuka ʿalayhim ḥasarātin ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalīmun bimā yaṣnaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What about those whose evil deeds are made alluring to them so that they think they are good? God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will. [Prophet], do not waste your soul away with regret for them: God knows exactly what they do.
verses.pickthall: Is he, the evil of whose deeds is made fairseeming unto him so that he deemeth it good, (other than Satan's dupe)? Allah verily sendeth whom He will astray, and guideth whom He will; so let not thy soul expire in sighings for them. Lo! Allah is Aware of what they do!

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.en: And it is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Thus is the resurrection.
verses.tr: wallāh adh-dhā ʾarsala ar-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fasuqnāhu ʾilā baladin mmayyitin fa-aḥyaynā bihi al-ʾarḍa baʿda mawtihā ۚ kadhālika an-nushūru
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who sends forth the winds; they raise up the clouds; We drive them to a dead land and with them revive the earth after its death: such will be the Resurrection.
verses.pickthall: And Allah it is Who sendeth the winds and they raise a cloud; then We lead it unto a dead land and revive therewith the earth after its death. Such is the Resurrection.

verses.ar: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ ٱلْكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُ يَرْفَعُهُۥ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَمَكْرُ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ
verses.en: Whoever desires honor [through power] - then to Allāh belongs all honor. To Him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it. But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.
verses.tr: man kāna yurīdu al-ʿizzaha fa-lillāh al-ʿizzahu jamīʿan ۚ ʾilayhi yaṣʿadu al-kalimu aṭ-ṭayyibu wa-l-ʿamalu aṣ-ṣāliḥu yarfaʿuhu ۚ wa-adh-dhīna yamkurūna as-sayyāti lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun ۖ wamakru ʾūlāʾika huwa yabūru
verses.abdelhaleem: If anyone desires power, all power belongs to God; good words rise up to Him and He lifts up the righteous deed, but a severe torment awaits those who plot evil and their plotting will come to nothing.
verses.pickthall: Whoso desireth power (should know that) all power belongeth to Allah. Unto Him good words ascend, and the pious deed doth He exalt; but those who plot iniquities, theirs will be an awful doom; and the plotting of such (folk) will come to naught.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verses.en: And Allāh created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then He made you mates. And no female conceives nor does she give birth except with His knowledge. And no aged person is granted [additional] life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. Indeed, that for Allāh is easy.
verses.tr: wallāh khalaqakum mmin turābin thumma min nnuṭfahin thumma jaʿalakum ʾazwājan ۚ wamā taḥmilu min ʾunthā walā taḍaʿu ʾillā biʿilmihi ۚ wamā yuʿammaru min mmuʿammarin walā yunqaṣu min ʿumurihi ʾillā fā kitābin ۚ ʾinna dhālika ʿalā Allāh yasīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who created you from dust and later from a drop of fluid; then He made you into two sexes; no female conceives or gives birth without His knowledge; no person grows old or has his life cut short, except in accordance with a Record: all this is easy for God.
verses.pickthall: Allah created you from dust, then from a little fluid, then He made you pairs (the male and female). No female beareth or bringeth forth save with His knowledge. And no-one groweth old who groweth old, nor is aught lessened of his life, but it is recorded in a Book, Lo! that is easy for Allah.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْبَحْرَانِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَآئِغٌ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And not alike are the two seas [i.e., bodies of water]. One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.tr: wamā yastawā al-baḥrāni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun sāʾighun sharābuhu wahādhā milḥun ʾujājun ۖ wamin kullin taʾkulūna laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijūna ḥilyahan talbasūnahā ۖ watarā al-fulka fīhi mawākhira litabtaghūā min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The two bodies of water are not alike- one is palatable, sweet, and pleasant to drink, the other salty and bitter- yet from each you eat fresh fish and extract ornaments to wear, and in each you see the ships ploughing their course so that you may seek God’s bounty and be grateful.
verses.pickthall: And the two seas are not alike: this, fresh, sweet, good to drink, this (other) bitter, salt. And from them both ye eat fresh meat and derive the ornament that ye wear. And thou seest the ship cleaving them with its prow that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may give thanks.

verses.ar: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ
verses.en: He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.
verses.tr: yūliju al-yla fā an-nahāri wayūliju an-nahāra fā al-yli wasakhara ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara kullun yajrā liʾajalin mmusammanā ۚ dhālikumu Allāh rabbukum lahu al-mulku ۚ wa-adh-dhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi mā yamlikūna min qiṭmīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: He makes the night merge into the day and the day into the night; He has subjected the sun and the moon- each runs for an appointed term. Such is God your Lord: all control belongs to Him. Those you invoke beside Him do not even control the skin of a date stone;
verses.pickthall: He maketh the night to pass into the day and He maketh the day to pass into the night. He hath subdued the sun and moon to service. Each runneth unto an appointed term. Such is Allah, your Lord; His is the Sovereignty; and those unto whom ye pray instead of Him own not so much as the white spot on a date-stone.

verses.ar: إِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا۟ دُعَآءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا۟ مَا ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ
verses.en: If you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. And on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your association. And none can inform you like [one] Aware [of all matters].
verses.tr: ʾin tadʿūhum lā yasmaʿūā duʿāʾakum walaw samiʿūā mā āstajābūā lakum ۖ wayawma al-qiyāmahi yakfurūna bishirkikum ۚ walā yunabbiʾuka mithlu khabīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: if you call them they cannot hear you; if they could hear, they could not answer you; on the Day of Resurrection they will disown your idolatry. None can inform you [Prophet] like the One who is all aware.
verses.pickthall: If ye pray unto them they hear not your prayer, and if they heard they could not grant it you. On the Day of Resurrection they will disown association with you. None can inform you like Him Who is Aware.

verses.ar: ۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.en: O mankind, you are those in need of Allāh, while Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: ۞ yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu ʾantumu al-fuqarāʾu ʾilā Allāh ۖ wallāh huwa al-ghanāu al-ḥamīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: People, it is you who stand in need of God- God needs nothing and is worthy of all praise-
verses.pickthall: O mankind! Ye are the poor in your relation to Allah. And Allah! He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.

verses.ar: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.en: If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.
verses.tr: ʾin yashaʾ yudhhibkum wayaʾti bikhalqin jadīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: if He wills, He can do away with you and bring in a new creation,
verses.pickthall: If He will, He can be rid of you and bring (instead of you) some new creation.

verses.ar: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ
verses.en: And that is for Allāh not difficult.
verses.tr: wamā dhālika ʿalā Allāh biʿazīzin
verses.abdelhaleem: that is not difficult for God.
verses.pickthall: That is not a hard thing for Allah.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰٓ ۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer. And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul. And to Allāh is the [final] destination.
verses.tr: walā taziru wāzirahun wizra ʾukhrā ۚ wa-in tadʿu muthqalahun ʾilā ḥimlihā lā yuḥmal minhu shāʾun walaw kāna dhā qurbā ۗ ʾinnamā tundhiru adh-dhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bi-l-ghaybi wa-aqāmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha ۚ waman tazakkā fa-innamā yatazakkā linafsihi ۚ wa-ʾilā Allāh al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: No burdened soul will bear the burden of another: even if a heavily laden soul should cry for help, none of its load will be carried, not even by a close relative. But you [Prophet] can only warn those who fear their Lord, though they cannot see Him, and keep up the prayer- whoever purifies himself does so for his own benefit–– everything returns to God.
verses.pickthall: And no burdened soul can bear another's burden, and if one heavy laden crieth for (help with) his load, naught of it will be lifted even though he (unto whom he crieth) be of kin. Thou warnest only those who fear their Lord in secret, and have established worship. He who groweth (in goodness), groweth only for himself, (he cannot by his merit redeem others). Unto Allah is the journeying.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.en: Not equal are the blind and the seeing,
verses.tr: wamā yastawā al-ʾaʿmā wa-l-baṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: The blind and the seeing are not alike,
verses.pickthall: The blind man is not equal with the seer;

verses.ar: وَلَا ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتُ وَلَا ٱلنُّورُ
verses.en: Nor are the darknesses and the light,
verses.tr: walā aẓ-ẓulumātu walā an-nūru
verses.abdelhaleem: nor are darkness and light;
verses.pickthall: Nor is darkness (tantamount to) light;

verses.ar: وَلَا ٱلظِّلُّ وَلَا ٱلْحَرُورُ
verses.en: Nor are the shade and the heat,
verses.tr: walā aẓ-ẓillu walā al-ḥarūru
verses.abdelhaleem: shade and heat are not alike,
verses.pickthall: Nor is the shadow equal with the sun's full heat;

verses.ar: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَحْيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلْأَمْوَٰتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.en: And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allāh causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.
verses.tr: wamā yastawā al-ʾaḥyāʾu walā al-ʾamwātu ۚ ʾinna Allāh yusmiʿu man yashāʾu ۖ wamā ʾanta bimusmiʿin mman fā al-qubūri
verses.abdelhaleem: nor are the living and the dead. God makes anyone He wills hear [His message]: you cannot make those in their graves hear.
verses.pickthall: Nor are the living equal with the dead. Lo! Allah maketh whom He will to hear. Thou canst not reach those who are in the graves.

verses.ar: إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ
verses.en: You, [O Muḥammad], are not but a warner.
verses.tr: ʾin ʾanta ʾillā nadhīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: You are only here to warn them-
verses.pickthall: Thou art but a warner.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ
verses.en: Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾarsalnāka bi-l-ḥaqqi bashīran wanadhīran ۚ wa-in mmin ʾummahin ʾillā khalā fīhā nadhīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent you with the Truth as a bearer of good news and warning- every community has been sent a warner.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have sent thee with the Truth, a bearer of glad tidings and a warner; and there is not a nation but a warner hath passed among them.

verses.ar: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ
verses.en: And if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening Scripture.
verses.tr: wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kadhaba adh-dhīna min qablihim jāʾathum rusuluhum bi-l-bayyināti wabālzzuburi wabālkitābi al-munīri
verses.abdelhaleem: If they call you a liar, their predecessors did the same: messengers came to them with clear signs, scriptures, and enlightening revelation
verses.pickthall: And if they deny thee, those before them also denied. Their messengers came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), and with the Psalms and the Scripture giving light.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.en: Then I seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
verses.tr: thumma ʾakhadhtu adh-dhīna kafarūā ۖ fakayfa kāna nakīri
verses.abdelhaleem: and afterwards I seized the disbelievers- how terrible My punishment was!
verses.pickthall: Then seized I those who disbelieved, and how intense was My abhorrence!

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ
verses.en: Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna Allāh ʾanzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan fa-akhrajnā bihi thamarātin mmukhtalifan ʾalwānuhā ۚ wamina al-jibāli judadun bīḍun waḥumrun mmukhtalifun ʾalwānuhā wagharābību sūdun
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you [Prophet] not considered how God sends water down from the sky and that We produce with it fruits of varied colours; that there are in the mountains layers of white and red of various hues, and jet black;
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen that Allah causeth water to fall from the sky, and We produce therewith fruit of divers hues; and among the hills are streaks white and red, of divers hues, and (others) raven-black;

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
verses.en: And among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. Only those fear Allāh, from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.
verses.tr: wamina an-nāsi wa-ad-dawābbi wa-l-ʾanʿāmi mukhtalifun ʾalwānuhu kadhālika ۗ ʾinnamā yakhshā Allāh min ʿibādihi al-ʿulamā ۗ ʾinna Allāh ʿazīzun ghafūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: that there are various colours among human beings, wild animals, and livestock too? It is those of His servants who have knowledge who stand in true awe of God. God is almighty, most forgiving.
