verses.pickthall: And of men and beasts and cattle, in like manner, divers hues? The erudite among His bondmen fear Allah alone. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Forgiving.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَـٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً لَّن تَبُورَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who recite the Book of Allāh and establish prayer and spend [in His cause] out of what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, [can] expect a transaction [i.e., profit] that will never perish -
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yatlūna kitāba Allāh wa-aqāmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha wa-anfaqūā mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyahan yarjūna tijārahan llan tabūra
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who recite God’s scripture, keep up the prayer, give secretly and openly from what We have provided for them, may hope for a trade that will never decline:
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who read the Scripture of Allah, and establish worship, and spend of that which We have bestowed on them secretly and openly, they look forward to imperishable gain,

verses.ar: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verses.en: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.
verses.tr: liyuwaffiyahum ʾujūrahum wayazīdahum mmin faḍlihi ۚ ʾinnahu ghafūrun shakūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: He will repay them in full, and give them extra from His bounty. He is most forgiving, most appreciative.
verses.pickthall: That He will pay them their wages and increase them of His grace. Lo! He is Forgiving, Responsive.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: And that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], of the Book is the truth, confirming what was before it. Indeed Allāh, of His servants, is Aware and Seeing.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhā ʾawḥaynā ʾilayka mina al-kitābi huwa al-ḥaqqu muṣaddiqan llimā bayna yadayhi ۗ ʾinna Allāh biʿibādihi lakhabīrun baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: The Scripture We have revealed to you [Prophet] is the Truth and confirms the scriptures that preceded it. God is well informed about His servants, He sees everything.
verses.pickthall: As for that which We inspire in thee of the Scripture, it is the Truth confirming that which was (revealed) before it. Lo! Allah is indeed Observer, Seer of His slaves.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.en: Then We caused to inherit the Book those We have chosen of Our servants; and among them is he who wrongs himself [i.e., sins], and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of Allāh. That [inheritance] is what is the great bounty.
verses.tr: thumma ʾawrathnā al-kitāba adh-dhīna āṣṭafaynā min ʿibādinā ۖ faminhum ẓālimun llinafsihi waminhum mmuqtaṣidun waminhum sābiqun bi-l-khayrāti biʾidhni Allāh ۚ dhālika huwa al-faḍlu al-kabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave the Scripture as a heritage to Our chosen servants: some of them wronged their own souls, some stayed between [right and wrong], and some, by God’s leave, were foremost in good deeds. That is the greatest favour:
verses.pickthall: Then We gave the Scripture as inheritance unto those whom We elected of Our bondmen. But of them are some who wrong themselves and of them are some who are lukewarm, and of them are some who outstrip (others) through good deeds, by Allah's leave. That is the great favour!

verses.ar: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
verses.en: [For them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.
verses.tr: jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā yuḥallawna fīhā min ʾasāwira min dhahabin waluʾluʾan ۖ walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: they will enter lasting Gardens where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, where they will wear silk garments.
verses.pickthall: Gardens of Eden! They enter them wearing armlets of gold and pearl and their raiment therein is silk.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verses.en: And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -
verses.tr: waqālūā al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhā ʾadhhaba ʿannā al-ḥazana ۖ ʾinna rabbanā laghafūrun shakūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘Praise be to God, who has separated us from all sorrow! Our Lord is truly most forgiving, most appreciative:
verses.pickthall: And they say: Praise be to Allah Who hath put grief away from us. Lo! Our Lord is Forgiving, Bountiful,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ
verses.en: He who has settled us in the home of duration [i.e., Paradise] out of His bounty. There touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]."
verses.tr: adh-dhā ʾaḥallanā dāra al-muqāmahi min faḍlihi lā yamassunā fīhā naṣabun walā yamassunā fīhā lughūbun
verses.abdelhaleem: He has, in His bounty, settled us in the everlasting Home where no toil or fatigue will touch us.’
verses.pickthall: Who, of His grace, hath installed us in the mansion of eternity, where toil toucheth us not nor can weariness affect us.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍ
verses.en: And for those who disbelieve will be the fire of Hell. [Death] is not decreed for them so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. Thus do We recompense every ungrateful one.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā lahum nāru jahannama lā yuqḍā ʿalayhim fayamūtūā walā yukhaffafu ʿanhum mmin ʿadhābihā ۚ kadhālika najzā kulla kafūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who reject the truth will stay in Hellfire, where they will neither be finished off by death, nor be relieved from Hell’s torment: this is how We reward hardened disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: But as for those who disbelieve, for them is fire of hell; it taketh not complete effect upon them so that they can die, nor is its torment lightened for them. Thus We punish every ingrate.

verses.ar: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
verses.en: And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us; we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.
verses.tr: wahum yaṣṭarikhūna fīhā rabbanā ʾakhrijnā naʿmal ṣāliḥan ghayra adh-dhā kunnā naʿmalu ۚ ʾawalam nuʿammirkum mmā yatadhakkaru fīhi man tadhakkara wajāʾakumu an-nadhīru ۖ fadhūqūā famā lilẓẓālimīna min nnaṣīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: They will cry out loud in Hell, ‘Lord, let us out, and we will do righteous deeds, not what we did before!’- ‘ Did We not give you a life long enough to take warning if you were going to? The warner came to you, now taste the punishment.’ The evildoers will have nobody to help them.
verses.pickthall: And they cry for help there, (saying): Our Lord! Release us; we will do right, not (the wrong) that we used to do. Did not We grant you a life long enough for him who reflected to reflect therein? And the warner came unto you. Now taste (the flavour of your deeds), for evil-doers have no helper.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَـٰلِمُ غَيْبِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh is Knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh ʿālimu ghaybi as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ ʾinnahu ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: God knows all that is hidden in the heavens and earth; He knows the thoughts contained in the heart;
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah is the Knower of the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. Lo! He is Aware of the secret of (men's) breasts.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.en: It is He who has made you successors upon the earth. And whoever disbelieves - upon him will be [the consequence of] his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their Lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā jaʿalakum khalāʾifa fā al-ʾarḍi ۚ faman kafara faʿalayhi kufruhu ۖ walā yazīdu al-kāfirīna kufruhum ʿinda rabbihim ʾillā maqtan ۖ walā yazīdu al-kāfirīna kufruhum ʾillā khasāran
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who made you [people] successors to the land. Those who deny the truth will bear the consequences: their denial will only make them more odious to their Lord, and add only to their loss.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath made you regents in the earth; so he who disbelieveth, his disbelief be on his own head. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers, in their Lord's sight, naught save abhorrence. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers naught save loss.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verses.en: Say, "Have you considered your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with Him] in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [No], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum shurakāʾakumu adh-dhīna tadʿūna min dūni Allāh ʾarūnā mādhā khalaqūā mina al-ʾarḍi ʾam lahum shirkun fā as-samāwāti ʾam ātaynāhum kitāban fahum ʿalā bayyinatin mminhu ۚ bal ʾin yaʿidu aẓ-ẓālimūna baʿḍuhum baʿḍan ʾillā ghurūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Consider those “partners” of yours that you call upon beside God. Show me! What part of the earth did they create? What share of the heavens do they possess?’ Have We given them a book that contains clear evidence? No indeed! The idolaters promise each other only delusion.
verses.pickthall: Say: Have ye seen your partner-gods to whom ye pray beside Allah? Show me what they created of the earth! Or have they any portion in the heavens? Or have We given them a scripture so they act on clear proof therefrom? Nay, the evil-doers promise one another only to deceive.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing and Forgiving.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinna Allāh yumsiku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa ʾan tazūlā ۚ walaʾin zālatā ʾin ʾamsakahumā min ʾaḥadin mmin baʿdihi ۚ ʾinnahu kāna ḥalīman ghafūran
verses.abdelhaleem: God keeps the heavens and earth from vanishing; if they did vanish, no one else could stop them. God is most forbearing, most forgiving.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah graspeth the heavens and the earth that they deviate not, and if they were to deviate there is not one that could grasp them after Him. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.

verses.ar: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
verses.en: And they swore by Allāh their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion
verses.tr: wa-aqsamūā billāh jahda ʾaymānihim laʾin jāʾahum nadhīrun llayakūnunna ʾahdā min ʾiḥdā al-ʾumami ۖ falammā jāʾahum nadhīrun mmā zādahum ʾillā nufūran
verses.abdelhaleem: [The idolaters] swore their most solemn oath that, if someone came to warn them, they would be more rightly guided than any [other] community, but when someone did come they turned yet further away,
verses.pickthall: And they swore by Allah, their most binding oath, that if a warner came unto them they would be more tractable than any of the nations; yet, when a warner came unto them it aroused in them naught save repugnance,

verses.ar: ٱسْتِكْبَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا
verses.en: [Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way [i.e., fate] of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way [i.e., established method] of Allāh any change, and you will never find in the way of Allāh any alteration.
verses.tr: āstikbāran fā al-ʾarḍi wamakra as-sayyiʾi ۚ walā yaḥīqu al-makru as-sayyiʾu ʾillā biʾahlihi ۚ fahal yanẓurūna ʾillā sunnata al-ʾawwalīna ۚ falan tajida lisunnati Allāh tabdīlan ۖ walan tajida lisunnati Allāh taḥwīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: became more arrogant in the land, and intensified their plotting of evil- the plotting of evil only rebounds on those who plot. Do they expect anything but what happened to earlier people? You will never find any change in God’s practice; you will never find any deviation there.
verses.pickthall: (Shown in their) behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil; and the evil plot encloseth but the men who make it. Then, can they expect aught save the treatment of the folk of old? Thou wilt not find for Allah's way of treatment any substitute, nor wilt thou find for Allah's way of treatment aught of power to change.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا
verses.en: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allāh is not to be caused failure [i.e., prevented] by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yasīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fayanẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu adh-dhīna min qablihim wakānūā ʾashadda minhum quwwahan ۚ wamā kāna Allāh liyuʿjizahu min shāʾin fā as-samāwāti walā fā al-ʾarḍi ۚ ʾinnahu kāna ʿalīman qadīran
verses.abdelhaleem: Have they not travelled in the land and seen how those before them met their end, although they were superior to them in strength? God is not to be frustrated by anything in the heavens or on the earth: He is all knowing, all powerful.
verses.pickthall: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them, and they were mightier than these in power? Allah is not such that aught in the heavens or in the earth escapeth Him. Lo! He is the Wise, the Mighty.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا
verses.en: And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allāh has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.
verses.tr: walaw yuākhidhu Allāh an-nāsa bimā kasabūā mā taraka ʿalā ẓahrihā min dābbahin walākin yuʾakhiruhum ʾilā ʾajalin mmusammanā ۖ fa-idhā jāʾa ʾajaluhum fa-inna Allāh kāna biʿibādihi baṣīranā
verses.abdelhaleem: If God were to punish people [at once] for the wrong they have done, there would not be a single creature left on the surface of the earth. He gives them respite for a stated time and, whenever their time comes, God has been watching His servants.
verses.pickthall: If Allah took mankind to task by that which they deserve, He would not leave a living creature on the surface of the earth; but He reprieveth them unto an appointed term, and when their term cometh - then verily (they will know that) Allah is ever Seer of His slaves.

verses.ar: يسٓ
verses.en: Yā, Seen.
verses.tr: ys
verses.abdelhaleem: Ya Sin
verses.pickthall: Ya Sin.

verses.ar: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.en: By the wise Qur’ān,
verses.tr: wa-l-qurāni al-ḥakīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: By the wise Quran,
verses.pickthall: By the wise Qur'an,

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,
verses.tr: ʾinnaka lamina al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: you [Muhammad] are truly one of the mes-sengers sent
verses.pickthall: Lo! thou art of those sent

verses.ar: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: On a straight path.
verses.tr: ʿalā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: on a straight path,
verses.pickthall: On a straight path,

verses.ar: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.en: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
verses.tr: tanzīla al-ʿazīzi ar-raḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: with a revelation from the Almighty, the Lord of Mercy,
verses.pickthall: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,

verses.ar: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ
verses.en: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
verses.tr: litundhira qawman mmā ʾundhira ābāʾuhum fahum ghāfilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: to warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so they are unaware.
verses.pickthall: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
verses.tr: laqad ḥaqqa al-qawlu ʿalā ʾaktharihim fahum lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The verdict has been passed against most of them, for they refuse to believe.
verses.pickthall: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not.

verses.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَـٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
verses.tr: ʾinnā jaʿalnā fā ʾaʿnāqihim ʾaghlālan fahāa ʾilā al-ʾadhqāni fahum mmuqmaḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [It is as if] We had placed [iron] collars around their necks, right up to their chins so that their heads are forced up
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā min bayni ʾaydīhim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan fa-aghshaynāhum fahum lā yubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and set barriers before and behind them, blocking their vision: they cannot see.
verses.pickthall: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.

verses.ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
verses.tr: wasawāʾun ʿalayhim ʾaʾandhartahum ʾam lam tundhirhum lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is all the same to them whether you warn them or not: they will not believe.
verses.pickthall: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā tundhiru mani āttabaʿa adh-dhikra wakhashāa ar-raḥmāna bi-l-ghaybi ۖ fabashirhu bimaghfirahin wa-ajrin karīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: You can warn only those who will follow the Quran and hold the Merciful One in awe, though they cannot see Him: give such people the glad news of forgiveness and a noble reward.
verses.pickthall: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward.

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَـٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
verses.tr: ʾinnā naḥnu nuḥāi al-mawtā wanaktubu mā qaddamūā wathārahum ۚ wakulla shāʾin ʾaḥṣaynāhu fā ʾimāmin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall certainly bring the dead back to life, and We record what they send ahead of them as well as what they leave behind: We keep an account of everything in a clear Record.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register.

verses.ar: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.en: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
verses.tr: wāḍrib lahum mmathalan ʾaṣḥāba al-qaryahi ʾidh jāʾahā al-mursalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Give them the example of the people to whose town messengers came.
verses.pickthall: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;

verses.ar: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verses.en: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
verses.tr: ʾidh ʾarsalnā ʾilayhimu āthnayni fakadhabūhumā faʿazzaznā bithālithin faqālūā ʾinnā ʾilaykum mmursalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent two messengers but they rejected both. Then We reinforced them with a third. They said, ‘Truly, we are messengers to you,’
verses.pickthall: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
verses.en: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
verses.tr: qālūā mā ʾantum ʾillā basharun mmithlunā wamā ʾanzala ar-raḥmānu min shāʾin ʾin ʾantum ʾillā takdhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but they answered, ‘You are only men like ourselves. The Lord of Mercy has sent nothing; you are just lying.'
verses.pickthall: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie!

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.en: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
verses.tr: qālūā rabbunā yaʿlamu ʾinnā ʾilaykum lamursalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Our Lord knows that we have been sent to you.
verses.pickthall: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,

verses.ar: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
verses.tr: wamā ʿalaynā ʾillā al-balāghu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: Our duty is only to deliver the message to you,’
verses.pickthall: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
verses.tr: qālūā ʾinnā taṭayyarnā bikum ۖ laʾin llam tantahūā lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum mminnā ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: but they answered, ‘We think you are an evil omen. If you do not stop, we shall stone you, and inflict a painful torment on you.’
verses.pickthall: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ
verses.en: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
verses.tr: qālūā ṭāʾirukum mmaʿakum ۚ ʾaʾin dhukkirtum ۚ bal ʾantum qawmun mmusrifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The messengers said, ‘The evil omen is within yourselves. Why do you take it as an evil omen when you are reminded of the Truth? You are going too far!’
verses.pickthall: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk!

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
verses.tr: wajāʾa min ʾaqṣā al-madīnahi rajulun yasʿā qāla yāqawmi āttabiʿūā al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then, from the furthest part of the city, a man came running. He said, ‘My people, follow the messengers.
verses.pickthall: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!

verses.ar: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
verses.tr: āttabiʿūā man llā yaslukum ʾajran wahum mmuhtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Follow them: they are not asking you to reward them and they are rightly guided.
verses.pickthall: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.

verses.ar: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
verses.tr: wamā lāa lā ʾaʿbudu adh-dhā faṭaranā wa-ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why should I not worship the One who created me? It is to Him that you will be returned.
verses.pickthall: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?

verses.ar: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
verses.en: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
verses.tr: ʾaʾattakhidhu min dūnihi ālihahan ʾin yuridni ar-raḥmānu biḍurrin llā tughni ʿannā shafāʿatuhum shayā walā yunqidhūni
verses.abdelhaleem: How could I take besides Him any other gods, whose intercession will not help me and who would not be able to save me if the Lord of Mercy wished to harm me?
verses.pickthall: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save?

verses.ar: إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾidhan llafā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Then I would clearly be in the wrong.
verses.pickthall: Then truly I should be in error manifest.

verses.ar: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
verses.en: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
verses.tr: ʾinnā āmantu birabbikum fāsmaʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me!

verses.ar: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
verses.tr: qīla ādkhuli al-jannaha ۖ qāla yālayta qawmā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He was told, ‘Enter the Garden,’ so he said, ‘If only my people knew
verses.pickthall: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew

verses.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.en: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
verses.tr: bimā ghafara lā rabbā wajaʿalanā mina al-mukramīna
verses.abdelhaleem: how my Lord has forgiven me and set me among the highly honoured.’
verses.pickthall: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!

verses.ar: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
verses.en: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
verses.tr: ۞ wamā ʾanzalnā ʿalā qawmihi min baʿdihi min jundin mmina as-samāʾi wamā kunnā munzilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: After him We did not send any army from heaven against his people, nor were We about to:
verses.pickthall: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send.

verses.ar: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَـٰمِدُونَ
verses.en: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
verses.tr: ʾin kānat ʾillā ṣayḥahan wāḥidahan fa-idhā hum khāmidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: there was just one blast, and they fell down lifeless.
verses.pickthall: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.

verses.ar: يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
verses.tr: yāḥasrahan ʿalā al-ʿibādi ۚ mā yaʾtīhim mmin rrasūlin ʾillā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Alas for human beings! Whenever a messenger comes to them they ridicule him.
verses.pickthall: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him!

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
verses.tr: ʾalam yarawā kam ʾahlaknā qablahum mmina al-qurūni ʾannahum ʾilayhim lā yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not see how many generations We have destroyed before them, none of whom will ever come back to them?
verses.pickthall: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them;

verses.ar: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
verses.tr: wa-in kullun llammā jamīʿun lladaynā muḥḍarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Yet] all of them will be brought before Us.
verses.pickthall: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.

verses.ar: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
verses.tr: wayahun llahumu al-ʾarḍu al-maytahu ʾaḥyaynāhā wa-akhrajnā minhā ḥabban faminhu yaʾkulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There is a sign for them in the lifeless earth: We give it life and We produce grain from it for them to eat;
verses.pickthall: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof;

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
verses.en: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā fīhā jannātin mmin nnakhīlin wa-aʿnābin wafajjarnā fīhā mina al-ʿuyūni
verses.abdelhaleem: We have put gardens of date palms and grapes in the earth, and We have made springs of water gush out of it
verses.pickthall: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein,

verses.ar: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
verses.tr: liyaʾkulūā min thamarihi wamā ʿamilathu ʾaydīhim ۖ ʾafalā yashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so that they could eat its fruit. It was not their own hands that made all this. How can they not give thanks?
verses.pickthall: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?

verses.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
verses.tr: subḥāna adh-dhā khalaqa al-ʾazwāja kullahā mimmā tunbitu al-ʾarḍu wamin ʾanfusihim wamimmā lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Glory be to Him who created all the pairs of things that the earth produces, as well as themselves and other things they do not know about.
verses.pickthall: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not!

verses.ar: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
verses.en: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
verses.tr: wayahun llahumu al-ylu naslakhu minhu an-nahāra fa-idhā hum mmuẓlimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The night is also a sign for them: We strip the daylight from it, and- lo and behold!- they are in darkness.
verses.pickthall: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness.

verses.ar: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.en: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.tr: wa-ash-shamsu tajrā limustaqarrin llahā ۚ dhālika taqdīru al-ʿazīzi al-ʿalīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: The sun, too, runs its determined course laid down for it by the Almighty, the All Knowing.
verses.pickthall: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
verses.en: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
verses.tr: wa-l-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ʿāda ka-l-ʿurjūni al-qadīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: We have determined phases for the moon until finally it becomes like an old date-stalk.
verses.pickthall: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.

verses.ar: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
verses.en: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
verses.tr: lā ash-shamsu yanbaghā lahā ʾan tudrika al-qamara walā al-ylu sābiqu an-nahāri ۚ wakullun fā falakin yasbaḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The sun cannot overtake the moon, nor can the night outrun the day: each floats in [its own] orbit.
verses.pickthall: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.

verses.ar: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.en: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
verses.tr: wayahun llahum ʾannā ḥamalnā dhurriyyatahum fā al-fulki al-mashḥūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Another sign for them is that We carried their seed in the laden Ark,
verses.pickthall: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,

verses.ar: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
verses.en: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
verses.tr: wakhalaqnā lahum mmin mmithlihi mā yarkabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We have made similar things for them to ride in.
verses.pickthall: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.

verses.ar: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
verses.en: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
verses.tr: wa-in nnashaʾ nughriqhum falā ṣarīkha lahum walā hum yunqadhūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If We wished, We could drown them, and there would be no one to help them: they could not be saved.
verses.pickthall: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;

verses.ar: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
verses.tr: ʾillā raḥmahan mminnā wamatāʿan ʾilā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Only by Our mercy could they be reprieved to enjoy life for a while.
verses.pickthall: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.en: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy..."
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla lahumu āttaqūā mā bayna ʾaydīkum wamā khalfakum laʿallakum turḥamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet when they are told, ‘Beware of what lies before and behind you, so that you may be given mercy,’
verses.pickthall: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).

verses.ar: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.en: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
verses.tr: wamā taʾtīhim mmin āyahin mmin āyāti rabbihim ʾillā kānūā ʿanhā muʿriḍīna
verses.abdelhaleem: they ignore every single sign that comes to them from their Lord,
verses.pickthall: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla lahum ʾanfiqūā mimmā razaqakumu Allāh qāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lilladhīna āmanūā ʾanuṭʿimu man llaw yashāʾu Allāh ʾaṭʿamahu ʾin ʾantum ʾillā fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: and when they are told, ‘Give to others out of what God has provided for you,’ the disbelievers say to the believers, ‘Why should we feed those that God could feed if He wanted? You must be deeply misguided.’
verses.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.tr: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā al-waʿdu ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And they say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
verses.pickthall: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?

verses.ar: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
verses.en: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
verses.tr: mā yanẓurūna ʾillā ṣayḥahan wāḥidahan taʾkhudhuhum wahum yakhiṣṣimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But all they are waiting for is a single blast that will overtake them while they are still arguing with each other.
verses.pickthall: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.

verses.ar: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
verses.tr: falā yastaṭīʿūna tawṣiyahan walā ʾilā ʾahlihim yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will have no time to make bequests, nor will they have the chance to return to their own people.
verses.pickthall: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.

verses.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
verses.en: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
verses.tr: wanufikha fā aṣ-ṣūri fa-idhā hum mmina al-ʾajdāthi ʾilā rabbihim yansilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Trumpet will be sounded and- lo and behold!- they will rush out to their Lord from their graves.
verses.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.en: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
verses.tr: qālūā yāwaylanā man baʿathanā min mmarqadinā ۜ ۗ hādhā mā waʿada ar-raḥmānu waṣadaqa al-mursalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘Alas for us! Who has resurrected us from our resting places?’ [They will be told], ‘This is what the Lord of Mercy promised, and the messengers told the truth.’
verses.pickthall: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.

verses.ar: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.en: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
verses.tr: ʾin kānat ʾillā ṣayḥahan wāḥidahan fa-idhā hum jamīʿun lladaynā muḥḍarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It was just one single blast and then- lo and behold!- they were all brought before Us.
verses.pickthall: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!

verses.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
verses.tr: fa-l-yawma lā tuẓlamu nafsun shayā walā tujzawna ʾillā mā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Today, no soul will be wronged in the least: you will only be repaid for your deeds.
verses.pickthall: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.

verses.ar: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
verses.en: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
verses.tr: ʾinna ʾaṣḥāba al-jannahi al-yawma fā shughulin fākihūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Paradise today are happily occupied-
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,

verses.ar: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
verses.en: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
verses.tr: hum wa-azwājuhum fā ẓilālin ʿalā al-ʾarāʾiki muttakiwna
verses.abdelhaleem: they and their spouses- seated on couches in the shade.
verses.pickthall: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;

verses.ar: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
verses.en: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
verses.tr: lahum fīhā fākihahun walahum mmā yaddaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: There they have fruit and whatever they ask for.
verses.pickthall: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
verses.en: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
verses.tr: salāmun qawlan mmin rrabbin rraḥīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: “Peace,” a word from the Lord of Mercy.
verses.pickthall: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!

verses.ar: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
verses.tr: wāmtāzūā al-yawma ʾayyuhā al-mujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But step aside today, you guilty ones.
verses.pickthall: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!

verses.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
verses.tr: ۞ ʾalam ʾaʿhad ʾilaykum yābanā ādama ʾan llā taʿbudūā ash-shayṭāna ۖ ʾinnahu lakum ʿaduwwun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan, for he was your sworn enemy,
verses.pickthall: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -

verses.ar: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.en: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
verses.tr: wa-ani āʿbudūnā ۚ hādhā ṣirāṭun mmustaqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: but to serve Me? This is the straight path.
verses.pickthall: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
verses.tr: walaqad ʾaḍalla minkum jibillan kathīran ۖ ʾafalam takūnūā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He has led great numbers of you astray. Did you not use your reason?
verses.pickthall: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?

verses.ar: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
verses.tr: hādhihi jahannamu at-tā kuntum tūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So this is the Fire that you were warned against.
verses.pickthall: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).

verses.ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
verses.tr: āṣlawhā al-yawma bimā kuntum takfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Enter it today, because you went on ignoring [my commands].’
verses.pickthall: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.

verses.ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
verses.tr: al-yawma nakhtimu ʿalā ʾafwāhihim watukallimunā ʾaydīhim watashhadu ʾarjuluhum bimā kānūā yaksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day We shall seal up their mouths, but their hands will speak to Us, and their feet bear witness to everything they have done.
verses.pickthall: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
verses.tr: walaw nashāʾu laṭamasnā ʿalā ʾaʿyunihim fāstabaqūā aṣ-ṣirāṭa fa-annā yubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If it had been Our will, We could have taken away their sight. They would have struggled to find the way, but how could they have seen it?
verses.pickthall: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?

verses.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
verses.tr: walaw nashāʾu lamasakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim famā āstaṭāʿūā muḍiyyan walā yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If it had been Our will, We could have paralysed them where they stood, so that they could not move forward or backward.
verses.pickthall: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.

verses.ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
verses.tr: waman nnuʿammirhu nunakkishu fā al-khalqi ۖ ʾafalā yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If We extend anyone’s life, We reverse his development. Do they not use their reason?
verses.pickthall: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān
verses.tr: wamā ʿallamnāhu ash-shiʿra wamā yanbaghā lahu ۚ ʾin huwa ʾillā dhikrun waqurānun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: We have not taught the Prophet poetry, nor could he everhave been a poet.
verses.pickthall: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,

verses.ar: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.
verses.tr: lliyundhira man kāna ḥayyan wayaḥiqqa al-qawlu ʿalā al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a revelation, an illuminating Quran to warn anyone who is truly alive, so that God’s verdict may be passed against the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
verses.en: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
verses.tr: ʾawalam yarawā ʾannā khalaqnā lahum mmimmā ʿamilat ʾaydīnā ʾanʿāman fahum lahā mālikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Can they not see how, among the things made by Our hands, We have created livestock they control,
verses.pickthall: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,

verses.ar: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
verses.tr: wadhallalnāhā lahum faminhā rakūbuhum waminhā yaʾkulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and made them obedient, so that some can be used for riding, some for food,
verses.pickthall: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?

verses.ar: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
verses.tr: walahum fīhā manāfiʿu wamashāribu ۖ ʾafalā yashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: some for other benefits, and some for drink? Will they not give thanks?
verses.pickthall: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?

verses.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
verses.tr: wāttakhadhūā min dūni Allāh ālihahan llaʿallahum yunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet they have taken other gods besides God to help them,
verses.pickthall: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.

verses.ar: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
verses.en: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
verses.tr: lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrahum wahum lahum jundun mmuḥḍarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: though these could not do so even if they called a whole army of them together!
verses.pickthall: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.

verses.ar: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verses.en: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
verses.tr: falā yaḥzunka qawluhum ۘ ʾinnā naʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿlinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] do not be distressed at what they say: We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
verses.pickthall: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
verses.tr: ʾawalam yara al-ʾinsānu ʾannā khalaqnāhu min nnuṭfahin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Can man not see that We created him from a drop of fluid? Yet- lo and behold!- he disputes openly,
verses.pickthall: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.

verses.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
verses.en: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
verses.tr: waḍaraba lanā mathalan wanasāa khalqahu ۖ qāla man yuḥāi al-ʿiẓāma wahāa ramīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: producing arguments against Us, forgetting his own creation. He says, ‘Who can give life back to bones after they have decayed?’
verses.pickthall: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?

verses.ar: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
verses.tr: qul yuḥyīhā adh-dhā ʾanshaʾahā ʾawwala marrahin ۖ wahuwa bikulli khalqin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘He who created them in the first place will give them life again: He has full knowledge of every act of creation.
verses.pickthall: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
verses.en: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
verses.tr: adh-dhā jaʿala lakum mmina ash-shajari al-ʾakhḍari nāran fa-idhā ʾantum mminhu tūqidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who produces fire for you out of the green tree- lo and behold!- and from this you kindle fire.
verses.pickthall: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.

verses.ar: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
verses.tr: ʾawalaysa adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa biqādirin ʿalā ʾan yakhluqa mithlahum ۚ balā wahuwa al-khallāqu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Is He who created the heavens and earth not able to create the likes of these people? Of course He is! He is the All Knowing Creator:
verses.pickthall: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,

verses.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.en: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā ʾamruhu ʾidhā ʾarāda shayā ʾan yaqūla lahu kun fayakūnu
verses.abdelhaleem: when He wills something to be, His way is to say, “Be”- and it is!
verses.pickthall: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.

verses.ar: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
verses.tr: fasubḥāna adh-dhā biyadihi malakūtu kulli shāʾin wa-ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So glory be to Him in whose Hand lies control over all things. It is to Him that you will all be brought back.’
verses.pickthall: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.

verses.ar: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا
verses.en: By those [angels] lined up in rows
verses.tr: wa-aṣ-ṣāffāti ṣaffan
verses.abdelhaleem: By those [angels] ranged in rows,
verses.pickthall: By those who set the ranks in battle order

verses.ar: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
verses.en: And those who drive [the clouds]
verses.tr: fa-az-zājirāti zajran
verses.abdelhaleem: who rebuke reproachfully
verses.pickthall: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof

verses.ar: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
verses.en: And those who recite the message,
verses.tr: fa-at-tāliyāti dhikran
verses.abdelhaleem: and recite God’s word,
verses.pickthall: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,

verses.ar: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
verses.en: Indeed, your God is One,
verses.tr: ʾinna ʾilāhakum lawāḥidun
verses.abdelhaleem: truly your God is One,
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;

verses.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
verses.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
verses.tr: rrabbu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā warabbu al-mashāriqi
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them, Lord of every sunrise.
verses.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.

verses.ar: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
verses.en: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
verses.tr: ʾinnā zayyannā as-samāʾa ad-dunyā bizīnahin al-kawākibi
verses.abdelhaleem: We have adorned the lowest heaven with stars,
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;

verses.ar: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
verses.en: And as protection against every rebellious devil
verses.tr: waḥifẓan mmin kulli shayṭānin mmāridin
verses.abdelhaleem: and made them a safeguard against every rebellious devil:
verses.pickthall: With security from every froward devil.

verses.ar: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
verses.en: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
verses.tr: llā yassammaʿūna ʾilā al-malaʾi al-ʾaʿlā wayuqdhafūna min kulli jānibin
verses.abdelhaleem: they cannot eavesdrop on the Higher Assembly––pelted from every side,
verses.pickthall: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,

verses.ar: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
verses.en: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
verses.tr: duḥūran ۖ walahum ʿadhābun wāṣibun
verses.abdelhaleem: driven away, they will have perpetual torment––
verses.pickthall: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
verses.en: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
verses.tr: ʾillā man khaṭifa al-khaṭfaha fa-atbaʿahu shihābun thāqibun
verses.abdelhaleem: if any [of them] stealthily snatches away a fragment, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.
verses.pickthall: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.

verses.ar: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
verses.en: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.
verses.tr: fāstaftihim ʾahum ʾashaddu khalqan ʾam mman khalaqnā ۚ ʾinnā khalaqnāhum mmin ṭīnin llāzibin
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet], ask the disbelievers: is it harder to create them than other beings We have created? We created them from sticky clay.
verses.pickthall: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.

verses.ar: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
verses.en: But you wonder, while they mock,
verses.tr: bal ʿajibta wayaskharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You marvel as they scoff,
verses.pickthall: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
verses.en: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
verses.tr: wa-idhā dhukkirūā lā yadhkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: take no heed when they are warned,
verses.pickthall: And heed not when they are reminded,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
verses.en: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.
verses.tr: wa-idhā raʾawā āyahan yastaskhirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and resort to ridicule when they see a sign,
verses.pickthall: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
verses.tr: waqālūā ʾin hādhā ʾillā siḥrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: saying, ‘This is no more than blatant sorcery.’
verses.pickthall: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;

verses.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.en: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
verses.tr: ʾaʾidhā mitnā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman ʾaʾinnā lamabʿūthūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘What! After we have died and become dust and bones, shall we really be raised up again,
verses.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?

verses.ar: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.en: And our forefathers [as well]?"
verses.tr: ʾawaābāʾunā al-ʾawwalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: along with our forefathers?’
verses.pickthall: And our forefathers?

verses.ar: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
verses.tr: qul naʿam wa-antum dākhirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Yes indeed, and you will be humiliated.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
verses.tr: fa-innamā hāa zajrahun wāḥidahun fa-idhā hum yanẓurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Just one blast and––lo and behold!––they will look
verses.pickthall: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
verses.tr: waqālūā yāwaylanā hādhā yawmu ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgement.’
verses.pickthall: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
verses.tr: hādhā yawmu al-faṣli adh-dhā kuntum bihi tukadhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [It will be said], ‘This is the Day of Decision, which you used to deny.
verses.pickthall: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.

verses.ar: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
verses.tr: ۞ āḥshurūā adh-dhīna ẓalamūā wa-azwājahum wamā kānūā yaʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Angels], gather together those who did wrong, and others like them, as well as whatever they worshipped
verses.pickthall: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship

verses.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
verses.tr: min dūni Allāh fāhdūhum ʾilā ṣirāṭi al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: beside God, lead them all to the path of Hell,
verses.pickthall: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;

verses.ar: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
verses.en: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
verses.tr: waqifūhum ۖ ʾinnahum mmaswlūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and halt them for questioning:
verses.pickthall: And stop them, for they must be questioned.

verses.ar: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
verses.en: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
verses.tr: mā lakum lā tanāṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: “Why do you not support each other now?” ’––
verses.pickthall: What aileth you that ye help not one another?

verses.ar: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
verses.en: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
verses.tr: bal humu al-yawma mustaslimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: no indeed! They will be in complete submission on that Day––
verses.pickthall: Nay, but this day they make full submission.

verses.ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.
verses.tr: wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāʾalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will turn on one another accusingly.
verses.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
verses.tr: qālūā ʾinnakum kuntum taʾtūnanā ʿani al-yamīni
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘You came to us from a position of power.’
verses.pickthall: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
verses.tr: qālūā bal llam takūnūā muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘No! It was you who would not believe-
verses.pickthall: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
verses.en: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
verses.tr: wamā kāna lanā ʿalaykum mmin sulṭānin ۖ bal kuntum qawman ṭāghīna
verses.abdelhaleem: we had no power over you- and you were already exceeding all limits.
verses.pickthall: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.

verses.ar: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
verses.en: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
verses.tr: faḥaqqa ʿalaynā qawlu rabbinā ۖ ʾinnā ladhāʾiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Our Lord’s sentence on us is just and we must all taste the punishment.
verses.pickthall: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).

verses.ar: فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ
verses.en: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
verses.tr: fa-aghwaynākum ʾinnā kunnā ghāwīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We led you astray as we ourselves were astray.’
verses.pickthall: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
verses.en: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
verses.tr: fa-innahum yawmaʾidhin fā al-ʿadhābi mushtarikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day they will all share the torment:
verses.pickthall: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
verses.tr: ʾinnā kadhālika nafʿalu bi-l-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: this is how We deal with the guilty.
verses.pickthall: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.en: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant
verses.tr: ʾinnahum kānūā ʾidhā qīla lahum lā ʾilāha ʾillā Allāh yastakbirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever it was said to them, ‘There is no deity but God,’ they became arrogant,
verses.pickthall: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
verses.en: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
verses.tr: wayaqūlūna ʾaʾinnā latārikūā ālihatinā lishāʿirin mmajnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: and said, ‘Are we to forsake our gods for a mad poet?’
verses.pickthall: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?

verses.ar: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
verses.tr: bal jāʾa bi-l-ḥaqqi waṣaddaqa al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘No: he brought the truth and confirmed the earlier messengers;
verses.pickthall: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).

verses.ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
verses.en: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
verses.tr: ʾinnakum ladhāʾiqūā al-ʿadhābi al-ʾalīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: you will taste the painful torment,
verses.pickthall: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -

verses.ar: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
verses.tr: wamā tujzawna ʾillā mā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and be repaid only according to your deeds.’
verses.pickthall: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -

verses.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
verses.tr: ʾillā ʿibāda Allāh al-mukhlaṣīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Not so God’s true servants.
verses.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah;

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
verses.en: Those will have a provision determined -
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika lahum rizqun mmaʿlūmun
verses.abdelhaleem: They will have familiar provisions––
verses.pickthall: For them there is a known provision,

verses.ar: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
verses.en: Fruits; and they will be honored
verses.tr: fawākihu ۖ wahum mmukramūna
verses.abdelhaleem: fruits- and will be honoured
verses.pickthall: Fruits. And they will be honoured

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: In gardens of pleasure
verses.tr: fā jannāti an-naʿīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: in gardens of delight;
verses.pickthall: In the Gardens of delight,

verses.ar: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.en: On thrones facing one another.
verses.tr: ʿalā sururin mmutaqābilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: seated on couches, facing one another.
verses.pickthall: On couches facing one another;

verses.ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
verses.en: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
verses.tr: yuṭāfu ʿalayhim bikaʾsin mmin mmaʿīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: A drink will be passed round among them from a flowing spring:
verses.pickthall: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,

verses.ar: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
verses.en: White and delicious to the drinkers;
verses.tr: bayḍāʾa ladhahin llilshāribīna
verses.abdelhaleem: white, delicious to those who taste it,
verses.pickthall: White, delicious to the drinkers,

verses.ar: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
verses.en: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
verses.tr: lā fīhā ghawlun walā hum ʿanhā yunzafūna
verses.abdelhaleem: causing no headiness or intoxication.
verses.pickthall: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.

verses.ar: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
verses.en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
verses.tr: waʿindahum qāṣirātu aṭ-ṭarfi ʿīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: With them will be spouses- modest of gaze and beautiful of eye-
verses.pickthall: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
verses.en: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
verses.tr: kaʾannahunna bayḍun mmaknūnun
verses.abdelhaleem: like protected eggs.
verses.pickthall: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).

verses.ar: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
verses.tr: fa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāʾalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will turn to one another with questions:
verses.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.

verses.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
verses.en: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
verses.tr: qāla qāʾilun mminhum ʾinnā kāna lā qarīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: one will say, ‘I had a close companion on earth
verses.pickthall: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade

verses.ar: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
verses.en: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
verses.tr: yaqūlu ʾaʾinnaka lamina al-muṣaddiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: who used to ask me, “Do you really believe that
verses.pickthall: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?

verses.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
verses.en: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
verses.tr: ʾaʾidhā mitnā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman ʾaʾinnā lamadīnūna
verses.abdelhaleem: after we die and become dust and bone, we shall be brought for judgement?”’
verses.pickthall: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?

verses.ar: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
verses.en: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
verses.tr: qāla hal ʾantum mmuṭṭaliʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then he will say, ‘Shall we look for him?’
verses.pickthall: He saith: Will ye look?

verses.ar: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
verses.tr: fāṭṭalaʿa faraāhu fā sawāʾi al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: He will look down and see him in the midst of the Fire,
verses.pickthall: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.

verses.ar: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
verses.en: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.
verses.tr: qāla tallāh ʾin kidtta laturdīni
verses.abdelhaleem: and say to him, ‘By God, you almost brought me to ruin!
verses.pickthall: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
verses.en: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
verses.tr: walawlā niʿmahu rabbā lakuntu mina al-muḥḍarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I too would have been taken to Hell.’
verses.pickthall: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).

verses.ar: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
verses.en: Then, are we not to die
verses.tr: ʾafamā naḥnu bimayyitīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then he will say [to his blessed companions], ‘Are we never to die again after our earlier death?
verses.pickthall: Are we then not to die

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.en: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
verses.tr: ʾillā mawtatanā al-ʾūlā wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Shall we never suffer?
verses.pickthall: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.en: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā lahuwa al-fawzu al-ʿaẓīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: This truly is the supreme triumph!’
verses.pickthall: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.

verses.ar: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ
verses.en: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
verses.tr: limithli hādhā falyaʿmali al-ʿāmilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Everyone should strive to attain this.
verses.pickthall: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.

verses.ar: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.en: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?
verses.tr: ʾadhālika khayrun nnuzulan ʾam shajarahu az-zaqqūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Is this the better welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum,
verses.pickthall: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?

verses.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: ʾinnā jaʿalnāhā fitnahan llilẓẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: which we have made a test for the evildoers?
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.

verses.ar: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
verses.tr: ʾinnahā shajarahun takhruju fā ʾaṣli al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: This tree grows in the heart of the blazing Fire,
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.

verses.ar: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
verses.en: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
verses.tr: ṭalʿuhā kaʾannahu ruʾūsu ash-shayāṭīni
verses.abdelhaleem: and its fruits are like devils’ heads.
verses.pickthall: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils
