verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
verses.tr: fa-innahum lākilūna minhā famāliwna minhā al-buṭūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will fill their bellies eating from it;
verses.pickthall: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
verses.en: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
verses.tr: thumma ʾinna lahum ʿalayhā lashawban mmin ḥamīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: then drink scalding water on top of it;
verses.pickthall: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
verses.tr: thumma ʾinna marjiʿahum li-ʾilā al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: then return to the blazing Fire.
verses.pickthall: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
verses.en: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
verses.tr: ʾinnahum ʾalfawā ābāʾahum ḍāllīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They found their forefathers astray,
verses.pickthall: They indeed found their fathers astray,

verses.ar: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
verses.en: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
verses.tr: fahum ʿalā āthārihim yuhraʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and rushed to follow in their footsteps- before the disbelievers [of Mecca],
verses.pickthall: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
verses.tr: walaqad ḍalla qablahum ʾaktharu al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: most men in the past went astray,
verses.pickthall: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
verses.en: And We had already sent among them warners.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā fīhim mmundhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: even though We sent messengers to warn them.
verses.pickthall: And verily We sent among them warners.

verses.ar: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.en: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
verses.tr: fānẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mundharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: See how those who were warned met their end!
verses.pickthall: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,

verses.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
verses.tr: ʾillā ʿibāda Allāh al-mukhlaṣīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Not so the true servants of God.
verses.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
verses.en: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
verses.tr: walaqad nādānā nūḥun falaniʿma al-mujībūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Noah cried to Us, and how excellent was Our response!
verses.pickthall: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer

verses.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
verses.tr: wanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina al-karbi al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved him and his people from great distress,
verses.pickthall: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
verses.en: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā dhurriyyatahu humu al-bāqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We let his offspring remain on the earth,
verses.pickthall: And made his seed the survivors,

verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.tr: wataraknā ʿalayhi fā al-ākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We let him be praised by later generations:
verses.pickthall: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
verses.tr: salāmun ʿalā nūḥin fā al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Peace be upon Noah among all the nations!’
verses.pickthall: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.tr: ʾinnā kadhālika najzā al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is how We reward those who do good:
verses.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu min ʿibādinā al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: he was truly one of Our faithful servants.
verses.pickthall: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].
verses.tr: thumma ʾaghraqnā al-ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We drowned the rest.
verses.pickthall: Then We did drown the others.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.en: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
verses.tr: ۞ wa-inna min shīʿatihi laʾibrāhīma
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham was of the same faith:
verses.pickthall: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham

verses.ar: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
verses.en: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
verses.tr: ʾidh jāʾa rabbahu biqalbin salīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: he came to his Lord with a devoted heart.
verses.pickthall: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla liʾabīhi waqawmihi mādhā taʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are you worshipping?
verses.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?

verses.ar: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
verses.en: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?
verses.tr: ʾaʾifkan ālihahan dūna Allāh turīdūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How can you choose false gods instead of the true God?
verses.pickthall: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?

verses.ar: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
verses.tr: famā ẓannukum birabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So what is your opinion about the Lord of all the Worlds?’
verses.pickthall: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?

verses.ar: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.en: And he cast a look at the stars.
verses.tr: fanaẓara naẓrahan fā an-nujūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: then he looked up to the stars.
verses.pickthall: And he glanced a glance at the stars

verses.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
verses.en: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
verses.tr: faqāla ʾinnā saqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘I am sick,’
verses.pickthall: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
verses.en: So they turned away from him, departing.
verses.tr: fatawallawā ʿanhu mudbirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: so [his people] turned away from him and left.
verses.pickthall: And they turned their backs and went away from him.

verses.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
verses.tr: farāgha ʾilā ālihatihim faqāla ʾalā taʾkulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He turned to their gods and said, ‘Do you not eat?
verses.pickthall: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?

verses.ar: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
verses.en: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".
verses.tr: mā lakum lā tanṭiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why do you not speak?’
verses.pickthall: What aileth you that ye speak not?

verses.ar: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
verses.tr: farāgha ʿalayhim ḍarbanā bi-l-yamīni
verses.abdelhaleem: then he turned and struck them with his right arm.
verses.pickthall: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.

verses.ar: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
verses.en: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.
verses.tr: fa-aqbalūā ʾilayhi yaziffūna
verses.abdelhaleem: His people hurried towards him,
verses.pickthall: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
verses.tr: qāla ʾataʿbudūna mā tanḥitūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but he said, ‘How can you worship things you carve with your own hands,
verses.pickthall: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"
verses.tr: wallāh khalaqakum wamā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: when it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?’
verses.pickthall: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."
verses.tr: qālūā ābnūā lahu bunyānan fa-ʾalqūhu fā al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Build a pyre and throw him into the blazing fire.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.

verses.ar: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
verses.en: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.
verses.tr: fa-arādūā bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu al-ʾasfalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They wanted to harm him, but We humiliated them.
verses.pickthall: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.en: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
verses.tr: waqāla ʾinnā dhāhibun ʾilā rabbā sayahdīni
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘I will go to my Lord: He is sure to guide me.
verses.pickthall: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.

verses.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
verses.tr: rabbi hab lā mina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord, grant me a righteous son,’
verses.pickthall: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.

verses.ar: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
verses.en: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
verses.tr: fabasharnāhu bighulāmin ḥalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: so We gave him the good news that he would have a patient son.
verses.pickthall: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."
verses.tr: falammā balagha maʿahu as-saʿāa qāla yābunāa ʾinnā ʾarā fā al-manāmi ʾannā ʾadhbaḥuka fānẓur mādhā tarā ۚ qāla yāʾabati āfʿal mā tuʾmaru ۖ satajidunā ʾin shāʾa Allāh mina aṣ-ṣābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the boy was old enough to work with his father, Abraham said, ‘My son, I have seen myself sacrificing you in a dream. What do you think?’ He said, ‘Father, do as you are commanded and, God willing, you will find me steadfast.’
verses.pickthall: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
verses.en: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
verses.tr: falammā ʾaslamā watallahu liljabīni
verses.abdelhaleem: When they had both submitted to God, and he had laid his son down on the side of his face,
verses.pickthall: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,

verses.ar: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verses.en: We called to him, "O Abraham,
verses.tr: wanādaynāhu ʾan yāʾibrāhīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: We called out to him, ‘Abraham,
verses.pickthall: We called unto him: O Abraham!

verses.ar: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.tr: qad ṣaddaqta ar-ruʾyā ۚ ʾinnā kadhālika najzā al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: you have fulfilled the dream.’ This is how We reward those who do good-
verses.pickthall: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā lahuwa al-balā al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: it was a test to prove [their true characters]-
verses.pickthall: Lo! that verily was a clear test.

verses.ar: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
verses.tr: wafadaynāhu bidhibḥin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: We ransomed his son with a momentous sacrifice,
verses.pickthall: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.

verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.tr: wataraknā ʿalayhi fā al-ākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We let him be praised by succeeding generations:
verses.pickthall: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.en: "Peace upon Abraham."
verses.tr: salāmun ʿalā ʾibrāhīma
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Peace be upon Abraham!’
verses.pickthall: Peace be unto Abraham!

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.tr: kadhālika najzā al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is how We reward those who do good:
verses.pickthall: Thus do We reward the good.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu min ʿibādinā al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.
verses.pickthall: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

verses.ar: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
verses.tr: wabasharnāhu biʾisḥāqa nabiyyan mmina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave Abraham the good news of Isaac- a prophet and a righteous man-
verses.pickthall: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.

verses.ar: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
verses.en: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].
verses.tr: wabāraknā ʿalayhi waʿalā ʾisḥāqa ۚ wamin dhurriyyatihimā muḥsinun waẓālimun llinafsihi mubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: and blessed him and Isaac too: some of their offspring were good, but some clearly wronged themselves.
verses.pickthall: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
verses.en: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
verses.tr: walaqad manannā ʿalā mūsā wahārūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We also bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron:
verses.pickthall: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron,

verses.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
verses.tr: wanajjaynāhumā waqawmahumā mina al-karbi al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved them and their people from great distress;
verses.pickthall: And saved them and their people from the great distress,

verses.ar: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.en: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
verses.tr: wanaṣarnāhum fakānūā humu al-ghālibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We helped them, so they were the ones to succeed;
verses.pickthall: And helped them so that they became the victors.

verses.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
verses.en: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],
verses.tr: wataynāhumā al-kitāba al-mustabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave them the Scripture that makes things clear;
verses.pickthall: And We gave them the clear Scripture

verses.ar: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
verses.en: And We guided them on the straight path.
verses.tr: wahadaynāhumā aṣ-ṣirāṭa al-mustaqīma
verses.abdelhaleem: We guided them to the right path;
verses.pickthall: And showed them the right path.

verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.tr: wataraknā ʿalayhimā fā al-ākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We let them be praised by succeeding generations:
verses.pickthall: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation):

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
verses.en: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
verses.tr: salāmun ʿalā mūsā wahārūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Peace be upon Moses and Aaron!’
verses.pickthall: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.tr: ʾinnā kadhālika najzā al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is how We reward those who do good:
verses.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
verses.tr: ʾinnahumā min ʿibādinā al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: truly they were among Our faithful servants.
verses.pickthall: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
verses.tr: wa-inna ʾilyāsa lamina al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Elijah too was one of the messengers.
verses.pickthall: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla liqawmihi ʾalā tattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said to his people, ‘Have you no fear of God?
verses.pickthall: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

verses.ar: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
verses.en: Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -
verses.tr: ʾatadʿūna baʿlan watadharūna ʾaḥsana al-khāliqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: How can you invoke Baal and forsake the Most Gracious Creator,
verses.pickthall: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,

verses.ar: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
verses.tr: Allāh rabbakum warabba ābāʾikumu al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’
verses.pickthall: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verses.en: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
verses.tr: fakadhabūhu fa-innahum lamuḥḍarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but they rejected him. They will be brought to punishment as a consequence;
verses.pickthall: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)

verses.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.
verses.tr: ʾillā ʿibāda Allāh al-mukhlaṣīna
verses.abdelhaleem: not so the true servants of God.
verses.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.

verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.tr: wataraknā ʿalayhi fā al-ākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We let him be praised by succeeding generations:
verses.pickthall: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
verses.en: "Peace upon Elias."
verses.tr: salāmun ʿalā ʾil yāsīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Peace be to Elijah!’
verses.pickthall: Peace be unto Elias!

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.tr: ʾinnā kadhālika najzā al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is how We reward those who do good:
verses.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu min ʿibādinā al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.
verses.pickthall: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
verses.tr: wa-inna lūṭan llamina al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Lot was also one of the messengers.
verses.pickthall: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).

verses.ar: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
verses.tr: ʾidh najjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved him and all his family-
verses.pickthall: When We saved him and his household, every one,

verses.ar: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].
verses.tr: ʾillā ʿajūzan fā al-ghābirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: except for an old woman who stayed behind-
verses.pickthall: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Then We destroyed the others.
verses.tr: thumma dammarnā al-ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We destroyed the rest.
verses.pickthall: Then We destroyed the others.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
verses.tr: wa-innakum latamurrūna ʿalayhim mmuṣbiḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You [people] pass by their ruins morning
verses.pickthall: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning

verses.ar: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
verses.tr: wabāllayli ۗ ʾafalā taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and night: will you not take heed?
verses.pickthall: And at night-time; have ye then no sense?

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
verses.tr: wa-inna yūnusa lamina al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Jonah too was one of the messengers.
verses.pickthall: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)

verses.ar: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.en: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
verses.tr: ʾidh ʾabaqa ʾilā al-fulki al-mashḥūni
verses.abdelhaleem: He fled to the overloaded ship.
verses.pickthall: When he fled unto the laden ship,

verses.ar: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
verses.en: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
verses.tr: fasāhama fakāna mina al-mudḥaḍīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They cast lots, he suffered defeat,
verses.pickthall: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;

verses.ar: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.en: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
verses.tr: fa-at-taqamahu al-ḥūtu wahuwa mulīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: and a great fish swallowed him, for he had committed blameworthy acts.
verses.pickthall: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
verses.en: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,
verses.tr: falawlā ʾannahu kāna mina al-musabbiḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If he had not been one of those who glorified God,
verses.pickthall: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)

verses.ar: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
verses.tr: lalabitha fā baṭnihi ʾilā yawmi yubʿathūna
verses.abdelhaleem: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day when all are raised up,
verses.pickthall: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;

verses.ar: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
verses.en: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
verses.tr: ۞ fanabadhnāhu bi-l-ʿarāʾi wahuwa saqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: but We cast him out, sick, on to a barren shore,
verses.pickthall: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;

verses.ar: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
verses.en: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
verses.tr: wa-anbatnā ʿalayhi shajarahan mmin yaqṭīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: and made a gourd tree grow above him.
verses.pickthall: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;

verses.ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verses.en: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
verses.tr: wa-arsalnāhu ʾilā māʾahi ʾalfin ʾaw yazīdūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent him to a hundred thousand people or more.
verses.pickthall: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more

verses.ar: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
verses.tr: fāmanūā famattaʿnāhum ʾilā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: They believed, so We let them live out their lives.
verses.pickthall: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.

verses.ar: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.en: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
verses.tr: fāstaftihim ʾalirabbika al-banātu walahumu al-banūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Now [Muhammad], ask the disbelievers: is it true that your Lord has daughters, while they choose sons for themselves?
verses.pickthall: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?

verses.ar: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
verses.en: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
verses.tr: ʾam khalaqnā al-malāʾikaha ʾināthan wahum shāhidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We create the angels as females while they were watching?
verses.pickthall: Or created We the angels females while they were present?

verses.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.en: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
verses.tr: ʾalā ʾinnahum mmin ʾifkihim layaqūlūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say,
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:

verses.ar: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
verses.tr: walada Allāh wa-innahum lakādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘God has begotten.’ How they lie!
verses.pickthall: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.

verses.ar: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
verses.en: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
verses.tr: ʾaṣṭafā al-banāti ʿalā al-banīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Did He truly choose daughters in preference to sons?
verses.pickthall: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.

verses.ar: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.en: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
verses.tr: mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What is the matter with you? How do you form your judgements?
verses.pickthall: What aileth you? How judge ye?

verses.ar: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Then will you not be reminded?
verses.tr: ʾafalā tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you not reflect?
verses.pickthall: Will ye not then reflect?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Or do you have a clear authority?
verses.tr: ʾam lakum sulṭānun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you perhaps have clear authority?
verses.pickthall: Or have ye a clear warrant?

verses.ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
verses.tr: fa-tūā bikitābikum ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Bring your scriptures, if you are telling the truth.
verses.pickthall: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verses.en: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].
verses.tr: wajaʿalūā baynahu wabayna al-jinnahi nasaban ۚ walaqad ʿalimati al-jinnahu ʾinnahum lamuḥḍarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They claim that He has kinship with the jinn, yet the jinn themselves know that they will be brought before Him.
verses.pickthall: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).

verses.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.en: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,
verses.tr: subḥāna Allāh ʿammā yaṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God is far above what they attribute to Him-
verses.pickthall: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),

verses.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].
verses.tr: ʾillā ʿibāda Allāh al-mukhlaṣīna
verses.abdelhaleem: the true servants of God do not do such things-
verses.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
verses.tr: fa-innakum wamā taʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and neither you nor what you worship
verses.pickthall: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,

verses.ar: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
verses.en: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
verses.tr: mā ʾantum ʿalayhi bifātinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: can lure away from God any
verses.pickthall: Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him.

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
verses.tr: ʾillā man huwa ṣāli al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: except those who will burn in Hell.
verses.pickthall: Save him who is to burn in hell.

verses.ar: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
verses.en: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
verses.tr: wamā minnā ʾillā lahu maqāmun mmaʿlūmun
verses.abdelhaleem: [The angels say], ‘Every single one of us has his appointed place:
verses.pickthall: There is not one of us but hath his known position.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
verses.en: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
verses.tr: wa-innā lanaḥnu aṣ-ṣāffūna
verses.abdelhaleem: we are ranged in ranks.
verses.pickthall: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."
verses.tr: wa-innā lanaḥnu al-musabbiḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We glorify God.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise

verses.ar: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,
verses.tr: wa-in kānūā layaqūlūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [The disbelievers] used to say,
verses.pickthall: And indeed they used to say:

verses.ar: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
verses.tr: law ʾanna ʿindanā dhikran mmina al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘If only we had a scripture like previous people,
verses.pickthall: If we had but a reminder from the men of old

verses.ar: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."
verses.tr: lakunnā ʿibāda Allāh al-mukhlaṣīna
verses.abdelhaleem: we would be true servants of God,’
verses.pickthall: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.

verses.ar: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
verses.tr: fakafarūā bihi ۖ fasawfa yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: yet now they reject [the Quran]. They will soon realize.
verses.pickthall: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
verses.tr: walaqad sabaqat kalimatunā liʿibādinā al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Our word has already been given to Our servants the messengers:
verses.pickthall: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
verses.en: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
verses.tr: ʾinnahum lahumu al-manṣūrūna
verses.abdelhaleem: it is they who will be helped,
verses.pickthall: That they verily would be helped,

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
verses.en: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.
verses.tr: wa-inna jundanā lahumu al-ghālibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and the ones who support Our cause will be the winners.
verses.pickthall: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.
verses.tr: fatawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
verses.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,

verses.ar: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
verses.tr: wa-abṣirhum fasawfa yubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Watch them: they will soon see.
verses.pickthall: And watch, for they will (soon) see.

verses.ar: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.en: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
verses.tr: ʾafabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they really wish to hasten Our punishment?
verses.pickthall: Would they hasten on Our doom?

verses.ar: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.en: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
verses.tr: fa-idhā nazala bisāḥatihim fasāʾa ṣabāḥu al-mundharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When it descends on their courtyards, how ter-rible that morning will be for those who were warned!
verses.pickthall: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.

verses.ar: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: And leave them for a time.
verses.tr: watawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
verses.pickthall: Withdraw from them awhile

verses.ar: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And see, for they are going to see.
verses.tr: wa-abṣir fasawfa yubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Watch them: they will soon see.
verses.pickthall: And watch, for they will (soon) see.

verses.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.en: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
verses.tr: subḥāna rabbika rabbi al-ʿizzahi ʿammā yaṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord, the Lord of Glory, is far above what they attribute to Him.
verses.pickthall: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)

verses.ar: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And peace upon the messengers.
verses.tr: wasalāmun ʿalā al-mursalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Peace be upon the messengers
verses.pickthall: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).

verses.ar: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: wa-l-ḥamdu lillāh rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and praise be to God the Lord of all the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!

verses.ar: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
verses.en: Ṣād. By the Qur’ān containing reminder...
verses.tr: ṣ ۚ wa-l-qurāni dhā adh-dhikri
verses.abdelhaleem: Sad By the Quran with its reminding . . .!
verses.pickthall: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
verses.en: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
verses.tr: bali adh-dhīna kafarūā fā ʿizzahin washiqāqin
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet the disbelievers are steeped in arrogance and hostility.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.

verses.ar: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
verses.en: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
verses.tr: kam ʾahlaknā min qablihim mmin qarnin fanādawā wwalāta ḥīna manāṣin
verses.abdelhaleem: How many generations We have destroyed before them! They all cried out, once it was too late, for escape.
verses.pickthall: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!

verses.ar: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
verses.en: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
verses.tr: waʿajibūā ʾan jāʾahum mmundhirun mminhum ۖ waqāla al-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhābun
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers think it strange that a prophet of their own people has come to warn them: they say, ‘He is just a lying sorcerer.
verses.pickthall: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.

verses.ar: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
verses.en: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
verses.tr: ʾajaʿala al-ālihaha ʾilāhan wāḥidan ۖ ʾinna hādhā lashāʾun ʿujābun
verses.abdelhaleem: How can he claim that all the gods are but one God? What an astonishing thing [to claim]!’
verses.pickthall: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.

verses.ar: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
verses.en: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
verses.tr: wānṭalaqa al-malaʾu minhum ʾani āmshūā wāṣbirūā ʿalā ālihatikum ۖ ʾinna hādhā lashāʾun yurādu
verses.abdelhaleem: Their leaders depart, saying, ‘Walk away! Stay faithful to your gods! That is what you must do.
verses.pickthall: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.

verses.ar: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
verses.en: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
verses.tr: mā samiʿnā bihādhā fā al-millahi al-ākhirahi ʾin hādhā ʾillā ākhtilāqun
verses.abdelhaleem: We did not hear any such claim in the last religion: it is all an invention.
verses.pickthall: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.

verses.ar: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
verses.en: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
verses.tr: ʾaʾunzila ʿalayhi adh-dhikru min bayninā ۚ bal hum fā shakkin mmin dhikrā ۖ bal llammā yadhūqūā ʿadhābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Was the message sent only to him out of all of us?’ In fact they doubt My warning; in fact they have not tasted My punishment yet.
verses.pickthall: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.

verses.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
verses.en: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
verses.tr: ʾam ʿindahum khazāʾinu raḥmahi rabbika al-ʿazīzi al-wahhābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord’s bounty, the Mighty, the All Giving?
verses.pickthall: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
verses.tr: ʾam lahum mmulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā ۖ falyartaqūā fā al-ʾasbābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they control the heavens and earth and everything between? Let them climb their ropes:
verses.pickthall: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!

verses.ar: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verses.en: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
verses.tr: jundun mmā hunālika mahzūmun mmina al-ʾaḥzābi
verses.abdelhaleem: their armed alliance is weak and will be crushed.
verses.pickthall: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
verses.tr: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wafirʿawnu dhū al-ʾawtādi
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Noah, Ad, and firmly-supported Pharaoh rejected their prophets before them.
verses.pickthall: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,

verses.ar: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
verses.en: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.
verses.tr: wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭin wa-aṣḥābu lykahi ۚ ʾūlāʾika al-ʾaḥzābu
verses.abdelhaleem: Thamud, the people of Lot, and the Forest-Dwellers each formed opposition [against theirs].
verses.pickthall: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions.

verses.ar: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verses.en: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
verses.tr: ʾin kullun ʾillā kadhaba ar-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: They all rejected the mes-sengers and they were deservedly struck by My punishment:
verses.pickthall: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,

verses.ar: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
verses.en: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
verses.tr: wamā yanẓuru hāʾulāʾi ʾillā ṣayḥahan wāḥidahan mmā lahā min fawāqin
verses.abdelhaleem: all the disbelievers here are waiting for is a single blast that cannot be postponed.
verses.pickthall: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
verses.tr: waqālūā rabbanā ʿajjil llanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi al-ḥisābi
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘Our Lord! Advance us our share of punishment before the Day of Reckoning!’
verses.pickthall: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.

verses.ar: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.en: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].
verses.tr: āṣbir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wādhkur ʿabdanā dāwuda dhā al-ʾaydi ۖ ʾinnahu ʾawwābun
verses.abdelhaleem: Bear their words patiently [Prophet]. Remember Our servant David, a man of strength who always turned to Us:
verses.pickthall: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).

verses.ar: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verses.en: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
verses.tr: ʾinnā sakharnā al-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥna bi-l-ʿashāi wa-l-ʾishrāqi
verses.abdelhaleem: We made the mountains join him in glorifying Us at sunset and sunrise;
verses.pickthall: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,

verses.ar: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.en: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
verses.tr: wa-aṭ-ṭayra maḥshūrahan ۖ kullun llahu ʾawwābun
verses.abdelhaleem: and the birds, too, in flocks, all echoed his praise.
verses.pickthall: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.

verses.ar: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.en: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
verses.tr: washadadnā mulkahu wataynāhu al-ḥikmaha wafaṣla al-khiṭābi
verses.abdelhaleem: We strengthened his kingdom; We gave him wisdom and a decisive way of speaking.
verses.pickthall: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.

verses.ar: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
verses.en: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
verses.tr: ۞ wahal ʾatāka nabaā al-khaṣmi ʾidh tasawwarūā al-miḥrāba
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you heard the story of the two litigants who climbed into his private quarters?
verses.pickthall: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber;

verses.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verses.en: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
verses.tr: ʾidh dakhalūā ʿalā dāwuda fafaziʿa minhum ۖ qālūā lā takhaf ۖ khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fāḥkum baynanā bi-l-ḥaqqi walā tushṭiṭ wāhdinā ʾilā sawāʾi aṣ-ṣirāṭi
verses.abdelhaleem: When they reached David, he took fright, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid. We are two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other: judge between us fairly- do not be unjust- and guide us to the right path.
verses.pickthall: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.en: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā ʾakhā lahu tisʿun watisʿūna naʿjahan walāa naʿjahun wāḥidahun faqāla ʾakfilnīhā waʿazzanā fā al-khiṭābi
verses.abdelhaleem: This is my brother. He had ninety-nine ewes and I just the one, and he said, “Let me take charge of her,” and overpowered me with his words.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩
verses.en: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
verses.tr: qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ʾilā niʿājihi ۖ wa-inna kathīran mmina al-khulaṭāʾi layabghā baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin ʾillā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlun mmā hum ۗ waẓanna dāwudu ʾannamā fatannāhu fāstaghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿan wa-anāba ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: David said, ‘He has done you wrong by demanding to add your ewe to his flock. Many partners treat each other unfairly. Those who sincerely believe and do good deeds do not do this, but these are very few.’ [Then] David realized that We had been testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness, fell down on his knees, and repented:
verses.pickthall: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.

verses.ar: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.en: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
verses.tr: faghafarnā lahu dhālika ۖ wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazulfā waḥusna mābin
verses.abdelhaleem: We forgave him [his misdeed]. His reward will be nearness to Us, a good place to return to.
verses.pickthall: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end.

verses.ar: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
verses.tr: yādāwudu ʾinnā jaʿalnāka khalīfahan fā al-ʾarḍi fāḥkum bayna an-nāsi bi-l-ḥaqqi walā tattabiʿi al-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli Allāh ۚ ʾinna adh-dhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli Allāh lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasūā yawma al-ḥisābi
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘David, We have given you mastery over the land. Judge fairly between people. Do not follow your desires, lest they divert you from God’s path: those who wander from His path will have a painful torment because they ignore the Day of Reckoning.’
verses.pickthall: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
verses.tr: wamā khalaqnā as-samāʾa wa-l-ʾarḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan ۚ dhālika ẓannu adh-dhīna kafarūā ۚ fawaylun llilladhīna kafarūā mina an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: It was not without purpose that We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between. That may be what the disbelievers assume- how they will suffer from the Fire!-
verses.pickthall: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire!

verses.ar: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
verses.en: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?
verses.tr: ʾam najʿalu adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ka-l-mufsidīna fā al-ʾarḍi ʾam najʿalu al-muttaqīna ka-l-fujjāri
verses.abdelhaleem: but would We treat those who believe and do good deeds and those who spread corruption on earth as equal? Would We treat those who are aware of God and those who recklessly break all bounds in the same way?
verses.pickthall: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked?

verses.ar: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
verses.tr: kitābun ʾanzalnāhu ʾilayka mubārakun lliyaddabbarūā āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ʾūlūā al-ʾalbābi
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a blessed Scripture which We sent down to you [Muhammad], for people to think about its messages, and for those with understanding to take heed.
verses.pickthall: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect.

verses.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.en: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
verses.tr: wawahabnā lidāwuda sulaymāna ۚ niʿma al-ʿabdu ۖ ʾinnahu ʾawwābun
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave David Solomon. He was an excellent servant who always turned to God.
verses.pickthall: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).

verses.ar: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
verses.en: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
verses.tr: ʾidh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bi-l-ʿashāi aṣ-ṣāfinātu al-jiyādu
verses.abdelhaleem: When well-bred light-footed horses were paraded before him near the close of day,
verses.pickthall: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers

verses.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verses.en: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
verses.tr: faqāla ʾinnā ʾaḥbabtu ḥubba al-khayri ʿan dhikri rabbā ḥattā tawārat bi-l-ḥijābi
verses.abdelhaleem: he kept saying, ‘My love of fine things is part of my remembering my Lord!’ until [the horses] disappeared from sight-
verses.pickthall: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain.

verses.ar: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
verses.en: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
verses.tr: ruddūhā ʿalāa ۖ faṭafiqa masḥanā bi-as-sūqi wa-l-ʾaʿnāqi
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Bring them back!’ [he said] and started to stroke their legs and necks.
verses.pickthall: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verses.en: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
verses.tr: walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-ā ʿalā kursiyyihi jasadan thumma ʾanāba
verses.abdelhaleem: We certainly tested Solomon, reducing him to a mere skeleton on his throne.
verses.pickthall: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi āghfir lā wahab lā mulkan llā yanbaghā liʾaḥadin mmin baʿdā ۖ ʾinnaka ʾanta al-wahhābu
verses.abdelhaleem: He turned to Us and prayed: ‘Lord forgive me! Grant me such power as no one after me will have- You are the Most Generous Provider.’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.

verses.ar: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
verses.en: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
verses.tr: fasakharnā lahu ar-rīḥa tajrā biʾamrihi rukhāʾan ḥaythu ʾaṣāba
verses.abdelhaleem: So We gave him power over the wind, which at his request ran gently wherever he willed,
verses.pickthall: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended.

verses.ar: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
verses.en: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver.
verses.tr: wa-ash-shayāṭīna kulla bannāʾin waghawwāṣin
verses.abdelhaleem: and the jinn––every kind of builder and diver
verses.pickthall: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient),

verses.ar: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verses.en: And others bound together in irons.
verses.tr: wakharīna muqarranīna fā al-ʾaṣfādi
verses.abdelhaleem: and others chained in fetters.
verses.pickthall: And others linked together in chains,

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.en: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
verses.tr: hādhā ʿaṭāʾunā fāmnun ʾaw ʾamsik bighayri ḥisābin
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘This is Our gift, so give or withhold as you wish without account.’
verses.pickthall: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.en: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
verses.tr: wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazulfā waḥusna mābin
verses.abdelhaleem: His reward will be nearness to Us, and a good place to return to.
verses.pickthall: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
verses.en: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
verses.tr: wādhkur ʿabdanā ʾayyūba ʾidh nādā rabbahu ʾannā massanāa ash-shayṭānu binuṣbin waʿadhābin
verses.abdelhaleem: Bring to mind Our servant Job who cried to his Lord, ‘Satan has afflicted me with weariness and suffering.’
verses.pickthall: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment.

verses.ar: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
verses.en: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
verses.tr: ārkuḍ birijlika ۖ hādhā mughtasalun bāridun washarābun
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Stamp your foot! Here is cool water for you to wash in and drink,’
verses.pickthall: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink.

verses.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
verses.tr: wawahabnā lahu ʾahlahu wamithlahum mmaʿahum raḥmahan mminnā wadhikrā liʾūlā al-ʾalbābi
verses.abdelhaleem: and We restored his family to him, with many more like them: a sign of Our mercy and a lesson to all who understand.
verses.pickthall: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding.

verses.ar: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.en: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
verses.tr: wakhudh biyadika ḍighthan fāḍrib bbihi walā taḥnath ۗ ʾinnā wajadnāhu ṣābiran ۚ nniʿma al-ʿabdu ۖ ʾinnahu ʾawwābun
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Take a small bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [her] with that so as not to break your oath.’ We found him patient in adversity; an excellent servant! He, too, always turned to God.
verses.pickthall: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord).

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
verses.en: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
verses.tr: wādhkur ʿibādanā ʾibrāhīma wa-isḥāqa wayaʿqūba ʾūlā al-ʾaydā wa-l-ʾabṣāri
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, all men of strength and vision.
verses.pickthall: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.en: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾakhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣahin dhikrā ad-dāri
verses.abdelhaleem: We caused them to be devoted to Us through their sincere remembrance of the Final Home:
verses.pickthall: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter).

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.en: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
verses.tr: wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina al-muṣṭafayna al-ʾakhyāri
verses.abdelhaleem: with Us they will be among the elect, the truly good.
verses.pickthall: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.en: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
verses.tr: wādhkur ʾismāʿīla wa-l-yasaʿa wadhā al-kifli ۖ wakullun mmina al-ʾakhyāri
verses.abdelhaleem: And remember Our servants Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu ’l-Kifl, each of them truly good.
verses.pickthall: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.en: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
verses.tr: hādhā dhikrun ۚ wa-inna lilmuttaqīna laḥusna mābin
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a lesson. The devout will have a good place to return to:
verses.pickthall: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end,

verses.ar: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
verses.en: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
verses.tr: jannāti ʿadnin mmufattaḥahan llahumu al-ʾabwābu
verses.abdelhaleem: Gardens of lasting bliss with gates wide open.
verses.pickthall: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them,

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
verses.en: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
verses.tr: muttakīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihahin kathīrahin washarābin
verses.abdelhaleem: They will be comfortably seated; they will call for abundant fruit and drink;
verses.pickthall: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein.

verses.ar: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
verses.en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
verses.tr: ۞ waʿindahum qāṣirātu aṭ-ṭarfi ʾatrābun
verses.abdelhaleem: they will have well-matched [wives] with modest gaze.
verses.pickthall: And with them are those of modest gaze, companions.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
verses.tr: hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmi al-ḥisābi
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning:
verses.pickthall: This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verses.en: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā larizqunā mā lahu min nnafādin
verses.abdelhaleem: Our provision for you will never end.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.en: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
verses.tr: hādhā ۚ wa-inna lilṭṭāghīna lasharra mābin
verses.abdelhaleem: But the evildoers will have the worst place to return to:
verses.pickthall: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end,

verses.ar: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.en: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
verses.tr: jahannama yaṣlawnahā fabiʾsa al-mihādu
verses.abdelhaleem: Hell to burn in, an evil place to stay-
verses.pickthall: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
verses.en: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
verses.tr: hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmun waghassāqun
verses.abdelhaleem: all this will be theirs: let them taste it- a scalding, dark, foul fluid,
verses.pickthall: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it,

verses.ar: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
verses.en: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
verses.tr: wakharu min shaklihi ʾazwājun
verses.abdelhaleem: and other such torments.
verses.pickthall: And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)!

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
verses.tr: hādhā fawjun mmuqtaḥimun mmaʿakum ۖ lā marḥabanā bihim ۚ ʾinnahum ṣālūā an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: [It will be said], ‘Here is another crowd of people rushing headlong to join you.’ [The response will be], ‘They are not welcome! They will burn in the Fire.’
verses.pickthall: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verses.en: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
verses.tr: qālūā bal ʾantum lā marḥabanā bikum ۖ ʾantum qaddamtumūhu lanā ۖ fabiʾsa al-qarāru
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say to them, ‘You are not welcome! It was you who brought this on us, an evil place to stay,’
verses.pickthall: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
verses.tr: qālūā rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazidhu ʿadhāban ḍiʿfan fā an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: adding, ‘Our Lord, give double punishment to those who brought this upon us.’
verses.pickthall: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire!

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
verses.en: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
verses.tr: waqālūā mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum mmina al-ʾashrāri
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘Why do we not see those we thought were bad
verses.pickthall: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?

verses.ar: أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
verses.en: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
verses.tr: ʾattakhadhnāhum sikhriyyan ʾam zāghat ʿanhumu al-ʾabṣāru
verses.abdelhaleem: and took as a laughing-stock? Have our eyes missed them?’
verses.pickthall: Did we take them (wrongly) for a laughing-stock, or have our eyes missed them?

verses.ar: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
verses.tr: ʾinna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ʾahli an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: This is how it will really be: the inhabitants of the Fire will blame one another in this way.
verses.pickthall: Lo! that is very truth: the wrangling of the dwellers in the Fire.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,
verses.tr: qul ʾinnamā ʾanā mundhirun ۖ wamā min ʾilāhin ʾillā Allāh al-wāḥidu al-qahhāru
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet] say, ‘I am only here to give warning. There is no god but God the One, the All Powerful,
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute,

verses.ar: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
verses.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
verses.tr: rabbu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā al-ʿazīzu al-ghaffāru
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Almighty, the Most Forgiving.’
verses.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, the Pardoning.

verses.ar: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: Say, "It is great news
verses.tr: qul huwa nabaʾunā ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘This message is a mighty one,
verses.pickthall: Say: It is tremendous tidings

verses.ar: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: From which you turn away.
verses.tr: ʾantum ʿanhu muʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: yet you ignore it.
verses.pickthall: Whence ye turn away!

verses.ar: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.en: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
verses.tr: mā kāna lāa min ʿilmin bi-l-malaʾi al-ʾaʿlā ʾidh yakhtaṣimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: I have no knowledge of what those on high discuss:
verses.pickthall: I had no knowledge of the Highest Chiefs when they disputed;

verses.ar: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
verses.tr: ʾin yūḥā ʾilāa ʾillā ʾannamā ʾanā nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: it is only revealed to me that I am here to give clear warning.’
verses.pickthall: It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner.

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
verses.en: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
verses.tr: ʾidh qāla rabbuka lilmalāʾikahi ʾinnā khāliqun basharan mmin ṭīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a man from clay.
verses.pickthall: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire,

verses.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
verses.tr: fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rrūḥā faqaʿūā lahu sājidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When I have shaped him and breathed from My Spirit into him, bow down before him.’
verses.pickthall: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate,

verses.ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
verses.tr: fasajada al-malāʾikahu kulluhum ʾajmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The angels all bowed down together,
verses.pickthall: The angels fell down prostrate, every one,

verses.ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
verses.tr: ʾillā ʾiblīsa āstakbara wakāna mina al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but not Iblis, who was too proud. He became a rebel.
verses.pickthall: Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
verses.tr: qāla yāʾiblīsu mā manaʿaka ʾan tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadāa ۖ ʾastakbarta ʾam kunta mina al-ʿālīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Iblis, what prevents you from bowing down to the man I have made with My own hands? Are you too high and mighty?’
verses.pickthall: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted?

verses.ar: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
verses.en: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
verses.tr: qāla ʾanā khayrun mminhu ۖ khalaqtanā min nnārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Iblis said, ‘I am better than him: You made me from fire, and him from clay.’
verses.pickthall: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
verses.tr: qāla fākhruj minhā fa-innaka rajīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Get out of here! You are rejected:
verses.pickthall: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast,

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
verses.tr: wa-inna ʿalayka laʿnatā ʾilā yawmi ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: My rejection will follow you till the Day of Judgement!’
verses.pickthall: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
verses.tr: qāla rabbi fa-anẓirnā ʾilā yawmi yubʿathūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but Iblis said, ‘My Lord, grant me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead,’
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
verses.tr: qāla fa-innaka mina al-munẓarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: so He said, ‘You have respite
verses.pickthall: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.en: Until the Day of the time well-known."
verses.tr: ʾilā yawmi al-waqti al-maʿlūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: till the Appointed Day.’
verses.pickthall: Until the day of the time appointed.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all.
verses.tr: qāla fabiʿizzatika laʾughwiyannahum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Iblis said, ‘I swear by Your might! I will tempt all
verses.pickthall: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one,

verses.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
verses.tr: ʾillā ʿibādaka minhumu al-mukhlaṣīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but Your true servants.’
verses.pickthall: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
verses.tr: qāla fa-l-ḥaqqu wa-l-ḥaqqa ʾaqūlu
verses.abdelhaleem: God said, ‘This is the truth- I speak only the truth-
verses.pickthall: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak,

verses.ar: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
verses.tr: laʾamlaʾanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka minhum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I will fill Hell with you and all those that follow you.’
verses.pickthall: That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
verses.tr: qul mā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi min ʾajrin wamā ʾanā mina al-mutakallifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say, ‘I ask no reward from you for this, nor do I claim to be what I am not:
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating.

verses.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
verses.tr: ʾin huwa ʾillā dhikrun llilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: this is only a warning for all people.
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples

verses.ar: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
verses.en: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
verses.tr: walataʿlamunna nabaʾahu baʿda ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: In time you will certainly come to know its truth.’
verses.pickthall: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof.

verses.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.en: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
