verses.tr: tanzīlu al-kitābi mina Allāh al-ʿazīzi al-ḥakīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: This Scripture is sent down from God the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muḥammad], in truth. So worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾanzalnā ʾilayka al-kitāba bi-l-ḥaqqi fāʿbudi Allāh mukhliṣan llahu ad-dīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is We who sent down the Scripture to you [Prophet] with the Truth, so worship God with your total devotion:
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have revealed the Scripture unto thee (Muhammad) with truth; so worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).

verses.ar: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَـٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
verses.en: Unquestionably, for Allāh is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allāh in position." Indeed, Allāh will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allāh does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
verses.tr: ʾalā lillāh ad-dīnu al-khāliṣu ۚ wa-adh-dhīna āttakhadhūā min dūnihi ʾawliyāʾa mā naʿbuduhum ʾillā liyuqarribūnā ʾilā Allāh zulfā ʾinna Allāh yaḥkumu baynahum fā mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūna ۗ ʾinna Allāh lā yahdā man huwa kādhibun kaffārun
verses.abdelhaleem: true devotion is due to God alone. [As for] those who choose other protectors beside Him, saying, ‘We only worship them because they bring us nearer to God,’ God Himself will judge between them regarding their differences. God does not guide any ungrateful liar.
verses.pickthall: Surely pure religion is for Allah only. And those who choose protecting friends beside Him (say): We worship them only that they may bring us near unto Allah. Lo! Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Lo! Allah guideth not him who is a liar, an ingrate.

verses.ar: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.en: If Allāh had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.
verses.tr: llaw ʾarāda Allāh ʾan yattakhidha waladan llāṣṭafā mimmā yakhluqu mā yashāʾu ۚ subḥānahu ۖ huwa Allāh al-wāḥidu al-qahhāru
verses.abdelhaleem: God could have chosen any of His creation He willed for offspring, but He is far above this! He is the One, the Almighty.
verses.pickthall: If Allah had willed to choose a son, He could have chosen what He would of that which He hath created. Be He Glorified! He is Allah, the One, the Absolute.

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
verses.en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
verses.tr: khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa bi-l-ḥaqqi ۖ yukawwiru al-yla ʿalā an-nahāri wayukawwiru an-nahāra ʿalā al-yli ۖ wasakhara ash-shamsa wa-l-qamara ۖ kullun yajrā liʾajalin mmusammanā ۗ ʾalā huwa al-ʿazīzu al-ghaffāru
verses.abdelhaleem: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose; He wraps the night around the day and the day around the night; He has subjected the sun and moon to run their courses for an appointed time; He is truly the Mighty, the Forgiving.
verses.pickthall: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. He maketh night to succeed day, and He maketh day to succeed night, and He constraineth the sun and the moon to give service, each running on for an appointed term. Is not He the Mighty, the Forgiver?

verses.ar: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍ ثَلَـٰثٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
verses.en: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
verses.tr: khalaqakum mmin nnafsin wāḥidahin thumma jaʿala minhā zawjahā wa-anzala lakum mmina al-ʾanʿāmi thamāniyaha ʾazwājin ۚ yakhluqukum fā buṭūni ʾummahātikum khalqan mmin baʿdi khalqin fā ẓulumātin thalāthin ۚ dhālikumu Allāh rabbukum lahu al-mulku ۖ lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۖ fa-annā tuṣrafūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He created you all from a single being, from which He made its mate; He gave you four kinds of livestock in pairs; He creates you in your mothers’ wombs, in one stage after another, in threefold depths of darkness. Such is God, your Lord; He holds control, there is no god but Him. How can you turn away?
verses.pickthall: He created you from one being, then from that (being) He made its mate; and He hath provided for you of cattle eight kinds. He created you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold gloom. Such is Allah, your Lord. His is the Sovereignty. There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye turned away?

verses.ar: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allāh is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves [i.e., likes] it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.tr: ʾin takfurūā fa-inna Allāh ghanāun ʿankum ۖ walā yarḍā liʿibādihi al-kufra ۖ wa-in tashkurūā yarḍahu lakum ۗ walā taziru wāzirahun wizra ʾukhrā ۗ thumma ʾilā rabbikum mmarjiʿukum fayunabbiʾukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna ۚ ʾinnahu ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: If you are ungrateful, remember God has no need of you, yet He is not pleased by ingrati-tude in His servants; if you are grateful, He is pleased [to see] it in you. No soul will bear another’s burden. You will return to your Lord in the end and He will inform you of what you have done: He knows well what is in the depths of [your] hearts.
verses.pickthall: If ye are thankless, yet Allah is Independent of you, though He is not pleased with thanklessness for His bondmen; and if ye are thankful He is pleased therewith for you. No laden soul will bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return; and He will tell you what ye used to do. Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men).

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
verses.tr: ۞ wa-idhā massa al-ʾinsāna ḍurrun daʿā rabbahu munīban ʾilayhi thumma ʾidhā khawwalahu niʿmahan mminhu nasāa mā kāna yadʿūā ʾilayhi min qablu wajaʿala lillāh ʾandādan lliyuḍilla ʿan sabīlihi ۚ qul tamattaʿ bikufrika qalīlan ۖ ʾinnaka min ʾaṣḥābi an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: When man suffers some affliction, he prays to his Lord and turns to Him, but once he has been granted a favour from God, he forgets the One he had been praying to and sets up rivals to God, to make others stray from His path. Say, ‘Enjoy your ingratitude for a little while: you will be one of the inhabitants of the Fire.’
verses.pickthall: And when some hurt toucheth man, he crieth unto his Lord, turning unto Him (repentant). Then, when He granteth him a boon from Him he forgetteth that for which he cried unto Him before, and setteth up rivals to Allah that he may beguile (men) from his way. Say (O Muhammad, unto such an one): Take pleasure in thy disbelief a while. Lo! thou art of the owners of the Fire.

verses.ar: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَـٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَآئِمًا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
verses.tr: ʾamman huwa qānitun ānāʾa al-yli sājidan waqāʾiman yaḥdharu al-ākhiraha wayarjūā raḥmaha rabbihi ۗ qul hal yastawā adh-dhīna yaʿlamūna wa-adh-dhīna lā yaʿlamūna ۗ ʾinnamā yatadhakkaru ʾūlūā al-ʾalbābi
verses.abdelhaleem: What about someone who worships devoutly during the night, bowing down, standing in prayer, ever mindful of the life to come, hoping for his Lord’s mercy? Say, ‘How can those who know be equal to those who do not know?’ Only those who have understanding will take heed.
verses.pickthall: Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night, prostrate and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Are those who know equal with those who know not? But only men of understanding will pay heed.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.en: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allāh is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."
verses.tr: qul yāʿibādi adh-dhīna āmanūā āttaqūā rabbakum ۚ lilladhīna ʾaḥsanūā fā hādhihi ad-dunyā ḥasanahun ۗ wa-arḍu Allāh wāsiʿahun ۗ ʾinnamā yuwaffā aṣ-ṣābirūna ʾajrahum bighayri ḥisābin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘[God says], believing servants, be mindful of your Lord! Those who do good in this world will have a good reward- God’s earth is wide––and those who persevere patiently will be given a full and unstinting reward.’
verses.pickthall: Say: O My bondmen who believe! Observe your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good, and Allah's earth is spacious. Verily the steadfast will be paid their wages without stint.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
verses.tr: qul ʾinnā ʾumirtu ʾan ʾaʿbuda Allāh mukhliṣan llahu ad-dīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I have been commanded to serve God, dedicating my worship entirely to Him.
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).

verses.ar: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
verses.tr: wa-umirtu liʾan ʾakūna ʾawwala al-muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: I have been commanded to be the first to submit.’
verses.pickthall: And I am commanded to be the first of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him).

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
verses.tr: qul ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʾin ʿaṣaytu rabbā ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I fear the torment of a terrible Day if I disobey my Lord.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Lo! if I should disobey my Lord, I fear the doom of a tremendous Day.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُۥ دِينِى
verses.en: Say, "Allāh [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
verses.tr: quli Allāh ʾaʿbudu mukhliṣan llahu dīnā
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘It is God I serve, dedicating my worship entirely to Him-
verses.pickthall: Say: Allah I worship, making my religion pure for Him (only).

verses.ar: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
verses.tr: fāʿbudūā mā shiʾtum mmin dūnihi ۗ qul ʾinna al-khāsirīna adh-dhīna khasirūā ʾanfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma al-qiyāmahi ۗ ʾalā dhālika huwa al-khusrānu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: you may serve whatever you please beside Him.’ Say, ‘The true losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their people on the Day of Resurrection: that is the most obvious loss.
verses.pickthall: Then worship what ye will beside Him. Say: The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss!

verses.ar: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ ۚ يَـٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.en: They will have canopies [i.e., layers] of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allāh threatens [i.e., warns] His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
verses.tr: lahum mmin fawqihim ẓulalun mmina an-nāri wamin taḥtihim ẓulalun ۚ dhālika yukhawwifu Allāh bihi ʿibādahu ۚ yāʿibādi fāttaqūni
verses.abdelhaleem: They will have layers of Fire above them and below.’ This is how God puts fear into His servants: My servants, beware of Me.
verses.pickthall: They have an awning of fire above them and beneath them a dais (of fire). With this doth Allah appal His bondmen. O My bondmen, therefor fear Me!

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
verses.en: But those who have avoided ṭāghūt, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allāh - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna ājtanabūā aṭ-ṭāghūta ʾan yaʿbudūhā wa-anābūā ʾilā Allāh lahumu al-bushrā ۚ fabashir ʿibādi
verses.abdelhaleem: There is good news for those who shun the worship of false gods and turn to God, so [Prophet] give good news to My servants
verses.pickthall: And those who put away false gods lest they should worship them and turn to Allah in repentance, for them there are glad tidings. Therefor give good tidings (O Muhammad) to My bondmen

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allāh has guided, and those are people of understanding.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yastamiʿūna al-qawla fayattabiʿūna ʾaḥsanahu ۚ ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna hadāhumu Allāh ۖ wa-ūlāʾika hum ʾūlūā al-ʾalbābi
verses.abdelhaleem: who listen to what is said and follow what is best. These are the ones God has guided; these are the people of understanding.
verses.pickthall: Who hear advice and follow the best thereof. Such are those whom Allah guideth, and such are men of understanding.

verses.ar: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
verses.tr: ʾafaman ḥaqqa ʿalayhi kalimahu al-ʿadhābi ʾafaʾanta tunqidhu man fā an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: What about the one who has been sentenced to punishment? Can you [Prophet] rescue those already in the Fire?
verses.pickthall: Is he on whom the word of doom is fulfilled (to be helped), and canst thou (O Muhammad) rescue him who is in the Fire?

verses.ar: لَـٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
verses.en: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.
verses.tr: lākini adh-dhīna āttaqawā rabbahum lahum ghurafun mmin fawqihā ghurafun mmabniyyahun tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru ۖ waʿda Allāh ۖ lā yukhlifu Allāh al-mīʿāda
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who are mindful of their Lord will have lofty dwellings built for them, one above the other, graced with flowing streams. This is a promise from God: God does not break His promise.
verses.pickthall: But those who keep their duty to their Lord, for them are lofty halls with lofty halls above them, built (for them), beneath which rivers flow. (It is) a promise of Allah. Allah faileth not His promise.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَـٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَـٰمًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: Do you not see that Allāh sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna Allāh ʾanzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan fasalakahu yanābīʿa fā al-ʾarḍi thumma yukhriju bihi zarʿan mmukhtalifan ʾalwānuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣfarran thumma yajʿaluhu ḥuṭāman ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika ladhikrā liʾūlā al-ʾalbābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you not considered that God sends water down from the sky, guides it along to form springs in the earth, and then, with it, brings forth vegetation of various colours, which later withers, turns yellow before your eyes, and is crumbled to dust at His command? There is truly a reminder in this for those who have understanding.
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath sent down water from the sky and hath caused it to penetrate the earth as watersprings, and afterward thereby produceth crops of divers hues; and afterward they wither and thou seest them turn yellow; then He maketh them chaff. Lo! herein verily is a reminder for men of understanding.

verses.ar: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَـٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقَـٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: So is one whose breast Allāh has expanded to [accept] Islām and he is upon [i.e., guided by] a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allāh. Those are in manifest error.
verses.tr: ʾafaman sharaḥa Allāh ṣadrahu lilʾislāmi fahuwa ʿalā nūrin mmin rrabbihi ۚ fawaylun llilqāsiyahi qulūbuhum mmin dhikri Allāh ۚ ʾūlāʾika fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: What about the one whose heart God has opened in devotion to Him, so that he walks in light from his Lord? Alas for those whose hearts harden at the mention of God! They have clearly lost their way.
verses.pickthall: Is he whose bosom Allah hath expanded for Al-Islam, so that he followeth a light from his Lord, (as he who disbelieveth)? Then woe unto those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allah. Such are in plain error.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَـٰبًا مُّتَشَـٰبِهًا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
verses.en: Allāh has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance [i.e., mention] of Allāh. That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no guide.
verses.tr: Allāh nazzala ʾaḥsana al-ḥadīthi kitāban mmutashābihan mmathānāa taqshaʿirru minhu julūdu adh-dhīna yakhshawna rabbahum thumma talīnu julūduhum waqulūbuhum ʾilā dhikri Allāh ۚ dhālika hudā Allāh yahdā bihi man yashāʾu ۚ waman yuḍlili Allāh famā lahu min hādin
verses.abdelhaleem: God has sent down the most beautiful of all teachings: a Scripture that is consistent and draws comparisons; that causes the skins of those in awe of their Lord to shiver. Then their skins and their hearts soften at the mention of God: such is God’s guidance. He guides with it whoever He will; no one can guide those God leaves to stray.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath (now) revealed the fairest of statements, a Scripture consistent, (wherein promises of reward are) paired (with threats of punishment), whereat doth creep the flesh of those who fear their Lord, so that their flesh and their hearts soften to Allah's reminder. Such is Allah's guidance, wherewith He guideth whom He will. And him whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.

verses.ar: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِى بِوَجْهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
verses.tr: ʾafaman yattaqā biwajhihi sūʾa al-ʿadhābi yawma al-qiyāmahi ۚ waqīla lilẓẓālimīna dhūqūā mā kuntum taksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What about the one who will only have his bare face to protect him from his terrible suffering on the Day of Resurrection? It will be said to the evildoers, ‘Taste what you have earned.’
verses.pickthall: Is he then, who will strike his face against the awful doom upon the Day of Resurrection (as he who doeth right)? And it will be said unto the wrong-doers: Taste what ye used to earn.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
verses.tr: kadhaba adh-dhīna min qablihim fa-atāhumu al-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Others before them also disbelieved, and the punishment fell on them unawares:
verses.pickthall: Those before them denied, and so the doom came on them whence they knew not.

verses.ar: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخِزْىَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So Allāh made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
verses.tr: fa-adhāqahumu Allāh al-khizāa fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۖ walaʿadhābu al-ākhirahi ʾakbaru ۚ law kānūā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God gave them the punishment of disgrace in this world to taste; the punishment will be even harder in the Hereafter, if only they knew.
verses.pickthall: Thus Allah made them taste humiliation in the life of the world, and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be greater if they did but know.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
verses.tr: walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fā hādhā al-qurāni min kulli mathalin llaʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In this Quran, We have put forward all kinds of illustration for people, so that they may take heed-
verses.pickthall: And verily We have coined for mankind in this Qur'an all kinds of similitudes, that haply they may reflect;

verses.ar: قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِى عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: [It is] an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
verses.tr: qurānan ʿarabiyyan ghayra dhā ʿiwajin llaʿallahum yattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: an Arabic Quran, free from any distortion- so that people may be mindful.
verses.pickthall: A Lecture in Arabic, containing no crookedness, that haply they may ward off (evil).

verses.ar: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَـٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Allāh presents an example: a man [i.e., slave] owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allāh! But most of them do not know.
verses.tr: ḍaraba Allāh mathalan rrajulan fīhi shurakāʾu mutashākisūna warajulan salaman llirajulin hal yastawiyāni mathalan ۚ al-ḥamdu lillāh ۚ bal ʾaktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God puts forward this illustration: can a man who has for his masters several partners at odds with each other be considered equal to a man devoted wholly to one master? All praise belongs to God, though most of them do not know.
verses.pickthall: Allah coineth a similitude: A man in relation to whom are several part-owners, quarrelling, and a man belonging wholly to one man. Are the two equal in similitude? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not.

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
verses.tr: ʾinnaka mayyitun wa-innahum mmayyitūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You [Prophet] will certainly die, and so will they,
verses.pickthall: Lo! thou wilt die, and lo! they will die;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.en: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
verses.tr: thumma ʾinnakum yawma al-qiyāmahi ʿinda rabbikum takhtaṣimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and, on the Day of Resurrection, you will dispute with one another in the presence of your Lord.
verses.pickthall: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord ye will dispute.

verses.ar: ۞ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allāh and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
verses.tr: ۞ faman ʾaẓlamu mimman kadhaba ʿalā Allāh wakadhaba bi-aṣ-ṣidqi ʾidh jāʾahu ۚ ʾalaysa fā jahannama mathwanā llilkāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So who could be more wrong than the person who invents a lie about God and rejects the truth when it comes to him? Is there not ample punishment for the disbelievers in Hell?
verses.pickthall: And who doth greater wrong than he who telleth a lie against Allah, and denieth the truth when it reacheth him? Will not the home of disbelievers be in hell?

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ ۙ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And the one who has brought the truth [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhā jāʾa bi-aṣ-ṣidqi waṣaddaqa bihi ۙ ʾūlāʾika humu al-muttaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is the one who brings the truth and the one who accepts it as true who are mindful of God:
verses.pickthall: And whoso bringeth the truth and believeth therein - Such are the dutiful.

verses.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -
verses.tr: lahum mmā yashāʾūna ʿinda rabbihim ۚ dhālika jazāʾu al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: they will have everything they wish for with their Lord. Such is the reward of those who do good:
verses.pickthall: They shall have what they will of their Lord's bounty. That is the reward of the good:

verses.ar: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: That Allāh may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
verses.tr: liyukaffira Allāh ʿanhum ʾaswaʾa adh-dhā ʿamilūā wayajziyahum ʾajrahum biʾaḥsani adh-dhā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God will absolve them even of their worst deeds and will reward them according to their best.
verses.pickthall: That Allah will remit from them the worst of what they did, and will pay them for reward the best they used to do.

verses.ar: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
verses.en: Is not Allāh sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allāh leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
verses.tr: ʾalaysa Allāh bikāfin ʿabdahu ۖ wayukhawwifūnaka bi-adh-dhīna min dūnihi ۚ waman yuḍlili Allāh famā lahu min hādin
verses.abdelhaleem: Is God not enough for His servant? Yet they threaten you [Prophet] with those they worship other than Him. If God allows someone to stray he has no one to guide him;
verses.pickthall: Will not Allah defend His slave? Yet they would frighten thee with those beside Him. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.

verses.ar: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّ ۗ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِى ٱنتِقَامٍ
verses.en: And whoever Allāh guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allāh Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
verses.tr: waman yahdi Allāh famā lahu min mmuḍillin ۗ ʾalaysa Allāh biʿazīzin dhā āntiqāmin
verses.abdelhaleem: if God guides someone no one can lead him astray. Is God not mighty and capable of retribution?
verses.pickthall: And he whom Allah guideth, for him there can be no misleader. Is not Allah Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong)?

verses.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَـٰشِفَـٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوْ أَرَادَنِى بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَـٰتُ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِىَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
verses.en: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allāh? If Allāh intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allāh; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."
verses.tr: walaʾin saʾaltahum mman khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa layaqūlunna Allāh ۚ qul ʾafaraʾaytum mmā tadʿūna min dūni Allāh ʾin ʾarādanāa Allāh biḍurrin hal hunna kāshifātu ḍurrihi ʾaw ʾarādanā biraḥmahin hal hunna mumsikātu raḥmatihi ۚ qul ḥasbāa Allāh ۖ ʿalayhi yatawakkalu al-mutawakkilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you [Prophet] ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and earth?’ they are sure to answer, ‘God,’ so say, ‘Consider those you invoke beside Him: if God wished to harm me, could they undo that harm? If God wished to show me mercy, could they withhold that mercy?’ Say, ‘God is enough for me: all those who trust should put their trust in Him.’
verses.pickthall: And verily, if thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they will say: Allah. Say: Bethink you then of those ye worship beside Allah, if Allah willed some hurt for me, could they remove from me His hurt; or if He willed some mercy for me, could they restrain His mercy? Say: Allah is my all. In Him do (all) the trusting put their trust.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَـٰمِلٌ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
verses.tr: qul yāqawmi āʿmalūā ʿalā makānatikum ʾinnā ʿāmilun ۖ fasawfa taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘My people, do whatever is in your power- and so will I. You will find out
verses.pickthall: Say: O my people! Act in your manner. Lo! I (too) am acting. Thus ye will come to know

verses.ar: مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
verses.en: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."
verses.tr: man yaʾtīhi ʿadhābun yukhzīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun mmuqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: who will suffer humiliation, and on whom a lasting torment will descend.’
verses.pickthall: Who it is unto whom cometh a doom that will abase him, and on whom there falleth everlasting doom.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager [i.e., authority] over them.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾanzalnā ʿalayka al-kitāba lilnnāsi bi-l-ḥaqqi ۖ famani āhtadā falinafsihi ۖ waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā ۖ wamā ʾanta ʿalayhim biwakīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent the Scripture down to you [Prophet] with the Truth for people. Whoever follows the guidance does so for his own benefit, whoever strays away from it does so at his own peril: you are not in charge of them.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture for mankind with truth. Then whosoever goeth right it is for his soul, and whosoever strayeth, strayeth only to its hurt. And thou art not a warder over them.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Allāh takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
verses.tr: Allāh yatawaffā al-ʾanfusa ḥīna mawtihā wa-at-tā lam tamut fā manāmihā ۖ fayumsiku at-tā qaḍā ʿalayhā al-mawta wayursilu al-ʾukhrā ʾilā ʾajalin mmusammanā ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yatafakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God takes the souls of the dead and the souls of the living while they sleep- He keeps hold of those whose death He has ordained and sends the others back until their appointed time- there truly are signs in this for those who reflect.
verses.pickthall: Allah receiveth (men's) souls at the time of their death, and that (soul) which dieth not (yet) in its sleep. He keepeth that (soul) for which He hath ordained death and dismisseth the rest till an appointed term. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought.

verses.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَ ۚ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Or have they taken other than Allāh as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"
verses.tr: ʾami āttakhadhūā min dūni Allāh shufaʿāʾa ۚ qul ʾawalaw kānūā lā yamlikūna shayā walā yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet they take intercessors besides God! Say, ‘Even though these have no power or understanding?’
verses.pickthall: Or choose they intercessors other than Allah? Say: What! Even though they have power over nothing and have no intelligence?

verses.ar: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ جَمِيعًا ۖ لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: Say, "To Allāh belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."
verses.tr: qul lillāh ash-shafāʿahu jamīʿan ۖ llahu mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ thumma ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘All intercession belongs to God alone; He holds control of the heavens and the earth; in the end you will all return to Him.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Unto Allah belongeth all intercession. His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. And afterward unto Him ye will be brought back.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ٱشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
verses.en: And when Allāh is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.
verses.tr: wa-idhā dhukira Allāh waḥdahu āshmaʾazzat qulūbu adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi ۖ wa-idhā dhukira adh-dhīna min dūnihi ʾidhā hum yastabshirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever God is mentioned on His own, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but they rejoice when gods other than Him are mentioned.
verses.pickthall: And when Allah alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter are repelled, and when those (whom they worship) beside Him are mentioned, behold! they are glad.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ عَـٰلِمَ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِى مَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: Say, "O Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."
verses.tr: quli Allāhumma fāṭira as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ʿālima al-ghaybi wa-ash-shahādahi ʾanta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fā mā kānūā fīhi yakhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘God! Creator of the heavens and earth! Knower of all that is hidden and all that is open, You will judge between Your servants regarding their differences.’
verses.pickthall: Say: O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! Thou wilt judge between Thy slaves concerning that wherein they used to differ.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَحْتَسِبُونَ
verses.en: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allāh that which they had not taken into account.
verses.tr: walaw ʾanna lilladhīna ẓalamūā mā fā al-ʾarḍi jamīʿan wamithlahu maʿahu lāftadawā bihi min sūʾi al-ʿadhābi yawma al-qiyāmahi ۚ wabadā lahum mmina Allāh mā lam yakūnūā yaḥtasibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If the evildoers possessed the earth’s assets twice over they would offer them to ransom themselves from the terrible suffering on the Day of Resurrection: God will show them something they had not reckoned with,
verses.pickthall: And though those who do wrong possess all that is in the earth, and therewith as much again, they verily will seek to ransom themselves therewith on the Day of Resurrection from the awful doom; and there will appear unto them, from their Lord, that wherewith they never reckoned.

verses.ar: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.tr: wabadā lahum sayyātu mā kasabūā waḥāqa bihim mmā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the evil of their deeds will become plain to them, and they will be overwhelmed by that at which they used to laugh.
verses.pickthall: And the evils that they earned will appear unto them, and that whereat they used to scoff will surround them.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَـٰهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.
verses.tr: fa-idhā massa al-ʾinsāna ḍurrun daʿānā thumma ʾidhā khawwalnāhu niʿmahan mminnā qāla ʾinnamā ʾūtītuhu ʿalā ʿilmin ۚ bal hāa fitnahun walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When man suffers some affliction, he cries out to Us, but when We favour him with Our blessing, he says, ‘All this has been given to me because of my knowledge’- it is only a test, though most of them do not know it.
verses.pickthall: Now when hurt toucheth a man he crieth unto Us, and afterward when We have granted him a boon from Us, he saith: Only by force of knowledge I obtained it. Nay, but it is a test. But most of them know not.

verses.ar: قَدْ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
verses.tr: qad qālahā adh-dhīna min qablihim famā ʾaghnā ʿanhum mmā kānūā yaksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who lived before them said the same. What they did was of no use to them;
verses.pickthall: Those before them said it, yet (all) that they had earned availed them not;

verses.ar: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
verses.en: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be struck [i.e., afflicted] by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.
verses.tr: fa-aṣābahum sayyātu mā kasabūā ۚ wa-adh-dhīna ẓalamūā min hāʾulāʾi sayuṣībuhum sayyātu mā kasabūā wamā hum bimuʿjizīna
verses.abdelhaleem: they suffered its evil effects. Today’s wrongdoers will also suffer the evil effects of their deeds: they will not escape.
verses.pickthall: But the evils that they earned smote them; and such of these as do wrong, the evils that they earn will smite them; they cannot escape.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Do they not know that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yaʿlamūā ʾanna Allāh yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yashāʾu wayaqdiru ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not know that God provides abun-dantly for anyone He will and gives sparingly to anyone He will? There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
verses.pickthall: Know they not that Allah enlargeth providence for whom He will, and straiteneth it (for whom He will). Lo! herein verily are portents for people who believe.

verses.ar: ۞ قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
verses.tr: ۞ qul yāʿibādāa adh-dhīna ʾasrafūā ʿalā ʾanfusihim lā taqnaṭūā min rraḥmahi Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh yaghfiru adh-dhunūba jamīʿan ۚ ʾinnahu huwa al-ghafūru ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘[God says], My servants who have harmed yourselves by your own excess, do not despair of God’s mercy. God forgives all sins: He is truly the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
verses.pickthall: Say: O My slaves who have been prodigal to their own hurt! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَأَنِيبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.
verses.tr: wa-anībūā ʾilā rabbikum wa-aslimūā lahu min qabli ʾan yaʾtiyakumu al-ʿadhābu thumma lā tunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Turn to your Lord. Submit to Him before the punishment overtakes you and you can no longer be helped.
verses.pickthall: Turn unto your Lord repentant, and surrender unto Him, before there come unto you the doom, when ye cannot be helped.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَحْسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān] before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,
verses.tr: wāttabiʿūā ʾaḥsana mā ʾunzila ʾilaykum mmin rrabbikum mmin qabli ʾan yaʾtiyakumu al-ʿadhābu baghtahan wa-antum lā tashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Follow the best teaching sent down to you from your Lord, before the punishment suddenly takes you, unawares,
verses.pickthall: And follow the better (guidance) of that which is revealed unto you from your Lord, before the doom cometh on you suddenly when ye know not,

verses.ar: أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَـٰحَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِى جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّـٰخِرِينَ
verses.en: Lest a soul should say, "Oh, [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allāh and that I was among the mockers."
verses.tr: ʾan taqūla nafsun yāḥasratā ʿalā mā farraṭtu fā janbi Allāh wa-in kuntu lamina as-sākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and your soul says, “Woe is me for having neglected what is due to God, and having been one of those who scoffed!”
verses.pickthall: Lest any soul should say: Alas, my grief that I was unmindful of Allah, and I was indeed among the scoffers!

verses.ar: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allāh had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."
verses.tr: ʾaw taqūla law ʾanna Allāh hadānā lakuntu mina al-muttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Or it says, “If God had guided me, I would have joined the righteous!”
verses.pickthall: Or should say: If Allah had but guided me I should have been among the dutiful!

verses.ar: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."
verses.tr: ʾaw taqūla ḥīna tarā al-ʿadhāba law ʾanna lā karrahan fa-akūna mina al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Or, faced by punishment, it says, “If only I could have another chance, I would join those who do good!”
verses.pickthall: Or should say, when it seeth the doom: Oh, that I had but a second chance that I might be among the righteous!

verses.ar: بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ ءَايَـٰتِى فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.
verses.tr: balā qad jāʾatka āyātā fakadhabta bihā wāstakbarta wakunta mina al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! My messages came to you and you rejected them: you were arrogant and rejected the truth.’
verses.pickthall: (But now the answer will be): Nay, for My revelations came unto thee, but thou didst deny them and wast scornful and wast among the disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
verses.en: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allāh [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?
verses.tr: wayawma al-qiyāmahi tarā adh-dhīna kadhabūā ʿalā Allāh wujūhuhum mmuswaddahun ۚ ʾalaysa fā jahannama mathwanā llilmutakabbirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day of Resurrection, you [Prophet] will see those who told lies against God, their faces darkened. Is there not ample punishment for the arrogant in Hell?
verses.pickthall: And on the Day of Resurrection thou (Muhammad) seest those who lied concerning Allah with their faces blackened. Is not the home of the scorners in hell?

verses.ar: وَيُنَجِّى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
verses.tr: wayunajjā Allāh adh-dhīna āttaqawā bimafāzatihim lā yamassuhumu as-sūʾu walā hum yaḥzanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But God will deliver those who took heed of Him to their place of safety: no harm will touch them, nor will they grieve.
verses.pickthall: And Allah delivereth those who ward off (evil) because of their deserts. Evil toucheth them not, nor do they grieve.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
verses.en: Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.
verses.tr: Allāh khāliqu kulli shāʾin ۖ wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin wakīlun
verses.abdelhaleem: God is the Creator of all things; He has charge of everything;
verses.pickthall: Allah is Creator of all things, and He is Guardian over all things.

verses.ar: لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allāh - it is those who are the losers.
verses.tr: llahu maqālīdu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۗ wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā bāyāti Allāh ʾūlāʾika humu al-khāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the keys of the heavens and earth are His. Those who have rejected the revelations of God will be the losers.
verses.pickthall: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth, and they who disbelieve the revelations of Allah - such are they who are the losers.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأْمُرُوٓنِّىٓ أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Is it other than Allāh that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"
verses.tr: qul ʾafaghayra Allāh taʾmurūnnā ʾaʿbudu ʾayyuhā al-jāhilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Do you order me to worship someone other than God, you foolish people?’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): Do ye bid me serve other than Allah? O ye fools!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allāh, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾūḥāa ʾilayka wa-ʾilā adh-dhīna min qablika laʾin ʾashrakta layaḥbaṭanna ʿamaluka walatakūnanna mina al-khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It has already been revealed to you [Prophet] and to those before you: ‘If you ascribe any partner to God, all your work will come to nothing: you will be one if the losers.
verses.pickthall: And verily it hath been revealed unto thee as unto those before thee (saying): If thou ascribe a partner to Allah thy work will fail and thou indeed wilt be among the losers.

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
verses.en: Rather, worship [only] Allāh and be among the grateful.
verses.tr: bali Allāh fāʿbud wakun mmina ash-shākirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: No! Worship God alone and be one of those who are grateful to Him.’
verses.pickthall: Nay, but Allah must thou serve, and be among the thankful!

verses.ar: وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ وَٱلْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ مَطْوِيَّـٰتٌۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
verses.tr: wamā qadarūā Allāh ḥaqqa qadrihi wa-l-ʾarḍu jamīʿan qabḍatuhu yawma al-qiyāmahi wa-as-samāwātu maṭwiyyātun biyamīnihi ۚ subḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: These people have no grasp of God’s true measure. On the Day of Resurrection, the whole earth will be in His grip. The heavens will be rolled up in His right hand- Glory be to Him! He is far above the partners they ascribe to Him!-
verses.pickthall: And they esteem not Allah as He hath the right to be esteemed, when the whole earth is His handful on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens are rolled in His right hand. Glorified is He and High Exalted from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him).

verses.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allāh wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.
verses.tr: wanufikha fā aṣ-ṣūri faṣaʿiqa man fā as-samāwāti waman fā al-ʾarḍi ʾillā man shāʾa Allāh ۖ thumma nufikha fīhi ʾukhrā fa-idhā hum qiyāmun yanẓurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the Trumpet will be sounded, and everyone in the heavens and earth will fall down senseless except those God spares. It will be sounded once again and they will be on their feet, looking on.
verses.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown, and all who are in the heavens and all who are in the earth swoon away, save him whom Allah willeth. Then it is blown a second time, and behold them standing waiting!

verses.ar: وَأَشْرَقَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ وَجِا۟ىٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.
verses.tr: wa-ashraqati al-ʾarḍu binūri rabbihā wawuḍiʿa al-kitābu wajāʾa bi-an-nabiyyina wa-ash-shuhadāʾi waquḍāa baynahum bi-l-ḥaqqi wahum lā yuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The earth will shine with the light of its Lord; the Record of Deeds will be laid open; the prophets and witnesses will be brought in. Fair judgement will be given between them: they will not be wronged
verses.pickthall: And the earth shineth with the light of her Lord, and the Book is set up, and the prophets and the witnesses are brought, and it is judged between them with truth, and they are not wronged.

verses.ar: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.
verses.tr: wawuffiyat kullu nafsin mmā ʿamilat wahuwa ʾaʿlamu bimā yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and every soul will be repaid in full for what it has done. He knows best what they do.
verses.pickthall: And each soul is paid in full for what it did. And He is Best Aware of what they do.

verses.ar: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا ۚ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word [i.e., decree] of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers."
verses.tr: wasīqa adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾilā jahannama zumaran ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾūhā futiḥat ʾabwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā ʾalam yaʾtikum rusulun mminkum yatlūna ʿalaykum āyāti rabbikum wayundhirūnakum liqāʾa yawmikum hādhā ۚ qālūā balā walākin ḥaqqat kalimahu al-ʿadhābi ʿalā al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who rejected the Truth will be led to Hell in their throngs. When they arrive, its gates will open and its keepers will say to them, ‘Were you not sent your own messengers to recite the revelations of your Lord to you and warn you that you would meet this Day?’ and they will say, ‘Yes indeed we were.’ But the sentence of punishment will have been passed against those who rejected the truth.
verses.pickthall: And those who disbelieve are driven unto hell in troops till, when they reach it and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Came there not unto you messengers of your own, reciting unto you the revelations of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this your Day? they say: Yea, verily. But the word of doom of disbelievers is fulfilled.

verses.ar: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
verses.en: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."
verses.tr: qīla ādkhulūā ʾabwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā ۖ fabiʾsa mathwā al-mutakabbirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It will be said, ‘Enter the gates of Hell: there you will remain. How evil is the abode of the arrogant!’
verses.pickthall: It is said (unto them): Enter ye the gates of hell to dwell therein. Thus hapless is the journey's end of the scorners.

verses.ar: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوهَا خَـٰلِدِينَ
verses.en: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].
verses.tr: wasīqa adh-dhīna āttaqawā rabbahum ʾilā al-jannahi zumaran ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾūhā wafutiḥat ʾabwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā salāmun ʿalaykum ṭibtum fādkhulūhā khālidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who were mindful of their Lord will be led in throngs to the Garden. When they arrive, they will find its gates wide open, and its keepers will say to them, ‘Peace be upon you. You have been good. Come in: you are here to stay,’
verses.pickthall: And those who keep their duty to their Lord are driven unto the Garden in troops till, when they reach it, and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Peace be unto you! Ye are good, so enter ye (the Garden of delight), to dwell therein;

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُۥ وَأَوْرَثَنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ ۖ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَـٰمِلِينَ
verses.en: And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."
verses.tr: waqālūā al-ḥamdu lillāh adh-dhā ṣadaqanā waʿdahu wa-awrathanā al-ʾarḍa natabawwaʾu mina al-jannahi ḥaythu nashāʾu ۖ faniʿma ʾajru al-ʿāmilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will say, ‘Praise be to God who has kept His promise to us and given us this land as our own. Now we may live wherever we please in the Garden.’ How excellent is the reward of those who labour!
verses.pickthall: They say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath fulfilled His promise unto us and hath made us inherit the land, sojourning in the Garden where we will! So bounteous is the wage of workers.

verses.ar: وَتَرَى ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ ٱلْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allāh] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
verses.tr: watarā al-malāʾikaha ḥāffīna min ḥawli al-ʿarshi yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim ۖ waquḍāa baynahum bi-l-ḥaqqi waqīla al-ḥamdu lillāh rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You [Prophet] will see the angels surrounding the Throne, glorifying their Lord with praise. True judgement will have been passed between them, and it will be said, ‘Praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.’
verses.pickthall: And thou (O Muhammad) seest the angels thronging round the Throne, hymning the praises of their Lord. And they are judged aright. And it is said: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!

verses.ar: حمٓ
verses.en: Ḥā, Meem.
verses.tr: ḥm
verses.abdelhaleem: Ha Mim
verses.pickthall: Ha. Mim.

verses.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.en: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,
verses.tr: tanzīlu al-kitābi mina Allāh al-ʿazīzi al-ʿalīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Almighty, the All Knowing,
verses.pickthall: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Knower,

verses.ar: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.
verses.tr: ghāfiri adh-dhanbi waqābili at-tawbi shadīdi al-ʿiqābi dhā aṭ-ṭawli ۖ lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۖ ʾilayhi al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Forgiver of sins and Accepter of repentance, severe in punishment, infinite in bounty. There is no god but Him; to Him is the ultimate return.
verses.pickthall: The Forgiver of sin, the Accepter of repentance, the Stern in punishment, the Bountiful. There is no Allah save Him. Unto Him is the journeying.

verses.ar: مَا يُجَـٰدِلُ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
verses.en: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allāh except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.
verses.tr: mā yujādilu fā āyāti Allāh ʾillā adh-dhīna kafarūā falā yaghrurka taqallubuhum fā al-bilādi
verses.abdelhaleem: It is only the disbelievers who dispute God’s revelations. [Prophet], do not be dazzled by their movements back and forth across the land.
verses.pickthall: None argue concerning the revelations of Allah save those who disbelieve, so let not their turn of fortune in the land deceive thee (O Muhammad).

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ ۖ وَجَـٰدَلُوا۟ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
verses.en: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
verses.tr: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wa-l-ʾaḥzābu min baʿdihim ۖ wahammat kullu ʾummahin birasūlihim liyaʾkhudhūhu ۖ wajādalūā bi-l-bāṭili liyudḥiḍūā bihi al-ḥaqqa fa-akhadhtuhum ۖ fakayfa kāna ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Before them the people of Noah rejected the truth and so did those who formed opposition after them: every community schemed to destroy its messenger and strove to refute truth with falsehood; but it was I who destroyed them. How terrible My punishment was!
verses.pickthall: The folk of Noah and the factions after them denied (their messengers) before these, and every nation purposed to seize their messenger and argued falsely, (thinking) thereby to refute the Truth. Then I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: And thus has the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.
verses.tr: wakadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾannahum ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way your Lord’s sentence was passed against the disbelievers that they would be the inhabitants of the Fire.
verses.pickthall: Thus was the word of thy Lord concerning those who disbelieve fulfilled: That they are owners of the Fire.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَٱغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yaḥmilūna al-ʿarsha waman ḥawlahu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayuʾminūna bihi wayastaghfirūna lilladhīna āmanūā rabbanā wasiʿta kulla shāʾin rraḥmahan waʿilman fāghfir lilladhīna tābūā wāttabaʿūā sabīlaka waqihim ʿadhāba al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those who surround it celebrate the praise of their Lord and have faith in Him. They beg forgiveness for the believers: ‘Our Lord, You embrace all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who turn to You and follow Your path. Save them from the pains of Hell
verses.pickthall: Those who bear the Throne, and all who are round about it, hymn the praises of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who believe (saying): Our Lord! Thou comprehendest all things in mercy and knowledge, therefor forgive those who repent and follow Thy way. Ward off from them the punishment of hell.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: rabbanā wa-adkhilhum jannāti ʿadnin at-tā waʿadttahum waman ṣalaḥa min ābāʾihim wa-azwājihim wadhurriyyātihim ۚ ʾinnaka ʾanta al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: and admit them, Lord, to the lasting Gardens You have promised to them, together with their righteous ancestors, spouses, and offspring: You alone are the Almighty, the All Wise.
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! And make them enter the Gardens of Eden which thou hast promised them, with such of their fathers and their wives and their descendants as do right. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُۥ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.en: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."
verses.tr: waqihimu as-sayyāti ۚ waman taqi as-sayyāti yawmaʾidhin faqad raḥimtahu ۚ wadhālika huwa al-fawzu al-ʿaẓīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Protect them from all evil deeds: those You protect on that Day from [the punishment for] evil deeds will receive Your mercy- that is the supreme triumph.’
verses.pickthall: And ward off from them ill-deeds; and he from whom Thou wardest off ill-deeds that day, him verily hast Thou taken into mercy. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allāh for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved [i.e., refused]."
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā yunādawna lamaqtu Allāh ʾakbaru min mmaqtikum ʾanfusakum ʾidh tudʿawna ʾilā al-ʾīmāni fatakfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who disbelieved will be told, ‘When you were called to the faith and rejected it, God’s disgust with you was even greater then than the self-disgust you feel [today].’
verses.pickthall: Lo! (on that day) those who disbelieve are informed by proclamation: Verily Allah's abhorrence is more terrible than your abhorrence one of another, when ye were called unto the faith but did refuse.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ فَٱعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍ مِّن سَبِيلٍ
verses.en: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"
verses.tr: qālūā rabbanā ʾamattanā āthnatayni wa-aḥyaytanā āthnatayni fāʿtarafnā bidhunūbinā fahal ʾilā khurūjin mmin sabīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘Our Lord, twice You have caused us to be lifeless and twice You have brought us to life. Now we recognize our sins. Is there any way out?’
verses.pickthall: They say: Our Lord! Twice hast Thou made us die, and twice hast Thou made us live. Now we confess our sins. Is there any way to go out?

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ
verses.en: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allāh was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allāh, the Most High, the Grand."
verses.tr: dhālikum biʾannahu ʾidhā duʿāa Allāh waḥdahu kafartum ۖ wa-in yushrak bihi tuʾminūā ۚ fa-l-ḥukmu lillāh al-ʿalāi al-kabīri
verses.abdelhaleem: [They will be told], ‘This is all because when God alone was invoked you rejected this, yet when others were associated with Him you believed [in them].’ Judgement belongs to God the Most High, the Most Great.
verses.pickthall: (It is said unto them): This is (your plight) because, when Allah only was invoked, ye disbelieved, but when some partner was ascribed to Him ye were believing. But the command belongeth only to Allah, the Sublime, the Majestic.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقًا ۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ
verses.en: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā yurīkum āyātihi wayunazzilu lakum mmina as-samāʾi rizqan ۚ wamā yatadhakkaru ʾillā man yunību
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who shows you [people] His signs and sends water down from the sky to sustain you, though only those who turn to God will take heed.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who showeth you His portents, and sendeth down for you provision from the sky. None payeth heed save him who turneth (unto Him) repentant.

verses.ar: فَٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: So invoke Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.
verses.tr: fādʿūā Allāh mukhliṣīna lahu ad-dīna walaw kariha al-kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So call upon God and dedicate your religion to Him alone, however hateful this may be to the disbelievers:
verses.pickthall: Therefor (O believers) pray unto Allah, making religion pure for Him (only), however much the disbelievers be averse -

verses.ar: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَـٰتِ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ
verses.en: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command [i.e., revelation] upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.
verses.tr: rafīʿu ad-darajāti dhū al-ʿarshi yulqā ar-rūḥa min ʾamrihi ʿalā man yashāʾu min ʿibādihi liyundhira yawma at-talāqi
verses.abdelhaleem: He is exalted in rank, the Lord of the Throne. He sends revelations with His teachings to whichever of His servants He will, in order to warn of the Day of Meeting,
verses.pickthall: The Exalter of Ranks, the Lord of the Throne. He causeth the Spirit of His command upon whom He will of His slaves, that He may warn of the Day of Meeting,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ هُم بَـٰرِزُونَ ۖ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌ ۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
verses.en: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allāh. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.
verses.tr: yawma hum bārizūna ۖ lā yakhfā ʿalā Allāh minhum shāʾun ۚ llimani al-mulku al-yawma ۖ lillāh al-wāḥidi al-qahhāri
verses.abdelhaleem: the Day when they will come out and nothing about them will be concealed from God. ‘Who has control today?’ ‘God, the One, the All Powerful.
verses.pickthall: The day when they come forth, nothing of them being hidden from Allah. Whose is the Sovereignty this day? It is Allah's, the One, the Almighty.

verses.ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.
verses.tr: al-yawma tujzā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat ۚ lā ẓulma al-yawma ۚ ʾinna Allāh sarīʿu al-ḥisābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Today each soul will be rewarded for whatever it has done; today no injustice will be done. God is swift in reckoning.’
verses.pickthall: This day is each soul requited that which it hath earned; no wrong (is done) this day. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.

verses.ar: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلْحَنَاجِرِ كَـٰظِمِينَ ۚ مَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ
verses.en: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.
verses.tr: wa-andhirhum yawma al-āzifahi ʾidhi al-qulūbu ladā al-ḥanājiri kāẓimīna ۚ mā lilẓẓālimīna min ḥamīmin walā shafīʿin yuṭāʿu
verses.abdelhaleem: Warn them [Prophet] of the ever-approaching Day, when hearts are at throats, choking them. The evildoer will have no friends, nor any intercessor to be heeded.
verses.pickthall: Warn them (O Muhammad) of the Day of the approaching (doom), when the hearts will be choking the throats, (when) there will be no friend for the wrong-doers, nor any intercessor who will be heard.

verses.ar: يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِى ٱلصُّدُورُ
verses.en: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.
verses.tr: yaʿlamu khāʾinaha al-ʾaʿyuni wamā tukhfā aṣ-ṣudūru
verses.abdelhaleem: God is aware of the most furtive of glances, and of all that hearts conceal:
verses.pickthall: He knoweth the traitor of the eyes, and that which the bosoms hide.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ يَقْضِى بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَىْءٍ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.en: And Allāh judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allāh - He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
verses.tr: wallāh yaqḍā bi-l-ḥaqqi ۖ wa-adh-dhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi lā yaqḍūna bishāʾin ۗ ʾinna Allāh huwa as-samīʿu al-baṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: God will judge with truth, while those they invoke besides Him will not judge at all. God is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
verses.pickthall: Allah judgeth with truth, while those to whom they cry instead of Him judge not at all. Lo! Allah, He is the Hearer, the Seer.

verses.ar: ۞ أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍ
verses.en: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allāh seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allāh any protector.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾawalam yasīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fayanẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu adh-dhīna kānūā min qablihim ۚ kānūā hum ʾashadda minhum quwwahan wathāran fā al-ʾarḍi fa-akhadhahumu Allāh bidhunūbihim wamā kāna lahum mmina Allāh min wāqin
verses.abdelhaleem: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how those who lived before them met their end? They were stronger than them and made a more impressive mark on the land, yet God destroyed them for their sins- they had no one to defend them against Him-
verses.pickthall: Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those who disbelieved before them? They were mightier than these in power and (in the) traces (which they left behind them) in the earth. Yet Allah seized them for their sins, and they had no protector from Allah.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَكَفَرُوا۟ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.en: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allāh seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾannahum kānat ttaʾtīhim rusuluhum bi-l-bayyināti fakafarūā fa-akhadhahumu Allāh ۚ ʾinnahu qawāun shadīdu al-ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: because messengers repeatedly came to them with clear signs and still they rejected them. God destroyed them: He is truly full of strength, severe in punishment.
verses.pickthall: That was because their messengers kept bringing them clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) but they disbelieved; so Allah seized them. Lo! He is Strong, severe in punishment.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
