verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā mūsā bāyātinā wasulṭānin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Moses with Our signs and clear authority
verses.pickthall: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations and a clear warrant

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ وَقَـٰرُونَ فَقَالُوا۟ سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
verses.en: To Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."
verses.tr: ʾilā firʿawna wahāmāna waqārūna faqālūā sāḥirun kadhābun
verses.abdelhaleem: to Pharaoh, Haman, and Korah and they said, ‘Sorcerer! Liar!’
verses.pickthall: Unto Pharaoh and Haman and Korah, but they said: A lying sorcerer!

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَبْنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسْتَحْيُوا۟ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ
verses.en: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.
verses.tr: falammā jāʾahum bi-l-ḥaqqi min ʿindinā qālūā āqtulūā ʾabnāʾa adh-dhīna āmanūā maʿahu wāstaḥyūā nisāʾahum ۚ wamā kaydu al-kāfirīna ʾillā fā ḍalālin
verses.abdelhaleem: When he brought the truth to them from Us, they said, ‘Kill the sons of those who believe with him; spare only their women’- the scheming of those who reject the truth can only go wrong-
verses.pickthall: And when he brought them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Slay the sons of those who believe with him, and spare their women. But the plot of disbelievers is in naught but error.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِىٓ أَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُۥٓ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَن يُظْهِرَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْفَسَادَ
verses.en: And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land."
verses.tr: waqāla firʿawnu dharūnā ʾaqtul mūsā walyadʿu rabbahu ۖ ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʾan yubaddila dīnakum ʾaw ʾan yuẓhira fā al-ʾarḍi al-fasāda
verses.abdelhaleem: and Pharaoh said, ‘Leave me to kill Moses- let him call upon his Lord!- for I fear he may cause you to change your religion, or spread disorder in the land.’
verses.pickthall: And Pharaoh said: Suffer me to kill Moses, and let him cry unto his Lord. Lo! I fear that he will alter your religion or that he will cause confusion in the land.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account."
verses.tr: waqāla mūsā ʾinnā ʿudhtu birabbā warabbikum mmin kulli mutakabbirin llā yuʾminu biyawmi al-ḥisābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said, ‘I seek refuge with my Lord and yours from every tyrant who refuses to believe in the Day of Reckoning.’
verses.pickthall: Moses said: Lo! I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every scorner who believeth not in a Day of Reckoning.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَـٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّىَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَـٰذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى يَعِدُكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ
verses.en: And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is Allāh' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, Allāh does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.
verses.tr: waqāla rajulun mmuʾminun mmin āli firʿawna yaktumu ʾīmānahu ʾataqtulūna rajulan ʾan yaqūla rabbāa Allāh waqad jāʾakum bi-l-bayyināti min rrabbikum ۖ wa-in yaku kādhiban faʿalayhi kadhibuhu ۖ wa-in yaku ṣādiqan yuṣibkum baʿḍu adh-dhā yaʿidukum ۖ ʾinna Allāh lā yahdā man huwa musrifun kadhābun
verses.abdelhaleem: A secret believer from Pharaoh’s family said, ‘How can you kill a man just for saying, “My Lord is God”? He has brought you clear signs from your Lord- if he is a liar, on his own head be it- and if he is truthful, then at least some of what he has threatened will happen to you. God does not guide any rebellious, outrageous liar.
verses.pickthall: And a believing man of Pharaoh's family, who hid his faith, said: Would ye kill a man because he saith: My Lord is Allah, and hath brought you clear proofs from your Lord? If he is lying, then his lie is upon him; and if he is truthful, then some of that wherewith he threateneth you will strike you. Lo! Allah guideth not one who is a prodigal, a liar.

verses.ar: يَـٰقَوْمِ لَكُمُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ظَـٰهِرِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأْسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَا ۚ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
verses.en: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allāh if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."
verses.tr: yāqawmi lakumu al-mulku al-yawma ẓāhirīna fā al-ʾarḍi faman yanṣurunā min baʾsi Allāh ʾin jāʾanā ۚ qāla firʿawnu mā ʾurīkum ʾillā mā ʾarā wamā ʾahdīkum ʾillā sabīla ar-rashādi
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, as masters in the land you have the power today, but who will help us against God’s might if it comes upon us?’ But Pharaoh said, ‘I have told you what I think; I am guiding you along the right path.’
verses.pickthall: O my people! Yours is the kingdom to-day, ye being uppermost in the land. But who would save us from the wrath of Allah should it reach us? Pharaoh said: I do but show you what I think, and I do but guide you to wise policy.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُم مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verses.en: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies -
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhā āmana yāqawmi ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʿalaykum mmithla yawmi al-ʾaḥzābi
verses.abdelhaleem: The believer said, ‘My people, I fear your fate will be the fate of those others who opposed [their prophets]:
verses.pickthall: And he who believed said: O my people! Lo! I fear for you a fate like that of the factions (of old);

verses.ar: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعِبَادِ
verses.en: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them. And Allāh wants no injustice for [His] servants.
verses.tr: mithla daʾbi qawmi nūḥin waʿādin wathamūda wa-adh-dhīna min baʿdihim ۚ wamā Allāh yurīdu ẓulman llilʿibādi
verses.abdelhaleem: the fate of the people of Noah, Ad, Thamud, and those who came after them- God never wills injustice on His creatures.
verses.pickthall: A plight like that of Noah's folk, and A'ad and Thamud, and those after them, and Allah willeth no injustice for (His) slaves.

verses.ar: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ
verses.en: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling -
verses.tr: wayāqawmi ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʿalaykum yawma at-tanādi
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, I fear for you on the Day you will cry out to one another,
verses.pickthall: And, O my people! Lo! I fear for you a Day of Summoning,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
verses.en: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allāh any protector. And whoever Allāh sends astray - there is not for him any guide.
verses.tr: yawma tuwallūna mudbirīna mā lakum mmina Allāh min ʿāṣimin ۗ waman yuḍlili Allāh famā lahu min hādin
verses.abdelhaleem: the Day you will turn tail and flee with no one to defend you from God! Whoever God leaves to stray will have no one to guide him.
verses.pickthall: A day when ye will turn to flee, having no preserver from Allah: and he whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُّرْتَابٌ
verses.en: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."
verses.tr: walaqad jāʾakum yūsufu min qablu bi-l-bayyināti famā ziltum fā shakkin mmimmā jāʾakum bihi ۖ ḥattā ʾidhā halaka qultum lan yabʿatha Allāh min baʿdihi rasūlan ۚ kadhālika yuḍillu Allāh man huwa musrifun mmurtābun
verses.abdelhaleem: Joseph came to you before with clear signs, but you never ceased to doubt the message he brought you. When he died, you said, “God will not send another messenger.”’ In this way God leaves the doubting rebels to stray-
verses.pickthall: And verily Joseph brought you of old clear proofs, yet ye ceased not to be in doubt concerning what he brought you till, when he died, ye said: Allah will not send any messenger after him. Thus Allah deceiveth him who is a prodigal, a doubter.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَـٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۖ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ
verses.en: Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allāh and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allāh seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yujādilūna fā āyāti Allāh bighayri sulṭānin ʾatāhum ۖ kabura maqtan ʿinda Allāh waʿinda adh-dhīna āmanūā ۚ kadhālika yaṭbaʿu Allāh ʿalā kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbārin
verses.abdelhaleem: those who dispute God’s messages, with no authority given to them, are doing something that is loathed by God and by those who believe. In this way God seals up the heart of every arrogant tyrant.
verses.pickthall: Those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without any warrant that hath come unto them, it is greatly hateful in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who believe. Thus doth Allah print on every arrogant, disdainful heart.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَـٰهَـٰمَـٰنُ ٱبْنِ لِى صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّىٓ أَبْلُغُ ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبَ
verses.en: And Pharaoh said, "O Hāmān, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -
verses.tr: waqāla firʿawnu yāhāmānu ābni lā ṣarḥan llaʿallā ʾablughu al-ʾasbāba
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh said, ‘Haman, build me a tall tower so that I may reach the ropes that lead
verses.pickthall: And Pharaoh said: O Haman! Build for me a tower that haply I may reach the roads,

verses.ar: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍ
verses.en: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.
verses.tr: ʾasbāba as-samāwāti fa-aṭṭaliʿa ʾilā ʾilāhi mūsā wa-innā laʾaẓunnuhu kādhiban ۚ wakadhālika zuyyina lifirʿawna sūʾu ʿamalihi waṣudda ʿani as-sabīli ۚ wamā kaydu firʿawna ʾillā fā tabābin
verses.abdelhaleem: to the heavens to look for this God of Moses. I am convinced that he is lying.’ In this way the evil of Pharaoh’s deed was made alluring to him and he was barred from the right path- his scheming led only to ruin.
verses.pickthall: The roads of the heavens, and may look upon the god of Moses, though verily I think him a liar. Thus was the evil that he did made fairseeming unto Pharaoh, and he was debarred from the (right) way. The plot of Pharaoh ended but in ruin.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
verses.en: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct.
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhā āmana yāqawmi āttabiʿūni ʾahdikum sabīla ar-rashādi
verses.abdelhaleem: The believer said, ‘My people, follow me! I will guide you to the right path.
verses.pickthall: And he who believed said: O my people! Follow me. I will show you the way of right conduct.

verses.ar: يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَتَـٰعٌ وَإِنَّ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ ٱلْقَرَارِ
verses.en: O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.
verses.tr: yāqawmi ʾinnamā hādhihi al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā matāʿun wa-inna al-ākhiraha hāa dāru al-qarāri
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, the life of this world is only a brief enjoyment; it is the Hereafter that is the lasting home.
verses.pickthall: O my people! Lo! this life of the world is but a passing comfort, and lo! the Hereafter, that is the enduring home.

verses.ar: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.en: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.
verses.tr: man ʿamila sayyiʾahan falā yujzā ʾillā mithlahā ۖ waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan mmin dhakarin ʾaw ʾunthā wahuwa muʾminun fa-ūlāʾika yadkhulūna al-jannaha yurzaqūna fīhā bighayri ḥisābin
verses.abdelhaleem: Whoever does evil will be repaid with its like; whoever does good and believes, be it a man or a woman, will enter Paradise and be provided for without measure.
verses.pickthall: Whoso doeth an ill-deed, he will be repaid the like thereof, while whoso doeth right, whether male or female, and is a believer, (all) such will enter the Garden, where they will be nourished without stint.

verses.ar: ۞ وَيَـٰقَوْمِ مَا لِىٓ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?
verses.tr: ۞ wayāqawmi mā lā ʾadʿūkum ʾilā an-najawāhi watadʿūnanā ʾilā an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: My people, why do I call you to salvation when you call me to the Fire?
verses.pickthall: And, O my people! What aileth me that I call you unto deliverance when ye call me unto the Fire?

verses.ar: تَدْعُونَنِى لِأَكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا۠ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرِ
verses.en: You invite me to disbelieve in Allāh and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
verses.tr: tadʿūnanā liʾakfura billāh wa-ushrika bihi mā laysa lā bihi ʿilmun wa-anā ʾadʿūkum ʾilā al-ʿazīzi al-ghaffāri
verses.abdelhaleem: You call me to disbelieve in God and to associate with Him things of which I have no knowledge; I call you to the Mighty, the Forgiving One.
verses.pickthall: Ye call me to disbelieve in Allah and ascribe unto Him as partners that whereof I have no knowledge, while I call you unto the Mighty, the Forgiver.

verses.ar: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَعْوَةٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allāh, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.
verses.tr: lā jarama ʾannamā tadʿūnanā ʾilayhi laysa lahu daʿwahun fā ad-dunyā walā fā al-ākhirahi wa-anna maraddanā ʾilā Allāh wa-anna al-musrifīna hum ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: There is no doubt that what you call me to serve is not fit to be invoked either in this world or the Hereafter: our return is to God alone, and it will be the rebels who will inhabit the Fire.
verses.pickthall: Assuredly that whereunto ye call me hath no claim in the world or in the Hereafter, and our return will be unto Allah, and the prodigals will be owners of the Fire.

verses.ar: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.en: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants."
verses.tr: fasatadhkurūna mā ʾaqūlu lakum ۚ wa-ufawwiḍu ʾamrā ʾilā Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh baṣīrun bi-l-ʿibādi
verses.abdelhaleem: [One Day] you will remember what I am saying to you now, so I commit my case to God: God is well aware of His servants.’
verses.pickthall: And ye will remember what I say unto you. I confide my cause unto Allah. Lo! Allah is Seer of (His) slaves.

verses.ar: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verses.en: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -
verses.tr: fawaqāhu Allāh sayyāti mā makarūā ۖ waḥāqa bāli firʿawna sūʾu al-ʿadhābi
verses.abdelhaleem: So God saved him from the harm they planned. A terrible punishment engulfed Pharaoh’s people;
verses.pickthall: So Allah warded off from him the evils which they plotted, while a dreadful doom encompassed Pharaoh's folk,

verses.ar: ٱلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا ۖ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verses.en: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."
verses.tr: an-nāru yuʿraḍūna ʿalayhā ghuduwwan waʿashiyyan ۖ wayawma taqūmu as-sāʿahu ʾadkhilūā āla firʿawna ʾashadda al-ʿadhābi
verses.abdelhaleem: they will be brought before the Fire morning and evening. On the Day the Hour comes, it will be said, ‘Throw Pharaoh’s people into the worst torment.’
verses.pickthall: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening; and on the day when the Hour upriseth (it is said): Cause Pharaoh's folk to enter the most awful doom.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَـٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"
verses.tr: wa-idh yataḥājjūna fā an-nāri fayaqūlu aḍ-ḍuʿafā lilladhīna āstakbarūā ʾinnā kunnā lakum tabaʿan fahal ʾantum mmughnūna ʿannā naṣīban mmina an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: In the Fire they will quarrel with one another: the weak will say to the haughty, ‘We were your followers, so can you now relieve us from some share of the Fire?’
verses.pickthall: And when they wrangle in the Fire, the weak say unto those who were proud: Lo! we were a following unto you; will ye therefor rid us of a portion of the Fire?

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ ٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.en: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, Allāh has judged between the servants."
verses.tr: qāla adh-dhīna āstakbarūā ʾinnā kullun fīhā ʾinna Allāh qad ḥakama bayna al-ʿibādi
verses.abdelhaleem: but they will say, ‘We are all in this together. God has judged between His creatures.’
verses.pickthall: Those who were proud say: Lo! we are all (together) herein. Lo! Allah hath judged between (His) slaves.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verses.en: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna fā an-nāri likhazanahi jahannama ādʿūā rabbakum yukhaffif ʿannā yawman mmina al-ʿadhābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, ‘Ask your Lord to lessen our suffering for one day,’
verses.pickthall: And those in the Fire say unto the guards of hell: Entreat your Lord that He relieve us of a day of the torment.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ ۚ قَالُوا۟ فَٱدْعُوا۟ ۗ وَمَا دُعَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ
verses.en: They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error [i.e., futility]."
verses.tr: qālūā ʾawalam taku taʾtīkum rusulukum bi-l-bayyināti ۖ qālūā balā ۚ qālūā fādʿūā ۗ wamā duʿā al-kāfirīna ʾillā fā ḍalālin
verses.abdelhaleem: but they will say, ‘Did your messengers not come to you with clear evidence of the truth?’ They will say, ‘Yes they did,’ and the keeper will say, ‘You can plead, then, but the pleas of disbelievers will always be in vain.’
verses.pickthall: They say: Came not your messengers unto you with clear proofs? They say: Yea, verily. They say: Then do ye pray, although the prayer of disbelievers is in vain.

verses.ar: إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْأَشْهَـٰدُ
verses.en: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -
verses.tr: ʾinnā lananṣuru rusulanā wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā wayawma yaqūmu al-ʾashhādu
verses.abdelhaleem: We support Our messengers and the believers, in the present life and on the Day when witnesses arise.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We verily do help Our messengers, and those who believe, in the life of the world and on the day when the witnesses arise,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ
verses.en: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home [i.e., Hell].
verses.tr: yawma lā yanfaʿu aẓ-ẓālimīna maʿdhiratuhum ۖ walahumu al-laʿnahu walahum sūʾu ad-dāri
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when excuses will not profit the evildoers, their fate will be rejection and they will have the worst of homes.
verses.pickthall: The day when their excuse availeth not the evil-doers, and theirs is the curse, and theirs the ill abode.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ
verses.en: And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā mūsā al-hudā wa-awrathnā banā ʾisrāʾīla al-kitāba
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave Moses guidance and passed down the Scripture to the Children of Israel,
verses.pickthall: And We verily gave Moses the guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture,

verses.ar: هُدًى وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.
verses.tr: hudanā wadhikrā liʾūlā al-ʾalbābi
verses.abdelhaleem: as a guide and a reminder to people of understanding.
verses.pickthall: A guide and a reminder for men of understanding.

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَـٰرِ
verses.en: So be patient, [O Muḥammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.
verses.tr: fāṣbir ʾinna waʿda Allāh ḥaqqun wāstaghfir lidhanbika wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika bi-l-ʿashāi wa-l-ʾibkāri
verses.abdelhaleem: So be patient, Prophet, for what God has promised is sure to come. Ask forgiveness for your sins; praise your Lord morning and evening.
verses.pickthall: Then have patience (O Muhammad). Lo! the promise of Allah is true. And ask forgiveness of thy sin, and hymn the praise of thy Lord at fall of night and in the early hours.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَـٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۙ إِن فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُم بِبَـٰلِغِيهِ ۚ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.en: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without [any] evidence having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, [the extent of] which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yujādilūna fā āyāti Allāh bighayri sulṭānin ʾatāhum ۙ ʾin fā ṣudūrihim ʾillā kibrun mmā hum bibālighīhi ۚ fāstaʿidh billāh ۖ ʾinnahu huwa as-samīʿu al-baṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who, with no authority to do so, dispute God’s messages, there is nothing in their hearts but a thirst for a greatness they will never attain. Seek refuge in God, for He is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without a warrant having come unto them, there is naught else in their breasts save pride which they will never attain. So take thou refuge in Allah. Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Seer.

verses.ar: لَخَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.
verses.tr: lakhalqu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ʾakbaru min khalqi an-nāsi walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater by far than the creation of mankind, though most people do not know it.
verses.pickthall: Assuredly the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of mankind; but most of mankind know not.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَلَا ٱلْمُسِىٓءُ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember.
verses.tr: wamā yastawā al-ʾaʿmā wa-l-baṣīru wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti walā al-musāʾu ۚ qalīlan mmā tatadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The blind and the sighted are not equal, just as those who believe and do good works and those who do evil are not equal: how seldom you reflect!
verses.pickthall: And the blind man and the seer are not equal, neither are those who believe and do good works (equal with) the evil-doer. Little do ye reflect!

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe.
verses.tr: ʾinna as-sāʿaha lātiyahun llā rayba fīhā walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Final Hour is sure to come, without doubt, but most people do not believe.
verses.pickthall: Lo! the Hour is surely coming, there is no doubt thereof; yet most of mankind believe not.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.
verses.tr: waqāla rabbukumu ādʿūnā ʾastajib lakum ۚ ʾinna adh-dhīna yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatā sayadkhulūna jahannama dākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord says, ‘Call on Me and I will answer you; those who are too proud to serve Me will enter Hell humiliated.’
verses.pickthall: And your Lord hath said: Pray unto Me and I will hear your prayer. Lo! those who scorn My service, they will enter hell, disgraced.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: It is Allāh who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight. Indeed, Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful.
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā jaʿala lakumu al-yla litaskunūā fīhi wa-an-nahāra mubṣiran ۚ ʾinna Allāh ladhū faḍlin ʿalā an-nāsi walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who has given you the night in which to rest and the day in which to see. God is truly bountiful to people, but most people do not give thanks.
verses.pickthall: Allah it is Who hath appointed for you night that ye may rest therein, and day for seeing. Lo! Allah is a Lord of bounty for mankind, yet most of mankind give not thanks.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.en: That is Allāh, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
verses.tr: dhālikumu Allāh rabbukum khāliqu kulli shāʾin llā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۖ fa-annā tuʾfakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Such is God your Lord, the Creator of all things: there is no god but Him. How can you be so deluded?
verses.pickthall: Such is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye perverted?

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.en: Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allāh.
verses.tr: kadhālika yuʾfaku adh-dhīna kānūā bāyāti Allāh yajḥadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is how deluded those who deny God’s messages are.
verses.pickthall: Thus are they perverted who deny the revelations of Allah.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: It is Allāh who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a structure [i.e., ceiling] and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allāh, your Lord; then blessed is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā jaʿala lakumu al-ʾarḍa qarāran wa-as-samāʾa bināʾan waṣawwarakum fa-aḥsana ṣuwarakum warazaqakum mmina aṭ-ṭayyibāti ۚ dhālikumu Allāh rabbukum ۖ fatabāraka Allāh rabbu al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who has given you the earth for a dwelling place and the heavens for a canopy. He shaped you, formed you well, and provided you with good things. Such is God your Lord, so glory be to Him, the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: Allah it is Who appointed for you the earth for a dwelling-place and the sky for a canopy, and fashioned you and perfected your shapes, and hath provided you with good things. Such is Allah, your Lord. Then blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱدْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ۗ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: He is the Ever-Living; there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: huwa al-ḥāu lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa fādʿūhu mukhliṣīna lahu ad-dīna ۗ al-ḥamdu lillāh rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He is the Living One and there is no god but Him, so call on Him, and dedicate your religion entirely to Him. Praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.pickthall: He is the Living One. There is no Allah save Him. So pray unto Him, making religion pure for Him (only). Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!

verses.ar: ۞ قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِىَ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ مِن رَّبِّى وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allāh once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds."
verses.tr: ۞ qul ʾinnā nuhītu ʾan ʾaʿbuda adh-dhīna tadʿūna min dūni Allāh lammā jāʾanāa al-bayyinātu min rrabbā wa-umirtu ʾan ʾuslima lirabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Since clear evidence has come to me from my Lord I am forbidden to serve those you call upon besides God: I am commanded to submit to the Lord of the Worlds.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): I am forbidden to worship those unto whom ye cry beside Allah since there have come unto me clear proofs from my Lord, and I am commanded to surrender to the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا۟ شُيُوخًا ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَجَلًا مُّسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā khalaqakum mmin turābin thumma min nnuṭfahin thumma min ʿalaqahin thumma yukhrijukum ṭiflan thumma litablughūā ʾashuddakum thumma litakūnūā shuyūkhan ۚ waminkum mman yutawaffā min qablu ۖ walitablughūā ʾajalan mmusammanā walaʿallakum taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who created you from dust, then from a drop of fluid, then from a tiny, clinging form, then He brought you forth as infants, then He allowed you to reach maturity, then He let you grow old- though some of you die sooner- and reach your appointed term so that you may reflect.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who created you from dust, then from a drop (of seed) then from a clot, then bringeth you forth as a child, then (ordaineth) that ye attain full strength and afterward that ye become old men - though some among you die before - and that ye reach an appointed term, that haply ye may understand.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.en: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā yuḥāi wayumītu ۖ fa-idhā qaḍā ʾamran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who gives life and death, and when He ordains a thing, He says only ‘Be’ and it is.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who quickeneth and giveth death. When He ordaineth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ
verses.en: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh - how are they averted?
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾilā adh-dhīna yujādilūna fā āyāti Allāh ʾannā yuṣrafūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do you see how deluded those who dispute God’s messages are-
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah, how they are turned away? -

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Those who deny the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know,
verses.tr: adh-dhīna kadhabūā bi-l-kitābi wabimā ʾarsalnā bihi rusulanā ۖ fasawfa yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who reject the Scripture and the messages We have sent through Our messengers? They will find out
verses.pickthall: Those who deny the Scripture and that wherewith We send Our messengers. But they will come to know,

verses.ar: إِذِ ٱلْأَغْلَـٰلُ فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ وَٱلسَّلَـٰسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ
verses.en: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged
verses.tr: ʾidhi al-ʾaghlālu fā ʾaʿnāqihim wa-as-salāsilu yusḥabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: when, with iron collars and chains around their necks, they are dragged
verses.pickthall: When carcans are about their necks and chains. They are dragged

verses.ar: فِى ٱلْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ
verses.en: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].
verses.tr: fā al-ḥamīmi thumma fā an-nāri yusjarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: into scalding water, and then burned in the Fire,
verses.pickthall: Through boiling waters; then they are thrust into the Fire.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]
verses.tr: thumma qīla lahum ʾayna mā kuntum tushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and asked, ‘Where now are those you called upon
verses.pickthall: Then it is said unto them: Where are (all) that ye used to make partners (in the Sovereignty)

verses.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنَّا بَل لَّمْ نَكُن نَّدْعُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ شَيْـًٔا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: Other than Allāh?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allāh put astray the disbelievers.
verses.tr: min dūni Allāh ۖ qālūā ḍallūā ʿannā bal llam nakun nnadʿūā min qablu shayā ۚ kadhālika yuḍillu Allāh al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: besides God?’ They will say, ‘They have abandoned us: those we called upon before were really nothing at all.’ ‘This is how God lets disbelievers go astray,
verses.pickthall: Beside Allah? They say: They have failed us; but we used not to pray to anything before. Thus doth Allah send astray the disbelievers (in His guidance).

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ
verses.en: [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.
verses.tr: dhālikum bimā kuntum tafraḥūna fā al-ʾarḍi bighayri al-ḥaqqi wabimā kuntum tamraḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: all because on earth you revelled in untruth and ran wild.
verses.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): This is because ye exulted in the earth without right, and because ye were petulant.

verses.ar: ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
verses.en: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."
verses.tr: ādkhulūā ʾabwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā ۖ fabiʾsa mathwā al-mutakabbirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Enter the gates of Hell, there to remain- an evil home for the arrogant.’
verses.pickthall: Enter ye the gates of hell, to dwell therein. Evil is the habitation of the scornful.

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: So be patient, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.
verses.tr: fāṣbir ʾinna waʿda Allāh ḥaqqun ۚ fa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa adh-dhā naʿiduhum ʾaw natawaffayannaka fa-ā yurjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So be patient [Prophet], for God’s promise is sure: whether We show you part of what We have promised them in this life or whether We take your soul back to Us first, it is to Us that they will be returned.
verses.pickthall: Then have patience (O Muhammad). Lo! the promise of Allah is true. And whether we let thee see a part of that which We promise them, or (whether) We cause thee to die, still unto Us they will be brought back.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِىَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verses.en: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of Allāh. So when the command of Allāh comes, it will be concluded [i.e., judged] in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all].
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā rusulan mmin qablika minhum mman qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka waminhum mman llam naqṣuṣ ʿalayka ۗ wamā kāna lirasūlin ʾan yaʾtāa bāyahin ʾillā biʾidhni Allāh ۚ fa-idhā jāʾa ʾamru Allāh quḍāa bi-l-ḥaqqi wakhasira hunālika al-mubṭilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent other messengers before you- some We have mentioned to you and some We have not- and no messenger could bring about a sign except with God’s permission. When [the Day] God ordained comes, just judgement will be passed between them: there and then, those who followed falsehood will be lost.
verses.pickthall: Verily We sent messengers before thee, among them those of whom We have told thee, and some of whom We have not told thee; and it was not given to any messenger that he should bring a portent save by Allah's leave, but when Allah's commandment cometh (the cause) is judged aright, and the followers of vanity will then be lost.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمَ لِتَرْكَبُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: It is Allāh who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat.
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā jaʿala lakumu al-ʾanʿāma litarkabūā minhā waminhā taʾkulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who provides livestock for you, some for riding and some for your food;
verses.pickthall: Allah it is Who hath appointed for you cattle, that ye may ride on some of them, and eat of some -

verses.ar: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةً فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts; and upon them and upon ships you are carried.
verses.tr: walakum fīhā manāfiʿu walitablughūā ʿalayhā ḥājahan fā ṣudūrikum waʿalayhā waʿalā al-fulki tuḥmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: you have other benefits in them too. You can reach any destination you wish on them: they carry you, as ships carry you [on the sea].
verses.pickthall: (Many) benefits ye have from them - and that ye may satisfy by their means a need that is in your breasts, and may be borne upon them as upon the ship.

verses.ar: وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ فَأَىَّ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ
verses.en: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allāh do you deny?
verses.tr: wayurīkum āyātihi faa āyāti Allāh tunkirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He shows you His signs: which of God’s signs do you still ignore?
verses.pickthall: And He showeth you His tokens. Which, then, of the tokens of Allah do ye deny?

verses.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
verses.tr: ʾafalam yasīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fayanẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ kānūā ʾakthara minhum wa-ashadda quwwahan wathāran fā al-ʾarḍi famā ʾaghnā ʿanhum mmā kānūā yaksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how those who lived before them met their end? They were more numerous than them, stronger than them, and made a more impressive mark on the land, yet what they achieved was of no use to them at all.
verses.pickthall: Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those before them? They were more numerous than these, and mightier in power and (in the) traces (which they left behind them) in the earth. But all that they used to earn availed them not.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.tr: falammā jāʾathum rusuluhum bi-l-bayyināti fariḥūā bimā ʿindahum mmina al-ʿilmi waḥāqa bihim mmā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When messengers came to them with clear signs, they revelled in the knowledge they had, and so they were engulfed by the very punishment they mocked:
verses.pickthall: And when their messengers brought them clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) they exulted in the knowledge they (themselves) possessed. And that which they were wont to mock befell them.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: And when they saw Our punishment, they said, "We believe in Allāh alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him."
verses.tr: falammā raʾawā baʾsanā qālūā āmannā billāh waḥdahu wakafarnā bimā kunnā bihi mushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: when they saw Our punishment, they said, ‘We believe in God alone; we reject any partner we ascribed to Him,’
verses.pickthall: Then, when they saw Our doom, they said: We believe in Allah only and reject (all) that we used to associate (with Him).

verses.ar: فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمْ إِيمَـٰنُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا ۖ سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ فِى عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. [It is] the established way of Allāh which has preceded among His servants. And the disbelievers thereupon lost [all].
verses.tr: falam yaku yanfaʿuhum ʾīmānuhum lammā raʾawā baʾsanā ۖ sunnata Allāh at-tā qad khalat fā ʿibādihi ۖ wakhasira hunālika al-kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but believing after seeing Our punishment did not benefit them at all- this has always been God’s way of dealing with His creatures- there and then the disbelievers were lost.
verses.pickthall: But their faith could not avail them when they saw Our doom. This is Allah's law which hath ever taken course for His bondmen. And then the disbelievers will be ruined.

verses.ar: حمٓ
verses.en: Ḥā, Meem.
verses.tr: ḥm
verses.abdelhaleem: Ha Mim
verses.pickthall: Ha. Mim.

verses.ar: تَنزِيلٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.en: [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -
verses.tr: tanzīlun mmina ar-raḥmāni ar-raḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: A revelation from the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy;
verses.pickthall: A revelation from the Beneficent, the Merciful,

verses.ar: كِتَـٰبٌ فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān for a people who know,
verses.tr: kitābun fuṣṣilat āyātuhu qurānan ʿarabiyyan lliqawmin yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: a Scripture whose verses are made distinct as a Quran in Arabic for people who understand,
verses.pickthall: A Scripture whereof the verses are expounded, a Lecture in Arabic for people who have knowledge,

verses.ar: بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
verses.en: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.
verses.tr: bashīran wanadhīran fa-aʿraḍa ʾaktharuhum fahum lā yasmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: giving good news and warning. Yet most of them turn away and so do not hear.
verses.pickthall: Good tidings and a warning. But most of them turn away so that they hear not.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا فِىٓ أَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَمِنۢ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَٱعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَـٰمِلُونَ
verses.en: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings [i.e., screened] from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work; indeed, we are working."
verses.tr: waqālūā qulūbunā fā ʾakinnahin mmimmā tadʿūnā ʾilayhi wafā ādhāninā waqrun wamin bayninā wabaynika ḥijābun fāʿmal ʾinnanā ʿāmilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘Our hearts are encased against [the faith] you call us to; our ears are heavy; there is a barrier between us and you. So you do whatever you want, and so shall we.’
verses.pickthall: And they say: Our hearts are protected from that unto which thou (O Muhammad) callest us, and in our ears there is a deafness, and between us and thee there is a veil. Act, then. Lo! we also shall be acting.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ۗ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allāh
verses.tr: qul ʾinnamā ʾanā basharun mmithlukum yūḥā ʾilāa ʾannamā ʾilāhukum ʾilāhun wāḥidun fāstaqīmūā ʾilayhi wāstaghfirūhu ۗ wawaylun llilmushrikīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘I am only a mortal like you, [but] it has been revealed to me that your God is One. Take the straight path to Him and seek His forgiveness. Woe to the idolaters,
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them O Muhammad): I am only a mortal like you. It is inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah, therefor take the straight path unto Him and seek forgiveness of Him. And woe unto the idolaters,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: Those who do not give zakāh, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna lā yuʾtūna az-zakawāha wahum bi-l-ākhirahi hum kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who do not pay the prescribed alms and refuse to believe in the world to come!
verses.pickthall: Who give not the poor-due, and who are disbelievers in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
verses.en: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum ʾajrun ghayru mamnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who believe and do good deeds will have a reward that never fails.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! as for those who believe and do good works, for them is a reward enduring.

verses.ar: ۞ قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."
verses.tr: ۞ qul ʾaʾinnakum latakfurūna bi-adh-dhā khalaqa al-ʾarḍa fā yawmayni watajʿalūna lahu ʾandādan ۚ dhālika rabbu al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘How can you disregard the One who created the earth in two Days? How can you set up other gods as His equals? He is the Lord of all the worlds!’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the idolaters): Disbelieve ye verily in Him Who created the earth in two Days, and ascribe ye unto Him rivals? He (and none else) is the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَـٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقْوَٰتَهَا فِىٓ أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
verses.en: And He placed on it [i.e., the earth] firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information of] those who ask.
verses.tr: wajaʿala fīhā rawāsāa min fawqihā wabāraka fīhā waqaddara fīhā ʾaqwātahā fā ʾarbaʿahi ʾayyāmin sawāʾan llilssāʾilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: He placed solid mountains on it, blessed it, measured out its varied provisions for all who seek them––all in four Days.
verses.pickthall: He placed therein firm hills rising above it, and blessed it and measured therein its sustenance in four Days, alike for (all) who ask;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ٱئْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَآ أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ
verses.en: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."
verses.tr: thumma āstawā ʾilā as-samāʾi wahāa dukhānun faqāla lahā walilʾarḍi āʾtiyā ṭawʿan ʾaw karhan qālatā ʾataynā ṭāʾiʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Then He turned to the sky, which was smoke––He said to it and the earth, ‘Come into being, willingly or not,’ and they said, ‘We come willingly’––
verses.pickthall: Then turned He to the heaven when it was smoke, and said unto it and unto the earth: Come both of you, willingly or loth. They said: We come, obedient.

verses.ar: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَاتٍ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا ۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.en: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired [i.e., made known] in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars, for beauty] and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.tr: faqaḍāhunna sabʿa samāwātin fā yawmayni wa-awḥā fā kulli samāʾin ʾamrahā ۚ wazayyannā as-samāʾa ad-dunyā bimaṣābīḥa waḥifẓan ۚ dhālika taqdīru al-ʿazīzi al-ʿalīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: and in two Days He formed seven heavens, and assigned an order to each. We have made the nearest one beautifully illuminated and secure. Such is the design of the Almighty, the All Knowing.
verses.pickthall: Then He ordained them seven heavens in two Days and inspired in each heaven its mandate; and We decked the nether heaven with lamps, and rendered it inviolable. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Knower.

verses.ar: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَقُلْ أَنذَرْتُكُمْ صَـٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صَـٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ
verses.en: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] ʿAad and Thamūd.
verses.tr: fa-in ʾaʿraḍūā faqul ʾandhartukum ṣāʿiqahan mmithla ṣāʿiqahi ʿādin wathamūda
verses.abdelhaleem: If they turn away, say, ‘I have warned you about a blast like the one which struck 'Ad and Thamud:
verses.pickthall: But if they turn away, then say: I warn you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt (which fell of old upon the tribes) of A'ad and Thamud;

verses.ar: إِذْ جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً فَإِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allāh." They said, "If our Lord had willed, He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers."
verses.tr: ʾidh jāʾathumu ar-rusulu min bayni ʾaydīhim wamin khalfihim ʾallā taʿbudūā ʾillā Allāh ۖ qālūā law shāʾa rabbunā laʾanzala malāʾikahan fa-innā bimā ʾursiltum bihi kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: when their messengers came to them, from all angles, saying, “Serve no one but God,” they said, “If our Lord had wished, He would have sent down angels. We do not believe in the message with which you have been sent.”
verses.pickthall: When their messengers came unto them from before them and behind them, saying: Worship none but Allah! they said: If our Lord had willed, He surely would have sent down angels (unto us), so lo! we are disbelievers in that wherewith ye have been sent.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.en: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.
verses.tr: fa-ammā ʿādun fāstakbarūā fā al-ʾarḍi bighayri al-ḥaqqi waqālūā man ʾashaddu minnā quwwahan ۖ ʾawalam yarawā ʾanna Allāh adh-dhā khalaqahum huwa ʾashaddu minhum quwwahan ۖ wakānūā bāyātinā yajḥadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of 'Ad behaved arrogantly throughout the land without any right, saying, “Who could be stronger than us?” Did they not realize that God, who created them, was stronger than them?’ They continued to reject Our message,
verses.pickthall: As for A'ad, they were arrogant in the land without right, and they said: Who is mightier than us in power? Could they not see that Allah Who created them, He was mightier than them in power? And they denied Our revelations.

verses.ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَخْزَىٰ ۖ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped.
verses.tr: fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fā ʾayyāmin nnaḥisātin llinudhīqahum ʿadhāba al-khizāi fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۖ walaʿadhābu al-ākhirahi ʾakhzā ۖ wahum lā yunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so We let a roaring wind loose on them for a few disastrous days to make them taste the punishment of shame in this world; more shameful still will be the punishment of the life to come, and they will not be helped.
verses.pickthall: Therefor We let loose on them a raging wind in evil days, that We might make them taste the torment of disgrace in the life of the world. And verily the doom of the Hereafter will be more shameful, and they will not be helped.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَـٰعِقَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: And as for Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.
verses.tr: wa-ammā thamūdu fahadaynāhum fāstaḥabbūā al-ʿamā ʿalā al-hudā fa-akhadhathum ṣāʿiqahu al-ʿadhābi al-hūni bimā kānūā yaksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for Thamud, We gave them guidance but they preferred blindness, so they were struck by a blast of humiliating punishment for their misdeeds.
verses.pickthall: And as for Thamud, We gave them guidance, but they preferred blindness to the guidance, so the bolt of the doom of humiliation overtook them because of what they used to earn.

verses.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.
verses.tr: wanajjaynā adh-dhīna āmanūā wakānūā yattaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved those who believed and were mindful of God.
verses.pickthall: And We delivered those who believed and used to keep their duty to Allah.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَآءُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day when the enemies of Allāh will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven], assembled in rows,
verses.tr: wayawma yuḥsharu ʾaʿdāʾu Allāh ʾilā an-nāri fahum yūzaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when God’s enemies are gathered up for the Fire and driven onward,
verses.pickthall: And (make mention of) the day when the enemies of Allah are gathered unto the Fire, they are driven on

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā mā jāʾūhā shahida ʿalayhim samʿuhum wa-abṣāruhum wajulūduhum bimā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: their ears, eyes, and skins will, when they reach it, testify against them for their misdeeds.
verses.pickthall: Till, when they reach it, their ears and their eyes and their skins testify against them as to what they used to do.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allāh, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.
verses.tr: waqālūā lijulūdihim lima shahidttum ʿalaynā ۖ qālūā ʾanṭaqanā Allāh adh-dhā ʾanṭaqa kulla shāʾin wahuwa khalaqakum ʾawwala marrahin wa-ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say to their skins, ‘Why did you testify against us?’ and their skins will reply, ‘God, who gave speech to everything, has given us speech- it was He who created you the first time and to Him you have been returned-
verses.pickthall: And they say unto their skins: Why testify ye against us? They say: Allah hath given us speech Who giveth speech to all things, and Who created you at the first, and unto Whom ye are returned.

verses.ar: وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَـٰرُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن ظَنَنتُمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And you were not covering [i.e., protecting] yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allāh does not know much of what you do.
verses.tr: wamā kuntum tastatirūna ʾan yashhada ʿalaykum samʿukum walā ʾabṣārukum walā julūdukum walākin ẓanantum ʾanna Allāh lā yaʿlamu kathīran mmimmā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: yet you did not try to hide yourselves from your ears, eyes, and skin to prevent them from testifying against you. You thought that God did not know about much of what you were doing,
verses.pickthall: Ye did not hide yourselves lest your ears and your eyes and your skins should testify against you, but ye deemed that Allah knew not much of what ye did.

verses.ar: وَذَٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَىٰكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."
verses.tr: wadhālikum ẓannukumu adh-dhā ẓanantum birabbikum ʾardākum fa-aṣbaḥtum mmina al-khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: so it was the thoughts you entertained about your Lord that led to your ruin, and you became losers.’
verses.pickthall: That, your thought which ye did think about your Lord, hath ruined you; and ye find yourselves (this day) among the lost.

verses.ar: فَإِن يَصْبِرُوا۟ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَسْتَعْتِبُوا۟ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُعْتَبِينَ
verses.en: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allāh], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease.
verses.tr: fa-in yaṣbirūā fa-an-nāru mathwanā llahum ۖ wa-in yastaʿtibūā famā hum mmina al-muʿtabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Fire will still be their home, even if they resign themselves to patience, and if they pray to be allowed to make amends, they will not be given permission to do so.
verses.pickthall: And though they are resigned, yet the Fire is still their home; and if they ask for favour, yet they are not of those unto whom favour can be shown.

verses.ar: ۞ وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُوا۟ لَهُم مَّا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: And We appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
verses.tr: ۞ waqayyaḍnā lahum quranāʾa fazayyanūā lahum mmā bayna ʾaydīhim wamā khalfahum waḥaqqa ʿalayhimu al-qawlu fā ʾumamin qad khalat min qablihim mmina al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi ۖ ʾinnahum kānūā khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have appointed, for the disbelievers, companions who make their past and present seem fair and right to them, but the sentence has already been passed on them, along with generations of jinn and men before them: they were losers.
verses.pickthall: And We assigned them comrades (in the world), who made their present and their past fairseeming unto them. And the Word concerning nations of the jinn and humankind who passed away before them hath effect for them. Lo! they were ever losers.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَسْمَعُوا۟ لِهَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَٱلْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ
verses.en: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur’ān and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lā tasmaʿūā lihādhā al-qurāni wa-l-ghawā fīhi laʿallakum taghlibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers say, ‘Do not listen to this Quran; drown it in frivolous talk: you may gain the upper hand.’
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve say: Heed not this Qur'an, and drown the hearing of it; haply ye may conquer.

verses.ar: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.
verses.tr: falanudhīqanna adh-dhīna kafarūā ʿadhāban shadīdan walanajziyannahum ʾaswaʾa adh-dhā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall certainly give the disbelievers a taste of severe punishment. We shall repay them according to their worst deeds-
verses.pickthall: But verily We shall cause those who disbelieve to taste an awful doom, and verily We shall requite them the worst of what they used to do.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعْدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ۖ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verses.en: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allāh - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting.
verses.tr: dhālika jazāʾu ʾaʿdāʾi Allāh an-nāru ۖ lahum fīhā dāru al-khuldi ۖ jazāʾan bimā kānūā bāyātinā yajḥadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: that is the reward of the enemies of God- the Fire will be their lasting home, a payment for their rejection of Our revelations.
verses.pickthall: That is the reward of Allah's enemies: the Fire. Therein is their immortal home, payment forasmuch as they denied Our revelations.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
verses.en: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet that they will be among the lowest."
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā rabbanā ʾarinā adh-dhayni ʾaḍallānā mina al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi najʿalhumā taḥta ʾaqdāminā liyakūnā mina al-ʾasfalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers will say, ‘Our Lord, show us those jinn and men who misled us and we shall trample them underfoot, so that they may be among the lowest of the low.’
verses.pickthall: And those who disbelieve will say: Our Lord! Show us those who beguiled us of the jinn and humankind. We will place them underneath our feet that they may be among the nethermost.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَبْشِرُوا۟ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh" and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna qālūā rabbunā Allāh thumma āstaqāmūā tatanazzalu ʿalayhimu al-malāʾikahu ʾallā takhāfūā walā taḥzanūā wa-abshirūā bi-l-jannahi at-tā kuntum tūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who say, ‘Our Lord is God,’ and take the straight path towards Him, the angels come down to them and say, ‘Have no fear or grief, but rejoice in the good news of Paradise, which you have been promised.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and afterward are upright, the angels descend upon them, saying: Fear not nor grieve, but hear good tidings of the paradise which ye are promised.

verses.ar: نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَآؤُكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِىٓ أَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ
verses.en: We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]
verses.tr: naḥnu ʾawliyāʾukum fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā wafā al-ākhirahi ۖ walakum fīhā mā tashtahā ʾanfusukum walakum fīhā mā taddaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We are your allies in this world and in the world to come, where you will have everything you desire and ask for
verses.pickthall: We are your protecting friends in the life of the world and in the Hereafter. There ye will have (all) that your souls desire, and there ye will have (all) for which ye pray.

verses.ar: نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُورٍ رَّحِيمٍ
verses.en: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.tr: nuzulan mmin ghafūrin rraḥīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: as a welcoming gift from the Most Forgiving, Most Merciful One.’
verses.pickthall: A gift of welcome from One Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allāh and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."
verses.tr: waman ʾaḥsanu qawlan mmimman daʿā ʾilā Allāh waʿamila ṣāliḥan waqāla ʾinnanā mina al-muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who speaks better than someone who calls people to God, does what is right, and says, ‘I am one of those devoted to God’?
verses.pickthall: And who is better in speech than him who prayeth unto his Lord and doeth right, and saith: Lo! I am of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him).

verses.ar: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌ
verses.en: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.
verses.tr: walā tastawā al-ḥasanahu walā as-sayyiʾahu ۚ ādfaʿ bi-at-tā hāa ʾaḥsanu fa-idhā adh-dhā baynaka wabaynahu ʿadāwahun kaʾannahu walāun ḥamīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Good and evil cannot be equal. [Prophet], repel evil with what is better and your enemy will become as close as an old and valued friend,
verses.pickthall: The good deed and the evil deed are not alike. Repel the evil deed with one which is better, then lo! he, between whom and thee there was enmity (will become) as though he was a bosom friend.

verses.ar: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].
verses.tr: wamā yulaqqāhā ʾillā adh-dhīna ṣabarūā wamā yulaqqāhā ʾillā dhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: but only those who are steadfast in patience, only those who are blessed with great righteousness, will attain to such goodness.
verses.pickthall: But none is granted it save those who are steadfast, and none is granted it save the owner of great happiness.

verses.ar: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.tr: wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina ash-shayṭāni nazghun fāstaʿidh billāh ۖ ʾinnahu huwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: If a prompting from Satan should stir you, seek refuge with God: He is the All Hearing and the All Knowing.
verses.pickthall: And if a whisper from the devil reach thee (O Muhammad) then seek refuge in Allah. Lo! He is the Hearer, the Knower.

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِ ٱلَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ ۚ لَا تَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostrate to Allāh, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi al-ylu wa-an-nahāru wa-ash-shamsu wa-l-qamaru ۚ lā tasjudūā lilshamsi walā lilqamari wāsjudūā lillāh adh-dhā khalaqahunna ʾin kuntum ʾiyyāhu taʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The night, the day, the sun, the moon, are only a few of His signs. Do not bow down in worship to the sun or the moon, but bow down to God who created them, if it is truly Him that you worship.
verses.pickthall: And of His portents are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or the moon; but prostrate to Allah Who created them, if it is in truth Him Whom ye worship.

verses.ar: فَإِنِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُونَ ۩
verses.en: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary.
verses.tr: fa-ini āstakbarūā fa-adh-dhīna ʿinda rabbika yusabbiḥūna lahu bi-l-yli wa-an-nahāri wahum lā yasmūna ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: If the disbelievers are too arrogant, [remember, Prophet, that] those who are with your Lord glorify Him tirelessly night and day.
verses.pickthall: But if they are too proud - still those who are with thy Lord glorify Him night and day, and tire not.

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ خَـٰشِعَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi ʾannaka tarā al-ʾarḍa khāshiʿahan fa-idhā ʾanzalnā ʿalayhā al-māʾa āhtazzat warabat ۚ ʾinna adh-dhā ʾaḥyāhā lamuḥāi al-mawtā ۚ ʾinnahu ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Another of His signs is this: you see the earth lying desolate, but when We send water down on to it, it stirs and grows. He who gives it life will certainly give life to the dead. He has power over everything.
verses.pickthall: And of His portents (is this): that thou seest the earth lowly, but when We send down water thereon it thrilleth and groweth. Lo! He Who quickeneth it is verily the Quickener of the Dead. Lo! He is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَآ ۗ أَفَمَن يُلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّن يَأْتِىٓ ءَامِنًا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yulḥidūna fā āyātinā lā yakhfawna ʿalaynā ۗ ʾafaman yulqā fā an-nāri khayrun ʾam mman yaʾtā āminan yawma al-qiyāmahi ۚ āʿmalūā mā shiʾtum ۖ ʾinnahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who distort the meaning of Our message are not hidden from Us. Is he who is hurled into the Fire better, or he who comes through safely on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you want, God certainly sees everything you do.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who distort Our revelations are not hid from Us. Is he who is hurled into the Fire better, or he who cometh secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do what ye will. Lo! He is Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَـٰبٌ عَزِيزٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā bi-adh-dhikri lammā jāʾahum ۖ wa-innahu lakitābun ʿazīzun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who reject the Quran when it comes to them- though it is an unassailable Scripture
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve in the Reminder when it cometh unto them (are guilty), for lo! it is an unassailable Scripture.

verses.ar: لَّا يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ ۖ تَنزِيلٌ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ
verses.en: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: llā yaʾtīhi al-bāṭilu min bayni yadayhi walā min khalfihi ۖ tanzīlun mmin ḥakīmin ḥamīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: which falsehood cannot touch from any angle, a Revelation sent down from the Wise One, Worthy of All Praise-
verses.pickthall: Falsehood cannot come at it from before it or from behind it. (It is) a revelation from the Wise, the Owner of Praise.

verses.ar: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: Nothing is said to you, [O Muḥammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.
verses.tr: mmā yuqālu laka ʾillā mā qad qīla lilrrusuli min qablika ۚ ʾinna rabbaka ladhū maghfirahin wadhū ʿiqābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: [should remember that] you [Prophet] are not told anything that the previous messengers were not told: your Lord is a Lord of forgiveness, but also of painful punishment.
verses.pickthall: Naught is said unto thee (Muhammad) save what was said unto the messengers before thee. Lo! thy Lord is owner of forgiveness, and owner (also) of dire punishment.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَانًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥٓ ۖ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّ وَعَرَبِىٌّ ۗ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هُدًى وَشِفَآءٌ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
