verses.en: And if We had made it a foreign [i.e., non-Arabic] Qur’ān, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.
verses.tr: walaw jaʿalnāhu qurānan ʾaʿjamiyyan llaqālūā lawlā fuṣṣilat āyātuhu ۖ āʿjamāun waʿarabāun ۗ qul huwa lilladhīna āmanūā hudanā washifāʾun ۖ wa-adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna fā ādhānihim waqrun wahuwa ʿalayhim ʿamanā ۚ ʾūlāʾika yunādawna min mmakānin baʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: If We had made it a foreign Quran, they would have said, ‘If only its verses were clear! What? Foreign speech to an Arab?’ Say, ‘It is guidance and healing for those who have faith, but the ears of the disbelievers are heavy, they are blind to it, it is as if they are being called from a distant place.’
verses.pickthall: And if We had appointed it a Lecture in a foreign tongue they would assuredly have said: If only its verses were expounded (so that we might understand)? What! A foreign tongue and an Arab? - Say unto them (O Muhammad): For those who believe it is a guidance and a healing; and as for those who disbelieve, there is a deafness in their ears, and it is blindness for them. Such are called to from afar.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۗ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
verses.en: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word [i.e., decree] that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā mūsā al-kitāba fākhtulifa fīhi ۗ walawlā kalimahun sabaqat min rrabbika laquḍāa baynahum ۚ wa-innahum lafā shakkin mminhu murībin
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave the Scripture to Moses but disputes arose about it- if it were not for a decree that had already been issued from your Lord, they would already have been judged- and still they are doubtful and suspicious of it.
verses.pickthall: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, but there hath been dispute concerning it; and but for a Word that had already gone forth from thy Lord, it would ere now have been judged between them; but lo! they are in hopeless doubt concerning it.

verses.ar: مَّنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۗ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.en: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.
verses.tr: mman ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi ۖ waman ʾasāʾa faʿalayhā ۗ wamā rabbuka biẓallāmin llilʿabīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: Whoever does good does it for his own soul and whoever does evil does it against his own soul: your Lord is never unjust to His creatures.
verses.pickthall: Whoso doeth right it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong it is against it. And thy Lord is not at all a tyrant to His slaves.

verses.ar: ۞ إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ ۚ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٍ مِّنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَاذَنَّـٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍ
verses.en: To Him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]."
verses.tr: ۞ ʾilayhi yuraddu ʿilmu as-sāʿahi ۚ wamā takhruju min thamarātin mmin ʾakmāmihā wamā taḥmilu min ʾunthā walā taḍaʿu ʾillā biʿilmihi ۚ wayawma yunādīhim ʾayna shurakā qālūā ādhannāka mā minnā min shahīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: Knowledge of the Hour belongs solely to Him and no crop comes out of its sheath, nor does any female conceive or give birth, without His knowledge. On the Day He asks them, ‘Where are My partners?’ they will answer, ‘We admit to You that none of us can see [them]’:
verses.pickthall: Unto Him is referred (all) knowledge of the Hour. And no fruits burst forth from their sheaths, and no female carrieth or bringeth forth but with His knowledge. And on the day when He calleth unto them: Where are now My partners? they will say: We confess unto Thee, not one of us is a witness (for them).

verses.ar: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَدْعُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَظَنُّوا۟ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.en: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.
verses.tr: waḍalla ʿanhum mmā kānūā yadʿūna min qablu ۖ waẓannūā mā lahum mmin mmaḥīṣin
verses.abdelhaleem: the gods they invoked before will have vanished away; they will know that there is no escape.
verses.pickthall: And those to whom they used to cry of old have failed them, and they perceive they have no place of refuge.

verses.ar: لَّا يَسْـَٔمُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٌ قَنُوطٌ
verses.en: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.
verses.tr: llā yasmu al-ʾinsānu min duʿāʾi al-khayri wa-in mmassahu ash-sharru fayawsun qanūṭun
verses.abdelhaleem: Man never tires of asking for good, but if evil touches him he loses all hope and becomes despondent.
verses.pickthall: Man tireth not of praying for good, and if ill toucheth him, then he is disheartened, desperate.

verses.ar: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَـٰذَا لِى وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّ لِى عِندَهُۥ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
verses.en: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me, and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.
verses.tr: walaʾin ʾadhaqnāhu raḥmahan mminnā min baʿdi ḍarrāʾa massathu layaqūlanna hādhā lā wamā ʾaẓunnu as-sāʿaha qāʾimahan walaʾin rrujiʿtu ʾilā rabbā ʾinna lā ʿindahu lalḥusnā ۚ falanunabbiʾanna adh-dhīna kafarūā bimā ʿamilūā walanudhīqannahum mmin ʿadhābin ghalīẓin
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever We let him taste some of Our mercy after he has been afflicted, he is sure to say, ‘This is all my own doing: I do not think the Hour will ever come, but even if I were to be taken back to my Lord, the best reward would await me with Him.’ We shall most certainly inform the disbelievers of what they have done and give them a taste of severe torment.
verses.pickthall: And verily, if We cause him to taste mercy after some hurt that hath touched him, he will say: This is my own; and I deem not that the Hour will ever rise, and if I am brought back to my Lord, I surely shall be better off with Him - But We verily shall tell those who disbelieve (all) that they did, and We verily shall make them taste hard punishment.

verses.ar: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٍ
verses.en: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.
verses.tr: wa-idhā ʾanʿamnā ʿalā al-ʾinsāni ʾaʿraḍa wanā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu ash-sharru fadhū duʿāʾin ʿarīḍin
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever We are gracious to man, he goes away haughtily, but, as soon as evil touches him, he turns to prolonged prayer.
verses.pickthall: When We show favour unto man, he withdraweth and turneth aside, but when ill toucheth him then he aboundeth in prayer.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.en: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum ʾin kāna min ʿindi Allāh thumma kafartum bihi man ʾaḍallu mimman huwa fā shiqāqin baʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Have you ever thought, what if this revelation really is from God and you still reject it? Who could be more astray than someone who cuts himself off so far [from God]?’
verses.pickthall: Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye reject it - Who is further astray than one who is at open feud (with Allah)?

verses.ar: سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فِى ٱلْـَٔافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.en: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?
verses.tr: sanurīhim āyātinā fā al-āfāqi wafā ʾanfusihim ḥattā yatabayyana lahum ʾannahu al-ḥaqqu ۗ ʾawalam yakfi birabbika ʾannahu ʿalā kulli shāʾin shahīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall show them Our signs in every region of the earth and in themselves, until it becomes clear to them that this is the Truth. Is it not enough that your Lord witnesses everything?
verses.pickthall: We shall show them Our portents on the horizons and within themselves until it will be manifest unto them that it is the Truth. Doth not thy Lord suffice, since He is Witness over all things?

verses.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطٌۢ
verses.en: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing.
verses.tr: ʾalā ʾinnahum fā miryahin mmin lliqāʾi rabbihim ۗ ʾalā ʾinnahu bikulli shāʾin mmuḥīṭun
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly, they doubt that they will meet their Lord; truly He encompasses everything.
verses.pickthall: How! Are they still in doubt about the meeting with their Lord? Lo! Is not He surrounding all things?

verses.ar: حمٓ
verses.en: Ḥā, Meem.
verses.tr: ḥm
verses.abdelhaleem: Ha Mim
verses.pickthall: Ha. Mim.

verses.ar: عٓسٓقٓ
verses.en: ʿAyn, Seen, Qāf.
verses.tr: ʿsq
verses.abdelhaleem: Ayn Sin Qaf
verses.pickthall: A'in. Sin. Qaf.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِىٓ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and to those before you - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: kadhālika yūḥā ʾilayka wa-ʾilā adh-dhīna min qablika Allāh al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: This is how God, the Mighty, the Wise, sends revelation to you [Prophet] as He did to those before you.
verses.pickthall: Thus Allah the Mighty, the Knower inspireth thee (Muhammad) as (He inspired) those before thee.

verses.ar: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.en: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.
verses.tr: lahu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۖ wahuwa al-ʿalāu al-ʿaẓīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: All that is in the heavens and earth belongs to Him: He is the Exalted, the Almighty.
verses.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and He is the Sublime, the Tremendous.

verses.ar: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ ۚ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: The heavens almost break from above them, and the angels exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allāh who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
verses.tr: takādu as-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min fawqihinna ۚ wa-l-malāʾikahu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayastaghfirūna liman fā al-ʾarḍi ۗ ʾalā ʾinna Allāh huwa al-ghafūru ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: The heavens are almost broken apart from above as the angels proclaim the praises of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. God is indeed the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
verses.pickthall: Almost might the heavens above be rent asunder while the angels hymn the praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on the earth. Lo! Allah, He is the Forgiver, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
verses.en: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allāh is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muḥammad], are not over them a manager.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āttakhadhūā min dūnihi ʾawliyāʾa Allāh ḥafīẓun ʿalayhim wamā ʾanta ʿalayhim biwakīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who take protectors other than Him, God is watching them; you are not responsible for them.
verses.pickthall: And as for those who choose protecting friends beside Him, Allah is Warden over them, and thou art in no wise a guardian over them.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ فَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِى ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.
verses.tr: wakadhālika ʾawḥaynā ʾilayka qurānan ʿarabiyyan llitundhira ʾumma al-qurā waman ḥawlahā watundhira yawma al-jamʿi lā rayba fīhi ۚ farīqun fā al-jannahi wafarīqun fā as-saʿīri
verses.abdelhaleem: So We have revealed an Arabic Quran to you, in order that you may warn the capital city and all who live nearby. And warn [especially] about the Day of Gathering, of which there is no doubt, when some shall be in the Garden and some in the blazing Flame.
verses.pickthall: And thus We have inspired in thee a Lecture in Arabic, that thou mayst warn the mother-town and those around it, and mayst warn of a day of assembling whereof there is no doubt. A host will be in the Garden, and a host of them in the Flame.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verses.en: And if Allāh willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.
verses.tr: walaw shāʾa Allāh lajaʿalahum ʾummahan wāḥidahan walākin yudkhilu man yashāʾu fā raḥmatihi ۚ wa-aẓ-ẓālimūna mā lahum mmin walāin walā naṣīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: If God had so pleased, He could have made them a single community, but He admits to His mercy whoever He will; the evildoers will have no one to protect or help them.
verses.pickthall: Had Allah willed, He could have made them one community, but Allah bringeth whom He will into His mercy. And the wrong-doers have no friend nor helper.

verses.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ وَهُوَ يُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides Him? But Allāh - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
verses.tr: ʾami āttakhadhūā min dūnihi ʾawliyāʾa ۖ fa-Allāh huwa al-walāu wahuwa yuḥāi al-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: How can they take protectors other than Him? God alone is the Protector; He gives life to the dead; He has power over all things.
verses.pickthall: Or have they chosen protecting friends besides Him? But Allah, He (alone) is the Protecting Friend. He quickeneth the dead, and He is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
verses.en: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allāh. [Say], "That is Allāh, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."
verses.tr: wamā ākhtalaftum fīhi min shāʾin faḥukmuhu ʾilā Allāh ۚ dhālikumu Allāh rabbā ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ʾilayhi ʾunību
verses.abdelhaleem: Whatever you may differ about is for God to judge. [Say], ‘Such is God, my Lord. In Him I trust and to Him I turn,
verses.pickthall: And in whatsoever ye differ, the verdict therein belongeth to Allah. Such is my Lord, in Whom I put my trust, and unto Whom I turn.

verses.ar: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًا ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.en: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
verses.tr: fāṭiru as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ jaʿala lakum mmin ʾanfusikum ʾazwājan wamina al-ʾanʿāmi ʾazwājan ۖ yadhraʾukum fīhi ۚ laysa kamithlihi shāʾun ۖ wahuwa as-samīʿu al-baṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: the Creator of the heavens and earth.’ He made mates for you from among yourselves––and for the animals too––so that you may multiply. There is nothing like Him: He is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
verses.pickthall: The Creator of the heavens and the earth. He hath made for you pairs of yourselves, and of the cattle also pairs, whereby He multiplieth you. Naught is as His likeness; and He is the Hearer, the Seer.

verses.ar: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.
verses.tr: lahu maqālīdu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yashāʾu wayaqdiru ۚ ʾinnahu bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: The keys of the heavens and the earth are His; He provides abundantly or sparingly for whoever He will; He has full knowledge of all things.
verses.pickthall: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlargeth providence for whom He will and straiteneth (it for whom He will). Lo! He is Knower of all things.

verses.ar: ۞ شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحًا وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجْتَبِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ
verses.en: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].
verses.tr: ۞ sharaʿa lakum mmina ad-dīni mā waṣṣā bihi nūḥan wa-adh-dhā ʾawḥaynā ʾilayka wamā waṣṣaynā bihi ʾibrāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā ۖ ʾan ʾaqīmūā ad-dīna walā tatafarraqūā fīhi ۚ kabura ʿalā al-mushrikīna mā tadʿūhum ʾilayhi ۚ Allāh yajtabā ʾilayhi man yashāʾu wayahdā ʾilayhi man yunību
verses.abdelhaleem: In matters of faith, He has laid down for you [people] the same commandment that He gave Noah, which We have revealed to you [Muhammad] and which We enjoined on Abraham and Moses and Jesus: ‘Uphold the faith and do not divide into factions within it’- what you [Prophet] call upon the idolaters to do is hard for them; God chooses whoever He pleases for Himself and guides towards Himself those who turn to Him.
verses.pickthall: He hath ordained for you that religion which He commended unto Noah, and that which We inspire in thee (Muhammad), and that which We commended unto Abraham and Moses and Jesus, saying: Establish the religion, and be not divided therein. Dreadful for the idolaters is that unto which thou callest them. Allah chooseth for Himself whom He will, and guideth unto Himself him who turneth (toward Him).

verses.ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
verses.en: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.
verses.tr: wamā tafarraqūā ʾillā min baʿdi mā jāʾahumu al-ʿilmu baghyanā baynahum ۚ walawlā kalimahun sabaqat min rrabbika ʾilā ʾajalin mmusammanā llaquḍāa baynahum ۚ wa-inna adh-dhīna ʾūrithūā al-kitāba min baʿdihim lafā shakkin mminhu murībin
verses.abdelhaleem: They divided, out of rivalry, only after knowledge had come to them, and, if it had not been for a decree already passed by your Lord to reprieve them until an appointed time, they would already have been judged. Those after them, who inherited the Scripture, are in disquieting doubt about it.
verses.pickthall: And they were not divided until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves; and had it not been for a Word that had already gone forth from thy Lord for an appointed term, it surely had been judged between them. And those who were made to inherit the Scripture after them are verily in hopeless doubt concerning it.

verses.ar: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدْعُ ۖ وَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَقُلْ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَـٰبٍ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ ۖ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ ۖ لَنَآ أَعْمَـٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ ۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ۖ ٱللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: So to that [religion of Allāh] invite, [O Muḥammad], and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allāh has revealed of scripture [i.e., the Qur’ān], and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allāh is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. There is no [need for] argument between us and you. Allāh will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."
verses.tr: falidhālika fādʿu ۖ wāstaqim kamā ʾumirta ۖ walā tattabiʿ ʾahwāʾahum ۖ waqul āmantu bimā ʾanzala Allāh min kitābin ۖ wa-umirtu liʾaʿdila baynakumu ۖ Allāh rabbunā warabbukum ۖ lanā ʾaʿmālunā walakum ʾaʿmālukum ۖ lā ḥujjaha baynanā wabaynakumu ۖ Allāh yajmaʿu baynanā ۖ wa-ʾilayhi al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] call people to that faith and follow the straight path as you have been commanded. Do not go by what they desire, but say, ‘I believe in whatever Scripture God has sent down. I am commanded to bring justice between you. God is our Lord and your Lord- to us our deeds and to you yours, so let there be no argument between us and you- God will gather us together, and to Him we shall return.’
verses.pickthall: Unto this, then, summon (O Muhammad). And be thou upright as thou art commanded, and follow not their lusts, but say: I believe in whatever scripture Allah hath sent down, and I am commanded to be just among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. Unto us our works and unto you your works; no argument between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and unto Him is the journeying.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ٱسْتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
verses.en: And those who argue concerning Allāh after He has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yuḥājjūna fā Allāh min baʿdi mā āstujība lahu ḥujjatuhum dāḥiḍahun ʿinda rabbihim waʿalayhim ghaḍabun walahum ʿadhābun shadīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who argue about God after He has been acknowledged, their argument has no weight with their Lord: anger will fall upon them and agonizing torment awaits them.
verses.pickthall: And those who argue concerning Allah after He hath been acknowledged, their argument hath no weight with their Lord, and wrath is upon them and theirs will be an awful doom.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ ۗ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ
verses.en: It is Allāh who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance [i.e., justice]. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā ʾanzala al-kitāba bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-l-mīzāna ۗ wamā yudrīka laʿalla as-sāʿaha qarībun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who has sent down the Scripture with Truth and the Balance. How can you tell? The Last Hour may well be near:
verses.pickthall: Allah it is Who hath revealed the Scripture with truth, and the Balance. How canst thou know? It may be that the Hour is nigh.

verses.ar: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِى ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.en: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.
verses.tr: yastaʿjilu bihā adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bihā ۖ wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā mushfiqūna minhā wayaʿlamūna ʾannahā al-ḥaqqu ۗ ʾalā ʾinna adh-dhīna yumārūna fā as-sāʿahi lafā ḍalālin baʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: those who do not believe in it seek to hasten it, but the believers stand in awe of it. They know it to be the Truth; those who argue about the Hour are far, far astray.
verses.pickthall: Those who believe not therein seek to hasten it, while those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the Truth. Are not they who dispute, in doubt concerning the Hour, far astray?

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
verses.en: Allāh is Subtle with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
verses.tr: Allāh laṭīfun biʿibādihi yarzuqu man yashāʾu ۖ wahuwa al-qawāu al-ʿazīzu
verses.abdelhaleem: God is most subtle towards His creatures; He provides [bounti-fully] for whoever He will; He is the Powerful, the Almighty.
verses.pickthall: Allah is gracious unto His slaves. He provideth for whom He will. And He is the Strong, the Mighty.

verses.ar: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُۥ فِى حَرْثِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ
verses.en: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest [i.e., reward]. And whoever desires the harvest [i.e., benefits] of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.
verses.tr: man kāna yurīdu ḥartha al-ākhirahi nazid lahu fā ḥarthihi ۖ waman kāna yurīdu ḥartha ad-dunyā nuʾtihi minhā wamā lahu fā al-ākhirahi min nnaṣībin
verses.abdelhaleem: If anyone desires a harvest in the life to come, We shall increase it for him; if anyone desires a harvest in this world, We shall give him a share of it, but in the Hereafter he will have no share.
verses.pickthall: Whoso desireth the harvest of the Hereafter, We give him increase in its harvest. And whoso desireth the harvest of the world, We give him thereof, and he hath no portion in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُا۟ شَرَعُوا۟ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلْفَصْلِ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Or have they partners [i.e., other deities] who have ordained for them a religion to which Allāh has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.
verses.tr: ʾam lahum shurakā sharaʿūā lahum mmina ad-dīni mā lam yaʾdhan bihi Allāh ۚ walawlā kalimahu al-faṣli laquḍāa baynahum ۗ wa-inna aẓ-ẓālimīna lahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: How can they believe in others who ordain for them things which God has not sanctioned in the practice of their faith? If it were not for God’s decree concerning the final Decision, judgement would already have been made between them. The evildoers will have a grievous punishment-
verses.pickthall: Or have they partners (of Allah) who have made lawful for them in religion that which Allah allowed not? And but for a decisive word (gone forth already), it would have been judged between them. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful doom.

verses.ar: تَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى رَوْضَاتِ ٱلْجَنَّاتِ ۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.en: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.
verses.tr: tarā aẓ-ẓālimīna mushfiqīna mimmā kasabūā wahuwa wāqiʿun bihim ۗ wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti fā rawḍāti al-jannāti ۖ lahum mmā yashāʾūna ʿinda rabbihim ۚ dhālika huwa al-faḍlu al-kabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: you will see them fearful because of what they have done: punishment is bound to fall on them- but those who believe and do good deeds will be in the flowering meadows of the Gardens. They will have whatever they wish from their Lord: this is the great bounty;
verses.pickthall: Thou seest the wrong-doers fearful of that which they have earned, and it will surely befall them, while those who believe and do good works (will be) in flowering meadows of the Gardens, having what they wish from their Lord. This is the great preferment.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ ۗ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسْنًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verses.en: It is that of which Allāh gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., this message] any payment [but] only good will through [i.e., due to] kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Appreciative.
verses.tr: dhālika adh-dhā yubashiru Allāh ʿibādahu adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ۗ qul llā ʾaslukum ʿalayhi ʾajran ʾillā al-mawaddaha fā al-qurbā ۗ waman yaqtarif ḥasanahan nnazid lahu fīhā ḥusnan ۚ ʾinna Allāh ghafūrun shakūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: it is of this that God gives good news to His servants who believe and do good deeds. Say [Prophet], ‘I ask no reward from you for this, only the affection due to kin.’ If anyone does good, We shall increase it for him; God is most forgiving and most appreciative.
verses.pickthall: This it is which Allah announceth unto His bondmen who believe and do good works. Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee therefor, save lovingkindness among kinsfolk. And whoso scoreth a good deed We add unto its good for him. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Responsive.

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا ۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ ۗ وَيَمْحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَـٰتِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allāh a lie"? But if Allāh willed, He could seal over your heart. And Allāh eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.tr: ʾam yaqūlūna āftarā ʿalā Allāh kadhiban ۖ fa-in yashaʾi Allāh yakhtim ʿalā qalbika ۗ wayamḥu Allāh al-bāṭila wayuḥiqqu al-ḥaqqa bikalimātihi ۚ ʾinnahu ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: How can they say, ‘He has invented a lie about God’? If God so willed, He could seal your heart and blot out lies: God confirms the Truth with His words. He has full knowledge of what is in the heart-
verses.pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented a lie concerning Allah? If Allah willed, He could have sealed thy heart (against them). And Allah will wipe out the lie and will vindicate the truth by His words. Lo! He is Aware of what is hidden in the breasts (of men).

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā yaqbalu at-tawbaha ʿan ʿibādihi wayaʿfūā ʿani as-sayyāti wayaʿlamu mā tafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons bad deeds- He knows everything you do.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who accepteth repentance from His bondmen, and pardoneth the evil deeds, and knoweth what ye do,

verses.ar: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
verses.en: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.
verses.tr: wayastajību adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti wayazīduhum mmin faḍlihi ۚ wa-l-kāfirūna lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: He responds to those who believe and do good deeds, and gives them more of His bounty; agonizing torment awaits the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: And accepteth those who do good works, and giveth increase unto them of His bounty. And as for disbelievers, theirs will be an awful doom.

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَوْ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: And if Allāh had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Aware and Seeing.
verses.tr: ۞ walaw basaṭa Allāh ar-rizqa liʿibādihi labaghawā fā al-ʾarḍi walākin yunazzilu biqadarin mmā yashāʾu ۚ ʾinnahu biʿibādihi khabīrun baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: If God were to grant His plentiful provision to [all] His creatures, they would act insolently on earth, but He sends down in due measure whatever He will, for He is well aware of His servants and watchful over them:
verses.pickthall: And if Allah were to enlarge the provision for His slaves they would surely rebel in the earth, but He sendeth down by measure as He willeth. Lo! He is Informed, a Seer of His bondmen.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا۟ وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُۥ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.en: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā yunazzilu al-ghaytha min baʿdi mā qanaṭūā wayanshuru raḥmatahu ۚ wahuwa al-walāu al-ḥamīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who sends relief through rain after they have lost hope, and spreads His mercy far and wide. He is the Protector, Worthy of All Praise.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who sendeth down the saving rain after they have despaired, and spreadeth out His mercy. He is the Protecting Friend, the Praiseworthy.

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi khalqu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā batha fīhimā min dābbahin ۚ wahuwa ʿalā jamʿihim ʾidhā yashāʾu qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and all the living creatures He has scattered throughout them: He has the power to gather them all together whenever He will.
verses.pickthall: And of His portents is the creation of the heaven and the earth, and of whatever beasts He hath dispersed therein. And He is Able to gather them when He will.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَصَـٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍ
verses.en: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
verses.tr: wamā ʾaṣābakum mmin mmuṣībahin fabimā kasabat ʾaydīkum wayaʿfūā ʿan kathīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: Whatever misfortune befalls you [people], it is because of what your own hands have done- God forgives much-
verses.pickthall: Whatever of misfortune striketh you, it is what your right hands have earned. And He forgiveth much.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
verses.en: And you will not cause failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allāh any protector or helper.
verses.tr: wamā ʾantum bimuʿjizīna fā al-ʾarḍi ۖ wamā lakum mmin dūni Allāh min walāin walā naṣīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: you cannot escape Him anywhere on earth: you have no protector or helper other than God.
verses.pickthall: Ye cannot escape in the earth, for beside Allah ye have no protecting friend nor any helper.

verses.ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِ ٱلْجَوَارِ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
verses.en: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.
verses.tr: wamin āyātihi al-jawāri fā al-baḥri ka-l-ʾaʿlāmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Among His signs are the ships, sailing like floating mountains:
verses.pickthall: And of His portents are the ships, like banners on the sea;

verses.ar: إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
verses.en: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
verses.tr: ʾin yashaʾ yuskini ar-rīḥa fayaẓlalna rawākida ʿalā ẓahrihi ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin llikulli ṣabbārin shakūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: if He willed, He could bring the wind to a standstill and they would lie motionless on the surface of the sea- there truly are signs in this for anyone who is steadfast and thankful-
verses.pickthall: If He will He calmeth the wind so that they keep still upon its surface - Lo! herein verily are signs for every steadfast grateful (heart). -

verses.ar: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ
verses.en: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.
verses.tr: ʾaw yūbiqhunna bimā kasabūā wayaʿfu ʿan kathīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: or He could cause them to be wrecked on account of what their passengers have done- God pardons much-
verses.pickthall: Or He causeth them to perish on account of that which they have earned - And He forgiveth much -

verses.ar: وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.en: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.
verses.tr: wayaʿlama adh-dhīna yujādilūna fā āyātinā mā lahum mmin mmaḥīṣin
verses.abdelhaleem: to let those who argue about Our messages know that there is no escape for them.
verses.pickthall: And that those who argue concerning Our revelations may know they have no refuge.

verses.ar: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَمَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verses.en: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allāh is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely
verses.tr: famā ʾūtītum mmin shāʾin famatāʿu al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۖ wamā ʿinda Allāh khayrun wa-abqā lilladhīna āmanūā waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What you have been given is only the fleeting enjoyment of this world. Far better and more lasting is what God will give to those who believe and trust in their Lord;
verses.pickthall: Now whatever ye have been given is but a passing comfort for the life of the world, and that which Allah hath is better and more lasting for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا۟ هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ
verses.en: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yajtanibūna kabāʾira al-ʾithmi wa-l-fawāḥisha wa-idhā mā ghaḍibūā hum yaghfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who shun great sins and gross indecencies; who forgive when they are angry;
verses.pickthall: And those who shun the worst of sins and indecencies and, when they are wroth, forgive,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.en: And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend,
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āstajābūā lirabbihim wa-aqāmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha wa-amruhum shūrā baynahum wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: respond to their Lord; keep up the prayer; conduct their affairs by mutual consultation; give to others out of what We have provided for them;
verses.pickthall: And those who answer the call of their Lord and establish worship, and whose affairs are a matter of counsel, and who spend of what We have bestowed on them,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلْبَغْىُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verses.en: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna ʾidhā ʾaṣābahumu al-baghāu hum yantaṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and defend themselves when they are oppressed.
verses.pickthall: And those who, when great wrong is done to them, defend themselves,

verses.ar: وَجَزَٰٓؤُا۟ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا ۖ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allāh. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.
verses.tr: wajazā sayyiʾahin sayyiʾahun mmithluhā ۖ faman ʿafā wa-aṣlaḥa fa-ajruhu ʿalā Allāh ۚ ʾinnahu lā yuḥibbu aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Let harm be requited by an equal harm, though anyone who forgives and puts things right will have his reward from God Himself––He does not like those who do wrong.
verses.pickthall: The guerdon of an ill-deed is an ill the like thereof. But whosoever pardoneth and amendeth, his wage is the affair of Allah. Lo! He loveth not wrong-doers.

verses.ar: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ
verses.en: And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].
verses.tr: walamani āntaṣara baʿda ẓulmihi fa-ūlāʾika mā ʿalayhim mmin sabīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: There is no cause to act against anyone who defends himself after being wronged,
verses.pickthall: And whoso defendeth himself after he hath suffered wrong - for such, there is no way (of blame) against them.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā as-sabīlu ʿalā adh-dhīna yaẓlimūna an-nāsa wayabghūna fā al-ʾarḍi bighayri al-ḥaqqi ۚ ʾūlāʾika lahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: but there is cause to act against those who oppress people and transgress in the land against all justice- they will have an agonizing torment-
verses.pickthall: The way (of blame) is only against those who oppress mankind, and wrongfully rebel in the earth. For such there is a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
verses.en: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.
verses.tr: walaman ṣabara waghafara ʾinna dhālika lamin ʿazmi al-ʾumūri
verses.abdelhaleem: though if a person is patient and forgives, this is one of the greatest things.
verses.pickthall: And verily whoso is patient and forgiveth - lo! that, verily, is (of) the steadfast heart of things.

verses.ar: وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِىٍّ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّ مِّن سَبِيلٍ
verses.en: And he whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"
verses.tr: waman yuḍlili Allāh famā lahu min walāin mmin baʿdihi ۗ watarā aẓ-ẓālimīna lammā raʾawā al-ʿadhāba yaqūlūna hal ʾilā maraddin mmin sabīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: Anyone God allows to stray will have no one else to protect him: you [Prophet] will see the wrongdoers, when they face the punishment, exclaiming, ‘Is there any way of going back?’
verses.pickthall: He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no protecting friend after Him. And thou (Muhammad) wilt see the evil-doers when they see the doom, (how) they say: Is there any way of return?

verses.ar: وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَـٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّ ۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِى عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ
verses.en: And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."
verses.tr: watarāhum yuʿraḍūna ʿalayhā khāshiʿīna mina adh-dhulli yanẓurūna min ṭarfin khafāin ۗ waqāla adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾinna al-khāsirīna adh-dhīna khasirūā ʾanfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma al-qiyāmahi ۗ ʾalā ʾinna aẓ-ẓālimīna fā ʿadhābin mmuqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: You will see them exposed to the Fire, abject in humiliation, glancing furtively, while those who believed exclaim, ‘The losers are the ones who have lost themselves and their people on the Day of Resurrection.’ Truly the evildoers will remain in lasting torment;
verses.pickthall: And thou wilt see them exposed to (the Fire), made humble by disgrace, and looking with veiled eyes. And those who believe will say: Lo! the (eternal) losers are they who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! are not the wrong-doers in perpetual torment?

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ
verses.en: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allāh. And whoever Allāh sends astray - for him there is no way.
verses.tr: wamā kāna lahum mmin ʾawliyāʾa yanṣurūnahum mmin dūni Allāh ۗ waman yuḍlili Allāh famā lahu min sabīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: they will have no allies to help them against God. There is no way [forward] for those God allows to stray.
verses.pickthall: And they will have no protecting friends to help them instead of Allah. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no road.

verses.ar: ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍ
verses.en: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.
verses.tr: āstajībūā lirabbikum mmin qabli ʾan yaʾtāa yawmun llā maradda lahu mina Allāh ۚ mā lakum mmin mmaljaʾin yawmaʾidhin wamā lakum mmin nnakīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: So [people] respond to your Lord before there comes a Day that cannot, against God’s will, be averted- you will have no refuge on that Day, and no possibility of denying [your sins].
verses.pickthall: Answer the call of your Lord before there cometh unto you from Allah a Day which there is no averting. Ye have no refuge on that Day, nor have a ye any (power of) refusal.

verses.ar: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ كَفُورٌ
verses.en: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.
verses.tr: fa-in ʾaʿraḍūā famā ʾarsalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓan ۖ ʾin ʿalayka ʾillā al-balāghu ۗ wa-innā ʾidhā ʾadhaqnā al-ʾinsāna minnā raḥmahan fariḥa bihā ۖ wa-in tuṣibhum sayyiʾahun bimā qaddamat ʾaydīhim fa-inna al-ʾinsāna kafūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: If they still turn away [remember that], We have not sent you [Prophet] to be their guardian: your only duty is to deliver the message. When We give man a taste of Our mercy, he rejoices in it, but if some harm befalls him on account of what he has done with his own hands, then he is ungrateful.
verses.pickthall: But if they are averse, We have not sent thee as a warder over them. Thine is only to convey (the message). And lo! when We cause man to taste of mercy from Us he exulteth therefor. And if some evil striketh them because of that which their own hands have sent before, then lo! man is an ingrate.

verses.ar: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَـٰثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
verses.en: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
verses.tr: lillāh mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ yakhluqu mā yashāʾu ۚ yahabu liman yashāʾu ʾināthan wayahabu liman yashāʾu adh-dhukūra
verses.abdelhaleem: God has control of the heavens and the earth; He creates whatever He will- He grants female offspring to whoever He will, male to whoever He will,
verses.pickthall: Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He createth what He will. He bestoweth female (offspring) upon whom He will, and bestoweth male (offspring) upon whom He will;

verses.ar: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَـٰثًا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
verses.tr: ʾaw yuzawwijuhum dhukrānan wa-ināthan ۖ wayajʿalu man yashāʾu ʿaqīman ۚ ʾinnahu ʿalīmun qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Or both male and female, and He makes whoever He will barren: He is all knowing and all powerful.
verses.pickthall: Or He mingleth them, males and females, and He maketh barren whom He will. Lo! He is Knower, Powerful.

verses.ar: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And it is not for any human being that Allāh should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
verses.tr: ۞ wamā kāna libasharin ʾan yukallimahu Allāh ʾillā waḥyan ʾaw min warāʾi ḥijābin ʾaw yursila rasūlan fayūḥāa biʾidhnihi mā yashāʾu ۚ ʾinnahu ʿalāun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is not granted to any mortal that God should speak to him except through revelation or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger to reveal by His command what He will: He is exalted and wise.
verses.pickthall: And it was not (vouchsafed) to any mortal that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation or from behind a veil, or (that) He sendeth a messenger to reveal what He will by His leave. Lo! He is Exalted, Wise.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَـٰنُ وَلَـٰكِن جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -
verses.tr: wakadhālika ʾawḥaynā ʾilayka rūḥan mmin ʾamrinā ۚ mā kunta tadrā mā al-kitābu walā al-ʾīmānu walākin jaʿalnāhu nūran nnahdā bihi man nnashāʾu min ʿibādinā ۚ wa-innaka latahdā ʾilā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: So We have revealed a spirit to you [Prophet] by Our command: you knew neither the Scripture nor the faith, but We made it a light, guiding with it whoever We will of Our servants. You give guidance to the straight path,
verses.pickthall: And thus have We inspired in thee (Muhammad) a Spirit of Our command. Thou knewest not what the Scripture was, nor what the Faith. But We have made it a light whereby We guide whom We will of Our bondmen. And lo! thou verily dost guide unto a right path,

verses.ar: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.en: The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].
verses.tr: ṣirāṭi Allāh adh-dhā lahu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۗ ʾalā ʾilā Allāh taṣīru al-ʾumūru
verses.abdelhaleem: the path of God, to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and earth: truly everything will return to God.
verses.pickthall: The path of Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Do not all things reach Allah at last?

verses.ar: حمٓ
verses.en: Ḥā, Meem.
verses.tr: ḥm
verses.abdelhaleem: Ha Mim
verses.pickthall: Ha. Mim.

verses.ar: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.en: By the clear Book,
verses.tr: wa-l-kitābi al-mubīni
verses.abdelhaleem: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
verses.pickthall: By the Scripture which maketh plain,

verses.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
verses.tr: ʾinnā jaʿalnāhu qurānan ʿarabiyyan llaʿallakum taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have made it a Quran in Arabic so that you [people] may understand.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
verses.tr: wa-innahu fā ʾummi al-kitābi ladaynā laʿalāun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is truly exalted in the Source of Scripture kept with Us, and full of wisdom.
verses.pickthall: And Lo! in the Source of Decrees, which We possess, it is indeed sublime, decisive.

verses.ar: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ
verses.en: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
verses.tr: ʾafanaḍribu ʿankumu adh-dhikra ṣafḥan ʾan kuntum qawman mmusrifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Should We ignore you and turn this revelation away from you because you are insolent people?
verses.pickthall: Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk?

verses.ar: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
verses.tr: wakam ʾarsalnā min nnabāin fā al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent many a prophet to earlier people
verses.pickthall: How many a prophet did We send among the men of old!

verses.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
verses.tr: wamā yaʾtīhim mmin nnabāin ʾillā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they mocked every one of them,
verses.pickthall: And never came there unto them a prophet but they used to mock him.

verses.ar: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
verses.tr: fa-ahlaknā ʾashadda minhum baṭshan wamaḍā mathalu al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: so We have destroyed mightier people than [the disbelievers of Mecca] and their example has gone down in history.
verses.pickthall: Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them).

verses.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"
verses.tr: walaʾin saʾaltahum mman khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunna al-ʿazīzu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: If you [Prophet] ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and earth?’ they are sure to say, ‘They were created by the Almighty, the All Knowing.’
verses.pickthall: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
verses.tr: adh-dhā jaʿala lakumu al-ʾarḍa mahdan wajaʿala lakum fīhā subulan llaʿallakum tahtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who smoothed out the earth for you and traced out routes on it for you to find your way,
verses.pickthall: Who made the earth a resting-place for you, and placed roads for you therein, that haply ye may find your way;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
verses.en: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhā nazzala mina as-samāʾi māʾan biqadarin fa-ansharnā bihi baldahan mmaytan ۚ kadhālika tukhrajūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who sends water down from the sky in due measure––We resurrect dead land with it, and likewise you will be resurrected from the grave––
verses.pickthall: And Who sendeth down water from the sky in (due) measure, and We revive a dead land therewith. Even so will ye be brought forth;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
verses.en: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhā khalaqa al-ʾazwāja kullahā wajaʿala lakum mmina al-fulki wa-l-ʾanʿāmi mā tarkabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who created every kind of thing, who gave you ships and animals to ride on
verses.pickthall: He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride.

verses.ar: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
verses.en: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
verses.tr: litastawā ʿalā ẓuhūrihi thumma tadhkurūā niʿmaha rabbikum ʾidhā āstawaytum ʿalayhi wataqūlūā subḥāna adh-dhā sakhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: so that you may remember your Lord’s grace when you are seated on them and say, ‘Glory be to Him who has given us control over this; we could not have done it by ourselves.
verses.pickthall: That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord's favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them);

verses.ar: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.en: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
verses.tr: wa-innā ʾilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly it is to our Lord that we are returning.’
verses.pickthall: And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
verses.tr: wajaʿalūā lahu min ʿibādihi juzʾan ۚ ʾinna al-ʾinsāna lakafūrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet they assign some of His own servants to Him as offspring!Man is clearly ungrateful!
verses.pickthall: And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate.

verses.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
verses.en: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
verses.tr: ʾami āttakhadha mimmā yakhluqu banātin wa-aṣfākum bi-l-banīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Has He taken daughters for Himself and favoured you with sons?
verses.pickthall: Or chooseth He daughters of all that He hath created, and honoureth He you with sons?

verses.ar: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
verses.tr: wa-idhā bushira ʾaḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lilrraḥmāni mathalan ẓalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa kaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When one of them is given news of the birth of a daughter, such as he so readily ascribes to the Lord of Mercy, his face grows dark and he is filled with gloom-
verses.pickthall: And if one of them hath tidings of that which he likeneth to the Beneficent One, his countenance becometh black and he is full of inward rage.

verses.ar: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ
verses.en: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allāh]?
verses.tr: ʾawaman yunashaā fā al-ḥilyahi wahuwa fā al-khiṣāmi ghayru mubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Someone who is brought up amongst trinkets, who cannot put together a clear argument?’
verses.pickthall: (Liken they then to Allah) that which is bred up in outward show, and in dispute cannot make itself plain?

verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَـٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَـٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَـٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.en: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
verses.tr: wajaʿalūā al-malāʾikaha adh-dhīna hum ʿibādu ar-raḥmāni ʾināthan ۚ ʾashahidūā khalqahum ۚ satuktabu shahādatuhum wayuslūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They consider the angels- God’s servants- to be female. Did they witness their creation? Their claim will be put on record and they will be questioned about it.
verses.pickthall: And they make the angels, who are the slaves of the Beneficent, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَـٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
verses.en: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.
verses.tr: waqālūā law shāʾa ar-raḥmānu mā ʿabadnāhum ۗ mmā lahum bidhālika min ʿilmin ۖ ʾin hum ʾillā yakhruṣūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘If the Lord of Mercy had willed it, we would not have worshipped them,’ but they do not know that- they are only guessing-
verses.pickthall: And they say: If the Beneficent One had (so) willed, we should not have worshipped them. They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do but guess.

verses.ar: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
verses.en: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?
verses.tr: ʾam ātaynāhum kitāban mmin qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: or have We perhaps given them a book before this one, to which they hold fast?
verses.pickthall: Or have We given them any scripture before (this Qur'an) so that they are holding fast thereto?

verses.ar: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
verses.tr: bal qālūā ʾinnā wajadnā ābāʾanā ʿalā ʾummahin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim mmuhtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! They say, ‘We saw our fathers following this tradition; we are guided by their footsteps.’
verses.pickthall: Nay, for they say only: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are guided by their footprints.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
verses.tr: wakadhālika mā ʾarsalnā min qablika fā qaryahin mmin nnadhīrin ʾillā qāla mutrafūhā ʾinnā wajadnā ābāʾanā ʿalā ʾummahin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim mmuqtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When-ever We sent a messenger before you to warn a township, those corrupted by wealth said, in the same way, ‘We saw our fathers following this tradition; we are only following in their footsteps.’
verses.pickthall: And even so We sent not a warner before thee (Muhammad) into any township but its luxurious ones said: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are following their footprints.

verses.ar: ۞ قَـٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
verses.tr: ۞ qāla ʾawalaw jiʾtukum biʾahdā mimmā wajadttum ʿalayhi ābāʾakum ۖ qālūā ʾinnā bimā ʾursiltum bihi kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The messenger said, ‘Even though I bring you a truer religion than what you saw your fathers following?’ and they replied, ‘But we do not believe the message you bring.’
verses.pickthall: (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers.

verses.ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
verses.tr: fāntaqamnā minhum ۖ fānẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu al-mukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We punished them: think about how those who rejected the Truth met their end.
verses.pickthall: So We requited them. Then see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla ʾibrāhīmu liʾabīhi waqawmihi ʾinnanā barāʾun mmimmā taʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham said to his father and his people, ‘I renounce what you worship.
verses.pickthall: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.en: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
verses.tr: ʾillā adh-dhā faṭaranā fa-innahu sayahdīni
verses.abdelhaleem: I worship only Him who created me, and it is He who will guide me,’
verses.pickthall: Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
verses.tr: wajaʿalahā kalimahan bāqiyahan fā ʿaqibihi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and he bequeathed these words to his descendants so that they might return [to God].
verses.pickthall: And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return.

verses.ar: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
verses.tr: bal mattaʿtu hāʾulāʾi wabāʾahum ḥattā jāʾahumu al-ḥaqqu warasūlun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: I have let these people and their fathers enjoy long lives, and now I have given them the Truth and a messenger to make things clear-
verses.pickthall: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
verses.tr: walammā jāʾahumu al-ḥaqqu qālūā hādhā siḥrun wa-innā bihi kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: yet when the Truth came to them, they said, ‘This is sorcery. We do not believe in it,’
verses.pickthall: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
verses.tr: waqālūā lawlā nuzzila hādhā al-qurānu ʿalā rajulin mmina al-qaryatayni ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: and they said, ‘Why was this Quran not sent down to a distinguished man, from either of the two cities?’
verses.pickthall: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns?

verses.ar: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
verses.en: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
verses.tr: ʾahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbika ۚ naḥnu qasamnā baynahum mmaʿīshatahum fā al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۚ warafaʿnā baʿḍahum fawqa baʿḍin darajātin lliyattakhidha baʿḍuhum baʿḍan sukhriyyan ۗ waraḥmatu rabbika khayrun mmimmā yajmaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Are they the ones who share out your Lord’s grace? We are the ones who give them their share of livelihood in this world and We have raised some of them above others in rank, so that some may take others into service: your Lord’s grace is better than anything they accumulate.
verses.pickthall: Is it they who apportion thy Lord's mercy? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass.

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
verses.en: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
verses.tr: walawlā ʾan yakūna an-nāsu ʾummahan wāḥidahan llajaʿalnā liman yakfuru bi-ar-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufan mmin fiḍḍahin wamaʿārija ʿalayhā yaẓharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If it were not that all mankind might have become a single nation [of disbelievers], We could have given all those who disbelieve in the Lord of Mercy houses with roofs of silver, sweeping staircases to ascend,
verses.pickthall: And were it not that mankind would have become one community, We might well have appointed, for those who disbelieve in the Beneficent, roofs of silver for their houses and stairs (of silver) whereby to mount,

verses.ar: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
verses.en: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
verses.tr: walibuyūtihim ʾabwāban wasururan ʿalayhā yattakiwna
verses.abdelhaleem: massive gates, couches to sit on,
verses.pickthall: And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline,

verses.ar: وَزُخْرُفًا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
verses.tr: wazukhrufan ۚ wa-in kullu dhālika lammā matāʿu al-ḥayawāhi ad-dunyā ۚ wa-l-ākhirahu ʿinda rabbika lilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and golden ornaments. All of these are mere enjoyments of this life; your Lord reserves the next life for those who take heed of Him.
verses.pickthall: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil.

verses.ar: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌ
verses.en: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
verses.tr: waman yaʿshu ʿan dhikri ar-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahu shayṭānan fahuwa lahu qarīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: We assign an evil one as a comrade for whoever turns away from the revelations of the Lord of Mercy:
verses.pickthall: And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade;

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
verses.tr: wa-innahum layaṣuddūnahum ʿani as-sabīli wayaḥsabūna ʾannahum mmuhtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: evil ones bar people from the right path, even though they may think they are well guided.
verses.pickthall: And lo! they surely turn them from the way of Allah, and yet they deem that they are rightly guided;

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
verses.en: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾanā qāla yālayta baynā wabaynaka buʿda al-mashriqayni fabiʾsa al-qarīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: When such a person comes to Us, he will say [to his comrade], ‘If only you had been as far away from me as east is from west. What an evil comrade!’
verses.pickthall: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade!

verses.ar: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
verses.en: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
verses.tr: walan yanfaʿakumu al-yawma ʾidh ẓẓalamtum ʾannakum fā al-ʿadhābi mushtarikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [It will be said to them], ‘You have done wrong. Having partners in punishment will not console you today.’
verses.pickthall: And it profiteth you not this day, because ye did wrong, that ye will be sharers in the doom.

verses.ar: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
verses.tr: ʾafaʾanta tusmiʿu aṣ-ṣumma ʾaw tahdā al-ʿumāa waman kāna fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Can you [Prophet] make the deaf hear? Or guide either the blind or those who are in gross error?
verses.pickthall: Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest?

verses.ar: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
verses.en: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
verses.tr: fa-immā nadhhabanna bika fa-innā minhum mmuntaqimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Either We shall take you away and punish them- indeed We will-
verses.pickthall: And if We take thee away, We surely shall take vengeance on them,

verses.ar: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَـٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
verses.en: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
verses.tr: ʾaw nuriyannaka adh-dhā waʿadnāhum fa-innā ʿalayhim mmuqtadirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: or We shall let you witness the punishment We threatened them with; We have full power over them.
verses.pickthall: Or (if) We show thee that wherewith We threaten them; for lo! We have complete command of them.

verses.ar: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
verses.tr: fāstamsik bi-adh-dhā ʾūḥāa ʾilayka ۖ ʾinnaka ʿalā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Hold fast to what has been revealed to you- you truly are on the right path-
