verses.pickthall: So hold thou fast to that which is inspired in thee. Lo! thou art on a right path.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
verses.tr: wa-innahu ladhikrun llaka waliqawmika ۖ wasawfa tuslūna
verses.abdelhaleem: for it is a reminder for you and your people: you will all be questioned.
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned.

verses.ar: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ
verses.en: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
verses.tr: wasl man ʾarsalnā min qablika min rrusulinā ʾajaʿalnā min dūni ar-raḥmāni ālihahan yuʿbadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Ask the prophets We sent before you: ‘Did We ever appoint any gods to be worshipped besides the Lord of Mercy?’
verses.pickthall: And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā mūsā bāyātinā ʾilā firʿawna wamalaʾīhi faqāla ʾinnā rasūlu rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Moses to Pharaoh and his courtiers and he said, ‘I am truly a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds,’
verses.pickthall: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.en: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
verses.tr: falammā jāʾahum bāyātinā ʾidhā hum mminhā yaḍḥakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but when he presented Our signs to them, they laughed,
verses.pickthall: But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them.

verses.ar: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
verses.tr: wamā nurīhim mmin āyahin ʾillā hāa ʾakbaru min ʾukhtihā ۖ wa-akhadhnāhum bi-l-ʿadhābi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: even though each sign We showed them was greater than the previous one. We inflicted torment on them so that they might return to the right path.
verses.pickthall: And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
verses.en: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
verses.tr: waqālūā yāʾayyuha as-sāḥiru ādʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka ʾinnanā lamuhtadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Sorcerer, call on your Lord for us, by virtue of His pledge to you: we shall certainly accept guidance,’
verses.pickthall: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
verses.en: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
verses.tr: falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu al-ʿadhāba ʾidhā hum yankuthūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but as soon as We relieved their torment they broke their word.
verses.pickthall: But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word.

verses.ar: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
verses.tr: wanādā firʿawnu fā qawmihi qāla yāqawmi ʾalaysa lā mulku miṣra wahādhihi al-ʾanhāru tajrā min taḥtā ۖ ʾafalā tubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh proclaimed to his people, ‘My people, is the Kingdom of Egypt not mine? And these rivers that flow at my feet, are they not mine? Do you not see?
verses.pickthall: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern?

verses.ar: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
verses.en: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
verses.tr: ʾam ʾanā khayrun mmin hādhā adh-dhā huwa mahīnun walā yakādu yubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: Am I not better than this contemptible wretch who can scarcely express himself?
verses.pickthall: I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain!

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
verses.en: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
verses.tr: falawlā ʾulqāa ʿalayhi ʾaswirahun mmin dhahabin ʾaw jāʾa maʿahu al-malāʾikahu muqtarinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why has he not been given any gold bracelets? Why have no angels come to accompany him?’
verses.pickthall: Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him?

verses.ar: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].
verses.tr: fāstakhaffa qawmahu fa-aṭāʿūhu ۚ ʾinnahum kānūā qawman fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: In this way he moved his people to accept and they obeyed him- they were perverse people.
verses.pickthall: Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
verses.tr: falammā āsafūnā āntaqamnā minhum fa-aghraqnāhum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they provoked Us, We punished and drowned them all:
verses.pickthall: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one.

verses.ar: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
verses.tr: fajaʿalnāhum salafan wamathalan llilākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We made them a lesson and an example for later people.
verses.pickthall: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them).

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
verses.en: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
verses.tr: ۞ walammā ḍuriba ābnu maryama mathalan ʾidhā qawmuka minhu yaṣiddūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the son of Mary is cited as an example, your people [Prophet] laugh and jeer,
verses.pickthall: And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out,

verses.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَـٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
verses.en: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?" They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
verses.tr: waqālūā ʾaālihatunā khayrun ʾam huwa ۚ mā ḍarabūhu laka ʾillā jadalanā ۚ bal hum qawmun khaṣimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: saying, ‘Are our gods better or him?’- they cite him only to challenge you: they are a contentious people-
verses.pickthall: And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk.

verses.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
verses.tr: ʾin huwa ʾillā ʿabdun ʾanʿamnā ʿalayhi wajaʿalnāhu mathalan llibanā ʾisrāʾīla
verses.abdelhaleem: but he is only a servant We favoured and made an example for the Children of Israel:
verses.pickthall: He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
verses.en: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
verses.tr: walaw nashāʾu lajaʿalnā minkum mmalāʾikahan fā al-ʾarḍi yakhlufūna
verses.abdelhaleem: if it had been Our will, We could have made you angels, succeeding one another on earth.
verses.pickthall: And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.en: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
verses.tr: wa-innahu laʿilmun llilssāʿahi falā tamtarunna bihā wāttabiʿūni ۚ hādhā ṣirāṭun mmustaqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: This [Quran] gives knowledge of the Hour: do not doubt it. Follow Me for this is the right path;
verses.pickthall: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
verses.tr: walā yaṣuddannakumu ash-shayṭānu ۖ ʾinnahu lakum ʿaduwwun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: do not let Satan hinder you, for he is your sworn enemy.
verses.pickthall: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.
verses.tr: walammā jāʾa ʿīsā bi-l-bayyināti qāla qad jiʾtukum bi-l-ḥikmahi waliʾubayyina lakum baʿḍa adh-dhā takhtalifūna fīhi ۖ fāttaqūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: When Jesus came with clear signs he said, ‘I have brought you wisdom; I have come to clear up some of your differences for you. Be mindful of God and obey me:
verses.pickthall: When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh huwa rabbā warabbukum fāʿbudūhu ۚ hādhā ṣirāṭun mmustaqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: God is my Lord and your Lord. Serve Him: this is the straight path.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.

verses.ar: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
verses.tr: fākhtalafa al-ʾaḥzābu min baynihim ۖ fawaylun llilladhīna ẓalamūā min ʿadhābi yawmin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet still the different factions among them disagreed- woe to the evildoers: they will suffer the torment of a grievous day!-
verses.pickthall: But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day.

verses.ar: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
verses.tr: hal yanẓurūna ʾillā as-sāʿaha ʾan taʾtiyahum baghtahan wahum lā yashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: what are they waiting for but the Hour, which will come upon them suddenly and take them unawares?
verses.pickthall: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not?

verses.ar: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
verses.tr: al-ʾakhillāʾu yawmaʾidhin baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun ʾillā al-muttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day, friends will become each other’s enemies. Not so the righteous-
verses.pickthall: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).

verses.ar: يَـٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
verses.en: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
verses.tr: yāʿibādi lā khawfun ʿalaykumu al-yawma walā ʾantum taḥzanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘My servants, there is no fear for you today, nor shall you grieve’––
verses.pickthall: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna āmanūā bāyātinā wakānūā muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who believed in Our revelations and devoted themselves to Us.
verses.pickthall: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered,

verses.ar: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
verses.en: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
verses.tr: ādkhulūā al-jannaha ʾantum wa-azwājukum tuḥbarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Enter Paradise, you and your spouses: you will be filled with joy.’
verses.pickthall: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.

verses.ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
verses.tr: yuṭāfu ʿalayhim biṣiḥāfin mmin dhahabin wa-akwābin ۖ wafīhā mā tashtahīhi al-ʾanfusu wataladhu al-ʾaʿyunu ۖ wa-antum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Dishes and goblets of gold will be passed around them with all that their souls desire and their eyes delight in. ‘There you will remain:
verses.pickthall: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.

verses.ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
verses.tr: watilka al-jannahu at-tā ʾūrithtumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: this is the Garden you are given as your own, because of what you used to do,
verses.pickthall: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.

verses.ar: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
verses.tr: lakum fīhā fākihahun kathīrahun mminhā taʾkulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and there is abundant fruit in it for you to eat.’
verses.pickthall: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
verses.tr: ʾinna al-mujrimīna fā ʿadhābi jahannama khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But the evildoers will remain in Hell’s punishment,
verses.pickthall: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment.

verses.ar: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
verses.en: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
verses.tr: lā yufattaru ʿanhum wahum fīhi mublisūna
verses.abdelhaleem: from which there is no relief: they will remain in utter despair.
verses.pickthall: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.

verses.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānūā humu aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We never wronged them; they were the ones who did wrong.
verses.pickthall: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong.

verses.ar: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verses.en: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
verses.tr: wanādawā yāmāliku liyaqḍi ʿalaynā rabbuka ۖ qāla ʾinnakum mmākithūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will cry, ‘Malik, if only your Lord would finish us off,’ but he will answer, ‘No! You are here to stay.’
verses.pickthall: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
verses.en: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
verses.tr: laqad jiʾnākum bi-l-ḥaqqi walākinna ʾaktharakum lilḥaqqi kārihūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have brought you the Truth but most of you despise it.
verses.pickthall: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.

verses.ar: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
verses.en: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
verses.tr: ʾam ʾabramūā ʾamran fa-innā mubrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have these disbelievers thought up some scheme? We too have been scheming.
verses.pickthall: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining.

verses.ar: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.en: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.
verses.tr: ʾam yaḥsabūna ʾannā lā nasmaʿu sirrahum wanajwāhum ۚ balā warusulunā ladayhim yaktubūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they think We cannot hear their secret talk and their private counsel? Yes we can: Our messengers are at their sides, recording everything.
verses.pickthall: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
verses.tr: qul ʾin kāna lilrraḥmāni waladun fa-anā ʾawwalu al-ʿābidīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘If the Lord of Mercy [truly] had offspring I would be the first to worship [them], but-
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).

verses.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.en: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
verses.tr: subḥāna rabbi as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi rabbi al-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: exalted be the Lord of the heavens and earth, the Lord of the Throne- He is far above their false descriptions.’
verses.pickthall: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!

verses.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
verses.tr: fadharhum yakhūḍūā wayalʿabūā ḥattā yulāqūā yawmahumu adh-dhā yūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Leave them to wade in deeper and play about, until they face the Day they have been promised.
verses.pickthall: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā fā as-samāʾi ʾilāhun wafā al-ʾarḍi ʾilāhun ۚ wahuwa al-ḥakīmu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who is God in heaven and God on earth; He is the All Wise, the All Knowing;
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower.

verses.ar: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
verses.tr: watabāraka adh-dhā lahu mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā waʿindahu ʿilmu as-sāʿahi wa-ʾilayhi turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Exalted is He who has control of the heavens and earth and everything between them; He has knowledge of the Hour; you will all be returned to Him.
verses.pickthall: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
verses.tr: walā yamliku adh-dhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi ash-shafāʿaha ʾillā man shahida bi-l-ḥaqqi wahum yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those gods they invoke besides Him have no power of intercession, unlike those who bore witness to the truth and recognized it.
verses.pickthall: And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly.

verses.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.en: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?
verses.tr: walaʾin saʾaltahum mman khalaqahum layaqūlunna Allāh ۖ fa-annā yuʾfakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If you [Prophet] ask them who created them they are sure to say, ‘God,’ so why are they so deluded?
verses.pickthall: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?

verses.ar: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
verses.tr: waqīlihi yārabbi ʾinna hāʾulāʾi qawmun llā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Prophet has said, ‘My Lord, truly these are people who do not believe,’
verses.pickthall: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.

verses.ar: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
verses.tr: fāṣfaḥ ʿanhum waqul salāmun ۚ fasawfa yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but turn away from them and say, ‘Peace’: they will come to know.
verses.pickthall: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.

verses.ar: حمٓ
verses.en: Ḥā, Meem.
verses.tr: ḥm
verses.abdelhaleem: Ha Mim
verses.pickthall: Ha. Mim.

verses.ar: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.en: By the clear Book,
verses.tr: wa-l-kitābi al-mubīni
verses.abdelhaleem: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
verses.pickthall: By the Scripture that maketh plain

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾanzalnāhu fā laylahin mmubārakahin ۚ ʾinnā kunnā mundhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––
verses.pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -

verses.ar: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.en: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct every precise matter -
verses.tr: fīhā yufraqu kullu ʾamrin ḥakīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct
verses.pickthall: Whereon every wise command is made clear

verses.ar: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
verses.en: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
verses.tr: ʾamran mmin ʿindinā ۚ ʾinnā kunnā mursilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––
verses.pickthall: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -

verses.ar: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,
verses.tr: raḥmahan mmin rrabbika ۚ ʾinnahu huwa as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all,
verses.pickthall: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,

verses.ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
verses.tr: rabbi as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā ۖ ʾin kuntum mmūqinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––
verses.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.

verses.ar: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
verses.tr: lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa yuḥāi wayumītu ۖ rabbukum warabbu ābāʾikumu al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––
verses.pickthall: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.

verses.ar: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.en: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
verses.tr: bal hum fā shakkin yalʿabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they play in doubt.

verses.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
verses.tr: fārtaqib yawma taʾtā as-samāʾu bidukhānin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see.
verses.pickthall: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

verses.ar: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
verses.tr: yaghshā an-nāsa ۖ hādhā ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment!
verses.pickthall: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.

verses.ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
verses.tr: rrabbanā ākshif ʿannā al-ʿadhāba ʾinnā muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’
verses.pickthall: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.

verses.ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
verses.tr: ʾannā lahumu adh-dhikrā waqad jāʾahum rasūlun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly,
verses.pickthall: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
verses.en: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
verses.tr: thumma tawallawā ʿanhu waqālūā muʿallamun mmajnūnun
verses.abdelhaleem: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’
verses.pickthall: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
verses.tr: ʾinnā kāshifūā al-ʿadhābi qalīlan ۚ ʾinnakum ʿāʾidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––
verses.pickthall: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).

verses.ar: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.en: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
verses.tr: yawma nabṭishu al-baṭshaha al-kubrā ʾinnā muntaqimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution.
verses.pickthall: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.

verses.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],
verses.tr: ۞ walaqad fatannā qablahum qawma firʿawna wajāʾahum rasūlun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,
verses.pickthall: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,

verses.ar: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
verses.tr: ʾan ʾaddūā ʾilāa ʿibāda Allāh ۖ ʾinnā lakum rasūlun ʾamīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you.
verses.pickthall: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.

verses.ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.
verses.tr: wa-an llā taʿlūā ʿalā Allāh ۖ ʾinnā ātīkum bisulṭānin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority.
verses.pickthall: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.

verses.ar: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
verses.en: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
verses.tr: wa-innā ʿudhtu birabbā warabbikum ʾan tarjumūni
verses.abdelhaleem: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults!
verses.pickthall: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.

verses.ar: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
verses.en: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
verses.tr: wa-in llam tuʾminūā lā fāʿtazilūni
verses.abdelhaleem: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’
verses.pickthall: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.

verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
verses.tr: fadaʿā rabbahu ʾanna hāʾulāʾi qawmun mmujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’
verses.pickthall: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.

verses.ar: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.en: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
verses.tr: fa-asri biʿibādā laylan ʾinnakum mmuttabaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued.
verses.pickthall: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,

verses.ar: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.en: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
verses.tr: wātruki al-baḥra rahwan ۖ ʾinnahum jundun mmughraqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’
verses.pickthall: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.

verses.ar: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
verses.tr: kam tarakūā min jannātin waʿuyūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Many a garden and spring they left behind,
verses.pickthall: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,

verses.ar: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: And crops and noble sites
verses.tr: wazurūʿin wamaqāmin karīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: many a cornfield and noble building,
verses.pickthall: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

verses.ar: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
verses.en: And comfort wherein they were amused.
verses.tr: wanaʿmahin kānūā fīhā fākihīna
verses.abdelhaleem: many a thing in which they had delighted:
verses.pickthall: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
verses.tr: kadhālika ۖ wa-awrathnāhā qawman ākharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave these to another people to inherit.
verses.pickthall: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;

verses.ar: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.en: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
verses.tr: famā bakat ʿalayhimu as-samāʾu wa-l-ʾarḍu wamā kānūā munẓarīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time.
verses.pickthall: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.en: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
verses.tr: walaqad najjaynā banā ʾisrāʾīla mina al-ʿadhābi al-muhīni
verses.abdelhaleem: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering
verses.pickthall: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;

verses.ar: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.en: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
verses.tr: min firʿawna ۚ ʾinnahu kāna ʿāliyan mmina al-musrifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.
verses.pickthall: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
verses.tr: walaqadi ākhtarnāhum ʿalā ʿilmin ʿalā al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We chose them knowingly above others:
verses.pickthall: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.

verses.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
verses.tr: wataynāhum mmina al-āyāti mā fīhi balāʾunā mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test.
verses.pickthall: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
verses.tr: ʾinna hāʾulāʾi layaqūlūna
verses.abdelhaleem: These people here assert,
verses.pickthall: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:

verses.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.en: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
verses.tr: ʾin hāa ʾillā mawtatunā al-ʾūlā wamā naḥnu bimunsharīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected.
verses.pickthall: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.

verses.ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: fa-tūā bābāʾinā ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’
verses.pickthall: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!

verses.ar: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
verses.tr: ʾahum khayrun ʾam qawmu tubbaʿin wa-adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ ʾahlaknāhum ۖ ʾinnahum kānūā mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty.
verses.pickthall: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
verses.en: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
verses.tr: wamā khalaqnā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between;
verses.pickthall: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.

verses.ar: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
verses.tr: mā khalaqnāhumā ʾillā bi-l-ḥaqqi walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend.
verses.pickthall: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.

verses.ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
verses.tr: ʾinna yawma al-faṣli mīqātuhum ʾajmaʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all;
verses.pickthall: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
verses.tr: yawma lā yughnā mawlanā ʿan mmawlanā shayā walā hum yunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: a Day when no friend can take another’s place.
verses.pickthall: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.tr: ʾillā man rraḥima Allāh ۚ ʾinnahu huwa al-ʿazīzu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord.
verses.pickthall: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.en: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm
verses.tr: ʾinna shajarata az-zaqqūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: The tree of Zaqqum
verses.pickthall: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,

verses.ar: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
verses.en: Is food for the sinful.
verses.tr: ṭaʿāmu al-ʾathīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: will be food for the sinners:
verses.pickthall: The food of the sinner!

verses.ar: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
verses.en: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
verses.tr: ka-l-muhli yaghlā fā al-buṭūni
verses.abdelhaleem: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies
verses.pickthall: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies

verses.ar: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.en: Like the boiling of scalding water.
verses.tr: kaghalāi al-ḥamīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: like seething water.
verses.pickthall: As the seething of boiling water.

verses.ar: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
verses.tr: khudhūhu fāʿtilūhu ʾilā sawāʾi al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell!
verses.pickthall: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.en: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
verses.tr: thumma ṣubbūā fawqa raʾsihi min ʿadhābi al-ḥamīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’
verses.pickthall: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.

verses.ar: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
verses.en: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
verses.tr: dhuq ʾinnaka ʾanta al-ʿazīzu al-karīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Taste this, you powerful, respected man!
verses.pickthall: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā mā kuntum bihi tamtarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is what you doubted.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:
verses.tr: ʾinna al-muttaqīna fā maqāmin ʾamīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: Within gardens and springs,
verses.tr: fā jannātin waʿuyūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: amid Gardens and springs,
verses.pickthall: Amid gardens and watersprings,

verses.ar: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.en: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
verses.tr: yalbasūna min sundusin wa-istabraqin mmutaqābilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another:
verses.pickthall: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.en: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
verses.tr: kadhālika wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.
verses.pickthall: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

verses.ar: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.en: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
verses.tr: yadʿūna fīhā bikulli fākihahin āminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit.
verses.pickthall: They call therein for every fruit in safety.

verses.ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
verses.tr: lā yadhūqūna fīhā al-mawta ʾillā al-mawtaha al-ʾūlā ۖ wawaqāhum ʿadhāba al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell,
verses.pickthall: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,

verses.ar: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.en: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
verses.tr: faḍlan mmin rrabbika ۚ dhālika huwa al-fawzu al-ʿaẓīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
verses.pickthall: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.
verses.tr: fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed.
verses.pickthall: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.

verses.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
verses.en: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
verses.tr: fārtaqib ʾinnahum mmurtaqibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting.
verses.pickthall: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.

verses.ar: حمٓ
verses.en: Ḥā, Meem.
verses.tr: ḥm
verses.abdelhaleem: Ha Mim
verses.pickthall: Ha. Mim.

verses.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.en: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: tanzīlu al-kitābi mina Allāh al-ʿazīzi al-ḥakīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
verses.tr: ʾinna fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi lāyātin llilmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: There are signs in the heavens and the earth for those who believe:
verses.pickthall: Lo! in the heavens and the earth are portents for believers.

verses.ar: وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
verses.tr: wafā khalqikum wamā yabuthu min dābbahin āyātun lliqawmin yūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: in the creation of you, in the creatures God scattered on earth, there are signs for people of sure faith;
verses.pickthall: And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure.

verses.ar: وَٱخْتِلَـٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَـٰحِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allāh sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
verses.tr: wākhtilāfi al-yli wa-an-nahāri wamā ʾanzala Allāh mina as-samāʾi min rrizqin fa-aḥyā bihi al-ʾarḍa baʿda mawtihā wataṣrīfi ar-riyāḥi āyātun lliqawmin yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: in the alternation of night and day, in the rain God provides, sending it down from the sky and reviving the dead earth with it, and in His shifting of the winds there are signs for those who use their reason.
verses.pickthall: And the difference of night and day and the provision that Allah sendeth down from the sky and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death, and the ordering of the winds, are portents for a people who have sense.

verses.ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَـٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: These are the verses of Allāh which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allāh and His verses will they believe?
verses.tr: tilka āyātu Allāh natlūhā ʿalayka bi-l-ḥaqqi ۖ fabiāi ḥadīthin baʿda Allāh wayātihi yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: These are God’s signs that We recount to you [Prophet, to show] the Truth. If they deny God and His revelations, what message will they believe in?
verses.pickthall: These are the portents of Allah which We recite unto thee (Muhammad) with truth. Then in what fact, after Allah and His portents, will they believe?

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.en: Woe to every sinful liar
verses.tr: waylun llikulli ʾaffākin ʾathīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe to every lying sinful person
verses.pickthall: Woe unto each sinful liar,

verses.ar: يَسْمَعُ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: Who hears the verses of Allāh recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
verses.tr: yasmaʿu āyāti Allāh tutlā ʿalayhi thumma yuṣirru mustakbiran kaʾan llam yasmaʿhā ۖ fabashirhu biʿadhābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: who hears God’s revelations being recited to him, yet persists in his arrogance as if he had never heard them––[Prophet] bring him news of a painful torment!––
verses.pickthall: Who heareth the revelations of Allah recited unto him, and then continueth in pride as though he heard them not. Give him tidings of a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.en: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
verses.tr: wa-idhā ʿalima min āyātinā shayā āttakhadhahā huzuwan ۚ ʾūlāʾika lahum ʿadhābun mmuhīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: who, if he knows anything about Our revelations, ridicules it! Such people will have a humiliating torment:
verses.pickthall: And when he knoweth aught of Our revelations he maketh it a jest. For such there is a shameful doom.

verses.ar: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allāh as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
verses.tr: mmin warāʾihim jahannamu ۖ walā yughnā ʿanhum mmā kasabūā shayā walā mā āttakhadhūā min dūni Allāh ʾawliyāʾa ۖ walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Hell lurks behind them and their gains will not benefit them, nor will those beings they took as protectors beside God––a tremendous torment awaits them.
verses.pickthall: Beyond them there is hell, and that which they have earned will naught avail them, nor those whom they have chosen for protecting friends beside Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا هُدًى ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
verses.tr: hādhā hudanā ۖ wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā bāyāti rabbihim lahum ʿadhābun mmin rrijzin ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: This is true guidance; those who reject their Lord’s revelations will have a woeful torment.
verses.pickthall: This is guidance. And those who disbelieve the revelations of their Lord, for them there is a painful doom of wrath.

verses.ar: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: It is Allāh who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.tr: ۞ Allāh adh-dhā sakhara lakumu al-baḥra litajrāa al-fulku fīhi biʾamrihi walitabtaghūā min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who subjected the sea for you––ships sail on it by His command so that you can seek His bounty and give Him thanks––
verses.pickthall: Allah it is Who hath made the sea of service unto you that the ships may run thereon by His command, and that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful;

verses.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
verses.tr: wasakhara lakum mmā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi jamīʿan mminhu ۚ ʾinna fā dhālika lāyātin lliqawmin yatafakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He has subjected all that is in the heavens and the earth for your benefit, as a gift from Him. There truly are signs in this for those who reflect.
verses.pickthall: And hath made of service unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; it is all from Him. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who reflect.

verses.ar: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allāh [i.e., of His retribution] so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
verses.tr: qul llilladhīna āmanūā yaghfirūā lilladhīna lā yarjūna ʾayyāma Allāh liyajzāa qawmanā bimā kānūā yaksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear God’s days [of punishment]––He will requite people for what they have done.
verses.pickthall: Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn.

verses.ar: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.en: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
verses.tr: man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi ۖ waman ʾasāʾa faʿalayhā ۖ thumma ʾilā rabbikum turjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whoever does good benefits himself, and whoever does evil harms himself: you will all be returned to your Lord.
verses.pickthall: Whoso doeth right, it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And afterward unto your Lord ye will be brought back.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
verses.tr: walaqad ātaynā banā ʾisrāʾīla al-kitāba wa-l-ḥukma wa-an-nubuwwaha warazaqnāhum mmina aṭ-ṭayyibāti wafaḍḍalnāhum ʿalā al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave scripture, wisdom, and prophethood to the Children of Israel; We provided them with good things and favoured them above others;
verses.pickthall: And verily we gave the Children of Israel the Scripture and the Command and the Prophethood, and provided them with good things and favoured them above (all) peoples;

verses.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم بَيِّنَـٰتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
verses.tr: wataynāhum bayyinātin mmina al-ʾamri ۖ famā ākhtalafūā ʾillā min baʿdi mā jāʾahumu al-ʿilmu baghyanā baynahum ۚ ʾinna rabbaka yaqḍā baynahum yawma al-qiyāmahi fīmā kānūā fīhi yakhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We gave them clear proof in matters [of religion]. They differed among themselves out of mutual rivalry, only after knowledge came to them: on the Day of Resurrection your Lord will judge between them regarding their differences.
verses.pickthall: And gave them plain commandments. And they differed not until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Then We put you, [O Muḥammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
verses.tr: thumma jaʿalnāka ʿalā sharīʿahin mmina al-ʾamri fāttabiʿhā walā tattabiʿ ʾahwāʾa adh-dhīna lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Now We have set you [Muhammad] on a clear religious path, so follow it. Do not follow the desires of those who lack [true] knowledge-
verses.pickthall: And now have We set thee (O Muhammad) on a clear road of (Our) commandment; so follow it, and follow not the whims of those who know not.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا۟ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allāh at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allāh is the protector of the righteous.
verses.tr: ʾinnahum lan yughnūā ʿanka mina Allāh shayā ۚ wa-inna aẓ-ẓālimīna baʿḍuhum ʾawliyāʾu baʿḍin ۖ wallāh walāu al-muttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: they cannot help you against God in any way. Wrongdoers only have each other to protect them; the righteous have God Himself as their protector.
verses.pickthall: Lo! they can avail thee naught against Allah. And lo! as for the wrong-doers, some of them are friends of others; and Allah is the Friend of those who ward off (evil).

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا بَصَـٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
verses.tr: hādhā baṣāʾiru lilnnāsi wahudanā waraḥmahun lliqawmin yūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This [revelation] is a means of insight for people, a source of guidance and mercy for those of sure faith.
verses.pickthall: This is clear indication for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for a folk whose faith is sure.

verses.ar: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَوَآءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
verses.en: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].
verses.tr: ʾam ḥasiba adh-dhīna ājtaraḥūā as-sayyāti ʾan nnajʿalahum ka-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti sawāʾan mmaḥyāhum wamamātuhum ۚ sāʾa mā yaḥkumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do those who commit evil deeds really think that We will deal with them in the same way as those who believe and do righteous deeds, that they will be alike in their living and their dying? How badly they judge!
verses.pickthall: Or do those who commit ill-deeds suppose that We shall make them as those who believe and do good works, the same in life and death? Bad is their judgment!

verses.ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
verses.tr: wakhalaqa Allāh as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa bi-l-ḥaqqi walitujzā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat wahum lā yuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God created the heavens and earth for a true purpose: to reward each soul according to its deeds. They will not be wronged.
verses.pickthall: And Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth, and that every soul may be repaid what it hath earned. And they will not be wronged.

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَـٰوَةً فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allāh has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allāh? Then will you not be reminded?
verses.tr: ʾafaraʾayta mani āttakhadha ʾilāhahu hawāhu wa-aḍallahu Allāh ʿalā ʿilmin wakhatama ʿalā samʿihi waqalbihi wajaʿala ʿalā baṣarihi ghishāwahan faman yahdīhi min baʿdi Allāh ۚ ʾafalā tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], consider the one who has taken his own desire as a god, whom God allows to stray in the face of knowledge, sealing his ears and heart and covering his eyes- who can guide such a person after God [has done this]? Will you [people] not take heed?
verses.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god, and Allah sendeth him astray purposely, and sealeth up his hearing and his heart, and setteth on his sight a covering? Then who will lead him after Allah (hath condemned him)? Will ye not then heed?

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
verses.en: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
verses.tr: waqālūā mā hāa ʾillā ḥayātunā ad-dunyā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā yuhlikunā ʾillā ad-dahru ۚ wamā lahum bidhālika min ʿilmin ۖ ʾin hum ʾillā yaẓunnūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘There is only our life in this world: we die, we live, nothing but time destroys us.’ They have no knowledge of this; they only follow guesswork. Their only argument,
verses.pickthall: And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: wa-idhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin mmā kāna ḥujjatahum ʾillā ʾan qālūā āʾtūā bābāʾinā ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: when Our clear revelations are recited to them, is to say, ‘Bring back our forefathers if what you say is true.’
verses.pickthall: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them their only argument is that they say: Bring (back) our fathers. then, if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Allāh causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
verses.tr: quli Allāh yuḥyīkum thumma yumītukum thumma yajmaʿukum ʾilā yawmi al-qiyāmahi lā rayba fīhi walākinna ʾakthara an-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say, ‘It is God who gives you life, then causes you to die, and then He gathers you all to the Day of Resurrection of which there is no doubt, though most people do not comprehend.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah giveth life to you, then causeth you to die, then gathereth you unto the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verses.en: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ wayawma taqūmu as-sāʿahu yawmaʾidhin yakhsaru al-mubṭilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Control of everything in the heavens and the earth belongs to God. When the Hour comes, those who follow falsehood will be the losers on that Day.
verses.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour riseth, on that day those who follow falsehood will be lost.

verses.ar: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَـٰبِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
verses.tr: watarā kulla ʾummahin jāthiyahan ۚ kullu ʾummahin tudʿā ʾilā kitābihā al-yawma tujzawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You will see every community kneeling. Every community will be summoned to its record: ‘Today you will be repaid for what you did.
verses.pickthall: And thou wilt see each nation crouching, each nation summoned to its record. (And it will be said unto them): This day ye are requited what ye used to do.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا كِتَـٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
verses.tr: hādhā kitābunā yanṭiqu ʿalaykum bi-l-ḥaqqi ۚ ʾinnā kunnā nastansikhu mā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Here is Our record that tells the truth about you: We have been recording everything you do.’
verses.pickthall: This Our Book pronounceth against you with truth. Lo! We have caused (all) that ye did to be recorded.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
verses.tr: fa-ammā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fā raḥmatihi ۚ dhālika huwa al-fawzu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who believed and did good deeds will be admitted by their Lord into His mercy- that is the clearest triumph-
verses.pickthall: Then, as for those who believed and did good works, their Lord will bring them in unto His mercy. That is the evident triumph.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a criminal people?
verses.tr: wa-ammā adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾafalam takun āyātā tutlā ʿalaykum fāstakbartum wakuntum qawman mmujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but those who disbelieved [will be asked]: ‘When My revelations were recited to you, were you not arrogant and persistent in wicked deeds?
verses.pickthall: And as for those who disbelieved (it will be said unto them): Were not Our revelations recited unto you? But ye were scornful and became a guilty folk.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِى مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ
verses.en: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla ʾinna waʿda Allāh ḥaqqun wa-as-sāʿahu lā rayba fīhā qultum mmā nadrā mā as-sāʿahu ʾin nnaẓunnu ʾillā ẓannan wamā naḥnu bimustayqinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: When it was said to you, “God’s promise is true: there is no doubt about the Hour,” did you not reply, “We know nothing of the Hour. This is only conjecture in our opinion. We are not convinced”?’
verses.pickthall: And when it was said: Lo! Allah's promise is the truth, and there is no doubt of the Hour's coming, ye said: We know not what the Hour is. We deem it naught but a conjecture, and we are by no means convinced.

verses.ar: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.tr: wabadā lahum sayyātu mā ʿamilūā waḥāqa bihim mmā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The evil of their actions will [then] become clear to them. The punishment they mocked will engulf them.
verses.pickthall: And the evils of what they did will appear unto them, and that which they used to deride will befall them.

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.en: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
verses.tr: waqīla al-yawma nansākum kamā nasītum liqāʾa yawmikum hādhā wamaʾwākumu an-nāru wamā lakum mmin nnāṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It will be said, ‘Today We shall ignore you just as you ignored your appointment with this Day. The Fire will be your home and no one will help you,
verses.pickthall: And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذْتُمْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
verses.en: That is because you took the verses of Allāh in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
verses.tr: dhālikum biʾannakumu āttakhadhtum āyāti Allāh huzuwan wagharratkumu al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā ۚ fa-l-yawma lā yukhrajūna minhā walā hum yustaʿtabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: because you received God’s revelations with ridicule and were deceived by worldly life.’ They will not be brought out of the Fire on that Day, nor will they be given the chance to make amends.
verses.pickthall: This, forasmuch as ye made the revelations of Allah a jest, and the life of the world beguiled you. Therefor this day they come not forth from thence, nor can they make amends.

verses.ar: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Then, to Allāh belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: fa-lillāh al-ḥamdu rabbi as-samāwāti warabbi al-ʾarḍi rabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So praise be to God, Lord of the heavens and earth, Lord of the worlds.
verses.pickthall: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: walahu al-kibriyāʾu fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: True greatness in the heavens and the earth is rightfully His: He is the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: And unto Him (alone) belongeth Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: حمٓ
verses.en: Ḥā, Meem.
verses.tr: ḥm
verses.abdelhaleem: Ha Mim
verses.pickthall: Ha. Mim.

verses.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.en: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: tanzīlu al-kitābi mina Allāh al-ʿazīzi al-ḥakīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Almighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: مَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُوا۟ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
verses.tr: mā khalaqnā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wamā baynahumā ʾillā bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-ajalin mmusammanā ۚ wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā ʿammā ʾundhirūā muʿriḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It was for a true purpose and a specific term that We created heaven and earth and everything in between, yet those who deny the truth ignore the warning they have been given.
verses.pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and for a term appointed. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ۖ ٱئْتُونِى بِكِتَـٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ هَـٰذَآ أَوْ أَثَـٰرَةٍ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum mmā tadʿūna min dūni Allāh ʾarūnā mādhā khalaqūā mina al-ʾarḍi ʾam lahum shirkun fā as-samāwāti ۖ āʾtūnā bikitābin mmin qabli hādhā ʾaw ʾathārahin mmin ʿilmin ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Consider those you pray to other than God: show me which part of the earth they created or which share of the heavens they own; bring me a previous scripture or some vestige of divine knowledge––if what you say is true.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Have ye thought on all that ye invoke beside Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or have they any portion in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this (Scripture), or some vestige of knowledge (in support of what ye say), if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَآئِهِمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ
verses.en: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allāh those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
verses.tr: waman ʾaḍallu mimman yadʿūā min dūni Allāh man llā yastajību lahu ʾilā yawmi al-qiyāmahi wahum ʿan duʿāʾihim ghāfilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who could be more wrong than a person who calls on those other than God, those who will not answer him till the Day of Resurrection, those who are unaware of his prayers,
verses.pickthall: And who is further astray than those who, instead of Allah, pray unto such as hear not their prayer until the Day of Resurrection, and are unconscious of their prayer,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَعْدَآءً وَكَانُوا۟ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
verses.tr: wa-idhā ḥushira an-nāsu kānūā lahum ʾaʿdāʾan wakānūā biʿibādatihim kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who, when all mankind is gathered, will become his enemies and disown his worship?
verses.pickthall: And when mankind are gathered (to the Judgment) will become enemies for them, and will become deniers of having been worshipped.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."
verses.tr: wa-idhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lilḥaqqi lammā jāʾahum hādhā siḥrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: When Our revelations are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say of the Truth that has reached them, ‘This is clearly sorcery,’
verses.pickthall: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say of the Truth when it reacheth them: This is mere magic.

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۖ كَفَىٰ بِهِۦ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: Or do they say, "He has invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allāh at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
verses.tr: ʾam yaqūlūna āftarāhu ۖ qul ʾini āftaraytuhu falā tamlikūna lā mina Allāh shayā ۖ huwa ʾaʿlamu bimā tufīḍūna fīhi ۖ kafā bihi shahīdanā baynā wabaynakum ۖ wahuwa al-ghafūru ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: or they say, ‘He has invented it himself.’ Say [Prophet], ‘If I have really invented it, there is nothing you can do to save me from God. He knows best what you say amongst yourselves about it; He is sufficient as a witness between me and you; He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.’
verses.pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented it? Say (O Muhammad): If I have invented it, still ye have no power to support me against Allah. He is Best Aware of what ye say among yourselves concerning it. He sufficeth for a witness between me and you. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدْرِى مَا يُفْعَلُ بِى وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
verses.tr: qul mā kuntu bidʿan mmina ar-rusuli wamā ʾadrā mā yufʿalu bā walā bikum ۖ ʾin ʾattabiʿu ʾillā mā yūḥā ʾilāa wamā ʾanā ʾillā nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I am nothing new among God’s messengers. I do not know what will be done with me or you; I only follow what is revealed to me; I only warn plainly.’
verses.pickthall: Say: I am no new thing among the messengers (of Allah), nor know I what will be done with me or with you. I do but follow that which is inspired in me, and I am but a plain warner.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
