verses.en: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was from Allāh, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum ʾin kāna min ʿindi Allāh wakafartum bihi washahida shāhidun mmin banā ʾisrāʾīla ʿalā mithlihi fāmana wāstakbartum ۖ ʾinna Allāh lā yahdā al-qawma aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Have you thought: what if this Quran really is from God and you reject it? What if one of the Children of Israel testifies to its similarity [to earlier scripture] and believes in it, and yet you are too proud to [do the same]? God certainly does not guide evildoers.’
verses.pickthall: Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye disbelieve therein, and a witness of the Children of Israel hath already testified to the like thereof and hath believed, and ye are too proud (what plight is yours)? Lo! Allah guideth not wrong-doing folk.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيْهِ ۚ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَـٰذَآ إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ
verses.en: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."
verses.tr: waqāla adh-dhīna kafarūā lilladhīna āmanūā law kāna khayran mmā sabaqūnā ʾilayhi ۚ wa-idh lam yahtadūā bihi fasayaqūlūna hādhā ʾifkun qadīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who disbelieve say of the believers, ‘If there were any good in this Quran, they would not have believed in it before we did,’and, since they refuse to be guided by it, they say, ‘This is an ancient fabrication.’
verses.pickthall: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe: If it had been (any) good, they would not have been before us in attaining it. And since they will not be guided by it, they say: This is an ancient lie;

verses.ar: وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ وَهَـٰذَا كِتَـٰبٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.
verses.tr: wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā ʾimāman waraḥmahan ۚ wahādhā kitābun mmuṣaddiqun llisānan ʿarabiyyan lliyundhira adh-dhīna ẓalamūā wabushrā lilmuḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet the scripture of Moses was revealed before it as a guide and a mercy, and this is a scripture confirming it in the Arabic language to warn those who do evil and bring good news for those who do good.
verses.pickthall: When before it there was the Scripture of Moses, an example and a mercy; and this is a confirming Scripture in the Arabic language, that it may warn those who do wrong and bring good tidings for the righteous.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna qālūā rabbunā Allāh thumma āstaqāmūā falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: For those who say, ‘Our lord is God,’ and then follow the straight path there is no fear, nor shall they grieve:
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and thereafter walk aright, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu al-jannahi khālidīna fīhā jazāʾan bimā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they are the people of Paradise, there to remain as a reward for what they were doing.
verses.pickthall: Such are rightful owners of the Garden, immortal therein, as a reward for what they used to do.

verses.ar: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ إِحْسَـٰنًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُۥ وَفِصَـٰلُهُۥ ثَلَـٰثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَـٰلِحًا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
verses.tr: wawaṣṣaynā al-ʾinsāna biwālidayhi ʾiḥsānan ۖ ḥamalathu ʾummuhu kurhan wawaḍaʿathu kurhan ۖ waḥamluhu wafiṣāluhu thalāthūna shahran ۚ ḥattā ʾidhā balagha ʾashuddahu wabalagha ʾarbaʿīna sanahan qāla rabbi ʾawziʿnā ʾan ʾashkura niʿmataka at-tā ʾanʿamta ʿalāa waʿalā wālidāa wa-an ʾaʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-aṣliḥ lā fā dhurriyyatā ۖ ʾinnā tubtu ʾilayka wa-innā mina al-muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have commanded man to be good to his parents: his mother struggled to carry him and struggled to give birth to him- his bearing and weaning took a full thirty months. When he has grown to manhood and reached the age of forty he [may] say, ‘Lord, help me to be truly grateful for Your favours to me and to my parents; help me to do good work that pleases You; make my offspring good. I turn to You; I am one of those who devote themselves to You.’
verses.pickthall: And We have commended unto man kindness toward parents. His mother beareth him with reluctance, and bringeth him forth with reluctance, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, till, when he attaineth full strength and reacheth forty years, he saith: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee).

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱلصِّدْقِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna nataqabbalu ʿanhum ʾaḥsana mā ʿamilūā wanatajāwazu ʿan sayyātihim fā ʾaṣḥābi al-jannahi ۖ waʿda aṣ-ṣidqi adh-dhā kānūā yūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We accept from such people the best of what they do and We overlook their bad deeds. They will be among the people of Paradise- the true promise that has been given to them.
verses.pickthall: Those are they from whom We accept the best of what they do, and overlook their evil deeds. (They are) among the owners of the Garden. This is the true promise which they were promised (in the world).

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِى قَالَ لِوَٰلِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَّكُمَآ أَتَعِدَانِنِىٓ أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلْقُرُونُ مِن قَبْلِى وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ ٱللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allāh for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former peoples" -
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhā qāla liwālidayhi ʾuffin llakumā ʾataʿidāninā ʾan ʾukhraja waqad khalati al-qurūnu min qablā wahumā yastaghīthāni Allāh waylaka āmin ʾinna waʿda Allāh ḥaqqun fayaqūlu mā hādhā ʾillā ʾasāṭīru al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But some say to their parents, ‘What? Are you really warning me that I shall be raised alive from my grave, when so many generations have already passed and gone before me?’ His parents implore God for help; they say, ‘Alas for you! Believe! God’s promise is true,’ but still he replies, ‘These are nothing but ancient fables.’
verses.pickthall: And whoso saith unto his parents: Fie upon you both! Do ye threaten me that I shall be brought forth (again) when generations before me have passed away? And they twain cry unto Allah for help (and say): Woe unto thee! Believe! Lo! the promise of Allah is true. But he saith: This is naught save fables of the men of old:

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.en: Those are the ones upon whom the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu al-qawlu fā ʾumamin qad khalat min qablihim mmina al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi ۖ ʾinnahum kānūā khāsirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: The verdict has been passed on such people, along with all the communities that went before them, jinn and human: they are lost.
verses.pickthall: Such are those on whom the Word concerning nations of the jinn and mankind which have passed away before them hath effect. Lo! they are the losers.

verses.ar: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَـٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ ۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
verses.tr: walikullin darajātun mmimmā ʿamilūā ۖ waliyuwaffiyahum ʾaʿmālahum wahum lā yuẓlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Everyone will be ranked according to their deeds and God will repay them in full for what they have done: they will not be wronged.
verses.pickthall: And for all there will be ranks from what they do, that He may pay them for their deeds; and they will not be wronged.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَـٰتِكُمْ فِى حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا فَٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ
verses.en: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."
verses.tr: wayawma yuʿraḍu adh-dhīna kafarūā ʿalā an-nāri ʾadhhabtum ṭayyibātikum fā ḥayātikumu ad-dunyā wāstamtaʿtum bihā fa-l-yawma tujzawna ʿadhāba al-hūni bimā kuntum tastakbirūna fā al-ʾarḍi bighayri al-ḥaqqi wabimā kuntum tafsuqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when those who deny the truth are brought before the Fire, it will be said to them, ‘You squandered the good things you were given in your earthly life, you took your fill of pleasure there, so on this Day a punishment of shame is yours: you were arrogant on earth without any right, and exceeded all limits.’
verses.pickthall: And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (it will be said): Ye squandered your good things in the life of the world and sought comfort therein. Now this day ye are rewarded with the doom of ignominy because ye were disdainful in the land without a right, and because ye used to transgress.

verses.ar: ۞ وَٱذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنذَرَ قَوْمَهُۥ بِٱلْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ ٱلنُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦٓ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: And mention, [O Muḥammad], the brother of ʿAad, when he warned his people in [the region of] al-Aḥqāf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.tr: ۞ wādhkur ʾakhā ʿādin ʾidh ʾandhara qawmahu bi-l-ʾaḥqāfi waqad khalati an-nudhuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi ʾallā taʿbudūā ʾillā Allāh ʾinnā ʾakhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Mention [Hud] of the tribe of Ad: he warned his people among the sand dunes- other warners have come and gone both before and after him- ‘ Worship no one but God: I fear for you, that you will be punished on a terrible Day,’
verses.pickthall: And make mention (O Muhammad) of the brother of A'ad when he warned his folk among the wind-curved sandhills - and verily warners came and went before and after him - saying: Serve none but Allah. Lo! I fear for you the doom of a tremendous Day.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.tr: qālūā ʾajiʾtanā litaʾfikanā ʿan ālihatinā fa-tinā bimā taʿidunā ʾin kunta mina aṣ-ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but they said, ‘Have you come to turn us away from our gods? If what you say is true, bring down that punishment you threaten us with!’
verses.pickthall: They said: Hast come to turn us away from our gods? Then bring upon us that wherewith thou threatenest us, if thou art of the truthful.

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allāh, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."
verses.tr: qāla ʾinnamā al-ʿilmu ʿinda Allāh wa-uballighukum mmā ʾursiltu bihi walākinnā ʾarākum qawman tajhalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘Only God knows when it will come: I simply convey to you the message I am sent with but I can see you are an insolent people.’
verses.pickthall: He said: The knowledge is with Allah only. I convey unto you that wherewith I have been sent, but I see you are a folk that know not.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا عَارِضٌ مُّمْطِرُنَا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ مَا ٱسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِۦ ۖ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,
verses.tr: falammā raʾawhu ʿāriḍan mmustaqbila ʾawdiyatihim qālūā hādhā ʿāriḍun mmumṭirunā ۚ bal huwa mā āstaʿjaltum bihi ۖ rīḥun fīhā ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: When they saw a cloud approaching their valley, they said, ‘This cloud will give us rain!’ ‘No indeed! It is what you wanted to hasten: a storm-wind bearing a painful punishment
verses.pickthall: Then, when they beheld it as a dense cloud coming toward their valleys, they said: Here is a cloud bringing us rain. Nay, but it is that which ye did seek to hasten, a wind wherein is painful torment,

verses.ar: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.
verses.tr: tudammiru kulla shāʾin biʾamri rabbihā fa-aṣbaḥūā lā yurā ʾillā masākinuhum ۚ kadhālika najzā al-qawma al-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: which will destroy everything by its Lord’s command.’ In the morning there was nothing to see except their [ruined] dwellings: this is how We repay the guilty.
verses.pickthall: Destroying all things by commandment of its Lord. And morning found them so that naught could be seen save their dwellings. Thus do We reward the guilty folk.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِيمَآ إِن مَّكَّنَّـٰكُمْ فِيهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَأَبْصَـٰرًا وَأَفْـِٔدَةً فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ وَلَآ أَفْـِٔدَتُهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوا۟ يَجْحَدُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allāh; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.tr: walaqad makkannāhum fīmā ʾin mmakkannākum fīhi wajaʿalnā lahum samʿan wa-abṣāran wa-afdahan famā ʾaghnā ʿanhum samʿuhum walā ʾabṣāruhum walā ʾafdatuhum mmin shāʾin ʾidh kānūā yajḥadūna bāyāti Allāh waḥāqa bihim mmā kānūā bihi yastahziʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We had established them in a way we have not established you [people of Mecca]; We gave them hearing, sight, and hearts, yet their hearing, sight, and hearts were of no use to them, since they denied God’s revelations. They were overwhelmed by the punishment they had mocked.
verses.pickthall: And verily We had empowered them with that wherewith We have not empowered you, and had assigned them ears and eyes and hearts; but their ears and eyes and hearts availed them naught since they denied the revelations of Allah; and what they used to mock befell them.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.en: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].
verses.tr: walaqad ʾahlaknā mā ḥawlakum mmina al-qurā waṣarrafnā al-āyāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have also destroyed other communities that once flourished around you- We had given them various signs so that they might return to the right way-
verses.pickthall: And verily We have destroyed townships round about you, and displayed (for them) Our revelation, that haply they might return.

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا ءَالِهَةًۢ ۖ بَلْ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنْهُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.en: Then why did those they took besides Allāh as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed [i.e., departed] from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.
verses.tr: falawlā naṣarahumu adh-dhīna āttakhadhūā min dūni Allāh qurbānan ālihahan ۖ bal ḍallūā ʿanhum ۚ wadhālika ʾifkuhum wamā kānūā yaftarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so why did their gods not help them, those they set up as gods besides God to bring them nearer to Him? No indeed! They failed them utterly: it was all a lie of their own making.
verses.pickthall: Then why did those whom they had chosen for gods as a way of approach (unto Allah) not help them? Nay, but they did fail them utterly. And (all) that was their lie, and what they used to invent.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَآ إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنصِتُوا۟ ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِىَ وَلَّوْا۟ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur’ān. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen attentively." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.
verses.tr: wa-idh ṣarafnā ʾilayka nafaran mmina al-jinni yastamiʿūna al-qurāna falammā ḥaḍarūhu qālūā ʾanṣitūā ۖ falammā quḍāa wallawā ʾilā qawmihim mmundhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent a group of jinn to you [Prophet] to listen to the Quran. When they heard it, they said to one another, ‘Be quiet!’ Then when it was finished they turned to their community and gave them warning.
verses.pickthall: And when We inclined toward thee (Muhammad) certain of the jinn, who wished to hear the Qur'an and, when they were in its presence, said: Give ear! and, when it was finished, turned back to their people, warning.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰقَوْمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَـٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.
verses.tr: qālūā yāqawmanā ʾinnā samiʿnā kitāban ʾunzila min baʿdi mūsā muṣaddiqan llimā bayna yadayhi yahdā ʾilā al-ḥaqqi wa-ʾilā ṭarīqin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Our people, we have been listening to a Scripture that came after Moses, confirming previous scriptures, giving guidance to the truth and the straight path.
verses.pickthall: They said: O our people! Lo! we have heard a scripture which hath been revealed after Moses, confirming that which was before it, guiding unto the truth and a right road.

verses.ar: يَـٰقَوْمَنَآ أَجِيبُوا۟ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: O our people, respond to the Caller [i.e., Messenger] of Allāh and believe in him; He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
verses.tr: yāqawmanā ʾajībūā dāʿāa Allāh waminūā bihi yaghfir lakum mmin dhunūbikum wayujirkum mmin ʿadhābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Our people, respond to the one who calls you to God. Believe in Him: He will forgive you your sins and protect you from a painful torment.’
verses.pickthall: O our people! respond to Allah's summoner and believe in Him. He will forgive you some of your sins and guard you from a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِىَ ٱللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءُ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allāh will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."
verses.tr: waman llā yujib dāʿāa Allāh falaysa bimuʿjizin fā al-ʾarḍi walaysa lahu min dūnihi ʾawliyāʾu ۚ ʾūlāʾika fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who fail to respond to God’s call cannot escape God’s power anywhere on earth, nor will they have any protector against Him: such people have clearly gone far astray.
verses.pickthall: And whoso respondeth not to Allah's summoner he can nowise escape in the earth, and he hath no protecting friends instead of Him. Such are in error manifest.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْىَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yarawā ʾanna Allāh adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa walam yaʿāa bikhalqihinna biqādirin ʿalā ʾan yuḥāa al-mawtā ۚ balā ʾinnahu ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Do the disbelievers not understand that God, who created the heavens and earth and did not tire in doing so, has the power to bring the dead back to life? Yes indeed! He has power over everything.
verses.pickthall: Have they not seen that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and was not wearied by their creation, is Able to give life to the dead? Aye, He verily is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَـٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment for what you used to deny."
verses.tr: wayawma yuʿraḍu adh-dhīna kafarūā ʿalā an-nāri ʾalaysa hādhā bi-l-ḥaqqi ۖ qālūā balā warabbinā ۚ qāla fadhūqūā al-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day the disbelievers are brought before Hell [it will be said to them], ‘Is this not real?’ ‘Yes, by our Lord,’ they will reply and He will say, ‘Then taste the punishment for having denied the truth.’
verses.pickthall: And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (they will be asked): Is not this real? They will say: Yea, by our Lord. He will say: Then taste the doom for that ye disbelieved.

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعَزْمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِل لَّهُمْ ۚ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّن نَّهَارٍۭ ۚ بَلَـٰغٌ ۚ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?
verses.tr: fāṣbir kamā ṣabara ʾūlūā al-ʿazmi mina ar-rusuli walā tastaʿjil llahum ۚ kaʾannahum yawma yarawna mā yūʿadūna lam yalbathūā ʾillā sāʿahan mmin nnahārin ۚ balāghun ۚ fahal yuhlaku ʾillā al-qawmu al-fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Be steadfast [Muhammad], like those messengers of firm resolve. Do not seek to hasten the punishment for the disbelievers: on the Day they see what they had been warned about, it will seem to them that they lingered no more than a single hour of a single day [in this life]. This is a warning. Shall any be destroyed except the defiant?
verses.pickthall: Then have patience (O Muhammad) even as the stout of heart among the messengers (of old) had patience, and seek not to hasten on (the doom) for them. On the day when they see that which they are promised (it will seem to them) as though they had tarried but an hour of daylight. A clear message. Shall any be destroyed save evil-living folk?

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
verses.en: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh - He will waste their deeds.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna kafarūā waṣaddūā ʿan sabīli Allāh ʾaḍalla ʾaʿmālahum
verses.abdelhaleem: God will bring to nothing the deeds of those who disbelieve and bar others from the way of God,
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve and turn (men) from the way of Allah, He rendereth their actions vain.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَءَامَنُوا۟ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ
verses.en: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muḥammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti wamanūā bimā nuzzila ʿalā muḥammadin wahuwa al-ḥaqqu min rrabbihim ۙ kaffara ʿanhum sayyātihim wa-aṣlaḥa bi-l-hum
verses.abdelhaleem: but He will overlook the bad deeds of those who have faith, do good deeds, and believe in what has been sent down to Muhammad––the truth from their Lord––and He will put them into a good state.
verses.pickthall: And those who believe and do good works and believe in that which is revealed unto Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He riddeth them of their ill-deeds and improveth their state.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ
verses.en: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allāh present to the people their comparisons.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾanna adh-dhīna kafarūā āttabaʿūā al-bāṭila wa-anna adh-dhīna āmanūā āttabaʿūā al-ḥaqqa min rrabbihim ۚ kadhālika yaḍribu Allāh lilnnāsi ʾamthālahum
verses.abdelhaleem: This is because the disbelievers follow falsehood, while the believers follow the truth from their Lord. In this way God shows people their true type.
verses.pickthall: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood and because those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus Allah coineth their similitudes for mankind.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَضَرْبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثْخَنتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوا۟ ٱلْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّۢا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَا۟ بَعْضَكُم بِبَعْضٍ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
verses.en: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure [their] bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allāh - never will He waste their deeds.
verses.tr: fa-idhā laqītumu adh-dhīna kafarūā faḍarba ar-riqābi ḥattā ʾidhā ʾathkhantumūhum fashuddūā al-wathāqa fa-immā mannanā baʿdu wa-immā fidāʾan ḥattā taḍaʿa al-ḥarbu ʾawzārahā ۚ dhālika walaw yashāʾu Allāh lāntaṣara minhum walākin lliyabluwā baʿḍakum bibaʿḍin ۗ wa-adh-dhīna qutilūā fā sabīli Allāh falan yuḍilla ʾaʿmālahum
verses.abdelhaleem: When you meet the disbelievers in battle, strike them in the neck, and once they are defeated, bind any captives firmly––later you can release them by grace or by ransom––until the toils of war have ended. That [is the way]. God could have defeated them Himself if He had willed, but His purpose is to test some of you by means of others. He will not let the deeds of those who are killed for His cause come to nothing;
verses.pickthall: Now when ye meet in battle those who disbelieve, then it is smiting of the necks until, when ye have routed them, then making fast of bonds; and afterward either grace or ransom till the war lay down its burdens. That (is the ordinance). And if Allah willed He could have punished them (without you) but (thus it is ordained) that He may try some of you by means of others. And those who are slain in the way of Allah, He rendereth not their actions vain.

verses.ar: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ
verses.en: He will guide them and amend their condition
verses.tr: sayahdīhim wayuṣliḥu bi-l-hum
verses.abdelhaleem: He will guide them and put them into a good state;
verses.pickthall: He will guide them and improve their state,

verses.ar: وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ ٱلْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ
verses.en: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.
verses.tr: wayudkhiluhumu al-jannaha ʿarrafahā lahum
verses.abdelhaleem: He will admit them into the Garden He has already made known to them.
verses.pickthall: And bring them in unto the Garden which He hath made known to them.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَنصُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ
verses.en: O you who have believed, if you support Allāh, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾin tanṣurūā Allāh yanṣurkum wayuthabbit ʾaqdāmakum
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe! If you help God, He will help you and make you stand firm.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! If ye help Allah, He will help you and will make your foothold firm.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَتَعْسًا لَّهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
verses.en: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā fataʿsan llahum wa-aḍalla ʾaʿmālahum
verses.abdelhaleem: As for the disbelievers, how wretched will be their state! God has brought their deeds to nothing.
verses.pickthall: And those who disbelieve, perdition is for them, and He will make their actions vain.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
verses.en: That is because they disliked what Allāh revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾannahum karihūā mā ʾanzala Allāh fa-aḥbaṭa ʾaʿmālahum
verses.abdelhaleem: It is because they hate what God has sent down that He has caused their deeds to go to waste.
verses.pickthall: That is because they are averse to that which Allah hath revealed, therefor maketh He their actions fruitless.

verses.ar: ۞ أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ دَمَّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْثَـٰلُهَا
verses.en: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allāh destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾafalam yasīrūā fā al-ʾarḍi fayanẓurūā kayfa kāna ʿāqibahu adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ dammara Allāh ʿalayhim ۖ walilkāfirīna ʾamthāluhā
verses.abdelhaleem: Have they not travelled the earth and seen how those before them met their end? God destroyed them utterly: a similar fate awaits the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those who were before them? Allah wiped them out. And for the disbelievers there will be the like thereof.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَأَنَّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
verses.en: That is because Allāh is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾanna Allāh mawlā adh-dhīna āmanūā wa-anna al-kāfirīna lā mawlā lahum
verses.abdelhaleem: That is because God protects the believers while the disbelievers have no one to protect them:
verses.pickthall: That is because Allah is patron of those who believe, and because the disbelievers have no patron.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمُ وَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh yudkhilu adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru ۖ wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā yatamattaʿūna wayaʾkulūna kamā taʾkulu al-ʾanʿāmu wa-an-nāru mathwanā llahum
verses.abdelhaleem: God will admit those who believe and do good deeds to Gardens graced with flowing streams; the disbelievers may take their fill of pleasure in this world, and eat as cattle do, but the Fire will be their home.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah will cause those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; while those who disbelieve take their comfort in this life and eat even as the cattle eat, and the Fire is their habitation.

verses.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ هِىَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّن قَرْيَتِكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ
verses.en: And how many a city was stronger than your city [i.e., Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.
verses.tr: wakaʾayyin mmin qaryahin hāa ʾashaddu quwwahan mmin qaryatika at-tā ʾakhrajatka ʾahlaknāhum falā nāṣira lahum
verses.abdelhaleem: We have destroyed many a town stronger than your own [Prophet]- the town which [chose to] expel you- and they had no one to help them.
verses.pickthall: And how many a township stronger than thy township (O Muhammad) which hath cast thee out, have We destroyed, and they had no helper!

verses.ar: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم
verses.en: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?
verses.tr: ʾafaman kāna ʿalā bayyinahin mmin rrabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sūʾu ʿamalihi wāttabaʿūā ʾahwāʾahum
verses.abdelhaleem: Can those who follow clear proof from their Lord be compared to those whose foul deeds are made to seem alluring to them, those who follow their own desires?
verses.pickthall: Is he who relieth on a clear proof from his Lord like those for whom the evil that they do is beautified while they follow their own lusts?

verses.ar: مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ فِيهَآ أَنْهَـٰرٌ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍ وَأَنْهَـٰرٌ مِّن لَّبَنٍ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُۥ وَأَنْهَـٰرٌ مِّنْ خَمْرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ وَأَنْهَـٰرٌ مِّنْ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّى ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَـٰلِدٌ فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُوا۟ مَآءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَآءَهُمْ
verses.en: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord... [Are its inhabitants] like those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?
verses.tr: mmathalu al-jannahi at-tā wuʿida al-muttaqūna ۖ fīhā ʾanhārun mmin mmāʾin ghayri āsinin wa-anhārun mmin llabanin llam yataghayyar ṭaʿmuhu wa-anhārun mmin khamrin lladhahin llilshāribīna wa-anhārun mmin ʿasalin mmuṣaffanā ۖ walahum fīhā min kulli ath-thamarāti wamaghfirahun mmin rrabbihim ۖ kaman huwa khālidun fā an-nāri wasuqūā māʾan ḥamīman faqaṭṭaʿa ʾamʿāʾahum
verses.abdelhaleem: Here is a picture of the Garden promised to the pious: rivers of water forever pure, rivers of milk forever fresh, rivers of wine, a delight for those who drink, rivers of honey clarified and pure, [all] flow in it; there they will find fruit of every kind; and they will find forgiveness from their Lord. How can this be compared to the fate of those stuck in the Fire, given boiling water to drink that tears their bowels?
verses.pickthall: A similitude of the Garden which those who keep their duty (to Allah) are promised: Therein are rivers of water unpolluted, and rivers of milk whereof the flavour changeth not, and rivers of wine delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of clear-run honey; therein for them is every kind of fruit, with pardon from their Lord. (Are those who enjoy all this) like those who are immortal in the Fire and are given boiling water to drink so that it teareth their bowels?

verses.ar: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُوا۟ مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ
verses.en: And among them, [O Muḥammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allāh has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.
verses.tr: waminhum mman yastamiʿu ʾilayka ḥattā ʾidhā kharajūā min ʿindika qālūā lilladhīna ʾūtūā al-ʿilma mādhā qāla ānifan ۚ ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna ṭabaʿa Allāh ʿalā qulūbihim wāttabaʿūā ʾahwāʾahum
verses.abdelhaleem: Some of these people listen to you [Prophet], but, once they leave your presence, they sneer at those who have been given knowledge, saying, ‘What was that he just said?’ These are the ones whose hearts God has sealed, those who follow their own desires.
verses.pickthall: Among them are some who give ear unto thee (Muhammad) till, when they go forth from thy presence they say unto those who have been given knowledge: What was that he said just now? Those are they whose hearts Allah hath sealed, and they follow their own lusts.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَءَاتَىٰهُمْ تَقْوَىٰهُمْ
verses.en: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āhtadawā zādahum hudanā watāhum taqwāhum
verses.abdelhaleem: God has increased the guidance of those who follow the right path, and given them their awareness [of Him].
verses.pickthall: While as for those who walk aright, He addeth to their guidance, and giveth them their protection (against evil).

verses.ar: فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا ۚ فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمْ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَىٰهُمْ
verses.en: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then how [i.e., what good] to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?
verses.tr: fahal yanẓurūna ʾillā as-sāʿaha ʾan taʾtiyahum baghtahan ۖ faqad jāʾa ʾashrāṭuhā ۚ fa-annā lahum ʾidhā jāʾathum dhikrāhum
verses.abdelhaleem: What are the disbelievers waiting for, other than the Hour which will come upon them unawares? Its signs are already here, but once the Hour has actually arrived, what use will it be then to take heed?
verses.pickthall: Await they aught save the Hour, that it should come upon them unawares? And the beginnings thereof have already come. But how, when it hath come upon them, can they take their warning?

verses.ar: فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَىٰكُمْ
verses.en: So know, [O Muḥammad], that there is no deity except Allāh and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allāh knows of your movement and your resting place.
verses.tr: fāʿlam ʾannahu lā ʾilāha ʾillā Allāh wāstaghfir lidhanbika walilmuʾminīna wa-l-muʾmināti ۗ wallāh yaʿlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwākum
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet], bear in mind that there is no god but God, and ask forgiveness for your sins and for the sins of believing men and women. God knows whenever any of you move, and whenever any of you stay still.
verses.pickthall: So know (O Muhammad) that there is no Allah save Allah, and ask forgiveness for thy sin and for believing men and believing women. Allah knoweth (both) your place of turmoil and your place of rest.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌ ۖ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُّحْكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلْقِتَالُ ۙ رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ ٱلْمَغْشِىِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۖ فَأَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
verses.en: Those who believe say, "Why has a sūrah not been sent down?" But when a precise sūrah is revealed and battle is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]
verses.tr: wayaqūlu adh-dhīna āmanūā lawlā nuzzilat sūrahun ۖ fa-idhā ʾunzilat sūrahun mmuḥkamahun wadhukira fīhā al-qitālu ۙ raʾayta adh-dhīna fā qulūbihim mmaraḍun yanẓurūna ʾilayka naẓara al-maghshāi ʿalayhi mina al-mawti ۖ fa-awlā lahum
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who believe ask why no sura [about fighting] has been sent down. Yet when a decisive sura [that mentions fighting] is sent down, you can see the sick at heart looking at you [Prophet] and visibly fainting at the prospect of death- better for them
verses.pickthall: And those who believe say: If only a surah were revealed! But when a decisive surah is revealed and war is mentioned therein, thou seest those in whose hearts is a disease looking at thee with the look of men fainting unto death. Therefor woe unto them!

verses.ar: طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ ۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ ٱلْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ
verses.en: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allāh, it would have been better for them.
verses.tr: ṭāʿahun waqawlun mmaʿrūfun ۚ fa-idhā ʿazama al-ʾamru falaw ṣadaqūā Allāh lakāna khayran llahum
verses.abdelhaleem: would be obedience and fitting words; it would also be better for them to be true to God when the decision to fight has been made.
verses.pickthall: Obedience and a civil word. Then, when the matter is determined, if they are loyal to Allah it will be well for them.

verses.ar: فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَن تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓا۟ أَرْحَامَكُمْ
verses.en: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?
verses.tr: fahal ʿasaytum ʾin tawallaytum ʾan tufsidūā fā al-ʾarḍi watuqaṭṭiʿūā ʾarḥāmakum
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘If you turn away now, could it be that you will go on to spread corruption all over the land and break your ties of kinship?’
verses.pickthall: Would ye then, if ye were given the command, work corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship?

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَىٰٓ أَبْصَـٰرَهُمْ
verses.en: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allāh has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna laʿanahumu Allāh fa-aṣammahum wa-aʿmā ʾabṣārahum
verses.abdelhaleem: These are the ones God has rejected, making their ears deaf and their eyes blind.
verses.pickthall: Such are they whom Allah curseth so that He deafeneth them and maketh blind their eyes.

verses.ar: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَآ
verses.en: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?
verses.tr: ʾafalā yatadabbarūna al-qurāna ʾam ʿalā qulūbin ʾaqfāluhā
verses.abdelhaleem: Will they not contemplate the Quran? Do they have locks on their hearts?
verses.pickthall: Will they then not meditate on the Qur'an, or are there locks on the hearts?

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَـٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَى ۙ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
verses.en: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna ārtaddūā ʿalā ʾadbārihim mmin baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu al-hudā ۙ ash-shayṭānu sawwala lahum wa-amlā lahum
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who turn on their heels after being shown guidance are duped and tempted by Satan;
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who turn back after the guidance hath been manifested unto them, Satan hath seduced them, and He giveth them the rein.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوا۟ مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِى بَعْضِ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ
verses.en: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allāh sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allāh knows what they conceal.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾannahum qālūā lilladhīna karihūā mā nazzala Allāh sanuṭīʿukum fā baʿḍi al-ʾamri ۖ wallāh yaʿlamu ʾisrārahum
verses.abdelhaleem: they say to those who hate what God has sent down, ‘We will obey you in some matters’––God knows their secret schemes.
verses.pickthall: That is because they say unto those who hate what Allah hath revealed: We will obey you in some matters; and Allah knoweth their secret talk.

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ
verses.en: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?
verses.tr: fakayfa ʾidhā tawaffathumu al-malāʾikahu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahum
verses.abdelhaleem: How will they feel when the angels take them in death and beat their faces and their backs
verses.pickthall: Then how (will it be with them) when the angels gather them, smiting their faces and their backs!

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَآ أَسْخَطَ ٱللَّهَ وَكَرِهُوا۟ رِضْوَٰنَهُۥ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
verses.en: That is because they followed what angered Allāh and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾannahumu āttabaʿūā mā ʾaskhaṭa Allāh wakarihūā riḍwānahu fa-aḥbaṭa ʾaʿmālahum
verses.abdelhaleem: because they practised things that incurred God’s wrath, and disdained to please Him? He makes their deeds go to waste.
verses.pickthall: That will be because they followed that which angereth Allah, and hated that which pleaseth Him. Therefor He hath made their actions vain.

verses.ar: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخْرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضْغَـٰنَهُمْ
verses.en: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allāh would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?
verses.tr: ʾam ḥasiba adh-dhīna fā qulūbihim mmaraḍun ʾan llan yukhrija Allāh ʾaḍghānahum
verses.abdelhaleem: Do the corrupt at heart assume that God will not expose their malice?
verses.pickthall: Or do those in whose hearts is a disease deem that Allah will not bring to light their (secret) hates?

verses.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَأَرَيْنَـٰكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُم بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ ۚ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِى لَحْنِ ٱلْقَوْلِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ
verses.en: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allāh knows your deeds.
verses.tr: walaw nashāʾu laʾaraynākahum falaʿaraftahum bisīmāhum ۚ walataʿrifannahum fā laḥni al-qawli ۚ wallāh yaʿlamu ʾaʿmālakum
verses.abdelhaleem: We could even point them out to you [Prophet] if We wished, and then you could identify them by their marks, but you will know them anyway by the tone of their speech. God knows everything you [people] do.
verses.pickthall: And if We would, We could show them unto thee (Muhammad) so that thou shouldst know them surely by their marks. And thou shalt know them by the burden of their talk. And Allah knoweth your deeds.

verses.ar: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ ٱلْمُجَـٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا۟ أَخْبَارَكُمْ
verses.en: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allāh] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.
verses.tr: walanabluwannakum ḥattā naʿlama al-mujāhidīna minkum wa-aṣ-ṣābirīna wanabluwā ʾakhbārakum
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall test you to see which of you strive your hardest and are steadfast; We shall test the sincerity of your assertions.
verses.pickthall: And verily We shall try you till We know those of you who strive hard (for the cause of Allah) and the steadfast, and till We test your record.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَشَآقُّوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًٔا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
verses.en: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allāh at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā waṣaddūā ʿan sabīli Allāh washāqqūā ar-rasūla min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu al-hudā lan yaḍurrūā Allāh shayā wasayuḥbiṭu ʾaʿmālahum
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who disbelieve, bar others from God’s path, and oppose the Messenger when they have been shown guidance, do not harm God in any way. He will make their deeds go to waste-
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve and turn from the way of Allah and oppose the messenger after the guidance hath been manifested unto them, they hurt Allah not a jot, and He will make their actions fruitless.

verses.ar: ۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوٓا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ
verses.en: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.
verses.tr: ۞ yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾaṭīʿūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūā ar-rasūla walā tubṭilūā ʾaʿmālakum
verses.abdelhaleem: believers, obey God and the Messenger: do not let your deeds go to waste-
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Obey Allah and obey the messenger, and render not your actions vain.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ
verses.en: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allāh forgive them.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā waṣaddūā ʿan sabīli Allāh thumma mātūā wahum kuffārun falan yaghfira Allāh lahum
verses.abdelhaleem: God will not forgive those who disbelieve, bar others from God’s path, and die as disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve and turn from the way of Allah and then die disbelievers, Allah surely will not pardon them.

verses.ar: فَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَتَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّلْمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ
verses.en: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allāh is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.
verses.tr: falā tahinūā watadʿūā ʾilā as-salmi wa-antumu al-ʾaʿlawna wallāh maʿakum walan yatirakum ʾaʿmālakum
verses.abdelhaleem: So [believers] do not lose heart and cry out for peace. It is you who have the upper hand: God is with you. He will not begrudge you the reward for your [good] deeds:
verses.pickthall: So do not falter and cry out for peace when ye (will be) the uppermost, and Allah is with you, and He will not grudge (the reward of) your actions.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ ۚ وَإِن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمْ أُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْـَٔلْكُمْ أَمْوَٰلَكُمْ
verses.en: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allāh, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā laʿibun walahwun ۚ wa-in tuʾminūā watattaqūā yuʾtikum ʾujūrakum walā yaslkum ʾamwālakum
verses.abdelhaleem: the life of this world is only a game, a pastime, but if you believe and are mindful of God, He will recompense you. He does not ask you to give up [all] your posses-sions-
verses.pickthall: The life of the world is but a sport and a pastime. And if ye believe and ward off (evil). He will give you your wages, and will not ask of you your wordly wealth.

verses.ar: إِن يَسْـَٔلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوا۟ وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَـٰنَكُمْ
verses.en: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your hatred [i.e., unwillingness].
verses.tr: ʾin yaslkumūhā fayuḥfikum tabkhalūā wayukhrij ʾaḍghānakum
verses.abdelhaleem: you would be grudging if He were to ask you and press you for them, and He would bring your ill-will to light-
verses.pickthall: If He should ask it of you and importune you, ye would hoard it, and He would bring to light your (secret) hates.

verses.ar: هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبْخَلُ ۖ وَمَن يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْغَنِىُّ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ ۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓا۟ أَمْثَـٰلَكُم
verses.en: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allāh - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allāh is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away [i.e., refuse], He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.
verses.tr: hāʾantum hāʾulāʾi tudʿawna litunfiqūā fā sabīli Allāh faminkum mman yabkhalu ۖ waman yabkhal fa-innamā yabkhalu ʿan nnafsihi ۚ wallāh al-ghanāu wa-antumu al-fuqarāʾu ۚ wa-in tatawallawā yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma lā yakūnūā ʾamthālakum
verses.abdelhaleem: though now you are called upon to give [a little] for the sake of God, some of you are grudging. Whoever is grudging is so only towards himself: God is the source of wealth and you are the needy ones. He will substitute other people for you if you turn away, and they will not be like you.
verses.pickthall: Lo! ye are those who are called to spend in the way of Allah, yet among you there are some who hoard. And as for him who hoardeth, he hoardeth only from his soul. And Allah is the Rich, and ye are the poor. And if ye turn away He will exchange you for some other folk, and they will not be the likes of you.

verses.ar: إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا
verses.en: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest
verses.tr: ʾinnā fataḥnā laka fatḥan mmubīnan
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly We have opened up a path to clear triumph for you [Prophet],
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have given thee (O Muhammad) a signal victory,

verses.ar: لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
verses.en: That Allāh may forgive for you what preceded of your sin [i.e., errors] and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path
verses.tr: lliyaghfira laka Allāh mā taqaddama min dhanbika wamā taʾakhara wayutimma niʿmatahu ʿalayka wayahdiyaka ṣirāṭan mmustaqīman
verses.abdelhaleem: so that God may forgive you your past and future sins, complete His grace upon you, guide you to a straight path,
verses.pickthall: That Allah may forgive thee of thy sin that which is past and that which is to come, and may perfect His favour unto thee, and may guide thee on a right path,

verses.ar: وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
verses.en: And [that] Allāh may aid you with a mighty victory.
verses.tr: wayanṣuraka Allāh naṣran ʿazīzan
verses.abdelhaleem: and help you mightily.
verses.pickthall: And that Allah may help thee with strong help -

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا مَّعَ إِيمَـٰنِهِمْ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.en: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā ʾanzala as-sakīnaha fā qulūbi al-muʾminīna liyazdādūā ʾīmānan mmaʿa ʾīmānihim ۗ wa-lillāh junūdu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ wakāna Allāh ʿalīman ḥakīman
verses.abdelhaleem: It was He who made His tranquillity descend into the hearts of the believers, to add faith to their faith––the forces of the heavens and earth belong to God; He is all knowing and all wise––
verses.pickthall: He it is Who sent down peace of reassurance into the hearts of the believers that they might add faith unto their faith. Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Knower, Wise -

verses.ar: لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
verses.en: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allāh, a great attainment
verses.tr: lliyudkhila al-muʾminīna wa-l-muʾmināti jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā wayukaffira ʿanhum sayyātihim ۚ wakāna dhālika ʿinda Allāh fawzan ʿaẓīman
verses.abdelhaleem: so as to admit believing men and women into Gardens graced with flowing streams, there to remain, absolving their bad deeds––a great triumph in God’s eyes––
verses.pickthall: That He may bring the believing men and the believing women into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide, and may remit from them their evil deeds - That, in the sight of Allah, is the supreme triumph -

verses.ar: وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۖ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًا
verses.en: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allāh an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allāh has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.
verses.tr: wayuʿadhiba al-munāfiqīna wa-l-munāfiqāti wa-l-mushrikīna wa-l-mushrikāti aẓ-ẓānnīna billāh ẓanna as-sawʾi ۚ ʿalayhim dāʾirahu as-sawʾi ۖ waghaḍiba Allāh ʿalayhim walaʿanahum wa-aʿadda lahum jahannama ۖ wasāʾat maṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: and to torment the hypocritical and idolatrous men and women who harbour evil thoughts about God––it is they who will be encircled by evil!––who carry the burden of God’s anger, whom God has rejected and for whom He has prepared Hell, an evil destination!
verses.pickthall: And may punish the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women, and the idolatrous men and the idolatrous women, who think an evil thought concerning Allah. For them is the evil turn of fortune, and Allah is wroth against them and hath cursed them, and hath made ready for them hell, a hapless journey's end.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
verses.en: And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh junūdu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ wakāna Allāh ʿazīzan ḥakīman
verses.abdelhaleem: The forces of heaven and earth belong to God; He is almighty and all wise.
verses.pickthall: Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ شَـٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾarsalnāka shāhidan wamubashiran wanadhīran
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent you [Prophet] to bring good news and to give warning,
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have sent thee (O Muhammad) as a witness and a bearer of good tidings and a warner,

verses.ar: لِّتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.en: That you [people] may believe in Allāh and His Messenger and honor him and respect him [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and exalt Him [i.e., Allāh] morning and afternoon.
verses.tr: llituʾminūā billāh warasūlihi watuʿazzirūhu watuwaqqirūhu watusabbiḥūhu bukrahan wa-aṣīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: so that you[people] may believe in God and His Messenger, support Him, honour Him, and praise Him morning and evening.
verses.pickthall: That ye (mankind) may believe in Allah and His messenger, and may honour Him, and may revere Him, and may glorify Him at early dawn and at the close of day.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَـٰهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
verses.en: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allāh. The hand of Allāh is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allāh - He will give him a great reward.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yubāyiʿūnaka ʾinnamā yubāyiʿūna Allāh yadu Allāh fawqa ʾaydīhim ۚ faman nnakatha fa-innamā yankuthu ʿalā nafsihi ۖ waman ʾawfā bimā ʿāhada ʿalayhu Allāh fasayuʾtīhi ʾajran ʿaẓīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who pledge loyalty to you [Prophet] are actually pledging loyalty to God Himself- God’s hand is placed on theirs––and anyone who breaks his pledge does so to his own detriment: God will give a great reward to the one who fulfils his pledge to Him.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who swear allegiance unto thee (Muhammad), swear allegiance only unto Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whosoever breaketh his oath, breaketh it only to his soul's hurt; while whosoever keepeth his covenant with Allah, on him will He bestow immense reward.

verses.ar: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَآ أَمْوَٰلُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًۢا ۚ بَلْ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۢا
verses.en: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allāh at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allāh, of what you do, Aware.
verses.tr: sayaqūlu laka al-mukhallafūna mina al-ʾaʿrābi shaghalatnā ʾamwālunā wa-ahlūnā fāstaghfir lanā ۚ yaqūlūna bi-ʾalsinatihim mmā laysa fā qulūbihim ۚ qul faman yamliku lakum mmina Allāh shayā ʾin ʾarāda bikum ḍarran ʾaw ʾarāda bikum nafʿanā ۚ bal kāna Allāh bimā taʿmalūna khabīranā
verses.abdelhaleem: The desert Arabs who stayed behind will say to you, ‘We were busy with our property and our families: ask forgiveness for us,’ but they say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, ‘Whether it is God’s will to do you harm or good, who can intervene for you?’ No! God is fully aware of everything you [people] do.
verses.pickthall: Those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind will tell thee: Our possessions and our households occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us! They speak with their tongues that which is not in their hearts. Say: Who can avail you aught against Allah, if He intend you hurt or intend you profit? Nay, but Allah is ever Aware of what ye do.

verses.ar: بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا
verses.en: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined."
verses.tr: bal ẓanantum ʾan llan yanqaliba ar-rasūlu wa-l-muʾminūna ʾilā ʾahlīhim ʾabadan wazuyyina dhālika fā qulūbikum waẓanantum ẓanna as-sawʾi wakuntum qawmanā būran
verses.abdelhaleem: No! You thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families and this thought warmed your hearts. Your thoughts are evil, for you are corrupt people:
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye deemed that the messenger and the believers would never return to their own folk, and that was made fairseeming in your hearts, and ye did think an evil thought, and ye were worthless folk.

verses.ar: وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ فَإِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرًا
verses.en: And whoever has not believed in Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.
verses.tr: waman llam yuʾmin billāh warasūlihi fa-innā ʾaʿtadnā lilkāfirīna saʿīran
verses.abdelhaleem: We have prepared a blazing Fire for those who do not believe in God and His Messenger.
verses.pickthall: And so for him who believeth not in Allah and His messenger - Lo! We have prepared a flame for disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.en: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: wa-lillāh mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ yaghfiru liman yashāʾu wayuʿadhibu man yashāʾu ۚ wakāna Allāh ghafūran rraḥīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Control of the heavens and earth belongs to God and He forgives whoever He will and punishes whoever He will: God is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: And Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He forgiveth whom He will, and punisheth whom He will. And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: سَيَقُولُ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ ۖ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُوا۟ كَلَـٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: Those who remained behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allāh. Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allāh say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.
verses.tr: sayaqūlu al-mukhallafūna ʾidhā ānṭalaqtum ʾilā maghānima litaʾkhudhūhā dharūnā nattabiʿkum ۖ yurīdūna ʾan yubaddilūā kalāma Allāh ۚ qul llan tattabiʿūnā kadhālikum qāla Allāh min qablu ۖ fasayaqūlūna bal taḥsudūnanā ۚ bal kānūā lā yafqahūna ʾillā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: When you [believers] set off for somewhere that promises war gains, those who [previously] stayed behind will say, ‘Let us come with you.’ They want to change God’s words, but tell them [Prophet], ‘You may not come with us: God has said this before.’ They will reply, ‘You begrudge us out of jealousy.’ How little they understand!
verses.pickthall: Those who were left behind will say, when ye set forth to capture booty: Let us go with you. They fain would change the verdict of Allah. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye shall not go with us. Thus hath Allah said beforehand. Then they will say: Ye are envious of us. Nay, but they understand not, save a little.

verses.ar: قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَـٰتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ ۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا ۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.en: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allāh will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."
verses.tr: qul llilmukhallafīna mina al-ʾaʿrābi satudʿawna ʾilā qawmin ʾūlā baʾsin shadīdin tuqātilūnahum ʾaw yuslimūna ۖ fa-in tuṭīʿūā yuʾtikumu Allāh ʾajran ḥasanan ۖ wa-in tatawallawā kamā tawallaytum mmin qablu yuʿadhibkum ʿadhāban ʾalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: Tell the desert Arabs who stayed behind, ‘You will be called to face a people of great might in war and to fight them, unless they surrender: if you obey, God will reward you well, but if you turn away, as you have done before, He will punish you heavily-
verses.pickthall: Say unto those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind: Ye will be called against a folk of mighty prowess, to fight them until they surrender; and if ye obey, Allah will give you a fair reward; but if ye turn away as ye did turn away before, He will punish you with a painful doom.

verses.ar: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.en: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.
verses.tr: llaysa ʿalā al-ʾaʿmā ḥarajun walā ʿalā al-ʾaʿraji ḥarajun walā ʿalā al-marīḍi ḥarajun ۗ waman yuṭiʿi Allāh warasūlahu yudkhilhu jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru ۖ waman yatawalla yuʿadhibhu ʿadhāban ʾalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: the blind, the lame, and the sick will not be blamed.’ God will admit anyone who obeys Him and His Messenger to Gardens graced with flowing streams; He will painfully punish anyone who turns away.
verses.pickthall: There is no blame for the blind, nor is there blame for the lame, nor is there blame for the sick (that they go not forth to war). And whoso obeyeth Allah and His messenger, He will make him enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; and whoso turneth back, him will He punish with a painful doom.

verses.ar: ۞ لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَـٰبَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا
verses.en: Certainly was Allāh pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest
verses.tr: ۞ llaqad raḍāa Allāh ʿani al-muʾminīna ʾidh yubāyiʿūnaka taḥta ash-shajarahi faʿalima mā fā qulūbihim fa-anzala as-sakīnaha ʿalayhim wa-athābahum fatḥan qarīban
verses.abdelhaleem: God was pleased with the believers when they swore allegiance to you [Prophet] under the tree: He knew what was in their hearts and so He sent tranquillity down to them and rewarded them with a speedy triumph
verses.pickthall: Allah was well pleased with the believers when they swore allegiance unto thee beneath the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, and He sent down peace of reassurance on them, and hath rewarded them with a near victory;

verses.ar: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
verses.en: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.tr: wamaghānima kathīrahan yaʾkhudhūnahā ۗ wakāna Allāh ʿazīzan ḥakīman
verses.abdelhaleem: and with many future gains. God is mighty and wise.
verses.pickthall: And much booty that they will capture. Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.

verses.ar: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَـٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِىَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
verses.en: Allāh has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.
verses.tr: waʿadakumu Allāh maghānima kathīrahan taʾkhudhūnahā faʿajjala lakum hādhihi wakaffa ʾaydāa an-nāsi ʿankum walitakūna āyahan llilmuʾminīna wayahdiyakum ṣirāṭan mmustaqīman
verses.abdelhaleem: He has promised you [people] many future gains: He has hastened this gain for you. He has held back the hands of hostile people from you as a sign for the faithful and He will guide you to a straight path.
verses.pickthall: Allah promiseth you much booty that ye will capture, and hath given you this in advance, and hath withheld men's hands from you, that it may be a token for the believers, and that He may guide you on a right path.

verses.ar: وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرًا
verses.en: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allāh has already encompassed. And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.
verses.tr: wa-ukhrā lam taqdirūā ʿalayhā qad ʾaḥāṭa Allāh bihā ۚ wakāna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīran
verses.abdelhaleem: There are many other gains [to come], over which you have no power. God has full control over them: God has power over all things.
verses.pickthall: And other (gain), which ye have not been able to achieve, Allah will compass it, Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ قَـٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوَلَّوُا۟ ٱلْأَدْبَـٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
verses.en: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.
verses.tr: walaw qātalakumu adh-dhīna kafarūā lawallawā al-ʾadbāra thumma lā yajidūna waliyyan walā naṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: If the disbelievers had fought against you, they would have taken flight and found no one to protect or support them:
verses.pickthall: And if those who disbelieve join battle with you they will take to flight, and afterward they will find no protecting friend nor helper.

verses.ar: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.en: [This is] the established way of Allāh which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allāh any change.
verses.tr: sunnaha Allāh at-tā qad khalat min qablu ۖ walan tajida lisunnahi Allāh tabdīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: such was God’s practice in the past and you will find no change in God’s practices.
verses.pickthall: It is the law of Allah which hath taken course aforetime. Thou wilt not find for the law of Allah aught of power to change.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
verses.en: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.
verses.tr: wahuwa adh-dhā kaffa ʾaydiyahum ʿankum wa-aydiyakum ʿanhum bibaṭni makkaha min baʿdi ʾan ʾaẓfarakum ʿalayhim ۚ wakāna Allāh bimā taʿmalūna baṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: In the valley of Mecca it was He who held their hands back from you and your hands back from them after He gave you the advantage over them––God sees all that you do.
verses.pickthall: And He it is Who hath withheld men's hands from you, and hath withheld your hands from them, in the valley of Mecca, after He had made you victors over them. Allah is Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌ مُّؤْمِنَـٰتٌ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.en: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample [i.e., kill] them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allāh might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment
