verses.tr: humu adh-dhīna kafarūā waṣaddūkum ʿani al-masjidi al-ḥarāmi wa-l-hadāa maʿkūfan ʾan yablugha maḥillahu ۚ walawlā rijālun mmuʾminūna wanisāʾun mmuʾminātun llam taʿlamūhum ʾan taṭawhum fatuṣībakum mminhum mmaʿarrahun bighayri ʿilmin ۖ lliyudkhila Allāh fā raḥmatihi man yashāʾu ۚ law tazayyalūā laʿadhabnā adh-dhīna kafarūā minhum ʿadhāban ʾalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: They were the ones who disbelieved, who barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and who prevented the offering from reaching its place of sacrifice. If there had not been among them, unknown to you, believing men and women whom you would have trampled underfoot, inadvertently incurring guilt on their account- God brings whoever He will into His mercy- if the [believers] had been clearly separated, We would have inflicted a painful punishment on the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: These it was who disbelieved and debarred you from the Inviolable Place of Worship, and debarred the offering from reaching its goal. And if it had not been for believing men and believing women, whom ye know not - lest ye should tread them under foot and thus incur guilt for them unknowingly; that Allah might bring into His mercy whom He will - If (the believers and the disbelievers) had been clearly separated We verily had punished those of them who disbelieved with painful punishment.

verses.ar: إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا
verses.en: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allāh sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.
verses.tr: ʾidh jaʿala adh-dhīna kafarūā fā qulūbihimu al-ḥamiyyaha ḥamiyyaha al-jāhiliyyahi fa-anzala Allāh sakīnatahu ʿalā rasūlihi waʿalā al-muʾminīna wa-ʾalzamahum kalimaha at-taqwā wakānūā ʾaḥaqqa bihā wa-ahlahā ۚ wakāna Allāh bikulli shāʾin ʿalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: While the disbelievers had fury in their hearts- the fury of ignorance- God sent His tranquillity down on to His Messenger and the believers and made binding on them [their] promise to obey God, for that was more appropriate and fitting for them. God has full knowledge of all things.
verses.pickthall: When those who disbelieve had set up in their hearts zealotry, the zealotry of the Age of Ignorance, then Allah sent down His peace of reassurance upon His messenger and upon the believers and imposed on them the word of self-restraint, for they were worthy of it and meet for it. And Allah is Aware of all things.

verses.ar: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا
verses.en: Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the vision [i.e., dream] in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, if Allāh wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].
verses.tr: llaqad ṣadaqa Allāh rasūlahu ar-ruʾyā bi-l-ḥaqqi ۖ latadkhulunna al-masjida al-ḥarāma ʾin shāʾa Allāh āminīna muḥalliqīna ruʾūsakum wamuqaṣṣirīna lā takhāfūna ۖ faʿalima mā lam taʿlamūā fajaʿala min dūni dhālika fatḥan qarīban
verses.abdelhaleem: God has truly fulfilled His Messenger’s vision: ‘God willing, you will most certainly enter the Sacred Mosque in safety, shavenheaded or with cropped hair, without fear!’- God knew what you did not- and He has granted you a speedy triumph.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath fulfilled the vision for His messenger in very truth. Ye shall indeed enter the Inviolable Place of Worship, if Allah will, secure, (having your hair) shaven and cut, not fearing. But He knoweth that which ye know not, and hath given you a near victory beforehand.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًا
verses.en: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allāh as Witness.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā ʾarsala rasūlahu bi-l-hudā wadīni al-ḥaqqi liyuẓhirahu ʿalā ad-dīni kullihi ۚ wakafā billāh shahīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: It was He who sent His Messenger, with guidance and the religion of Truth, for him to show that it is above all [false] religion. God suffices as a witness:
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may cause it to prevail over all religion. And Allah sufficeth as a Witness.

verses.ar: مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا
verses.en: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] pleasure. Their sign is in their faces from the effect of prostration [i.e., prayer]. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that He [i.e., Allāh] may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allāh has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
verses.tr: mmuḥammadun rrasūlu Allāh ۚ wa-adh-dhīna maʿahu ʾashiddāʾu ʿalā al-kuffāri ruḥamāʾu baynahum ۖ tarāhum rukkaʿan sujjadan yabtaghūna faḍlan mmina Allāh wariḍwānan ۖ sīmāhum fā wujūhihim mmin ʾathari as-sujūdi ۚ dhālika mathaluhum fā at-tawrāhi ۚ wamathaluhum fā al-ʾinjīli kazarʿin ʾakhraja shaṭhu fāzarahu fāstaghlaẓa fāstawā ʿalā sūqihi yuʿjibu az-zurrāʿa liyaghīẓa bihimu al-kuffāra ۗ waʿada Allāh adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti minhum mmaghfirahan wa-ajran ʿaẓīmanā
verses.abdelhaleem: Muhammad is the Messenger of God. Those who follow him are harsh towards the disbelievers and compassionate towards each other. You see them kneeling and prostrating, seeking God’s bounty and His good pleasure: on their faces they bear the marks of their prostrations. This is how they are pictured in the Torah and the Gospel: like a seed that puts forth its shoot, becomes strong, grows thick, and rises on its stem to the delight of its sowers. So God infuriates the disbelievers through them; God promises forgiveness and a great reward to those who believe and do righteous deeds.
verses.pickthall: Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. And those with him are hard against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves. Thou (O Muhammad) seest them bowing and falling prostrate (in worship), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) acceptance. The mark of them is on their foreheads from the traces of prostration. Such is their likeness in the Torah and their likeness in the Gospel - like as sown corn that sendeth forth its shoot and strengtheneth it and riseth firm upon its stalk, delighting the sowers - that He may enrage the disbelievers with (the sight of) them. Allah hath promised, unto such of them as believe and do good works, forgiveness and immense reward.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allāh and His Messenger but fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā tuqaddimūā bayna yadāi Allāh warasūlihi ۖ wāttaqūā Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh samīʿun ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, do not push yourselves forward in the presence of God and His Messenger––be mindful of God: He hears and knows all––
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Be not forward in the presence of Allah and His messenger, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā tarfaʿūā ʾaṣwātakum fawqa ṣawti an-nabāi walā tajharūā lahu bi-l-qawli kajahri baʿḍikum libaʿḍin ʾan taḥbaṭa ʾaʿmālukum wa-antum lā tashʿurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: believers, do not raise your voices above the Prophet’s, do not raise your voice when speaking to him as you do to one another, or your [good] deeds may be cancelled out without you knowing.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Lift not up your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout when speaking to him as ye shout one to another, lest your works be rendered vain while ye perceive not.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allāh - they are the ones whose hearts Allāh has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yaghuḍḍūna ʾaṣwātahum ʿinda rasūli Allāh ʾūlāʾika adh-dhīna āmtaḥana Allāh qulūbahum lilttaqwā ۚ lahum mmaghfirahun wa-ajrun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is those who lower their voices in the presence of God’s Messenger whose hearts God has proved to be aware––they will have forgiveness, and a great reward––
verses.pickthall: Lo! they who subdue their voices in the presence of the messenger of Allah, those are they whose hearts Allah hath proven unto righteousness. Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muḥammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yunādūnaka min warāʾi al-ḥujurāti ʾaktharuhum lā yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but most of those who shout to you [Prophet] from outside your private rooms lack understanding.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who call thee from behind the private apartments, most of them have no sense.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: walaw ʾannahum ṣabarūā ḥattā takhruja ʾilayhim lakāna khayran llahum ۚ wallāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It would have been better for them if they had waited patiently for you to come out to them but God is all forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: And if they had had patience till thou camest forth unto them, it had been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَـٰلَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَـٰدِمِينَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾin jāʾakum fāsiqun binabaʾin fatabayyanūā ʾan tuṣībūā qawmanā bijahālahin fatuṣbiḥūā ʿalā mā faʿaltum nādimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, if a troublemaker brings you news, check it first, in case you wrong others unwittingly and later regret what you have done,
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did.

verses.ar: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
verses.en: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allāh. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allāh has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.
verses.tr: wāʿlamūā ʾanna fīkum rasūla Allāh ۚ law yuṭīʿukum fā kathīrin mmina al-ʾamri laʿanittum walākinna Allāh ḥabbaba ʾilaykumu al-ʾīmāna wazayyanahu fā qulūbikum wakarraha ʾilaykumu al-kufra wa-l-fusūqa wa-l-ʿiṣyāna ۚ ʾūlāʾika humu ar-rāshidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and be aware that it is God’s Messenger who is among you: in many matters you would certainly suffer if he were to follow your wishes. God has endeared faith to you and made it beautiful to your hearts; He has made disbelief, mischief, and disobedience hateful to you. It is people like this who are rightly guided
verses.pickthall: And know that the messenger of Allah is among you. If he were to obey you in much of the government, ye would surely be in trouble; but Allah hath endeared the faith to you and hath beautified it in your hearts, and hath made disbelief and lewdness and rebellion hateful unto you. Such are they who are the rightly guided.

verses.ar: فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: [It is] as bounty from Allāh and favor. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: faḍlan mmina Allāh waniʿmahan ۚ wallāh ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: through God’s favour and blessing: God is all knowing and all wise.
verses.pickthall: (It is) a bounty and a grace from Allah; and Allah is Knower, Wise.

verses.ar: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَـٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
verses.en: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allāh. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.
verses.tr: wa-in ṭāʾifatāni mina al-muʾminīna āqtatalūā fa-aṣliḥūā baynahumā ۖ fa-in baghat ʾiḥdāhumā ʿalā al-ʾukhrā faqātilūā at-tā tabghā ḥattā tafāʾa ʾilā ʾamri Allāh ۚ fa-in fāʾat fa-aṣliḥūā baynahumā bi-l-ʿadli wa-aqsiṭūā ۖ ʾinna Allāh yuḥibbu al-muqsiṭīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If two groups of the believers fight, you [believers] should try to reconcile them; if one of them is [clearly] oppressing the other, fight the oppressors until they submit to God’s command, then make a just and even-handed reconciliation between the two of them: God loves those who are even-handed.
verses.pickthall: And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.en: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā al-muʾminūna ʾikhwahun fa-aṣliḥūā bayna ʾakhawaykum ۚ wāttaqūā Allāh laʿallakum turḥamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The believers are brothers, so make peace between your two brothers and be mindful of God, so that you may be given mercy.
verses.pickthall: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَـٰبِ ۖ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name [i.e., mention] of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā yaskhar qawmun mmin qawmin ʿasā ʾan yakūnūā khayran mminhum walā nisāʾun mmin nnisāʾin ʿasā ʾan yakunna khayran mminhunna ۖ walā talmizūā ʾanfusakum walā tanābazūā bi-l-ʾalqābi ۖ biʾsa al-āsmu al-fusūqu baʿda al-ʾīmāni ۚ waman llam yatub fa-ūlāʾika humu aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, no one group of men should jeer at another, who may after all be better than them; no one group of women should jeer at another, who may after all be better than them; do not speak ill of one another; do not use offensive nicknames for one another. How bad it is to be called a mischief-maker after accepting faith! Those who do not repent of this behaviour are evildoers.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ājtanibūā kathīran mmina aẓ-ẓanni ʾinna baʿḍa aẓ-ẓanni ʾithmun ۖ walā tajassasūā walā yaghtab bbaʿḍukum baʿḍan ۚ ʾayuḥibbu ʾaḥadukum ʾan yaʾkula laḥma ʾakhīhi maytan fakarihtumūhu ۚ wāttaqūā Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh tawwābun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, avoid making too many assumptions- some assumptions are sinful- and do not spy on one another or speak ill of people behind their backs: would any of you like to eat the flesh of your dead brother? No, you would hate it. So be mindful of God: God is ever relenting, most merciful.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allāh is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nāsu ʾinnā khalaqnākum mmin dhakarin wa-unthā wajaʿalnākum shuʿūban waqabāʾila litaʿārafūā ۚ ʾinna ʾakramakum ʿinda Allāh ʾatqākum ۚ ʾinna Allāh ʿalīmun khabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: People, We created you all from a single man and a single woman, and made you into races and tribes so that you should recognize one another. In God’s eyes, the most honoured of you are the ones most mindful of Him: God is all knowing, all aware.
verses.pickthall: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَـٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَـٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allāh and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.tr: ۞ qālati al-ʾaʿrābu āmannā ۖ qul llam tuʾminūā walākin qūlūā ʾaslamnā walammā yadkhuli al-ʾīmānu fā qulūbikum ۖ wa-in tuṭīʿūā Allāh warasūlahu lā yalitkum mmin ʾaʿmālikum shayā ۚ ʾinna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: The desert Arabs say, ‘We have faith.’ [Prophet], tell them, ‘You do not have faith. What you should say instead is, “We have submitted,” for faith has not yet entered your hearts.’ If you obey God and His Messenger, He will not diminish any of your deeds: He is most forgiving and most merciful.
verses.pickthall: The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقُونَ
verses.en: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allāh and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allāh. It is those who are the truthful.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā al-muʾminūna adh-dhīna āmanūā billāh warasūlihi thumma lam yartābūā wajāhadūā biʾamwālihim wa-anfusihim fā sabīli Allāh ۚ ʾūlāʾika humu aṣ-ṣādiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The true believers are the ones who have faith in God and His Messenger and leave all doubt behind, the ones who have struggled with their possessions and their persons in God’s way: they are the ones who are true.
verses.pickthall: The (true) believers are those only who believe in Allah and His messenger and afterward doubt not, but strive with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah. Such are the sincere.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Say, "Would you acquaint Allāh with your religion while Allāh knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allāh is Knowing of all things?"
verses.tr: qul ʾatuʿallimūna Allāh bidīnikum wallāh yaʿlamu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۚ wallāh bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Do you presume to teach God about your religion, when God knows everything in the heavens and earth, and He has full knowledge of all things?’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things?

verses.ar: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَـٰمَكُم ۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَـٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islām. Say, "Do not consider your Islām a favor to me. Rather, Allāh has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: yamunnūna ʿalayka ʾan ʾaslamūā ۖ qul llā tamunnūā ʿalāa ʾislāmakum ۖ bali Allāh yamunnu ʿalaykum ʾan hadākum lilʾīmāni ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They think they have done you [Prophet] a favour by submitting. Say, ‘Do not consider your submission a favour to me; it is God who has done you a favour, by guiding you to faith, if you are truly sincere.’
verses.pickthall: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh yaʿlamu ghayba as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ wallāh baṣīrun bimā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God knows the secrets of the heavens and earth: He sees everything you do.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
verses.en: Qāf. By the honored Qur’ān...
verses.tr: q ۚ wa-l-qurāni al-majīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: Qaf By the glorious Quran!
verses.pickthall: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an,

verses.ar: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.en: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
verses.tr: bal ʿajibūā ʾan jāʾahum mmundhirun mminhum faqāla al-kāfirūna hādhā shāʾun ʿajībun
verses.abdelhaleem: But the disbelievers are amazed that a warner has come from among them and they say, ‘How strange!
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:

verses.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
verses.en: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."
verses.tr: ʾaʾidhā mitnā wakunnā turāban ۖ dhālika rajʿun baʿīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: To come back [to life] after we have died and become dust? That is too farfetched.’
verses.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!

verses.ar: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
verses.en: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
verses.tr: qad ʿalimnā mā tanquṣu al-ʾarḍu minhum ۖ waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓun
verses.abdelhaleem: We know very well what the earth takes away from them: We keep a comprehensive record.
verses.pickthall: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.

verses.ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
verses.en: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
verses.tr: bal kadhabūā bi-l-ḥaqqi lammā jāʾahum fahum fā ʾamrin mmarījin
verses.abdelhaleem: But the disbelievers deny the truth when it comes to them; they are in a state of confusion.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.

verses.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
verses.en: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
verses.tr: ʾafalam yanẓurūā ʾilā as-samāʾi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūjin
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not see the sky above them––how We have built and adorned it, with no rifts in it;
verses.pickthall: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
verses.en: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
verses.tr: wa-l-ʾarḍa madadnāhā wa-ā fīhā rawāsāa wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin bahījin
verses.abdelhaleem: how We spread out the earth and put solid mountains on it, and caused every kind of joyous plant to grow in it,
verses.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,

verses.ar: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.en: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].
verses.tr: tabṣirahan wadhikrā likulli ʿabdin mmunībin
verses.abdelhaleem: as a lesson and reminder for every servant who turns to God;
verses.pickthall: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.

verses.ar: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
verses.en: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
verses.tr: wanazzalnā mina as-samāʾi māʾan mmubārakan fa-anbatnā bihi jannātin waḥabba al-ḥaṣīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: and how We send blessed water down from the sky and grow with it gardens, the harvest grain,
verses.pickthall: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
verses.en: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
verses.tr: wa-an-nakhla bāsiqātin llahā ṭalʿun nnaḍīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: and tall palm trees laden with clusters of dates,
verses.pickthall: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,

verses.ar: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
verses.en: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
verses.tr: rrizqan llilʿibādi ۖ wa-aḥyaynā bihi baldahan mmaytan ۚ kadhālika al-khurūju
verses.abdelhaleem: as a provision for everyone; how with water We give [new] life to a land that is dead? This is how the dead will emerge [from their graves].
verses.pickthall: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
verses.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamūd
verses.tr: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wa-aṣḥābu ar-rassi wathamūdu
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Noah disbelieved long before these disbelievers, as did the people of Rass, Thamud,
verses.pickthall: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,

verses.ar: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
verses.en: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
verses.tr: waʿādun wafirʿawnu wa-ikhwānu lūṭin
verses.abdelhaleem: Ad, Pharaoh, Lot,
verses.pickthall: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,

verses.ar: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verses.en: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
verses.tr: wa-aṣḥābu al-ʾaykahi waqawmu tubbaʿin ۚ kullun kadhaba ar-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: the Forest-Dwellers, Tubba: all of these people disbelieved their messengers, and so My warning was realized.
verses.pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.

verses.ar: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.en: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
verses.tr: ʾafaʿayīnā bi-l-khalqi al-ʾawwali ۚ bal hum fā labsin mmin khalqin jadīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: So were We incapable of the first creation? No indeed! Yet they doubt a second creation.
verses.pickthall: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
verses.en: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.
verses.tr: walaqad khalaqnā al-ʾinsāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu ۖ wanaḥnu ʾaqrabu ʾilayhi min ḥabli al-warīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: We created man––We know what his soul whispers to him: We are closer to him than his jugular vein––
verses.pickthall: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

verses.ar: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
verses.en: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive, seated on the right and on the left.
verses.tr: ʾidh yatalaqqā al-mutalaqqiyāni ʿani al-yamīni waʿani ash-shimāli qaʿīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: with two receptors set to record, one on his right side and one on his left:
verses.pickthall: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,

verses.ar: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
verses.en: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
verses.tr: mmā yalfiẓu min qawlin ʾillā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: he does not utter a single word without an ever-present watcher.
verses.pickthall: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
verses.en: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
verses.tr: wajāʾat sakrahu al-mawti bi-l-ḥaqqi ۖ dhālika mā kunta minhu taḥīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: The trance of death will bring the Truth with it: ‘This is what you tried to escape.’
verses.pickthall: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.

verses.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.en: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
verses.tr: wanufikha fā aṣ-ṣūri ۚ dhālika yawmu al-waʿīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: The Trumpet will be sounded: ‘This is the Day [you were] warned of.’
verses.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
verses.en: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
verses.tr: wajāʾat kullu nafsin mmaʿahā sāʾiqun washahīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: Each person will arrive attended by an [angel] to drive him on and another to bear witness:
verses.pickthall: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.

verses.ar: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
verses.en: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
verses.tr: llaqad kunta fā ghaflahin mmin hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāʾaka fabaṣaruka al-yawma ḥadīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘You paid no attention to this [Day]; but today We have removed your veil and your sight is sharp.’
verses.pickthall: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
verses.en: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
verses.tr: waqāla qarīnuhu hādhā mā ladāa ʿatīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: The person’s attendant will say, ‘Here is what I have prepared’-
verses.pickthall: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).

verses.ar: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
verses.en: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
verses.tr: ʾalqiyā fā jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Hurl every obstinate disbeliever into Hell,
verses.pickthall: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,

verses.ar: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
verses.en: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
verses.tr: mmannāʿin llilkhayri muʿtadin mmurībin
verses.abdelhaleem: everyone who hindered good, was aggressive, caused others to doubt,
verses.pickthall: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
verses.en: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
verses.tr: adh-dhā jaʿala maʿa Allāh ʾilāhan ākhara fa-āhu fā al-ʿadhābi ash-shadīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: and set up other gods alongside God. Hurl him into severe punishment!’-
verses.pickthall: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
verses.en: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
verses.tr: ۞ qāla qarīnuhu rabbanā mā ʾaṭghaytuhu walākin kāna fā ḍalālin baʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: and his [evil] companion will say, ‘Lord, I did not make him transgress; he had already gone far astray himself.’
verses.pickthall: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.en: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
verses.tr: qāla lā takhtaṣimūā ladāa waqad qaddamtu ʾilaykum bi-l-waʿīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: God will say, ‘Do not argue in My presence. I sent you a warning
verses.pickthall: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.

verses.ar: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.en: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
verses.tr: mā yubaddalu al-qawlu ladāa wamā ʾanā biẓallāmin llilʿabīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: and My word cannot be changed: I am not unjust to any creature.’
verses.pickthall: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
verses.en: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
verses.tr: yawma naqūlu lijahannama hali āmtalaʾti wataqūlu hal min mmazīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall say to Hell on that day, ‘Are you full?’ and it will reply, ‘Are there no more?’
verses.pickthall: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?

verses.ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
verses.en: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
verses.tr: wa-uzlifati al-jannahu lilmuttaqīna ghayra baʿīdin
verses.abdelhaleem: But Paradise will be brought close to the righteous and will no longer be distant:
verses.pickthall: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
verses.en: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
verses.tr: hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli ʾawwābin ḥafīẓin
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘This is what you were promised––this is for everyone who turned often to God and kept Him in mind,
verses.pickthall: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,

verses.ar: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.en: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
verses.tr: mman khashāa ar-raḥmāna bi-l-ghaybi wajāʾa biqalbin mmunībin
verses.abdelhaleem: who held the Most Gracious in awe, though He is unseen, who comes before Him with a heart turned to Him in devotion-
verses.pickthall: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.

verses.ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
verses.en: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
verses.tr: ādkhulūhā bisalāmin ۖ dhālika yawmu al-khulūdi
verses.abdelhaleem: so enter it in peace. This is the Day of everlasting Life.’
verses.pickthall: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.

verses.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
verses.en: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
verses.tr: lahum mmā yashāʾūna fīhā waladaynā mazīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: They will have all that they wish for there, and We have more for them.
verses.pickthall: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.

verses.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.en: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
verses.tr: wakam ʾahlaknā qablahum mmin qarnin hum ʾashaddu minhum baṭshan fanaqqabūā fā al-bilādi hal min mmaḥīṣin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have destroyed even mightier generations before these disbelievers, who travelled through [many] lands- was there any escape?
verses.pickthall: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika ladhikrā liman kāna lahu qalbun ʾaw ʾalqā as-samʿa wahuwa shahīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: There truly is a reminder in this for whoever has a heart, whoever listens attentively.
verses.pickthall: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
verses.en: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
verses.tr: walaqad khalaqnā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa wamā baynahumā fā sittahi ʾayyāmin wamā massanā min llughūbin
verses.abdelhaleem: We created the heavens, the earth, and everything between, in six Days without tiring.
verses.pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verses.en: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
verses.tr: fāṣbir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi ash-shamsi waqabla al-ghurūbi
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet], bear everything they say with patience; celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising and setting of the sun;
verses.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.en: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
verses.tr: wamina al-yli fasabbiḥhu wa-adbāra as-sujūdi
verses.abdelhaleem: proclaim His praise in the night and at the end of every prayer;
verses.pickthall: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.

verses.ar: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
verses.en: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
verses.tr: wāstamiʿ yawma yunādi al-munādi min mmakānin qarībin
verses.abdelhaleem: listen out for the Day when the caller will call from a nearby place.
verses.pickthall: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verses.en: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
verses.tr: yawma yasmaʿūna aṣ-ṣayḥaha bi-l-ḥaqqi ۚ dhālika yawmu al-khurūji
verses.abdelhaleem: They will come out [from their graves] on that Day, the Day when they hear the mighty blast in reality.
verses.pickthall: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
verses.tr: ʾinnā naḥnu nuḥāi wanumītu wa-ā al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: It is We who give life and death; the final return will be to Us
verses.pickthall: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
verses.en: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
verses.tr: yawma tashaqqaqu al-ʾarḍu ʿanhum sirāʿan ۚ dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: on the Day when the earth will be torn apart, letting them rush out- that gathering will be easy for Us.
verses.pickthall: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).

verses.ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.en: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
verses.tr: nnaḥnu ʾaʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna ۖ wamā ʾanta ʿalayhim bijabbārin ۖ fadhakkir bi-l-qurāni man yakhāfu waʿīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: We know best what the disbelievers say. You [Prophet] are not there to force them, so remind, with this Quran, those who fear My warning.
verses.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.

verses.ar: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
verses.en: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhāriyāti dharwan
verses.abdelhaleem: By those [winds] that scatter far and wide,
verses.pickthall: By those that winnow with a winnowing

verses.ar: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
verses.en: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
verses.tr: fa-l-ḥāmilāti wiqran
verses.abdelhaleem: and those that are heavily laden,
verses.pickthall: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)

verses.ar: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
verses.en: And the ships sailing with ease
verses.tr: fa-l-jāriyāti yusran
verses.abdelhaleem: that speed freely,
verses.pickthall: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)

verses.ar: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.en: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
verses.tr: fa-l-muqassimāti ʾamran
verses.abdelhaleem: that distribute [rain] as ordained!
verses.pickthall: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
verses.en: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā tūʿadūna laṣādiqun
verses.abdelhaleem: What you [people] are promised is true:
verses.pickthall: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.en: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
verses.tr: wa-inna ad-dīna lawāqiʿun
verses.abdelhaleem: the Judgement will come––
verses.pickthall: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.en: By the heaven containing pathways,
verses.tr: wa-as-samāʾi dhāti al-ḥubuki
verses.abdelhaleem: by the sky with its pathways,
verses.pickthall: By the heaven full of paths,

verses.ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
verses.en: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
verses.tr: ʾinnakum lafā qawlin mmukhtalifin
verses.abdelhaleem: you differ in what you say––
verses.pickthall: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).

verses.ar: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.en: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.
verses.tr: yuʾfaku ʿanhu man ʾufika
verses.abdelhaleem: those who turn away from it are [truly] deceived.
verses.pickthall: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.

verses.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.en: Destroyed are the misinformers
verses.tr: qutila al-kharrāṣūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Perish the liars,
verses.pickthall: Accursed be the conjecturers

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
verses.en: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna hum fā ghamrahin sāhūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those steeped in error and unaware!
verses.pickthall: Who are careless in an abyss!

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
verses.tr: yaslūna ʾayyāna yawmu ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: They ask, ‘When is this Judgement Day coming?’
verses.pickthall: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?

verses.ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.en: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.
verses.tr: yawma hum ʿalā an-nāri yuftanūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On a Day when they will be punished by the Fire,
verses.pickthall: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,

verses.ar: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.en: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
verses.tr: dhūqūā fitnatakum hādhā adh-dhā kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Taste the punishment! This is what you wished to hasten.’
verses.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
verses.tr: ʾinna al-muttaqīna fā jannātin waʿuyūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: The righteous will be in Gardens with [flowing] springs.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,

verses.ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
verses.tr: ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum ۚ ʾinnahum kānūā qabla dhālika muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will receive their Lord’s gifts because of the good they did before:
verses.pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;

verses.ar: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.en: They used to sleep but little of the night,
verses.tr: kānūā qalīlan mmina al-yli mā yahjaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: sleeping only little at night,
verses.pickthall: They used to sleep but little of the night,

verses.ar: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.en: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
verses.tr: wabālʾasḥāri hum yastaghfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: praying at dawn for God’s forgiveness,
verses.pickthall: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,

verses.ar: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.en: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
verses.tr: wafā ʾamwālihim ḥaqqun llilssāʾili wa-l-maḥrūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: giving a rightful share of their wealth to the beggar and the deprived.
verses.pickthall: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.

verses.ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.en: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
verses.tr: wafā al-ʾarḍi āyātun llilmūqinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: On earth there are signs for those with sure faith––
verses.pickthall: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.

verses.ar: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
verses.tr: wafā ʾanfusikum ۚ ʾafalā tubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and in yourselves too, do you not see?––
verses.pickthall: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?

verses.ar: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
verses.tr: wafā as-samāʾi rizqukum wamā tūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: in the sky is your sustenance and all that you are promised.
verses.pickthall: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.en: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
verses.tr: fawarabbi as-samāʾi wa-l-ʾarḍi ʾinnahu laḥaqqun mmithla mā ʾannakum tanṭiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: By the Lord of the heavens and earth! All this is as real as your speaking.
verses.pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.

verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.en: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
verses.tr: hal ʾatāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ʾibrāhīma al-mukramīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Muhammad], have you heard the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?
verses.pickthall: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?

verses.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.en: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."
verses.tr: ʾidh dakhalūā ʿalayhi faqālūā salāman ۖ qāla salāmun qawmun mmunkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They went in to see him and said, ‘Peace.’ ‘Peace,’ he said, [adding to himself] ‘These people are strangers.’
verses.pickthall: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).

verses.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
verses.en: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.
verses.tr: farāgha ʾilā ʾahlihi fajāʾa biʿijlin samīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: He turned quickly to his household, brought out a fat calf,
verses.pickthall: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;

verses.ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
verses.tr: faqarrabahu ʾilayhim qāla ʾalā taʾkulūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and placed it before them. ‘Will you not eat?’ he said,
verses.pickthall: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?

verses.ar: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.en: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
verses.tr: fa-awjasa minhum khīfahan ۖ qālūā lā takhaf ۖ wabasharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: beginning to be afraid of them, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid.’ They gave him good news of a son who would be gifted with knowledge.
verses.pickthall: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.

verses.ar: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
verses.en: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
verses.tr: fa-aqbalati āmraʾatuhu fā ṣarrahin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: His wife then entered with a loud cry, struck her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman?’
verses.pickthall: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
verses.tr: qālūā kadhāliki qāla rabbuki ۖ ʾinnahu huwa al-ḥakīmu al-ʿalīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: but they said, ‘It will be so. This is what your Lord said, and He is the Wise, the All Knowing.’
verses.pickthall: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
verses.tr: ۞ qāla famā khaṭbukum ʾayyuhā al-mursalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Abraham said, ‘What is your errand, messengers?’
verses.pickthall: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
verses.tr: qālūā ʾinnā ʾursilnā ʾilā qawmin mmujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘We are sent to a people lost in sin,
verses.pickthall: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,

verses.ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
verses.en: To send down upon them stones of clay,
verses.tr: linursila ʿalayhim ḥijārahan mmin ṭīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: to bring down rocks of clay,
verses.pickthall: That we may send upon them stones of clay,

verses.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.en: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
verses.tr: mmusawwamahan ʿinda rabbika lilmusrifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: marked by your Lord for those who exceed all bounds.’
verses.pickthall: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.

verses.ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.
verses.tr: fa-akhrajnā man kāna fīhā mina al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We brought out such believers as were there-
verses.pickthall: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.

verses.ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
verses.tr: famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytin mmina al-muslimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We found only one household devoted to God-
verses.pickthall: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).

verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.en: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
verses.tr: wataraknā fīhā āyahan llilladhīna yakhāfūna al-ʿadhāba al-ʾalīma
verses.abdelhaleem: and left the town to be a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
verses.pickthall: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
verses.tr: wafā mūsā ʾidh ʾarsalnāhu ʾilā firʿawna bisulṭānin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
verses.pickthall: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.en: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."
verses.tr: fatawallā biruknihi waqāla sāḥirun ʾaw majnūnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Pharaoh turned away with his supporters, saying, ‘This is a sorcerer, or maybe a madman,’
verses.pickthall: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.en: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
verses.tr: fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fā al-yammi wahuwa mulīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: so We seized him and his forces and threw them into the sea: he was to blame.
verses.pickthall: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.

verses.ar: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.en: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
verses.tr: wafā ʿādin ʾidh ʾarsalnā ʿalayhimu ar-rīḥa al-ʿaqīma
verses.abdelhaleem: There is another sign in the Ad: We sent the life-destroying wind against them
verses.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.

verses.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.en: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
verses.tr: mā tadharu min shāʾin ʾatat ʿalayhi ʾillā jaʿalathu ka-ar-ramīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: and it reduced everything it came up against to shreds.
verses.pickthall: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.

verses.ar: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
verses.tr: wafā thamūda ʾidh qīla lahum tamattaʿūā ḥattā ḥīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: And also in the Thamud: it was said to them, ‘Make the most of your lives for a while,’
verses.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.

verses.ar: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
verses.tr: faʿatawā ʿan ʾamri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumu aṣ-ṣāʿiqahu wahum yanẓurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them. They looked on helplessly:
verses.pickthall: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;

verses.ar: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.en: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
verses.tr: famā āstaṭāʿūā min qiyāmin wamā kānūā muntaṣirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: they could not even remain standing, let alone defend themselves.
verses.pickthall: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.

verses.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: waqawma nūḥin mmin qablu ۖ ʾinnahum kānūā qawman fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Before that We destroyed the people of Noah. They were a truly sinful people!
verses.pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.en: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
verses.tr: wa-as-samāʾa banaynāhā biʾayydin wa-innā lamūsiʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We built the heavens with Our power and made them vast,
verses.pickthall: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ
verses.en: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
verses.tr: wa-l-ʾarḍa farashnāhā faniʿma al-māhidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We spread out the earth- how well We smoothed it out!-
verses.pickthall: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!

verses.ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.
verses.tr: wamin kulli shāʾin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and We created pairs of all things so that you [people] might take note.
verses.pickthall: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.

verses.ar: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: So flee to Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
verses.tr: fafirrūā ʾilā Allāh ۖ ʾinnā lakum mminhu nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: [So, say to them, Prophet], ‘Quickly, turn to God- I am sent by Him to give you clear warning-
verses.pickthall: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
verses.tr: walā tajʿalūā maʿa Allāh ʾilāhan ākhara ۖ ʾinnā lakum mminhu nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: and do not set up any other god alongside Him. I am sent by Him to give you clear warning!’
verses.pickthall: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.en: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
verses.tr: kadhālika mā ʾatā adh-dhīna min qablihim mmin rrasūlin ʾillā qālūā sāḥirun ʾaw majnūnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Every previous people to whom a messenger was sent also said, ‘A sor-cerer, or maybe a madman!’
verses.pickthall: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!

verses.ar: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.en: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
verses.tr: ʾatawāṣawā bihi ۚ bal hum qawmun ṭāghūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Did they tell one another to do this? No! They are a people who exceed all bounds,
verses.pickthall: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
verses.en: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.
verses.tr: fatawalla ʿanhum famā ʾanta bimalūmin
verses.abdelhaleem: so ignore them [Prophet]- you are not to blame-
verses.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,

verses.ar: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
verses.tr: wadhakkir fa-inna adh-dhikrā tanfaʿu al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and go on reminding [people], it is good for those who believe to be reminded.
verses.pickthall: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.en: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
verses.tr: wamā khalaqtu al-jinna wa-l-ʾinsa ʾillā liyaʿbudūni
verses.abdelhaleem: I created jinn and mankind only to worship Me:
verses.pickthall: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.

verses.ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.en: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
verses.tr: mā ʾurīdu minhum mmin rrizqin wamā ʾurīdu ʾan yuṭʿimūni
verses.abdelhaleem: I want no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me-
verses.pickthall: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.en: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh huwa ar-razzāqu dhū al-quwwahi al-matīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: God is the Provider, the Lord of Power, the Ever Mighty.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.
verses.tr: fa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamūā dhanūban mmithla dhanūbi ʾaṣḥābihim falā yastaʿjilūni
verses.abdelhaleem: The evildoers, like their predecessors, will have a share of punishment- they need not ask Me to hasten it-
verses.pickthall: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).

verses.ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
verses.tr: fawaylun llilladhīna kafarūā min yawmihimu adh-dhā yūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and woe betide those who deny the truth on the Day they have been promised.
verses.pickthall: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.

verses.ar: وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.en: By the mount
verses.tr: wa-aṭ-ṭūri
verses.abdelhaleem: By the mountain,
verses.pickthall: By the Mount,

verses.ar: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
verses.en: And [by] a Book inscribed
verses.tr: wakitābin mmasṭūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: by a Scripture inscribed
verses.pickthall: And a Scripture inscribed

verses.ar: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
verses.en: In parchment spread open
verses.tr: fā raqqin mmanshūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: in unrolled parch-ment,
verses.pickthall: On fine parchment unrolled,

verses.ar: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verses.en: And [by] the frequented House
verses.tr: wa-l-bayti al-maʿmūri
verses.abdelhaleem: by the much-visited House,
verses.pickthall: And the House frequented,

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verses.en: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high
verses.tr: wa-as-saqfi al-marfūʿi
verses.abdelhaleem: by the raised canopy,
verses.pickthall: And the roof exalted,

verses.ar: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verses.en: And [by] the sea set on fire,
verses.tr: wa-l-baḥri al-masjūri
verses.abdelhaleem: by the ocean ever filled,
verses.pickthall: And the sea kept filled,

verses.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.en: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
verses.tr: ʾinna ʿadhāba rabbika lawāqiʿun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is coming––
verses.pickthall: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;

verses.ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
verses.en: Of it there is no preventer.
verses.tr: mmā lahu min dāfiʿin
verses.abdelhaleem: it cannot be put off––
verses.pickthall: There is none that can ward it off.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
verses.en: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
verses.tr: yawma tamūru as-samāʾu mawran
verses.abdelhaleem: on the Day when the sky sways back and forth
verses.pickthall: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,

verses.ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
verses.en: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
verses.tr: watasīru al-jibālu sayran
verses.abdelhaleem: and the mountains float away.
verses.pickthall: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,

verses.ar: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
verses.tr: fawaylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe on that Day to those who deny the Truth,
verses.pickthall: Then woe that day unto the deniers

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.en: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna hum fā khawḍin yalʿabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who amuse themselves with idle chatter:
verses.pickthall: Who play in talk of grave matters;

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.en: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
verses.tr: yawma yudaʿʿūna ʾilā nāri jahannama daʿʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: on that Day they will be thrust into the Fire of Hell.
verses.pickthall: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell

verses.ar: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
verses.tr: hādhihi an-nāru at-tā kuntum bihā tukadhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘This is the Fire you used to deny.
verses.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.

verses.ar: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
verses.tr: ʾafasiḥrun hādhā ʾam ʾantum lā tubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So is this sorcery? Do you still not see it?
verses.pickthall: Is this magic, or do ye not see?

verses.ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
verses.tr: āṣlawhā fāṣbirūā ʾaw lā taṣbirūā sawāʾun ʿalaykum ۖ ʾinnamā tujzawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Burn in it––it makes no difference whether you bear it patiently or not–– you are only being repaid for what you have done.’
verses.pickthall: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
verses.tr: ʾinna al-muttaqīna fā jannātin wanaʿīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who were mindful of God are in Gardens and in bliss,
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,

verses.ar: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
verses.tr: fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum wawaqāhum rabbuhum ʿadhāba al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: rejoicing in their Lord’s gifts: He has saved them from the torment of the Blaze,
verses.pickthall: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.

verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
verses.tr: kulūā wāshrabūā hanīā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Eat and drink with healthy enjoyment as a reward for what you have done.’
verses.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.en: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
verses.tr: muttakīna ʿalā sururin mmaṣfūfahin ۖ wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: They are comfortably seated on couches arranged in rows; We pair them with beautiful-eyed maidens;
verses.pickthall: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
verses.en: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā wāttabaʿathum dhurriyyatuhum biʾīmānin ʾalḥaqnā bihim dhurriyyatahum wamā ʾalatnāhum mmin ʿamalihim mmin shāʾin ۚ kullu āmriʾin bimā kasaba rahīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: We unite the believers with their offspring who followed them in faith–– We do not deny them any of the rewards for their deeds: each person is in pledge for his own deeds––
verses.pickthall: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.

verses.ar: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.en: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
verses.tr: wa-amdadnāhum bifākihahin walaḥmin mmimmā yashtahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We provide them with any fruit or meat they desire.
verses.pickthall: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.

verses.ar: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
verses.en: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
verses.tr: yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kaʾsan llā laghwun fīhā walā taʾthīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: They pass around a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or sin.
verses.pickthall: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.

verses.ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
verses.en: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
verses.tr: ۞ wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim ghilmānun llahum kaʾannahum luʾluʾun mmaknūnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Devoted youths like hidden pearls wait on them.
verses.pickthall: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.

verses.ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
verses.tr: wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāʾalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They turn to one another and say,
verses.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verses.en: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].
verses.tr: qālūā ʾinnā kunnā qablu fā ʾahlinā mushfiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘When we were still with our families [on earth] we used to live in fear––
verses.pickthall: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;

verses.ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.en: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
verses.tr: famanna Allāh ʿalaynā wawaqānā ʿadhāba as-samūmi
