verses.abdelhaleem: God has been gracious to us and saved us from the torment of intense heat-
verses.pickthall: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.

verses.ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
verses.tr: ʾinnā kunnā min qablu nadʿūhu ۖ ʾinnahu huwa al-barru ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: We used to pray to Him: He is the Good, the Merciful One.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.

verses.ar: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verses.en: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
verses.tr: fadhakkir famā ʾanta biniʿmati rabbika bikāhinin walā majnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] remind [people]. By the grace of your Lord [Prophet], you are neither oracle nor madman.
verses.pickthall: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verses.en: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?
verses.tr: ʾam yaqūlūna shāʿirun nnatarabbaṣu bihi rayba al-manūni
verses.abdelhaleem: If they say, ‘He is only a poet: we shall await his fate,’
verses.pickthall: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?

verses.ar: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
verses.tr: qul tarabbaṣūā fa-innā maʿakum mmina al-mutarabbiṣīna
verses.abdelhaleem: say, ‘Wait if you wish; I too am waiting’-
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.

verses.ar: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.en: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
verses.tr: ʾam taʾmuruhum ʾaḥlāmuhum bihādhā ۚ ʾam hum qawmun ṭāghūna
verses.abdelhaleem: does their reason really tell them to do this, or are they simply insolent people?
verses.pickthall: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
verses.tr: ʾam yaqūlūna taqawwalahu ۚ bal llā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they say, ‘He has made it up himself’- they certainly do not believe-
verses.pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!

verses.ar: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
verses.tr: falyaʾtūā biḥadīthin mmithlihi ʾin kānūā ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: let them produce one like it, if what they say is true.
verses.pickthall: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.

verses.ar: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
verses.en: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
verses.tr: ʾam khuliqūā min ghayri shāʾin ʾam humu al-khāliqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Were they created without any agent? Were they the creators?
verses.pickthall: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?

verses.ar: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
verses.tr: ʾam khalaqūā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa ۚ bal llā yūqinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Did they create the heavens and the earth? No! They do not have faith.
verses.pickthall: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!

verses.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verses.en: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
verses.tr: ʾam ʿindahum khazāʾinu rabbika ʾam humu al-muṣyṭirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they possess your Lord’s treasures or have control over them?
verses.pickthall: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].
verses.tr: ʾam lahum sullamun yastamiʿūna fīhi ۖ falyaʾti mustamiʿuhum bisulṭānin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they have a ladder to climb, in order to eavesdrop [on Heaven’s secrets]? Let their eavesdropper produce clear proof.
verses.pickthall: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.en: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
verses.tr: ʾam lahu al-banātu walakumu al-banūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Does God have daughters while you have sons?
verses.pickthall: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?

verses.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.en: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
verses.tr: ʾam tasluhum ʾajran fahum mmin mmaghramin mmuthqalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you [Prophet] demand a payment from them that would burden them with debt?
verses.pickthall: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?

verses.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
verses.tr: ʾam ʿindahumu al-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they have [access to] the unseen? Could they write it down?
verses.pickthall: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?

verses.ar: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verses.en: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
verses.tr: ʾam yurīdūna kaydan ۖ fa-adh-dhīna kafarūā humu al-makīdūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they think they can ensnare you? It is the disbelievers who have been ensnared.
verses.pickthall: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
verses.tr: ʾam lahum ʾilāhun ghayru Allāh ۚ subḥāna Allāh ʿammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they really have another god besides God? God is far above anything they set alongside Him.
verses.pickthall: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!

verses.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
verses.en: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
verses.tr: wa-in yarawā kisfan mmina as-samāʾi sāqiṭan yaqūlūā saḥābun mmarkūmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Even if they saw a piece of heaven falling down on them, they would say, ‘Just a heap of clouds,’
verses.pickthall: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.

verses.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verses.en: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
verses.tr: fadharhum ḥattā yulāqūā yawmahumu adh-dhā fīhi yuṣʿaqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so leave them, Prophet, until they face the Day when they will be thunderstruck,
verses.pickthall: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
verses.tr: yawma lā yughnā ʿanhum kayduhum shayā walā hum yunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the Day when their snares will be of no use to them, when they will get no help.
verses.pickthall: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
verses.tr: wa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamūā ʿadhāban dūna dhālika walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Another punishment awaits the evildoers, though most of them do not realize it.
verses.pickthall: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.

verses.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.en: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise
verses.tr: wāṣbir liḥukmi rabbika fa-innaka biʾaʿyuninā ۖ wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: you are under Our watchful eye. Celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise.
verses.pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.en: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
verses.tr: wamina al-yli fasabbiḥhu wa-idbāra an-nujūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Glorify Him at night and at the fading of the stars.
verses.pickthall: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
verses.en: By the star when it descends,
verses.tr: wa-an-najmi ʾidhā hawā
verses.abdelhaleem: By the star when it sets!
verses.pickthall: By the Star when it setteth,

verses.ar: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
verses.en: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
verses.tr: mā ḍalla ṣāḥibukum wamā ghawā
verses.abdelhaleem: Your companion has not strayed; he is not deluded;
verses.pickthall: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;

verses.ar: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
verses.en: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
verses.tr: wamā yanṭiqu ʿani al-hawā
verses.abdelhaleem: he does not speak from his own desire.
verses.pickthall: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.

verses.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
verses.en: It is not but a revelation revealed,
verses.tr: ʾin huwa ʾillā waḥāun yūḥā
verses.abdelhaleem: The Quran is nothing less than a revelation that is sent to him.
verses.pickthall: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,

verses.ar: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
verses.en: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -
verses.tr: ʿallamahu shadīdu al-quwā
verses.abdelhaleem: It was taught to him by [an angel] with mighty powers
verses.pickthall: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,

verses.ar: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.en: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
verses.tr: dhū mirrahin fāstawā
verses.abdelhaleem: and great strength, who stood
verses.pickthall: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view

verses.ar: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.en: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
verses.tr: wahuwa bi-l-ʾufuqi al-ʾaʿlā
verses.abdelhaleem: on the highest horizon
verses.pickthall: When he was on the uppermost horizon.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
verses.en: Then he approached and descended
verses.tr: thumma danā fatadallā
verses.abdelhaleem: and then approached––coming down
verses.pickthall: Then he drew nigh and came down

verses.ar: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
verses.en: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
verses.tr: fakāna qāba qawsayni ʾaw ʾadnā
verses.abdelhaleem: until he was two bow-lengths away or even closer––
verses.pickthall: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,

verses.ar: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
verses.en: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].
verses.tr: fa-awḥā ʾilā ʿabdihi mā ʾawḥā
verses.abdelhaleem: and revealed to God’s servant what He revealed.
verses.pickthall: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.

verses.ar: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
verses.en: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
verses.tr: mā kadhaba al-fuādu mā raā
verses.abdelhaleem: [The Prophet’s] own heart did not distort what he saw.
verses.pickthall: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.

verses.ar: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
verses.en: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
verses.tr: ʾafatumārūnahu ʿalā mā yarā
verses.abdelhaleem: Are you going to dispute with him what he saw with his own eyes?
verses.pickthall: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.en: And he certainly saw him in another descent
verses.tr: walaqad raāhu nazlahan ʾukhrā
verses.abdelhaleem: A second time he saw him:
verses.pickthall: And verily he saw him yet another time

verses.ar: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
verses.en: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
verses.tr: ʿinda sidrahi al-muntahā
verses.abdelhaleem: by the lote tree beyond which none may pass
verses.pickthall: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,

verses.ar: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
verses.en: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -
verses.tr: ʿindahā jannahu al-maʾwā
verses.abdelhaleem: near the Garden of Restfulness,
verses.pickthall: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.

verses.ar: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
verses.en: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
verses.tr: ʾidh yaghshā as-sidraha mā yaghshā
verses.abdelhaleem: when the tree was covered in nameless [splendour].
verses.pickthall: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,

verses.ar: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
verses.en: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
verses.tr: mā zāgha al-baṣaru wamā ṭaghā
verses.abdelhaleem: His sight never wavered, nor was it too bold,
verses.pickthall: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
verses.en: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
verses.tr: laqad raā min āyāti rabbihi al-kubrā
verses.abdelhaleem: and he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.
verses.pickthall: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
verses.en: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?
verses.tr: ʾafaraʾaytumu al-lāta wa-l-ʿuzzā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Disbelievers], consider al-Lat and al-Uzza,
verses.pickthall: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza

verses.ar: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
verses.en: And Manāt, the third - the other one?
verses.tr: wamanawāha ath-thālithaha al-ʾukhrā
verses.abdelhaleem: and the third one, Manat––
verses.pickthall: And Manat, the third, the other?

verses.ar: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.en: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
verses.tr: ʾalakumu adh-dhakaru walahu al-ʾunthā
verses.abdelhaleem: are you to have the male and He the female?
verses.pickthall: Are yours the males and His the females?

verses.ar: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
verses.en: That, then, is an unjust division.
verses.tr: tilka ʾidhan qismahun ḍīzā
verses.abdelhaleem: That would be a most unjust distribution!––
verses.pickthall: That indeed were an unfair division!

verses.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.en: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
verses.tr: ʾin hāa ʾillā ʾasmāʾun sammaytumūhā ʾantum wabāʾukum mmā ʾanzala Allāh bihā min sulṭānin ۚ ʾin yattabiʿūna ʾillā aẓ-ẓanna wamā tahwā al-ʾanfusu ۖ walaqad jāʾahum mmin rrabbihimu al-hudā
verses.abdelhaleem: these are nothing but names you have invented yourselves, you and your forefathers. God has sent no authority for them. These people merely follow guesswork and the whims of their souls, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.
verses.pickthall: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.

verses.ar: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
verses.en: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
verses.tr: ʾam lilʾinsāni mā tamannā
verses.abdelhaleem: Is man to have everything he wishes for,
verses.pickthall: Or shall man have what he coveteth?

verses.ar: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
verses.tr: fa-lillāh al-ākhirahu wa-l-ʾūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: when the present life and the life to come belong only to God?
verses.pickthall: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.

verses.ar: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
verses.en: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
verses.tr: ۞ wakam mmin mmalakin fā as-samāwāti lā tughnā shafāʿatuhum shayā ʾillā min baʿdi ʾan yaʾdhana Allāh liman yashāʾu wayarḍā
verses.abdelhaleem: There are many angels in heaven whose intercession will be of no use until God gives permission to those He will, whose words He will accept.
verses.pickthall: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.en: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna lā yuʾminūna bi-l-ākhirahi layusammūna al-malāʾikaha tasmiyaha al-ʾunthā
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who deny the life to come give the angels female names.
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.

verses.ar: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
verses.en: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
verses.tr: wamā lahum bihi min ʿilmin ۖ ʾin yattabiʿūna ʾillā aẓ-ẓanna ۖ wa-inna aẓ-ẓanna lā yughnā mina al-ḥaqqi shayā
verses.abdelhaleem: They have no knowledge to base this on: they merely follow guesswork. Guesswork is of no value against the Truth.
verses.pickthall: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.

verses.ar: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.en: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
verses.tr: fa-aʿriḍ ʿan mman tawallā ʿan dhikrinā walam yurid ʾillā al-ḥayawāha ad-dunyā
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] ignore those who turn away from Our revelation, who want only the life of this world.
verses.pickthall: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.en: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
verses.tr: dhālika mablaghuhum mmina al-ʿilmi ۚ ʾinna rabbaka huwa ʾaʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa ʾaʿlamu bimani āhtadā
verses.abdelhaleem: Their knowledge does not go beyond that. Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who follows guidance.
verses.pickthall: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
verses.en: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
verses.tr: wa-lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi liyajzāa adh-dhīna ʾasāwā bimā ʿamilūā wayajzāa adh-dhīna ʾaḥsanūā bi-l-ḥusnā
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and reward, with what is best, those who do good.
verses.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
verses.en: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yajtanibūna kabāʾira al-ʾithmi wa-l-fawāḥisha ʾillā al-lamama ۚ ʾinna rabbaka wāsiʿu al-maghfirahi ۚ huwa ʾaʿlamu bikum ʾidh ʾanshaʾakum mmina al-ʾarḍi wa-idh ʾantum ʾajinnahun fā buṭūni ʾummahātikum ۖ falā tuzakkūā ʾanfusakum ۖ huwa ʾaʿlamu bimani āttaqā
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who avoid grave sins and foul acts, though they may commit small sins, your Lord is ample in forgiveness. He has been aware of you from the time He produced you from the earth and from your hiding places in your mothers’ wombs, so do not assert your own goodness:He knows best who is mindful of Him.
verses.pickthall: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
verses.en: Have you seen the one who turned away
verses.tr: ʾafaraʾayta adh-dhā tawallā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], consider that man who turned away:
verses.pickthall: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,

verses.ar: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
verses.en: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
verses.tr: wa-aʿṭā qalīlan wa-akdā
verses.abdelhaleem: he only gave a little and then he stopped.
verses.pickthall: And gave a little, then was grudging?

verses.ar: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
verses.en: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
verses.tr: ʾaʿindahu ʿilmu al-ghaybi fahuwa yarā
verses.abdelhaleem: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen? Can he see [the Hereafter]?
verses.pickthall: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
verses.en: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
verses.tr: ʾam lam yunabbaʾ bimā fā ṣuḥufi mūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: Has he not been told what was written in the Scriptures of Moses
verses.pickthall: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses

verses.ar: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
verses.en: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
verses.tr: wa-ibrāhīma adh-dhā waffā
verses.abdelhaleem: and of Abraham, who fulfilled his duty:
verses.pickthall: And Abraham who paid his debt:

verses.ar: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.en: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
verses.tr: ʾallā taziru wāzirahun wizra ʾukhrā
verses.abdelhaleem: that no soul shall bear the burden of another;
verses.pickthall: That no laden one shall bear another's load,

verses.ar: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.en: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
verses.tr: wa-an llaysa lilʾinsāni ʾillā mā saʿā
verses.abdelhaleem: that man will only have what he has worked towards;
verses.pickthall: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
verses.en: And that his effort is going to be seen -
verses.tr: wa-anna saʿyahu sawfa yurā
verses.abdelhaleem: that his labour will be seen
verses.pickthall: And that his effort will be seen.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
verses.en: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -
verses.tr: thumma yujzāhu al-jazāʾa al-ʾawfā
verses.abdelhaleem: and that in the end he will be repaid in full for it;
verses.pickthall: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
verses.en: And that to your Lord is the finality
verses.tr: wa-anna ʾilā rabbika al-muntahā
verses.abdelhaleem: that the final goal is your Lord;
verses.pickthall: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
verses.en: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
verses.tr: wa-annahu huwa ʾaḍḥaka wa-abkā
verses.abdelhaleem: that it is He who makes people laugh and weep;
verses.pickthall: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
verses.en: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
verses.tr: wa-annahu huwa ʾamāta wa-aḥyā
verses.abdelhaleem: that it is He who gives death and life;
verses.pickthall: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.en: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
verses.tr: wa-annahu khalaqa az-zawjayni adh-dhakara wa-l-ʾunthā
verses.abdelhaleem: that He Himself created the two sexes, male and female,
verses.pickthall: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,

verses.ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
verses.en: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
verses.tr: min nnuṭfahin ʾidhā tumnā
verses.abdelhaleem: from an ejected drop of sperm;
verses.pickthall: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
verses.en: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.
verses.tr: wa-anna ʿalayhi an-nashʾaha al-ʾukhrā
verses.abdelhaleem: that He will undertake the second Creation;
verses.pickthall: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
verses.en: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
verses.tr: wa-annahu huwa ʾaghnā wa-aqnā
verses.abdelhaleem: that it is He who gives wealth and possessions;
verses.pickthall: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
verses.en: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.
verses.tr: wa-annahu huwa rabbu ash-shiʿrā
verses.abdelhaleem: that He is the Lord of Sirius;
verses.pickthall: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad.
verses.tr: wa-annahu ʾahlaka ʿādan al-ʾūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: that it was He who destroyed, in their entirety, ancient 'Ad
verses.pickthall: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,

verses.ar: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
verses.en: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -
verses.tr: wathamūdā famā ʾabqā
verses.abdelhaleem: and Thamud,
verses.pickthall: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;

verses.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
verses.en: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
verses.tr: waqawma nūḥin mmin qablu ۖ ʾinnahum kānūā hum ʾaẓlama wa-aṭghā
verses.abdelhaleem: and before them the people of Noah who were even more unjust and insolent;
verses.pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;

verses.ar: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
verses.en: And the overturned towns He hurled down.
verses.tr: wa-l-muʾtafikaha ʾahwā
verses.abdelhaleem: that it was He who brought down the ruined cities
verses.pickthall: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed

verses.ar: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
verses.en: And covered them by that which He covered.
verses.tr: faghashāhā mā ghashā
verses.abdelhaleem: and enveloped them in the punishment He ordained for them?
verses.pickthall: So that there covered them that which did cover.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
verses.en: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbika tatamārā
verses.abdelhaleem: Which then of your Lord’s blessings do you deny?
verses.pickthall: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
verses.en: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.
verses.tr: hādhā nadhīrun mmina an-nudhuri al-ʾūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a warning just like the warnings sent in former times.
verses.pickthall: This is a warner of the warners of old.

verses.ar: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
verses.en: The Approaching Day has approached.
verses.tr: ʾazifati al-āzifahu
verses.abdelhaleem: The imminent Hour draws near
verses.pickthall: The threatened Hour is nigh.

verses.ar: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
verses.en: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.
verses.tr: laysa lahā min dūni Allāh kāshifahun
verses.abdelhaleem: and only God can disclose it.
verses.pickthall: None beside Allah can disclose it.

verses.ar: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
verses.en: Then at this statement do you wonder?
verses.tr: ʾafamin hādhā al-ḥadīthi taʿjabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you [people] marvel at this?
verses.pickthall: Marvel ye then at this statement,

verses.ar: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
verses.en: And you laugh and do not weep
verses.tr: wataḍḥakūna walā tabkūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why do you laugh instead of weeping?
verses.pickthall: And laugh and not weep,

verses.ar: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
verses.en: While you are proudly sporting?
verses.tr: wa-antum sāmidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why do you pay no heed?
verses.pickthall: While ye amuse yourselves?

verses.ar: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
verses.en: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].
verses.tr: fāsjudūā lillāh wāʿbudūā ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: Bow down before God and worship.
verses.pickthall: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.

verses.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.en: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
verses.tr: āqtarabati as-sāʿahu wānshaqqa al-qamaru
verses.abdelhaleem: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.
verses.pickthall: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.

verses.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
verses.en: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
verses.tr: wa-in yarawā āyahan yuʿriḍūā wayaqūlūā siḥrun mmustamirrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’
verses.pickthall: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.

verses.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.en: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
verses.tr: wakadhabūā wāttabaʿūā ʾahwāʾahum ۚ wakullu ʾamrin mmustaqirrun
verses.abdelhaleem: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––
verses.pickthall: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verses.en: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.
verses.tr: walaqad jāʾahum mmina al-ʾanbāʾi mā fīhi muzdajarun
verses.abdelhaleem: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––
verses.pickthall: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,

verses.ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.en: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
verses.tr: ḥikmahun bālighahun ۖ famā tughni an-nudhuru
verses.abdelhaleem: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:
verses.pickthall: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
verses.en: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
verses.tr: fatawalla ʿanhum ۘ yawma yadʿu ad-dāʿi ʾilā shāʾin nnukurin
verses.abdelhaleem: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,
verses.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.

verses.ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
verses.en: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
verses.tr: khushaʿan ʾabṣāruhum yakhrujūna mina al-ʾajdāthi kaʾannahum jarādun mmuntashirun
verses.abdelhaleem: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts
verses.pickthall: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,

verses.ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
verses.en: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
verses.tr: mmuhṭiʿīna ʾilā ad-dāʿi ۖ yaqūlu al-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasirun
verses.abdelhaleem: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’
verses.pickthall: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.

verses.ar: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verses.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
verses.tr: ۞ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhabūā ʿabdanā waqālūā majnūnun wāzdujira
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,
verses.pickthall: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.

verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verses.en: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
verses.tr: fadaʿā rabbahu ʾannā maghlūbun fāntaṣir
verses.abdelhaleem: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’
verses.pickthall: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.

verses.ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
verses.en: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
verses.tr: fafataḥnā ʾabwāba as-samāʾi bimāʾin mmunhamirin
verses.abdelhaleem: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,
verses.pickthall: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

verses.ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verses.en: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
verses.tr: wafajjarnā al-ʾarḍa ʿuyūnan fa-at-taqā al-māʾu ʿalā ʾamrin qad qudira
verses.abdelhaleem: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.
verses.pickthall: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.

verses.ar: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
verses.en: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
verses.tr: waḥamalnāhu ʿalā dhāti ʾalwāḥin wadusurin
verses.abdelhaleem: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails
verses.pickthall: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,

verses.ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.en: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
verses.tr: tajrā biʾaʿyuninā jazāʾan lliman kāna kufira
verses.abdelhaleem: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.
verses.pickthall: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.

verses.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
verses.tr: walaqad ttaraknāhā āyahan fahal min mmuddakirin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?
verses.pickthall: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.tr: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābā wanudhuri
verses.abdelhaleem: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
verses.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.tr: walaqad yassarnā al-qurāna lildhikri fahal min mmuddakirin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
verses.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.tr: kadhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābā wanudhuri
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
verses.pickthall: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾarsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fā yawmi naḥsin mmustamirrin
verses.abdelhaleem: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;
verses.pickthall: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,

verses.ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
verses.en: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
verses.tr: tanziʿu an-nāsa kaʾannahum ʾaʿjāzu nakhlin mmunqaʿirin
verses.abdelhaleem: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.
verses.pickthall: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.tr: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābā wanudhuri
verses.abdelhaleem: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
verses.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.tr: walaqad yassarnā al-qurāna lildhikri fahal min mmuddakirin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
verses.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.en: Thamūd denied the warning.
verses.tr: kadhabat thamūdu bi-an-nudhuri
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:
verses.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings

verses.ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.en: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
verses.tr: faqālūā ʾabasharan mminnā wāḥidan nnattabiʿuhu ʾinnā ʾidhan llafā ḍalālin wasuʿurin
verses.abdelhaleem: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!
verses.pickthall: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.

verses.ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
verses.en: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
verses.tr: ʾaʾulqāa adh-dhikru ʿalayhi min bayninā bal huwa kadhābun ʾashirun
verses.abdelhaleem: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’
verses.pickthall: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.

verses.ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verses.en: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
verses.tr: sayaʿlamūna ghadan mmani al-kadhābu al-ʾashiru
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,
verses.pickthall: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.

verses.ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verses.en: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
verses.tr: ʾinnā mursilūā an-nāqahi fitnahan llahum fārtaqibhum wāṣṭabir
verses.abdelhaleem: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;

verses.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
verses.en: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
verses.tr: wanabbiʾhum ʾanna al-māʾa qismahun baynahum ۖ kullu shirbin mmuḥtaḍarun
verses.abdelhaleem: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’
verses.pickthall: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.

verses.ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.en: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
verses.tr: fanādawā ṣāḥibahum fataʿāṭā faʿaqara
verses.abdelhaleem: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.
verses.pickthall: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.tr: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābā wanudhuri
verses.abdelhaleem: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
verses.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾarsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥahan wāḥidahan fakānūā kahashīmi al-muḥtaẓiri
verses.abdelhaleem: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.tr: walaqad yassarnā al-qurāna lildhikri fahal min mmuddakirin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
verses.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.en: The people of Lot denied the warning.
verses.tr: kadhabat qawmu lūṭin bi-an-nudhuri
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
verses.pickthall: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾarsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban ʾillā āla lūṭin ۖ nnajjaynāhum bisaḥarin
verses.abdelhaleem: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn
verses.pickthall: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,

verses.ar: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verses.en: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
verses.tr: nniʿmahan mmin ʿindinā ۚ kadhālika najzā man shakara
verses.abdelhaleem: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.
verses.pickthall: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.en: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾandharahum baṭshatanā fatamārawā bi-an-nudhuri
verses.abdelhaleem: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-
verses.pickthall: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
verses.tr: walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā ʾaʿyunahum fadhūqūā ʿadhābā wanudhuri
verses.abdelhaleem: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-
verses.pickthall: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.en: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
verses.tr: walaqad ṣabbaḥahum bukrahan ʿadhābun mmustaqirrun
verses.abdelhaleem: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-
verses.pickthall: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.

verses.ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: So taste My punishment and warning.
verses.tr: fadhūqūā ʿadhābā wanudhuri
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’
verses.pickthall: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.tr: walaqad yassarnā al-qurāna lildhikri fahal min mmuddakirin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
verses.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.en: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
verses.tr: walaqad jāʾa āla firʿawna an-nudhuru
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.
verses.pickthall: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

verses.ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.en: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
verses.tr: kadhabūā bāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum ʾakhdha ʿazīzin mmuqtadirin
verses.abdelhaleem: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.
verses.pickthall: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.

verses.ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.en: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?
verses.tr: ʾakuffārukum khayrun mmin ʾūlāʾikum ʾam lakum barāʾahun fā az-zuburi
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’
verses.pickthall: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
verses.en: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
verses.tr: ʾam yaqūlūna naḥnu jamīʿun mmuntaṣirun
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?
verses.pickthall: Or say they: We are a host victorious?

verses.ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.en: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
verses.tr: sayuhzamu al-jamʿu wayuwallūna ad-dubura
verses.abdelhaleem: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.
verses.pickthall: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.en: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
verses.tr: bali as-sāʿahu mawʿiduhum wa-as-sāʿahu ʾadhā wa-amarru
verses.abdelhaleem: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:
verses.pickthall: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness..
verses.tr: ʾinna al-mujrimīna fā ḍalālin wasuʿurin
verses.abdelhaleem: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––
verses.pickthall: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.en: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
verses.tr: yawma yusḥabūna fā an-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqūā massa saqara
verses.abdelhaleem: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’
verses.pickthall: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.

verses.ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
verses.en: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
verses.tr: ʾinnā kulla shāʾin khalaqnāhu biqadarin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have created all things in due measure;
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verses.en: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
verses.tr: wamā ʾamrunā ʾillā wāḥidahun kalamḥin bi-l-baṣari
verses.abdelhaleem: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;
verses.pickthall: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
verses.tr: walaqad ʾahlaknā ʾashyāʿakum fahal min mmuddakirin
verses.abdelhaleem: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?
verses.pickthall: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.en: And everything they did is in written records.
verses.tr: wakullu shāʾin faʿalūhu fā az-zuburi
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything they do is noted in their records:
verses.pickthall: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.en: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
verses.tr: wakullu ṣaghīrin wakabīrin mmustaṭarun
verses.abdelhaleem: every action, great or small, is recorded.
verses.pickthall: And every small and great thing is recorded.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
verses.tr: ʾinna al-muttaqīna fā jannātin wanaharin
verses.abdelhaleem: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers,
verses.pickthall: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,

verses.ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verses.en: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
verses.tr: fā maqʿadi ṣidqin ʿinda malīkin mmuqtadirin
verses.abdelhaleem: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign.
verses.pickthall: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
verses.en: The Most Merciful
verses.tr: ar-raḥmānu
verses.abdelhaleem: It is the Lord of Mercy
verses.pickthall: The Beneficent

verses.ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
verses.en: Taught the Qur’ān,
verses.tr: ʿallama al-qurāna
verses.abdelhaleem: who taught the Quran.
verses.pickthall: Hath made known the Qur'an.

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
verses.en: Created man,
verses.tr: khalaqa al-ʾinsāna
verses.abdelhaleem: He created man
verses.pickthall: He hath created man.

verses.ar: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
verses.en: [And] taught him eloquence.
verses.tr: ʿallamahu al-bayāna
verses.abdelhaleem: and taught him to communicate.
verses.pickthall: He hath taught him utterance.

verses.ar: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
verses.en: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
verses.tr: ash-shamsu wa-l-qamaru biḥusbānin
verses.abdelhaleem: The sun and the moon follow their calculated courses;
verses.pickthall: The sun and the moon are made punctual.

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
verses.en: And the stars and trees prostrate.
verses.tr: wa-an-najmu wa-ash-shajaru yasjudāni
verses.abdelhaleem: the plants and the trees submit to His designs;
verses.pickthall: The stars and the trees prostrate.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verses.en: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
verses.tr: wa-as-samāʾa rafaʿahā wawaḍaʿa al-mīzāna
verses.abdelhaleem: He has raised up the sky. He has set the balance
verses.pickthall: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,

verses.ar: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
verses.en: That you not transgress within the balance.
verses.tr: ʾallā taṭghawā fā al-mīzāni
verses.abdelhaleem: so that you may not exceed in the balance:
verses.pickthall: That ye exceed not the measure,

verses.ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verses.en: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
verses.tr: wa-aqīmūā al-wazna bi-l-qisṭi walā tukhsirūā al-mīzāna
verses.abdelhaleem: weigh with justice and do not fall short in the balance.
verses.pickthall: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
verses.en: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
verses.tr: wa-l-ʾarḍa waḍaʿahā lilʾanāmi
verses.abdelhaleem: He set down the Earth for His creatures,
verses.pickthall: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,

verses.ar: فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
verses.en: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
verses.tr: fīhā fākihahun wa-an-nakhlu dhātu al-ʾakmāmi
verses.abdelhaleem: with its fruits, its palm trees with sheathed clusters,
verses.pickthall: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,

verses.ar: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
verses.en: And grain having husks and scented plants.
verses.tr: wa-l-ḥabbu dhū al-ʿaṣfi wa-ar-rayḥānu
verses.abdelhaleem: its husked grain, its fragrant plants.
verses.pickthall: Husked grain and scented herb.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
verses.en: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
verses.tr: khalaqa al-ʾinsāna min ṣalṣālin ka-l-fakhāri
verses.abdelhaleem: He created mankind out of dried clay, like pottery,
verses.pickthall: He created man of clay like the potter's,

verses.ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
verses.en: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
verses.tr: wakhalaqa al-jānna min mmārijin mmin nnārin
verses.abdelhaleem: the jinn out of smokeless fire.
verses.pickthall: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
verses.en: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
verses.tr: rabbu al-mashriqayni warabbu al-maghribayni
verses.abdelhaleem: He is Lord of the two risings and Lord of the two settings.
verses.pickthall: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
verses.en: He released the two seas, meeting [one another];
verses.tr: maraja al-baḥrayni yaltaqiyāni
verses.abdelhaleem: He released the two bodies of [fresh and salt] water. They meet,
verses.pickthall: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.

verses.ar: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
verses.en: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.
verses.tr: baynahumā barzakhun llā yabghiyāni
verses.abdelhaleem: yet there is a barrier between them they do not cross.
verses.pickthall: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
verses.en: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
verses.tr: yakhruju minhumā al-luʾluʾu wa-l-marjānu
verses.abdelhaleem: Pearls come forth from them: large ones, and small, brilliant ones.
verses.pickthall: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
verses.en: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
verses.tr: walahu al-jawāri al-munshātu fā al-baḥri ka-l-ʾaʿlāmi
verses.abdelhaleem: His are the moving ships that float, high as mountains, on the sea.
verses.pickthall: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
verses.en: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,
verses.tr: kullu man ʿalayhā fānin
verses.abdelhaleem: Everyone on earth perishes;
verses.pickthall: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;

verses.ar: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.en: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
verses.tr: wayabqā wajhu rabbika dhū al-jalāli wa-l-ʾikrāmi
verses.abdelhaleem: all that remains is the Face of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
verses.pickthall: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
verses.en: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.
verses.tr: yasluhu man fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ kulla yawmin huwa fā shaʾnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Everyone in heaven and earth entreats Him; every day He is at work.
verses.pickthall: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
verses.en: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
verses.tr: sanafrughu lakum ʾayyuha ath-thaqalāni
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall attend to you two huge armies [of jinn and mankind].
verses.pickthall: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
verses.en: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].
verses.tr: yāmaʿshara al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi ʾini āstaṭaʿtum ʾan tanfudhūā min ʾaqṭāri as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi fānfudhūā ۚ lā tanfudhūna ʾillā bisulṭānin
verses.abdelhaleem: Jinn and mankind, if you can pass beyond the regions of heaven and earth, then do so: you will not pass without Our authority.
verses.pickthall: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
verses.en: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
verses.tr: yursalu ʿalaykumā shuwāẓun mmin nnārin wanuḥāsun falā tantaṣirāni
verses.abdelhaleem: A flash of fire and smoke will be released upon you and no one will come to your aid.
verses.pickthall: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
verses.en: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
verses.tr: fa-idhā ānshaqqati as-samāʾu fakānat wardahan ka-ad-dihāni
verses.abdelhaleem: When the sky is torn apart and turns crimson, like red hide.
verses.pickthall: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -

verses.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
verses.en: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
verses.tr: fayawmaʾidhin llā yuslu ʿan dhanbihi ʾinsun walā jānnun
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day neither mankind nor jinn will be asked about their sins.
verses.pickthall: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
verses.en: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
verses.tr: yuʿrafu al-mujrimūna bisīmāhum fayuʾkhadhu bi-an-nawāṣā wa-l-ʾaqdāmi
verses.abdelhaleem: The guilty will be known by their mark and will be seized by their foreheads and their feet.
verses.pickthall: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
verses.tr: hādhihi jahannamu at-tā yukadhibu bihā al-mujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is the Hell the guilty deny,
verses.pickthall: This is hell which the guilty deny.

verses.ar: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍ
verses.en: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
verses.tr: yaṭūfūna baynahā wabayna ḥamīmin ānin
verses.abdelhaleem: but they will go round between its flames and scalding water.
verses.pickthall: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
verses.en: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
verses.tr: waliman khāfa maqāma rabbihi jannatāni
verses.abdelhaleem: For those who fear [the time when they will] stand before their Lord there are two gardens.
verses.pickthall: But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍ
verses.en: Having [spreading] branches.
verses.tr: dhawātā ʾafnānin
verses.abdelhaleem: With shading branches.
verses.pickthall: Of spreading branches.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ
verses.en: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
verses.tr: fīhimā ʿaynāni tajriyāni
verses.abdelhaleem: With a pair of flowing springs.
verses.pickthall: Wherein are two fountains flowing.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ زَوْجَانِ
verses.en: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
verses.tr: fīhimā min kulli fākihahin zawjāni
verses.abdelhaleem: With every kind of fruit in pairs.
verses.pickthall: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ
verses.en: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
verses.tr: muttakīna ʿalā furushin baṭāʾinuhā min ʾistabraqin ۚ wajanā al-jannatayni dānin
verses.abdelhaleem: They will sit on couches upholstered with brocade, the fruit of both gardens within easy reach.
verses.pickthall: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِنَّ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
verses.en: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinnī -
verses.tr: fīhinna qāṣirātu aṭ-ṭarfi lam yaṭmithhunna ʾinsun qablahum walā jānnun
verses.abdelhaleem: There will be maidens restraining their glances, untouched beforehand by man or jinn.
verses.pickthall: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
verses.en: As if they were rubies and coral.
verses.tr: kaʾannahunna al-yāqūtu wa-l-marjānu
verses.abdelhaleem: Like rubies and brilliant pearls.
verses.pickthall: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَـٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَـٰنُ
verses.en: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
verses.tr: hal jazāʾu al-ʾiḥsāni ʾillā al-ʾiḥsānu
verses.abdelhaleem: Shall the reward of good be anything but good?
verses.pickthall: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
verses.en: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
verses.tr: wamin dūnihimā jannatāni
verses.abdelhaleem: There are two other gardens below these two.
verses.pickthall: And beside them are two other gardens,

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ
verses.en: Dark green [in color].
verses.tr: mudhāmmatāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Both of deepest green.
verses.pickthall: Dark green with foliage.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
verses.en: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
verses.tr: fīhimā ʿaynāni naḍḍākhatāni
verses.abdelhaleem: With a pair of gushing springs.
verses.pickthall: Wherein are two abundant springs.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِمَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ
verses.en: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
verses.tr: fīhimā fākihahun wanakhlun warummānun
verses.abdelhaleem: With fruits- date palms and pomegranate trees.
verses.pickthall: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌ
verses.en: In them are good and beautiful women -
verses.tr: fīhinna khayrātun ḥisānun
verses.abdelhaleem: There are good-natured, beautiful maidens.
verses.pickthall: Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful -

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -

verses.ar: حُورٌ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ
verses.en: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
verses.tr: ḥūrun mmaqṣūrātun fā al-khiyāmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Dark-eyed, sheltered in pavilions.
verses.pickthall: Fair ones, close-guarded in pavilions -

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -

verses.ar: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
verses.en: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -
verses.tr: lam yaṭmithhunna ʾinsun qablahum walā jānnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Untouched beforehand by man or jinn.
verses.pickthall: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them -

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍ
verses.en: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
verses.tr: muttakīna ʿalā rafrafin khuḍrin waʿabqarāin ḥisānin
verses.abdelhaleem: They will all sit on green cushions and fine carpets.
verses.pickthall: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.tr: fabiāi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
verses.abdelhaleem: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
verses.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

verses.ar: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.en: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
verses.tr: tabāraka āsmu rabbika dhā al-jalāli wa-l-ʾikrāmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
verses.pickthall: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!

verses.ar: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
verses.en: When the Occurrence occurs,
verses.tr: ʾidhā waqaʿati al-wāqiʿahu
verses.abdelhaleem: When that which is coming arrives,
verses.pickthall: When the event befalleth -

verses.ar: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
verses.en: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
verses.tr: laysa liwaqʿatihā kādhibahun
verses.abdelhaleem: no one will be able to deny it has come,
verses.pickthall: There is no denying that it will befall -

verses.ar: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
verses.en: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
verses.tr: khāfiḍahun rrāfiʿahun
verses.abdelhaleem: bringing low and raising high.
verses.pickthall: Abasing (some), exalting (others);

verses.ar: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
verses.en: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
verses.tr: ʾidhā rujjati al-ʾarḍu rajjan
verses.abdelhaleem: When the earth is shaken violently
