verses.pickthall: When the earth is shaken with a shock

verses.ar: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
verses.en: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
verses.tr: wabussati al-jibālu bassan
verses.abdelhaleem: and the mountains are ground to powder
verses.pickthall: And the hills are ground to powder

verses.ar: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
verses.en: And become dust dispersing,
verses.tr: fakānat habāʾan mmunbathan
verses.abdelhaleem: and turn to scattered dust,
verses.pickthall: So that they become a scattered dust,

verses.ar: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
verses.en: And you become [of] three kinds:
verses.tr: wakuntum ʾazwājan thalāthahan
verses.abdelhaleem: then you will be sorted into three classes.
verses.pickthall: And ye will be three kinds:

verses.ar: فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
verses.en: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
verses.tr: fa-aṣḥābu al-maymanahi mā ʾaṣḥābu al-maymanahi
verses.abdelhaleem: Those on the Right––what people they are!
verses.pickthall: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?

verses.ar: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
verses.en: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?
verses.tr: wa-aṣḥābu al-mashmahi mā ʾaṣḥābu al-mashmahi
verses.abdelhaleem: Those on the Left––what people they are!
verses.pickthall: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
verses.en: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
verses.tr: wa-as-sābiqūna as-sābiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And those in front––ahead indeed!
verses.pickthall: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.en: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika al-muqarrabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: For these will be the ones brought nearest to God
verses.pickthall: Those are they who will be brought nigh

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
verses.tr: fā jannāti an-naʿīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: in Gardens of Bliss:
verses.pickthall: In gardens of delight;

verses.ar: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: A [large] company of the former peoples
verses.tr: thullahun mmina al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: many from the past
verses.pickthall: A multitude of those of old

verses.ar: وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And a few of the later peoples,
verses.tr: waqalīlun mmina al-ākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and a few from later generations.
verses.pickthall: And a few of those of later time.

verses.ar: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّوْضُونَةٍ
verses.en: On thrones woven [with ornament],
verses.tr: ʿalā sururin mmawḍūnahin
verses.abdelhaleem: On couches of well-woven cloth
verses.pickthall: On lined couches,

verses.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.en: Reclining on them, facing each other.
verses.tr: mmuttakīna ʿalayhā mutaqābilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: they will sit facing each other;
verses.pickthall: Reclining therein face to face.

verses.ar: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
verses.en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.
verses.tr: yaṭūfu ʿalayhim wildānun mmukhalladūna
verses.abdelhaleem: everlasting youths will go round among them
verses.pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths

verses.ar: بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ
verses.en: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
verses.tr: biʾakwābin wa-abārīqa wakaʾsin mmin mmaʿīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: with glasses, flagons, and cups of a pure drink
verses.pickthall: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring

verses.ar: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
verses.en: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
verses.tr: llā yuṣaddaʿūna ʿanhā walā yunzifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: that causes no headache or intoxication;
verses.pickthall: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,

verses.ar: وَفَـٰكِهَةٍ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
verses.en: And fruit of what they select
verses.tr: wafākihahin mmimmā yatakhayyarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [there will be] any fruit they choose;
verses.pickthall: And fruit that they prefer

verses.ar: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.en: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
verses.tr: walaḥmi ṭayrin mmimmā yashtahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the meat of any bird they like;
verses.pickthall: And flesh of fowls that they desire.

verses.ar: وَحُورٌ عِينٌ
verses.en: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
verses.tr: waḥūrun ʿīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: and beautiful companions
verses.pickthall: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,

verses.ar: كَأَمْثَـٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ
verses.en: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
verses.tr: kaʾamthāli al-luʾluʾi al-maknūni
verses.abdelhaleem: like hidden pearls:
verses.pickthall: Like unto hidden pearls,

verses.ar: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: As reward for what they used to do.
verses.tr: jazāʾan bimā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: a reward for what they used to do.
verses.pickthall: Reward for what they used to do.

verses.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
verses.en: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
verses.tr: lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā taʾthīman
verses.abdelhaleem: They will hear no idle or sinful talk there,
verses.pickthall: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination

verses.ar: إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَـٰمًا سَلَـٰمًا
verses.en: Only a saying [of] peace, peace.
verses.tr: ʾillā qīlan salāman salāman
verses.abdelhaleem: only clean and wholesome speech.
verses.pickthall: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.

verses.ar: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
verses.tr: wa-aṣḥābu al-yamīni mā ʾaṣḥābu al-yamīni
verses.abdelhaleem: Those on the Right, what people they are!
verses.pickthall: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?

verses.ar: فِى سِدْرٍ مَّخْضُودٍ
verses.en: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed.
verses.tr: fā sidrin mmakhḍūdin
verses.abdelhaleem: They will dwell amid thornless lote trees
verses.pickthall: Among thornless lote-trees

verses.ar: وَطَلْحٍ مَّنضُودٍ
verses.en: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit].
verses.tr: waṭalḥin mmanḍūdin
verses.abdelhaleem: and clustered acacia
verses.pickthall: And clustered plantains,

verses.ar: وَظِلٍّ مَّمْدُودٍ
verses.en: And shade extended.
verses.tr: waẓillin mmamdūdin
verses.abdelhaleem: with spreading shade,
verses.pickthall: And spreading shade,

verses.ar: وَمَآءٍ مَّسْكُوبٍ
verses.en: And water poured out
verses.tr: wamāʾin mmaskūbin
verses.abdelhaleem: constantly flowing water,
verses.pickthall: And water gushing,

verses.ar: وَفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ
verses.en: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
verses.tr: wafākihahin kathīrahin
verses.abdelhaleem: abundant fruits,
verses.pickthall: And fruit in plenty

verses.ar: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ
verses.en: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
verses.tr: llā maqṭūʿahin walā mamnūʿahin
verses.abdelhaleem: unfailing, unforbidden,
verses.pickthall: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,

verses.ar: وَفُرُشٍ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ
verses.en: And [upon] beds raised high.
verses.tr: wafurushin mmarfūʿahin
verses.abdelhaleem: with incomparable companions
verses.pickthall: And raised couches;

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءً
verses.en: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾanshaʾnāhunna ʾinshāʾan
verses.abdelhaleem: We have specially created––
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation

verses.ar: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا
verses.en: And made them virgins,
verses.tr: fajaʿalnāhunna ʾabkāran
verses.abdelhaleem: virginal,
verses.pickthall: And made them virgins,

verses.ar: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا
verses.en: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
verses.tr: ʿuruban ʾatrāban
verses.abdelhaleem: loving, of matching age––
verses.pickthall: Lovers, friends,

verses.ar: لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: For the companions of the right [who are]
verses.tr: lliʾaṣḥābi al-yamīni
verses.abdelhaleem: for those on the Right,
verses.pickthall: For those on the right hand;

verses.ar: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: A company of the former peoples
verses.tr: thullahun mmina al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: many from the past
verses.pickthall: A multitude of those of old

verses.ar: وَثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And a company of the later peoples.
verses.tr: wathullahun mmina al-ākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and many from later generations.
verses.pickthall: And a multitude of those of later time.

verses.ar: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
verses.en: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
verses.tr: wa-aṣḥābu ash-shimāli mā ʾaṣḥābu ash-shimāli
verses.abdelhaleem: But those on the Left, what people they are!
verses.pickthall: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?

verses.ar: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
verses.en: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
verses.tr: fā samūmin waḥamīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: They will dwell amid scorching wind and scalding water
verses.pickthall: In scorching wind and scalding water

verses.ar: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
verses.en: And a shade of black smoke,
verses.tr: waẓillin mmin yaḥmūmin
verses.abdelhaleem: in the shadow of black smoke,
verses.pickthall: And shadow of black smoke,

verses.ar: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: Neither cool nor beneficial.
verses.tr: llā bāridin walā karīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: neither cool nor refreshing.
verses.pickthall: Neither cool nor refreshing.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
verses.en: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
verses.tr: ʾinnahum kānūā qabla dhālika mutrafīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Before, they overindulged in luxury
verses.pickthall: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury

verses.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: And they used to persist in the great violation,
verses.tr: wakānūā yuṣirrūna ʿalā al-ḥinthi al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: and persisted in great sin,
verses.pickthall: And used to persist in the awful sin.

verses.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.en: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
verses.tr: wakānūā yaqūlūna ʾaʾidhā mitnā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman ʾaʾinnā lamabʿūthūna
verses.abdelhaleem: always saying, ‘What? When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then be raised up?
verses.pickthall: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,

verses.ar: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.en: And our forefathers [as well]?"
verses.tr: ʾawaābāʾunā al-ʾawwalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And our earliest forefathers too?’
verses.pickthall: And also our forefathers?

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples
verses.tr: qul ʾinna al-ʾawwalīna wa-l-ākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘The earliest and latest generations
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time

verses.ar: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.en: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
verses.tr: lamajmūʿūna ʾilā mīqāti yawmin mmaʿlūmin
verses.abdelhaleem: will all be gathered on a predetermined Day
verses.pickthall: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
verses.tr: thumma ʾinnakum ʾayyuhā aḍ-ḍāllūna al-mukadhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and you who have gone astray and denied the truth
verses.pickthall: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,

verses.ar: لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍ مِّن زَقُّومٍ
verses.en: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm
verses.tr: lākilūna min shajarin mmin zaqqūmin
verses.abdelhaleem: will eat from the bitter tree of Zaqqum,
verses.pickthall: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum

verses.ar: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
verses.en: And filling with it your bellies
verses.tr: famāliwna minhā al-buṭūna
verses.abdelhaleem: filling your bellies with it,
verses.pickthall: And will fill your bellies therewith;

verses.ar: فَشَـٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.en: And drinking on top of it from scalding water.
verses.tr: fashāribūna ʿalayhi mina al-ḥamīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: and drink scalding water,
verses.pickthall: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,

verses.ar: فَشَـٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ
verses.en: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
verses.tr: fashāribūna shurba al-hīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: lapping it like thirsty camels.’
verses.pickthall: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
verses.tr: hādhā nuzuluhum yawma ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgement.
verses.pickthall: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.

verses.ar: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
verses.en: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
verses.tr: naḥnu khalaqnākum falawlā tuṣaddiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It was We who created you: will you not believe?
verses.pickthall: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ
verses.en: Have you seen that which you emit?
verses.tr: ʾafaraʾaytum mmā tumnūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Consider [the semen] you eject-
verses.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye emit?

verses.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
verses.en: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
verses.tr: ʾaʾantum takhluqūnahu ʾam naḥnu al-khāliqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: do you create it yourselves or are We the Creator?
verses.pickthall: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?

verses.ar: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verses.en: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
verses.tr: naḥnu qaddarnā baynakumu al-mawta wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We ordained death to be among you. Nothing could stop Us
verses.pickthall: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,

verses.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَـٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
verses.tr: ʿalā ʾan nnubaddila ʾamthālakum wanunshiʾakum fā mā lā taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: if We intended to change you and recreate you in a way unknown to you.
verses.pickthall: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
verses.tr: walaqad ʿalimtumu an-nashʾaha al-ʾūlā falawlā tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You have learned how you were first created: will you not reflect?
verses.pickthall: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ
verses.en: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
verses.tr: ʾafaraʾaytum mmā taḥruthūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Consider the seeds you sow in the ground-
verses.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?

verses.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ
verses.en: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
verses.tr: ʾaʾantum tazraʿūnahu ʾam naḥnu az-zāriʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: is it you who make them grow or We?
verses.pickthall: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?

verses.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ حُطَـٰمًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
verses.en: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
verses.tr: law nashāʾu lajaʿalnāhu ḥuṭāman faẓaltum tafakkahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If We wished, We could turn your harvest into chaff and leave you to wail,
verses.pickthall: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:

verses.ar: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ
verses.en: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
verses.tr: ʾinnā lamughramūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘We are burdened with debt;
verses.pickthall: Lo! we are laden with debt!

verses.ar: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
verses.en: Rather, we have been deprived."
verses.tr: bal naḥnu maḥrūmūna
verses.abdelhaleem: we are bereft.’
verses.pickthall: Nay, but we are deprived!

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ
verses.en: And have you seen the water that you drink?
verses.tr: ʾafaraʾaytumu al-māʾa adh-dhā tashrabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Consider the water you drink-
verses.pickthall: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?

verses.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
verses.en: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
verses.tr: ʾaʾantum ʾanzaltumūhu mina al-muzni ʾam naḥnu al-munzilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: was it you who brought it down from the rain-cloud or We?
verses.pickthall: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?

verses.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
verses.tr: law nashāʾu jaʿalnāhu ʾujājan falawlā tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If We wanted, We could make it bitter: will you not be thankful?
verses.pickthall: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى تُورُونَ
verses.en: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
verses.tr: ʾafaraʾaytumu an-nāra at-tā tūrūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Consider the fire you kindle-
verses.pickthall: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;

verses.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ
verses.en: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
verses.tr: ʾaʾantum ʾanshaʾtum shajaratahā ʾam naḥnu al-munshiwna
verses.abdelhaleem: is it you who make the wood for it grow or We?
verses.pickthall: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?

verses.ar: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَـٰهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَمَتَـٰعًا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ
verses.en: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
verses.tr: naḥnu jaʿalnāhā tadhkirahan wamatāʿan llilmuqwīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We made it a reminder, and useful to those who kindle it,
verses.pickthall: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
verses.tr: fasabbiḥ bāsmi rabbika al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: so [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Supreme.
verses.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.

verses.ar: ۞ فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.en: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
verses.tr: ۞ falā ʾuqsimu bimawāqiʿi an-nujūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: I swear by the positions of the stars-
verses.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٌ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
verses.tr: wa-innahu laqasamun llaw taʿlamūna ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: a mighty oath, if you only knew-
verses.pickthall: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرْءَانٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu laqurānun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: that this is truly a noble Quran,
verses.pickthall: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an

verses.ar: فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مَّكْنُونٍ
verses.en: In a Register well-protected;.
verses.tr: fā kitābin mmaknūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: in a protected Record
verses.pickthall: In a Book kept hidden

verses.ar: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ
verses.en: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].
verses.tr: llā yamassuhu ʾillā al-muṭahharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: that only the purified can touch,
verses.pickthall: Which none toucheth save the purified,

verses.ar: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: tanzīlun mmin rrabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: sent down from the Lord of all being.
verses.pickthall: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: أَفَبِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ
verses.en: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
verses.tr: ʾafabihādhā al-ḥadīthi ʾantum mmudhinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: How can you scorn this statement?
verses.pickthall: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,

verses.ar: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
verses.tr: watajʿalūna rizqakum ʾannakum tukadhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: And how, in return for the livelihood you are given, can you deny it?
verses.pickthall: And make denial thereof your livelihood?

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ
verses.en: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat
verses.tr: falawlā ʾidhā balaghati al-ḥulqūma
verses.abdelhaleem: When the soul of a dying man comes up to his throat
verses.pickthall: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)

verses.ar: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: And you are at that time looking on -
verses.tr: wa-antum ḥīnaʾidhin tanẓurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: while you gaze on-
verses.pickthall: And ye are at that moment looking

verses.ar: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
verses.tr: wanaḥnu ʾaqrabu ʾilayhi minkum walākin llā tubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We are nearer to him than you, though you do not see Us-
verses.pickthall: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ
verses.en: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
verses.tr: falawlā ʾin kuntum ghayra madīnīna
verses.abdelhaleem: why, if you are not to be judged,
verses.pickthall: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),

verses.ar: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
verses.tr: tarjiʿūnahā ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: do you not restore his soul to him, if what you say is true?
verses.pickthall: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?

verses.ar: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.en: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],
verses.tr: fa-ammā ʾin kāna mina al-muqarrabīna
verses.abdelhaleem: If that dying person is one of those who will be brought near to God,
verses.pickthall: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,

verses.ar: فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ
verses.en: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
verses.tr: farawḥun warayḥānun wajannatu naʿīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: he will have rest, ease, and a Garden of Bliss;
verses.pickthall: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: And if he was of the companions of the right,
verses.tr: wa-ammā ʾin kāna min ʾaṣḥābi al-yamīni
verses.abdelhaleem: if he is one of those on the Right,
verses.pickthall: And if he is of those on the right hand,

verses.ar: فَسَلَـٰمٌ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
verses.tr: fasalāmun llaka min ʾaṣḥābi al-yamīni
verses.abdelhaleem: [he will hear], ‘Peace be on you,’ from his companions on the Right;
verses.pickthall: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.en: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
verses.tr: wa-ammā ʾin kāna mina al-mukadhibīna aḍ-ḍāllīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but if he is one of those who denied the truth and went astray,
verses.pickthall: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,

verses.ar: فَنُزُلٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
verses.en: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
verses.tr: fanuzulun mmin ḥamīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: he will be welcomed with scalding water.
verses.pickthall: Then the welcome will be boiling water

verses.ar: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
verses.en: And burning in Hellfire.
verses.tr: wataṣliyahu jaḥīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: He will burn in Hell.
verses.pickthall: And roasting at hell-fire.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verses.en: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā lahuwa ḥaqqu al-yaqīni
verses.abdelhaleem: This is the certain truth:
verses.pickthall: Lo! this is certain truth.

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
verses.tr: fasabbiḥ bāsmi rabbika al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Supreme.
verses.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.

verses.ar: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: sabbaḥa lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God––He is the Almighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
verses.tr: lahu mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ yuḥāi wayumītu ۖ wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Control of the heavens and earth belongs to Him; He gives life and death; He has power over all things.
verses.pickthall: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرُ وَٱلظَّـٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
verses.tr: huwa al-ʾawwalu wa-l-ākhiru wa-aẓ-ẓāhiru wa-l-bāṭinu ۖ wahuwa bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: He is the First and the Last; the Outer and the Inner; He has knowledge of all things.
verses.pickthall: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa fā sittahi ʾayyāmin thumma āstawā ʿalā al-ʿarshi ۚ yaʿlamu mā yaliju fā al-ʾarḍi wamā yakhruju minhā wamā yanzilu mina as-samāʾi wamā yaʿruju fīhā ۖ wahuwa maʿakum ʾayna mā kuntum ۚ wallāh bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: It was He who created the heavens and earth in six Days and then established Himself on the throne. He knows what enters the earth and what comes out of it; what descends from the sky and what ascends to it. He is with you wherever you are; He sees all that you do;
verses.pickthall: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.en: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.
verses.tr: llahu mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ wa-ʾilā Allāh turjaʿu al-ʾumūru
verses.abdelhaleem: control of the heavens and earth belongs to Him. Everything is brought back to God.
verses.pickthall: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back.

verses.ar: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.tr: yūliju al-yla fā an-nahāri wayūliju an-nahāra fā al-yli ۚ wahuwa ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: He makes night merge into day and day into night. He knows what is in every heart.
verses.pickthall: He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts.

verses.ar: ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.en: Believe in Allāh and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.
verses.tr: āminūā billāh warasūlihi wa-anfiqūā mimmā jaʿalakum mmustakhlafīna fīhi ۖ fa-adh-dhīna āmanūā minkum wa-anfaqūā lahum ʾajrun kabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Believe in God and His Messenger, and give out of what He has made pass down to you: those of you who believe and give will have a great reward.
verses.pickthall: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great reward.

verses.ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَـٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And why do you not believe in Allāh while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?
verses.tr: wamā lakum lā tuʾminūna billāh ۙ wa-ar-rasūlu yadʿūkum lituʾminūā birabbikum waqad ʾakhadha mīthāqakum ʾin kuntum mmuʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Why should you not believe in God when the Mes-senger calls you to believe in your Lord, and He has already made a pledge with you, if you have faith?
verses.pickthall: What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers?

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muḥammad (ﷺ)] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allāh is to you Kind and Merciful.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā yunazzilu ʿalā ʿabdihi āyātin bayyinātin lliyukhrijakum mmina aẓ-ẓulumāti ʾilā an-nūri ۚ wa-inna Allāh bikum laraʾūfun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who has sent down clear revelations to His Servant, so that He may bring you from the depths of darkness into light; God is truly kind and merciful to you.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَـٰتَلَ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَـٰتَلُوا۟ ۚ وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allāh while to Allāh belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allāh has promised the best [reward]. And Allāh, of what you do, is Aware.
verses.tr: wamā lakum ʾallā tunfiqūā fā sabīli Allāh wa-lillāh mīrāthu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ lā yastawā minkum mman ʾanfaqa min qabli al-fatḥi waqātala ۚ ʾūlāʾika ʾaʿẓamu darajahan mmina adh-dhīna ʾanfaqūā min baʿdu waqātalūā ۚ wakullan waʿada Allāh al-ḥusnā ۚ wallāh bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Why should you not give for God’s cause when God alone will inherit what is in the heavens and earth? Those who gave and fought before the triumph are not like others: they are greater in rank than those who gave and fought afterwards. But God has promised a good reward to all of them: God is fully aware of all that you do.
verses.pickthall: And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.

verses.ar: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَـٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
verses.tr: mman dhā adh-dhā yuqriḍu Allāh qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍāʿifahu lahu walahu ʾajrun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Who will make God a good loan? He will double it for him and reward him generously.
verses.pickthall: Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him and his may be a rich reward?

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَـٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.en: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.
verses.tr: yawma tarā al-muʾminīna wa-l-muʾmināti yasʿā nūruhum bayna ʾaydīhim wabiʾaymānihim bushrākumu al-yawma jannātun tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ۚ dhālika huwa al-fawzu al-ʿaẓīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when you [Prophet] see the believers, both men and women, with their light streaming out ahead of them and to their right, [they will be told], ‘The good news for you today is that there are Gardens graced with flowing streams where you will stay: that is truly the supreme triumph!’
verses.pickthall: On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَـٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ
verses.en: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
verses.tr: yawma yaqūlu al-munāfiqūna wa-l-munāfiqātu lilladhīna āmanūā ānẓurūnā naqtabis min nnūrikum qīla ārjiʿūā warāʾakum fa-at-tamisūā nūran faḍuriba baynahum bisūrin llahu bābun bāṭinuhu fīhi ar-raḥmahu waẓāhiruhu min qibalihi al-ʿadhābu
verses.abdelhaleem: On the same Day, the hypocrites, both men and women, will say to the believers, ‘Wait for us! Let us have some of your light!’ They will be told, ‘Go back and look for a light.’ A wall with a door will be erected between them: inside it lies mercy, outside lies torment.
verses.pickthall: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom.

verses.ar: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
verses.en: They [i.e., the hypocrites] will call to them [i.e., the believers], "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allāh. And the Deceiver [i.e., Satan] deceived you concerning Allāh.
verses.tr: yunādūnahum ʾalam nakun mmaʿakum ۖ qālūā balā walākinnakum fatantum ʾanfusakum watarabbaṣtum wārtabtum wagharratkumu al-ʾamānāu ḥattā jāʾa ʾamru Allāh wagharrakum billāh al-gharūru
verses.abdelhaleem: The hypocrites will call out to the believers, ‘Were we not with you?’ They will reply, ‘Yes. But you allowed yourselves to be tempted, you were hesitant, doubtful, deceived by false hopes until God’s command came- the Deceiver tricked you about God.
verses.pickthall: They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you? They will say: Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah;

verses.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination."
verses.tr: fa-l-yawma lā yuʾkhadhu minkum fidyahun walā mina adh-dhīna kafarūā ۚ maʾwākumu an-nāru ۖ hāa mawlākum ۖ wabiʾsa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Today no ransom will be accepted from you or from the disbelievers: your home is the Fire- that is where you belong––a miserable destination!’
verses.pickthall: So this day no ransom can be taken from you nor from those who disbelieved. Your home is the Fire; that is your patron, and a hapless journey's end.

verses.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allāh and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾalam yaʾni lilladhīna āmanūā ʾan takhshaʿa qulūbuhum lidhikri Allāh wamā nazala mina al-ḥaqqi walā yakūnūā ka-adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-kitāba min qablu faṭāla ʿalayhimu al-ʾamadu faqasat qulūbuhum ۖ wakathīrun mminhum fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Is it not time for believers to humble their hearts to the remembrance of God and the Truth that has been revealed, and not to be like those who received the Scripture before them, whose time was extended but whose hearts hardened and many of whom were lawbreakers?
verses.pickthall: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers.

verses.ar: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Know that Allāh gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.
verses.tr: āʿlamūā ʾanna Allāh yuḥāi al-ʾarḍa baʿda mawtihā ۚ qad bayyannā lakumu al-āyāti laʿallakum taʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Remember that God revives the earth after it dies; We have made Our revelation clear to you so that you may use your reason.
verses.pickthall: Know that Allah quickeneth the earth after its death. We have made clear Our revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَـٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَـٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allāh a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.
verses.tr: ʾinna al-muṣṣaddiqīna wa-l-muṣṣaddiqāti wa-aqraḍūā Allāh qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿafu lahum walahum ʾajrun karīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Charitable men and women who make a good loan to God will have it doubled and have a generous reward.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who give alms, both men and women, and lend unto Allah a goodly loan, it will be doubled for them, and theirs will be a rich reward.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: And those who have believed in Allāh and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā billāh warusulihi ʾūlāʾika humu aṣ-ṣiddīqūna ۖ wa-ash-shuhadāʾu ʿinda rabbihim lahum ʾajruhum wanūruhum ۖ wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā wakadhabūā bāyātinā ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who believe in God and His messengers are the truthful ones who will bear witness before their Lord: they will have their reward and their light. But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations are the inhabitants of Hell.
verses.pickthall: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.

verses.ar: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَـٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَـٰمًا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ
verses.en: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allāh and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.
verses.tr: āʿlamūā ʾannamā al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā laʿibun walahwun wazīnahun watafākhurun baynakum watakāthurun fā al-ʾamwāli wa-l-ʾawlādi ۖ kamathali ghaythin ʾaʿjaba al-kuffāra nabātuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣfarran thumma yakūnu ḥuṭāman ۖ wafā al-ākhirahi ʿadhābun shadīdun wamaghfirahun mmina Allāh wariḍwānun ۚ wamā al-ḥayawāhu ad-dunyā ʾillā matāʿu al-ghurūri
verses.abdelhaleem: Bear in mind that the present life is just a game, a diversion, an attraction, a cause of boasting among you, of rivalry in wealth and children. It is like plants that spring up after the rain: their growth at first delights the sowers, but then you see them wither away, turn yellow, and become stubble. There is terrible punishment in the next life as well as forgiveness and approval from God; the life of this world is only an illusory pleasure.
verses.pickthall: Know that the life of the world is only play, and idle talk, and pageantry, and boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children; as the likeness of vegetation after rain, whereof the growth is pleasing to the husbandman, but afterward it drieth up and thou seest it turning yellow, then it becometh straw. And in the Hereafter there is grievous punishment, and (also) forgiveness from Allah and His good pleasure, whereas the life of the world is but matter of illusion.

verses.ar: سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: Race [i.e., compete] toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allāh and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allāh which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
verses.tr: sābiqūā ʾilā maghfirahin mmin rrabbikum wajannahin ʿarḍuhā kaʿarḍi as-samāʾi wa-l-ʾarḍi ʾuʿiddat lilladhīna āmanūā billāh warusulihi ۚ dhālika faḍlu Allāh yuʾtīhi man yashāʾu ۚ wallāh dhū al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: So race for your Lord’s forgiveness and a Garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believe in God and His messengers: that is God’s bounty, which He bestows on whoever He pleases. God’s bounty is infinite.
verses.pickthall: Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

verses.ar: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verses.en: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allāh, is easy -
verses.tr: mā ʾaṣāba min mmuṣībahin fā al-ʾarḍi walā fā ʾanfusikum ʾillā fā kitābin mmin qabli ʾan nnabraʾahā ۚ ʾinna dhālika ʿalā Allāh yasīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: No misfortune can happen, either in the earth or in yourselves, that was not set down in writing before We brought it into being- that is easy for God-
verses.pickthall: Naught of disaster befalleth in the earth or in yourselves but it is in a Book before we bring it into being - Lo! that is easy for Allah -

verses.ar: لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
verses.en: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -
verses.tr: llikaylā taʾsawā ʿalā mā fātakum walā tafraḥūā bimā ātākum ۗ wallāh lā yuḥibbu kulla mukhtālin fakhūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: so you need not grieve for what you miss or gloat over what you gain. God does not love the conceited, the boastful,
verses.pickthall: That ye grieve not for the sake of that which hath escaped you, nor yet exult because of that which hath been given. Allah loveth not all prideful boasters,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبُخْلِ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.en: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yabkhalūna wayaʾmurūna an-nāsa bi-l-bukhli ۗ waman yatawalla fa-inna Allāh huwa al-ghanāu al-ḥamīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: those who are miserly, and who tell other people to be miserly. If anyone turns away, remember that God is self-sufficient and worthy of praise.
verses.pickthall: Who hoard and who enjoin upon the people avarice. And whosoever turneth away, still Allah is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
verses.en: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allāh may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
verses.tr: laqad ʾarsalnā rusulanā bi-l-bayyināti wa-anzalnā maʿahumu al-kitāba wa-l-mīzāna liyaqūma an-nāsu bi-l-qisṭi ۖ wa-anzalnā al-ḥadīda fīhi baʾsun shadīdun wamanāfiʿu lilnnāsi waliyaʿlama Allāh man yanṣuruhu warusulahu bi-l-ghaybi ۚ ʾinna Allāh qawāun ʿazīzun
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Our messengers with clear signs, the Scripture and the Balance, so that people could uphold justice: We also sent iron, with its mighty strength and many uses for mankind, so that God could mark out those who would help Him and His messengers though they cannot see Him. Truly God is powerful, almighty.
verses.pickthall: We verily sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may observe right measure; and He revealed iron, wherein is mighty power and (many) uses for mankind, and that Allah may know him who helpeth Him and His messengers, though unseen. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: walaqad ʾarsalnā nūḥan wa-ibrāhīma wajaʿalnā fā dhurriyyatihimā an-nubuwwaha wa-l-kitāba ۖ faminhum mmuhtadin ۖ wakathīrun mminhum fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Noah and Abraham, and gave prophethood and scripture to their offspring: among them there were some who were rightly guided, but many were lawbreakers.
verses.pickthall: And We verily sent Noah and Abraham and placed the prophethood and the scripture among their seed, and among them there is he who goeth right, but many of them are evil-livers.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ٱبْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَـٰهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا ۖ فَـَٔاتَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: Then We sent following their footsteps [i.e., traditions] Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allāh. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: thumma qaffaynā ʿalā āthārihim birusulinā waqaffaynā biʿīsā ābni maryama wataynāhu al-ʾinjīla wajaʿalnā fā qulūbi adh-dhīna āttabaʿūhu raʾfahan waraḥmahan warahbāniyyahan ābtadaʿūhā mā katabnāhā ʿalayhim ʾillā ābtighāʾa riḍwāni Allāh famā raʿawhā ḥaqqa riʿāyatihā ۖ fātaynā adh-dhīna āmanūā minhum ʾajrahum ۖ wakathīrun mminhum fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent other messengers to follow in their footsteps. After those We sent Jesus, son of Mary: We gave him the Gospel and put compassion and mercy into the hearts of his followers. But monasticism was something they invented- We did not ordain it for them- only to seek God’s pleasure, and even so, they did not observe it properly. So We gave a reward to those of them who believed, but many of them were lawbreakers.
verses.pickthall: Then We caused Our messengers to follow in their footsteps; and We caused Jesus, son of Mary, to follow, and gave him the Gospel, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. But monasticism they invented - We ordained it not for them - only seeking Allah's pleasure, and they observed it not with right observance. So We give those of them who believe their reward, but many of them are evil-livers.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā āttaqūā Allāh waminūā birasūlihi yuʾtikum kiflayni min rraḥmatihi wayajʿal llakum nūran tamshūna bihi wayaghfir lakum ۚ wallāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, be mindful of God and have faith in His Messenger: He will give you a double share of His mercy; He will provide a light to help you walk; He will forgive you- God is most forgiving, most merciful.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Be mindful of your duty to Allah and put faith in His messenger. He will give you twofold of His mercy and will appoint for you a light wherein ye shall walk, and will forgive you. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful;

verses.ar: لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ مِّن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allāh and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allāh; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
verses.tr: lliʾallā yaʿlama ʾahlu al-kitābi ʾallā yaqdirūna ʿalā shāʾin mmin faḍli Allāh ۙ wa-anna al-faḍla biyadi Allāh yuʾtīhi man yashāʾu ۚ wallāh dhū al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: The People of the Book should know that they have no power over any of God’s grace and that grace is in the hand of God alone: He gives it to whoever He will. God’s grace is truly immense.
verses.pickthall: That the People of the Scripture may know that they control naught of the bounty of Allah, but that the bounty is in Allah's hand to give to whom He will. And Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

verses.ar: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
verses.tr: qad samiʿa Allāh qawla at-tā tujādiluka fā zawjihā watashtakā ʾilā Allāh wallāh yasmaʿu taḥāwurakumā ۚ ʾinna Allāh samīʿun baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: God has heard the words of the woman who disputed with you [Prophet] about her husband and complained to God: God has heard what you both had to say. He is all hearing, all seeing.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath heard the saying of her that disputeth with thee (Muhammad) concerning her husband, and complaineth unto Allah. And Allah heareth your colloquy. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَـٰتِهِمْ ۖ إِنْ أُمَّهَـٰتُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
verses.en: Those who pronounce ẓihār among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yuẓāhirūna minkum mmin nnisāʾihim mmā hunna ʾummahātihim ۖ ʾin ʾummahātuhum ʾillā al-ā waladnahum ۚ wa-innahum layaqūlūna munkaran mmina al-qawli wazūran ۚ wa-inna Allāh laʿafuwwun ghafūrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Even if any of you say to their wives, ‘You are to me like my mother’s back,’they are not their mothers; their only mothers are those who gave birth to them. What they say is certainly blameworthy and false, but God is pardoning and forgiving.
verses.pickthall: Such of you as put away your wives (by saying they are as their mothers) - They are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave them birth - they indeed utter an ill word and a lie. And lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا۟ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: And those who pronounce ẓihār from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allāh is Aware of what you do.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yuẓāhirūna min nnisāʾihim thumma yaʿūdūna limā qālūā fataḥrīru raqabahin mmin qabli ʾan yatamāssā ۚ dhālikum tūʿaẓūna bihi ۚ wallāh bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those of you who say such a thing to their wives, then go back on what they have said, must free a slave before the couple may touch one another again––this is what you are commanded to do, and God is fully aware of what you do––
verses.pickthall: Those who put away their wives (by saying they are as their mothers) and afterward would go back on that which they have said, (the penalty) in that case (is) the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. Unto this ye are exhorted; and Allah is Informed of what ye do.

verses.ar: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allāh and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
verses.tr: faman llam yajid faṣiyāmu shahrayni mutatābiʿayni min qabli ʾan yatamāssā ۖ faman llam yastaṭiʿ fa-iṭʿāmu sittīna miskīnan ۚ dhālika lituʾminūā billāh warasūlihi ۚ watilka ḥudūdu Allāh ۗ walilkāfirīna ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: but anyone who does not have the means should fast continuously for two months before they touch each other, and anyone unable to do this should feed sixty needy people. This is so that you may [truly] have faith in God and His Messenger. These are the bounds set by God: grievous torment awaits those who ignore them.
verses.pickthall: And he who findeth not (the wherewithal), let him fast for two successive months before they touch one another; and for him who is unable to do so (the penance is) the feeding of sixty needy ones. This, that ye may put trust in Allah and His messenger. Such are the limits (imposed by Allah); and for disbelievers is a painful doom.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُوا۟ كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۚ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who oppose Allāh and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yuḥāddūna Allāh warasūlahu kubitūā kamā kubita adh-dhīna min qablihim ۚ waqad ʾanzalnā āyātin bayyinātin ۚ walilkāfirīna ʿadhābun mmuhīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who oppose God and His Messenger will be brought low, like those before them: We have revealed clear messages, and humiliating torment awaits those who ignore them,
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who oppose Allah and His messenger will be abased even as those before them were abased; and We have sent down clear tokens, and for disbelievers is a shameful doom

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ ۚ أَحْصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.en: On the Day when Allāh will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allāh had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allāh is, over all things, Witness.
verses.tr: yawma yabʿathuhumu Allāh jamīʿan fayunabbiʾuhum bimā ʿamilūā ۚ ʾaḥṣāhu Allāh wanasūhu ۚ wallāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin shahīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: on the Day when God will raise everyone and make them aware of what they have done. God has taken account of it all, though they may have forgotten: He witnesses everything.
verses.pickthall: On the day when Allah will raise them all together and inform them of what they did. Allah hath kept account of it while they forgot it. And Allah is Witness over all things.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ ثَلَـٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَآ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ ۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Have you not considered that Allāh knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There are not three in a private conversation but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾanna Allāh yaʿlamu mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۖ mā yakūnu min nnajwā thalāthahin ʾillā huwa rābiʿuhum walā khamsahin ʾillā huwa sādisuhum walā ʾadnā min dhālika walā ʾakthara ʾillā huwa maʿahum ʾayna mā kānūā ۖ thumma yunabbiʾuhum bimā ʿamilūā yawma al-qiyāmahi ۚ ʾinna Allāh bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you not see [Prophet] that God knows everything in the heavens and earth? There is no secret conversation between three people where He is not the fourth, nor between five where He is not the sixth, nor between less or more than that without Him being with them, wherever they may be. On the Day of Resurrection, He will show them what they have done: God truly has full knowledge of everything.
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen that Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth? There is no secret conference of three but He is their fourth, nor of five but He is their sixth, nor of less than that or more but He is with them wheresoever they may be; and afterward, on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what they did. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نُهُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَـٰجَوْنَ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَإِذَا جَآءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا ٱللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ ۚ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation [i.e., ridicule and conspiracy] and then return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allāh does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allāh not punish us for what we say?" Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination.
verses.tr: ʾalam tara ʾilā adh-dhīna nuhūā ʿani an-najwā thumma yaʿūdūna limā nuhūā ʿanhu wayatanājawna bi-l-ʾithmi wa-l-ʿudwāni wamaʿṣiyati ar-rasūli wa-idhā jāʾūka ḥayyawka bimā lam yuḥayyika bihi Allāh wayaqūlūna fā ʾanfusihim lawlā yuʿadhibunā Allāh bimā naqūlu ۚ ḥasbuhum jahannamu yaṣlawnahā ۖ fabiʾsa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you not seen how those who have been forbidden to hold secret conversations go back afterwards and hold them, and conspire with one another in what is sinful, hostile, and disobedient to the Messenger? When they come to you they greet you with words God has never used to greet you, and say inwardly, ‘Why does God not punish us for what we say?’ Hell will be punishment enough for them: they will burn there- an evil destination.
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not observed those who were forbidden conspiracy and afterward returned to that which they had been forbidden, and (now) conspire together for crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger? And when they come unto thee they greet thee with a greeting wherewith Allah greeteth thee not, and say within themselves: Why should Allah punish us for what we say? Hell will suffice them; they will feel the heat thereof - a hapless journey's end!

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَنَـٰجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَـٰجَوْا۟ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَتَنَـٰجَوْا۟ بِٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allāh, to whom you will be gathered.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾidhā tanājaytum falā tatanājawā bi-l-ʾithmi wa-l-ʿudwāni wamaʿṣiyati ar-rasūli watanājawā bi-l-birri wa-at-taqwā ۖ wāttaqūā Allāh adh-dhā ʾilayhi tuḥsharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, when you converse in secret, do not do so in a way that is sinful, hostile, and disobedient to the Messenger, but in a way that is good and mindful [of God]. Be mindful of God, to whom you will all be gathered.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! When ye conspire together, conspire not together for crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger, but conspire together for righteousness and piety, and keep your duty toward Allah, unto whom ye will be gathered.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ لِيَحْزُنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيْسَ بِضَآرِّهِمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā an-najwā mina ash-shayṭāni liyaḥzuna adh-dhīna āmanūā walaysa biḍārrihim shayā ʾillā biʾidhni Allāh ۚ waʿalā Allāh falyatawakkali al-muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Any other kind of] secret conversation is the work of Satan, designed to cause trouble to the believers, though it cannot harm them in the least unless God permits it. Let the believers put their trust in God.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Conspiracy is only of the devil, that he may vex those who believe; but he can harm them not at all unless by Allah's leave. In Allah let believers put their trust.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْمَجَـٰلِسِ فَٱفْسَحُوا۟ يَفْسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُوا۟ فَٱنشُزُوا۟ يَرْفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ دَرَجَـٰتٍ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allāh will make space for you. And when you are told, "Arise," then arise; Allāh will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾidhā qīla lakum tafassaḥūā fā al-majālisi fāfsaḥūā yafsaḥi Allāh lakum ۖ wa-idhā qīla ānshuzūā fānshuzūā yarfaʿi Allāh adh-dhīna āmanūā minkum wa-adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-ʿilma darajātin ۚ wallāh bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, if you are told to make room for one another in your assemblies, then do so, and God will make room for you, and if you are told to rise up, do so: God will raise up, by many degrees, those of you who believe and those who have been given knowledge: He is fully aware of what you do.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! when it is said unto you, Make room! in assemblies, then make room; Allah will make way for you (hereafter). And when it is said, Come up higher! go up higher; Allah will exalt those who believe among you, and those who have knowledge, to high ranks. Allah is Informed of what ye do.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نَـٰجَيْتُمُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ نَجْوَىٰكُمْ صَدَقَةً ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, when you [wish to] privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not [the means] - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾidhā nājaytumu ar-rasūla faqaddimūā bayna yadā najwākum ṣadaqahan ۚ dhālika khayrun llakum wa-aṭharu ۚ fa-in llam tajidūā fa-inna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, when you come to speak privately with the Messenger, offer something in charity before your conversation: that is better for you and purer. If you do not have the means, God is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! When ye hold conference with the messenger, offer an alms before your conference. That is better and purer for you. But if ye cannot find (the wherewithal) then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: ءَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَن تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ نَجْوَىٰكُمْ صَدَقَـٰتٍ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَتَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allāh has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
verses.tr: ʾaʾashfaqtum ʾan tuqaddimūā bayna yadā najwākum ṣadaqātin ۚ fa-idh lam tafʿalūā watāba Allāh ʿalaykum fa-aqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha watūā az-zakawāha wa-aṭīʿūā Allāh warasūlahu ۚ wallāh khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Were you afraid to give charity before consulting the Prophet? Since you did not give charity, and God has relented towards you, you should [at least] observe your prayers, pay the prescribed alms, and obey God and His Messenger: God is well aware of your actions.
verses.pickthall: Fear ye to offer alms before your conference? Then, when ye do it not and Allah hath forgiven you, establish worship and pay the poor-due and obey Allah and His messenger. And Allah is Aware of what ye do.

verses.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا۟ قَوْمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى ٱلْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying].
verses.tr: ۞ ʾalam tara ʾilā adh-dhīna tawallawā qawman ghaḍiba Allāh ʿalayhim mmā hum mminkum walā minhum wayaḥlifūna ʿalā al-kadhibi wahum yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you not seen [Prophet] those who give their loyalty to people with whom God is angry? They are neither with you nor with them, and knowingly swear to lies.
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen those who take for friends a folk with whom Allah is wroth? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear a false oath knowingly.

verses.ar: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.
verses.tr: ʾaʿadda Allāh lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan ۖ ʾinnahum sāʾa mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God has prepared a severe torment for them: what they do is truly evil.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath prepared for them a dreadful doom. Evil indeed is that which they are wont to do.

verses.ar: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.en: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh, and for them is a humiliating punishment.
verses.tr: āttakhadhūā ʾaymānahum junnahan faṣaddūā ʿan sabīli Allāh falahum ʿadhābun mmuhīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: They have used their oaths to cover up [their false deeds], and barred others from the path of God. A humiliating torment awaits them-
verses.pickthall: They make a shelter of their oaths and turn (men) from the way of Allah; so theirs will be a shameful doom.

verses.ar: لَّن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.en: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allāh at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
verses.tr: llan tughnāa ʿanhum ʾamwāluhum walā ʾawlāduhum mmina Allāh shayā ۚ ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri ۖ hum fīhā khālidūna
verses.abdelhaleem: neither their wealth nor their children will be of any use to them against God- they will be the inhabitants of Hell, where they will remain.
verses.pickthall: Their wealth and their children will avail them naught against Allah. Such are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُۥ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ ۚ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: On the Day Allāh will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are [standing] on something. Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars.
verses.tr: yawma yabʿathuhumu Allāh jamīʿan fayaḥlifūna lahu kamā yaḥlifūna lakum ۖ wayaḥsabūna ʾannahum ʿalā shāʾin ۚ ʾalā ʾinnahum humu al-kādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day God raises them all from the dead, they will swear before Him as they swear before you now, thinking that it will help them. What liars they are!
verses.pickthall: On the day when Allah will raise them all together, then will they swear unto Him as they (now) swear unto you, and they will fancy that they have some standing. Lo! is it not they who are the liars?

verses.ar: ٱسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ ذِكْرَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allāh. Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers.
verses.tr: āstaḥwadha ʿalayhimu ash-shayṭānu fa-ansāhum dhikra Allāh ۚ ʾūlāʾika ḥizbu ash-shayṭāni ۚ ʾalā ʾinna ḥizba ash-shayṭāni humu al-khāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Satan has gained control over them and made them forget God. They are on Satan’s side, and Satan’s side will be the losers:
verses.pickthall: The devil hath engrossed them and so hath caused them to forget remembrance of Allah. They are the devil's party. Lo! is it not the devil's party who will be the losers?

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْأَذَلِّينَ
verses.en: Indeed, the ones who oppose Allāh and His Messenger - those will be among the most humbled.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yuḥāddūna Allāh warasūlahu ʾūlāʾika fā al-ʾadhallīna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who oppose God and His Messenger will be among the most humiliated.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who oppose Allah and His messenger, they will be among the lowest.

verses.ar: كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا۠ وَرُسُلِىٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
verses.en: Allāh has written [i.e., decreed], "I will surely overcome, I and My messengers." Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
verses.tr: kataba Allāh laʾaghlibanna ʾanā warusulā ۚ ʾinna Allāh qawāun ʿazīzun
verses.abdelhaleem: God has written, ‘I shall most certainly win, I and My messengers.’ God is powerful and almighty.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath decreed: Lo! I verily shall conquer, I and My messengers. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.

verses.ar: لَّا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ يُوَآدُّونَ مَنْ حَآدَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَوْ كَانُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ أَوْ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ أَوْ إِخْوَٰنَهُمْ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحٍ مِّنْهُ ۖ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: You will not find a people who believe in Allāh and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allāh and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. Those - He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit from Him. And We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Allāh is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him - those are the party of Allāh. Unquestionably, the party of Allāh - they are the successful.
