verses.tr: llā tajidu qawman yuʾminūna billāh wa-l-yawmi al-ākhiri yuwāddūna man ḥādda Allāh warasūlahu walaw kānūā ābāʾahum ʾaw ʾabnāʾahum ʾaw ʾikhwānahum ʾaw ʿashīratahum ۚ ʾūlāʾika kataba fā qulūbihimu al-ʾīmāna wa-ayyadahum birūḥin mminhu ۖ wayudkhiluhum jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ۚ raḍāa Allāh ʿanhum waraḍūā ʿanhu ۚ ʾūlāʾika ḥizbu Allāh ۚ ʾalā ʾinna ḥizba Allāh humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], you will not find people who truly believe in God and the Last Day giving their loyalty to those who oppose God and His Messenger, even though they may be their fathers, sons, brothers, or other relations: these are the people in whose hearts God has inscribed faith, and whom He has strengthened with His spirit. He will let them enter Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will stay: God is well pleased with them, and they with Him. They are on God’s side, and God’s side will be the one to prosper.
verses.pickthall: Thou wilt not find folk who believe in Allah and the Last Day loving those who oppose Allah and His messenger, even though they be their fathers or their sons or their brethren or their clan. As for such, He hath written faith upon their hearts and hath strengthened them with a Spirit from Him, and He will bring them into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide. Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. They are Allah's party. Lo! is it not Allah's party who are the successful?

verses.ar: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: sabbaḥa lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۖ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God; He is the Almighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ ٱلْحَشْرِ ۚ مَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ ۖ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُم مَّانِعَتُهُمْ حُصُونُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُوا۟ ۖ وَقَذَفَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعْبَ ۚ يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم بِأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَيْدِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَٱعْتَبِرُوا۟ يَـٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
verses.en: It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allāh; but [the decree of] Allāh came upon them from where they had not expected, and He cast terror into their hearts [so] they destroyed their houses by their [own] hands and the hands of the believers. So take warning, O people of vision.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā ʾakhraja adh-dhīna kafarūā min ʾahli al-kitābi min diyārihim liʾawwali al-ḥashri ۚ mā ẓanantum ʾan yakhrujūā ۖ waẓannūā ʾannahum mmāniʿatuhum ḥuṣūnuhum mmina Allāh fa-atāhumu Allāh min ḥaythu lam yaḥtasibūā ۖ waqadhafa fā qulūbihimu ar-ruʿba ۚ yukhribūna buyūtahum biʾaydīhim wa-aydā al-muʾminīna fāʿtabirūā yāʾūlā al-ʾabṣāri
verses.abdelhaleem: It was He who drove those of the People of the Book who broke faith out from their homes at the first gathering of forces––you [believers] never thought they would go, and they themselves thought their fortifications would protect them against God. God came up on them from where they least expected and put panic into their hearts: their homes were destroyed by their own hands, and the hands of the believers. Learn from this, all of you with insight!
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath caused those of the People of the Scripture who disbelieved to go forth from their homes unto the first exile. Ye deemed not that they would go forth, while they deemed that their strongholds would protect them from Allah. But Allah reached them from a place whereof they recked not, and cast terror in their hearts so that they ruined their houses with their own hands and the hands of the believers. So learn a lesson, O ye who have eyes!

verses.ar: وَلَوْلَآ أَن كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْجَلَآءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابُ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: And if not that Allāh had decreed for them evacuation, He would have punished them in [this] world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire.
verses.tr: walawlā ʾan kataba Allāh ʿalayhimu al-jalāʾa laʿadhabahum fā ad-dunyā ۖ walahum fā al-ākhirahi ʿadhābu an-nāri
verses.abdelhaleem: If God had not decreed exile for them, He would have tormented them [even more severely] in this world. In the Hereafter they will have the torment of the Fire
verses.pickthall: And if Allah had not decreed migration for them, He verily would have punished them in the world, and theirs in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ ۖ وَمَن يُشَآقِّ ٱللَّهَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.en: That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾannahum shāqqūā Allāh warasūlahu ۖ waman yushāqqi Allāh fa-inna Allāh shadīdu al-ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: because they set themselves against God and His Messenger: God is stern in punishment towards anyone who sets himself against Him.
verses.pickthall: That is because they were opposed to Allah and His messenger; and whoso is opposed to Allah, (for him) verily Allah is stern in reprisal.

verses.ar: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: mā qaṭaʿtum mmin llīnahin ʾaw taraktumūhā qāʾimahan ʿalā ʾuṣūlihā fabiʾidhni Allāh waliyukhzāa al-fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Whatever you [believers] may have done to [their] palm trees–– cutting them down or leaving them standing on their roots––was done by God’s leave, so that He might disgrace those who defied Him.
verses.pickthall: Whatsoever palm-trees ye cut down or left standing on their roots, it was by Allah's leave, in order that He might confound the evil-livers.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ مِنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: And what Allāh restored [of property] to His Messenger from them - you did not spur for it [in an expedition] any horses or camels, but Allāh gives His messengers power over whom He wills, and Allāh is over all things competent.
verses.tr: wamā ʾafāʾa Allāh ʿalā rasūlihi minhum famā ʾawjaftum ʿalayhi min khaylin walā rikābin walākinna Allāh yusalliṭu rusulahu ʿalā man yashāʾu ۚ wallāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: You [believers] did not have to spur on your horses or your camels for whatever gains God turned over to His Messenger from them. God gives authority to His messengers over whoever He will: God has power over all things.
verses.pickthall: And that which Allah gave as spoil unto His messenger from them, ye urged not any horse or riding-camel for the sake thereof, but Allah giveth His messenger lordship over whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: مَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْقُرَىٰ فَلِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ كَىْ لَا يَكُونَ دُولَةًۢ بَيْنَ ٱلْأَغْنِيَآءِ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ فَٱنتَهُوا۟ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.en: And what Allāh restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for Allāh and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and orphans and the needy and the [stranded] traveler - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
verses.tr: mmā ʾafāʾa Allāh ʿalā rasūlihi min ʾahli al-qurā fa-lillāh walilrrasūli walidhā al-qurbā wa-l-yatāmā wa-l-masākīni wābni as-sabīli kā lā yakūna dūlahan bayna al-ʾaghniyāʾi minkum ۚ wamā ātākumu ar-rasūlu fakhudhūhu wamā nahākum ʿanhu fāntahūā ۚ wāttaqūā Allāh ۖ ʾinna Allāh shadīdu al-ʿiqābi
verses.abdelhaleem: Whatever gains God has turned over to His Messenger from the inhabitants of the villages belong to God, the Messenger, kinsfolk, orphans, the needy, the traveller in need- this is so that they do not just circulate among those of you who are rich––so accept whatever the Messenger gives you, and abstain from whatever he forbids you. Be mindful of God: God is severe in punishment.
verses.pickthall: That which Allah giveth as spoil unto His messenger from the people of the townships, it is for Allah and His messenger and for the near of kin and the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer, that it become not a commodity between the rich among you. And whatsoever the messenger giveth you, take it. And whatsoever he forbiddeth, abstain (from it). And keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is stern in reprisal.

verses.ar: لِلْفُقَرَآءِ ٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِمْ وَأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًا وَيَنصُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقُونَ
verses.en: For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] approval and supporting [the cause of] Allāh and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful.
verses.tr: lilfuqarāʾi al-muhājirīna adh-dhīna ʾukhrijūā min diyārihim wa-amwālihim yabtaghūna faḍlan mmina Allāh wariḍwānan wayanṣurūna Allāh warasūlahu ۚ ʾūlāʾika humu aṣ-ṣādiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The poor emigrants who were driven from their homes and possessions, who seek God’s favour and approval, those who help God and His Messenger- these are the ones who are true- [shall have a share].
verses.pickthall: And (it is) for the poor fugitives who have been driven out from their homes and their belongings, who seek bounty from Allah and help Allah and His messenger. They are the loyal.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُو ٱلدَّارَ وَٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِى صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةً مِّمَّآ أُوتُوا۟ وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ ۚ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: And [also for] those who were settled in the Home [i.e.,al-Madīnah] and [adopted] the faith before them. They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what they [i.e., the emigrants] were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna tabawwaʾū ad-dāra wa-l-ʾīmāna min qablihim yuḥibbūna man hājara ʾilayhim walā yajidūna fā ṣudūrihim ḥājahan mmimmā ʾūtūā wayuʾthirūna ʿalā ʾanfusihim walaw kāna bihim khaṣāṣahun ۚ waman yūqa shuḥḥa nafsihi fa-ūlāʾika humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who were already firmly established in their homes [in Medina], and firmly rooted in faith, show love for those who migrated to them for refuge and harbour no desire in their hearts for what has been given to them. They give them preference over themselves, even if they too are poor: those who are saved from their own souls’ greed are truly successful.
verses.pickthall: Those who entered the city and the faith before them love those who flee unto them for refuge, and find in their breasts no need for that which hath been given them, but prefer (the fugitives) above themselves though poverty become their lot. And whoso is saved from his own avarice - such are they who are successful.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: And [there is a share for] those who come after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna jāʾū min baʿdihim yaqūlūna rabbanā āghfir lanā waliʾikhwāninā adh-dhīna sabaqūnā bi-l-ʾīmāni walā tajʿal fā qulūbinā ghillan llilladhīna āmanūā rabbanā ʾinnaka raʾūfun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who came after them say, ‘Lord, forgive us our sins and the sins of our brothers who believed before us, and leave no malice in our hearts towards those who believe. Lord, You are truly compassionate and merciful.’
verses.pickthall: And those who came (into the faith) after them say: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe. Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful.

verses.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَئِنْ أُخْرِجْتُمْ لَنَخْرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمْ وَلَا نُطِيعُ فِيكُمْ أَحَدًا أَبَدًا وَإِن قُوتِلْتُمْ لَنَنصُرَنَّكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: Have you not considered those who practice hypocrisy, saying to their brothers [i.e., associates] who have disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, "If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will not obey, in regard to you, anyone - ever; and if you are fought, we will surely aid you." But Allāh testifies that they are liars.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾalam tara ʾilā adh-dhīna nāfaqūā yaqūlūna liʾikhwānihimu adh-dhīna kafarūā min ʾahli al-kitābi laʾin ʾukhrijtum lanakhrujanna maʿakum walā nuṭīʿu fīkum ʾaḥadan ʾabadan wa-in qūtiltum lananṣurannakum wallāh yashhadu ʾinnahum lakādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you [Prophet] considered the hypocrites who say to their fellows, the faithless among the People of the Book, ‘If you are driven out, we shall go with you- we would never listen to anyone who sought to harm you- and if you are attacked, we shall certainly come to your aid’? God bears witness that they are in fact liars:
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not observed those who are hypocrites, (how) they tell their brethren who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture: If ye are driven out, we surely will go out with you, and we will never obey anyone against you, and if ye are attacked we verily will help you. And Allah beareth witness that they verily are liars.

verses.ar: لَئِنْ أُخْرِجُوا۟ لَا يَخْرُجُونَ مَعَهُمْ وَلَئِن قُوتِلُوا۟ لَا يَنصُرُونَهُمْ وَلَئِن نَّصَرُوهُمْ لَيُوَلُّنَّ ٱلْأَدْبَـٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: If they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and if they are fought, they will not aid them. And [even] if they should aid them, they will surely turn their backs; then [thereafter] they will not be aided.
verses.tr: laʾin ʾukhrijūā lā yakhrujūna maʿahum walaʾin qūtilūā lā yanṣurūnahum walaʾin nnaṣarūhum layuwallunna al-ʾadbāra thumma lā yunṣarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: if they are driven out, they will never leave with them; if they are attacked, they will never help them. Even if they did come to their aid, they would soon turn tail and flee- in the end they would have no help.
verses.pickthall: (For) indeed if they are driven out they go not out with them, and indeed if they are attacked they help them not, and indeed if they had helped them they would have turned and fled, and then they would not have been victorious.

verses.ar: لَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ رَهْبَةً فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.en: You [believers] are more fearful within their breasts than Allāh. That is because they are a people who do not understand.
verses.tr: laʾantum ʾashaddu rahbahan fā ṣudūrihim mmina Allāh ۚ dhālika biʾannahum qawmun llā yafqahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Fear of you [believers] is more intense in their hearts than fear of God because they are people devoid of understanding.
verses.pickthall: Ye are more awful as a fear in their bosoms than Allah. That is because they are a folk who understand not.

verses.ar: لَا يُقَـٰتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِى قُرًى مُّحَصَّنَةٍ أَوْ مِن وَرَآءِ جُدُرٍۭ ۚ بَأْسُهُم بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدٌ ۚ تَحْسَبُهُمْ جَمِيعًا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّىٰ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: They will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls. Their violence [i.e., enmity] among themselves is severe. You think they are together, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reason.
verses.tr: lā yuqātilūnakum jamīʿan ʾillā fā quranā mmuḥaṣṣanahin ʾaw min warāʾi judurin ۚ baʾsuhum baynahum shadīdun ۚ taḥsabuhum jamīʿan waqulūbuhum shattā ۚ dhālika biʾannahum qawmun llā yaʿqilūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Even united they would never fight you, except from within fortified strongholds or behind high walls. There is much hostility between them: you think they are united but their hearts are divided because they are people devoid of reason.
verses.pickthall: They will not fight against you in a body save in fortified villages or from behind walls. Their adversity among themselves is very great. Ye think of them as a whole whereas their hearts are divers. That is because they are a folk who have no sense.

verses.ar: كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَرِيبًا ۖ ذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: [Theirs is] like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
verses.tr: kamathali adh-dhīna min qablihim qarīban ۖ dhāqūā wabāla ʾamrihim walahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Like those who went just before them, they have tasted the result of their conduct and a painful punishment awaits them.
verses.pickthall: On the likeness of those (who suffered) a short time before them, they taste the ill-effects of their own conduct, and theirs is painful punishment.

verses.ar: كَمَثَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ ٱكْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنكَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
verses.tr: kamathali ash-shayṭāni ʾidh qāla lilʾinsāni ākfur falammā kafara qāla ʾinnā barāʾun mminka ʾinnā ʾakhāfu Allāh rabba al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Like Satan, who says to man, ‘Do not believe!’ but when man disbelieves, says, ‘I disown you; I fear God, the Lord of the Worlds,’
verses.pickthall: (And the hypocrites are) on the likeness of the devil when he telleth man to disbelieve, then, when he disbelieveth saith: Lo! I am quit of thee. Lo! I fear Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: فَكَانَ عَـٰقِبَتَهُمَآ أَنَّهُمَا فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَـٰلِدَيْنِ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: fakāna ʿāqibatahumā ʾannahumā fā an-nāri khālidayni fīhā ۚ wadhālika jazā aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: both will end up in the Fire, there to remain. That is the reward of evildoers.
verses.pickthall: And the consequence for both will be that they are in the Fire, therein abiding. Such is the reward of evil-doers.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, fear Allāh. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Aware of what you do.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā āttaqūā Allāh waltanẓur nafsun mmā qaddamat lighadin ۖ wāttaqūā Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe! Be mindful of God, and let every soul consider carefully what it sends ahead for tomorrow; be mindful of God, for God is well aware of everything you do.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah. And let every soul look to that which it sendeth on before for the morrow. And observe your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: And be not like those who forgot Allāh, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.
verses.tr: walā takūnūā ka-adh-dhīna nasūā Allāh fa-ansāhum ʾanfusahum ۚ ʾūlāʾika humu al-fāsiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do not be like those who forget God, so God causes them to forget their own souls: they are the rebellious ones-
verses.pickthall: And be not ye as those who forgot Allah, therefor He caused them to forget their souls. Such are the evil-doers.

verses.ar: لَا يَسْتَوِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۚ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
verses.en: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success].
verses.tr: lā yastawā ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri wa-aṣḥābu al-jannahi ۚ ʾaṣḥābu al-jannahi humu al-fāʾizūna
verses.abdelhaleem: there is no comparison between the inhabitants of the Fire and the inhabitants of Paradise- and the inhabitants of Paradise are the successful ones.
verses.pickthall: Not equal are the owners of the Fire and the owners of the Garden. The owners of the Garden, they are the victorious.

verses.ar: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُۥ خَـٰشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: If We had sent down this Qur’ān upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and splitting from fear of Allāh. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.
verses.tr: law ʾanzalnā hādhā al-qurāna ʿalā jabalin llaraʾaytahu khāshiʿan mmutaṣaddiʿan mmin khashyahi Allāh ۚ watilka al-ʾamthālu naḍribuhā lilnnāsi laʿallahum yatafakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If We had sent this Quran down to a mountain, you [Prophet] would have seen it humbled and split apart in its awe of God: We offer people such illustrations so that they may reflect.
verses.pickthall: If We had caused this Qur'an to descend upon a mountain, thou (O Muhammad) verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah. Such similitudes coin We for mankind that haply they may reflect.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ۖ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.tr: huwa Allāh adh-dhā lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۖ ʿālimu al-ghaybi wa-ash-shahādahi ۖ huwa ar-raḥmānu ar-raḥīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: He is God: there is no god other than Him. It is He who knows what is hidden as well as what is in the open, He is the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy.
verses.pickthall: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible. He is the Beneficent, Merciful.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَـٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Grantor of Security, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
verses.tr: huwa Allāh adh-dhā lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa al-maliku al-quddūsu as-salāmu al-muʾminu al-muhayminu al-ʿazīzu al-jabbāru al-mutakabbiru ۚ subḥāna Allāh ʿammā yushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He is God: there is no god other than Him, the Controller, the Holy One, Source of Peace, Granter of Security, Guardian over all, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Truly Great; God is far above anything they consider to be His partner.
verses.pickthall: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, Peace, the Keeper of Faith, the Guardian, the Majestic, the Compeller, the Superb. Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him).

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: He is Allāh, the Creator, the Producer, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: huwa Allāh al-khāliqu al-bāriʾu al-muṣawwiru ۖ lahu al-ʾasmāʾu al-ḥusnā ۚ yusabbiḥu lahu mā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۖ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: He is God: the Creator, the Originator, the Shaper. The best names belong to Him. Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies Him: He is the Almighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: He is Allah, the Creator, the Shaper out of naught, the Fashioner. His are the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

name: Al-Mumtahanah
translated: She that is to be examined

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ عَدُوِّى وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِم بِٱلْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا جَآءَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْحَقِّ يُخْرِجُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۙ أَن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَـٰدًا فِى سَبِيلِى وَٱبْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِى ۚ تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِم بِٱلْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا۠ أَعْلَمُ بِمَآ أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَآ أَعْلَنتُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْهُ مِنكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allāh, your Lord. If you have come out for jihād [i.e., fighting or striving] in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection [i.e., instruction], but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā tattakhidhūā ʿaduwwā waʿaduwwakum ʾawliyāʾa tulqūna ʾilayhim bi-l-mawaddahi waqad kafarūā bimā jāʾakum mmina al-ḥaqqi yukhrijūna ar-rasūla wa-iyyākum ۙ ʾan tuʾminūā billāh rabbikum ʾin kuntum kharajtum jihādan fā sabīlā wābtighāʾa marḍātā ۚ tusirrūna ʾilayhim bi-l-mawaddahi wa-anā ʾaʿlamu bimā ʾakhfaytum wamā ʾaʿlantum ۚ waman yafʿalhu minkum faqad ḍalla sawāʾa as-sabīli
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, do not take My enemies and yours as your allies, showing them friendship when they have rejected the truth you have received, and have driven you and the Messenger out simply because you believe in God, your Lord––not if you truly emigrated in order to strive for My cause and seek My good pleasure. You secretly show them friendship––I know all you conceal and all you reveal–– but any of you who do this are straying from the right path.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Choose not My enemy and your enemy for allies. Do ye give them friendship when they disbelieve in that truth which hath come unto you, driving out the messenger and you because ye believe in Allah, your Lord? If ye have come forth to strive in My way and seeking My good pleasure, (show them not friendship). Do ye show friendship unto them in secret, when I am Best Aware of what ye hide and what ye proclaim? And whosoever doeth it among you, he verily hath strayed from the right way.

verses.ar: إِن يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا۟ لَكُمْ أَعْدَآءً وَيَبْسُطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلسُّوٓءِ وَوَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.en: If they gain dominance over you, they would be [i.e., behave] to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve.
verses.tr: ʾin yathqafūkum yakūnūā lakum ʾaʿdāʾan wayabsuṭūā ʾilaykum ʾaydiyahum wa-ʾalsinatahum bi-as-sūʾi wawaddūā law takfurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If they gain the upper hand over you, they will revert to being your enemies and stretch out their hands and tongues to harm you; it is their dearest wish that you may renounce your faith.
verses.pickthall: If they have the upper hand of you, they will be your foes, and will stretch out their hands and their tongues toward you with evil (intent), and they long for you to disbelieve.

verses.ar: لَن تَنفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ ۚ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
verses.tr: lan tanfaʿakum ʾarḥāmukum walā ʾawlādukum ۚ yawma al-qiyāmahi yafṣilu baynakum ۚ wallāh bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Neither your kinsfolk nor your children will be any use to you on the Day of Resurrection: He will separate you out. God sees everything you do.
verses.pickthall: Your ties of kindred and your children will avail you naught upon the Day of Resurrection. He will part you. Allah is Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَءَٰٓؤُا۟ مِنكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةُ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءُ أَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَوْلَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۖ رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allāh. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allāh alone" - except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allāh. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
verses.tr: qad kānat lakum ʾuswahun ḥasanahun fā ʾibrāhīma wa-adh-dhīna maʿahu ʾidh qālūā liqawmihim ʾinnā buraā minkum wamimmā taʿbudūna min dūni Allāh kafarnā bikum wabadā baynanā wabaynakumu al-ʿadāwahu wa-l-baghḍāʾu ʾabadan ḥattā tuʾminūā billāh waḥdahu ʾillā qawla ʾibrāhīma liʾabīhi laʾastaghfiranna laka wamā ʾamliku laka mina Allāh min shāʾin ۖ rrabbanā ʿalayka tawakkalnā wa-ʾilayka ʾanabnā wa-ʾilayka al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: You have a good example in Abraham and his companions, when they said to their people, ‘We disown you and what you worship besides God! We renounce you! Until you believe in God alone, the enmity and hatred that has arisen between us will endure!’––except when Abraham said to his father, ‘I will pray for forgiveness for you though I cannot protect you from God’––[they prayed] ‘Lord, we have put our trust in You; we turn to You; You are our final destination.
verses.pickthall: There is a goodly pattern for you in Abraham and those with him, when they told their folk: Lo! we are guiltless of you and all that ye worship beside Allah. We have done with you. And there hath arisen between us and you hostility and hate for ever until ye believe in Allah only - save that which Abraham promised his father (when he said): I will ask forgiveness for thee, though I own nothing for thee from Allah - Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
verses.tr: rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fitnahan llilladhīna kafarūā wāghfir lanā rabbanā ۖ ʾinnaka ʾanta al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord, do not expose us to mistreatment [at the hands of] the disbelievers. Forgive us, Lord, for You are the Almighty, the All Wise.’
verses.pickthall: Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! Lo! Thou, only Thou, are the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.en: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: laqad kāna lakum fīhim ʾuswahun ḥasanahun lliman kāna yarjūā Allāh wa-l-yawma al-ākhira ۚ waman yatawalla fa-inna Allāh huwa al-ghanāu al-ḥamīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly, they are a good example for you [believers] to follow, a good example for those who fear God and the Last Day. If anyone turns away, [remember] God is self-sufficing and worthy of all praise.
verses.pickthall: Verily ye have in them a goodly pattern for everyone who looketh to Allah and the Last Day. And whosoever may turn away, lo! still Allah, He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.

verses.ar: ۞ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُم مِّنْهُم مَّوَدَّةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: Perhaps Allāh will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allāh is competent, and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: ۞ ʿasā Allāh ʾan yajʿala baynakum wabayna adh-dhīna ʿādaytum mminhum mmawaddahan ۚ wallāh qadīrun ۚ wallāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: God may still bring about affection between you and your present enemies- God is all powerful, God is most forgiving and merciful-
verses.pickthall: It may be that Allah will ordain love between you and those of them with whom ye are at enmity. Allah is Mighty, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: لَّا يَنْهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَـٰتِلُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِكُمْ أَن تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
verses.en: Allāh does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.
verses.tr: llā yanhākumu Allāh ʿani adh-dhīna lam yuqātilūkum fā ad-dīni walam yukhrijūkum mmin diyārikum ʾan tabarrūhum watuqsiṭūā ʾilayhim ۚ ʾinna Allāh yuḥibbu al-muqsiṭīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and He does not forbid you to deal kindly and justly with anyone who has not fought you for your faith or driven you out of your homes: God loves the just.
verses.pickthall: Allah forbiddeth you not those who warred not against you on account of religion and drove you not out from your homes, that ye should show them kindness and deal justly with them. Lo! Allah loveth the just dealers.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا يَنْهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ قَـٰتَلُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَأَخْرَجُوكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِكُمْ وَظَـٰهَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ إِخْرَاجِكُمْ أَن تَوَلَّوْهُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: Allāh only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā yanhākumu Allāh ʿani adh-dhīna qātalūkum fā ad-dīni wa-akhrajūkum mmin diyārikum waẓāharūā ʿalā ʾikhrājikum ʾan tawallawhum ۚ waman yatawallahum fa-ūlāʾika humu aẓ-ẓālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: But God forbids you to take as allies those who have fought against you for your faith, driven you out of your homes, and helped others to drive you out: any of you who take them as allies will truly be wrongdoers.
verses.pickthall: Allah forbiddeth you only those who warred against you on account of religion and have driven you out from your homes and helped to drive you out, that ye make friends of them. Whosoever maketh friends of them - (All) such are wrong-doers.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ مُهَـٰجِرَٰتٍ فَٱمْتَحِنُوهُنَّ ۖ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَـٰنِهِنَّ ۖ فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِنَـٰتٍ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ ۖ لَا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَّهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ ۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مَّآ أَنفَقُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۚ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوا۟ بِعِصَمِ ٱلْكَوَافِرِ وَسْـَٔلُوا۟ مَآ أَنفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْـَٔلُوا۟ مَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ حُكْمُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine [i.e., test] them. Allāh is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give them [i.e., the disbelievers] what they have spent. And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation [i.e., mahr]. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them [i.e., the disbelievers] ask for what they have spent. That is the judgement of Allāh; He judges between you. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾidhā jāʾakumu al-muʾminātu muhājirātin fāmtaḥinūhunna ۖ Allāh ʾaʿlamu biʾīmānihinna ۖ fa-in ʿalimtumūhunna muʾminātin falā tarjiʿūhunna ʾilā al-kuffāri ۖ lā hunna ḥillun llahum walā hum yaḥillūna lahunna ۖ watūhum mmā ʾanfaqūā ۚ walā junāḥa ʿalaykum ʾan tankiḥūhunna ʾidhā ātaytumūhunna ʾujūrahunna ۚ walā tumsikūā biʿiṣami al-kawāfiri waslūā mā ʾanfaqtum walyaslūā mā ʾanfaqūā ۚ dhālikum ḥukmu Allāh ۖ yaḥkumu baynakum ۚ wallāh ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, test the believing women when they come to you as emigrants- God knows best about their faith- and if you are sure of their belief, do not send them back to the disbelievers: they are not lawful wives for them, nor are the disbelievers their lawful husbands. Give the disbelievers whatever bride-gifts they have paid- if you choose to marry them, there is no blame on you once you have paid their bride-gifts- and do not yourselves hold on to marriage ties with disbelieving women. Ask for repayment of the bride-gifts you have paid, and let the disbelievers do the same. This is God’s judgement: He judges between you, God is all knowing and wise.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! When believing women come unto you as fugitives, examine them. Allah is Best Aware of their faith. Then, if ye know them for true believers, send them not back unto the disbelievers. They are not lawful for them (the disbelievers), nor are they (the disbelievers) lawful for them. And give them (the disbelievers) that which they have spent (upon them). And it is no sin for you to marry such women when ye have given them their dues. And hold not to the ties of disbelieving women; and ask for (the return of) that which ye have spent; and let them (the disbelievers) ask for that which they have spent. That is the judgment of Allah. He judgeth between you. Allah is Knower, Wise.

verses.ar: وَإِن فَاتَكُمْ شَىْءٌ مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبْتُمْ فَـَٔاتُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ أَزْوَٰجُهُم مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنتُم بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain [something], then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allāh, in whom you are believers.
verses.tr: wa-in fātakum shāʾun mmin ʾazwājikum ʾilā al-kuffāri faʿāqabtum fātūā adh-dhīna dhahabat ʾazwājuhum mmithla mā ʾanfaqūā ۚ wāttaqūā Allāh adh-dhā ʾantum bihi muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: If any of you have wives who leave you for the disbelievers, and if your community subsequently acquires [gains] from them, then pay those whose wives have deserted them the equivalent of whatever bride-gift they paid. Be mindful of God, in whom you believe.
verses.pickthall: And if any of your wives have gone from you unto the disbelievers and afterward ye have your turn (of triumph), then give unto those whose wives have gone the like of that which they have spent, and keep your duty to Allah in Whom ye are believers.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن لَّا يُشْرِكْنَ بِٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلَـٰدَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتَـٰنٍ يَفْتَرِينَهُۥ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِى مَعْرُوفٍ ۙ فَبَايِعْهُنَّ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allāh, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs, nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu ʾidhā jāʾaka al-muʾminātu yubāyiʿnaka ʿalā ʾan llā yushrikna billāh shayā walā yasriqna walā yaznīna walā yaqtulna ʾawlādahunna walā yaʾtīna bibuhtānin yaftarīnahu bayna ʾaydīhinna wa-arjulihinna walā yaʿṣīnaka fā maʿrūfin ۙ fabāyiʿhunna wāstaghfir lahunna Allāh ۖ ʾinna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, when believing women come and pledge to you that they will not ascribe any partner to God, nor steal, nor commit adultery, nor kill their children, nor lie about who has fathered their children, nor disobey you in any righteous thing, then you should accept their pledge of allegiance and pray to God to forgive them: God is most forgiving and merciful.
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! If believing women come unto thee, taking oath of allegiance unto thee that they will ascribe no thing as partner unto Allah, and will neither steal nor commit adultery nor kill their children, nor produce any lie that they have devised between their hands and feet, nor disobey thee in what is right, then accept their allegiance and ask Allah to forgive them. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ قَوْمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَدْ يَئِسُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ كَمَا يَئِسَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.en: O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry. They have despaired of [reward in] the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of [meeting] the companions [i.e., inhabitants] of the graves.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā tatawallawā qawman ghaḍiba Allāh ʿalayhim qad yaʾisūā mina al-ākhirahi kamā yaʾisa al-kuffāru min ʾaṣḥābi al-qubūri
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, do not take as allies those with whom God is angry: they despair of the life to come as the disbelievers despair of those buried in their graves.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Be not friendly with a folk with whom Allah is wroth, (a folk) who have despaired of the Hereafter as the disbelievers despair of those who are in the graves.

verses.ar: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: sabbaḥa lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۖ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God––He is the Almighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lima taqūlūna mā lā tafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, why do you say things and then do not do them?
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Why say ye that which ye do not?

verses.ar: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: Greatly hateful in the sight of Allāh is that you say what you do not do.
verses.tr: kabura maqtan ʿinda Allāh ʾan taqūlūā mā lā tafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: It is most hateful to God that you say things and then do not do them;
verses.pickthall: It is most hateful in the sight of Allah that ye say that which ye do not.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَـٰنٌ مَّرْصُوصٌ
verses.en: Indeed, Allāh loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.
verses.tr: ʾinna Allāh yuḥibbu adh-dhīna yuqātilūna fā sabīlihi ṣaffan kaʾannahum bunyānun mmarṣūṣun
verses.abdelhaleem: God truly loves those who fight in solid lines for His cause, like a well-compacted wall.
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah loveth them who battle for His cause in ranks, as if they were a solid structure.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَـٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِى وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوٓا۟ أَزَاغَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allāh to you?" And when they deviated, Allāh caused their hearts to deviate. And Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi yāqawmi lima tuʾdhūnanā waqad ttaʿlamūna ʾannā rasūlu Allāh ʾilaykum ۖ falammā zāghūā ʾazāgha Allāh qulūbahum ۚ wallāh lā yahdā al-qawma al-fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses said to his people, ‘My people, why do you hurt me when you know that I am sent to you by God?’ When they went astray, God left their hearts to stray: God does not guide rebellious people.
verses.pickthall: And (remember) when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Why persecute ye me, when ye well know that I am Allah's messenger unto you? So when they went astray Allah sent their hearts astray. And Allah guideth not the evil-living folk.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic."
verses.tr: wa-idh qāla ʿīsā ābnu maryama yābanā ʾisrāʾīla ʾinnā rasūlu Allāh ʾilaykum mmuṣaddiqan llimā bayna yadāa mina at-tawrāhi wamubashiranā birasūlin yaʾtā min baʿdā āsmuhu ʾaḥmadu ۖ falammā jāʾahum bi-l-bayyināti qālūā hādhā siḥrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Jesus, son of Mary, said, ‘Children of Israel, I am sent to you by God, confirming the Torah that came before me and bringing good news of a messenger to follow me whose name will be Ahmad.’ Yet when he came to them with clear signs, they said, ‘This is obviously sorcery.’
verses.pickthall: And when Jesus son of Mary said: O Children of Israel! Lo! I am the messenger of Allah unto you, confirming that which was (revealed) before me in the Torah, and bringing good tidings of a messenger who cometh after me, whose name is the Praised One. Yet when he hath come unto them with clear proofs, they say: This is mere magic.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh untruth while he is being invited to Islām. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
verses.tr: waman ʾaẓlamu mimmani āftarā ʿalā Allāh al-kadhiba wahuwa yudʿā ʾilā al-ʾislāmi ۚ wallāh lā yahdā al-qawma aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Who could be more wrong than someone who invents lies against God when called to submit to Him? God does not guide the wrongdoers:
verses.pickthall: And who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie against Allah when he is summoned unto Al-Islam? And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

verses.ar: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِـُٔوا۟ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَٱللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: They want to extinguish the light of Allāh with their mouths, but Allāh will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it.
verses.tr: yurīdūna liyuṭfiwā nūra Allāh biʾafwāhihim wallāh mutimmu nūrihi walaw kariha al-kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they wish to put His light out with their mouths. But He will perfect His light, even though the disbelievers hate it;
verses.pickthall: Fain would they put out the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah will perfect His light however much the disbelievers are averse.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allāh dislike it.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā ʾarsala rasūlahu bi-l-hudā wadīni al-ḥaqqi liyuẓhirahu ʿalā ad-dīni kullihi walaw kariha al-mushrikūna
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to show that it is above all [other] religions, even though the idolaters hate it.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it conqueror of all religion however much idolaters may be averse.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ تِجَـٰرَةٍ تُنجِيكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā hal ʾadullukum ʿalā tijārahin tunjīkum mmin ʿadhābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, shall I show you a bargain that will save you from painful torment?
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Shall I show you a commerce that will save you from a painful doom?

verses.ar: تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُجَـٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: [It is that] you believe in Allāh and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allāh with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you only knew.
verses.tr: tuʾminūna billāh warasūlihi watujāhidūna fā sabīli Allāh biʾamwālikum wa-anfusikum ۚ dhālikum khayrun llakum ʾin kuntum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have faith in God and His Messenger and struggle for His cause with your possessions and your persons––that is better for you, if only you knew-
verses.pickthall: Ye should believe in Allah and His messenger, and should strive for the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives. That is better for you, if ye did but know.

verses.ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَمَسَـٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِى جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.en: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment.
verses.tr: yaghfir lakum dhunūbakum wayudkhilkum jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru wamasākina ṭayyibahan fā jannāti ʿadnin ۚ dhālika al-fawzu al-ʿaẓīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: and He will forgive your sins, admit you into Gardens graced with flowing streams, into pleasant dwellings in the Gardens of Eternity. That is the supreme triumph.
verses.pickthall: He will forgive you your sins and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, and pleasant dwellings in Gardens of Eden. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.ar: وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا ۖ نَصْرٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allāh and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.
verses.tr: wa-ukhrā tuḥibbūnahā ۖ naṣrun mmina Allāh wafatḥun qarībun ۗ wabashiri al-muʾminīna
verses.abdelhaleem: And He will give you something else that will really please you: His help and an imminent breakthrough. [Prophet], give the faithful the good news.
verses.pickthall: And (He will give you) another (blessing) which ye love: help from Allah and present victory. Give good tidings (O Muhammad) to believers.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā kūnūā ʾanṣāra Allāh kamā qāla ʿīsā ābnu maryama lilḥawāriyyina man ʾanṣārā ʾilā Allāh ۖ qāla al-ḥawāriyyūna naḥnu ʾanṣāru Allāh ۖ fāmanat ṭṭāʾifahun mmin banā ʾisrāʾīla wakafarat ṭṭāʾifahun ۖ fa-ayyadnā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʿalā ʿaduwwihim fa-aṣbaḥūā ẓāhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: You who believe, be God’s helpers. As Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples, ‘Who will come with me to help God?’ The disciples said, ‘We shall be God’s helpers.’ Some of the Children of Israel believed and some disbelieved: We supported the believers against their enemy and they were the ones who came out on top.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Be Allah's helpers, even as Jesus son of Mary said unto the disciples: Who are my helpers for Allah? They said: We are Allah's helpers. And a party of the Children of Israel believed, while a party disbelieved. Then We strengthened those who believed against their foe, and they became the uppermost.

verses.ar: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْمَلِكِ ٱلْقُدُّوسِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: yusabbiḥu lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi al-maliki al-quddūsi al-ʿazīzi al-ḥakīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God, the Controller, the Holy One, the Almighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: It is He who has sent among the unlettered [Arabs] a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and wisdom [i.e., the sunnah] - although they were before in clear error -
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā baʿatha fā al-ʾummiyyina rasūlan mminhum yatlūā ʿalayhim āyātihi wayuzakkīhim wayuʿallimuhumu al-kitāba wa-l-ḥikmaha wa-in kānūā min qablu lafā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who raised a mes-senger, among the people who had no Scripture, to recite His revelations to them, to make them grow spiritually and teach them the Scripture and wisdom––before that they were clearly astray––
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath sent among the unlettered ones a messenger of their own, to recite unto them His revelations and to make them grow, and to teach them the Scripture and wisdom, though heretofore they were indeed in error manifest,

verses.ar: وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُوا۟ بِهِمْ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: wakharīna minhum lammā yalḥaqūā bihim ۚ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: to them and others yet to join them. He is the Almighty, the Wise:
verses.pickthall: Along with others of them who have not yet joined them. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: That is the bounty of Allāh, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
verses.tr: dhālika faḍlu Allāh yuʾtīhi man yashāʾu ۚ wallāh dhū al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: such is God’s favour that He grants it to whoever He will; God’s favour is immense.
verses.pickthall: That is the bounty of Allah; which He giveth unto whom He will. Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

verses.ar: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ حُمِّلُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ ٱلْحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفَارًۢا ۚ بِئْسَ مَثَلُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allāh. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
verses.tr: mathalu adh-dhīna ḥummilūā at-tawrāha thumma lam yaḥmilūhā kamathali al-ḥimāri yaḥmilu ʾasfāranā ۚ biʾsa mathalu al-qawmi adh-dhīna kadhabūā bāyāti Allāh ۚ wallāh lā yahdā al-qawma aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who have been charged to obey the Torah, but do not do so, are like asses carrying books: how base such people are who disobey God’s revelations! God does not guide people who do wrong.
verses.pickthall: The likeness of those who are entrusted with the Law of Moses, yet apply it not, is as the likeness of the ass carrying books. Wretched is the likeness of folk who deny the revelations of Allah. And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوٓا۟ إِن زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا۟ ٱلْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allāh, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."
verses.tr: qul yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna hādūā ʾin zaʿamtum ʾannakum ʾawliyāʾu lillāh min dūni an-nāsi fatamannawā al-mawta ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘You who follow the Jewish faith, if you truly claim that out of all people you alone are friends of God, then you should be hoping for death.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): O ye who are Jews! If ye claim that ye are favoured of Allah apart from (all) mankind, then long for death if ye are truthful.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوْنَهُۥٓ أَبَدًۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
verses.tr: walā yatamannawnahu ʾabadanā bimā qaddamat ʾaydīhim ۚ wallāh ʿalīmun bi-aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But because of what they have stored up for themselves with their own hands they would never hope for death––God knows the wrongdoers very well––
verses.pickthall: But they will never long for it because of all that their own hands have sent before, and Allah is Aware of evil-doers.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْمَوْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَفِرُّونَ مِنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مُلَـٰقِيكُمْ ۖ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do."
verses.tr: qul ʾinna al-mawta adh-dhā tafirrūna minhu fa-innahu mulāqīkum ۖ thumma turaddūna ʾilā ʿālimi al-ghaybi wa-ash-shahādahi fayunabbiʾukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so say, ‘The death you run away from will come to meet you and you will be returned to the One who knows the unseen as well as the seen: He will tell you everything you have done.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! the death from which ye shrink will surely meet you, and afterward ye will be returned unto the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, and He will tell you what ye used to do.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نُودِىَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوْمِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فَٱسْعَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلْبَيْعَ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, when [the adhān] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumuʿah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allāh and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾidhā nūdāa lilṣṣalawāhi min yawmi al-jumuʿahi fāsʿawā ʾilā dhikri Allāh wadharūā al-bayʿa ۚ dhālikum khayrun llakum ʾin kuntum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers! When the call to prayer is made on the day of congregation, hurry towards the reminder of God and leave off your trading––that is better for you, if only you knew––
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading. That is better for you if ye did but know.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allāh, and remember Allāh often that you may succeed.
verses.tr: fa-idhā quḍiyati aṣ-ṣalawāhu fāntashirūā fā al-ʾarḍi wābtaghūā min faḍli Allāh wādhkurūā Allāh kathīran llaʿallakum tufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: then when the prayer has ended, disperse in the land and seek out God’s bounty. Remember God often so that you may prosper.
verses.pickthall: And when the prayer is ended, then disperse in the land and seek of Allah's bounty, and remember Allah much, that ye may be successful.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ تِجَـٰرَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا ٱنفَضُّوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَآئِمًا ۚ قُلْ مَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهْوِ وَمِنَ ٱلتِّجَـٰرَةِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.en: But [on one occasion] when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muḥammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allāh is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allāh is the best of providers."
verses.tr: wa-idhā raʾawā tijārahan ʾaw lahwan ānfaḍḍūā ʾilayhā watarakūka qāʾiman ۚ qul mā ʿinda Allāh khayrun mmina al-lahwi wamina at-tijārahi ۚ wallāh khayru ar-rāziqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet they scatter towards trade or entertainment whenever they observe it, and leave you [Prophet] standing there. Say, ‘God’s gift is better than any entertainment or trade: God is the best provider.’
verses.pickthall: But when they spy some merchandise or pastime they break away to it and leave thee standing. Say: That which Allah hath is better than pastime and than merchandise, and Allah is the Best of providers.

verses.ar: إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ قَالُوا۟ نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muḥammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allāh." And Allāh knows that you are His Messenger, and Allāh testifies that the hypocrites are liars.
verses.tr: ʾidhā jāʾaka al-munāfiqūna qālūā nashhadu ʾinnaka larasūlu Allāh ۗ wallāh yaʿlamu ʾinnaka larasūluhu wallāh yashhadu ʾinna al-munāfiqīna lakādhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When the hypocrites come to you [Prophet], they say, ‘We bear witness that you are the Messenger of God.’ God knows that you truly are His Messenger and He bears witness that the hypocrites are liars––
verses.pickthall: When the hypocrites come unto thee (O Muhammad), they say: We bear witness that thou art indeed Allah's messenger. And Allah knoweth that thou art indeed His messenger, and Allah beareth witness that the hypocrites indeed are speaking falsely.

verses.ar: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.
verses.tr: āttakhadhūā ʾaymānahum junnahan faṣaddūā ʿan sabīli Allāh ۚ ʾinnahum sāʾa mā kānūā yaʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they use their oaths as a cover and so bar others from God’s way: what they have been doing is truly evil––
verses.pickthall: They make their faith a pretext so that they may turn (men) from the way of Allah. Verily evil is that which they are wont to do,

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.en: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾannahum āmanūā thumma kafarūā faṭubiʿa ʿalā qulūbihim fahum lā yafqahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: because they professed faith and then rejected it, so their hearts have been sealed and they do not understand.
verses.pickthall: That is because they believed, then disbelieved, therefore their hearts are sealed so that they understand not.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَقُولُوا۟ تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ ۖ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُّسَنَّدَةٌ ۖ يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ هُمُ ٱلْعَدُوُّ فَٱحْذَرْهُمْ ۚ قَـٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.en: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allāh destroy them; how are they deluded?
verses.tr: ۞ wa-idhā raʾaytahum tuʿjibuka ʾajsāmuhum ۖ wa-in yaqūlūā tasmaʿ liqawlihim ۖ kaʾannahum khushubun mmusannadahun ۖ yaḥsabūna kulla ṣayḥahin ʿalayhim ۚ humu al-ʿaduwwu fāḥdharhum ۚ qātalahumu Allāh ۖ ʾannā yuʾfakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When you see them [Prophet], their outward appearance pleases you; when they speak, you listen to what they say. But they are like propped-up tim-bers––they think every cry they hear is against them––and they are the enemy. Beware of them. May God confound them! How devious they are!
verses.pickthall: And when thou seest them their figures please thee; and if they speak thou givest ear unto their speech. (They are) as though they were blocks of wood in striped cloaks. They deem every shout to be against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. Allah confound them! How they are perverted!

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوْا۟ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allāh will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla lahum taʿālawā yastaghfir lakum rasūlu Allāh lawwawā ruʾūsahum waraʾaytahum yaṣuddūna wahum mmustakbirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They turn their heads away in disdain when they are told, ‘Come, so that the Messenger of God may ask forgiveness for you,’ and you see them walking away arrogantly.
verses.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Come! The messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you! they avert their faces and thou seest them turning away, disdainful.

verses.ar: سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allāh forgive them. Indeed, Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
verses.tr: sawāʾun ʿalayhim ʾastaghfarta lahum ʾam lam tastaghfir lahum lan yaghfira Allāh lahum ۚ ʾinna Allāh lā yahdā al-qawma al-fāsiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: It makes no difference whether you ask forgiveness for them or not, God will not forgive them: God does not guide such treacherous people.
verses.pickthall: Whether thou ask forgiveness for them or ask not forgiveness for them is all one for them; Allah will not forgive them. Lo! Allah guideth not the evil-living folk.

verses.ar: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَنْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّوا۟ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
verses.en: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allāh until they disband." And to Allāh belong the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.
verses.tr: humu adh-dhīna yaqūlūna lā tunfiqūā ʿalā man ʿinda rasūli Allāh ḥattā yanfaḍḍūā ۗ wa-lillāh khazāʾinu as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi walākinna al-munāfiqīna lā yafqahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They are the ones who say, ‘Give nothing to those who follow God’s Messenger, until they abandon him’, but to God belong the treasures of the heavens and earth, though the hypocrites do not understand this.
verses.pickthall: They it is who say: Spend not on behalf of those (who dwell) with Allah's messenger that they may disperse (and go away from you); when Allah's are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; but the hypocrites comprehend not.

verses.ar: يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَآ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ ٱلْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا ٱلْأَذَلَّ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: They say, "If we return to al-Madīnah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allāh belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.
verses.tr: yaqūlūna laʾin rrajaʿnā ʾilā al-madīnahi layukhrijanna al-ʾaʿazzu minhā al-ʾadhalla ۚ wa-lillāh al-ʿizzahu walirasūlihi walilmuʾminīna walākinna al-munāfiqīna lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘Once we return to Medina the powerful will drive out the weak,’ but power belongs to God, to His Messenger, and to the believers, though the hypocrites do not know this.
verses.pickthall: They say: Surely, if we return to Al-Madinah the mightier will soon drive out the weaker; when might belongeth to Allah and to His messenger and to the believers; but the hypocrites know not.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from the remembrance of Allāh. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā lā tulhikum ʾamwālukum walā ʾawlādukum ʿan dhikri Allāh ۚ waman yafʿal dhālika fa-ūlāʾika humu al-khāsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, do not let your wealth and your children distract you from remembering God: those who do so will be the ones who lose.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Let not your wealth nor your children distract you from remembrance of Allah. Those who do so, they are the losers.

verses.ar: وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِن مَّا رَزَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَآ أَخَّرْتَنِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And spend [in the way of Allāh] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be of the righteous."
verses.tr: wa-anfiqūā min mmā razaqnākum mmin qabli ʾan yaʾtāa ʾaḥadakumu al-mawtu fayaqūla rabbi lawlā ʾakhartanā ʾilā ʾajalin qarībin fa-aṣṣaddaqa wa-akun mmina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Give out of what We have provided for you, before death comes to one of you and he says, ‘My Lord, if You would only reprieve me for a little while, I would give in charity and become one of the righteous.’
verses.pickthall: And spend of that wherewith We have provided you before death cometh unto one of you and he saith: My Lord! If only thou wouldst reprieve me for a little while, then I would give alms and be among the righteous.

verses.ar: وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: But never will Allāh delay a soul when its time has come. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
verses.tr: walan yuʾakhira Allāh nafsan ʾidhā jāʾa ʾajaluhā ۚ wallāh khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God does not reprieve a soul when its turn comes: God is fully aware of what you do.
verses.pickthall: But Allah reprieveth no soul when its term cometh, and Allah is Informed of what ye do.

verses.ar: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.
verses.tr: yusabbiḥu lillāh mā fā as-samāwāti wamā fā al-ʾarḍi ۖ lahu al-mulku walahu al-ḥamdu ۖ wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Everything that is in the heavens and earth glorifies God; all control and all praise belong to Him; He has power over everything.
verses.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah; unto Him belongeth Sovereignty and unto Him belongeth praise, and He is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā khalaqakum faminkum kāfirun waminkum mmuʾminun ۚ wallāh bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who created you, yet some of you disbelieve and some believe: God sees everything you do.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who created you, but one of you is a disbeliever and one of you is a believer, and Allah is Seer of what ye do.

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
verses.tr: khalaqa as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍa bi-l-ḥaqqi waṣawwarakum fa-aḥsana ṣuwarakum ۖ wa-ʾilayhi al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose; He formed you and made your forms good: you will all return to Him.
verses.pickthall: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He shaped you and made good your shapes, and unto Him is the journeying.

verses.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.tr: yaʿlamu mā fā as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wayaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿlinūna ۚ wallāh ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: He knows what is in the heavens and earth; He knows what you conceal and what you reveal; God knows very well the secrets of every heart.
verses.pickthall: He knoweth all that is in the heavens and the earth, and He knoweth what ye conceal and what ye publish. And Allah is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men).

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
verses.tr: ʾalam yaʾtikum nabaā adh-dhīna kafarūā min qablu fadhāqūā wabāla ʾamrihim walahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Disbelievers], have you not heard about those who disbelieved before you? They tasted the evil consequences of their conduct, and a painful torment awaits them.
verses.pickthall: Hath not the story reached you of those who disbelieved of old and so did taste the ill-effects of their conduct, and theirs will be a painful doom.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ ۚ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
verses.en: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allāh dispensed [with them]; and Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
verses.tr: dhālika biʾannahu kānat ttaʾtīhim rusuluhum bi-l-bayyināti faqālūā ʾabasharun yahdūnanā fakafarūā watawallawā ۚ wwāstaghnā Allāh ۚ wallāh ghanāun ḥamīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: That is because their messengers came to them with clear signs, yet they said, ‘Should we take guidance from mere mortals?’, rejected the message, and turned away. But God had no need for them: He is all sufficient, worthy of all praise.
verses.pickthall: That was because their messengers (from Allah) kept coming unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they said: Shall mere mortals guide us? So they disbelieved and turned away, and Allah was independent (of them). Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.

verses.ar: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا۟ ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
