verses.en: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allāh, is easy."
verses.tr: zaʿama adh-dhīna kafarūā ʾan llan yubʿathūā ۚ qul balā warabbā latubʿathunna thumma latunabbaʾunna bimā ʿamiltum ۚ wadhālika ʿalā Allāh yasīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers claim they will not be raised from the dead. Say [Prophet], ‘Yes indeed! I swear by my Lord! You will be raised and then you will be informed about everything you have done: an easy matter for God.’
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve assert that they will not be raised again. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Yea, verily, by my Lord! ye will be raised again and then ye will be informed of what ye did; and that is easy for Allah.

verses.ar: فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: So believe in Allāh and His Messenger and the light [i.e., the Qur’ān] which We have sent down. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
verses.tr: fāminūā billāh warasūlihi wa-an-nūri adh-dhā ʾanzalnā ۚ wallāh bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: So believe in God, in His Messenger, and in the light We have sent down: God is fully aware of what you do.
verses.pickthall: So believe in Allah and His messenger and the light which We have revealed. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْجَمْعِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.en: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
verses.tr: yawma yajmaʿukum liyawmi al-jamʿi ۖ dhālika yawmu at-taghābuni ۗ waman yuʾmin billāh wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yukaffir ʿanhu sayyātihi wayudkhilhu jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ʾabadan ۚ dhālika al-fawzu al-ʿaẓīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: When He gathers you for the Day of Gathering, the Day of mutual neglect, He will cancel the sins of those who believed in Him and acted righteously: He will admit them into Gardens graced with flowing streams, there to remain for ever- the supreme triumph.
verses.pickthall: The day when He shall gather you unto the Day of Assembling, that will be a day of mutual disillusion. And whoso believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will remit from him his evil deeds and will bring him unto Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā wakadhabūā bāyātinā ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu an-nāri khālidīna fīhā ۖ wabiʾsa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who disbelieved and rejected Our signs will be the inhabitants of the Fire, there to remain- a miserable destination.
verses.pickthall: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, such are owners of the Fire; they will abide therein - a hapless journey's end!

verses.ar: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
verses.tr: mā ʾaṣāba min mmuṣībahin ʾillā biʾidhni Allāh ۗ waman yuʾmin billāh yahdi qalbahu ۚ wallāh bikulli shāʾin ʿalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Misfortunes can only happen with God’s permission––He will guide the heart of anyone who believes in Him: God knows all things––
verses.pickthall: No calamity befalleth save by Allah's leave. And whosoever believeth in Allah, He guideth his heart. And Allah is Knower of all things.

verses.ar: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.
verses.tr: wa-aṭīʿūā Allāh wa-aṭīʿūā ar-rasūla ۚ fa-in tawallaytum fa-innamā ʿalā rasūlinā al-balāghu al-mubīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: so obey God and the Messenger. If you turn away, remember that Our Messenger’s duty is only to make plain his message.
verses.pickthall: Obey Allah and obey His messenger; but if ye turn away, then the duty of Our messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
verses.tr: Allāh lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa ۚ waʿalā Allāh falyatawakkali al-muʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God! There is no god but Him, so let the faithful put their trust in Him.
verses.pickthall: Allah! There is no god except Him. In Allah, therefore, let believers put their trust.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾinna min ʾazwājikum wa-awlādikum ʿaduwwan llakum fāḥdharūhum ۚ wa-in taʿfūā wataṣfaḥūā wataghfirūā fa-inna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, even among your spouses and your children you have some enemies- beware of them- but if you overlook their offences, forgive them, pardon them, then God is all forgiving, all merciful.
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Lo! among your wives and your children there are enemies for you, therefor beware of them. And if ye efface and overlook and forgive, then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allāh has with Him a great reward.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā ʾamwālukum wa-awlādukum fitnahun ۚ wallāh ʿindahu ʾajrun ʿaẓīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Your wealth and your children are only a test for you. There is great reward with God:
verses.pickthall: Your wealth and your children are only a temptation, whereas Allah! with Him is an immense reward.

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.en: So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allāh]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
verses.tr: fāttaqūā Allāh mā āstaṭaʿtum wāsmaʿūā wa-aṭīʿūā wa-anfiqūā khayran lliʾanfusikum ۗ waman yūqa shuḥḥa nafsihi fa-ūlāʾika humu al-mufliḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: be mindful of God as much as you can; hear and obey; be charitable- it is for your own good. Those who are saved from their own meanness will be the prosperous ones:
verses.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah as best ye can, and listen, and obey, and spend; that is better for your souls. And whoso is saved from his own greed, such are the successful.

verses.ar: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَـٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.en: If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is [most] Appreciative and Forbearing,
verses.tr: ʾin tuqriḍūā Allāh qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum ۚ wallāh shakūrun ḥalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: if you make a generous loan to God He will multiply it for you and forgive you. God is ever thankful and forbearing;
verses.pickthall: If ye lend unto Allah a goodly loan, He will double it for you and will forgive you, for Allah is Responsive, Clement,

verses.ar: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.tr: ʿālimu al-ghaybi wa-ash-shahādahi al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: He knows the unseen, as well as the seen; He is the Almighty, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Mighty, the Wise.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا۟ ٱلْعِدَّةَ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ ۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأْتِينَ بِفَـٰحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥ ۚ لَا تَدْرِى لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرًا
verses.en: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allāh, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allāh has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allāh will bring about after that a [different] matter.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu ʾidhā ṭallaqtumu an-nisāʾa faṭalliqūhunna liʿiddatihinna wa-aḥṣūā al-ʿiddaha ۖ wāttaqūā Allāh rabbakum ۖ lā tukhrijūhunna min buyūtihinna walā yakhrujna ʾillā ʾan yaʾtīna bifāḥishahin mmubayyinahin ۚ watilka ḥudūdu Allāh ۚ waman yataʿadda ḥudūda Allāh faqad ẓalama nafsahu ۚ lā tadrā laʿalla Allāh yuḥdithu baʿda dhālika ʾamran
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, when any of you intend to divorce women, do so at a time when their prescribed waiting period can properly start, and calculate the period carefully: be mindful of God, your Lord. Do not drive them out of their homes––nor should they themselves leave––unless they commit a flagrant indecency. These are the limits set by God–– whoever oversteps God’s limits wrongs his own soul––for you cannot know what new situation God may perhaps bring about.
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! When ye (men) put away women, put them away for their (legal) period and reckon the period, and keep your duty to Allah, your Lord. Expel them not from their houses nor let them go forth unless they commit open immorality. Such are the limits (imposed by) Allah; and whoso transgresseth Allah's limits, he verily wrongeth his soul. Thou knowest not: it may be that Allah will afterward bring some new thing to pass.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَـٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًا
verses.en: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allāh. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him a way out
verses.tr: fa-idhā balaghna ʾajalahunna fa-amsikūhunna bimaʿrūfin ʾaw fāriqūhunna bimaʿrūfin wa-ashhidūā dhawā ʿadlin mminkum wa-aqīmūā ash-shahādaha lillāh ۚ dhālikum yūʿaẓu bihi man kāna yuʾminu billāh wa-l-yawmi al-ākhiri ۚ waman yattaqi Allāh yajʿal llahu makhrajan
verses.abdelhaleem: When they have completed their appointed term, either keep them honourably, or part with them honourably. Call two just witnesses from your people and establish witness for the sake of God. Anyone who believes in God and the Last Day should heed this: God will find a way out for those who are mindful of Him,
verses.pickthall: Then, when they have reached their term, take them back in kindness or part from them in kindness, and call to witness two just men among you, and keep your testimony upright for Allah. Whoso believeth in Allah and the Last Day is exhorted to act thus. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, Allah will appoint a way out for him,

verses.ar: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَـٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا
verses.en: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allāh - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allāh will accomplish His purpose. Allāh has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.
verses.tr: wayarzuqhu min ḥaythu lā yaḥtasibu ۚ waman yatawakkal ʿalā Allāh fahuwa ḥasbuhu ۚ ʾinna Allāh bālighu ʾamrihi ۚ qad jaʿala Allāh likulli shāʾin qadran
verses.abdelhaleem: and will provide for them from an unexpected source; God will be enough for those who put their trust in Him. God achieves His purpose; God has set a due measure for everything.
verses.pickthall: And will provide for him from (a quarter) whence he hath no expectation. And whosoever putteth his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Lo! Allah bringeth His command to pass. Allah hath set a measure for all things.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَـٰثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰتُ ٱلْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ يُسْرًا
verses.en: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him of his matter ease.
verses.tr: wa-l-ā yaʾisna mina al-maḥīḍi min nnisāʾikum ʾini ārtabtum faʿiddatuhunna thalāthahu ʾashhurin wa-l-ā lam yaḥiḍna ۚ wa-ūlātu al-ʾaḥmāli ʾajaluhunna ʾan yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna ۚ waman yattaqi Allāh yajʿal llahu min ʾamrihi yusran
verses.abdelhaleem: If you are in doubt, the period of waiting will be three months for those women who have ceased menstruating and for those who have not [yet] menstruated; the waiting period of those who are pregnant will be until they deliver their burden: God makes things easy for those who are mindful of Him.
verses.pickthall: And for such of your women as despair of menstruation, if ye doubt, their period (of waiting) shall be three months, along with those who have it not. And for those with child, their period shall be till they bring forth their burden. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, He maketh his course easy for him.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا
verses.en: That is the command of Allāh, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allāh - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.
verses.tr: dhālika ʾamru Allāh ʾanzalahu ʾilaykum ۚ waman yattaqi Allāh yukaffir ʿanhu sayyātihi wayuʿẓim lahu ʾajran
verses.abdelhaleem: This is God’s command, which He has sent down to you. God will wipe out the sinful deeds and increase the rewards of anyone who is mindful of Him.
verses.pickthall: That is the commandment of Allah which He revealeth unto you. And whoso keepeth his duty to Allah, He will remit from him his evil deeds and magnify reward for him.

verses.ar: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُو۟لَـٰتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنفِقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا۟ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.en: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him [i.e., the father] another woman.
verses.tr: ʾaskinūhunna min ḥaythu sakantum mmin wujdikum walā tuḍārrūhunna lituḍayyiqūā ʿalayhinna ۚ wa-in kunna ʾūlāti ḥamlin fa-anfiqūā ʿalayhinna ḥattā yaḍaʿna ḥamlahunna ۚ fa-in ʾarḍaʿna lakum fātūhunna ʾujūrahunna ۖ wa-tamirūā baynakum bimaʿrūfin ۖ wa-in taʿāsartum fasaturḍiʿu lahu ʾukhrā
verses.abdelhaleem: House the wives you are divorcing according to your means, wherever you house yourselves, and do not harass them so as to make their lives difficult. If they are pregnant, maintain them until they are delivered of their burdens; if they suckle your infants, pay them for it. Consult together in a good way- if you make difficulties for one another, another woman may suckle the child for the father––
verses.pickthall: Lodge them where ye dwell, according to your wealth, and harass them not so as to straiten life for them. And if they are with child, then spend for them till they bring forth their burden. Then, if they give suck for you, give them their due payment and consult together in kindness; but if ye make difficulties for one another, then let some other woman give suck for him (the father of the child).

verses.ar: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُۥ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا
verses.en: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allāh has given him. Allāh does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allāh will bring about, after hardship, ease [i.e., relief].
verses.tr: liyunfiq dhū saʿahin mmin saʿatihi ۖ waman qudira ʿalayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimmā ātāhu Allāh ۚ lā yukallifu Allāh nafsan ʾillā mā ātāhā ۚ sayajʿalu Allāh baʿda ʿusrin yusran
verses.abdelhaleem: and let the wealthy man spend according to his wealth. But let him whose provision is restricted spend according to what God has given him: God does not burden any soul with more than He has given it- after hardship, God will bring ease.
verses.pickthall: Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance, and he whose provision is measured, let him spend of that which Allah hath given him. Allah asketh naught of any soul save that which He hath given it. Allah will vouchsafe, after hardship, ease.

verses.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَـٰهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَـٰهَا عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا
verses.en: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.
verses.tr: wakaʾayyin mmin qaryahin ʿatat ʿan ʾamri rabbihā warusulihi faḥāsabnāhā ḥisāban shadīdan waʿadhabnāhā ʿadhāban nnukran
verses.abdelhaleem: Many a town that insolently opposed the command of its Lord and His messengers We have brought sternly to account: We punished them severely
verses.pickthall: And how many a community revolted against the ordinance of its Lord and His messengers, and We called it to a stern account and punished it with dire punishment,

verses.ar: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا
verses.en: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair [i.e., rebellion], and the outcome of its affair was loss.
verses.tr: fadhāqat wabāla ʾamrihā wakāna ʿāqibahu ʾamrihā khusran
verses.abdelhaleem: to make them taste the ill effect of their conduct- the result of their conduct was ruin.
verses.pickthall: So that it tasted the ill-effects of its conduct, and the consequence of its conduct was loss.

verses.ar: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَـٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ قَدْ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا
verses.en: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allāh, O you of understanding who have believed. Allāh has sent down to you a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].
verses.tr: ʾaʿadda Allāh lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan ۖ fāttaqūā Allāh yāʾūlā al-ʾalbābi adh-dhīna āmanūā ۚ qad ʾanzala Allāh ʾilaykum dhikran
verses.abdelhaleem: God has prepared a severe torment for them. So, you who have understanding, you who believe, beware of God. He has sent you the Quran
verses.pickthall: Allah hath prepared for them stern punishment; so keep your duty to Allah, O men of understanding! O ye who believe! Now Allah hath sent down unto you a reminder,

verses.ar: رَّسُولًا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَـٰتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزْقًا
verses.en: [He sent] a Messenger [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allāh that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allāh will have perfected for him a provision.
verses.tr: rrasūlan yatlūā ʿalaykum āyāti Allāh mubayyinātin lliyukhrija adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti mina aẓ-ẓulumāti ʾilā an-nūri ۚ waman yuʾmin billāh wayaʿmal ṣāliḥan yudkhilhu jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ʾabadan ۖ qad ʾaḥsana Allāh lahu rizqan
verses.abdelhaleem: and a messenger- reciting to you God’s revelations that make things clear- to bring those who believe and do righteous deeds from darkness into light. God will admit those who believe in Him and do righteous deeds into Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will remain for ever––He has made good provision for them.
verses.pickthall: A messenger reciting unto you the revelations of Allah made plain, that He may bring forth those who believe and do good works from darkness unto light. And whosoever believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will bring him into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. Allah hath made good provision for him.

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا
verses.en: It is Allāh who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allāh is over all things competent and that Allāh has encompassed all things in knowledge.
verses.tr: Allāh adh-dhā khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin wamina al-ʾarḍi mithlahunna yatanazzalu al-ʾamru baynahunna litaʿlamūā ʾanna Allāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun wa-anna Allāh qad ʾaḥāṭa bikulli shāʾin ʿilmanā
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God who created seven heavens and a similar [number] of earths. His command descends throughout them. So you should realize that He has power over all things and that His knowledge encompasses everything.
verses.pickthall: Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu lima tuḥarrimu mā ʾaḥalla Allāh laka ۖ tabtaghā marḍāta ʾazwājika ۚ wallāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, why do you prohibit what God has made lawful to you in your desire to please your wives? Yet God is forgiving and merciful:
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Why bannest thou that which Allah hath made lawful for thee, seeking to please thy wives? And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: قَدْ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَـٰنِكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Allāh has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. And Allāh is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.
verses.tr: qad faraḍa Allāh lakum taḥillaha ʾaymānikum ۚ wallāh mawlākum ۖ wahuwa al-ʿalīmu al-ḥakīmu
verses.abdelhaleem: He has ordained a way for you [believers] to release you from [such] oaths––God is your helper: He is the All Knowing, the Wise.
verses.pickthall: Allah hath made lawful for you (Muslims) absolution from your oaths (of such a kind), and Allah is your Protector. He is the Knower, the Wise.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.en: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allāh showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Aware."
verses.tr: wa-idh ʾasarra an-nabāu ʾilā baʿḍi ʾazwājihi ḥadīthan falammā nabbaʾat bihi wa-aẓharahu Allāh ʿalayhi ʿarrafa baʿḍahu wa-aʿraḍa ʿan baʿḍin ۖ falammā nabbaʾahā bihi qālat man ʾanbaʾaka hādhā ۖ qāla nabbaʾanāa al-ʿalīmu al-khabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: The Prophet told something in confidence to one of his wives. When she disclosed it [to another wife] and God made this known to him, he confirmed part of it, keeping the rest to himself. When he confronted her with what she had done, she asked, ‘Who told you about this?’ and he replied, ‘The All Knowing, the All Aware told me.’
verses.pickthall: When the Prophet confided a fact unto one of his wives and when she afterward divulged it and Allah apprised him thereof, he made known (to her) part thereof and passed over part. And when he told it her she said: Who hath told thee? He said: The Knower, the Aware hath told me.

verses.ar: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَـٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَـٰلِحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ
verses.en: If you two [wives] repent to Allāh, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allāh is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.
verses.tr: ʾin tatūbā ʾilā Allāh faqad ṣaghat qulūbukumā ۖ wa-in taẓāharā ʿalayhi fa-inna Allāh huwa mawlāhu wajibrīlu waṣāliḥu al-muʾminīna ۖ wa-l-malāʾikahu baʿda dhālika ẓahīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: If both of you [wives] repent to God––for your hearts have deviated––[all will be well]; if you collaborate against him, [be warned that] God will aid him, as will Gabriel and all righteous believers, and the angels too will back him.
verses.pickthall: If ye twain turn unto Allah repentant, (ye have cause to do so) for your hearts desired (the ban); and if ye aid one another against him (Muhammad) then lo! Allah, even He, is his Protecting Friend, and Gabriel and the righteous among the believers; and furthermore the angels are his helpers.

verses.ar: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُۥٓ أَزْوَٰجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَـٰتٍ مُّؤْمِنَـٰتٍ قَـٰنِتَـٰتٍ تَـٰٓئِبَـٰتٍ عَـٰبِدَٰتٍ سَـٰٓئِحَـٰتٍ ثَيِّبَـٰتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا
verses.en: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allāh], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.
verses.tr: ʿasā rabbuhu ʾin ṭallaqakunna ʾan yubdilahu ʾazwājan khayran mminkunna muslimātin mmuʾminātin qānitātin tāʾibātin ʿābidātin sāʾiḥātin thayyibātin wa-abkāran
verses.abdelhaleem: His Lord may well replace you with better wives if the Prophet decides to divorce any of you: wives who are devoted to God, true believers, devout, who turn to Him in repentance and worship Him, given to fasting, whether previously married or virgins.
verses.pickthall: It may happen that his Lord, if he divorce you, will give him in your stead wives better than you, submissive (to Allah), believing, pious, penitent, devout, inclined to fasting, widows and maids.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَّا يَعْصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allāh in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā qūā ʾanfusakum wa-ahlīkum nāran waqūduhā an-nāsu wa-l-ḥijārahu ʿalayhā malāʾikahun ghilāẓun shidādun llā yaʿṣūna Allāh mā ʾamarahum wayafʿalūna mā yuʾmarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, guard yourselves and your families against a Fire fuelled by people and stones, over which stand angels, stern and strong; angels who never disobey God’s commands to them, but do as they are ordered:
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Ward off from yourselves and your families a Fire whereof the fuel is men and stones, over which are set angels strong, severe, who resist not Allah in that which He commandeth them, but do that which they are commanded.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna kafarūā lā taʿtadhirūā al-yawma ۖ ʾinnamā tujzawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘You who disbelieve, make no excuses today: you are only being repaid for what you used to do.’
verses.pickthall: (Then it will be said): O ye who disbelieve! Make no excuses for yourselves this day. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ ۖ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, repent to Allāh with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allāh will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā adh-dhīna āmanūā tūbūā ʾilā Allāh tawbahan nnaṣūḥan ʿasā rabbukum ʾan yukaffira ʿankum sayyātikum wayudkhilakum jannātin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru yawma lā yukhzā Allāh an-nabāa wa-adh-dhīna āmanūā maʿahu ۖ nūruhum yasʿā bayna ʾaydīhim wabiʾaymānihim yaqūlūna rabbanā ʾatmim lanā nūranā wāghfir lanā ۖ ʾinnaka ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Believers, turn to God in sincere repentance. Your Lord may well cancel your bad deeds for you and admit you into Gardens graced with flowing streams, on a Day when God will not disgrace the Prophet or those who have believed with him. With their lights streaming out ahead of them and to their right, they will say, ‘Lord, perfect our lights for us and forgive us: You have power over everything.’
verses.pickthall: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَـٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā an-nabāu jāhidi al-kuffāra wa-l-munāfiqīna wāghluẓ ʿalayhim ۚ wamaʾwāhum jahannamu ۖ wabiʾsa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: Prophet, strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Deal with them sternly. Hell will be their home, an evil destination!
verses.pickthall: O Prophet! Strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern with them. Hell will be their home, a hapless journey's end.

verses.ar: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verses.en: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."
verses.tr: ḍaraba Allāh mathalan llilladhīna kafarūā āmraʾata nūḥin wāmraʾata lūṭin ۖ kānatā taḥta ʿabdayni min ʿibādinā ṣāliḥayni fakhānatāhumā falam yughniyā ʿanhumā mina Allāh shayā waqīla ādkhulā an-nāra maʿa ad-dākhilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God has given examples of disbelievers: the wives of Noah and Lot who married two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them. Their husbands could not help them against God: it was said, ‘Both of you enter the Fire with the others.’
verses.pickthall: Allah citeth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot, who were under two of Our righteous slaves yet betrayed them so that they (the husbands) availed them naught against Allah and it was said (unto them): Enter the Fire along with those who enter.

verses.ar: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."
verses.tr: waḍaraba Allāh mathalan llilladhīna āmanūā āmraʾata firʿawna ʾidh qālat rabbi ābni lā ʿindaka baytan fā al-jannahi wanajjinā min firʿawna waʿamalihi wanajjinā mina al-qawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: God has also given examples of believers: Pharaoh’s wife, who said, ‘Lord, build me a house near You in the Garden. Save me from Pharaoh and his actions; save me from the evildoers,’
verses.pickthall: And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk;

verses.ar: وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ
verses.en: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.
verses.tr: wamaryama ābnata ʿimrāna at-tā ʾaḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhi min rrūḥinā waṣaddaqat bikalimāti rabbihā wakutubihi wakānat mina al-qānitīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and Mary, daughter of Imran. She guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her from Our spirit. She accepted the truth of her Lord’s words and Scriptures: she was truly devout.
verses.pickthall: And Mary, daughter of 'Imran, whose body was chaste, therefor We breathed therein something of Our Spirit. And she put faith in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, and was of the obedient.

verses.ar: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
verses.tr: tabāraka adh-dhā biyadihi al-mulku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin qadīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Exalted is He who holds all control in His hands; who has power over all things;
verses.pickthall: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
verses.en: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
verses.tr: adh-dhā khalaqa al-mawta wa-l-ḥayawāha liyabluwakum ʾayyukum ʾaḥsanu ʿamalan ۚ wahuwa al-ʿazīzu al-ghafūru
verses.abdelhaleem: who created death and life to test you [people] and reveal which of you does best––He is the Mighty, the Forgiving;
verses.pickthall: Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
verses.en: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
verses.tr: adh-dhā khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan ۖ mmā tarā fā khalqi ar-raḥmāni min tafāwutin ۖ fārjiʿi al-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: who created the seven heavens, one above the other. You will not see any flaw in what the Lord of Mercy creates. Look again! Can you see any flaw?
verses.pickthall: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts?

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
verses.en: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
verses.tr: thumma ārjiʿi al-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ʾilayka al-baṣaru khāsiʾan wahuwa ḥasīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Look again! And again! Your sight will turn back to you, weak and defeated.
verses.pickthall: Then look again and yet again, thy sight will return unto thee weakened and made dim.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
verses.tr: walaqad zayyannā as-samāʾa ad-dunyā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūman llilshayāṭīni ۖ wa-aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba as-saʿīri
verses.abdelhaleem: We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and made them [missiles] for stoning devils for whom We have also prepared the torment of a blazing fire.
verses.pickthall: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
verses.tr: walilladhīna kafarūā birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama ۖ wabiʾsa al-maṣīru
verses.abdelhaleem: For those who defy their Lord We have prepared the torment of Hell: an evil destination.
verses.pickthall: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a hapless journey's end!

verses.ar: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
verses.en: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
verses.tr: ʾidhā ʾulqūā fīhā samiʿūā lahā shahīqan wahāa tafūru
verses.abdelhaleem: They will hear it drawing in its breath when they are thrown in. It blazes forth,
verses.pickthall: When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up,

verses.ar: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
verses.en: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
verses.tr: takādu tamayyazu mina al-ghayẓi ۖ kullamā ʾulqāa fīhā fawjun saʾalahum khazanatuhā ʾalam yaʾtikum nadhīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: almost bursting with rage. Its keepers will ask every group that is thrown in, ‘Did no one come to warn you?’
verses.pickthall: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ
verses.en: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
verses.tr: qālūā balā qad jāʾanā nadhīrun fakadhabnā waqulnā mā nazzala Allāh min shāʾin ʾin ʾantum ʾillā fā ḍalālin kabīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: They will reply, ‘Yes, a warner did come to us, but we did not believe him. We said, “God has revealed nothing: you are greatly misguided”.’
verses.pickthall: They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
verses.tr: waqālūā law kunnā nasmaʿu ʾaw naʿqilu mā kunnā fā ʾaṣḥābi as-saʿīri
verses.abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘If only we had listened, or reasoned, we would not be with the inhabitants of the blazing fire,’ and
verses.pickthall: And they say: Had we been wont to listen or have sense, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames.

verses.ar: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
verses.tr: fāʿtarafūā bidhanbihim fasuḥqan lliʾaṣḥābi as-saʿīri
verses.abdelhaleem: they will confess their sins. Away with the inhabitants of the blazing fire!
verses.pickthall: So they acknowledge their sins; but far removed (from mercy) are the dwellers in the flames.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bi-l-ghaybi lahum mmaghfirahun wa-ajrun kabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: But there is forgiveness and a great reward for those who fear their Lord though they cannot see Him.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who fear their Lord in secret, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.

verses.ar: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.tr: wa-asirrūā qawlakum ʾawi ājharūā bihi ۖ ʾinnahu ʿalīmun bidhāti aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: Whether you keep your words secret or state them openly, He knows the contents of every heart.
verses.pickthall: And keep your opinion secret or proclaim it, lo! He is Knower of all that is in the breasts (of men).

verses.ar: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.en: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
verses.tr: ʾalā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa al-laṭīfu al-khabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: How could He who created not know His own creation, when He is the Most Subtle, the All Aware?
verses.pickthall: Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.en: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
verses.tr: huwa adh-dhā jaʿala lakumu al-ʾarḍa dhalūlan fāmshūā fā manākibihā wakulūā min rrizqihi ۖ wa-ʾilayhi an-nushūru
verses.abdelhaleem: It is He who has made the earth manageable for you––travel its regions; eat His provision- and to Him you will be resurrected.
verses.pickthall: He it is Who hath made the earth subservient unto you, so Walk in the paths thereof and eat of His providence. And unto Him will be the resurrection (of the dead).

verses.ar: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
verses.en: Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
verses.tr: ʾaʾamintum mman fā as-samāʾi ʾan yakhsifa bikumu al-ʾarḍa fa-idhā hāa tamūru
verses.abdelhaleem: Are you sure that He who is in Heaven will not make the earth swallow you up with a violent shudder?
verses.pickthall: Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed?

verses.ar: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
verses.en: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
verses.tr: ʾam ʾamintum mman fā as-samāʾi ʾan yursila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban ۖ fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīri
verses.abdelhaleem: Are you sure that He who is in Heaven will not send a whirlwind to pelt you with stones? You will come to know what My warning means.
verses.pickthall: Or have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not let loose on you a hurricane? But ye shall know the manner of My warning.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.en: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
verses.tr: walaqad kadhaba adh-dhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīri
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who went before them also disbelieved- how terrible was My condemnation!
verses.pickthall: And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)!

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
verses.tr: ʾawalam yarawā ʾilā aṭ-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātin wayaqbiḍna ۚ mā yumsikuhunna ʾillā ar-raḥmānu ۚ ʾinnahu bikulli shāʾin baṣīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they not see the birds above them spreading and closing their wings? It is only the Lord of Mercy who holds them up: He watches over everything.
verses.pickthall: Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and closing them? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all things.

verses.ar: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
verses.en: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
verses.tr: ʾamman hādhā adh-dhā huwa jundun llakum yanṣurukum mmin dūni ar-raḥmāni ۚ ʾini al-kāfirūna ʾillā fā ghurūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: What force can help you if the Lord of Mercy does not? The disbelievers are truly deluded.
verses.pickthall: Or who is he that will be an army unto you to help you instead of the Beneficent? The disbelievers are in naught but illusion.

verses.ar: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
verses.en: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
verses.tr: ʾamman hādhā adh-dhā yarzuqukum ʾin ʾamsaka rizqahu ۚ bal llajjūā fā ʿutuwwin wanufūrin
verses.abdelhaleem: Who can provide for you if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in their insolence and their avoidance of the Truth.
verses.pickthall: Or who is he that will provide for you if He should withhold His providence? Nay, but they are set in pride and frowardness.

verses.ar: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
verses.tr: ʾafaman yamshā mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ʾahdā ʾamman yamshā sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭin mmustaqīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Who is better guided: someone who falls on his face, or someone who walks steadily on a straight path?
verses.pickthall: Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh upright on a straight road?

verses.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."
verses.tr: qul huwa adh-dhā ʾanshaʾakum wajaʿala lakumu as-samʿa wa-l-ʾabṣāra wa-l-ʾafdaha ۖ qalīlan mmā tashkurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘It is He who brought you into being, He who endowed you with hearing, sight, and understanding- what small thanks you give!’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!

verses.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
verses.tr: qul huwa adh-dhā dharaʾakum fā al-ʾarḍi wa-ʾilayhi tuḥsharūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘It is He who scattered you throughout the earth, He to whom you will be gathered.’
verses.pickthall: Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.tr: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā al-waʿdu ʾin kuntum ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘If what you say is true, when will this promise be fulfilled?’
verses.pickthall: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
verses.tr: qul ʾinnamā al-ʿilmu ʿinda Allāh wa-innamā ʾanā nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘God alone has knowledge of this: my only duty is to give clear warning.’
verses.pickthall: Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner;

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
verses.en: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."
verses.tr: falammā raʾawhu zulfahan sīt wujūhu adh-dhīna kafarūā waqīla hādhā adh-dhā kuntum bihi taddaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they see it close at hand, the disbelievers’ faces will be gloomy, and it will be said, ‘This is what you were calling for.’
verses.pickthall: But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry, and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered: whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum ʾin ʾahlakanāa Allāh waman mmaʿāa ʾaw raḥimanā faman yujīru al-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Just think- regardless of whether God destroys me and my followers or has mercy on us- who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful doom?

verses.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
verses.tr: qul huwa ar-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā ۖ fasataʿlamūna man huwa fā ḍalālin mmubīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘He is the Lord of Mercy; we believe in Him; we put our trust in Him. You will come to know in time who is in obvious error.’
verses.pickthall: Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
verses.en: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
verses.tr: qul ʾaraʾaytum ʾin ʾaṣbaḥa māʾukum ghawran faman yaʾtīkum bimāʾin mmaʿīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘Just think: if all your water were to sink deep into the earth who could give you flowing water in its place?’
verses.pickthall: Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water?

verses.ar: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
verses.en: Nūn. By the pen and what they inscribe,
verses.tr: n ۚ wa-l-qalami wamā yasṭurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Nun By the pen! By all they write!
verses.pickthall: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith),

verses.ar: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
verses.en: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
verses.tr: mā ʾanta biniʿmahi rabbika bimajnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord’s grace does not make you [Prophet] a madman:
verses.pickthall: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
verses.en: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
verses.tr: wa-inna laka laʾajran ghayra mamnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: you will have a never-ending reward––
verses.pickthall: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
verses.tr: wa-innaka laʿalā khuluqin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: truly you have a strong character––
verses.pickthall: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.

verses.ar: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: So you will see and they will see.
verses.tr: fasatubṣiru wayubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and soon you will see, as will they,
verses.pickthall: And thou wilt see and they will see

verses.ar: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
verses.en: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
verses.tr: biʾayyyikumu al-maftūnu
verses.abdelhaleem: which of you is afflicted with madness.
verses.pickthall: Which of you is the demented.

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
verses.tr: ʾinna rabbaka huwa ʾaʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa ʾaʿlamu bi-l-muhtadīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is rightly guided.
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.

verses.ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Then do not obey the deniers.
verses.tr: falā tuṭiʿi al-mukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So do not yield to those who deny the truth––
verses.pickthall: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters

verses.ar: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
verses.en: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
verses.tr: waddūā law tudhinu fayudhinūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they want you to compromise with them and then they will compromise with you––
verses.pickthall: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.

verses.ar: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
verses.en: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
verses.tr: walā tuṭiʿ kulla ḥallāfin mmahīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: do not yield to any contemptible swearer,
verses.pickthall: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,

verses.ar: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
verses.en: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
verses.tr: hammāzin mmashāʾin binamīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: to any backbiter, slander-monger,
verses.pickthall: Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders,

verses.ar: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.en: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
verses.tr: mmannāʿin llilkhayri muʿtadin ʾathīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: or hinderer of good, to anyone who is sinful, aggressive,
verses.pickthall: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor

verses.ar: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
verses.en: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
verses.tr: ʿutullin baʿda dhālika zanīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: coarse, and on top of all that, an imposter.
verses.pickthall: Greedy therewithal, intrusive.

verses.ar: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
verses.en: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
verses.tr: ʾan kāna dhā mālin wabanīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Just because he has wealth and sons,
verses.pickthall: It is because he is possessed of wealth and children

verses.ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
verses.tr: ʾidhā tutlā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla ʾasāṭīru al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: when our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘These are just ancient fables.’
verses.pickthall: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.

verses.ar: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
verses.en: We will brand him upon the snout.
verses.tr: sanasimuhu ʿalā al-khurṭūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall brand him on the snout!
verses.pickthall: We shall brand him on the nose.

verses.ar: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
verses.tr: ʾinnā balawnāhum kamā balawnā ʾaṣḥāba al-jannahi ʾidh ʾaqsamūā layaṣrimunnahā muṣbiḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We have tried them as We tried the owners of a certain garden, who swore that they would harvest its fruits in the morning
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,

verses.ar: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
verses.en: Without making exception.
verses.tr: walā yastathnūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and made no allowance [for the Will of God]:
verses.pickthall: And made no exception (for the Will of Allah);

verses.ar: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
verses.en: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
verses.tr: faṭāfa ʿalayhā ṭāʾifun mmin rrabbika wahum nāʾimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: a disaster from your Lord struck the garden as they slept
verses.pickthall: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept

verses.ar: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
verses.en: And it became as though reaped.
verses.tr: fa-aṣbaḥat ka-aṣ-ṣarīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: and by morning it was stripped bare, a desolate land.
verses.pickthall: And in the morning it was as if plucked.

verses.ar: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.en: And they called one another at morning,
verses.tr: fatanādawā muṣbiḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Still they called each other at daybreak,
verses.pickthall: And they cried out one unto another in the morning,

verses.ar: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
verses.en: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
verses.tr: ʾani āghdūā ʿalā ḥarthikum ʾin kuntum ṣārimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Go early to your field if you wish to gather all its fruits,’
verses.pickthall: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).

verses.ar: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
verses.en: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
verses.tr: fānṭalaqūā wahum yatakhāfatūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and went off, whispering,
verses.pickthall: So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones:

verses.ar: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
verses.en: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
verses.tr: ʾan llā yadkhulannahā al-yawma ʿalaykum mmiskīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Make sure no poor person enters the garden today!’––
verses.pickthall: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.

verses.ar: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
verses.en: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
verses.tr: waghadawā ʿalā ḥardin qādirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: they left early, bent on their purpose-
verses.pickthall: They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.en: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
verses.tr: falammā raʾawhā qālūā ʾinnā laḍāllūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but when they saw the garden, they said, ‘We must have lost our way!
verses.pickthall: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!

verses.ar: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
verses.en: Rather, we have been deprived."
verses.tr: bal naḥnu maḥrūmūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No- we are ruined!’
verses.pickthall: Nay, but we are desolate!

verses.ar: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
verses.en: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"
verses.tr: qāla ʾawsaṭuhum ʾalam ʾaqul llakum lawlā tusabbiḥūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The wisest of them said, ‘Did I not say to you, “Will you not glorify God?”’-
verses.pickthall: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
verses.tr: qālūā subḥāna rabbinā ʾinnā kunnā ẓālimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: they said, ‘Glory be to God, Our Lord! Truly, we were doing wrong!’-
verses.pickthall: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.

verses.ar: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
verses.en: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
verses.tr: fa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatalāwamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and then they turned to each other in mutual reproach.
verses.pickthall: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
verses.en: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
verses.tr: qālūā yāwaylanā ʾinnā kunnā ṭāghīna
verses.abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Alas for us! We have done terrible wrong,
verses.pickthall: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.

verses.ar: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
verses.en: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
verses.tr: ʿasā rabbunā ʾan yubdilanā khayran mminhā ʾinnā ʾilā rabbinā rāghibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but maybe our Lord will give us something better in its place: we truly turn to Him in hope.’
verses.pickthall: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
verses.tr: kadhālika al-ʿadhābu ۖ walaʿadhābu al-ākhirahi ʾakbaru ۚ law kānūā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Such is the punishment [in this life], but greater still is the punishment in the Hereafter, if only they knew.
verses.pickthall: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know.

verses.ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
verses.tr: ʾinna lilmuttaqīna ʿinda rabbihim jannāti an-naʿīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: There will be Gardens of bliss for those who are mindful of God.
verses.pickthall: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.

verses.ar: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
verses.tr: ʾafanajʿalu al-muslimīna ka-l-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Should We treat those who submit to Us as We treat those who do evil?
verses.pickthall: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?

verses.ar: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.en: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
verses.tr: mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What is the matter with you? On what basis do you judge?
verses.pickthall: What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge!

verses.ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
verses.en: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
verses.tr: ʾam lakum kitābun fīhi tadrusūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you have a Scripture that tells you
verses.pickthall: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn

verses.ar: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
verses.en: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
verses.tr: ʾinna lakum fīhi lamā takhayyarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: that you will be granted whatever you choose?
verses.pickthall: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.en: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
verses.tr: ʾam lakum ʾaymānun ʿalaynā bālighahun ʾilā yawmi al-qiyāmahi ۙ ʾinna lakum lamā taḥkumūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you received from Us solemn oaths, binding to the Day of Resurrection, that you will get whatever you yourselves decide?
verses.pickthall: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?

verses.ar: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
verses.en: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
verses.tr: salhum ʾayyuhum bidhālika zaʿīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Ask them [Prophet] which of them will guarantee this.
verses.pickthall: Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that!

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
verses.tr: ʾam lahum shurakāʾu falyaʾtūā bishurakāʾihim ʾin kānūā ṣādiqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they have ‘partners’ [besides God]? Let them produce their ‘partners’, if what they say is true.
verses.pickthall: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verses.en: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,
verses.tr: yawma yukshafu ʿan sāqin wayudʿawna ʾilā as-sujūdi falā yastaṭīʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when matters become dire, they will be invited to prostrate themselves but will be prevented from doing so,
verses.pickthall: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,

verses.ar: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
verses.tr: khāshiʿahan ʾabṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillahun ۖ waqad kānūā yudʿawna ʾilā as-sujūdi wahum sālimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and their eyes will be downcast and they will be overwhelmed with shame: they were invited to prostrate themselves when they were safe [but refused].
verses.pickthall: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.

verses.ar: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
verses.tr: fadharnā waman yukadhibu bihādhā al-ḥadīthi ۖ sanastadrijuhum mmin ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] leave those who reject this revelation to Me: We shall lead them on, step by step, in ways beyond their knowledge;
verses.pickthall: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.

verses.ar: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
verses.en: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
verses.tr: wa-umlā lahum ۚ ʾinna kaydā matīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: I will allow them more time, for My plan is powerful.
verses.pickthall: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.

verses.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.en: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
verses.tr: ʾam tasluhum ʾajran fahum mmin mmaghramin mmuthqalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you demand some reward from them that would burden them with debt?
verses.pickthall: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?

verses.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
verses.tr: ʾam ʿindahumu al-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do they have knowledge of the unseen that enables them to write it down?
verses.pickthall: Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)?

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
verses.en: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.
verses.tr: fāṣbir liḥukmi rabbika walā takun kaṣāḥibi al-ḥūti ʾidh nādā wahuwa makẓūmun
verses.abdelhaleem: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: do not be like the man in the whale who called out in distress:
verses.pickthall: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.

verses.ar: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
verses.en: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
verses.tr: llawlā ʾan tadārakahu niʿmahun mmin rrabbihi lanubidha bi-l-ʿarāʾi wahuwa madhmūmun
verses.abdelhaleem: if his Lord’s grace had not reached him, he would have been left, abandoned and blameworthy, on the barren shore,
verses.pickthall: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.

verses.ar: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
verses.tr: fājtabāhu rabbuhu fajaʿalahu mina aṣ-ṣāliḥīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but his Lord chose him and made him one of the Righteous.
verses.pickthall: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.

verses.ar: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verses.en: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
verses.tr: wa-in yakādu adh-dhīna kafarūā layuzliqūnaka biʾabṣārihim lammā samiʿūā adh-dhikra wayaqūlūna ʾinnahu lamajnūnun
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers almost strike you down with their looks when they hear the Quran. They say, ‘He must be mad!’
verses.pickthall: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;

verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
verses.tr: wamā huwa ʾillā dhikrun llilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: but truly it is nothing other than a Reminder for all peoples.
verses.pickthall: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verses.en: The Inevitable Reality -
verses.tr: al-ḥāqqahu
verses.abdelhaleem: The Inevitable Hour!
verses.pickthall: The Reality!

verses.ar: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verses.en: What is the Inevitable Reality?
verses.tr: mā al-ḥāqqahu
verses.abdelhaleem: What is the Inevitable Hour?
verses.pickthall: What is the Reality?

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā al-ḥāqqahu
verses.abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the Inevitable Hour is?
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
verses.en: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].
verses.tr: kadhabat thamūdu waʿādun bi-l-qāriʿahi
verses.abdelhaleem: The people of Thamud and 'Ad denied that the crashing blowwould come:
verses.pickthall: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
verses.en: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
verses.tr: fa-ammā thamūdu fa-uhlikūā bi-aṭ-ṭāghiyahi
verses.abdelhaleem: Thamud was destroyed by a deafening blast;
verses.pickthall: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
verses.en: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
verses.tr: wa-ammā ʿādun fa-uhlikūā birīḥin ṣarṣarin ʿātiyahin
verses.abdelhaleem: Ad was destroyed by a furious wind
verses.pickthall: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,

verses.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
verses.en: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
verses.tr: sakharahā ʿalayhim sabʿa layālin wathamāniyaha ʾayyāmin ḥusūman fatarā al-qawma fīhā ṣarʿā kaʾannahum ʾaʿjāzu nakhlin khāwiyahin
verses.abdelhaleem: that God let loose against them for seven consecutive nights, eight consecutive days, so that you could have seen its people lying dead like hollow palm-trunks.
verses.pickthall: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.

verses.ar: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
verses.en: Then do you see of them any remains?
verses.tr: fahal tarā lahum mmin bāqiyahin
verses.abdelhaleem: Can you see any trace of them now?
verses.pickthall: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
verses.en: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
verses.tr: wajāʾa firʿawnu waman qablahu wa-l-muʾtafikātu bi-l-khāṭiʾahi
verses.abdelhaleem: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
verses.pickthall: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,

verses.ar: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
verses.en: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
verses.tr: faʿaṣawā rasūla rabbihim fa-akhadhahum ʾakhdhahan rrābiyahan
verses.abdelhaleem: these people committed grave sins and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an ever-tightening grip.
verses.pickthall: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.

verses.ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
verses.en: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship
verses.tr: ʾinnā lammā ṭaghā al-māʾu ḥamalnākum fā al-jāriyahi
verses.abdelhaleem: But when the Flood rose high, We saved you in the floating ship,
verses.pickthall: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

verses.ar: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
verses.en: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
verses.tr: linajʿalahā lakum tadhkirahan wataʿiyahā ʾudhunun wāʿiyahun
verses.abdelhaleem: making that event a reminder for you: attentive ears may take heed.
verses.pickthall: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
verses.en: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
verses.tr: fa-idhā nufikha fā aṣ-ṣūri nafkhahun wāḥidahun
verses.abdelhaleem: When the Trumpet is sounded a single time,
verses.pickthall: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast

verses.ar: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
verses.en: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
verses.tr: waḥumilati al-ʾarḍu wa-l-jibālu fadukkatā dakkahan wāḥidahan
verses.abdelhaleem: when the earth and its mountains are raised high and then crushed with a single blow,
