verses.pickthall: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,

verses.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
verses.en: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,
verses.tr: fayawmaʾidhin waqaʿati al-wāqiʿahu
verses.abdelhaleem: on that Day the Great Event will come to pass.
verses.pickthall: Then, on that day will the Event befall.

verses.ar: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
verses.en: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
verses.tr: wānshaqqati as-samāʾu fahāa yawmaʾidhin wāhiyahun
verses.abdelhaleem: The sky will be torn apart on that Day, it will be so frail.
verses.pickthall: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.

verses.ar: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
verses.en: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
verses.tr: wa-l-malaku ʿalā ʾarjāʾihā ۚ wayaḥmilu ʿarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaʾidhin thamāniyahun
verses.abdelhaleem: The angels will be on all sides of it and, on that Day, eight of them will bear the throne of your Lord above them.
verses.pickthall: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.

verses.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
verses.en: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
verses.tr: yawmaʾidhin tuʿraḍūna lā takhfā minkum khāfiyahun
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day you will be brought to judgement and none of your secrets will remain hidden.
verses.pickthall: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
verses.en: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
verses.tr: fa-ammā man ʾūtāa kitābahu biyamīnihi fayaqūlu hāʾumu āqraʾūā kitābiyah
verses.abdelhaleem: Anyone who is given his Record in his right hand will say, ‘Here is my Record, read it.
verses.pickthall: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!

verses.ar: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
verses.en: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
verses.tr: ʾinnā ẓanantu ʾannā mulāqin ḥisābiyah
verses.abdelhaleem: I knew I would meet my Reckoning,’
verses.pickthall: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.

verses.ar: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
verses.en: So he will be in a pleasant life -
verses.tr: fahuwa fā ʿīshahin rrāḍiyahin
verses.abdelhaleem: and so he will have a pleasant life
verses.pickthall: Then he will be in blissful state

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
verses.en: In an elevated garden,
verses.tr: fā jannahin ʿāliyahin
verses.abdelhaleem: in a lofty Garden,
verses.pickthall: In a high garden

verses.ar: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
verses.en: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
verses.tr: quṭūfuhā dāniyahun
verses.abdelhaleem: with clustered fruit within his reach.
verses.pickthall: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.

verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
verses.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
verses.tr: kulūā wāshrabūā hanīā bimā ʾaslaftum fā al-ʾayyāmi al-khāliyahi
verses.abdelhaleem: It will be said, ‘Eat and drink to your heart’s content as a reward for what you have done in days gone by.’
verses.pickthall: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
verses.en: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
verses.tr: wa-ammā man ʾūtāa kitābahu bishimālihi fayaqūlu yālaytanā lam ʾūta kitābiyah
verses.abdelhaleem: But anyone who is given his Record in his left hand will say, ‘If only I had never been given any Record
verses.pickthall: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book

verses.ar: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
verses.en: And had not known what is my account.
verses.tr: walam ʾadri mā ḥisābiyah
verses.abdelhaleem: and knew nothing of my Reckoning.
verses.pickthall: And knew not what my reckoning!

verses.ar: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
verses.en: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.
verses.tr: yālaytahā kānati al-qāḍiyaha
verses.abdelhaleem: How I wish death had been the end of me.
verses.pickthall: Oh, would that it had been death!

verses.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
verses.en: My wealth has not availed me.
verses.tr: mā ʾaghnā ʿannā māliyah ۜ
verses.abdelhaleem: My wealth has been no use to me,
verses.pickthall: My wealth hath not availed me,

verses.ar: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
verses.en: Gone from me is my authority."
verses.tr: halaka ʿannā sulṭāniyah
verses.abdelhaleem: and my power has vanished.’
verses.pickthall: My power hath gone from me.

verses.ar: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
verses.en: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
verses.tr: khudhūhu faghullūhu
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Take him, put a collar on him,
verses.pickthall: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
verses.en: Then into Hellfire drive him.
verses.tr: thumma al-jaḥīma ṣallūhu
verses.abdelhaleem: lead him to burn in the blazing Fire,
verses.pickthall: And then expose him to hell-fire

verses.ar: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
verses.en: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
verses.tr: thumma fā silsilahin dharʿuhā sabʿūna dhirāʿan fāslukūhu
verses.abdelhaleem: and [bind him] in a chain seventy metres long:
verses.pickthall: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,
verses.tr: ʾinnahu kāna lā yuʾminu billāh al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: he would not believe in Almighty God,
verses.pickthall: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,

verses.ar: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
verses.en: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
verses.tr: walā yaḥuḍḍu ʿalā ṭaʿāmi al-miskīni
verses.abdelhaleem: he never encouraged feeding the hungry,
verses.pickthall: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.

verses.ar: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
verses.en: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
verses.tr: falaysa lahu al-yawma hāhunā ḥamīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: so today he has no real friend here,
verses.pickthall: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,

verses.ar: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
verses.en: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
verses.tr: walā ṭaʿāmun ʾillā min ghislīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: and the only food he has is the filth
verses.pickthall: Nor any food save filth

verses.ar: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
verses.en: None will eat it except the sinners.
verses.tr: llā yaʾkuluhu ʾillā al-khāṭiwna
verses.abdelhaleem: that only sinners eat.’
verses.pickthall: Which none but sinners eat.

verses.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: So I swear by what you see
verses.tr: falā ʾuqsimu bimā tubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So I swear by what you can see
verses.pickthall: But nay! I swear by all that ye see

verses.ar: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And what you do not see
verses.tr: wamā lā tubṣirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and by what you cannot see:
verses.pickthall: And all that ye see not

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu laqawlu rasūlin karīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: this [Quran] is the speech of an honoured messenger,
verses.pickthall: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.

verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
verses.tr: wamā huwa biqawli shāʿirin ۚ qalīlan mmā tuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: not the words of a poet- how little you believe!-
verses.pickthall: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!

verses.ar: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
verses.tr: walā biqawli kāhinin ۚ qalīlan mmā tadhakkarūna
verses.abdelhaleem: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect!
verses.pickthall: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!

verses.ar: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: tanzīlun mmin rrabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This [Quran] is a message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds:
verses.pickthall: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
verses.en: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
verses.tr: walaw taqawwala ʿalaynā baʿḍa al-ʾaqāwīli
verses.abdelhaleem: if [the Prophet] had attributed some fabrication to Us,
verses.pickthall: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,

verses.ar: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: We would have seized him by the right hand;
verses.tr: laʾakhadhnā minhu bi-l-yamīni
verses.abdelhaleem: We would certainly have seized his right hand
verses.pickthall: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
verses.en: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
verses.tr: thumma laqaṭaʿnā minhu al-watīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and cut off his lifeblood,
verses.pickthall: And then severed his life-artery,

verses.ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
verses.en: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
verses.tr: famā minkum mmin ʾaḥadin ʿanhu ḥājizīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and none of you could have defended him.
verses.pickthall: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
verses.tr: wa-innahu latadhkirahun llilmuttaqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This [Quran] is a reminder for those who are aware of God.
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
verses.tr: wa-innā lanaʿlamu ʾanna minkum mmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We know that some of you consider it to be lies-
verses.pickthall: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
verses.tr: wa-innahu laḥasrahun ʿalā al-kāfirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: this will be a source of bitter regret for the disbelievers-
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verses.en: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
verses.tr: wa-innahu laḥaqqu al-yaqīni
verses.abdelhaleem: but it is in fact the certain Truth.
verses.pickthall: And lo! it is absolute truth.

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
verses.tr: fasabbiḥ bāsmi rabbika al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Almighty.
verses.pickthall: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.

verses.ar: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
verses.en: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
verses.tr: saʾala sāʾilun biʿadhābin wāqiʿin
verses.abdelhaleem: A man [mockingly] demanded the punishment.
verses.pickthall: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall

verses.ar: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
verses.en: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
verses.tr: llilkāfirīna laysa lahu dāfiʿun
verses.abdelhaleem: It will fall on the disbelievers––none can deflect it––
verses.pickthall: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel,

verses.ar: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
verses.en: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.
verses.tr: mmina Allāh dhā al-maʿāriji
verses.abdelhaleem: from God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent,
verses.pickthall: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways

verses.ar: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
verses.en: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
verses.tr: taʿruju al-malāʾikahu wa-ar-rūḥu ʾilayhi fā yawmin kāna miqdāruhu khamsīna ʾalfa sanahin
verses.abdelhaleem: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him, on a Day whose length is fifty thousand years.
verses.pickthall: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا
verses.en: So be patient with gracious patience.
verses.tr: fāṣbir ṣabran jamīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: So be patient, [Prophet], as befits you.
verses.pickthall: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًا
verses.en: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
verses.tr: ʾinnahum yarawnahu baʿīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: The disbelievers think it is distant,
verses.pickthall: Lo! they behold it afar off

verses.ar: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًا
verses.en: But We see it [as] near.
verses.tr: wanarāhu qarīban
verses.abdelhaleem: but We know it to be close.
verses.pickthall: While we behold it nigh:

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ
verses.en: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
verses.tr: yawma takūnu as-samāʾu ka-l-muhli
verses.abdelhaleem: On a Day when the heavens will be like molten brass
verses.pickthall: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,

verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ
verses.en: And the mountains will be like wool,
verses.tr: watakūnu al-jibālu ka-l-ʿihni
verses.abdelhaleem: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
verses.pickthall: And the hills become as flakes of wool,

verses.ar: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا
verses.en: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
verses.tr: walā yaslu ḥamīmun ḥamīman
verses.abdelhaleem: when no friend will ask about his friend,
verses.pickthall: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend

verses.ar: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
verses.en: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children.
verses.tr: yubaṣṣarūnahum ۚ yawaddu al-mujrimu law yaftadā min ʿadhābi yawmiʾidhin bibanīhi
verses.abdelhaleem: even when they are within sight of one another. The guilty person will wish he could save himself from the suffering of that Day by sacrificing his sons,
verses.pickthall: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children

verses.ar: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
verses.en: And his wife and his brother
verses.tr: waṣāḥibatihi wa-akhīhi
verses.abdelhaleem: his spouse, his brother,
verses.pickthall: And his spouse and his brother

verses.ar: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
verses.en: And his nearest kindred who shelter him.
verses.tr: wafaṣīlatihi at-tā tuwīhi
verses.abdelhaleem: the kinsfolk who gave him shelter,
verses.pickthall: And his kin that harboured him

verses.ar: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
verses.en: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
verses.tr: waman fā al-ʾarḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīhi
verses.abdelhaleem: and everyone on earth, if it could save him.
verses.pickthall: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
verses.en: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
verses.tr: kallā ۖ ʾinnahā laẓā
verses.abdelhaleem: But no! There is a raging flame
verses.pickthall: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell

verses.ar: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ
verses.en: A remover of exteriors.
verses.tr: nazzāʿahan llilshawā
verses.abdelhaleem: that strips away the skin,
verses.pickthall: Eager to roast;

verses.ar: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.en: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
verses.tr: tadʿūā man ʾadbara watawallā
verses.abdelhaleem: and it will claim everyone who rejects the truth, turns away,
verses.pickthall: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),

verses.ar: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
verses.en: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
verses.tr: wajamaʿa fa-awʿā
verses.abdelhaleem: amasses wealth and hoards it.
verses.pickthall: And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
verses.en: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinna al-ʾinsāna khuliqa halūʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: Man was truly created anxious:
verses.pickthall: Lo! man was created anxious,

verses.ar: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
verses.en: When evil touches him, impatient,
verses.tr: ʾidhā massahu ash-sharru jazūʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: he is fretful when misfortune touches him,
verses.pickthall: Fretful when evil befalleth him

verses.ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
verses.en: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
verses.tr: wa-idhā massahu al-khayru manūʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: but tight-fisted when good fortune comes his way.
verses.pickthall: And, when good befalleth him, grudging;

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
verses.en: Except the observers of prayer -
verses.tr: ʾillā al-muṣallīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Not so those who pray
verses.pickthall: Save worshippers.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
verses.en: Those who are constant in their prayer
verses.tr: adh-dhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim dāʾimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and are constant in their prayers;
verses.pickthall: Who are constant at their worship

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
verses.en: And those within whose wealth is a known right
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna fā ʾamwālihim ḥaqqun mmaʿlūmun
verses.abdelhaleem: who give a due share of their wealth
verses.pickthall: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged

verses.ar: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.en: For the petitioner and the deprived -
verses.tr: llilssāʾili wa-l-maḥrūmi
verses.abdelhaleem: to beggars and the deprived;
verses.pickthall: For the beggar and the destitute;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna yuṣaddiqūna biyawmi ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: who believe in the Day of Judgement
verses.pickthall: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.en: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum mmin ʿadhābi rabbihim mmushfiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and fear the punishment of their Lord––
verses.pickthall: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -

verses.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
verses.tr: ʾinna ʿadhāba rabbihim ghayru maʾmūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: none may feel wholly secure from it––
verses.pickthall: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
verses.en: And those who guard their private parts
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who guard their chastity
verses.pickthall: And those who preserve their chastity

verses.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
verses.tr: ʾillā ʿalā ʾazwājihim ʾaw mā malakat ʾaymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna
verses.abdelhaleem: from all but their spouses or their slave-girls––there is no blame attached to [relations with] these,
verses.pickthall: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;

verses.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
verses.tr: famani ābtaghā warāʾa dhālika fa-ūlāʾika humu al-ʿādūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but those whose desires exceed this limit are truly transgressors––
verses.pickthall: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
verses.en: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum liʾamānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who are faithful to their trusts and their pledges;
verses.pickthall: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
verses.en: And those who are in their testimonies upright
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum bishahādātihim qāʾimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who give honest testimony
verses.pickthall: And those who stand by their testimony

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.en: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim yuḥāfiẓūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and are steadfast in their prayers.
verses.pickthall: And those who are attentive at their worship.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
verses.en: They will be in gardens, honored.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika fā jannātin mmukramūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will be honoured in Gardens of bliss.
verses.pickthall: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.

verses.ar: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
verses.en: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],
verses.tr: famāli adh-dhīna kafarūā qibalaka muhṭiʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: What is wrong with the disbelievers? Why do they rush to peer at you [Prophet],
verses.pickthall: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,

verses.ar: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
verses.en: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
verses.tr: ʿani al-yamīni waʿani ash-shimāli ʿizīna
verses.abdelhaleem: from right and left, in crowds?
verses.pickthall: On the right and on the left, in groups?

verses.ar: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
verses.en: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
verses.tr: ʾayaṭmaʿu kullu āmriʾin mminhum ʾan yudkhala jannaha naʿīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Does every one of them expect to enter a Garden of bliss?
verses.pickthall: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?

verses.ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
verses.tr: kallā ۖ ʾinnā khalaqnāhum mmimmā yaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No! We created them from the substance they know,
verses.pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.

verses.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.en: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
verses.tr: falā ʾuqsimu birabbi al-mashāriqi wa-l-maghāribi ʾinnā laqādirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and, by the Lord of every sunrise and sunset, We have the power
verses.pickthall: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able

verses.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verses.en: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
verses.tr: ʿalā ʾan nnubaddila khayran mminhum wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna
verses.abdelhaleem: to substitute for them others better than they are- nothing can prevent Us from doing this.
verses.pickthall: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.

verses.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
verses.tr: fadharhum yakhūḍūā wayalʿabūā ḥattā yulāqūā yawmahumu adh-dhā yūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So leave them to wallow in idle talk, until they come face to face with their promised Day,
verses.pickthall: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
verses.en: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
verses.tr: yawma yakhrujūna mina al-ʾajdāthi sirāʿan kaʾannahum ʾilā nuṣubin yūfiḍūna
verses.abdelhaleem: the Day they will rush out of their graves as if rallying to a flag,
verses.pickthall: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,

verses.ar: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
verses.tr: khāshiʿahan ʾabṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillahun ۚ dhālika al-yawmu adh-dhā kānūā yūʿadūna
verses.abdelhaleem: eyes downcast and covered in shame: that is the Day of which they were warned.
verses.pickthall: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾarsalnā nūḥan ʾilā qawmihi ʾan ʾandhir qawmaka min qabli ʾan yaʾtiyahum ʿadhābun ʾalīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent Noah to his people: ‘Warn your people, before a painful punishment comes to them.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -
verses.tr: qāla yāqawmi ʾinnā lakum nadhīrun mmubīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: And so he said, ‘My people, I am here to warn you plainly.
verses.pickthall: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you

verses.ar: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.
verses.tr: ʾani āʿbudūā Allāh wāttaqūhu wa-aṭīʿūni
verses.abdelhaleem: Serve God, be mindful of Him and obey me.
verses.pickthall: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,

verses.ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."
verses.tr: yaghfir lakum mmin dhunūbikum wayuʾakhirkum ʾilā ʾajalin mmusammanā ۚ ʾinna ʾajala Allāh ʾidhā jāʾa lā yuʾakharu ۖ law kuntum taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: He will forgive you your sins and spare you until your appointed time––when God’s appointed time arrives it cannot be postponed. If only you understood!’
verses.pickthall: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
verses.tr: qāla rabbi ʾinnā daʿawtu qawmā laylan wanahāran
verses.abdelhaleem: He said, ‘My Lord, I have called my people night and day,
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day

verses.ar: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
verses.en: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].
verses.tr: falam yazidhum duʿā ʾillā firāran
verses.abdelhaleem: but the more I call them, the further they run away:
verses.pickthall: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;

verses.ar: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
verses.en: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
verses.tr: wa-innā kullamā daʿawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaʿalūā ʾaṣābiʿahum fā ādhānihim wāstaghshawā thiyābahum wa-aṣarrūā wāstakbarūā āstikbāran
verses.abdelhaleem: every time I call them, so that You may forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, cover their heads with their garments, persist in their rejection, and grow more insolent and arrogant.
verses.pickthall: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
verses.en: Then I invited them publicly.
verses.tr: thumma ʾinnā daʿawtuhum jihāran
verses.abdelhaleem: I have tried calling them openly.
verses.pickthall: And lo! I have called unto them aloud,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
verses.en: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
verses.tr: thumma ʾinnā ʾaʿlantu lahum wa-asrartu lahum ʾisrāran
verses.abdelhaleem: I have tried preaching to them in public and speaking to them in private.
verses.pickthall: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.

verses.ar: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
verses.en: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
verses.tr: faqultu āstaghfirūā rabbakum ʾinnahu kāna ghaffāran
verses.abdelhaleem: I said, “Ask forgiveness of your Lord: He is ever forgiving.
verses.pickthall: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.

verses.ar: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
verses.en: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
verses.tr: yursili as-samāʾa ʿalaykum mmidrāran
verses.abdelhaleem: He will send down abundant rain from the sky for you;
verses.pickthall: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,

verses.ar: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
verses.en: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
verses.tr: wayumdidkum biʾamwālin wabanīna wayajʿal llakum jannātin wayajʿal llakum ʾanhāran
verses.abdelhaleem: He will give you wealth and sons; He will provide you with gardens and rivers.
verses.pickthall: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.

verses.ar: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
verses.en: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur
verses.tr: mmā lakum lā tarjūna lillāh waqāran
verses.abdelhaleem: What is the matter with you? Why will you not fear God’s majesty,
verses.pickthall: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity

verses.ar: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
verses.en: While He has created you in stages?
verses.tr: waqad khalaqakum ʾaṭwāran
verses.abdelhaleem: when He has created you stage by stage?
verses.pickthall: When He created you by (divers) stages?

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
verses.en: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers
verses.tr: ʾalam tarawā kayfa khalaqa Allāh sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you ever wondered how God created seven heavens, one above the other,
verses.pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
verses.en: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
verses.tr: wajaʿala al-qamara fīhinna nūran wajaʿala ash-shamsa sirājan
verses.abdelhaleem: placed the moon as a light in them and the sun as a lamp,
verses.pickthall: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
verses.en: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
verses.tr: wallāh ʾanbatakum mmina al-ʾarḍi nabātan
verses.abdelhaleem: how God made you spring forth from the earth like a plant,
verses.pickthall: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
verses.en: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
verses.tr: thumma yuʿīdukum fīhā wayukhrijukum ʾikhrājan
verses.abdelhaleem: how He will return you into it and then bring you out again,
verses.pickthall: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
verses.en: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse
verses.tr: wallāh jaʿala lakumu al-ʾarḍa bisāṭan
verses.abdelhaleem: and how He has spread the Earth out for you
verses.pickthall: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you

verses.ar: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
verses.en: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"
verses.tr: llitaslukūā minhā subulan fijājan
verses.abdelhaleem: to walk along its spacious paths?” ’
verses.pickthall: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.

verses.ar: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.en: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
verses.tr: qāla nūḥun rrabbi ʾinnahum ʿaṣawnā wāttabaʿūā man llam yazidhu māluhu wawaladuhu ʾillā khasāran
verses.abdelhaleem: Noah said, ‘My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose riches and children only increase their ruin;
verses.pickthall: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;

verses.ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
verses.en: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
verses.tr: wamakarūā makran kubbāran
verses.abdelhaleem: who have made a grand plan,
verses.pickthall: And they have plotted a mighty plot,

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
verses.en: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'
verses.tr: waqālūā lā tadharunna ālihatakum walā tadharunna waddan walā suwāʿan walā yaghūtha wayaʿūqa wanasran
verses.abdelhaleem: saying, “Do not renounce your gods! Do not renounce Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq, or Nasr!”
verses.pickthall: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.

verses.ar: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
verses.en: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
verses.tr: waqad ʾaḍallūā kathīran ۖ walā tazidi aẓ-ẓālimīna ʾillā ḍalālan
verses.abdelhaleem: They have led many astray. Lord, bring nothing but destruction down on the evildoers!’
verses.pickthall: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error.

verses.ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
verses.en: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.
verses.tr: mmimmā khaṭītihim ʾughriqūā fa-udkhilūā nāran falam yajidūā lahum mmin dūni Allāh ʾanṣāran
verses.abdelhaleem: They were drowned and sent to Hell for their evildoings: they found no one to help them against God.
verses.pickthall: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verses.en: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
verses.tr: waqāla nūḥun rrabbi lā tadhar ʿalā al-ʾarḍi mina al-kāfirīna dayyāran
verses.abdelhaleem: And Noah said, ‘Lord, do not leave any of the disbelievers on the earth-
verses.pickthall: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
verses.en: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
verses.tr: ʾinnaka ʾin tadharhum yuḍillūā ʿibādaka walā yalidūā ʾillā fājiran kaffāran
verses.abdelhaleem: if you leave them they will lead Your servants astray and beget only sinners and disbelievers-
verses.pickthall: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.

verses.ar: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
verses.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
verses.tr: rrabbi āghfir lā waliwālidāa waliman dakhala baytāa muʾminan walilmuʾminīna wa-l-muʾmināti walā tazidi aẓ-ẓālimīna ʾillā tabāranā
verses.abdelhaleem: Lord, forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer. Forgive believing men and women but bring nothing but ruin down on the evildoers!’
verses.pickthall: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.

verses.ar: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
verses.tr: qul ʾūḥāa ʾilāa ʾannahu āstamaʿa nafarun mmina al-jinni faqālūā ʾinnā samiʿnā qurānan ʿajaban
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn once listened in and said, “We have heard a wondrous Quran,
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,

verses.ar: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
verses.en: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
verses.tr: yahdā ʾilā ar-rushdi fāmannā bihi ۖ walan nnushrika birabbinā ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: that gives guidance to the right path, and we have come to believe it––We shall never set up partners with our Lord––
verses.pickthall: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
verses.en: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
verses.tr: wa-annahu taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mā āttakhadha ṣāḥibahan walā waladan
verses.abdelhaleem: and that He––exalted be the glory of our Lord!––has neither spouse nor child.
verses.pickthall: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
verses.en: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
verses.tr: wa-annahu kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ʿalā Allāh shaṭaṭan
verses.abdelhaleem: Outrageous things have been said about God by the foolish among us,
verses.pickthall: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
verses.en: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.
verses.tr: wa-annā ẓanannā ʾan llan taqūla al-ʾinsu wa-l-jinnu ʿalā Allāh kadhiban
verses.abdelhaleem: although we had thought that no man or jinn would [dare to] tell a lie about Him.
verses.pickthall: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
verses.en: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].
verses.tr: wa-annahu kāna rijālun mmina al-ʾinsi yaʿūdhūna birijālin mmina al-jinni fazādūhum rahaqan
verses.abdelhaleem: Men have sought refuge with the jinn in the past, but they only misguided them further.
verses.pickthall: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
verses.en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].
verses.tr: wa-annahum ẓannūā kamā ẓanantum ʾan llan yabʿatha Allāh ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: They thought, as you did, that God would never raise anyone from the dead.
verses.pickthall: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
verses.en: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
verses.tr: wa-annā lamasnā as-samāʾa fawajadnāhā muliʾat ḥarasan shadīdan washuhuban
verses.abdelhaleem: We tried to reach heaven, but discovered it to be full of stern guards and shooting stars––
verses.pickthall: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
verses.en: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
verses.tr: wa-annā kunnā naqʿudu minhā maqāʿida lilssamʿi ۖ faman yastamiʿi al-āna yajid lahu shihāban rraṣadan
verses.abdelhaleem: we used to sit in places there, listening, but anyone trying to listen now will find a shooting star lying in wait for him––
verses.pickthall: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
verses.en: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
verses.tr: wa-annā lā nadrā ʾasharrun ʾurīda biman fā al-ʾarḍi ʾam ʾarāda bihim rabbuhum rashadan
verses.abdelhaleem: [so now] we do not know whether those who live on earth are due for misfortune, or whether their Lord intends to guide them.
verses.pickthall: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
verses.en: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
verses.tr: wa-annā minnā aṣ-ṣāliḥūna waminnā dūna dhālika ۖ kunnā ṭarāʾiqa qidadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Some of us are righteous and others less so: we follow different paths.
verses.pickthall: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
verses.en: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
verses.tr: wa-annā ẓanannā ʾan llan nnuʿjiza Allāh fā al-ʾarḍi walan nnuʿjizahu haraban
verses.abdelhaleem: We know we can never frustrate God on earth; we can never escape Him.
verses.pickthall: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
verses.en: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
verses.tr: wa-annā lammā samiʿnā al-hudā āmannā bihi ۖ faman yuʾmin birabbihi falā yakhāfu bakhsan walā rahaqan
verses.abdelhaleem: When we heard the guidance we came to believe: whoever believes in his Lord need fear no loss nor injustice.
verses.pickthall: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
verses.en: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
verses.tr: wa-annā minnā al-muslimūna waminnā al-qāsiṭūna ۖ faman ʾaslama fa-ūlāʾika taḥarrawā rashadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Some of us submit to Him and others go the wrong way: those who submit to God have found wise guidance,
verses.pickthall: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
verses.en: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
verses.tr: wa-ammā al-qāsiṭūna fakānūā lijahannama ḥaṭaban
verses.abdelhaleem: but those who go wrong will be fuel for Hellfire.” ’
verses.pickthall: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.

verses.ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
verses.en: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].
verses.tr: wa-ʾallawi āstaqāmūā ʿalā aṭ-ṭarīqahi laʾasqaynāhum mmāʾan ghadaqan
verses.abdelhaleem: If they had taken to the right way, We would have given them abundant water to drink-
verses.pickthall: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance

verses.ar: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
verses.en: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
verses.tr: llinaftinahum fīhi ۚ waman yuʿriḍ ʿan dhikri rabbihi yaslukhu ʿadhāban ṣaʿadan
verses.abdelhaleem: a test for them––but anyone who turns away from his Lord’s Revelation will be sent by Him to spiralling torment.
verses.pickthall: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
verses.en: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.
verses.tr: wa-anna al-masājida lillāh falā tadʿūā maʿa Allāh ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Places of worship are for God alone- so do not pray to anyone other than God-
verses.pickthall: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
verses.en: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
verses.tr: wa-annahu lammā qāma ʿabdu Allāh yadʿūhu kādūā yakūnūna ʿalayhi libadan
verses.abdelhaleem: yet when God’s Servant stood up to pray to Him, they pressed in on him.
verses.pickthall: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
verses.tr: qul ʾinnamā ʾadʿūā rabbā walā ʾushriku bihi ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I pray to my Lord alone; I set up no partner with Him.’
verses.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
verses.tr: qul ʾinnā lā ʾamliku lakum ḍarran walā rashadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I have no control over any harm or good that may befall you.’
verses.pickthall: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
verses.tr: qul ʾinnā lan yujīranā mina Allāh ʾaḥadun walan ʾajida min dūnihi multaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘No one can protect me from God: I have no refuge except in Him.
verses.pickthall: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him

verses.ar: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
verses.en: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
verses.tr: ʾillā balāghan mmina Allāh warisālātihi ۚ waman yaʿṣi Allāh warasūlahu fa-inna lahu nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā ʾabadan
verses.abdelhaleem: I only deliver [what I receive] from God- only His messages.’ Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger will have Hell’s Fire as his permanent home:
verses.pickthall: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
verses.en: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾidhā raʾawā mā yūʿadūna fasayaʿlamūna man ʾaḍʿafu nāṣiran wa-aqallu ʿadadan
verses.abdelhaleem: when they are confronted by what they have been warned about, they will realize who has the weaker protector and the smaller number.
verses.pickthall: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
verses.en: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
verses.tr: qul ʾin ʾadrā ʾaqarībun mmā tūʿadūna ʾam yajʿalu lahu rabbā ʾamadan
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I do not know whether what you have been warned about is near, or whether a distant time has been appointed for it by my Lord.’
verses.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.

verses.ar: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
verses.tr: ʿālimu al-ghaybi falā yuẓhiru ʿalā ghaybihi ʾaḥadan
verses.abdelhaleem: He is the One who knows what is hidden.
verses.pickthall: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
verses.en: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers
verses.tr: ʾillā mani ārtaḍā min rrasūlin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi raṣadan
verses.abdelhaleem: He does not disclose it except to a messenger of His choosing. He sends watchers to go in front and behind
verses.pickthall: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him

verses.ar: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
verses.en: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
verses.tr: lliyaʿlama ʾan qad ʾablaghūā risālāti rabbihim wa-aḥāṭa bimā ladayhim wa-aḥṣā kulla shāʾin ʿadadanā
verses.abdelhaleem: to ensure that each of His messengers delivers his Lord’s message: He knows all about them, and He takes account of everything.
verses.pickthall: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
verses.en: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā al-muzzammilu
verses.abdelhaleem: You [Prophet], enfolded in your cloak!
verses.pickthall: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment!

verses.ar: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
verses.tr: qumi al-yla ʾillā qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Stay up throughout the night, all but a small part of it,
verses.pickthall: Keep vigil the night long, save a little -

verses.ar: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
verses.en: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
verses.tr: nniṣfahu ʾawi ānquṣ minhu qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: half, or a little less,
verses.pickthall: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof

verses.ar: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
verses.en: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.
verses.tr: ʾaw zid ʿalayhi warattili al-qurāna tartīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: or a little more; recite the Quran slowly and distinctly:
verses.pickthall: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,

verses.ar: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
verses.tr: ʾinnā sanulqā ʿalayka qawlan thaqīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall send a momentous message down to you.
verses.pickthall: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight.

verses.ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
verses.tr: ʾinna nāshiʾaha al-yli hāa ʾashaddu waṭā wa-aqwamu qīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Night prayer makes a deeper impression and sharpens words––
verses.pickthall: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.

verses.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
verses.tr: ʾinna laka fā an-nahāri sabḥan ṭawīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: you are kept busy for long periods of the day––
verses.pickthall: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
verses.en: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
verses.tr: wādhkuri āsma rabbika watabattal ʾilayhi tabtīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: so celebrate the name of your Lord and devote yourself wholeheart-edly to Him.
verses.pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -

verses.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
verses.en: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
verses.tr: rrabbu al-mashriqi wa-l-maghribi lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa fāttakhidhhu wakīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: He is Lord of the east and west, there is no god but Him, so take Him as your Protector,
verses.pickthall: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -

verses.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
verses.en: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
verses.tr: wāṣbir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wāhjurhum hajran jamīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: patiently endure what they say, ignore them politely,
verses.pickthall: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.

verses.ar: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
verses.en: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
verses.tr: wadharnā wa-l-mukadhibīna ʾūlā an-naʿmahi wamahhilhum qalīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: and leave to Me those who deny the truth and live in luxury. Bear with them for a little while;
verses.pickthall: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.

verses.ar: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
verses.en: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire.
verses.tr: ʾinna ladaynā ʾankālan wajaḥīman
verses.abdelhaleem: We have fetters, a blazing fire,
verses.pickthall: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,

verses.ar: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.en: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
verses.tr: waṭaʿāman dhā ghuṣṣahin waʿadhāban ʾalīman
verses.abdelhaleem: food that chokes, and agonizing torment in store for them
verses.pickthall: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
verses.en: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
verses.tr: yawma tarjufu al-ʾarḍu wa-l-jibālu wakānati al-jibālu kathīban mmahīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will shake. The mountains will become a heap of loose sand.
verses.pickthall: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
verses.en: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾarsalnā ʾilaykum rasūlan shāhidan ʿalaykum kamā ʾarsalnā ʾilā firʿawna rasūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: We have sent a messenger to you [people] to be your witness, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh,
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.

verses.ar: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
verses.en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
verses.tr: faʿaṣā firʿawnu ar-rasūla fa-akhadhnāhu ʾakhdhan wabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: but Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger and so We inflicted a heavy punishment on him.
verses.pickthall: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
verses.en: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?
verses.tr: fakayfa tattaqūna ʾin kafartum yawman yajʿalu al-wildāna shīban
verses.abdelhaleem: So if you disbelieve, how can you guard yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair grey,
verses.pickthall: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,

verses.ar: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
verses.en: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
verses.tr: as-samāʾu munfaṭirun bihi ۚ kāna waʿduhu mafʿūlan
verses.abdelhaleem: a Day when the sky will be torn apart? God’s promise will certainly be fulfilled.
verses.pickthall: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhihi tadhkirahun ۖ faman shāʾa āttakhadha ʾilā rabbihi sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes take the way to his Lord.
verses.pickthall: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.tr: ۞ ʾinna rabbaka yaʿlamu ʾannaka taqūmu ʾadnā min thuluthāi al-yli waniṣfahu wathuluthahu waṭāʾifahun mmina adh-dhīna maʿaka ۚ wallāh yuqaddiru al-yla wa-an-nahāra ۚ ʿalima ʾan llan tuḥṣūhu fatāba ʿalaykum ۖ fāqraʾūā mā tayassara mina al-qurāni ۚ ʿalima ʾan sayakūnu minkum mmarḍā ۙ wakharūna yaḍribūna fā al-ʾarḍi yabtaghūna min faḍli Allāh ۙ wakharūna yuqātilūna fā sabīli Allāh ۖ fāqraʾūā mā tayassara minhu ۚ wa-aqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha watūā az-zakawāha wa-aqriḍūā Allāh qarḍan ḥasanan ۚ wamā tuqaddimūā liʾanfusikum mmin khayrin tajidūhu ʿinda Allāh huwa khayran wa-aʿẓama ʾajran ۚ wāstaghfirūā Allāh ۖ ʾinna Allāh ghafūrun rraḥīmun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], your Lord is well aware that you sometimes spend nearly two-thirds of the night at prayer––sometimes half, sometimes a third––as do some of your followers. God determines the division of night and day. He knows that you will not be able to keep a measure of it and He has relented towards all of you, so recite as much of the Quran as is easy for you. He knows that some of you will be sick, some of you travelling through the land seeking God’s bounty, some of you fighting in God’s way: recite as much as is easy for you, keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and make God a good loan. Whatever good you store up for yourselves will be improved and increased for you. Ask God for His forgiveness, He is most forgiving, most merciful.
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
verses.en: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā al-muddathiru
verses.abdelhaleem: You, wrapped in your cloak,
verses.pickthall: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,

verses.ar: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
verses.en: Arise and warn.
verses.tr: qum fa-andhir
verses.abdelhaleem: arise and give warning!
verses.pickthall: Arise and warn!

verses.ar: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
verses.en: And your Lord glorify.
verses.tr: warabbaka fakabbir
verses.abdelhaleem: Proclaim the greatness of your Lord;
verses.pickthall: Thy Lord magnify,

verses.ar: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
verses.en: And your clothing purify.
verses.tr: wathiyābaka faṭahhir
verses.abdelhaleem: cleanse yourself;
verses.pickthall: Thy raiment purify,

verses.ar: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
verses.en: And uncleanliness avoid.
verses.tr: wa-ar-rujza fāhjur
verses.abdelhaleem: keep away from all filth;
verses.pickthall: Pollution shun!

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
verses.en: And do not confer favor to acquire more.
verses.tr: walā tamnun tastakthiru
verses.abdelhaleem: do not be overwhelmed and weaken;
verses.pickthall: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!

verses.ar: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
verses.en: But for your Lord be patient.
verses.tr: walirabbika fāṣbir
verses.abdelhaleem: be steadfast in your Lord’s cause.
verses.pickthall: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!

verses.ar: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
verses.en: And when the trumpet is blown,
verses.tr: fa-idhā nuqira fā an-nāqūri
verses.abdelhaleem: When the Trumpet sounds,
verses.pickthall: For when the trumpet shall sound,

verses.ar: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
verses.en: That Day will be a difficult day
verses.tr: fadhālika yawmaʾidhin yawmun ʿasīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: that will be a Day of anguish for the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,

verses.ar: عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ
verses.en: For the disbelievers - not easy.
verses.tr: ʿalā al-kāfirīna ghayru yasīrin
verses.abdelhaleem: They will have no ease.
verses.pickthall: Not of ease, for disbelievers.

verses.ar: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
verses.en: Leave Me with the one I created alone
verses.tr: dharnā waman khalaqtu waḥīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], leave Me to deal with the one I created helpless,
verses.pickthall: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
verses.en: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
verses.tr: wajaʿaltu lahu mālan mmamdūdan
verses.abdelhaleem: then gave vast wealth,
verses.pickthall: And then bestowed upon him ample means,

verses.ar: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
verses.en: And children present [with him]
verses.tr: wabanīna shuhūdan
verses.abdelhaleem: and sons by his side,
verses.pickthall: And sons abiding in his presence

verses.ar: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
verses.en: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
verses.tr: wamahhadttu lahu tamhīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: making everything easy for him––
verses.pickthall: And made (life) smooth for him.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
verses.en: Then he desires that I should add more.
verses.tr: thumma yaṭmaʿu ʾan ʾazīda
verses.abdelhaleem: yet he still hopes I will give him more.
verses.pickthall: Yet he desireth that I should give more.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
verses.en: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
verses.tr: kallā ۖ ʾinnahu kāna lāyātinā ʿanīdan
verses.abdelhaleem: No! He has been stubbornly hostile to Our revelation:
verses.pickthall: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.

verses.ar: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
verses.en: I will cover him with arduous torment.
verses.tr: saʾurhiquhu ṣaʿūdan
verses.abdelhaleem: I will inflict a spiralling torment on him.
verses.pickthall: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
verses.en: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu fakkara waqaddara
verses.abdelhaleem: He planned and plotted––
verses.pickthall: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -

verses.ar: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
verses.en: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
verses.tr: faqutila kayfa qaddara
verses.abdelhaleem: devilishly he plotted!
verses.pickthall: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
verses.en: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
verses.tr: thumma qutila kayfa qaddara
verses.abdelhaleem: ferociously he plotted!––
verses.pickthall: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
verses.en: Then he considered [again];
verses.tr: thumma naẓara
verses.abdelhaleem: and looked
verses.pickthall: Then looked he,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
verses.en: Then he frowned and scowled;
verses.tr: thumma ʿabasa wabasara
verses.abdelhaleem: and frowned and scowled
verses.pickthall: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
verses.en: Then he turned back and was arrogant
verses.tr: thumma ʾadbara wāstakbara
verses.abdelhaleem: and turned away and behaved arrogantly
verses.pickthall: Then turned he away in pride

verses.ar: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
verses.en: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
verses.tr: faqāla ʾin hādhā ʾillā siḥrun yuʾtharu
verses.abdelhaleem: and said, ‘This is just old sorcery,
verses.pickthall: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;

verses.ar: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
verses.en: This is not but the word of a human being."
verses.tr: ʾin hādhā ʾillā qawlu al-bashari
verses.abdelhaleem: just the talk of a mortal!’
verses.pickthall: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.

verses.ar: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
verses.en: I will drive him into Saqar.
verses.tr: saʾuṣlīhi saqara
verses.abdelhaleem: I will throw him into the scorching Fire.
verses.pickthall: Him shall I fling unto the burning.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā saqaru
verses.abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the scorching Fire is?
verses.pickthall: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -

verses.ar: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
verses.en: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
verses.tr: lā tubqā walā tadharu
verses.abdelhaleem: It spares nothing and leaves nothing;
verses.pickthall: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught

verses.ar: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ
verses.en: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.
verses.tr: lawwāḥahun llilbashari
verses.abdelhaleem: it scorches the flesh of humans;
verses.pickthall: It shrivelleth the man.

verses.ar: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
verses.en: Over it are nineteen [angels].
verses.tr: ʿalayhā tisʿaha ʿashara
verses.abdelhaleem: there are nineteen in charge of it––
verses.pickthall: Above it are nineteen.

verses.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
verses.en: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.
verses.tr: wamā jaʿalnā ʾaṣḥāba an-nāri ʾillā malāʾikahan ۙ wamā jaʿalnā ʿiddatahum ʾillā fitnahan llilladhīna kafarūā liyastayqina adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-kitāba wayazdāda adh-dhīna āmanūā ʾīmānan ۙ walā yartāba adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-kitāba wa-l-muʾminūna ۙ waliyaqūla adh-dhīna fā qulūbihim mmaraḍun wa-l-kāfirūna mādhā ʾarāda Allāh bihādhā mathalan ۚ kadhālika yuḍillu Allāh man yashāʾu wayahdā man yashāʾu ۚ wamā yaʿlamu junūda rabbika ʾillā huwa ۚ wamā hāa ʾillā dhikrā lilbashari
verses.abdelhaleem: none other than angels appointed by Us to guard Hellfire- and We have made their number a test for the disbelievers. So those who have been given the Scripture will be certain and those who believe will have their faith increased: neither those who have been given the Scripture nor the believers will have any doubts, but the sick at heart and the disbelievers will say, ‘What could God mean by this description?’ God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will- no one knows your Lord’s forces except Him- this [description] is a warning to mortals.
verses.pickthall: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.

verses.ar: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
verses.en: No! By the moon.
verses.tr: kallā wa-l-qamari
verses.abdelhaleem: Yes––by the moon!
verses.pickthall: Nay, by the Moon

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
verses.en: And [by] the night when it departs.
verses.tr: wa-l-yli ʾidh ʾadbara
verses.abdelhaleem: By the departing night!
verses.pickthall: And the night when it withdraweth

verses.ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
verses.en: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
verses.tr: wa-aṣ-ṣubḥi ʾidhā ʾasfara
verses.abdelhaleem: By the shining dawn!
verses.pickthall: And the dawn when it shineth forth,

verses.ar: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
verses.en: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions].
verses.tr: ʾinnahā laʾiḥdā al-kubari
verses.abdelhaleem: It is one of the mightiest things,
verses.pickthall: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)

verses.ar: نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ
verses.en: As a warning to humanity -
verses.tr: nadhīran llilbashari
verses.abdelhaleem: a warning to all mortals,
verses.pickthall: As a warning unto men,

verses.ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
verses.en: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
verses.tr: liman shāʾa minkum ʾan yataqaddama ʾaw yataʾakhara
verses.abdelhaleem: to those of you who choose to go ahead and those who lag behind.
verses.pickthall: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.

verses.ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
verses.en: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained.
verses.tr: kullu nafsin bimā kasabat rahīnahun
verses.abdelhaleem: Every soul is held in pledge for its deeds,
verses.pickthall: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;

verses.ar: إِلَّآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: Except the companions of the right,.
verses.tr: ʾillā ʾaṣḥāba al-yamīni
verses.abdelhaleem: but the Companions of the Right will stay
verses.pickthall: Save those who will stand on the right hand.

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
verses.tr: fā jannātin yatasāʾalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: in Gardens and ask
verses.pickthall: In gardens they will ask one another

verses.ar: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: About the criminals,
verses.tr: ʿani al-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: about the guilty.
verses.pickthall: Concerning the guilty:

verses.ar: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
verses.en: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
verses.tr: mā salakakum fā saqara
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘What drove you to the Scorching Fire?’ [they will ask]
verses.pickthall: What hath brought you to this burning?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
verses.en: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
verses.tr: qālūā lam naku mina al-muṣallīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will answer, ‘We did not pray;
verses.pickthall: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed

verses.ar: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
verses.en: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
verses.tr: walam naku nuṭʿimu al-miskīna
verses.abdelhaleem: we did not feed the poor;
verses.pickthall: Nor did we feed the wretched.

verses.ar: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
verses.en: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
verses.tr: wakunnā nakhūḍu maʿa al-khāʾiḍīna
verses.abdelhaleem: we indulged with others [in mocking the believers];
verses.pickthall: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,

verses.ar: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
verses.tr: wakunnā nukadhibu biyawmi ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: we denied the Day of Judgement
verses.pickthall: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
verses.en: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."
verses.tr: ḥattā ʾatānā al-yaqīnu
verses.abdelhaleem: until the Certain End came upon us.’
verses.pickthall: Till the Inevitable came unto us.

verses.ar: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
verses.en: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
verses.tr: famā tanfaʿuhum shafāʿahu ash-shāfiʿīna
verses.abdelhaleem: No intercessor’s plea will benefit them now.
verses.pickthall: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.

verses.ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
