verses.en: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away.
verses.tr: famā lahum ʿani at-tadhkirahi muʿriḍīna
verses.abdelhaleem: What is the matter with them? Why do they turn away from the warning,
verses.pickthall: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
verses.en: As if they were alarmed donkeys.
verses.tr: kaʾannahum ḥumurun mmustanfirahun
verses.abdelhaleem: like frightened asses
verses.pickthall: As they were frightened asses

verses.ar: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
verses.en: Fleeing from a lion?
verses.tr: farrat min qaswarahin
verses.abdelhaleem: fleeing from a lion?
verses.pickthall: Fleeing from a lion?

verses.ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
verses.en: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
verses.tr: bal yurīdu kullu āmriʾin mminhum ʾan yuʾtā ṣuḥufan mmunasharahan
verses.abdelhaleem: Each one of them demands that a scripture be sent down to him and unrolled before his very eyes-
verses.pickthall: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).

verses.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
verses.en: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
verses.tr: kallā ۖ bal llā yakhāfūna al-ākhiraha
verses.abdelhaleem: No! Truly they have no fear of the life to come-
verses.pickthall: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
verses.en: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder.
verses.tr: kallā ʾinnahu tadhkirahun
verses.abdelhaleem: but truly this is a reminder.
verses.pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.

verses.ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
verses.en: Then whoever wills will remember it.
verses.tr: faman shāʾa dhakarahu
verses.abdelhaleem: Let whoever wishes to take heed do so:
verses.pickthall: So whosoever will may heed.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
verses.en: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
verses.tr: wamā yadhkurūna ʾillā ʾan yashāʾa Allāh ۚ huwa ʾahlu at-taqwā wa-ahlu al-maghfirahi
verses.abdelhaleem: they will only take heed if God so wishes. He is the Lord who should be heeded, the Lord of forgiveness.
verses.pickthall: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.

verses.ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
verses.en: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
verses.tr: lā ʾuqsimu biyawmi al-qiyāmahi
verses.abdelhaleem: By the Day of Resurrection
verses.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;

verses.ar: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
verses.en: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
verses.tr: walā ʾuqsimu bi-an-nafsi al-lawwāmahi
verses.abdelhaleem: and by the self-reproaching soul!
verses.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
verses.en: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
verses.tr: ʾayaḥsabu al-ʾinsānu ʾallan nnajmaʿa ʿiẓāmahu
verses.abdelhaleem: Does man think We shall not put his bones back together?
verses.pickthall: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?

verses.ar: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
verses.en: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
verses.tr: balā qādirīna ʿalā ʾan nnusawwāa banānahu
verses.abdelhaleem: In fact, We can reshape his very fingertips.
verses.pickthall: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!

verses.ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
verses.en: But man desires to continue in sin.
verses.tr: bal yurīdu al-ʾinsānu liyafjura ʾamāmahu
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet man wants to deny what is ahead of him:
verses.pickthall: But man would fain deny what is before him.

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
verses.en: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
verses.tr: yaslu ʾayyāna yawmu al-qiyāmahi
verses.abdelhaleem: he says, ‘So, when will this Day of Resurrection be?’
verses.pickthall: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?

verses.ar: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
verses.en: So when vision is dazzled.
verses.tr: fa-idhā bariqa al-baṣaru
verses.abdelhaleem: When eyes are dazzled
verses.pickthall: But when sight is confounded

verses.ar: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.en: And the moon darkens.
verses.tr: wakhasafa al-qamaru
verses.abdelhaleem: and the moon eclipsed,
verses.pickthall: And the moon is eclipsed

verses.ar: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.en: And the sun and the moon are joined,
verses.tr: wajumiʿa ash-shamsu wa-l-qamaru
verses.abdelhaleem: when the sun and the moon are brought together,
verses.pickthall: And sun and moon are united,

verses.ar: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
verses.en: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
verses.tr: yaqūlu al-ʾinsānu yawmaʾidhin ʾayna al-mafarru
verses.abdelhaleem: on that Day man will say, ‘Where can I escape?’
verses.pickthall: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!

verses.ar: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
verses.en: No! There is no refuge.
verses.tr: kallā lā wazara
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly, there is no refuge:
verses.pickthall: Alas! No refuge!

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
verses.en: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
verses.tr: ʾilā rabbika yawmaʾidhin al-mustaqarru
verses.abdelhaleem: they will all return to your Lord on that Day.
verses.pickthall: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.

verses.ar: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
verses.en: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
verses.tr: yunabbaā al-ʾinsānu yawmaʾidhin bimā qaddama wa-akhara
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day, man will be told what he put first and what he put last.
verses.pickthall: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
verses.en: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
verses.tr: bali al-ʾinsānu ʿalā nafsihi baṣīrahun
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly, man is a clear witness against himself,
verses.pickthall: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,

verses.ar: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
verses.en: Even if he presents his excuses.
verses.tr: walaw ʾalqā maʿādhīrahu
verses.abdelhaleem: despite all the excuses he may put forward.
verses.pickthall: Although he tender his excuses.

verses.ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
verses.en: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].
verses.tr: lā tuḥarrik bihi lisānaka litaʿjala bihi
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do not rush your tongue in an attempt to hasten [your memorization of] the Revelation:
verses.pickthall: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.

verses.ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
verses.en: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
verses.tr: ʾinna ʿalaynā jamʿahu waqurānahu
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall make sure of its safe collection and recitation.
verses.pickthall: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
verses.en: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
verses.tr: fa-idhā qaraʾnāhu fāttabiʿ qurānahu
verses.abdelhaleem: When We have recited it, repeat the recitation
verses.pickthall: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
verses.en: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
verses.tr: thumma ʾinna ʿalaynā bayānahu
verses.abdelhaleem: and We shall make it clear.
verses.pickthall: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.

verses.ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
verses.en: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate
verses.tr: kallā bal tuḥibbūna al-ʿājilaha
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly you [people] love this fleeting world
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now

verses.ar: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
verses.en: And leave [i.e., neglect] the Hereafter.
verses.tr: watadharūna al-ākhiraha
verses.abdelhaleem: and neglect the life to come.
verses.pickthall: And neglect the Hereafter.

verses.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
verses.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
verses.tr: wujūhun yawmaʾidhin nnāḍirahun
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day there will be radiant faces,
verses.pickthall: That day will faces be resplendent,

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
verses.en: Looking at their Lord.
verses.tr: ʾilā rabbihā nāẓirahun
verses.abdelhaleem: looking towards their Lord,
verses.pickthall: Looking toward their Lord;

verses.ar: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
verses.en: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
verses.tr: wawujūhun yawmaʾidhin bāsirahun
verses.abdelhaleem: and on that Day there will be the sad and despairing faces
verses.pickthall: And that day will other faces be despondent,

verses.ar: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
verses.en: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
verses.tr: taẓunnu ʾan yufʿala bihā fāqirahun
verses.abdelhaleem: of those who realize that a great calamity is about to befall them.
verses.pickthall: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
verses.en: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones
verses.tr: kallā ʾidhā balaghati at-tarāqāa
verses.abdelhaleem: Truly, when the soul reaches the collarbone;
verses.pickthall: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
verses.en: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
verses.tr: waqīla man ۜ rāqin
verses.abdelhaleem: when it is said, ‘Could any charm-healer save him now?’;
verses.pickthall: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?

verses.ar: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
verses.en: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation
verses.tr: waẓanna ʾannahu al-firāqu
verses.abdelhaleem: when he knows it is the final parting;
verses.pickthall: And he knoweth that it is the parting;

verses.ar: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
verses.en: And the leg is wound about the leg,
verses.tr: wa-at-taffati as-sāqu bi-as-sāqi
verses.abdelhaleem: when his legs are brought together:
verses.pickthall: And agony is heaped on agony;

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
verses.en: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
verses.tr: ʾilā rabbika yawmaʾidhin al-masāqu
verses.abdelhaleem: on that day he will be driven towards your Lord.
verses.pickthall: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.

verses.ar: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
verses.en: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.
verses.tr: falā ṣaddaqa walā ṣallā
verses.abdelhaleem: He neither believed nor prayed,
verses.pickthall: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.

verses.ar: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.en: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
verses.tr: walākin kadhaba watawallā
verses.abdelhaleem: but denied the truth and turned away,
verses.pickthall: But he denied and flouted.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
verses.en: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
verses.tr: thumma dhahaba ʾilā ʾahlihi yatamaṭṭā
verses.abdelhaleem: walking back to his people with a conceited swagger.
verses.pickthall: Then went he to his folk with glee.

verses.ar: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
verses.en: Woe to you, and woe!
verses.tr: ʾawlā laka fa-awlā
verses.abdelhaleem: Closer and closer it comes to you.
verses.pickthall: Nearer unto thee and nearer,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
verses.en: Then woe to you, and woe!
verses.tr: thumma ʾawlā laka fa-awlā
verses.abdelhaleem: Closer and closer still.
verses.pickthall: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
verses.en: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
verses.tr: ʾayaḥsabu al-ʾinsānu ʾan yutraka sudanā
verses.abdelhaleem: Does man think he will be left alone?
verses.pickthall: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
verses.en: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
verses.tr: ʾalam yaku nuṭfahan mmin mmanāin yumnā
verses.abdelhaleem: Was he not just a drop of spilt-out sperm,
verses.pickthall: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
verses.en: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allāh] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
verses.tr: thumma kāna ʿalaqahan fakhalaqa fasawwā
verses.abdelhaleem: which became a clinging form, which God shaped in due proportion,
verses.pickthall: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned

verses.ar: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
verses.en: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
verses.tr: fajaʿala minhu az-zawjayni adh-dhakara wa-l-ʾunthā
verses.abdelhaleem: fashioning from it the two sexes, male and female?
verses.pickthall: And made of him a pair, the male and female.

verses.ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
verses.en: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
verses.tr: ʾalaysa dhālika biqādirin ʿalā ʾan yuḥāa al-mawtā
verses.abdelhaleem: Does He who can do this not have the power to bring the dead back to life?
verses.pickthall: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?

verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
verses.en: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
verses.tr: hal ʾatā ʿalā al-ʾinsāni ḥīnun mmina ad-dahri lam yakun shayā mmadhkūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Was there not a period of time when man was nothing to speak of ?
verses.pickthall: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?

verses.ar: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
verses.tr: ʾinnā khalaqnā al-ʾinsāna min nnuṭfahin ʾamshājin nnabtalīhi fajaʿalnāhu samīʿanā baṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: We created man from a drop of mingled fluid to put him to the test; We gave him hearing and sight;
verses.pickthall: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.

verses.ar: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.en: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
verses.tr: ʾinnā hadaynāhu as-sabīla ʾimmā shākiran wa-immā kafūran
verses.abdelhaleem: We guided him to the right path, whether he was grateful or not.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾaʿtadnā lilkāfirīna salāsilā wa-aghlālan wasaʿīran
verses.abdelhaleem: We have prepared chains, iron collars, and blazing Fire for the disbelievers, but
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,
verses.tr: ʾinna al-ʾabrāra yashrabūna min kaʾsin kāna mizājuhā kāfūran
verses.abdelhaleem: the righteous will have a drink mixed with kafur,
verses.pickthall: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,

verses.ar: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
verses.en: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
verses.tr: ʿaynan yashrabu bihā ʿibādu Allāh yufajjirūnahā tafjīran
verses.abdelhaleem: a spring for God’s servants, which flows abundantly at their wish.
verses.pickthall: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,

verses.ar: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
verses.en: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
verses.tr: yūfūna bi-an-nadhri wayakhāfūna yawman kāna sharruhu mustaṭīran
verses.abdelhaleem: They fulfil their vows; they fear a day of widespread woes;
verses.pickthall: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,

verses.ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.en: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
verses.tr: wayuṭʿimūna aṭ-ṭaʿāma ʿalā ḥubbihi miskīnan wayatīman wa-asīran
verses.abdelhaleem: they give food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive, though they love it themselves,
verses.pickthall: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.en: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā nuṭʿimukum liwajhi Allāh lā nurīdu minkum jazāʾan walā shukūran
verses.abdelhaleem: saying, ‘We feed you for the sake of God alone: We seek neither recompense nor thanks from you.
verses.pickthall: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
verses.tr: ʾinnā nakhāfu min rrabbinā yawman ʿabūsan qamṭarīran
verses.abdelhaleem: We fear the Day of our Lord––a woefully grim Day.’
verses.pickthall: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.

verses.ar: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
verses.en: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
verses.tr: fawaqāhumu Allāh sharra dhālika al-yawmi walaqqāhum naḍrahan wasurūran
verses.abdelhaleem: So God will save them from the woes of that Day, give them radiance and gladness,
verses.pickthall: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;

verses.ar: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
verses.en: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
verses.tr: wajazāhum bimā ṣabarūā jannahan waḥarīran
verses.abdelhaleem: and reward them, for their steadfastness, with a Garden and silken robes.
verses.pickthall: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;

verses.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
verses.en: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
verses.tr: mmuttakīna fīhā ʿalā al-ʾarāʾiki ۖ lā yarawna fīhā shamsan walā zamharīran
verses.abdelhaleem: They will sit on couches, feeling neither scorching heat nor biting cold,
verses.pickthall: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.

verses.ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
verses.en: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
verses.tr: wadāniyahan ʿalayhim ẓilāluhā wadhullilat quṭūfuhā tadhlīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: with shady [branches] spread above them and clusters of fruit hanging close at hand.
verses.pickthall: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.

verses.ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.en: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
verses.tr: wayuṭāfu ʿalayhim bāniyahin mmin fiḍḍahin wa-akwābin kānat qawārīrā
verses.abdelhaleem: They will be served with silver plates
verses.pickthall: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass

verses.ar: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
verses.en: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
verses.tr: qawārīrā min fiḍḍahin qaddarūhā taqdīran
verses.abdelhaleem: and gleaming silver goblets according to their fancy,
verses.pickthall: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).

verses.ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.en: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
verses.tr: wayusqawna fīhā kaʾsan kāna mizājuhā zanjabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will be given a drink infused with ginger
verses.pickthall: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,

verses.ar: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
verses.en: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.
verses.tr: ʿaynan fīhā tusammā salsabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: from a spring called Salsabil.
verses.pickthall: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.

verses.ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
verses.en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
verses.tr: ۞ wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim wildānun mmukhalladūna ʾidhā raʾaytahum ḥasibtahum luʾluʾan mmanthūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Everlasting youths will attend them––if you could see them, you would think they were scattered pearls––
verses.pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
verses.tr: wa-idhā raʾayta thamma raʾayta naʿīman wamulkan kabīran
verses.abdelhaleem: and if you were to look around, you would see bliss and great wealth:
verses.pickthall: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.

verses.ar: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
verses.en: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
verses.tr: ʿāliyahum thiyābu sundusin khuḍrun wa-istabraqun ۖ waḥullūā ʾasāwira min fiḍḍahin wasaqāhum rabbuhum sharāban ṭahūran
verses.abdelhaleem: they will wear garments of green silk and brocade; they will be adorned with silver bracelets; their Lord will give them a pure drink.
verses.pickthall: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.en: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā kāna lakum jazāʾan wakāna saʿyukum mmashkūran
verses.abdelhaleem: [It will be said], ‘This is your reward. Your endeavours are appreciated.’
verses.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.
verses.tr: ʾinnā naḥnu nazzalnā ʿalayka al-qurāna tanzīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: We Ourself have sent down this Quran to you [Prophet] in gradual revelation.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
verses.en: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
verses.tr: fāṣbir liḥukmi rabbika walā tuṭiʿ minhum āthiman ʾaw kafūran
verses.abdelhaleem: Await your Lord’s Judgement with patience; do not yield to any of these sinners or disbelievers;
verses.pickthall: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.en: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
verses.tr: wādhkuri āsma rabbika bukrahan wa-aṣīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: remember the name of your Lord at dawn and in the evening;
verses.pickthall: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
verses.en: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.
verses.tr: wamina al-yli fāsjud lahu wasabbiḥhu laylan ṭawīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: bow down before Him, and glorify Him at length by night.
verses.pickthall: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
verses.tr: ʾinna hāʾulāʾi yuḥibbūna al-ʿājilaha wayadharūna warāʾahum yawman thaqīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: These people love the fleeting life. They put aside [all thoughts of] a Heavy Day.
verses.pickthall: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.

verses.ar: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.en: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
verses.tr: nnaḥnu khalaqnāhum washadadnā ʾasrahum ۖ wa-idhā shiʾnā baddalnā ʾamthālahum tabdīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet We created them; We strengthened their constitution; if We please, We can replace such people completely.
verses.pickthall: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhihi tadhkirahun ۖ faman shāʾa āttakhadha ʾilā rabbihi sabīlan
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes, take the way to his Lord.
verses.pickthall: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.en: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.
verses.tr: wamā tashāʾūna ʾillā ʾan yashāʾa Allāh ۚ ʾinna Allāh kāna ʿalīman ḥakīman
verses.abdelhaleem: But you will only wish to do so if God wills- God is all knowing, all wise-
verses.pickthall: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

verses.ar: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
verses.en: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
verses.tr: yudkhilu man yashāʾu fā raḥmatihi ۚ wa-aẓ-ẓālimīna ʾaʿadda lahum ʿadhāban ʾalīmanā
verses.abdelhaleem: He admits whoever He will into His Mercy and has prepared a painful torment for the disbelievers.
verses.pickthall: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.

verses.ar: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
verses.en: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
verses.tr: wa-l-mursalāti ʿurfan
verses.abdelhaleem: By the [winds] sent forth in swift succession,
verses.pickthall: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another

verses.ar: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
verses.en: And the winds that blow violently
verses.tr: fa-l-ʿāṣifāti ʿaṣfan
verses.abdelhaleem: violently storming,
verses.pickthall: By the raging hurricanes,

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
verses.en: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
verses.tr: wa-an-nāshirāti nashran
verses.abdelhaleem: scattering far and wide,
verses.pickthall: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;

verses.ar: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
verses.en: And those [angels] who bring criterion
verses.tr: fa-l-fāriqāti farqan
verses.abdelhaleem: separating forcefully,
verses.pickthall: By those who winnow with a winnowing,

verses.ar: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
verses.en: And those [angels] who deliver a message.
verses.tr: fa-l-mulqiyāti dhikran
verses.abdelhaleem: delivering a reminder,
verses.pickthall: By those who bring down the Reminder,

verses.ar: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
verses.en: As justification or warning,
verses.tr: ʿudhran ʾaw nudhran
verses.abdelhaleem: as a proof or a warning:
verses.pickthall: To excuse or to warn,

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.en: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā tūʿadūna lawāqiʿun
verses.abdelhaleem: what you are promised will come to pass.
verses.pickthall: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
verses.en: So when the stars are obliterated
verses.tr: fa-idhā an-nujūmu ṭumisat
verses.abdelhaleem: When the stars are dimmed
verses.pickthall: So when the stars are put out,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
verses.en: And when the heaven is opened
verses.tr: wa-idhā as-samāʾu furijat
verses.abdelhaleem: and the sky is torn apart,
verses.pickthall: And when the sky is riven asunder,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
verses.en: And when the mountains are blown away
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-jibālu nusifat
verses.abdelhaleem: when the mountains are turned to dust
verses.pickthall: And when the mountains are blown away,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
verses.en: And when the messengers' time has come...
verses.tr: wa-idhā ar-rusulu ʾuqqitat
verses.abdelhaleem: and the messengers given their appointed time––
verses.pickthall: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -

verses.ar: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
verses.en: For what Day was it postponed?
verses.tr: lii yawmin ʾujjilat
verses.abdelhaleem: for what Day has all this been set?
verses.pickthall: For what day is the time appointed?

verses.ar: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
verses.en: For the Day of Judgement.
verses.tr: liyawmi al-faṣli
verses.abdelhaleem: The Day of Decision.
verses.pickthall: For the Day of Decision.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā yawmu al-faṣli
verses.abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the Day of Decision is?
verses.pickthall: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
verses.tr: ʾalam nuhliki al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We not destroy the first [of them]?
verses.pickthall: Destroyed We not the former folk,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
verses.tr: thumma nutbiʿuhumu al-ākhirīna
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall make the last follow them:
verses.pickthall: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
verses.tr: kadhālika nafʿalu bi-l-mujrimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: this is how We deal with the guilty.
verses.pickthall: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
verses.en: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
verses.tr: ʾalam nakhluqkkum mmin mmāʾin mmahīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We not make you from an underrated fluid
verses.pickthall: Did We not create you from a base fluid

verses.ar: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
verses.en: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]
verses.tr: fajaʿalnāhu fā qarārin mmakīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: which We housed in a safe lodging
verses.pickthall: Which We laid up in a safe abode

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.en: For a known extent.
verses.tr: ʾilā qadarin mmaʿlūmin
verses.abdelhaleem: for a determined period?
verses.pickthall: For a known term?

verses.ar: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.en: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
verses.tr: faqadarnā faniʿma al-qādirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: We determine [it]: how excellently We determine!
verses.pickthall: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
verses.en: Have We not made the earth a container
verses.tr: ʾalam najʿali al-ʾarḍa kifātan
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We not make the earth a home
verses.pickthall: Have We not made the earth a receptacle

verses.ar: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوَٰتًا
verses.en: Of the living and the dead?
verses.tr: ʾaḥyāʾan wa-amwātan
verses.abdelhaleem: for the living and the dead?
verses.pickthall: Both for the living and the dead,

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
verses.en: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā fīhā rawāsāa shāmikhātin wa-asqaynākum mmāʾan furātan
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We not place firm, lofty mountains on it and provide you with sweet water?
verses.pickthall: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
verses.tr: ānṭaliqūā ʾilā mā kuntum bihi tukadhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will be told, ‘Go to that which you used to deny!
verses.pickthall: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;

verses.ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ
verses.en: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns.
verses.tr: ānṭaliqūā ʾilā ẓillin dhā thalāthi shuʿabin
verses.abdelhaleem: Go to a shadow of smoke!’ It rises in three columns;
verses.pickthall: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,

verses.ar: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
verses.en: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
verses.tr: llā ẓalīlin walā yughnā mina al-lahabi
verses.abdelhaleem: no shade does it give, nor relief from the flame;
verses.pickthall: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.

verses.ar: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
verses.en: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
verses.tr: ʾinnahā tarmā bishararin ka-l-qaṣri
verses.abdelhaleem: it shoots out sparks as large as treetrunks
verses.pickthall: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَـٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ
verses.en: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
verses.tr: kaʾannahu jimālatun ṣufrun
verses.abdelhaleem: and as bright as copper.
verses.pickthall: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
verses.en: This is a Day they will not speak,
verses.tr: hādhā yawmu lā yanṭiqūna
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day they will be speechless,
verses.pickthall: This is a day wherein they speak not,

verses.ar: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
verses.en: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
verses.tr: walā yuʾdhanu lahum fayaʿtadhirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will be given no chance to offer any excuses.
verses.pickthall: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
verses.tr: hādhā yawmu al-faṣli ۖ jamaʿnākum wa-l-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: [They will be told], ‘This is the Day of Decision: We have gathered you and earlier generations.
verses.pickthall: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.

verses.ar: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
verses.en: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
verses.tr: fa-in kāna lakum kaydun fakīdūni
verses.abdelhaleem: If you have any plots against Me, try them now.’
verses.pickthall: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
verses.tr: ʾinna al-muttaqīna fā ẓilālin waʿuyūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who took heed of God will enjoy cool shade, springs,
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,

verses.ar: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.en: And fruits from whatever they desire,
verses.tr: wafawākiha mimmā yashtahūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and any fruit they desire;
verses.pickthall: And fruits such as they desire.

verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
verses.tr: kulūā wāshrabūā hanīā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [they will be told], ‘Eat and drink to your hearts’ content as a reward for your deeds:
verses.pickthall: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.tr: ʾinnā kadhālika najzā al-muḥsinīna
verses.abdelhaleem: this is how We reward those who do good.’
verses.pickthall: Thus do We reward the good.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
verses.tr: kulūā watamattaʿūā qalīlan ʾinnakum mmujrimūna
verses.abdelhaleem: [You may] eat and enjoy yourselves for a short while, evildoers that you are.
verses.pickthall: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
verses.tr: wa-idhā qīla lahumu ārkaʿūā lā yarkaʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: When they are told, ‘Bow down in prayer,’ they do not do so.
verses.pickthall: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?
verses.tr: fabiāi ḥadīthin baʿdahu yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In what revelation, after this, will they believe?
verses.pickthall: In what statement, after this, will they believe?

verses.ar: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: About what are they asking one another?
verses.tr: ʿamma yatasāʾalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: What are they asking about?
verses.pickthall: Whereof do they question one another?

verses.ar: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: About the great news -
verses.tr: ʿani an-nabaʾi al-ʿaẓīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: The momentous announcement
verses.pickthall: (It is) of the awful tidings,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: That over which they are in disagreement.
verses.tr: adh-dhā hum fīhi mukhtalifūna
verses.abdelhaleem: about which they differ.
verses.pickthall: Concerning which they are in disagreement.

verses.ar: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: No! They are going to know.
verses.tr: kallā sayaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: They will find out.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but they will come to know!

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Then, no! They are going to know.
verses.tr: thumma kallā sayaʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: In the end they will find out.
verses.pickthall: Nay, again, but they will come to know!

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَـٰدًا
verses.en: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
verses.tr: ʾalam najʿali al-ʾarḍa mihādan
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We not make the earth smooth,
verses.pickthall: Have We not made the earth an expanse,

verses.ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا
verses.en: And the mountains as stakes?
verses.tr: wa-l-jibāla ʾawtādan
verses.abdelhaleem: and make the mountains to keep it stable?
verses.pickthall: And the high hills bulwarks?

verses.ar: وَخَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا
verses.en: And We created you in pairs.
verses.tr: wakhalaqnākum ʾazwājan
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We not create you in pairs,
verses.pickthall: And We have created you in pairs,

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا
verses.en: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā nawmakum subātan
verses.abdelhaleem: give you sleep for rest,
verses.pickthall: And have appointed your sleep for repose,

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا
verses.en: And made the night as clothing.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā al-yla libāsan
verses.abdelhaleem: the night as a cover,
verses.pickthall: And have appointed the night as a cloak,

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا
verses.en: And made the day for livelihood.
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā an-nahāra maʿāshan
verses.abdelhaleem: and the day for your livelihood?
verses.pickthall: And have appointed the day for livelihood.

verses.ar: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا
verses.en: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens].
verses.tr: wabanaynā fawqakum sabʿan shidādan
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We not build seven strong [heavens] above you,
verses.pickthall: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا
verses.en: And made [therein] a burning lamp
verses.tr: wajaʿalnā sirājan wahhājan
verses.abdelhaleem: and make a blazing lamp?
verses.pickthall: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,

verses.ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجًا
verses.en: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water.
verses.tr: wa-anzalnā mina al-muʿṣirāti māʾan thajjājan
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We not send water pouring down from the clouds
verses.pickthall: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,

verses.ar: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا
verses.en: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation.
verses.tr: llinukhrija bihi ḥabban wanabātan
verses.abdelhaleem: to bring forth with it grain, plants,
verses.pickthall: Thereby to produce grain and plant,

verses.ar: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
verses.en: And gardens of entwined growth.
verses.tr: wajannātin ʾalfāfan
verses.abdelhaleem: and luxuriant gardens?
verses.pickthall: And gardens of thick foliage.

verses.ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَـٰتًا
verses.en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
verses.tr: ʾinna yawma al-faṣli kāna mīqātan
verses.abdelhaleem: A time has been appointed for the Day of Decision:
verses.pickthall: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
verses.en: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
verses.tr: yawma yunfakhu fā aṣ-ṣūri fataʾtūna ʾafwājan
verses.abdelhaleem: a Day when the Trumpet will sound and you will come forward in crowds,
verses.pickthall: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,

verses.ar: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًا
verses.en: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways.
verses.tr: wafutiḥati as-samāʾu fakānat ʾabwāban
verses.abdelhaleem: when the sky will open up like wide portals,
verses.pickthall: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,

verses.ar: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
verses.en: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
verses.tr: wasuyyirati al-jibālu fakānat sarāban
verses.abdelhaleem: when the mountains will vanish like a mirage.
verses.pickthall: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.

verses.ar: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا
verses.en: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
verses.tr: ʾinna jahannama kānat mirṣādan
verses.abdelhaleem: Hell lies in wait,
verses.pickthall: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,

verses.ar: لِّلطَّـٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًا
verses.en: For the transgressors, a place of return,
verses.tr: llilṭṭāghīna māban
verses.abdelhaleem: a home for oppressors
verses.pickthall: A home for the rebellious.

verses.ar: لَّـٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًا
verses.en: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
verses.tr: llābithīna fīhā ʾaḥqāban
verses.abdelhaleem: to stay in for a long, long time,
verses.pickthall: They will abide therein for ages.

verses.ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
verses.en: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.
verses.tr: llā yadhūqūna fīhā bardan walā sharāban
verses.abdelhaleem: where they will taste no coolness nor drink
verses.pickthall: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink

verses.ar: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا
verses.en: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
verses.tr: ʾillā ḥamīman waghassāqan
verses.abdelhaleem: except one that is scalding and dark––
verses.pickthall: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:

verses.ar: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
verses.en: An appropriate recompense.
verses.tr: jazāʾan wifāqan
verses.abdelhaleem: a fitting requital,
verses.pickthall: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
verses.en: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
verses.tr: ʾinnahum kānūā lā yarjūna ḥisāban
verses.abdelhaleem: for they did not fear a reckoning,
verses.pickthall: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;

verses.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
verses.en: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
verses.tr: wakadhabūā bāyātinā kidhāban
verses.abdelhaleem: and they rejected Our messages as lies.
verses.pickthall: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.

verses.ar: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
verses.en: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
verses.tr: wakulla shāʾin ʾaḥṣaynāhu kitāban
verses.abdelhaleem: We have recorded everything in a Record.
verses.pickthall: Everything have We recorded in a Book.

verses.ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
verses.en: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
verses.tr: fadhūqūā falan nnazīdakum ʾillā ʿadhāban
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Taste this: all you will get from Us is more torment.’
verses.pickthall: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.

verses.ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
verses.en: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
verses.tr: ʾinna lilmuttaqīna mafāzan
verses.abdelhaleem: For those who were aware of God there is supreme fulfilment:
verses.pickthall: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -

verses.ar: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
verses.en: Gardens and grapevines.
verses.tr: ḥadāʾiqa wa-aʿnāban
verses.abdelhaleem: private gardens, vineyards,
verses.pickthall: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,

verses.ar: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
verses.en: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age.
verses.tr: wakawāʿiba ʾatrāban
verses.abdelhaleem: nubile, well-matched companions,
verses.pickthall: And voluptuous women of equal age;

verses.ar: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
verses.en: And a full cup.
verses.tr: wakaʾsan dihāqan
verses.abdelhaleem: and an overflowing cup.
verses.pickthall: And a full cup.

verses.ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
verses.en: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
verses.tr: llā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā kidhāban
verses.abdelhaleem: There they will hear no vain or lying talk:
verses.pickthall: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -

verses.ar: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
verses.en: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
verses.tr: jazāʾan mmin rrabbika ʿaṭāʾan ḥisāban
verses.abdelhaleem: a reward from your Lord, a fitting gift
verses.pickthall: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -

verses.ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
verses.en: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
verses.tr: rrabbi as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā ar-raḥmāni ۖ lā yamlikūna minhu khiṭāban
verses.abdelhaleem: from the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Lord of Mercy. They will have no authority from Him to speak.
verses.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
verses.en: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
verses.tr: yawma yaqūmu ar-rūḥu wa-l-malāʾikahu ṣaffan ۖ llā yatakallamūna ʾillā man ʾadhina lahu ar-raḥmānu waqāla ṣawāban
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in rows, they will not speak except for those to whom the Lord of Mercy gives permission, who will say only what is right.
verses.pickthall: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verses.en: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
verses.tr: dhālika al-yawmu al-ḥaqqu ۖ faman shāʾa āttakhadha ʾilā rabbihi māban
verses.abdelhaleem: That is the Day of Truth. So whoever wishes to do so should take the path that leads to his Lord.
verses.pickthall: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
verses.en: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾandharnākum ʿadhāban qarīban yawma yanẓuru al-marʾu mā qaddamat yadāhu wayaqūlu al-kāfiru yālaytanā kuntu turābanā
verses.abdelhaleem: We have warned you of imminent torment, on the Day when every person will see what their own hands have sent ahead for them, when the disbeliever will say, ‘If only I were dust!’
verses.pickthall: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
verses.en: By those [angels] who extract with violence
verses.tr: wa-an-nāziʿāti gharqan
verses.abdelhaleem: By the forceful chargers
verses.pickthall: By those who drag forth to destruction,

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
verses.en: And [by] those who remove with ease
verses.tr: wa-an-nāshiṭāti nashṭan
verses.abdelhaleem: raring to go,
verses.pickthall: By the meteors rushing,

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
verses.en: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
verses.tr: wa-as-sābiḥāti sabḥan
verses.abdelhaleem: sweeping ahead at full stretch,
verses.pickthall: By the lone stars floating,

verses.ar: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
verses.en: And those who race each other in a race
verses.tr: fa-as-sābiqāti sabqan
verses.abdelhaleem: overtaking swiftly
verses.pickthall: By the angels hastening,

verses.ar: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.en: And those who arrange [each] matter,
verses.tr: fa-l-mudabbirāti ʾamran
verses.abdelhaleem: to bring the matter to an end,
verses.pickthall: And those who govern the event,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
verses.en: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
verses.tr: yawma tarjufu ar-rājifahu
verses.abdelhaleem: on the Day when the blast reverberates
verses.pickthall: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.

verses.ar: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
verses.en: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
verses.tr: tatbaʿuhā ar-rādifahu
verses.abdelhaleem: and the second blast follows,
verses.pickthall: And the second followeth it,

verses.ar: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
verses.en: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
verses.tr: qulūbun yawmaʾidhin wājifahun
verses.abdelhaleem: hearts will tremble
verses.pickthall: On that day hearts beat painfully

verses.ar: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
verses.en: Their eyes humbled.
verses.tr: ʾabṣāruhā khāshiʿahun
verses.abdelhaleem: and eyes will be downcast.
verses.pickthall: While eyes are downcast

verses.ar: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
verses.en: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
verses.tr: yaqūlūna ʾaʾinnā lamardūdūna fā al-ḥāfirahi
verses.abdelhaleem: They say, ‘What? shall we be brought back to life,
verses.pickthall: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state

verses.ar: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
verses.en: Even if we should be decayed bones?"
verses.tr: ʾaʾidhā kunnā ʿiẓāman nnakhirahan
verses.abdelhaleem: after we have turned into decayed bones?’ and they say,
verses.pickthall: Even after we are crumbled bones?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
verses.en: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
verses.tr: qālūā tilka ʾidhan karrahun khāsirahun
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Such a return is impossible!’
verses.pickthall: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
verses.en: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
verses.tr: fa-innamā hāa zajrahun wāḥidahun
verses.abdelhaleem: But all it will take is a single blast,
verses.pickthall: Surely it will need but one shout,

verses.ar: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
verses.en: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
verses.tr: fa-idhā hum bi-as-sāhirahi
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will be back above ground.
verses.pickthall: And lo! they will be awakened.

verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.en: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
verses.tr: hal ʾatāka ḥadīthu mūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you [Prophet] heard the story of Moses?
verses.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?

verses.ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verses.en: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,
verses.tr: ʾidh nādāhu rabbuhu bi-l-wādi al-muqaddasi ṭuwanā
verses.abdelhaleem: His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:
verses.pickthall: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,

verses.ar: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.en: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
verses.tr: ādhhab ʾilā firʿawna ʾinnahu ṭaghā
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘Go to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds,
verses.pickthall: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -

verses.ar: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.en: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
verses.tr: faqul hal llaka ʾilā ʾan tazakkā
verses.abdelhaleem: and ask him, “Do you want to purify yourself [of sin]?
verses.pickthall: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?

verses.ar: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
verses.en: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
verses.tr: wa-ahdiyaka ʾilā rabbika fatakhshā
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you want me to guide you to your Lord, so that you may hold Him in awe?” ’
verses.pickthall: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).

verses.ar: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verses.en: And he showed him the greatest sign,
verses.tr: fa-arāhu al-āyaha al-kubrā
verses.abdelhaleem: Moses showed him the great sign,
verses.pickthall: And he showed him the tremendous token.

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
verses.en: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.
verses.tr: fakadhaba waʿaṣā
verses.abdelhaleem: but he denied it and refused [the faith].
verses.pickthall: But he denied and disobeyed,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
verses.en: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].
verses.tr: thumma ʾadbara yasʿā
verses.abdelhaleem: He turned away and hastily
verses.pickthall: Then turned he away in haste,

verses.ar: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
verses.en: And he gathered [his people] and called out.
verses.tr: faḥashara fanādā
verses.abdelhaleem: gathered his people, proclaiming,
verses.pickthall: Then gathered he and summoned

verses.ar: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.en: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
verses.tr: faqāla ʾanā rabbukumu al-ʾaʿlā
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘I am your supreme lord,’
verses.pickthall: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
verses.en: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]..
verses.tr: fa-akhadhahu Allāh nakāla al-ākhirahi wa-l-ʾūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: so God condemned him to punishment in the life to come as well as in this life:
verses.pickthall: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].
verses.tr: ʾinna fā dhālika laʿibrahan lliman yakhshā
verses.abdelhaleem: there truly is a lesson in this for anyone who stands in awe of God.
verses.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.

verses.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
verses.en: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.
verses.tr: ʾaʾantum ʾashaddu khalqan ʾami as-samāʾu ۚ banāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: Which is harder to create: you people or the sky that He built,
verses.pickthall: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?

verses.ar: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verses.en: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
verses.tr: rafaʿa samkahā fasawwāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: raising it high and perfecting it,
verses.pickthall: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;

verses.ar: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.en: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
verses.tr: wa-aghṭasha laylahā wa-akhraja ḍuḥāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: giving darkness to its night and bringing out its morning brightness,
verses.pickthall: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
verses.en: And after that He spread the earth.
verses.tr: wa-l-ʾarḍa baʿda dhālika daḥāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: and the earth, too, He spread out,
verses.pickthall: And after that He spread the earth,

verses.ar: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
verses.en: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
verses.tr: ʾakhraja minhā māʾahā wamarʿāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: bringing waters and pastures out of it,
verses.pickthall: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,

verses.ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
verses.en: And the mountains He set firmly
verses.tr: wa-l-jibāla ʾarsāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: and setting firm mountains [in it]
verses.pickthall: And He made fast the hills,

verses.ar: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
verses.en: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
verses.tr: matāʿan llakum waliʾanʿāmikum
verses.abdelhaleem: for you and your animals to enjoy?
verses.pickthall: A provision for you and for your cattle.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verses.en: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
verses.tr: fa-idhā jāʾati aṭ-ṭāmmahu al-kubrā
verses.abdelhaleem: When the great overwhelming event arrives
verses.pickthall: But when the great disaster cometh,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.en: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
verses.tr: yawma yatadhakkaru al-ʾinsānu mā saʿā
verses.abdelhaleem: on the Day that man remembers what he has done
verses.pickthall: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,

verses.ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
verses.en: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
verses.tr: waburrizati al-jaḥīmu liman yarā
verses.abdelhaleem: and Hell is there for all to see,
verses.pickthall: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
verses.en: So as for he who transgressed
verses.tr: fa-ammā man ṭaghā
verses.abdelhaleem: for anyone who has transgressed
verses.pickthall: Then, as for him who rebelled

verses.ar: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.en: And preferred the life of the world,
verses.tr: wathara al-ḥayawāha ad-dunyā
verses.abdelhaleem: and preferred the present life
verses.pickthall: And chose the life of the world,

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
verses.en: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
verses.tr: fa-inna al-jaḥīma hāa al-maʾwā
verses.abdelhaleem: Hell will be home;
verses.pickthall: Lo! hell will be his home.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
verses.en: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
verses.tr: wa-ammā man khāfa maqāma rabbihi wanahā an-nafsa ʿani al-hawā
verses.abdelhaleem: for anyone who feared the meeting with his Lord and restrained himself from base desires,
verses.pickthall: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
verses.en: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
verses.tr: fa-inna al-jannaha hāa al-maʾwā
verses.abdelhaleem: Paradise will be home.
verses.pickthall: Lo! the Garden will be his home.

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
verses.en: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
verses.tr: yaslūnaka ʿani as-sāʿahi ʾayyāna mursāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: They ask you [Prophet] about the Hour,
verses.pickthall: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?

verses.ar: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
verses.en: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
verses.tr: fīma ʾanta min dhikrāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: saying, ‘When will it arrive?’, but how can you tell [them that]?
verses.pickthall: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
verses.en: To your Lord is its finality.
verses.tr: ʾilā rabbika muntahāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: Its time is known only to your Lord;
verses.pickthall: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
verses.en: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
verses.tr: ʾinnamā ʾanta mundhiru man yakhshāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: you are only sent to warn those who fear it.
verses.pickthall: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
verses.tr: kaʾannahum yawma yarawnahā lam yalbathūā ʾillā ʿashiyyahan ʾaw ḍuḥāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day they see it, it will seem they lingered [in this life] an evening [at most,] or its morning.
verses.pickthall: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.

verses.ar: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
verses.en: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away
verses.tr: ʿabasa watawallā
verses.abdelhaleem: He frowned and turned away
verses.pickthall: He frowned and turned away

verses.ar: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
verses.en: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
verses.tr: ʾan jāʾahu al-ʾaʿmā
verses.abdelhaleem: when the blind man came to him––
verses.pickthall: Because the blind man came unto him.

verses.ar: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
verses.en: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified
verses.tr: wamā yudrīka laʿallahu yazzakkā
verses.abdelhaleem: for all you know, he might have grown in spirit,
verses.pickthall: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)

verses.ar: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
verses.en: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
verses.tr: ʾaw yadhakkaru fatanfaʿahu adh-dhikrā
verses.abdelhaleem: or taken note of something useful to him.
verses.pickthall: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?

verses.ar: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
verses.en: As for he who thinks himself without need,
verses.tr: ʾammā mani āstaghnā
verses.abdelhaleem: For the self-satisfied one
verses.pickthall: As for him who thinketh himself independent,

verses.ar: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
verses.en: To him you give attention.
verses.tr: fa-anta lahu taṣaddā
verses.abdelhaleem: you go out of your way––
verses.pickthall: Unto him thou payest regard.

verses.ar: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
verses.en: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
verses.tr: wamā ʿalayka ʾallā yazzakkā
verses.abdelhaleem: though you are not to be blamed for his lack of spiritual growth––
verses.pickthall: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
verses.en: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
verses.tr: wa-ammā man jāʾaka yasʿā
verses.abdelhaleem: but from the one who has come to you full of eagerness
verses.pickthall: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose

verses.ar: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
verses.en: While he fears [Allāh],
verses.tr: wahuwa yakhshā
verses.abdelhaleem: and awe
verses.pickthall: And hath fear,

verses.ar: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
verses.en: From him you are distracted.
verses.tr: fa-anta ʿanhu talahhā
verses.abdelhaleem: you allow yourself to be distracted.
verses.pickthall: From him thou art distracted.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
verses.en: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;
verses.tr: kallā ʾinnahā tadhkirahun
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! This [Quran] is a lesson
verses.pickthall: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,

verses.ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
verses.en: So whoever wills may remember it.
verses.tr: faman shāʾa dhakarahu
verses.abdelhaleem: from which those who wish to be taught should learn,
verses.pickthall: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,

verses.ar: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
verses.en: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
verses.tr: fā ṣuḥufin mmukarramahin
verses.abdelhaleem: [written] on honoured,
verses.pickthall: On honoured leaves

verses.ar: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
verses.en: Exalted and purified,
verses.tr: mmarfūʿahin mmuṭahharahin
verses.abdelhaleem: exalted, pure pages,
verses.pickthall: Exalted, purified,

verses.ar: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍ
verses.en: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
verses.tr: biʾaydā safarahin
verses.abdelhaleem: by the hands of
verses.pickthall: (Set down) by scribes

verses.ar: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍ
verses.en: Noble and dutiful.
verses.tr: kirāmin bararahin
verses.abdelhaleem: noble and virtuous scribes.
verses.pickthall: Noble and righteous.

verses.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
verses.en: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man; how disbelieving is he.
verses.tr: qutila al-ʾinsānu mā ʾakfarahu
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe to man! How ungrateful he is!
verses.pickthall: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful!

verses.ar: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
verses.en: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?
verses.tr: min āi shāʾin khalaqahu
verses.abdelhaleem: From what thing does God create him?
verses.pickthall: From what thing doth He create him?

verses.ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
verses.en: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
verses.tr: min nnuṭfahin khalaqahu faqaddarahu
verses.abdelhaleem: He creates him from a droplet, He proportions him,
verses.pickthall: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
verses.en: Then He eased the way for him;
verses.tr: thumma as-sabīla yassarahu
verses.abdelhaleem: He makes the way easy for him,
verses.pickthall: Then maketh the way easy for him,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
verses.en: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
verses.tr: thumma ʾamātahu fa-aqbarahu
verses.abdelhaleem: then He causes him to die and be buried.
verses.pickthall: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
verses.en: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
verses.tr: thumma ʾidhā shāʾa ʾansharahu
verses.abdelhaleem: When He wills, He will raise him up again.
verses.pickthall: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.

verses.ar: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
verses.en: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
verses.tr: kallā lammā yaqḍi mā ʾamarahu
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet man does not fulfil God’s commands.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.

verses.ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
verses.en: Then let mankind look at his food -
verses.tr: falyanẓuri al-ʾinsānu ʾilā ṭaʿāmihi
verses.abdelhaleem: Let man consider the food he eats!
verses.pickthall: Let man consider his food:

verses.ar: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّا
verses.en: How We poured down water in torrents,
verses.tr: ʾannā ṣababnā al-māʾa ṣabban
verses.abdelhaleem: We pour down abundant water
verses.pickthall: How We pour water in showers

verses.ar: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّا
verses.en: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
verses.tr: thumma shaqaqnā al-ʾarḍa shaqqan
verses.abdelhaleem: and cause the soil to split open.
verses.pickthall: Then split the earth in clefts

verses.ar: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا
verses.en: And caused to grow within it grain
verses.tr: fa-anbatnā fīhā ḥabban
verses.abdelhaleem: We make grain grow,
verses.pickthall: And cause the grain to grow therein

verses.ar: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا
verses.en: And grapes and herbage
verses.tr: waʿinaban waqaḍban
verses.abdelhaleem: and vines, fresh vegetation,
verses.pickthall: And grapes and green fodder

verses.ar: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا
verses.en: And olive and palm trees
verses.tr: wazaytūnan wanakhlan
verses.abdelhaleem: olive trees, date palms,
verses.pickthall: And olive-trees and palm-trees

verses.ar: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًا
verses.en: And gardens of dense shrubbery
verses.tr: waḥadāʾiqa ghulban
verses.abdelhaleem: luscious gardens,
verses.pickthall: And garden-closes of thick foliage

verses.ar: وَفَـٰكِهَةً وَأَبًّا
verses.en: And fruit and grass -
verses.tr: wafākihahan wa-abban
verses.abdelhaleem: fruits, and fodder:
verses.pickthall: And fruits and grasses:

verses.ar: مَّتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
verses.en: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
verses.tr: mmatāʿan llakum waliʾanʿāmikum
verses.abdelhaleem: all for you and your livestock to enjoy.
verses.pickthall: Provision for you and your cattle.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
verses.en: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
verses.tr: fa-idhā jāʾati aṣ-ṣākhahu
verses.abdelhaleem: When the Deafening Blast comes––
verses.pickthall: But when the Shout cometh

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
verses.en: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
verses.tr: yawma yafirru al-marʾu min ʾakhīhi
verses.abdelhaleem: the Day man will flee from his own brother,
verses.pickthall: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother

verses.ar: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
verses.en: And his mother and his father
verses.tr: wa-ummihi wa-abīhi
verses.abdelhaleem: his mother, his father,
verses.pickthall: And his mother and his father

verses.ar: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
verses.en: And his wife and his children,
verses.tr: waṣāḥibatihi wabanīhi
verses.abdelhaleem: his wife, his children:
verses.pickthall: And his wife and his children,

verses.ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
verses.en: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
verses.tr: likulli āmriʾin mminhum yawmaʾidhin shaʾnun yughnīhi
verses.abdelhaleem: each of them will be absorbed in concerns of their own on that Day-
verses.pickthall: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).

verses.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ
verses.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
verses.tr: wujūhun yawmaʾidhin mmusfirahun
verses.abdelhaleem: on that Day some faces will be beaming,
verses.pickthall: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,

verses.ar: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
verses.en: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
verses.tr: ḍāḥikahun mmustabshirahun
verses.abdelhaleem: laughing, and rejoicing,
verses.pickthall: Laughing, rejoicing at good news;

verses.ar: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
verses.en: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
verses.tr: wawujūhun yawmaʾidhin ʿalayhā ghabarahun
verses.abdelhaleem: but some faces will be dust-stained
verses.pickthall: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,

verses.ar: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
verses.en: Blackness will cover them.
verses.tr: tarhaquhā qatarahun
verses.abdelhaleem: and covered in darkness:
verses.pickthall: Veiled in darkness,

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
verses.en: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika humu al-kafarahu al-fajarahu
verses.abdelhaleem: those are the disbelievers, the licentious.
verses.pickthall: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.

verses.ar: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
verses.en: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
verses.tr: ʾidhā ash-shamsu kuwwirat
verses.abdelhaleem: When the sun is shrouded in darkness,
verses.pickthall: When the sun is overthrown,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
verses.en: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
verses.tr: wa-idhā an-nujūmu ānkadarat
verses.abdelhaleem: when the stars are dimmed,
verses.pickthall: And when the stars fall,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
verses.en: And when the mountains are removed
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-jibālu suyyirat
verses.abdelhaleem: when the mountains are set in motion,
verses.pickthall: And when the hills are moved,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
verses.en: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-ʿishāru ʿuṭṭilat
verses.abdelhaleem: when pregnant camels are abandoned,
verses.pickthall: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
verses.en: And when the wild beasts are gathered
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-wuḥūshu ḥushirat
verses.abdelhaleem: when wild beasts are herded together,
verses.pickthall: And when the wild beasts are herded together,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
verses.en: And when the seas are filled with flame
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-biḥāru sujjirat
verses.abdelhaleem: when the seas boil over,
verses.pickthall: And when the seas rise,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
verses.en: And when the souls are paired
verses.tr: wa-idhā an-nufūsu zuwwijat
verses.abdelhaleem: when souls are sorted into classes,
verses.pickthall: And when souls are reunited,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
verses.en: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-mawʾudahu suʾilat
verses.abdelhaleem: when the baby girl buried alive is asked
verses.pickthall: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked

verses.ar: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍ قُتِلَتْ
verses.en: For what sin she was killed
verses.tr: bii dhanbin qutilat
verses.abdelhaleem: for what sin she was killed,
verses.pickthall: For what sin she was slain,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
verses.en: And when the pages are spread [i.e., made public]
verses.tr: wa-idhā aṣ-ṣuḥufu nushirat
verses.abdelhaleem: when the records of deeds are spread open,
verses.pickthall: And when the pages are laid open,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
verses.en: And when the sky is stripped away
verses.tr: wa-idhā as-samāʾu kushiṭat
verses.abdelhaleem: when the sky is stripped away,
verses.pickthall: And when the sky is torn away,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
verses.en: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-jaḥīmu suʿʿirat
verses.abdelhaleem: when Hell is made to blaze
verses.pickthall: And when hell is lighted,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
verses.en: And when Paradise is brought near,
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-jannahu ʾuzlifat
verses.abdelhaleem: and Paradise brought near:
verses.pickthall: And when the Garden is brought nigh,

verses.ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
