verses.en: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
verses.tr: ʿalimat nafsun mmā ʾaḥḍarat
verses.abdelhaleem: then every soul will know what it has brought about.
verses.pickthall: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.

verses.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
verses.en: So I swear by the retreating stars -
verses.tr: falā ʾuqsimu bi-l-khunnasi
verses.abdelhaleem: I swear by the planets
verses.pickthall: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,

verses.ar: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
verses.en: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]
verses.tr: al-jawāri al-kunnasi
verses.abdelhaleem: that recede, move, and hide,
verses.pickthall: The stars which rise and set,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
verses.en: And by the night as it closes in
verses.tr: wa-l-yli ʾidhā ʿasʿasa
verses.abdelhaleem: by the night that descends,
verses.pickthall: And the close of night,

verses.ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
verses.en: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]
verses.tr: wa-aṣ-ṣubḥi ʾidhā tanaffasa
verses.abdelhaleem: by the dawn that softly breathes:
verses.pickthall: And the breath of morning

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]
verses.tr: ʾinnahu laqawlu rasūlin karīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: this is the speech of a noble messenger,
verses.pickthall: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,

verses.ar: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
verses.en: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
verses.tr: dhā quwwahin ʿinda dhā al-ʿarshi makīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: who possesses great strength and is held in honour by the Lord of the Throne––
verses.pickthall: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,

verses.ar: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
verses.en: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
verses.tr: mmuṭāʿin thamma ʾamīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: he is obeyed there and worthy of trust.
verses.pickthall: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;

verses.ar: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
verses.en: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.
verses.tr: wamā ṣāḥibukum bimajnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: Your companion is not mad:
verses.pickthall: And your comrade is not mad.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.en: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.
verses.tr: walaqad raāhu bi-l-ʾufuqi al-mubīni
verses.abdelhaleem: he did see him on the clear horizon.
verses.pickthall: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.

verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
verses.en: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
verses.tr: wamā huwa ʿalā al-ghaybi biḍanīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: He does not withhold what is revealed to him from beyond.
verses.pickthall: And he is not avid of the Unseen.

verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
verses.en: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
verses.tr: wamā huwa biqawli shayṭānin rrajīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: This is not the word of an outcast devil.
verses.pickthall: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.

verses.ar: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
verses.en: So where are you going?
verses.tr: fa-ayna tadhhabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So where are you [people] going?
verses.pickthall: Whither then go ye?

verses.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
verses.tr: ʾin huwa ʾillā dhikrun llilʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: This is a message for all people;
verses.pickthall: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,

verses.ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
verses.en: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
verses.tr: liman shāʾa minkum ʾan yastaqīma
verses.abdelhaleem: for those who wish to take the straight path.
verses.pickthall: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.
verses.tr: wamā tashāʾūna ʾillā ʾan yashāʾa Allāh rabbu al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: But you will only wish to do so by the will of God, the Lord of all people.
verses.pickthall: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.

verses.ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
verses.en: When the sky breaks apart
verses.tr: ʾidhā as-samāʾu ānfaṭarat
verses.abdelhaleem: When the sky is torn apart,
verses.pickthall: When the heaven is cleft asunder,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
verses.en: And when the stars fall, scattering,
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-kawākibu āntatharat
verses.abdelhaleem: when the stars are scattered,
verses.pickthall: When the planets are dispersed,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
verses.en: And when the seas are erupted
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-biḥāru fujjirat
verses.abdelhaleem: when the seas burst forth,
verses.pickthall: When the seas are poured forth,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
verses.en: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-qubūru buʿthirat
verses.abdelhaleem: when graves turn inside out:
verses.pickthall: And the sepulchres are overturned,

verses.ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
verses.en: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
verses.tr: ʿalimat nafsun mmā qaddamat wa-akharat
verses.abdelhaleem: each soul will know what it has done and what it has left undone.
verses.pickthall: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.en: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā al-ʾinsānu mā gharraka birabbika al-karīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: Mankind, what has lured you away from God,
verses.pickthall: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
verses.en: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
verses.tr: adh-dhā khalaqaka fasawwāka faʿadalaka
verses.abdelhaleem: your generous Lord, who created you, shaped you, proportioned you,
verses.pickthall: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?

verses.ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.en: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
verses.tr: fā āi ṣūrahin mmā shāʾa rakkabaka
verses.abdelhaleem: in whatever form He chose?
verses.pickthall: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.

verses.ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: No! But you deny the Recompense.
verses.tr: kallā bal tukadhibūna bi-ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet you still take the Judgement to be a lie!
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
verses.tr: wa-inna ʿalaykum laḥāfiẓīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Over you stand
verses.pickthall: Lo! there are above you guardians,

verses.ar: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
verses.en: Noble and recording;
verses.tr: kirāman kātibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: watchers, noble recorders
verses.pickthall: Generous and recording,

verses.ar: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: They know whatever you do.
verses.tr: yaʿlamūna mā tafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who know what you do:
verses.pickthall: Who know (all) that ye do.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
verses.tr: ʾinna al-ʾabrāra lafā naʿīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: the good will live in bliss,
verses.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
verses.en: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
verses.tr: wa-inna al-fujjāra lafā jaḥīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: and the wicked will burn in the Fire.
verses.pickthall: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;

verses.ar: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
verses.tr: yaṣlawnahā yawma ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: They will enter it on the Day of Judgement
verses.pickthall: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,

verses.ar: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
verses.en: And never therefrom will they be absent.
verses.tr: wamā hum ʿanhā bighāʾibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will find no escape.
verses.pickthall: And will not be absent thence.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā yawmu ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

verses.ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
verses.tr: thumma mā ʾadrāka mā yawmu ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: Yes! What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?
verses.pickthall: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
verses.en: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.
verses.tr: yawma lā tamliku nafsun llinafsin shayā ۖ wa-l-ʾamru yawmaʾidhin lillāh
verses.abdelhaleem: The Day when no soul will be able to do anything for another; on that Day, command will belong to God.
verses.pickthall: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
verses.en: Woe to those who give less [than due],
verses.tr: waylun llilmuṭaffifīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe to those who give short measure,
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the defrauders:

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
verses.en: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ʾidhā āktālūā ʿalā an-nāsi yastawfūna
verses.abdelhaleem: who demand of other people full measure for themselves,
verses.pickthall: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
verses.en: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
verses.tr: wa-idhā ka-l-whum ʾaw wwazanūhum yukhsirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but give less than they should when it is they who weigh or measure for others!
verses.pickthall: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.

verses.ar: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
verses.en: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
verses.tr: ʾalā yaẓunnu ʾūlāʾika ʾannahum mmabʿūthūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Do these people not realize that they will be raised up
verses.pickthall: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again

verses.ar: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: For a tremendous Day -
verses.tr: liyawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: on a mighty Day,
verses.pickthall: Unto an Awful Day,

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
verses.tr: yawma yaqūmu an-nāsu lirabbi al-ʿālamīna
verses.abdelhaleem: a Day when everyone will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
verses.pickthall: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
verses.en: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
verses.tr: kallā ʾinna kitāba al-fujjāri lafā sijjīnin
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! The list of the wicked is in Sijjin––
verses.pickthall: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā sijjīnun
verses.abdelhaleem: what will explain to you what Sijjin is?––
verses.pickthall: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -

verses.ar: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
verses.en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
verses.tr: kitābun mmarqūmun
verses.abdelhaleem: a clearly numbered list.
verses.pickthall: A written record.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
verses.tr: waylun yawmaʾidhin llilmukadhibīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe on that day to the deniers,
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
verses.tr: adh-dhīna yukadhibūna biyawmi ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: those who deny the Day of Judgement!
verses.pickthall: Those who deny the Day of Judgment

verses.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.en: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
verses.tr: wamā yukadhibu bihi ʾillā kullu muʿtadin ʾathīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: Only the evil aggressor denies it:
verses.pickthall: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,

verses.ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
verses.tr: ʾidhā tutlā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla ʾasāṭīru al-ʾawwalīna
verses.abdelhaleem: when Our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘Ancient fables!’
verses.pickthall: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.

verses.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
verses.tr: kallā ۖ bal ۜ rāna ʿalā qulūbihim mmā kānūā yaksibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! Their hearts are encrusted with what they have done.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
verses.en: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
verses.tr: kallā ʾinnahum ʿan rrabbihim yawmaʾidhin llamaḥjūbūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from their Lord,
verses.pickthall: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
verses.tr: thumma ʾinnahum laṣālūā al-jaḥīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: they will burn in Hell,
verses.pickthall: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
verses.tr: thumma yuqālu hādhā adh-dhā kuntum bihi tukadhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and they will be told, ‘This is what you called a lie.’
verses.pickthall: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.en: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.
verses.tr: kallā ʾinna kitāba al-ʾabrāri lafā ʿilliyyīna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! The list of the truly good is in 'Illiyyin––
verses.pickthall: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā ʿilliyyūna
verses.abdelhaleem: what will explain to you what 'Illiyyin is?––
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -

verses.ar: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
verses.en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
verses.tr: kitābun mmarqūmun
verses.abdelhaleem: a clearly written list,
verses.pickthall: A written record,

verses.ar: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.en: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].
verses.tr: yashhaduhu al-muqarrabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: witnessed by those brought near.
verses.pickthall: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
verses.tr: ʾinna al-ʾabrāra lafā naʿīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: The truly good will live in bliss,
verses.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,

verses.ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: On adorned couches, observing.
verses.tr: ʿalā al-ʾarāʾiki yanẓurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: seated on couches, gazing around.
verses.pickthall: On couches, gazing,

verses.ar: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
verses.tr: taʿrifu fā wujūhihim naḍraha an-naʿīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.
verses.pickthall: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.

verses.ar: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
verses.en: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
verses.tr: yusqawna min rraḥīqin mmakhtūmin
verses.abdelhaleem: They will be served a sealed nectar,
verses.pickthall: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,

verses.ar: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
verses.en: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
verses.tr: khitāmuhu miskun ۚ wafā dhālika falyatanāfasi al-mutanāfisūna
verses.abdelhaleem: its seal [perfumed with] a fragrant herb––let those who strive, strive for this––
verses.pickthall: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -

verses.ar: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
verses.en: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
verses.tr: wamizājuhu min tasnīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: mixed with the water of Tasnim,
verses.pickthall: And mixed with water of Tasnim,

verses.ar: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.en: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.
verses.tr: ʿaynan yashrabu bihā al-muqarrabūna
verses.abdelhaleem: a spring from which those brought near will drink.
verses.pickthall: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna ʾajramūā kānūā mina adh-dhīna āmanūā yaḍḥakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: The wicked used to laugh at the believers––
verses.pickthall: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
verses.en: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
verses.tr: wa-idhā marrūā bihim yataghāmazūna
verses.abdelhaleem: they would wink at one another when the believers passed by them,
verses.pickthall: And wink one to another when they passed them;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verses.en: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
verses.tr: wa-idhā ānqalabūā ʾilā ʾahlihimu ānqalabūā fakihīna
verses.abdelhaleem: joke about them when they got back to their own people,
verses.pickthall: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
verses.tr: wa-idhā raʾawhum qālūā ʾinna hāʾulāʾi laḍāllūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and say, when they saw them, ‘These people are misguided,’
verses.pickthall: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
verses.en: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
verses.tr: wamā ʾursilūā ʿalayhim ḥāfiẓīna
verses.abdelhaleem: though they were not sent to be their keepers-
verses.pickthall: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.

verses.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.en: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
verses.tr: fa-l-yawma adh-dhīna āmanūā mina al-kuffāri yaḍḥakūna
verses.abdelhaleem: so today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers
verses.pickthall: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,

verses.ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: On adorned couches, observing.
verses.tr: ʿalā al-ʾarāʾiki yanẓurūna
verses.abdelhaleem: as they sit on couches, gazing around.
verses.pickthall: On high couches, gazing.

verses.ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
verses.tr: hal thuwwiba al-kuffāru mā kānūā yafʿalūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Have the disbelievers [not] been repaid for their deeds?
verses.pickthall: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?

verses.ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
verses.en: When the sky has split [open]
verses.tr: ʾidhā as-samāʾu ānshaqqat
verses.abdelhaleem: When the sky is ripped apart,
verses.pickthall: When the heaven is split asunder

verses.ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
verses.en: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.tr: wa-adhinat lirabbihā waḥuqqat
verses.abdelhaleem: obeying its Lord as it rightly must,
verses.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear,

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
verses.en: And when the earth has been extended
verses.tr: wa-idhā al-ʾarḍu muddat
verses.abdelhaleem: when the earth is levelled out,
verses.pickthall: And when the earth is spread out

verses.ar: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
verses.en: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it].
verses.tr: wa-ʾalqat mā fīhā watakhallat
verses.abdelhaleem: casts out its contents, and becomes empty,
verses.pickthall: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty

verses.ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
verses.en: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
verses.tr: wa-adhinat lirabbihā waḥuqqat
verses.abdelhaleem: obeying its Lord as it rightly must,
verses.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear!

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
verses.en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
verses.tr: yāʾayyuhā al-ʾinsānu ʾinnaka kādiḥun ʾilā rabbika kadḥan famulāqīhi
verses.abdelhaleem: you humans, toiling laboriously towards your Lord, will meet Him:
verses.pickthall: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
verses.en: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
verses.tr: fa-ammā man ʾūtāa kitābahu biyamīnihi
verses.abdelhaleem: whoever is given his record in his right hand
verses.pickthall: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand

verses.ar: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
verses.en: He will be judged with an easy account
verses.tr: fasawfa yuḥāsabu ḥisāban yasīran
verses.abdelhaleem: will have an easy reckoning
verses.pickthall: He truly will receive an easy reckoning

verses.ar: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
verses.en: And return to his people in happiness.
verses.tr: wayanqalibu ʾilā ʾahlihi masrūran
verses.abdelhaleem: and return to his people well pleased,
verses.pickthall: And will return unto his folk in joy.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
verses.en: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
verses.tr: wa-ammā man ʾūtāa kitābahu warāʾa ẓahrihi
verses.abdelhaleem: but whoever is given his record from behind his back
verses.pickthall: But whoso is given his account behind his back,

verses.ar: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
verses.en: He will cry out for destruction
verses.tr: fasawfa yadʿūā thubūran
verses.abdelhaleem: will cry out for destruction––
verses.pickthall: He surely will invoke destruction

verses.ar: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
verses.en: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
verses.tr: wayaṣlā saʿīran
verses.abdelhaleem: he will burn in the blazing Fire.
verses.pickthall: And be thrown to scorching fire.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
verses.en: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
verses.tr: ʾinnahu kāna fā ʾahlihi masrūran
verses.abdelhaleem: He used to live among his people well pleased.
verses.pickthall: He verily lived joyous with his folk,

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
verses.en: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].
verses.tr: ʾinnahu ẓanna ʾan llan yaḥūra
verses.abdelhaleem: He thought he would never return [to his Lord]––
verses.pickthall: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).

verses.ar: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
verses.en: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.
verses.tr: balā ʾinna rabbahu kāna bihi baṣīran
verses.abdelhaleem: indeed he will! His Lord was watching him.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!

verses.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
verses.en: So I swear by the twilight glow
verses.tr: falā ʾuqsimu bi-ash-shafaqi
verses.abdelhaleem: I swear by the glow of sunset,
verses.pickthall: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
verses.en: And [by] the night and what it envelops
verses.tr: wa-l-yli wamā wasaqa
verses.abdelhaleem: by the night and what it covers,
verses.pickthall: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,

verses.ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
verses.en: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
verses.tr: wa-l-qamari ʾidhā āttasaqa
verses.abdelhaleem: by the full moon,
verses.pickthall: And by the moon when she is at the full,

verses.ar: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
verses.en: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.
verses.tr: latarkabunna ṭabaqan ʿan ṭabaqin
verses.abdelhaleem: you will progress from stage to stage.
verses.pickthall: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.

verses.ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
verses.tr: famā lahum lā yuʾminūna
verses.abdelhaleem: So why do they not believe?
verses.pickthall: What aileth them, then, that they believe not

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
verses.en: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?
verses.tr: wa-idhā quriʾa ʿalayhimu al-qurānu lā yasjudūna ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: Why, when the Quran is read to them, do they not prostrate themselves [to God]?
verses.pickthall: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: But those who have disbelieved deny,
verses.tr: bali adh-dhīna kafarūā yukadhibūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No! The disbelievers reject the Quran––
verses.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
verses.tr: wallāh ʾaʿlamu bimā yūʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: God knows best what they keep hidden inside––
verses.pickthall: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.

verses.ar: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
verses.tr: fabashirhum biʿadhābin ʾalīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: so give them news of a painful torment.
verses.pickthall: So give them tidings of a painful doom,

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
verses.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
verses.tr: ʾillā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum ʾajrun ghayru mamnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: But those who believe and do good deeds will have a never-ending reward.
verses.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
verses.en: By the sky containing great stars
verses.tr: wa-as-samāʾi dhāti al-burūji
verses.abdelhaleem: By the sky with its towering constellations,
verses.pickthall: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,

verses.ar: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
verses.en: And [by] the promised Day
verses.tr: wa-l-yawmi al-mawʿūdi
verses.abdelhaleem: by the promised Day,
verses.pickthall: And by the Promised Day.

verses.ar: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
verses.en: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
verses.tr: washāhidin wamashhūdin
verses.abdelhaleem: by the Witness and that which is witnessed,
verses.pickthall: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,

verses.ar: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
verses.en: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench
verses.tr: qutila ʾaṣḥābu al-ʾukhdūdi
verses.abdelhaleem: damned were the makers of the trench,
verses.pickthall: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

verses.ar: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
verses.en: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
verses.tr: an-nāri dhāti al-waqūdi
verses.abdelhaleem: the makers of the fuel-stoked fire!
verses.pickthall: Of the fuel-fed fire,

verses.ar: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
verses.en: When they were sitting near it.
verses.tr: ʾidh hum ʿalayhā quʿūdun
verses.abdelhaleem: They sat down
verses.pickthall: When they sat by it,

verses.ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
verses.en: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
verses.tr: wahum ʿalā mā yafʿalūna bi-l-muʾminīna shuhūdun
verses.abdelhaleem: to watch what they were doing to the believers.
verses.pickthall: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.

verses.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verses.en: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
verses.tr: wamā naqamūā minhum ʾillā ʾan yuʾminūā billāh al-ʿazīzi al-ḥamīdi
verses.abdelhaleem: Their only grievance against them was their faith in God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy,
verses.pickthall: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.en: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.
verses.tr: adh-dhā lahu mulku as-samāwāti wa-l-ʾarḍi ۚ wallāh ʿalā kulli shāʾin shahīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: to whom all control over the heavens and earth belongs: God is witness over all things.
verses.pickthall: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.en: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna fatanūā al-muʾminīna wa-l-muʾmināti thumma lam yatūbūā falahum ʿadhābu jahannama walahum ʿadhābu al-ḥarīqi
verses.abdelhaleem: For those who persecute believing men and women, and do not repent afterwards, there will be the torment of Hell and burning.
verses.pickthall: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātun tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru ۚ dhālika al-fawzu al-kabīru
verses.abdelhaleem: But for those who believe and do good deeds there will be Gardens graced with flowing streams: that is the great triumph.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.

verses.ar: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
verses.en: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.
verses.tr: ʾinna baṭsha rabbika lashadīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is truly stern––
verses.pickthall: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
verses.en: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu huwa yubdiʾu wayuʿīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: it is He who brings people to life, and will restore them to life again––
verses.pickthall: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
verses.en: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
verses.tr: wahuwa al-ghafūru al-wadūdu
verses.abdelhaleem: and He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Loving.
verses.pickthall: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,

verses.ar: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
verses.en: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
verses.tr: dhū al-ʿarshi al-majīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: The Glorious Lord of the Throne,
verses.pickthall: Lord of the Throne of Glory,

verses.ar: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
verses.en: Effecter of what He intends.
verses.tr: faʿʿālun llimā yurīdu
verses.abdelhaleem: He does whatever He will.
verses.pickthall: Doer of what He will.

verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
verses.en: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
verses.tr: hal ʾatāka ḥadīthu al-junūdi
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you [not] heard the stories of the forces
verses.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts

verses.ar: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
verses.en: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?
verses.tr: firʿawna wathamūda
verses.abdelhaleem: of Pharaoh and Thamud?
verses.pickthall: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
verses.en: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
verses.tr: bali adh-dhīna kafarūā fā takdhībin
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet still the disbelievers persist in denial.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
verses.en: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.
verses.tr: wallāh min warāʾihim mmuḥīṭun
verses.abdelhaleem: God surrounds them all.
verses.pickthall: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.

verses.ar: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.en: But this is an honored Qur’ān
verses.tr: bal huwa qurānun mmajīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: This is truly a glorious Quran
verses.pickthall: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.

verses.ar: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
verses.en: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
verses.tr: fā lawḥin mmaḥfūẓin
verses.abdelhaleem: [written] on a preserved Tablet.
verses.pickthall: On a guarded tablet.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
verses.en: By the sky and the night comer
verses.tr: wa-as-samāʾi wa-aṭ-ṭāriqi
verses.abdelhaleem: By the sky and the night-comer––
verses.pickthall: By the heaven and the Morning Star

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā aṭ-ṭāriqu
verses.abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the night-comer is?
verses.pickthall: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!

verses.ar: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
verses.en: It is the piercing star
verses.tr: an-najmu ath-thāqibu
verses.abdelhaleem: The piercing star––
verses.pickthall: - The piercing Star!

verses.ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
verses.en: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
verses.tr: ʾin kullu nafsin llammā ʿalayhā ḥāfiẓun
verses.abdelhaleem: there is a watcher over every soul.
verses.pickthall: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.

verses.ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
verses.en: So let man observe from what he was created.
verses.tr: falyanẓuri al-ʾinsānu mimma khuliqa
verses.abdelhaleem: Man should reflect on what he was created from.
verses.pickthall: So let man consider from what he is created.

verses.ar: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
verses.en: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
verses.tr: khuliqa min mmāʾin dāfiqin
verses.abdelhaleem: He is created from spurting fluid,
verses.pickthall: He is created from a gushing fluid

verses.ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
verses.en: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
verses.tr: yakhruju min bayni aṣ-ṣulbi wa-at-tarāʾibi
verses.abdelhaleem: then he emerges from between the backbone and breastbone:
verses.pickthall: That issued from between the loins and ribs.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
verses.en: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.
verses.tr: ʾinnahu ʿalā rajʿihi laqādirun
verses.abdelhaleem: God is certainly able to bring him back to life.
verses.pickthall: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
verses.en: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
verses.tr: yawma tublā as-sarāʾiru
verses.abdelhaleem: On the Day when secrets are laid bare
verses.pickthall: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.

verses.ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
verses.en: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.
verses.tr: famā lahu min quwwahin walā nāṣirin
verses.abdelhaleem: he will have no power and no one to help him.
verses.pickthall: Then will he have no might nor any helper.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
verses.en: By the sky which sends back
verses.tr: wa-as-samāʾi dhāti ar-rajʿi
verses.abdelhaleem: By the sky and its recurring rain,
verses.pickthall: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
verses.en: And [by] the earth which splits,
verses.tr: wa-l-ʾarḍi dhāti aṣ-ṣadʿi
verses.abdelhaleem: by the earth that cracks open!
verses.pickthall: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
verses.en: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,
verses.tr: ʾinnahu laqawlun faṣlun
verses.abdelhaleem: This is truly a decisive statement;
verses.pickthall: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,

verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
verses.en: And it is not amusement.
verses.tr: wamā huwa bi-l-hazli
verses.abdelhaleem: it is not something to be taken lightly.
verses.pickthall: It is no pleasantry.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
verses.en: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
verses.tr: ʾinnahum yakīdūna kaydan
verses.abdelhaleem: They plot and scheme,
verses.pickthall: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)

verses.ar: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
verses.en: But I am planning a plan.
verses.tr: wa-akīdu kaydan
verses.abdelhaleem: but so do I:
verses.pickthall: And I plot a plot (against them).

verses.ar: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
verses.en: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
verses.tr: famahhili al-kāfirīna ʾamhilhum ruwaydanā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], let the disbelievers be, let them be for a while.
verses.pickthall: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.

verses.ar: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
verses.en: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
verses.tr: sabbiḥi āsma rabbika al-ʾaʿlā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Most High,
verses.pickthall: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
verses.en: Who created and proportioned
verses.tr: adh-dhā khalaqa fasawwā
verses.abdelhaleem: who created [all things] in due proportion;
verses.pickthall: Who createth, then disposeth;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
verses.en: And who destined and [then] guided
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhā qaddara fahadā
verses.abdelhaleem: who determined their destinies and guided them;
verses.pickthall: Who measureth, then guideth;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
verses.en: And who brings out the pasture
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhā ʾakhraja al-marʿā
verses.abdelhaleem: who brought out the green pasture
verses.pickthall: Who bringeth forth the pasturage,

verses.ar: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
verses.en: And [then] makes it black stubble.
verses.tr: fajaʿalahu ghuthāʾan ʾaḥwā
verses.abdelhaleem: then made it dark debris.
verses.pickthall: Then turneth it to russet stubble.

verses.ar: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
verses.en: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,
verses.tr: sanuqriʾuka falā tansā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], We shall teach you [the Quran] and you will not forget––
verses.pickthall: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
verses.en: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
verses.tr: ʾillā mā shāʾa Allāh ۚ ʾinnahu yaʿlamu al-jahra wamā yakhfā
verses.abdelhaleem: unless God wishes; He knows both what is open and what is hidden––
verses.pickthall: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;

verses.ar: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
verses.en: And We will ease you toward ease.
verses.tr: wanuyassiruka lilyusrā
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall show you the easy way.
verses.pickthall: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.

verses.ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
verses.en: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
verses.tr: fadhakkir ʾin nnafaʿati adh-dhikrā
verses.abdelhaleem: So remind, if reminding will help.
verses.pickthall: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.

verses.ar: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
verses.en: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.
verses.tr: sayadhakkaru man yakhshā
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who stand in awe of God will heed the reminder,
verses.pickthall: He will heed who feareth,

verses.ar: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
verses.en: But the wretched one will avoid it
verses.tr: wayatajannabuhā al-ʾashqā
verses.abdelhaleem: but it will be ignored by the most wicked,
verses.pickthall: But the most hapless will flout it,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verses.en: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
verses.tr: adh-dhā yaṣlā an-nāra al-kubrā
verses.abdelhaleem: who will enter the Great Fire,
verses.pickthall: He who will be flung to the great Fire

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.en: Neither dying therein nor living.
verses.tr: thumma lā yamūtu fīhā walā yaḥyā
verses.abdelhaleem: where they will neither die nor live.
verses.pickthall: Wherein he will neither die nor live.

verses.ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.en: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
verses.tr: qad ʾaflaḥa man tazakkā
verses.abdelhaleem: Prosperous are those who purify themselves,
verses.pickthall: He is successful who groweth,

verses.ar: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
verses.en: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
verses.tr: wadhakara āsma rabbihi faṣallā
verses.abdelhaleem: remember the name of their Lord, and pray.
verses.pickthall: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,

verses.ar: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.en: But you prefer the worldly life,
verses.tr: bal tuʾthirūna al-ḥayawāha ad-dunyā
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet you [people] prefer the life of this world,
verses.pickthall: But ye prefer the life of the world

verses.ar: وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.en: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
verses.tr: wa-l-ākhirahu khayrun wa-abqā
verses.abdelhaleem: even though the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
verses.pickthall: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
verses.tr: ʾinna hādhā lafā aṣ-ṣuḥufi al-ʾūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: All this is in the earlier scriptures,
verses.pickthall: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.

verses.ar: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.en: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
verses.tr: ṣuḥufi ʾibrāhīma wamūsā
verses.abdelhaleem: the scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
verses.pickthall: The Books of Abraham and Moses.

verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَـٰشِيَةِ
verses.en: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
verses.tr: hal ʾatāka ḥadīthu al-ghāshiyahi
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you heard tell [Prophet] about the Overwhelming Event?
verses.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?

verses.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَـٰشِعَةٌ
verses.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
verses.tr: wujūhun yawmaʾidhin khāshiʿahun
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day, there will be downcast faces,
verses.pickthall: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,

verses.ar: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ
verses.en: Working [hard] and exhausted.
verses.tr: ʿāmilahun nnāṣibahun
verses.abdelhaleem: toiling and weary,
verses.pickthall: Toiling, weary,

verses.ar: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً
verses.en: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
verses.tr: taṣlā nāran ḥāmiyahan
verses.abdelhaleem: as they enter the blazing Fire
verses.pickthall: Scorched by burning fire,

verses.ar: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍ
verses.en: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
verses.tr: tusqā min ʿaynin āniyahin
verses.abdelhaleem: and are forced to drink from a boiling spring,
verses.pickthall: Drinking from a boiling spring,

verses.ar: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
verses.en: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
verses.tr: llaysa lahum ṭaʿāmun ʾillā min ḍarīʿin
verses.abdelhaleem: with no food for them except bitter dry thorns
verses.pickthall: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit

verses.ar: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ
verses.en: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
verses.tr: llā yusminu walā yughnā min jūʿin
verses.abdelhaleem: that neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
verses.pickthall: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.

verses.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ
verses.en: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
verses.tr: wujūhun yawmaʾidhin nnāʿimahun
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day there will also be faces radiant with bliss,
verses.pickthall: In that day other faces will be calm,

verses.ar: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ
verses.en: With their effort [they are] satisfied
verses.tr: llisaʿyihā rāḍiyahun
verses.abdelhaleem: well pleased with their labour,
verses.pickthall: Glad for their effort past,

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
verses.en: In an elevated garden,
verses.tr: fā jannahin ʿāliyahin
verses.abdelhaleem: in a lofty garden,
verses.pickthall: In a high Garden

verses.ar: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
verses.en: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
verses.tr: llā tasmaʿu fīhā lāghiyahan
verses.abdelhaleem: where they will hear no idle talk,
verses.pickthall: Where they hear no idle speech,

verses.ar: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
verses.en: Within it is a flowing spring.
verses.tr: fīhā ʿaynun jāriyahun
verses.abdelhaleem: with a flowing spring,
verses.pickthall: Wherein is a gushing spring,

verses.ar: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
verses.en: Within it are couches raised high
verses.tr: fīhā sururun mmarfūʿahun
verses.abdelhaleem: raised couches,
verses.pickthall: Wherein are couches raised

verses.ar: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
verses.en: And cups put in place
verses.tr: wa-akwābun mmawḍūʿahun
verses.abdelhaleem: goblets placed before them,
verses.pickthall: And goblets set at hand

verses.ar: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
verses.en: And cushions lined up
verses.tr: wanamāriqu maṣfūfahun
verses.abdelhaleem: cushions set in rows,
verses.pickthall: And cushions ranged

verses.ar: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
verses.en: And carpets spread around.
verses.tr: wazarābāu mabthūthahun
verses.abdelhaleem: and carpets spread.
verses.pickthall: And silken carpets spread.

verses.ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
verses.en: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
verses.tr: ʾafalā yanẓurūna ʾilā al-ʾibili kayfa khuliqat
verses.abdelhaleem: Do the disbelievers not see how rain clouds are formed
verses.pickthall: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?

verses.ar: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
verses.en: And at the sky - how it is raised?
verses.tr: wa-ʾilā as-samāʾi kayfa rufiʿat
verses.abdelhaleem: how the heavens are lifted,
verses.pickthall: And the heaven, how it is raised?

verses.ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
verses.en: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
verses.tr: wa-ʾilā al-jibāli kayfa nuṣibat
verses.abdelhaleem: how the mountains are raised high,
verses.pickthall: And the hills, how they are set up?

verses.ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
verses.en: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
verses.tr: wa-ʾilā al-ʾarḍi kayfa suṭiḥat
verses.abdelhaleem: how the earth is spread out?
verses.pickthall: And the earth, how it is spread?

verses.ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
verses.en: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.
verses.tr: fadhakkir ʾinnamā ʾanta mudhakkirun
verses.abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] warn them: your only task is to give warning,
verses.pickthall: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,

verses.ar: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
verses.en: You are not over them a controller.
verses.tr: llasta ʿalayhim bimuṣayṭirin
verses.abdelhaleem: you are not there to control them.
verses.pickthall: Thou art not at all a warder over them.

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
verses.en: However, he who turns away and disbelieves
verses.tr: ʾillā man tawallā wakafara
verses.abdelhaleem: As for those who turn away and disbelieve,
verses.pickthall: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,

verses.ar: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
verses.en: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.
verses.tr: fayuʿadhibuhu Allāh al-ʿadhāba al-ʾakbara
verses.abdelhaleem: God will inflict the greatest torment upon them.
verses.pickthall: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.

verses.ar: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
verses.en: Indeed, to Us is their return.
verses.tr: ʾinna ʾilaynā ʾiyābahum
verses.abdelhaleem: It is to Us they will return,
verses.pickthall: Lo! unto Us is their return

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
verses.en: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
verses.tr: thumma ʾinna ʿalaynā ḥisābahum
verses.abdelhaleem: and then it is for Us to call them to account.
verses.pickthall: And Ours their reckoning.

verses.ar: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
verses.en: By the dawn
verses.tr: wa-l-fajri
verses.abdelhaleem: By the Daybreak,
verses.pickthall: By the Dawn

verses.ar: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ
verses.en: And [by] ten nights
verses.tr: walayālin ʿashrin
verses.abdelhaleem: by the Ten Nights,
verses.pickthall: And ten nights,

verses.ar: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
verses.en: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
verses.tr: wa-ash-shafʿi wa-l-watri
verses.abdelhaleem: by the even and the odd,
verses.pickthall: And the Even and the Odd,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
verses.en: And [by] the night when it passes,
verses.tr: wa-l-yli ʾidhā yasri
verses.abdelhaleem: by the passing night––
verses.pickthall: And the night when it departeth,

verses.ar: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
verses.en: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
verses.tr: hal fā dhālika qasamun llidhā ḥijrin
verses.abdelhaleem: is this oath strong enough for a rational person?
verses.pickthall: There surely is an oath for thinking man.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
verses.en: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ʿAad -
verses.tr: ʾalam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka biʿādin
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you [Prophet] considered how your Lord dealt with [the people] of 'Ad,
verses.pickthall: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,

verses.ar: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
verses.en: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
verses.tr: ʾirama dhāti al-ʿimādi
verses.abdelhaleem: of Iram, [the city] of lofty pillars,
verses.pickthall: With many-columned Iram,

verses.ar: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
verses.en: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
verses.tr: at-tā lam yukhlaq mithluhā fā al-bilādi
verses.abdelhaleem: whose like has never been made in any land,
verses.pickthall: The like of which was not created in the lands;

verses.ar: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
verses.en: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
verses.tr: wathamūda adh-dhīna jābūā aṣ-ṣakhra bi-l-wādi
verses.abdelhaleem: and the Thamud, who hewed into the rocks in the valley,
verses.pickthall: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;

verses.ar: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.en: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?
verses.tr: wafirʿawna dhā al-ʾawtādi
verses.abdelhaleem: and the mighty and powerful Pharaoh?
verses.pickthall: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
verses.en: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
verses.tr: adh-dhīna ṭaghawā fā al-bilādi
verses.abdelhaleem: All of them committed excesses in their lands,
verses.pickthall: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,

verses.ar: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
verses.en: And increased therein the corruption.
verses.tr: fa-aktharūā fīhā al-fasāda
verses.abdelhaleem: and spread corruption there:
verses.pickthall: And multiplied iniquity therein?

verses.ar: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
verses.en: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
verses.tr: faṣabba ʿalayhim rabbuka sawṭa ʿadhābin
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord let a scourge of punishment loose on them.
verses.pickthall: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
verses.tr: ʾinna rabbaka labālmirṣādi
verses.abdelhaleem: Your Lord is always watchful.
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
verses.en: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
verses.tr: fa-ammā al-ʾinsānu ʾidhā mā ābtalāhu rabbuhu fa-akramahu wanaʿʿamahu fayaqūlu rabbā ʾakramani
verses.abdelhaleem: [The nature of] man is that, when his Lord tries him through honour and blessings, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me,’
verses.pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
verses.en: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
verses.tr: wa-ammā ʾidhā mā ābtalāhu faqadara ʿalayhi rizqahu fayaqūlu rabbā ʾahānani
verses.abdelhaleem: but when He tries him through the restriction of his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’
verses.pickthall: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.

verses.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
verses.en: No! But you do not honor the orphan
verses.tr: kallā ۖ bal llā tukrimūna al-yatīma
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! You [people] do not honour orphans,
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan

verses.ar: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
verses.en: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
verses.tr: walā taḥāḍḍūna ʿalā ṭaʿāmi al-miskīni
verses.abdelhaleem: you do not urge one another to feed the poor,
verses.pickthall: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.

verses.ar: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
verses.en: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
verses.tr: wataʾkulūna at-turātha ʾaklan llamman
verses.abdelhaleem: you consume inheritance greedily,
verses.pickthall: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.

verses.ar: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
verses.en: And you love wealth with immense love.
verses.tr: watuḥibbūna al-māla ḥubban jamman
verses.abdelhaleem: and you love wealth with a passion.
verses.pickthall: And love wealth with abounding love.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
verses.en: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed
verses.tr: kallā ʾidhā dukkati al-ʾarḍu dakkan dakkan
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! When the earth is pounded to dust, pounded and pounded,
verses.pickthall: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
verses.en: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
verses.tr: wajāʾa rabbuka wa-l-malaku ṣaffan ṣaffan
verses.abdelhaleem: when your Lord comes with the angels, rank upon rank,
verses.pickthall: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,

verses.ar: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
verses.en: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but how [i.e., what good] to him will be the remembrance?
verses.tr: wajāʾa yawmaʾidhin bijahannama ۚ yawmaʾidhin yatadhakkaru al-ʾinsānu wa-annā lahu adh-dhikrā
verses.abdelhaleem: when Hell is that Day brought near- on that Day man will take heed, but what good will that be to him then?
verses.pickthall: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?

verses.ar: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
verses.en: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
verses.tr: yaqūlu yālaytanā qaddamtu liḥayātā
verses.abdelhaleem: He will say, ‘Would that I had provided for this life to come!’
verses.pickthall: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!

verses.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verses.en: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
verses.tr: fayawmaʾidhin llā yuʿadhibu ʿadhābahu ʾaḥadun
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day, no one will punish as He punishes,
verses.pickthall: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!

verses.ar: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verses.en: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
verses.tr: walā yūthiqu wathāqahu ʾaḥadun
verses.abdelhaleem: and no one will bind as He binds.
verses.pickthall: None bindeth as He then will bind.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
verses.en: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
verses.tr: yāʾayyatuhā an-nafsu al-muṭmaʾinnahu
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘[But] you, soul at peace:
verses.pickthall: But ah! thou soul at peace!

verses.ar: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
verses.en: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
verses.tr: ārjiʿā ʾilā rabbiki rāḍiyahan mmarḍiyyahan
verses.abdelhaleem: return to your Lord well pleased and well pleasing;
verses.pickthall: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!

verses.ar: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
verses.en: And enter among My [righteous] servants
verses.tr: fādkhulā fā ʿibādā
verses.abdelhaleem: go in among My servants;
verses.pickthall: Enter thou among My bondmen!

verses.ar: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
verses.en: And enter My Paradise."
verses.tr: wādkhulā jannatā
verses.abdelhaleem: and into My Garden.’
verses.pickthall: Enter thou My Garden!

verses.ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
verses.en: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah]
verses.tr: lā ʾuqsimu bihādhā al-baladi
verses.abdelhaleem: I swear by this city––
verses.pickthall: Nay, I swear by this city -

verses.ar: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
verses.en: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city
verses.tr: wa-anta ḥillun bihādhā al-baladi
verses.abdelhaleem: and you [Prophet] are an inhabitant of this city––
verses.pickthall: And thou art an indweller of this city -

verses.ar: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
verses.en: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
verses.tr: wawālidin wamā walada
verses.abdelhaleem: [I swear] by parent and offspring,
verses.pickthall: And the begetter and that which he begat,

verses.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
verses.en: We have certainly created man into hardship.
verses.tr: laqad khalaqnā al-ʾinsāna fā kabadin
verses.abdelhaleem: that We have created man for toil and trial.
verses.pickthall: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
verses.en: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
verses.tr: ʾayaḥsabu ʾan llan yaqdira ʿalayhi ʾaḥadun
verses.abdelhaleem: Does he think that no one will have power over him?
verses.pickthall: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?

verses.ar: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا
verses.en: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
verses.tr: yaqūlu ʾahlaktu mālan llubadan
verses.abdelhaleem: ‘I have squandered great wealth,’ he says.
verses.pickthall: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verses.en: Does he think that no one has seen him?
verses.tr: ʾayaḥsabu ʾan llam yarahu ʾaḥadun
verses.abdelhaleem: Does he think no one observes him?
verses.pickthall: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
verses.en: Have We not made for him two eyes?
verses.tr: ʾalam najʿal llahu ʿaynayni
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We not give him eyes,
verses.pickthall: Did We not assign unto him two eyes

verses.ar: وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
verses.en: And a tongue and two lips?
verses.tr: walisānan washafatayni
verses.abdelhaleem: a tongue, lips,
verses.pickthall: And a tongue and two lips,

verses.ar: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
verses.en: And have shown him the two ways?
verses.tr: wahadaynāhu an-najdayni
verses.abdelhaleem: and point out to him the two clear ways [of good and evil]?
verses.pickthall: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?

verses.ar: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
verses.en: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
verses.tr: falā āqtaḥama al-ʿaqabaha
verses.abdelhaleem: Yet he has not attempted the steep path.
verses.pickthall: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā al-ʿaqabahu
verses.abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the steep path is?
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -

verses.ar: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
verses.en: It is the freeing of a slave
verses.tr: fakku raqabahin
verses.abdelhaleem: It is to free a slave,
verses.pickthall: (It is) to free a slave,

verses.ar: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ
verses.en: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
verses.tr: ʾaw ʾiṭʿāmun fā yawmin dhā masghabahin
verses.abdelhaleem: to feed at a time of hunger
verses.pickthall: And to feed in the day of hunger.

verses.ar: يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
verses.en: An orphan of near relationship
verses.tr: yatīman dhā maqrabahin
verses.abdelhaleem: an orphaned relative
verses.pickthall: An orphan near of kin,

verses.ar: أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ
verses.en: Or a needy person in misery
verses.tr: ʾaw miskīnan dhā matrabahin
verses.abdelhaleem: or a poor person in distress,
verses.pickthall: Or some poor wretch in misery,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
verses.en: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
verses.tr: thumma kāna mina adh-dhīna āmanūā watawāṣawā bi-aṣ-ṣabri watawāṣawā bi-l-marḥamahi
verses.abdelhaleem: and to be one of those who believe and urge one another to steadfastness and compassion.
verses.pickthall: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
verses.en: Those are the companions of the right.
verses.tr: ʾūlāʾika ʾaṣḥābu al-maymanahi
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who do this will be on the right-hand side,
verses.pickthall: Their place will be on the right hand.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
verses.en: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
verses.tr: wa-adh-dhīna kafarūā bāyātinā hum ʾaṣḥābu al-mashmahi
verses.abdelhaleem: but those who disbelieve in Our revelations will be on the left-hand side,
verses.pickthall: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.

verses.ar: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
verses.en: Over them will be fire closed in.
verses.tr: ʿalayhim nārun mmuʾṣadahun
verses.abdelhaleem: and the Fire will close in on them.
verses.pickthall: Fire will be an awning over them.

verses.ar: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
verses.en: By the sun and its brightness
verses.tr: wa-ash-shamsi waḍuḥāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: By the sun in its morning brightness
verses.pickthall: By the sun and his brightness,

verses.ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the moon when it follows it
verses.tr: wa-l-qamari ʾidhā talāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: and by the moon as it follows it,
verses.pickthall: And the moon when she followeth him,

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the day when it displays it
verses.tr: wa-an-nahāri ʾidhā jallāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: by the day as it displays the sun’s glory
verses.pickthall: And the day when it revealeth him,

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it
verses.tr: wa-l-yli ʾidhā yaghshāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: and by the night as it conceals it,
verses.pickthall: And the night when it enshroudeth him,

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
verses.tr: wa-as-samāʾi wamā banāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: by the sky and how He built it
verses.pickthall: And the heaven and Him Who built it,

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
verses.tr: wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā ṭaḥāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: and by the earth and how He spread it,
verses.pickthall: And the earth and Him Who spread it,

verses.ar: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
verses.tr: wanafsin wamā sawwāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: by the soul and how He formed it
verses.pickthall: And a soul and Him Who perfected it

verses.ar: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
verses.en: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
verses.tr: fa-ā fujūrahā wataqwāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: and inspired it [to know] its own rebellion and piety!
verses.pickthall: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.

verses.ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
verses.en: He has succeeded who purifies it,
verses.tr: qad ʾaflaḥa man zakkāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: The one who purifies his soul succeeds
verses.pickthall: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,

verses.ar: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
verses.en: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
verses.tr: waqad khāba man dassāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: and the one who corrupts it fails.
verses.pickthall: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
verses.en: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
verses.tr: kadhabat thamūdu biṭaghwāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: In their arrogant cruelty, the people of Thamud called [their messenger] a liar,
verses.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,

verses.ar: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
verses.en: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
verses.tr: ʾidhi ānbaʿatha ʾashqāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: when the most wicked man among them rose [against him].
verses.pickthall: When the basest of them broke forth

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
verses.en: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."
verses.tr: faqāla lahum rasūlu Allāh nāqaha Allāh wasuqyāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: The messenger of God said to them, ‘[Leave] God’s camel to drink,’
verses.pickthall: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verses.en: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
verses.tr: fakadhabūhu faʿaqarūhā fadamdama ʿalayhim rabbuhum bidhanbihim fasawwāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: but they called him a liar and hamstrung her. Their Lord destroyed them for their crime and levelled them.
verses.pickthall: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).

verses.ar: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
verses.en: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
verses.tr: walā yakhāfu ʿuqbāhā
verses.abdelhaleem: He did not hesitate to punish them.
verses.pickthall: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
verses.en: By the night when it covers
verses.tr: wa-l-yli ʾidhā yaghshā
verses.abdelhaleem: By the enshrouding night,
verses.pickthall: By the night enshrouding

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
verses.en: And [by] the day when it appears
verses.tr: wa-an-nahāri ʾidhā tajallā
verses.abdelhaleem: by the radiant day,
verses.pickthall: And the day resplendent

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
verses.en: And [by] He who created the male and female,
verses.tr: wamā khalaqa adh-dhakara wa-l-ʾunthā
verses.abdelhaleem: by His creation of male and female!
verses.pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female,

verses.ar: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
verses.en: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
verses.tr: ʾinna saʿyakum lashattā
verses.abdelhaleem: The ways you take differ greatly.
verses.pickthall: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
verses.en: As for he who gives and fears Allāh
verses.tr: fa-ammā man ʾaʿṭā wāttaqā
verses.abdelhaleem: There is the one who gives, who is mindful of God,
verses.pickthall: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)

verses.ar: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verses.en: And believes in the best [reward],
verses.tr: waṣaddaqa bi-l-ḥusnā
verses.abdelhaleem: who testifies to goodness––
verses.pickthall: And believeth in goodness;

verses.ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
verses.en: We will ease him toward ease.
verses.tr: fasanuyassiruhu lilyusrā
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall smooth his way towards ease.
verses.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
verses.en: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
verses.tr: wa-ammā man bakhila wāstaghnā
verses.abdelhaleem: There is the one who is miserly, who is self-satisfied,
verses.pickthall: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,

verses.ar: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verses.en: And denies the best [reward],
verses.tr: wakadhaba bi-l-ḥusnā
verses.abdelhaleem: who denies goodness––
verses.pickthall: And disbelieveth in goodness;

verses.ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
verses.en: We will ease him toward difficulty.
verses.tr: fasanuyassiruhu lilʿusrā
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall smooth his way towards hardship
verses.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.

verses.ar: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
verses.en: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
verses.tr: wamā yughnā ʿanhu māluhu ʾidhā taraddā
verses.abdelhaleem: and his wealth will not help him as he falls.
verses.pickthall: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.

verses.ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
verses.en: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
verses.tr: ʾinna ʿalaynā lalhudā
verses.abdelhaleem: Our part is to provide guidance––
verses.pickthall: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
verses.tr: wa-inna lanā lalākhiraha wa-l-ʾūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: this world and the next belong to Us––
verses.pickthall: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.

verses.ar: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
verses.en: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
verses.tr: fa-andhartukum nāran talaẓẓā
verses.abdelhaleem: so I warn you about the raging Fire,
verses.pickthall: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire

verses.ar: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
verses.en: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
verses.tr: lā yaṣlāhā ʾillā al-ʾashqā
verses.abdelhaleem: in which none but the most wicked one will burn,
verses.pickthall: Which only the most wretched must endure,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.en: Who had denied and turned away.
verses.tr: adh-dhā kadhaba watawallā
verses.abdelhaleem: who denied [the truth], and turned away.
verses.pickthall: He who denieth and turneth away.

verses.ar: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
verses.en: But the righteous one will avoid it
verses.tr: wasayujannabuhā al-ʾatqā
verses.abdelhaleem: The most pious one will be spared this––
verses.pickthall: Far removed from it will be the righteous

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
verses.en: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
verses.tr: adh-dhā yuʾtā mālahu yatazakkā
verses.abdelhaleem: who gives his wealth away as self-purification,
verses.pickthall: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).

verses.ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
verses.en: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
verses.tr: wamā liʾaḥadin ʿindahu min nniʿmahin tujzā
verses.abdelhaleem: not to return a favour to anyone
verses.pickthall: And none hath with him any favour for reward,

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.en: But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.
verses.tr: ʾillā ābtighāʾa wajhi rabbihi al-ʾaʿlā
verses.abdelhaleem: but for the sake of his Lord the Most High––
verses.pickthall: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.

verses.ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
verses.en: And he is going to be satisfied.
verses.tr: walasawfa yarḍā
verses.abdelhaleem: and he will be well pleased.
verses.pickthall: He verily will be content.

verses.ar: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
verses.en: By the morning brightness
verses.tr: wa-aḍ-ḍuḥā
verses.abdelhaleem: By the morning brightness
verses.pickthall: By the morning hours

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
verses.en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
verses.tr: wa-l-yli ʾidhā sajā
verses.abdelhaleem: and by the night when it grows still,
verses.pickthall: And by the night when it is stillest,

verses.ar: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
verses.en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].
verses.tr: mā waddaʿaka rabbuka wamā qalā
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord has not forsaken you [Prophet], nor does He hate you,
verses.pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,

verses.ar: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
verses.tr: walalākhirahu khayrun llaka mina al-ʾūlā
verses.abdelhaleem: and the future will be better for you than the past;
verses.pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,

verses.ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
verses.en: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
verses.tr: walasawfa yuʿṭīka rabbuka fatarḍā
verses.abdelhaleem: your Lord is sure to give you so much that you will be well satisfied.
verses.pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
verses.en: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
verses.tr: ʾalam yajidka yatīman fāwā
verses.abdelhaleem: Did He not find you an orphan and shelter you?
verses.pickthall: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?

verses.ar: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
verses.en: And He found you lost and guided [you],
verses.tr: wawajadaka ḍāllan fahadā
verses.abdelhaleem: Did He not find you lost and guide you?
verses.pickthall: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?

verses.ar: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
verses.en: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
verses.tr: wawajadaka ʿāʾilan fa-aghnā
verses.abdelhaleem: Did He not find you in need and make you self-sufficient?
verses.pickthall: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
verses.en: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
verses.tr: fa-ammā al-yatīma falā taqhar
verses.abdelhaleem: So do not be harsh with the orphan
verses.pickthall: Therefor the orphan oppress not,

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
verses.en: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
verses.tr: wa-ammā as-sāʾila falā tanhar
verses.abdelhaleem: and do not chide the one who asks for help;
verses.pickthall: Therefor the beggar drive not away,

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
verses.en: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
verses.tr: wa-ammā biniʿmahi rabbika faḥaddith
verses.abdelhaleem: talk about the blessings of your Lord.
verses.pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
verses.en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?
verses.tr: ʾalam nashraḥ laka ṣadraka
verses.abdelhaleem: Did We not relieve your heart for you [Prophet],
verses.pickthall: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,

verses.ar: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
verses.en: And We removed from you your burden
verses.tr: wawaḍaʿnā ʿanka wizraka
verses.abdelhaleem: and remove the burden
verses.pickthall: And eased thee of the burden

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
verses.en: Which had weighed upon your back
verses.tr: adh-dhā ʾanqaḍa ẓahraka
verses.abdelhaleem: that weighed so heavily on your back,
verses.pickthall: Which weighed down thy back;

verses.ar: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
verses.en: And raised high for you your repute.
verses.tr: warafaʿnā laka dhikraka
verses.abdelhaleem: and raise your reputation high?
verses.pickthall: And exalted thy fame?

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
verses.en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].
verses.tr: fa-inna maʿa al-ʿusri yusran
verses.abdelhaleem: So truly where there is hardship there is also ease;
verses.pickthall: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,

verses.ar: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
verses.en: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
verses.tr: ʾinna maʿa al-ʿusri yusran
verses.abdelhaleem: truly where there is hardship there is also ease.
verses.pickthall: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;

verses.ar: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
verses.en: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
verses.tr: fa-idhā faraghta fānṣab
verses.abdelhaleem: The moment you are freed [of one task] work on,
verses.pickthall: So when thou art relieved, still toil

verses.ar: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
