verses.en: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
verses.tr: wa-ʾilā rabbika fārghab
verses.abdelhaleem: and turn to your Lord for everything.
verses.pickthall: And strive to please thy Lord.

verses.ar: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
verses.en: By the fig and the olive
verses.tr: wa-at-tīni wa-az-zaytūni
verses.abdelhaleem: By the fig, by the olive,
verses.pickthall: By the fig and the olive,

verses.ar: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
verses.en: And [by] Mount Sinai
verses.tr: waṭūri sīnīna
verses.abdelhaleem: by Mount Sinai,
verses.pickthall: By Mount Sinai,

verses.ar: وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
verses.en: And [by] this secure city [i.e., Makkah],
verses.tr: wahādhā al-baladi al-ʾamīni
verses.abdelhaleem: by this safe town,
verses.pickthall: And by this land made safe;

verses.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
verses.en: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
verses.tr: laqad khalaqnā al-ʾinsāna fā ʾaḥsani taqwīmin
verses.abdelhaleem: We create man in the finest state
verses.pickthall: Surely We created man of the best stature

verses.ar: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.en: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
verses.tr: thumma radadnāhu ʾasfala sāfilīna
verses.abdelhaleem: then reduce him to the lowest of the low,
verses.pickthall: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
verses.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
verses.tr: ʾillā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti falahum ʾajrun ghayru mamnūnin
verses.abdelhaleem: except those who believe and do good deeds–– they will have an unfailing reward.
verses.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.

verses.ar: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
verses.tr: famā yukadhibuka baʿdu bi-ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: After this, what makes you [man] deny the Judgement?
verses.pickthall: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?

verses.ar: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verses.en: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?
verses.tr: ʾalaysa Allāh biʾaḥkami al-ḥākimīna
verses.abdelhaleem: Is God not the most decisive of judges?
verses.pickthall: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?

verses.ar: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
verses.en: Recite in the name of your Lord who created
verses.tr: āqraʾ bāsmi rabbika adh-dhā khalaqa
verses.abdelhaleem: Read! In the name of your Lord who created:
verses.pickthall: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
verses.en: Created man from a clinging substance.
verses.tr: khalaqa al-ʾinsāna min ʿalaqin
verses.abdelhaleem: He created manfrom a clinging form.
verses.pickthall: Createth man from a clot.

verses.ar: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
verses.en: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
verses.tr: āqraʾ warabbuka al-ʾakramu
verses.abdelhaleem: Read! Your Lord is the Most Bountiful One
verses.pickthall: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
verses.en: Who taught by the pen
verses.tr: adh-dhā ʿallama bi-l-qalami
verses.abdelhaleem: who taught by [means of] the pen,
verses.pickthall: Who teacheth by the pen,

verses.ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
verses.en: Taught man that which he knew not.
verses.tr: ʿallama al-ʾinsāna mā lam yaʿlam
verses.abdelhaleem: who taught man what he did not know.
verses.pickthall: Teacheth man that which he knew not.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
verses.en: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses
verses.tr: kallā ʾinna al-ʾinsāna layaṭghā
verses.abdelhaleem: But man exceeds all bounds
verses.pickthall: Nay, but verily man is rebellious

verses.ar: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
verses.en: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
verses.tr: ʾan rraāhu āstaghnā
verses.abdelhaleem: when he thinks he is self-sufficient:
verses.pickthall: That he thinketh himself independent!

verses.ar: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
verses.en: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
verses.tr: ʾinna ʾilā rabbika ar-rujʿā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], all will return to your Lord.
verses.pickthall: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.

verses.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
verses.en: Have you seen the one who forbids
verses.tr: ʾaraʾayta adh-dhā yanhā
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you seen the man who forbids
verses.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth

verses.ar: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
verses.en: A servant when he prays?
verses.tr: ʿabdan ʾidhā ṣallā
verses.abdelhaleem: [Our] servant to pray?
verses.pickthall: A slave when he prayeth?

verses.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.en: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
verses.tr: ʾaraʾayta ʾin kāna ʿalā al-hudā
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you seen whether he is rightly guided,
verses.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)

verses.ar: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
verses.en: Or enjoins righteousness?
verses.tr: ʾaw ʾamara bi-at-taqwā
verses.abdelhaleem: or encourages true piety?
verses.pickthall: Or enjoineth piety?

verses.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
verses.en: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
verses.tr: ʾaraʾayta ʾin kadhaba watawallā
verses.abdelhaleem: Have you seen whether he denies the truth and turns away from it?
verses.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
verses.en: Does he not know that Allāh sees?
verses.tr: ʾalam yaʿlam biʾanna Allāh yarā
verses.abdelhaleem: Does he not realize that God sees all?
verses.pickthall: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?

verses.ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
verses.en: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock
verses.tr: kallā laʾin llam yantahi lanasfaʿanā bi-an-nāṣiyahi
verses.abdelhaleem: No! If he does not stop, We shall drag him by his forehead––
verses.pickthall: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -

verses.ar: نَاصِيَةٍ كَـٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ
verses.en: A lying, sinning forelock.
verses.tr: nāṣiyahin kādhibahin khāṭiʾahin
verses.abdelhaleem: his lying, sinful forehead.
verses.pickthall: The lying, sinful forelock -

verses.ar: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
verses.en: Then let him call his associates;
verses.tr: falyadʿu nādiyahu
verses.abdelhaleem: Let him summon his comrades;
verses.pickthall: Then let him call upon his henchmen!

verses.ar: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
verses.en: We will call the angels of Hell.
verses.tr: sanadʿu az-zabāniyaha
verses.abdelhaleem: We shall summon the guards of Hell.
verses.pickthall: We will call the guards of hell.

verses.ar: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
verses.en: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allāh].
verses.tr: kallā lā tuṭiʿhu wāsjud wāqtarib ۩
verses.abdelhaleem: No! Do not obey him [Prophet]: bow down in worship and draw close.
verses.pickthall: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾanzalnāhu fā laylahi al-qadri
verses.abdelhaleem: We sent it down on the Night of Glory.
verses.pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā laylahu al-qadri
verses.abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what that Night of Glory is?
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!

verses.ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
verses.en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
verses.tr: laylahu al-qadri khayrun mmin ʾalfi shahrin
verses.abdelhaleem: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months;
verses.pickthall: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.

verses.ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
verses.en: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
verses.tr: tanazzalu al-malāʾikahu wa-ar-rūḥu fīhā biʾidhni rabbihim mmin kulli ʾamrin
verses.abdelhaleem: on that night the angels and the Spirit descend again and again with their Lord’s permission on every task;
verses.pickthall: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
verses.en: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
verses.tr: salāmun hāa ḥattā maṭlaʿi al-fajri
verses.abdelhaleem: [there is] peace that night until the break of dawn.
verses.pickthall: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.

verses.ar: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
verses.en: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence
verses.tr: lam yakuni adh-dhīna kafarūā min ʾahli al-kitābi wa-l-mushrikīna munfakkīna ḥattā taʾtiyahumu al-bayyinahu
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idolaters were not about to change their ways until they were sent clear evidence,
verses.pickthall: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,

verses.ar: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
verses.en: A Messenger from Allāh, reciting purified scriptures
verses.tr: rasūlun mmina Allāh yatlūā ṣuḥufan mmuṭahharahan
verses.abdelhaleem: a messenger from God, reading out pages [blessed with] purity,
verses.pickthall: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages

verses.ar: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
verses.en: Within which are correct writings [i.e., rulings and laws].
verses.tr: fīhā kutubun qayyimahun
verses.abdelhaleem: containing true scriptures.
verses.pickthall: Containing correct scriptures.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
verses.en: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
verses.tr: wamā tafarraqa adh-dhīna ʾūtūā al-kitāba ʾillā min baʿdi mā jāʾathumu al-bayyinahu
verses.abdelhaleem: [Yet] those who were given the Scripture became divided only after they were sent [such] clear evi-dence
verses.pickthall: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
verses.en: And they were not commanded except to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.
verses.tr: wamā ʾumirūā ʾillā liyaʿbudūā Allāh mukhliṣīna lahu ad-dīna ḥunafāʾa wayuqīmūā aṣ-ṣalawāha wayuʾtūā az-zakawāha ۚ wadhālika dīnu al-qayyimahi
verses.abdelhaleem: though all they are ordered to do is worship God alone, sincerely devoting their religion to Him as people of true faith, keep up the prayer, and pay the prescribed alms, for that is the true religion.
verses.pickthall: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
verses.en: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna kafarūā min ʾahli al-kitābi wa-l-mushrikīna fā nāri jahannama khālidīna fīhā ۚ ʾūlāʾika hum sharru al-bariyyahi
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idolaters will have the Fire of Hell, there to remain. They are the worst of creation.
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
verses.en: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
verses.tr: ʾinna adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti ʾūlāʾika hum khayru al-bariyyahi
verses.abdelhaleem: Those who believe and do good deeds are the best of creation.
verses.pickthall: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings.

verses.ar: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
verses.en: Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
verses.tr: jazāʾuhum ʿinda rabbihim jannātu ʿadnin tajrā min taḥtihā al-ʾanhāru khālidīna fīhā ʾabadan ۖ rraḍāa Allāh ʿanhum waraḍūā ʿanhu ۚ dhālika liman khashāa rabbahu
verses.abdelhaleem: Their reward with their Lord is everlasting Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will stay forever. God is well pleased with them and they with Him. All this is for those who stand in awe of their Lord.
verses.pickthall: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.

verses.ar: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
verses.en: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
verses.tr: ʾidhā zulzilati al-ʾarḍu zilzālahā
verses.abdelhaleem: When the earth is shaken violently in its [last] quaking,
verses.pickthall: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake

verses.ar: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
verses.en: And the earth discharges its burdens
verses.tr: wa-akhrajati al-ʾarḍu ʾathqālahā
verses.abdelhaleem: when the earth throws out its burdens,
verses.pickthall: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا
verses.en: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
verses.tr: waqāla al-ʾinsānu mā lahā
verses.abdelhaleem: when man cries, ‘What is happening to it?’;
verses.pickthall: And man saith: What aileth her?

verses.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
verses.en: That Day, it will report its news
verses.tr: yawmaʾidhin tuḥaddithu ʾakhbārahā
verses.abdelhaleem: on that Day, it will tell all
verses.pickthall: That day she will relate her chronicles,

verses.ar: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
verses.en: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.
verses.tr: biʾanna rabbaka ʾawḥā lahā
verses.abdelhaleem: because your Lord will inspire it [to do so].
verses.pickthall: Because thy Lord inspireth her.

verses.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
verses.en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
verses.tr: yawmaʾidhin yaṣduru an-nāsu ʾashtātan lliyurawā ʾaʿmālahum
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day, people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds:
verses.pickthall: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.

verses.ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
verses.en: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
verses.tr: faman yaʿmal mithqāla dharrahin khayran yarahu
verses.abdelhaleem: whoever has done an atom’s-weight of good will see it,
verses.pickthall: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,

verses.ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
verses.en: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
verses.tr: waman yaʿmal mithqāla dharrahin sharran yarahu
verses.abdelhaleem: but whoever has done an atom’s-weight of evil will see that.
verses.pickthall: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.

verses.ar: وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
verses.en: By the racers, panting,
verses.tr: wa-l-ʿādiyāti ḍabḥan
verses.abdelhaleem: By the charging steeds that pant
verses.pickthall: By the snorting courses,

verses.ar: فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
verses.en: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
verses.tr: fa-l-mūriyāti qadḥan
verses.abdelhaleem: and strike sparks with their hooves,
verses.pickthall: Striking sparks of fire

verses.ar: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
verses.en: And the chargers at dawn,
verses.tr: fa-l-mughīrāti ṣubḥan
verses.abdelhaleem: who make dawn raids,
verses.pickthall: And scouring to the raid at dawn,

verses.ar: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
verses.en: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
verses.tr: fa-atharna bihi naqʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: raising a cloud of dust,
verses.pickthall: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,

verses.ar: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
verses.en: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
verses.tr: fawasaṭna bihi jamʿan
verses.abdelhaleem: and plunging into the midst of the enemy,
verses.pickthall: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
verses.en: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
verses.tr: ʾinna al-ʾinsāna lirabbihi lakanūdun
verses.abdelhaleem: man is ungrateful to his Lord––
verses.pickthall: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
verses.en: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
verses.tr: wa-innahu ʿalā dhālika lashahīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: and He is witness to this––
verses.pickthall: And lo! he is a witness unto that;

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
verses.en: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
verses.tr: wa-innahu liḥubbi al-khayri lashadīdun
verses.abdelhaleem: he is truly excessive in his love of wealth.
verses.pickthall: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.

verses.ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.en: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
verses.tr: ۞ ʾafalā yaʿlamu ʾidhā buʿthira mā fā al-qubūri
verses.abdelhaleem: Does he not know that when the contents of graves burst forth,
verses.pickthall: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth

verses.ar: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: And that within the breasts is obtained,
verses.tr: waḥuṣṣila mā fā aṣ-ṣudūri
verses.abdelhaleem: when the secrets of hearts are uncovered, on that Day,
verses.pickthall: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
verses.en: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.
verses.tr: ʾinna rabbahum bihim yawmaʾidhin llakhabīrun
verses.abdelhaleem: their Lord will be fully aware of them all?
verses.pickthall: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.

verses.ar: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
verses.en: The Striking Calamity -
verses.tr: al-qāriʿahu
verses.abdelhaleem: The Crashing Blow!
verses.pickthall: The Calamity!

verses.ar: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
verses.en: What is the Striking Calamity?
verses.tr: mā al-qāriʿahu
verses.abdelhaleem: What is the Crashing Blow?
verses.pickthall: What is the Calamity?

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā al-qāriʿahu
verses.abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the Crashing Blow is?
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
verses.en: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
verses.tr: yawma yakūnu an-nāsu ka-l-farāshi al-mabthūthi
verses.abdelhaleem: On a Day when people will be like scattered moths
verses.pickthall: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths

verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
verses.en: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
verses.tr: watakūnu al-jibālu ka-l-ʿihni al-manfūshi
verses.abdelhaleem: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
verses.pickthall: And the mountains will become as carded wool.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
verses.en: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
verses.tr: fa-ammā man thaqulat mawāzīnuhu
verses.abdelhaleem: the one whose good deeds are heavy on the scales
verses.pickthall: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),

verses.ar: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
verses.en: He will be in a pleasant life.
verses.tr: fahuwa fā ʿīshahin rrāḍiyahin
verses.abdelhaleem: will have a pleasant life,
verses.pickthall: He will live a pleasant life.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
verses.en: But as for one whose scales are light,
verses.tr: wa-ammā man khaffat mawāzīnuhu
verses.abdelhaleem: but the one whose good deeds are light
verses.pickthall: But as for him whose scales are light,

verses.ar: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌ
verses.en: His refuge will be an abyss.
verses.tr: fa-ummuhu hāwiyahun
verses.abdelhaleem: will have the Bottomless Pit for his home––
verses.pickthall: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
verses.en: And what can make you know what that is?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā hiyah
verses.abdelhaleem: what will explain to you what that is?––
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -

verses.ar: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
verses.en: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
verses.tr: nārun ḥāmiyahun
verses.abdelhaleem: a blazing fire.
verses.pickthall: Raging Fire.

verses.ar: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
verses.en: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
verses.tr: ʾalhākumu at-takāthuru
verses.abdelhaleem: Striving for more distracts you
verses.pickthall: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
verses.en: Until you visit the graveyards.
verses.tr: ḥattā zurtumu al-maqābira
verses.abdelhaleem: until you go into your graves.
verses.pickthall: Until ye come to the graves.

verses.ar: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: No! You are going to know.
verses.tr: kallā sawfa taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! You will come to know.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Then, no! You are going to know.
verses.tr: thumma kallā sawfa taʿlamūna
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! In the end you will come to know.
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!

verses.ar: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verses.en: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
verses.tr: kallā law taʿlamūna ʿilma al-yaqīni
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! If only you knew for certain.
verses.pickthall: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!

verses.ar: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
verses.en: You will surely see the Hellfire.
verses.tr: latarawunna al-jaḥīma
verses.abdelhaleem: You will most definitely see Hellfire,
verses.pickthall: For ye will behold hell-fire.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verses.en: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
verses.tr: thumma latarawunnahā ʿayna al-yaqīni
verses.abdelhaleem: you will see it with the eye of certainty.
verses.pickthall: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
verses.tr: thumma latuslunna yawmaʾidhin ʿani an-naʿīmi
verses.abdelhaleem: On that Day, you will be asked about your pleasures.
verses.pickthall: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.

verses.ar: وَٱلْعَصْرِ
verses.en: By time,
verses.tr: wa-l-ʿaṣri
verses.abdelhaleem: By the declining day,
verses.pickthall: By the declining day,

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
verses.en: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
verses.tr: ʾinna al-ʾinsāna lafā khusrin
verses.abdelhaleem: man is [deep] in loss,
verses.pickthall: Lo! man is a state of loss,

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
verses.en: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
verses.tr: ʾillā adh-dhīna āmanūā waʿamilūā aṣ-ṣāliḥāti watawāṣawā bi-l-ḥaqqi watawāṣawā bi-aṣ-ṣabri
verses.abdelhaleem: except for those who believe, do good deeds, urge one another to the truth, and urge one another to steadfastness.
verses.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُّمَزَةٍ
verses.en: Woe to every scorner and mocker
verses.tr: waylun llikulli humazahin llumazahin
verses.abdelhaleem: Woe to every fault-finding backbiter
verses.pickthall: Woe unto every slandering traducer,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
verses.en: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
verses.tr: adh-dhā jamaʿa mālan waʿaddadahu
verses.abdelhaleem: who amasses riches, counting them over,
verses.pickthall: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.

verses.ar: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
verses.en: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
verses.tr: yaḥsabu ʾanna mālahu ʾakhladahu
verses.abdelhaleem: thinking they will make him live for ever.
verses.pickthall: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.

verses.ar: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
verses.en: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
verses.tr: kallā ۖ layunbadhanna fā al-ḥuṭamahi
verses.abdelhaleem: No indeed! He will be thrust into the Crusher!
verses.pickthall: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
verses.tr: wamā ʾadrāka mā al-ḥuṭamahu
verses.abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the Crusher is?
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!

verses.ar: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
verses.en: It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,
verses.tr: nāru Allāh al-mūqadahu
verses.abdelhaleem: It is God’s Fire, made to blaze,
verses.pickthall: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,

verses.ar: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
verses.en: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
verses.tr: at-tā taṭṭaliʿu ʿalā al-ʾafdahi
verses.abdelhaleem: which rises over people’s hearts.
verses.pickthall: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).

verses.ar: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌ
verses.en: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them
verses.tr: ʾinnahā ʿalayhim mmuʾṣadahun
verses.abdelhaleem: It closes in on them
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is closed in on them

verses.ar: فِى عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
verses.en: In extended columns.
verses.tr: fā ʿamadin mmumaddadahin
verses.abdelhaleem: in towering columns.
verses.pickthall: In outstretched columns.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
verses.en: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
verses.tr: ʾalam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka biʾaṣḥābi al-fīli
verses.abdelhaleem: Do you [Prophet] not see how your Lord dealt with the army of the elephant?
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
verses.en: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
verses.tr: ʾalam yajʿal kaydahum fā taḍlīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: Did He not utterly confound their plans?
verses.pickthall: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,

verses.ar: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
verses.en: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
verses.tr: wa-arsala ʿalayhim ṭayran ʾabābīla
verses.abdelhaleem: He sent ranks of birds against them,
verses.pickthall: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,

verses.ar: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
verses.en: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
verses.tr: tarmīhim biḥijārahin mmin sijjīlin
verses.abdelhaleem: pelting them with pellets of hard-baked clay:
verses.pickthall: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,

verses.ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
verses.en: And He made them like eaten straw.
verses.tr: fajaʿalahum kaʿaṣfin mmaʾkūlin
verses.abdelhaleem: He made them [like] cropped stubble.
verses.pickthall: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?

verses.ar: لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
verses.en: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
verses.tr: liʾīlāfi qurayshin
verses.abdelhaleem: [He did this] to make the Quraysh feel secure,
verses.pickthall: For the taming of Qureysh.

verses.ar: إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
verses.en: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
verses.tr: ʾilāfihim riḥlaha ash-shitāʾi wa-aṣ-ṣayfi
verses.abdelhaleem: secure in their winter and summer journeys.
verses.pickthall: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.

verses.ar: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
verses.en: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
verses.tr: falyaʿbudūā rabba hādhā al-bayti
verses.abdelhaleem: So let them worship the Lord of this House:
verses.pickthall: So let them worship the Lord of this House,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
verses.en: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
verses.tr: adh-dhā ʾaṭʿamahum mmin jūʿin wamanahum mmin khawfin
verses.abdelhaleem: who provides them with food to ward off hunger, safety to ward off fear.
verses.pickthall: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.

verses.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
verses.tr: ʾaraʾayta adh-dhā yukadhibu bi-ad-dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: [Prophet], have you considered the person who denies the Judgement?
verses.pickthall: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?

verses.ar: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
verses.en: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
verses.tr: fadhālika adh-dhā yaduʿʿu al-yatīma
verses.abdelhaleem: It is he who pushes aside the orphan
verses.pickthall: That is he who repelleth the orphan,

verses.ar: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
verses.en: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
verses.tr: walā yaḥuḍḍu ʿalā ṭaʿāmi al-miskīni
verses.abdelhaleem: and does not urge others to feed the needy.
verses.pickthall: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.

verses.ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
verses.en: So woe to those who pray
verses.tr: fawaylun llilmuṣallīna
verses.abdelhaleem: So woe to those who pray
verses.pickthall: Ah, woe unto worshippers

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
verses.en: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
verses.tr: adh-dhīna hum ʿan ṣalātihim sāhūna
verses.abdelhaleem: but are heedless of their prayer;
verses.pickthall: Who are heedless of their prayer;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
verses.en: Those who make show [of their deeds]
verses.tr: adh-dhīna hum yurāʾūna
verses.abdelhaleem: those who are all show
verses.pickthall: Who would be seen (at worship)

verses.ar: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
verses.en: And withhold [simple] assistance.
verses.tr: wayamnaʿūna al-māʿūna
verses.abdelhaleem: and forbid common kindnesses.
verses.pickthall: Yet refuse small kindnesses!

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
verses.en: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.
verses.tr: ʾinnā ʾaʿṭaynāka al-kawthara
verses.abdelhaleem: We have truly given abundance to you [Prophet]––
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;

verses.ar: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
verses.en: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].
verses.tr: faṣalli lirabbika wānḥar
verses.abdelhaleem: so pray to your Lord and make your sacrifice to Him alone––
verses.pickthall: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.

verses.ar: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
verses.en: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
verses.tr: ʾinna shāniʾaka huwa al-ʾabtaru
verses.abdelhaleem: it is the one who hates you who has been cut off.
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.en: Say, "O disbelievers,
verses.tr: qul yāʾayyuhā al-kāfirūna
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘Disbelievers:
verses.pickthall: Say: O disbelievers!

verses.ar: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: I do not worship what you worship.
verses.tr: lā ʾaʿbudu mā taʿbudūna
verses.abdelhaleem: I do not worship what you worship,
verses.pickthall: I worship not that which ye worship;

verses.ar: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
verses.en: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
verses.tr: walā ʾantum ʿābidūna mā ʾaʿbudu
verses.abdelhaleem: you do not worship what I worship,
verses.pickthall: Nor worship ye that which I worship.

verses.ar: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
verses.en: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
verses.tr: walā ʾanā ʿābidun mmā ʿabadttum
verses.abdelhaleem: I will never worship what you worship,
verses.pickthall: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.

verses.ar: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
verses.en: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
verses.tr: walā ʾantum ʿābidūna mā ʾaʿbudu
verses.abdelhaleem: you will never worship what I worship:
verses.pickthall: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.

verses.ar: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
verses.en: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
verses.tr: lakum dīnukum walāa dīni
verses.abdelhaleem: you have your religion and I have mine.’
verses.pickthall: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.

verses.ar: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
verses.en: When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,
verses.tr: ʾidhā jāʾa naṣru Allāh wa-l-fatḥu
verses.abdelhaleem: When God’s help comes and He opens up your way [Prophet],
verses.pickthall: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh

verses.ar: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
verses.en: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allāh in multitudes,
verses.tr: waraʾayta an-nāsa yadkhulūna fā dīni Allāh ʾafwājan
verses.abdelhaleem: when you see people embracing God’s faith in crowds,
verses.pickthall: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
verses.en: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
verses.tr: fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wāstaghfirhu ۚ ʾinnahu kāna tawwābanā
verses.abdelhaleem: celebrate the praise of your Lord and ask His forgiveness: He is always ready to accept repentance.
verses.pickthall: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.

verses.ar: تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
verses.en: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
verses.tr: tabbat yadā ʾabā lahabin watabba
verses.abdelhaleem: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined! May he be ruined too!
verses.pickthall: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.

verses.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verses.en: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
verses.tr: mā ʾaghnā ʿanhu māluhu wamā kasaba
verses.abdelhaleem: Neither his wealth nor his gains will help him:
verses.pickthall: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.

verses.ar: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ
verses.en: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
verses.tr: sayaṣlā nāran dhāta lahabin
verses.abdelhaleem: he will burn in the Flaming Fire––
verses.pickthall: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,

verses.ar: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
verses.en: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
verses.tr: wāmraʾatuhu ḥammālaha al-ḥaṭabi
verses.abdelhaleem: and so will his wife, the firewood-carrier,
verses.pickthall: And his wife, the wood-carrier,

verses.ar: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
verses.en: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
verses.tr: fā jīdihā ḥablun mmin mmasadin
verses.abdelhaleem: with a palm-fibre rope around her neck.
verses.pickthall: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.

verses.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
verses.en: Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,
verses.tr: qul huwa Allāh ʾaḥadun
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘He is God the One,
verses.pickthall: Say: He is Allah, the One!

verses.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
verses.en: Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.
verses.tr: Allāh aṣ-ṣamadu
verses.abdelhaleem: God the eternal.
verses.pickthall: Allah, the eternally Besought of all!

verses.ar: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
verses.en: He neither begets nor is born,
verses.tr: lam yalid walam yūlad
verses.abdelhaleem: He begot no one nor was He begotten.
verses.pickthall: He begetteth not nor was begotten.

verses.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
verses.en: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
verses.tr: walam yakun llahu kufuwan ʾaḥadun
verses.abdelhaleem: No one is comparable to Him.’
verses.pickthall: And there is none comparable unto Him.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
verses.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
verses.tr: qul ʾaʿūdhu birabbi al-falaqi
verses.abdelhaleem: Say [Prophet], ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak
verses.pickthall: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak

verses.ar: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
verses.en: From the evil of that which He created
verses.tr: min sharri mā khalaqa
verses.abdelhaleem: against the harm in what He has created,
verses.pickthall: From the evil of that which He created;

verses.ar: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
verses.en: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
verses.tr: wamin sharri ghāsiqin ʾidhā waqaba
verses.abdelhaleem: the harm in the night when darkness gathers,
verses.pickthall: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,

verses.ar: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
verses.en: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
verses.tr: wamin sharri an-naffāthāti fā al-ʿuqadi
verses.abdelhaleem: the harm in witches when they blow on knots,
verses.pickthall: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,

verses.ar: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
verses.en: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
verses.tr: wamin sharri ḥāsidin ʾidhā ḥasada
verses.abdelhaleem: the harm in the envier when he envies.’
verses.pickthall: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
verses.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
verses.tr: qul ʾaʿūdhu birabbi an-nāsi
verses.abdelhaleem: Say, ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of people,
verses.pickthall: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

verses.ar: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
verses.en: The Sovereign of mankind,
verses.tr: maliki an-nāsi
verses.abdelhaleem: the Controller of people,
verses.pickthall: The King of mankind,

verses.ar: إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
verses.en: The God of mankind,
verses.tr: ʾilāhi an-nāsi
verses.abdelhaleem: the God of people,
verses.pickthall: The God of mankind,

verses.ar: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
verses.en: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
verses.tr: min sharri al-waswāsi al-khannāsi
verses.abdelhaleem: against the harm of the slinking whisperer––
verses.pickthall: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
verses.en: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
verses.tr: adh-dhā yuwaswisu fā ṣudūri an-nāsi
verses.abdelhaleem: who whispers into the hearts of people––
verses.pickthall: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
verses.en: From among the jinn and mankind".
verses.tr: mina al-jinnahi wa-an-nāsi
verses.abdelhaleem: whether they be jinn or people.’
verses.pickthall: Of the jinn and of mankind.
